Together, the findings suggest persisting problems in creating and accessing stable and distinctive phonological memory representations for word forms in adults with DLD, along with altered hemispheric balance in processing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察有发育性语言障碍（DLD）史的年轻成人在学习新词时的脑活动特点，用脑磁图记录他们接触真实词和两组语音相近的假词时的反应，其中一组假词经过三天配对图片的训练。行为上两组都能学会新假词，但DLD组回忆出的词更少，也更常混淆发音相似的假词。脑活动上两组都出现左颞叶学习效应并涉及左额下区，DLD组还表现出更强的右半球参与和显著的右颞叶学习效应；学习后只有DLD组对真实词的左右颞叶反应发生变化。作者据此认为，DLD成人可能在建立和提取稳定、可区分的词形语音记忆表征上存在持续困难，并伴随半球加工平衡的改变。

papers.title: Functional and Structural Neuroanatomic Correlates of Intraoperative Anesthetic Dose-Adjusted EEG Alpha Power Among Older Surgical Patients
papers.authors: Reekes T, Browndyke JN, Reese Smith M, Weiss Y, Yu J, Cooter Wright M, Kang HJ, Timko NJ, Boykin P, Hsia B, Devinney MJ, Berger M.
papers.abstract: Background: Alterations in intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) alpha power and anesthetic dose-adjusted EEG alpha power (ADA-FP alpha power) have been associated with both preoperative cognitive impairment and postoperative delirium (POD) among older surgical patients, yet the neurologic underpinnings of alterations in these anesthetic brain response patterns are unknown. Methods: We conducted a single center prospective observational cohort study (ALADDIN), of older adults undergoing non-cardiac/non-cranial surgery, which included preoperative structural and resting state functional MRI, lumbar punctures to obtain CSF, 32 channel intraoperative EEG recordings, and repeated POD assessments. To account for anesthetic dose, frontoparietal EEG alpha power (ADA-FP alpha power) was adjusted using our established formula: [intraoperative alpha power]/(2.5 - end-tidal MAC fraction). Multivoxel pattern analysis (MVPA) with follow-up seed-to-voxel analyses identified functional connectivity patterns associated with intraoperative ADA-FP alpha power. Voxel-wise regression analysis with threshold free cluster estimation (TFCE) correction was used to evaluate associations between cortical thickness and ADA-FP alpha power. CSF biomarker values were obtained from NULISA proximity extension assays. Delirium incidence and severity was assessed with the 3-Minute Diagnostic Confusion Assessment Method (3D-CAM). Delirium severity area under the curve (AUC) during hospitalization was defined as the sum of all 3D-CAM delirium severity scores within the postoperative hospitalization period (for up to 7 days after surgery). The Confusion Assessment Method for the Intensive Care Unit (CAM-ICU) was used in cases of non-verbal/intubated patients. Results: ALADDIN enrolled 215 patients, of whom 168 underwent surgery and had high-quality intraoperative EEG data (44.6% female; mean age 70.9 years). MVPA showed that ADA-FP alpha power was associated with altered functional connectivity within the bilateral frontal poles, left superior frontal gyrus and the right superior parietal lobule (p-FWE < 0.05). Seed-to-voxel analyses revealed that higher ADA-FP alpha power was associated with increased connectivity between DMN MVPA regions and DMN, DAN and salience/ventral attention and decreased connectivity with visual regions. Conversely, right superior parietal lobule connectivity shifted towards greater DMN segregation and increased somatosensory/motor coupling (p-FWE < 0.05). Lower ADA-FP alpha power was also associated with lower cortical thickness in left occipitotemporal and superior parietal cortices (TFCE-corrected p < 0.05). ADA-FP alpha power was also lower among participants with (vs those without) postoperative ward/floor delirium (mean difference, 1.33; 95% CI, 0.22 to 2.44; p=0.019), and ADA-FP alpha power was inversely associated with peak delirium severity (spearman's rho = -0.26; 95% CI, -0.40 to -0.11; p <0.001) and delirium severity AUC (spearman's rho = -0.28; 95% CI, -0.42 to -0.13; p < 0.001). Discussion: These findings suggest a functional and structural neuroanatomic basis for the decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power values seen among some older surgical patients, which may explain the association between decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power and increased rates of both preoperative cognitive impairment and postoperative delirium. More specifically, these findings suggest that altered default mode and dorsal attention network connectivity is linked to decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power and raise the possibility that preoperative/baseline functional connectivity alterations within these networks may play a role in delirium risk.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在老年非心脏、非颅脑手术患者中，考察术中麻醉剂量校正后额顶区脑电α功率（ADA-FP alpha power）与术前脑功能连接、皮层厚度及术后谵妄的关系。多体素模式分析显示，ADA-FP alpha功率与双侧额极、左侧额上回及右侧顶上小叶的功能连接模式相关；种子点分析进一步表明，较高功率对应默认网络与注意、突显网络连接增强而与视觉区连接减弱，较低功率则与左侧枕颞及顶上皮层变薄相关。术后病房谵妄者该功率较低，且功率与谵妄严重程度呈负相关。作者据此提出，默认网络和背侧注意网络的功能连接改变可能与α功率降低及谵妄风险相关，但研究为观察性设计，相关关系不等于因果。

papers.title: Characterization of Sleep, Spectral, and Epileptiform Activity in Individuals Aged 8-27 Years with SYNGAP1-Related Disorder Using an at-Home Dry EEG Headband
papers.authors: Sheehan TC, Schwartz EL, Laberinto KP, Reh RK, Dorsey M, McGuckin K, Sritharan SY, Graglia JM, McNamar V, Helde KA, Misko A, Linares AJ, Dinsmore CJ, Donoghue J, Pathmanathan J.
papers.abstract: SYNGAP1-related disorder (SYNGAP1-RD) is associated with sleep disturbances, seizures, and neurophysiological abnormalities. However, in-lab EEG can be difficult to obtain due to the behavioral and sensory disorders associated with this condition. In this study we collected EEG in SYNGAP1-RD participants (n=30 enrolled, 27 contributing data) in a decentralized protocol using a dry electrode headband as a path to longitudinal, research-grade data collection in this population. At-home data collection was successful with 180 recordings containing over 1 hour of usable data collected from 23 participants. Across these recordings, sporadic interictal epileptiform discharges were present in 22 of 23 participants but electrographic seizures were not observed. Relative to an adolescent control population (n=10), SYNGAP1-RD participants showed increased wake after sleep onset, reduced sleep efficiency, and decreased time in N1 and N3 sleep stages along with increased time in N2. We reproduced prior findings from awake spectral EEG analyses, including elevated broadband power along with reduced relative alpha power and alpha-theta ratio in the SYNGAP1 cohort. Notably, differences in spectral power were tightly linked to sleep stage, revealing sleep-stage-dependent spectral biomarker dynamics not previously characterized in SYNGAP1-RD. Finally, we examined differences between variants producing truncations downstream of the GAP domain and those producing truncations before or within it, but analyses were limited by a small sample size (n=4 for the post-GAP variant). Overall, this study demonstrates the feasibility of at-home multi-night sleep EEG collection in participants with SYNGAP1-RD and led to both corroborative and novel findings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对SYNGAP1相关障碍患者难以在实验室获取脑电数据的问题，采用干电极头带在居家环境中进行多夜脑电采集，以评估该方式的可行性并刻画睡眠、频谱及癫痫样活动特征。结果显示居家采集可行，多数参与者记录到散发性发作间期癫痫样放电，但未观察到脑电发作；与青少年对照组相比，患者入睡后觉醒增多、睡眠效率降低，睡眠阶段分布也发生改变。研究还重复了清醒期宽带功率升高、相对α功率及α-θ比降低等既往发现，并首次揭示频谱功率差异与睡眠阶段紧密相关，提示睡眠阶段依赖的频谱生物标志物动态。作者还比较了不同变异类型，但受样本量限制，相关分析有限。

papers.title: EEG Biomarkers for Rett Syndrome: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning with Explainable AI
papers.authors: Gupta M, Jin C, Valdes AL, Bosetti C, Marinella G, Bartolini, Battini R, Dong R, Tropea D.
papers.abstract: Rett syndrome (RTT) is a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by abnormal cortical activity, which can be captured using electroencephalography (EEG). Although machine learning (ML) has shown promise for diagnosing several neurological conditions, comprehensive evaluation of classical ML and deep learning (DL) methods, together with physiologically meaningful explanations, remains limited for RTT. This study analyses resting-state, eyes-closed EEG recordings from RTT patients and healthy controls using both power spectral density (PSD)-based ML and end-to-end DL frameworks. Classical ML models, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forest, and XGBoost, were trained on PSD features, while EEG-specific DL architectures, including ShallowConvNet, DeepConvNet, EEGNet, and EEG Conformer, were trained directly on preprocessed EEG signals. Subjectwise cross-validation was used to avoid data leakage, with balanced accuracy as the primary performance metric because it equally accounts for sensitivity and specificity. Random Forest achieved the best performance among the classical ML models, whereas EEGNet achieved the highest DL performance. An ablation study indicated that 4-second EEG epochs offered the optimal trade-off between model performance and robustness. Model interpretability was investigated using SHAP for Random Forest and occlusion sensitivity analysis for EEGNet. Both methods consistently identified delta and theta oscillations, along with centro-frontal brain regions, as key contributors to RTT classification. These findings show that both PSD-based machine learning and end-to-end deep learning methods can reliably identify RTT and highlight common neurophysiological biomarkers, offering an interpretable framework for EEG-based diagnosis and biomarker discovery for Rett Syndrome.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了基于功率谱密度的经典机器学习与端到端深度学习在静息闭眼脑电中区分Rett综合征患者与健康对照的表现，并借助可解释方法探究分类依据。结果显示，随机森林在经典方法中表现最佳，EEGNet在深度模型中表现最佳；两种解释方法均一致指向delta和theta振荡及中央-额区活动是分类的关键贡献因素。这表明两类方法均能较可靠地识别RTT，并提示了共通的神经生理标志物，为基于脑电的可解释诊断与生物标志物发现提供了框架。

papers.title: Single-Case Design for Network-based BCI Rehabilitation: Individual Learning Trajectories and Effects of Motor Imagery Timing in Stroke Patients
papers.authors: Bousfiha C, Gabot C, Baili D, Soller E, Couton M, Adwane G, Obadia M, Zavanone C, Dupont S, Bayen E, Bougrain L, Bartolomeo P, de Vico Fallani F.
papers.abstract: Motor imagery (MI) brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are increasingly investigated for promoting motor recovery after stroke. However, it remains unclear how BCI control improves through repeated training in stroke patients and whether the timing of MI decoding systematically influences this trajectory. To address this question, we implemented a single-case experimental design involving five chronic stroke patients enrolling in a longitudinal electroencephalography MI-BCI training involving their affected hand. Across 18 sessions conducted over six weeks, the onset of a fixed-duration MI decoding window was randomized to occur 1, 2, or 3~s after cue onset according to an alternating-treatments single-case design. Notably, the BCI combined spectral power and functional connectivity features to classify MI states. The MI classification timing had no significant effect on BCI accuracy, fatigue, or spasticity. BCI accuracy increased across training in four of five patients and was accompanied by patient-specific longitudinal changes in local spectral activity and functional connectivity. These convergent trajectories were consistent with acquisition of BCI control, but were not accompanied by clinically meaningful improvement in motor function. Varying the onset of the MI decoding window provided no systematic benefit for BCI control. Instead, differences in neurophysiological trajectories across patients indicate that MI decoding parameters need to be personalized and reassessed throughout the training. Overall, these findings inform more individualized and effective BCI settings for neuromotor stroke rehabilitation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注卒中患者经重复训练后脑机接口控制能力如何变化，以及运动想象解码窗口的起始时机是否系统影响这一过程。作者采用单例实验设计，对五名慢性卒中患者进行纵向脑电运动想象脑机接口训练，并将解码窗口起始时间随机设为提示出现后不同延迟。结果显示，解码时机对分类准确率、疲劳和痉挛均无显著影响；多数患者的准确率随训练提高，并伴随个体化的频谱活动与功能连接变化，但这些变化未带来有临床意义的运动功能改善。作者据此认为，运动想象解码参数需个体化并在训练中重新评估。

papers.title: Gut-Brain Axis and Appetite: A Hypothesis-Generating Narrative Review of Traditional Chinese Medicine for Non-Organic Poor Appetite in Children.
papers.authors: Qiao J, Zhang H.
papers.abstract: Non-organic poor appetite/feeding difficulty in children is characterized by persistent poor appetite or reduced food intake without the body-image disturbance or fear of weight gain characteristic of anorexia nervosa. This hypothesis-generating narrative review examines gut-brain axis dysfunction in this condition and evaluates proposed mechanisms of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) interventions. Peer-reviewed literature published from January 2000 to August 2026 was reviewed using PubMed, Web of Science, and China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI). Human, animal, and review studies relevant to appetite regulation, pathogenesis, or TCM were considered, while studies exclusively concerning anorexia nervosa were excluded unless used as clearly identified indirect mechanistic evidence. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 (RoB 2) tool, Risk Of Bias In Non-randomized Studies of Interventions (ROBINS-I), and A Measurement Tool to Assess Systematic Reviews 2 (AMSTAR 2), where applicable. The evidence was organized across four dimensions: central appetite-regulatory networks, including neurotransmitters; brain-gut peptides; intestinal barrier function; and gut microbiota. Available studies suggest alterations across these dimensions and propose that specific TCM interventions, including herbal formulas, acupuncture, and tuina, may influence related pathways. Evidence concerning microbiota composition and short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) is primarily preclinical or indirect, and functional restoration of gut-brain communication has not been demonstrated in affected children. Overall, the evidence is heterogeneous, predominantly correlational, and frequently derived from animal models, in-vitro studies, other disease populations, or specific interventions. Direct pediatric mechanistic evidence remains limited, causal pathways have not been established, and no efficacy conclusion can currently be drawn.

papers.title: Quantifying the Functional Effect of Transmural Interpolation Strategies on Atrial Wave Propagation Using a Custom Open-Source Pipeline.
papers.authors: Sinitsyna A, Syrovnev V, Sergeeva O, Rzaev F, Biganov R, Kushnerev E, Kalemberg A, Semidetnov I, Slotvitsky M, Tsvelaya V.
papers.abstract: Atrial fibrillation (AF) management increasingly relies on patient-specific computational modeling to simulate arrhythmia mechanisms and optimize ablation strategies. However, predictive reliability is strongly influenced by accurate reconstruction of myocardial fiber architecture, which governs electrical anisotropy. Because patient-specific atrial fiber orientations cannot currently be acquired reliably in vivo using diffusion tensor magnetic resonance imaging (DT-MRI), alternative computational mapping strategies are required. This protocol presents a comprehensive, open-source pipeline for constructing patient-specific 3D models of the human left atrium with explicit transmural fiber reconstruction from high-resolution clinical computed tomography (CT) data. The methodology extends the Universal Atrial Coordinate (UAC) framework into the volumetric domain by solving the Laplace-Dirichlet problem to derive a continuous transmural coordinate. This enables transfer of atlas-based fiber orientations and subsequent interpolation across the atrial wall. Linear and threshold-based transmural interpolation strategies are quantitatively compared, and their effects on fiber orientation and macroscopic wavefront propagation are evaluated. Across all six models, the mean angular deviation between interpolation methods was 8.06 ± 1.13°. Electrophysiological simulations demonstrate that the choice of interpolation delayed activation in Region 1 by 2.0 ± 0.6 ms, corresponding to 6.1 ± 1.5 ms (p = 0.031 for both comparisons). The open-source pipeline and patient-specific CT-based atrial models provide a reproducible framework for evaluating the functional effects of transmural fiber reconstruction strategies.

papers.title: The SPOT Grid: Naturalistic images with predefined settings, patterns, objects, and textures.
papers.authors: Hirschstein Z, Aly M, Baldassano C.
papers.abstract: In the natural world, higher-level visual features (e.g., scenes and objects) systematically covary with specific lower-level constituent features (e.g., textures and patterns). This natural covariation makes it difficult to isolate aspects of behavior or brain activity that are specific to a single level of the feature hierarchy. For example, a particular neural or behavioral response may reflect recognition of a "jungle" scene, or it may reflect sensitivity to the lower-level features - leaf textures, dense vertical lines, etc. - that constitute jungle scenes. To address this challenge, we developed a novel approach for partially decoupling higher- and lower-level features in naturalistic images. We employed a Stable Diffusion image generation framework to create a naturalistic image set in which setting-object pairings and texture-pattern pairings are factorially combined, enabling systematic manipulation of higher-level and lower-level image content. To validate our approach, we used state-of-the-art image-processing models to confirm that higher-level features are represented similarly regardless of their lower-level constituents and, conversely, that lower-level features are represented similarly regardless of the higher-level objects/settings they constitute. We then confirmed that human participants can readily and rapidly categorize these features in our generated images. We present the image generation framework and introduce the SPOT (Settings, Patterns, Objects, Textures) Grid, a publicly available stimulus set accompanied by image-specific metrics (upon request: forms.gle/X2HpzRYUGigFS1S27). This resource provides new opportunities for investigating hierarchical visual representations, feature binding, and abstraction across perception, behavior, and the brain.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对自然图像中高层特征（如场景、物体）与低层特征（如纹理、图案）天然共变、难以分离的问题，提出一种基于Stable Diffusion图像生成框架的方法，将场景—物体配对与纹理—图案配对进行因子化组合，从而系统操纵高层与低层图像内容。作者用图像处理模型验证高层特征的表征不受其低层构成影响，低层特征的表征也不受其所构成的物体或场景影响，并确认人类被试能快速对这些特征进行分类。由此构建并公开了SPOT Grid刺激集，为研究层级视觉表征、特征绑定与抽象提供了工具。

papers.title: Neural Organoids and Organoid Extracellular Vesicles for Spinal Cord Injury Repair.
papers.authors: Wang H, Zhou Q, Zhang H, Jiang C, Su J, Liu H.
papers.abstract: Spinal cord injury (SCI) causes long-term disability in part because secondary injury progressively reshapes the lesion microenvironment and restricts axonal regeneration, circuit re-establishment, and white matter repair. Neural organoids are emerging from human pluripotent stem cell-derived disease models into implantable regenerative constructs that may provide structured cellular niches, support host-graft integration, and contribute to remyelination. However, their translation remains constrained by batch variability, limited vascularization, immune-related risk, and long-term safety concerns. In parallel, organoid-derived extracellular vesicles (OEVs) represent a cell-free modality linked to the organoid platform and are more amenable to controlled dosing and repeated administration. However, direct evidence supporting the therapeutic use of neural OEVs in SCI remains limited. OEVs should not be viewed as inherently superior alternatives to conventional extracellular vesicles (EVs); rather, their potential distinctiveness depends on experimentally verifiable links to source-organoid identity, developmental stage, multicellular context, and cargo-function logic. In SCI repair, current evidence should be stratified into direct evidence from neural OEV studies, supportive evidence from SCI-relevant conventional EV systems and related organoid/OEV studies, and testable translational hypotheses. This Review defines neural organoids and neural OEVs as source-linked but mechanistically non-equivalent repair modules, and proposes a mechanism-linked, stage-aware, and quality-oriented framework to guide OEV characterization, benchmarking, and translational evaluation for SCI repair.

papers.title: What is a standard temporal lobectomy? A survey of epilepsy neurosurgeons.
papers.authors: Staudt MD, Rammo R, Wu C.
papers.abstract: Objective Anterior temporal lobectomy (ATL) is the most common surgical procedure used to treat drug-resistant epilepsy. ATL fundamentally involves removal of the anterior temporal neocortex and mesial structures; however, there may be substantial variability in resection extent across surgeons. The objective of this study was to evaluate the practice patterns and ATL surgical techniques of epilepsy surgeons. Methods An anonymous REDCap-based survey of epilepsy neurosurgeons was conducted to collect demographic and resection data. Resection extent was assessed by asking participants to draw their typical resection limits on six 2-dimensional cartoons of the temporal lobe. Individual maps were superimposed over the base template image with a pixel size equivalent to 0.25 mm2 to create cohort-level resection maps, with pixel intensity reflecting the number of respondents who selected that region. Results Fifty responses were received that included image sets suitable for analysis. The mean ± SD age of respondents was 44.8 ± 7.6 years, they had been in practice for a mean of 9.9 ± 7.6 years, and 89.7% had completed an epilepsy-related fellowship. Significant variability was noted in the posterior extent of neocortical resection and resection of the superior temporal gyrus, which was more extensive on the right side. Variability was likewise observed in the parahippocampal gyrus and piriform cortex. While nearly all respondents included the inferior amygdala, there was less consistency in resection of the dorsal amygdala. Longer duration of practice was associated with significantly decreased neocortical resection. Higher annual ATL volume was positively correlated with more superior resection in the region of the inferior circular sulcus as well as more posterior neocortical resection, particularly along the inferior temporal gyrus. Conclusions Despite overall agreement on the general extent of anterior temporal resection and generally more extensive resections on the right side, this study highlights the substantial variability in both lateral neocortical and mesial structure resection.

papers.title: Intraoperative dorsal cochlear nucleus action potential monitoring in hearing preservation retrosigmoid surgery for vestibular schwannoma: a predictive analysis of short-term hearing outcomes.
papers.authors: Pang X, Yin S, Zhang S, Wang Z, Hu Y, Zhang S, Zong Y, Hui X, Zhang Y, Liu W, Hu Y, Fang Y, Guo L.
papers.abstract: Objective The aim of this study was to evaluate the safety and short-term predictive value of continuous intraoperative monitoring of the dorsal cochlear nucleus action potential (DNAP) using a 4-contact depth electrode during retrosigmoid vestibular schwannoma resection, and to compare its accuracy in predicting postoperative hearing outcomes with that of standard auditory brainstem response (ABR). Methods Adult patients with a preoperative word recognition score (WRS) ≥ 50% who underwent primary retrosigmoid vestibular schwannoma resection were included in this retrospective cohort study. A multimodal monitoring protocol comprising ABR, cochlear nerve action potential mapping, and continuous DNAP monitoring was used. Short-term hearing outcomes were assessed 5-7 days postoperatively based on two criteria: serviceable hearing (American Academy of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery class A or B) and speech function preservation (WRS ≥ 50%). Multivariate Firth logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analyses were performed to identify independent predictors and determine the optimal predictive threshold for DNAP amplitude. In patients with available follow-up, 6-month hearing outcomes were assessed. Results Overall, 153 patients (93 female, mean age 42 years [range 18-68 years]) were included in this analysis, with a mean tumor diameter of 2.2 cm (range 1.5-4.3 cm). Stable baseline DNAP signals were successfully recorded in 80.4% (123/153) of patients compared with 60.8% (93/153) for ABR. No procedure-related complications were attributable to the depth electrode. At 5-7 days postoperatively, serviceable hearing was achieved in 41.2% (63/153) and speech function in 56.2% (86/153) of patients. At the 6-month follow-up, the corresponding rates were 40.9% (56/137) and 56.2% (77/137), respectively, among patients with available audiometric data. In the multivariable analyses, DNAP preservation remained the most consistent independent predictor of both early and 6-month hearing-related outcomes. ROC analysis identified an optimal DNAP residual amplitude ratio cutoff of 0.41 for early postoperative outcomes. In the group with available 6-month follow-up, DNAP retained favorable diagnostic performance and consistently higher sensitivity than that of ABR. Conclusions DNAP monitoring via a 4-contact depth electrode was a safe and reliable technique that provided robust nearly real-time feedback during hearing-preservation vestibular schwannoma surgery. A DNAP residual amplitude ratio > 0.41 was strongly associated with favorable early hearing outcomes, and its diagnostic advantage remained evident at the 6-month follow-up.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究评估经乙状窦后入路切除听神经瘤时，用四触点深部电极连续监测耳蜗背核动作电位（DNAP）的安全性和对短期听力结局的预测价值，并与标准听性脑干反应（ABR）比较。回顾性分析显示，DNAP信号可稳定记录的比例高于ABR，且未出现与电极相关的并发症；术后早期可服务听力与言语功能保留率在6个月随访时大致维持。多因素分析中，DNAP保留是早期及6个月听力相关结局最一致的独立预测因素，残余波幅比存在预测阈值，其诊断敏感性和预测表现优于ABR。结果提示该监测技术安全可行，但属预测性关联，不能据此推断治疗获益。

papers.title: CortexLens: Systematically Decoding Interpretable Visual Patterns from Human Visual Cortex
papers.authors: Qi Q, Tang Y, Mi L, Zhou J, Cai ZG, Duan X, Liu D.
papers.abstract: Understanding how the human brain encodes visual information remains a fundamental challenge in cognitive neuroscience. Sparse dictionary learning (SDL) has recently been applied to fMRI to discover visual features represented in the visual cortex. Existing approaches, however, depend on a vision-language model to identify the feature at discovery, and report limited discovery of the low-level visual features processed in early retinotopic visual regions that play an essential role in human visual cognition. We propose an automatic framework that systematically discovers visual features encoded in the human visual cortex, encompassing both high-level and low-level visual features. The framework decomposes fMRI responses across the full visual hierarchy with Matryoshka sparse autoencoders applied per region of interest, interprets the resulting fMRI activity patterns with a vision-language model, and introduces a set of feature channels to recover the low-level visual features that language-based interpretation fails to capture. On the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) and on the Brain Encoder Generated Dataset (BEGD), a separate set of synthesized responses from a transformer brain encoder, the low-level stream recovers thousands of interpretable low-level visual features from early retinotopic visual regions, where prior language-based pipelines report limited discovery. The high-level stream recovers interpretable semantic visual features on both datasets and generalizes to BOLD5000. Our analysis further reveals a systematic confound in language-based interpretation: fMRI activity patterns whose true representation is a low-level visual feature can be misidentified as a semantic visual feature when that feature co-varies with a salient semantic visual feature.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有稀疏字典学习方法依赖视觉语言模型识别特征、且对早期视网膜拓扑视觉区低层特征发现有限的问题，提出一个自动框架，结合按感兴趣区分区的Matryoshka稀疏自编码器、视觉语言模型解释和专门的特征通道，系统解码人视觉皮层的视觉特征。在自然场景数据集和由Transformer脑编码器生成的合成数据集上，低层通道从早期视觉区恢复出数千个可解释的低层视觉特征，而此前基于语言的流程在此发现有限；高层通道则恢复出可解释的语义特征，并能泛化到另一数据集。分析还揭示基于语言解释存在系统性混淆：当低层特征与显著语义特征共变时，前者可能被误判为语义特征。

papers.title: Human similarity judgments reveal fine-grained representations of dynamic social scenes
papers.authors: Garcia K, Isik L.
papers.abstract: How does the human mind organize dynamic social scenes? Existing accounts rely on pre-defined social-affective or action-based taxonomies, yet whether humans use these dimensions to structure their representations of naturalistic social scenes remains unknown. We collected 53,223 human similarity judgments of videos depicting two-person actions and trained a sparse-positive-embedding model to recover the underlying latent dimensions. These learned dimensions explained twice as much variance in similarity judgments as pre-labeled annotations, captured interpretable fine-grained social-event structure (combining information about social relationships and actions), and fractionated broad semantic content (e.g., separating parent-child interactions into caregiving versus affectionate play). The same dimensions also predicted fMRI responses to passively viewed stimuli across visual cortex better than pre-labeled annotations, highlighting their importance beyond similarity judgments. Together, these results suggest that humans represent dynamic social scenes along fine-grained axes not captured by current taxonomies, and offer behaviorally-grounded targets for future studies of social vision.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人如何组织对动态社交场景的心理表征，让参与者对描绘双人动作的视频做相似性判断，并用稀疏正嵌入模型从判断中提取潜在维度。结果显示，这些学习到的维度比预先标注的分类体系更能解释相似性判断，能刻画结合社会关系与动作信息的细粒度社会事件结构，还能把宽泛语义内容进一步细分，例如将亲子互动区分为照料与亲昵玩耍。相同维度在预测被动观看刺激时的fMRI反应上也优于预标注，提示人类对动态社交场景的表征沿现有分类未覆盖的细粒度轴线展开，并为后续社会视觉研究提供了有行为依据的靶点。

papers.title: The joint modulation of language distance and task demands on the neural mechanisms underlying bilingual lexical processing
papers.authors: Qi Y, Cai W, Li Z, Yang J, Wang X.
papers.abstract: Whether bilinguals share the same neural mechanisms for processing their first language (L1) and second language (L2) is a question of broad interest to researchers. Existing studies have accumulated substantial evidence, yet findings remain divergent. The primary sources of inconsistency lie in the language distance between bilinguals' L1 and L2, as well as differences in experimental tasks. Leveraging the advantages of meta-analysis, the present study examined brain activation patterns during L1 and L2 lexical processing in two groups of bilinguals: Chinese–English bilinguals with distant language distance (logographically–alphabetic) and alphabetic–alphabetic bilinguals with close language distance—across different tasks (phonological and semantic). Results showed that in phonological tasks, Chinese–English bilinguals recruited the left inferior parietal lobule/supramarginal gyrus more for L2, a region implicated in orthography-to-phonology conversion; in contrast, alphabetic bilinguals with close language distance shared overlapping neural mechanisms for L1 and L2. In semantic tasks, Chinese–English bilinguals engaged the left middle frontal gyrus and left precuneus more for L1 to support orthography-to-semantics conversion. In contrast, alphabetic bilinguals recruited the left middle temporal gyrus more for L1 for phonology-to-semantics conversion, and engaged language-control regions including the left middle frontal gyrus/inferior frontal gyrus, insula, and inferior parietal lobule more for L2. Further comparisons of brain activation during language-switching tasks between the two bilingual groups also revealed that alphabetic bilinguals with close language distance required greater involvement of executive control regions. Collectively, these findings indicate that the differential brain activation patterns observed when bilinguals process L1 and L2 arise from differences in underlying cognitive processes, jointly driven by language distance and task demands.
papers.summary_zh: 该元分析关注双语者加工母语和第二语言是否共享神经机制，并比较了语言距离较远的中英双语者与语言距离较近的字母语言双语者在语音和语义任务中的脑激活模式。结果显示，在语音任务中，中英双语者加工第二语言时更多招募与形音转换有关的左侧顶下小叶/缘上回，而语言距离近的双语者两种语言出现重叠机制；在语义任务中，中英双语者加工母语时更多依赖支持形义转换的左侧额中回和楔前叶，语言距离近的双语者则表现出不同的语义转换及语言控制区域参与。作者据此认为，双语者加工两种语言时的脑激活差异源于底层认知过程不同，并由语言距离和任务需求共同驱动。

papers.title: Clinical profiles of ambulatory and non-ambulatory school-aged children and young people with cerebral palsy in Aotearoa New Zealand: implications for the health education interface.
papers.authors: Adams K, Hill J, Sorhage A, Vorster A, Blamires J.
papers.abstract: Aim In Aotearoa New Zealand, ambulatory ability impacts Ministry of Education - Te Tāhuhu o te Mātauranga therapy funding for school-aged children with cerebral palsy, yet demographic and clinical profiles across mobility groups remain poorly described. This study utilises data from the New Zealand Cerebral Palsy Register/Te Rēhita a Hōkai Nukurangi Aotearoa to compare ambulatory and non-ambulatory school-aged children, highlighting their distinct clinical needs. Method A correlational, observational analysis of 1,149 participants aged 5-21 years was conducted. Data were categorised into Gross Motor Function Classification System (GMFCS) I-III, and GMFCS IV and V, with significant associations identified using Chi-squared tests and univariate logistic regression. Results Three hundred and forty-one (29.7%) children were classified as GMFCS IV and V. Compared to GMFCS I-III, those classified as GMFCS IV and V were more likely to have epilepsy (odds ratio [OR]=7.2 [5.2-10.0]), bilateral deafness (OR=5.4 [2.6-11.4]), moderate or severe intellectual impairment (OR=21.9 [13.3-35.9]) and be non-verbal (OR=89.1 [48.3-164.5]) or functionally blind (OR=63.4 [30.3-133.0]) (all 95% confidence interval [95% CI]). GMFCS levels corresponded with higher Manual Ability Classification System, Communication Function Classification System and Eating and Drinking Ability Classification System levels. Conclusion Non-ambulatory children with cerebral palsy have more complex, co-occurring impairments that extend beyond physical limitations and require support outside of school-based service provision. The findings underscore the need for whole-of-life, transdisciplinary approaches to both funding and management in Aotearoa New Zealand.

papers.title: Neuroanatomy of Orthorexia Nervosa: Emerging Insights from Structural Neuroimaging
papers.authors: Tinelli E, Maiolo A, Renzo AD, Muscari MA, Tallarico N, Sabatini U, Segura-Garcia C, Tarsitano MG.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective There are no published studies in the contemporary scientific literature that have directly applied neuroimaging techniques (such as fMRI, PET, or structural/functional MRI) to individuals with orthorexia nervosa (ON) to characterize brain alterations specific to this condition. Although interest in ON is increasing, a critical area of investigation concerns its phenomenological overlap with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and other feeding and eating disorders (FED). The present study aims to examine morphological brain differences in individuals with ON using high-resolution 3D T1-weighted MRI, with the goal of determining whether structural profiles observed in ON are comparable to those seen in OCD and in established eating disorder phenotypes. Methods Twenty-seven participants (12 females, 15 males) were enrolled in the study and underwent a comprehensive psychometric assessment including the ORTO-15, Italian-Düsseldorf Orthorexia Scale (I-DOS), Yale-Brown Obsessive Compulsive Scale (Y-BOCS), and the Multidimensional Perfectionism Scale (MPS). Participants were stratified into those exhibiting orthorexic behaviour and those without (healthy control group, HC) according to ORTO-15 scores. The imaging protocol included the acquisition of high-resolution three-dimensional T1-weighted MRI scans. Groups were compared regarding cortical and subcortical parameters in order to identify neuroanatomical differences associated with orthorexic behaviour. Results Morphometric analysis revealed a significant correlation between ORTO-15 score and cortical thickness (CT) in key brain regions. Specifically, lower ORTO-15 scores—indicative of greater orthorexic tendencies—were associated with a marked reduction in CT of the entorhinal cortex (EC). Conversely, an increased CT was observed in the right posterior cingulate cortex (PCC). Discussions The observed alterations in the EC and PCC suggest that ON may share neurobiological patterns with OCD and FED. These findings support the notion of ON as a distinct yet transdiagnostic clinical entity. However, the small sample size highlights the need for further large-scale investigations to confirm the presence and reliability of these potential neurobiological biomarkers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对目前尚无直接神经影像学证据刻画神经性正食症（ON）脑改变的问题，用高分辨率三维T1加权MRI考察具有正食倾向者的皮层与皮层下形态，并借助心理测量量表评估正食、强迫及完美主义特征。结果显示，正食倾向越强（ORTO-15得分越低），内嗅皮层厚度越低，而右侧后扣带皮层厚度越高。作者据此提出，ON可能与强迫症及进食障碍共享部分神经生物学模式，支持其作为一种独立却跨诊断的临床实体；但样本量小，这些潜在生物标志物仍需更大规模研究确认。

papers.title: APOE ε4 carriage is associated with pallido-putaminal diffusion alterations in early Parkinson’s disease
papers.authors: Restuccia G, Ielo A, Buono VL, Quartarone A, Bonanno L.
papers.abstract: Abstract APOE ε4 may influence Parkinson’s disease (PD) progression, but its microstructural correlates remain unclear. We examined 75 early drug-naïve PD patients (25 ε4 carriers) and 46 healthy controls (HC; 16 ε4 carriers) from the Parkinson’s Progression Markers Initiative using ROI and voxel-wise diffusion tensor imaging analyses. Within PD, ε4 carriers showed higher pallidal mean, radial and axial diffusivity and lower pallidal and putaminal fractional anisotropy. Voxel-wise analyses localized differences to left pallido-putaminal clusters. HC showed no significant APOE -related differences. In exploratory analyses across the overall PD sample, higher cluster radial diffusivity was associated with higher serum neurofilament light chain at baseline (β = 0.395, p = 0.001) and across two years, without evidence of moderation by APOE genotype or association with longitudinal change. These findings link APOE ε4 to regional diffusion differences in early PD without detectable subcortical volume differences. Their disease specificity and prognostic relevance remain to be established.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注APOE ε4携带状态是否与早期帕金森病的脑微结构改变相关，基于帕金森病进展标志物计划的早期未用药患者与健康对照，采用弥散张量成像分析。结果显示，在患者内部，ε4携带者出现苍白球弥散率升高及苍白球、壳核各向异性降低，差异集中于左侧苍白球-壳核区域；健康对照中未见明显的APOE相关差异。探索性分析还提示，该区域弥散指标与血清神经丝轻链水平存在关联，但未见APOE基因型调节或与纵向变化的关联。作者据此认为，APOE ε4与早期帕金森病区域性弥散差异相关，而未见皮层下体积差异，其疾病特异性和预后意义仍待确认。

papers.title: Conserved Thalamic Astrocytic Pathology in Mice and Patients Links TBI to Epilepsy
papers.authors: Moro F, Lisi I, Needham E, O'Loughlin E, Sapia RD, Chary K, Columbro SF, Lubarsky A, Loose L, Mazzone E, Husarik S, Sytsma K, Kobeissy F, Micotti E, Vezzani A, Newcombe VF, Stamatakis EA, Bonetto V, Ravizza T, Lubbers L, Wang KKW, Haskins WE, Nolan AL, Menon DK, Zanier ER.
papers.abstract: Abstract Post-traumatic epilepsy (PTE) can emerge months to years after traumatic brain injury (TBI) and is a major cause of morbidity, yet the pathological processes that distinguish TBI progressing to epilepsy remain poorly defined. Here, we combined longitudinal multimodal imaging, electrophysiology, neuropathology, and human imaging and postmortem analyses to identify cross-species features associated with PTE. In a mouse model of PTE-prone TBI, injury produced widespread brain pathology, whereas animals developing PTE showed disproportionate thalamic atrophy, white-matter abnormalities with reduced optic tract fractional anisotropy, and persistent metabolic alterations. Histological analyses revealed pronounced thalamic astrocytic reactivity, reduced cytoskeletal complexity, and impaired expression of proteins involved in glutamate homeostasis. Using an early ECoG signature to prospectively stratify PTE risk, we found that astrocytic simplification and accumulation of insoluble GFAP were already present during the latent period before spontaneous seizure onset. In patients with PTE, thalamic volume loss and reduced posterior thalamic radiation fractional anisotropy independently improved PTE classification beyond clinical variables. PTE patients also showed reduced pulvinar-centered thalamocortical functional connectivity involving visual and default mode networks. Postmortem tissue further demonstrated pronounced astrocytic reactivity and reduced astrocytic complexity in cortex and thalamus. In contrast, IBA1-defined microglial reactivity did not distinguish PTE from non-PTE at the chronic time points examined. Together, these findings identify a conserved thalamocortical phenotype associated with PTE and show that astrocytic remodeling emerges before spontaneous seizures. The convergence of cellular pathology with structural, metabolic, and functional abnormalities identifies the thalamus as a candidate hub of post-traumatic epileptogenesis and provides translational markers for tracking disease progression after TBI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究结合小鼠模型的多模态纵向成像、电生理与组织学分析，以及患者影像和尸检资料，寻找创伤性脑损伤后进展为创伤后癫痫的跨物种病理特征。结果显示，易发生癫痫的小鼠在潜伏期、自发性癫痫发作之前就已出现明显的丘脑星形胶质细胞反应性增强、细胞骨架复杂性下降及谷氨酸稳态相关蛋白表达受损，并伴有丘脑萎缩、白质异常和持续代谢改变；在患者中，丘脑体积减小和后丘脑辐射各向异性降低可独立提升创伤后癫痫的判别，患者还表现出以丘脑枕为中心的丘脑皮层功能连接减弱，尸检组织同样显示皮层和丘脑星形胶质细胞反应性增强、复杂性降低，而小胶质细胞反应性在所观察的慢性时间点未能区分是否发生癫痫。作者据此提出，丘脑是创伤后癫痫发生的一个候选枢纽，星形胶质细胞重塑先于自发性发作出现，相关结构和功能指标或可作为追踪伤后疾病进展的转化标志物。

papers.title: Predicting Macroscopic Axon Topology from Microscopic Kinematics: An Interactive Tracking and Random Walk Pipeline for Substrate-Dependent Cortical Neurospheres
papers.authors: Kim C, Kim M, Cao H, Hsieh T, Zhang YJ, Cohen-Karni T, Webster-Wood VA.
papers.abstract: Abstract The cortical neuron is a fundamental building block of the mammalian brain, and the morphology of its axonal projections is central to how functional circuits assemble. The trajectory along which an axon grows is a key determinant of connectivity, yet the kinematics of cortical axon outgrowth remain poorly quantified. Characterizing these dynamics is most tractable in vitro , where axonal growth can be measured directly and under controlled, reproducible conditions. Even in culture, however, this remains challenging because cortical neurons require dense plating for viability, and their soma is motile, so growth behavior is highly sensitive to local density and population context, complicating reproducible measurement of intrinsic dynamics. To overcome these limitations, we used size-controlled cortical neurospheres, which provide a fixed spatial origin and a reproducible environment, together with a custom semi-automated tracking pipeline to quantify single-axon kinematics across two functionalized substrates and two developmental phases. This approach revealed a substrate-dependent divergence in outgrowth: during the later developmental phase, axons on poly-D-lysine with laminin (PDL-LA) substrate grew faster than those on PDL, with a mean step size of 0.436 versus 0.339 \((\mu)\)m /min. Decomposing trajectories into Katz dynamic states, we built a generative biased random walk model that reproduces axonal behavior at both microscopic (single-axon) and macroscopic (network topology) scales. This open, reproducible framework links single-axon kinematics to network architecture, enabling the structural connectivity of neurosphere-based circuits in vitro to be predicted from measurable growth dynamics, a necessary foundation for future studies linking circuit structure to emergent function.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注皮质轴突生长轨迹如何决定连接性，但轴突生长的运动学特征此前缺乏可重复的量化手段。作者利用尺寸可控的皮质神经球提供固定起点和可重复环境，结合半自动追踪流程，在两种功能化基底和两个发育阶段测量单根轴突的运动学。结果显示生长行为随基底分化：在较晚发育阶段，层粘连蛋白基底上的轴突生长快于仅多聚赖氨酸基底。作者进一步将轨迹分解为动态状态并构建有偏随机游走生成模型，该模型能在单轴突和网络拓扑两个尺度上再现轴突行为，从而把可测的生长动力学与体外神经球回路的结构连接预测联系起来，为后续研究回路结构与功能的关系提供基础。

papers.title: Visuomotor coordination on the road: Low-dimensional representations reveal adaptive, context-dependent reductions in the dimensionality of natural driving behavior.
papers.authors: Madrid-Carvajal J, Derakhshan S, König P.
papers.abstract: The brain's ability to transform complex, high-dimensional sensory and motor inputs into coordinated, goal-directed behavior remains a central challenge in neuroscience research. Current research suggests that behavior is generated through patterns within a low-dimensional structure. What visuomotor patterns underlie complex, unconstrained behaviors such as driving, and how stereotypical they are, remain poorly understood. Driving involves complex perception-action interactions, which we hypothesize are specific to the driver's role and adapt to task demands. Here, we unfold these dynamics using an immersive virtual drive that recreates ten hazardous on-road events. We collected eye, head, and vehicle movements from participants assigned to either a manual or an automated driving condition. From the behavioral movements of 284 drivers, we constructed a common time-resolved behavioral state space based on collective variance, computed via principal component analysis across participants. The obtained low-dimensional representation thus captures generalized visuomotor coordination strategies. We then characterized the evolving low-dimensional structure with cosine similarity and various measures of effective dimensionality. We tested whether leading components contained condition-specific information using discriminant analysis. Throughout the entire drive, few components accounted for most of the variance in behavior, and effective dimensionality decreased reliably around critical events, indicating tighter coordination between perceptual and motor variables. During periods of low effective dimensionality, the contributions of eye, head, steering, and vehicle heading reorganized toward leading dimensions in a task-dependent manner. Across events, between-subject similarity was partially stable and stronger among manual drivers. This reorganization also made behaviors more distinct across driving conditions, enabling better classification of driving modes using only the first two components. These results show that naturalistic driving is supported by shared low-dimensional visuomotor coordination strategies that are flexibly reshaped by contextual demands, and provide a principled behavioral framework for linking neural manifolds, human driver models, and the design of adaptive automated vehicles.

papers.title: A Multidisciplinary Neuro-Lupus Program for the Evaluation and Management of Patients With SLE and Cognitive Concerns.
papers.authors: Wilcox DR, Mathieu EE, Weizenbaum EL, Baum ML, Bhattacharyya S, Costenbader KH.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives To develop and implement a standardized, comprehensive multidisciplinary program for the evaluation and management of patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and cognitive concerns that would lead to improved diagnosis and management. Methods The Neuro-Lupus Program evaluated 50 patients with SLE referred for any neurocognitive concern over a 12-month period. A specific sequential work-up protocol was developed for standardized patient evaluation. Initial history and examination were performed by a dedicated lupus neurologist followed by referral for comprehensive neurocognitive testing. Patients with suspected mood or psychotic disorders were evaluated in a specialized autoimmune psychiatry clinic. MRI brain scans were performed in all patients. Patients with MRI evidence of inflammation or cognitive impairment were further assessed with CSF studies and FDG-PET/CT brain. Management of neuropsychiatric medications and immunotherapy was a collaboration between neurology, psychiatry, and rheumatology. Results Full neurocognitive evaluation revealed a previously undiagnosed cognitive impairment in 46.4% of patients tested (mild 39.3%, major 7.1%), with an additional 39.3% demonstrating a normal cognitive profile with isolated weakness. MRI demonstrated white matter disease in 50% of patients and cerebral atrophy in 10%. Brain FDG-PET/CT was performed in 8 patients (16%), 7 (88%) of which were abnormal. CSF studies demonstrated normal protein and white cell counts, but 25% had elevated kappa free light chains. As a result of this program, neuropsychiatric medications were optimized in 86% of patients and 8% had an escalation in immunotherapy. Discussion This multidisciplinary Neuro-Lupus Program model brings together neurologists, psychiatrists, rheumatologists, and neuropsychologists to standardize the approach to neurocognitive symptoms in SLE. Among the patients enrolled, this program detected previously undiagnosed cognitive impairment in the majority of those tested and was associated with changes in neuropsychiatric and immunotherapy management.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究描述了一个多学科神经狼疮项目，用于标准化评估和管理伴有认知担忧的SLE患者，在12个月内纳入50名转诊患者，采用顺序化检查流程并结合神经科、精神科、风湿科与神经心理评估。结果显示，完整神经认知评估在受试者中发现了此前未诊断的认知损害（多数为轻度，少数为重度），另有相当比例患者认知表现正常但存在孤立薄弱；MRI常见白质病变，部分患者脑萎缩，少数接受FDG-PET/CT者多数异常，脑脊液蛋白和白细胞计数正常但部分kappa游离轻链升高。项目还促使多数患者的神经精神药物得到优化，少数患者免疫治疗升级，提示该模式有助于发现隐匿认知问题并推动管理调整，但摘要未报告对照或疗效证据。

papers.title: A web modular AI interface for brain tumor MRI classification using deep learning models.
papers.authors: Hamalaya J, Fayad H, Torfeh T, Rihana S.
papers.abstract: In order to improve patient outcomes and treatment processes, early and precise diagnosis of brain tumors is crucial. Despite the strong performance shown by deep learning models in classifying brain tumors from MRI scans, integrating these models into user-friendly clinical workflows remains challenging. This study presents a web-based AI platform designed for brain tumor classification using MRI images. The platform enables users to upload MRI scans, apply standardized preprocessing, select between different deep learning models, and receive real-time predictions. A custom convolutional neural network (CNN), pretrained VGG19, and pretrained Xception were evaluated using a publicly available T1-weighted contrast-enhanced brain MRI dataset of approximately 7,000 images across four classes: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no tumor. The dataset lacks patient demographic and clinical metadata, limiting assessment of clinical generalizability. The models achieved test accuracies of 96.03%, 98%, and 96%, respectively, with VGG19 demonstrating the best performance. The study is limited by the use of a single public, slice-based dataset and the absence of external clinical validation; future work will focus on multi-sequence MRI and independent clinical cohorts.

papers.title: Sensitivity of physeal-metaphyseal tractography correlations with height velocity for fractional anisotropy threshold selection.
papers.authors: Perdomo-Luna C, Jaramillo D, Santos L, Mostoufi-Moab S, Galvis I, Do H, Jambawalikar S, Kammen B, Kvist O.
papers.abstract: Objective Diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) tractography of the physeal-metaphyseal complex (PMC) provides insights into skeletal maturation. Fractional anisotropy (FA) minimal and maximal thresholds of 0.15 and 1.0, respectively, are commonly used to reconstruct tracts; these values were developed for highly organized tissues and may exclude the less organized hypertrophic and transitional zones that drive growth. Whether lowering the FA thresholds better captures growth-sensitive features and correlates with annualized height velocity is unknown. Material and methods Forty-five healthy adolescents (20 boys; 12-17 years) underwent 3 T DTI of the distal femoral PMC. Deterministic tractography was performed using nine previously untested FA threshold combinations (FA_min: 0.05, 0.10, 0.15 paired with FA_max: 0.40, 0.50, 0.60) and a conventional threshold (0.15-1.0). Partial Pearson correlations between extracted metrics (tract FA, apparent diffusion coefficient [ADC], volume) and annualized height velocity were computed, controlling for Tanner stage. Results Tract ADC showed strong positive correlations with height velocity across all thresholds (r = 0.55-0.63). Tract FA showed consistent negative correlations (r = -0.38 to -0.45). Tract volume correlations were threshold-dependent: positive at lower FA_min thresholds (r = 0.33-0.37, at FA_min = 0.05) but attenuated or reversed at higher FA_min thresholds (r = -0.26, at 0.15-1.0). Conclusion Tract ADC and FA are robust metrics of growth plate activity, insensitive to FA threshold selection. Tract volume associations with height velocity are threshold-dependent, with lower FA_min thresholds capturing growth-sensitive PMC tissue and lower FA_max excluding inactive PMC tissues. These findings underscore the importance of standardized tractography parameters in growth plate DTI studies. Key points Question How can we prevent conventional DTI FA thresholds from underestimating growth-sensitive tract volumes in the pediatric PMC? Findings Lower FA thresholds accurately capture tract volume correlations with height velocity, while tract ADC and FA correlate reliably across all thresholds. Relevance statement Optimizing FA thresholds in physeal-metaphyseal-complex DTI improves microstructural imaging correlations with height velocity, ensures reproducible data in pediatric skeletal growth studies, enhances noninvasive skeletal growth monitoring in adolescents, and potentially supplements traditional bone-age radiographs.

papers.title: Preoperative prediction of HCC microvascular invasion by multimodel peritumoral diffusion MRI.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Chen J, Qian X, Zeng M.
papers.abstract: Objective Most studies emphasize intratumoral diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) metrics, but few studies have examined whether peritumoral DWI metrics can provide added value. We aimed to evaluate three-dimensional, multiscale, multimodel DWI parameters within intratumoral and peritumoral volumes of interest for predicting microvascular invasion (MVI) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Materials and methods Seventy patients with HCC, including 42 with MVI, were prospectively enrolled. We calculated parameters from monoexponential, intravoxel incoherent motion, diffusion kurtosis imaging (DKI), stretched-exponential model (SEM), and continuous-time random-walk models within the tumor and in 3-mm (P3) and 5-mm (P5) peritumoral rims. Features showing differences on univariable analysis were further screened using logistic regression with variance inflation factor filtering to build combined models. Diagnostic performance was assessed by areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). Results Four intratumoral diffusion-coefficient-related metrics showed significant differences between groups. In the peritumoral regions, 12 parameters differed between groups, including diffusion-coefficient-related indices and heterogeneity-related metrics. Among single parameters, P3_DKI_Kapp achieved the best discrimination for MVI (AUROC = 0.713); P5_DKI_Kapp and Tumor_SEM_DDC were selected as independent imaging predictors. After integrating alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and tumor size, the combined model (Cli-IntraPeriDWI) yielded the best performance (AUROC = 0.844). SHAP analysis indicated that higher AFP, larger tumor size, higher P5_DKI_Kapp , and lower Tumor_SEM_DDC were associated with increased MVI risk. Conclusion Peritumoral DWI offers multiple biomarkers and outperforms intratumoral metrics for MVI prediction. An interpretable model integrating peritumoral and intratumoral DWI with clinical factors enables accurate, noninvasive preoperative MVI risk stratification in HCC. Key points Question Can multiscale, multimodel peritumoral DWI metrics improve preoperative prediction of MVI in HCC compared with intratumoral DWI metrics? Findings Compared with intratumoral DWI, peritumoral DWI offered more potential imaging biomarkers and superior diagnostic capability for the preoperative diagnosis of MVI in HCC. Relevance statement By integrating intratumoral and peritumoral metrics with clinical risk factors, we developed a model achieving optimal performance and transparent decision interpretability for MVI assessment, supporting preoperative prognostic evaluation and individualized treatment planning in HCC.

papers.title: Reassessment of the DTI-ALPS index in focal epilepsy.
papers.authors: Chambers S, Hofer L, Tranfa M, Kienast P, Shawarba J, Stepponat R, Jud J, Aull-Watschinger S, Pataraia E, Fischmeister FPS, Barkhof F, Hangel G, Rössler K, Pontillo G, Kasprian G, Haider L.
papers.abstract: Objective Recent evidence highlights the limited specificity of diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) along perivascular spaces (ALPS) as a noninvasive glymphatic biomarker because microstructural tract degeneration and crossing-fiber geometry confound it. We aimed to reassess the interpretation of the DTI-ALPS index in people with focal epilepsy. Materials and methods Seventy-nine people with drug-resistant focal epilepsy (PWFE) underwent comprehensive presurgical work-up and 3-T magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Etiologies included MRI-negative epilepsy, malformations of cortical development, temporal lobe epilepsy, and low-grade epilepsy-associated tumors. DTI preprocessing was conducted using QSIPrep with automated region-of-interest (ROI) placement. Linear regression models and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests were used to assess group differences and associations with clinical variables. Twenty-five age- and sex-matched healthy controls were included for comparison. Results Seventy-nine patients (28.6 years ± 11.3 [mean ± standard deviation]; 47 men, 32 women) and 25 healthy controls (mean age, 26.7 years ± 4.2; 11 men, 14 women) were evaluated. DTI-ALPS findings were more abnormal in lesions in proximity to the ROI (p = 0.014), implicating local white matter disruption as a modifier, which was further corroborated by reduced postoperative values. No associations were identified with disease duration, sex, or normalized gray-or white matter volumes. Conclusion Our results demonstrate a distance-dependent correlation of DTI-ALPS values to the seizure onset zone in focal epilepsy, whilst no significant associations to disease duration or normalized brain volumes were found. Together, these findings suggest that local disruption of fiber tracts may act as important modifiers of this measure and warrant caution in the interpretation of the DTI-ALPS index. Key points Question Microstructural changes may significantly confound the interpretation of the DTI-ALPS index as a surrogate parameter for glymphatic system dysfunction in epilepsy. Findings No significant differences in the DTI-ALPS index were observed comparing PWFE with healthy controls; however, lesion proximity and post-operative status significantly alter the metric. Relevance statement Local white-matter disruption and microstructural architecture may significantly alter the DTI-ALPS index; therefore, caution is warranted when interpreting the index as a glymphatic biomarker in focal epilepsy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究重新审视了DTI-ALPS指数作为局灶性癫痫中类淋巴系统生物标志物的解释，纳入耐药性局灶性癫痫患者与年龄性别匹配的健康对照，比较该指数并分析其与临床变量的关联。结果显示，患者与健康对照之间未见显著差异，但病灶靠近感兴趣区时该指数更异常，术后数值也降低，提示局部白质纤维束破坏会影响这一指标；未发现其与病程或标准化灰白质体积相关。作者据此提醒，在局灶性癫痫中解读DTI-ALPS指数需谨慎，局部纤维束微结构改变可能是重要混杂因素。

papers.title: General information reliability, perceived educational quality, and transparency of YouTube videos on epileptiform discharges: an exploratory cross-sectional study.
papers.authors: Ünal E, Issı ES.
papers.abstract: Objective Electroencephalography (EEG) is central to diagnosing and classifying epileptiform discharges, but interpretation requires structured training. This exploratory cross-sectional study evaluated general information reliability and completeness, perceived educational quality, and transparency of English-language YouTube videos on epileptiform discharges. Although these patterns are described using established electrographic criteria, interpretation may vary, particularly in borderline recordings. Methods A cross-sectional YouTube search was conducted in May 2025 using five keywords. The first 100 results per keyword were screened and 25 of 500 records met all eligibility criteria. The final sample was limited to narrated, English-language videos lasting 1 to 20 min that were returned by the selected search terms and YouTube ranking system. Two neurologists independently rated the videos using DISCERN as a general reliability indicator, the Global Quality Scale (GQS) for educational quality, and the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) criteria for transparency. Exploratory analyses included group comparisons, Spearman correlations, single-measure intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs), effect sizes, confidence intervals, and false-discovery-rate-adjusted q values. Results Six videos (24%) were from academic/educational channels and 19 (76%) from individual healthcare professionals. Mean scores were 52.1 for DISCERN (95% CI 46.7-57.5), 3.86 for GQS (95% CI 3.58-4.14), and 1.98 for JAMA (95% CI 1.69-2.27). Single-measure ICCs were 0.971, 0.655, and 0.816, respectively. Duration was nominally correlated with GQS (ρ = 0.431, p = 0.031) and JAMA (ρ = 0.553, p = 0.004), and DISCERN with GQS (ρ = 0.496, p = 0.012); none remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction (all q ≥ 0.052). Conclusion Among the small subset of eligible videos, general-purpose instruments suggested moderate-to-good average perceived educational quality and information reliability, whereas transparency was limited. Because DISCERN, GQS, and JAMA are not EEG-specific and no qualitative EEG-accuracy, pedagogical, or learner-outcome assessment was performed, the findings are exploratory. These results should not be understood as estimating the quality of all YouTube material related to EEG or epileptiform discharges, nor do they establish EEG-specific accuracy or educational effectiveness. The evaluated videos should therefore be used only as critically appraised adjuncts to expert-supervised EEG training.

papers.title: Changes in gray matter volume associated with gait speed and muscle mass in older adults with mild cognitive impairment.
papers.authors: Chuang TC, Liang CK, Chou MY, Chan YH, Wang HP, Wang YC, Hsu YH, Lin YT.
papers.abstract: BackgroundMild cognitive impairment (MCI) is an early stage of cognitive decline between normal aging and dementia. Gait speed, a key marker of physical function, has been associated with both cognitive decline and brain atrophy. Sarcopenia, characterized by age-related loss of muscle mass and function, has also been linked to structural brain changes.ObjectiveTo investigate the associations between sarcopenia, its individual components and regional gray matter volume (GMV) in older adults with MCI.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 234 older adults with MCI. Sarcopenia, gait speed, handgrip strength, and appendicular skeletal muscle mass index (ASMI) were assessed according to the 2019 Asian Working Group for Sarcopenia criteria. Brain T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging was analyzed using voxel-based morphometry. Voxel-wise group comparisons were performed to identify GMV differences after adjustment age, sex, comorbidity, depressive symptoms, nutritional status, and total intracranial volume.ResultsSlower gait speed was significantly associated with lower GMV in the bilateral putamen and left superior frontal cortex. Lower ASMI was associated with higher GMV in the left inferior temporal cortex. No significant GMV differences were found by sarcopenia status or handgrip strength.ConclusionsSlower gait speed is associated with reduced GMV in motor-related brain regions, indicating early brain structural changes in older adults with MCI. Although lower ASMI was associated with higher GMV, this finding should be interpreted cautiously. These findings highlight the complex interactions between physical function and brain structure, emphasizing gait speed as a potential indicator of brain health in older adults with MCI.

papers.title: The uncinate fasciculus in frontotemporal dementia subtypes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of diffusion-tensor imaging studies.
papers.authors: Mowafi S, Nassar L, Ezzeldin S, Salama M, Chun S.
papers.abstract: BackgroundFrontotemporal dementia (FTD) is a leading cause of early-onset neurodegeneration with selective frontal and temporal lobe degeneration. Despite well-characterized gray and white matter atrophy patterns across FTD subtypes, the extent of degeneration of the uncinate fasciculus (UF) tract has not been systematically quantified across FTD subtypes.ObjectiveTo compare uncinate fasciculus fractional anisotropy, mean diffusivity, radial diffusivity, and axial diffusivity between frontotemporal dementia subtypes and healthy controls.MethodsWe systematically searched PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science and performed a random-effects meta-analysis of diffusion tensor imaging studies published between 2011 and October 2025 according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines.ResultsWe systematically reviewed 11 studies and performed a meta-analysis of 540 participants across 10 studies. We found that all FTD subtypes demonstrated significant degeneration of the UF compared to controls. The greatest effect sizes were observed when comparing the left UF between the semantic variant primary progressive aphasia (svPPA) and controls (FA: SMD = -2.5396, 95% CI: -3.7914, -1.2878, p < 0.0001; RD: SMD = 2.2414, 95% CI:1.7972, 2.6855, p < 0.0001; AD: SMD = 1.9831, 95% CI: 1.1434, 2.8227, p < 0.0001; MD: SMD = 2.5268, 95% CI: 1.9993, 3.0542, p < 0.0001), while the behavioral variant (bvFTD) showed the largest reduction in right UF fractional anisotropy. Within-group analyses revealed significant left-right asymmetry in svPPA and non-fluent aphasia (nfvPPA), with greater left UF involvement, while bvFTD and controls showed no hemispheric differences.ConclusionsWe highlight the UF as a promising tract for understanding disease mechanisms and developing imaging biomarkers in FTD.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述与荟萃分析系统检索并汇总了额颞叶痴呆各亚型与健康对照之间钩束弥散张量成像的研究，比较各向异性、平均弥散率、径向和轴向弥散率。结果显示，所有额颞叶痴呆亚型均存在钩束的显著退变；其中语义变异型原发性进行性失语与对照相比，左侧钩束的效应量最大，行为变异型则在右侧钩束各向异性下降上最明显。组内分析还发现语义变异型和非流利变异型存在左右不对称、以左侧受累更重，而行为变异型和对照未见半球差异。作者据此认为钩束是理解额颞叶痴呆疾病机制和开发影像生物标志物的有前景的纤维束。

papers.title: An exploratory synthetic MRI-derived FLAIR-DIR contrast in olfactory-limbic regions in mild cognitive impairment.
papers.authors: Ekanayake A, Hwang S, Peiris S, Elyan R, Mustafa G, Tulchinsky M, Wang J, Eslinger P, Yang Q, Karunanayaka P.
papers.abstract: BackgroundOdor identification impairment is an early feature of Alzheimer's disease and predicts memory decline, but its microstructural basis remains unclear.ObjectiveTo evaluate FD, a semi-quantitative synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-derived Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery (FLAIR)-Double Inversion Recovery (DIR) contrast, against myelin volume fraction (MVF) in olfactory-limbic brain regions of patients diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment (MCI).MethodsSixteen healthy controls (HC) and 17 individuals diagnosed with MCI completed olfactory and cognitive testing and underwent 3T MRI using a QALAS sequence. MVF maps were generated and FD was computed as (FLAIR - DIR)/FLAIR. Group differences were examined in olfactory-limbic gray matter and associated white-matter tracts, and voxel-wise regression assessed FD-odor identification associations, including models adjusted for voxel-wise MVF. Region of interest and voxel-wise analyses were exploratory and largely uncorrected for multiple comparisons.ResultsCompared with HC, MCI showed lower FD across olfactory-limbic gray matter and white-matter pathways, including hippocampus, amygdala, orbitofrontal cortex, thalamus and corpus callosum, whereas MVF differences were more limited. Better odor identification was associated with higher FD in hippocampal/parahippocampal regions and insula, persisting after MVF adjustment. MVF showed positive associations in the right parahippocampal gyrus, left thalamus and genu of the corpus callosum. In an exploratory secondary analysis reported in the Supplemental Material, FD-based classification exceeded chance but was not separable from age alone.ConclusionsFD is a semi-quantitative relaxation-contrast metric showing regional patterns partially distinct from MVF. These exploratory findings require replication in larger, demographically matched, biomarker-confirmed cohorts before FD can be regarded as a marker of early olfactory-limbic microstructural change in MCI.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究比较了轻度认知障碍患者与健康对照在嗅-边缘系统灰质及白质通路中的合成MRI衍生FLAIR-DIR对比度（FD），并以髓鞘体积分数（MVF）作参照。结果显示，患者组多个嗅-边缘区域的FD降低，而MVF差异较有限；嗅觉识别表现较好与海马/海马旁及岛叶FD较高相关，且在调整MVF后仍存在。作者指出FD是半定量指标，其区域模式与MVF部分不同，这些未校正的探索性发现尚需在更大、匹配且经生物标志物确认的队列中重复，不能据此将FD视为MCI早期微结构改变的标志物。

papers.title: Neuropsychological and Quality-of-Life Outcomes After Aneurysmal Subarachnoid Hemorrhage.
papers.authors: Sagues E, Diaz L, Van Dam A, Shenoy N, Romero-Soto J, Biswas S, Aamot C, Gudino A, Peethambar G, Torner JC, Manzel KW, Garcia-Casares N, Samaniego EA.
papers.journal: Journal of the American Heart Association
papers.abstract: Background Survivors of aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage often have long-term neuropsychological disturbances. This study aims to characterize depressive symptoms, quality of life, and personality changes in a large cohort of survivors of aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage. Methods This cross-sectional study included patients with a history of aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage from the Brain Aneurysm Foundation patient registry. Patients completed the Beck Depression Inventory-II and the Stroke-Specific Quality of Life scale, and family members completed the Iowa Scales of Personality Change. Multiple linear regression was used to identify symptoms associated with reduced work productivity. Wilcoxon and chi-square tests were used to identify variables associated with severity of depressive symptoms and personality changes. Results A total of 318 patients were included, with 242 completing the Beck Depression Inventory-II and Stroke-Specific Quality of Life, and 112 family members completing the Iowa Scales of Personality Change. Moderate depressive symptoms were reported by 18% of patients, and severe symptoms were reported by 11%. Impairments in thinking, social roles, language, and energy were independently associated with reduced work productivity. Acquired personality disturbances were observed in 72% of patients for executive function, 44% for social behavior, 49% for hypomotivation, 50% for irascibility, and 72% for distress. Ruptured aneurysms in the anterior cerebral and anterior communicating artery were associated with a trend toward a higher prevalence of moderate to severe depressive symptoms and executive personality changes. Conclusions Depressive symptoms and personality changes are common after aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage, affecting work productivity. Recognizing challenges in thinking, social interactions, language, and vulnerability to pressure may help guide targeted interventions by families, employers, and health care providers.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究基于脑动脉瘤基金会患者登记数据，考察动脉瘤性蛛网膜下腔出血幸存者的抑郁症状、生活质量与人格改变，并由家属评估人格变化。结果显示，中度和重度抑郁症状分别见于约18%和11%的患者，家属报告的人格改变在执行功能、社交行为、动力不足、易怒和痛苦等方面均较常见。思维、社会角色、语言和精力方面的受损与工作生产力下降独立相关，提示出血后认知、社交与情绪问题可能共同影响患者重返工作的能力，值得家庭、雇主和医疗提供者关注并据此设计针对性支持。

papers.title: Channel-Adaptive Temporal Modeling with Grouped Convolutional Network and Informer for Seizure Detection and Prediction.
papers.authors: Zhao W, Liu R, Shao Y, Zhang Y, Dong X, Zhou J.
papers.abstract: Reliable identification and early prediction of epileptic seizures play a critical role in improving patient outcomes and supporting timely therapeutic decision-making. To address the challenges of spatiotemporal feature coupling and long-range dependency modeling in multi-channel EEG signals, this paper proposes a channel-adaptive temporal modeling framework named GCNN-Informer. The framework follows a three-stage pipeline: a grouped convolutional network (GCNN) extracts local features and selects the five most discriminative channels; a convolutional block attention module (CBAM) performs dual spatiotemporal enhancement; and a lightweight Informer encoder captures global temporal dependencies via the ProbSparse self-attention mechanism. Experiments on the CHB-MIT dataset, conducted under a patient-specific evaluation scheme, demonstrated that the proposed method achieved accuracies of 97.33% for seizure detection and 97.28% for seizure prediction, with a low false detection rate (FDR) of 0.30/h and a false prediction rate (FPR) of 0.03/h. Grad-CAM visualization further shows that as EEG signals evolve from normal/interictal to preictal and then to ictal stages, the model's attention heatmap progressively transitions from locally sparse highlighting to continuous block-like highlighting, and finally to dense deep-red responses - a pattern that closely aligns with clinical electrophysiological dynamics. This study provides an accurate and generalizable deep-learning solution for real-time epileptic monitoring and early-warning systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对多通道脑电信号中时空特征耦合与长程依赖建模的难题，提出名为GCNN-Informer的通道自适应时序建模框架，并在CHB-MIT数据集上按患者特异性方案进行实验。该框架先由分组卷积网络提取局部特征并筛选出最具判别力的通道，再经注意力模块增强，最后由轻量级Informer编码器捕捉全局时序依赖。结果显示，癫痫检测与预测均取得较高准确率，误检率和误预测率较低；Grad-CAM可视化还表明，模型关注区域随脑电从发作间期向发作前期和发作期演变，由局部稀疏逐渐转为密集响应，与临床电生理动态较为吻合。作者据此认为，该框架为实时癫痫监测与预警提供了一种较准确且具泛化性的深度学习方案，但相关性能仍需在更多场景中验证。

papers.title: Retroviral insertions contributed to the divergence of human and chimpanzee brains.
papers.authors: Gerdes P, Karlsson O, Garza R, Atacho DAM, Hsieh P, Prajapati B, Yoo D, Muralidharan C, Adami A, Davis-Hansson C, Johansson EM, Sharma Y, Castilla-Vallmanya L, West W, Vinod M, Domitrovic L, Johansson PA, Johansson J, Douse CH, Kanduri C, Jern P, Eichler EE, Jakobsson J.
papers.abstract: Over the past 5 to 7 million years, humans and chimpanzees have diverged in brain size, structure, and cognition despite high conservation of protein-coding genes. However, retroviral infections within host genomes have introduced numerous species-specific regulatory elements. Chimpanzees harbor lineage-specific PTERV1 endogenous retroviruses that are absent in humans, but their role in brain evolution has remained unclear. We performed an epigenomic analysis of PTERV1 insertions in chimpanzee neural organoids and found they are heavily DNA methylated, forming over 150 species-specific heterochromatin domains with the potential to influence gene regulation. We identified a chimpanzee-specific insertion on chromosome 19 that silences the long noncoding RNA LINC00662 through DNA methylation spreading. CRISPR-mediated deletion of this PTERV1 restored LINC00662 expression in chimpanzee induced pluripotent stem cells. We show that LINC00662 , a human-specific transcript expressed during brain development, plays a role in neuronal maturation, axon outgrowth, and neural organoid development. These findings reveal a mechanism by which endogenous retroviral insertions contributed to human-chimpanzee brain divergence.

papers.title: Biophysically constrained learning from healthy neural priors improves motor decoding in pathological cortical networks.
papers.authors: Wu Y, Chang T, Chen S, Quan Y, Sun Q, Van Hulle MM, Liu Y, Jiang N, Farina D, Yang Y, Mao Q, He J.
papers.abstract: High-performance brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) rely on stable neural representations, yet brain functional impairments inherently disrupt canonical encoding, creating a fundamental decoding paradox. Conventional data-driven approaches struggle to bridge this gap because of pathological data scarcity and heterogeneity. Here, we propose to leverage healthy neural priors and introduce Pathology-Aware Consensus Training (PACT), a paradigm embedding biophysical constraints into healthy neural recordings to guide neural decoding. In a gesture classification task using high-density electrocorticography from patients with gliomas infiltrating the motor cortex, PACT improved the accuracy by more than 10%, effectively restoring the distorted semantic geometry of motor commands and realigning them with healthy canonical representations (correlation increase: r = 0.66 to r = 0.94). Mechanistically, PACT induced an emergent "inverse weighting" strategy: The model autonomously suppresses high-power pathological noise while reanchoring spatial attention to functional compensatory regions. This study provides a proof of concept for improving decoding in compromised networks by harnessing healthy neural dynamics, laying the theoretical foundation for future BCI deployments in clinical populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对病理状态下神经编码被破坏、而病理数据又稀缺异质所导致的解码难题，提出将健康神经先验与生物物理约束嵌入解码训练的PACT范式，并在胶质瘤浸润运动皮层患者的高密度皮层脑电手势分类任务中检验。结果显示，PACT使解码准确率提升逾一成，并把失真的运动指令语义几何重新对齐到健康典型表征，表征相关性由r=0.66升至0.94。机制上，模型自发形成“反向加权”策略，抑制高功率病理噪声并将空间注意重新锚定到功能代偿区域。作者据此认为，利用健康神经动力学改善受损网络解码具有概念验证意义，为未来临床人群的脑机接口应用奠定理论基础，但尚非治疗证据。

papers.title: Temporal lobe cortical thickness and cognition in paediatric cancer survivors previously treated with chemotherapy.
papers.authors: Henry SS, Nandi S, Holtzer R, Rabin M, Gennarini L, Tal A, Lu J, Duong TQ.
papers.abstract: Long-term neurocognitive outcomes in paediatric cancer survivors treated with chemotherapy remain incompletely characterized, particularly in relation to cortical structure. Prior neuroimaging studies have included limited representation of racial and ethnic minority survivors. We analysed temporal lobe cortical thickness and cognition in paediatric cancer survivors treated with chemotherapy (n = 21; 8-25 years post-chemotherapy; aged 15-34 years) and age-matched controls (n = 21). Cognition was assessed using National Institute of Health (NIH) Toolbox scores. Cortical thickness of nine bilateral temporal regions was derived from T1-weighted 3T magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) using FreeSurfer. Group differences and brain-cognition associations were analysed using adjusted regression models with false discovery rate correction. Survivors scored lower on crystallized (p < 0.001), fluid (p = 0.013) and total cognition scores (p = 0.001). They showed reduced temporal lobe cortical thickness (2.62 ± 0.13 vs. 2.74 ± 0.11 mm; p = 0.001), with reductions in seven subregions. Greater thickness was associated with better cognitive performance in 10 of 27 associations, most prominently for crystallized cognition. Fully corrected T-score sensitivity analyses showed crystallized cognition remained lower in survivors (p = 0.044). Paediatric cancer survivors previously treated with chemotherapy showed reduced temporal lobe cortical thickness, which was associated with worse crystallized cognition, suggesting a potential structure-function association.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注接受过化疗的儿童癌症幸存者其颞叶皮层厚度与认知表现的关系，比较了幸存者与年龄匹配对照，并结合磁共振成像测量的颞叶皮层厚度与NIH Toolbox认知评分进行分析。结果显示，幸存者的晶体化、流体及总体认知得分均较低，颞叶皮层整体及多个亚区厚度也减少；在部分脑区与认知的关联中，皮层越厚对应认知表现越好，尤以晶体化认知最为突出。作者据此提出，颞叶皮层变薄可能与幸存者晶体化认知较差存在结构-功能关联，但这一关联尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: A compact teacher-student knowledge-distillation framework for lumbar MRI segmentation.
papers.authors: Sari Y.
papers.abstract: Accurate segmentation of lumbar magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is important for quantitative assessment of degenerative spine disease, but it remains challenging because spinal structures show low contrast, variable morphology, and severe pixel-class imbalance. This study evaluates a compact teacher-student knowledge-distillation framework for multi-class lumbar MRI segmentation. The student network integrates a Res2Net encoder-decoder, a lightweight transformer bottleneck, and deep supervision; a manifold-constrained hyper-skip (MHC) module is evaluated as an optional constrained skip-fusion variant rather than assumed to be the sole source of improvement. A UNet++ teacher transfers soft probability, class-focused, and boundary-weighted information to guide boundary-sensitive anatomical regions. Under five-fold case-level GroupKFold validation on the primary public axial lumbar MRI dataset, the MHC full-KD variant achieved Dice 0.9141 ± 0.0021, foreground Dice 0.8934 ± 0.0026, IoU 0.8519 ± 0.0033, and HD95 3.1451 ± 0.2101.
