papers.abstract: Exhaustion due to chronic stress, a hallmark feature of burnout, represents a substantial and growing public health burden, yet its structural brain correlates remain poorly understood. We used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to examine associations between regional gray matter volume and symptom severity in a cohort of 300 individuals on self-reported sick leave due to the Swedish medical condition stress-induced exhaustion disorder (ED), characterized by debilitating fatigue following prolonged stress exposure. Symptom severity was assessed using the Shirom-Melamed Burnout Questionnaire (SMBQ-18) and its subscales. Overall symptom severity (SMBQ-18 total score) and Physical Exhaustion (PE) were negatively associated with gray matter volume in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC), a region implicated in stress regulation and affective control, which remained significant when adjusting for depressive symptoms. An exploratory finding was that Listlessness was negatively associated with gray matter volume in the bilateral hippocampi and right middle temporal gyrus after adjustment for depressive symptoms. These results provide evidence from a large cohort for brain-symptom associations in chronic stress and highlight the value of dimensional approaches for capturing heterogeneity in stress-related conditions.

papers.title: Age- and noise-related differences in neural entrainment to speech sounds.
papers.authors: MacLean J, Bidelman GM.
papers.abstract: Speech-in-noise (SIN) perception is a difficult everyday listening task that becomes more difficult with age. Neural tracking of target speech is associated with successful speech perception in clean and noise-degraded listening environments. How aging impacts neural tracking of speech and behavioral decrements in SIN perception remains unclear. To address these questions, we measured neural speech tracking during a continuous SIN perception task in younger and older adults via multichannel electroencephalography (EEG). Participants (N = 83) monitored a continuous stream of syllables (~4.5 Hz) presented in quiet and noise conditions during EEG recordings. We assessed neural phase-locking value (PLV) to the acoustic speech envelope to investigate interactions between aging, hearing loss, and stimulus noise on neural synchronization to speech. Compared to younger adults, older adults demonstrated less behavioral sensitivity to noise effects than young adults and had higher overall PLV to target speech. Older adults also showed greater noise-related degradations in neural speech processing relative to younger listeners. Age remained a strong predictor of behavioral responses to speech even after controlling for hearing loss. Covarying for hearing loss removed most age-related effects on neural PLV. Older adults demonstrate exaggerated neural tracking to ongoing speech presented in quiet and greater noise-related reductions in neurobehavioral speech processing than young adults. Our results support the decline-compensation hypothesis, corroborate unusually large speech envelope encoding in older listeners, and suggest more robust neural synchronization to the speech signal is not always perceptually advantageous.

papers.title: Age-dependent gray matter correlates of perceived financial exploitation vulnerability in cognitively unimpaired older adults.
papers.authors: Zhang BY, Wallman-Jones A, Salminen LE, Oyen E, Leguizamon M, Axelrod J, Molinare CP, Noriega-Makarskyy DT, Williams JT, Han SD.
papers.abstract: Financial exploitation vulnerability in aging is a growing public health concern, yet its neural correlates remain poorly understood. Although psychosocial and cognitive factors confer risk, emerging evidence suggests that regional differences in brain structure may also contribute to vulnerability before overt cognitive impairment. In this study, 128 cognitively unimpaired older adults (ages 51 to 87 years, 76% female) completed structural magnetic resonance imaging and the Perceived Financial Vulnerability Scale, a self-report measure of financial exploitation risk. We examined age-stratified associations between perceived financial exploitation vulnerability and gray matter volume in relatively younger (n = 67) and older (n = 61) participants. Whole-brain voxel-based morphometry analyses revealed that higher perceived financial exploitation vulnerability was associated with lower gray matter volume in the right amygdala/anterior hippocampus (max t = 4.55, pFWE = 0.029) and left precuneus (max t = 5.40, p FWE = 0.031) among older participants, but not younger participants. In post hoc exploratory analyses modeling age as a continuous variable across the full sample, the age × perceived financial exploitation vulnerability interaction was significant for gray matter volume in the left precuneus and was observed at a trend level in the right amygdala/anterior hippocampus, with more negative associations at older ages. These cross-sectional findings identify regional gray matter correlates of perceived financial exploitation vulnerability that may vary across later adulthood.

papers.title: Infant gut microbiome neuroactive pathways link to social disadvantage, toddler neurodevelopment, cognitive and behavioural outcomes: a longitudinal cohort study.
papers.authors: Lee G, Rosa BA, Ndao IM, Martin J, Anzà S, Luby JL, Smyser CD, Rogers CE, Barch DM, Kimmel MC, Hall-Moore C, Bryant RE, Warner BB, Mitreva M.
papers.abstract: Background Early life is a critical window for co-development of the brain and gut microbiome (GM). Evidence supports a role for the GM in brain development, but longitudinal human data remain limited, particularly regarding the influence of social disadvantage (SD), a powerful determinant of child mental health and neurodevelopment. Here, we examine longitudinal relationships between the GM and neurodevelopmental outcomes over the first three years of life, and the impact of SD on them. Methods We sequenced and analysed stool samples of 187 children, collected at 5 timepoints over 4-36 months of life (MOL; 905 samples) using a whole-metagenome sequencing approach. Associations between GM-derived Gut-Brain Modules (GBM) and neuroactive potential were assessed using generalised linear mixed models, adjusting for covariates. Neurodevelopmental outcomes were evaluated by Bayley-III (cognitive, language, and motor), and neurobehavioural dysregulation and externalising/internalising-behaviour by the Infant-Toddler Social and Emotional Assessment (ITSEA) and Preschool Age Psychiatric Assessment (PAPA). Findings Temporal changes were observed in GBMs, including glutamate/GABA synthesis and degradation pathways, as well as short-chain fatty acids. GM community structure and GBMs were significantly associated with concurrent and later Bayley-III outcomes, most consistently for cognition and language (FDR < 0.10). Several GBMs were associated with both neurobehavioural outcomes and SD, including S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) synthesis, butyrate synthesis, and glutamate and GABA synthesis II (FDR < 0.10). A partial mediating effect between SD and 36 MOL language outcomes was observed using SAM synthesis at 4 MOL (β = -0.042, P = 0.048). Interpretation This longitudinal cohort study of GM neuroactive metabolic capacity across early transitional developmental windows reveals a dynamic pattern of GM-derived neuroactive metabolic pathways and identifies specific pathways associated with later neurodevelopmental (cognitive, language) and neurobehavioural outcomes, even after controlling for important covariates. These pathways are shaped by the socioeconomic status of mothers, starting with in-utero exposure, and GBMs partially mediated this effect. The study identifies microbial pathways associated with both SD and neurodevelopmental outcomes, highlighting potential biological processes that may contribute to neurodevelopmental risk and warrant further investigation. Funding This work was supported by the National Institute of Mental Health, March of Dimes, Children's Discovery Institute, National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases, and National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences.
papers.summary_zh: 该纵向队列研究追踪儿童出生后头三年肠道微生物组与神经发育的关系，并考察社会劣势的影响。研究者对儿童多个时间点的粪便样本进行全宏基因组测序，分析微生物来源的肠脑模块及神经活性潜力，同时用标准化工具评估认知、语言、运动及神经行为结局。结果显示，微生物群落结构和若干神经活性代谢通路与同期及后续的认知、语言等发育指标相关，其中部分通路（如SAM合成、丁酸合成及谷氨酸/GABA合成）同时与社会劣势和神经行为结局相关，且SAM合成在早期对社会劣势与后续语言结局之间表现出部分中介效应。作者据此提出，这些微生物通路可能参与社会劣势影响神经发育的生物学过程，但相关发现仍需进一步研究验证。

papers.title: Mapping the developmental course of the multispectral dynamics serving executive functioning.
papers.authors: Son JJ, Howard CE, Santos E, Killanin AD, Rice DL, Schantell M, Ward TW, Ende GC, Coutant AT, Embury CM, Picci G, Wilson TW.
papers.abstract: While the cortical regions serving basic sensory processing undergo extensive maturation during early childhood that slows considerably during adolescence, the circuitry and neural dynamics serving higher-order executive functions continue to develop throughout adolescence and early adulthood. While many studies have mapped the accompanying changes in cortical thickness and brain activation, far fewer have quantified changes in the cortical dynamics that likely underlie the improvements seen in executive function during this developmental window. In the current study, we use an advanced dynamic functional mapping technique based on high-density magnetoencephalography (MEG) to quantify neural oscillatory responses during a validated executive function task in 80 typically developing 11-16 year-olds. All MEG data were transformed into the time-frequency domain and significant oscillatory responses were imaged using a beamforming approach. The resulting voxel-wise, whole-brain functional images were examined for developmental changes using chronological age, sex, and sex-by-age interactions. Our primary results indicated that alpha oscillations in the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and anterior cingulate cortex became significantly weaker (i.e., less negative relative to baseline) with increasing age. Likewise, the strength of gamma oscillations also declined with increasing age in the left prefrontal cortex, left superior parietal cortices, and the right supplementary motor area. Critically, significant age-by-sex interactions in the alpha and gamma range were identified in the bilateral parietal cortices. These findings reveal developmental changes in alpha and gamma oscillatory dynamics in key cortical regions for higher-order cognitive function which may support the refinement of executive function during adolescence and early adulthood.

papers.title: Fetal brain volumes in complete vascular ring: A cross-sectional MRI study.
papers.authors: Ren JY, Chen CA, Zhu M, Zhang X, Li Y, Dong SZ.
papers.abstract: Background The association between complete vascular ring (CVR) and prenatal brain development remains poorly characterized. Objective To compare global and regional fetal brain volumes between fetuses with CVR and controls, accounting for gestational age (GA), fetal sex, and estimated fetal weight. Methods In this retrospective single-center study, 70 prenatally diagnosed CVR fetuses and 200 GA-matched controls with normal brain anatomy (22-37 weeks) underwent 1.5-T fetal MRI. Motion-corrected three-dimensional brain reconstructions were generated by slice-to-volume registration, and 19 regions were automatically segmented using a deep-learning pipeline. Linear regression included continuous GA, group, their interaction, fetal sex, and estimated fetal weight. Regional-to-intracranial volume ratios and sensitivity analyses incorporating maternal body mass index were evaluated. Multiple comparisons were controlled using the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. Results At the 28-week reference age, adjusted supratentorial brain, cortical gray matter, white matter, thalamic, lentiform nucleus, brainstem, and lateral ventricular volumes were smaller in the CVR group (all false-discovery-rate-adjusted P < 0.05). Intracranial volume did not differ significantly. Thalamic, lentiform nucleus, brainstem, and lateral ventricular proportions were also smaller. No group-by-GA interaction survived correction in the primary model. Conclusions CVR was associated with differences in selected fetal brain volumes, including regional differences relative to intracranial volume. Larger longitudinal studies with postnatal follow-up are needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注完全性血管环（CVR）胎儿在产前是否已出现脑发育差异，采用回顾性单中心设计，对产前诊断CVR的胎儿与孕龄匹配、脑解剖正常的对照胎儿进行1.5-T胎儿MRI，并通过三维重建和深度学习分割比较整体与分区脑体积，分析中纳入孕龄、胎儿性别和估计胎儿体重。结果显示，在参考孕龄下，CVR组幕上脑、皮层灰质、白质、丘脑、豆状核、脑干和侧脑室的调整后体积均较小，颅内总体积则无显著差异；丘脑、豆状核、脑干和侧脑室相对颅内体积的比例也较低，而组别与孕龄的交互作用未通过校正。作者据此认为CVR与部分胎儿脑体积差异相关，包括相对于颅内体积的分区差异，但强调这些是关联性发现，仍需更大规模、带出生后随访的纵向研究来验证。

papers.title: Altered white matter functional activity and connectivity in pretreatment breast cancer: Exploratory associations with affective symptoms.
papers.authors: Wu S, Zhang Z, Chen N, Cheng S, Xu W, Xu Z, Jia X, Wei F, Cheng Y, Mao G.
papers.abstract: Objective Resting-state fMRI studies in breast cancer have predominantly focused on gray matter, with limited attention to white matter functional organization. This study investigated white matter functional activity and connectivity before treatment and their associations with anxiety and depressive symptoms. Methods Female patients with breast cancer (BC) were recruited from Zhejiang Provincial Tongde Hospital from November 2023 to December 2025. Amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF) and fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (fALFF) were used to compare local white matter functional activity between the BC and healthy control (HC) groups. Seed-based functional connectivity (FC) analysis was then performed to investigate whole-brain white matter FC alterations. Correlations between clinical scale scores and rs-fMRI indices were analyzed. Results Compared with HCs, patients with BC showed altered ALFF/fALFF in the anterior and posterior corona radiata, internal capsule, posterior thalamic radiation, body of the corpus callosum, pontine crossing tract, left superior cerebellar peduncle, and left superior longitudinal fasciculus. Seed-based analysis revealed decreased FC within the bilateral anterior corona radiata and between the body of the corpus callosum and right anterior corona radiata, and increased FC between the left superior cerebellar peduncle and left posterior thalamic radiation. Higher ALFF in the body of the corpus callosum and reduced FC between this region and the right anterior corona radiata were associated with higher Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale scores at an uncorrected threshold. Neither association survived FDR correction. Conclusion Patients with BC showed altered white matter functional activity and connectivity before cancer-related treatment, suggesting that pretreatment brain functional alterations may also involve white matter functional organization. The relationship between these white matter changes and anxiety or depressive symptoms remains exploratory.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注乳腺癌患者治疗前白质功能活动与连接的变化及其与焦虑、抑郁症状的关系，采用静息态fMRI比较乳腺癌患者与健康对照的白质局部活动及基于种子的全脑功能连接。结果显示，患者在白质多个区域（如放射冠、内囊、胼胝体等）的局部活动指标发生改变，并出现部分白质连接减弱或增强。胼胝体体部活动升高及其与右侧前放射冠连接减弱与焦虑评分较高相关，但该关联未通过多重比较校正，作者因此仅将其视为探索性线索，提示治疗前脑功能改变可能也涉及白质功能组织。

papers.title: Attention Load Modulates Functional Brain Connectivity Reorganization in Children with High Autistic Traits: Evidence from Phase and Amplitude Coupling Metrics.
papers.authors: Latifoğlu F, Alp ZA, Benli ŞG.
papers.abstract: Whether emotional processing difficulties in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) stem from deficits in recognizing emotional stimuli or from limitations in flexibly reorganizing brain networks under increasing cognitive demands remains an open question. To our knowledge, this study is among the first to investigate the effects of graded attentional load (low/moderate/high) on EEG-based functional connectivity and brain network organization during task-irrelevant emotional prosody processing in children with high autistic traits (n = 31), by integrating phase-based (iPLV, wPLI) and amplitude-based (AEC) metrics together with graph-theoretic indices within a unified analytic framework. Connectivity matrices from a sliding-window approach were decomposed into edge-level, distributional, and graph-theoretic features and load-dependent changes in connectivity were assessed with statistical analyzes and classification models. The results suggested that attentional load did not uniformly increase or decrease connectivity but rather produced a multi-layered pattern of reorganization that varied as a function of frequency band, connectivity metric, and network topology. Phase-based connectivity in the beta band was decreased with increasing load, while amplitude envelope coupling (AEC) in the theta and alpha bands was increased under high load. This dual-mechanism pattern was most pronounced under the high-load condition, which yielded the greatest number of nominally significant features (uncorrected p<0.05; none survived FDR correction), the largest theta-AEC effect size (Kendall's W up to 0.22), and the best-performing classification model among those tested (accuracy = 72.6%, F1 = 0.725, AUC = 0.764). In conclusion, this exploratory study suggests that, in children with high autistic traits, increasing cognitive demands may be associated with band-specific network reorganization characterized by attenuated phase-based coordination alongside enhanced amplitude-based coupling; these patterns did not survive correction for multiple comparisons, have not been compared with those of typically developed children, and should be treated as hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory. If replicated, such findings could eventually inform how environmental stimulation and cognitive load are structured in special education settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨高孤独症特质儿童在情绪韵律加工中，注意负荷升高时脑功能网络如何重组，结合相位与振幅两类连接指标及图论分析脑电数据。结果显示，注意负荷并未统一增强或减弱连接，而是呈现随频段、指标和网络拓扑而异的层次化重组：beta频段相位连接随负荷下降，而高负荷下theta和alpha频段振幅耦合增强。作者强调这些探索性结果未通过多重比较校正，也未与典型发育儿童对比，应视为假设生成而非确证性结论。

papers.title: Dissociable associations of free-water fraction and DTI-ALPS index with disease manifestation and mutation carrier status in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Liu C, Liu X, Dong M, Li W, Zhang H, Zhang L, Zhang Y, Chen Y.
papers.abstract: Purpose Parkinson's disease (PD) is a biologically heterogeneous disorder. Diffusion MRI-derived free-water fraction (FWf ) and DTI-ALPS index have been proposed as biomarkers of PD-related brain alterations; however, their relationships with clinical disease manifestation and genetic susceptibility remain unclear. This study investigated whether substantia nigra pars compacta (SNc) FWf and DTI-ALPS indices show different associations with disease status and mutation carrier status across the PD continuum. Materials and methods Diffusion MRI data from the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative were analyzed, including healthy controls (HCs), non-manifesting mutation carriers (NMCs), and patients with sporadic or genetic PD. A 2 × 2 factorial analysis of covariance was performed to assess the effects of disease status and mutation carrier status on SNc FWf and DTI-ALPS indices. Exploratory longitudinal associations between baseline imaging measures and 4-year clinical outcomes were examined using multivariable linear regression with adjustment for the corresponding baseline clinical measures. Results Among 284 participants (63 HCs, 48 NMCs, 126 sporadic PD patients, and 47 genetic PD patients), mean SNc FWf showed a significant main effect of disease status, whereas mutation carrier status and the interaction effect were not significant. Sporadic PD patients exhibited higher SNc FWf than HCs and NMCs. In contrast, the left-sided DTI-ALPS index was associated with mutation carrier status. NMCs had lower left-sided DTI-ALPS indices than HCs and sporadic PD patients. In the exploratory longitudinal analysis, higher baseline mean SNc FWf was associated with a higher 4-year MDS-UPDRS Part II score, although this association was not significant when the analysis was restricted to participants with manifest PD. Conclusions SNc FWf and DTI-ALPS may capture complementary aspects of PD heterogeneity. SNc FWf appears more closely related to clinical disease expression, whereas DTI-ALPS index may reflect differences associated with genetic susceptibility. Further validation in larger mutation-stratified and longitudinal cohorts is warranted.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于帕金森病进展标志物计划的弥散磁共振数据，考察黑质致密部自由水分数与DTI-ALPS指数是否分别对应临床疾病表现和突变携带状态，比较了健康对照、未发病突变携带者及散发性和遗传性帕金森病患者。结果显示，黑质自由水分数主要随疾病状态升高，在散发性患者中高于健康对照和未发病携带者，而突变携带状态及其交互作用不显著；左侧DTI-ALPS指数则与突变携带状态相关，未发病携带者低于健康对照和散发性患者。探索性纵向分析提示基线自由水分数较高与四年后运动体验评分较差相关，但该关联在已发病患者中不显著。作者据此认为两者可能反映帕金森病异质性的互补方面，前者更贴近临床疾病表达，后者或与遗传易感性相关，尚需更大规模突变分层和纵向队列验证。

papers.title: Advanced brain age and longitudinal cognitive decline in healthy older adults.
papers.authors: Kristinsson S, Newman-Norlund R, Bonilha L, Bakos L, Rorden C, Sigurdsson S, Gudnason V, Fridriksson J.
papers.abstract: Advanced brain age relative to chronological age may predict cognitive decline in healthy aging, but prospective evidence remains limited. We tested whether the brain age gap (BAG) predicts cognition and 5-year cognitive decline in the AGES-Reykjavik Study. Participants with structural MRI and neuropsychological data were included cross-sectionally (n = 4,606); mean age 76.4y; 58% female) and longitudinally (n = 2,561; mean follow-up 5.2y). BAG was estimated from T1-weighted MRI. Mixed-effects models examined BAG effects on Memory (M), processing speed (PS), and executive function (EF), adjusting for age, sex, and education. Higher BAG was associated with worse cognition across all domains (β = -0.037 to -0.047, all p < 0.001). BAG significantly predicted greater decline in M (β = -0.007, p = 0.046); subgroup analyses revealed steeper decline in M and EF with advanced brain age. BAG predicts longitudinal cognitive decline beyond chronological age, supporting its utility as a biomarker in preventative care of healthy aging.

papers.title: SOFEx: A Self-Organized Feature Extraction Approach for Detecting Mild Cognitive Impairment and Alzheimer's Disease using EEG Datasets.
papers.authors: Tasci B, Yildirim K, Barua PD, Dogan S, Salvi M, Tuncer T, Tan RS, Devi A, Deo RC, Li Y, Mir H, Molinari F, Acharya UR.
papers.abstract: Early differentiation of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) from Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains difficult because diagnosis integrates cognitive, imaging, laboratory, and neurological evidence. EEG-based models may provide complementary information, but fixed descriptors can miss signal-specific structure. SOFEx was developed as an adaptive and interpretable EEG feature-engineering framework. The analysis used 1,905 EEG segments from 451 recordings of 168 participants (59 AD, seven MCI, and 102 controls). SOFEx combined self-organized rose pattern extraction, fold-wise feature selection, channel-wise classification, and iterative majority voting. Validation used leave-one-subject-out (LOSO), leave-one-record-out (LORO), and participant-grouped 10-fold cross-validation (CV). Five classifiers were compared under LOSO, and a support vector machine (SVM) was retained. LOSO, used as the primary evaluation of generalization to unseen participants, achieved 84.09% accuracy (95% Wilson CI, 82.38-85.67%), with class-wise recall of 94.47% for AD, 56.59% for controls, and 21.18% for MCI (UAR, 57.41%; macro F1-score, 62.95%). LORO and participant-grouped 10-fold CV achieved 93.65% and 96.38% accuracy, respectively, indicating substantial performance variation across validation schemes. Frontal and parietal electrodes contributed repeatedly to the selected configurations, providing sensor-space information on the signals supporting classification. SOFEx provides an adaptive and interpretable feature-engineering framework for EEG-based classification, combining input-specific pattern selection with sensor-level traceability. Participant-independent evaluation showed high sensitivity for AD, while discrimination of MCI remained more challenging. These findings support the potential of the proposed framework and motivate further validation on larger and independent cohorts to assess its generalizability across clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出并评估了一种自适应、可解释的脑电特征工程框架SOFEx，用于区分阿尔茨海默病、轻度认知障碍与对照者，方法上结合自组织模式提取、特征选择、通道级分类与多数投票，并以留一被试等方式验证。在留一被试评估中，该框架对阿尔茨海默病识别灵敏度较高，但轻度认知障碍的判别仍较困难，且不同验证方案下准确率差异明显。额叶和顶叶电极反复参与所选配置，为分类所依据的信号提供了传感器层面的线索。作者据此认为该框架具有应用潜力，但其跨临床场景的泛化性仍需在更大、独立队列中验证。

papers.title: Field-Strength Dependence of Automated Subcortical Volumetry: A Paired 3 T-7 T Benchmarking Study of BrainSuite, FastSurfer and NextBrain.
papers.authors: Emekli E, Demirel BC, Emekli E.
papers.journal: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
papers.abstract: Automated segmentation pipelines are widely used for quantitative assessment of subcortical brain structures, yet it remains unclear whether measurements obtained at different magnetic field strengths are numerically interchangeable. This study evaluated the cross-field agreement and inter-software consistency of automated subcortical volumetry using paired 3T and 7T structural MRI data from 30 healthy adults. T1-weighted images were independently processed using BrainSuite, FastSurfer and NextBrain. Volumes of the bilateral putamen, globus pallidus, nucleus accumbens, thalamus and caudate nucleus were analysed. Within-software agreement between 3 and 7T measurements was assessed using two-way mixed-effects, single-measure intraclass correlation coefficients for absolute agreement. Inter-software agreement was examined separately at 3T and 7T using both absolute agreement and consistency intraclass correlation coefficients. All within-software regional comparisons and selected inter-software comparisons were further evaluated using Bland-Altman analyses. Cross-field agreement varied markedly across software packages and anatomical regions. BrainSuite showed poor absolute agreement across all regions, whereas FastSurfer and NextBrain demonstrated moderate-to-good agreement in selected structures. Inter-software consistency was generally higher than absolute agreement, indicating preservation of relative participant ranking despite systematic differences in measured volumes. Segmentation failures were more frequent at 7T, particularly for BrainSuite. Bland-Altman analyses confirmed software- and region-specific systematic differences and wide limits of agreement. These findings indicate that the evaluated automated segmentation pipelines do not provide field-strength-invariant subcortical volume estimates. Measurements obtained at 3T and 7T, or using different software packages, should not be considered directly interchangeable without pipeline-specific validation or harmonisation.

papers.title: Is photophobia associated with the structure of the visual thalamus? A MRI morphometric study.
papers.authors: Coppola G, Di Renzo A, Sebastianelli G, Giardina I, Chiffi D, Giuliani G, Casillo F, Abagnale C, Ziccardi L, Pucci A, Song M, Parisi V, Altieri M, Caramia F.
papers.journal: Neurological sciences : official journal of the Italian Neurological Society and of the Italian Society of Clinical Neurophysiology
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Photophobia is a common migraine symptom, but its cause is unknown. The posterior thalamic nuclei may directly affect ambient light discomfort. This study examined the link between photophobia and the structure and morphometry of the thalamus and its subregions, including the lateral geniculate nuclei and pulvinar subnuclei. Methods Twenty episodic migraine patients without aura (MO) and 20 healthy controls (HCs) underwent high-resolution T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging, diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), and full ophthalmological assessment. Scans were acquired interictally, with all patients off preventive therapy. Volumetric segmentation included the whole thalamus, lateral geniculate nuclei, and pulvinar subregions. Photophobia was rated from 0 to 10 using a visual analogue scale. Thalamic and subregion volumes served as dependent variables, while photophobia scores were independent variables in a general linear model (GLM). Bilateral thalamic DTI metrics were analyzed for relationships with volumes and photophobia scores using GLMs. Results No statistically significant differences were observed in the overall thalamic volume or in any of its subregions and DTI metrics between MO patients and HCs (p > 0.05). No relationships emerged between thalamic volumes, DTI metrics, and interictal subjective photophobia scores (p > 0.05). Conclusions Our results suggest a lack of association between photophobia and thalamic macro- and microstructural measures in MO patients during the interictal phase, with no significant structural or microstructural correlates identified. Further research is needed to determine whether these negative results could be extended to patients with migraine with aura or during other phases of the migraine cycle.

papers.title: Glymphatic dysfunction in early-onset schizophrenia: DTI-ALPS index reduction tracks illness burden and is independently associated with cognitive performance in treatment-resistant patients.
papers.authors: Oz A, Saglam Y, Turan K, Ficicioglu IEG, Karacetin G, Yesilkaya UH.
papers.abstract: Early-onset schizophrenia (EOS) is associated with greater cognitive impairment than adult-onset disease, and many patients also develop treatment resistance. Glymphatic dysfunction has been described in adult schizophrenia but not in EOS or in relation to treatment resistance. We used diffusion tensor imaging along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) to assess glymphatic function in 30 adolescents with EOS (15 treatment-resistant, TRS; 15 non-treatment-resistant, nTRS) and 29 age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HC). Participants completed a neuropsychological battery covering verbal memory, processing speed, executive function, working memory, verbal fluency, and social cognition. ALPS differed across groups (F(2,56) = 34.66, p < 0.001, η² = 0.553), with values decreasing from HC (1.625 ± 0.072) to nTRS (1.501 ± 0.098) to TRS (1.439 ± 0.048); the TRS-nTRS difference was not significant (d = 0.81, p = 0.066). Patients showed broad cognitive deficits relative to HC, but nTRS and TRS did not differ on any measure after FDR correction. ALPS showed a nominal inverse association with the number of psychotic episodes (ρ = -0.391, p = 0.033) but was unrelated to PANSS scores or antipsychotic dose. Within TRS, ALPS was independently associated with phonemic verbal fluency (COWAT: β = +0.74, p = 0.003); a parallel association with categorical fluency (β = +0.88, p < 0.001) was partly driven by an influential observation and is exploratory. Glymphatic dysfunction appears to be a disease-intrinsic feature of EOS, lowest in TRS, possibly linked to cumulative episodes rather than current symptoms, and may contribute to cognitive impairment in treatment-resistant patients.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用弥散张量成像评估早发性精神分裂症青少年的类淋巴功能，比较治疗抵抗、非治疗抵抗患者与健康对照，并考察其与认知的关系。结果显示，类淋巴功能指标从健康对照到非治疗抵抗再到治疗抵抗患者依次降低，提示类淋巴功能障碍可能是早发性精神分裂症的疾病内在特征，且在治疗抵抗者中最明显。该指标与既往精神病发作次数呈名义上的负相关，而与当前症状严重程度和抗精神病药剂量无关；在治疗抵抗患者中，它还独立关联于音位言语流畅性，但类别流畅性的关联受个别观测影响，属探索性。作者据此推测，类淋巴功能异常可能与发作累积有关，并可能参与治疗抵抗患者的认知损害。

papers.title: Epilepsy in paediatric neurofibromatosis type 1: clinical features and associated factors in a single-centere cohort.
papers.authors: Bektas H, Eroglu Ertuğrul NG, Citak Kurt AN.
papers.abstract: Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) is associated with an increased risk of epilepsy, but the clinical spectrum and associated factors of epilepsy in paediatric NF1 remain incompletely characterized. We aimed to describe frequency and features of epilepsy in paediatric NF1 and to compare the characteristics of NF1 patients with and without epilepsy. We retrospectively reviewed 253 paediatric NF1 patients followed up between January 2020 and December 2025. Demographic, clinical, electroencephalographic, and radiological data were collected. Categorical comparisons between patients with and without epilepsy were performed using χ2 or Fisher's exact tests. Of 253 patients (53.8% female; median age 12.3 years), 12 (4.74%) had epilepsy. Median age at epilepsy onset was 3.2 years (IQR 2.4-7.0). Seizure semiology was focal in 7 (58.3%) and generalized in 5 (41.7%). EEG reports were available in 10 patients: normal in 4, focal discharges in 4, and multifocal discharges in 2; no patient had generalized spike-and-wave discharges. Four (33.3%) had drug-resistant epilepsy; median number of antiseizure medications was 1, median seizure-free duration was 44 months. Compared with patients without epilepsy, those with epilepsy had significantly higher rates of moyamoya syndrome (25.0% vs 0.4%, p < 0.001), autism spectrum disorder (16.7% vs 0%, p = 0.002), learning difficulties (58.3% vs 14.5%, p < 0.001), and overall neurodevelopmental comorbidity (83.3% vs 29.0%, p < 0.001). No significant differences were found in the frequencies of neurofibromatosis bright objects (NBOs), optic pathway gliomas, or low-grade gliomas. Conclusions In our cohort, epilepsy occurred in 4.74% of patients. Most had favorable seizure outcomes. Epilepsy was associated with cerebrovascular anomalies and neurodevelopmental comorbidities but not with NBOs or intracranial tumours. These findings suggest that children with NF1 and cerebrovascular abnormalities may warrant particular vigilance for seizures, while those with epilepsy should undergo systematic neurodevelopmental assessment. What is known • Epilepsy affects 4-14% of patients with NF1, is usually mild, but its determinants remain poorly defined. • Neurofibromatosis bright objects show no consistent association with epilepsy. What is new • In 253 children, epilepsy (4.74%) was associated with moyamoya syndrome and neurodevelopmental comorbidity. • Optic pathway gliomas, low-grade gliomas and bright objects did not predict epilepsy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于单中心儿童1型神经纤维瘤病（NF1）队列的回顾性资料，描述癫痫的发生频率与临床特征，并比较伴与不伴癫痫患儿的差异。结果显示，癫痫在患儿中占少数，发作以局灶性居多，多数发作结局较好，但部分为难治性癫痫；伴癫痫者更常合并烟雾病综合征、孤独症谱系障碍、学习困难及总体神经发育共病，而神经纤维瘤亮物体、视路胶质瘤和低级别胶质瘤未见明显关联。作者据此提示，对伴脑血管异常的NF1患儿应提高对癫痫的警惕，而对已患癫痫者宜进行系统的神经发育评估；这些关联来自单中心回顾性比较，尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: "It cannot depend solely on the parents"-professionals' perspectives on patient journeys of children with chronic conditions across health and social care in Germany.
papers.authors: Herr CJ, Herrler A, De Bock F.
papers.abstract: Purpose Professionals in healthcare, social services and the education system are confronted with a growing number of children with chronic conditions. Complex treatment plans, care coordination and cross-system care needs result in additional demands on professionals. This study aimed to explore professionals' perspectives on the patient journeys of children with chronic conditions in Germany and identify opportunities to improve care. Methods This qualitative study used semi-structured interviews conducted from May 2023 to February 2024. A purposive sample of professionals working with children with chronic conditions (attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, autism spectrum disorder, developmental disorders, cerebral palsy, bronchial asthma, type 1 diabetes) was recruited from the health, social care, and education systems in Germany. Sampling was guided by an assessment of thematic saturation. Data were analysed using structuring qualitative content analysis. Results Twenty-two professionals participated, including physicians (n = 7), therapists (n = 8) and social workers and counsellors (n = 7). Care was perceived as fragmented, difficult to navigate, and poorly coordinated across health, social care, and education systems. Key barriers included long waiting times, unclear care pathways, and limited interprofessional communication. Greater difficulties in navigating care and support were perceived among families facing socioeconomic disadvantage or language barriers. Conclusion Professionals perceived current care structures as insufficiently meeting the needs of children with chronic conditions, particularly where families face greater barriers to navigating services. Strengthening cross-system coordination and accessibility may improve patient journeys. Future research should examine how barriers vary according to socioeconomic circumstances and across stages of the patient journey and evaluate condition-independent approaches to improving care. Trial registration This study was registered in the German Clinical Trials Register, ID: DRKS00032139, on 07 November 2023. What is known • Research on patient journeys of children with chronic conditions has primarily focused on individual, often rare, conditions. • Evidence spanning multiple chronic conditions and the healthcare, social services, and education systems remains highly limited. What is new • Drawing on diverse professionals' perspectives, this study provides a cross-system, cross-condition view of paediatric patient journeys. • It identifies common barriers to care coordination and access across systems and diagnoses, highlighting actionable opportunities for integrated care.

papers.title: Quantifying dexterity and grip strength associations between age, cognitive function (MoCA), and cerebellar gray matter volume in healthy adults across the adult lifespan.
papers.authors: Rajesh Kannan P, Pallapothu R, Kudaravalli S, Pallapothu S, Newman-Norlund RD.
papers.abstract: Cerebellar Crus I/II gray matter volume (GMV) is a structural marker of cognitive aging, and motor performance predicts age-related cognitive decline. Whether grip strength and manual dexterity dissociate in their cerebellar and cognitive correlates is unknown. We computed Pearson partial correlations (age, sex, and race covaried) between grip strength, Nine-Hole Peg Test (9HPT) dexterity, cerebellar Crus I/II GMV, and Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) subscores in 304 healthy adults aged 20-79 from the University of South Carolina Aging Brain Cohort. GMV was derived from T1-weighted MRI using CAT12 with the AAL3 atlas. After false discovery rate (FDR) correction, dominant 9HPT time correlated with MoCA total score (r=-.240) and memory index (r=-.220; both pFDR<0.001). Grip strength was unrelated to any MoCA measure but correlated bilaterally with Crus II GMV (r=.156-.224, all pFDR≤0.041). Bootstrapped mediation indicated that dexterity statistically accounted for 28.8% of the age-cognition association and Crus II volume for 34.4-41.4% of the age-grip association. Dichotomizing at the MoCA cut-off of 26, each additional second of peg time carried 17.6% higher odds of scoring below cut-off (odds ratio = 1.176, 95% CI [1.062,1.302]) while grip strength carried none. Grip strength, but not dexterity, was independently associated with Crus II GMV, whereas dexterity, but not grip, was associated with cognition. Grip strength and dexterity are therefore not interchangeable indices of motor function. Because the design is cross-sectional, mediation estimates describe shared variance rather than causal pathways, and the pronounced MoCA ceiling likely attenuated the cognitive associations.

papers.title: Locus coeruleus abnormalities on neuromelanin-sensitive MRI in Parkinson's disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Zhao J, Abuliezi N, Wei R, Sun Y, Aikemu A, Lei J, Wu Y, Tang B, Guo J, Wu Q.
papers.abstract: Neuromelanin-sensitive magnetic resonance imaging (NM-MRI) enables in vivo assessment of locus coeruleus (LC) integrity, but findings in Parkinson's disease (PD) vary across cohorts and methods. We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus from inception to 5 September 2026 and pooled independent PD-healthy control (HC) comparisons using random-effects models. Sixty-five reports were included, of which 17 contributed to at least one main pooled outcome. The primary LC-signal analysis included 14 independent cohorts (1,078 participants with PD and 543 HCs) and showed lower LC signal in PD (Hedges' g = - 0.95, 95% confidence interval (CI) - 1.32 to - 0.57; P = 0.00011). Between-study heterogeneity was substantial (I2 = 88.4%), and the 95% prediction interval crossed zero (- 2.28 to 0.38). The LC-volume analysis included five independent cohorts (215 participants with PD and 134 HCs) and likewise showed lower values in PD (g = - 0.87, 95% CI - 1.13 to - 0.62; P = 0.00071; I2 = 0%). The negative mean LC-signal effect was preserved across sensitivity analyses, but every specification-level prediction interval crossed zero. Of the 65 reports, 64 yielded 243 secondary-outcome records, of which 102 contained directly usable quantitative information; however, no additional outcome cluster simultaneously met the criteria for construct compatibility, cohort independence and numerical poolability. LC NM-MRI shows group-level differences in PD, but LC-signal differences vary across settings. These comparisons do not establish individual diagnostic accuracy. Clinical translation will require harmonized acquisition, analysis and reporting, together with independent, multicentre and longitudinal validation. This review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261498031).

papers.title: Dynamic long-term modulation of cognition, brain structure and covariance networks in mild cognitive impairment due to AD by donepezil: A 36-month longitudinal study.
papers.authors: Chen Y, Tong Z, Wang H, Xu X, Chen Q, Lu J, Hu Y, Zhang X, Zhao H, Chen J, Zhang B.
papers.abstract: Background Whether donepezil exerts long-term efficacy in mitigating cognitive decline, preserving brain structure, and restoring impaired structural covariance networks in patients with mild cognitive impairment due to Alzheimer's disease (AD-MCI) remains controversial. Objective This study aimed to characterize the longitudinal dynamic alterations in cognition, brain morphology, and structural covariance network topology in AD-MCI patients receiving continuous 36-month donepezil treatment, thereby elucidating the long-term modulatory effects of donepezil on AD progression. Methods Cross-sectional analysis included 92 normal controls (NC) and 107 AD-MCI patients to identify baseline abnormalitiesin cognitive performance, brain morphological parameters, global topological features, and nodal metrics of individual gray matter covariance networks. Subsequently, 35 AD-MCI patients who completed 36-month continuous donepezil treatment were retrospectively enrolled to explore the therapeutic modulation of donepezil on the aforementioned abnormal indicators. Linear and piecewise linear mixed-effects models were employed to quantify longitudinal changes. Results AD-MCI patients showed left hippocampus (including subfields) atrophy and widespread structural covariance network impairment at baseline. During treatment, significant time main effects were observed in MMSE scores and the volume of the left hippocampus and multiple subfields, both of which continued to show progressive decline, with accelerated deterioration between 12 and 18 months. Global topological metrics stabilized after initial short-term improvement, while right hippocampus nodal metrics were significantly enhanced. Conclusions Donepezil treatment in AD-MCI patients represents a dynamic therapeutic process: it elicits transient short-term improvement of global brain network topology but confers only modest long-term benefits, with insufficient evidence supporting sustained, impactful neuroprotective effects. This study provides novel multi-level longitudinal evidence describing the neuroimaging changes underlying donepezil's modulation of AD progression.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注多奈哌齐对阿尔茨海默病所致轻度认知障碍（AD-MCI）患者认知、脑结构及结构协方差网络的长期调控作用，先横断面比较患者与正常对照的基线异常，再回顾性追踪完成36个月持续治疗的患者，用线性及分段线性混合效应模型刻画纵向变化。结果显示，患者基线存在左侧海马及多个亚区萎缩和广泛的结构协方差网络损害；治疗期间MMSE评分与左侧海马等体积仍随时间进展性下降，且在12至18个月间加速恶化，全局拓扑指标在短期改善后趋于稳定，右侧海马节点指标则明显增强。作者据此认为，多奈哌齐的作用是动态过程：仅带来短暂的全局网络拓扑改善和有限的长期获益，不足以支持持续、有实质影响的神经保护效应。

papers.title: Prediction of short-term and long-term responses to cladribine in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis: a Danish nationwide real-world study.
papers.authors: Bramow S, Pontieri L, Heick A, Thormann A, Sejbæk T, Rasmussen PV, Weglewski A, Qadir SH, Christensen JR, Mærsk-Møller C, Zachariassen K, Schäfer J, Stilund M, Jensen HB, Kristensen CCH, Kant M, Sellebjerg F, Sørensen PS, Magyari M, Danish Multiple Sclerosis Group.
papers.abstract: Cladribine is regarded highly efficacious in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS). However, prediction of treatment response and optimal management remain elusive, particularly during long-term. We screened the Danish Multiple Sclerosis Registry for patients with RRMS who received ≥2 5-day treatment cycles of cladribine and were followed for >90 days. Annualised relapse rates (ARR) and activity parameters (relapses or MRI activity) were analysed from 90 days after the first dose (index) to year 3 (short-term) together with time-to-first 24-week confirmed disability worsening (CDW), CDW independent of relapses (PIRA), and activity/CDW (loss of "no evidence of disease activity", NEDA-3). Kaplan-Meier log-rank tests were validated in a subgroup who completed ≥4 five-day cladribine cycles before year 3 and contributed with >3 years follow-up (3YFS). Predicting covariables included age (< /≥ 45 years), pre-baseline activity, and short-term NEDA-3 status regarding 3YFS outcomes beyond year 3 (long-term). ARR declined significantly from ~0.55 in the year pre-baseline to ~0.23-0.25 from index to year 3. Younger age and pre-baseline activity predicted more frequent short-term activity. Pre-baseline activity additionally predicted short-term NEDA-3 loss. Short-term findings were consistent in 3YFS patients. CDW and PIRA were rare during short-term (~ 10%) and long-term (~ 20%), even in older patients. However, during long-term, NEDA-3 loss resumed steadily and this was largely unpredictable. While cladribine showed sustained short-term efficacy, treatment response appeared more favourable in older patients and patients without pre-baseline activity. Rare CDW and PIRA events warrant more research in cladribine for disability prevention. Optimal long-term management following cladribine treatment requires more research.

papers.title: TSPO-PET binding in vivo reflects increased phagocytic microglia at post mortem in people with frontotemporal dementia.
papers.authors: Vontobel DS, Lai KO, Bacioglu M, Nolan G, Maddison DC, Adamski A, Goddard J, Shapiro NL, Crook H, Fryer T, Hong Y, Wijesinghe S, Aigbirhio F, Avezov E, Allinson KSJ, Quaegebeur A, O'Brien JT, Rowe JB, Spillantini MG, Malpetti M.
papers.abstract: Brain inflammation is a key feature of frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Positron emission tomography (PET) of the 18 kDa translocator protein (TSPO) is widely used as an in vivo proxy for neuroinflammation, but whether the elevated signal reflects microglial, astrocytic or vascular pathology remains controversial, and this has not previously been resolved in FTD using matched ante mortem imaging and post-mortem tissue. We paired ante mortem [11 C]PK11195 TSPO-PET with quantitative post-mortem neuropathology in 10 individuals with FTD (5 FTLD-tau, 5 FTLD-TDP) and 5 age- and sex-matched controls, combining CD68 immunohistochemistry across 17 brain regions, multiplex immunofluorescence pairing TSPO with microglial/macrophagic (IBA1, CD68), astrocytic (GFAP) and endothelial (CD31) markers in three frontotemporal cortical regions, and three-dimensional single-cell reconstruction of individual microglia. CD68 area fraction was elevated in FTD relative to controls, predominantly in white matter, and was positively associated with regional TSPO-PET-binding potential across the cohort (β = 8.66, P < 0.001), with comparable slopes in FTLD-tau and FTLD-TDP. Total tissue TSPO-area fraction was likewise increased in FTD and tracked regional PET binding in two independently processed slide sets. Of the four cell-type markers, only the CD68-TSPO co-localised fraction was positively associated with the PET signal (β = +0.0041, P = 0.015, PFDR = 0.062), with null or negative associations for IBA1, GFAP and CD31. At single-cell resolution, IBA1+ microglia that were also CD68+ carried more absolute TSPO and were larger than CD68- microglia, without an increase in the TSPO fraction of cell volume. The elevated TSPO-PET signal in FTD, therefore, likely reflects an increased burden of CD68+ phagocytic microglia rather than TSPO expression in other cell types, supporting TSPO-PET as a microglial-burden biomarker across both FTLD-tau and FTLD-TDP.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨额颞叶痴呆（FTD）中升高的TSPO-PET信号究竟反映哪类细胞的病理改变，将生前[11C]PK11195 TSPO-PET与死后定量神经病理学配对分析，比较FTD患者与年龄性别匹配的对照。结果显示，FTD中CD68面积分数升高且以白质为主，并与区域TSPO-PET结合潜能在整个队列中呈正相关，FTLD-tau与FTLD-TDP亚型斜率相近；组织TSPO面积分数同样升高并追踪PET信号。在多种细胞标志物中，仅CD68与TSPO的共定位分数与PET信号正相关，而小胶质/巨噬细胞、星形胶质细胞和内皮标志物的关联为零或负。单细胞层面，同时表达CD68的小胶质细胞携带更多TSPO且体积更大。作者据此认为，FTD中升高的TSPO-PET信号更可能反映CD68阳性吞噬性小胶质细胞负荷增加，而非其他细胞类型的TSPO表达，支持其作为跨FTLD-tau和FTLD-TDP的小胶质细胞负荷生物标志物。

papers.title: Imaging features of pituitary Crooke cell adenoma: a 13-case series.
papers.authors: Xing Y, Wang J, Du S, Lou L, Zhang S, Zheng N, Zhou L.
papers.abstract: Objective Crooke cell adenoma (CCA) is a rare and aggressive subtype of pituitary neuroendocrine tumor (PitNET). This study aimed to characterize the imaging features of CCA. Methods Preoperative and postoperative follow-up MR images of 13 patients with CCA were retrospectively reviewed to characterize their imaging features in conjunction with clinical and pathological findings. Results Among the 13 CCAs, 8 (61.5%) were macroadenomas and 5 (38.5%) were microadenomas. On T1-weighted imaging, 12 tumors (92.3%) were isointense. On T2-weighted imaging, 6 (46.2%) were hyperintense, 4 (30.8%) were hypointense, and 3 (23.1%) were isointense. Macroadenomas were predominantly hyperintense (5/8) or isointense (3/8), whereas microadenomas were predominantly hypointense (4/5). Multiple microcystic changes were observed in 2 macroadenomas (15.4%). Mild contrast enhancement was observed in 10 tumors (76.9%). Knosp grade 1 was the most common pattern of parasellar extension (8/13, 61.5%). During postoperative follow-up of 2-39 months, tumor progression occurred in 4 patients (30.8%), all of whom had undergone subtotal resection. Retrospective review of their preoperative contrast-enhanced MRI showed reduced enhancement of the tumor-adjacent internal carotid artery wall (ICAW) in all four cases. Conclusion CCA exhibits several imaging characteristics, particularly mild contrast enhancement and a tumor size-related T2-weighted signal pattern. Knosp grade 1 was the most frequent parasellar extension pattern. Reduced enhancement of the tumor-adjacent ICAW was observed in four cases with postoperative tumor progression; however, the clinical significance of this finding requires validation in larger cohorts with longer-term follow-up.

papers.title: Toward Brain Biosignature at 7 T-Repeatability of a Multiparametric CEST, QSM, QTI, and Sodium Imaging Protocol.
papers.authors: Hofmann A, Freudensprung M, Mücke L, Wilferth T, Yang Z, Perrin D, Glaser J, Tkotz K, Duarte M, Weinmüller S, Chaudry O, Wirth A, Mennecke A, Gödicke O, Liebig P, Gast LV, Ehses P, Stilianu C, Stollberger R, Hanspach J, German A, Winkler J, Uder M, Doerfler A, Bickelhaupt S, Maier A, Breininger K, Zaiss M, Nagel AM, Laun FB, Knoll F.
papers.abstract: Purpose To evaluate the repeatability of an extended multiparametric 7 T MRI protocol for voxel-wise tissue characterization combining morphological, CEST, QSM, QTI, and Sodium contrasts. Methods A repeatability study was performed in 12 volunteers without diagnosed neurological disease on a 7 T MRI system, using a comprehensive acquisition protocol with a combined acquisition time of 45:24 min, from which 45 contrast maps were derived. Quantitative repeatability was assessed using region-based and voxel-wise analyses. Precision and reliability were evaluated using the coefficient of variation (CV), repeatability coefficient (%RC), and intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC). Voxel-wise agreement between scan-rescan images was assessed using Pearson correlation coefficients. Results Across contrasts spanning morphological, CEST, QSM, QTI, and 23 Na imaging, %RC was below 20% for 20 contrasts, with mean CV below 5% for most. Repeatability was highest for MP2RAGE T1 maps and QTI MD (CV ≈ 1%-2%; ICC up to 0.86) and lowest for 23 Na imaging (ICC < 0.6). CEST contrasts were highly repeatable at low saturation power but more variable at higher power (CV up to ≈8%). QSM contrasts showed moderate ICC (0.46-0.82). Voxel-wise correlations exceeded r = 0.8 for most contrasts, confirming preserved spatial patterns across repeated scans. Conclusion Multiparametric 7 T MRI enables reproducible voxel-wise characterization of brain tissue across a wide range of contrasts. Despite variability in specific contrasts, the overall high repeatability and strong voxel-wise agreement support the feasibility of voxel-wise imaging approaches for quantitative brain imaging and provide a foundation for future applications in clinical research and neuroscience.

papers.title: Complementary stable and dynamic prelimbic ensembles encode learned threat value underlying generalization and discrimination.
papers.authors: Normandin ME, Ogallar PM, Lopez MR, Ramos-Alvarez MM, Muzzio IA.
papers.abstract: Adaptive behavior requires assigning emotional value to sensory cues and generalizing to similar stimuli. The prelimbic cortex (PL) is critical for threat expression and discrimination, yet its neuronal ensembles undergo substantial turnover over time. How stable population codes emerge despite this reorganization remains unknown. Using longitudinal calcium imaging in freely moving mice, we tracked PL activity for 30 days during auditory discriminative fear learning and retrieval. Despite substantial ensemble turnover, stable graded representations persisted in PL populations. A generalized linear model showed that the tone threat value explained graded activity better than freezing, indicating that PL primarily encodes stimulus significance. Population similarity across stimulus presentations was highest for shock-associated and highly generalized tones, suggesting a stable population code underlying threat generalization. Stable neurons preserved graded gradients across sessions, whereas learning modulated the rate of dynamic frequency-selective neurons. Together, these populations enabled stable threat-value coding despite ongoing ensemble reorganization.

papers.title: A mechanistic theory of planning in prefrontal cortex.
papers.authors: Jensen KT, Doohan PT, Sablé-Meyer M, Reinert S, Baram AB, Sahani M, Akam T, Behrens TE.
papers.abstract: Planning is critical for adaptive behaviour in a changing world, because it lets us anticipate the future and adjust our actions accordingly. While prefrontal cortex is crucial for this process, it remains unknown how planning is implemented in neural circuits. Prefrontal representations were recently discovered in simpler sequence memory tasks, where different populations of neurons represent different future time points. We demonstrate that combining such representations with the ubiquitous principle of neural attractor dynamics allows circuits to solve much richer problems, including planning. This is achieved by embedding the environment structure directly in synaptic connections to implement an attractor network that infers desirable futures. The resulting 'spacetime attractor' excels at planning in challenging tasks known to depend on the prefrontal cortex. Recurrent neural networks trained by gradient descent on such tasks learn a solution that precisely recapitulates the spacetime attractor - in representation, in dynamics, and in connectivity. Analyses of networks trained across different environment structures reveal a generalisation mechanism that rapidly reconfigures the world model used for planning, without the need for synaptic plasticity. The spacetime attractor is a testable mechanistic theory of planning. If true, it would provide a path towards detailed mechanistic understanding of how prefrontal cortex structures adaptive behaviour.

papers.title: Strong mnemonic prediction errors increase cognitive control, attention, and arousal.
papers.authors: Xue AM, Jokhani J, Norcia AM, Wagner AD.
papers.abstract: Ongoing experience is continuously processed in the context of past events. Divergence between current experience and memory-based predictions (i.e., a mnemonic prediction error; MPE) is theorized to be a signal that encoding, as opposed to retrieval, should be prioritized. We asked how MPEs place demands on control and attention-related processes, and whether these demands differ as a function of prediction strength. We investigated these questions across two experiments, wherein we recorded scalp electroencephalography and/or pupillometry as 101 young human adults performed an associative memory task. Strong MPEs, more so than weak MPEs, increased physiological indices of cognitive control (frontal theta), attention (posterior alpha and pupil size), and arousal (pupil size). Greater cognitive control (frontal theta) during strong MPEs promoted better learning of prediction-violating (i.e., unexpected) stimuli. Collectively, these findings reveal multiple pathways through which the mind and brain respond adaptively to violations of strong mnemonic predictions.

papers.title: Structural damage of the cervical spinal cord within and beyond the maximal compression area in mucopolysaccharidosis types I and VI
papers.authors: Nestrašil I, Lenglet C, Krasovec I, Mueller BA, Ahmed A, Bondy MT, Labounková I, Chekouo T, Svátková A, Whitley CB, Labounek R.
papers.abstract: Background Cervical spinal cord (CSC) compression and myelopathy are frequent, severe complications in mucopolysaccharidosis (MPS) types I and VI. Early detection is critical to prevent irreversible neurological deficits and preserve quality of life. This prospective study aimed to identify quantitative neuroimaging biomarkers of structural CSC damage and myelopathy in MPS I and VI. Methods Structural and diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the CSC was analyzed in 17 MPS I patients, 3 MPS VI patients (19±7 years), and 19 case-matched healthy controls (20±7 years). CSC macrostructure (cross-sectional area, diameters) and microstructure (fractional anisotropy [FA], radial [RD], mean, axial diffusivities) were evaluated within and beyond the maximal compression areas. Results MPS patients demonstrated reduced CSC cross-sectional area and anterior-posterior diameter at upper cervical levels, alongside widespread microstructural alterations (lower FA, higher RD) throughout the CSC versus controls (p FDR <0.05). Restricted foramen magnum space was associated with microstructural damage at lower cervical levels without overt macrostructural compression. Morphological and microstructural metrics were sensitive to CSC compression and myelopathy severity (p FDR <0.05). Lower CSC integrity correlated with more advanced growth retardation (p<0.001). Among patients receiving hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, earlier treatment correlated with preserved upper CSC morphology (p<0.05). Distinct neuroimaging phenotypes were observed across MPS genotypes (p FDR <0.05). Conclusions CSC MRI provides candidate neuroimaging biomarkers for early detection and characterization of myelopathy in MPS I and VI. Structural damage extends beyond primary maximal compression areas, highlighting these markers for clinical monitoring and future therapeutic trials.

papers.title: Left Temporoparietal Neural Synchrony Tracks Cooperative Performance Across Adult Dyads
papers.authors: Carollo A, Cavallaro R, Bizzego A, Dimitriou D, Hoehl S, Esposito G.
papers.abstract: Cooperation requires interacting individuals to coordinate their actions toward shared goals, and interpersonal neural synchrony (INS) has been proposed as a neural correlate of this coordination. However, the relationship between INS and cooperative performance remains heterogeneous, and relatively little is known about how it varies across social relationships. The present study examined INS and behavioral performance during a naturalistic cooperative tabletop Jenga task in close-friend, romantic-partner, and mother–child dyads (N = 284 participants). Brain activity was simultaneously recorded using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) hyperscanning, and INS was quantified using wavelet transform coherence across the bilateral inferior frontal gyrus (IFG) and temporoparietal junction (TPJ). Cooperative performance was assessed using tower collapse and the number of valid turns completed during the game. True interacting dyads exhibited significantly greater neural synchrony than surrogate dyads across all examined regional pairings ( d range = 0.35–0.55), indicating robust interaction-related inter-brain synchrony. Behavioral performance was not associated with INS at the whole-network level. Region-specific analyses, however, showed that tower collapse was associated with reduced synchrony in the left TPJ–left TPJ ( p Bonf = 0.009) and left TPJ–right TPJ ( p Bonf = 0.017) pairings, whereas the number of valid turns was unrelated to INS. Follow-up analyses further indicated that the association between tower collapse and left TPJ–left TPJ synchrony was present in close-friend ( p Bonf = 0.020) and romantic-partner ( p Bonf = 0.026) dyads but not in mother–child dyads. These findings suggest that the behavioral relevance of interpersonal neural synchrony is not uniform, but depends on the neural systems involved, the specific index of cooperative performance, and the relational and developmental context in which interaction unfolds.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察合作表现与人际神经同步之间的关系，并关注这种关系是否随社会关系类型而变化。研究让亲密朋友、恋人和母子配对完成自然情境下的叠叠乐合作任务，同时用功能性近红外光谱超扫描记录脑活动，并以小波变换相干量化双侧额下回与颞顶联合区的同步。结果显示，真实互动配对在各区域配对上的神经同步均高于替代配对，但全网络水平的同步与合作表现无关；区域特异分析中，叠叠乐塔倒塌与左侧颞顶联合区自身及左右颞顶联合区之间的同步降低相关，而有效回合数则与同步无关。进一步分析表明，塔倒塌与左侧颞顶联合区同步的关联只见于亲密朋友和恋人配对，未见于母子配对。作者据此认为，人际神经同步的行为意义并不统一，而取决于所涉及的神经系统、具体的合作表现指标以及互动发生的关系与发展情境。

papers.title: Anatomically optimised structural connectome derivation for the neonatal brain
papers.authors: Hew CK, Leserri S, Aydogan DB, Bastin ME, Bonthrone AF, Paterson K, Barclay G, Jardine C, Smith KM, Thrippleton MJ, Marioni R, Boardman JP, Blesa Cabez M.
papers.abstract: Structural connectomics provides a means of characterising white matter (WM) network organisation using diffusion MRI (dMRI), but reconstructing neonatal structural connectomes remains challenging due to the immature and heterogeneous nature of the developing brain. Although recent neonatal studies have increasingly adopted approaches beyond conventional diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), there remains scope to incorporate more advanced tractography and streamline post-processing approaches within neonatal pipelines. Here, we propose a neonatal structural connectome pipeline integrating surface-based anatomical constraints, ensemble tractography, hierarchical anatomical refinement of pathways (HARP) filtering, and spherical-deconvolution informed filtering (SIFT2) reweighting. We acquired 3T MRI data from 300 neonates (185 preterm, 115 term-born) to assess the impact of pipeline configuration on network organisation. Mean gestational age (GA) at birth was 29.31 (23.43–32.86) weeks in preterm infants and 39.52 (37.00–42.43) weeks in term infants. At scan, mean GA was 40.85 (36.29–49.00) weeks in preterm infants and 42.06 (38.29–48.00) weeks in term infants. Four connectome variants were generated: raw surfaced-based tractograms, HARP-filtered, SIFT2-weighted, and combined HARP+SIFT2. Pipeline performance was primarily evaluated using an existing brain age prediction model: connectome-based predictive model (CPM) and our derived connectomes to estimate GA at scan in term and preterm infants. In addition, global graph theoretical metric analyses were conducted to provide a complementary assessment of pipeline configuration differences in network organisation. In total, seven graph theoretical metrics were calculated and evaluated: global efficiency, local efficiency, transitivity, modularity, assortativity, degree variance and statistical complexity. Across all configurations, connectomes supported accurate brain age prediction, with mean absolute errors (MAE) of 0.76–0.79 weeks in term infants and 1.00–1.06 weeks in preterm infants. Prediction error and brain age gap variability were greater in preterm than term infants across configurations, with HARP+SIFT2 achieving the lowest preterm MAE (1.00 weeks) and brain age gap (BAG) variability (SD = 1.38 weeks). However, differences in prediction performance across configurations were minimal, suggesting limited influence of pipeline choice on brain age prediction. However, analysis of global network metrics demonstrated that pipeline choice significantly influenced downstream measures of network organisation, with HARP+SIFT2 being the only configuration to identify significant preterm vs. term differences across all seven metrics examined. These findings demonstrate the importance of considering tractography and streamline-processing choices when constructing neonatal structural connectomes and provide a framework for more anatomically informed investigation of early brain development. Issue Section Research
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对新生儿大脑结构连接组重建困难的问题，提出了一套整合表面解剖约束、集成纤维追踪、分层解剖路径细化（HARP）过滤和SIFT2重加权的处理流程，并利用足月与早产新生儿的弥散MRI数据，以脑龄预测和全局图论指标评估不同流程配置对网络组织刻画的影响。结果显示，各配置下的连接组均能较准确地预测扫描时胎龄，且配置间预测表现差异很小，说明流程选择对脑龄预测影响有限；但全局网络指标对流程配置敏感，仅HARP+SIFT2组合在所有考察指标上均检出早产与足月的差异。作者据此强调，构建新生儿结构连接组时需重视纤维追踪与流线后处理的选择，并为更符合解剖结构的早期脑发育研究提供了流程框架。

papers.title: Accentuated Divergence, Constrained Expression: Autistic Traits Modulate the Creative Brain in Adults with ADHD
papers.authors: Liu N, Mu Z, Wang X, Jia G, Alitanshunbuer, Liu J, Xu J, Li H, Wang Y, Qiu J, Qian Q, Liu L.
papers.abstract: Background Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition, and co-occurring autistic traits may shape its phenotypic expression. Although creativity has been discussed as a relative strength in ADHD, it remains unclear whether autistic traits are associated with different dimensions of creativity in adults with ADHD and whether large-scale brain networks contribute to these associations. Methods We compared divergent thinking (DT) and real-life creativity between 65 adults with ADHD and 73 neurotypical controls. We used subgroup comparisons, partial correlation analyses, and multiple regression models to determine the effects of autistic traits (ATs) on creativity dimensions within the ADHD cohort. Guided by prior creativity-network research, we analyzed resting-state functional connectivity (FC) of the Default Mode Network (DMN) and Frontoparietal Network (FPN) to uncover the neural mechanisms. Results The ADHD cohort demonstrated significantly higher scores on both DT ( p s = 0.002–0.009) and real-life creativity measures ( p s = 0.011–0.017) compared to the neurotypical control group. Importantly, increased ATs within the ADHD group were associated with a dissociated creativity profile, showing positive associations with DT but negative associations with real-life creativity. At the neural level, stronger right DMN–FPN connectivity mediated positive associations between ATs and DT performance (ps = 0.007–0.018), but mediated a negative association between ATs and self-reported imagination (p = 0.029). Conclusions In individuals with ADHD, co-occurring ATs exert a paradoxical effect on creativity, enhancing DT while compromising real-life creative achievement. In this subgroup with ADHD and elevated ATs, interventions should capitalize on ATs-associated ideational strengths while circumventing translational barriers, to enhance real-world creative outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）成人中并存的孤独症特质是否与创造力的不同维度相关，以及默认网络与额顶网络的功能连接是否参与其中。研究比较了ADHD成人与神经典型对照的发散思维和现实生活创造力，并在ADHD组内分析孤独症特质的作用。结果显示，ADHD组在两类创造力指标上均高于对照组；而在ADHD组内，孤独症特质越高，发散思维表现越好，现实生活创造力却越差，呈现分离的创造力剖面。神经层面，右侧默认网络—额顶网络连接增强中介了孤独症特质与发散思维的正向关联，也中介了其与自报想象力的负向关联。作者据此提出，并存孤独症特质对ADHD成人的创造力具有看似矛盾的影响，干预上或可借助其观念生成优势，同时设法跨越现实转化障碍。

papers.title: Inverse covariation between the neocortex and the limbic system is concentrated at deep evolutionary divergences
papers.authors: Wu B, Imam N.
papers.abstract: The macroscale architecture of mammalian brains consists of a broadly conserved set of structures, but the relative sizes of these structures vary substantially across species. Much of this variation follows conserved scaling relationships, but particular systems can expand or contract relative to the rest of the brain, providing targets for adaptive selection. One prominent example is a volumetric tradeoff between the neocortex and the limbic system, in which expansion of one is associated with reduction of the other, a feature apparent when brain structure volumes are examined across living species. However, whether this relationship has operated throughout mammalian evolution or arose during particular periods of diversification is unknown. Using phylogenetic comparative methods, we here show that the tradeoff between the neocortex and the limbic system is concentrated at deep evolutionary divergences separating major mammalian groups. After accounting for shared ancestry and brain size, the tradeoff strengthens progressively among deeper branches of the mammalian phylogeny, extending broadly across limbic structures, with the strongest signal involving olfactory components. Recent divergences show no consistent relationship. Our analyses indicate that the neocortex-limbic tradeoff emerged during the early diversification of mammals, highlighting how present-day variation in brain organization retains signatures of ancient evolutionary transitions.

papers.title: Dose-dependent myelin g-ratio alterations in the white matter of 16p11.2 copy number variations
papers.authors: Lu WD, Martin C, Jizi K, Nelson MC, Draganski B, Jacquemont S, Tardif CL.
papers.abstract: Copy number variations (CNVs) at the 16p11.2 locus are major genetic risk factors for neurodevelopmental conditions and drive reciprocal alterations in cerebral white matter structure and connectivity. However, whether these alterations reflect differences in the axonal or myelin compartments remains unresolved with conventional diffusion MRI. We combined diffusion MRI with magnetization transfer saturation mapping across two ComBat-harmonized cohorts comprising 80 controls, 26 16p11.2 deletion carriers, and 13 duplication carriers. We quantified axonal volume, myelin volume, and aggregate g-ratio of white matter tracts forming the structural connectome. Metrics were evaluated using normative modeling across tract length, resting-state functional networks, and cortical nodes. We additionally examined 29 individuals carrying other neurodevelopmental CNVs. 16p11.2 gene dosage was associated with regional reciprocal differences in tract axonal volume, with greater volume in deletion carriers and lower volume in duplication carriers. In contrast, myelin volume did not differ significantly from controls. This mismatch resulted in pervasive aggregate g-ratio alterations, with higher g-ratios (relatively thinner myelin sheaths) in deletion carriers and lower g-ratios (relatively thicker sheaths) in duplication carriers. Regional g-ratio alterations also extended to other neurodevelopmental CNVs. These findings resolve some of the biological ambiguity underlying white matter alterations in 16p11.2 CNV carriers, implicating the axonal compartment while revealing comparatively stable myelin volume. The disrupted axon-myelin scaling results in connectome-wide g-ratio alterations and may represent a shared microstructural hallmark of genetic neurodevelopmental risk.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注16p11.2拷贝数变异携带者白质结构改变究竟源于轴突还是髓鞘区室，为此结合弥散MRI与磁化转移饱和成像，在缺失型与重复型携带者及对照中量化结构连接组各纤维束的轴突体积、髓鞘体积和总体g比。结果显示，16p11.2基因剂量与轴突体积呈区域性反向差异相关：缺失携带者轴突体积较大，重复携带者较小；而髓鞘体积与对照无显著差异。这种轴突与髓鞘的不匹配造成广泛的g比改变，缺失携带者g比偏高（髓鞘相对较薄），重复携带者偏低（髓鞘相对较厚），且类似改变也见于其他神经发育相关拷贝数变异。作者据此认为，白质改变主要涉及轴突区室，轴突-髓鞘比例失调可能是此类遗传风险共有的微结构特征。

papers.title: Sensorimotor cortex activity during cued gait differs in Parkinson’s freezers and non-freezers
papers.authors: Ma L, Miura M, Talu I, Cross KA.
papers.abstract: Gait impairments are a major contributor to disability in patients with Parkinson’s disease despite dopaminergic and neuromodulation therapies. External cues (e.g., visual targets, rhythmic auditory sounds) are commonly used to improve gait quality and reduce freezing of gait (FOG), yet their effectiveness varies across patients and contexts. Improved understanding of the neural mechanisms of cueing benefits is essential to personalize rehabilitation strategies and improve outcomes. We use mobile electroencephalography (EEG) to test the hypothesis that cues improve gait through engagement of voluntary motor control mechanisms to compensate for impaired gait automaticity. In addition, we investigate whether this mechanism is related to cueing benefits or freezing status. Eighteen PD patients with a history of freezing (PD-F), 21 patients without freezing (PD-NF) and 19 age-matched healthy controls (HC) walked overground under three conditions: normal walking, synchronizing to auditory cues, and stepping over visual cues. Stride-locked beta band (13–30 Hz) power dynamics in sensorimotor cortex were used to measure cortical control of stepping. Spatiotemporal gait parameters improved with cues in all groups. However, PD-F had smaller cue-related gains in speed and stride length when compared with PD-NF for both cue types, and did not improve gait speed with visual cues. EEG revealed greater contralateral sensorimotor cortex swing-phase beta suppression in PD-F than PD-NF patients, with visual cues eliciting the most robust response. In contrast, beta suppression with cues was less pronounced in PD-NF and HC, despite greater behavioral gains. In addition, engagement of sensorimotor cortex during visual cueing was associated with divergent gait effects across PD subgroups: In PD-NF greater beta suppression was associated with less gait improvement, whereas in PD-F the opposite was observed. These findings suggest distinct sensorimotor control mechanisms for cue utilization in PD-F and PD-NF, and indicate that engagement of voluntary motor control circuits may underlie cueing benefits primarily in PD-F.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用移动脑电考察帕金森病患者在有声或视觉提示下行走时感觉运动皮层的β频段活动，比较有冻结史患者、无冻结史患者与健康对照。结果发现，提示虽能改善各组步态，但有冻结史患者的步速和步长获益较小，视觉提示下步速未见提升；其感觉运动皮层在摆动期的β抑制反而更强，视觉提示时最明显，而无冻结史患者和健康对照的β抑制较弱却行为获益更大。视觉提示下β抑制与步态改善的关系在两个患者亚组中方向相反，提示两类患者利用提示的感觉运动控制机制不同，主动运动控制环路的参与可能主要解释有冻结史患者的提示获益。

papers.title: Perisynaptic matrix gene variants underlie DystoniaGeneNet endophenotypes in isolated focal dystonia
papers.authors: Domingo A, Yao D, Kshatriya N, Mangkalaphiban K, Battistella G, O’Flynn LC, Reese B, Hincher M, Yadav R, Sharma N, Williams L, Fearon C, Killian O, Reilly R, Hutchinson M, Raymond D, Saunders-Pullman R, Bressman S, Frucht SJ, Talkowski M, Simonyan K, Ozelius LJ.
papers.abstract: Isolated focal dystonia is a rare movement disorder characterized by abnormalities in brain structure and function. The genes underlying isolated focal dystonia are not fully elucidated, and genetic studies are constrained by incomplete penetrance and small family sizes. Neuroimaging endophenotypes shared by patients and unaffected relatives can reveal genetic liability independently of clinical manifestation and offer a strategy for advancing gene discovery. We developed DystoniaGeneNet, a 3D convolutional neural network that predicts familial status from T1-weighted brain MRIs. We then used its predictions to guide genetic analyses in isolated focal dystonia. DystoniaGeneNet was trained on 40 patients with familial laryngeal dystonia and 40 healthy controls, then applied to independent cohorts of 21 patients with familial isolated focal dystonia, 364 patients with sporadic dystonia, and 98 unaffected relatives. Model predictions were incorporated into variant prioritization and segregation analysis in 214 individuals with whole-exome sequencing data, and results were replicated in another 738 independent exomes, in genetic data from a hospital-based biobank (892 dystonia cases, 2,475 controls), and in the All of Us Research Program genetic data (1,343 dystonia cases, 6,840 controls). DystoniaGeneNet discriminated familial dystonia from healthy controls in the training set and correctly classified 85.7% of independent familial cases, using a biomarker centred on the corpus callosum and inferior temporal gyrus. Across the discovery and replication cohorts, we identified rare, likely pathogenic genetic variants in RAP1GAP and TNN segregating with disease in families. Additional variants were found in singletons with isolated focal dystonia. In patients with clinically sporadic dystonia but predicted to have familial features, we observed multiple rare variants in ITSN2 , including three high-confidence loss-of-function variants, and an enrichment of damaging missense variants in its Dbl homology domain. To determine the functional impact of discovered genetic variants, we assessed gene expression and splicing via qPCR and RNA sequencing ( n = 74), revealing reduced RAP1GAP and ITSN2 expression in variant carriers. At the pathway level, rare nonsynonymous variants in brain-expressed matrisome genes were associated with dystonia ( P = 0.012). Our strategy utilizing a deep learning-derived neuroimaging endophenotype to empower gene discovery uncovered RAP1GAP, TNN , and ITSN2 as novel genes associated with isolated focal dystonia. These genes converge on perisynaptic extracellular matrix-synapse signalling, implicating a mechanism linked to synaptic plasticity deficits, and identifying a molecular substrate for network-level brain abnormalities that characterize this disorder. Further, we exemplify a generalizable framework for leveraging endophenotypes in rare neurogenetic diseases with incomplete penetrance.

papers.title: Predictors of methadone response in chronic neuropathic pain
papers.authors: Barbosa MM, Pentiado Júnior JAM, Kubota GT, Martins PN, Moreira LI, Fernandes AM, da Silva VA, Júnior JR, Figueiredo EG, Yeng LT, Teixeira MJ, de Andrade DC.
papers.abstract: Background Although opioids are frequently prescribed for refractory chronic neuropathic pain, few data are available on baseline factors that may identify individuals more likely to respond and inform individually tailored practice. Methods This was a post hoc, exploratory analysis of individual-level data from a placebo-controlled trial of methadone for chronic neuropathic pain ( NCT05235191 ). Baseline clinical, psychological, psychophysical and radiological variables were tested for association with ≥30% pain reduction in the methadone group. The correlation between expectation of improvement and pain reduction was examined in both groups. Results Of the 81 participants completing the 8-week follow-up, 28 (70%) on methadone and 14 (34.1%) on placebo achieved ≥30% pain reduction. In the methadone group, responders had higher baseline expectation of improvement (median 100 [80-100] vs. 55 [50-81]; p=0.004), which correlated moderately with percentage pain reduction (r s =0.508; p<0.001).
