papers.authors: Byun S, Sotzen MR, Bento MT, Knappenberger MA, Asker M, Wright JR, Lamendella R, Mu C, Skibicka KP.
papers.abstract: The gut microbiome communicates bidirectionally with the brain and peripheral metabolic organs to regulate appetite and body weight. Semaglutide (SEMA), a GLP-1 receptor agonist, produces robust weight loss by reducing food intake, largely through brain GLP-1 receptors, yet whether its effects on the gut microbiome are secondary to this centrally driven hypophagia is poorly understood. Given the profound impact of SEMA on food intake and body weight, we propose that SEMA treatment reshapes gut microbial composition and that these shifts are correlated with metabolic outcomes. Diet-induced obese rats received a 4-week SEMA treatment and gut microbial composition was analyzed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. To differentiate the impact of reduced food intake associated with SEMA from other effects of the drug treatment on the gut microbiome, a pair-fed to SEMA group was tested. SEMA significantly reduced body weight gain and food intake in both sexes. Significant SEMA-induced changes in microbial richness and evenness were detected. Linear discriminant analysis Effect Size (LEfSe) identified enrichment of Firmicutes taxa-particularly members of the Clostridiaceae family-in SEMA-treated rats, whereas controls showed greater representation of Bacteroidota taxa. Sex-specific associations between host metabolic parameters and gut microbial composition were also identified. These findings demonstrate profound, not necessarily health positive, partly sex-specific gut microbial community shifts following GLP-1 analogue treatment. Many of the changes in the gut microbiota were not simply driven by the decreased food intake. Thus, GLP-1 analogue treatment engages the gut microbiome through both food intake-dependent (brain-to-gut) and intake-independent pathways.

papers.title: Temporal Magnetic Resonance Imaging Changes in Acute Hypoglycemic Encephalopathy: Two Cases With Different Gray Matter Lesion Patterns.
papers.authors: Kawada Y, Inokuchi R, Wada T, Doi K.
papers.abstract: Early MRI in two patients with hypoglycemic encephalopathy revealed contrasting lesion distributions. Case 1 demonstrated widespread gray matter involvement, including the basal ganglia, with persistent coma. Case 2 exhibited patchy cortical lesions with neurological improvement. Early deep gray-matter involvement may portend poorer recovery.

papers.title: A Recurrent 3'UTR Variant in CAPN3 Highlights the Diagnostic Impact of Non-Coding Variants in Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophies.
papers.authors: Estévez-Arias B, Segarra-Casas A, Seoane P, Romo L, Polavarapu K, Nectoux J, Caballero-Ávila M, Austin-Tse C, Konyukh M, Obeid K, Hinderhofer K, Aksel-Kilicarslan O, Matalonga L, Rojano E, Ranea JA, O'Heir E, Singer-Berk M, O'Leary M, O'Donnell-Luria A, Spinazzi M, Verebi C, Leturcq F, Van Den Bergh P, Specht S, de Luna N, de Castro M, Roggenbuck J, Carrera-García L, Expósito-Escudero J, Jou C, Ortez C, Llansó L, Hernández-Laín A, Straub V, Gallano P, Nascimento A, Evangelista T, Olivé M, Domínguez-González C, Lochmüller H, Malfatti E, Töpf A, Gallardo E, González-Quereda L, Natera-de Benito D.
papers.abstract: Objective A substantial proportion of individuals with suspected genetic conditions, including neuromuscular disorders, lack a definitive molecular diagnosis. Non-coding variants, particularly those in the 3' untranslated region (3´UTR), which regulate mRNA stability, translation, and localization, may underlie part of this gap. We investigated the clinical, genetic, and functional relevance of a novel 3'UTR variant in CAPN3 in individuals with persistent hyperCKemia, most of whom also presented with proximal muscle weakness. Methods Clinical assessment, including muscle biopsy and muscle magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), was performed in individuals harboring the CAPN3 c.*534T>C variant. In silico analyses included the assessment of miRNA binding, mRNA secondary structure, creation or disruption of a poly-A tail, and RNA-binding protein (RBP) motifs. A luciferase reporter assay with the c.*534T>C and reference sequence, in the presence or absence of RBFOX1 co-expression, was performed. Results We identified 13 individuals from 11 unrelated families presenting with persistent hyperCKemia, commonly accompanied by proximal muscle weakness and myalgia, all harboring the c.*534T>C variant in combination with a previously identified heterozygous CAPN3 variant. Western blot analyses consistently demonstrated absent or markedly reduced calpain-3 expression, and muscle RNA sequencing (RNAseq) showed reduced CAPN3 levels. In silico analyses indicated that the c.*534T>C variant creates a novel binding site for the RNA-binding protein RBFOX1. Luciferase reporter assays supported a regulatory effect of the identified variant on calpain-3 expression. Interpretation Our results show that a recurrent non-coding CAPN3 variant causes disease by disrupting post-transcriptional regulation and demonstrate a generalizable principle, as 3'UTR variants can affect mRNA stability and protein expression across neuromuscular and other Mendelian diseases. Although often difficult to interpret as pathogenic, these variants can be therapeutically actionable, highlighting the importance of systematically investigating non-coding regions in unsolved genetic cases. ANN NEUROL 2026.

papers.title: Multimodal Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Relapse in Major Depressive Disorder.
papers.authors: Teutenberg L, Winter NR, Usemann P, Stein F, Thomas-Odenthal F, Flinkenflügel K, Borgers T, Meinert S, Leehr EJ, Grotegerd D, Papenbrock S, Teckentrup S, Hildebrand A, Wellms S, Mahjoory K, Konowski M, Spanagel J, Fehse L, Heider D, Andlauer TFM, David FS, Forstner AJ, Schöppner P, Renz H, Bang C, Franke A, Witt SH, Rietschel M, Streit F, Alexander N, Jansen A, Nenadic I, Straube B, Jamalabadi H, Dannlowski U, Hahn T, Kircher T.
papers.abstract: Importance Early identification of patients at high risk of relapse is key to personalized preventive strategies in major depressive disorder (MDD). However, current predictive models do not adequately account for the multimodal factors contributing to MDD relapse and fail to provide clinically meaningful predictions. Objective To predict relapse within 2 years in patients with MDD by using a comprehensive machine learning pipeline that integrates an unprecedented set of multimodal data. Design, setting, and participants This naturalistic longitudinal prognostic study used data from the Marburg-Münster Affective Disorders Cohort Study, with baseline assessments collected from October 2014 to May 2019 and follow-up approximately 2 years later, between October 2016 and June 2021. Data analysis was conducted between July 2024 and June 2026. The study was performed at 2 sites in Germany (Marburg and Münster), with participants recruited from psychiatric inpatient and outpatient departments and the general population. Patients meeting diagnostic criteria for current or lifetime MDD without history of neurological or severe somatic conditions were included. Exposure Natural course of illness in patients with MDD. Main outcomes and measures Balanced accuracy (BACC) for binary prediction of relapse vs no relapse during 2-year follow-up served as the primary outcome. Baseline features comprised 9 modalities including clinical and psychometric data, 4 structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging modalities, genetics, neurocognition, blood markers, and gut microbiome. Results A total of 564 patients with a current or lifetime MDD diagnosis were included (367 female [65.1%]; mean [SD] age, 37.34 [13.38] years). A total of 270 patients relapsed during the 2-year follow-up, while 294 did not. Mean (SD) BACC for the prediction of relapse ranged from 47.21% (5.85%) to 64.43% (6.63%). The best-performing model was solely based on few clinical relapse risk factors, while multimodal data integration did not improve performance. Conclusions and relevance In this prognostic study, the models achieved moderate accuracy, yet the results suggest limited scope for guiding individual-level clinical decision-making. Predictive performance was largely driven by established clinical risk factors, indicating limited incremental value of multimodal measures when assessed at a single time point. Future advances may instead benefit from dynamic modeling approaches that more closely align temporally evolving multimodal markers with longitudinal clinical outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于德国两站点的自然主义纵向队列，用整合多模态基线的机器学习流程预测抑郁症患者两年内是否复发，主要看平衡准确率。结果显示，预测仅达中等水平，表现最好的模型只依赖少数临床复发风险因素，加入影像、遗传、认知、血液和肠道菌群等多模态数据并未提升效果。作者据此认为，单时点多模态测量的增量价值有限，这些模型尚不足以指导个体化临床决策，未来或需转向与纵向结局在时间上更匹配的动态建模。

papers.title: Multiplexed CRISPRi reveals a transcriptional switch between KLF activators and repressors in the maturing neocortex.
papers.authors: Kirk RW, Sun L, Xiao R, Clark EA, Nelson SB.
papers.abstract: A critical phase of mammalian brain development takes place after birth. Neurons of the mouse neocortex undergo dramatic changes in their morphology, physiology, and synaptic connections during the first postnatal month, while properties of immature neurons, such as the capacity for robust axon outgrowth, are lost. The genetic and epigenetic programs controlling prenatal development are well studied, but our understanding of the transcriptional mechanisms that regulate postnatal neuronal maturation is comparatively lacking. By integrating chromatin accessibility and gene expression data from two subtypes of neocortical pyramidal neurons in the neonatal and maturing brain, we predicted a role for the Krüppel-like factor (KLF) family of transcription factors in the developmental regulation of neonatally expressed genes. Using a multiplexed CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) knockdown strategy, we found that a shift in expression from KLF activators (Klf6, Klf7) to repressors (Klf9, Klf13) during early postnatal development functions as a transcriptional 'switch' to first activate, then repress a set of shared targets with cytoskeletal functions including Tubb2b and Dpysl3 . We demonstrate that this switch is buffered by redundancy between KLF paralogs, which our multiplexed CRISPRi strategy is equipped to overcome and study. Our results indicate that competition between activators and repressors within the KLF family regulates a conserved component of the postnatal maturation program that may underlie the loss of intrinsic axon growth in maturing neurons. This could facilitate the transition from axon growth to synaptic refinement required to stabilize mature circuits.

papers.title: Infantile amnesia results from differential memory retrieval in humans
papers.authors: Power SD, Werwach A, Peikert A, Fey M, Forbes-Mitchell T, Hild J, Buss C, Lindenberger U, Ryan TJ, Werkle-Bergner M.
papers.abstract: Infantile amnesia, the inability to recall memories from our earliest years, is the most common form of forgetting in mammals 1 . Whether early memories never form, decay, or persist but become inaccessible remains unknown. Here, we investigated the nature of forgetting during the infantile amnesia period by longitudinally testing toddlers aged 18-24 months across the complete memory cycle from encoding, initial retrieval one day later, and delayed retrieval up to six months later, in a novel naturalistic episodic memory paradigm. Computational modelling revealed that forgetting during the infantile amnesia period was heterogeneous. Toddlers were as likely to retain the full memory as to lose it completely, while nearly a quarter retained only part of the memory. Encoding accuracy predicted which toddlers retained the full memory at the test one day later, but not at the delayed test up to six months on. Instead, a retrieval-specific EEG signature predicted complete, but not partial, memory retrieval, distinguishing which toddlers had retained the full memory before their behavioural response. Finally, leveraging the COVID-19 pandemic as a natural experiment, we found that maternal immune activation during pregnancy, as in rodents 2 , alters vulnerability to infantile forgetting in humans. Together, these findings show that early memories formed during the infantile amnesia period are not simply erased but persist in an increasingly inaccessible form, a transformation whose trajectory can be shaped by both the neural retrieval mechanism and the prenatal environment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注婴儿期遗忘究竟是记忆未形成、消退，还是仍存在但难以提取，对18至24个月幼儿进行纵向情节记忆测试，覆盖编码、次日提取及最长六个月后的延迟提取，并结合计算建模与脑电指标。结果显示，遗忘并非单一过程：部分幼儿完整保留记忆，部分完全丢失，还有近四分之一仅保留部分内容；编码准确性只能预测次日能否完整提取，而一种与提取相关的脑电特征则能在行为反应前区分记忆是否被完整提取。作者还利用新冠疫情期间的自然情境发现，孕期母体免疫激活可能改变人类婴儿期遗忘的易感性。总体而言，早期记忆并非被简单抹去，而是以越来越难以提取的形式持续存在，其变化轨迹可能受提取神经机制和产前环境共同影响。

papers.title: Gut microbiota dysbiosis in adrenoleukodystrophy: a new piece in the puzzle?
papers.authors: Torreni L, Schlüter A, Marti S, Ruiz M, Vélez-Santamaria V, Rodríguez-Palmero A, Artuch A, Guilera C, Arias A, Mochel F, Aguilera-Albesa S, Cantarin V, Casasnovas C, Artuch R, Köhler W, Pujol A, Fourcade S.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (X-ALD) is the most common monogenic disorder affecting brain white matter, presenting a broad clinical spectrum from slowly progressive adrenomyeloneuropathy (AMN) to rapidly advancing cerebral demyelination. Factors influencing the variable disease expressivity remain poorly understood. We conducted shotgun metagenomic profiling of fecal samples from X-ALD patients and integrated these data with targeted plasma metabolomic analyses of amino acids and key metabolic intermediates. We identified distinct microbiome-associated metabolic signatures across X-ALD phenotypes. Notably, Bacteroides cellulosilyticus and Helicobacter apodemus abundance were significantly altered in AMN compared with childhood CALD patients. In parallel, X-ALD patients exhibited evidence of microbial metabolic remodeling characterized by altered amino acid metabolism, reduced folate biosynthetic potential, and enrichment of stress-adaptive pathways, including redox-associated functions, glyoxylate shunt activity, lipid A modification, lipopolysaccharide assembly, biofilm adhesin biosynthesis, and curli fiber production. Consistent with these microbial changes, plasma levels of branched-chain amino acids and methionine, as well as serum folate concentrations, were significantly reduced. Importantly, methionine levels showed an inverse correlation with neurofilament light chain (NfL) concentrations in patients with cerebral disease. Our findings reveal a previously unrecognized link between gut microbial metabolic capacity and systemic metabolic alterations in X-ALD. Our results reinforce previous evidence implicating methionine metabolism in disease severity. Collectively, these data support a modulatory role of the microbiota–gut–brain axis in neuroinflammatory and mitochondrial-related processes underlying X-ALD progression and highlight new opportunities for biomarker development and microbiome-informed therapeutic interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对X连锁肾上腺脑白质营养不良（X-ALD）疾病表现差异原因不明的问题，对患者粪便样本进行鸟枪法宏基因组测序，并结合血浆氨基酸及关键代谢中间物的靶向代谢组分析。结果显示，不同X-ALD表型具有不同的微生物组相关代谢特征，患者存在氨基酸代谢改变、叶酸生物合成潜力下降及应激适应通路富集等微生物代谢重塑迹象，血浆支链氨基酸、甲硫氨酸和血清叶酸水平也相应降低；在脑型患者中，甲硫氨酸水平与神经丝轻链浓度呈负相关。作者据此提出肠道微生物代谢能力与X-ALD全身代谢改变相关，并认为微生物群—肠—脑轴可能对疾病进展中的神经炎症和线粒体相关过程起调节作用，但相关关系尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: Individual-level Structural Neuroimaging Biomarkers across the Psychosis Spectrum
papers.authors: Rivas AM, Sari E, Demirlek C, Weerasekera A, Stein A, Loshin J, Chouinard V, Halko M, Brady RO, Lewandowski KE, Murphy M, Shinn AK, Yuksel C, Millman ZB, Du F, Kubicki M, Öngür D, Türközer HB.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Hypothesis Although psychotic disorders are characterized by widespread cortical thinning, translating these findings into individualized biomarkers remains challenging. Regional Vulnerability Index (RVI) and Neuroscore are candidate individual-level biomarkers that quantify the similarity between an individual’s structural brain pattern and generic psychosis-associated alterations. This study investigated cortical thickness (CT)-based RVI and Neuroscore, along with mean CT deviation from healthy individuals, across the psychosis spectrum. Study Design Using structural 3T MRI data from 289 participants (clinical high risk for psychosis [CHR], n=39; first episode psychosis [FEP], n=44, chronic psychosis [CP], n=86; healthy controls [HC], n=120), RVI, Neuroscore, and mean CT deviation (z) scores were computed from region-wise CT measures quantified using FreeSurfer v7.2. Group differences and associations with symptoms were evaluated. Study Results RVI and Neuroscore were significantly higher, and mean CT z-scores lower, in FEP and CP compared with CHR and HC, with moderate-to-large effect sizes (|Cohen’s d| = 0.55–1.15). No differences were observed between FEP and CP or CHR and HC. Indices were not associated with psychosis-spectrum symptom severity in the CHR, FEP, or CP groups. RVI ( r = −0.561, p < .001) and Neuroscore ( r = −0.997, p < .001) were strongly negatively correlated with the mean CT z-score. Conclusions CT-based RVI and Neuroscore appear to index established disease status but not risk status, while showing substantial overlap with mean CT deviation. These findings highlight the need to further refine these biomarkers through data-driven and multimodal approaches to improve their utility for risk and prognostic prediction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于结构MRI的皮层厚度数据，考察个体水平的区域脆弱性指数（RVI）和Neuroscore能否区分精神病谱系中的不同阶段。结果显示，首发精神病和慢性精神病患者的RVI与Neuroscore显著高于临床高危个体和健康对照，平均皮层厚度偏离也更明显，而临床高危组与健康对照之间、首发与慢性组之间均无差异；这些指标也未与症状严重程度相关。RVI和Neuroscore与平均皮层厚度偏离呈强负相关，提示它们主要反映已确立的疾病状态而非风险状态，且与整体皮层厚度偏离高度重叠，作者因此指出需借助数据驱动和多模态方法进一步改进这类生物标志物。

papers.title: Mapping the brain signature of dyslexia risk onto histamine, acetylcholine and glutamate receptor systems
papers.authors: Çelik MC, Çiçek Y, Şakiroğlu MA, Aslan D, Altunç AT, Velioğlu HA.
papers.abstract: The brain differences of dyslexia are well described and its genetic risk is now measurable; the brain systems that connect the two are unknown. That link decides which measures complement one another in early identification and which systems intervention research should examine. Here we compared large-scale polygenic score maps of brain structure in dyslexia with normative maps of brain neurotransmitter systems. The structural signature of genetic liability aligned with the cortical distribution of neurotransmitter systems. The strongest and most consistent alignment appeared for the histamine H3 receptor, the vesicular acetylcholine transporter (VAChT) and the N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) glutamate receptor. The alignment was most pronounced in cingulate, medial and superior frontal cortex and the paracentral lobule. The H3 alignment held after adjustment for cortical position and for metabolic and cognitive reference maps. Once the component common to all nineteen maps and position were removed together, no individual system remained significant, while the shared component itself aligned with liability. The signature therefore follows the topography these systems share. In 169 children, per-person alignment with the H3 map related to reading skill with the opposite sign to liability. To our knowledge, this is the first study to relate the structural signature of genetic liability for dyslexia to normative maps of neurotransmitter receptor and transporter density. It places that signature within the shared geography of the systems that set attention, arousal and synaptic plasticity during learning, and gives the genetics of dyslexia a testable biological axis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阅读障碍遗传风险与脑结构差异之间缺乏可测生物学桥梁的问题，将阅读障碍的大规模多基因评分脑结构图谱与规范性神经递质系统图谱进行比较。结果发现，遗传易感性的结构特征与组胺H3受体、囊泡乙酰胆碱转运体和NMDA谷氨酸受体的皮层分布对齐最明显，尤其在扣带、内侧和上额叶皮层及中央旁小叶；但去除十九张图谱共有的成分和皮层位置后，各系统单独不再显著，提示该特征主要沿这些系统共享的地形分布。在儿童中，个体与H3图谱的对齐程度与阅读技能相关，方向与遗传易感性相反。作者据此将该结构特征定位到与注意、唤醒和学习期突触可塑性相关的系统共享空间，为阅读障碍遗传学提供了一个可检验的生物学轴。

papers.title: Beyond the Percentile: CDC-referenced BMI-for-Age and Brain Structure Across Childhood and Adolescence
papers.authors: Beck D, Westlye LT, Tamnes CK.
papers.abstract: Importance Pediatric obesity affects 1 in 5 US children and has been linked to brain structural differences. Most evidence is cross-sectional and models body mass index (BMI) linearly, with metrics that compress severe obesity. Objective To examine associations between brain structure and BMI-for-age across the weight spectrum and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) weight status categories, distinguishing between- and within-person associations, and their age and sex moderation. Design, Setting, and Participants Longitudinal cohort study of youth aged 8–10 years at baseline in the US community-based Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (4 waves, 2016–2025; ages 8–18 years). Exposures Extended CDC BMI-for-age z-score, grouped by wave-mean z-score: underweight (<5th percentile, n=297), healthy weight (5th–<85th, n=7,452), overweight (85th–<95th, n=1,919), and obesity (≥95th, n=1,842). Main Outcomes and Measures Cortical thickness (12 regions) and subcortical volume (7 regions) from T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), defined a priori. Results Among 11,510 participants contributing 32,212 observations (mean [SD] age, 12.6 [2.5] years; 52.2% male), higher between-person BMI-for-age z was associated with lower frontal and temporal thickness (6 regions) and larger subcortical volume (5 regions; all q < .001), but associations were nonlinear (17 of 19 regions). Youth with obesity had lower thickness than healthy weight youth in 8 frontal and temporal regions (largest, −0.21 SD; q < .001), with dorsal frontal differences decreasing across adolescence; underweight youth had smaller subcortical volumes. Higher BMI-for-age z was associated with larger subcortical volume (all 7 regions) within the healthy weight category and lower cortical thickness (11 of 12 regions; fusiform: β = −0.27; q < .001) within the obesity category, steeper than in healthy weight youth in 10 regions, but not in overweight or underweight youth. Within-person associations did not reproduce the obesity associations, reversed from negative at age 10 to positive at age 16, and were more negative in female than male participants. Conclusions and Relevance Youth with obesity had lower cortical thickness than healthy weight peers, but associations between brain structure and BMI-for-age differed between CDC weight status groups, suggesting a complex relationship between adiposity and brain structure. Key Points Question How is BMI-for-age associated with brain structure across the weight spectrum, within CDC weight status categories, and within individuals over time in youth? Findings In this cohort study of 11,510 youth aged 8–18 years, those with obesity had lower frontal and temporal cortical thickness than healthy weight youth. Within categories, higher BMI-for-age was associated with lower thickness in obesity but larger subcortical volumes in healthy weight youth; within individuals over time, the obesity association was not reproduced. Meaning BMI–brain associations differ between CDC weight status categories and may be obscured by assuming a single linear association.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于美国青少年脑认知发育队列的纵向数据，考察儿童青少年BMI-for-age与皮层厚度及皮层下体积的关系，并区分个体间与个体内关联。结果发现，肥胖青少年在多个额叶和颞叶区域的皮层厚度低于健康体重同龄人，且部分差异随青春期推进而减小；在肥胖类别内，BMI-for-age越高皮层厚度越低，而在健康体重类别内则表现为皮层下体积更大。个体内随时间变化的关联未能重现上述肥胖相关模式，提示BMI与脑结构的关联在不同体重类别和个体内层面并不一致，单一线性假设可能掩盖这种复杂性。

papers.title: Intelligent systems distribute memory across internal and embodied resources
papers.authors: Zhang R, Pitkow X, Angelaki DE.
papers.abstract: Intelligent systems do not operate in isolation from the body, yet how bodily actions support internal computation remains unclear. Here we show that primates and artificial agents recruit eye movements to maintain beliefs about hidden goals when internal computation is constrained. In a naturalistic navigation task, both systems spontaneously tracked goals with their eyes after they disappeared from view. This strategy emerged in artificial agents only when internal memory was constrained, identifying resource constraints as a driver of memory externalization. Restricting gaze impaired performance in both systems, while natural behavioral variability and causal perturbations in agents established a direct influence of oculomotor state on internal beliefs about hidden goals. Across agents, varying the reliability of internal memory and gaze redistributed goal information between internal and embodied states. The same resource-allocation principle predicted the distribution of goal information in macaque parietal cortex, where greater reliance on gaze was accompanied by weaker gaze-independent neural representations. Together, these findings identify eye movements as embodied memory and reveal a convergent principle across intelligent systems: memory is allocated across internal and embodied resources according to their reliability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨身体动作如何支持内部计算，比较了灵长类与人工代理在自然导航任务中维持隐藏目标信念的方式。结果显示，两者在目标从视野消失后都会自发用眼动追踪目标；人工代理仅在内部记忆受限时才出现这一策略，提示资源约束是记忆外化的驱动因素。限制注视会损害双方表现，而对代理的因果扰动表明眼动状态直接影响关于隐藏目标的内部信念。研究进一步发现，内部记忆与注视的可靠性变化会重新分配目标信息，这一资源分配原则也能预测猕猴顶叶皮层中目标信息的分布。作者据此将眼动视为具身记忆，提出记忆会依据可靠性在内部与具身资源之间进行分配。

papers.title: Renovascular hypertension drives ischemic white matter injury through brain endothelial AT1R signaling
papers.authors: Jin X, Kim H, Jeong HJ, Cui Y, Singh SS, Seo HG, Kim SE, Lee HW, Farr TD, Wardlaw JM, Cox SR, Choi SH, Valdés Hernández MdC, Choi JY, Kim BG.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND White matter hyperintensities (WMHs), the principal imaging manifestation of cerebral small vessel disease, lack an animal model that produces pathology of sufficient magnitude to validate potential therapeutics. We characterized white matter (WM) degeneration in a renovascular hypertension (RVH) rat model, interrogated its mechanism, and tested its relevance in patients. METHODS RVH was induced by two-kidney, two-clip surgery and assessed by T2-weighted and diffusion MRI, myelin and axonal histology, and blood-brain barrier (BBB) leakage markers. The influence of angiotensin II (Ang II) on barrier function in brain endothelial cells was examined using transendothelial electrical resistance and reactive oxygen species (ROS) assays. Losartan was infused intracerebroventricularly to block brain AT1R (Ang II type 1 receptor) without systemic blood pressure reduction. WMH burden was compared between patients with and without renal artery stenosis, and WMH progression across antihypertensive classes was assessed in the CHALLENGE (Korea), MSS2 (UK), LBC1936 (UK), and SPRINT-MIND-MRI (US) cohorts. RESULTS Approximately two-thirds of RVH rats developed WMHs that expanded between 7 and 9 weeks, accompanied by reduced fractional anisotropy, demyelination, axonal and mature oligodendrocyte loss, and glial activation. IgG, albumin, and fibrinogen leakage was confined to affected WM. Ang II impaired endothelial barrier function and generated ROS through AT1R. Intracerebroventricular losartan attenuated WM pathology and improved behavior while blood pressure remained comparably elevated. Patients with renal artery stenosis had higher WMH volumes (10.52 versus 6.52 mL; P = 0.035). Angiotensin receptor blocker use was associated with the slowest tertile of annual WMH progression in the Korean cohort (OR, 2.57 [95% CI, 1.20–5.61]) and among White participants in SPRINT-MIND-MRI (OR, 3.52 [95% CI, 1.05–12.29]). CONCLUSIONS RVH produces prominent ischemic WM degeneration driven by AT1R signaling, identifying a blood pressure–independent therapeutic target with corroborating clinical evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在大鼠肾血管性高血压模型中刻画白质损伤，并结合脑内皮细胞实验和患者队列数据探讨其机制。约三分之二的模型大鼠出现白质高信号并随时间扩展，伴弥散指标改变、髓鞘和轴突丢失及胶质激活，屏障渗漏局限于受累白质；血管紧张素II经AT1R损害内皮屏障并产生活性氧，而脑室内给予氯沙坦可在血压仍升高的情况下减轻白质病理并改善行为。患者中肾动脉狭窄者白质高信号体积更高，部分队列中血管紧张素受体阻滞剂使用与白质高信号进展较慢相关。作者据此提出，AT1R信号驱动的高血压性白质缺血性损伤可能构成不依赖降压的治疗靶点，但临床部分为关联性证据，尚不能说明治疗效应。该研究为原始研究，动物结果与人群观察需分别看待。

papers.title: Longitudinal diffusion tensor imaging identifies coordinated white matter remodeling during cocaine self-administration in mice
papers.authors: Fernandez Z, McQueney A, Osowski M, Liu X, Liang Y, Ma S, Bender A, Scheel N, Shapiro E, Robison AJ, Qian C.
papers.abstract: White matter microstructural alterations are increasingly recognized as a feature of cocaine use disorder (CUD), yet the longitudinal progression and biological underpinnings of these changes remain poorly understood. Although rodent intravenous self-administration (IVSA) provides a translational model of voluntary cocaine use, longitudinal diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) has not previously been combined with cocaine IVSA in mice. Here, we established a longitudinal IVSA-DTI framework to characterize white matter microstructural remodeling during cocaine self-administration and early withdrawal. Male C57BL/6 mice underwent DTI at baseline, following 11 consecutive days of cocaine (0.5 mg/kg/infusion) or saline IVSA, and after a 7-day withdrawal period immediately following a cocaine-seeking test (n = 4/group). Fractional anisotropy (FA) was evaluated longitudinally using atlas-based region-of-interest analyses and whole-brain diffusion maps. Cocaine-treated mice acquired robust operant responding and exhibited coordinated longitudinal FA alterations across interconnected hippocampal-associated white matter pathways. The most consistent changes occurred within the bilateral dorsal hippocampal commissure, fornix, and fimbria, with cocaine-treated mice demonstrating increased FA during self-administration relative to baseline while saline controls exhibited smaller or opposing longitudinal changes. Difference-in-differences maps further demonstrated cocaine-associated FA alterations within hippocampal pathways and localized regions of the corpus callosum after accounting for longitudinal changes in saline controls. These findings establish the feasibility of combining longitudinal DTI with cocaine IVSA in mice and demonstrate coordinated white matter microstructural remodeling during voluntary cocaine exposure. This framework provides a translational platform for future studies integrating longitudinal neuroimaging with genetically modified mouse models, tractography, and histological validation to investigate the mechanisms underlying cocaine-associated white matter plasticity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在小鼠中建立纵向弥散张量成像与可卡因静脉自身给药相结合的框架，考察自愿用药期间及早期戒断阶段白质微结构的变化。可卡因组小鼠在给药期间，海马相关白质通路（尤其双侧背侧海马连合、穹窿和伞）出现协调的纵向各向异性分数改变，多表现为相对基线的升高，而生理盐水对照组的纵向变化较小或方向相反；在扣除对照组的纵向变化后，差异分析仍显示海马通路及胼胝体局部区域存在可卡因相关改变。作者据此认为，该框架可行，并提示自愿可卡因暴露伴随协调的白质微结构重塑，为后续机制研究提供转化平台。

papers.title: REM Sleep Iota Oscillations Across the Lifespan
papers.authors: Snipes S, Cox R, Krugliakova E, Kurth S, Leach S, Markovic A, Jaramillo V, Volk C, Pugin F, Wilhelm I, Tarokh L, van Someren E, Huber R, Andrillon T.
papers.abstract: Iota oscillations are a newly discovered marker of wakefulness and rapid eye movement (REM) sleep. So far, iota in REM sleep has only been reported in the surface electroencephalography (EEG) of a small sample of young adults and in intracranial recordings of epileptic patients. Here, we investigated the presence of these oscillations in a large dataset (N=937) of high-density sleep EEG recordings from individuals 7 to 70 years old. We found that iota spectral peaks during REM sleep were between 25 and 40 Hz, slightly faster than in wake (25-35 Hz). Iota power was significantly associated with REM sleep architecture, increasing with both REM duration and across progressive sleep cycles. Iota peaks were observed in individuals of all ages, although the prevalence decreased gradually with age, from 88% in children to 44% in older adults. Most iota spectral peak properties (frequency, amplitude, timing, topography) likewise shifted with age. The most striking effect, however, was in bandwidth, such that children had narrow iota peaks, older adults had broad iota peaks, and 20-30 year olds could have either. It remains unclear whether narrowband and broadband iota are functionally equivalent. On shorter time scales (< 1 year), iota properties remained stable across measurements. Analyses of a separate dataset of monozygotic and dizygotic twins revealed high heritability of all iota peak properties except bandwidth. Overall, these results establish iota as a genetically determined trait-like marker of REM sleep with unique age-related changes. Iota oscillations open new avenues to investigate the interaction between sleep, genetics, development, and aging.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用大规模高密度睡眠脑电数据，考察了快速眼动睡眠中iota振荡在7至70岁人群中的表现。结果显示，REM期iota频谱峰值频率略高于清醒期，其功率随REM时长和睡眠周期推进而增加；各年龄段均可观察到iota峰，但出现比例随年龄增长而下降，多数峰属性也随年龄变化，最突出的是带宽——儿童峰较窄、老年人较宽，青年则两者兼有。短期内iota属性保持稳定，双生子数据分析提示除带宽外各属性具有较高遗传度。作者据此认为iota是受遗传影响、类似特质标记的REM睡眠标志物，但其窄带与宽带形式是否功能等价尚不清楚。

papers.title: Amygdala Persistence in Aging: Replication and Extension of Puccetti et al. (2021)
papers.authors: Turnbull A, Ai M, Gross JJ, Vankee-Lin F.
papers.abstract: Age-related differences in affect are well established, but their neural mechanisms remain unclear. In a preregistered replication of Puccetti et al. (2021) and extension, we examined age, affect, left-amygdala negative persistence, and amygdala–ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC) task-based connectivity using MIDUS 3 daily diary and fMRI data. Older age predicted higher positive and lower negative affect in the daily diary sample ( N = 1,168; ps < .001). In the primary diary + fMRI sample ( N = 81; ages 48–95, 61.7% female, 82.7% White), greater persistence predicted higher raw negative affect (β = 0.278, 95% CI [0.012, 0.544], p = .020); associations with positive and log-transformed negative affect were nonsignificant ( ps ≥ .063). Older age predicted lower persistence in the final fMRI sample ( N = 127; β = −0.00260, 95% CI [−0.00504, −0.00016], p = .018), but this association was weaker in the primary diary + fMRI sample ( p = .200), with no evidence of mediation. Greater anterior vmPFC connectivity predicted lower raw negative affect (β = −0.106, 95% CI [−0.223, 0.012], p = .039) and log-transformed negative affect ( p = .014). In MIDUS Refresher 1, affect estimates were directionally similar but nonsignificant ( N = 48; ps ≥ .081), whereas the age–persistence estimate reversed direction. These findings provide partial support for amygdala persistence and task-based connectivity as neural correlates of daily affect, while highlighting variability in the magnitude and replicability of fMRI–behavior associations. Public Significance Statement Among middle-aged and older adults, lingering brain responses to negative images and communication between emotion-related brain regions were associated with negative feelings in daily life. However, the findings did not establish why emotional experience differs with age, and evidence from a second sample was inconclusive. Larger studies are needed to determine how reliably these brain measures relate to everyday emotional well-being.

papers.title: Spatial Patterns of White Matter Hyperintensities and Cognitive Function in Older Adults: A Community-Based Study
papers.authors: Chen X, Nishimaki K, Tomoshige S, Chotiyanonta JS, Uchida Y, Wasserman BA, Gottesman RF, Guallar E, Windham BG, Oishi K.
papers.abstract: Objectives White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are associated with cognitive decline in older adults. We examined whether anatomically defined spatial WMH patterns are associated with cognitive performance and subsequent decline in a large community-based cohort with approximately six years of follow-up. Methods We analyzed 1,667 participants (mean age 76 years) from the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Neurocognitive Study. WMH were segmented from FLAIR images and mapped to 112 white matter regions using deep-learning-based parcellation. Principal component analysis identified dominant WMH distribution patterns; candidate components were selected by Horn’s parallel analysis and retained if stable across resampled split samples. Linear mixed-effects models examined associations between WMH patterns and cognitive performance at baseline and follow-up, adjusting for demographic, genomic, and vascular risk factors. Robustness was assessed using analyses accounting for total WMH burden, study center, and selective attrition. Results Of 14 candidate principal components (PCs) identified by parallel analysis, eight met the resampling stability criterion and were retained, together explaining 42% of the variance. Three components were associated with cross-sectional or future cognition. PC3, characterized by deep white matter burden in the corpus callosum and anterior corona radiata with relative preservation of superficial white matter, showed no cross-sectional association at baseline but was associated with accelerated decline across multiple domains. Interpretation A deep spatial pattern of WMH loading on the corpus callosum and anterior corona radiata was associated with subsequent cognitive decline in the absence of a cross-sectional association at baseline, independent of total lesion burden.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于社区老年人群的影像与认知随访数据，考察白质高信号在解剖空间上的分布模式是否与认知表现及其后续下降相关。作者用深度学习分区将白质高信号映射到多个白质区域，再以主成分分析提取稳定的分布模式，并用混合效应模型检验其与认知的关联。结果显示，多数候选模式未达稳定标准，少数保留模式中，一种以胼胝体和前放射冠深部白质受累为主、浅表白质相对保留的模式在基线时与认知无关，却与多个认知领域的加速下降相关，且独立于总体病灶负荷。这提示白质病变的空间位置可能比总负荷更能反映后续认知风险，但关联性研究尚不能确立因果。

papers.title: Development of py-mea-span for comprehensive analysis of multi-electrode array data and its application to LGI2-deficient neurons
papers.authors: Han ZZ, Deane JE.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Summary Multi-electrode arrays (MEAs) generate mid- to high-throughput electrophysiological data widely used to characterise neural network activity in vitro. Downstream analysis of recordings from Axion Biosystems instruments, however, has long depended on the manufacturer’s closed-source pipeline (AxIS Navigator, NeuralMetric Tool, AxIS Metric Plotting Tool), limiting customisation and integration into flexible Python workflows. We present py-mea-span, an open-source Python package providing end-to-end analysis of Axion Biosystems spk binary files. Our package enables spike extraction, inter-spike interval burst detection, network burst detection and spike synchrony. We also provide tools for preparation of publication-ready visualisations including raster plots with spike-detection-rate histograms, plate-layout heatmaps, time-course trajectories, single timepoint violin plots and statistical comparisons. Outputs reproduce the manufacturer’s NeuralMetric Tool reference with near perfect accuracy in all benchmarked metrics. A mea-span command-line interface enables batch processing without writing Python code. As a proof of concept, we applied py-mea-span to human iPSC-derived cortical neurons with CRISPRi-mediated LGI2 knockdown. This revealed a reproducible network hyperexcitability phenotype in which burst and network burst frequencies were elevated while spike synchrony remained unchanged. Availability and implementation The package is distributed on PyPI (pip install py-mea-span), and version-controlled at https://github.com/Molecularbiologyworld/py-mea-span . User feedback can be provided via the GitHub issues tab.

papers.title: APOE ε4 Modifies the Association of Left Atrial Remodeling With Brain Aging
papers.authors: Badea A, Xu J, Laskowitz DT, Badea CT.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION Whether APOE ε4 modifies relationships between subclinical cardiac phenotypes and brain structure is unknown. METHODS In Framingham Heart Study Offspring participants, we related antecedent echocardiographic remodeling (Examinations 4–6) to repeated brain MRI, and cardiac magnetic resonance phenotypes to regional cortical morphometry, testing cardiac × APOE ε4 interactions with false-discovery-rate (FDR) correction and permutation testing of the regional screen. RESULTS APOE ε4 modified the association between antecedent left atrial (LA) remodeling and subsequent lateral ventricular expansion (β=−0.00858, P=1.45×10⁻⁴, q=0.0023; N=1,305; 3,787 MRI observations), the only FDR-significant result of 16 longitudinal tests, including with participant-specific MRI-time slopes (q=0.034); it weakened when intracranial volume × MRI time was modeled. Four regional ventricular cardiac × APOE ε4 interactions met within-family FDR criteria, but their number was consistent with chance (permutation P=0.70). Maximum LA volume index showed an APOE ε4-dependent association with left middle-occipital cortical-thickness variability (whole-brain q=0.017; permutation P=0.041) that persisted after ventricular adjustment. Cardiac phenotypes and trajectories showed no FDR-significant APOE ε4-dependent associations with plasma Aβ42/40, p-tau181, GFAP, or NfL, and adjustment for these biomarkers changed the regional interactions by at most 3.2%. Allen Human Brain Atlas data showed cholesterol-biosynthesis enrichment in the right superior frontal cortex, implicated by the LV end-systolic volume interaction, but without convergent pathway evidence. DISCUSSION APOE ε4 modified atrial–brain relationships, with the strongest evidence linking antecedent atrial remodeling to later ventricular expansion. Replication with prespecified models is needed. Highlights APOE ε4 modified how left atrial remodeling related to later brain ventricle growth. It was the only FDR-significant result of 16 tests and persisted with random slopes. In ε4 carriers, larger LA volume tracked lower occipital thickness variability. This atrial–cortical association was independent of LV mass and ejection fraction. Exploratory: HbA1c related to LV end-diastolic volume differently by APOE ε4 status.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于弗雷明汉心脏研究后代队列，考察APOE ε4是否修饰亚临床心脏表型与脑结构之间的关联，将既往超声心动图重构指标与重复脑MRI及区域皮层形态学相联系。结果显示，APOE ε4修饰了既往左心房重构与随后侧脑室扩张的关联，这是16项纵向检验中唯一经FDR校正显著的结果，但在模型中纳入颅内体积与MRI时间的交互后该关联减弱；区域心室交互的数量与随机预期相符。最大左心房容积指数与左中枕叶皮层厚度变异性的关联依赖APOE ε4状态，且在调整心室指标后仍存在。心脏表型与血浆Aβ42/40、p-tau181、GFAP及NfL均无经FDR校正的APOE ε4依赖关联。作者指出这些发现需用预设模型重复验证。

papers.title: Optimising neural contrast and minimising tissue shrinkage in dragon lizard brains: buffered Lugol’s iodine versus phosphotungstic acid for contrast-enhanced µCT
papers.authors: Navea F, Black J, Whiteley S, Dissanayake D, Kerr C, Collin S, Crowe-Riddell J.
papers.abstract: Contrast-enhanced micro-computed tomography (µCT) has become a valuable tool for addressing neuroanatomical questions that previously required destructive histology. As a relatively new technique, it remains subject to ongoing technical refinement, and taxon- and tissue-specific protocol optimisation. We evaluated the performance of two common contrast-enhancing agents, buffered Lugol’s iodine and phosphotungstic acid (PTA) in aqueous solution, for µCT visualisation of the nervous system in the Jacky dragon lizard, Amphibolurus muricatus by comparing staining time, contrast specificity and brain tissue shrinkage evaluated at three concentrations (1.25%, 2.5% and 5%). Buffered Lugol’s iodine outperformed aqueous PTA by requiring shorter staining times (as short as four days) and providing better white matter-grey matter differentiation, whereas PTA required longer incubation periods of approximately three weeks and produced poorer white-grey matter differentiation. Importantly, buffered Lugol’s iodine produced higher brain-to-endocast occupancy estimates than aqueous PTA, suggesting substantially reduced tissue shrinkage. PTA-treated specimens exhibited an estimated 13.3% reduction in occupancy and approximately 20% greater brain tissue shrinkage than buffered Lugol’s-treated specimens. Together, these findings demonstrate that buffered Lugol’s iodine staining provides the high level of internal tissue contrast required to resolve fine-scale neuroanatomical organisation in three dimensions, preserves the spatial relationships among anatomical structures, and reduces artefacts, all of which result in a closer correspondence between the brain and endocranial cavity. From a practical perspective, the study provides guidance for contrast agent selection in future µCT studies and reveals that buffered Lugol’s iodine is better suited to fine-scale neuroanatomical, volumetric and geometric morphometric analyses, whereas PTA is advantageous for applications prioritising general soft-tissue or musculoskeletal visualisation. Graphical Abstract Buffered Lugol’s iodine improves µCT visualisation of dragon lizard brains through faster staining, greater neural contrast, reduced tissue shrinkage and closer correspondence between brain and endocast surfaces compared with phosphotungstic acid (PTA).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以杰克龙蜥为对象，比较了缓冲卢戈氏碘液与磷钨酸（PTA）两种对比剂在神经组织对比增强µCT成像中的表现，考察染色时间、对比特异性和脑组织皱缩。结果显示，缓冲卢戈氏碘液染色更快，白质与灰质的区分更好，且脑组织皱缩明显更轻，脑与颅内腔的对应关系更接近；PTA则需要更长孵育时间，白灰质对比更差，皱缩更明显。作者据此认为，缓冲卢戈氏碘液更适合精细神经解剖、体积和几何形态测量分析，而PTA更适用于优先观察一般软组织或肌肉骨骼的应用。

papers.title: Comparing re-referencing methods for human intracranial EEG
papers.authors: Kolibius LD, Parish G, ter Wal M, van der Plas M, Rollings DT, Gollwitzer S, Walther K, Hopfengärtner R, Hamer H, Wimber M, Hanslmayr S.
papers.abstract: Stereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) involves the implantation of depth electrodes in the brain to monitor epileptic seizures for surgical feasibility. As the electrodes advance into deeper limbic structures, the macro contacts distributed along the shaft record electrical activity from more lateral sites, while a bundled array of microwires simultaneously captures highly localised signals from the tip of the electrode. In a clinical setting these electrical signals are recorded relative to a reference signal, which may be sub-optimal for subsequent analyses that are unrelated to clinical objectives. Therefore, a secondary re-referencing operation is often undertaken to transform the signal in relation to a specific hypothesis. Despite a recent surge in SEEG studies, comparative studies on the much-understudied issue of re-referencing are sparse. Here, we analyse data collected from 16 human patients during an episodic memory task and comparatively apply a range of re-referencing methods to both macro contact and micro-wire data. We find that the choice of method changes the proportion of trials that survive artefact rejection, low frequency power, and the aperiodic background against which that power is read. In the hippocampal recordings, however, no method differed from any other in the size of a memory effect in power or spike–field coherence. This early transformative decision therefore bears on how the signal is described. We found no evidence that it changes the detectability of the behavioural effects tested here, and no method reversed the direction of a memory effect.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了人颅内脑电（SEEG）中不同重参考方法对信号分析的影响，数据来自癫痫患者执行情景记忆任务时的宏电极和微丝记录。结果显示，重参考方法的选择会改变通过伪迹剔除的试次比例、低频功率以及功率所依托的非周期背景，但在海马记录中，各方法在记忆效应的功率大小和锋电位-场相干性上并无差异，也没有方法逆转记忆效应的方向。作者据此指出，这一早期转换步骤影响信号的描述方式，但未发现其改变此处所测行为效应的可检测性。

papers.title: Synergistic modulation of the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and precuneus enhances cognitive recovery in mild cognitive impairment: A multimodal neuroimaging study.
papers.authors: Guo Z, Chen W, Xie J, Pu Y, Yang H, Mu Q.
papers.abstract: Abstract Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation is a promising intervention for mild cognitive impairment; however, conventional single-site stimulation protocols are often incapable of addressing the complex pathological network alterations underlying the condition. This study investigated the clinical efficacy and neurobiological modulatory mechanisms of multisite versus single-site repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation in patients with mild cognitive impairment. A total of 101 patients with mild cognitive impairment completed a 10-day repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation intervention and were analyzed in two cohorts: a single-site group receiving stimulation over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (n = 50) and a multi-site group receiving sequential stimulation over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and precuneus (n = 51). The multi-site group demonstrated significantly greater enhancements in global cognition [Mini-Mental State Examination: group×time interaction F(99) = 25.08, P < 0.001; Montreal Cognitive Assessment: F(99) = 6.17, P = 0.015], memory [Auditory Verbal Learning Test-immediate recall: F(99) = 6.03, P = 0.016], and language (Verbal Fluency Test, Animal Fluency Test: F(99) = 8.13, P = 0.005) compared with the single-site group. Neuroimaging analyses revealed that multi-site repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation induced robust structural and functional alterations across broader cognitionrelated regions and networks. Specifically, the multi-site protocol significantly increased gray matter volume in the left parahippocampal gyrus and large-scale networks (e.g., default mode network, executive control network), while modulating amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation and regional homogeneity in core memory and executive regions, including the precuneus, hippocampus, parahippocampal gyrus, and middle frontal gyrus. Additionally, multi-site stimulation drove more extensive functional connectivity alterations within the left parahippocampal network. Crucially, these specific neuroimaging alterations significantly correlated with behavioral improvements in memory, language, and global cognitive scores. Multi-site repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation targeting the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and precuneus yields superior cognitive improvements in mild cognitive impairment compared with conventional single-site stimulation. This enhanced efficacy is underpinned by the robust modulation of structural integrity, spontaneous neural activity, and functional connectivity within core cognitive brain networks. These mechanisms reflect repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation-induced synaptic plasticity and neurovascular coupling, driving network-level neural repair and providing a mechanistic rationale for optimized, connectivity-based neuromodulation in the early intervention of Alzheimer's disease.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了多位点与单位点重复经颅磁刺激对轻度认知障碍患者的认知改善效果，并借助多模态神经影像探讨其神经机制。结果显示，在左侧背外侧前额叶之外联合刺激楔前叶的多位点方案，在整体认知、记忆和语言方面的改善均优于仅刺激左侧背外侧前额叶的单位点方案。影像分析进一步表明，多位点刺激在更广泛的认知相关脑区和网络中引起结构与功能改变，且这些改变与行为改善相关。作者据此认为，联合靶向的刺激方案可能通过调控核心认知网络的结构完整性、自发活动和功能连接而带来更好的认知恢复，为基于连接组的神经调控提供了初步依据。

papers.title: Neurodegeneration epicenters: Distinct network mechanisms of dopaminergic treatment in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Duanmu X, Zhu Z, Lu N, Zhang W, Wang L, Wen J, Qin J, Tao Q, Jin Y, Zhou L, Zhou C, Guo T, Wu H, Chen J, Wu J, Yan Y, Tian J, Zhang M, Guan X, Xu X.
papers.abstract: Abstract Parkinson's disease exhibits heterogeneous spatiotemporal patterns of neurodegeneration. Dopaminergic therapy improves motor symptoms by modulating brain function in affected regions, yet whether the neural mechanisms through which dopaminergic therapy exerts its effects are linked to this heterogeneity of neurodegeneration remains unclear. A connectivity-based epicenter framework combined with spectral dynamic causal modeling was applied to resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data from 160 drug-naïve Parkinson's disease patients and 174 healthy controls to identify subtype-specific degenerative epicenters and characterize directional interactions among affected regions. Ninety-seven patients additionally underwent an acute levodopa challenge to evaluate how dopaminergic modulation influences these interactions and relates to symptom improvements. Two distinct Parkinson's disease subtypes were identified: subtype 1 was characterized by degenerative epicenters predominantly located in subcortical and cerebellar regions, whereas subtype 2 exhibited epicenters primarily involving cortical regions. Both subtypes exhibited widespread dysregulation of directional interactions among epicenter regions relative to healthy controls. Levodopa treatment partially reversed these network abnormalities in a manner specific to each subtype, notably within cerebellar vermis in subtype 1 and frontal cortex in subtype 2. Symptom improvements were linked to distinct network interactions: in subtype 1, tremor correlated with the thalamus, midbrain nuclei, and cerebellar vermis, whereas bradykinesia primarily involved the cerebellar vermis; in subtype 2, rigidity improvements mapped to frontal cortex and limbic regions, and bradykinesia to limbic regions. These findings suggest that Parkinson's disease involves distinct epicenter networks in each subtype, with widespread directional dysregulation contributing to symptom diversity in patients. Levodopa treatment selectively modulates these network interactions, shedding light on the mechanisms underlying treatment heterogeneity and guiding precision-targeted therapeutic strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病神经退行性变的异质性是否与多巴胺能治疗的网络机制相关。研究对160名未用药帕金森病患者和174名健康对照的静息态功能磁共振数据，采用基于连接性的起源中心框架结合谱动态因果建模，识别亚型特异的退行性起源中心并刻画受影响区域间的方向性相互作用；其中97名患者另接受急性左旋多巴挑战。结果识别出两个亚型：亚型1的起源中心主要位于皮层下和小脑区域，亚型2主要涉及皮层区域，两亚型相对健康对照均存在起源中心区域间方向性相互作用的广泛失调，左旋多巴以亚型特异方式部分逆转这些异常。症状改善与不同的网络相互作用相关，提示左旋多巴选择性调节这些网络相互作用，有助于理解治疗异质性，但摘要未报告效应量或临床转化证据。

papers.title: CT Ventricular Volume Reference Percentile Curves Using Automated nnU-Net Segmentation: A Study with LLM-Facilitated Cohort Selection.
papers.authors: Vishwanathan N, Wasserthal J, Yang S, Segeroth M, Cyriac J, Lieb JM, Bach M, Psychogios MN, Mutke MA.
papers.abstract: Background: Age- and sex-specific CT reference percentile curves of ventricular volume may support objective assessment of ventricular enlargement. We aimed to generate such curves by combining a locally deployed large language model (LLM) for cohort curation with nnU-Net 12-subcompartment segmentation. Methods: This retrospective study did not require formal ethics approval under the Swiss Human Research Act. We screened 42,211 head CT reports from January 2019 to April 2024. A phrase prefilter identified 9622 candidates for German-tuned 70-billion-parameter LLM review of stroke, leukoencephalopathy, parenchymal defects, enlarged ventricles, and space-occupying lesions; 6516 remained. A second LLM workflow screened 210,761 clinical data warehouse summaries to exclude dementia, organic brain disease, or cognitive decline. After image-availability and series-mismatch exclusions, the final cohort comprised 2608 CTs from 2608 patients (1374 males, 1234 females; age 14-98 years). Ventricular masks were obtained using a validated nnU-Net tool integrated in TotalSegmentator. Results: LLM labelling accuracy in 471 blinded reports ranged from 0.966 to 0.992. CDW screening audit showed 91% agreement, sensitivity 0.96, and negative predictive value 0.96. Median total ventricular volume rose from 10.94 mL in young females and 13.42 mL in young males to 21.97 mL and 31.97 mL, respectively, in the 60-69 age group. Except for the fourth ventricle, compartments showed positive age correlations (r = 0.44-0.69); the fourth ventricle showed no relevant association (r = 0.01 males; r = 0.05 females). After adjustment for age, male sex remained associated with greater total ventricular volume (6.54 mL; 95% CI, 5.61-7.46; p<0.001). Conclusions: This study provides age- and sex-specific CT ventricular nomograms in a selected reference cohort. The LLM-assisted curation and nnU-Net segmentation workflow provides a feasible approach for large-scale cohort analysis.

papers.title: Clinical and Imaging Patterns of Neurological Involvement in Intravascular Large B-Cell Lymphoma: A Single-Center Retrospective Study.
papers.authors: Di Y, Geng C, Fan S, Chen C, Lang M, Zhang W, Zhou D, Zhang Y.
papers.abstract: Objective: Neurological involvement in intravascular large B-cell lymphoma (IVLBCL) is heterogeneous, prompting us to characterize its diverse manifestations through an integrated clinical and neuroimaging framework. Methods: This single-center retrospective study included 55 patients with pathologically confirmed IVLBCL diagnosed at Peking Union Medical College Hospital between January 2015 and June 2023. Pretreatment neurological involvement was identified in 29 patients based on attributable clinical and/or imaging findings after exclusion of more plausible alternative causes. Patterns were assigned primarily by clinical manifestations, supported by available imaging. Results: Six potentially overlapping clinicoradiologic patterns were identified. The str oke-like pattern ( n = 5) comprised acute focal deficits with corresponding infarct-like or ischemic lesions. The encephalopathy pattern ( n = 11) included cognitive decline, behavioral changes, impaired consciousness, and/or seizures, with or without infarct-like lesions or white matter hyperintensities. Three patients developed encephalopathic features following stroke-like presentations, including one with concomitant myelopathy. The mass-like pattern ( n = 1) presented with headache and vomiting associated with enhancing lesions and surrounding edema. Myelopathy ( n = 3) was characterized by lower-limb weakness with spinal cord-localizing signs, whereas radiculoneuropathy ( n = 5) manifested as bilateral lumbosacral nerve-root involvement with weakness, sensory abnormalities, and reduced reflexes. Corresponding MRI abnormalities were absent in two patients with encephalopathy and one with myelopathy. The asymptomatic pattern ( n = 8) comprised patients with imaging abnormalities but no neurological symptoms or signs. A total of 19 of 22 patients evaluable for treatment response achieved complete remission. Conclusions: Neurological involvement in IVLBCL comprises overlapping and evolving clinicoradiologic presentations, with variable correspondence between symptoms and imaging findings. This descriptive framework may help clinicians recognize its diverse manifestations and consider IVLBCL when the clinical course or imaging findings remain insufficiently explained.

papers.title: Disruption of the Muscle-Brain Axis in Ageing: Role of Myokines in Sarcopenia and Neurodegeneration.
papers.authors: Morales Molina VA, Salinas CNL, Vásquez CA, Matos A, Riofrío DA.
papers.abstract: This narrative review analyzes how myokines act as key links in communication between skeletal muscle and the brain, focusing on the impact of aging on this axis. Although the current literature links defects in this signaling pathway to sarcopenia, neurodegeneration, and cognitive decline, we still do not know exactly what role each molecule plays individually. Among the main gaps in our understanding are questions about how these substances are transported to the nervous system, what their specific receptors are, and what cause-and-effect relationship actually exists between losing muscle mass and developing neurological problems. In fact, in humans, it remains unclear whether myokines actually reach the brain in truly effective concentrations or whether their benefits are due more to peripheral metabolic, vascular, and inflammatory changes. Today, most of the mechanistic evidence comes from animal and cellular models, while observational studies predominate in humans. This is further complicated by uncertainties regarding the actual origin of these proteins in tissues, their passage through the blood-brain barrier, and their measurement in the blood, making it difficult to determine whether these proteins act as causes, consequences, or simply compensatory responses to aging and disease. On the other hand, although exercise remains the most robust tool for maintaining muscle health and protecting cognitive function, it is still unclear whether we could replicate those same benefits by isolating and stimulating specific myokines. The major challenge for the future is to develop human studies that combine standardized biomarkers with long-term monitoring of muscle function, cognition, and brain structure. Only then will we know whether this fascinating muscle-brain axis can move beyond being a promising hypothesis to become a real therapeutic target.

papers.title: Perinatal Brain Injuries in Preterm Infants.
papers.authors: Papazovska Cherepnalkovski A, Brajkovic L, Cogelja K, Milostic LK, Vidovic N, Renic A, Bulat D, Sabljic J, Batinovic E, Bucat M.
papers.abstract: Background Preterm infants are vulnerable to brain injury because of immature white matter, vascular regulation, and neuroprotective mechanisms. White matter injury (WMI), formerly known as periventricular leukomalacia, is a major cause of cerebral palsy and neurocognitive impairment, while perinatal stroke is an important cerebrovascular cause of adverse outcomes. White matter injury: WMI is linked to hypoxia-ischemia, inflammation or infection, oxidative stress, and impaired oligodendrocyte maturation. It may be cystic or diffuse non-cystic, which is now the most common phenotype. Cystic lesions are strongly associated with motor impairment and spastic cerebral palsy, whereas diffuse injury is increasingly related to cognitive, behavioral, and language deficits. Diagnosis relies on cranial ultrasonography and MRI; prevention focuses on optimized perinatal care, infection control, respiratory stabilization, and neuroprotection. Perinatal stroke: Stroke in preterm infants may occur antenatally or neonatally and includes periventricular hemorrhagic infarction, perinatal arterial ischemic stroke, and cerebral sinovenous thrombosis. Periventricular hemorrhagic infarction is the most common subtype and is often associated with germinal matrix hemorrhage-intraventricular hemorrhage. Risk factors are multifactorial, including fetal, neonatal, placental, thrombotic, infectious, and hemodynamic contributors. Clinical signs may be subtle, making neuroimaging central to classification and prognosis. Conclusion Despite advances in neonatal care, WMI and perinatal stroke remain major causes of long-term neurological morbidity in preterm infants. Early recognition, systematic neuroimaging, risk stratification, and multidisciplinary follow-up are essential. Future research should identify reliable biomarkers and targeted neuroprotective therapies.

papers.title: Cerebral Hemodynamic Patterns in People with Subjective Cognitive Decline: A Systematic Review Based on Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy.
papers.authors: Pebe-Muñoz CDP, Alzola P, Díez-Villoria E, Contador I.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives : Subjective cognitive decline (SCD) has been proposed as an early symptomatic manifestation of dementia/Alzheimer's disease. However, its associated brain patterns are not yet fully characterized. In recent years, functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) has emerged as a cost-effective technique to detect hemodynamic changes associated with cognitive decline. Therefore, fNIRS may be a valuable tool to investigate SCD neural underpinnings. This systematic review synthesizes current fNIRS evidence regarding the hemodynamic correlates of SCD during both resting-state and cognitive task conditions. Methods : Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched Scopus, PubMed, and Web of Science databases for studies combining keywords ('subjective cognitive decline', 'cognitive complaints', 'memory complaints', 'fNIRS', and 'near-infrared spectroscopy') with Boolean operators. Results : We identified 181 records, of which 10 studies fulfilled the inclusion and exclusion criteria. All studies were cross-sectional. Furthermore, 33% lacked a healthy control group, 56% lacked a standardized SCD identification protocol, 55% used small or imbalanced samples, and 66% did not clearly differentiate prefrontal subregions. In both resting-state and task conditions, SCD individuals showed heterogeneous hemodynamic responses in prefrontal areas. The severity of SCD and the difficulty of the tasks may be useful moderators of these associations. Conclusions : The limited evidence and methodological differences prevent identifying a specific hemodynamic pattern for SCD. Adopting longitudinal, well-powered, and well-controlled designs will be essential to evaluate fNIRS-derived hemodynamic responses in SCD.

papers.title: Skeletal Muscle Aging Is a Significant Contributor to Systemic Aging.
papers.authors: Li MM, Liu X, Li Y, Li H, Wang Y, Qiu K, Kong W.
papers.abstract: Skeletal muscle aging is a conserved biological process characterized by progressive declines in muscle mass, strength, regenerative capacity, and metabolic adaptability, contributing to impaired mobility, frailty and age-related diseases. Beyond its canonical role in locomotion, skeletal muscle functions as an endocrine and metabolic organ that actively regulates organismal aging through myokines, metabolites, extracellular vesicles, thermogenic activity, and dynamic communication with distant organs. In this review, we summarize the intrinsic mechanisms driving skeletal muscle aging, including protein turnover imbalance and anabolic resistance, myosteatosis, denervation and motor unit loss, and cellular composition remodeling. We also discuss how aging skeletal muscle influences systemic aging through bidirectional interactions with metabolic organs, brain, cardiovascular system, and bone via endocrine signaling and interorgan communication. Finally, we highlight emerging interventions targeting skeletal muscle aging, including exercise, nutritional strategies, pharmacological approaches, and other novel therapies. Understanding skeletal muscle as both a target and regulator of systemic aging provides a framework for developing strategies to promote healthy aging and reduce the burden of age-associated diseases.

papers.title: Functional neuroimaging as a tool to understand social determinants of health in cognitive aging and ADRD: a scoping review
papers.authors: Jenkins JE, Rich A, Manrique I, Moukaled S, Marchant NL, Carmichael O.
papers.abstract: The social, structural, and physical conditions in which individuals live, work, and age, collectively termed social determinants of health (SDOH), are associated with risk of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD). Differences in brain function in later life may offer understanding of how SDOH become biologically embedded and confer differential ADRD risk. However, how functional neuroimaging techniques have been used to study SDOH in cognitive aging and ADRD has yet to be systematically characterized. We therefore conducted a scoping review. Three databases were searched, 2,930 articles were screened, and 41 studies were included. Education was the most frequently studied SDOH domain, accounting for 65.9% (k = 27) of studies, followed by economic and occupation (k = 9, 22.0%), social and community (k = 5, 12.2%), food (k = 4, 9.8%), and physical environment (k = 3, 7.3%). Of the 41 studies, five (12.2%) examined multidomain determinants and one study (2.4%) examined three determinants each from different domains. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) was most frequently employed (k = 31, 75.6%), followed by electroencephalography (EEG; k = 7, 17.1%), and magnetoencephalography (MEG; k = 4, 9.8%). One study (2.4%) employed a multimodal approach, while none used functional near-infrared spectroscopy. Resting state paradigms (k = 27, 65.9%) outnumbered task-based (k = 14, 34.1%) and most studies were cross-sectional (k = 38, 92.7%). The predominant focus on education, fMRI, and cross-sectional designs highlights many opportunities for future investigation of how SDOH may be associated with later life brain function.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了功能神经影像如何被用于研究认知老化与阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆中的健康社会决定因素。纳入的研究以教育这一决定因素为主，其次是经济与职业、社会与社区、食品和物理环境，且多采用功能磁共振成像和静息态范式，绝大多数为横断面设计。作者指出，这种对教育、功能磁共振成像和横断面设计的集中关注，为未来探究健康社会决定因素与晚年脑功能的关联留下了大量空间。

papers.title: Problematic social media and gaming use, screen time, and youth mental health and brain structure in the ABCD Study
papers.authors: Lo W, Lopez RB, Nephew B.
papers.abstract: In an increasingly digital age, knowing which kinds of screen use relate to mental health in adolescents could help guide prevention efforts for a vulnerable population. Earlier work has examined this question, but the findings have been difficult to interpret. For instance, most studies measure screen use in hours, while it may be more informative to know whether adolescents have difficulty controlling their use. This is especially important now that adolescents use screens for school, games and contact with friends. Whether these patterns are reflected in the brain also remains largely unexplored. ABCD Study release 7.0 (N=11,860) is well suited to these questions because of its comprehensive profiling across neuroimaging, behavioral and clinical domains. In a preregistered study, we examined how screen time, problematic social media use (SMAQ) and problematic video game use (VGAQ) relate to parent-rated mental health, brain structure and resting-state connectivity. All five confirmatory associations were positive but small (β = 0.051 to 0.173) and remained consistent across several robustness checks. In the same participants, the problematic use scales were more strongly related to attention problems than hours of use were. The association between screen time and anxiety problems was present in male but not female participants. More screen time was associated with slightly smaller putamen and caudate volumes, while resting-state connectivity did not predict SMAQ. In exploratory analyses, SMAQ predicted later attention problems more than the reverse, while for gaming, attention problems predicted later VGAQ more strongly. Most of the association seemed to come from problematic use rather than use time by itself. Overall, the effects were small but consistent, in line with earlier work in the ABCD Study. We hope this analysis can contribute to a better understanding of how social media and gaming relate to adolescent mental health and brain development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ABCD研究数据，考察青少年屏幕使用时间、问题性社交媒体使用和问题性电子游戏使用与心理健康、脑结构及静息态连接的关系。五项验证性关联均为正向但效应较小，且在多项稳健性检验中保持一致；问题性使用量表与注意力问题的关联强于使用时长，屏幕时间与焦虑问题的关联仅见于男性。屏幕时间较多与壳核和尾状核体积略小相关，而静息态连接不能预测问题性社交媒体使用。探索性分析提示，社交媒体使用对后续注意力问题的预测强于反向关系，游戏使用则相反；大部分关联似乎来自问题性使用而非使用时长本身。

papers.title: The Neural Correlates of Implicit Emotion Regulation through Affect Labeling as Reflected in EEG
papers.authors: Chen J, Baas JM, Kenemans L, van de Vijver I.
papers.abstract: Affect labeling reduces emotional responses during and immediately after use, but evidence for lasting regulatory effects remains mixed. While there is no experiential evidence for lasting effects, psychophysiological studies do hint at a longer-lasting impact. However, neuroimaging research has mainly compared affect labeling with affect matching. Although both involve emotional processing, affect labeling additionally engages linguistic processing. Thus, it remains unclear whether observed neural differences reflect emotion-focused labeling or mere linguistic processing, and whether such effects endure over time. We recorded EEG to examine the effects of affect labeling on negative emotion across two re-exposure phases: immediate and after a short interval (15 minutes). Affect labeling (emotion-specific words) was compared with affect matching (emotion-focused perceptual processing) and feature labeling (linguistic processing without emotional content), allowing us to dissociate emotional and linguistic components. Event-related potentials and EEG oscillatory activity were analyzed in both phases, with pre-intervention neural responses included as baseline. Robust emotion-related neural activity was observed. Negative (vs. neutral) stimuli elicited increased late positive potential (LPP) amplitudes, enhanced fronto-central-parietal theta power, and greater right-hemispheric alpha activity. However, LPP, theta-, and alpha-band power did not show effects of affect labeling compared to the control conditions. Thus, the present findings provide no evidence for a lasting labeling effect. Because we focused on re-exposure, we may have missed potential regulatory effects during the intervention itself. Future research should further identify factors that influence the effectiveness of labeling and clarify when this implicit emotion regulation pathway is engaged.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电考察情绪标签（用情绪词标记负性情绪）是否产生即时及短时程的调节效应，并将情绪标签与情绪匹配、特征标签对比，以分离情绪加工与语言加工成分。结果显示，负性刺激相较中性刺激诱发了更强的晚期正电位、额中央顶区theta功率和右半球alpha活动，但在干预后立即和间隔一段时间后的再次暴露阶段，情绪标签相比对照条件并未改变这些指标。作者据此指出，未发现情绪标签具有持续调节作用的证据，并提示由于聚焦于再暴露阶段，可能遗漏了干预过程中的调节效应，后续需明确该内隐调节路径何时被激活及影响其效果的因素。

papers.title: Humanizing AI-generated exemplars: Human-source framing facilitates group creative ideation
papers.authors: Xiaoyong S, Lu Y, Liu Y, Ge Y, Ruan Q, Jiang K, KelongLu.
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-generated creative exemplars are increasingly used as scalable digital instructional resources in creativity education. However, it remains unclear whether labeling identical exemplars as human- or AI-generated shapes how learners engage in group creative activities. We tested this possibility in 113 dyads using an fNIRS hyperscanning group creative ideation paradigm. Dyads completed creative ideation tasks before, during, and after exemplar-stimulation. During stimulation, the human- and AI-attribution groups received identical exemplars labeled as produced by human or AI, whereas the control group received no exemplar. Human attribution increased idea uniqueness during stimulation relative to both the other phases and the AI-attribution and control groups. AI attribution temporarily increased switching among ideation pathways. Neither behavioral effect persisted after exemplar withdrawal. The two attribution groups did not differ in exemplar-category overlap or nearest-exemplar semantic distance, but human-attribution dyads rated the exemplars as more helpful. Human attribution also increased interbrain synchronization (IBS) in bilateral premotor and supplementary motor cortices during stimulation, whereas AI attribution was associated with decreased IBS in the left supramarginal gyrus and right frontopolar cortex from pre- to post-stimulation. Thus, exemplar-source attribution shapes the process and outcome of group creative ideation, revealing an important social-contextual factor in AI-supported creativity education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注同一批AI生成的创造性范例被标注为“人类创作”还是“AI生成”时，会如何影响小组创造性构思。研究采用fNIRS超扫描小组创造性构思范式，让双人小组在范例呈现前后及呈现期间完成构思任务，并比较人类归因、AI归因和无范例对照三种条件。结果显示，人类归因在范例呈现期间提高了想法的独特性，AI归因则暂时增加了构思路径之间的切换，但两种行为效应在范例撤除后均未持续；人类归因组还认为范例更有帮助，并伴随双侧前运动区和辅助运动区的脑间同步增强。作者据此指出，范例来源的归因会塑造小组创造性构思的过程与结果，是AI支持创造性教育中一个重要的社会情境因素。

papers.title: A Longitudinal Investigation of Cannabis Use on Adolescent Neurocognitive Development in the ABCD Study®
papers.authors: Moore A, Perica M, Visontay R, Mewton L, Squeglia L.
papers.abstract: Objective. Evidence pertaining to the effect of adolescent cannabis use on neurocognitive development has been mixed, with recent reports highlighting the limitations of existing findings. By leveraging the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study® sample, the present study addresses previous methodological constraints to clarify cannabis’s potential effect on cognitive development.Methods. Youth (N=4,191) performed neurocognitive tasks during their baseline (age ~10) and Year 6 (age ~16) follow-up assessments. Domains included overall cognitive function (crystallized/fluid), memory, executive functioning, processing speed, reward sensitivity, and language skills. Lifetime, cumulative cannabis use was divided along a median split to account for skewed data, resulting in no, low (≤5 cannabis use occasions; average=1.8), and high use (>5 use occasions; average=256) groups. Initial models (Bonferroni corrected, n=19) compared Year 6 follow-up cognitive performance between groups while controlling for baseline performance, sex, and age. Sensitivity analyses incorporated 1) socioeconomic status (SES), 2) additional substance use, and 3) SES and additional substance use.Results. Cannabis use during early adolescence was significantly related (adj. p<0.05) to worse crystallized cognitive function (β=[-0.23,-0.21]), memory (β=[-0.35,-0.17]), and language skills (β=[-0.26,-0.13]). Cannabis effects remained generally consistent after controlling for SES alone. After controlling for additional substance use, the unique effect of cannabis use was no longer statistically significant.Conclusions. The present study highlights that cannabis likely has an overall negative effect on neurocognitive development; while present over and above SES, this effect may not be substance specific. Future work aims to disentangle the shared effect of these relationships.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用ABCD队列的纵向数据，考察青少年早期使用大麻与后续神经认知发展的关系，比较基线至约6年后随访期间无使用、低使用和高使用组在多项认知任务上的表现，并控制基线成绩、性别和年龄。结果显示，早期大麻使用与晶体认知、记忆和语言能力的较差表现相关，控制社会经济地位后关联基本一致；但进一步控制其他物质使用后，大麻的独立效应不再显著。作者据此认为，大麻对神经认知发展可能总体呈负面影响，且该效应可能并非大麻所特有，未来需区分共同作用。

papers.title: Personalized Network Mapping Reveals State-Trait Dissociation of Frontoparietal Connectivity in Adolescent Depression: A Longitudinal Study
papers.authors: Laca J, Ojha A, Herting MM, Mummaneni A, Keller A, Uddin L, Ho T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Prior research linking resting-state networks (RSNs) to adolescent depression has yielded inconsistent findings, partly because group-average templates poorly capture individual brains; a mismatch that may be especially consequential during adolescence, when RSNs grow increasingly heterogeneous across individuals. Using a personalized analysis pipeline in the longitudinal Characterizing Adolescent Trajectories of Depression cohort (38 depressed adolescents [28 female]; ages 14–18; 181 usable scans; avg. participation: 446.18 days), we derived individualized definitions of three canonical depression-related RSNs. Because longitudinal RSN connectivity may reflect both trait-like vulnerability and state-like symptom fluctuation, we used mixed-effects models to decompose connectivity profiles into both components. FPN connectivity showed a significant state-trait dissociation: chronically elevated connectivity predicted greater average symptom burden, while transient increases predicted momentary relief. These effects were undetectable using group-atlas estimates. We suggest FPN connectivity plays a dual, compensatory role in adolescent depression and demonstrate that personalized definitions can reveal clinically meaningful brain–symptom associations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年抑郁症中静息态网络连接与症状的关系，针对群体平均模板难以反映个体差异的问题，采用个性化分析流程在纵向队列中定义三个抑郁相关网络，并用混合效应模型把连接特征分解为特质性与状态性成分。结果显示，额顶网络连接存在明显的状态—特质分离：长期偏高的连接预测更高的平均症状负担，而短暂升高则对应症状的即时缓解，且这些关联在群体图谱估计中无法检出。作者据此提出额顶网络连接在青少年抑郁中可能起双重补偿作用，并强调个体化网络定义有助于揭示具有临床意义的大脑—症状关联。

papers.title: Predictive EEG Signatures of Alzheimer's Disease: A Cross-Validated, Cross-Method Analysis Using ANCOVA Filtering and Sparse Logistic Regression
papers.authors: Joshi G.
papers.abstract: Abstract Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) changes how the brain’s electrical activity behaves, and these changes can, in principle, be picked up directly from a resting-state EEG recording without any invasive testing. This study asks a much narrower question: does a small subset of four EEG-derived measurement families, namely signal complexity, spectral power, functional connectivity and network topology, reliably separate individuals with AD from Healthy Controls (HC), and does that separation hold up under strict, leakage-free testing?
