Using a public dataset of 36 AD and 29 HC subjects, candidate features were selected through permutation-based ANCOVA with false discovery rate correction, controlling for age and gender, and each selected feature was then re-checked using a complementary method (Mann-Whitney U with FDR correction, plus network-based statistics for connectivity), applied to the same subjects, to confirm the finding wasn’t an artifact of the first method’s particular assumptions. Agreement between the two methods was strong for signal complexity (Jaccard = 0.85) and spectral power (Jaccard = 0.87), essentially perfect for two of the four network measures (Jaccard = 1.00), and weaker for connectivity (Jaccard = 0.60, assessed at the level of frequency bands). A sparse logistic regression classifier was then trained using 5-fold cross-validation in which feature selection was independently repeated inside each fold, a design specifically intended to stop information from test subjects leaking into which features get chosen. This classifier reached 78.5% ± 5.8% accuracy at discriminating AD from HC (sensitivity 0.803 ± 0.116, specificity 0.753 ± 0.100, AUC 0.808 ± 0.134). A single spectral power feature was among the two features retained in three of the five folds, more than any other individual feature. Taken together, the results point to a real but modest EEG signature of AD in this dataset, identified using a validation design built specifically so that reported accuracy reflects genuine generalization rather than an artifact of how the features were selected.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用静息态脑电，考察由信号复杂度、频谱功率、功能连接和网络拓扑四类指标构成的小规模特征集能否区分阿尔茨海默病患者与健康对照，并检验这种区分在严格避免信息泄漏的评估下是否成立。研究先以控制年龄和性别的置换检验筛选特征，再用另一种统计方法复核，发现复杂度、频谱功率及部分网络指标在两种方法间一致性较高，连接指标一致性较弱。随后在每折内独立重复特征选择的交叉验证框架下训练稀疏逻辑回归分类器，区分表现中等但稳定，且某一频谱功率特征在多折中被保留。作者据此认为该数据集中存在真实但有限的脑电判别信号，并强调其准确率反映的是泛化表现而非特征选择假象。

papers.title: Molecularly distinct neurodegeneration shapes the DOPA-dependent dynamic of large-scale brain connectomics in GBA-associated Parkinson’s disease
papers.authors: Treddenti M, Guerra A, D’Onofrio V, Guidetti M, Lucchi G, Yahya V, Sartirana E, Zappasodi F, Antonini A, Priori A, Marceglia S, Bocci T.
papers.abstract: Abstract GBA1-associated Parkinson’s disease (GBA1-PD) is a biologically distinct synucleinopathy associated with glucocerebrosidase deficiency, lysosomal dysfunction, and more extensive cortical neurodegeneration. How these molecular abnormalities shape large-scale cortical network dynamics in vivo remains incompletely understood. This study aimed to characterize resting-state EEG functional connectivity and network topology in GBA1-PD and to determine whether GBA1-related molecular pathology is associated with a distinct oscillatory connectome signature and its modulation by dopaminergic treatment. We recorded resting-state EEG in 22 patients with PD (GBA1-PD = 7; LRRK2-PD = 5; sporadic PD = 10) together with 14 age-matched healthy controls. EEG was acquired in OFF and ON dopaminergic states. Functional connectivity was estimated using imaginary coherence (ImCoh) and phase-locking value (PLV) across canonical frequency bands, while network organization was quantified using the graph-theoretical clustering coefficient. Linear mixed-effects models were used to assess therapy- and subtype-specific effects. GBA1-PD exhibited a selective increase in gamma-band clustering coefficient in the ON condition (p = 0.044), which was not observed in LRRK2 or sporadic PD. PLV-based analyses highlighted opposite clustering changes in GBA1 and LRRK2 patients. ImCoh analyses further revealed different therapy-related connectivity changes in genetic and sporadic PD across all frequency bands (all p ≤ 0.0035). Compared with healthy controls, PD was associated with widespread disruption of cortico-cortical connectivity. All significant effects were abolished in surrogate-data analyses, supporting their physiological specificity. Resting-state EEG connectomics may reveal genotype-specific network alterations in GBA1-PD and their modulation by dopaminergic treatment, supporting a relationship between genetic background and large-scale brain network dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨GBA1相关帕金森病中葡萄糖脑苷脂酶缺乏等分子病理是否对应特异的静息态脑电连接组特征，以及多巴胺能治疗如何调节这些特征。研究比较了GBA1、LRRK2和散发性帕金森病患者在用药关与开状态下的脑电功能连接和网络拓扑，并以健康对照作参照。结果显示，GBA1患者在开状态下出现选择性的伽马频段聚类系数升高，而LRRK2和散发性患者未见这一变化；基于相位锁值的分析还提示GBA1与LRRK2患者的聚类变化方向相反，不同遗传背景与散发性患者在各频段的治疗相关连接改变也不相同。作者据此认为，静息态脑电连接组学可能揭示GBA1相关帕金森病基因型特异的网络改变及其受多巴胺能治疗的调节，但样本量小，结果尚属初步，不能据此推断临床疗效。

papers.title: Elderly men and women with similar areal bone density show significant differences in bone microstructure and fracture pattern.
papers.authors: Gama EMFD, Vieira L, Paranhos-Neto FP, Mendonça LMC, Andrade LSM, Madeira M, Souza GC, Guimarães JAM, Duarte MEL, Farias MLF.
papers.abstract: Objective To compare bone microarchitecture and fracture patterns between elderly men and women with similar spine and hip bone mineral densities (BMDs). Subjects and methods Twenty-eight men and 84 age-BMI-BMD-matched women aged 65 years and older with at least one major osteoporotic fracture underwent laboratory tests, dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), high-resolution peripheral quantitative computed tomography (HR-pQCT), and trabecular bone score (TBS). Results There were no sex differences in biochemistry, BMD or lowest T-scores. TBS values were low in 67% of the cohort and significantly correlated with HR-pQCT parameters. At HR-pQCT evaluation, men had greater bones (total area and cortical perimeter at distal radius and tibia) and better trabecular vBMD and microstructure at distal radius, but similar values for cortical vBMD and cortical thickness. When compared with Brazilian age-sex-reference HR-pQCT data from healthy individuals, all parameters tested were numerically lower in the study group. These differences seemed more pronounced in men, particularly for cortical thickness at the distal tibia, where relative deficits reached -46.9% in men and -35.4% in women. There was no sex difference in vertebral fractures, but wrist and shoulder fractures were more common in women (p = 0.006), whereas hip fractures were more common in men (p = 0.03). Conclusion To achieve similar DXA values, men appear to have greater relative bone deficits than women when compared to age-sex-matched healthy Brazilian population. This study highlights the importance of HR-pQCT to understand sex-specific differences in fracture pattern in the study population.

papers.title: Termination Failure as a Framework for Bipolar Disorder: Candidate Mechanisms and Testable Pharmacological Predictions
papers.authors: Eom Y.
papers.abstract: Bioenergetic accounts of bipolar disorder (BD) have been shaped by a persistent observation: resting brain ATP and phosphocreatine often appear near-normal, even in symptomatic patients. Challenge-based work has moved the field beyond static measures, showing that patients fail to sustain ATP under high demand, and has framed the core abnormality as a deficit of capacity. This review re-examines that literature from a control perspective and argues that the capacity to terminate demand-driven energetic upregulation has been largely untested, chiefly because resting and single-challenge designs cannot resolve return kinetics. The argument is developed in three steps. First, we review how neuronal energy supply is matched to demand, giving comparable weight to adenine-nucleotide feedback, mitochondrial calcium signalling, and phosphotransfer buffering, and we note evidence that cytosolic ATP and ATP:ADP are strikingly stable during physiological activity. Second, we set out three candidate implementations of the termination step — mitochondrial Ca² efflux via NCLX, adenine ⁺ nucleotide feedback, and the creatine kinase–phosphocreatine system — and grade the evidence for each, distinguishing findings obtained in BD from those extrapolated from other systems. None has been assayed directly in BD tissue. Third, using a minimal control-loop model, we show that reduced termination capacity alone does not generate cycling; depending on parameters it produces slowed return, latching, persistent elevation, or sustained oscillation. Cycling therefore requires additional conditions, which we state explicitly. We close with pharmacological strategies that would discriminate among the candidates.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述从控制论角度重新审视双相障碍的能量代谢研究，指出既往静息态和单次负荷设计只能反映产能不足，却无法检验需求驱动的能量上调能否被及时终止，因而“终止能力”这一环节基本未被测试。作者围绕神经元能量供需匹配，比较了腺嘌呤核苷酸反馈、线粒体钙信号和磷酸转移缓冲等机制，并提出NCLX介导的线粒体钙外排、核苷酸反馈及肌酸激酶-磷酸肌酸系统三种可能的终止实现方式，但强调均未在双相障碍组织中直接检测。基于简化控制回路模型，作者指出单纯终止能力下降不足以产生循环，还可能表现为回落变慢、状态锁定或持续升高，循环需附加条件，并据此提出可区分候选机制的药理预测。

papers.title: Differential Trajectories of Brain Atrophy in Multiple Sclerosis, MOGAD, and AQP4 + NMOSD: The Role of Disease Activity in MOGAD.
papers.authors: Cortese R, Bianchi A, de Mauro A, Luchetti L, Gentile G, Amato MP, Apóstolos-Pereira SL, Arrambide G, Bisecco A, Bodini B, Calabrese M, Camera V, de Medeiros Rimkus C, Durand-Dubief F, Filippi M, Gallo A, Gasperini C, Granziera C, Huda S, Inglese M, Lapucci C, Lazzarotto A, Liu Y, Margoni M, Marignier R, Messina S, Müller J, Palace J, Portaccio E, Rocca MA, Rocchi C, Rovira À, Ruggieri S, Santana de Araujo R, Sastre-Garriga J, Stankoff B, Toosy AT, Tortorella C, Barkhof F, Ciccarelli O, Battaglini M, De Stefano N, MAGNIMS Study Group.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Multiple sclerosis (MS), myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease (MOGAD), and aquaporin-4 antibody-positive neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (AQP4 + NMOSD) are inflammatory demyelinating disorders with distinct mechanisms of tissue injury. MS is characterized by diffuse neurodegeneration, whereas damage in antibody-mediated diseases is considered attack related. In MOGAD, the relationship between disease activity and brain atrophy remains unclear. We aimed to compare longitudinal trajectories of global and regional brain atrophy across MS, MOGAD, and AQP4 + NMOSD and investigate whether atrophy in MOGAD is associated with disease course and lesion dynamics. Methods In this retrospective multicenter Magnetic Resonance Imaging in Multiple Sclerosis (MAGNIMS) study, patients fulfilling the following criteria were enrolled: (1) age 18 years or older, (2) MS/MOGAD/AQP4 + NMOSD diagnosis, (3) ≥2 same-scanner brain MRIs ≥6 months apart and ≥3 months postattack, (4) concurrent Expanded Disability Status Scale, and (5) disease course information. White matter lesions were segmented using the Lesion Segmentation Toolbox. Longitudinal brain volumes were quantified on lesion-filled T1-weighted images using Sequence Adaptive Multimodal SEGmentation (SAMSEG) with a within-subject template approach. In MOGAD, lesion dynamics were classified as stable/new lesions/lesion resolution. Linear mixed-effects models adjusted for age, sex, baseline volume, and center estimated atrophy rates. Results Overall, 489 participants from 15 centers were included (98 MS [mean age 39.79 years, 68.37% female], 72 MOGAD [42.14 years, 66.67%], 41 AQP4 + NMOSD [51.25 years, 87.80%], and 278 healthy controls [42.94 years, 61.87%]). The mean follow-up was MS: 2.44 ± 1.55 years, MOGAD: 2.57 ± 1.85, and AQP4 + NMOSD: 3.22 ± 2.42. Compared with controls, MS showed accelerated global brain atrophy (β = -2.027 cm3 per year, 95% CI -3.430 to -0.623). MOGAD demonstrated white matter volume loss (β = -0.989, 95% CI -1.889 to -0.090) and ventricular enlargement (lateral: β = 0.219, 95% CI 0.089-0.350; third ventricle: β = 0.009, 95% CI 0.003-0.015). AQP4 + NMOSD showed pallidal volume reduction (β = -0.008, 95% CI -0.014 to -0.001). Within MOGAD, relapsing patients (62.5%) exhibited greater third ventricular expansion than MS (β = 0.009, 95% CI 0.001-0.017). MOGAD with new lesions (22.22%) had greater ventricular enlargement than controls (lateral: β = 0.359, 95% CI 0.147-0.572; third ventricle: β = 0.016, 95% CI 0.006-0.025), MS, and AQP4 + NMOSD. Discussion Each inflammatory demyelinating disease exhibits a characteristic pattern of brain atrophy. In MOGAD, neuroaxonal loss seems associated with inflammatory activity and lesion accrual, supporting an event-driven pattern of tissue injury rather than diffuse neurodegeneration. Limitations include small NMOSD sample, heterogeneous follow-up, and potential scanner-related variability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了多发性硬化（MS）、MOG抗体相关疾病（MOGAD）和AQP4抗体阳性视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病（AQP4+NMOSD）患者脑萎缩的纵向变化轨迹，采用多中心回顾性设计，分析同一扫描仪上的重复脑MRI及临床病程信息。结果显示，三种疾病各有特征性的萎缩模式：MS表现为整体脑萎缩加速，MOGAD以白质体积下降和脑室扩大为主，AQP4+NMOSD则见苍白球体积缩小。在MOGAD内部，复发患者及出现新病灶者的脑室扩大更明显，提示其神经轴索丢失可能与炎症活动和病灶累积相关，更接近事件驱动的损伤模式，而非弥漫性神经变性。作者同时指出，NMOSD样本较小、随访异质及扫描仪差异等局限需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Plasticity in Human Brain Language Areas After Stroke: What Can the Right Hemisphere Do?
papers.authors: Seydell-Greenwald A, Martin KC.
papers.journal: The Neuroscientist : a review journal bringing neurobiology, neurology and psychiatry
papers.abstract: Among the most devastating effects stroke can have on the lives of survivors and those around them are language production and comprehension impairments. The most notable of them - often given the joint diagnostic label of "aphasia" despite their heterogeneity and dissociability - are associated with damage to the brain's left hemisphere, which, in large part for this reason, is considered the "language-dominant" hemisphere. However, the right hemisphere's contribution to language should not be underestimated and may in fact be key to understanding the possibilities and limitations of neuroplasticity for supporting language recovery after stroke. Thus, in this review, we focus on the role of the right hemisphere in supporting human language function, in the neurologically healthy brain and after stroke. We discuss the remarkable capability of the right hemisphere to support normal language abilities after a large left-hemisphere stroke early in life, the more limited capacity for right-hemisphere language support after left-hemisphere stroke in adulthood, and potential interactions between typically left-hemisphere dominant "core" language functions with language functions typically thought to be right-hemisphere dominant, such as emotional prosody. We conclude by highlighting gaps in current knowledge and suggesting areas for future research.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦右半球在人类语言功能中的作用，梳理其在健康脑以及卒中后语言恢复中的贡献。作者指出，生命早期发生大面积左半球卒中后，右半球仍能支持接近正常的语言能力；而成年期左半球卒中后，右半球的支持能力则较为有限。文章还讨论了通常由左半球主导的“核心”语言功能与情绪韵律等右半球优势功能之间可能的相互作用，并强调现有认识仍存在空白，需要进一步研究。

papers.title: The Pallidothalamic Tract in Functional Neurosurgery: A Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Al-Smadi MW, Al-Khafaji YQ, Aslan S, Giampiccolo D, San Xu S, Akram H, Limousin P, Foltynie T, Zrinzo L, Krueger MT.
papers.abstract: Introduction The pallidothalamic tract (PTT), formed by convergence of the ansa lenticularis and fasciculus lenticularis at Forel's field H1, is a major basal ganglia efferent pathway and an emerging functional neurosurgical target. No systematic review has previously synthesised outcomes across PTT-targeted interventions. Methods This PRISMA 2020-compliant systematic review was registered on PROSPERO (CRD420251248260). PubMed, OVID, and Web of Science were searched for studies reporting functional neurosurgical outcomes targeting the PTT or Forel's fields. Prospective and retrospective studies, case series, and case reports were eligible. Methodological quality was assessed using design-appropriate risk-of-bias tools. Results Forty studies encompassing 483 patients (1966-2025) were included across five modalities: MR-guided focused ultrasound (n = 143), radiofrequency ablation (n = 167), deep brain stimulation (n = 40), cryogenic lesioning (n = 82), and oil-wax injection (n = 52). Mean follow-up was 21 months. In Parkinson disease (PD; 11 studies; n = 135), mean Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale-III improvement was 39%, with reductions in dyskinesia (Unified Dyskinesia Ratings Scale 90%) and tremor (75%). In dystonia (12 studies; n = 87), Burke Fahn Marsden Dystonia Rating Scale and TWSTRS improved by 57% and 47%, respectively. Dual-target strategies, particularly PTT-VIM combinations, showed additive effects, including greater tremor reduction (77%) and improved rigidity. In drug-resistant epilepsy (6 studies; n = 157), seizure reduction occurred in 71% and seizure freedom in 33%. Conclusion PTT-targeted interventions yield meaningful motor improvements in PD and dystonia, with preliminary evidence supporting additive dual-target benefits. Seizure-reducing effects in refractory epilepsy have been reported. Evidence remains limited by small uncontrolled studies, heterogeneous outcomes, and inconsistent adverse-event reporting. Prospective trials will elucidate the efficacy, safety, and clinical role of the PTT in neurosurgery.
papers.summary_zh: 该系统综述聚焦苍白球丘脑束（PTT）这一基底节主要传出通路作为功能神经外科靶点的疗效，汇总了针对PTT或Forel区干预的研究。纳入研究涵盖磁共振引导聚焦超声、射频毁损、脑深部电刺激、冷冻毁损和油蜡注射等多种方式，涉及帕金森病、肌张力障碍和药物难治性癫痫。结果显示，帕金森病患者运动症状及异动症、震颤有所改善，肌张力障碍量表评分明显下降，双重靶点策略（如PTT-VIM联合）表现出叠加效应；难治性癫痫中也有发作减少乃至无发作的报道。作者指出，现有证据受限于小样本、非对照研究、结局异质和不良事件报告不一致，PTT的疗效、安全性和临床定位仍需前瞻性试验确认。

papers.title: The effect of text-picture consistency on memory integration in college students: Evidence from ERPs.
papers.authors: Jia W, Wang K, Zhao X.
papers.journal: The British journal of educational psychology
papers.abstract: Background In multimedia learning, individuals often need to integrate textual and visual information. The neural mechanisms underlying how consistency between text and pictures affects memory integration remain unclear. Aim To examine the effect of text-picture consistency on memory integration in college students and to determine the processing time at which this effect occurs. Sample Totally 28 Chinese college students (nfemale = 20, nmale = 8; Mage = 21.64 ± 2.30) participated in this experiment. Methods An adapted pictorial demonstration paradigm was employed. Participants sequentially learned two pairs of text-picture stem facts (consistent vs. inconsistent), separated by an interval, followed by a recognition test for stem and integrated facts. Behavioural and event-related potential (ERP) data were recorded simultaneously. Results Under the text-picture consistency condition, college students showed significantly better memory integration performance than under the inconsistency condition (58% vs. 48%). EEG results showed that the text-picture inconsistency condition (i.e., the picture and text within a single stem fact were semantically mismatched) elicited a larger P600 wave (500-800 ms) than the text-picture consistency condition, suggesting that text-picture inconsistency primarily induces conflict and integration difficulties during late cognitive processing. No significant differences were observed in the early N400 component. Conclusion Text-picture consistency facilitates memory integration primarily during late processing, aligning with cognitive theories of multimedia learning. Educationally, it serves as a key quality indicator for multimedia material design. Instructors should prioritize semantic alignment and assess knowledge integration during evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大学生在多媒体学习情境中，文本与图片的一致性如何影响记忆整合及其对应的神经加工时程，采用改编的图词启动范式，结合行为测量与脑电记录。结果显示，文本与图片一致条件下的记忆整合成绩优于不一致条件；脑电上，不一致条件在较晚时间窗诱发更大的P600成分，而早期N400未见明显差异，提示不一致主要引发晚期认知加工中的冲突与整合困难。作者据此认为，文本与图片的一致性主要在加工后期促进记忆整合，这一结果与多媒体学习的认知理论相符，也提示教学材料设计应重视语义匹配，并在评价中关注知识整合。

papers.title: The network localization and underlying biological basis of heterogeneous structural and functional brain abnormalities in insomnia disorder.
papers.authors: Xue W, Gao Z, Shi Y, Zhang Y, Du W, Tao B, Zhu F, Wan Q, Zhang W, Lui S, Lu P, Tang X, Xiao Y.
papers.abstract: Insomnia disorder (ID) has become a prevalent sleep disorder worldwide, yet its underlying neural mechanisms remain unclear due to heterogeneous neuroimaging findings and uncertain network localization. We identified brain structural and functional abnormality locations associated with ID from 63 published neuroimaging studies, including 3391 patients and 3433 healthy controls. Using coordinate network mapping combined with a normative connectome database, we mapped these abnormalities to large-scale brain networks of ID across imaging modalities and further decoded them by integrating microscale chemo-architectural, cellular, and cognitive maps. The structural network widely involved the ventral attention (VAN), sensorimotor (SMN), dorsal attention (DAN) and default mode network (DMN); the task-induced network showed a similar but less extensive pattern, predominantly implicating the VAN, DMN, SMN and subcortical network (SCN); in contrast, the resting-state network was largely confined to the left middle frontal gyrus and the bilateral mid-cingulate cortex. Molecular mapping revealed both shared and distinct neurotransmitter signatures across the three networks, involving cholinergic, histaminergic, glutamatergic, noradrenergic, and opioid systems. Cellular decoding showed relatively selective associations of the structural and task-based networks with glial cells and excitatory neurons, whereas the resting-state network exhibited broader associations with glial cells and multiple excitatory and inhibitory neuronal subtypes. Cognitive decoding linked structural and task-based networks to sensorimotor processing and the resting-state network to memory-related functions. Our findings reconcile heterogeneous neuroimaging results and reveal neurobiological substrates of ID from a network perspective, providing a promising biomarker and paving the way for circuit-based precision therapies of ID.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对失眠障碍神经影像结果异质、网络定位不清的问题，整合已发表的脑结构与功能异常坐标，借助坐标网络映射和规范连接组数据库，将异常定位到大规模脑网络，并结合分子、细胞和认知图谱进行解码。结果显示，结构网络主要涉及腹侧注意、感觉运动、背侧注意和默认模式网络，任务诱发网络模式相似但范围较小，静息态网络则较局限；三类网络在神经递质、细胞类型和认知功能关联上既有共享也有差异。作者认为，这有助于调和异质影像发现，并从网络视角揭示失眠障碍的神经生物学基础，为生物标记和环路精准治疗提供线索。

papers.title: ADHDeepNet: An Explainable Framework for EEG-Based ADHD Detection From Raw Signals.
papers.authors: Amini A, Alijanpour Shalmani M, Latifi B, Nasrabadi AM.
papers.abstract: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is a common brain disorder in children that can persist into adulthood, affecting social, academic, and career life. Early diagnosis is crucial for managing these impacts on patients and the healthcare system but is often labor-intensive and time-consuming. This paper presents a novel method to improve ADHD diagnosis precision and timeliness by leveraging Deep Learning (DL) approaches and electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. We introduce ADHDeepNet, a deep learning model that utilizes comprehensive temporal-spatial characterization, attention modules, and explainability techniques optimized for EEG signals. ADHDeepNet integrates feature extraction and refinement processes to enhance ADHD diagnosis. The model was trained and validated on a dataset of 121 participants (61 ADHD, 60 Healthy Controls), employing nested cross-validation for robust performance. The proposed two-stage methodology uses a 10-fold cross-subject validation strategy. Initially, each iteration optimizes the model's hyper-parameters with inner 2-fold cross-validation. Then, Additive Gaussian Noise (AGN) with various standard deviations and magnification levels is applied for data augmentation. ADHDeepNet achieved 100% sensitivity and 99.17% accuracy in classifying ADHD/HC subjects. To clarify model explainability and identify key brain regions and frequency bands for ADHD diagnosis, we analyzed the learned weights and activation patterns of the model's primary layers. Additionally, t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) visualized high-dimensional data, aiding in interpreting the model's decisions. This study highlights the potential of deep learning and EEG in enhancing ADHD diagnosis accuracy and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出ADHDeepNet深度学习框架，直接以原始脑电信号进行注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）与健康对照的分类，并结合时空特征提取、注意力模块和可解释性分析。模型在儿童及可延续至成年的人群数据上训练与验证，采用嵌套交叉验证和跨被试评估，并引入加噪数据增强。结果显示该框架在区分ADHD与健康对照时取得很高的敏感度和准确率；作者进一步通过分析模型权重与激活模式、并用降维可视化辅助解释，指出对诊断较关键的大脑区域和频段。总体而言，研究提示深度学习结合脑电在提升ADHD诊断准确性与效率方面具有潜力，但结论基于特定数据集和验证方案，尚不能直接等同于临床诊断效用。

papers.title: Effect sizes for brain-based predictive models of cognition across the lifespan.
papers.authors: Christensen E, Wiersch L, Wang M, McPherson B, Shearer H, Noble S, Lam K, Poline JB, Dhamala E.
papers.abstract: Brain-based predictive models offer a promising approach to understanding individual differences in cognitive functioning across the lifespan. This review synthesizes current literature on brain-based cognitive predictions using large-scale datasets, examining how methodological choices and data-related factors impact model performance. We find that brain-based predictive models demonstrate relatively consistent, albeit wide ranging performance across the lifespan, explaining approximately 10-40% of variance in cognitive abilities. Key findings include: (1) models perform better when predicting general cognitive ability compared to specific functions; (2) crystallized abilities are more predictable than fluid abilities; (3) task-based functional connectivity generally outperforms resting-state approaches in younger populations, while structural measures become superior predictors in older adults; (4) multimodal approaches using hierarchical stacked models optimize prediction accuracy; and (5) elastic net and ridge regression provide optimal balance between predictive performance and computational efficiency. In summary, we propose methodological advances to improve the precision and utility of brain-based cognitive predictions.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了基于脑的认知预测模型在毕生发展中的表现，重点考察方法学选择和数据因素如何影响模型效能。作者指出，这类模型在全年龄段表现相对稳定但差异较大，可解释认知能力约10%至40%的变异；一般认知能力比特定功能更易预测，晶体能力比流体能力更易预测，任务态功能连接在年轻群体中通常优于静息态，而结构指标在老年人中预测更佳，多模态分层堆叠模型可优化精度，弹性网和岭回归在性能与计算效率间较平衡。文章据此提出方法学改进方向，以提高预测的精确性和实用性。

papers.title: Two distinct projection pathways converge onto the same BLA neurons to contribute to fear memory retrieval.
papers.authors: Yang H, Xia T, Kuang S, Fu Y, Cao Z, Wen Y, Yuan Y, Chu C, Guo X, Yang L, Sheng H, Lei C, Cui D, Shao D, Cai Z, Lai B, Chen M, Zheng P.
papers.abstract: Studying the neural circuits that mediate context-induced fear memory retrieval is of importance to develop new therapeutic approaches to prevent post-traumatic stress disorder relapse. The basolateral amygdala (BLA) is crucial for context-induced retrieval of fear memory. Previous studies indicate that projection neurons from the ventral hippocampus CA1 (vCA1) to the BLA (vCA1-BLA neurons) mediate context-induced retrieval of fear memory. However, it remains unclear whether other projection neurons to the BLA are involved in context-induced retrieval of fear memory and how they interact with vCA1-BLA neurons. Our findings indicate that the postrhinal cortex (POR) to the BLA (POR-BLA ) neurons are also involved in context-induced retrieval of fear memory. These neurons innervate the same BLA neurons as vCA1-BLA neurons and participate in fear memory retrieval. These results suggest that two different projection neurons of POR-BLA and vCA1-BLA innervate on the same BLA neurons and POR-BLA neurons and vCA1-BLA neuron contribute to fear memory retrieval. These findings provide new insights into the neural mechanisms underlying fear memory retrieval.

papers.title: The spatial extent of fast ripples is associated with cognitive and language deficits in children with focal epilepsy: An exploratory SEEG study.
papers.authors: Dallavalle M, von Ellenreider N, Bellerose J, Fiorino A, Hooker M, Sylvain-Roy S, Myers K, Osterman B, Simard-Tremblay E, Gotman J, Dudley RWR.
papers.abstract: Objective To determine if the spatial extent of interictal fast ripples in focal epilepsy patients is associated with brain dysfunction. Methods Thirty pediatric focal epilepsy patients who underwent SEEG investigation had their cognitive and language deficits assessed in scales of 0 to 4. Fast ripples (250-500 Hz), ripples (80-250 Hz), and IEDs were automatically detected in 10 min during NREM sleep. We fitted linear models to the relationship between the cognitive deficit scale and the spatial spread of the interictal neurophysiologic events (number of channels with rate of events > 10 % of maximum rate). For the language deficit, we computed the Spearman correlation between the median rate of events in all brain regions and the deficit scale. Results Cognitive deficit scale was significantly associated with the number of channels with fast ripples (p = 0.049), not so with ripples (p = 0.31), IEDs (p = 0.31). The potential confound of number of explored channels did not improve the fitting of the models. Language deficits were not correlated with the number of channels showing interictal events. However, from all brain regions the most statistically significant correlations (p < 0.01) were between median fast ripple rates in the left and right pars opercularis and triangularis of the inferior frontal gyrus (Broca's area and its contralateral counterpart) with r = 0.66, p = 0.003 (18 patients), in the superior temporal gyrus in the language dominant hemisphere with r = 0.72, p = 0.005 (13 patients), and the dominant basal temporal region with r = 0.79, p = 0.006 (10 patients). Median rates of IEDs and ripples exhibited lower correlation with language deficits in these regions. Conclusion Widespread fast ripples are associated with increased cognitive deficits, and language deficiencies are correlated with fast ripple rates in brain regions associated with language. The extent of fast-ripple activity was associated with cognitive deficit severity in this cohort, whereas the corresponding associations for ripples and IEDs did not reach statistical significance.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究在局灶性癫痫患儿中考察发作间期快涟漪的空间范围是否与认知和语言缺陷相关，利用SEEG记录并结合缺陷量表评估。结果显示，认知缺陷严重程度与出现快涟漪的电极通道数相关，而涟漪和IEDs未见这种关联；语言缺陷则与左侧及右侧额下回、优势半球颞上回和优势基底颞区等语言相关脑区的快涟漪中位发生率相关，涟漪和IEDs在这些区域的关联较弱。作者据此认为，广泛的快涟漪活动与更重的认知缺陷相关，语言缺陷则与语言相关脑区的快涟漪发生率相关，但这是关联性发现，尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: Generalized Spike-Wave discharges and myoclonic features in a subgroup of children with Self-Limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes.
papers.authors: Guo B, Jia Y, Duan Y, Han J, Zhang X, Gao L, Zhao X, Zhang L, Wang Y.
papers.abstract: Objective Generalized spike-wave discharges (GSWD) are occasionally observed in patients with self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes (SeLECTS), but their clinical significance remains unclear. This study aimed to characterize the electroclinical features of these patients and to explore their potential clinical implications. Methods We retrospectively reviewed the clinical data of 148 children diagnosed with SeLECTS at Xuanwu Hospital from June 2015 to October 2025. Patients with GSWD on electroencephalography were identified and compared with those without GSWD regarding demographic characteristics, seizure semiology, auxiliary examination findings, treatment response, and outcomes. Results GSWD were identified in 9 of 148 patients (6.1 %) with SeLECTS. These 9 patients included 4 males and 5 females, with a median onset age of 8 (IQR: 5-10) years. Compared with those without GSWD, they more frequently showed wakefulness seizures (44.4 % vs 5.8 %, p < 0.05), generalized tonic-clonic seizures during sleep (44.4 %), and myoclonic manifestations (77.8 %). Other clinical variables were similar between groups. All 9 patients achieved freedom from focal and generalized tonic-clonic seizures, though one required prolonged combination therapy. Two patients with follow-up exceeding 10 years showed electroclinical evolution toward juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, characterized by the absence of centrotemporal spikes, with generalized spike-wave bursts recurring on later EEGs. Conclusion We identified a subgroup of patients with SeLECTS characterized by the coexistence of GSWD and myoclonic features, showing partial electroclinical overlap with juvenile myoclonic epilepsy. These findings broaden the electroclinical spectrum of SeLECTS, though the relationship between focal and generalized network dysfunction in this subgroup requires confirmation in larger, prospectively followed cohorts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注伴中央颞区棘波的自限性癫痫（SeLECTS）患儿中出现的广泛性棘慢波放电（GSWD）有何临床意义，回顾性分析了单中心确诊患儿的临床与脑电资料，并将有GSWD者与无GSWD者进行比较。结果发现，GSWD仅见于少数患儿，这部分患儿更常出现清醒期发作、睡眠中的全面强直阵挛发作以及肌阵挛表现；其局灶性和全面强直阵挛发作最终均得到控制，但个别需要较长时间的联合治疗，且长期随访中有病例的脑电与临床特征向青少年肌阵挛癫痫演变。作者据此提出，SeLECTS中存在一个以GSWD与肌阵挛特征共存为特点的亚组，与青少年肌阵挛癫痫有部分重叠，提示该病的电临床谱可能更广；不过局灶与全面网络异常之间的关系仍需更大规模的前瞻性队列确认。

papers.title: Differential resting-state functional connectivity of anterior and posterior cerebellar divisions with canonical networks in PTSD.
papers.authors: Tunstall L, Steele N, Hussain A, Russell C, Beakas J, Huggins AA, Stevens JS, Ressler K, Jovanovic T, van Rooij SJH, Fani N, Daniels JK, Sierk A, Manthey A, Walter H, Grupe DW, Nitschke JB, Davidson RJ, Baugh LA, Simons RM, Simons JS, Magnotta VA, Fercho KA, Zhu Y, Li G, Wang L, Morey RA, Sun D.
papers.journal: Journal of mood and anxiety disorders
papers.abstract: Background Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a complex psychiatric condition that may develop following exposure to a singular or series of traumatic events producing disruptions in cognitive and affective processes. Although the cerebellum is traditionally linked to voluntary movement coordination and balance, recent work highlights posterior cerebellar regions are involved in affective and cognitive functions. Our goal was to investigate functional connectivity between the cerebellum and canonical cortical resting-state networks in PTSD, with a particular focus on the posterior cerebellum based on previously reported structural changes associated with PTSD on the posterior cerebellum. Methods A total of 313 participants ( Mage = 35, 218 females) were comprised of two groups; 119 PTSD patients and 194 healthy controls from eight study sites within the ENIGMA-PTSD working group. The cerebellum was segmented using ACAPULCO into posterior and anterior divisions. Resting-state fMRI preprocessed with HALFpipe was used to assess the functional connectivity of the anterior and posterior divisions of the cerebellum with major canonical cortical networks. Results Compared to the non-PTSD control group, the PTSD group had greater connectivity of the posterior cerebellum with somatomotor (t = 4.32, p = 0.040) and default mode (t = 4.41, p = 0.040) networks. Correspondingly, PTSD symptom severity was linked to greater connectivity differentially affecting the posterior relative to the anterior cerebellum with major cortical networks. PTSD symptom severity was positively associated with greater posterior cerebellum connectivity with the default mode (t = 4.32, pfdr =0.020), somatomotor (t = 3.57, pfdr =0.040), limbic (t = 3.74, pfdr =0.036), salience (t = 3.61, pfdr =0.040) and central executive network (t = 3.59, pfdr =0.040). Conclusion PTSD symptom severity is associated with altered connectivity of the posterior cerebellum with default mode, salience and central executive networks. Cortical connections with the posterior cerebellum, an important socioemotional hub, are involved in PTSD pathology.

papers.title: An insular-orbitofrontal pathway supporting awareness of respiratory effort.
papers.authors: Jelinčić V, von Leupoldt A.
papers.abstract: In a recent study using human intracranial EEG recordings during inspiratory loading, Assi and colleagues identified parallel pathways for respiratory compensation and awareness. The anterior insula signals a neuromechanical mismatch to the orbitofrontal cortex for conscious appraisal, while high-frequency insular-frontal coupling enables ventilatory adjustments. The findings are highly relevant for disorders of altered respiratory perception.

papers.title: Temporal evolution of EEG hallmarks in childhood Lennox-Gastaut syndrome.
papers.authors: Bergonzini L, Harvey S, Das K, Eltze C, Pressler R.
papers.abstract: Purpose The temporal development of generalized paroxysmal fast activity (GPFA) and slow spike-and-wave complexes in childhood Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS) remains poorly characterized. This study mapped the emergence and longitudinal evolution of these EEG hallmarks in a real-world LGS cohort. Methods This retrospective observational cohort study was conducted at a tertiary pediatric neurophysiology and neurology center. Patients aged 1-18 years fulfilling current International League Against Epilepsy criteria for LGS were identified through local databases. All available sleep video-EEG recordings before November 2024 were reviewed; clinical features, EEG findings, and comorbidities were collected at each recording. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. Results We reviewed 234 EEGs from 51 patients (75% male). Median age at first EEG was 5 years. GPFA emerged later than slow spike-and-wave (mean age: 9.6 vs 8.3 years, p = 0.002), with non-parametric analysis confirming a significant difference in age at first detection (p = 0.004). Median age at epilepsy onset was 1.1 years, while all clinical and EEG criteria for LGS were met at a median age of 10.9 years. Conclusion EEG hallmarks of LGS emerged progressively during childhood, with slow spike-and-wave preceding GPFA during sleep. Following early clinical manifestations, a prolonged developmental phase may precede full electroclinical expression of LGS, with implications for early diagnosis and longitudinal EEG surveillance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童Lennox-Gastaut综合征（LGS）中全面性阵发性快活动（GPFA）与慢棘慢波复合波这两种脑电图标志随时间出现和演变的过程，采用回顾性观察队列设计，在三级儿童神经生理与神经内科中心分析患儿睡眠视频脑电图及相应临床资料。结果显示，这些脑电图标志在童年期逐步出现，慢棘慢波先于GPFA被检出，而GPFA首次出现的年龄晚于慢棘慢波；癫痫起病较早，但满足LGS全部临床和脑电图标准的中位年龄明显更晚。作者据此指出，LGS在早期临床表现之后可能经历较长的发育阶段才达到完整的电临床表达，这对早期诊断和长期脑电图监测具有提示意义。

papers.title: Machine learning of connectome-wide functional connectivity in spinal muscular atrophy.
papers.authors: Li Y, Cai H, Zhang M, Yan M, Lan S, Nie H, Shen W, Yan C, Xu B, Liang Y, Tang W, Li Y, Xiang P, Chen Y.
papers.abstract: While traditional view posed SMA as a pure motor neuron disorder, accumulating evidence pointed to the broader involvement of central nervous system. This study aimed to combined connectome-wide resting-state functional connectivity with machine learning algorithms to investigate the underlying brain mechanisms in SMA and capture the potential neuroimaging biomarker. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging were acquired from 43 SMA (26 SMA type 2 and 17 type 3) and 45 healthy controls (HCs). Connectome-wide functional connectivity, defined based on the Automated Anatomical Labeling 116 atlas (AAL116), combined with machine learning algorithms including logistic regression (LR), support vector machine (SVM) and random forest (RF) were conducted for SMA vs HCs and SMA type 2 vs 3 classification. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) algorithm was used to quantify the contribution of individual connections. Connectome-wide functional connectivity allowed individual classification of SMA and HCs with stable performance across machine learning models. The majority of the most discriminative functional connectivity involved the high-level associative regions and cerebellum, subserving sensory and motor processing. Furthermore, the functional connectivity between right superior parietal gyrus and right inferior temporal gyrus was positively correlated with motor function. In conclusion, our study provided connectome-wide evidence that functional connectivity patterns involving high-level associative cortices and the cerebellum could distinguish SMA from HCs using machine learning. The identified connectivity features offer new insight into the distributed brain pathology of SMA beyond the traditional classical motor neuron view, and may serve as promising neuroimaging marker for this disease.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）是否仅为运动神经元疾病这一问题，采集SMA患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振数据，结合全连接组功能连接与多种机器学习算法进行分类，并用SHAP量化各连接的贡献。结果显示，全连接组功能连接能在各模型中较稳定地区分SMA与健康对照，最具判别力的连接多涉及高级联合皮层和小脑，参与感觉与运动加工；其中右侧顶上回与右侧颞下回之间的功能连接与运动功能呈正相关。作者据此认为，这些连接特征提示SMA存在超出经典运动神经元观点的分布式脑病理改变，并可能作为潜在的神经影像标志物，但相关关联并不代表因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Resting-state fMRI biomarkers of surgical outcome in temporal lobe epilepsy: Network reorganization, rsfMRI-based prediction models, and cognition - A systematic review.
papers.authors: Xu CMC, Marstrand-Joergensen MR, McCulloch DE, Pinborg LH.
papers.abstract: Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is a network disorder extending beyond the structurally defined epileptogenic zone. Resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI) may provide information on brain network alterations relevant to seizure outcome and cognitive risk after epilepsy surgery. We reviewed rsfMRI studies in TLE surgical cohorts to evaluate postoperative network changes, preoperative predictors of seizure outcome, and associations between functional connectivity and cognition. This systematic review followed PRISMA guidelines and was registered in PROSPERO. Fifteen studies were included, comprising 474 TLE patients who underwent resective epilepsy surgery and had at least 1 year of follow-up. Studies were reviewed for patient population, surgery, rsfMRI methodology, networks or regions, outcome definition, postoperative network changes, and cognitive assessments. Despite heterogeneity in patient selection, surgery, rsfMRI analysis, and outcome definition, studies consistently reported reduced DMN-related connectivity in TLE compared with healthy controls. Postoperative functional connectivity in seizure-free patients shifted toward healthy controls patterns in few studies. Preoperative rsfMRI-based prediction models showed promising accuracy for predicting seizure outcome but were generally developed in small cohorts and lacked external validation. Evidence relating rsfMRI to cognition was limited, but implicated thalamic, ascending reticular activating system, and thalamo-occipital connectivity in attention, language, and executive functions. RsfMRI is a promising research biomarker for network-level risk stratification in TLE surgery, particularly for seizure outcome prediction and postoperative network reorganization. Current evidence remains insufficient for clinical implementation. Future studies require larger homogeneous multicenter cohorts, standardized acquisition and preprocessing, consistent outcome definitions, systematic postoperative rsfMRI, neuropsychological assessment, and external validation of prediction models.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA规范系统梳理了颞叶癫痫手术队列的静息态功能MRI研究，关注术后网络变化、术前发作结局预测以及功能连接与认知的关联。纳入研究普遍报告患者默认网络相关连接较健康对照降低，少数研究显示术后无发作患者的连接向健康模式偏移；基于术前静息态数据的预测模型对发作结局显示出较好准确度，但多在小队列中开发且缺乏外部验证。与认知相关的证据有限，涉及丘脑及丘脑-枕叶连接等。作者认为静息态功能MRI是有前景的研究性生物标志物，但现有证据尚不足以支持临床常规应用。

papers.title: Interpersonal neural synchrony and parent-child behaviors during naturalistic interactions: A systematic review.
papers.authors: De Leener M, Sfeir M, Galdiolo S, Rossignol M.
papers.abstract: Interpersonal neural synchrony (INS), defined as the temporal alignment of neural activity between socially interacting individuals, has been proposed as an index of parent-child interaction quality. However, its relationship with moment-to-moment adjustment of parent-child behavior remains insufficiently understood. This systematic review examined associations between INS and observable behavior during naturalistic parent-child interactions, the factors influencing these associations, and the methods used to investigate them. Following PRISMA guidelines, systematic searches of Scopus, PubMed, and ScienceDirect identified 15 peer-reviewed empirical studies involving children from preschool age to early adolescence. INS-behavior associations were heterogeneous across studies. Higher INS was most consistently associated with mutual engagement, shared positive affect, and supportive parenting, whereas findings concerning reciprocity, responsiveness, and child agency were more context-dependent. Time-resolved analyses further indicated that INS fluctuated in relation to specific behavioral events and revealed temporally asymmetric patterns in which parent or child neural activity preceded that of the interaction partner. However, these patterns do not establish causal directionality and may partly reflect shared exposure to task-related or interactional inputs. Task structure and the availability of direct social cues appeared to shape INS-behavior associations, while parental stress and child social functioning emerged as potential sources of variability in INS. Methodologically, the findings highlight the value of combining micro- and macro-level behavioral coding with time-resolved and directionality-sensitive analyses, alongside stronger controls for spurious synchrony and common inputs. Given the limited number and methodological heterogeneity of available studies, the findings should be regarded as preliminary and primarily hypothesis-generating.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察自然情境下亲子互动中人际神经同步与可观察行为的关联及其影响因素和方法。同步与共同投入、共享积极情绪和支持性养育关联较一致，与互惠、回应性和儿童主动性关系更依赖情境；时间分辨分析显示同步随行为事件波动，先后模式不对称，但不能确立因果，也可能反映共同输入。任务结构和社会线索似乎塑造关联，父母压力与儿童社会功能可能是变异来源。作者强调研究有限且方法异质，结论属初步、以生成假设为主。

papers.title: White matter hyperintensities of presumed vascular origin: current understanding of development and progression.
papers.authors: Shang T.
papers.journal: Journal of stroke and cerebrovascular diseases : the official journal of National Stroke Association
papers.abstract: Background and purpose White matter hyperintensities (WMH) of presumed vascular origin are among the most common MRI manifestations of cerebral small vessel disease and are a major contributor to vascular contributions to cognitive impairment and dementia. Although WMH have traditionally been attributed to chronic ischemia resulting from small vessel pathology, the biological mechanisms underlying their development and, more importantly, their progression remain incompletely understood. Recent advances in longitudinal neuroimaging, quantitative MRI, pathology, genetics, and physiological imaging have substantially expanded our understanding of WMH progression, making this an appropriate time to evaluate current concepts and synthesize emerging evidence. Observations We review contemporary evidence regarding the biological processes implicated in WMH development and progression, including hypertension and vascular risk factors, acute ischemic injury, chronic hypoperfusion, blood-brain barrier (BBB) dysfunction, endothelial activation and vascular inflammation, arterial stiffness, intracranial artery dolichoectasia (IADE), altered cerebral fluid dynamics and genetic susceptibility. Longitudinal studies demonstrate that WMH exhibit dynamic trajectories characterized by progression, stability, and partial regression, indicating that lesion evolution is not uniformly irreversible. Pathological and advanced neuroimaging studies show that WMH represent heterogeneous tissue injury involving demyelination, axonal loss, gliosis, interstitial fluid accumulation, and microvascular abnormalities. Hypertension and blood pressure variability are consistently associated with greater WMH burden and progression, whereas baseline WMH burden is the strongest predictor of future lesion expansion. Acute ischemic lesions detected by diffusion-weighted imaging contribute to, but account for only a minority of WMH progression. Longitudinal studies evaluating cerebral perfusion, BBB permeability, inflammation, arterial stiffness, IADE and cerebral fluid dynamics have yielded variable findings but, together with genetic evidence, support roles of BBB leakage, vascular inflammation, chronic hypoperfusion, arterial and extracellular-matrix remodeling, and impaired interstitial fluid clearance in WMH progression. Conclusions Emerging evidence supports a paradigm in which WMH are viewed as a dynamic manifestation of progressive neurovascular dysfunction rather than the consequence of chronic ischemia alone. Current data suggest that early neurovascular injury evolves into a potentially self-reinforcing process characterized by persistent BBB disruption, vascular inflammation, chronic hypoperfusion, altered fluid dynamics, and recurrent ischemic injury, collectively contributes to WMH progression. Future multimodal longitudinal studies integrating cerebral hemodynamics, neurovascular function and intracranial arterial remodeling will be essential to understand WMH progression.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了推测为血管源性白质高信号（WMH）发生与进展的生物学机制，整合了纵向神经影像、定量MRI、病理、遗传和生理影像等方面的证据。文章指出，WMH并非慢性缺血的单一后果，而是异质性组织损伤，其演变呈进展、稳定甚至部分消退的动态轨迹；高血压和血压变异性与WMH负荷及进展相关，基线WMH负荷是未来病灶扩展的最强预测因素，而弥散加权成像所见的急性缺血灶仅能解释少部分进展。作者据此提出，WMH是进行性神经血管功能障碍的动态表现，早期损伤可能经血脑屏障破坏、血管炎症、慢性低灌注、流体动力学改变和反复缺血等过程形成自我强化的进展循环，并强调未来需开展整合脑血流动力学、神经血管功能和颅内动脉重塑的多模态纵向研究。

papers.title: Stage-dependent gray matter morphological alterations across the clinical spectrum of depressive disorder.
papers.authors: Xu K, Wu B, Zhao Z, Shao Y, Li L, Jia Z.
papers.abstract: Background Previous studies have reported gray matter volume (GMV) deficits in different illness stages of depression; however, whether patients at different stages show shared or distinct GMV abnormality patterns has not been systematically characterized. Methods We conducted a quantitative voxel-wise meta-analysis of whole-brain voxel-based morphometry studies in individuals with subthreshold depression (STD), first-episode drug-naïve depression (FEND), and long-term major depressive disorder (MDD). Separate, pooled and comparative meta-analyses were performed using the seed-based d mapping (SDM) toolbox. Meta-regression analyses were conducted to explore age- and disease-related alterations in depression. Results Twelve studies including 467 individuals with STD, 19 studies including 854 patients with FEND, and 14 studies including 525 patients with long-term depression were included. Compared with controls, STD and FEND exhibited mixed patterns of GMV increases and decreases predominantly involving key emotional and default mode network regions. In contrast, long-term MDD showed consolidated GMV reductions confined to the paracingulate gyrus and left middle temporal gyrus extending to insula. Direct comparisons across stages confirmed that GMV alterations in prefrontal and temporal regions showed progressive divergence from early to chronic depression. Meta-regression analyses revealed stage-specific associations between clinical characteristics and GMV changes. Conclusions This meta-analysis reveals stage-specific GMV abnormalities across depression. GMV changes shift from mixed alterations in early stages to purely atrophic reductions in chronic MDD, supporting a progressive model. Fronto-limbic deficits at the subthreshold stage may serve as early vulnerability markers, while GMV consolidation in long-term MDD underscores the importance of early intervention.

papers.title: Intrinsic and extrinsic connectivity of the seizure onset zone at rest and during stimulation.
papers.authors: LaRocque JJ, Ojemann WKS, Xu J, Lucas A, Sinha N, Cornblath EJ, Armstrong C, Tomlinson S, Marsh ED, Sinha SR, Litt B, Davis KA, Cao Q, Conrad EC.
papers.abstract: Background About half of patients who undergo epilepsy surgery for drug-resistant epilepsy have seizure recurrence, supporting the need for approaches that more accurately identify the epileptogenic zone, defined as the brain areas whose removal causes cessation of seizures. Altered network connectivity has emerged as a candidate biomarker of the epileptogenic zone, but how connectivity is altered in the epileptogenic zone remains uncertain, with prior studies reporting inconsistent results. Hypothesis We hypothesized that a difference in intrinsic versus extrinsic connectivity of the epileptogenic zone may explain prior discrepant findings. Methods We retrospectively studied a multicenter cohort of 37 adult and 42 pediatric patients who underwent intracranial EEG recording and brain stimulation as part of epilepsy surgery planning. We measured spontaneous connectivity using Pearson correlation and perturbational connectivity using stimulation evoked potentials, modeling the connectivity according to the location of contacts in relation to the seizure onset zone while controlling for inter-electrode distance. Results For both adult and pediatric patients, resting connectivity was higher within compared to outside the seizure onset zone. However, resting connectivity between channels within and outside seizure onset zone was reduced. Stimulation connectivity followed a similar pattern, with elevated connectivity within the seizure onset zone but reduced connectivity from within to outside seizure onset zone. Significance These results support the hypothesis that the seizure onset zone is disconnected from the rest of the brain but intrinsically hyperconnected. This result helps reconcile prior inconsistencies across studies, aligns with basic science studies, and suggests an approach for future translational work aiming to localize the epileptogenic zone.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注耐药性癫痫患者致痫区网络连接改变方向不一致的问题，提出致痫区内部与外部连接可能存在差异的假设。作者回顾性分析多中心接受颅内脑电记录与脑刺激的成人和儿童患者，分别测量静息自发连接和刺激诱发连接，并控制电极间距。结果在两组人群中一致：致痫区内部连接高于外部，而致痫区与外部之间的连接减弱，刺激连接呈相似模式。作者据此认为致痫区表现为内部超连接但与大脑其余部分连接减弱，这一框架有助于调和既往研究矛盾，并为致痫区定位的转化研究提供思路。

papers.title: Along-tract statistical mapping of white matter abnormalities in children with SeLECTS.
papers.authors: Xu G, Zhang Y, Huang K, Liu J, Song G, Chen X, Zeng L, Zhang Y, Liu H, Zhang T.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Emerging evidence suggests that self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes (SeLECTS) may reflect atypical neurodevelopment. As WM maturation extends from the second trimester through adolescence, this study aimed to identify regions of delayed or aberrant white matter (WM) development in children with SeLECTS using along-tract statistical mapping for precise localization of microstructural alterations. Materials and methods 38 children with SeLECTS and 31 healthy controls underwent diffusion-weighted MRI scan. Fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD), and radial diffusivity (RD) were derived from the diffusion tensor model. Whole-brain tractography was performed using deterministic EuDX tracking and registered to a standardized bundle atlas in MNI space. Thirty WM tracts per subject were extracted. Linear mixed models within the BUAN tractometry framework were used to assess segment wise group differences, while partial correlations were performed to evaluate associations between diffusion metrics and cognitive performance. FDR correction was applied per bundle for all comparisons. Results After FDR correction, children with SeLECTS showed increased MD in the forceps minor, midbody of the corpus callosum, right corticospinal tract, right extreme capsule, and bilateral uncinate fasciculi. MD values in the affected WM segments showed negative correlations with performance and full-scale IQ, and the segments showing significant correlations overlapped with those showing significant group differences. Conclusions SeLECTS is associated with MD-based microstructural alterations in superficial frontal, temporal, and parietal pathways, potentially indicating delayed white matter maturation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注伴中央颞区棘波的自我限定性癫痫（SeLECTS）儿童是否存在白质发育延迟或异常，采用弥散加权MRI和沿纤维束统计映射，比较患儿与健康对照的白质微结构并考察其与认知表现的关系。结果显示，患儿在额钳、胼胝体中部、右侧皮质脊髓束、右侧极外囊及双侧钩束等纤维束节段出现平均弥散率升高，且这些节段的弥散指标与认知表现和全量表智商呈负相关，相关节段与组间差异节段重叠。作者据此认为，SeLECTS与额、颞、顶叶浅表通路的弥散率改变有关，可能提示白质成熟延迟；但这是组间关联，尚不能说明因果关系或临床治疗效果。

papers.title: Engineering composites inspired cortical-trabecular interlocking effect underlies bone strength in mouse vertebrae.
papers.authors: Mao R, Li Q, Yao J, Song C, Wang L, Fan Y.
papers.abstract: Bone strength is a major determinant of osteoporotic fracture risk. Current clinical assessments, however, rely primarily on imaging-based surrogates such as bone mineral density, offering limited insight into the integrated mechanical behavior of vertebral bone. Inspired by engineered composite structures, in which interfacial interactions substantially enhance mechanical properties, this study introduces the concept of the cortical-trabecular interlocking effect to characterize the mechanical integration between these two compartments and investigate its contribution to vertebral bone strength. Micro-finite element models of mouse L4 vertebrae (control, mild, and severe osteoporosis) and idealized vertebral models were employed to quantify the independent contributions of isolated cortical bone, isolated trabecular bone, and the cortical-trabecular interlocking effect to whole-bone mechanical properties under axial load. To better characterize the cortical-trabecular interlocking effect, we propose a novel microstructural parameter, Lr.BV/TV, defined as the bone volume fraction within the interlocking ring, an interface region where cortical and trabecular bone are structurally integrated. The cortical-trabecular interlocking effect contributed 12.2-26.1% (mean 19.5%) to vertebral yield strength and its magnitude varied systematically with osteoporosis severity. Notably, asynchronous deterioration of cortical and trabecular bone in osteoporosis constrained the effective utilization of the interlocking effect, whereas well-matched components maximized this effect. Lr.BV/TV was identified as the dominant predictor of vertebral strength and outperformed both cortical thickness and trabecular bone volume fraction, accounting for 45.83% of the total explained variance, with its predictive relevance varying across stages of osteoporosis. These findings advance our understanding of vertebral fragility.

papers.title: Neurovascular Coupling and Subclinical White Matter Alterations in Young Adults with Migraine without Aura: A Multimodal MRI and Machine Learning Study.
papers.authors: Chen Y, Kong Y, Zhang J, Wang H, Zhan S, Wang B, Tan W, Xu J.
papers.abstract: Rationale and objectives Young adults with migraine without aura (MwoA) may exhibit subtle white matter abnormalities, but their relationships with neurovascular measures, neurotransmitter distributions, and clinical burden remain unclear. We investigated these multimodal imaging associations in MwoA. Materials and methods A total of 130 patients with MwoA and 110 healthy controls (HCs) were enrolled. Multimodal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was used to quantify white matter hyperintensity volume, free water (FW) fraction, peak width of skeletonized mean diffusivity (PSMD), and global neurovascular coupling (NVC); the regional measure was the cerebral blood flow (CBF)/fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) ratio. Regional CBF/fALFF ratio alterations were spatially correlated with canonical neurotransmitter maps. Correlation, chain mediation, and machine-learning analyses were performed. Results Relative to HCs, patients with MwoA showed increased global FW fraction and PSMD and reduced global NVC. Decreased regional CBF/fALFF ratios involved sensorimotor, striatal, and cingulate regions. The spatial pattern of NVC abnormalities was positively associated with 5-HT1A, D1, DAT, and GABAergic maps, and negatively associated with D2 and noradrenaline transporter maps. FW fraction, PSMD, and regional CBF/fALFF ratio alterations were associated with migraine-related clinical indices. Random forest yielded the numerically highest area under the curve (0.866). Exploratory mediation analysis indicated that FW and PSMD statistically accounted for part of the association between regional CBF/fALFF ratios and clinical severity. Conclusion Young adults with MwoA exhibited subtle white matter microstructural abnormalities, reduced global NVC, and altered regional CBF/fALFF ratios. These cross-sectional findings suggest a potentially clinically relevant multimodal imaging pattern but require longitudinal and independent validation.
keywords: Peak Width Of Skeletonized Mean Diffusivity
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在无先兆偏头痛年轻成人中考察白质微结构、神经血管耦合与临床负担之间的关系，采用多模态磁共振成像结合相关、中介和机器学习分析，并与健康对照比较。结果显示，患者整体白质自由水分数和骨架化平均弥散度峰宽升高、全局神经血管耦合降低，局部脑血流与低频涨落振幅比值下降涉及感觉运动、纹状体和扣带区域；这些异常的空间分布与多种神经递质图谱相关，白质指标也与偏头痛临床指标相关。随机森林分类的曲线下面积在数值上最高，探索性中介分析提示白质指标可统计上解释局部耦合比值与临床严重度关联的一部分。作者据此提出一种可能具有临床意义的多模态影像模式，但强调这是横断面发现，尚需纵向和独立验证，不能据此推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Altered brain function and its spatial correlations with neurotransmitter maps in anterior shoulder pain patients.
papers.authors: Diao Z, Li H, Li Y, Liu C, Zheng Y, Lu J, Liu Y, Wei Z, Liu P, Qiao H.
papers.abstract: Neuroimaging studies have reported that chronic pain may be associated with brain functional changes and related molecular mechanisms. However, there are few studies in anterior shoulder pain (ASP). Thus, we aimed to assess the possible brain functional changes and their associations with neurotransmitter receptor maps in ASP patients. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data were obtained from 27 ASP patients and 20 healthy controls (HCs). Regional homogeneity (ReHo) and fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (fALFF) methods were used to examine altered brain functions. JuSpace toolbox was employed for evaluating the spatial correlations between ReHo and fALFF changes and neurotransmitter receptor maps. Regression analysis was conducted to explore the associations between neuroimaging findings and clinical characteristics in ASP patients. Furthermore, we investigated reliable biomarkers to distinguish ASP patients from HCs using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. ASP patients had abnormal ReHo/fALFF in the middle temporal gyrus, putamen, caudate, pallidum, precentral gyrus, medial prefrontal cortex, precuneus, posterior cingulate cortex and inferior temporal gyrus. ReHo/fALFF alterations in ASP patients were associated with the serotonin, dopamine, GABA, choline, glutamate and norepinephrine neurotransmitter systems. Visual analog scale was positively correlated with ReHo in the right insula. Moreover, ROC analysis showed higher classification accuracy in the middle temporal gyrus, precentral gyrus and putamen. Our study investigated abnormal brain function and associated neurotransmitter receptor maps in ASP patients, which may contribute to improving our understanding of the pathophysiological mechanisms in ASP.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注前肩痛患者是否存在脑功能改变及其与神经递质受体分布的空间关联，采用静息态功能磁共振比较患者与健康对照的局部一致性和低频波动振幅。结果显示，患者多个脑区出现异常活动，且这些改变与血清素、多巴胺、GABA、胆碱、谷氨酸和去甲肾上腺素等递质系统存在空间相关；视觉模拟评分与右侧岛叶局部一致性正相关，部分脑区还显示出一定的分类区分能力。作者认为，这些发现有助于理解前肩痛的病理生理机制，但相关分析不能说明因果关系，其临床价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Microglia in Perioperative Neurocognitive Disorders: Pathogenic Mechanisms and Emerging Concepts of Microglial Heterogeneity.
papers.authors: Wang H, Wang X, Ai Q, Pei D.
papers.abstract: Perioperative neurocognitive disorders (PND) comprise a spectrum of cognitive disturbances after anesthesia and surgery, affecting learning, memory, and executive function. Although systemic inflammation, surgical trauma, anesthetic exposure, and patient vulnerability have been implicated in PND, the mechanisms linking perioperative stress to persistent cognitive changes remain incompletely understood. Microglia, as resident immune cells of the central nervous system, are important regulators of neuroimmune interactions and may contribute to PND through alterations in inflammatory signaling, synaptic regulation, vascular function, metabolism, and epigenetic programs. In this Overview, we summarize current evidence regarding microglial involvement in PND across five interconnected domains: neuroinflammation, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, microglia-neuron communication, mitochondrial and metabolic regulation, and epigenetic remodeling. We further discuss emerging single-cell transcriptomic and multi-omic studies indicating that microglial responses are heterogeneous, dynamic, and context dependent rather than adequately described by the traditional M1/M2 framework. We propose that PND involves complex interactions among peripheral immune activation, neurovascular dysfunction, microglial state transitions, and neuronal vulnerability. Finally, we highlight current challenges in translating microglial mechanisms into clinical applications and discuss future directions for identifying biomarkers and developing context-specific perioperative neuroprotective strategies.

papers.title: Bidirectional Regulatory Mechanisms of T cell-microglia Interactions in Cerebral Ischemic Disease: Molecular Crosstalk, Experimental Techniques and Therapeutic Implications.
papers.authors: Zheng Y, Cheng J, Li F, Ren Z, Chen C, Zhang Z, Lan X, Zhang C, Zhao Y, Han J, Li J, Cheng F, Wang Q, Li C, Wang X.
papers.abstract: Cerebral ischemic diseases, such as ischemic stroke (IS) and vascular dementia (VaD), are major causes of neurological disability and mortality. Neuroinflammation acts as a pivotal driver of secondary brain injury, mediated by intricate bidirectional interactions between peripheral T cells and central nervous system (CNS)-resident microglia. This review delineates the molecular mechanisms underlying T cell-microglia crosstalk in cerebral ischemia, emphasizing their dual roles in exacerbating neurotoxicity and promoting repair. Direct interactions involve antigen presentation via MHC-TCR engagement and co-stimulatory checkpoints (e.g., CD80/CD86-CD28, PD-L1-PD-1), which regulate T cell activation and microglial polarization. Direct signaling through cytokines (IFN-γ, IL-4, IL-17, IL-10) further modulates microglial phenotypes: Th1/Th17 cells drive pro-inflammatory M1 polarization via STAT1/NF-κB pathways, while Tregs/Th2 cells induce anti-inflammatory M2 states through STAT6/SMAD signaling. Spatial transcriptomics and single-cell omics reveal spatiotemporal dynamics of these interactions, identifying STAT1/STAT6 imbalance as a critical determinant of neuroinflammatory outcomes. Advanced methodologies, including two-photon intravital microscopy and microfluidic blood-brain barrier (BBB) models, enable real-time visualization of immune cell trafficking and synaptic communication. Therapeutically, targeting immune checkpoints (CTLA-4, PD-1) or cytokine pathways (e.g., IL-4 mimetics) shows promise in recalibrating neuroimmune responses. However, challenges such as blood-brain barrier impermeability to biologics and interspecies immune heterogeneity necessitate innovative delivery strategies. This review integrates molecular, cellular, and technological insights to propose a framework for precision immunomodulation. By elucidating context-dependent signaling nodes and leveraging emerging tools, the study underscores the potential of harnessing T cell-microglia crosstalk to mitigate neuroinflammation and enhance neural repair, offering transformative avenues for stroke and dementia therapy.

papers.title: Differential resting-state functional connectivity of anterior and posterior cerebellar divisions with canonical networks in PTSD
papers.authors: Tunstall L, Steele N, Hussain A, Russell C, Beakas J, Huggins A, Stevens J, Ressler K, Jovanovic T, van Rooij S, Fani N, Daniels J, Sierk A, Manthey A, Walter H, Grupe D, Nitschke J, Davidson R, Baugh L, Simons R, Simons J, Magnotta V, Fercho K, Zhu Y, Li G, Wang L, Morey R, Sun D.
papers.journal: Journal of mood and anxiety disorders

papers.title: Human brain white matter charts in international populations
papers.authors: Huo Y, Zhang C, Ren F, Han T, Gao Y, Wang J, Ding J, Le L, Ou P, Bai T, Shen M, Feng G, Huang T, Li X, Chen Y, Jing R, Liu L, Tao S, Huang W, Cheng J, Su L, Zhang B, Xu Y, Ji G, Sun Y, Cao Q, Han Y, Ma G, He Y, Zuo X, Liu Y, Dong Q, Zhang Z, Shu N, Chinese Child Brain Development (CCBD) Consortium.
papers.abstract: Brain charts provide normative references for identifying neurodevelopmental milestones and clinically meaningful deviations. Existing white matter (WM) charts are derived predominantly from European and North American populations, limiting generalizability. Here, we established the first set of population-specific WM charts of 198 morphological and microstructural phenotypes for both Chinese (N=19,215) and Western (N=15,584) populations across the human lifespan. Developmental trajectories and spatial organization of WM maturation and degeneration were broadly conserved across the populations, whereas maturational timing varied across pathways and metrics. The Chinese population showed earlier maturation in several projection and sensorimotor pathways, but more protracted maturation in higher-order association and limbic pathways. Chinese population-matched charts more accurately predicted WM phenotypes and detected more extreme disease-related deviations in brain health in the Chinese population than Western-derived models. Individual deviation patterns further discriminated patients from healthy controls and predicted cognitive performance and plasma biomarkers. Our findings reveal population-specific WM maturation and show that reference-population mismatch can reduce the accuracy and clinical sensitivity of normative brain charts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有白质脑图谱主要基于欧美人群、外推性有限的问题，分别构建了中国与西方人群覆盖全生命周期的白质形态学和微结构表型图谱。结果显示，两大人群白质发育与退化的总体轨迹及空间组织大体一致，但成熟时间因通路和指标而异：中国人群在部分投射和感觉运动通路上成熟更早，而在高阶联合和边缘通路上成熟更晚。与中国人群匹配的图谱比西方模型更准确地预测白质表型，并在脑健康评估中检出更多极端疾病相关偏差；个体偏差模式还能区分患者与健康对照，并预测认知表现和血浆生物标志物。作者据此指出，参考人群不匹配会降低规范性脑图谱的准确性和临床敏感性。

papers.title: Responses to unannounced rule changes in adults with developmental disabilities: A community-based pilot study with consumer-grade EEG
papers.authors: Jeong Y, Hyun S.
papers.abstract: Unannounced changes in rules or environments often precede challenging behavior and limit community participation for adults with developmental disabilities, yet their responses to change have rarely been quantified directly. We recruited adults with developmental disabilities, including those with intellectual disability, at a community day-service center. We administered a probabilistic reversal learning task and recorded resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) via a 14-channel wireless EEG system. Among the 12 adults who performed the task, total errors were comparable across participants (range 31–57), whereas a switch bias index, contrasting perseverative errors (persisting with the previously correct option) with regressive errors (failing to maintain the newly correct option), ranged from −0.96 to +0.91. In the 9 participants included in resting-state EEG analyses, a flatter aperiodic spectrum over the frontal cluster (preregistered, but selected as the focus post hoc) was associated with fewer switches after negative feedback (ρ = .80) and more perseverative errors (ρ = −.72). The preregistered parieto-occipital cluster showed the same direction (ρ = .69, 95% confidence interval [−.11, .97], n = 8), which was opposite to the preregistered prediction. Frontal alpha peak amplitude was associated with accuracy (ρ = .77), and the between-run reliability of resting-state measures was .82–.99. These findings provide preliminary evidence that EEG recorded in community settings can capture individual differences in how people respond to change. Field measurement that includes people with intellectual disability may help extend the evidence base for the Sustainable Development Goals of good health and well-being (SDG 3) and reduced inequalities (SDG 10).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在社区日间服务中心招募发育障碍成人，用概率反转学习任务和便携式静息态脑电，考察他们对未预告规则变化的反应能否被直接量化。结果显示，参与者的总错误数相近，但切换偏向指数差异很大，从明显固着于旧选项到难以维持新选项不等；额区非周期频谱越平坦，负反馈后切换越少、固着性错误越多，而预先设定的顶枕区结果方向与预期相反。作者据此认为，社区环境下采集的脑电有望捕捉个体应对变化的差异，但样本小、部分分析为事后选择，只能视为初步证据。

papers.title: Clinical referral text overrides MRI evidence in multimodal large language models: glioma versus brain abscess
papers.authors: Beste NC, Bauer F, Lopez N, Schömig T, Schönfeld M, Zopfs D, Goertz L, Persigehl T, Kabbasch C, Schlamann M, Maintz D, Gertz RJ, Weitzer N, Kottlors J.
papers.abstract: Objectives To determine how strongly clinical referral text, rather than image content, drives the decisions of multimodal large language models (LLMs) differentiating glioma from brain abscess on MRI. Materials and methods This retrospective single-center study included 60 contrast-enhanced T1-weighted brain MRI examinations (30 gliomas, 30 abscesses; reference-standard diagnosis). One axial slice per case was paired with five referral texts (explicitly inflammatory to explicitly tumor-suggestive) under three prompt instructions and submitted 20 times each to GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Qwen 3.6 (72,000 answers). The primary outcome was the text-driven span (difference in tumor-call frequency between explicit inflammatory and explicit tumor text). Two blinded radiologists classified the images without text; sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy were compared descriptively. Results Patients (29 women) had a mean age of 55.8 ± 16.4 years. With neutral text, models answered tumor in 45–67% of queries (specificity, 0.38–0.78), versus 52% and 60% for radiologists (specificity, 0.77 and 0.63). The text-driven span was 0.79–1.00 ( p < 0.001 for all models), whereas confirmed gliomas and abscesses differed by only 0.01–0.10 in three models and 0.25 in Gemini 3.5 Flash. Subtle wording produced at least 83% of the span in three models. An instruction to ignore the text reduced the span to 0.48–0.70 in three models and to 0.04 in Gemini 3.5 Flash, partly through reversion to a tumor default. Model accuracy was 0.52–0.73 versus 0.78 and 0.73 for radiologists. Conclusion Multimodal LLMs deferred to referral text over imaging evidence in differentiating glioma from brain abscess, and prompt instructions did not reliably correct this. Key Points Question Multimodal large language models receive images together with clinical referral text, but how strongly the text rather than the image determines their diagnosis is unknown. Findings Changing only the referral text largely reversed the glioma-versus-abscess decision for identical MRI images in four models; instructions to ignore the text reduced this inconsistently. Clinical relevance Before clinical use, multimodal large language models require model- and task-specific testing of their susceptibility to referral text, because instructing them to prioritize the image is not a dependable safeguard against text-driven misdiagnosis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察多模态大语言模型在区分胶质瘤与脑脓肿时，其判断究竟更多由MRI图像还是转诊文本驱动。作者用同一批增强T1加权脑MRI切片搭配从明显提示炎症到明显提示肿瘤的五种转诊文本，在多种提示指令下反复查询四个模型，并与两位盲法阅片放射科医生的判断作描述性比较。结果显示，仅改变转诊文本就几乎能完全翻转模型对同一图像的诊断，而真实胶质瘤与脓肿之间的差异很小；即便要求模型忽略文本，这种文本驱动效应也只在部分模型中减弱，且部分源于模型回退到偏向肿瘤的默认判断。作者据此指出，在临床使用前需针对具体模型和任务检验其对转诊文本的敏感性，仅靠指令要求优先依据图像并不可靠。

papers.title: Morphometric Brain Networks at Ultra-Low Field: A First Assessment of Feasibility and Reliability
papers.authors: Karoui H, Bourke NJ, Cole JH, Yeow RW, Dick F, Razin R, Thomas DL, Schröder KWR, Cash DM, Bocchetta M, Williams SC, Váša F.
papers.abstract: Background Ultra-low field (ULF) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) offers accessible point-of-care neuroimag-ing, yet its capability to support multivariate network analyses remains understudied. Methods We systematically evaluated the feasibility and reliability of Morphometric Similarity Networks (MSN) and Morphometric Inverse Divergence (MIND) networks derived from paired high-field (HF, 3T/1.5T) and ULF (64mT) scans in a primary cohort (N=23) and an independent replication cohort (N=19). We tested the impact of super-resolution processing, cortical parcellation granularity (Desikan-Killiany vs. Destrieux), and mesh resolution (fsnative vs. fsaverage5) on edge-level cross-scanner agreement (Lin’s concordance correlation coefficient, CCC) and subject-level identifiability. Results MIND networks demonstrated higher edge-level HF-ULF agreement (mean CCC = 0.95) and ULF reproducibility (mean CCC = 0.98) compared to MSNs (mean CCC = 0.86-0.87 and 0.91-0.94, respectively). In contrast, MSNs yielded higher subject-level differential identifiability across field strengths due to a broader dis-tinction between within- and between-subject similarity. Reconstructing MIND networks on native high-resolution meshes (fsnative) maximised cross-scanner agreement, whereas coarser meshes and finer cortical parcellations enhanced individual network identifiability. Conclusions Structural similarity networks can be reliably constructed from ULF MRI data. Optimal analytic choices depend on study objectives: MIND on native meshes maximises cross-scanner stability, whereas MSNs excel at preserving individual uniqueness, paving the way for globally scalable connectomic research.

papers.title: Hidden Markov Modeling Reveals Altered Functional Network Dynamics in Multiple Sclerosis
papers.authors: Hiremath KC, Hobbs DA, Hettish DMR, Khan E, Alias BP, Lin MM, Fox PT, Chiang FL.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Purpose Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a neurodegenerative and demyelinating disease of the central nervous system. Recent evidence suggests that localized gray matter atrophy in MS may be involved in distributed functional brain networks. However, the dynamic trajectory of functional network alterations in MS remains unclear. The current study extends prior network-mediated findings and aims to investigate the dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) and energetic landscape across an atrophy-prone network in MS. Methods Twenty MS participants and twenty healthy controls (HC) underwent resting-state fMRI. The atrophy-based functional network (AFN) model was implemented, and time series from atrophy-prone regions were fit to a 12-state hidden Markov model. Each functional network state, a recurring pattern of activity across the AFN, was characterized by the AFN regions with the strongest activation. The states were then grouped into two metastates. Dynamic functional network metrics were compared between groups by permutation testing and correlated with disability and cognition. The energetic landscape of the network was mapped with a pairwise maximum-entropy model. Temporal irreversibility was also measured, which defines the arrow-of-time asymmetry of network dynamics. Results People with MS showed lower occupancy of state 1, which peaked on the right middle frontal and anterior cingulate cortex. Occupancy and mean lifetime were higher in states 3 and 10 (p < 0.05). In state 3, cortical activity was below the network average, and state 10 peaked on the postcentral gyrus. At the metastate level, MS participants spent more time in metastate M1 and less in M2 (p = 0.04). Within the MS group, a longer interval between visits to state 3 was associated with greater disability (r = 0.57), and a higher switching rate in state 10 with poorer verbal fluency (r = −0.50). The energetic landscape was similar between groups. Temporal irreversibility was lower in MS, mainly across subcortical connections. Conclusion MS participants dwelled longer in specific dFC states of the AFN, while the rate of transition between states did not differ from healthy controls. Dynamic functional network metrics were associated with disability and cognitive performance and may serve as functional correlates of clinical impairment. The states were similar between groups, whereas the directed drive between states was lower across subcortical connections. This pattern suggests altered network dynamics rather than altered network architecture in MS. Findings from this study characterize the functional network dynamics of neurodegeneration in MS, which may inform future development of network-based approaches for monitoring disease progression.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注多发性硬化患者易萎缩功能网络中的动态功能连接及其能量景观，采用静息态fMRI结合隐马尔可夫模型，比较患者与健康对照的功能网络状态及转换特征。结果显示，患者在某些特定状态上的停留时间更长，状态间转换速率与健康对照无差异，且状态本身在两组间相似；患者的时间不可逆性较低，主要体现在皮层下连接上。在患者组内，部分状态访问间隔和切换率与残疾程度、言语流畅性相关。作者据此认为，多发性硬化更多表现为网络动态的改变而非网络架构的改变，这些动态指标或可作为临床损害的功能相关物，但相关关系不等于因果，其临床应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Spectral power and functional connectivity of resting EEG in people exposed to armed conflict and controls
papers.authors: Nitola-Pulido L, Bonilla DS, Herrera Murcia E, Reyes Gavilan PA, Santamaria-Garcia H.
