papers.abstract: Exposure to armed conflict can leave persistent effects on mental health, yet its neurophysiological correlates remain poorly characterized, particularly in populations exposed to prolonged violence outside narrowly defined post traumatic stress disorder samples. Here we examined resting state electroencephalographic activity in 122 Colombian adults, including 74 participants exposed to armed conflict and 48 controls. Eyes closed EEG was analysed for 240 seconds per participant. We quantified absolute and relative spectral power across delta, theta, alpha and beta bands and regional functional connectivity using weighted phase lag index in theta, alpha and beta. Group comparisons were adjusted for age, education, sex and assessment year, with correction across 78 EEG contrasts. Median occipital and global alpha power was lower in exposed participants, although adjusted estimates were close to the null and confidence intervals were broad. Temporal theta relative power was lower in exposed participants at nominal significance, but this association did not survive Holm correction. No spectral power or regional connectivity contrast remained significant after multiple testing correction. Exploratory associations between EEG measures and MoCA performance were modest in participants with confirmed scores. These findings provide a systematic characterization of resting EEG after exposure to armed conflict in a population shaped by prolonged violence and displacement. They also indicate that large or widespread alterations in resting spectral power and connectivity were not detectable with the current sample and analytical framework, while defining candidate signals and methodological priorities for larger studies of conflict related brain health.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察长期暴露于武装冲突是否会在静息脑电的频谱功率和功能连接上留下可检测的痕迹，对象为哥伦比亚成年人，比较暴露组与对照组，并分析闭眼静息脑电的绝对与相对频谱功率及区域功能连接。结果显示，在多重比较校正后，没有一项频谱功率或区域连接对比保持显著；枕区与全局α功率在暴露组中看似较低，但校正后的估计接近零且置信区间较宽，颞区θ相对功率的差异也未通过校正。作者据此指出，在当前样本和分析框架下未能检出广泛或大幅度的静息脑电改变，同时为更大规模研究提示了候选信号和方法学重点。

papers.title: Longitudinal associations between neuropsychiatric symptoms, structural and perfusion MRI changes in older adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment
papers.authors: Lombardi G, Leung CC, Burge R, Zelaya F, Bhattacharyya S, Velayudhan L.
papers.abstract: Neuropsychiatric symptoms (NPS) are highly prevalent in Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), conceptualized as an intermediate clinical state between normal aging and dementia. Although neuroimaging studies have reported associations between NPS and brain alterations in MCI, longitudinal evidence on NPS and their relationship with multimodal MRI measures remains limited. We aimed to investigate (1) longitudinal changes in NPS, volumetric assessment and measurement of regional cerebral blood flow (CBF) within the medial temporal lobe (MTL); (2) associations between longitudinal changes in MRI measures and NPS; (3) whether baseline MRI measures predicted longitudinal changes in NPS. Thirty individuals with MCI aged over 65 years were recruited, of whom eighteen followed up for a mean period of 29 ± 8.9 months. There were significant reductions in total grey matter and white matter volumes, together with volume loss in the bilateral hippocampus, bilateral parahippocampal gyrus and right entorhinal cortex (p FDR< 0.05) over the follow up period. Volume loss in the right parahippocampal gyrus was associated with increase in aggression (p FDR <0.01), and CBF increase in the right hippocampus and parahippocampal gyrus was associated with worsening in agitation (p FDR <0.01). Furthermore, lower baseline volume of the right entorhinal cortex was associated with increase in aggression, and lower baseline CBF in the right hippocampus and parahippocampal gyrus was associated with worsening of agitation (p FDR <0.05). Our findings highlight the importance of identifying NPS in individuals with MCI and the role of structural and perfusion MRI measures as promising biomarkers for monitoring disease progression and improving risk prediction of conversion to dementia.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究追踪轻度认知障碍老年人，考察神经精神症状与内侧颞叶结构及灌注MRI指标在纵向上的关联。随访期间可见灰质、白质及双侧海马、海马旁回和右侧内嗅皮层体积下降；右侧海马旁回体积损失与攻击性增加相关，右侧海马及海马旁回血流增加与激越加重相关。基线右侧内嗅皮层体积较低与攻击性增加相关，基线右侧海马及海马旁回血流较低与激越加重相关。作者据此认为，结构和灌注MRI指标有望作为监测疾病进展和预测向痴呆转化的候选生物标志物，但样本量小、随访有限，相关发现尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Alpha-range neural oscillations are associated with multiple dynamic brain networks
papers.authors: Nomi J, Román-López T, Chang F, Friedman-Jha A, Truong H, Diaz-Fong J, Chang C, Karalunas S, Phadikar S, Calhoun V, Dillon A, Loo S, Lenartowicz A.
papers.abstract: We asked whether alpha range (8-12 Hz) EEG neural oscillations, a robust indicator of cortical excitability, are associated with dynamic BOLD brain networks. Two independent EEG-fMRI resting-state datasets (discovery: n = 94 and replication: n = 33) show that low-and high-alpha periods are associated with dynamic BOLD coactivation patterns (dCAPS) involving multiple dynamic networks rather than a single static network. Unique BOLD dCAPs consisting of visual cortex activation along with sensorimotor and attention networks in addition to the posterior thalamus, were mainly associated with periods of low-alpha power. However, overlapping BOLD dCAPs consisting of default, control, and attention networks were associated with periods of both low-and high-alpha power. The results suggest low-alpha dCAPS contain unique temporal-dependent configurations related to visual, sensorimotor, and attention networks while both low-and high-alpha dCAPs consist of overlapping temporal-dependent configurations involving CON, DMN, and attention networks involved in internal and external cognition. These findings reconcile discrepancies across static connectivity EEG-fMRI findings by showing that distinct transient BOLD configurations are associated with similar patterns of alpha EEG modulation in visual cortex, providing a dynamic framework for the gating function of alpha oscillations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察alpha频段（8–12 Hz）脑电振荡是否与动态BOLD脑网络相关，基于两个独立的静息态EEG-fMRI数据集进行分析。结果显示，低alpha与高alpha时段对应的是涉及多个网络的动态BOLD共激活模式，而非单一静态网络：低alpha时段主要伴随包含视觉皮层、感觉运动与注意网络以及后丘脑的独特模式，而默认网络、控制网络与注意网络重叠的模式则在低、高alpha时段均出现。作者据此认为，不同的瞬时BOLD配置可与视觉皮层相似的alpha调制相关联，这为调和既往静态连接EEG-fMRI研究间的差异提供了动态框架，并将alpha振荡的门控功能置于动态视角下理解。

papers.title: Hippocampal-somatomotor coactivation and perceived benefit following Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for Life in healthcare students: An exploratory randomized study
papers.authors: Clairis N, Saccaro L, Delplanque S, Holman C, Celen Z, Cachet C, Serquet C, Meuleman B, Bondolfi G, Jermann F, Rudaz S, Piguet C.
papers.abstract: Mindfulness-based interventions are known to enhance emotion regulation and stress management, yet their neural mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Effective coping strategies for emotion regulation and stress management would be particularly beneficial for healthcare students, frequently exposed to highly stressful situations. Based on prior work implicating hippocampal-somatomotor dynamics in emotion regulation, we tested whether Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for Life (MBCT-L) modulates hippocampal micro-coactivation patterns (μCAPs) in healthcare students. In a randomized controlled study including 161 healthcare students, 57 participants (39 females; mean age: 23±5 years old) completed resting-state fMRI before and after the 8-weeks intervention and were allocated to MBCT-L (N = 24) or a no-intervention control (N = 33) condition. Hippocampus-seeded CAPs analysis identified six recurrent patterns, including a somatomotor network. MBCT-L improved self-reported mindfulness, but no significant Group × Time interaction for hippocampus-somatomotor coactivation or resting physiological measures was found. In the MBCT-L group, higher hippocampus-somatomotor co-activity was associated with higher perceived importance of the intervention, perceived long-lasting benefits, and post-intervention mindfulness scores. This study suggests that the capacity to up-regulate hippocampus-somatomotor coactivation may index part of the individual benefit derived from mindfulness, supporting its role as a tool for emotion regulation and stress management.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性随机研究以医护学生为对象，用静息态fMRI分析海马种子点的微共激活模式，考察为期八周的MBCT-L课程能否调节海马-躯体运动网络共激活。结果显示，干预提升了自评正念，但海马-躯体运动共激活及静息生理指标均未出现显著的组别与时间交互。在MBCT-L组内，较高的海马-躯体运动共激活与更高的干预重要性感知、持久获益感知及干预后正念得分相关。作者据此提出，上调该共激活的能力可能反映个体从正念干预中获益的差异，但这一关联并非干预效果的证据。

papers.title: Diminished ascending drive in transdiagnostic anhedonia shifts the cortico-subcortical hierarchy away from bottom-up dominance
papers.authors: Roghani P, Vohryzek J, Kringelbach ML, Deco G.
papers.abstract: Anhedonia, the diminished capacity to experience or pursue pleasure, is a core feature of mood and psychotic disorders, yet the large-scale brain dynamics underlying it remain uncharacterized. Dominant accounts posit striatal hypofunction with compensatory prefrontal over-recruitment, but they rest on activation magnitudes and symmetric correlations, which cannot resolve the direction of influence. Here, in 210 adults from the Transdiagnostic Connectome Project, we defined symptom-derived low- and high-anhedonia subgroups and estimated each participant's directed effective connectivity using a whole-brain generative model fitted to resting-state fMRI. In high anhedonia, the cortex shifted upstream relative to the subcortex, flattening the cortico-subcortical hierarchy. Correspondingly, the net balance of direct cortico-subcortical flow shifted from bottom-up to balanced. This shift recurred within the frontostriatal reward circuit and replicated across independent halves of each participant's data. Flow asymmetry also increased with subject-level severity. Decomposing flow into ascending and descending arms showed that both weakened in high anhedonia, but ascending subcortex-to-cortex and striatum-to-prefrontal drive fell more than the descending drive. These findings identify a reorganization of cortico-subcortical hierarchy in anhedonia and suggest that the previously reported prefrontal over-recruitment reflects diminished ascending drive rather than stronger cortical output.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注快感缺失背后的大尺度脑动力学，尤其是皮层与皮层下之间的信息流方向。作者在跨诊断成人样本中按症状划分高低快感缺失亚组，用全脑生成模型基于静息态fMRI估计有向有效连接。结果发现，高快感缺失者的皮层相对皮层下上移，皮层-皮层下层级变平，净流向由自下而上转为大致平衡；这一变化在额纹状体奖赏环路内同样出现，并在数据分半中重复，且流向不对称随个体症状严重度增加。进一步分解显示上行与下行驱动均减弱，但上行驱动下降更多，提示既往观察到的前额叶过度激活可能反映上行驱动减弱，而非皮层输出增强。

papers.title: Concussion Safety Beliefs and Participation Decisions Among US Adults With a History of Concussion.
papers.authors: Anderson S, Andrade S, Viswanath O, Ganti L.
papers.abstract: Introduction Concussion safety education must address specific participation decisions as well as general beliefs. Method An anonymous, opt-in online survey of 100 US adults with self-reported concussion history was analyzed descriptively. Results Ninety-one percent endorsed avoiding same-day return after suspected concussion, and 81% would not allow a child to continue immediately after a "mild" concussion. Among the 91 endorsing no same-day return, 9 would allow immediate continuation, 7 selected sport-dependent participation, and 2 were unsure. Medical clearance was supported by 88% on an agreement item, whereas 77% selected clearance after every concussion on a separate question. Conclusions Responses varied across differently worded safety questions; they do not establish actual behavior or national prevalence. Practical applications Education could distinguish immediate removal from later graduated return and explicitly address injuries described as mild. These descriptive findings support testing such messages, rather than demonstrating their effectiveness.

papers.title: Combined eye tracking and electroencephalography during referential selection in dyadic interaction.
papers.authors: Brilmayer I, Georgis P, Schumacher PB.
papers.abstract: Understanding language in real-world interaction requires methods that integrate auditory, visual, and neural signals. We present a proof-of-concept study combining mobile electroencephalography (EEG) and eye tracking to investigate referential selection during dyadic communication. Using a simplified version of the director task, pairs of participants engaged in naturalistic object-movement instructions while EEG and gaze data were recorded and synchronized via LabStreamingLayer, allowing us to calculate overlap-corrected, regression-based event-related potentials (rERPs) time-locked to spoken nouns and to participants' fixations, focusing on the N400/P300 (300-500 ms) and later (500-800 ms) time windows. Our results show that gaze behavior and fixation-related potentials provide crucial information for interpreting language-related ERPs: Targets competing with occluded referents elicited a stronger posterior positivity consistent with greater attentional demands. Fixation timing systematically modulated neural responses. Contrary to predictions, competitors received little visual attention, indicating that participants prioritized task-relevant information. These findings highlight the potential of multimodal data integration for understanding attentional and predictive mechanisms in real-world communication. Importantly, we show that established analytic techniques, such as artifact subspace reconstruction, independent component analysis, and linear deconvolution for ERP calculation, apply to noisy, naturalistic datasets. In addition, we provide a subsampling sensitivity approach to test the stability of the effects across different sample sizes. This study provides a methodological framework linking gaze and neural activity during interactive language processing. All preprocessing and analysis scripts, along with example datasets, are openly available on OSF ( https://osf.io/5ds4z ; a modified and optimized Python implementation is also available on GitHub: https://github.com/XlinCLab/DGAME ).
papers.summary_zh: 该概念验证研究将移动脑电与眼动追踪同步，在双人互动中考察指称选择过程，记录被试执行简化指令任务时的神经与注视活动。结果显示，注视行为和注视相关电位对解读语言相关脑电十分关键：与遮挡指称物竞争的靶标引发更强的后部正波，提示注意需求更高；注视时机也系统性地调节神经反应。与预期相反，竞争物获得的视觉注意很少，表明被试优先处理任务相关信息。研究还表明常用分析技术可用于嘈杂的自然情境数据，并提供了检验效应稳定性的方法框架。

papers.title: Phenotypic and Molecular Diversity of Salicornia bigelovii and Its Potential for Salinity-Resilient Industrial Oilseed Production.
papers.authors: AlYammahi J, Chelaifa H, Mohammed BG, Hernandez HH.
papers.abstract: Salicornia bigelovii is a promising oilseed crop known for its high yield potential and exceptional salt tolerance, ranking among the most salt-resistant vascular plants. Although previous studies have investigated individual phenotypic and genetic characteristics of S. bigelovii , integrated assessments combining agronomic performance, seed morphometric variation, and genetic relationships among geographically distinct accessions remain limited. This study evaluated six S. bigelovii accessions from the Texas Gulf coastline, focusing on phenotypic and morphometric traits, geographic origins, and genomic distances. Significant variability was observed among accessions in key traits, such as plant height, spike number, root length, and seed yield. Notably, the South Padre and Boca Chica accessions demonstrated superior growth and higher seed productivity compared with Corpus Christi Bridge and Galveston accessions, indicating substantial phenotypic diversity and potential for selecting high-performing accessions for breeding. Morphological analysis revealed minor but distinct differences among the six seed accessions. The southern accessions, SPN and SP, exhibited advantageous traits, including a high surface area, circularity values close to 1, and increased seed volume, suggesting favorable dispersal and flow characteristics. Multivariate analyses and hierarchal clustering showed significant relationships among accessions, providing insights for breeding programs. Phylogenetic analysis indicated the divergence of CCB and G accessions from BC, BCW, SP, and SPN. This morphological and genetic assessment establishes a foundation for accelerated molecular breeding and genomic-assisted improvement of S. bigelovii as an industrial crop.

papers.title: Enzyme-Assisted Bacteria-Yeast Co-Fermentation of Ganoderma lucidum: Metabolomic Reprogramming, Sensory Evolution, and Sleep-Promoting Effects.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Cui Y, Yang R, Wu H, Zhou A, Ma Z, Song Y, An H, Chen Y, Ma H, Zou R, Liang J.
papers.abstract: To enhance the extraction efficiency and bioactivity of Ganoderma lucidum , this study developed a novel enzyme-assisted bacteria-yeast co-fermentation system utilizing Lactobacillus acidophilus and Saccharomyces cerevisiae . Following optimization using response surface methodology, the maximum yields of polysaccharides and triterpenoids reached 2.07% and 3.55%, respectively, substantially exceeding those obtained by direct extraction. Structural characterization revealed that the integrated process induced substantial changes in the polysaccharides, including increased homogeneity, mannose enrichment, and a more porous microstructure. Furthermore, untargeted metabolomics demonstrated that co-fermentation significantly altered the small-molecule profile, characterized by the differential regulation of specific triterpenoids and the enrichment of peptides and amino acids. These metabolic shifts were associated with the evolution of the sensory profile, particularly increased taste richness. In vivo evaluations using a mouse model of PCPA-induced insomnia revealed that the fermented extract exhibited greater sleep-promoting activity than the direct extract. The fermented extract increased hypothalamic 5-HT and GABA levels and was accompanied by modulated gut microbiota composition by increasing the abundance of Lactobacillus and reducing that of Prevotella . These findings suggest that the combined enzymatic-fermentation strategy alleviates insomnia, potentially involving modulation of the microbiota-gut-brain axis, offering preliminary insights into the potential application of Ganoderma lucidum in functional foods.

papers.title: Brain Blindness Versus Eye Blindness: Genetic and Molecular Connections Between Alzheimer's Disease and Visual Impairment.
papers.authors: Bagyinszky E, An SSA.
papers.abstract: Visual dysfunctions were observed among Alzheimer's disease (AD) patients, including posterior cortical degeneration, retinal abnormalities, or coexisting ocular disease. Posterior cortical atrophy (PCA) is a clinical syndrome characterized by progressive higher-order visual impairment and is most frequently associated with AD pathology, although other neurodegenerative causes may be possible. Pathogenic variants in PSEN1 and PSEN2 were reported in individual cases of PCA and may support a possible monogenic contribution to selected early-onset posterior phenotypes. By contrast, variants and common AD risk genes, including GRN, MAPT, TREM2, BIN1, PICALM, ABCA7, and APOE E4 allele, represented broader genetic associations whose specific contribution to posterior cortical vulnerability remains incompletely defined. These forms of evidence should be interpreted separately. Genome-wide association studies identified overlapping loci associated with AD and glaucoma, including loci on chromosome 11 involving MTCH2, NDUFS3, and SPI1. This overlap reflected shared genetic susceptibility, pleiotropy, or putative convergent biological pathways involving mitochondrial function, immune regulation, and cellular stress. However, shared loci and pathway associations did not establish direct signaling, anatomical communication, or a causal relationship between brain and ocular tissues. The opposing tissue-specific effects reported for APOE further indicated that data in the brain may not be extrapolated to the retina. Future studies should clarify the cell-specific effects, causal direction, and clinical significance of shared genetic factors using well-characterized cohorts and tissue-specific experimental models. Overall, current evidence supported the partially overlapping genetic and cellular mechanisms in AD and selected ocular disorders, while further studies should be needed on the biological relationship between the brain and eye.

papers.title: ABR-DeepLabV3+: Adaptive Boundary-Refined Multi-Backbone DeepLabV3+ for MRI Brain Tumor Segmentation.
papers.authors: Saifullah S, Dreżewski R.
papers.abstract: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis, treatment planning, surgical guidance, and quantitative tumor assessment. However, automated segmentation remains challenging due to the heterogeneous tumor appearance, irregular morphology, weak tissue contrast, and ambiguous tumor boundaries. Conventional encoder-decoder segmentation models, including DeepLabV3+, can capture multi-scale semantic information but may still produce boundary inconsistencies when tumor margins are diffuse or visually similar to surrounding tissues. To address this limitation, this study proposes ABR-DeepLabV3+, an Adaptive Boundary-Refined Multi-Backbone DeepLabV3+ framework for MRI brain tumor segmentation. The proposed framework integrates an Adaptive Boundary Refinement (ABR) module after decoder fusion to enhance boundary-sensitive feature representation before final mask prediction. Four encoder backbones, namely InceptionResNetV2, Xception, MobileNetV2, and ResNet50, were evaluated under the same framework using the Figshare Brain Tumor Segmentation (FBTS) dataset consisting of 3064 MRI images from meningioma, glioma, and pituitary tumor classes. The evaluation employed patient-level train-validation-test partitioning together with patient-grouped five-fold cross-validation to reduce subject-level information leakage between data subsets. Experimental results show that ABR-DeepLabV3+ with Xception achieved the best overall test performance, with accuracy of 0.9994, Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.9753, and Jaccard Index (JI) of 0.9519. ResNet50 also achieved competitive performance with DSC of 0.9732 and JI of 0.9478, while MobileNetV2 demonstrated strong class-wise performance for meningioma and pituitary tumors. For the Xception configuration, the component-wise ablation analysis showed that Full ABR achieved higher performance than both plain DeepLabV3+ and an ordinary convolutional refinement control. Relative to plain DeepLabV3+, Full ABR increased DSC from 0.89002 to 0.97530 and JI from 0.80183 to 0.95190, while reducing the 95th-percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) from 8.72 to 3.28 pixels and the Average Symmetric Surface Distance (ASSD) from 2.41 to 0.87 pixels. Five-fold cross-validation showed that the Xception-based configuration achieved the highest mean DSC of 0.9017 and mean JI of 0.8258 among the evaluated backbones; however, the lower cross-validation mean relative to the single-split test result indicates sensitivity to patient-level data partitioning rather than unconditional evidence of robustness. Qualitative analysis using segmentation overlays, error heatmaps, and prediction-region heatmaps illustrated representative patterns of contour agreement and localized residual segmentation error without interpreting prediction-derived heatmaps as internal model attention or attribution. Overall, the findings indicate that the proposed ABR design improves within-dataset tumor-region overlap and boundary agreement relative to plain DeepLabV3+ under the evaluated experimental conditions, while external validation and repeated-run statistical evaluation remain necessary to establish broader generalizability and reproducibility.

papers.title: Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping of the Centromedian Nucleus and Indirect Comparison with Alternate Sequences.
papers.authors: Rasheed MA, Nguyen V, Ryan MV, Ojemann SG, Kramer DR, Thompson JA, Awad IA, Satzer D.
papers.abstract: Introduction Neuromodulation of the thalamic centromedian nucleus (CM) is an established therapy for epilepsy and been applied for pain, Tourette syndrome, and disorders of consciousness. Accurate targeting remains challenging because CM is poorly visualized on conventional MRI sequences, necessitating reliance on indirect targeting approaches. Although advanced MRI sequences, such as magnetization-prepared rapid acquisition of two gradient echoes (MP2RAGE) and white matter null (WMn), have been explored, they fail to reliably delineate the boundary between CM and lateral thalamus, a region associated with optimal stimulation outcomes, particularly in epilepsy. Quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) has emerged as a promising technique for differentiating thalamic nuclei based on tissue magnetic susceptibility. Objective The purpose of this study was to evaluate visualization of CM using QSM, assess contrast between CM and adjacent nuclei, and indirectly compare across WMn and MP2RAGE. Methods This retrospective study included patients with solitary cerebral cavernous malformations, not involving the thalamus, who underwent surveillance MRI including QSM (n=24). WMn sequences were obtained from a separate cohort of patients with epilepsy (n=16). MP2RAGE sequences were acquired from healthy individuals (n=24). All sequences were registered to the MNI152 template space and compared with the Morel histological atlas. Normalized intensity differences, contrast-to-noise ratios (CNR), and signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) were calculated for CM and neighboring nuclei. Results On QSM, CM was hypointense to medial and posterior thalamus and hyperintense relative to motor thalamus. Median CNR on QSM (P<0.05) relative to CM was highest for medial pulvinar (median 2.9, interquartile range 1.6-4.7) and ventral lateral thalamus (1.6, 0.6-2.3). Highest overall CNR was seen on WMn for PuM (3.4, 3.0-4.0). SNR on QSM was highest for anterior pulvinar (2.4, 1.1-3.6) and highest overall SNR was on on MP2RAGE for PuA (20.8, 17.3-24.3). In an indirect comparison across independent cohorts, QSM showed greater lateral thalamic contrast than WMn and MP2RAGE, but lower overall SNR. Conclusion QSM allows visualization of CM including the lateral border poorly seen on other sequences, and may be useful as a complementary sequence for direct targeting of CM.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究评估定量磁化率成像（QSM）能否显示丘脑中央中核（CM）并区分其与邻近核团，同时与白质抑制序列（WMn）和MP2RAGE做间接比较；所用数据来自接受QSM检查的脑内海绵状血管畸形患者，以及分别采集WMn和MP2RAGE的癫痫患者与健康人队列，各序列均配准到标准空间并与组织学图谱对照。结果显示，QSM上CM相对内侧和后部丘脑呈低信号、相对运动丘脑呈高信号，与内侧枕及腹外侧丘脑的对比度较高；跨队列间接比较中，QSM对丘脑外侧边界的对比优于WMn和MP2RAGE，但整体信噪比更低。作者据此认为，QSM可显示其他序列难以看清的CM外侧边界，或可作为CM直接靶向的补充序列，但这一用途尚待进一步验证。

papers.title: BCI & AI for Cognitively-Aware Learning: A Review of Technologies, Tools, and Applications
papers.authors: Amangeldy N, Omarbekova A, Bekmanova G, Milosz M, Zholdassova S, Gazizova N, Dospol N.
papers.abstract: This article presents a comprehensive review of technologies, tools, and applications in the field of brain-computer interfaces (BCI) and artificial intelligence (AI) for developing cognitively adaptive learning environments. Unlike prior reviews that treat BCI hardware, AI decoding models, and pedagogical deployment as separate topics, this review develops an integrated cross-layer taxonomy linking hardware constraints, AI architecture requirements, and classroom deployment conditions. Emphasis is placed on the transition from cumbersome laboratory systems to wearable hybrid solutions combining electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), as well as textile sensors that offer a favorable trade-off between neurophysiological signal quality and mobility in real-world classroom settings. The review includes a detailed analysis of modern AI architectures, transformer-based models for processing non-stationary neural signals, and Siamese neural networks implementing a few-shot learning paradigm to address the calibration problem associated with new users. It further proposes a unified state-estimation framework integrating cognitive load, attention, and affect into a single formalization for closed-loop adaptive learning systems. The review concludes with a critical analysis of fundamental barriers to scalability, signal instability, mental state privacy issues, and the risk of a neurocognitive divide arising from unequal access to technology. The authors argue that the future of neuroeducation lies in the symbiotic interaction of humans and AI, supported by unified international standards and the convergence of BCI with large language models (LLM) for predictive communication.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合了脑机接口硬件、人工智能解码模型与课堂教学部署三个层面，提出一个跨层分类框架，重点讨论从笨重实验室系统向脑电与功能性近红外光谱结合的可穿戴混合方案及织物传感器的转变，以兼顾信号质量与课堂移动性。文章分析了面向非平稳神经信号的Transformer架构和用于缓解新用户校准问题的孪生网络少样本学习，并提出将认知负荷、注意与情感统一纳入闭环自适应学习的状态估计框架。作者最后指出可扩展性、信号稳定性、心理状态隐私及技术获取不均可能带来的神经认知鸿沟等障碍，认为神经教育的未来取决于人与人工智能的共生互动、国际标准统一以及脑机接口与大语言模型的融合。

papers.title: A Bioinformatics Data Platform on Snowflake Using Life-Science Ontologies as Context for AI Agents
papers.authors: Koreeda T, Kurogi N, Yagi R.
papers.abstract: Life-science ontologies describe concepts such as genes, phenotypes, diseases, and chemical entities under shared identifiers and hierarchies, and over a quarter of a century they have become a foundation for annotation and analysis in bioinformatics. AI agents now assemble research procedures on their own, choosing and running databases and analysis tools, and how well they work depends on the definitions of meaning they can consult, that is, on the context layer. In enterprise data platforms, this layer is increasingly built as an organization-internal operational ontology, as exemplified by Palantir, whereas reference ontologies in the life sciences are maintained by communities outside any single organization. Using Snowflake as an example, we discuss an architecture composed of semantic views that define the meaning of internal data, Cortex Agent that queries through them, and custom tools and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that reach external ontologies. The results of concept resolution and mapping obtained from outside are stored by a custom tool in tables within Snowflake for each query, and are joined with internal data under the semantic view and under the same access control. Taking target–disease matching in drug discovery and cohort definition in real-world data as hypothetical use cases, we show, as a conceptual design, that the set of entities to be matched changes with how far the ontology hierarchy is traversed, and that the temporal conditions of a cohort are applied to the same records as the concept set obtained from the ontology.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论的是：当AI代理自行选择并运行数据库和分析工具时，企业数据平台如何为其提供可查询的语义上下文。作者以Snowflake为例提出一种概念性架构，用语义视图定义内部数据的含义，由Cortex Agent通过语义视图查询，并借助自定义工具和模型上下文协议接入外部生命科学本体；外部获得的概念解析与映射结果按每次查询存入Snowflake表，再在语义视图和同一访问控制下与内部数据连接。文章以药物发现中的靶点—疾病匹配和真实世界数据中的队列定义作为假设用例，说明本体层级遍历深度会改变待匹配实体集合，而队列的时间条件会施加于从本体获得的概念集所对应的同一批记录。这些结果属于概念设计层面的演示，并非实际系统评估。

papers.title: Late Integration of Prior Expectations During Precision-Weighted Perceptual Decisions.
papers.authors: Gastrell T, Rangelov D, Mattingley JB.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Adaptive perceptual decision-making relies on the ability to combine sensory evidence with prior expectations in a precision-weighted manner. Although Bayesian inference provides a clear normative account of how such integration should occur, the neural mechanisms through which the brain represents and combines priors and likelihoods remain poorly understood. Across two preregistered experiments, we investigated how the precision of learned priors and sensory likelihoods influence visual motion judgements and associated neural activity patterns during a random-dot motion estimation task. Neurotypical adult participants (N=80, 58 female) reported directions of visual motion stimuli, with motion coherence varying randomly across trials. Prior expectations over the continuous motion direction space were manipulated block-wise by implicitly varying the probabilities with which different motion directions were presented. Consistent with precision-weighted inference, response accuracy improved as motion coherence increased with robust response biases toward the expected motion direction. Neural activity measured using electroencephalography (EEG) revealed reliable effects of prior expectation on the univariate central-parietal positivity (CPP), consistent with reduced accumulation of sensory evidence under informative priors. Multivariate analysis using inverted-encoding models revealed robust effects of prior precision on stimulus-specific neural representations, but only late, during response planning stages. Together, these findings suggest that priors learned over a continuous space do not modulate the encoding of sensory evidence and are instead integrated later in the decision-process.Significance Statement Perceptual decisions require combining noisy sensory input with prior expectations about what is likely to occur. It remains unclear how the brain integrates prior expectations with incoming sensory evidence. Using a visual motion task and concurrent brain imaging, we show that expectations do not alter early stimulus-encoding, but are instead integrated at later stages of decision formation and action planning. These findings add nuance to influential theories proposing that learned expectations directly affect stimulus representations and instead highlight their contribution to later decision-related processes. This work advances understanding of how the brain uses experience to optimise perceptual decisions under uncertainty.

papers.title: A pathogenic AMPAR mutation disrupts hippocampal synapse maturation and homeostasis.
papers.authors: Xu J, Wang YZ, Nomura T, Van HM, Zhu Y, Castillon CCM, Chiesa M, Marshall JJ, Armstrong JN, Zhu Y, Savas JN, Contractor A.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: AMPA receptors (AMPARs) mediate fast excitatory synaptic transmission and are critical for activity-dependent synapse maturation and circuit development. De novo missense mutations in AMPAR subunits are linked to neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs), yet how these variants disrupt neuronal function remains unclear. Here, we examine a recurrent pathogenic mutation in the GluA1 subunit (GRIA1 p.A636T) that alters AMPAR function and is associated with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and intellectual disability (ID). Using GluA1A636T knock-in mice of either sex, we identify impairments in hippocampal-dependent learning and working memory. Quantitative proteomics combined with bulk RNA-seq revealed age-dependent molecular remodeling in mutant hippocampus. Synaptic protein alterations were present in juvenile and adult mice, whereas a pronounced upregulation of mitochondrial and glial-associated proteins emerged more strongly in adulthood. Transcriptomic analyses showed partial concordance and highlighted divergence between RNA and protein regulation. Consistent with these molecular changes, there were increases in markers of oxidative stress in juvenile and adult mutant animals, whereas altered mitochondria morphology emerged selectively in adult mutants. Electrophysiological recordings demonstrated reduced basal excitatory transmission, persistence of silent synapses in adulthood and exaggerated activity-dependent synaptic potentiation, which were associated with reduced spine size consistent with impaired synapse maturation. Together, these findings indicate that a pathogenic AMPAR mutation disrupts developmental synapse maturation with secondary metabolic adaptations emerging over time.Significance Statement Mutations in genes encoding AMPA-type glutamate receptors are increasingly linked to neurodevelopmental disorders, including autism and intellectual disability. However, how these mutations disrupt brain function and development remains poorly understood. Using a mouse model carrying a recurrent disease-associated mutation in the GluA1 AMPA receptor subunit, we show that the presence of this mutant subunit protein impairs the normal maturation of excitatory synapses in the hippocampus. Mutant mice retain immature "silent" synapses into adulthood, exhibit abnormal synaptic plasticity, reduced spine size, and deficits in learning and memory. Molecular analyses reveal age-dependent remodeling of synaptic and mitochondrial proteins, suggesting that metabolic changes arise secondary to disrupted synapse development. These findings clarify how pathogenic AMPA receptor variants alter brain function over time.

papers.title: Representation of emotional expressions across the face and voice brain networks.
papers.authors: Mattioni S, Falagiarda F, Arya T, Gau R, Rezk M, Battal C, Van Audenhaege A, Collignon O.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Recognizing emotions from faces and voices is fundamental to successful social interaction, yet how the brain represents emotional information across sensory systems remains unclear. Here, we systematically mapped the contribution of individually-defined face- and voice-selective cortical regions in 24 human participants of either sex to unimodal and crossmodal emotion expressions. Using multivariate pattern classification, we show that emotional expressions are robustly decodable from the dominant sensory modality across all individually defined face- and voice-selective areas, and that these representations cannot be accounted for by low- and mid-level stimulus properties alone. Strikingly, emotional information from the non-dominant modality-vocal expressions within face networks and facial expressions within voice networks-was also represented throughout the network, with the exception of the occipital face areas. Crossmodal decoding further revealed a shared neural code for facial and vocal emotions in the temporal voice areas, posterior superior temporal sulcus, and precentral gyrus, indicating that these regions contain emotion representations that generalize across sensory modalities. Furthermore, in most face- and voice-selective regions, audiovisual emotional expressions could be distinguished from representations elicited by the dominant unimodal modality, indicating that bimodal signals are not simply represented as their strongest sensory component. Together, these findings reveal that emotion representations are distributed broadly across face- and voice-selective regions and identify temporo-frontal regions as key sites supporting modality-independent emotion representations.Significance statement Recognizing emotions from faces and voices is essential for everyday social interaction, yet the brain mechanisms that integrate these signals remain poorly understood. Using functional MRI (fMRI) and advanced pattern analyses, we show that emotional expressions are represented widely across both face- and voice-selective brain regions-even when conveyed through a non-preferred sensory modality. Strikingly, specific temporo-frontal regions encode facial and vocal emotions using a partially shared, modality-independent neural code. We further demonstrate that seeing and hearing emotions together reshapes how emotional information is organized in the brain, revealing a graded transition from sensory-specific to multisensory representations. These findings challenge strictly segregated models of emotion processing and provide a more integrated account of how the brain supports social understanding.

papers.title: Insulin regulates activity-dependent mitochondrial depolarization and calcium dynamics in dentate granule cells.
papers.authors: Ferrán B, Rose HM, Gray J, Redwine TL, Pham S, Rubin O, Rice HC, Sonntag WE, Díaz-García CM.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Systemic insulin resistance is associated with reduced hippocampal energy metabolism and cognitive impairment both in humans and animal models. However, whether insulin rapidly regulates neuronal metabolic stability during activity remains unclear. Here, we examined insulin signaling and queried the corresponding mitochondrial responses in dentate granule cells (DGCs) of adult female mice. This layer of excitatory neurons within the hippocampus plays an essential role in learning and memory. Insulin robustly increased Akt phosphorylation in dentate gyrus tissue when insulin degradation was inhibited, and this response was attenuated by genetic deletion of the insulin receptor in DGCs, consistent with cell-autonomous signaling. We found that insulin did not alter mitochondrial membrane potential at rest, but significantly limited activity-evoked mitochondrial depolarization induced by neuronal stimulation. However, this change had no measurable impact on cytosolic ATP availability and was instead associated with Ca2+ dynamics. Removing Ca2+ ions from the extracellular solution, or disrupting mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake, prevented insulin modulation of the mitochondrial membrane potential. Furthermore, insulin limited cytosolic Ca2+ accumulation through an insulin receptor-dependent mechanism that persisted despite Akt inhibition. Insulin also accelerated the clearance of mitochondrial Ca2+ transients in active neurons, which occurred without changes in either neuronal excitability or pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphorylation. Together, these findings identify endogenous insulin degradation as a key regulator of hippocampal insulin signaling, and reveal a previously unrecognized interaction between insulin and Ca2+ signaling in stimulated DGCs. This work also establishes a direct link between central insulin signaling and the maintenance of mitochondrial electrochemical homeostasis in the adult brain.Significance Statement Insulin signaling is known to influence synaptic plasticity, yet its direct effects on neuronal metabolism remain poorly defined. Here, we show that endogenous insulin degradation limits insulin signaling in adult hippocampal tissue. This finding suggests that inhibitors of the insulin degrading enzyme may hold the potential to improve the efficacy of insulin-based interventions aimed at improving learning and memory. Acute insulin signaling does not modify neuronal excitability, or cytosolic ATP availability. Instead, it stabilizes mitochondrial membrane potential and reduces calcium accumulation in active dentate granule cells. By identifying an insulin-dependent mechanism that regulates the electrochemical homeostasis of mitochondria in active neurons, this work provides insight into how brain insulin resistance may contribute to cognitive dysfunction in aging and neurometabolic disorders.

papers.title: Vascular dementia and vascular cognitive impairment-current treatments and future prospects.
papers.authors: Markus HS.
papers.journal: International journal of stroke : official journal of the International Stroke Society
papers.abstract: Vascular cognitive impairment (VCI) and vascular dementia (VaD) represent a substantial and growing global health burden, yet remain under-recognized and comparatively under-researched. Two broad categories are post-stroke cognitive impairment, and VCI secondary to chronic cerebrovascular disease of which the most common cause is cerebral small vessel disease (SVD). In addition, cerebrovascular pathology frequently coexists with Alzheimer's disease (AD), increasing the probability that AD pathology will manifest as clinical dementia. Current management focuses primarily on prevention through modification of cardiovascular risk factors and lifestyle interventions. Intensive blood-pressure control has shown the strongest evidence, reducing future all-cause dementia while slowing progression of white-matter abnormalities. Multidomain lifestyle interventions incorporating exercise, diet, cognitive training, and vascular risk monitoring may also preserve cognition, although results across trials remain variable. In established VCI and VaD, treatment options are limited; cholinesterase inhibitors and memantine lack convincing evidence of benefit, and no pharmacological therapy has definitively demonstrated symptomatic improvement or delayed disease progression. Advances in understanding SVD and VCI pathophysiology are, however, identifying promising therapeutic targets. Emerging evidence highlights endothelial dysfunction, impaired cerebral autoregulation, increased blood-brain barrier permeability, inflammation, and glymphatic dysfunction as possible mechanisms underlying SVD. Current trials are evaluating treatment approaches based on this framework including cerebral vasodilators such as cilostazol, isosorbide mononitrate and phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors, anti-inflammatory therapies, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, remote ischemic conditioning, and strategies targeting glymphatic function. Improved mechanistic understanding, appropriately targeted interventions, and adequately powered long-term clinical trials are required to translate these emerging approaches into effective treatments for VCI and VaD.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了血管性认知障碍与血管性痴呆的诊疗现状及未来方向，指出这类疾病负担沉重却仍被低估和研究不足，主要包括卒中后认知障碍和以脑小血管病为最常见原因的慢性脑血管病所致认知障碍，且常与阿尔茨海默病病理共存。当前管理以通过控制心血管危险因素和生活方式干预进行预防为主，其中强化降压证据最强，多领域生活方式干预也可能保护认知，但试验结果不一。对于已形成的认知障碍和痴呆，胆碱酯酶抑制剂与美金刚缺乏令人信服的获益证据，尚无药物被明确证实能改善症状或延缓进展；作者据此提出内皮功能障碍、脑血流自动调节受损、血脑屏障通透性增加、炎症和类淋巴功能障碍等可能机制，并介绍了针对这些机制正在评估的多种干预策略，强调仍需更充分的机制研究和长期临床试验。

papers.title: Altered network organization with shift to local processing during adaptive behaviour in multiple sclerosis.
papers.authors: Elmers J, Mückschel M, Ziemssen T, Beste C.
papers.abstract: To adjust to changing environmental demands, the brain needs to organize and (re)configure mental resources in so-called task sets. Following a network perspective of cognitive functions, these processes are considered to rely on dynamic exchange of information between distant brain regions, possibly synchronized by slow-wave theta oscillations. However, few attempts have been made to describe the directional transfer of information in theta networks during behavioural adaptation. In the current study, we examined directed neural information transfer in 57 healthy individuals and 57 patients with multiple sclerosis with a focus on brain-behaviour associations during task switching. For this, we calculated behavioural switch costs and further applied an artificial neural network-based approach on neurophysiological EEG data to estimate linear and non-linear effective connectivity measures within cortical networks during task switching. Source reconstruction and connectivity analyses revealed distinct neural network architectures and communication strategies during task switching in healthy controls compared to patients with multiple sclerosis. In healthy controls, enhanced modulations of long-range fronto-parietal connectivities were associated with higher reaction time switch costs, possibly reflecting increased cognitive demands rather than adaptive processes. In contrast, patients with multiple sclerosis relied more strongly on local intra-regional modulations, which is consistent with the idea of a dysconnectivity syndrome in multiple sclerosis. Strikingly, stronger modulations in self-connectivities were associated with better accuracy measures in patients with multiple sclerosis, suggesting a compensatory mechanism to support performance. Notably, only non-linear directed connectivity measures were related to behavioural switch costs, emphasizing the importance of non-linear models for adaptive cognitive processes.

papers.title: What Does a Donor Need to Know? Content Analysis of Informed Consent Documents Used for Brain Organoid Research.
papers.authors: Hale ZJ, Beretta A, Cohn B, MacDuffie KE.
papers.abstract: Donors of cells used to create induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) and brain organoids may not understand what brain organoids are, how they will be used, or the long-term implications of the research. Informed consent documents (ICDs) often contain highly technical language and are written at reading grade levels higher than those attained by the target population. Our goal was to evaluate informed consent documents used for brain organoid research. We compared 20 currently active, IRB-approved consent documents to published templates/guidelines for iPSC research consent. Analyzed ICDs adhered to guidelines in explaining risks and benefits, de-identification, commercial potential, storage, and results sharing. However, descriptions of current and future use were lacking in detail, and the average reading level of ICDs far exceeded that of the general population. Our findings suggest additional transparency in ICDs would assist participants in making an informed choice about participation in iPSC and brain organoid research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注用于脑类器官研究的知情同意文件是否能让细胞捐赠者真正理解研究内容，通过对多份在用的伦理审查获批同意文件与已发表的iPSC研究同意模板和指南进行对比分析。结果显示，这些文件在风险与获益说明、去标识化、商业潜力、样本储存和结果共享等方面基本符合指南，但对细胞当前及未来用途的描述不够具体，且文件平均阅读难度远高于一般人群的阅读水平。作者据此认为，提高知情同意文件的透明度有助于参与者在充分知情的前提下决定是否参与iPSC和脑类器官研究。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Design and Access: Toward Visual Scene Displays for Brain-Computer Interface Use in Augmentative and Alternative Communication by Children.
papers.authors: Pitt KM, Sawall J, Butler E, Bubak A, Behboodi A.
papers.journal: Journal of speech, language, and hearing research : JSLHR
papers.abstract: Purpose Brain-computer interface (BCI) may support communication and computer interaction through neural signals such as the P300 event-related potential (ERP). As a step toward integrating photographic visual scene displays (VSDs) in BCI, this study examined the feasibility of incorporating contextual, naturalistic scenes in which communication items were embedded asymmetrically. Method To evaluate the effects of contextual scene use, 24 neurotypical children aged 8-13 years completed three experimental conditions: (1) a contextual scene with asymmetrical item placement, (2) an asymmetrical arrangement of the same items without contextual information, and (3) a standard grid. Electroencephalogram data were analyzed for the N170, P300, and N400 ERP components, and offline (predicted) BCI augmentative and alternative communication accuracy was calculated. Results The results showed that asymmetry increased frontal and centro-parietal P300 amplitudes, and the scene enhanced occipital N170. Offline BCI performance was similar across the scene and grid conditions, and participants rated the scene as more visually appealing. Conclusion These findings indicate that asymmetry and contextual embedding within scenes may enhance neural engagement and user experience, providing a preliminary foundation for considering photographic VSDs into pediatric BCI research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨将照片式视觉场景显示用于儿童脑机接口辅助沟通的可行性，以24名8至13岁神经发育典型儿童为对象，比较嵌入不对称摆放沟通项目的场景、无场景信息的同样不对称排列以及标准网格三种条件，并分析脑电成分与离线预测的脑机接口准确率。结果显示，不对称摆放提高了额区与中央顶区P300波幅，场景背景增强了枕区N170，而场景与网格条件下的离线脑机接口表现相近，参与者对场景的视觉吸引力评价更高。作者据此认为，场景中的不对称与情境嵌入可能提升神经参与度和使用体验，为将照片式视觉场景显示纳入儿童脑机接口研究提供了初步基础。

papers.title: Sentence Completion Expressive Language Task-Preschool: Preliminary Evidence of Validity and Feasibility for the Neuroimaging Environment.
papers.authors: Washington KN, Kokotek LE, Altaye M, Vannest J, DiFrancesco M, Maloney T.
papers.journal: Journal of speech, language, and hearing research : JSLHR
papers.abstract: Purpose This preliminary investigation occurred across two studies and examined validity, discriminant accuracy, and feasibility of the Sentence Completion Expressive Language Task-Preschool (SCELT-P) for characterizing language production in a neuroimaging environment for typically developing (TD) preschoolers and those with developmental language disorder (DLD). Method Two separate studies were completed. Study 1 (validity) included 82 preschoolers (50% female; 69 TD, 13 DLD) aged 4;0 (years;months) to 5;11 (M age = 4;7). All children were assessed using standardized language measures (e.g., Clinical Evaluation of Language Fundamentals Preschool-Second Edition), a play-based language sample (analyzed using Developmental Sentence Scoring), and the 30-item SCELT-P (outside the neuroimaging environment), later streamlined to 20 items (SCELT-P Revised [SCELT-PR]). Study 2 (feasibility) included 14 preschoolers (M age = 4;9, 43% female; nine TD, five with DLD) that were assessed using the SCELT-P (inside the neuroimaging environment) and functional magnetic resonance imaging using a sparse acquisition approach with a "listen" (passive) and "listen + speak" (active) condition implemented using DirectRT software. Results In Study 1, the SCELT-P and SCELT-PR demonstrated high reliability, including interrater (intraclass correlation coefficient = .99), test-retest (r = .86 and .80, respectively), and internal consistency (Cronbach's α > .86 and .83, respectively), and similar strong criterion validity (r = . 53-.84). Area under the curve analyses (.91) revealed both versions also evidenced fair sensitivity (.88 and .87) and specificity (.85) rates with a cutoff score of 15.5 and 9.5, respectively. In Study 2, 89% of TD preschoolers and 60% of preschoolers with DLD successfully completed the SCELT-P/R inside the neuroimaging environment, with activation maps illustrating relatively similar neurobiological characteristics across preschoolers in some brain regions. Conclusion The SCELT-P, including its streamlined version, the SCELT-PR, holds promise as a reliable and valid task for including 4- to 5-year-olds in the neuroimaging environment to inform neural and cognitive systems involved in language development. Supplemental material https://doi.org/10.23641/asha.34543209.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究通过两项子研究检验学龄前句子完成表达性语言任务（SCELT-P）在神经影像环境中的效度与可行性，对象为典型发育儿童和发育性语言障碍儿童。第一项研究显示，原版及精简版任务在评分者间、重测和内部一致性上信度较高，与标准化语言测量的效标效度也较强，并表现出一定的判别敏感性和特异性。第二项研究初步表明，多数典型发育儿童能在扫描环境中完成任务，部分语言障碍儿童亦可完成，且部分脑区激活模式在儿童间相对相似。作者据此认为该任务有望用于4至5岁儿童的神经影像研究，但证据仍属初步，尚不能据此推断临床应用价值。

papers.title: An amygdala-mediated simulation-to-decision cascade aligns interbrain dynamics to solve social dilemmas.
papers.authors: Ni J, Meng F, Zhang C, Tan H, Zeng X, Yang J, Li H, Qi Y, Yan Y, Zhang Y, Zhang K, Ma Y.
papers.abstract: Mutual cooperation (MC) requires independent decision-makers to coordinate under uncertainty about each other's intentions. Using simultaneous intracranial electroencephalography from epilepsy-patient dyads playing a real-time iterated prisoner's dilemma, we identified neurocognitive mechanisms that enable interacting brains to align during mutual cooperation. Amygdala interbrain representational alignment (IBRA), similarity in fine-grained neural spectral patterns across partners, emerged selectively during MC and predicted trial-by-trial outcomes. Early θ-suppression-characterized IBRA reflected rapid, history-sensitive alignment, whereas later IBRA, characterized by low-frequency suppression and γ increases, supported coordinated commitment and action. Furthermore, mutual cooperation relied on an amygdala-mediated, simulation-to-decision cascade, operationalized here as a model-based prospective estimate of partner cooperation that guided self-choice. Amygdala low-frequency suppression tracked this prospective estimate of partner cooperation and θ-γ coupling linked this partner estimate to self-decision processes. Conditional cooperators strategically relied on partner tracking, whereas unconditional cooperators leveraged dispositional tolerance of uncertainty to transition into anticipatory neural alignment. These findings reveal the neural interdependency underpinning MC, redefining cooperation not as isolated decision-making but as a dynamic, interbrain, cognitive alignment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用癫痫患者配对同时进行的颅内脑电记录，考察两人在实时重复囚徒困境中如何实现相互合作。结果显示，杏仁核的脑间表征对齐只在相互合作时出现，并能预测逐试次的结果；早期对齐反映对互动历史的快速敏感调整，后期对齐则与协调承诺和行动有关。研究进一步提出，相互合作依赖杏仁核介导的“模拟到决策”级联：杏仁核低频抑制追踪对伙伴合作的前瞻性估计，θ-γ耦合把这一估计与自身决策联系起来；条件合作者策略性地依赖伙伴追踪，无条件合作者则借助对不确定性的容忍转向预期性的神经对齐。作者据此把合作理解为动态的脑间认知对齐，而非孤立的个体决策。

papers.title: Cortex-wide imaging in naturally behaving mice with 1-gram wireless mesoscopes.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Li A, Yuan L, Wang M, Zhao W, Wang Z, Zang B, Zhou Y, Yu T, Gao L, Wu Y, Zhu R, Tian M, Li K, Wu J, Dai P, Dai Q.
papers.abstract: Revealing how distributed cortical circuits coordinate behavior in freely moving animals remains a central challenge in systems neuroscience, constrained by limited fields of view, low throughput, and the tethering required by current miniaturized microscopes1-4 . Here, we present Airscope, a wireless mesoscope delivering 4 μm lateral resolution across a 6 mm field of view at 12.5 Hz, weighing 1.0 gram. An aspheric-lens design achieves a 2.84× shorter total track length than previous miniaturized microscopes1,2,5,6 while matching the neuron yield of benchtop one-photon mesoscopes; a tailored wireless link supports cable-free calcium imaging from >8,500 neurons per animal (25‑fold increase). Paired with a zero-shot behavior analyzer, Airscope enables cortical imaging across rich behavioral conditions, including room-scale enriched arenas, swimming assays, and multi-organ implantation, with concurrent recording from multiple animals. Using Airscope, we demonstrate versatile applications of untethered cortical imaging across diverse behavioral paradigms. We identify cortical activity patterns across multiple dorsal regions that correlate with behavioral signatures of social dominance, and show dorsal-cortical population activity prospectively decodes competition outcomes across paired animals. We observe reward-location-associated cortical activity patterns during maze exploration, and characterize Granger-causal influence from spinal cord to cortex during fear conditioning, enabled by simultaneous brain-spinal recordings. By uniting large-scale, cellular-resolution recording with unconstrained behavior, Airscope makes naturalistic, multi-animal cortical recording experimentally practical, and provides a broadly accessible technology for systems neuroscience.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对自由活动动物中分布式皮层环路如何协调行为这一难题，研制了重1.0克、可无线工作的介观显微镜Airscope，能在较大视野内以细胞分辨率对小鼠进行无束缚钙成像，并结合行为分析工具在多种行为范式中应用。作者据此观察到与社交优势相关的多背侧皮层活动模式，并发现背侧皮层群体活动可前瞻性解码配对动物间的竞争结果；还看到迷宫探索中与奖励位置相关的皮层活动，以及恐惧条件化过程中脊髓到皮层的因果影响。这些结果说明，大规模、细胞分辨率的无束缚皮层记录在自然行为和多动物场景中已具备可行性，为系统神经科学提供了更易推广的技术手段。

papers.title: Predicting trail-making test performance using 7-Tesla structural cerebral MRI.
papers.authors: Schnellbächer GJ, Rajkumar R, Veselinović T, Ramkiran S, Hagen J, Collee M, Shah NJ, Neuner I, Dammers J.
papers.abstract: Psychopharmaceutical therapy has seen a lack of improvement in efficacy, highlighting the need for a more individualized treatment approach that optimally leverages pharmaceutical effects. To achieve this, it is necessary to identify factors that can predict psychological attributes and treatment outcomes. We hypothesize that brain morphology may serve as a predictor of performance in psychological tests. A 7-Tesla-MRI system was used to measure 74 transdiagnostic patients and 41 healthy controls. Values for grey matter volume (GMV), cortical thickness and gyrification based on the Schaefer 100 Atlas for parcellation were determined. Using this morphological data, performance in a Trail-Making Test (TMT) - A and B was predicted with the help of a deep learning model. A SHAP analysis was conducted to identify the key variables important for the model. The accuracy in predicting TMT performance was very good at 0.795. The most decisive feature influencing predictions was gyrification. Areas indicating inter-group differences were focused in the frontal cortex, as well as in temporal and parietal regions. Morphological characteristics can predict test performance with high accuracy. These results support the implementation of a transdiagnostic approach in clinical practice to better address the underlying pathophysiology. Symptom prediction based on neuroimaging data appears to be an achievable goal.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨能否用脑形态学特征预测心理测验表现，基于7特斯拉结构MRI测量跨诊断患者与健康对照的灰质体积、皮层厚度和脑回化程度，并用深度学习模型预测连线测验A、B部分的表现。结果显示预测准确度很高，其中脑回化是最具决定性的特征，组间差异相关区域主要位于额叶以及颞叶和顶叶。作者认为形态特征可高精度预测测验表现，支持在临床中采用跨诊断思路理解潜在病理生理，并将基于神经影像的症状预测视为可实现的目标；但摘要未报告预测在独立样本中的验证或临床效用。

papers.title: Shared cortical morphometry and molecular signatures across depression and physical diseases.
papers.authors: Jiang C, Zhou H, Yuan Y, Xu W, Zhou Y, Sun T, You L, Chen S, Yin Y, Yue Y, Liu X, Sun G, Zhang Y, Tan J, Shi R, Xu X, Xu Z, Zhou Z, Guo W, Jiang W, Yuan Y.
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is highly comorbid with physical diseases, suggesting shared neurobiological mechanisms. However, the common structural and molecular substrates underlying this comorbidity remain poorly understood. We analyzed multimodal MRI data from 577 patients (MDD, asthma, fibromyalgia, gastroesophageal reflux disease, type 2 diabetes) and 275 healthy controls, constructed individual morphometric similarity networks (MSN) to identify shared cortical alterations, and applied principal component analysis with multiscale molecular annotation (transcriptomic, cell-type, neurotransmitter, and cognitive mapping) to characterize underlying mechanisms. All patient groups exhibited regional MSN abnormalities. A shared MSN pattern emerged, featuring increased similarity in visual and somatomotor regions and decreased similarity in ventral attention, limbic, and default mode networks, and was replicated in independent cohorts. This pattern was significantly associated with spatial gene expression enriched for synaptic signaling, membrane potential regulation, and neuronal architecture, with predominant expression in excitatory/inhibitory neurons and astrocytes. It further mapped onto specific neurotransmitter systems, with exploratory cognitive decoding suggesting possible relevance to emotion and social cognition. Related genes overlapped with known risk loci for Alzheimer's disease and bipolar disorder. These findings identify a robust across diseases cortical MSN phenotype linked to convergent molecular and neurochemical correlates, offering a framework for studying shared vulnerability and transdiagnostic mechanisms across depression and physical diseases.

papers.title: Audio long read: How to stay smart in the age of AI - the science of critical thinking.
papers.authors: Pearson H, Thompson B.

papers.title: Neural correlates of self-directed violence: A large-sample resting-state fMRI study from UK Biobank.
papers.authors: Lin JY, Chi IJ, Zhu JD, Yang AC.
papers.abstract: Background Suicide remains a leading cause of death worldwide, underscoring the importance of identifying neurobiological markers associated with suicidal behaviors. While nonsuicidal self-directed violence (NSSDV) is an established risk factor for future suicide attempts (SAs), the underlying neural distinctions between these behaviors remain insufficiently understood. Methods A total of 1,070 participants with a history of self-directed violence (SDV) were stratified into SA (n = 579) and NSSDV (n = 491) groups based on self-reported questionnaires. All data were collected from the UK Biobank between October 2016 and January 2024. Whole-brain connectome across 90 brain regions were analyzed. A general linear regression model was employed to identify significant functional connectivity (FC) correlations with SA. An exploratory analysis examined the correlation between FC and SDV frequency and recency. Results Compared to NSSDV, the SA group exhibited decreased FC in the bilateral amygdala and right putamen, alongside increased FC in the right caudate. Higher frequency of SDV was correlated with increased FC between the orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) and occipital regions, whereas individuals reporting SDV within the past 12 months showed trends of decreased FC between the OFC and both the rectus gyrus and temporal lobe. Conclusions This large-sample rs-fMRI study highlights distinct FC alterations associated with different dimensions of self-harm. Results implicated that the limbic and reward circuits appear particularly relevant in differentiating SA from NSSDV and in capturing variations tied to SDV frequency and recency. These insights advance our understanding of suicidal behaviors' neurobiological underpinnings and may inform targeted risk stratification.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于英国生物银行的大样本静息态功能磁共振数据，比较有自杀尝试史与仅有非自杀性自伤行为史两类人群的全脑功能连接差异，并探索连接强度与自伤频率、近期性的关联。结果显示，自杀尝试组在双侧杏仁核和右侧壳核的功能连接降低，右侧尾状核连接升高；自伤频率较高者眶额皮层与枕叶区域连接增强，而近一年内有自伤者眶额皮层与直回及颞叶的连接呈下降趋势。作者据此提出，边缘系统与奖赏回路可能有助于区分自杀尝试与非自杀性自伤，并与自伤行为的频率和近期性相关，但这些关联尚属横断面观察，不能推断因果或直接用于临床风险分层。

papers.title: EEG Resting-State Beta Band Dynamic Functional Connectivity Reveals State-Dependent Disruption of Language Network Lateralisation in First-Episode Schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Aubonnet R, Fiori Nastro F, Di Lorenzo C, Hassan M, Gargiulo P, Seri S, semantico working group, Di Lorenzo G.
papers.abstract: Language disorganisation is a core feature of schizophrenia with significant functional consequences. However, its neurophysiological substrates remain poorly characterised, particularly in the early stages of the illness. This study investigated whether first-episode schizophrenia (FES) is associated with disruption in the organisation of language-network lateralisation, using both static and dynamic functional connectivity metrics in the EEG beta band. Thirty-one FES patients and 32 age-matched healthy volunteer subjects (HVS) underwent resting-state 64-channel EEG. Source-level connectivity was estimated using the weighted phase lag index with sliding windows, yielding 979 connectivity matrices per participant. Brain network states (BNS) were identified via k-means clustering. Static connectivity was obtained by time-averaging. Temporal features, graph-theoretical metrics, and language-network laterality indices were extracted for both whole-network and language-specific analyses. Group comparisons used permutation-based tests with family-wise error correction. Static connectivity yielded no significant group differences in any metric. Dynamic analysis identified six BNS. FES showed a significant increase in the variability of the temporal dynamics and graph-theory features of BNS5, a state characterised by parieto-occipital dominance. The core language network laterality index was significantly reduced in FES within BNS1, a state characterised by auditory-visual dominance. BNS1 occurrence correlated negatively with language disorganisation scores. Dynamic BNS-specific language network metrics correlated with verbal fluency performance exclusively in FES. These findings demonstrate that language dysfunction in early psychosis is expressed as state-dependent disruption of brain network stability and language lateralisation, detectable only through dynamic connectivity analysis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注首发精神分裂症患者语言网络偏侧化的组织是否受损，采用静息态脑电β频段的静态与动态功能连接指标，比较患者与健康志愿者的脑网络状态。静态连接分析未发现任何指标的组间差异；动态分析识别出六种脑网络状态，患者在其中一种以顶枕优势为特征的状态下表现出时间动态和图论特征变异性增加，而在另一种以听视觉优势为特征的状态下，核心语言网络的偏侧化指数显著降低。该状态的出现频率与语言紊乱评分呈负相关，且状态特异的语言网络指标仅在患者中与言语流畅性表现相关。作者据此认为，早期精神病的语言功能障碍表现为依赖网络状态的稳定性与偏侧化破坏，只有通过动态连接分析才能检出。

papers.title: A shape deformation-based framework for constructing individualized subcortical morphological networks.
papers.authors: Lu S, Zhang J, Li J, Wang J.
papers.abstract: Individualized morphological brain networks have emerged as an important framework for imaging-based connectomics. However, existing methods have focused predominantly on the cerebral cortex, leaving subcortical structures largely unexplored despite their central roles in cognition and neuropsychiatric disorders. Here, we developed a novel framework for constructing individualized subcortical morphological networks from structural magnetic resonance imaging. Specifically, subcortical surfaces were reconstructed using a Point2Mesh-optimized multilayer perceptron architecture and vertex-wise shape deformation was quantified as the signed Euclidean distance between each vertex on an individual mesh and the corresponding vertex on the group-average template mesh. Interregional morphological connectivity in local shape deformation distributions was subsequently estimated using Jensen-Shannon Divergence. Applying this approach to the Human Connectome Project dataset, we found that subcortical morphological networks exhibited complex topological organization, including small-world architecture, modular organization, and highly connected hubs, which were consistently preserved at finer subregional scales. Analyses using an independent test-retest dataset further demonstrated fair-to-good reliability of these network properties. Importantly, these shape deformation-based networks showed significant coupling with subcortical functional networks estimated from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging. Leveraging large-scale multisite clinical datasets, we further demonstrated alterations of subcortical morphological networks in schizophrenia and major depressive disorder. Schizophrenia was characterized predominantly by right caudate-centered disruptions in morphological connectivity and nodal centrality, whereas major depressive disorder exhibited alterations only in nodal centrality of the right amygdala. Together, these findings establish a novel and reliable framework for investigating subcortical morphological network organization in the human brain across both healthy and psychiatric populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种基于形状变形的框架，用于从结构磁共振影像构建个体化皮层下形态学网络：先重建皮层下表面，再以顶点到组平均模板的带符号欧氏距离量化局部形状变形，并用Jensen-Shannon散度估计区域间形态连接。在人类连接组计划数据中，该网络呈现小世界、模块化和高连接枢纽等拓扑组织，且在更细分区尺度上保持一致；独立重测数据表明网络属性具有中等至良好信度，并与静息态功能网络显著耦合。利用多站点临床数据，作者报告精神分裂症主要表现为以右侧尾状核为中心的形态连接和节点中心性异常，重性抑郁障碍仅见右侧杏仁核节点中心性改变。这些结果提示该框架可用于研究健康与精神疾病人群的皮层下形态网络组织，但临床发现基于组间比较，尚不能推断因果或治疗意义。

papers.title: Amplitude-conditioned brain dynamics reveal widespread negative modulation and targeted positive modulation of functional networks.
papers.authors: Salehi MR, BashirGonbadi A, Soltanian-Zadeh H.
papers.abstract: Functional connectivity is traditionally characterized through pairwise interactions between brain regions. However, growing evidence suggests that neural communication is also shaped by higher-order interactions in which the activity of a third region modulates the coupling between others. Here, we introduce a whole-brain framework for mapping resting-state nonlinear conditional connectivity from functional MRI. For each cortical region, we quantified how spontaneous amplitude fluctuations modulate the functional connectivity of all other region pairs. This procedure generated a modulation spectrum for every connection, describing connectivity changes across multiple amplitude states of the modulator. From these spectra, we derived four interpretable features capturing modulatory strength, polarity, volatility, and nonlinear complexity. The framework was applied to resting-state data from the Human Connectome Project and evaluated using stationary surrogate models, spatial topography analyses, test-retest reliability assessments, and behavioral prediction. Surrogate analyses demonstrated that the observed modulation spectra could not be explained by static covariance structure or spectral properties alone, indicating genuine state-dependent dynamic interactions. Topographic mapping reveals a profound functional asymmetry: the macroscopic connectome is dominated by widespread negative modulatory influences, with positive modulation restricted to sparse assortative pathways. Furthermore, by evaluating the effect of temporal integration, we show that spatial and temporal aggregation robustly stabilizes these dynamic fluctuations into reliable, individual-specific traits. Finally, employing regularized predictive modeling, we demonstrate that these dynamic modulatory features can provide complementary predictive value beyond conventional static FC, particularly for capturing state-dependent affective traits such as internalizing behavior. Together, this framework unveils a structured, asymmetric, and behaviorally relevant higher-order modulatory architecture.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个基于静息态功能磁共振的全脑框架，量化每个皮层区域的自发振幅波动如何调节其他脑区之间的功能连接，并从调节谱中提取强度、极性、波动性和非线性复杂度等特征。对公开数据集的替代模型分析显示，这些调节谱无法仅由静态协方差或频谱特性解释，提示其反映真实的状态依赖动态交互。空间映射发现明显的功能不对称：全脑连接组以广泛的负向调节为主，正向调节仅见于稀疏的同类连接通路；时空聚合可将这些动态波动稳定为可靠的个体特异性特征。正则化预测建模进一步表明，这些动态调节特征在传统静态功能连接之外具有补充预测价值，尤其有助于捕捉内化行为等状态依赖的情感特质。

papers.title: Subjective emotional ratings dissociate brain activation and network patterns during counterfactual outcome processing.
papers.authors: Zhang T, Bai D, Wei X, Zhuo L, Zhang Q, Zhang J, Jin Z, Li L.
papers.abstract: Human decision-making integrates outcome evaluation, counterfactual comparison, and individual traits. We investigated the neural processing of outcome-related emotions during economic decision-making by classifying feedback according to participants' subjective emotional ratings rather than objective gain-loss categories. Participants completed a Wheel of Fortune gambling task during fMRI scanning and provided emotional ratings for feedback outcomes, enabling identification of regret, relief, disappointment, and elation. We also assessed individual differences in regret proneness, maximization tendencies, alternative search, high standards, and decision difficulty. Behaviorally, emotional ratings increased with larger obtained outcomes and decreased as reference outcomes increased, indicating robust modulation of outcome evaluation by counterfactual information Whole-brain analyses revealed greater activation for low-rating than high-rating outcomes, indicating stronger neural responses to negative than positive emotions across feedback types. Complete feedback also elicited greater activation than partial feedback within the same emotional valence. Network-level analyses revealed partially dissociable neural profiles for positive and negative emotions. Positive emotions, including elation and relief, predominantly recruited the somatomotor network, whereas negative emotions, including disappointment and regret, engaged broader distributions across the default mode, dorsal attention, and other large-scale networks. Regret elicited the largest activation extent, whereas elation elicited the smallest. Region-of-interest analyses showed that bilateral orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) responses were significantly greater for negative than positive emotions and for complete than partial feedback conditions. Across all four emotions, right OFC activation was negatively associated with maximization. For elation, relief, and disappointment, right OFC activation was also negatively associated with alternative search and decision difficulty, whereas these associations were absent for regret. Together, these findings demonstrate that subjective emotional evaluation, counterfactual context, and decision-related traits jointly shape the neural processing of decision outcomes, while suggesting relatively trait-independent neural processing of regret.

papers.title: Parietal structural and functional differentiation associated with visual tracking across motor participation profiles.
papers.authors: Zhang K, Qi M, Jiang L, Yan Q, Wang Y, Bai S, Cao C, Zhang D, Ma S.
papers.abstract: Purpose This study aimed to examine whether structural and resting-state functional measures of parietal subregions differ across predefined motor participation groups with comparable physical activity levels, and whether these neural measures are associated with visual tracking performance. Methods We adopted an a priori motor-cognitive grouping framework and recruited athletes accordingly, using two representative sports as operational exemplars for each profile: (1) externally driven spatial updating and action planning (ESU; basketball and taekwondo), (2) body-environment calibration and rhythmic sensorimotor integration (SCP; skating and running), and 3) internally guided control and sustained attentional precision (IPS; tai chi and shooting). A sedentary control group (CON) with low habitual physical activity was also recruited. In total, 80 college students participated. Physical activity (PA) was assessed using a standardized questionnaire. All participants underwent structural MRI and resting-state fMRI to derive gray matter volume (GMV), fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF), degree centrality (DC), regional homogeneity (ReHo), and functional connectivity (FC) within parietal subregions (S1, SPL, AG, and SMG). Supplementary SPL-based FC analyses further examined connectivity with regions of the broader visuospatial and sensorimotor network. Visual tracking was assessed using a multiple object tracking (MOT) task across three difficulty levels. Results PA levels were significantly higher in all athlete groups than in sedentary controls, with no differences among athlete groups. Across structural and resting-state functional measures, the most consistent group differences were selectively concentrated in S1 and SPL, whereas effects involving other parietal regions were less consistent across measures. Specifically, the ESU group exhibited the highest bilateral S1 GMV, the SCP group showed the highest bilateral SPL GMV, and the IPS group demonstrated the highest fALFF in both S1 and SPL. The IPS group also showed the highest ReHo in bilateral SPL. FC differed significantly across several parietal connections, with distinct connectivity patterns across the three athlete groups. MOT accuracy differed significantly across groups at all difficulty levels, with the ESU and IPS groups outperforming the SCP and CON groups overall. Across all participants, multiple S1 and SPL metrics showed modest associations with MOT performance (r = 0.20-0.40). Within athlete subgroups, stronger and task-specific associations were observed, particularly in the SCP and IPS groups (r = 0.50-0.80). Conclusions These findings identify distinct structural and functional patterns predominantly involving S1 and SPL across different motor participation profiles, despite comparable overall physical activity levels among the athlete groups. Such parietal differences are accompanied by difficulty-dependent differences in visual tracking performance and heterogeneous brain-behavior associations. Together, the results highlight S1 and SPL as the parietal regions showing the most consistent differentiation across structural and functional measures in association with distinct motor participation profiles and visual tracking performance, and provide a focused empirical basis for future investigations into the sources of this heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察不同运动参与特征的大学生在顶叶亚区结构与静息态功能指标上是否存在差异，以及这些指标是否与多目标视觉追踪表现相关。研究按预设的运动—认知分组框架招募运动员，并设久坐对照组，采集结构MRI与静息态fMRI，同时用多难度视觉追踪任务评估表现。结果显示，在总体身体活动水平相当的运动员组之间，最一致的组间差异集中在S1和SPL，不同运动组在这两个区域的结构与功能指标上各有优势，顶叶部分连接模式也随组别不同；视觉追踪成绩存在组间差异，且S1、SPL的多个指标与追踪表现呈中等关联，在运动员亚组内关联更强并具有任务特异性。作者据此认为，S1和SPL是随运动参与特征和视觉追踪表现出现最一致分化的顶叶区域，但脑与行为关联存在异质性，相关结果尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Multivariate prediction of white matter BOLD activity and its relationship to marginal connectivity.
papers.authors: Li M, Ding Z, Gore JC.
papers.abstract: Functional MRI studies have traditionally focused on gray matter, whereas white matter BOLD signals have often been treated as weak or artifactual. However, white matter BOLD fluctuations are robustly detectable and contain reproducible functional information, yet most gray-to-white matter analyses rely on only marginal functional connectivity, which cannot separate pairwise coupling from shared variance among distributed cortical systems.
