A separate cohort of 675 patients with missing registry labels was used for an exploratory missingness-recovery analysis, validated against annotations of a random subsample. Our best-performing model was used to conduct further site-specific metastasis classification, based on available registry data. Results More than half (675/1260, 54%) of initially identified cohort 1 patients had missing or unknown registry metastasis labels. MedGemma demonstrated the best performance in overall metastasis classification (cohort 1: F1 -score=0.80; cohort 2 patient-level: F1 -score=1.0; cohort 2 note-level: F1 -score=0.93). For brain/CNS metastasis, Llama3 performed best in both cohorts (cohort 1: F1 -score=0.79; cohort 2 patient-level: F1 -score=0.93; cohort 2 note-level: F1 -score=0.86). The fine-tuned GatorTron model showed strong performance for classification of overall metastasis in cohort 1 (F1 -score=0.72). Error analysis indicated that several model errors reflected incomplete registry labels, ambiguous clinical language, or missing documentation. In the exploratory recovery analysis, model predictions agreed with manual annotations at an accuracy of 0.90 and F1 -score of 0.89. Additional site-specific metastasis classification by MedGemma demonstrated high performance for liver metastasis (F1 -score=0.82) and bone metastasis (F1 -score=0.79). Conclusions All models demonstrated relatively high performance. The zero-shot generative models were more robust to nuanced documentation and context-dependent brain/CNS metastasis extraction. The fine-tuned encoder model demonstrated strong classification performance but may have been limited by potential inaccuracies in the registry reference standards during model training. This study further demonstrated the potential of LLMs in recovering plausible structured labels from narrative text, complementing cancer registries for metastasis ascertainment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了三种大语言模型从非小细胞肺癌临床记录中提取转移信息的效果，任务包括判断是否存在任何部位转移以及是否存在脑或中枢神经系统转移，并在两个独立队列上分别以登记字段和人工双标注为参照。结果显示，零样本生成模型整体表现较好，其中MedGemma在总体转移分类上最优，Llama 3.1-70B在脑或中枢神经系统转移上最优，微调编码器模型也有较强表现。误差分析提示部分错误源于登记标签不完整、临床表述含糊或记录缺失；探索性分析还表明模型预测与人工标注吻合度较高，提示大语言模型或可从叙述性文本中补全结构化登记字段，但结论仍属回顾性比较，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Striatal tissue iron in depressed and healthy individuals and the effect of buproprion
papers.authors: Jeleńska H, Grigoras I, Price R, Walsh A, Browning M, Harmer C, Reinecke A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction: Dopaminergic dysfunction in the striatum is thought to play a central role in anhedonia in major depressive disorder (MDD). Normalised T2*-weighted (nT2*w) imaging provides a widely available MRI-derived proxy of striatal tissue iron, an indirect marker of dopaminergic function, but its relationship with reward processing and anhedonia in MDD has not been established. In this secondary analysis, we examined whether striatal nT2*w distinguishes individuals with MDD from healthy controls, is associated with reward learning and clinical symptoms, including anhedonia and depression, and is sensitive to treatment with the dopaminergic antidepressant bupropion Methods Depressed (n = 40) and healthy participants (n = 41) underwent clinical assessment, functional MRI, and a probabilistic instrumental learning task (PILT) at baseline, with follow-up assessments after 2 and 6 weeks. Participants with MDD received open-label bupropion treatment throughout the 6-week study. The primary outcome was MRI-derived striatal tissue iron, quantified using nT2*w signal extracted from resting-state fMRI within the whole striatum, caudate, putamen, and nucleus accumbens. Associations between nT2*w, diagnostic group, reward learning, clinical symptoms, and treatment response were examined. Results At baseline, depressed participants compared to healthy controls showed significantly higher striatal and caudate nT2*w values, indicative of lower tissue iron. The marker demonstrated excellent 2-week test-retest reliability in healthy participants. Striatal nT2*w was not associated with reward learning, anhedonia, or depression severity at baseline, and did not change following 2 weeks of bupropion treatment or predict clinical response after 6 weeks. Across groups, females demonstrated higher nT2*w values (lower tissue iron) than males in the striatum, caudate, and putamen. Discussion Striatal nT2*w represents a promising, robust and widely accessible neuroimaging marker of depression, reliably distinguishing depressed individuals from healthy controls while demonstrating excellent test–retest reliability. Larger longitudinal studies are now needed to establish its clinical utility and determine whether it can detect changes in reward processing and treatment response across the course of illness.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以抑郁症患者与健康对照为对象，结合静息态功能MRI衍生的纹状体组织铁代理指标、奖赏学习任务和临床评估，考察该指标能否区分抑郁个体、是否与奖赏学习及快感缺失等症状相关，以及是否随多巴胺能抗抑郁药安非他酮治疗而变化。结果显示，基线时抑郁者的纹状体和尾状核nT2*w值更高，提示组织铁较低，且该指标在健康人中重测信度良好；但它与奖赏学习、快感缺失和抑郁严重程度均无关联，治疗两周后也未改变，亦不能预测六周后的临床反应。作者据此认为该指标是有前景且易获取的抑郁症影像标记，但其临床效用及对奖赏加工和治疗反应的敏感性仍需更大规模纵向研究确认。

papers.title: PAI-1-IL-17 statistical interaction and periventricular white matter hyperintensity severity in sporadic cerebral small vessel disease.
papers.authors: Zilong Y, Chunlan H, Baoai W.
papers.abstract: The factors influencing the severity of periventricular white matter hyperintensity (WMH) in cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) are not fully understood. This study investigated the multiplicative interaction between circulating plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 (PAI-1) and interleukin-17 (IL-17) concerning periventricular WMH severity. In this single-center, cross-sectional study, we enrolled 151 patients with sporadic CSVD, selected from 526 consecutively screened inpatients. Serum levels of PAI-1, IL-17, and matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) were quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays. Regional WMH was graded on magnetic resonance imaging using the Fazekas scale. Multivariable logistic regression was employed to assess the PAI-1-IL-17 interaction for moderate-to-severe periventricular WMH (Fazekas scores 2-3 vs. 0-1), with additional adjustments for MMP-9 and sensitivity analyses. The primary interaction odds ratio (OR) was 1.72 per one-standard-deviation increase in the standardized product term (95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.07-2.77; p = 0.026). Adjusting for MMP-9 did not substantially change this estimate. The interaction was not statistically significant in the ordinal periventricular analysis (OR: 1.40; 95% CI: 0.99-1.99; p = 0.061) or the deep-WMH model (OR: 0.83; 95% CI: 0.51-1.37; p = 0.468). While alternative binary models showed positive interaction estimates, resampling analyses indicated limited stability, and additive interaction lacked consistent support. These exploratory findings suggest a multiplicative statistical interaction between PAI-1 and IL-17 for dichotomized periventricular WMH severity. However, they do not establish causality, biological synergy, or clinical biomarker utility. Prospective multicenter validation is essential.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究在散发性脑小血管病患者中探讨循环PAI-1与IL-17对侧脑室旁白质高信号严重程度的相乘交互作用，采用酶联免疫吸附测定血清水平并以Fazekas量表评估影像学分级。多变量logistic回归显示，两指标标准化乘积项每增加一个标准差，中重度侧脑室旁白质高信号的交互比值比为1.72，校正MMP-9后估计值变化不大；但该交互在有序分析和深部白质模型中不显著，重采样分析提示稳定性有限，相加交互也缺乏一致支持。作者将这些结果定位为探索性发现，强调其仅提示统计学交互，不能据此推断因果、生物学协同或临床生物标志物价值，尚需前瞻性多中心验证。

papers.title: Remembered event features shape default mode network engagement during emotional memory recall.
papers.authors: Curko N, Samide R, Krenz V, Kensinger EA, Ritchey M.
papers.abstract: Episodic memory involves reconstruction of past events through integration of multiple types of information, including perceptual details, narrative content, and emotional tone. The default mode network (DMN) is a set of regions thought to support episodic retrieval, yet it remains unclear how distinct subnetworks contribute to recall of these different memory features. Here, we examined how DMN subnetworks support and represent memory for naturalistic emotional events. Male and female human participants encoded short news videos that varied in emotional valence and recalled them in response to neutral cues during functional MRI scanning. Videos were again recalled one day later and memories were scored for perceptual and narrative details. Activity in the dorsomedial subnetwork was related to the emotional valence of the memory, while activity in the medial temporal subnetwork was associated with the number of perceptual details recalled. Multivariate pattern analyses further revealed that the medial temporal subnetwork exhibited greater pattern stability across recalls when recalling more perceptual details, while stability in the dorsomedial and core subnetworks was tied to emotional remembering. Our findings suggest that the dorsomedial subnetwork provides an affective frame for a memory, while the medial temporal subnetwork contributes perceptual specificity. These results demonstrate that the contents of memory retrieval shape network engagement during emotional recall, providing insight into how the brain reconstructs complex real-world experiences.Significance Statement How do we remember the emotional tone of an event versus its visual details? This study examines how distinct subnetworks within the brain's default mode network (DMN) contribute to remembering different features of memory. While the medial temporal subnetwork is connected to retrieving the perceptual details of past events, the dorsomedial subnetwork supports recall of the emotional tone. Furthermore, patterns of activity in the medial temporal subnetwork are more stable when recalling more perceptually rich memories, while stability in the dorsomedial subnetwork is tied to emotional remembering. These findings suggest that the default mode network flexibly responds to different kinds of memory features, supporting the reconstruction of rich emotional memories from complex real-world experiences.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注默认模式网络（DMN）内部不同亚网络如何参与自然情境下情绪性事件的记忆提取。研究者在功能磁共振扫描中让被试观看情绪效价不同的新闻短片，并在中性线索提示下回忆，次日再次回忆并对记忆中的知觉与叙事细节评分。结果显示，背内侧亚网络的活动与记忆的情绪效价相关，内侧颞叶亚网络的活动则与回忆出的知觉细节数量相关；多变量模式分析进一步表明，回忆的知觉细节越多，内侧颞叶亚网络在多次回忆间的活动模式越稳定，而背内侧和核心亚网络的稳定性则与情绪性回忆相关。作者据此提出，背内侧亚网络为记忆提供情感框架，内侧颞叶亚网络贡献知觉特异性，说明记忆提取的内容会塑造情绪回忆时的网络参与方式。

papers.title: White Matter Functional Disconnection Predicts Long-Term Disability and Early Mortality in Spontaneous Intracerebral Hemorrhage.
papers.authors: Morello A, Coletta L, Barchi M, Rizzo F, Zigiotto L, Sarubbo S, Garbossa D, Avesani P, Cofano F.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) has the highest short-term mortality among stroke subtypes, and progress in treatment has been hindered by the limited accuracy of current prognostic tools. We investigated whether white matter functional disconnection severity, estimated using a normative lesion network mapping framework integrating direct electrical stimulation and resting-state functional MRI data from previously published independent Data sets, improves prediction of 6-month functional outcome measured with the modified Rankin Scale (mRS). Methods We analyzed 97 patients with spontaneous ICH. Ordinal logistic regression models were used to evaluate the association between domain-specific disconnection severity and 6-month mRS, and to compare traditional functional outcome in patients with primary intracerebral hemorrhage and ICH scores with connectivity-enriched models incorporating disconnection measures. Results White matter functional disconnectivity was significantly associated with 6-month functional outcome (mRS; P < .001; Nagelkerke's R2 = 0.507). Integrating disconnection severity into the functional outcome in patients with primary intracerebral hemorrhage and ICH scores improved predictive performance in both cases (Nagelkerke's R2 = 0.615 vs 0.389 and 0.651 vs 0.434, respectively), with the connectivity-enriched ICH score achieving the strongest overall fit across all models tested. Exploratory analyses showed associations between domain-specific disconnection severity, residual functional deficits, and early mortality. Conclusion Assessment of white matter functional disconnection severity seems to be a promising approach for predicting long-term disability after ICH, although prospective validation in larger multicenter cohorts is required before clinical implementation. The findings suggest that different brain networks exhibit variable vulnerability to injury and differential potential for functional recovery.
keywords: Functional Outcome In Patients With Primary Intracerebral Hemorrhage
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨自发性脑出血后白质功能失连接严重程度能否改善对6个月功能结局的预测，并比较其与传统评分的预测表现。研究基于97例患者，采用整合直接电刺激与静息态功能MRI数据的规范病灶网络映射框架估计失连接，用序贯逻辑回归分析其与改良Rankin量表的关系。结果显示，白质功能失连接与6个月功能结局显著相关，将其加入传统评分后预测表现均有提升，其中整合失连接的ICH评分整体拟合最佳；探索性分析还提示特定域失连接与残余功能缺损及早期死亡存在关联。作者认为，该指标有望用于预测脑出血后长期残疾，但临床应用前仍需在更大规模多中心队列中前瞻性验证，且不同脑网络对损伤的易感性和恢复潜力可能不同。

papers.title: Midlife and Late-Life Alzheimer Disease Blood Biomarkers and 11-Year Cognitive Decline.
papers.authors: Smith JR, Pike JR, Lu Y, Walker KA, Sullivan KJ, Windham BG, Thyagarajan B, Mielke MM, Lutsey PL, Hughes TM, Knopman DS, Gottesman RF, Mosley TH, Coresh J, Deal JA, Sharrett AR, Palta P.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Plasma biomarkers of Alzheimer disease (AD) neuropathology (amyloid-β42 to amyloid β40 [Aβ42/40] ratio, phosphorylated tau at threonine [p-tau181]), neurodegeneration (neurofilament light [NfL]), and neuroinflammation (glial fibrillary acidic protein [GFAP]) in late-life are associated with cognitive decline. Whether these biomarkers in midlife are predictive of subsequent cognitive decline, and whether they are associated with different cognitive domains, is uncertain. In this study, we investigated associations of midlife and late-life plasma Aβ42/40, p-tau181, NfL, and GFAP with late-life change in domain-specific (memory, language, and executive function) and global cognitive function. Methods We performed a prospective cohort analysis of the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Neurocognitive Study (ARIC-NCS). Outcome follow-up was from ARIC visit 5 (2011-2013) to visit 9 (2021-2022). We included all individuals from ARIC field centers (Jackson, Mississippi; Forsyth County, North Carolina; Washington County, Maryland; and Minneapolis suburbs, Minnesota) with biomarkers measured from stored specimens in midlife (visit 3, 1993-1995, mean age 59.0 years) and late-life (visit 5, 2011-2013, mean age 76.8 years). Aβ42/40, p-tau181, NfL, and GFAP were measured with the Quanterix Simoa platform and standardized to visit 3 to facilitate cross-biomarker comparisons of their rate of change from midlife to late-life. We estimated change in memory, language, executive function, and global cognition factor scores from visit 5 to visit 9 with linear mixed-effect models. Results In 1,515 included participants, 60.7% (n = 920) were female and 25.5% (n = 387) were Black. Each SD increase in p-tau181 in midlife was significantly associated with faster late-life memory decline (β = -0.030 [95% CI -0.059 to -0.001] SD. Midlife Aβ42/40, NfL, and GFAP were not associated with subsequent decline in any cognitive domain. In late-life, p-tau181, NfL, and GFAP were significantly associated with faster decline in different cognitive domains, with the strongest associations seen with memory (β = -0.091 [95% CI -0.123 to -0.058] SD; β = -0.064 [95% CI -0.106 to -0.023] SD; and β = -0.048 [95% CI -0.082 to -0.013] SD, respectively). Discussion Midlife p-tau181 was associated with faster 11-year memory decline beginning 20 years later in the ARIC cohort, which underscores a potentially long prodromal phase of cognitive decline that could precede dementia onset. In late-life, biomarkers for AD, neurodegeneration, and neuroinflammation were associated with faster decline across different cognitive domains, but associations remained strongest for p-tau181 and memory.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ARIC前瞻性队列，考察中年和晚年血浆阿尔茨海默病相关生物标志物与随后11年认知功能下降的关联。结果显示，中年p-tau181升高与晚年记忆下降更快相关，而中年Aβ42/40、NfL和GFAP未见类似关联；晚年p-tau181、NfL和GFAP则分别与不同认知域的更快下降相关，其中p-tau181与记忆的关联最强。作者据此提示，中年p-tau181可能预示约20年后开始的记忆衰退，反映认知下降前存在较长的前驱期；晚年AD病理、神经变性和神经炎症标志物则与多认知域下降相关，但关联强度仍以p-tau181和记忆最为突出。

papers.title: Recommendations for the Management of Spontaneous Intracranial Hypotension With Spinal Longitudinal Epidural CSF Collection: A Delphi Study.
papers.authors: Choi S, Carroll I, Friedman DI, Kranz PG, Lee E, Matharu M, Parikh S, Schytz HW, Souza MNP, Wang YF, Yuan H, Lee MJ.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Spontaneous intracranial hypotension (SIH) results from spinal CSF leakage. Epidural blood patch (EBP) is an important first-line treatment. However, pre-EBP, intra-EBP, and post-EBP practice varies widely owing to limited consensus guidance. We aimed to develop expert consensus statements to support clinical decision-making in SIH management, including peri-EBP practices, focusing on patients with spinal longitudinal epidural CSF collection (SLEC) before definitive leak type classification. Methods An international multidisciplinary Delphi process was conducted between January 2024 and July 2025, involving experts in neurology, neurosurgery, radiology, and anesthesiology. Consensus was defined a priori as ≥70% agreement for strong agreement, 60%-69% for partial agreement, and <60% for no consensus, based on a 5-point Likert scale in round 3. Responses were collected anonymously using an online survey platform, with summarized feedback from the previous round provided between rounds. Results Fourteen experts were invited, with 10, 9, and 9 participants in rounds 1, 2, and 3, respectively. Before EBP, bed rest was recommended for recent-onset SIH with severe orthostatic headache (88.9%); other conservative methods such as abdominal binder and hydration were considered not mandatory (90%). Semitargeted EBP was recommended as initial management for patients with extradural CSF collections (70%). Dynamic CT myelography was preferred for localization (70%). Post-EBP care was variable, particularly in bed rest duration, with most recommendations (70%) exceeding 12 hours. Definitions of clinical remission (80%) and radiologic remission (90%) were established. Radiologic follow-up after clinical remission was recommended (78%). No consensus was reached on follow-up strategies for persistent symptoms, although "doing nothing" was not recommended. No consensus was reached for persistent extradural CSF despite clinical remission, requiring an individualized approach. Light activity after EBP was recommended within a few days (70%). No consensus was reached on the optimal number of EBPs before invasive leak localization or surgical intervention. Discussion This Delphi study outlines expert recommendations and uncertainties for SIH management, including peri-EBP practices. This study incorporated the initial management strategy for patients in whom leak-type classification was incomplete. However, the treatment section primarily focused on the SLEC-positive setting and presumed ventral dural tears; lateral dural tears and CSF-venous fistulas warrant future consensus development.

papers.title: A Primer on COL4A1/COL4A2-Related Cerebral Small Vessel Disease for Neurologists.
papers.authors: Alten B, Ullman NL, Porcari G, Sloane KL, Cristancho AG, Rothstein A.
papers.abstract: COL4A1 and COL4A2 encode type IV collagen, a principal structural component of basement membranes, and pathogenic variants in these genes cause a multisystem small vessel vasculopathy with prominent cerebrovascular involvement. Despite increasing recognition with the expansion of genetic testing, COL4A1/2 -related cerebral small vessel disease remains underrecognized in clinical practice, in part due to its striking phenotypic heterogeneity. Presentations span a broad clinical spectrum-from asymptomatic individuals or incidental imaging findings to recurrent ischemic events, intracerebral hemorrhage, and catastrophic perinatal brain injury-and may occur across the lifespan. In this narrative review, we provide a clinically oriented framework for recognizing and managing COL4A1/2 -related cerebral small vessel disease. We integrate underlying molecular mechanisms of type IV collagen dysfunction with vascular pathophysiology, highlighting how impaired basement membrane integrity leads to a dual hemorrhagic-ischemic phenotype. We describe characteristic neuroimaging patterns, including microhemorrhages, white matter hyperintensities, lacunes, and dilated perivascular spaces, and emphasize their anatomic distribution and clinical relevance. Given the systemic nature of the disorder, we also review key extracerebral manifestations-including ocular, renal, and musculoskeletal features-that serve as important diagnostic "red flags." We outline practical considerations for clinical care, including indications for genetic testing, initial diagnostic evaluation, and longitudinal management strategies tailored to neurologists. Particular emphasis is placed on individualized decision-making around antithrombotic therapy, hemorrhage risk mitigation, and surveillance for complications such as intracranial aneurysms. Illustrative multigenerational cases are incorporated to demonstrate genotype-phenotype correlation, incomplete penetrance, and common diagnostic pitfalls. By providing a mechanism-informed and clinically actionable synthesis, this review aims to improve recognition, reduce misdiagnosis, and guide management of COL4A1/2 -related cerebral small vessel disease.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述面向神经科医生，梳理了COL4A1/COL4A2基因致病变异引起的脑小血管病。作者将IV型胶原功能障碍的分子机制与血管病理生理联系起来，指出基底膜完整性受损可导致出血与缺血并存的双重表型，并总结了微出血、白质高信号、腔隙和血管周围间隙扩大等神经影像特征及其解剖分布。文章还强调眼、肾和骨骼肌肉等脑外表现可作为诊断线索，并讨论了基因检测指征、抗栓治疗的个体化决策、出血风险控制及颅内动脉瘤监测等临床管理要点，借助家系病例说明基因型-表型相关、不完全外显和常见诊断误区，旨在提高对该病的识别并减少误诊。

papers.title: Seizures Secondary to Aconitum Plant Poisoning: a case report.
papers.authors: Zhao Z, Zhang J, Du J, Liu L, Rao G, Zhou M.
papers.abstract: Background Aconitum plant poisoning typically manifests as isolated early cardiotoxicity or late neurotoxicity. However, the dynamic temporal evolution from arrhythmia-driven cardiogenic syncope to true epileptic seizures mediated by direct central nervous system injury remains rarely documented and poorly characterized. Case presentation We report a 53-year-old Han Chinese male who presented with ventricular tachycardia rapidly degenerating into ventricular fibrillation and cardiac arrest following ingestion of homemade Aconitum kusnezoffii (caowu)-infused liquor. Initial convulsions were tightly coupled with malignant arrhythmias, consistent with cardiogenic syncope. After successful resuscitation, hemoperfusion, and restoration of stable sinus rhythm, the patient developed breakthrough generalized tonic-clonic seizures on hospital days 4-6. Electroencephalography performed during sedation withdrawal revealed bilateral occipital spike-and-slow and sharp-and-slow waves with focal epileptiform discharges, confirming direct central nervous system neurotoxicity rather than recurrent cardiac ischemia. A mechanism-based, staged treatment strategy was employed: early advanced cardiac life support and hemoperfusion targeted cardiotoxicity, while sodium valproate and acetylglutamine were administered for antiepileptic prophylaxis and neuroprotection. The patient was discharged on day 13; antiepileptic therapy was successfully tapered and discontinued at 3 months without seizure recurrence, with normalization of electroencephalography and electrocardiography. Conclusions This case provides the first systematic documentation, validated by electroencephalography, of the transition from cardiogenic convulsions to true epileptic seizures in Aconitum alkaloid poisoning. The findings highlight the critical role of pharmacokinetic-driven central nervous system retention in delayed seizure onset and underscore the necessity of prolonged neurological monitoring, early electroencephalography evaluation for late-onset convulsions, and sustained antiepileptic prophylaxis to reduce mortality and long-term neurological sequelae. Key clinical message Aconitum plant poisoning may manifest as early cardiogenic syncope and convulsions secondary to malignant arrhythmias, progressing in the late stage to genuine seizures caused by central nervous system (CNS) injury. Effective management requires a staged treatment strategy targeting both cardiotoxicity and neurotoxicity, with a focus on stabilizing cardiac rhythm and providing neuroprotection as needed.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一篇病例报告，报告一名53岁男性饮用自制草乌药酒后，先出现室性心动过速并恶化为心室颤动和心脏骤停，早期抽搐与恶性心律失常同步，符合心源性晕厥。复苏并恢复窦性心律后，患者在第4至6天出现全面性强直-阵挛发作，脑电图显示双侧枕区尖慢波和尖慢复合波伴局灶性癫痫样放电，提示中枢神经系统直接神经毒性，而非心脏缺血复发。作者据此采用分阶段治疗，早期针对心脏毒性进行高级生命支持和血液灌流，后期用丙戊酸钠和乙酰谷酰胺进行抗癫痫预防和神经保护，患者出院后抗癫痫治疗逐渐减停且无复发。该病例强调草乌中毒迟发性癫痫发作需延长神经监测、尽早脑电图评估并持续抗癫痫预防。

papers.title: Amygdala neurofeedback as an adjunct to residential dialectical behavior therapy for borderline personality disorder: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
papers.authors: Hofmanová M, Santangelo PS, Kleindienst N, Schmahl C, Paret C.
papers.abstract: Background Borderline personality disorder (BPD) is characterized by affective instability and amygdala hyperreactivity. Although dialectical behavior therapy (DBT) reduces symptoms and amygdala-related abnormalities, many patients show only partial remission. Real-time functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) amygdala neurofeedback (amy-NF) directly targets hyperactive limbic responses and has shown promise in uncontrolled trials. We examined whether amy-NF adds benefit to inpatient DBT. Methods Thirty-six mid-therapy people with BPD and clinically significant residual symptoms (BSL-23 > 1.5) were randomized to DBT plus amy-NF (n = 23) or DBT alone, termed treatment as usual (TAU = 13). Post-treatment assessments were completed by 15/9 (amy-NF/TAU), with 15/8 and 12/7 completing the 3- and 6-month follow-ups. Ecological momentary assessment (EMA) of daily-life affective instability served as the primary outcome. Secondary outcomes included self-reports, amygdala responses during two fMRI tasks, and resting-state fMRI. Assessments occurred at pre-, post-, 3-, and 6-month follow-up. Results Participants successfully downregulated amygdala activity during neurofeedback. EMA showed improvements in negative affect, inner tension, and affective instability over time, without consistent superiority of amy-NF. Self-reports likewise showed no additional benefit of amy-NF, and BSL-23 scores increased after discharge in both groups. Amy-NF was associated with transient pre-post reductions in amygdala activity during both viewing and regulation in the emotion regulation task, and with more stable amygdala reactivity over time than TAU in the faces task. Resting-state analyses showed transient pre-post increases in amygdala connectivity with precuneus and dorsomedial frontal regions in amy-NF. Conclusions Amygdala neurofeedback is feasible and reduced amygdala activity in BPD, but did not yield additional clinical benefit when delivered alongside intensive residential DBT, although the small sample may have limited power to detect such effects. Trial registration The study protocol was preregistered 2020/03/26 on ClinicalTrials.gov and received the ID NCT04333888.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步随机对照试验检验在住院辩证行为治疗（DBT）基础上加入杏仁核实时fMRI神经反馈，能否为仍有明显残留症状的边缘型人格障碍患者带来额外获益。参与者能在神经反馈中下调杏仁核活动，但日常情绪不稳定的生态瞬时评估及自评量表均未显示神经反馈组持续优于单用DBT，两组出院后症状评分都有回升。神经反馈仅伴随治疗前后杏仁核活动的短暂变化及后续反应稳定性差异，作者据此认为其可行但未显示附加临床疗效，样本量小可能限制检验效力。

papers.title: Mentalizing from self and friend perspectives: Relations between inter-brain neural similarity, affective similarity and social anxiety symptoms.
papers.authors: Vallorani A, McNaughton KA, Lytle MN, Hallquist MN, Redcay E, Pérez-Edgar K.
papers.abstract: Social interactions are dynamic and complex, relying on tracking variation in your own and your partner's affective and mental states. Being "in-sync" neurally and building a shared consensus can mark successful social interactions. In addition, social anxiety can impact social experiences. We used a novel, naturalistic paradigm to investigate relations between inter-brain neural similarity within mentalizing regions, affective similarity, and social anxiety symptoms. Undergraduate student friend pairs (N = 34, 85% White, 65% Women) engaged in a social interaction while videos captured from their individual perspectives were recorded. Participants watched clips of the social interaction from both their own perspective (their personal view of the social interaction) and their friend's perspective (their friend's personal view of the social interaction) while fMRI data were collected. They rated their affect after each clip. Inter-brain neural similarity was computed across three conditions: 1) Same-Stimuli: both participants viewed identical visual stimuli as in a traditional neural similarity paradigm, 2) Self-Perspective: both participants viewed the clip from their own perspective like the originally experienced social interaction, and 3) Friend-Perspective: both participants viewed the clip from their friend's perspective, a novel perspective. Participants self-reported their social anxiety symptoms, and affective similarity captured affect rating concordance within dyads. In contrast to the Same-Stimuli condition, when participants viewed the clips like they originally experienced the social interaction (Self-Perspective), greater affective similarity was associated with greater inter-brain neural similarity. When participants viewed the clips from a novel perspective (Friend-Perspective), participants lower in social anxiety symptoms exhibited greater inter-brain neural similarity with greater affective similarity; whereas participants higher in social anxiety symptoms exhibited greater inter-brain neural similarity with less affective similarity. The results suggest stimuli from socially relevant perspectives, rather than identical stimuli, may reveal more nuanced brain-behavior dynamics, allowing for a better understanding of individual differences in socioemotional experience.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用自然互动视频结合fMRI，考察朋友配对在心理化脑区的人际神经相似性与情绪相似性、社交焦虑症状之间的关系。参与者分别从自己和朋友的第一视角观看互动片段并评定情绪。结果发现，当双方按原本经历互动的方式观看（自我视角）时，情绪相似性越高，人际神经相似性越强；而从朋友这一新视角观看时，社交焦虑症状较低者表现出情绪相似性与神经相似性的正向关联，症状较高者则呈相反方向。作者据此认为，具有社会相关性的视角比相同刺激更能揭示脑与行为之间的细致动态，有助于理解社会情绪体验的个体差异。

papers.title: Insulin resistance and brain sulcal morphology in non-diabetic adults.
papers.authors: Yoshimaru D, Yuzawa A, Ozawa M, Hirabayashi M, Matsushita Y, Tsurugizawa T, Okano HJ.
papers.abstract: Insulin resistance exerts direct effects on brain structure, yet most neuroimaging evidence comes from populations with established diabetes, and conventional gray matter volumetry may lack sensitivity to detect early structural changes. Here, we examined associations between insulin resistance and sulcal morphology, a measure that integrates cortical thinning, subcortical atrophy, and white matter degeneration into a single outcome, in 728 non-diabetic adults (518 men, 210 women; mean age 61.4 ± 11.6 years). Brain volumes were quantified using OpenMAP-T1, an automated deep learning-based parcellation tool, and associations between HOMA-IR and 30 cerebrospinal fluid-related regional volumes were examined using multiple linear regression adjusted for age, sex, and estimated total intracranial volume, with FDR correction for multiple comparisons. Higher HOMA-IR was significantly associated with greater frontal sulcal volumes (left: β = 596 mm³, right: β = 344 mm³; both FDR-corrected p < 0.001), with a dose-response relationship across insulin resistance categories. This association was observed only in men (sex × HOMA-IR interaction p = 0.019) and was strongest in participants younger than 70 years. Mediation analysis revealed that the relationship between BMI and frontal sulcal enlargement was largely accounted for by the indirect pathway through insulin resistance, with no significant direct effect of BMI. These findings suggest that sulcal morphology can detect metabolic effects on brain structure at a pre-diabetic stage, changes that were not apparent through frontal gray matter volumetry in the same sample, and identify insulin resistance as a potential modifiable target for preserving brain health.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在非糖尿病成年人中考察胰岛素抵抗与脑沟形态的关系，用自动化工具量化脑区脑脊液相关体积并结合回归分析。结果发现，较高的胰岛素抵抗与额叶脑沟体积增大相关，且呈分级关系；这一关联仅见于男性，并在较年轻参与者中更强。中介分析提示，体重指数与额叶脑沟扩大的联系主要通过胰岛素抵抗间接实现，而体重指数的直接效应不显著。作者认为，脑沟形态或能在糖尿病前期捕捉代谢对脑结构的影响，而同一样本中额叶灰质体积测量未显示相应变化；不过这些均为观察性关联，不能据此推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Assessing the reliability of hippocampal single-voxel proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy through intra-class effect decomposition.
papers.authors: Nilsson M, Berrebi J, Nikkhou-Aski S, Avelar-Pereira B, Thorsell P, Legendi V, Guitart-Masip M, Papenberg G.
papers.abstract: The hippocampus is crucial for learning, memory, and stress regulation, but is vulnerable to influences that compromise its structural and metabolic integrity. Proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) enables in vivo quantification of hippocampal neurochemistry, yet the absolute and relative reliability of these measures has rarely been systematically evaluated. We assessed hippocampal metabolite estimates acquired with single-voxel MRS using a semi-adiabatic localization by adiabatic selective refocusing (semi-LASER) sequence at 3 T. Nineteen healthy adults (8 male; mean age = 40.9 ± 16.9 years) underwent four measurements across 2 consecutive days, with one session including an extended acquisition. Absolute reliability was quantified using within-subject coefficients of variation (CVs), and relative reliability was estimated with the Intra-Class Effect Decomposition (ICED) framework, which partitions variance into true-score, day-specific, session-specific, and residual components. Despite good spectral quality and high absolute reliability for several metabolites, relative reliability ranged from poor to good. Good relative reliability was observed only for water-referenced myo-inositol, total choline, and total creatine; no creatine-referenced metabolite reached this threshold. Increasing the number of transients increased signal-to-noise ratio but did not improve relative reliability; only creatine-referenced total N-acetylaspartate showed significant session-specific variance. Thus, high absolute reliability did not necessarily imply high relative reliability. Hippocampal MRS at 3 T may, therefore, be suitable for group-level or mean-level metabolite estimates, but appears less suitable for correlational, biomarker, or other individual-difference applications that require stable between-person differences. Methodological refinement, including improved voxel placement, motion correction, shimming, and quantification pipelines, may improve the relative reliability of hippocampal MRS.

papers.title: Inter-subject correlations and their behavioral associations vary across movies: Implications for generalizability.
papers.authors: Leipold S, Ravi Rao R, Schoffelen JM, Bögels S, Toni I.
papers.abstract: Movie-watching functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has become increasingly popular in neuroscience. Movie-fMRI data are commonly analyzed using inter-subject correlation (ISC), which quantifies the similarity of neural time series across individuals. Differences in ISC during movie viewing have been associated with psychological traits and clinical diagnoses. However, most studies investigating group differences in ISC or ISC-behavior associations have drawn conclusions from a single movie. Because ISC is inherently stimulus driven, effects observed for one movie may not generalize to another. Yet, the extent to which ISC patterns and ISC-behavior associations depend on the specific movie being viewed has received limited systematic attention. Here, we analyzed three independent datasets comprising 318 subjects and 36 movies in total to quantify between-movie variability in ISC and assess its consequences for ISC-behavior associations. Across datasets, ISC varied between movies throughout the cortex. This variability was spatially heterogeneous: regions with stronger ISC showed greater between-movie variability. Movie-specific inter-subject representational similarity analysis revealed distinct spatial distributions of ISC-behavior associations, with little overlap between movies. This pattern was observed for two distinct behavioral constructs. These findings suggest that ISC-behavior associations can be strongly movie specific.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注观看电影时个体间神经反应相似性（ISC）及其与行为关联是否依赖具体影片，分析了三个独立数据集（共318名被试、36部电影）的fMRI数据。结果显示，ISC在全皮层范围内随影片不同而变化，且这种变异在空间上不均匀：ISC较强的区域在影片间差异也更大。影片特异的表征相似性分析进一步表明，ISC与行为的关联在不同影片间空间分布各异、重叠很少，且这一模式在两种不同行为构念上均出现。作者据此指出，ISC-行为关联可能具有很强的影片特异性，提示仅凭单一影片得出的相关结论未必能推广到其他影片。

papers.title: Bridging language phenotypes, neural dynamics and gene regulation in autism.
papers.authors: Vinurel M, Wang X, Kordon D, Jochaut D, Speranza M, Boeckx C, Giraud AL.
papers.abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASDs) affect approximately 1% of the global population, with prevalence rising over recent decades. Although ASDs are heritable (~70%), translating genetic findings into effective therapeutics remains challenging due to the vast number of implicated risk genes (>700) and the limited influence of individual genes on disease expression. Their collective impact and convergent expression patterns of small-effect genes provide insights into ASD-related neurobiological mechanisms. Current interventions remain symptom-focused and do not address underlying neurodevelopmental mechanisms. Emerging approaches in functional genomics offer new insights into ASD pathogenesis by exploring gene expression diversity, yet clinical applications remain distant. Language deficits are among the most frequent and disabling features of ASD, profoundly affecting individuals' and families' quality of life. Recent evidence from neuroimaging and electrophysiology studies suggests disrupted neural oscillatory dynamics are linked to language deficits in ASD. Several ASD-associated genes have been implicated in biological pathways involved in the regulation of brain oscillatory dynamics, suggesting a potential mechanistic link between genetic variation, altered brain rhythms, and language impairment. We propose a neurophysiological imaging genetics framework that leverages neural oscillatory profiles as endophenotypes for targeted investigation and as functional readouts of gene expression. Within this framework, neuromodulation is proposed as an experimental approach to investigate and potentially modulate altered oscillatory dynamics associated with speech communication deficits in ASD, while integrating oscillation-related ASD candidate genes into a symptom-oriented model of functional genomics. This approach shows how integrating genetic variation, non-invasive neuroimaging, and behavioral phenotypes can advance our understanding of ASD and inform targeted, mechanism-based interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕自闭症谱系障碍中语言缺陷的机制展开，提出一个神经生理影像遗传学框架。作者指出，自闭症相关风险基因数量众多且单个基因效应有限，而神经影像与电生理证据提示脑振荡动态异常与语言缺陷相关，部分风险基因也涉及调控脑振荡的生物通路，从而可能在遗传变异、脑节律改变与语言障碍之间建立机制联系。文章据此主张将神经振荡作为内表型和基因表达的功能读出，并设想用神经调控实验探究和调节与言语交流缺陷相关的振荡动态，把振荡相关候选基因纳入以症状为导向的功能基因组学模型。这些多为框架性设想，临床应用尚远。

papers.title: Multiomics Profiling Supports Cathepsin B as a Protective Factor in White Matter Hyperintensities and Cognition.
papers.authors: Rivier CA, Diaz-Perez S, Bories G, Huo S, Clocchiatti-Tuozzo S, de Havenon A, Debette S, Sheth KN, Sansing LH, Falcone GJ.
papers.abstract: Background White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are a common brain magnetic resonance imaging marker of cerebral small vessel disease and a major risk factor for stroke and dementia, yet the molecular mechanisms governing lesion formation remain incompletely understood. We sought to identify circulating proteins that lie upstream of WMH and influence related clinical manifestations. Methods We conducted a 4-stage proteogenomic study. Stage 1 tested a WMH polygenic risk score against 2923 plasma proteins in 52 560 UK Biobank participants (mean age, 56.8 years, 53.9% female, 94.0% White), and candidate proteins against WMH volume in the neuroimaging subset (n=5443; mean age 54.2 years, 53.5% female). Stage 2 applied bidirectional Mendelian randomization, colocalization, and local genetic correlation using cis protein quantitative trait locus and cis expression quantitative trait locus instruments from plasma, vascular, and brain tissue. Stage 3 analyzed single-nucleus RNA sequencing of 8 postmortem periventricular white matter samples (4 WMH lesions, 4 controls; mean age, 81 years; 50% female). Stage 4 tested circulating and genetically predicted protein levels against general cognitive ability. Results Stages 1 and 2 converged on CTSB (cathepsin B) and ECHDC3 (enoyl-coenzyme A hydratase domain-containing 3). Higher plasma CTSB was associated with lower WMH volume (β=-0.09 [95% CI, -0.13 to -0.05]; n=5260), and Mendelian randomization estimates were directionally consistent across all 5 instrument sets (plasma protein quantitative trait locus β=-0.052 [95% CI, -0.064 to -0.040]), with concordant effects on white matter microstructure, perivascular spaces, and lacunar stroke. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing showed CTSB downregulation within lesions, predominantly in astrocytes (log2 fold change=-1.70) and oligodendrocytes (log2 fold change=-0.48; both false discovery rate P <1×10-20 ). Higher plasma CTSB (β=0.061 [95% CI, 0.010-0.112]; n=5193) and a cis protein quantitative trait locus polygenic score (β=0.031 [95% CI, 0.009-0.054]; n=8884) predicted better cognitive performance. ECHDC3 showed no consistent association beyond stage 1. Conclusions Multimodal proteogenomic evidence nominates CTSB as a lesion-suppressed protein associated with lower WMH burden and better cognition, and a candidate therapeutic target for cerebral small vessel disease.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在识别位于白质高信号（WMH）上游并影响相关临床表现的循环蛋白，采用多组学蛋白质基因组学策略，结合大规模血浆蛋白关联分析、孟德尔随机化与共定位、死后脑组织单核RNA测序及认知表型分析。结果指向组织蛋白酶B（CTSB）：较高的血浆CTSB与较低的WMH体积相关，遗传学估计方向一致，并对白质微结构、血管周围间隙和腔隙性卒中呈现同向效应；病灶内CTSB表达下调，主要见于星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞。较高的血浆CTSB及遗传预测水平还与更好的认知表现相关。作者据此提出CTSB是病灶抑制性蛋白，与较低WMH负担和较好认知相关，并作为脑小血管病的候选治疗靶点；这些发现基于关联与遗传学证据，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Extended field-of-view two-photon imaging in the deep brain of freely behaving mice using lightweight microfabricated corrective optics.
papers.authors: Nardin C, Sattin A, Curreli S, Letti G, Maddalena L, Nacci L, Fellin T.
papers.abstract: Investigating neural circuits underlying complex behavior requires high-resolution imaging of large neuronal populations during naturalistic conditions. Miniaturized two-photon microscopes (MINI2Ps) enable deep brain imaging in freely moving animals when coupled with gradient index (GRIN)-based microendoscopes. However, intrinsic optical aberrations in GRIN-based microendoscopes degrade spatial resolution and limit the effective field-of-view (FOV). Here, we address these limitations using lightweight microfabricated optics to correct GRIN aberrations during deep brain MINI2P imaging. The aberration corrected system demonstrated improved and more homogeneous axial resolution across the FOV, resulting in more than fourfold increase in effective FOV. We applied the corrected system to the ventral posteromedial thalamus in freely moving mice and performed optical mapping of head direction (HD) tuned cells. These measurements revealed the absence of spatial clustering of HD preference, suggesting spatially sparse HD coding in sensory thalamus. Combining the MINI2P with aberration corrected GRIN-based microendoscopes is a powerful approach for large-scale and high-resolution functional imaging of deep brain circuits during naturalistic behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对微型双光子显微镜结合GRIN微内窥镜进行自由活动小鼠深脑成像时，GRIN固有像差降低空间分辨率、限制有效视场的问题，采用轻量微加工校正光学元件进行像差校正。校正后系统在整个视场内获得更优且更均匀的轴向分辨率，有效视场提升四倍以上。作者将该系统应用于自由活动小鼠丘脑腹后内侧核，对头方向调谐细胞进行光学映射，发现头方向偏好不存在空间聚集，提示感觉丘脑中的头方向编码在空间上较为稀疏。这表明像差校正GRIN微内窥镜结合微型双光子显微镜可用于自然行为下深脑环路的大范围高分辨率功能成像。

papers.title: Phosphorylation by CaMKIV regulates the transcriptional repressor activity and half-life of REST/NRSF.
papers.authors: Tsushima Semini H, Corradi B, Canevari C, Shmal D, Chiacchiaretta M, Liessi N, Di Fonzo A, Carminati E, Armirotti A, Fassio A, Maragliano L, Rocchi A, Benfenati F.
papers.abstract: Repressor Element-1 (RE1)-Silencing Transcription Factor (REST) homeostatically regulates neural activity by repressing a large cluster of neural genes. However, whether REST can be regulated by calcium(2+) (Ca2+ )-activated kinases is unknown. We investigated Ca2+ /calmodulin-dependent protein kinases (CaMKs) as upstream regulators of REST fate and activity. We show that REST is phosphorylated by CaMKIV at Ser322 site in the fifth-to-sixth Zn-finger domain linker. A phosphomimic mutant at Ser322 decreased REST repressor activity and caused its transition to the cytosol, followed by degradation. Molecular dynamics simulations of the phosphomimic REST mutant revealed a sharp decrease in the stability of the REST-RE1 binding interface. Phosphorylation of REST by CaMKIV suppressed the downscaling of excitatory postsynaptic current (EPSC) frequency in response to hyperactivity. Moreover, the homeostatic effects of CaMKIV on EPSC amplitude were inhibited in the absence of REST. The results demonstrate that CaMKIV phosphorylation plays a crucial role in regulating REST levels and repressor activity and that an interplay exists between CaMKIV and REST in homeostatic plasticity mechanisms.

papers.title: Multiscale neural signatures of long-lag repetition learning: a simultaneous fNIRS-EEG study.
papers.authors: Ren J, Noah A, Zhang X, Gracco V, Joanisse M, Bajracharya A, Rueckl JG, Buchweitz A, Koirala N, Hirsch J, Pugh K.
papers.abstract: Significance Repetition-based learning supports word recognition and reading fluency, yet its neural mechanisms remain poorly understood, particularly where deficits in consolidating repeated linguistic input may underlie reading and language difficulties. Establishing reliable neural markers of repetition-based learning is a critical first step toward characterizing the phenotypes of these difficulties in children. Aim We developed a whole-brain simultaneous functional near-infrared spectroscopy-electroencephalography (fNIRS-EEG) approach to capture fast temporal electrophysiological and spatially accurate hemodynamic signals during long-lag repetition learning. Approach Thirty participants performed a semantic judgment task with words repeated across four runs with intervening items, modeling repetition demands central to reading instruction. A multimodal decoding framework integrating electrophysiological, hemodynamic, and cross-modal fNIRS-EEG correlation features was used to classify repetition-based learning. Results Repeated words showed response time reductions. EEG captured a frontal N400-range repetition-related negativity and attenuation of alpha-beta suppression, reflecting changes in recognition-related and post-recognition processing. fNIRS revealed left inferior frontal and superior temporal efficiency increases alongside right supramarginal activation, suggesting integrative processing. Multimodal classifiers outperformed unimodal classifiers, indicating that each modality captured complementary aspects of learning. Conclusions Combining fNIRS and EEG with multimodal machine learning provides a richer characterization of repetition-based learning than either modality alone, establishing a framework for phenotyping language learning capacity and identifying neural markers of reading difficulties in pediatric populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注长间隔重复学习（即单词在间隔其他项目后再次出现）的神经机制，采用同步fNIRS-EEG记录被试完成语义判断任务时的脑活动，并用融合电生理、血流动力学及跨模态相关特征的多模态框架对重复学习进行分类。结果显示，重复词伴随反应时缩短；EEG上出现额区N400范围的重复相关负波和alpha-beta抑制减弱，反映识别相关及识别后加工的变化；fNIRS则显示左侧额下回和颞上回效率提高并伴右侧缘上回激活，提示整合加工。多模态分类器优于单模态，说明两种模态捕捉到互补的学习信息。作者据此认为，fNIRS与EEG结合多模态机器学习能更全面地刻画重复学习，为后续刻画语言学习能力及儿童阅读困难的神经标记提供框架，但摘要未报告临床应用结果。

papers.title: Altered glymphatic system measures and functional network connectivity in autism spectrum disorder: A longitudinal study examining associations with prognosis.
papers.authors: Zhang M, Luo T, Zhao S, Li L, Jiang Y, Duan X, Situ M, Huang Y.
papers.abstract: Aim Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by social deficits and repetitive behaviors, yet prognostic biomarkers remain elusive. This study investigated the interplay between glymphatic function and functional network connectivity (FNC) in ASD and their longitudinal associations with clinical outcomes. Method This combined cross-sectional and two-year prospective longitudinal study included 50 ASD children and 50 controls. Glymphatic function was assessed using the along the perivascular space (ALPS) index and global blood-oxygen-level-dependent to cerebrospinal fluid (gBOLD-CSF) coupling, alongside FNC analysis. Results Cross-sectionally, ASD participants showed significantly reduced ALPS index, gBOLD-CSF coupling, and widespread FNC reductions. Longitudinally, among the 40 ASD participants who completed follow-up, glymphatic function increased over time. Greater increases in ALPS were correlated with greater reductions in ADOS-CSS. In the symptom-improved subgroup, four FNC connections (including DMN-DAN) increased over time. In contrast, no consistent pattern was found in the non-improved group. Baseline inter-network connectivity measures were associated with ADOS-CSS reduction in univariate analyses, but the multivariate model was not significant. Mediation analysis showed an indirect association between baseline gBOLD-CSF coupling and long-term ADOS-CSS reduction via DMN-DAN FNC reduction (indirect effect = -0.22, 95% CI [-0.42, -0.07]). Conclusion These findings indicate that glymphatic function and FNC are altered cross-sectionally and improve longitudinally in parallel with symptom changes in ASD and suggest that baseline gBOLD-CSF coupling is indirectly associated with long-term clinical improvement through DMN-DAN connectivity. Together, these results highlight the potential of glymphatic and functional connectivity measures as prognostic imaging markers in ASD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自闭症谱系障碍中类淋巴功能与功能网络连接的关系及其与临床预后的纵向关联，采用横断面结合两年追踪设计，比较自闭症儿童与对照者的类淋巴指标和功能网络连接。横断面上，自闭症儿童表现出类淋巴功能指标降低及较广泛的功能网络连接减弱；纵向看，完成随访的自闭症儿童类淋巴功能随时间上升，且类淋巴指标改善越大，症状严重度下降越明显，症状改善亚组还出现部分网络连接增强，而未改善组缺乏一致模式。中介分析提示，基线类淋巴功能指标与长期症状改善之间的关联可能部分经由默认网络与背侧注意网络间连接的下降间接实现，但基线网络连接的多变量预测模型并不显著。作者据此认为这些指标有潜力作为预后影像标记，但关联并非因果，结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Effects of postmortem interval on myelin integrity in rhesus macaque brain tissue.
papers.authors: Novoseltseva A, Robinson R, Niziolek P, Jang A, Xie T, Tiwari A, Abdelhakeem A, Nicks R, Lucas Y, Yang Q, Mortazavi F, Boas D, Wang H, Moore TL, Rosene DL, Bigio IJ.
papers.abstract: When conducting microscopy of human brain sections, the postmortem interval (PMI) introduces myelin-related artifacts that can confound neuropathological interpretation, yet the extent and detectability of these changes remain poorly characterized. This study examined the impact of controlled PMI on myelin integrity in rhesus macaque brain tissue using advanced optical imaging approaches. Brains from five aged rhesus macaques (20.5-28.5 years) were maintained at 4°C and analyzed at 0, 24, and 72 h postmortem. Myelin integrity in white and gray matter was assessed using quantitative birefringence microscopy to measure relative retardance and polarization-sensitive optical coherence tomography to quantify scattering coefficients, retardance, and volumetric features. Increasing PMI was associated with progressive myelin degradation, reflected by significant reductions in relative optical retardance in white matter (p < 0.01) and gray matter (p < 0.001), alongside increased scattering coefficients in both regions (p < 0.001). Morphological analyses revealed a marked increase in myelin defects per mm2 with longer PMI (p < 0.001), characterized by swellings, vesicles, and structural discontinuities. These findings demonstrate that PMI causes significant detectable myelin changes, which can be quantified using optical imaging techniques, providing critical implications for interpreting postmortem neuropathological studies (especially with human brain tissues) and establishing a need for standardized PMI considerations in research protocols to ensure accurate pathological assessment in neurological disease investigations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注死后间隔时间（PMI）对髓鞘完整性的影响，因为这类变化可能干扰神经病理学判读，但其程度和可检测性此前尚不清楚。作者用定量双折射显微镜和偏振敏感光学相干断层扫描，在离体恒河猴脑组织上考察了不同PMI下白质和灰质的髓鞘状态。结果显示，随着PMI延长，两区域的光学延迟量下降、散射系数升高，髓鞘缺陷密度明显增加，并出现肿胀、囊泡和结构断裂等形态改变。作者据此指出，PMI引起的髓鞘变化可被光学成像定量检出，这提示解读死后神经病理研究（尤其是人脑组织）时需考虑PMI，并应在研究方案中标准化相关处理。

papers.title: Individualized Theta Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation Modulates Mnemonic Discrimination and ERP Responses to Positive Information in Individuals With Elevated Depressive Symptoms.
papers.authors: Huang X, Zhou M, Wang C, Huang Y, Wang W, Shao J, Mao J, Li J, Zhang L, Ye R, Zhu C, Tian Y, He K, Yu F, Wang K.
papers.abstract: Individuals with elevated depressive symptoms often show impairments in positive memory processing. This randomized, double-blind study investigated whether individualized theta-frequency transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) using an OFC-oriented montage modulates mnemonic discrimination and ERP responses to positive information. Sixty-one individuals with elevated depressive symptoms received either real or sham stimulation before completing an emotional mnemonic discrimination task. Behavioral results showed that lure discrimination increased following real stimulation but not sham stimulation. EEG results showed that real stimulation modulated ERP responses during positive memory encoding and retrieval, as reflected by increased late positive potential (LPP) amplitudes during encoding and altered early retrieval-related ERP amplitudes. These findings suggest that individualized theta-tACS may influence both mnemonic discrimination performance and neural responses to positive information.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究关注抑郁症状升高者的积极记忆加工受损问题，采用随机双盲设计，以个体化θ频率经颅交流电刺激（tACS）作用于眶额皮层方向，考察其对情绪记忆辨别及事件相关电位的影响。行为结果显示，真实刺激后诱饵辨别成绩提高，而伪刺激组未见此变化；脑电结果则显示真实刺激改变了积极信息编码和提取阶段的ERP反应，编码期晚正电位波幅增大，提取早期成分亦发生改变。作者据此认为，个体化θ-tACS可能同时影响记忆辨别表现和对积极信息的神经反应，但摘要仅报告刺激前后的组间差异，尚不足以推断临床疗效。

papers.title: Advanced age at onset is associated with distinct functional brain reorganization in multiple sclerosis.
papers.authors: Tedone N, Valsasina P, Meani A, Preziosa P, Grosselle M, Esposito F, Filippi M, Rocca MA.
papers.abstract: Functional network reorganization supports compensatory mechanisms in multiple sclerosis, but ageing and later disease onset may alter this balance. Late-onset multiple sclerosis (age at onset ≥50 years) represents a relevant subgroup to examine how disease onset in older age is associated with functional connectivity abnormalities. In this cross-sectional study, we investigated resting-state functional connectivity alterations in late-onset multiple sclerosis versus adult-onset multiple sclerosis and their associations with clinical, cognitive and structural MRI measures. Thirty-four late-onset multiple sclerosis, 169 sex- and disease duration-matched adult-onset multiple sclerosis, and 163 age- and sex-matched healthy controls underwent clinical, neuropsychological (Brief Repeatable Battery of Neuropsychological Tests) and MRI assessment including resting-state functional MRI. Independent component analysis quantified resting-state functional connectivity within 10 large-scale networks. Between-group differences were tested using sex- and scanner-adjusted voxel-wise models (P < 0.001, uncorrected, cluster extent ≥10 voxels); resulting abnormal clusters were then examined for exploratory uncorrected associations with Expanded Disability Status Scale, disease duration, cognitive performance, T2-hyperintense lesion volume and normalized brain volume, without correction for multiple comparisons. At MRI acquisition, compared with the adult-onset multiple sclerosis group, the late-onset multiple sclerosis group was significantly older (median age: 60.5 [IQR: 56.6-66.1] versus 35.6 [IQR: 30.0-40.1] years; pFDR = 0.006) and showed higher Expanded Disability Status Scale score (pFDR = 0.016) and higher T2-hyperintense lesion volume (pFDR = 0.028) despite similar disease duration (median: 4.5 [IQR: 1.7-13.2] versus 6.0 [IQR: 2.1-11.8] years; pFDR = 0.894), whereas no significant between-group cognitive difference was found. Both multiple sclerosis groups showed widespread functional connectivity abnormalities versus healthy controls, partly overlapping and partly distinct. Adult-onset multiple sclerosis displayed functional connectivity increases in the executive control and occipital default mode networks. Late-onset multiple sclerosis showed diffuse functional connectivity alterations, including decreases in the left fronto-parietal, thalamic and occipital default mode networks. Exploratory uncorrected correlation analyses included 117 tested associations. In late-onset multiple sclerosis, decreased functional connectivity in the left fronto-parietal network is related to lower normalized brain volume and worse cognition (P = 0.02-0.03), whereas altered thalamic network connectivity is related to higher Expanded Disability Status Scale, longer disease duration, and higher T2-hyperintense lesion volume (P = 0.01-0.02). These associations did not survive correction for multiple comparisons and should therefore be considered hypothesis-generating. These findings suggest that late-onset multiple sclerosis was associated with a distinct resting-state functional connectivity profile compared with adult-onset multiple sclerosis within a cross-sectional, age-matched healthy control framework, possibly reflecting the combined contribution of multiple sclerosis-related damage, age-related vulnerability and the more severe clinical profile of late-onset multiple sclerosis.

papers.title: Amygdala volume and psychiatric burden in focal epilepsy: PET evidence for a glial substrate.
papers.authors: Imhoff-Smith TP, McMillan A, Hurley SA, Kalkach Aparicio M, Nair V, Philibert-Rosas S, Binder JR, Meyerand ME, Jones J, Hermann B, Prabhakaran V, Adluru N, Struck AF.
papers.abstract: Temporal lobe epilepsy is of heterogeneous pathology. While many patients present with hippocampal sclerosis and ipsilateral mesiotemporal atrophy, a subgroup of patients without human-detectable sclerosis via structural MRI are characterized by ipsilateral amygdala enlargement and worse postsurgical outcomes. A bidirectional relationship between temporal lobe epilepsy and depression is well-established, with amygdala enlargement and neuroimmune alterations increasingly implicated as substrates for both. In this study, we interrogate the link between amygdala volume and psychiatric burden in temporal lobe epilepsy and evaluate gliosis as a possible substrate. We hypothesize that gliosis drives ipsilateral amygdala volume changes that underlie psychiatric burden in patients with no hippocampal sclerosis. To test these relationships, we analyzed two independent cross-sectional cohorts: (i) a Discovery cohort (43 patients, 80 controls) with structural MRI and robust psychiatric measures and (ii) a Mechanistic pilot cohort (10 patients, 9 controls) with both structural MRI and [18 F]FEPPA PET/MR, an in vivo measure of gliosis, to conceptually replicate and extend findings from the Discovery cohort. Amygdala volumes were assessed with FreeSurfer. Psychiatric burden in the Discovery cohort was assessed with the Depressive Problems subscale from the Achenbach Adult Self-Report. Regional gliosis in the Mechanistic cohort was quantified using [18 F]FEPPA PET, and an exploratory measure of psychiatric burden for this cohort was obtained via medical chart review. In the Discovery cohort, the group without hippocampal sclerosis showed significant ipsilateral enlargement of the whole amygdala, basolateral and central subnuclei compared to controls and the group with sclerosis and a group-dependent association between decreased amygdala volume and increased depressive symptoms. In the Mechanistic cohort, increased [18 F]FEPPA binding was associated with reduced amygdala volume. Adjusting for this effect unmasked significant amygdala enlargement in the group without hippocampal sclerosis. Exploratory analysis revealed a possible central subnucleus-specific relationship between gliosis, volume and psychiatric burden in patients without sclerosis, such that amygdala volume was positively correlated with psychiatric burden specifically in patients with a greater degree of gliosis. These data associate amygdala volume alterations with psychiatric burden in patients without sclerosis and implicate gliosis as a potential mechanistic substrate. Findings support a conceptual shift towards understanding amygdala enlargement not as a static structural phenotype, but as a dynamic, glia-associated state that may confer risk for psychiatric illness. Consequently, patients without hippocampal sclerosis may derive a distinct dual benefit from therapeutic strategies targeted at underlying neuroimmune function.

papers.title: A multi-atlas ensemble learning framework for autism spectrum disorder diagnosis.
papers.authors: Liang S, Zhang Z, Du W, Gu F.
papers.abstract: Objective. Clinical autism spectrum disorder (ASD) relies on subjective scales and neuroimaging, with traditional approaches suffering from high subjectivity and insufficient feature extraction, increasing misdiagnoses risk.Approach. To improve the diagnostic accuracy, we propose a multimodal ASD prediction network (APN) that integrates resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging with non-imaging data. Algorithmically, we first introduce a novel cumulative distribution divergence score (CDDS) feature selection method based on the multi-atlas functional connectivity (FC), which quantifies statistical distributional differences between positive and negative samples, effectively addressing the limitations of the traditionalF -score in overlapping or weakly discriminative features. Building upon this, we adapt existing deep learning (DL) paradigms to construct a deep neural architecture (variational autoencoder-denoising autoencoder (VAEA)), combining a variational autoencoder (VAE), a denoising autoencoder, and a multilayer perceptron. The combination of these modules is non-trivial: the novel CDDS first purifies the high-dimensional feature space, enabling the VAEA to learn robust latent probabilistic representations via unsupervised pre-training without suffering from the curse of dimensionality. This is followed by the supervised fine-tuning to optimize parameters. We further incorporate demographic factors including age, full-scale intelligence quotient, and gender via a late-fusion strategy to prevent them from being overshadowed by imaging features, thereby enhancing the discriminability. FC features from three atlases including AAL, CC400, and Dosenbach160 are weighted and integrated to achieve the effective multi-source fusion.Main results. We conduct 10-fold cross-validations on the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) dataset, and the proposed APN achieves 81.63% accuracy, 81.89% sensitivity and 81.46% specificity, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Interpretability analysis identifies hippocampus, amygdala, and cingulate gyrus as strongly ASD-associated regions, offering neural mechanistic insights.Significance. This study provides an efficient, objective, and interpretable multimodal DL framework for ASD assisted diagnosis, with substantial clinical application and neuroscience value.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对自闭症谱系障碍临床诊断依赖主观量表、特征提取不足的问题，提出一个融合静息态功能磁共振与非影像数据的多模态深度学习预测框架。方法上，作者先用基于多图谱功能连接的新特征选择方法筛选特征，再结合变分自编码器、去噪自编码器和多层感知机进行表征学习，并以晚期融合方式纳入年龄、智商和性别等人口学信息，同时加权整合三个脑图谱的功能连接特征。在ABIDE数据集上的交叉验证显示，该框架在准确率、敏感性和特异性上均优于现有方法，可解释性分析还提示海马、杏仁核和扣带回与自闭症关联较强。研究为自闭症辅助诊断提供了一种较客观且可解释的多模态深度学习思路，但其临床价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Involuntary facial muscle activity during imagined vocalisation contaminates EEG and enables emotion decoding.
papers.authors: Tang Y, Corballis PM, Hallum LE.
papers.abstract: Objective. Decoding imagined speech from electroencephalography (EEG) recordings is potentially useful for brain-computer interfaces. Previous studies have focused on decoding semantic information from EEG, leaving the decoding of emotion - an important component of human communication - largely unexplored.Approach. Here, we report two experiments involving participants tasked with overt (n = 14) or imagined (n = 21) emotional vocalisation in five different categories: anger, happiness, neutral, sadness, and pleasure. Throughout, we recorded 64-channel EEG; we computed time-frequency features and used a logistic-regression classifier to evaluate emotion decoding accuracy. In five participants, we also recorded facial surface electromyography (sEMG) during imagined vocalisation, and studied the contamination of EEG by sEMG.Main results. Our results show that emotion can be decoded from single-trial EEG recordings of both overt (78.1%, chance = 20%) and imagined vocalisation (36.4%). The high-gamma band (50 to 100 Hz) and lateral EEG channels (T7, T8, and proximal) were important for decoding. sEMG analysis indicated that involuntary facial muscle activity contributed to these spectral and spatial patterns during imagined vocalisation. We identified a prominent muscle-induced pattern over lateral EEG channels - the railroad cross-tie pattern - showing greater activation during imagined happy vocalisations. We conclude that involuntary facial muscle activity is associated with certain emotion categories (i.e. happiness) and contributes to the decoding of emotion from single-trial EEG recordings.Significance. This study provides converging EEG and sEMG evidence demonstrating that involuntary facial muscle activity occurs during imagined vocalisation and is modulated by emotion, producing emotion-specific EEG contamination patterns. Although we focused on imagined vocalisations, the EMG patterns we observed closely resembled EEG patterns commonly reported in emotion decoding studies, raising concerns about involuntary facial muscle activity in such work.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注想象发声时脑电信号能否解码情绪，以及面部肌肉活动是否混入脑电。实验让参与者分别进行实际发声和想象发声，采集脑电并用分类器评估情绪解码，同时对部分参与者记录面部表面肌电。结果显示，实际发声和想象发声的单试次脑电都能解码情绪，想象条件下的准确率明显较低；高频伽马波段和外侧导联对解码较重要。肌电分析表明，想象发声时存在不自主的面部肌肉活动，这种活动与高兴等情绪相关，并在外侧导联形成特定模式，可能混入脑电、影响情绪解码。作者据此提醒，常用情绪解码研究中的脑电模式可能部分源于面部肌肉活动。

papers.title: Impact of depth-of-interaction and spatially-variant point-spread-function model on the performance of ultra-high resolution brain PET.
papers.authors: Zeng T, Najmaoui Y, Zhang J, Volpi T, Fontaine K, Chemli Y, Hu Y, Gallezot JD, Sun C, Lu Y, El Fakhri G, Carson RE, Marin T.
papers.abstract: Objective. To implement a spatially-variant point spread function (VarPSF) model for the NeuroEXPLORER (NX) brain positron emission tomography (PET) scanner in the open-source Yale Reconstruction Toolkit for PET, and investigate the interplay between depth-of-interaction (DOI) resolution and resolution modeling.Approach. PSF parameters were estimated from simulated and physically measured point sources. Three primary DOI configurations were evaluated: eight-layer DOI (8DOI), two-layer DOI (2DOI), and no DOI (noDOI), with an additional 4DOI comparison in the off-center simulated Derenzo study. Reconstructions using VarPSF, a spatially-invariant PSF measured at the field-of-view center (SinglePSF), and no PSF modeling (noPSF) were assessed using simulated Derenzo and brain phantoms, a physical Derenzo phantom, and one non-human primate (NHP) scan.Main results. In simulated and physical Derenzo studies, VarPSF yielded higher peak-to-valley ratios than SinglePSF and noPSF at the final evaluated iterations, with pronounced gains at large radial offsets. In the simulated brain phantom, VarPSF reduced the estimated transverse blur by 0.3 mm relative to SinglePSF and 0.5 mm relative to noPSF in 2DOI, and by 0.6 mm and 0.8 mm, respectively, in noDOI. In the NHP study, VarPSF improved contrast and structural delineation with reduced DOI encoding at approximately matched white-matter coefficient of variation, while its incremental benefit over SinglePSF was small with 8DOI at clinically relevant iteration settings.Significance. Spatially-variant PSF modeling can partially compensate for limited DOI information. The findings motivate combining modest DOI capability with accurate resolution modeling, while further validation is required for redesigned detectors and fully corrected acquisitions. The open-source implementation enables controlled investigation of the complementary roles of DOI encoding and resolution modeling.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在开源PET重建工具包中为NeuroEXPLORER脑PET扫描仪实现空间变化点扩散函数（VarPSF）模型，并考察相互作用深度（DOI）分辨率与分辨率建模之间的相互影响。研究通过模拟与实测点源估计PSF参数，比较不同DOI配置下VarPSF、中心测量的空间不变PSF及无PSF建模的重建表现。结果显示，VarPSF在Derenzo模体和脑模体中均能提升对比度恢复并减少横向模糊，在大径向偏移处增益更明显；在非人灵长类扫描中，DOI编码较少时VarPSF改善对比度和结构勾画，但在八层DOI和临床相关迭代设置下，其相对SinglePSF的额外收益较小。作者据此认为，空间变化PSF建模可部分补偿有限的DOI信息，提示可将适度DOI能力与准确的分辨率建模结合，但尚需针对重新设计的探测器和充分校正的采集进一步验证。

papers.title: Video EEG in pediatric epilepsy: Diagnostic significance and association between frequency band power and cognitive impairment severity.
papers.authors: Li B, Wu F.
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to compare video electroencephalogram (VEEG) and routine electroencephalogram (EEG) in childhood epilepsy diagnosis and analyze the correlation between EEG frequency band power and cognitive impairment severity. Methods One hundred and sixty children suspected of having epilepsy underwent routine EEG and VEEG examinations. Diagnostic efficacy and detection rates were compared. Cognitive function was evaluated in 80 children diagnosed with epilepsy, who were allocated into normal intelligence (35 cases), borderline intelligence (25 cases), and intelligence-impaired (20 cases) groups. Clinical data, EEG parameters, and their correlation with cognitive impairment were analyzed. Results VEEG showed higher sensitivity, accuracy, and negative predictive value, and detection rates of epileptiform discharges, synchronous clinical seizures, and clinical symptoms than routine EEG (p < 0.05). Clinical characteristics and EEG parameters differed among the three groups (p < 0.05). The relative power of δ and θ bands and the awake and sleep discharge indices were positively correlated with cognitive impairment severity (r = 0.300, 0.643, 0.622, and 0.456), whereas α and β band power were negatively correlated (r = -0.515 and -0.410) (all p < 0.001). Conclusion VEEG demonstrated higher diagnostic performance than routine EEG, and EEG frequency band power was correlated with cognitive impairment severity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以疑似癫痫儿童为对象，比较视频脑电图与常规脑电图在儿童癫痫诊断中的效能，并分析脑电频带功率与认知损害严重程度的相关性。结果显示，视频脑电图在敏感性、准确性、阴性预测值以及癫痫样放电、同步临床发作和临床症状的检出率上均优于常规脑电图。在确诊癫痫的儿童中，不同认知状态组的临床特征和脑电参数存在差异，δ和θ频带相对功率及清醒、睡眠期放电指数与认知损害严重程度呈正相关，α和β频带功率则呈负相关。作者据此认为视频脑电图诊断表现更好，且脑电频带功率与认知损害严重程度相关；但相关关系不等于因果关系，其临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The endocannabinoid system and the ageing brain.
papers.authors: Zimmer A.
papers.abstract: Ageing is accompanied by a progressive decline in homeostatic resilience that increases vulnerability to chronic disease, disability and cognitive impairment. Although unhealthy brain ageing can often be prevented by managing the underlying risk factors, the molecular, cellular and physiological mechanisms that connect risk factors to late-life brain dysfunction remain incompletely understood. This review examines the role of the endocannabinoid system in brain ageing. The endocannabinoid system is a short-range lipid signalling network that helps to maintain neuronal, glial, metabolic and inflammatory homeostasis. Endocannabinoid signalling follows a dynamic lifespan trajectory, with relatively high activity during early adulthood and functional decline during ageing. Genetic or pharmacological disruption of endocannabinoid system activity impairs several processes linked to hallmarks of brain ageing, including neuroinflammatory control, adult neurogenesis, synaptic plasticity, cognitive performance, metabolic regulation and epigenetic stability. Conversely, low-dose Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) treatment can ameliorate several ageing-related brain phenotypes in old animals. However, clinical evidence in older humans remains limited, and the therapeutic potential of cannabinoid-based interventions requires further evaluation.

papers.title: Infant hippocampal and amygdala volume in an observational follow-up from a randomized clinical trial for maternal prenatal depression.
papers.authors: Demers CH, Hankin BL, Deer LK, Gallop RJ, Hoeflich Haase M, Hoffman MC, Styner MA, Grote NK, Davis EP.
papers.abstract: Prenatal maternal depression may have intergenerational effects on offspring brain development, with potential socioemotional consequences. This observational follow-up study examines brain development and subsequent negative emotionality among 109 infants born to mothers participating in a randomized clinical trial (NCT03011801). In the prior trial, brief interpersonal psychotherapy significantly reduced prenatal depression symptoms and disorder as the published primary and secondary endpoints. Exploratory infant outcomes include hippocampal and amygdala volumes at 6 weeks and negative emotionality at 6 months. Here we show that infants of mothers randomized to interpersonal psychotherapy during pregnancy have lower right hippocampal volume than infants of mothers in the enhanced usual care group (p = .002, d = 0.62). No statistically significant group differences are observed in left hippocampal or amygdala volume. Smaller hippocampal volume predicts subsequent lower negative emotionality (r = 0.19, p = 0.045). In this study, a maternal prenatal depression intervention is associated with differences in infant brain development with implications for their subsequent emotional health.

papers.title: Memory stays strong in old age when this brain enzyme is active.
papers.authors: Mullard A.

papers.title: Toward early dyslexia screening through handwriting: A trustworthy XAI-enhanced deep learning framework.
papers.authors: Matthias SL, Lau J, Tang YM, Geda MW.
papers.abstract: Dyslexia, a prevalent learning disorder, significantly impairs children's ability to process written language, often leading to challenges such as letter reversals, inconsistent spacing, and scrambled writing sequences. Early detection is critical for timely intervention, yet traditional diagnostic methods such as behavioral assessments and neuroimaging-are either time-consuming, subjective, or prohibitively expensive. Recent advances in deep learning offer promising alternatives, particularly through handwriting analysis, which is non-invasive and scalable. However, the "black-box" nature of many deep learning models raises concerns about interpretability, a key requirement for clinical and educational adoption. This study introduces a novel deep learning framework combining a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs), and an Attention mechanism to detect dyslexia from handwriting samples. The study uses handwriting samples from adolescents aged 12-15 with an established dyslexia diagnosis and a control group. It therefore provides a proof-of-concept for handwriting-based classification and a foundation for early screening, rather than a validated early screening tool. The CNN extracts spatial features, while GRUs model temporal patterns in writing sequences. The Attention mechanism highlights the most discriminative regions for screening. To enhance transparency, Explainable AI (XAI) techniques such as Grad-CAM, LIME, and feature scatter plots are added to provide visual explanations of the model's decisions. Evaluated on a dataset of 3170 handwriting images from dyslexic and non-dyslexic students, the model achieved 99.5% accuracy using leave-one-out cross validation, outperforming pre-trained models like ResNet-50. Ablation studies confirmed the CNN's pivotal role while GRUs and Attention provided complementary improvements. These findings demonstrate technical feasibility; however, the model has not yet been evaluated in younger, undiagnosed children, and conclusions about early screening utility should therefore be interpreted with caution. XAI visualizations, such as Grad-CAM and LIME, offer interpretable saliency maps, and the results show that the predictions made by the model depend on the regions where known dyslexic characteristics, such as irregularities in letter curvature, spacing, and alignment, often occur.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个结合卷积神经网络、门控循环单元和注意力机制的深度学习框架，用书写笔迹样本区分有阅读障碍诊断的青少年与对照组，并借助Grad-CAM、LIME等方法为模型判断提供可视化解释。模型在笔迹图像数据集上取得很高的分类准确率，消融分析显示卷积网络起主要作用，循环单元和注意力机制带来补充提升，可视化结果也表明预测依赖字母曲率、间距和对齐等已知障碍特征常出现的区域。作者强调这仅证明笔迹分类的技术可行性，模型尚未在更年幼、未确诊儿童中验证，因此不能据此认定其具备早期筛查效用。

papers.title: Decoding spatial attention in the cocktail party problem using whole-head high-density fNIRS.
papers.authors: Duwadi S, Rogers D, Boyd AD, Carlton LB, Zhang Y, Gaona AK, Pathiyaparambath AD, Chaudhury R, Magee G, Zimmermann BB, O'Brien WJ, von Lühmann A, Boas DA, Yücel MA, Sen K.
papers.abstract: Spatial attention is critical for solving the cocktail party problem, a longstanding problem in neuroscience and artificial speech recognition. The ability to decode where humans are attending in a cocktail party like scene would empower applications in brain computer interfaces and assistive devices such as hearing aids. Here we demonstrate that, in an overt attention task, the attended spatial location can be decoded robustly from single trial hemodynamic responses, using a whole head high density fNIRS system. We also identify critical brain regions that make the highest contribution to decoding accuracy. Specifically, we find that decoding based on a small fraction of channels located within the left and right inferior parietal lobule (IPL) achieves maximal decoding accuracy comparable to all channels. Decoding fell close to chance in a covert auditory condition in which participants held central fixation while attending to the same talkers, indicating that auditory attention alone without orientation is not sufficient for decoding. Finally, control experiments suggest that overt-condition decoding is influenced by sustained eye position/gaze direction, not eye movement. These results support the development of fNIRS-integrated BCIs and assistive devices controlled by overt spatial attention.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨能否用全头高密度fNIRS从单试次血流动力学反应中解码“鸡尾酒会”场景下受试者所注意的空间位置。结果显示，在需朝向声源的显性注意任务中，注意位置可被稳健解码，且仅用左右顶下小叶内少量通道即可达到与全部通道相当的准确率；而在保持中央注视的隐性听觉注意条件下，解码接近随机水平，提示缺乏朝向的纯听觉注意不足以支持解码。控制实验进一步表明，显性条件下的解码受持续眼位或注视方向影响，而非眼动本身。作者据此认为，这些结果支持开发由显性空间注意控制的fNIRS脑机接口与助听器等辅助设备。

papers.title: Neural dynamics of auditory attention: Interactions between top-down and bottom-up processes.
papers.authors: Graceffo S, Elhilali M.
papers.abstract: Auditory attention allows listeners to navigate complex acoustic environments by prioritizing behaviorally-relevant sounds while limiting interference from competing input. This process is guided by a dynamic interplay between top-down attention, driven by behavioral goals and expectations, and bottom-up attention, triggered by stimulus-driven salience.
