Although this distinction remains useful at a conceptual level, growing evidence suggests that auditory attention emerges from continuous interactions between goal-directed and stimulus-driven processes that recruit partially overlapping neural systems and vary with task demands, stimulus properties, and prior experience. This review focuses on the neural mechanisms underlying attentional control and interactions between top-down and bottom-up auditory attention. It synthesizesevidence from neurophysiological, behavioral, and neuroimaging studies and explores how top-down control modulates the neural processing and attentional impact of salient input, how bottom-up signals override attentional focus, and how these interactions are shaped by task demands and individual cognitive capacity. The findings synthesized here support a view of auditory attention as a flexible and adaptive system, whose operation emerges from context-dependent interactions, with important implications for models of attention and real-world listening behaviors.

papers.title: Reorienting TMS treatments for fear memories and posttraumatic stress disorder. The emerging potential of the anterior prefrontal cortex.
papers.authors: La Pastina AC, Manassero E, Sacchetti B.
papers.abstract: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is characterized by re-experiencing trauma through vivid and involuntary intrusions, avoidance of cues that could trigger traumatic memories, and alterations in mood and cognition. Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) offers a promising approach to modulating activity and functional coupling within neural circuits underlying these processes. To date, TMS studies in fear-conditioning research and PTSD have mainly focused on dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) and ventromedial (vmPFC)-connected or broader medial-prefrontal (mPFC) targets, yielding encouraging but heterogeneous effects on posttraumatic symptoms. In parallel, emerging evidence has implicated the anterior prefrontal cortex (aPFC; Brodmann area 10) in threat- and trauma-related processes, including memory retrieval, higher-order control of defensive responding, adaptive strategy selection, and resilience. Whereas the dlPFC and vmPFC have been incorporated into mechanistic models of fear regulation, the aPFC has received limited attention in theoretical frameworks of fear and PTSD. Here, we review TMS studies organized around dlPFC, vmPFC-connected or mPFC, and aPFC neuroanatomical targets, integrating evidence from experimental and clinical research. Based on the hierarchical model of prefrontal organization, we argue that these regions represent potential TMS targets or circuit nodes, but likely act on partially distinct mechanisms. The vmPFC appears primarily involved in early automatic downregulation of defensive responses; the dlPFC may support cognitive control strategies such as reappraisal; and the aPFC may enable a supraordinate influence over higher-order representations and avoidance-related circuitry, as well as flexible selection of emotion-regulation strategies. We conclude that integrating the aPFC into this framework may guide next-generation, mechanistically-informed TMS treatments for PTSD.

papers.title: White matter-guided transtemporal corridors: An anatomical blueprint for safe access through the temporal lobe.
papers.authors: Bilgin B, Yuncu ME, Karadag A, Bozkurt B, Tanriover N.
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
papers.abstract: Background Transtemporal approaches provide access to deep temporal and intraventricular lesions but may traverse critical white matter pathways, making tract-aware planning important for minimizing postoperative deficits. Therefore, the microsurgical anatomy of commonly used transtemporal corridors, the fibers encountered along each approach, and their tract-specific risk profiles should be defined to guide corridor selection. Methods Three formalin-fixed cadaveric brain specimens (six hemispheres) were dissected, proceeding stepwise from the cortical surface to the ventricular system. Results Posterior superior temporal gyrus approaches lay close to the arcuate fasciculus (AF) and superior longitudinal fasciculus, with the middle longitudinal fasciculus encountered at a deeper plane; trajectories toward the roof of the temporal horn or atrium approached the optic radiation (OR) and Meyer's loop. Middle temporal gyrus and inferior temporal sulcus corridors lay adjacent to the OR-particularly Meyer's loop-and the inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus (IFOF) within the sagittal stratum. Inferior temporal gyrus approaches remained distant from the AF and uncinate fasciculus (UF), with the inferior longitudinal fasciculus (ILF) most closely related to the trajectory, while the OR and IFOF remained superior and medial. The transsylvian corridor traversed the temporal stem near the UF and central IFOF, with superior extension toward the ventricular roof placing Meyer's loop and the OR at risk. Conclusion Safer transtemporal surgery depends on the relationship between the surgical corridor and associated fibers, rather than the cortical entry point alone. These findings provide an anatomical framework for white matter-guided planning and tract-sparing corridor selection.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注经颞叶入路如何避开关键白质纤维束，以降低术后神经功能缺损风险。作者在固定尸脑标本上逐层解剖，从皮层表面追踪至脑室系统，比较不同经颞叶走廊与邻近纤维束的空间关系。结果显示，不同皮层入口对应的深部纤维风险各异：后部颞上回入路靠近弓状束和上纵束，向颞角顶或房部延伸时接近视辐射和Meyer环；颞中回及颞下沟走廊邻近视辐射与下额枕束；颞下回入路则远离弓状束和钩束，与下纵束关系最密切。作者据此强调，安全入路选择取决于走廊与纤维束的关系而非仅看皮层入口，并为白质导向的保束规划提供了解剖学框架。

papers.title: Trigeminal nerve microstructure in chronic temporomandibular joint pain: A diffusion tensor imaging study.
papers.authors: Droguett Tidy C, Aliberas J, Arriagada V, Moreno A, Figueras O.
papers.journal: Journal of oral biology and craniofacial research
papers.abstract: Objective To evaluate whether chronic temporomandibular joint (TMJ) pain secondary to internal joint disorders is associated with microstructural alterations of the trigeminal nerve (TN), assessed by diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) and fractional anisotropy (FA). Methods Forty individuals were included: 20 patients with chronic TMJ pain and 20 pain-free controls. All participants underwent magnetic resonance imaging with DTI focused on the cisternal segment of the TN. FA values were measured bilaterally. Between-group comparisons were performed using Mann-Whitney tests, and associations between FA and clinical variables were assessed using Spearman rank correlations. Results No significant side-to-side FA difference was observed in controls (P = 0.20), and no significant FA difference was detected between painful TMJs and control sides (P = 0.75). FA was not associated with pain duration (P = 0.50) or pain intensity during mandibular function (P = 0.64). In contrast, among TMJs with pain at rest, greater resting pain intensity was significantly associated with lower ipsilateral TN FA (21 TMJs from 15 patients; Spearman ρ = -0.51, P = 0.019). Conclusion Chronic TMJ pain secondary to internal joint disorders was not associated with a detectable global reduction in cisternal TN FA. However, the inverse association between resting pain intensity and ipsilateral FA suggests subtle pain-related microstructural variation in a clinically relevant subgroup. These findings support further investigation of trigeminal neuroplasticity in persistent TMJ pain while avoiding interpretation of FA as a direct marker of structural nerve damage.

papers.title: An efficient convolutional neural network model for classifying positive affective states from EEG data considering sleep condition.
papers.authors: Gazan MK, Moghaddamnia S, Habiboglu MG.
papers.abstract: Background The recognition of affective states from EEG recordings considering the sleep condition can be an important supporting tool in therapy and in the treatment of psychological or psychiatric disorders. New method Since sleep deprivation changes EEG characteristics, a two-stage framework is developed for affective state classification. First, a classification between "Normal Sleep" (NS) and "Sleep-Deprived" (SD) is conducted using resting-state EEG data. The data are then fed into one of two newly proposed, lightweight Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to recognize four affective states. Results In the first stage, CNN-BiLSTM achieves 95.96% accuracy under window-level splitting and 70.46% under subject-independent 5-fold cross-validation, while in the second stage the proposed models achieve 93.40% (NS) and 90.95% (SD) under window-level splitting, and 38.98% (NS) and 38.97% (SD) under cross-validation. The lower subject-independent accuracies reflect the class imbalance and the clustering of scores near the class boundaries, which make cross-subject four-class generalization challenging. Comparison with existing methods As existing studies mostly classify momentary emotions without addressing sleep conditions, direct comparison with prior work is difficult; we therefore benchmarked our framework against several established baseline models, including SqueezeNet, EEGNet, ShallowConvNet, Support Vector Machine, and Random Forest. Conclusions This study suggests that considering physiological states can improve multi-class classification of affective states from time-varying neurophysiological signals such as EEG. The framework performs strongly under window-level evaluation, whereas its performance under the stricter subject-independent setting is more limited and should be interpreted accordingly. It can nonetheless contribute to more comprehensive research in affective neuroscience.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个两阶段框架，先从静息态脑电中区分正常睡眠与睡眠剥夺状态，再将数据送入两种轻量卷积神经网络识别四种情绪状态。结果显示，在窗口级划分下各阶段分类准确率较高，但在更严格、跨被试的交叉验证下准确率明显下降，作者将其归因于类别不平衡和得分聚集在类别边界附近，说明跨被试四分类泛化仍具挑战。由于既有研究多未考虑睡眠条件，作者转而与多种基线模型比较，并指出纳入生理状态有助于改善脑电情绪多分类，但框架在严格跨被试设定下的表现有限，需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Aberrant amygdala subregion volumes in youth at high risk for bipolar disorder predict antidepressant-induced adverse events.
papers.authors: Tang B, Patino LR, Blom TJ, Welge JA, Strawn JR, Bruns KM, Zhang W, Lui S, DelBello MP, Singh MK.
papers.abstract: Youth with familial risk for bipolar disorder (BD) and current depression/anxiety are vulnerable to antidepressant-induced adverse events (AE), including mania. The amygdala, implicated in the pathophysiology of mood disorders, may play a key role in these AE. 105 youth with at least one first-degree relative with BD-I and a current depressive/anxiety disorder (high-risk) and 51 healthy controls (HC) underwent baseline MRI to investigate neurostructural risk factors for antidepressant-induced AE. High-risk youth were randomized to either psychotherapy plus escitalopram or psychotherapy plus placebo (2:1) for up to 16 weeks. Clinical efficacy was assessed using the Children's Depression Rating Scale-Revised and Pediatric Anxiety Rating Scale, and AE were assessed using the Pediatric Adverse Events Rating Scale and Treatment-Emergent Activation and Suicidality Assessment Profile. Baseline amygdala subregion volumes and their associations with the rates of change in clinical symptoms and AE over time were evaluated using linear regression models. Compared to HC, high-risk youth had reduced volumes in left lateral and medial nuclei, bilateral central and cortical nuclei, and bilateral corticoamygdaloid transition area and increased volumes in bilateral basal and accessory basal nuclei. In escitalopram-treated youth, but not those receiving placebo, smaller baseline volumes in bilateral cortical nuclei and left medial nucleus were associated with fewer arousal-related AE. Additionally, larger bilateral basal nuclei volumes at baseline were associated with more arousal-related AE. Widespread amygdala volume abnormalities provide insights into neurobiological mechanisms underlying the development of BD in high-risk youth, and specific subregion volumes may serve as neurostructural markers for predicting antidepressant-induced AE.

papers.title: Deep TMS modulates neurovascular responses and enhances dual-task computation in healthy adults.
papers.authors: Zeng B, Wang W, Ding Z, Wang C, Li C, Yuan R, Zhou B, Zhu Y.
papers.abstract: Dual-task performance requires coordination between cognitive control and motor systems. This study examined how deep transcranial magnetic stimulation (DTMS) influences cortical responses and computational performance during dual-task processing. In a randomized crossover study, 19 healthy adults underwent DTMS targeting the bilateral prefrontal cortex and anterior cingulate cortex and sham stimulation in separate sessions, with functional near-infrared spectroscopy and dual-task assessments performed before and after each intervention. Compared with sham stimulation, DTMS increased task-related cortical activation in regions involved in cognitive-motor processing and improved computation number without affecting accuracy. Activation changes involving the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, secondary motor cortex, and language-related regions were associated with dual-task performance. These findings suggest that DTMS may modulate distributed cortical dynamics supporting cognitive-motor coordination and inform its potential application in populations with cognitive-motor impairments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察深度经颅磁刺激（DTMS）如何影响健康成人双任务加工中的皮层反应与计算表现，采用随机交叉设计，对健康成人分别施加靶向双侧前额叶和 anterior cingulate cortex 的 DTMS 与假刺激，并用功能近红外光谱和双任务评估比较干预前后变化。结果显示，与假刺激相比，DTMS 增强了参与认知—运动加工区域的任務相关皮层激活，并在不影响准确率的情况下提高了计算数量；背外侧前额叶、次级运动皮层及语言相关区域的激活变化与双任务表现相关。作者据此提出，DTMS 可能调节支持认知—运动协调的分布式皮层动态，并提示其在认知—运动障碍人群中的潜在应用，但该应用仍属推测，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Prejudicial essentialist bias in cognitive neuroscience studies with people who use drugs.
papers.authors: Oldfield CJ, Owens M, Hogarth L.
papers.abstract: Objectives Professional judgement can be biased (or prejudiced) by the incidental social characteristics of marginalised clients. Perhaps unexpectedly, psychologists have been hypothesised to express prejudicial essentialist bias in their writing; disproportionately invoking pathological constitutional deficits to explain observed differences in study participants with marginalised social characteristics. Methods To test whether this bias exists in cognitive neuroscience publications, 67 case-controlled studies reporting lower cognitive task performance in people who use drugs (PWUD) versus controls were collated. The percentage of explanations of PWUD's performance using essentialist terms ('deficits', 'dysfunction', 'impairments') versus neutral-agnostic terms ('difference', 'change', 'alteration' etc.) were tested for associations with PWUD's social characteristics, study effect size and publication year. Results Deficit descriptions were used on 64% of occasions and were significantly associated with PWUD's social characteristics including their mean age (r = 0.40), percent male (r = 0.24), primary drug (η2 = 0.24), and dependence severity indexed by their recruitment from clinical sources (η2 = 0.12) and characterisation using clinical diagnostics (η2 = 0.15); but not with the effect size of the task performance difference (r = 0.029) or publication year (r = -0.18). Conclusions Psychologists' unwarranted causal inference that task performance differences arise from constitutional pathogenic origins may be prejudiced by the incidental social characteristics of their PWUD sample. This bias may be explained by professional incentives, journal remit and author training influencing narrative construction. Solutions for the bias may involve meta-scientific auditing, strengthening of language guidelines, and critical reflective practice implemented through positionality statements in quantitative research.

papers.title: Differentiating non-fluent and logopenic primary progressive aphasia via automated acoustic speech analysis.
papers.authors: Antonicelli G, Morin BT, Bogley R, Newbury R, Ezzes Z, Ramkrishnan S, Miller Z, Mandelli ML, Tee BL, García AM, Gorno-Tempini ML, Vonk JMJ.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: In primary progressive aphasia, differential diagnosis between non-fluent (nfvPPA) and logopenic (lvPPA) variants can be clinically challenging. Although linguistic features from connected speech may aid in PPA subtype classification, they depend on labor-intensive transcriptions. In contrast, acoustic features are extracted directly from the audio signal and have shown potential in capturing variant-specific patterns, but their diagnostic relevance is not well understood. In this study, we analyzed connected speech recordings from 242 individuals (40 healthy controls, 91 lvPPA, 111 nfvPPA) performing a ∼2-min picture description task. We extracted 103 acoustic features from each recording and reduced them to 9, which we finally grouped into four domain scores representing speech rate and voice quality. Domain scores were tested as predictors in classification models to detect PPA and distinguish between PPA variants. Voxel-based morphometry was used to investigate brain-behavior relationships. Classification models combining the four domain scores and MMSE yielded 88% balanced-sample accuracy for PPA-versus-controls and 73% accuracy for lvPPA-versus-nfvPPA. Pitch and speech rate were the most discriminative markers. Voxel-based morphometry associated speech rate with the frontal speech production network, pitch with the middle frontal and inferior frontal gyrus, perturbation with the insula, and spectrum with the basal ganglia and the thalamus. We showed that acoustic analysis of brief speech samples has the potential to aid the diagnostic process and contribute to more nuanced phenotyping. With further validation, such measures could be integrated into clinical workflows as low-burden, objective tools to support differential diagnosis and track disease progression in PPA.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何区分非流利型与logopenic型原发性进行性失语，利用图片描述任务中的连续语音录音提取声学特征，并结合简易认知筛查建立分类模型。结果显示，声学指标对识别失语患者及区分两种亚型的准确率较好，其中音高和语速最具区分力；基于体素的形态学分析进一步将这些声学指标与额叶言语产生网络等脑结构联系起来。作者认为，简短语音的自动化声学分析有望作为低负担、客观的辅助工具支持鉴别诊断和追踪疾病进展，但相关临床价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Basic-level category processing advantage in fear generalization and its modulation by threat-conditioned stimulus diversity: Behavioral and event-related potential evidence.
papers.authors: Zhang P, Li J, Wu S, Li H, Weng Y, Zheng X.
papers.abstract: Category-based fear generalization refers to the extension of acquired fear responses to novel stimuli sharing categorical cues with a threat stimulus. Categories are organized into superordinate, basic-level, and subordinate levels, which differ in cognitive processing advantages; however, whether this categorical advantage influences fear generalization remains unclear. Experiment 1 used a discriminative fear conditioning paradigm, employing subordinate exemplars of birds and measuring tools as the threat-conditioned stimulus (CS+) and the safety-conditioned stimulus (CS-), respectively. During the generalization test, we included generalization stimuli sharing either the same basic-level category (GSBasic ) or the same superordinate category (but different basic-level category) as the CS+. Fear generalization was assessed via shock expectancy ratings and skin conductance responses. Experiment 2 manipulated CS+ diversity (high vs. low) in the same task while recording electroencephalography to examine its moderating role. Behaviorally, acquired fear generalized more robustly to GSBasic than to GS sharing the same superordinate category (GSSuperordinate ). Participants in the high-diversity group showed higher shock expectancy ratings for both the CS+ and GSBasic than those in the low-diversity group. Event-related potential results revealed that GSBasic elicited P2 and N400 amplitudes comparable to those of the CS+, and exhibited more positive P2 and less negative N400 amplitudes than GSSuperordinate and CS-. Moreover, only the CS+ and GSBasic elicited more positive LPP amplitudes than CS-. These findings suggest that early attentional allocation, late semantic processing, and motivational attention collectively constitute the electrophysiological basis of the basic-level category processing advantage in fear generalization, offering implications for the intervention of anxiety disorders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察基本层次类别的加工优势是否会影响恐惧泛化，以及威胁条件刺激的多样性是否起调节作用。实验一采用辨别性恐惧条件化范式，以鸟类和测量工具的下位样例分别作为威胁与安全刺激，并结合主观电击预期和皮肤电反应测量泛化；实验二操纵威胁刺激多样性并记录脑电。行为结果显示，恐惧更明显地泛化到与威胁刺激同属基本层次的刺激，而非仅同属上位层次的刺激，高多样性组的电击预期也更高。脑电结果提示，基本层次泛化刺激在早期注意分配、语义加工和晚期动机性注意上与威胁刺激更为接近。作者据此认为，早期注意、晚期语义加工与动机性注意共同构成基本层次类别优势的电生理基础，并提示其对焦虑障碍干预的潜在意义。

papers.title: Latent HIV Infection of BBB Pericytes Enhances Gap Junction-mediated Crosstalk with Endothelial Cells.
papers.authors: Schmidlin S, Naranjo O, Torices S, Fattakhov N, Gilicinska M, Minevich M, Schindler KA, Tiburcio D, Osborne OM, Acharya A, Park M, Stevenson M, Byrareddy SN, Toborek M.
papers.abstract: HIV-Associated Neurocognitive Impairments persist, with over 50% of patients experiencing cognitive decline. Blood-brain barrier (BBB) impairment is a consistent feature of this comorbidity, which is remarkable, because BBB endothelial cells are not productively infected by HIV-1. Conversely, pericytes can be productively infected with HIV-1 and are essential for cerebrovascular homeostasis. Given this, we hypothesized that HIV-1 infection of pericytes disrupts BBB endothelial cell integrity through dysfunctional gap junction and hemichannel signaling, impairing pericyte-endothelial intercellular communication. Using a co-culture model with primary human BBB pericytes and brain microvascular endothelial cells, pericytes were infected with HIV-1 for 3 or 7 days, exhibiting active and latent viral phenotypes. Findings revealed enhanced gap junction communication between HIV-infected pericytes and endothelial cells under both conditions, and blocking gap junctions modulated endothelial inflammatory responses. Overall, this study advances our understanding of the molecular mechanisms underlying HIV-associated BBB dysfunction and may inform the development of targeted therapeutic strategies.

papers.title: Tenecteplase, alteplase, and endovascular thrombectomy in extended-window acute ischemic stroke with intracranial large-vessel occlusion: a Bayesian network meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Li W, Wu C, Deng R, Zhou J, Li L, Liu Y, Chen S.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose The comparative effects of intravenous thrombolytic agents, endovascular thrombectomy (EVT), and bridging therapy in imaging-selected patients with acute ischemic stroke treated beyond 4.5 hours remain uncertain. We compared these strategies while distinguishing confirmed large-vessel occlusion (LVO) evidence from broader mixed populations. Methods We searched PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library for randomized trials evaluating reperfusion treatments administered 4.5 to 24 hours after stroke onset or last known well. The primary network included trials requiring confirmed intracranial LVO or basilar artery occlusion (BAO). An anterior-circulation LVO network and an all-available network were examined as sensitivity and exploratory analyses. Bayesian random-effects consistency models estimated odds ratios (ORs) with 95% credible intervals (CrIs). The primary outcome was functional independence, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 2 at 90 days. Results Fifteen randomized trials were included, of which 8 contributed to the primary confirmed LVO/BAO network. Compared with placebo or best medical care, EVT significantly improved functional independence (OR, 2.93 [95% CrI, 1.40-6.53]) and excellent functional outcome, defined as mRS 0 to 1 (OR, 2.22 [95% CrI, 1.30-4.11]), reduced 90-day mortality (OR, 0.71 [95% CrI, 0.50-0.98]), and increased trial-defined recanalization or reperfusion at approximately 24 hours (OR, 5.27 [95% CrI, 1.83-16.04]); sICH was also increased (OR, 2.65 [95% CrI, 1.28-5.81]). Compared with EVT, tenecteplase plus EVT showed numerically favorable but statistically inconclusive estimates for functional independence (OR, 1.10 [95% CrI, 0.34-3.52]) and excellent outcome (OR, 1.16 [95% CrI, 0.52-2.64]). Direct pairwise analyses of 2 trials were similarly inconclusive. Tenecteplase alone did not show clear differences from placebo or best medical care. Findings were directionally consistent in the anterior-circulation sensitivity and all-available exploratory networks. Conclusions Among imaging-selected patients with confirmed intracranial LVO or BAO treated 4.5 to 24 hours after onset or last known well, EVT had the most consistent evidence of benefit versus placebo or best medical care. Tenecteplase plus EVT showed favorable but imprecise estimates, and neither network nor direct pairwise analyses established superiority over EVT alone. The incremental benefit of bridging tenecteplase remains uncertain.

papers.title: Reversal of refractory epilepsy in an adult with GAMT deficiency: A case report and comparative literature review.
papers.authors: Sung WH, Chen H, Hsu CW, Tsai MH.
papers.abstract: Objective Guanidinoacetate methyltransferase (GAMT) deficiency is a rare autosomal recessive creatine biosynthesis disorder. Reports specifically focusing on adult patients remain scarce. Methods We report a 52-year-old female (the oldest documented case of GAMT deficiency to date) presenting with severe intellectual disability, refractory epilepsy, and adult-onset disease progression. Whole-exome sequencing identified novel compound heterozygous GAMT variants (c.265_267del and c.253G>T), and magnetic resonance spectroscopy confirmed cerebral creatine depletion. Remarkably, initiating oral creatine supplementation at age 52 achieved complete seizure freedom, normalization of the electroencephalogram (EEG), and significant motor function recovery. Results A comprehensive review revealed that untreated adult patients face a high risk of progressive neurological deterioration. Compared to the pediatric cohort, adults exhibited a significantly higher prevalence of movement disorders (69.2% vs. 33.1%, p < 0.001) and a trend toward a higher prevalence of epilepsy (92.3% vs. 74.2%). Especially, atonic seizures (drop attacks) are particularly characteristic of adult GAMT deficiency, with EEGs frequently demonstrating background slowing, multifocal epileptiform discharges, and electrodecremental patterns. Significance This study underscores that continuous disease progression and prolonged neurotoxicity still could compromise the well-being of adult GAMT deficiency patients. Accurate diagnosis is essential for adults presenting with developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE) phenotype, as even late treatment for GAMT deficiency can still dramatically alleviate the epileptic burden and reverse motor decline. Plain language summary We report the oldest known adult diagnosed with GAMT deficiency. Our case demonstrates that starting creatine treatment even at age 52 can dramatically reduce seizures and restore motor function. Literature shows that untreated adults suffer from more severe epilepsy and movement disorders than children, with symptoms worsening over time. These findings highlight the critical need for genetic testing in adults with unexplained severe epilepsy; timely creatine supplementation can halt cognitive decline and significantly restore quality of life.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告结合文献比较，关注成人GAMT缺乏症的识别与治疗。作者报告一名52岁女性，经全外显子测序和磁共振波谱确诊，在接受口服肌酸补充后癫痫发作完全停止、脑电图恢复正常并出现明显运动功能改善。文献梳理还提示，未治疗的成人患者神经功能恶化风险高，运动障碍和癫痫（尤其失张力发作）比儿童更常见。作者据此强调，对表现为发育性和癫痫性脑病的成人应重视基因检测，即使较晚开始治疗也可能显著减轻癫痫负担并逆转运动衰退。

papers.title: Frequent involvement of cingulate and insulo-opercular regions in sleep-related hypermotor epilepsy: A multimodal presurgical study.
papers.authors: Zhu F, Shi XR, Weng SW, Delazer L, Fearns N, Arafat T, Lv RJ, Hu WH, Zhang C, Koepp M, Wang Q.
papers.abstract: Objective Sleep-related hypermotor epilepsy (SHE) is classically considered a frontal lobe epilepsy; however, accumulating evidence suggests that hypermotor seizures may arise from multiple frontal and extrafrontal regions. We characterized the anatomical distribution of best available localizations in patients with SHE using multimodal presurgical data. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 17 patients with clinically diagnosed SHE who underwent comprehensive evaluation, including long-term video-electroencephalographic (EEG) monitoring, 3-T high-resolution magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography, and, where indicated, magnetoencephalography, stereo-EEG (SEEG), and surgical assessment. Best available anatomical localizations were assigned using a hierarchical multimodal framework incorporating surgical, SEEG, and concordant noninvasive findings. Their anatomical distribution was subsequently assessed at the cohort level. Results Sixteen patients (94.1%) had an assigned best available localization. Cingulate or insulo-opercular regions were involved in 11 of 16 patients (68.8%), whereas the remaining cases were localized to other frontal regions. In a sensitivity analysis restricted to 10 patients with SEEG-defined and/or surgically supported localizations, six involved cingulate or insulo-opercular regions. All patients were MRI-negative. In contrast, MRI-positron emission tomography fusion provided regionally informative anatomical findings in 16 of 17 cases and contributed to multimodal localization. Interictal epileptiform discharges were identified in 15 patients, whereas regionally informative ictal scalp EEG patterns were observed in eight; ictal interpretation was frequently limited by rapid propagation, movement-related artifacts, and delayed EEG onset. Focal cortical dysplasia-related histopathological findings were identified in five of seven resected specimens, whereas interpretation in two was limited by prior thermocoagulation. Significance These descriptive findings indicate that cingulate and insulo-opercular regions were frequently represented among the identified localizations in this presurgical cohort. Multimodal evaluation integrating electroclinical, imaging, and invasive findings may support presurgical localization in MRI-negative SHE.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注睡眠相关过度运动性癫痫（SHE）的致痫区是否只位于额叶，利用多模态术前评估资料回顾性分析患者可获得的最佳解剖定位及其分布。结果显示，多数患者的最佳定位涉及扣带回或岛盖-岛叶区域，其余位于其他额叶区域；在经立体脑电或手术支持的敏感性分析中也有相近表现。所有患者MRI均为阴性，而MRI与PET融合在多数病例中提供了有定位价值的解剖信息，间歇期脑电和发作期头皮脑电的定位价值则常受快速扩散、运动伪差和脑电起始延迟限制。作者据此认为，扣带回和岛盖-岛叶区域在该术前队列的定位中较常见，整合电临床、影像和侵入性检查的多模态评估可能有助于MRI阴性SHE的术前定位；这些为描述性发现，尚不能据此推断因果关系或治疗效果。

papers.title: Empagliflozin in Lafora disease: A first-in-human 6-month pilot study with electroclinical and FDG-PET findings.
papers.authors: d'Orsi G, Liantonio A, Imbrici P, Lolli G, Dinoi G, Conte E, Altomare CD, Ciccone F, Calò E, Perrone E, Cazzanelli G, DEFEAT‐LD Study Group, Carella M.
papers.journal: Epileptic disorders : international epilepsy journal with videotape
papers.abstract: Objective Lafora disease (LD) is a rare, fatal neurodegenerative epilepsy with no approved treatments. Empagliflozin, a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor, has shown neuroprotective actions in preclinical models through modulation of glycogen metabolism, induction of a pseudo-ketogenic state, improved mitochondrial efficiency, and reduction of excitatory neurotransmission. Based on this rationale, we conducted a first-in-human pilot study of empagliflozin in two genetically confirmed LD patients. Methods Two patients with genetically confirmed LD received empagliflozin 10 mg/day for 6 months. Serial assessments included safety and tolerability, seizure frequency, myoclonus severity, electroencephalographic findings, neuropsychological and motor evaluations, brain MRI, and quantitative FDG-PET with regional Z-score analysis. Results Empagliflozin was safe and well tolerated, with no serious adverse events. Seizure frequency, myoclonus, and overall clinical status remained largely stable over 6 months, although some neuropsychological and motor measures showed variable changes between patients. EEG background activity and spike index were largely unchanged. Brain MRI showed stable mild cortical atrophy in both patients. In contrast, FDG-PET revealed progressive and spatially expanding cerebral hypometabolism in both patients, with worsening regional Z-scores, particularly in the parietal and precuneus regions. Significance In this first-in-human, 6-month pilot study, empagliflozin showed acceptable short-term safety and feasibility in LD, but no definitive conclusions on efficacy can be drawn. The dissociation between relative electroclinical stability and progressive metabolic impairment suggests that quantitative FDG-PET may represent a sensitive biomarker for monitoring disease trajectory in this ultra-rare epilepsy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对缺乏获批疗法的致命性神经退行性癫痫——拉福拉病，首次在人体中开展为期6个月的恩格列净试点研究，两名经基因确诊的患者接受每日10毫克治疗并接受安全性、癫痫发作、肌阵挛、脑电图、神经心理与运动评估、脑MRI及定量FDG-PET等系列评估。结果显示，药物安全且耐受良好，无严重不良事件；癫痫发作频率、肌阵挛和整体临床状态基本稳定，脑电图背景活动与棘波指数大体不变，MRI显示轻度皮质萎缩保持稳定。但FDG-PET显示两名患者脑代谢减低呈进行性且范围扩大，以顶叶和楔前叶区域Z评分恶化尤为明显。作者指出，该研究仅能说明短期安全性与可行性，无法就疗效得出结论；电临床相对稳定与代谢损害进展之间的分离提示，定量FDG-PET或可作为监测这一超罕见癫痫疾病轨迹的敏感生物标志物。

papers.title: Three-hinge gyri link individualized folding topology to cortical and superficial white-matter diffusion organization
papers.authors: Chen M, Dong X, Cheng J, Hu D, Liu T, Zhu D, Li G.
papers.abstract: Individual differences in cortical folding are a hallmark of human brain anatomy, but what this variability reflects in the underlying tissue remains unclear. Three-hinge gyri (3HGs), where three gyral crests converge, provide an individualized higher-order folding landmark for probing this relationship. Using 7T diffusion MRI in six postmortem hemispheres, we found lower mean, axial, and radial diffusivity and higher fractional anisotropy at 3HGs than at matched gyral crowns, with the principal tensor pattern replicated in 414 age-matched in vivo adults. Diffusivity differences extended across the cortical ribbon, whereas anisotropy- and fiber-related differences strengthened toward and beneath the white surface. Ex vivo , diffusion measures also varied with gyral-skeleton degree, and streamlines sampled beneath 3HGs preferentially reached other 3HGs. These findings link individualized folding topology to cortical and superficial white-matter diffusion-inferred tissue properties, providing tissue-level context for understanding the microstructural correlates of individual folding variation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注个体化的皮层折叠形态在组织层面反映了什么，以三条脑回嵴汇聚形成的“三铰链脑回”作为折叠标志，结合死后半球的高场扩散磁共振成像与在体成人数据进行比较。结果显示，三铰链脑回处的扩散率低于匹配的脑回顶部，各向异性更高，且这种差异跨越皮层带，并在靠近白质表面处增强；纤维追踪还提示三铰链脑回下方的流线更倾向于连接其他三铰链脑回。作者据此认为，个体化的折叠拓扑与皮层及浅表白质的扩散推断组织特性相关，为理解折叠个体差异的微结构基础提供了组织层面的线索，但相关关系并不等同于因果。

papers.title: Speech Tracking in fMRI Reveals a Distinct Response to Sentence Boundaries During Comprehension
papers.authors: Levy-David O, Tikoschinski R, Reichart R, Zion Golumbic E, Deschamps I, Agmon G.
papers.abstract: Psycholinguistic research and linguistic theory suggest that comprehending continuous speech involves segmenting it into sentences. Yet, direct neuroimaging evidence for this process remains scarce, partly because sentence boundaries coincide with acoustic, prosodic, lexical, and syntactic changes. Here, we used whole-brain fMRI to test whether sentence boundaries elicit a neural response beyond these accompanying speech properties during spontaneous speech comprehension. We modelled BOLD responses to sentence-final words alongside continuous regressors characterizing accompanying speech properties. This approach revealed sensitivity to continuously varying features of speech across multiple brain regions. Notably, the acoustic envelope predicted BOLD responses in bilateral primary auditory cortices. Responses associated with prosodic breaks and emphasis were found in right temporal cortex, syntactic bottom-up node count in the left superior temporal sulcus, and word concreteness in the parahippocampal gyri. Critically, sentence-final words were associated with an increased activation in right temporal regions, after accounting for acoustic, prosodic, lexical, semantic and syntactic properties. These findings provide evidence for a neural response to sentence boundaries consistent with active sentence segmentation. More generally, this study demonstrates the value of continuous-regressor modelling for investigating speech comprehension with fMRI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用全脑fMRI考察自然语句理解中，句子边界是否在声学、韵律、词汇和句法变化之外引发独立的神经反应。作者将句末词与连续描述这些伴随言语特征的回归量一起建模，发现多个脑区对连续变化的言语特征敏感，而在控制上述属性后，句末词仍与右侧颞叶区域激活增强相关。这一结果提示句子边界存在独立于伴随线索的神经响应，与主动的句子切分过程相符，也说明连续回归建模有助于用fMRI研究言语理解。

papers.title: Brain FACTs: A same-section workflow for Fiber Architecture, Cytoarchitecture and cell Types in large-scale brain sections
papers.authors: Kooijmans RN, Axer M, Graessel D, Amunts K.
papers.abstract: Understanding the human brain's multiscale organization requires linking cells, connections and architecture, yet conventional methods are incompatible within a single specimen, and inter-individual variability confounds cross-brain comparisons. Multiple-label immunohistochemistry for different cell types has been applied in interleaved sections but remains challenging within a single large human brain section and, has never been combined on the same tissue with 3D polarized light imaging (3D-PLI) for three-dimensional fiber architecture. Here we introduce a sequential multimodal workflow integrating 3D-PLI, multiplex chromogenic immunohistochemistry and Nissl staining on the same large human brain section, preserving each technique's quality and specificity. The method was validated on vervet monkey and Wistar rat sections. The resulting paired high-resolution images eliminate inter-subject variability and enable direct micron-scale mapping of fiber tracts relative to molecularly defined cell types, yielding previously inaccessible insights such as molecular identification of white-matter components, refined cortical layering and cytoarchitectural disambiguation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人脑多尺度组织研究中不同成像与染色方法难以在同一标本上兼容、跨个体比较又受变异干扰的问题，提出并验证了一套在同一张大尺度脑切片上依次整合三维偏振光成像、多重显色免疫组化和尼氏染色的多模态流程，并在猴和大鼠切片上做了验证。由此获得的高分辨率配对图像消除了个体间差异，使纤维束能够相对分子定义的细胞类型进行微米级直接定位，并带来以往难以获得的信息，例如白质成分的分子鉴定、更精细的皮层分层以及细胞构筑的区分。

papers.title: Time at Home for Whom? Unequal Returns of Paid Family Leave for Infant White Matter and Language Development
papers.authors: Lazarus MF, Nelson CA.
papers.abstract: Paid family leave (PFL) may give parents more time with infants, ease financial strain, and support stable routines. Although PFL has been linked to child development, little is known about neural pathways that might underpin its benefits or whether associations vary across families. Using data from 274 infants in the HEALthy Brain and Child Development Study, we examined associations of maternal and paternal PFL with language ability at 12 months and white matter microstructure at 6 months. We tested whether associations varied by the corresponding parent’s education. Neither maternal nor paternal PFL was directly associated with language scores or fractional anisotropy in the left arcuate, inferior longitudinal, or uncinate fasciculus. Maternal education moderated associations between maternal PFL and fractional anisotropy in the arcuate ( p = .014) and inferior longitudinal fasciculus ( p = .003; n = 148). In both tracts, PFL was associated with higher fractional anisotropy only among infants whose mothers had relatively high education. No comparable pattern emerged for language, the uncinate fasciculus, or paternal PFL. Findings suggest that the neurodevelopmental correlates of PFL may depend on family resources rather than operate uniformly across families, underscoring the need to pair paid leave with additional supports and resources. Lay Summary Paid family leave may give parents more time at home, steadier daily routines, and less financial worry in the months after a birth, all of which could change the care an infant receives. But these benefits may not be equal across families. In a national study of infants, we examined whether paid leave taken by mothers, fathers or partners was related to early language skills and to the organization of brain pathways involved in language. Paid leave was not directly related to language scores or brain development overall. However, maternal paid leave was associated with more mature organization in two language-related brain pathways only among infants whose mothers had higher levels of education. No similar pattern was found for father or partner leave. These findings suggest that paid leave alone may not reduce early developmental disparities, and that policies offering paid leave may need to be paired with additional support for families with fewer resources.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察母亲和父亲的带薪家庭假是否与婴儿语言能力及语言相关白质微结构有关，并检验这种关联是否随父母教育程度而变化，数据来自一项婴儿队列的脑发育研究。总体上，母亲或父亲的带薪假与12个月语言得分及多个语言相关纤维束的各向异性均无直接关联；但母亲教育程度调节了母亲带薪假与其中两个纤维束各向异性的关系，仅在教育程度较高的母亲所生婴儿中，带薪假与更高的各向异性相关，语言指标及其他纤维束未见类似模式，父亲带薪假也无此模式。作者据此指出，带薪家庭假的神经发育相关可能取决于家庭资源而非普遍适用，提示带薪假政策或需配合额外支持，但这些关联不等于因果，也不能据此推断带薪假具有治疗效果。

papers.title: Agency and Embodiment Provide Dissociable Benefits to Perception, Metacognition and Neural Processing During Active Sensing
papers.authors: Tang Z, Dowsett J, Taylor P, Ferreiro DN, Pecka M.
papers.abstract: Metacognition, judging how reliable our own perceptual decisions are, is central to adaptive behavior. Such judgments hinge on the reliability of the sensory evidence on which that decision is based, and active sensing through self-directed exploration is known to improve perception itself. Yet, how agency, the authorship over self-initiated actions, and the processing of the sensory consequences, which is implicit to active sensing, modulate metacognition and its calibration, remains unknown. Whether physical embodiment adds to this beyond virtual exploration is similarly unclear, yet relevant both for daily life and for self-monitoring in agentic AI. Here, we combined a naturalistic auditory search paradigm with mobile electroencephalography. Twenty participants performed a target-detection task under three conditions: active embodied exploration, active screen-based exploration, and passive listening to replays of their own trials, while we obtained steady-state auditory evoked potentials (SSAEPs) to characterize stimulus-locked neural responses. We find that both agency conditions improved accuracy, metacognitive sensitivity, and overall SSAEP amplitude relative to passive listening, indicating that agency, rather than whole-body movement, drives these enhancements. Crucially, however, embodiment uniquely grounded both the target-evoked neural response and the subjects’ confidence to immediate sensory evidence. Thus, agency alone broadly enhances perceptual and neural processing, but embodiment specifically anchors confidence, neurally and behaviorally, to the present. Significance Statement How well we judge the reliability of our perception, called metacognitive sensitivity, matters more than ever, as we increasingly are presented with information passively through screens rather than gathering it actively via self-initiated exploration. Does actively seeking information sharpen self-monitoring, and does the medium (body vs. screen) matter? We show that active search enhances metacognitive sensitivity and brain responses alike, whether embodied or screen-based. Only embodied search, however, anchors self-evaluation to the present: Behaviorally, embodiment facilitates coupling of confidence tracking directly to current evidence rather than the previous trial’s outcome, while neuronally, it enhances responses in frontal brain regions during periods of heightened subjective confidence. This embodied grounding of self-monitoring may prove pivotal for building reliably agentic AI systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注主动感知中的能动性（对自主动作的作者感）与身体具身性如何分别影响知觉、元认知及其神经基础，采用自然听觉搜索任务结合移动脑电，记录稳态听觉诱发电位，比较主动具身探索、主动屏幕探索和被动重放三种条件。结果显示，两种主动条件相对被动聆听都提高了准确率、元认知敏感性和总体诱发电位幅度，说明这些提升主要来自能动性而非全身运动；但只有具身探索使目标诱发神经反应和主观信心更紧密地锚定于当前感觉证据，行为上表现为信心追踪更依赖当前证据而非上一试次结果。作者据此提出，能动性广泛增强知觉与神经加工，具身性则特异地让信心在行为和神经层面扎根于当下，这一区分对理解自我监控及构建可靠的能动人工智能具有启示意义。

papers.title: Autoencoder-based anomaly mapping and visualization of white matter deformation with application to glioma cases
papers.authors: Shams B, Fekonja LS, Vajkoczy P, Picht T, Aydogan DB.
papers.abstract: Introduction Gliomas can alter white matter pathways, causing structural deformation and functional impairments. However, there is no method to map these structural alterations across the whole brain to support diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment planning. To address this gap, we propose a novel framework based on a convolutional autoencoder that learns geometry-preserving streamline embeddings for mapping structural connectivity anomalies Methods We trained and validated the autoencoder on 100 million synthetic streamlines and evaluated the anomaly-mapping pipeline using data from 118 healthy subjects. We analyzed how different tractography algorithms affect anomaly scores and demonstrated its feasibility in five glioma patients using multi-shell and single-shell diffusion MRI. Results Latent-space distances strongly associated with native-space geometric distances ( R ² = 0.82–0.98), supporting preserved streamline geometry in the learned embeddings. Anomaly scores varied with both the input and reference tractography methods. Patient anomaly maps showed elevated scores near gliomas and extending distally along affected pathways. These whole-brain anomaly maps were generated within minutes. Conclusion The framework offers a practical way to quantify and visualize geometric deviations in whole-brain tractograms, providing novel insights beyond current network and microstructural analyses, with relevance to clinical applications where white matter deformation is pertinent.
papers.summary_zh: 针对胶质瘤可改变白质通路、却缺乏全脑结构异常映射方法的问题，作者提出一种基于卷积自编码器的框架，学习保持几何结构的流线嵌入以映射结构连接异常。该框架在合成流线上训练，并用健康受试者数据评估，结果显示潜在空间距离与原始空间几何距离高度相关，说明嵌入保留了流线几何；异常分数会随输入和参考纤维束成像方法而变化。在胶质瘤病例中，异常图在肿瘤附近及受累通路远端显示升高，且可在数分钟内生成全脑图，提示该框架能用于量化与可视化全脑纤维束的几何偏差，但摘要未报告诊断或治疗效果的验证。

papers.title: Movie Watching for Individual Functional Brain Network Estimation in Adolescents
papers.authors: Godfrey KJ, Grimsrud GJ, Ramirez JS, Corlett A, Houlihan K, Byington N, Gell M, Kretsch S, Dosenbach NU, Barch DM, Gordon EM, Greene DJ, Mueller BA, Betzel RF, Fair DA, Conelea CA, Tervo-Clemmens B, Nelson SM.
papers.abstract: SUMMARY Precision functional mapping (PFM) reveals stable individual differences in brain functional network organization and holds promise for advancing neuropsychiatric clinical care. PFM requires sufficient high-quality and densely sampled functional MRI data at the individual level that is typically acquired during the so-called resting state while passively fixating on a crosshair. However, crosshair fixation acquisitions can be challenging especially for pediatric or patient populations, where alternatives like movie watching might be used to improve data quality and reduce participant burden. Here, we compare the use of resting state crosshair fixation and movie watching fMRI data to derive individual-specific functional brain network topography using PFM data (28–38 minutes of low-motion fMRI data per-participant per-condition) in nineteen adolescents (12-18 years) with a range of transdiagnostic psychiatric diagnoses. Network assignments were largely conserved between crosshair fixation and movie watching, with a smaller subset of reproducible network reassignments which were overwhelmingly border shifts between neighboring networks. This suggests largely conserved global structure of functional network topography between crosshair fixation and movie watching, though border shifts can compound into variable estimates of cortical network size particularly for movie positive (language, salience, and parietal memory) and movie negative networks (default mode, action mode). Functional network assignments derived from movies and crosshair were also similarly individual-specific and consistent within common neuromodulation targets including dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and somatomotor cortex. Key results were replicated in independent pediatric consortia data (Healthy Brain Network, n = 466, 6-22 years) and reproduced across independent PFM data sessions. Acknowledging individual differences and level of analysis, we conclude that movies are a viable alternative to resting state crosshair fixation for individual network definitions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了静息态注视十字与观看电影两种fMRI采集方式，能否在青少年中用于个体化功能脑网络拓扑的估计。作者对十九名携带多种跨诊断精神科诊断的青少年进行了分析，发现两种条件下网络归属总体一致，仅少数可重复的归属改变，且多为相邻网络间的边界偏移；这些边界偏移会累积成皮层网络大小的不同估计，尤其影响电影正性网络和电影负性网络。两种条件得到的网络归属同样具有个体特异性，在常见神经调控靶点内也保持一致。作者据此认为，在承认个体差异和分析层次的前提下，电影观看可作为静息态注视十字的可行替代方案，用于个体网络定义。

papers.title: Aging effects on retrospective and naturalistic encoding of time and their relationship with memory
papers.authors: Fricker F, Buzi G, Morantin M, Doidy F, Clochon P, Bordas R, Leroy N, D’Argembeau A, van Wassenhove V, Hinault T.
papers.abstract: In everyday life, attention is not explicitly directed toward time. Yet, we can reconstruct how long an experience lasted from the memory traces it left behind, a process intertwined with episodic memory and subjective experience. As both memory and temporal processing change with advancing age, investigating aging effects could provide critical insights on these reconstructive processes. In this study, 31 younger (aged 24±3) and 36 older (aged 69±6) healthy adults completed two EEG sessions: 1) a resting-state recording followed by an unexpected retrospective time estimation, and 2) a video-based prospective duration estimation task where participants encoded and judged the duration of 50 naturalistic videos (2-32s) varying in eventfulness. Using a cycle-by-cycle burst analysis of alpha (α: 8-12 Hz), we examined oscillatory correlates of both retrospective temporal judgement and prospective temporal processing. Behaviorally, both groups reconstructed short intervals similarly, but older adults produced longer prospective duration estimates than younger adults for longer video clips (16-32s), particularly under low-eventfulness. Regression analyses also showed that individual differences in older adults’ prospective duration judgments were influenced by both their retrospective time estimation and episodic memory abilities, especially for longer videos. At the neural level, resting-state α-burst dynamics were higher in older adults and predicted, with α-power, longer retrospective estimates in older adults. Additionally, resting-state α-burst activity predicted α-burst during video encoding in both groups. Together, these findings reveal that individual α-power and α-burst dynamics could constitute memory-based time-tracking mechanism that aging reshapes in ways that manifest behaviorally under naturalistic conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察健康老年人对时间的主观重建是否随年龄改变，以及这种改变与情景记忆和静息态α振荡活动的关系。研究比较了年轻与老年健康成人在回溯性时间估计和自然视频前瞻性时长判断中的表现，并结合脑电α节律的爆发分析。行为上，两组对短时距的回溯重建相近，但老年人对较长、事件性较低的视频给出更长的时间估计；其前瞻性判断还与回溯性估计和情景记忆能力相关。神经层面，老年人静息态α爆发活动更强，并与α功率一起预测其更长的回溯估计，且静息态α爆发可预测视频编码时的α爆发。作者据此提出，个体α功率与爆发动态可能构成基于记忆的时间追踪机制，而衰老会在自然情境下改变这一机制的行为表现。

papers.title: Cortex-wide single-cell activity mapping in freely moving mice
papers.authors: Guo C, Xie M, Qiu G, Lu J, Liu Y, Qu L, Huang Y, Guo Z, Tian J, Lin J, Zhang B, Zhang X, Zhao J, Liu X, Long H, Ma J, Zhou B, Ye X, Zhao P, Cao J, Lin Z, Zhang Z, Deng W, Wang J, Wu W, Wang J, Peng X, Zhao S, Na S, Li H, Liu W, Fu Q, Guo ZV, Zhao W, Chen L.
papers.abstract: How the cortex supports complex, naturalistic behavior can be revealed only in freely moving animals. Although head-mounted microscopes promise access to the neural dynamics underlying such behavior, fundamental trade-offs among field of view, spatial resolution, device weight, and background contamination have prevented cortex-wide single-neuron recording, leaving distributed cortical coordination largely inaccessible. To meet these challenges, we introduce COMET (C ortex-wide O bservational M iniature E pifluorescence T echnique ) , a 3.75-g head-mounted mesoscope that integrates an aberration-controlled wide-field optical design, uniform high-efficiency excitation and single-coaxial power-and-data transmission with an end-to-end denoising and signal-extraction pipeline. This enables cortex-wide calcium imaging at single-cell resolution in freely moving mice. COMET captures activity from >15,000 layer 2/3 neurons per 5-min recording over fields of view up to 10 mm in diameter while preserving natural behavior. Benchmarking against benchtop two-photon microscopy demonstrates high spatial concordance of detected neurons and matched event-level calcium dynamics. We apply COMET to social interaction to quantify region-specific engagement and to an auditory trace fear-conditioning task that requires natural movement and behavioral expression, revealing time-ordered changes in regional firing-rate structure and functional connectivity preceding a global conditioned response. COMET provides an open, lightweight hardware–software framework for linking single-neuron activity to cortex-scale network dynamics during freely expressed behaviors under changing internal or external conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对自由活动小鼠难以同时实现全皮层、单细胞分辨率记录的问题，开发了轻量头戴式介观显微成像系统COMET，结合宽场光学设计、高效激发与信号去噪提取流程，在自由活动状态下实现全皮层钙成像。系统可在直径达10毫米的视野内记录大量第2/3层神经元活动，并与台式双光子显微镜在神经元定位和钙事件动态上高度一致。作者将其用于社交互动和听觉痕迹恐惧条件化任务，发现区域参与程度存在差异，并在全局条件化反应出现前观察到区域放电率结构和功能连接的时间有序变化，为将单神经元活动与全皮层网络动态联系起来提供了开放框架。

papers.title: Subcortical Microstructural Changes Associated with Multiple Metal Exposure.
papers.authors: Lee EY.
papers.abstract: Metal exposure has been associated with neurodegenerative disorders including Parkinson's disease (PD). This study examined microstructural changes in subcortical motor areas associated with chronic metal exposure. Subjects with/without a welding history (metal-exposed subjects; n = 23 and controls; n = 24) were examined. Brain microstructural differences were assessed by MRI diffusion metrics [mean (MD), axial (AD), radial diffusivity (RD) and fractional anisotropy (FA)] in subcortical motor areas [nigro-basal ganglia-thalamic circuit: substantia nigra (SN), caudate nucleus (CN), putamen, globus pallidus (GP), and thalamus; dentatorubral circuit: dentate nucleus (DN) and red nucleus (RN)]. Metal exposure was estimated by lifetime welding years, whole blood metal levels, and T1 and R2* (1/T2*) metrics (estimates of brain metal accumulation). Compared to controls, metal-exposed subjects displayed higher diffusivities in the GP and thalamus (p 's < 0.033) but lower FA values in the putamen, SN, and thalamus (p 's < 0.039) without differences in DN and RN (p 's > 0.115). Blood metal mixtures predicted higher GP and SN T1 metrics (p 's < 0.05). Higher T1 metrics predicted higher GP and TH diffusivities and lower SN and TH FA values (p 's < 0.044). Higher blood vanadium levels predicted lower SN FA values (p = 0.009). Multiple metal exposure may be associated with microstructural compromises within the nigro-basal ganglia-thalamic circuit, while the dentatorubral circuit remains relatively spared, a pattern resembling that of PD at-risk populations.

papers.title: MUSA: A Multimodal MRI-Based Major Depressive Disorder Classification Model with a Unified ROI Semantic Space.
papers.authors: Wang H, Peng X, Wu H, Xiang J, Liu J, Ding Y, Wu L, Qi B.
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a common disabling psychiatric disorder mainly diagnosed through clinical interviews and rating-scale assessments. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides a promising basis for computer-aided MDD identification, particularly through multimodal models that can integrate structural and functional brain information. However, existing multimodal MRI fusion models often use data-level fusion or post hoc feature concatenation, potentially overlooking differences in spatial resolution, voxel organization, and region of interest (ROI)-level semantic correspondence. To address this issue, this study proposes MUSA, a unified ROI semantic space model for multimodal MRI-based MDD classification. An Automated Anatomical Labeling (AAL) atlas-guided ROI semantic space establishes consistent brain-region correspondence across heterogeneous MRI features. An ROI-level 3D Vision Transformer (3D ViT) encodes ROI voxel information into fixed-dimensional representations, allowing structural, local functional, and connectivity information to be organized and integrated within a consistent brain-region semantic space. Experiments on 2380 participants from REST-meta-MDD validated MUSA for MDD and normal controls (NCs) classification. The feature combination of white matter (WM), functional connectivity (FC), regional homogeneity (ReHo), and degree centrality (DC) achieved 79.20% ± 0.65% accuracy and an AUC of 87.08% ± 0.51%. Brain-region importance analysis identified classifier-derived discriminative patterns across frontoparietal, sensorimotor, visual, temporal, and limbic-related regions.

papers.title: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis in a Patient Treated for Neurosyphilis: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Giecko M, Bossowski F, Bossowska M, Moniuszko-Malinowska A, Chorąży M, Sarnowska M, Grygorczuk S.
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Neurosyphilis is a recognized treatable mimic of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS); syphilis serology is commonly included in the work-up of suspected motor neuron disease. We describe the converse situation: neurosyphilis that delayed recognition of coexisting ALS. Methods A 46-year-old man with type 2 diabetes mellitus and degenerative spine disease presented with a six-month history of progressive limb weakness and gait disturbance. Serum syphilis serology was reactive (Venereal Disease Research Laboratory [VDRL] titer 1:32; Treponema pallidum hemagglutination assay [TPHA] titer 1:20,480), and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) showed a mild mononuclear pleocytosis with raised protein and immunoglobulin G. Neurosyphilis was diagnosed and treated with a 14-day course of intravenous penicillin. The subsequent course was followed with neuroimaging and electrodiagnostic studies. Results Despite treatment and resolution of the CSF pleocytosis, weakness and wasting progressed and bulbar involvement developed. Examination showed combined upper and lower motor neuron signs, electromyography showed an anterior horn cell pattern with widespread fasciculations, and cervical spine imaging showed degenerative changes without spinal cord compression. ALS was diagnosed at a later neurological admission. Conclusions Identifying a treatable mimic does not close the diagnostic process. Combined upper and lower motor neuron signs that continue to progress despite adequate treatment of neurosyphilis should prompt early electrodiagnostic evaluation for ALS, even though the relative contribution of each condition may remain uncertain.

papers.title: Color and Spatial Cue Modulation of Emotional Word Processing: Evidence from ERPs.
papers.authors: Luo X, Li C, Sun Y.
papers.abstract: Emotional word processing is shaped by lexical meaning and concurrent perceptual context. This study investigated when red and green color cues and symbolic upward and downward direction cues modulate the processing of positive and negative Chinese emotional words. Thirty-four native Chinese speakers were recruited, and 27 remained in the final ERP sample after behavioral and EEG-quality exclusions. The experiment used a 2 (color: red vs. green) × 2 (direction: up vs. down) × 2 (word valence: positive vs. negative) within-subject design. Positive words elicited larger P1 amplitudes, and negative words elicited more negative-going N1 and N400 amplitudes. A significant Color × Valence interaction emerged in the late positive complex (LPC) window. The positive-minus-negative LPC difference was descriptively larger under green cues than under red cues, and neither within-color comparison reached significance after Bonferroni correction. Interactions involving spatial direction were not significant across the four components. These findings trace emotional word processing from early valence-sensitive visual attention through semantic processing to late color-dependent evaluation. The temporal pattern supports a context-sensitive account in which perceptual cues, lexical valence, and learned cultural associations contribute to emotional meaning at different processing stages.

papers.title: Assessment of Liver Fibrosis Using the Coefficient of Variation on Gadoxetic Acid-Enhanced Hepatobiliary Phase MR Imaging: A Prospective Multicenter Study.
papers.authors: Kim YR, Kim TH, Jeong CW, Lee YH, Cho EY, Choi KH, Jeong YY, Heo SH, Kim KW, Ko Y, Shin Y, Kang DM, Yoon KH.
papers.abstract: Background: Accurate non-invasive assessment of liver fibrosis is needed in patients with chronic liver disease. Gadoxetic acid (Gd-EOB-DTPA)-enhanced hepatobiliary phase (HBP) magnetic resonance (MR) imaging reflects hepatocyte function and parenchymal heterogeneity, and the coefficient of variation (CV), which quantifies pixel-level signal inhomogeneity, has been proposed as a quantitative imaging biomarker of liver fibrosis. However, previous studies were retrospective, single-center, and lacked direct pathological validation. Objectives: To investigate the factors associated with CV on HBP images, evaluate the correlation between CV and pathologically confirmed liver fibrosis stage, and compare the diagnostic performance of CV with serum biomarkers, including the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index (APRI) and fibrosis-4 (FIB-4), in a prospective multicenter setting. Methods: This prospective multicenter study was conducted between April 2017 and August 2020 at three medical centers. Ninety-nine participants who underwent Gd-EOB-DTPA-enhanced HBP T1-weighted MRI and liver biopsy or surgery were enrolled. CV was measured on HBP images, and the METAVIR fibrosis stage was used as the reference standard. Univariate and multivariable linear regression analyses, including an additional model adjusted for institution and pathology confirmation method, Welch's analysis of variance with the Games-Howell post hoc test, Spearman's rank correlation analysis, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis with DeLong's method for AUROC comparison, and intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) analyses were performed. Results: Ninety-nine participants (64 men and 35 women; mean age, 55.5 ± 15.1 years) were enrolled. In multivariable linear regression analysis adjusted for institution and pathology confirmation method, pathologic fibrosis stage (B = 0.468; 95% CI, 0.358-0.578; p < 0.001) and serum albumin level (B = -0.341; p = 0.015) were independently associated with CV. Spearman's correlation coefficient between CV and fibrosis stage was 0.74 (p < 0.001). The AUROCs of CV for significant fibrosis (≥F2), advanced fibrosis (≥F3), and cirrhosis (F4) were 0.92, 0.88, and 0.86, respectively (all p < 0.001). CV outperformed APRI and FIB-4 across most fibrosis thresholds (p < 0.001 to p = 0.045), except for FIB-4 in the diagnosis of ≥F2 fibrosis (p = 0.09). The intra- and inter-observer ICC values were 0.94 and 0.84, respectively. Conclusions: In this prospective multicenter study with pathologically confirmed fibrosis stages, CV derived from Gd-EOB-DTPA-enhanced HBP MR images showed a strong correlation with liver fibrosis stage and higher diagnostic performance than APRI and FIB-4 across most fibrosis thresholds. Because CV can be calculated from routine clinical MRI acquisitions without additional hardware or blood tests, it may serve as a practical biomarker for non-invasive liver fibrosis assessment. However, because this study was conducted in a Korean cohort with predominantly hepatitis B virus-related liver disease, further validation in other ethnic groups and etiologies is needed.

papers.title: Decoding Cell-Cell Interactions in Neurovascular Unit Co-Cultures Through Molecular Vibrational Spectroscopy and Biology.
papers.authors: Pragnąca A, Borkowska A, Antolak A, Leśniak M, Augustyniak K, Czechowska I, Malek K, Zdanowski R.
papers.abstract: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) is a coordinated multicellular interface in which intercellular communication shapes responses to injury and metabolic stress. However, the contributions of individual cell types to collective stress adaptation remain poorly understood. Here, we examined molecular and metabolic responses of 2D neurovascular unit (NVU) co-culture models comprising endothelial cells, astrocytes, and pericytes exposed to hypoxia or sublethal HgCl2 toxicity. An integrated platform combining gene and protein expression profiling, label-free vibrational spectroscopic imaging, and machine-learning-based analysis was used to assess stress-induced changes in cell-cycle regulation and metabolism across mono- and co-culture configurations. Hypoxia broadly suppressed G1 /S and G2 /M regulators, inducing cell-cycle arrest with limited cell death, consistent with an adaptive response. HgCl2 caused heterogeneous, model-dependent changes in viability and proliferative capacity. Spectroscopic phenotyping revealed that the triple co-culture exhibited spectral features resembling those of pericyte monocultures, although the contributions of cell-cell interactions and differences in culture conditions could not be distinguished. Fluorescence imaging further revealed mitochondria-associated signals at cell-cell contact sites, suggesting a possible association of mitochondrial material with regions of close cellular interaction. The presence of pericytes was associated with a more stress-resistant cellular phenotype in the investigated co-culture configurations. The developed spectroscopic-molecular platform provides a label-free framework for characterizing cellular communication and stress responses in multicellular NVU co-culture models.

papers.title: Sleep disturbance is associated with reduced DTI-ALPS index and altered functional-network efficiency in internet gaming disorder.
papers.authors: Ma L, Mei B, Zhang M, Li W, Wang X, Tian J, Zhang H, Lang Y, Lv Q, Wei Y, Han S, Zhang Y.
papers.abstract: Background Sleep disturbance is common in internet gaming disorder (IGD), but its possible involvement in the pathophysiology of IGD remains unclear. Therefore, we aimed to investigate the glymphatic system-related function in IGD patients and to establish the associations among glymphatic system, human brain network, and clinical features. Methods This study recruited 66 IGD patients and 35 healthy controls (HC), who underwent magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanning and clinical assessment. The glymphatic system-related diffusivity and network efficiency were calculated based on diffusion images along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) method and resting-state functional MRI, respectively. Differences between groups, neural/clinical correlations, and mediation analyses were further explored. Results Compared with HC, IGD patients showed a significantly lower ALPS index and global network efficiency. The partial correlation analysis showed that the ALPS index in IGD patients was associated with PSQI, HAMA, and HAMD scores. Moreover, the ALPS index partially mediated the association between global brain efficiency and sleep quality in exploratory cross-sectional mediation analysis. Conclusions The current study revealed abnormalities of ALPS index and network efficiency in IGD patients and suggested that the cross-sectional associations among global brain efficiency, sleep quality, and ALPS index were consistent with an indirect pathway, which may reveal the neuropathological mechanisms of IGD.
keywords: Diffusion Tensor Imaging Analysis Along The Perivascular Space

papers.title: Dynamic adaptation of attentional control across bilingual interactional contexts.
papers.authors: Li M, Shi X, Xu Q, Li J.
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Bilingual experience is thought to shape cognitive control via adaptive attentional reorganization, yet the neural mechanisms by which different interactional contexts dynamically modulate attentional control remain unclear. This study used EEG to examine how Chinese monolingual, English monolingual, bilingual, and voluntary naming contexts influence attentional control in Chinese-English bilinguals. Methods Thirty-five bilinguals completed picture-naming tasks in different contexts, followed by an antisaccade task with concurrent EEG. We analyzed reaction time, ERPs, frontal and parietal delta/theta power, and frontoparietal functional connectivity (wPLI). Results Bilingual and voluntary naming contexts shortened antisaccade reaction times (all p < 0.01). No significant main effect of context was found on N2 amplitudes (p = 0.615). Both contexts reduced parietal delta and theta power relative to the English monolingual context (all p < 0.05). Exploratory connectivity analysis initially suggested bilingual-context effects, but this finding did not survive homologous ROI validation. These preliminary sensor-level findings await validation by source-localized EEG or fMRI. Conclusions These findings suggest that bilingual and voluntary naming contexts may facilitate attentional control through adaptive reorganization of the attentional system rather than through enhancing a specific inhibitory process. This pattern is consistent with the adaptationist perspective on bilingual cognition and provides preliminary neural evidence for the language mode theory.

papers.title: Redox compromise as an early, modifiable entry point in schizophrenia: a staging framework for early intervention.
papers.authors: Lado LA, Misir A.
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia is understood as a disorder of dopamine signaling and is treated with dopamine receptor antagonists. These drugs reduce hallucinations and delusions but leave cognitive impairment, negative symptoms and functional decline largely untouched. This article advances a complementary view, as a hypothesis rather than an established account. It treats redox compromise, meaning chronic oxidative stress, glutathione depletion, mitochondrial inefficiency and the inflammatory state that accompanies them, as an early and modifiable point of entry into a self-reinforcing loop. The loop also involves NMDA receptor hypofunction, impairment of parvalbumin interneurons, disturbed circuit connectivity and, last, the dopaminergic phenotype that current drugs address. It runs in both directions: blocking NMDA receptors itself generates oxidative stress in animal models, so the claim is not that redox compromise comes first, but that it can be measured and modified early, before the changes that current treatment cannot reverse. The clinical staging framework of McGorry and the neuroprogression framework of Berk provide the architecture for translating this into intervention windows, with the first two levels treated as risk strata rather than disease stages. Impaired glucose tolerance in first-episode patients who have never taken antipsychotics, which neither medication nor chronicity can explain, is presented as evidence that metabolic disturbance is a parallel expression of the same systemic process. The progressive framing is contested. The principal counterevidence, including the contribution of antipsychotic exposure to brain volume loss and the largely stable course of cognitive impairment after onset, is set out together with the results that would require abandoning it. We organize the biomarker literature by stage and propose three predictions that a trial could refute: that biomarker-stratified prevention will outperform unselected prevention at the clinical high-risk stage; that medial prefrontal glutathione and mismatch negativity deficit will add predictive value beyond clinical assessment; and that removing the redox measures from a multimodal panel will worsen its prediction of transition. A biomarker-stratified phase 2b trial with a formal power calculation is proposed. The human evidence supports association and biological plausibility rather than proven causal direction.

papers.title: Naturalistic language assessment and brain-network biomarkers in post-stroke aphasia for precision neurorehabilitation.
papers.authors: Xia J, Pei S, Zhou S, Bai Y.
papers.abstract: Advances in naturalistic language assessment, portable neuroimaging, electrophysiology, and brain-network modeling are creating new opportunities to evaluate post-stroke aphasia under conditions closer to real-world communication. Conventional aphasia batteries and isolated linguistic tasks remain essential for diagnosis, severity classification, and treatment planning, but they provide limited information about how language-network activity supports communication in dynamic, naturalistic contexts. This integrative review, informed by a structured literature search and descriptive thematic mapping, synthesizes evidence on connected speech, discourse production, narrative comprehension, interactive communication, and contextual reading after stroke. We examine how multilevel features from these behaviors can be organized into graded, interacting dimensions of lexical-semantic access, phonological encoding, grammatical organization, discourse processing, executive-predictive control, and speech-motor output. We further review multimodal evidence from fNIRS, fMRI, EEG/ERP, lesion-symptom mapping, structural connectivity, and functional connectivity, highlighting residual left-hemisphere language networks, conditional right-hemisphere support, bilateral reorganization, domain-general control systems, and longitudinal recovery. Portable EEG and fNIRS are considered complementary approaches for repeated assessment during less constrained language tasks, with distinct temporal, spatial, and practical trade-offs. Building on this evidence, we propose an operational ecological biomarker framework that links task choice, multilevel feature extraction, multivariate behavioral profiles, neural measures, prespecified clinical questions, and longitudinal outcomes. This framework may support recovery prediction, rehabilitation stratification, neuromodulation target selection, individualized therapy planning, and monitoring of functional communication.

papers.title: Hierarchical affective predictive imbalance in adolescent borderline personality disorder: task-evoked fMRI evidence from multimodal machine learning.
papers.authors: Ma M, Wang X, Tan Z, Liu J, Xiao Q, Hu T, Grecucci A, Yi X.
papers.abstract: Background Predictive-processing accounts of BPD, including the hierarchical-prior-imbalance account proposed by Herzog, offer a framework for interpreting affective instability and impulsivity. The present task-fMRI study evaluates whether discriminative task-evoked patterns are consistent with this framework; because it does not directly estimate prediction errors, precision weighting, or hierarchical belief updating, it is not a mechanistic test of predictive processing. Methods To evaluate this question, this study developed a leakage-controlled multimodal machine learning framework for individualized classification of adolescents with BPD and healthy controls based on emotional Go/No-Go task-fMRI activity. Three feature domains were constructed: functional connectivity (FC), task-evoked general linear model (GLM)-derived temporal features, and clinical variables. Seven feature settings, including single-modality, dual-modality, and full multimodal combinations, were evaluated using multiple conventional machine learning classifiers, including logistic regression, support vector machine, k-nearest neighbors, Gaussian naive Bayes, multilayer perceptron, random forest, and XGBoost or gradient boosting. Results The results showed that task-evoked GLM-derived features provided the strongest single-modality discriminative information (AUC of 0.881 ± 0.055). SHAP analysis confirmed the predominance of GLM-derived features, accounting for 83.1% of total model attribution, compared to 9.5 and 7.5% for functional connectivity and clinical variables, respectively. At the neural level, discriminative features were distributed across visual/perceptual regions (calcarine, cuneus, occipital cortex), temporoparietal/default-mode hubs (angular and supramarginal gyri), frontal control regions (inferior frontal gyrus), and subcortical structures (putamen). This distributed pattern aligns with a hierarchical organization spanning perceptual input, contextual/self-referential processing, and top-down inhibitory control systems, consistent with the proposed model of hierarchical affective predictive imbalance. Conclusion Task-evoked GLM-derived features were the primary source of discriminative information for adolescent BPD, with functional connectivity and clinical variables providing modest additional value. The resulting classification pattern is consistent with hierarchical predictive-processing accounts but does not establish a specific predictive-processing mechanism. The same regional pattern may also reflect visual attention, salience processing, and executive inhibitory control.

papers.title: Normative functional network localization of gray matter alterations in idiopathic generalized epilepsy.
papers.authors: Wang X, Zhang ZP, Zheng BC, Liu L, Wang GD, Yang HC, Ma LL.
papers.abstract: Objective Idiopathic generalized epilepsy (IGE) has traditionally been considered a non-lesional epilepsy syndrome on conventional MRI, yet voxel-based morphometry (VBM) studies have reported subtle gray matter (GM) abnormalities across diverse brain regions. These findings remain spatially heterogeneous and difficult to reconcile. We aimed to characterize the normative functional connectivity patterns associated with reported GM alterations in IGE using functional connectivity network mapping (FCNM), and to explore whether these spatially heterogeneous findings show a reproducible pattern of observed network overlap. Methods We systematically identified 18 whole-brain VBM studies of IGE, including 111 reported peak coordinates from 1,492 participants. Coordinates reflecting both increased and decreased GM were pooled in the primary analysis to characterize normative connectivity patterns associated with reported GM alterations irrespective of alteration direction. Using resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) data from a normative discovery cohort (Human Connectome Project, N = 1,093), we mapped the functional connectivity of these GM coordinates to identify a convergent IGE-related network. The reproducibility of the observed spatial pattern was explored using an independent, cross-scanner validation cohort (Southwest University Adult Lifespan Dataset, N = 329) and two alternative seed sizes (1-mm and 7-mm radii). Results Reported GM alterations in IGE were associated with an observed distributed normative functional connectivity pattern involving the bilateral middle temporal gyri, bilateral thalami, left superior frontal gyrus, and right putamen. In the HCP discovery analysis, this network showed the greatest observed overlap with the subcortical network (overlap proportion = 42.77%) and secondary correspondence with the default mode network (DMN; overlap proportion = 11.06%). Analysis using the independent SALD connectome showed a similar descriptive pattern, with the greatest observed overlap again involving the subcortical network (overlap proportion = 43.98%), whereas DMN correspondence was weaker.
