Long-term repair ultimately depends on lineage completion and stable myelin formation rather than OPC accumulation alone. The strongest causal evidence supports signaling from the surrounding niche as a regulator of OPC differentiation and demonstrates that OPC-derived myelin repair contributes to neuronal preservation and functional recovery. By contrast, evidence that endogenous OPCs themselves substantially regulate post-stroke inflammation, angiogenesis, blood-brain barrier integrity, or synaptic reconstruction remains less complete and often derives from culture, conditioned-medium, pharmacological, or transplantation paradigms. Therapeutic strategies are therefore organized according to the signaling and lineage bottleneck they target, including acute OPC preservation, niche remodeling, lineage completion, oligovascular reconstruction, and cell-based interventions. Conclusions OPC fate after ischemic stroke is determined by the interaction of cell-intrinsic signaling competence with temporally and spatially changing neuroimmune-oligovascular cues. Translation will require lineage-resolved causal studies, human spatial and longitudinal validation, signaling-linked target-engagement measures, and treatment strategies matched to lesion phase, compartment, and repair bottleneck. A cell-communication framework may therefore provide a more mechanistically testable basis for OPC-centered white-matter repair after stroke.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕缺血性卒中后少突胶质前体细胞（OPC）的命运与白质修复，梳理神经、免疫与血管微环境信号如何经胞内通路影响OPC的存活、募集、状态转换、分化及髓鞘再生。作者指出，严重缺血核心区使前体细胞池耗竭，而部分灌注的梗死周围组织允许反应性增殖与迁移；亚急性期微环境信号决定被募集OPC走向炎症样、促血管、具备分化能力或停滞状态，长期修复取决于谱系完成和稳定髓鞘形成而非OPC单纯堆积。综述强调，最强因果证据支持微环境信号调控OPC分化、以及OPC来源的髓鞘修复有助于神经元保全和功能恢复，而内源性OPC直接调控炎症、血管新生、血脑屏障或突触重塑的证据仍不完整；治疗策略据此按所针对的信号与谱系瓶颈分类，并指出转化仍需谱系分辨的因果研究、人体空间与纵向验证及与损伤时相匹配的干预。

papers.title: The role of matrix metalloproteinases in Alzheimer's disease and small vessel disease.
papers.authors: Nguyen N, Huynh S, Mroczko B, Glodzik L.
papers.abstract: Matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) are a family of enzymes participating in maintenance and remodeling of the extracellular matrix. Their many types are involved in diverse, sometimes contrasting physiological processes, and they are ubiquitously present throughout the CNS. In this mini-review we focused on MMP-2, MMP-3, MMP-9, and MMP-14, highlighting their importance in pathways linked to Alzheimer's disease and small vessel disease. Despite overlapping roles in modulating brain-blood barrier impairment, neuroinflammation, and the accumulation of disease-specific proteins like amyloid-β and tau, they show somewhat distinct expression patterns in different cells and differ in their primary influences on disease mechanisms. Although our knowledge is still very limited, there is evidence linking them to imaging manifestations of cerebral vessel disease and suggesting they could be a target for therapeutic interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦MMP-2、MMP-3、MMP-9和MMP-14，梳理它们在阿尔茨海默病与脑小血管病相关通路中的作用。作者指出，这些酶在血脑屏障损伤、神经炎症以及淀粉样蛋白β和tau积累等过程中作用有所重叠，但在不同细胞中的表达模式及其对疾病机制的主要影响并不相同。文章强调现有认识仍很有限，但已有证据将这些酶与脑小血管病的影像表现联系起来，并提示其可能作为治疗干预的靶点。

papers.title: Longitudinal quantitative MRI of blood-brain barrier leakage in chronic cerebral hypoperfusion rat model.
papers.authors: Sampedro Viana A, Fernández-Rodicio S, Castillo J, Hervella P, Alonso Alonso ML, Iglesias Rey R.
papers.journal: Journal of cerebral blood flow and metabolism : official journal of the International Society of Cerebral Blood Flow and Metabolism
papers.abstract: Objective/methods Chronic cerebral-hypoperfusion is a key contributor to vascular cognitive impairment, with blood-brain barrier (BBB) dysfunction proposed as an early driver of white matter injury. The temporal-evolution and regional-heterogeneity of BBB-leakage remain poorly characterized in vivo. We longitudinally assessed BBB permeability in Sprague-Dawley rats subjected to bilateral-common carotid artery occlusion (2VO) versus sham controls using contrast-enhanced T1 -weighted MRI 9.4T over 12-weeks. Gadolinium-leakage maps were generated and analyzed in predefined regions (cortex, hippocampus, striatum, corpus callosum). Exploratory histological observations included GFAP immunostaining, and circulating biochemical biomarkers (sTWEAK, MMP-9, GOT, cytokines) were quantified. Results Localized BBB disruption was observed at weeks 3, 6 post-2VO and progressed heterogeneously, with pronounced leakage strictly targeted toward corpus callosum, hippocampus and striatum. Despite descriptive trends showing increased astroglial activation, systemic biochemical biomarkers did not correlate with imaging-derived central BBB-leakage. Volumetric analysis revealed subtle but significant brain atrophy (18% whole-brain reduction) preceding overt T2 -signal abnormalities. In the 2VO model studied, BBB dysfunction in chronic-hypoperfusion appears to be a dynamic, region-specific process. Conclusion Longitudinal contrast-enhanced MRI detected changes that were not mirrored by the circulating biomarkers studied, suggesting its potential utility as a surrogate endpoint in preclinical studies, which should be confirmed in larger cohorts and complementary models.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性脑低灌注中血脑屏障渗漏的时间演变与区域异质性，用双侧颈总动脉结扎大鼠模型与假手术对照，在12周内进行纵向增强T1加权MRI并分析预定脑区的钆渗漏。结果显示渗漏在术后特定时间点出现并呈异质性进展，主要集中于胼胝体、海马和纹状体；同时可见脑萎缩先于明显的T2信号异常。作者指出，在所研究的模型中血脑屏障功能障碍是动态且区域特异的，循环生化标志物与影像所示的中枢渗漏并不对应，提示纵向增强MRI有潜力作为临床前研究的替代终点，但需在更大队列和其他模型中确认。

papers.title: Anatomical determinants of DTI-ALPS: Effects of ROI definition, ventricular morphology, and periventricular deformation.
papers.authors: Wright DK.
papers.abstract: The diffusion tensor image analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) index is increasingly used as a non-invasive MRI biomarker proposed to reflect glymphatic and perivascular function, yet the anatomical validity and measurement stability of the metric remain incompletely characterised. Using diffusion MRI data from 850 healthy young adults and 150 healthy ageing participants from the Human Connectome Project, I systematically evaluated the influence of region-of-interest (ROI) placement and ventricular anatomy on ALPS measurements. Reference ALPS implementations demonstrated substantial hemispheric variability, with a median left-right difference of 12.5% and marked asymmetry in the underlying numerator and denominator tensor components. A two-stage optimisation framework incorporating fibre-pool alignment, hemispheric symmetry, component stability, and directional purity identified anatomically improved ROI configurations that significantly increased fibre specificity and reduced measurement variability in independent validation cohorts. Despite these improvements, residual hemispheric asymmetry persisted, suggesting an intrinsic anatomical contribution to ALPS variability. In the healthy ageing cohort, ventricular volume emerged as the strongest predictor of ALPS, explaining substantially more variance than chronological age. Voxel-wise deformation-based morphometry demonstrated that lower ALPS values were associated with ventricular and periventricular expansion, while optimisation increased coupling between ALPS and ventricular anatomy. Collectively, these findings indicate that ALPS measurements are strongly influenced by ROI definition, ventricular morphology, and surrounding periventricular tissue architecture. Rather than functioning as a direct measure of glymphatic transport in isolation, ALPS appears to represent a composite anatomical diffusion biomarker shaped by both methodological implementation and underlying neuroanatomy. These results provide a framework for improving methodological standardisation and interpretation of ALPS measurements in future neuroimaging studies.

papers.title: Vitamin D binding protein in ventral CA3 of the hippocampus drives stress-induced depression.
papers.authors: Kong Y, Huang Z, Zeng C, Xu Y, Zhang Z.
papers.abstract: The ventral hippocampus plays a crucial role in regulating emotional and motivated behaviors. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying its dysfunction in major depressive disorder (MDD) remain poorly understood. Here, we identified elevated expression of vitamin D binding protein (VDBP) in the hippocampi of chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS)-susceptible mice, which correlated with the severity of depression-like behaviors. Notably, VDBP up-regulation was specifically in ventral CA3 excitatory (vCA3CaMKIIα ) neurons. CA3CaMKIIα VDBP overexpression led to inhibited neuronal activity, synaptic and dendritic impairments, and, ultimately, depression-like behaviors. Conversely, vCA3CaMKIIα -specific VDBP knockdown enhanced resilience to chronic stress. Mechanistically, VDBP directly interacted with PIK3R3 to inhibit the PI3K-Akt-mTOR pathway in a cell-autonomous manner, leading to excessive autophagy and subsequent neuronal dysfunction. Chemogenetic activation, intervention using the Akt-specific activator SC79, and site-specific mutation disrupting the VDBP-PIK3R3 interaction ameliorated vCA3CaMKIIα VDBP-induced depression-like phenotypes. Collectively, these findings underscore the critical involvement of vCA3CaMKIIα neuron-derived VDBP in stress-induced depressive pathology and highlight its potential as a therapeutic target for MDD.

papers.title: Learning to infer transitively on a mental line in premotor cortex.
papers.authors: Raglio S, Di Antonio G, Brunamonti E, Ferraina S, Mattia M.
papers.abstract: Transitive inference (TI) is a form of deductive reasoning that enables the derivation of unknown relationships among premises. It is hypothesized that this cognitive process relies on mapping stimuli onto a "mental line," a linear workspace organized by arbitrarily assigned ranks. However, its neural basis remains unclear: Does this mental line have a neural correlate and how is it learned? This study investigates the role of dorsal premotor cortex (PMd) in encoding the hypothesized mental line as monkeys acquire item relationships for motor decisions. Findings reveal that PMd multiunit activity organizes along a theoretically predicted direction, supporting a geometrical model that explains behavior. Moreover, a learning process is observed, where the mental line rotates to align with motor planning.

papers.title: Mitochondrial carbonic anhydrase-VB inhibition rescues brain endothelial stress and memory in Alzheimer's disease models.
papers.authors: Lemon NL, Canepa E, Vázquez-Torres R, Parodi-Rullán R, Hirt T, Petersohn LM, Rifat T, Abyaneh MH, Ilies MA, Fossati S.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a devastating neurodegenerative disorder with no effective cure, characterized by the cerebral parenchymal and vascular accumulation of aggregated amyloid-β (Aβ) and hyperphosphorylated tau. Cerebrovascular and mitochondria dysfunction are early causal events in the progression of AD. Previous studies support that inhibiting carbonic anhydrases (CAs) may prevent mitochondrial and cerebrovascular dysfunction in AD models. Here, we selectively target the mitochondrial CA isoform CA-VB by pharmacological and genetic manipulation in human cerebral microvascular endothelial cells (hCMEC), and we confirm the protective effects of the CA-V inhibitor in AD mice. CA-V inhibition and CA-VB KO prevent Aβ induced mitochondria-mediated endothelial apoptosis, loss of barrier resistance, and hCMEC inflammatory activation. Strikingly, CA-V inhibition also mitigates caspase activation and endothelial cell activation in the brains of 3xTg AD mice, resulting in preserved memory function. Our results demonstrate that selective CA-V inhibition is an effective and promising strategy against AD-mediated cerebrovascular pathology, neuroinflammation and cognitive impairment.

papers.title: Passive Language Mapping With High-Gamma Modulations.
papers.authors: Ervin B, Asano E, Crone NE.
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neurophysiology : official publication of the American Electroencephalographic Society
papers.abstract: Summary Passive language mapping using high-gamma modulation (HGM) has emerged as a valuable tool in both presurgical evaluation for epilepsy and neuroscientific discovery. HGM mapping leverages task-related synchronization in high-gamma frequencies to identify language areas without the risks associated with electrical stimulation mapping. This review outlines the principles and techniques used in the field of HGM-based mapping, including electrode types, referencing schemes, power analysis, and localization techniques. We survey a range of cognitive tasks-speech production, auditory processing, reading, and memory-that elicit language-related HGM responses and discuss their relevance to comprehensive language mapping. We examine perspectives on methodologic challenges, including artifact management, variability across patients, and spatial sampling. We assess validation studies comparing HGM with electrical stimulation mapping and neuropsychological outcomes, noting HGM's unique role in identifying language cortex in pediatric and cognitively impaired populations. Finally, we speculate on the future directions of the field, including integration with corticocortical evoked potentials and the potential for HGM-informed speech synthesis. As the field matures, HGM mapping is poised to contribute to improved clinical outcomes and enhance our understanding of the dynamics and development of the human language network.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了基于高伽马调制（HGM）的被动语言映射在癫痫术前评估和神经科学研究中的应用，介绍了电极类型、参考方案、功率分析与定位等技术原理，并回顾了言语产生、听觉加工、阅读和记忆等能诱发语言相关HGM反应的认知任务。文章讨论了伪迹管理、患者间变异和空间采样等方法学挑战，并评估了HGM与电刺激映射及神经心理学结果的对照验证研究，指出HGM在儿童和认知受损人群中识别语言皮层的独特作用。作者还展望了与皮层-皮层诱发电位整合及基于HGM的语音合成等方向，认为随着领域成熟，HGM映射有望改善临床结局并加深对人语言网络动态与发育的理解。

papers.title: Mapping the Evolution of Machine Learning in Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Research: A Comprehensive Scientometric Analysis.
papers.authors: Sadeghi-Bazargani H, Ghojazadeh M, Ahmadi Bonabi M, Narimani M, Abdolrahmanzadeh R, Asadi Shally A, Taghizadeh S.
papers.journal: Topics in magnetic resonance imaging : TMRI
papers.abstract: Objectives Coupled with functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), machine learning (ML), enables advanced pattern recognition and predictive modeling, driving progress in cognitive neuroscience and clinical diagnostics. Scientometrics offers a framework for examining the evolving intersection of fMRI and ML, uncovering knowledge gaps, trends, and collaborations. Materials and methods A scientometric analysis was conducted using data from the Scopus database, focusing on studies combining fMRI and ML. After filtering for peer-reviewed articles, reviews, and editorials, eligible studies were preprocessed using KNIME tools to standardize text. Data were analyzed with the Bibliometrix package in R-Studio and VOS-viewer to generate thematic maps, citation networks, and collaboration visualizations. These analyses identified key trends, influential contributors, and research gaps, offering a structured view of this interdisciplinary field. Results The Scopus search yielded 4657 documents, with 2639 included after filtering. Scientific production in this field has grown steadily since 2004, with an upward trend resuming after 2021. Thematic mapping identified 4 types of research topics: motor (hot and well-developed), basic (foundational and cross-cutting), niche (specialized), and emerging or declining (less developed). Key active themes include "machine learning" and "functional connectivity," while advanced techniques like generative adversarial networks are gaining attention. Collaboration among 139 researchers and 47 countries highlighted the United States and China as leaders in publications and citations. Among 582 journals, Neuroimage had the highest number of articles and citations. Conclusions The evaluated studies depict steady progress, with notable contributions to clinical diagnostics, cognitive neuroscience, and therapy development. Thematic analysis highlights foundational methods, such as fMRI and support vector machines, alongside emerging innovations like generative adversarial networks and dynamic functional connectomics.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用科学计量学方法梳理Scopus中fMRI与机器学习交叉领域的文献，经筛选后对纳入文献进行文本标准化，并借助文献计量工具生成主题图、引文网络与合作可视化。结果显示，该领域发文量自2004年起持续增长，2021年后回升；主题可分为运动相关、基础、小众及新兴或衰退四类，机器学习与功能连接是活跃主题，生成对抗网络等新技术受到关注，美国和中国在发文与引用上领先。作者据此认为该交叉领域稳步发展，对临床诊断、认知神经科学和治疗开发有贡献，但主题分析也提示部分方向仍不成熟。

papers.title: Multimodal Evidence for Large-scale Network Imbalance in Etomidate Use Disorder.
papers.authors: Le J, Wang X, Tang Y, Chen H, Chen X, Wang X, Tang Y, Zhao L, Zhao L, Shen H, Huang Q, Liao Z.
papers.abstract: Background Etomidate use disorder (EUD) is an escalating public health issue in East and Southeast Asia, yet its neuroimaging features remain poorly understood. This study used simultaneous electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to examine multimodal functional connectivity alterations in individuals with EUD. Methods A total of 54 individuals with EUD and 46 healthy controls (HCs) were recruited and underwent simultaneous resting-state EEG and fNIRS recordings. Psychological dimensions including impulsivity, aggression, and craving were evaluated using standardized and validated scales. Source-level EEG functional connectivity and fNIRS hemodynamic connectivity were analyzed to identify group differences. Associations between altered connectivity features and clinical measures were examined within the EUD group. Machine learning analyses were conducted as exploratory assessments of the discriminative information contained in multimodal connectivity features. Results In unadjusted exploratory analyses of BIS-11 and BPAQ subscales, the EUD group showed higher cognitive impulsivity, non-planning impulsivity, physical aggression, anger and self-directed aggression (t=2.32 to 4.54, p<0.05), but lower motor impulsivity, compared with HCs. Source-level EEG analysis revealed significant group differences only in the delta band, with reduced large-scale connectivity in EUD involving default mode, dorsal attention, visual and sensorimotor systems. fNIRS analysis showed reduced hemodynamic connectivity across multiple frontal subregions and motor-related areas. Weaker connectivity between the primary motor cortex and the triangular part of the inferior frontal gyrus was associated with stronger negative reinforcement craving (rho=-0.471, p_FDR<0.05). Exploratory machine learning analysis showed preliminary discriminative performance, with the random forest model producing the numerically highest test-set AUC (0.80) in this particular data split. Conclusions Convergent EEG-fNIRS findings suggest delta-band network decoupling and reduced frontal hemodynamic connectivity as multimodal neural features of EUD. These findings provide preliminary evidence for the neural mechanisms of EUD and may inform future objective assessment and treatment-monitoring studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注依托咪酯使用障碍（EUD）者的多模态脑功能连接改变，采用同步静息态脑电与功能性近红外光谱，比较EUD组与健康对照，并考察连接特征与冲动、攻击和渴求等心理指标的关系。结果显示，EUD组在脑电源层面仅delta频段出现大范围连接减弱，涉及默认模式、背侧注意、视觉和感觉运动系统；近红外则显示多个额叶子区及运动相关区域的血流动力学连接下降。初级运动皮层与额下回三角部之间较弱的连接与更强的负强化渴求相关，探索性机器学习也显示出初步的区分能力。作者据此提出，delta频段网络解耦和额叶血流动力学连接降低可能是EUD的多模态神经特征，但相关结果尚属初步，不能直接推及临床评估或治疗效果。

papers.title: Biallelic variants in PIKFYVE cause a hypomyelinating leukodystrophy with endolysosomal dysfunction.
papers.authors: Averdunk L, Groß M, Hamacher AB, Donkervoort S, Herebian D, Mohammad S, Knaus A, Seibt A, Schaper J, Sticht H, Bryen S, Bergmann AK, Langener M, De Simone L, Markshausen A, Lenk G, Ghosh S, Sandaradura S, Guthoff T, Leventer RJ, Orbach R, Rius R, Morton N, Gilmour K, Mayatepek E, Krawitz P, Bönnemann CG, Bremer J, Distelmaier F.
papers.abstract: The PIKfyve-FIG4-VAC14 lipid kinase complex generates phosphoinositide PI(3,5)P2. Pathogenic variants in VAC14 and FIG4 cause neurodevelopmental disorders and PIKFYVE has been linked to autosomal dominant fleck corneal dystrophy. We searched for the underlyging, genetic cause of a neurodevelopmental disorder in five affected individuals from three families using exome- or genome sequencing. Cranial MRI images and clinical phenotypes were analyzed. Size, number and acidity of cellular vacuoles were investigated in patient-derived fibroblasts from family 1 using LysoSensor acidophilic probes. Levels of PI(3,5)P2 were quantified in patient-derived fibroblasts from family 1 using high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. Pikfyve-mutant zebrafish larvae were injected with wildtype-mRNA or mutant mRNA harboring the PIKFYVE missense variant identified in family 3. Pikfyve-mutant zebrafish larvae were treated with metformin, bafilomycin A1, or rapamycin. We identified biallelic PIKFYVE variants in five affected individuals with hypomyelinating leukodystrophy, brain hyperintensities of inferior olives, thalami, long tracts, and optic nerves. Clinically, they presented with intellectual disability, spasticity, muscular weakness, and nystagmus. Additional features included feeding difficulties, auditory dysfunction, insulin resistance, microcephaly, peripheral neuropathy, and mild creatine kinase elevations. We detected four distinct PIKFYVE variants: three loss-of-function variants (family 1 & 2), and one p.Arg1156Pro missense variant (family 3). The pathogenicity of the p.Arg1156Pro variant was confirmed by phenotypic rescue of pikfyve-mutant zebrafish larvae injected with wildtype-mRNA but not with p.Arg1156Pro mRNA. Consistent with the role of PIKfyve in maintaining endolysosomal homeostasis, patient-derived fibroblasts of family 1 accumulated enlarged, hyperacidic vacuoles and showed a reduced PI(3,5)P2 production upon hyperosmotic stimulation. Exposing pikfyve-mutant zebrafisch larvae to the mTORC1 inhibitor and TRPML1 activator rapamycin attenuated cellular vacuolization, highlighting potential therapeutic approaches. Our findings establish PIKFYVE deficiency as a novel cause of hypomyelinating leukodystrophy and endolysosomal dysfunction.

papers.title: Explainable fMRI decoding reveals neurobiological signatures of emotional arousal complementary to traditional analyses.
papers.authors: Agostinho D, Borra D, Castelo-Branco M, Simões M.
papers.abstract: Objective. Understanding how emotional arousal is represented in the brain is fundamental for elucidating affective regulation and its alterations in autism spectrum disorder. Classical neuroimaging approaches, such as the general linear model (GLM), have provided important insights into emotional processing. However, the extent to which data-driven decoding and traditional model-based analyses provide complementary information about emotional arousal remains unclear.Approach. We introduce an explainable artificial intelligence framework that combines the lightweight functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoder (fMRINet) with Deep Learning Important FeaTures to derive data-driven neurobiological signatures of emotional arousal. The framework enables interpretation of spatiotemporal neural contributions during emotional processing. We applied the framework to fMRI data acquired while neurotypically and autistic participants viewed naturalistic emotional videos and compared the resulting signatures with categorical and parametric GLM analyses.Main results. The framework identified distinct spatiotemporal neurobiological signatures associated with emotional arousal. Neurotypical participants engaged a distributed perceptual-limbic-prefrontal network under high arousal and frontoparietal executive regions under low arousal. In contrast, autistic participants exhibited a more spatially restricted and posterior-biased pattern under high arousal, with reduced ventromedial prefrontal and limbic contributions, while low-arousal patterns resembled typically developing, suggesting preserved executive mechanisms during low-arousal processing. The GLM analyses revealed partly convergent and partly distinct findings: categorical GLM detected no significant group differences, whereas parametric GLM identified widespread cortical-subcortical modulation in neurotypical individuals and cerebellar-restricted effects in autistic, consistent with compensatory reliance on motor-timing circuits.Significance . The proposed framework provides an interpretable, data-driven perspective on emotional processing and reveals neurobiologically plausible patterns consistent with existing literature. Together, the explainable decoding and GLM results highlight complementary aspects of emotional arousal processing, suggesting that explainable decoding approaches may provide additional insights alongside traditional model-based neuroimaging analyses.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个可解释的fMRI解码框架，将轻量解码器与特征归因方法结合，用于刻画情绪唤醒的神经表征，并与传统GLM分析进行比较。结果发现，高唤醒下神经典型参与者调动分布式的知觉—边缘—前额网络，而孤独症参与者表现为更局限、偏后部的模式，腹内侧前额与边缘系统贡献减弱；低唤醒下两组模式相近。分类GLM未检出组间差异，参数GLM则显示神经典型者广泛的皮层—皮层下调制与孤独症者局限于小脑的效应。作者认为，可解释解码与传统分析提供互补信息，但相关模式尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Nine minutes is enough: An accelerated fMRI protocol for reliable connectivity mapping in healthy young adults.
papers.authors: Falkowski A, Szwed K.
papers.abstract: Introduction Resting‑state fMRI is widely used to map brain connectivity, yet the field lacks a clear, data‑driven standard for acquisition duration. We compared traditional Single‑Band (SB) imaging with an accelerated Multiband factor 4 (MB4) protocol to identify a time‑efficient approach for capturing stable network topology. Methods Twenty‑five healthy young adults completed two sessions one month apart, each including counterbalanced 13‑minute SB and MB4 scans. Test-retest reliability was evaluated across multiple durations using Portrait Divergence, a multiscale graph‑theoretic metric. Supplementary analyses compared Portrait Divergence with the field-standard Intraclass Correlation Coefficient, assessed robustness across preprocessing pipelines and parcellation schemes, and examined MB4's ability to capture both cortical and subcortical connectivity. Results MB4 consistently outperformed SB across all tested durations, with peak topological stability at 9 minutes. Stability declined beyond this point, likely due to cumulative motion artefacts. Supplementary analyses confirmed MB4's robustness across preprocessing strategies and atlas choices and demonstrated effective whole‑brain coverage. Conclusions In healthy young adults, MB4 captures network topology more effectively than SB and reaches peak stability at 9 minutes before declining, challenging the assumption that longer scans are always better. These findings require validation in clinical, paediatric, and geriatric cohorts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了传统单频段与加速多频段（MB4）静息态fMRI采集方案在健康年轻成人中映射脑连接拓扑的可靠性，以确定更高效的采集时长。结果显示，MB4在各测试时长下均优于单频段方案，网络拓扑稳定性在约9分钟时达到峰值，此后反而下降，可能与累积的头动伪影有关；补充分析表明该结果在不同预处理流程和脑图谱下较为稳健，并能覆盖全脑皮层与皮层下连接。作者据此提出，更长的扫描未必更好，但这一结论仍需在临床、儿童和老年人群中验证。

papers.title: Technological interventions in dyslexia: a neurobiological perspective of language learning.
papers.authors: R V MS, Ponniah RJ.
papers.abstract: Objective Developmental dyslexia is a neurodevelopmental language learning disorder characterised by persistent difficulty in phonological processing and fluent word recognition. To address these challenges, a range of interventions has been developed to support reading acquisition and fluency. These interventions include a promising field of technological aids that cater to a broader audience. However, the limited understanding of the neurobiological effects of technological interventions restricts significant evaluation of their effectiveness. The paper examines the influence of technological interventions on the neural mechanisms that support reading in individuals with developmental dyslexia. Methods This narrative review maintains methodological precision by focusing exclusively on literature that bridges the gap between instructional technology and its neurobiological outcomes, offering an integrated analysis of behavioural and neurobiological shifts in literacy development. Impact The findings suggest that the technological interventions enhance phonological processing efficiency by strengthening neurocognitive networks and promoting compensatory activation patterns. However, these results cannot be widely generalised due to the inconsistencies in intervention design and methodological rigour. Thus, to take a closer look at the efficacy of technological interventions, this paper aims to offer a comprehensive neurobiological review of the effects of interventions and assistive technologies, highlighting the neural and behavioural outcomes while pointing to unresolved questions for future investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦技术类干预对发展性阅读障碍者阅读相关神经机制的影响，梳理了将教学技术与神经生物学结果相衔接的文献，并整合分析读写发展中的行为与神经变化。作者指出，这些干预可能通过增强神经认知网络和促进补偿性激活模式来提高语音加工效率，但干预设计和方法严谨性不一致使结果难以广泛推广。文章据此强调，需更系统地评估技术干预的神经与行为效果，并留下待解问题供后续研究。

papers.title: Osteocalcin and impaired cerebral resting-state functional connectivity in postmenopausal osteoporosis: a pilot case-control study.
papers.authors: Pickering ME, Morel V, Pereira B, Pickering G, Chapurlat R, Tournadre A, Chassain C, Sontheimer A.
papers.abstract: Purpose Postmenopausal osteoporosis and circulating osteocalcin have been suggested to influence brain function. Objectives aim to explore associations between brain network resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) connectivity, bone status, and circulating osteocalcin with the hypothesis of an impairment of the bone-brain axis in osteoporosis. Methods This pilot fMRI case-control study included postmenopausal osteoporosis women and matched healthy volunteers, and took place in University Hospital, Clermont-Fd, France. Endpoints were the comparisons between cases and controls of intra- and internetworks connectivity and correlations with bone mineral density (BMD) and osteocalcin. Results Twenty women with osteoporosis and ten matched healthy volunteers were included. Salience, visual and language intranetwork connectivity were all decreased compared to controls (False Discovery Rate (FDR)-corrected p = 0.006, 0.0132 and 0.0199, respectively). Internetwork connectivity was also impaired. For visual network, with three regions of the default mode (p-FDR = 0.0265, 0.0296 and 0.0265) and one with dorsal attention network (p-FDR = 0.0296), and for salience, with dorsal attention networks (p-FDR = 0.0494). Circulating osteocalcin correlated with connectivity between right anterior insula (salience network) and bilateral intraparietal sulci (dorsal attention network) (p-FDR = 0.0145 right side, p-FDR = 0.0421 left side). BMD correlated with connectivity between left regions of the dorsal attention and language networks (p-FDR = 0.0164). Conclusion This pilot study suggests possible impairment of brain connectivity and compensatory protective mechanisms/maladaptive mechanisms in postmenopausal osteoporosis. It also unveils that lower osteocalcin concentrations and BMD may be associated with altered cerebral connectivity, confirming animal studies, and providing preliminary findings for further research.
papers.summary_zh: 这项初步的病例对照研究探讨绝经后骨质疏松女性的静息态脑网络功能连接是否改变，以及其与骨密度和循环骨钙素水平的关联。结果显示，与健康对照相比，骨质疏松女性在显著性、视觉和语言网络内的连接均下降，网络间连接也出现受损，涉及默认模式、背侧注意等网络。循环骨钙素和骨密度分别与特定网络间连接相关，提示较低的骨钙素和骨密度可能与脑连接改变有关。作者据此提出绝经后骨质疏松中可能存在骨-脑轴受损及代偿或适应不良机制，但样本量小、设计为初步探索，相关发现尚不能说明因果关系，需进一步研究验证。

papers.title: Reading After Traumatic Brain Injury: Shifts in Engagement, Purpose, and Format Across Everyday Material Types.
papers.authors: O'Brien KH, Pei Y, Vruwink O, Becker N, Klukas C, Covington NV.
papers.abstract: Purpose Reading is central to adult participation in everyday life, yet little is known about how everyday reading habits change following traumatic brain injury (TBI). Prior research has focused primarily on reading speed and comprehension, with less attention to real-world reading behavior. The purpose of this study was to describe and compare everyday reading habits in adults with mild TBI, moderate-severe TBI, and no history of TBI. Method Survey data from a sequential mixed-methods study of reading after TBI were analyzed for 170 adults with mild TBI, 55 with moderate-severe TBI, and 370 uninjured controls (UC) with no TBI. Everyday reading behavior was assessed using the Reading Habits Inventory, capturing frequency of reading engagement, estimated daily reading time, reading purpose across material types, and format preference (screen vs. physical). Group differences were examined using chi-square tests, analyses of covariance, and nonparametric tests, with demographic covariates and corrections for multiple comparisons. Results TBI groups reported lower weekly engagement with leisure reading than UC, driven by less fiction and magazine reading. Among those who read at least weekly, daily reading time did not differ across groups for most categories; however, participants with mild TBI spent more time reading functional materials than UC (d = -0.34). TBI groups allocated a smaller proportion of reading time to pleasure, and participants with mild TBI allocated a greater proportion to communicating than UC. Screen-based reading was more common in TBI groups for leisure and informational short-form materials. Reading for communication was the dominant reading activity and equivalent across all groups. Conclusions Together, these findings suggest that people with TBI allocate their reading time and purpose differently than their uninjured peers, with comparatively lower engagement in leisure reading and more emphasis on functional and communicative purposes, rather than reading being uniformly lower across all material types. Notably, communication was the primary reading activity across all groups. These findings highlight the importance of assessing real-world reading behavior and participation-level outcomes after brain injury, including the pervasiveness of written language as a primary modern communication modality. Supplemental material https://doi.org/10.23641/asha.34364070.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注创伤性脑损伤（TBI）后成人日常阅读习惯的变化，采用混合方法调查数据，比较轻度TBI、中重度TBI与无TBI史对照组在阅读投入、目的和媒介格式上的差异。结果显示，TBI组每周休闲阅读的参与度低于对照组，主要体现为小说和杂志阅读减少；在至少每周阅读的人群中，多数类别的每日阅读时间组间无差异，但轻度TBI组花在功能性材料上的时间更多。TBI组将更小比例的阅读时间用于消遣，轻度TBI组用于沟通的比例更高，且TBI组在休闲和短篇信息材料上更常用屏幕阅读。沟通性阅读是各组最主要的阅读活动且组间相当，提示TBI后并非所有材料类型的阅读都普遍减少，而是阅读时间和目的发生了重新分配。

papers.title: Interhemispheric monsoon dynamics over the past 450,000 years.
papers.authors: Olson EJ, Gillikin DP, Parmenter D, Burns S, Verheyden A, Miyawaki O, Vuille M, Piccirillo LF, Castro R, Yurivilca G, Edwards RL, Rodbell DT.
papers.abstract: The global monsoon system provides freshwater to much of Earth's biota, including its human population1 . The Milankovitch theory predicts changes in Earth's solar insolation over geologic time, and these variations are expected to result in changes to the global monsoon2 . Internal climate forcings, such as ice cover and sea surface temperatures, may also affect the system. However, few records of monsoon variability in the Southern Hemisphere over glacial-interglacial cycles exist to test our understanding of the factors that drive variations in the global monsoon. Here we show that monsoons in both the Southern and Northern Hemispheres vary with Milankovitch forcing, and with internal boundary conditions over the past 450,000 years. We present a record of South American Summer Monsoon (SASM) variability, based on speleothem oxygen-isotope data from the Amazon Basin. South American Summer Monsoon variability and that of a major Northern Hemisphere monsoon-that is, the Asian monsoon3,4 -have been strikingly out of phase. However, we observe occasional synchronous behaviour in regions impacted by both monsoons. We identify a synchronicity threshold that is exceeded during ten events, including during glacial terminations. Comparison with palaeoclimatic forcing factors during these intervals indicates that greenhouse gas concentrations, cross-equatorial thermal gradients and sea surface temperatures in both the Atlantic and Pacific probably influence these events. This record demonstrates that the global monsoon can reorganize itself, especially during intervals of rapidly changing planetary boundary conditions.

papers.title: Evidence for multi-Li<sup>+</sup> clustering in lithium-ion battery electrolytes.
papers.authors: Stevenson JM, Agarwal G, Debnath S, Goldsmith ZK, Mondal M, Svirinovsky-Arbeli A, Yeu IW, Metlay AS, Kwon Y, Bhai L, Guha RD, Keeler EG, Weber JL, Steingart DA, Marbella LE, Urban A, Jacobson LD, Halls MD, Friesner RA.
papers.abstract: In lithium-ion batteries, the bulk solvation structure of the electrolyte is a major determinant of the physical and electrochemical properties of the cell, for example, conductivity, viscosity, salt dissociation and subsequent reactivity, the electrochemical stability window (and thus solid electrolyte interphase formation), and the composition of the electrochemical double layer1-3 . However, elucidation of this structure at an atomic level of detail has been challenging to accomplish via a purely experimental approach. Here we combine machine-learning-enabled atomistic simulations4-16 , nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, electrochemical data3,17-20 and quantum-chemical calculations to reveal previously unstudied multi-Li+ complexes without bound anions that are uniquely facile for reduction. This insight explains the success of empirically chosen ethylene-carbonate-containing solvent mixtures and provides a foundation for the rational design of improved electrolytes. Furthermore, our machine-learning force-field-based lithium-ion-battery electrolyte simulations accurately reproduce a wide range of condensed-phase experiments3,21-24 , despite being parameterized to only quantum-chemical gas-phase cluster calculations, and hence provide a compelling demonstration that machine-learning force-field-based models developed from first principles can robustly represent a complex chemical system to atomic resolution.

papers.title: A microexon regulatory code reveals autism-linked genetic variation.
papers.authors: Parada GE, Bretschneider H, Li JD, Fine JL, Dupas SJ, Ellis JD, Braunschweig U, Bonnal S, Dalal T, Engchuan W, Zarrei M, Wei W, Zafar N, Hemberg M, Attisano L, Ellis J, Irimia M, Wainberg M, Trost B, Scherer SW, Morris QD, Blencowe BJ.
papers.abstract: Neuronal microexons are a highly conserved class of alternative splicing events enriched in genes with critical functions in nervous system biology1,2 . Microexon splicing is often disrupted in the brains of autistic individuals, and mice with microexon deficiencies display autism-like phenotypes1,3,4 . However, the full landscape of microexons is not known, and the impact of genetic variation on these exons has not been systematically investigated. Here, through extensive transcriptome profiling, we detect hundreds of new microexons, including many with neuronal subtype-specific splicing patterns, and others that activate nonsense-mediated mRNA decay. Using machine learning, we define a sequence code predictive of neuronally spliced microexons and use this to identify critical regulatory elements surrounding the expanded microexon repertoire. This code further reveals genomic variants predicted to alter microexon splicing in individuals affected by autism, with rare variants having the strongest estimated impact. These variants are mostly detected in idiopathic individuals and are associated with autism status. They also converge on synaptic and other autism-linked genes, as well as genes not previously linked to autism. Our results collectively define an expanded repertoire of microexons, delineate their regulatory code, and pinpoint variants predicted to affect their splicing, with implications for the disruption of functions central to neuronal biology and brain disorders.

papers.title: Examinations of the heterogeneity in the structural brain connectome in schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Zhao S, Jin Q, Wang Z, Liu MY, Liu M, Zhao JN, Xu Y, Zhang YH, Wu WJ, Wu D, Liu Y, Wei Y, Cui LB.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a heterogeneous disorder characterized by widespread brain dysconnectivity, yet it remains unclear whether variable structural dysconnectivity patterns reflect biologically and clinically meaningful subtypes. Methods We recruited 105 SCZ patients and 97 healthy controls, collecting magnetic resonance imaging, clinical assessment, and laboratory test data. Double generalized linear models were first applied to estimate group differences in the mean and inter-individual variability of structural connectivity between SCZ and controls. Subsequently, nonnegative matrix factorization was used to identify SCZ subtypes according to dysconnectivity profiles. Results We observed a significantly altered subnetwork that exhibited increased inter-individual variability in SCZ, with its connections and regions predominantly enriched in the ventral-attention, frontal-parietal, and default-mode networks that support higher-order cognition. Connectivity-derived subtype analysis grouped patients into two subtypes, with subtype-II tending to show more severe positive symptoms (t = 2.272, nominal P = 0.025), a lower neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio (t = -2.383, nominal P = 0.025), a better treatment response (t = 2.366, nominal P = 0.021), and greater short-term symptom improvement (t = 3.509, nominal P = 0.006) within the olanzapine monotherapy subgroup. This subtype also demonstrated distinct neuroanatomical features, including a subtype-specific cortical thickness change pattern unrelated to SCZ or bipolar disorder, as well as subtype-specific brain epicenters, such as left posterior cingulate and rostral middle frontal regions. Conclusions Our study demonstrates increased inter-individual variability in the structural connectome of SCZ and highlights the potential of connectome-based subtyping approaches for characterizing disease heterogeneity related to pathophysiological processes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症患者结构脑连接组是否存在具有生物学和临床意义的异质性亚型，对患者与健康对照的磁共振成像、临床评估和实验室数据进行比较，并结合连接组特征进行分型。结果显示，患者在一个涉及高级认知相关网络的子网络中表现出更大的个体间连接变异，并可据此分为两个亚型；其中Ⅱ型在奥氮平单药治疗下症状改善更明显、治疗反应更好，同时具有该亚型特异的皮层厚度模式和脑枢纽区域。作者认为，这提示结构连接组的个体差异有助于刻画精神分裂症的疾病异质性，但亚型与临床特征的关系仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Profound Tacrolimus-Induced Catatonic Encephalopathy in a Kidney Transplant Recipient With Mitochondrial Myopathy: A Cautionary Case of Reversible Neurotoxicity.
papers.authors: Ripa V, Geffner SR, Rosenzweig MG, Hanlon M, Sun H.
papers.abstract: Introduction Maternally inherited diabetes and deafness (MIDD) is a multisystem mitochondrial disorder most commonly caused by the m.3243A>G pathogenic variant in the MT-TL1 gene. Kidney transplantation in affected individuals presents unique perioperative and immunosuppressive management challenges due to underlying metabolic, neurologic, cardiac, and neuromuscular vulnerability. Case report We report a 64-year-old woman with end-stage renal disease secondary to insulin-dependent diabetes and MIDD (m.3243A>G) who underwent unrelated living donor kidney transplantation. The immediate postoperative period was complicated by diabetic ketoacidosis with lactic acidosis, transient slow graft function, and profound encephalopathy with catatonic features. Neuroimaging showed no acute abnormalities, and electroencephalography demonstrated severe diffuse encephalopathy without epileptiform activity. Tacrolimus levels were supratherapeutic in the early postoperative period. Given concern for calcineurin inhibitor neurotoxicity superimposed on mitochondrial dysfunction, tacrolimus was discontinued, and immunosuppression was switched to cyclosporine. Neurologic status gradually improved, and kidney allograft function fully normalized. Discussion This case highlights the substantial perioperative metabolic and neurologic risks associated with kidney transplantation in patients with MIDD. Patients with compensated cardiac dysfunction and manageable neuromuscular impairment should not be excluded from transplantation solely on the basis of mitochondrial cytopathy.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一名患有母系遗传性糖尿病伴耳聋（MIDD）的终末期肾病患者接受活体肾移植后，出现严重紧张症样脑病。术后早期他克莫司血药浓度高于治疗范围，神经影像未见急性异常，脑电图显示严重弥漫性脑病但无癫痫样活动；停用他克莫司并改用环孢素后神经状态逐渐改善，移植肾功能也完全恢复。作者据此提示，线粒体细胞病患者肾移植围术期存在显著的代谢和神经风险，钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂神经毒性与线粒体功能障碍叠加可能是重要诱因，但不应仅因线粒体细胞病而将心功能代偿、神经肌肉损害可控的患者排除在移植之外。

papers.title: Resilience and vulnerability in the midbrain dopamine system during aging.
papers.authors: McMurtrie G, Mabry SJ, Glausier JR, Rocha EM, Freyberg Z.
papers.abstract: The midbrain dopamine system is integral to movement, reward, and motivation, and its dysfunction underlies a range of brain disorders. Age is a primary risk factor for many of these disorders, yet systematic analysis of how the dopamine system changes during healthy aging remains relatively understudied. In this review, we first examine the impact of healthy aging on the dopamine system across sexes and species, including flies, mice, rats, and humans. We next consider the neuroadaptive mechanisms that sustain dopamine neuron function with age. Finally, we contrast the molecular mechanisms of age-related neurodegenerative diseases with those of healthy aging, exploring the possibility that loss of neuroadaptive reserve drives dopamine neurodegeneration. Elucidating these neuroadaptive mechanisms could offer a path toward preserving dopamine neuron function across the lifespan and potentially preventing age-related neurodegeneration.

papers.title: Rhythmic nasal air-puff as a potential noninvasive brain stimulation approach for stabilizing integrated brain network states.
papers.authors: Mohammadi S, Hossein-Zadeh GA, Raoufy MR.
papers.abstract: Breathing modulates neural oscillations and large-scale brain network organization, partly through mechanical stimulation of olfactory sensory neurons (OSNs). To investigate the mechanosensory contribution of olfactory input, we compared rhythmic, odorless nasal air-puff stimulation (~0.2 Hz) with oral breathing during resting-state fMRI in healthy adults (n = 21). Dynamic functional connectivity was analyzed using a hidden Markov model (HMM) applied to BOLD fluctuations centered on the stimulation frequency. Four recurrent brain states were identified, spanning a continuum from highly segregated to globally integrated configurations. Relative to oral breathing, nasal air-puff stimulation increased the fractional occupancy and lifetime of the integrated state characterized by higher global and local efficiency and lower modularity, reduced the overall switching rate, and selectively reshaped transition probabilities away from fragmented configurations. These effects partially reproduced key features observed during natural nasal breathing in our prior work, suggesting that rhythmic mechanosensory activation of OSNs contributes to the stabilization of integrated large-scale brain states. The findings support a respiration-entrained framework in which olfactory input contributes to the organization and temporal stability of large-scale brain networks.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康成人中比较了节律性无气味鼻腔气流刺激与经口呼吸时的静息态脑活动，用隐马尔可夫模型分析以刺激频率为中心的动态功能连接。结果识别出从高度分离到全局整合的四种反复出现的脑状态；相比经口呼吸，鼻腔气流刺激提高了整合状态的出现比例和持续时间，降低了整体状态切换率，并改变了状态间的转换概率。作者认为，节律性机械感觉激活可能有助于稳定大规模整合性脑网络状态，但这一解释基于与既往自然鼻呼吸观察的部分吻合，尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Between patterns and predictions: Interpretable latent EEG representations for clinical insights.
papers.authors: Krumm L, Terziev R, Kranz DD, Westover MB, Meisel C.
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) captures rich brain dynamics, yet in clinical practice this complexity is often reduced to simplified summaries or categorical labels, limiting its interpretability for decision-making. We tested the hypothesis that a pretrained latent embedding framework, the Universal Map of EEG (UM-EEG), can preserve clinically meaningful structure across heterogeneous datasets and provide a generalizable representation of brain states. We applied UM-EEG, without retraining, to three independent cohorts spanning distinct clinical contexts: long-term EEG recordings from cardiac arrest patients (n = 575), subarachnoid hemorrhage (n = 100), and routine clinical EEG recordings containing physiological and pathological patterns (n = 141). EEG segments were projected into a 128-dimensional space anchored by expert-derived reference states, including wakefulness, sleep stages, ictal-interictal continuum activity, and burst suppression. Across datasets, favorable outcome or physiological recordings were consistently located closer to healthy reference states, whereas poor outcome and pathological recordings shifted toward pathological regions of the embedding space. Trajectory-derived geometric and temporal features discriminated outcome in cardiac arrest (ROC-AUC 0.83) and subarachnoid hemorrhage (ROC-AUC 0.76), and distinguished physiological from pathological routine EEGs (ROC-AUC 0.93). In routine EEG, similarity relationships derived from embedding trajectories correlated with those derived from structured clinical reports, indicating that the latent space recapitulates clinically relevant organization. These findings show that a fixed, semantically structured EEG embedding generalizes across etiologies and recording settings, enabling prognostic stratification and contextual interpretation while preserving the relational structure of brain states.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究检验一个预训练的脑电潜嵌入框架能否在不重新训练的情况下，跨不同临床数据集保留有临床意义的结构。作者将心脏骤停、蛛网膜下腔出血和常规临床脑电三类队列的脑电片段投影到以专家参考状态锚定的潜空间中，发现结局良好或生理性记录更靠近健康参考状态，而结局不良和病理性记录则偏向病理区域。由轨迹导出的几何与时间特征能区分心脏骤停和蛛网膜下腔出血的结局，也能区分生理性与病理性常规脑电，且常规脑电中的相似性关系与结构化临床报告所得关系相关。结果表明，这种固定且具语义结构的脑电嵌入可跨病因和记录场景泛化，支持预后分层与情境化解读，并保留脑状态之间的关系结构。

papers.title: Ventral striatal and caudate contributions to episodic retrieval.
papers.authors: Sommer T, Bierbrauer A, Gamer M, Wagner AD.
papers.abstract: Striatal activity during episodic memory retrieval is a robust phenomenon observed across various stimulus types and experimental paradigms. Previous research suggests that the ventral striatum and the caudate contribute differentially to retrieval processes: ventral striatal activity is posited to vary with the intrinsic reward of successful retrieval, whereas caudate activity is attributed to effortful cognitive control. The present fMRI study aimed to test the overarching hypothesis that these striatal subregions make distinct contributions to episodic retrieval and to further specify their functional roles. To this end, we employed a word-picture paired-associates learning paradigm in which words served as cues in two consecutive cued-recall tests that were separated by 24 h. Participants indicated the specificity of their associative memories, enabling characterization of striatal response profiles as a function of associative memory specificity and treatment of memory specificity as a proxy for the intrinsic reward associated with retrieval success. Rather than being not readily compatible with a role of the caudate in effortful post-retrieval control, the results suggest that elevated caudate activity during successful recall reflects pre-retrieval control or involuntary orienting to salient mnemonic information. In contrast, rather than reflect intrinsic reward itself, ventral striatal activity varied with the discrepancy between expected and actual intrinsic reward elicited by retrieval outcomes-that is, a metacognitive reward prediction error. Moreover, ventral striatum signaled the relevance of retrieved information and modulated its re-encoding to facilitate future retrievals.

papers.title: Semantic working memory supports phrasal planning: Evidence from acute stroke.
papers.authors: Zahn R, Dial H, Schnur T, Martin R.
papers.abstract: This study examined the contribution of semantic and phonological working memory (WM) to lexical-semantic planning during language production for individuals tested acutely after left-hemisphere stroke. Participants completed tasks assessing phrase and sentence production, single-word retrieval, semantic and phonological WM, and single-word input processing. Using a constrained production paradigm that manipulated structure (phrase vs. sentence) and number of adjectival modifiers (one vs. two), we found that semantic WM capacity, indexed by performance on a category probe task, predicted accuracy in producing phrases containing multiple content words, even after controlling for single-word processing abilities. In contrast, phonological WM capacity, indexed by performance on a digit matching span task, did not relate to production accuracy. The relation to semantic WM was specific to the condition with the largest number of content words within a phrase (two-adjective noun phrase). These findings support the contention that lexical-semantic planning occurs phrase by phrase and is constrained by the capacity of a semantic maintenance buffer that supports activation and maintenance of multiple lexical-semantic representations prior to articulation. In contrast, phonological planning appears to operate within a narrower window that makes few demands on phonological WM. The results converge with prior neuropsychological evidence linking semantic WM to phrase-level planning and further imply that the phrase serves as the default scope of lexical-semantic encoding in production. Implications for models of WM and language production are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在左半球卒中急性期考察语义与语音工作记忆对语言产出中词汇语义规划的贡献，采用控制性短语和句子产出任务，并结合单词提取与输入加工等测量。结果显示，语义工作记忆容量能预测含多个内容词的短语产出准确性，且在控制单词加工能力后仍成立；这一关联主要出现在内容词最多的双形容词名词短语条件，而语音工作记忆与产出准确性无关。作者据此认为，词汇语义规划以短语为单位进行，并受语义维持缓冲容量的约束，语音规划的作用窗口则较窄、对语音工作记忆需求有限。

papers.title: Highly replicable multisite patterns of adolescent white matter maturation.
papers.authors: Meisler SL, Cieslak M, Bagautdinova J, Hendrickson TJ, Pandhi T, Chen AA, Hillman N, Radhakrishnan H, Salo T, Feczko E, Weldon KB, McCollum R, Fayzullobekova B, Moore LA, Sisk LM, Davatzikos C, Huang H, Avelar-Pereira B, Caffarra S, Chang K, Cook PA, Flook EA, Gomez T, Grotheer M, Hagen MP, Huque ZM, Karipidis II, Keller AS, Kruper J, Luo AC, Macedo B, Mehta K, Mitchell JL, Pines AR, Pritschet L, Rauland A, Roy E, Sevchik BL, Shafiei G, Singleton SP, Stone HL, Sun KY, Sydnor VJ, Tong TT, Yablonski M, Yeatman JD, Rokem A, Shinohara RT, Fair DA, Satterthwaite TD.
papers.abstract: Adolescent brain development is difficult to study at scale because diffusion MRI (dMRI) measures are sensitive to technical variability across scanning environments. The Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study is the largest US-based longitudinal neuroimaging study of adolescent brain maturation. We present ABCD-Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) Community Collection (ABCC) release 3.1.0, a curated resource of more than 24,000 fully processed human ABCD dMRI datasets from participants aged 8-17 years. ABCC provides processed images, nuanced image quality metrics, advanced microstructural measures, and person-specific white matter bundle tractography. Across 62 bundles, measures of diffusion restriction and non-Gaussianity-including intracellular volume fraction from neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging (NODDI), mean kurtosis tensor from diffusion kurtosis imaging (DKI), and return-to-origin probability from mean apparent propagator (MAP)-MRI-were more sensitive to development and more robust to variation in image quality than tensor-derived measures. Longitudinal harmonization of microstructural features with ComBat-GAMM markedly improved the cross-vendor generalizability of developmental effects. Together, ABCC accelerates reproducible, rigorous research on adolescent white matter development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究围绕青少年脑白质发育在跨扫描环境下难以大规模可重复测量的问题，整理并发布了包含8至17岁参与者逾两万套完整处理弥散MRI数据的ABCC资源，并提供图像质量指标、微结构指标和个体化白质纤维束追踪结果。作者在多个白质纤维束中比较不同弥散指标的发育敏感性与图像质量稳健性，发现基于扩散限制和非高斯性的微结构指标比张量衍生指标更敏感、更稳健；结合纵向协调处理后，跨厂商发育效应的可推广性明显提高。这些结果提示，该资源与相应指标有助于推动青少年白质发育研究走向可重复和严谨，但摘要未报告具体发育效应的大小或临床意义。

papers.title: Convergent microglial and astrocytic responses across diverse stress paradigms: Integrating inflammation, metabolism, and behavior.
papers.authors: Suk K.
papers.abstract: The central nervous system responds to diverse challenges through convergent glial mechanisms, yet most reviews examine single stressor paradigms in isolation. This review uniquely integrates current knowledge across five major stress categories (psychosocial, immune/inflammatory, infectious, injury/damage, and metabolic), revealing both shared pathways and stimulus-specific glial responses that have not been systematically compared. Because microglia and astrocytes are the principal immune-metabolic sensors mediating these responses, this review is centered on these two cell types, while acknowledging that oligodendrocytes, oligodendrocyte precursor cells, and ependymal cells also participate in stress-related glial pathology, particularly with respect to white matter and cerebrospinal fluid homeostasis. While all stressors activate common inflammatory cascades including NF-κB signaling, complement activation, and inflammasome assembly, they elicit distinguishable molecular signatures. For instance, psychosocial stress uniquely engages type I interferon responses driving microglial synapse elimination. Viral infections produce severe metabolic reprogramming, hijacking host metabolism to support viral replication while depleting cellular NAD + and ATP. Autoimmune inflammation generates lipid-laden disease-associated microglia with upregulated cholesterol metabolism genes. Unlike previous reviews focusing solely on inflammation or metabolism, we emphasize their bidirectional integration as a unifying principle. Inflammatory signals trigger metabolic shifts toward aerobic glycolysis, generating lactate serving dual functions as neuronal fuel and inflammatory mediator. This metabolic reprogramming, orchestrated by pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase, hypoxia-inducible factor-1α, and mTOR, creates feedback loops linking glial dysfunction to neuronal alterations. Complement-mediated synaptic pruning, disrupted neuron-glia metabolic coupling, and impaired neurotrophic support converge to produce depression, cognitive impairment, and sickness behaviors. Individual variability reflects interactions among genetic factors, sex, age, and blood-brain barrier integrity. This cross-paradigm comparative approach identifies high-value therapeutic targets applicable across multiple conditions rather than single diseases. We propose integrated intervention strategies simultaneously targeting inflammatory and metabolic pathways, guided by single-cell profiling for personalized medicine tailored to individual patient molecular signatures. We further discuss the conceptual overlaps inherent to the five-category classification scheme adopted here and outline the limitations of extrapolating across heterogeneous stress paradigms, glial cell types, and species.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合了心理社会、免疫炎症、感染、损伤和代谢五类应激下小胶质细胞与星形胶质细胞的反应，指出各应激源虽共同激活NF-κB信号、补体激活和炎症小体组装等炎症通路，却产生可区分的分子特征，例如心理社会应激独特地调动I型干扰素反应驱动小胶质细胞突触消除，而感染则引发严重的代谢重编程。作者强调炎症与代谢的双向整合是统一原则：炎症信号推动代谢转向有氧糖酵解，产生的乳酸兼具神经元燃料和炎症介质作用，并由相关激酶和转录因子形成反馈环路，将胶质细胞功能障碍与神经元改变联系起来。补体介导的突触修剪、神经元-胶质细胞代谢耦联受损和神经营养支持不足共同促成抑郁、认知障碍和疾病行为，个体差异则与遗传、性别、年龄和血脑屏障完整性有关。综述据此提出同时靶向炎症和代谢通路的整合干预思路，并讨论了五类分类方案的概念重叠及跨应激范式、胶质细胞类型和物种外推的局限。

papers.title: A spatio-temporal fingerprints with hierarchical activation refinement for predicting task activation maps from resting-state fMRI.
papers.authors: Pasumarthi S, Devarasetty S, Tiwari N, Padole H.
papers.abstract: Predicting task-induced brain activation maps from resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is an important challenge in computational neuroimaging, with potential applications for studying brain function without task-based scanning. However, most existing approaches rely primarily on functional connectivity representations, which often overlook the rich temporal dynamics embedded within rs-fMRI signals. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical framework that uniquely combines spatio-temporal fingerprinting with residual refinement to predict individualized task-activation maps directly from rs-fMRI. The framework first captures complementary spatial and temporal characteristics of resting-state brain activity and subsequently employs hierarchical residual learning to progressively refine the predicted activation maps. Evaluation on the Human Connectome Project (HCP) dataset across seven task contrasts demonstrates strong agreement between predicted and ground-truth activation maps, with correlations reaching up to 0.884. Additional evaluation on the Chinese Human Connectome Project (CHCP) dataset further demonstrates the robustness and generalizability of the proposed framework. The results thus highlight the potential of integrating spatio-temporal representations with hierarchical residual learning for individualized prediction of task-related brain activation from resting-state fMRI.

papers.title: Dorsolateral prefrontal TMS-evoked N100 as a neurophysiological correlate of symptom change in adolescent depression.
papers.authors: Klomfass S, Loy JK, Wunram HL, Biermann L, Pokorny L, Bender S.
papers.abstract: Background Major depressive disorder (MDD) is highly prevalent in adolescence. Up to 30% of patients insufficiently benefit from first-line treatments, underscoring the need for improved treatment strategies and better understanding of pathophysiology. In depression, an imbalance between cortical excitation and inhibition in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC), assessed by the TMS-evoked N100 potential, is suggested as one of several contributing neurobiological mechanisms. While elevated N100 amplitudes have been observed in depressed adults and adolescents, its association with symptom change remains insufficiently investigated. Methods In a randomized controlled trial, N = 54 adolescents (38 girls, 16 boys) with MDD received six weeks of whole body vibration training (exercising on a vibrating plate that triggers involuntary muscle contractions through a neurological reflex) or light stretching as add-on treatments to treatment as usual. TMS-EEG was applied before and after the intervention to assess N100 amplitudes over the left and right DLPFC. Depressive symptoms were measured using the Children's Depression Rating Scale-Revised. Changes in N100 amplitudes were analyzed using repeated measures ANOVA. Multiple regression analyses with intervention group as predictor examined associations between changes in N100 amplitudes and depressive symptoms, including sex as moderator and a subsequent girls-only analysis. Results Across both groups, N100 amplitudes significantly decreased from pre-to post-intervention. No differential effects between interventions were observed. Reductions in right-hemispheric N100 amplitudes were significantly associated with improvements in depressive symptoms. This association reached statistical significance in girls. Conclusions Our findings support the N100 as a candidate neurophysiological correlate of depressive symptom improvement.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年抑郁症中背外侧前额叶皮层兴奋—抑制平衡的脑电指标（TMS诱发的N100）是否与症状变化相关。54名患抑郁症的青少年在接受常规治疗基础上被随机分配进行六周全身振动训练或轻度拉伸，干预前后用TMS-EEG测量左右背外侧前额叶的N100波幅，并以儿童抑郁评定量表评估症状。结果显示，两组N100波幅均随时间下降，两种干预之间无差异；右侧N100波幅的下降与抑郁症状改善显著相关，且该关联在女孩中达到统计显著。作者据此认为N100可作为抑郁症状改善的候选神经生理相关指标，但这一关联并非干预效果的直接证据，样本和设计也限制了结论的推广。

papers.title: Diagnostic value of Tc-99m-HDP SPECT/CT in temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis: correlation with clinical and structural findings.
papers.authors: Jeon JH, Baik SH, Yun PY, Ku JK.
papers.journal: Journal of stomatology, oral and maxillofacial surgery
papers.abstract: Background This study evaluated the diagnostic utility of quantitative Tc-99m-hydroxydiphosphonate (HDP) bone single-photon emission computed tomography/computed tomography (SPECT/CT) in temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis (TMJ OA) by analyzing correlations among tracer uptake, clinical features, and structural imaging to detect early metabolically active disease. Methods A retrospective review included 48 patients (96 TMJs) with TMJ discomfort who underwent SPECT/CT and conventional imaging. Clinical parameters included pain duration, visual analog scale (VAS) score, joint sounds, mandibular range of motion, and occlusal findings. Radiography assessed condylar morphology and cortical erosion, and a Destructive Change Index (DCI) quantified bony changes. SPECT/CT uptake was expressed as maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax). Correlation and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses were performed. Results SPECT/CT uptake strongly correlated with condylar cortical erosion on CT (r = 0.80) and moderately with lateral pole tenderness (r = 0.51) and pain VAS score (r = 0.40). Joint sounds and condylar morphology correlated weakly (r = 0.26 and 0.21, respectively), while other clinical factors had negligible associations. ROC analysis identified an optimal SUVmax cutoff of 3.88, yielding 91% sensitivity (95% CI: 80-97%) and 85% specificity (95% CI: 73-94%) for detecting cortical erosion. SPECT/CT revealed increased metabolic uptake in some radiographically normal joints, suggesting the possibility of early osteoarthritic change before overt structural abnormalities became apparent. Conclusion Quantitative SPECT/CT provides complementary metabolic information beyond structural imaging and may facilitate the detection of metabolically active TMJ osteoarthritis.

papers.title: Analysis choices can produce apparent rich-club differences: an Alzheimer's disease EEG case study.
papers.authors: Liu KW, Pang RTE, Durongbhan P.
papers.abstract: Background The weighted rich-club coefficient tests whether a network's most strongly connected nodes are preferentially interconnected. Its interpretation depends on two often-implicit choices: how the randomised comparison networks are constructed, and whether the hubs are re-identified in each comparison network or held fixed at those of the observed network. When hubs are defined by connection strength, these choices change what the coefficient tests. New method We examined how these choices affect inference using resting-state EEG from 20 people with Alzheimer's disease and 20 controls. Holding the data fixed, we compared four analysis pipelines, crossing two ways of building the comparison networks (global weight reshuffle or strength-conditioned null) with the two hub choices, and ran a calibration study using data constructed to contain no preferential hub coupling beyond nodal strength. Results An apparent eyes-open group difference in rich-club organisation appeared only under the pipeline combining a global weight reshuffle with re-identified hubs. Under the empirical resampling ensemble, that pipeline reported a group difference in 43% of pseudo-studies, always higher in the Alzheimer's disease group, while the other three stayed near the expected 5%. Comparison with existing methods Unlike global weight reshuffling, strength-conditioned nulls approximately preserve nodal strengths; fixing observed hubs also retains the identity of the core being tested. Conclusions The same data can support or dissolve an apparent rich-club difference depending on these choices. No single choice is universally correct, but reporting which were made, and why they fit the question being asked, is essential to interpreting the result.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以阿尔茨海默病患者的静息态脑电为案例，考察加权rich-club系数的两项分析选择——如何构建随机对照网络，以及枢纽节点是重新识别还是固定为观测网络中的节点——如何影响推断。作者在固定数据的前提下比较了四种分析流程，并用不含额外枢纽耦合的构造数据做校准。结果显示，只有将全局权重重排与重新识别枢纽相结合的流程会呈现睁眼条件下的组间差异，且该差异在伪研究中被报告的比例远高于其他三种流程，而后者接近预期水平。作者据此指出，同一数据可能因这些选择而支持或消解表观的rich-club差异，没有普遍正确的选择，但报告所选做法及其与研究问题的匹配是解释结果的关键。

papers.title: Post-traumatic stress disorder recognition using the fNIRS dual-attention network.
papers.authors: Pan H, Ding P, Wang F, Ma Y, Gong A, Nan W, Li N, Fu Y.
papers.abstract: Background Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a prevalent psychological disorder that can impair daily functioning and mental health. Current clinical assessment mainly relies on structured interviews and symptom scales, which may introduce subjectivity and inter-rater variability. Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) provides a noninvasive approach for measuring task-evoked hemodynamic responses and may offer objective physiological information for auxiliary PTSD recognition. New method This study proposes an end-to-end deep learning framework, the fNIRS Dual Attention Network (FDANet), for PTSD recognition. Ten PTSD patients and ten healthy controls (HC) were recruited, and prefrontal hemodynamic signals, including oxyhemoglobin (HbO), deoxyhemoglobin (HbR), and total hemoglobin (HbT), were recorded during fear and neutral facial-expression stimuli. The three hemodynamic signals were concatenated along the channel dimension to form the model input. FDANet combines Transformer-based temporal modeling, one-dimensional temporal-channel attention, and convolutional feature extraction to learn discriminative representations from multichannel fNIRS signals. Results The model was evaluated using subject-wise nested cross-validation with five outer folds. At the trial level, FDANet achieved an accuracy of 79.4%. At the subject level, FDANet achieved an accuracy of 95.0%. Comparison with existing methods Compared with the evaluated traditional machine-learning and deep-learning baseline methods, FDANet achieved higher classification accuracy at both trial and subject levels. Conclusions These findings indicate that task-evoked prefrontal fNIRS signals contain discriminative information for PTSD recognition. Given the portability and noninvasive measurement characteristics of fNIRS, FDANet may support the future development of objective auxiliary screening tools for PTSD, although further validation with larger and independent samples is required.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种端到端深度学习框架FDANet，利用恐惧与中性面孔表情刺激下记录的前额叶fNIRS血流动力学信号，对PTSD患者与健康对照进行分类识别。模型结合Transformer时序建模、时间—通道注意力与卷积特征提取，在受试者级嵌套交叉验证中于试次级和受试者级均取得高于所比较的传统机器学习和深度学习基线的准确率。作者认为，任务诱发的前额叶fNIRS信号含有可用于PTSD识别的判别信息，并提示该便携、无创方法有望用于未来客观辅助筛查工具的研发，但结论仍需更大规模独立样本验证。

papers.title: Microstructural changes in prefrontal-cingulate networks following bilateral dorsomedial prefrontal cortex-targeted intermittent theta-burst stimulation in treatment-resistant depression: A diffusion tensor imaging study.
papers.authors: Ersungur Çelik EB, Poyraz BÇ, Arslan S, Kargın OA.
papers.abstract: Intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS) is a transcranial magnetic stimulation protocol used in treatment-resistant depression (TRD), yet its effects on brain structural connectivity remain incompletely understood. The dorsomedial prefrontal cortex (dmPFC), a key node within emotion regulation networks, has emerged as a promising therapeutic target. This study investigated white matter microstructural changes associated with bilateral dmPFC-targeted iTBS and their relationship with treatment response. A total of 21 patients with TRD and 32 healthy controls were included. Diffusion tensor imaging was acquired in all participants and repeated in patients after a full course of dmPFC-targeted iTBS. Analyses focused on longitudinal changes in white matter microstructure within prefrontal-cingulate-limbic pathways, group differences, and their associations with changes in depressive symptom severity. Correction for multiple comparisons was applied throughout. iTBS treatment was associated with a significant reduction in depressive symptoms. At the microstructural level, a post-treatment increase in fractional anisotropy was observed in a left prefrontal-cingulate pathway. Notably, changes in several pathways showed associations with clinical improvement. The tract-level findings were significant under tract-wise FDR correction but did not survive correction across all tract-metric comparisons, and are therefore interpreted as exploratory. Baseline microstructural properties within orbitofrontal-subgenual cingulate connections were also related to treatment response. These findings indicate tract-specific changes in diffusion metrics within prefrontal-cingulate-limbic pathways over the course of dmPFC-targeted iTBS. Given the modest sample size and the absence of a sham-controlled comparison, the results should be regarded as exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and require confirmation in larger, sham-controlled studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨双侧背内侧前额叶靶向间歇性θ爆发刺激治疗难治性抑郁症后，前额叶-扣带回-边缘通路白质微结构的变化及其与疗效的关系，采用弥散张量成像对患者治疗前后进行追踪并与健康对照比较。治疗后抑郁症状显著减轻，左侧前额叶-扣带回通路各向异性分数升高，部分通路的变化与临床改善相关，基线眶额-膝下扣带回连接特征也与治疗反应有关。不过这些通路层面的结果仅在通路内多重比较校正下显著，未能在全部通路-指标比较的校正中存活，且样本量有限、缺少假刺激对照，作者将其定位为探索性和假设生成性的初步发现，需更大规模对照研究验证。

papers.title: Differences in neurovascular coupling in patients with major depressive disorder: Evidence from simultaneous resting-state EEG-fNIRS.
papers.authors: Yan F, Wang X, Zhao Y, Yang S, Wang Z.
papers.abstract: Neurovascular coupling (NVC), the relationship between neural activity and cerebral hemodynamic responses, remains poorly understood in major depressive disorder (MDD). To investigate alterations in NVC associated with depressive symptom severity, we simultaneously recorded resting-state electroencephalography (rsEEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) in 206 participants, including 134 patients with MDD and 72 healthy controls stratified by age to disentangle disease-related alterations from age-associated effects. NVC in the prefrontal cortex (PFC) was characterized by the consistency and temporal lag between spontaneous electrophysiological peaks and corresponding hemodynamic responses. We found that age significantly enhances the NVC consistency (p < 0.05), whereas this relationship was altered in patients with MDD during both the oxygen-consumption phase and the subsequent hemodynamic compensation phase. Furthermore, among patients with MDD, the strength of this consistency decreased more significantly with greater illness severity (partial r = -0.336, p = 0.0601). These findings suggest that changes in neurovascular coupling effects are strongly associated with the severity of depression. By leveraging wearable neuroimaging techniques, this study provides multimodal evidence for altered neurovascular coupling in depression and highlights its potential as a biomarker for disease monitoring and recovery trajectories.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍患者的神经血管耦合是否发生改变，以及这种改变与抑郁症状严重程度的关系。作者同步采集静息态脑电和功能性近红外光谱数据，以评估前额叶自发神经活动峰值与血流动力学反应之间的一致性和时间滞后。结果显示，年龄会增强神经血管耦合的一致性，而患者在该耦合的氧消耗阶段和随后的血流动力学补偿阶段均表现出不同于健康对照的模式；在患者内部，症状越重，这种一致性越弱。作者据此认为，神经血管耦合的改变与抑郁严重程度相关，并提示其作为疾病监测与恢复轨迹生物标志物的可能性，但相关分析结果本身尚不足以确立因果关系或临床效用。

papers.title: Impact of entry trajectory angle-to-skull on electrode placement accuracy in robot-assisted stereoelectroencephalography.
papers.authors: Park C, Kim JH, Kim JH, Shin JH, Roh H.
papers.abstract: Objective Despite the widespread use of robotic systems to improve stereotactic accuracy in stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG), targeting errors still occur. Several studies have suggested that the trajectory-to-skull angle is closely associated with targeting error among various influencing factors; however, quantitative analyses remain limited. Therefore, this study aimed to quantitatively evaluate the relationship between trajectory-to-skull angle and implantation accuracy and to establish practical cut-off values for surgical planning. Methods A total of 10 patients (103 electrodes) were included in this study and various clinical variables were analyzed to identify whether trajectory-to-skull angle has a significant relation with accuracy using multivariate linear regression. Then, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis with Youden index optimization was applied to determine angle thresholds for achieving ≤ 3 mm accuracy. Results Multivariate analysis showed that both axial and coronal trajectory-to-skull angles were significantly associated with target error, with more tangential incidence angles corresponding to larger deviations (p < 0.01). Axial angle-to-skull was particularly associated with anteroposterior (Y-axis) error, whereas coronal angle-to-skull primarily predicted superoinferior (Z-axis) error. ROC curve analysis identified optimal angle thresholds of 11.8° for axial trajectories and 6.3° for coronal trajectories to predict targeting accuracy within 3 mm. When both axial and coronal angles were maintained within these cut-offs, the probability of achieving a target error ≤ 3 mm was 88.2%. Conclusion Trajectory-to-skull angle is a key geometric determinant of electrode placement accuracy in robot-assisted SEEG. Quantitative angle thresholds identified in this study provide practical guidance for trajectory planning and may help minimize mechanical deviation, improve implantation safety, and enhance the reliability of seizure-network localization.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注机器人辅助立体脑电图电极植入中，入颅轨迹与颅骨的夹角是否影响靶点精度，并基于患者电极数据用多因素回归和ROC曲线分析角度与误差的关系。结果显示，轴向和冠状面夹角越大（越接近切向入射），靶点偏差越大，且两平面夹角分别主要对应前后方向和上下方向误差。作者据此给出轴向约11.8°、冠状约6.3°的角度参考阈值，两角度均在此范围内时达到3毫米以内误差的概率较高。研究提示该夹角是影响植入精度的重要几何因素，可为轨迹规划提供量化参考，但结论基于有限患者数据，阈值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Does delayed removal of stereo-EEG electrodes following radiofrequency thermocoagulation increase haemorrhage?
papers.authors: Tjangdjaja N, Pardoe HR, Dalic LJ, Bulluss KJ, Archer JS.
papers.abstract: Background Stereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) guided radiofrequency thermocoagulation (RF-TC) is used in the assessment and treatment of medically refractory epilepsy, typically with electrode removal immediately following ablation. Our SEEG-guided RF-TC protocol includes the option of three further days of recording following thermocoagulation, prior to electrode removal. It is not known whether delayed removal of electrodes following RF-TC may increase the risk of haemorrhage. Objective To compare the rate and volume of intracranial haemorrhage with immediate versus delayed electrode removal following RF-TC. Methods 217 SEEG electrodes from 16 consecutive patients were retrospectively reviewed for haemorrhage. 3D T1-weighted (T1w) and Susceptibility Weighted (SWI) imaging were reviewed for haemorrhage along the electrode tract and at the site of RF-TC. The primary outcome measure was the per-electrode volume of T1w detectable haemorrhage at the site of RF-TC in electrodes removed immediately after RF-TC, compared to electrodes removed 3-days after RF-TC. Secondary outcomes compared the incidence and volume of T1w haemorrhage along the electrode tract in thermocoagulated versus non-thermocoagulated electrodes, presumed due to reflect haemorrhage from electrode insertion/removal. We also describe the temporal evolution of the MRI appearance of haemorrhage following SEEG-guided RF-TC. Results No clinically significant haemorrhages occurred. At the site of RF-TC a small amount of blood product is universally present but there was no significant difference in per-electrode haemorrhage volume following delayed (93.8 ± 39.8 mm3 ; ~diameter 5.6 mm) and immediate (80.0 ± 37.5 mm3 ; ~ diameter 5.3 mm) removal of electrodes (Mann-Whitney U test, p = 0.10). At the cortical surface there was no significant difference in the rate of T1w haemorrhage between thermocoagulated and non-thermocoagulated electrodes (63.1% vs 52.5%, p = 0.12, chi-squared). Conclusion Delayed removal of electrodes post-RF-TC allows assessment of response to RFA and the opportunity for further thermocoagulation if necessary. This exploratory study found no significant increase in haemorrhage volume with delayed electrode removal following RF-TC but a larger study would be required to definitively estimate haemorrhage risk.
