Finally, we tested whether socioeconomic status modulated the associations between latent polygenic scores and brain structures. Results We identified three distinct genetic latent factors, which we label lack of self-control, reward drive, and sensation seeking. In children, polygenic scores for the three factors showed associations with partly differentiated brain patterns: lack of self-control associated with reduced prefrontal cortical thickness, reward drive with increased subcortical cellular density, and sensation seeking with increased cortical surface area and white matter integrity. Longitudinally, lack of self-control predicted variation in white matter development. We found little evidence that socioeconomic factors modulated associations between polygenic scores and brain structure. Conclusions Using genome-wide association study data of European genetic ancestry samples, we identified three genetically distinct dimensions of impulsivity and risk-taking. These genetic predispositions showed association with brain structure as early as ages 9-10, with limited evidence that these associations varied across socioeconomic context.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注冲动性与冒险倾向不同侧面背后的遗传结构是否重叠，以及这些遗传倾向与儿童脑发育的关系。作者用基因组结构方程模型分析多项冲动性和冒险相关特质，识别出缺乏自我控制、奖赏驱动和感觉寻求三个遗传潜在因子，并在儿童样本中计算其多基因评分，考察与脑结构、发育和行为的关联。结果显示，三个因子对应部分分化的脑模式：缺乏自我控制与前额叶皮层厚度降低相关，奖赏驱动与皮层下细胞密度增加相关，感觉寻求与皮层表面积和白质完整性增加相关；纵向看，缺乏自我控制还预测白质发育差异。研究几乎未发现社会经济因素调节这些关联的证据，提示这些遗传倾向在儿童早期即与脑结构相关，且这种关联在不同社会经济背景下较为一致。

papers.title: Development of a messenger RNA therapy for schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Simons NW, Patel V, Li H, Iyer S, Zhong Y, Cao D, Yu C, Obiajulu D, Keller K, Hynes G, Lee S, Nadukuru R, Cheng E, Chen EP, Hashemi A, Lund AN, Rogers HC, Jackson R, Preuss M, Thibeau H, Nadkarni GN, Liharska LE, Charney DS, Barbosa M, Marro SG, Kahn RS, Yang N, Dong Y, Charney AW.
papers.abstract: Background Few gene-disease associations identified by human genetic studies lead to new drugs that advance to first-in-human trials. Schizophrenia exemplifies this translational gap: thousands of gene-disease associations have been reported, but antipsychotics act via mechanisms introduced in the 1950s. To close the gap, clinical research strategies are needed that generalize across genes and diseases. Methods Candidate drug targets were defined as genes linked to schizophrenia by population-based studies. Clinical validation of candidate targets was performed through family-based studies. The molecular effects of clinically validated targets were confirmed by correcting mutations in the neurons from affected family members. For one validated target, a messenger RNA (mRNA) drug was developed, and pre-clinical studies of the drug were performed. Results Carriers of rare protein-truncating variants (PTVs) in schizophrenia risk genes were identified in 30,813 patients of a US healthcare system. These included two female relatives with a rare PTV in GRIA3, which encodes the GluA3 subunit of the AMPA-type glutamate receptor. Further investigation of the family found an X-linked pattern of inheritance between the PTV and severe mental illness. Correction of the PTV in neurons of affected male family members restored GRIA3 expression. A GRIA3 mRNA drug was developed and in mice was well tolerated, resulted in broad brain expression of GluA3, and rescued behavioral abnormalities in a pharmacologically induced psychosis model (MK-801). Conclusions Further development toward clinical evaluation of a novel GRIA3 mRNA drug to treat schizophrenia is warranted.

papers.title: Excitation-Inhibition Balance and Fronto-Limbic Connectivity Distinguish TMS Treatment Outcomes in Refractory Depression.
papers.authors: Momi D, Wang Z, Oveisi MP, Kadak K, Bastiaens SP, Lissemore JI, Noda Y, Downar J, Rodriguez FV, Strafella R, Daskalakis ZJ, Zrenner C, Zomorrodi R, Rolle CE, Saggar M, Williams N, Keller CJ, Blumberger DM, Voineskos D, Griffiths JD.
papers.abstract: Background Intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) targeting the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) is effective for treatment-resistant depression, but outcomes remain variable. The neurophysiological mechanisms underlying response remain poorly understood, limiting precision neuromodulation. Methods We combined transcranial magnetic stimulation with electroencephalography (TMS-EEG) and connectome-based Jansen-Rit neural mass modeling to investigate the mechanistic basis of treatment efficacy in 90 patients with treatment-resistant depression. Individualized whole-brain models were fitted to pre- and post-iTBS TMS-evoked potentials, yielding subject-specific estimates of synaptic connectivity, excitation-inhibition (E/I) balance, and cortical dynamics. Brain states were defined by singular value decomposition of the model's population activity, and partial least squares analysis with nested cross-validation identified the brain-state pattern distinguishing responders from non-responders. Results We identified two neurophysiological signatures associated with treatment response. First, responders showed greater post-treatment reductions in 3-10 Hz oscillatory power, driven by shifts in E/I balance toward greater inhibitory control through reduced excitatory drive and increased inhibitory-to-pyramidal connectivity. Second, a pre-treatment brain state characterized by opposite-polarity dynamics between subgenual anterior cingulate cortex (sgACC) and left DLPFC distinguished responders from non-responders, consistent with prior fMRI findings on frontolimbic anticorrelation. Neural trajectory analysis further revealed greater dynamical reorganization and increased attractor stability in responders following treatment. Conclusions These findings provide a neurophysiologically-informed framework linking iTBS treatment efficacy to specific changes in cortical E/I balance and frontolimbic circuit dynamics, pointing toward candidate markers that, with subject-specific structural connectivity and independent validation, may inform personalized neuromodulation approaches in treatment-resistant depression.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注难治性抑郁症患者接受左侧背外侧前额叶间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）后疗效差异的神经生理机制，结合TMS-EEG与基于连接组的Jansen-Rit神经质量建模，对患者治疗前后的诱发电位进行个体化全脑建模。结果显示，应答者治疗后3-10 Hz振荡功率下降更明显，这与兴奋-抑制平衡向抑制性控制增强偏移有关；治疗前以sgACC与左侧DLPFC反极性动态为特征的大脑状态也能区分应答者与非应答者，与既往额边缘系统反相关的fMRI发现一致。轨迹分析还提示应答者治疗后出现更大的动态重组和吸引子稳定性提升。作者据此提出将iTBS疗效与皮层兴奋-抑制平衡及额边缘环路动态变化联系起来的框架，并指出这些候选标记在结合个体结构连接和独立验证后，或可服务于个体化神经调控，但目前尚属机制层面的发现。

papers.title: Cytokine dysregulation and hippocampal neurogenesis: A shared mechanism underlying cognitive impairments across neuropsychiatric and neurodegenerative disorders.
papers.authors: Tukiran N, Kolb T, Maggioni L, Rai S, Rafath Z, Borsini A.
papers.abstract: Neuropsychiatric and neurodegenerative disorders, such as major depressive disorder, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, Alzheimer's disease, and Parkinson's disease, all show a neuroimmune signature with dysregulated inflammatory cytokine profile and cognitive impairment. Although these deficits are clinically relevant, the immunological mechanisms that cause cognitive dysfunction across these conditions remain poorly defined. Recent studies demonstrate that inflammatory cytokines actively modulate adult hippocampal neurogenesis, a process critical for learning, memory, and affective regulation. Here, we synthesise clinical evidence to characterise the disorder-specific inflammatory profile of each of these five disorders, representing each profile with three frequently dysregulated cytokines rather than a single cytokine signature shared across conditions. We also integrate preclinical data where cytokines induce behavioural, cognitive, and hippocampal-related deficits in animal and cellular models. Hence, this review develops a mechanistic framework that links brain-immune communication directly to cognitive impairment through hippocampal neurogenesis, thereby suggesting neuroimmune targets for therapeutic intervention.

papers.title: Individual susceptibility to disgust modulates neural and systemic immune responses to virtual infections.
papers.authors: Born M, Akselrod M, Trabanelli S, Girondini M, Papadopoulou G, Vanoni G, Cornu A, Bertoni T, Jandus C, Serino A.
papers.abstract: Disgust is a key psychological mechanism for avoiding pathogen exposure and constitutes a central component of the behavioral immune system. While disgust is thought to reduce infection risk through avoidance, it remains unclear how individual differences in disgust sensitivity shape downstream neuroimmune responses to perceived pathogen threats. Here, we show that lower disgust sensitivity is associated with stronger activation of type 1 innate lymphoid cells during exposure to infectious, compared with neutral, avatars in virtual reality. Disgust sensitivity further correlated with circulating signaling factors involved in immune regulation, including hormones related to the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, and eicosanoids. Linear models incorporating disgust sensitivity and threat exposure predicted these signaling factors, which in turn enabled accurate prediction of type 1 innate lymphoid cells responses using a pretrained neural network. Recreating this putative pathway, we were able to predict immune responses solely by disgust scores. Additionally, resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging revealed that exposure to infectious avatars altered hypothalamic connectivity with brain regions involved in visual processing, peripersonal space representation, and social cognition, and these effects were modulated by individual disgust sensitivity. Together, these findings suggest that disgust sensitivity modulates multiple levels of the neuroimmune response to perceived pathogen threats. Across two complementary experiments, our results are consistent with a model linking sensory threat detection, hypothalamic signaling, and systemic immune activation. Rather than uniformly amplifying immune responses, higher disgust sensitivity appears to bias pathogen defense toward neural processing, whereas lower disgust sensitivity is associated with stronger physiological immune activation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨个体厌恶敏感度如何影响面对虚拟病原威胁时的神经与免疫反应，结合虚拟现实暴露、静息态功能磁共振成像和免疫指标测量开展了两项互补实验。结果显示，厌恶敏感度较低者在观看感染性虚拟形象时，1型固有淋巴样细胞活化更强；厌恶敏感度还与HPA轴相关激素和类花生酸等循环信号因子相关，这些因子可进一步预测免疫细胞反应，仅凭厌恶评分即可预测免疫反应。感染性形象还改变了下丘脑与视觉加工、近身空间表征和社会认知相关脑区的连接，且受厌恶敏感度调节。作者据此提出，较高的厌恶敏感度可能使病原防御更多偏向神经加工，而较低者则伴随更强的生理免疫激活，而非免疫反应被普遍放大。

papers.title: Toddler EEG power reflects behavioral social engagement state during naturalistic parent-child interaction.
papers.authors: Manning BL, Roberts MY, Wakschlag LS, Norton ES.
papers.abstract: Social engagement is a critical process for children's language and social development and is altered in neurodevelopmental conditions such as autism. Although previous EEG studies have investigated correlates of children's social development in closely controlled experimental studies, few studies have examined how the brain reflects meaningful behavioral states, such as social engagement, within naturalistic parent-child interaction. This study collected EEG from typically developing toddlers of varying language ability and their parent (n = 49, 24-44 months) during the Social EEG paradigm; dyads completed contexts of dyadic interaction (book reading and puzzle play) and baseline (movie watching) during EEG recording. Videos of the interaction session were coded for social engagement using moment-by-moment behavioral coding and applied to the EEG data. As predicted, child EEG alpha power decreased (p < .001) and theta power increased (p = .01) during social engagement relative to baseline movie engagement. Further, the same pattern was replicated in an independent sample (n = 24, 25-47 months) including children diagnosed with autism, who showed the same pattern of power. These results demonstrate for the first time that EEG power is associated with naturally occurring moments of parent-child social engagement across a range of social/linguistic abilities and ages. This opens avenues for study of more naturalistic and meaningful developmental constructs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注幼儿在与父母自然互动时，大脑活动能否反映其当下的社会参与状态。研究者对语言能力各异的幼儿及其父母在阅读、拼图等互动情境和看电影的基线情境中同步记录脑电，并用逐刻行为编码标出社会参与时刻。结果显示，相较于基线，幼儿在社会参与时脑电α功率下降、θ功率上升，这一模式在包含自闭症诊断幼儿的独立样本中同样出现。作者据此认为，脑电功率与自然发生的亲子社会参与时刻相关，为在更贴近日常的情境中研究发展性构念提供了可能。

papers.title: Revisiting cortical language and praxis representations in males and females.
papers.authors: Kanert J, Króliczak G.
papers.abstract: Although the past few decades have seen numerous researchers questioning the nature of sex differences in cognition, the answers remain surprisingly unclear. For example, there is evidence against the long-standing hypothesis that women have more bilateral language representation than men. Indeed, the nature and extent of sex differences in language representation remain largely controversial. So are potential sex differences in praxis representation. In this study, functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data obtained from 64 females and 61 males during word generation and tool use pantomime were analyzed. The majority of participants had typically organized functions. Whole-brain activity maps and laterality indices (LIs) from regions of interest (ROIs) were examined, using both voxel count and signal intensity. The fMRI results for the language task indicated significantly different activity only for a small region within the female's left occipital cortex. Additional exploratory statistical analysis revealed some, but weak evidence for significant sex difference in the lateralization of the fusiform gyrus. Meanwhile, the statistical analysis of LIs obtained during the praxis task, as well as the whole-brain activity contrasts suggested no sex differences in praxis representation. Moreover, the results from both tasks did not differ depending on the LI calculation method, despite voxel-count based LIs being consistently larger than those based on signal intensity. In conclusion, this study provides new insights into sex differences in cognitive functions, challenging the long-standing assumptions about their nature and extent.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能磁共振成像考察男女在词语生成和工具使用模仿任务中的皮层语言与运用表征是否存在性别差异，并比较了基于体素计数和信号强度的偏侧化指标。结果显示，多数参与者功能组织典型，语言任务中仅女性左侧枕叶皮层一小区域活动存在显著性别差异，梭状回偏侧化的性别差异证据也很弱；运用任务的全脑活动和偏侧化指标均未显示性别差异，且两种偏侧化计算方法所得结论一致。作者据此认为，结果对关于性别差异性质和程度的长期假设提出了挑战。

papers.title: From Contrasts to Representations: Rethinking fMRI Approaches for Cortico-Cerebellar Networks.
papers.authors: Irving CN, King M, LeBel A.
papers.abstract: The relationship between the cerebellum and cerebrum remains poorly understood in the neuroimaging literature, despite decades of functional magnetic resonance (fMRI) research. In this opinion article, we argue that this gap reflects fundamental methodological constraints rather than merely a lack of scientific interest. We first discuss challenges in acquiring fMRI data and analysis, with an emphasis on the cerebellum. We then critically evaluate the most common analysis approaches including functional connectivity, univariate contrasts, multivariate pattern analysis, and encoding models, examining the contributions and limitations of each to identify and quantify cortico-cerebellar networks. Through the lens of language processing, we briefly review how these approaches have been applied to characterize cortico-cerebellar networks underlying cognitive function. We conclude by proposing that encoding model frameworks, combined with ecologically valid naturalistic paradigms, offer advantages that can help resolve longstanding debates about cortico-cerebellar network function and organization.
papers.summary_zh: 这篇观点文章讨论为何数十年fMRI研究后小脑与大脑的关系仍不清楚，认为主要障碍来自方法学限制而非研究兴趣不足。作者评述功能连接、单变量对比、多变量模式分析和编码模型等常见分析途径在识别与量化皮层—小脑网络时的贡献和局限，并以语言加工为例说明这些方法的应用情况。作者提出，编码模型框架结合生态效度较高的自然范式更有助于厘清该网络的功能与组织，从而推进相关长期争论。

papers.title: Reduced structural connectivity in age-related hearing loss aligns with the sensory deprivation theory.
papers.authors: Boons JHC, De Luca A, Dingemanse G, Vinke EJ, Kremer B, Vernooij MW, Goedegebure A.
papers.abstract: Age-related hearing loss (ARHL) may contribute to cognitive decline through structural degeneration and brain reorganization, as posited by the sensory deprivation theory. These processes can be characterized by topological changes, such as strengthening and weakening of structural connections between brain regions. Stronger connections are more relevant to reorganization, as reorganization is thought to support speech processing by recruiting additional brain networks as a compensatory mechanism. We investigated connectivity changes associated with ARHL to improve the understanding of the sensory deprivation theory. Similar to the lateralization of speech processing, we hypothesized that structural reorganization associated with ARHL would be most evident in the left hemisphere. We assessed whole-brain structural connectivity using 1.5 Tesla diffusion-weighted MRI and structural T1 images in 2402 participants (median age = 66.1 years, females = 54.7%) from the population-based Rotterdam Study. Pure-tone audiometry was performed, and pure-tone averages (PTAs), for different frequency ranges including PTAlow (250-1000 Hz) and PTAall (250-8000 Hz), were determined for the better-hearing ear to reflect ARHL. ARHL was primarily associated with weaker connections involving frontal and subcortical gray matter regions. Contrary to our hypothesis, no lateralization in the connectivity alterations was observed. PTAlow and PTAall yielded the strongest associations, likely driven by low-frequency hearing thresholds. Adjusting for cardiovascular risk factors attenuated associations, especially for PTAlow . In conclusion, the findings contradict the hypothesized compensatory structural reorganization expected from the neural effects of sensory deprivation. While the observed weaker connectivity aligns with the sensory deprivation theory, the results also suggest cardiovascular health as a common risk factor.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于鹿特丹研究人群的弥散加权与结构MRI及纯音测听数据，考察年龄相关听力损失与全脑结构连接的关系，以检验感觉剥夺理论。结果显示，听力损失主要与涉及额叶和皮层下灰质区域的较弱连接相关，且未出现假设中的左半球偏侧化；低频听力阈值相关的关联最强，校正心血管风险因素后关联减弱。作者认为，较弱的连接符合感觉剥夺理论，但未支持补偿性结构重组，并提示心血管健康可能是共同风险因素。

papers.title: Leveraging traditional and advanced machine learning for comprehensive oncology data integration and outcome prediction.
papers.authors: Hey G, Del Sesto M, Still M, Patel G, Crlenjak N, Dagra A, Wu Y, Guo Y, Ghiaseddin AP.
papers.abstract: Background Outcome prediction in neuro-oncology remains challenging due to heterogeneity in tumor biology, imaging characteristics, treatment response, and patient-specific clinical factors. Although molecular databases have advanced understanding of brain tumor biology, many datasets lack broader data necessary for generalizable predictive modeling. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are increasingly being explored to integrate these heterogeneous data sources and support precision neuro-oncology. Methods A narrative review was performed using PubMed and Embase to identify studies evaluating oncology databases, ML models, multimodal data integration, and AI applications relevant to neuro-oncology. Studies published between 2020 and 2026 were preferentially reviewed, with additional landmark studies included when relevant. Results Traditional ML approaches including regression-based models, random forests, support vector machines, and gradient boosting algorithms have been applied to survival prediction, recurrence classification, treatment response estimation, and molecular biomarker prediction using clinical, imaging, molecular, and population-level datasets. More advanced architectures including natural language processing, large language models, vision transformers, geometric deep learning, and graph neural networks have expanded the ability to analyze unstructured and multimodal data sources including radiology reports, histopathology slides, MRI volumes, molecular datasets, and electronic health records. Multimodal AI systems integrating imaging, molecular, histopathologic, clinical, and socioeconomic data frequently demonstrated improved predictive performance compared with single-modality models. However, widespread clinical implementation remains limited by dataset heterogeneity, limited external validation, interpretability concerns, and inconsistent representation across patient populations. Conclusions AI and ML approaches are increasingly capable of integrating complex neuro-oncology datasets in ways that more closely reflect real-world clinical decision-making. Although most current models remain investigational, multimodal AI frameworks may ultimately improve prognostic assessment, treatment stratification, and precision neuro-oncology care. Continued progress will require larger representative datasets, improved data harmonization, external validation, and clinically interpretable models.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了传统与先进机器学习在神经肿瘤学多源数据整合及结局预测中的应用。传统方法已用于生存、复发、治疗反应和分子标志物预测，而自然语言处理、大语言模型、视觉Transformer和图神经网络等扩展了对影像报告、病理切片、MRI及电子健康记录等非结构化与多模态数据的分析能力；整合影像、分子、病理、临床和社会经济信息的多模态模型常优于单模态模型。作者同时指出，数据集异质性、外部验证不足、可解释性问题和人群代表性不一致仍限制临床落地，多数模型尚处研究阶段，未来需更大代表性数据、数据协调、外部验证和可解释模型。

papers.title: Scalp Topography of Event-Related Potentials Reveals Differences in Audiovisual Speech Processing in Autistic and Non-Autistic Children.
papers.authors: Dunham-Carr K, Feldman JI, Simon DM, Wallace MT, Murray MM, Woynaroski TG.
papers.journal: Journal of autism and developmental disorders
papers.abstract: Purpose In our prior work, conventional event-related potential (ERP) responses to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech were found to explain variance in language abilities in autistic and non-autistic children but failed to differentiate autistic children from non-autistic children. This study extends previous ERP analyses of responses to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech in autistic and non-autistic school-aged children to investigate group and condition differences in the strength and topography of the ERP based on data-driven, reference-independent metrics that overcome limitations of conventional ERP analyses. Methods Extant ERP data from 50 5-12-year-old children (25 per group, matched at the group level on age and sex assigned at birth) recorded during a passive task of listening and watching videos of auditory-only and audiovisual speech syllables were analyzed for differences in ERP strength and topography, quantified via global field power (GFP) and global map dissimilarity (GMD), respectively. Results GFP was significantly reduced for audiovisual compared to auditory-only speech at 245-275 ms post-stimulus. Groups differed in GMD of the ERPs reflecting the difference in response to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech at 139-170 ms post-stimulus, wherein microstates suggested predominantly differential occipital electrode responses. Conclusions The benefits of audiovisual integration manifest as a facilitation effect (reduced signal strength of the ERP response to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech) across autistic and non-autistic children. Autistic children also display different patterns of activation underlying ERPs in response to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech relative to non-autistic children. Topographic ERP analyses show promise for advancing our understanding of audiovisual speech processing in autism.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析自闭症与非自闭症学龄儿童在视听与纯听觉言语刺激下的脑电事件相关电位，采用不依赖参考电极的数据驱动指标刻画其强度与头皮分布。结果发现，两组儿童在视听条件下均出现约245至275毫秒的电位强度降低，提示视听整合带来易化效应；但两组在反映视听与纯听觉差异的电位地形上于约139至170毫秒出现差异，微状态分析提示差异主要涉及枕区电极反应。作者认为，地形学分析有助于揭示自闭症儿童视听言语加工的不同激活模式，但其临床意义尚待进一步研究。

papers.title: Fixed-Sequence OFF-to-ON Differences in Low-Beta State Dynamics in Parkinson's Disease: A Paired Source-Space Resting-State EEG Study.
papers.authors: Wang H, Cheng Y, Wu G, Du X, Fan H, Yan J, Du G.
papers.abstract: Resting-state EEG studies in Parkinson's disease (PD) have largely emphasized static power or connectivity, whereas fixed-sequence OFF-to-ON session differences may also involve the temporal organization of network states. Paired source-space evidence under such fixed acquisition protocols remains limited. We analyzed 64-channel eyes-closed resting-state EEG in 39 patients with PD contributing paired OFF/ON recordings for the prespecified 90 s primary analysis; 24 also contributed paired 178 s recordings for duration robustness. After individual MRI-based source reconstruction, low-beta (13-20 Hz) dynamic amplitude-envelope connectivity was computed with 2 s windows. Primary endpoints were switching rate (SR) and normalized Shannon entropy (H); fractional occupancy (FO_path) and mean dwell time (MDT_path) of an internally defined OFF-dominant state were prespecified secondary conditional endpoints and are interpreted only as conditional summaries. PD-only linear mixed-effects models quantified the fixed-sequence OFF-to-ON session contrast; medication state and session order were necessarily collinear. In the 90 s analysis, the later ON session showed higher SR (β = 3.3224, Holm p = 0.00406) and H (β = 0.06781, Holm p = 0.000749) than the earlier OFF session. FO_path (β = -0.09167, Holm p = 1.08 × 10⁻⁵) and MDT_path (β = -1.05171, Holm p = 0.00524) were lower in the later ON session. The 178 s reanalysis preserved the same directions, although SR and especially MDT_path were more parameter-sensitive across sensitivity analyses. The fixed OFF-then-ON protocol was associated with reproducible within-subject differences in low-beta state dynamics, with the strongest evidence arising from SR and H. Because medication state was perfectly collinear with session order, these findings cannot distinguish medication-specific effects from order-, time-, vigilance-, fatigue-, or adaptation-related influences. FO_path and MDT_path remain conditional summaries tied to an internally defined OFF-dominant state, and MDT was less stable in the 178 s and OFF-only sensitivity analyses.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病患者在固定先OFF后ON的采集顺序下，静息态脑电低beta频段网络状态的时间组织是否出现可重复的个体内差异。作者对患者进行基于个体MRI的源空间重建，计算低beta动态振幅包络连接，并以状态切换率和归一化香农熵为主要指标。结果发现，较晚的ON session切换率和熵均高于较早的OFF session，预设的OFF优势状态占据比例和平均停留时间则较低，延长记录的重分析方向一致。由于用药状态与session顺序完全共线，这些差异无法区分药物特异性效应与顺序、时间、警觉、疲劳或适应等因素的影响，相关状态指标也只是内部定义下的条件性总结。

papers.title: Preoperative Functional Imaging Predicts Deep Brain Stimulation Outcome in Craniocervical Dystonia.
papers.authors: Fan H, Boutet A, Elias GJB, Hua T, Wang R, Yin Z, Xu Y, Zhao Z, Su YH, Loh A, Pijar J, Bogojevic I, Au HCT, Wang Y, Hu T, Yuen J, Iskin S, Chavira-Hernandez G, Yang A, Lozano AM, Bai Y, Germann J, Zhang J.
papers.journal: Movement disorders : official journal of the Movement Disorder Society
papers.abstract: Background Deep brain stimulation (DBS) is an established treatment for craniocervical dystonia (CCD), yet postoperative benefit varies widely and cannot be estimated before surgery. Resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) has shown prognostic value across DBS indications. The objective of this study was to develop and externally validate preoperative rs-fMRI models estimating DBS response in CCD. Methods Forty-two patients from two independent centers underwent preoperative 3 T rs-fMRI (discovery, n = 26; validation, n = 16). Using 12 literature-informed, symptom-relevant regions of interest, we quantified the amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation as a measure of intrinsic regional neural activity. We applied regularized modeling to classify super-responders, distinguish responders from non-responders, and estimate improvement in Burke-Fahn-Marsden Dystonia Rating Scale motor subscore. Results When applied to the validation cohort, the imaging models achieved a three-category classification accuracy of 75.0% (50.5%-89.8%) using a sequential two-step procedure (Pperm = 0.002). Predicted continuous improvement was also correlated with empirical improvement (Rext = 0.65, Q2 = 0.34, Pperm = 0.004). Within the discovery cohort, nested leave-one-out-cross-validation, in which feature selection and decision-threshold derivation were repeated independently within each training fold, yielded areas under the curve (AUCs) of 0.73 (0.50-0.96) and 0.77 (0.51-1.00). Across models, baseline primary motor cortex activity was consistently associated with diminished postoperative benefit. Conclusions Preoperative rs-fMRI captures clinically relevant variation in baseline brain state in CCD, with predictive performance supported in an external validation. These findings provide preliminary support for rs-fMRI as a potential source of information to aid patient counseling and clinical decision-making, pending prospective validation. © 2026 International Parkinson and Movement Disorder Society.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在利用术前静息态功能磁共振成像预测颅颈肌张力障碍患者对脑深部电刺激的术后反应，基于两个独立中心患者的低频波动振幅构建并外部验证预测模型。结果显示，影像模型在验证队列中能对超应答者、应答者与无应答者进行三分类，预测的连续改善程度也与实际改善相关；基线初级运动皮层活动在多个模型中一致地与术后获益较小相关。作者认为术前静息态功能磁共振成像可反映与临床相关的基线脑状态差异，为患者咨询和临床决策提供初步信息，但尚需前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Self- and other-directed harmful behavior following deep brain stimulation of the anterior nucleus of the thalamus for drug-resistant epilepsy.
papers.authors: Roth RW, Sloan J, Yun W, Karpychev V, Villarreal H, Teagarden D, Carns D, Hacker C, Laxpati N, Gleichgerrcht E.
papers.abstract: Objective The current study examined the occurrence, clinical predictors, and neuroanatomical correlates of self- or other-directed harmful ideation or behavior (HIB) following deep brain stimulation of the anterior nucleus of the thalamus (ANT-DBS) for drug-resistant epilepsy. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 90 ANT-DBS patients followed longitudinally, tracking stimulation parameters, seizure outcomes, and psychiatric status. HIB was defined as documented suicidal ideation, suicide attempt, homicidal ideation, threats, or physical aggression requiring clinical intervention. Preoperative predictors were identified using Firth penalized logistic regression. Lead reconstructions, volumes of tissue activated, sweet spot analysis, and normative structural and functional connectivity mapping were performed in Lead-DBS to compare patients with and without HIB. Stimulation parameters associated with symptom emergence and resolution were examined within patients longitudinally. Results Eleven of the 90 patients (12.2%) developed new or worsening HIB following ANT-DBS. Preoperative HIB predicted postoperative HIB (odds ratio = 8.07, p = .003). Neither the volume of tissue activated by stimulation nor the structural or functional connectivity of the stimulated tissue differed between patients who developed HIB and those who did not. Within patient analyses (n = 11), eight patients' symptoms were resolved by changing from high- to low-frequency stimulation, and three were resolved via contact and amplitude changes. Significance HIB following ANT-DBS occurs in a clinically meaningful minority of patients and is strongly associated with preoperative psychiatric vulnerability rather than differences in lead location or network engagement. Most cases were resolved through stimulation parameter adjustments, particularly frequency reduction, suggesting these complications are often reversible through routine DBS reprogramming. Careful preoperative psychiatric evaluation and close postoperative monitoring are recommended for patients undergoing ANT-DBS.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注药物难治性癫痫患者接受丘脑前核脑深部电刺激（ANT-DBS）后出现的自伤或伤人意念及行为，回顾性分析了90例患者的刺激参数、癫痫控制与精神状况，并结合电极重建和连接性分析。结果显示，约一成患者出现新发或加重的此类问题，术前已有相关表现是最强的预测因素，而刺激覆盖范围及结构、功能连接在有无此类问题的患者间未见差异。多数症状可通过调整刺激参数（尤其降低频率）缓解，提示术后精神并发症更多与术前易感性相关，而非电极位置或网络参与差异，强调术前精神评估和术后监测的重要性。

papers.title: A touch that lingers: synchronized patting strengthens neural tracking of auditory rhythm in newborns
papers.authors: Hegde M, Edalati M, Kösem A, Foulon A, Lefebvre S, Wallois F, Trainor L, Tillmann B, Moghimi S.
papers.abstract: Rhythmic auditory stimulation in early life rarely occurs in isolation. Caregivers naturally combine singing and speech with rhythmic touch, rocking, and visual cues. Newborns are sensitive to auditory rhythm from birth, yet little is known about how temporally aligned information across sensory modalities shapes the neural encoding of auditory rhythmic structure. Here, we tested whether rhythmic touch can alter how the newborn brain tracks an ongoing auditory signal beyond the period of tactile stimulation. We recorded high-density electroencephalography from full-term newborns (N = 40), 1-3 days after birth, while they were exposed to recorded French lullabies presented either alone or accompanied by gentle patting synchronized with the metrically strong beat. Patting was delivered intermittently, allowing us to compare neural responses to lullabies across conditions, notably during periods without concurrent tactile stimulation. We quantified neural tracking of the lullabies using brain-stimulus coherence and temporal response function modeling. Newborns’ neural activity synchronized with the rhythmic structure of the lullabies at frequencies corresponding to both the beat and the metrically accented strong beat. Critically, neural tracking was stronger when the lullabies had been accompanied by synchronized touch than when they were presented alone, and this enhancement persisted during subsequent periods in which no touch was delivered. Although rhythmic touch enhanced tracking in newborns with both weaker and stronger auditory-only tracking, there was a larger gain in those who initially showed weaker auditory tracking. Together, our findings reveal that the newborn brain exploits rhythmic touch to strengthen its encoding of auditory rhythm, and that this benefit outlasts the touch itself. This provides neural evidence that patting an infant in time with a song, a caregiving practice shared across cultures, does more than simply provide a tactile stimulation. It shapes how the newborn brain encodes the song’s rhythm.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察与听觉节律同步的轻拍触觉能否改变新生儿对摇篮曲节奏的神经编码，并检验这种影响是否在触觉停止后仍持续。研究者对出生1至3天的足月新生儿记录高密度脑电，比较摇篮曲单独呈现与伴随同步轻拍呈现时的神经追踪。结果显示，新生儿脑活动能与摇篮曲的节拍及重拍频率同步；伴随同步触觉时神经追踪更强，且在随后无触觉的时段仍然保持，原本听觉追踪较弱的新生儿获益更大。这表明节律性触觉可增强并延长新生儿对听觉节奏的编码，为跨文化照护中随歌轻拍婴儿提供了神经层面的解释。

papers.title: Hemispheric Complementarity is Associated with Distinct Functional and Structural Brain Profiles
papers.authors: Labache L, Beyh A, Cooper R, Parkes L, Holmes AJ.
papers.abstract: Hemispheric specialization is thought to follow a principle of complementarity, with homotopic functions such as language and attention lateralizing to opposite hemispheres, yet its consistency across individuals and relevance for cognition remain unclear. Using multimodal neuroimaging and twin-family data from 987 Human Connectome Project participants, we identified three sustained attentional lateralization phenotypes (right, left, bilateral) that were independent of handedness, differed by sex, and tracked broad shifts in brain organization, with bilateral individuals showing stronger intrahemispheric and homotopic connectivity. Examining attention and language revealed three multidomain profiles (crowded, mixed, split) reflecting whether functions colocalize within or are distributed across hemispheres. Mixed organization was linked to higher planum polare myelination, whereas crowded organization showed higher fiber density connectivity across dorsal attention–default network. Both phenotypes were heritable, yet neither predicted cognitive performance. These findings reveal a brain organization in which specialization emerges from flexible, heritable patterns linking function, structural connectivity, and myeloarchitecture.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大脑半球互补性组织在个体间是否一致，以及它与认知的关系，利用多模态神经影像和双生子家系数据，考察注意与语言功能的偏侧化模式。作者识别出右偏、左偏和双侧三类持续性注意偏侧化表型，它们与利手无关、存在性别差异，并伴随脑组织方式的整体变化；在注意与语言的多域组合上，又区分出功能同侧聚集、混合分布和分侧分布等模式，这些模式分别与不同的髓鞘化和纤维连接特征相关。两类组织表型均具遗传性，但都未预测认知表现，提示半球特化可能来自连接功能、结构连接与髓鞘构筑的可遗传而灵活的组织方式，而非直接决定认知能力。

papers.title: rpSTS Stimulation Disrupts Shared Neural Responses to Social Content during Naturalistic Viewing
papers.authors: Thompson JC, Marsh C, Kakalec P, Rawlings K, Roy R.
papers.abstract: Shared understanding of common experiences can foster feelings of social closeness and friendship, and help us understand those experiences. Recent work has suggested that patterns of neural activity shared across individuals, especially throughout the default mode network, may underlie shared representations. Here we used repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) and functional magnetic resonance imaging during movie watching to show that shared neural patterns to common experiences rely on the encoding of social information from the environment by the right posterior superior temporal sulcus (rpSTS). An encoding model of movie features showed that rTMS selectively degraded social feature encoding in rpSTS, leaving low-level visual encoding in early visual cortex intact. Using natural language processing (NLP)-based analysis, we found that rpSTS stimulation was associated with reduced memory and intersubject pattern similarity across DMN and limbic networks during scenes central to the movie narrative. Projecting scene embeddings onto NLP-based concept axes revealed reductions in memory and neural pattern similarity for scenes conveying helplessness and empathy following rTMS. These findings provide causal evidence that the rpSTS is a key region that encodes shared social information into common neural representations, and suggest that disrupting its input leads DMN representations to become idiosyncratic.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨共同经历下的共享神经表征是否依赖右侧后颞上沟（rpSTS）对社会信息的编码，采用重复经颅磁刺激结合功能磁共振成像，让被试在观看电影时接受刺激。结果显示，刺激选择性地削弱了rpSTS对社会特征的编码，而早期视觉皮层的低层视觉编码未受影响；在电影叙事核心场景中，刺激还与记忆表现及默认网络和边缘网络个体间神经模式相似性的下降相关，且这种下降集中在传达无助与共情等内容的场景上。作者据此提出因果性证据，认为rpSTS是将共享社会信息编码为共同神经表征的关键区域，干扰其输入会使默认网络表征趋于个体化。

papers.title: Attention warps visual-semantic representations across the human cerebellum
papers.authors: LeBel A, Visconti di Oleggio Castello M, Gallant JL, Ivry RB.
papers.abstract: Humans effortlessly shift their attention between objects and events in the environment. These attentional shifts modulate the representation of information in many regions of the cerebral cortex, including those that represent visual-semantic information. Based on recent evidence that the cerebellum also represents semantic information, we hypothesized that attention would also shift semantic representations in the cerebellum. To test this hypothesis, we used fMRI to measure brain activity while participants watched naturalistic movie clips and were instructed to attend to either people or vehicles. We used a voxelwise encoding model framework to recover visual-semantic representations in the cerebral cortex and cerebellum under the two conditions, and quantified the direction and magnitude of visual-semantic tuning shifts between conditions. Attention to different semantic categories had a large effect on visual-semantic tuning in the cerebellum. Representations in some regions shifted toward the attended category, and representations in other regions shifted away from the attended category. Within cerebellar regions that best represent visual-semantic information, the tuning shifts were most pronounced in Crus I and II and in lobule VI. Further, the magnitude of attentional tuning shifts was greater in the cerebellum than in the cerebral cortex, particularly for tuning shifts towards the attended category. These differences suggest that attentional modulation in the cerebellum is different than in the cerebral cortex and may not solely be driven by cerebral inputs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注注意如何改变小脑中的视觉-语义表征。研究者让被试观看自然电影片段并分别注意人或车辆，用fMRI结合体素级编码模型比较两种条件下皮层和小脑的视觉-语义调谐变化。结果显示，注意不同语义类别会大幅改变小脑的视觉-语义调谐，部分区域的表征向被注意类别偏移，另一些区域则偏离该类别，其中Crus I、Crus II和小脑叶VI的变化最明显。小脑的注意调谐变化幅度大于大脑皮层，尤其向被注意类别的偏移更突出，提示小脑的注意调制可能不完全依赖皮层输入。

papers.title: Retinal arteriolar tortuosity as a candidate genetic window to inner-ear microvasculature: distributed sharing with blood pressure at CSK and PAWR and a roadmap for larger hearing GWAS
papers.authors: Yang L, Liu Y.
papers.abstract: Background The inner ear is supplied by the labyrinthine artery, which is functionally close to an end artery with limited collateral reserve. Microvascular abnormalities have been implicated in sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL) and age-related hearing loss, yet inner-ear microvasculature cannot be assessed in vivo and current hearing genome-wide association studies (GWAS) are underpowered. We evaluated the shared genetic architecture of retinal arteriolar tortuosity (retina_AT) with blood pressure, cerebral small vessel disease (cSVD) and hearing phenotypes, and examined whether retinal microvasculature could serve as a candidate genetic window to inner-ear microvasculature. Methods We used linkage-disequilibrium score regression (LDSC) to estimate SNP heritability for 19 phenotypes and genome-wide genetic correlations (rg) for 11 prespecified pairs. We ran approximate Bayes-factor colocalization (coloc.abf) between 19 independent retinal loci and systolic blood pressure (SBP), together with 95% credible-set fine-mapping, UCSC gene annotation, colocalization with GTEx aortic and tibial-artery expression QTL (eQTL) data and with white-matter hyperintensities (WMH), hearing-GWAS power calculations, and univariable and multivariable Mendelian randomization (MR) of blood pressure and heart rate on hearing. Results Only retina_AT with SBP was significant genome-wide (rg = 0.10, P = 4.2×10⁻⁵, FDR q = 0.00042). The strongest retinal locus, 13q34, did not colocalize (PP.H3 = 0.996; peaks about 267 kb apart; allelic heterogeneity), whereas two secondary loci colocalized strongly—CSK at 15q24 (PP.H4 = 0.98; 3/3 credible variants within CSK) and PAWR at 12q21 (PP.H4 = 0.99; 3/5 within PAWR)— supported by tissue-matched, moderate eQTL evidence (PP.H4 = 0.71–0.75). At 13q34, retina_AT with WMH was an adequately powered null (PP.H4 = 0.019; only this region and phenotype were tested). On the hearing side, sharing of the blood-pressure magnitude (rg ≈ 0.10) was a near-powered null (about 1.5-fold larger sample needed for 80% power under that assumption, versus about 15-fold for weak rg ≈ 0.03 sharing), and rg ≥ 0.12 was excluded; MR found no robust causal effect. Conclusions Retinal arteriolar tortuosity shows limited, distributed genetic sharing with blood pressure at the vascular-tone genes CSK and PAWR; no sharing with WMH was observed at 13q34 (only this region was tested). Retinal microvasculature may serve as a candidate genetic window to inner-ear microvasculature, but this analogy awaits direct testing by larger, vessel-oriented hearing GWAS and inner-ear tissue functional studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用遗传相关、共定位和孟德尔随机化等方法，评估视网膜小动脉迂曲度与血压、脑小血管病及听力表型之间的共享遗传结构，并探讨视网膜微血管能否作为观察内耳微血管的遗传窗口。结果显示，视网膜小动脉迂曲度仅与收缩压存在显著的全基因组遗传相关，且这种共享是有限而分散的：最强的视网膜位点未与血压共定位，而CSK和PAWR两个次级位点共定位较强，并获得组织匹配的表达数量性状基因座证据支持；在测试区域内未观察到与白质高信号共享，听力方面也未发现稳健的因果效应。作者据此提出，视网膜微血管或可候选性地反映内耳微血管，但这一类比仍需更大规模、面向血管的听力全基因组关联研究和内耳组织功能研究直接检验。

papers.title: Latent Brain-Symptom Dimensions Characterize Heterogeneity in Clinical High Risk for Psychosis
papers.authors: Feng J, Genon S, Eickhoff SB, Li F, Jiang L, Wang Y, Dong D.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Clinical high risk (CHR) for psychosis is characterized by substantial heterogeneity in symptoms, functioning, and outcomes. Although distributed resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC) abnormalities have been reported, it remains unclear whether this heterogeneity can be organized into consistent multivariate brain-symptom dimensions and clinically meaningful subgroups. METHODS: We analyzed RSFC and 34 clinical variables from 701 CHR participants in the Accelerating Medicines Partnership Schizophrenia Program (AMP SCZ). Partial least squares analysis identified latent brain-symptom dimensions, which were further examined using transcriptomic annotation, independent psychosocial and cognitive measures, hierarchical clustering, and Month 2 follow-up data. RESULTS: Two significant brain-symptom dimensions emerged. The first reflected general psychopathology and was associated with somatomotor-salience and higher-order connectivity, with enrichment for genes related to neuronal development. The second, capturing symptom differentiation, spanned negative/internalizing features with psychobehavioral overactivation and involved cerebellar-thalamic-somatomotor circuitry, with enrichment for genes related to synaptic signaling. These dimensions showed dissociable associations with broader psychosocial and cognitive measures, and their loading patterns were substantially reproducible at Month 2. Clustering based on these dimensions identified two biotypes with distinct clinical and connectivity profiles that remained broadly similar at Month 2 despite divergent short-term RSFC changes. CONCLUSIONS: These findings support complementary dimensional and categorical representations of CHR heterogeneity that link clinical variation with distributed brain connectivity and molecular signatures, while demonstrating short-term reproducibility of the identified dimensions and divergent RSFC changes across biotypes. This multilevel framework may help characterize biologically meaningful variation in psychosis risk.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神病临床高危人群在症状与功能上的异质性，能否用一致的多变量脑-症状维度来组织，并据此划分有临床意义的亚组。作者分析了该人群的静息态功能连接与多项临床变量，用偏最小二乘分析提取出两个显著的脑-症状维度：一个反映一般精神病理，涉及感觉运动-突显及高级连接，并富集神经发育相关基因；另一个刻画症状分化，涵盖阴性/内化特征与心理行为过度激活，涉及小脑-丘脑-感觉运动环路，富集突触信号相关基因。两个维度与心理社会和认知测量的关联可分离，其载荷模式在短期随访中基本可重现；基于维度聚类得到两种生物型，临床与连接特征不同，短期功能连接变化方向亦不同。作者认为这支持对高危异质性同时作维度和分类刻画，但结论限于关联与短期可重复性，未涉及治疗或临床预测效用。

papers.title: A representation of the visual environment in the human basolateral amygdala supports learning and choice
papers.authors: Jang G, Riels K, Aberman E, Tao G, Kragel PA.
papers.abstract: Animals continuously transform sensory inputs into representations that guide behavior. Although the amygdala is a brain structure critical for learning and choice, how natural sensory experience is represented within this circuit remains unknown. Here, we identify a representation of the visual environment in the human basolateral amygdala (BLA) that contains information relevant for learning and choice. Using image-computable encoding models trained on responses to naturalistic videos, we recover a continuous, low-dimensional representation of visual experience in the BLA. The representation generalizes across individuals and independent datasets and prospectively predicts BLA responses to novel visual stimuli generated through closed-loop image synthesis. Signals derived from the representation also informed reinforcement-learning models of human choice. Together, these findings show that the human BLA organizes complex visual experience into a structured representation that can support learning and flexible behavioral responses.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类基底外侧杏仁核如何表征自然视觉经验，并考察这种表征是否与学习和选择有关。作者用基于自然视频反应训练的、可由图像计算的编码模型，在人类基底外侧杏仁核中恢复出一个连续的低维视觉环境表征。该表征能跨个体和独立数据集泛化，并可前瞻性预测对新合成视觉刺激的杏仁核反应；由该表征导出的信号还能为人类选择的强化学习模型提供信息。结果表明，人类基底外侧杏仁核将复杂视觉经验组织成结构化表征，可能支持学习与灵活的行为反应。

papers.title: Modulation of the speed of Intrinsic Alpha Frequency (IAF) with tACS modulates variability of illusory speech perception
papers.authors: Deb S, Bhunia D, Singh VAV, Muralidharan V, Roy D.
papers.abstract: Navigating the world requires our brains to constantly process a massive influx of information from the environment. One of the most remarkable yet complex feats the human brain performs daily is speech perception. It is a multifaceted, hierarchical process that relies heavily on the integration of auditory and visual cues, particularly in noisy environments. Neural integration of these streams is hypothesized to depend on temporal mechanisms governed by individual alpha frequency (IAF, 8-12 Hz), which serves as a key neural correlate of the temporal binding window (TBW). While IAF has been linked to multisensory integration, its role in shaping multisensory illusions remains largely unexplored. Here, we tested this directly using transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) to modulate occipital activity during multisensory conflict. In a two-day protocol involving 27 healthy participants, resting-state EEG was recorded to determine IAF. On Day 2, participants then performed a multisensory speech task involving congruent (pa/, /ta/, /ka/) and incongruent McGurk stimuli (auditory /pa/, visual /ka/), both at baseline and during tACS applied at IAF and offset frequencies (IAF ± 2 Hz) over occipital electrodes. While accuracy for congruent syllables remained high across conditions, results revealed that tACS significantly reduced the perception of illusory /ta/ percepts during McGurk trials. Finally, using a phenomenological model based on Kuramoto oscillators, we provided a mechanistic explanation for the percentage of illusory responses observed across participants under the influence of tACS at IAF and offsets. This study highlights the potential for targeted neuromodulatory interventions to influence multisensory processing in clinical or professional settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨个体α频率（IAF）是否以及如何影响多感官言语错觉，采用枕区tACS调控健康参与者的脑活动，并结合静息态脑电与McGurk言语任务进行检验。结果显示，一致音节的识别在各条件下保持较高水平，而tACS显著降低了对McGurk冲突刺激的虚幻/ta/知觉；作者还用基于Kuramoto振子的现象学模型解释了不同刺激频率下虚幻反应比例的变化。研究提示，针对IAF的神经调控可能影响多感官整合，并为临床或专业场景中的干预提供了初步线索，但实际应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: FMR1 Perturbations Disrupt Sensory Corticostriatal Circuits and Mitochondrial Energetics in Fragile X Syndrome
papers.authors: Yan Y, Li D, Yuan J, Feng D, Chang J, Zhang F, Xiong M, Jiang Y, Yan B, Xu Q, Li R, He Y, Liu P, Shao M, Shen M.
papers.abstract: Fragile X syndrome (FXS) features sensory, social, and cognitive dysfunction, but how fragile X messenger ribonucleoprotein 1 (FMR1) deficiency disrupts sensory corticostriatal circuitry and whether distinct FMR1 perturbations converge on shared cellular mechanisms remain incompletely defined. We integrated diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in individuals with FXS and Fmr1-knockout (KO) mice with projection-defined calcium recording, bidirectional optogenetic manipulation, primary somatosensory cortex (S1)-targeted expression of three patient-associated FMR1 missense variants, regional transcriptomics, and optical manipulation of mitochondrial energetic state. Individuals with FXS exhibited disrupted sensory corticostriatal structural connectivity, with mouse analyses further localizing abnormalities to S1–striatal pathways. Fmr1 deficiency impaired recruitment of the S1–dorsomedial striatum (DMS) pathway during social interaction, and projection-specific manipulation demonstrated that S1–DMS dysfunction contributes to social and cognitive deficits. Three patient-associated FMR1 variants, I234T, E329G, and R586Q, converged on social behavioral deficits, which were improved by S1–DMS activation. Transcriptomic analyses revealed convergent oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS)-related mitochondrial remodeling in S1 and DMS across Fmr1 deficiency and variant models. Systemic treatment with the mitochondria-targeted antioxidant MitoQ attenuated novel-location-recognition, social-interaction, and social-novelty deficits in Fmr1 -KO mice. Moreover, mt-EcGAPR-based Mitochondrial OptoEnergetic Activation (Mito-OptoEA) enhanced mitochondrial energetic state in S1 and improved novel-location recognition and sociability in both Fmr1 -KO and I234T models. Together, these findings define a sensory corticostriatal circuit–metabolic framework for FXS in which S1–DMS circuit dysfunction and convergent mitochondrial energetic abnormalities contribute to FMR1 -related social and cognitive phenotypes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注FMR1缺陷如何破坏感觉皮层-纹状体环路，以及不同FMR1扰动是否汇聚到共同的细胞机制。作者结合FXS患者扩散磁共振成像、Fmr1敲除小鼠的投射特异性钙记录与光遗传操作、患者相关错义变体在S1的表达、转录组学及线粒体能量状态操控，发现患者存在感觉皮层-纹状体结构连接异常，小鼠分析进一步定位到S1-背内侧纹状体通路。该通路在社交互动中招募受损，其功能障碍参与社交和认知缺陷；三种患者变体均导致社交行为缺陷，激活该通路可改善。转录组分析显示S1和DMS存在汇聚的氧化磷酸化相关线粒体重塑，线粒体靶向抗氧化剂和光遗传增强线粒体能量状态均能改善小鼠的行为缺陷。这些结果提示S1-DMS环路功能障碍与线粒体能量异常共同贡献于FXS相关表型。

papers.title: Tonotopic mapping in children shows an overrepresentation of high frequencies in autism
papers.authors: Chen B, Boxberger A, Mahmalji J, Do T, Herrera M, Tuy S, De Oliveira Campos GA, Sereno MI, Fishman I, Linke AC.
papers.abstract: Altered sensitivity to sounds despite normal peripheral hearing is common in neurodevelopmental disorders but the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here we investigate tonotopic organization in 86 children (6-11 years) with autism spectrum and related neurodevelopmental disorders as well as typically developing (TD) peers, using a child-friendly, passive listening, functional magnetic resonance imaging design. In TD children, tonotopic maps in primary auditory cortex resembled the typical high-low-high frequency gradients previously reported in adults, while children with autism showed an overrepresentation of high frequencies consistent with what has been observed in animal models of autism. Higher frequency tuning further correlated with greater caregiver-reported sound but not touch sensitivities. Importantly, tonotopy is a core organizational feature of auditory cortex that develops early in life and remains relatively stable after the critical period of heightened plasticity ends. Thus, these results suggest that atypical auditory processing in autism may result from early disruption to tonotopic map formation. Longitudinal neuroimaging studies are needed to understand the genetic and environmental causes of altered auditory cortex topology and its long-term consequences for higher-level auditory, language, and social communication development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自闭症及相关神经发育障碍儿童听觉皮层的频率拓扑组织是否异常，采用适合儿童的被动听声功能磁共振设计，比较了自闭症谱系及相关障碍儿童与典型发育儿童。结果显示，典型发育儿童的初级听觉皮层频率映射与成人报道的高—低—高梯度相似，而自闭症儿童表现出高频过度表征，与自闭症动物模型中的观察一致；较高频率调谐还与照护者报告的声音敏感（而非触觉敏感）相关。作者据此提出，自闭症中非典型的听觉加工可能源于频率拓扑图形成的早期扰动，但这一解释仍需纵向神经影像研究检验其遗传与环境成因及对高级听觉、语言和社交沟通发展的长期影响。

papers.title: Mapping reward processing circuits: the orbitofrontal-nucleus accumbens white matter pathways and their associations to psychopathological traits
papers.authors: Mezzano S, Saini F, Orbecchi V, Fernández-Borkel T, Raghavan M, Irfanoglu M, Beyh A, Dell’Acqua F.
papers.abstract: Dysfunctions in reward circuits, including projections from the orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) to the nucleus accumbens (NAcc), have been implicated in psychopathology. The OFC is functionally divided into the medial OFC (mOFC), which processes rewards, and the lateral OFC (lOFC), which responds to non-reward or punishment stimuli. We investigated the structural connectivity of the lOFC-NAcc and mOFC-NAcc pathways and their associations with psychopathological traits using tractography-defined ROI analysis. Diffusion-weighted imaging data from 165 participants (aged 22 - 35, 53% male) in the Human Connectome Project (HCP) were analysed using spherical deconvolution tractography. MegaTrack, a novel tool, enabled tract segmentation via a single manual dissection mapped back to native space. Virtual dissection identified four bilateral pathways connecting the lOFC and mOFC to the NAcc, from which fractional anisotropy (FA) was extracted, and an lOFC/mOFC ratio was computed. Psychopathological traits were measured using HCP Achenbach Adult Self-Report scores. The lOFC-NAcc pathway showed positive associations with psychopathology and the mOFC-NAcc pathway negative associations. The lOFC/mOFC ratio emerged as a stronger predictor than individual pathways, with significant associations for depression, somatic problems, anti-social personality traits, and inattention. Effects were lateralized to the left hemisphere. These findings show that the lOFC-NAcc and mOFC-NAcc pathways can be structurally separated with tractography and display opposing correlations with psychopathological traits in a healthy population. Their ratio may index reward-processing dysfunction, and future research should test whether it is sensitive to dysfunction in clinical populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注眶额皮层至伏隔核的奖赏通路结构连接是否与精神病理特质相关，利用弥散加权成像和纤维束追踪，在健康成人中分别重建了外侧与内侧眶额-伏隔核通路，并计算两者各向异性比值。结果显示，外侧通路与精神病理特质呈正相关，内侧通路呈负相关，且两者比值比单条通路更能预测抑郁、躯体问题、反社会人格特质和注意力不足，效应偏向左半球。作者据此提出，该比值或可反映奖赏加工功能异常，但其对临床人群的敏感性尚待检验。

papers.title: Spoken language comprehension relies on context-dependent neural weighting of syntax and prosody
papers.authors: Coopmans CW, Martin AE.
papers.abstract: Comprehending spoken language requires extracting syntactic structure and meaning from a continuous acoustic signal. Psycholinguistic evidence points to a key role for prosody in this process. However, because interactions between prosody and syntax are typically demonstrated using carefully controlled sentence constructions, it remains unclear whether such interactions constitute a general, default property of spoken language processing. Addressing this question requires naturalistic, broad-coverage data. Here, we combined experimental psycholinguistics with naturalistic neuroscience to investigate the joint neural encoding of syntax and prosody in MEG recordings of 26 participants (19 female) listening to narrative speech. Linguistic annotations revealed that strong prosodic boundaries tend to coincide with syntactic phrase closures, and that the strength of prosodic boundaries scales with the number of phrases closed. Using time-resolved regression with temporal response functions, we modeled how these features relate to delta-band neural activity during continuous speech processing. Our results reveal a bidirectional interaction between syntax and prosody. Prosodic marking modulates the neural processing of syntax, with phrase closures being encoded more strongly when accompanied by strong prosodic boundaries. Conversely, syntactic structure shapes prosodic encoding, such that boundary strength is neurally encoded primarily at points of syntactic phrase closure. These findings demonstrate that syntax and prosody are encoded not independently, but in a context-dependent and mutually constraining manner, highlighting their joint role in guiding structure building during naturalistic spoken language comprehension. Significance statement How the brain transforms continuous sensory stimulation into structured representations is a central question in cognitive neuroscience. Spoken language comprehension provides a particularly compelling case: as the acoustic signal alone underdetermines linguistic meaning, the brain must integrate bottom-up sensory information with top-down linguistic knowledge, such as syntax. Here, we recorded brain activity during audiobook listening to examine how syntax and prosody jointly shape neural responses to narrative speech. We find evidence for a bidirectional neural interaction: prosody modulates the neural encoding of syntax, and syntactic context shapes the neural encoding of prosody. These findings suggest that the brain flexibly integrates bottom-up and top-down information depending on how informative each cue is for extracting structured meaning from naturalistic speech.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然叙事语音理解中句法与韵律是否以及如何共同影响神经活动，结合心理语言学实验与脑磁图记录，让被试聆听有声书并借助时间分辨回归建模连续语音下的神经响应。结果显示二者存在双向交互：强韵律边界会增强句法短语闭合的神经编码，而韵律边界强度也主要在句法短语闭合处被神经编码，说明句法与韵律并非独立加工，而是以依赖语境、相互约束的方式共同参与结构构建。这一发现提示，在自然语音理解中，大脑会依据各线索的信息量灵活整合自下而上与自上而下的信息。

papers.title: Intracranial characterization of gamma in humans in response to auditory gratings
papers.authors: Gulati D, Rao MB, Mundlamuri RC, Arimappamagan A, Sadashiva N, Sinha S, Kenchaiah R, Asranna A, Viswanathan LG, Ray S.
papers.abstract: Activity in the gamma frequency range (>30Hz) serves as a neural hallmark of stimulus encoding across multiple sensory modalities. Based on its distinct properties, this activity could be classified as broadband or narrowband oscillations. Visual stimuli, such as a grating, induce narrowband oscillations, which have shown promise as diagnostic markers for neurological disorders. However, such tasks are discomforting for the subjects. These can be made subject-friendly by swapping the stimulus for an auditory one; however, most auditory stimuli elicit a broadband activity. In search of an ideal candidate to induce auditory narrowband oscillations, we previously recorded responses to auditory gratings in electroencephalography (EEG) recordings (Gulati & Ray, 2024) using a passive listening paradigm. We observed a focal sustained broadband increase in high gamma activity (70-150Hz), which was not selective towards any stimulus attributes. Nevertheless, since EEG represents activity of a large population, it remained unclear whether observed activity represented a broadband increase or comprised multiple narrowband rhythms, and whether it was indeed untuned. To elucidate this, we recorded invasively from the regions on and around the superior temporal gyrus, closer to Heschl’s gyrus of seven patients undergoing epilepsy resection surgery. Patients were either under anesthesia or fully awake while we presented auditory gratings through loudspeakers. We found a transient increase in broadband gamma activity (30-100Hz) followed by a sustained suppression of beta rhythm (14-28Hz). This broadband gamma was selective for slower spectro-temporal modulations. Our result compares the responses obtained across different recording scales and corroborates that auditory gratings produce broadband but not narrowband gamma activity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注听觉光栅刺激能否诱发类似视觉光栅的窄带伽马振荡，以寻找对受试者更友好的诊断性刺激。作者在癫痫切除手术患者中，于清醒或麻醉状态下通过扬声器呈现听觉光栅，并直接记录颞上回及邻近区域（靠近Heschl回）的颅内活动。结果显示，听觉光栅引起的是瞬时的宽带伽马活动（30-100Hz），随后伴随持续的beta节律抑制，且该宽带伽马对较慢的频谱-时间调制具有选择性。作者据此指出，听觉光栅产生的是宽带而非窄带伽马活动，这在不同记录尺度间具有可比性，也提示此前EEG中观察到的聚焦性高伽马增强可能并非由多个窄带节律叠加而成。

papers.title: Whole-brain receptor markers and hub excitabilities determine acute and long-term outcomes in stroke
papers.authors: Schulte J, Vohryzek J, Monge i Asensio M, Zamora-López G, Patow G, Sanz Perl Y, Corbetta M, Deco G.
papers.abstract: Following a stroke, changes in receptor systems have been observed that may influence the excitability of affected brain regions and drive recovery trajectories. Translating results from animal studies to patients remains a major challenge, and while imaging modalities have provided a wealth of findings, a mechanistic link between local receptor systems and observed imaging data is still missing. To bridge this gap, we built patient-specific digital twins with their own neuromodulatory profiles: we integrated 19 receptor and transporter density maps into a mechanistic whole-brain model, and estimated their influence on cortical excitability for each stroke patient and how these systems subsequently explain recovery trajectories. We found that distinct receptor profiles modulated excitability in perilesional versus non-perilesional tissue. Favourable acute motor outcomes were most strongly explained by increased inhibition mediated by non-perilesional GABA-A receptors, together with enhanced excitability driven by cannabinoid, histaminergic, and noradrenergic systems. For acute language outcomes, we identified receptor signatures that, together with motor findings, formed two cross-domain clusters linking excitability to either better or poorer performance. Remarkably, structurally highly connected hubs played a key role: their acute excitability explained cognitive and language deficits and predicted language recovery at one year. Together, our results establish a mechanistic link between receptor-specific modulation of cortical excitability and behavioural recovery, highlighting potential targets for pharmacological and non-invasive therapeutic interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注卒中后局部受体系统如何通过调节皮层兴奋性影响急性表现与长期恢复，并针对动物结果难以转化到患者的问题，构建了整合多种受体与转运体密度图谱的患者个体化全脑数字孪生模型。结果显示，不同受体谱对病灶周围与非病灶周围组织兴奋性的调节方式不同：急性运动结局较好主要与非病灶区GABA-A受体介导的抑制增强，以及大麻素、组胺能和去甲肾上腺素能系统驱动的兴奋性提升相关；语言结局则呈现与运动结果相连的跨域受体特征。结构高度连接的枢纽区，其急性兴奋性可解释认知与语言缺损，并预测一年后的语言恢复。作者据此提出受体特异性兴奋性调节与行为恢复之间的机制联系，并指出潜在的药物与非侵入性干预靶点，但相关结论仍属模型推断，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Global statistical constraint and local partner-sensitive inference support dynamic, open-ended verbal coordination
papers.authors: Zhang T, Shaw DJ, Zhou S, Zhu L, Lu C.
papers.abstract: Effective verbal communication requires individuals to align their communicative intentions through the precise use of utterances, yet how this is achieved in dynamic, open-ended communication remains unclear. Combining predictive deep language models (DLMs) with cognitive computational modeling, we tested a computational division of labor between context-sensitive global constraint on the utterance space and partner-sensitive local adjustment of selection priorities. We formalized local adjustment using an active-inference-inspired updating rule within a statistical– pragmatic hybrid model. Thirty dyads performed a dynamic, open-ended collaborative word-generation task during functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) hyperscanning. Interlocutors converged in their lexical choices, and lexical alignment was best explained by a hybrid model integrating contextual selection priors with interaction-specific local adjustment among the models tested. This hybrid process formed a dynamic hypothesis landscape comprising a global semantic search region and local selection priorities. Critically, interaction did not simply reduce uncertainty: within individuals, the hypothesis space of global semantic search progressively narrowed while local uncertainty among plausible alternatives increased; between partners, both global hypothesis space and local selection became increasingly aligned, with alignment of local selection priorities most strongly predicting subsequent lexical alignment. The contribution of local adjustment was stronger during precise verbal communication than in the control tasks. Neural analyses further identified correlates of the local adjustment process: temporoparietal and anterior temporal regions supported partner-related inference and semantic prediction error, respectively, and their activity during thinking predicted subsequent inferior frontal activity associated with self-updating during speaking. The participant’s own hypothesis landscape was also represented in the left inferior parietal–supramarginal cortex. The main findings generalized across language models and an independent Czech dataset. Together, these findings reveal that alignment in open-ended communication emerges from complementary statistical and pragmatic computations, providing a framework for understanding human and human–AI communication.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注动态开放式言语交流中双方如何实现词汇对齐，结合预测性深度语言模型与认知计算建模，让被试在fNIRS超扫描下完成协作词语生成任务。结果显示，词汇对齐最好由融合语境选择先验与互动特异性局部调整的混合模型解释：互动中个体全局语义搜索空间逐步收窄，而局部备选间的不确定性上升，双方在全局假设空间和局部选择上均趋于一致，且局部选择优先级的对齐最能预测随后的词汇对齐。局部调整在精确言语交流中作用更强，并伴随颞顶和前颞等区域的活动，这些结果在多个语言模型和独立数据集中得到推广。

papers.title: Experimental Evaluation of the Mechanical Properties and Microstructure of Cemented Paste Backfill Containing Rheological Modifier.
papers.authors: Gao B, Li J, Zhang H, Kou Y, Li G, Li Q, Song W.
papers.abstract: The macroscopic mechanical properties of cemented paste backfill (CPB) are closely related to its microstructural evolution. However, the mechanism by which rheology modifier influences the mechanical properties of CPB while improving the flowability of the backfill slurry remains unclear. This study investigated the effects of different cementitious material-to-tailings ratios (c/t) (1:6, 1:8, 1:10) in CPB containing a rheological modifier on the mechanical properties and microstructure at various curing ages (7 d, 14 d, 28 d). Strength parameters and failure characteristics of CPB were determined through uniaxial compression tests and direct shear tests. Pore structure, crack analysis, and microstructural characterization were conducted using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), computed tomography (CT), and scanning electron microscopy (SEM/EDS). The results of the study indicate that both uniaxial compressive strength and shear strength increase with higher c/t ratios and longer curing periods. The addition of rheological modifier resulted in a 0.9% to 31.5% reduction in uniaxial compressive strength. This negative effect was more pronounced at low c/t ratios and during early-stage curing. However, the effect on shear strength is twofold. Cohesion decreased significantly, while the angle of internal friction increased slightly. Therefore, the strength-reducing effect of the rheological modifier is somewhat mitigated under high normal stress conditions. Analysis of the stress-strain curves indicates that the rheological modifier increased the deformation during the pore consolidation stage and reduced the slope during the linearly elastic stage. However, it slowed the post-peak failure rate, suggesting that it improved the ductility characteristics of CPB to a certain extent. CT analysis showed that the rheological modifier increased the extent of crack damage and the fractal dimension, but did not alter the overall tensile-shear composite failure mode. NMR and SEM analyses further confirmed that the rheological modifier increased the number of micropores, but did not alter the type or elemental composition of the hydration products. This study elucidates the mechanisms by which rheological modifier influences the macroscopic mechanical behavior, pore structure, crack evolution, and microstructure of CPB. It provides a theoretical basis for the optimization of CPB mix designs and the engineering application of rheological modifier.

papers.title: Identification of CLOCK and MARK2 as Candidate Blood-Based Biomarkers in Type 2 Diabetes: An Integrated Bulk and Single-Cell Transcriptomic Study.
papers.authors: Yang L, Tang J, Zhang D, Yun P.
papers.abstract: Background: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is often accompanied by nervous system complications. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying T2DM remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to identify candidate blood-based biomarkers associated with T2DM by screening a neural-related gene set through integrated bulk and single-cell transcriptomic analysis of peripheral blood. The present analysis focused on the systemic expression patterns of the selected genes in peripheral blood as indicators of T2DM-associated immunometabolic dysregulation, rather than on neurological involvement. The neural-related gene set was used only as a predefined screening starting point. Methods: We employed a three-tier validation framework comprising (1) a training cohort (GSE15932, 8 T2DM patients vs. 8 controls) for biomarker discovery using differential expression analysis and machine learning (XGBoost, random forest, and PPI network topology); (2) an independent validation cohort (GSE184050, 50 T2DM patients vs. 65 controls) for cross-dataset diagnostic performance assessment (ROC analysis); and (3) an experimental validation cohort (5 T2DM patients vs. 5 controls) for independent clinical confirmation by RT-qPCR. Additionally, single-cell RNA sequencing (GSE268210) was used to investigate cell type-specific expression and immune regulatory networks. Results: By combining multiple screening methods and cross-dataset validation, we identified CLOCK and MARK2 as key candidate genes from the neural-related gene set. CLOCK and MARK2 showed high discriminatory performance in the discovery cohort, whereas their AUCs were 0.613 and 0.653, respectively, in the validation cohort, indicating limited standalone discriminatory ability. Both genes are highly expressed in peripheral blood monocytes and are associated with MIF-(CD74+CXCR4)-mediated cell communication, TNFA-NFκB inflammatory signaling, and activation of oxidative phosphorylation pathways. Finally, RT-qPCR in clinical samples confirmed that both genes were indeed upregulated (p < 0.05). Conclusions: CLOCK and MARK2 were identified as candidate T2DM-associated blood-based biomarkers with reproducible expression differences across datasets. Their discriminatory performance was more modest in the independent validation cohort, indicating limited standalone diagnostic utility. Single-cell and computational analyses further suggested potential immunometabolic relevance. Because neurological phenotyping, cognitive assessment, and direct measures of nervous system involvement were not available in this study, any relationship between these genes and the neurological manifestations of T2DM remains speculative and hypothesis-generating, and requires prospective validation in cohorts with matched neurocognitive data.

papers.title: Quantitative MRI Characterization of Fluid-Related Phenotypes in Pediatric Epilepsy: Deep Learning-Assisted Assessment of Enlarged Perivascular Space Burden, Regional Distribution, and Clinical Associations.
papers.authors: Aytaç A, Aydın H.
papers.abstract: Objective: To quantitatively characterize EPVS burden and regional distribution, together with CP and ventricular CSF structural imaging phenotypes, in pediatric epilepsy and to explore within-epilepsy clinical associations of EPVS measures differing from controls. Methods: This retrospective cross-sectional study included 123 children with epilepsy and 108 controls aged 10-17 years. Enlarged perivascular space (EPVS), choroid plexus (CP), and ventricular cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) structural imaging phenotypes were quantitatively assessed using SHIVA-PVS, FreeSurfer, and 3D Slicer with expert visual quality control. Primary between-group comparisons used general linear models adjusted for age and sex, with estimated total intracranial volume additionally included for absolute volumetric measures, and multiple comparisons were controlled using the false discovery rate (FDR). Exploratory within-epilepsy clinical-association analyses were subsequently performed for EPVS measures showing FDR-significant between-group differences. Results: Global EPVS burden was higher in the epilepsy group than in controls (q < 0.01), with the most pronounced regional differences in the basal ganglia (BG; q < 0.001). Relative distribution measures showed higher BG burden and lower centrum semiovale (CSO) burden and CSO/BG ratios in epilepsy (q < 0.01). No statistically significant between-group differences were observed in the CP or ventricular CSF phenotypes. In exploratory within-epilepsy analyses, longer disease duration and drug resistance were associated predominantly with BG-EPVS measures, whereas associations with antiseizure medication burden were limited. Bilateral epileptiform activity was also associated with higher BG-EPVS burden after FDR correction (q < 0.05). Conclusions: Primary between-group analyses identified greater EPVS burden in pediatric epilepsy, with the most pronounced regional differences involving the BG. Exploratory within-epilepsy analyses identified associations between selected EPVS measures and specific clinical characteristics. These cross-sectional structural imaging findings characterize a regional EPVS phenotype for further longitudinal and multimodal investigation but do not establish an underlying glymphatic mechanism.

papers.title: Probable neuronal intranuclear inclusion disease in an Asian woman without detectable NOTCH2NLC repeat expansion on routine testing
papers.authors: Xie S, Wen J, Liu Y, Lin X.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Neuronal intranuclear inclusion disease (NIID) is a clinically heterogeneous neurodegenerative disorder characterized by eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions. GGC repeat expansion in NOTCH2NLC is strongly associated with adult-onset NIID in East Asian populations. Fragile X-associated tremor/ataxia syndrome (FXTAS), associated with an FMR1 CGG premutation, can overlap with NIID clinically, radiologically, and pathologically. Negative targeted repeat-expansion results therefore require interpretation alongside clinicopathological findings. Case presentation: A 67-year-old Asian woman with no known family history of neurological disease developed progressive cognitive decline in 2021, followed by limb ataxia and bilateral lower-limb weakness. In 2025, her ADL and mRS scores were 51/56 and 3; MoCA and MMSE scores were 8/30 and 19/30. Electrophysiological findings suggested predominantly motor demyelinating polyneuropathy. Brain MRI showed bilateral corticomedullary-junction hyperintensities on DWI and confluent periventricular and deep white-matter abnormalities on FLAIR and T2WI. A skin biopsy obtained above the lateral malleolus showed eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions in sweat gland epithelial cells and fibroblasts, with positive SQSTM1/p62 and SUMO1 immunostaining. RP-PCR did not detect a NOTCH2NLC GGC repeat expansion. Both FMR1 alleles were reported to contain 29 CGG repeats, below the premutation range. During 14 months of follow-up, no impaired consciousness, seizures, or encephalopathy-like episodes occurred, and the mRS Scale score remained 3. Cognitive scores changed in opposite directions, precluding conclusions about cognitive change or treatment response. The clinical, radiological, and previously reported pathological findings supported probable NIID, apparently sporadic, without molecular confirmation. Conclusions: Characteristic MRI and skin biopsy findings remain diagnostically informative when routine NOTCH2NLC screening detects no expansion. FMR1 analysis aids differentiation from FXTAS. A negative targeted result alone should neither exclude NIID nor imply a novel causative gene; confirmation using an independent repeat-expansion assay or long-read sequencing should be considered when available.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例临床疑似神经元核内包涵体病（NIID）的亚洲女性病例，核心问题是常规NOTCH2NLC重复扩增检测阴性时如何解读诊断。患者表现为进行性认知下降、肢体共济失调和双下肢无力，脑MRI显示特征性皮质髓质交界处弥散受限及白质异常，皮肤活检在汗腺上皮细胞和成纤维细胞中见嗜酸性核内包涵体，免疫染色支持该发现；但RP-PCR未检出NOTCH2NLC的GGC重复扩增，FMR1两个等位基因均为29个CGG重复，低于前突变范围。作者据此认为，临床、影像和病理所见支持可能为散发性NIID，但缺乏分子确诊；随访期间未出现意识障碍、癫痫或脑病样发作，认知评分变化方向不一致，无法就认知变化或治疗反应下结论。文章强调，常规靶向检测阴性既不能排除NIID，也不意味着存在新的致病基因，必要时应考虑用独立重复扩增检测或长读长测序加以确认，FMR1分析则有助于与FXTAS鉴别。

papers.title: An EEG-informed fNIRS framework uncovers stage-associated cortical dynamics during unassisted upper-limb movement after stroke
papers.authors: Wang M, Chen X, Li Z, Gong Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Upper-limb impairment after stroke is primarily characterized by the emergence and resolution of spastic synergies. Brunnstrom staging captures these recovery phases and provides a clinically grounded framework for studying cortical reorganization. Applying functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) during ecological gross-motor tasks introduces task-related systemic hemodynamic artifacts that obscure focal cortical signals. This study aims to determine whether an EEG-informed multimodal framework can effectively mitigate these artifacts and extract stage-sensitive patterns of cortical reorganization. Methods After multimodal quality control, 32 participants with stroke (Brunnstrom stages III–VI) and 15 healthy controls were enrolled. EEG and fNIRS were recorded simultaneously during an auditory-cued unilateral arm-raising task with concomitant fist clenching, comprising movement initiation, sustained elevation, and rest. Our framework combined Filter Bank Common Spatial Pattern (FBCSP) with an EEG-informed General Linear Model (GLM). FBCSP extracted focal sensorimotor features, while EEG-derived motor-intention regressors improved GLM modeling of task-related hemodynamic responses. Model performance was evaluated using R ² and ΔAIC, and feature discriminability using AUC from a linear discriminant analysis (LDA) classifier. Results The proposed FBCSP-GLM framework demonstrated improved model fit and spatial discriminability compared with conventional analytical approaches. Participant-level FBCSP estimates revealed a distinct non-linear, stage-associated trajectory of cortical reorganization. Specifically, the FBCSP-derived EW-LI significantly decreased from 0.46 at Stage III to − 0.55 at Stage IV, and rebounded to 0.13 at Stage V.
