The target-M1 response t -score similarly dropped from − 0.06 to − 1.05 before increasing to 0.85 at Stage V (all FDR-corrected q < 0.01). The standard GLM did not capture these stage-associated patterns, as its corresponding comparisons did not survive FDR correction. Conclusions By improving hemodynamic model fit during ecological gross-motor execution, the EEG-informed multimodal framework reveals cortical reorganization patterns associated with post-stroke synergistic recovery stages. Its artifact-resilient EW-LI and target-M1 response t -score provide a robust computational assessment of neural state transitions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注脑卒中后上肢运动恢复过程中，能否用脑电引导的多模态框架去除fNIRS在真实粗大运动任务中的系统性血流动力学伪迹，并提取与Brunnstrom分期相关的皮层重组模式。作者同步采集脑电与fNIRS，比较所提出的FBCSP-GLM框架与传统分析方法的模型拟合和空间区分能力。结果显示，新框架的拟合与区分表现更好，并呈现出非线性的分期相关轨迹：皮层偏侧化指标和靶区M1反应在III至V期之间先降后升，而标准GLM未能捕捉这些模式。作者据此认为，该框架可为卒中后协同恢复阶段的神经状态转变提供较稳健的计算评估，但结论限于所纳入的分期范围，尚不涉及治疗效应。

papers.title: Mechanical Digitorum Sensory Stimulation Enhances Hemiplegic Upper Limb Motor Function in Stroke Patients by Increasing Cortical Excitability and Functional Connectivity
papers.authors: Huang W, Zhang H, Yu J, Ma Y, Li Q, Wu R, Yao Y, Zhang S, Hong Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Relieving flexor spasticity, enhancing extensor strength, and improving hand function in patients with stroke remain significant clinical challenges. Mechanical Digitorum Sensory Stimulation (MDSS), a novel therapy that applies precise mechanical pressure to the affected fingers, may address these issues; however, its effects and mechanisms have not been thoroughly studied. Methods Sixty convalescent patients with post-stroke hemiplegia were randomly assigned to a Control group (conventional rehabilitation + sham MDSS) or an MDSS group (conventional rehabilitation + MDSS) for 3–4 weeks. Muscle spasticity, strength, upper-limb motor function, and activities of daily living were assessed using the Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS), Manual Muscle Testing (MMT), Fugl-Meyer Assessment–Upper Extremity (FMA-UE), and Modified Barthel Index (MBI), respectively. Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) was used to measure oxyhemoglobin (HbO) concentrations in regions of interest (ROIs) during the resting state (RS) and task state (TS; i.e., MDSS) to evaluate cortical excitability and functional connectivity (FC) by calculating correlations of HbO concentration changes between specific ROIs. Results After the intervention, the MDSS group showed significantly lower MAS scores for all finger flexors ( P < 0.001) and significantly higher MMT scores for all finger extensors, as well as higher FMA-UE and MBI scores ( P < 0.01) compared with the Control group. Regarding cortical excitability, increases in HbO concentration were higher in most ROIs in the MDSS group than in the Control group, including 10 ROIs (83.33%) during RS and 11 ROIs (91.67%) during TS. Moreover, increases in FC across all ROI-to-ROI pairs were greater in the MDSS group than in the Control group during both RS and TS. Conclusions MDSS effectively alleviates flexor spasticity, enhances extensor strength, and improves upper-limb motor function in patients with stroke. These effects are associated with enhanced cortical excitability and strengthened functional connectivity, supporting MDSS as a promising rehabilitation strategy for hemiparetic hand recovery. Trial registration The study protocol was registered in the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (Website https//www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.html?proj=176575 Registration Number ChiCTR2200063792)
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨机械指部感觉刺激（MDSS）能否改善脑卒中后偏瘫患者的上肢运动功能，并将60名恢复期患者随机分为常规康复加伪刺激的对照组和加MDSS的干预组，比较干预前后的痉挛、肌力、上肢运动功能与日常生活能力，并用功能性近红外光谱测量静息和任务状态下的皮层兴奋性与功能连接。结果显示，MDSS组手指屈肌痉挛评分低于对照组，伸肌肌力及上肢运动功能、日常生活能力评分更高；同时多数感兴趣区的氧合血红蛋白反应增强，各脑区间的功能连接也更强。作者据此认为，MDSS改善偏瘫手功能的效应与皮层兴奋性提高和功能连接增强相关，提示其可能是一种有前景的康复策略，但摘要未说明这些机制变化与行为改善之间的因果关系。

papers.title: Depressive and PTSD symptoms are associated with regional differences in light-evoked brain responses in chronic ocular pain
papers.authors: Moulton E, Karakoleva E, Valdes-Arias D, Pattany P, Faria V, Helix E, Galor A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background/Objectives: Chronic ocular pain (COP) often co-occurs with depression or post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), but whether these comorbidities confer a distinct biological signature is unknown. Thus, we compared light-evoked blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) responses in individuals with COP, stratified by the presence or absence of clinically relevant depressive and/or PTSD symptoms. Subjects/Methods: 43 individuals with COP (pain intensity ≥ 1/10 for ≥ 3 months) underwent event-related functional magnetic resonance imaging using bright-light. Thirty participants were classified as COP with mental health comorbidity (COP + MHC+) based on a Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) score ≥ 5 and/or a PTSD Checklist-Military Version (PCL-M) ≥ 33; 13 were classified as COP without MHC (COP + MHC-). BOLD responses exceeding an exploratory voxelwise threshold of Z > 2.3 were compared within predefined bilateral regions of interest (ROIs) comprising the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), anterior mid-cingulate cortex (aMCC), anterior insula, and amygdala. Regional parameter estimates were correlated with clinical symptoms. Result Demographics were similar between groups. Participants with COP + MHC+ reported greater dry-eye symptom burden and non-ocular pain, whereas measured ocular surface signs and in-scanner eye-pain and unpleasantness ratings did not differ significantly between groups. In exploratory ROI analyses, COP + MHC+ participants demonstrated greater light-evoked BOLD responses in the right ACC and caudal right aMCC, whereas COP + MHC- participants demonstrated greater responses in the rostral right aMCC and right anterior insula. Conclusions These findings suggest that depressive and PTSD symptoms may contribute to heterogeneity in central pain processing among individuals with COP. If confirmed, such differences could help refine COP phenotyping and inform more targeted, mechanism-based treatment strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性眼痛患者若同时伴有抑郁或创伤后应激障碍症状，其光诱发脑反应是否呈现不同模式。研究者按是否存在临床相关抑郁和/或PTSD症状，将慢性眼痛个体分组，比较其观看亮光时的事件相关功能磁共振血氧水平依赖反应，并考察这些反应与临床症状的关联。结果发现，伴心理共病症状者在右侧前扣带皮层和右侧中扣带皮层尾部的光诱发反应更强，而不伴共病症状者则在右侧中扣带皮层吻部和右侧前岛叶反应更强；两组在眼表体征及扫描时的眼痛和不愉快评分上未见明显差异。作者据此提出，抑郁和PTSD症状可能参与慢性眼痛中枢疼痛处理的异质性，但这些探索性发现尚需验证，不能直接视为临床分型或治疗依据。

papers.title: Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome during enfortumab vedotin therapy: a case report
papers.authors: Ishii M, Hirata I, Kiyota K, Funakoshi R.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) are widely used to treat solid malignancies. Enfortumab vedotin (EV) is an effective therapeutic option for advanced urothelial carcinoma. Although EV-associated neurotoxicity is most commonly reported as peripheral neuropathy, central nervous system complications, particularly posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES), are rare. We report a case of PRES associated with EV therapy. Case presentation: A man in his 50s underwent right nephroureterectomy for urothelial carcinoma, followed by adjuvant nivolumab therapy. Subsequently, multiple liver metastases developed, and treatment with EV was initiated. One day after EV administration during the second cycle, the patient developed acute visual impairment and altered consciousness. Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) with fluid-attenuated inversion recovery sequences revealed hyperintense lesions in the subcortical white matter, predominantly involving both occipital lobes, consistent with PRES. EV was discontinued, and conservative management was initiated. The patient's neurological symptoms improved rapidly, and follow-up MRI demonstrated complete radiological resolution of the lesions. Conclusions In patients who develop visual disturbances, altered mental status, or other central neurological symptoms after treatment with EV, PRES should be considered in the differential diagnosis in addition to brain metastases. Early diagnosis of PRES during EV therapy may prevent irreversible neurological sequelae. Prompt neuroimaging evaluation and appropriate management are essential to achieve favorable outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例晚期尿路上皮癌患者在接受恩诺单抗维多汀（EV）治疗期间出现可逆性后部脑病综合征（PRES）的病例。患者在第二周期EV给药后次日出现急性视力障碍和意识改变，脑MRI显示以双侧枕叶为主的白质高信号病灶，符合PRES表现；停用EV并予保守处理后，神经症状迅速改善，复查MRI病灶完全消退。作者提示，EV治疗后出现视觉异常或意识改变等中枢神经症状时，除脑转移外还应考虑PRES，早期识别和及时影像评估有助于避免不可逆的神经后遗症。

papers.title: Arachidonic and docosahexaenoic acid supplementation affects white matter microstructure in preterm infants.
papers.authors: Gunnarsdottir G, Maximov II, Geier OM, Nordvik T, Ramm-Pettersen A, Stiris T, Moltu SJ, Pfeiffer HCV.
papers.abstract: Arachidonic acid and docosahexaenoic acid are long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids that serve as key structural components of neuronal cell membranes and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. They accumulate most rapidly during the third trimester of pregnancy, leaving very preterm infants deprived at birth. We conducted a double-blind randomized controlled trial comparing arachidonic and docosahexaenoic acid supplementation to medium chain triglycerides oil and assessed effects on white matter maturation using advanced diffusion imaging techniques. We used tract-based spatial statistics to localize significant changes across major tracts. Diffusion kurtosis imaging and Bayesian rotation invariant approach were applied to describe white matter microstructure within the intra- and extra-axonal water compartments enabling a more detailed characterization of tissue changes. These advanced diffusion MRI data were acquired at term-equivalent age for 64 infants born before 29 weeks of gestation, including 33 in the supplemented group and 31 in the control group. We identified significantly higher fractional anisotropy and lower radial diffusivity in several white matter regions in the supplemented group, mostly pronounced in areas that myelinate early. There were no significant differences in diffusion kurtosis imaging metrics between the two groups, but the Bayesian rotational invariant approach revealed several significant differences. This might illustrate a different developmental trajectory in the supplemented group compared to the control group. Applying advanced diffusion models can potentially provide a deeper understanding of early brain development and facilitate opportunities for early detection and intervention for preterm children.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早产儿出生时缺乏长链多不饱和脂肪酸的问题，通过双盲随机对照试验比较花生四烯酸和二十二碳六烯酸补充与中链甘油三酯油对照对白质成熟的影响，并在矫正胎龄足月时用扩散成像评估。结果显示，补充组在若干白质区域各向异性分数更高、径向扩散率更低，尤其在较早髓鞘化的区域更明显；扩散峰度成像指标未见组间差异，但贝叶斯旋转不变量方法提示存在差异，可能反映两组不同的发育轨迹。作者认为，先进扩散模型有助于更深入理解早期脑发育，并可能为早产儿的早期识别和干预提供线索，但相关发现仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Folded tissue geometry adds an electrodiffusive slowing term to cortical spreading depolarization.
papers.authors: Pereira A, Malheiros M, Guedes R.
papers.abstract: Cortical spreading depolarization (CSD) propagates across cortex at millimeters per minute and can slow in sulcal regions, but the contribution of folded geometry remains unresolved. We tested whether sulcal dipole alignment adds a measurable electrodiffusive delay in a reduced surface model in which extracellular diffusion remains the dominant transport process. The model included overlapping extracellular and intracellular surface compartments, explicit K+ , Na+ , and Cl- concentrations, Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz membrane voltage, activation-dependent membrane sources, Na+ /K+ pump dynamics, dynamic extracellular-space restriction, and a quasi-static screened potential. A nonlocal dipole kernel coupled membrane-current deviations through geodesic distance and surface-normal opposition. We compared paired simulations with dipole alignment disabled or enabled in one representative folded surface, 12 synthetic folded geometries plus a flat control, and 8 sulcal versus 8 flatter fsaverage6 patches. In the representative simulation, cross-fold speed decreased from 2.609 to 2.537 mm/min and the region-of-interest E1-E2 delay increased from 128.0 to 131.6 s. Across the synthetic sweep, all folded geometries slowed, whereas the flat control did not. Mean slowdown was 0.136 mm/min (95% bootstrap CI 0.106-0.170), corresponding to a 4.88% speed reduction, and mean delay increased by 6.81 s (95% CI 5.31-8.26). Null kernels and atlas patches supported geometry specificity. In this reduced surface model, folded cortical anatomy adds an orientation-dependent electrodiffusive slowing term to diffusion-driven CSD propagation.

papers.title: Postnatal corpus callosum microstructural deviations are linked to neurobehavioral outcomes in preterm infants.
papers.authors: Wang W, Yang L, Wu K, Li S, Peng S, Gong G.
papers.abstract: The neonatal period surrounding term represents a critical window for corpus callosum (CC) maturation, when axonal growth, pre-myelination, and fiber organization rapidly advance to support emerging motor and cognitive functions, yet preterm birth disrupts this process with unclear mechanisms and long-term consequences. To address this gap, we employed a normative modeling framework, based on a large term-born cohort, to characterize segment-specific CC developmental trajectories and then quantify individual deviations in preterm infants at term-equivalent age (TEA). Preterm infants exhibited selective CC microstructural abnormalities-most pronounced in the genu, anterior body, and splenium-while midsagittal area remained within normative limits. Using partial least squares correlation, we examined associations with neurobehavioral outcomes during toddler period and identified a multivariate brain-behavior coupling unique to the preterm cohort. Specifically, higher gross motor and cognitive scores but lower fine motor score were linked to a coordinated CC profile of increased anisotropy, higher splenial neurite density, reduced diffusivity, and lower genu orientation dispersion. This relationship was absent in term-born controls. These findings suggest that microstructure-informed deviation mapping at TEA may be sensitive to subtle CC alterations that are not apparent on macrostructural measures and are associated with later functional outcomes. This sensitivity to subtle and outcome-related variation highlights the value of this approach as a complement to conventional imaging, and lays the groundwork for future efforts to characterize early white matter development and identify preterm infants at elevated neurodevelopmental risk.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早产对胼胝体成熟的影响及其与后期神经行为发育的关系，基于足月儿大队列构建规范模型，刻画胼胝体各节段发育轨迹，并量化早产儿在足月等效年龄的个体偏离。结果显示，早产儿存在选择性的胼胝体微结构异常，以膝部、前体部和压部较明显，而正中矢状面积仍在正常范围内；偏转程度与幼儿期神经行为表现存在仅见于早产儿群体的多变量脑—行为关联，即较高的粗大运动和认知得分、较低的精细运动得分与各向异性增高、压部神经突密度增高、弥散率降低及膝部方向离散度降低的组合特征相关，足月对照组未见此关联。作者据此认为，基于微结构的偏离映射能捕捉宏观指标难以显现的细微改变，并与后续功能结局相关，可作为常规影像的补充，但相关关系不等于因果，其临床预测价值尚待验证。

papers.title: Gray matter abnormalities associated with long-term opium use: A voxel-based morphometry study.
papers.authors: Ebrahimi MN, Pourrahimi A, Amiri H.
papers.abstract: Background Chronic raw opium use can result in opioid use disorder (OUD). Although voxel-based morphometry (VBM) studies have demonstrated decreased gray matter volume (GMV) in heroin-induced OUD, the structural impacts of long-term raw opium consumption remain poorly understood. This study investigated GMV alterations in men with opium-induced OUD and their association with use duration. Methods High-resolution T1-weighted MRI scans were acquired from 28 men with opium-induced OUD (mean use duration 17.89 ± 5.85 years) receiving opium tincture maintenance and 25 age- and education-matched healthy male controls. Whole-brain VBM (CAT12/SPM12) was controlled for age, total intracranial volume, and nicotine use. Analysis used a voxel-level uncorrected threshold of p < 0.05 with cluster-level FDR correction (p < 0.05), along with stricter thresholds (uncorrected p < 0.001, TFCE with FWE), and small-volume correction (SVC). Partial correlation and multiple linear regression investigated clinical associations. Results Whole-brain analysis identified a left-hemisphere cluster of reduced GMV (cluster-level FDR-corrected p = 0.009). No clusters survived p < 0.001 or TFCE with FWE correction. Reductions in the left insula, inferior frontal gyrus, and parahippocampal gyrus remained significant after SVC. Left insula GMV was negatively associated with duration of opium use (partial r = -0.45, p = 0.027; β = -0.48, p = 0.027 in regression). Conclusion Prolonged raw opium use is associated with decreased GMV in areas involved in craving and impulse control. Given that the whole-brain findings were not confirmed by more stringent statistical approaches, the results should be considered exploratory and necessitate replication in larger samples.

papers.title: Electroencephalographic complexity and cognitive decline: Insights from approximate entropy across aging and dementia.
papers.authors: Cacciotti A, Fabbrocino A, Pappalettera C, Ginatempo F, Loi N, Sottana D, Deriu F, Rossini PM, Vecchio F.
papers.abstract: Introduction Physiological aging involves gradual modifications of brain activity patterns sometimes leading to pathological outcomes. Understanding changes in brain signal complexity from healthy aging to mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and Alzheimer's disease (AD) may provide insights into cognitive decline and support early diagnosis. Methods Electroencephalography (EEG) data were collected from 269 participants divided into three groups: healthy elderly (HE, n = 109), MCI (n = 75), and AD (n = 85). Approximate entropy (ApEn) was computed for the total EEG spectrum and frequency bands. A random forest classifier with a one-versus-one strategy and recursive feature elimination (RFE) was used for group discrimination. Additionally, group comparisons and correlations with neuropsychological scores were performed to further investigate the functional relevance of these entropy changes by assessing their association with cognitive and functional performance. Results Significant group differences in total ApEn were found, particularly in central brain regions, with progressive decreases from HE to MCI and AD. Frequency-specific patterns emerged: (1) delta ApEn was increased in those with AD across the scalp; (2) alpha 1 ApEn showed frontal decreases and occipital increases in the AD group, with an intermediate pattern in MCI; (3) gamma ApEn was markedly reduced in those with AD compared to both HE and MCI groups, with central and frontal localization, and extended occipital differences in those with MCI versus AD. The classifier achieved 66.55% accuracy, with sensitivities of 78.90% (HE), 49.33% (MCI), and 65.88% (AD). Positive correlations were found between ApEn and cognitive scores in both the total EEG spectrum and gamma band; conversely, delta and alpha 1 ApEn showed negative correlations with cognitive and functional scores. Discussion The distinct entropy patterns observed across frequency bands and scalp/brain regions may help characterize electrophysiological changes associated with cognitive decline and AD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较健康老年人、轻度认知障碍（MCI）和阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者的脑电近似熵，并尝试用其区分各组。结果显示，总熵从健康老人到MCI再到AD逐步下降，尤以中央区明显；不同频段表现不一：AD组delta熵升高，alpha1熵呈额区降低、枕区升高，gamma熵在AD组明显降低。熵值与认知功能评分的相关方向因频段而异。基于熵特征的分类器总体准确率约66.55%，对MCI的敏感性偏低。作者认为，跨频段和脑区的熵模式有助于刻画认知衰退相关的电生理变化，但区分能力有限，尚不能据此推断临床诊断效用。

papers.title: Using the aperiodic slope across learning to predict sleep-based memory consolidation
papers.authors: Anesbury A, Caldwell HB, Lushington K, Al Safadi M, Chatburn A.
papers.abstract: Homeostatic mechanisms adjust synaptic strengths to regulate neuronal activity across wake-sleep cycles. Although sleep supports memory consolidation, limited research has explored how sleep-induced homeostatic changes influence memory outcomes in humans. The EEG-derived aperiodic slope (1/f) could be a candidate measure of homeostatic memory processes through its reflection of neural excitation-inhibition balance. In this study, 27 participants learned object-word pairs, and completed an immediate recognition test before either a nap or equivalent wakeful period. Resting-state EEG was recorded, both before and after learning and the interval, to derive changes in aperiodic slope values. A delayed recognition test then assessed whether changes in the aperiodic slope (i.e., homeostatic activity) across learning and the interval predicted memory accuracy and N400 amplitude, an index of stimulus expectancy and recognition. Our study found evidence to suggest homeostatic renormalisation, for the nap condition only, indicated by a shift towards inhibition across sleep which was inversely related to the slope change across learning. Although the aperiodic slope change across the nap and wake intervals did not predict delayed memory accuracy, a shift towards inhibition during learning was beneficial for memory accuracy, only in the nap condition. Similarly, a shift towards inhibition across learning, followed by a shift towards excitation in the nap condition, predicted reduced N400 amplitudes. This suggests that homeostatic renormalisation across the nap influenced model updating and stimulus expectancy. This study provides evidence for a link between synaptic homeostatic processes and memory consolidation, emphasising the importance of encoding-related aperiodic activity in this relationship.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察学习前后及小睡或清醒间隔中脑电非周期斜率的变化能否预测睡眠相关的记忆巩固，27名参与者学习物体—词对并在间隔前后接受静息态脑电与延迟再认测试。结果显示，仅小睡条件出现向抑制偏移的稳态重归一化迹象，且该偏移与学习期间的斜率变化呈反向关系；学习期间向抑制偏移只在随后小睡时有利于再认准确率，而学习期抑制偏移继以小睡期兴奋偏移则预测N400波幅降低。作者据此认为，小睡中的稳态重归一化可能影响模型更新与刺激预期，提示突触稳态过程与记忆巩固相关，但斜率变化本身并未预测延迟再认准确率。

papers.title: A Bayesian approach to volumetric analysis in rare neurodegenerative disorders
papers.authors: Shan Ho SY, Schmidt T, Ghosh B, Rowe JB, Rittman T.
papers.abstract: Identifying regional brain atrophy is critical for understanding neurodegenerative disorders. Traditionally, group comparisons rely on frequentist statistics, utilising p -values and point estimates that offer limited characterization of uncertainty. Bayesian methods provide an alternative by estimating effect sizes and credible intervals while incorporating prior knowledge and uncertainty. This study evaluated the feasibility of Bayesian hierarchical modelling to assess regional brain atrophy in Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP) and Corticobasal Syndrome (CBS) compared to healthy controls. Participants meeting diagnostic criteria for CBS or PSP, together with healthy controls, were recruited from the Cambridge Centre for Parkinson-plus. Grey matter volume, cortical thickness, and subcortical volumes were derived using FreeSurfer for 210 cortical and 36 subcortical regions defined by the Human Brainnetome Atlas. Participants with PSP were classified into Richardson syndrome (PSP-RS), corticobasal syndrome variant (PSP-CBS), frontal variant (PSP-F), and other presentations (PSP-Other). Bayesian hierarchical ANOVA models with appropriate priors were used to estimate group differences. Regions of practical equivalence (ROPE) were calculated to assess evidence of meaningful group effects. A total of 428 people were included (113 PSP-RS, 30 PSP-CBS, 23 PSP-Other, 19 PSP-F, 81 CBS, and 162 healthy controls). For grey matter volume, there was evidence of whole brain volume loss compared to controls for all disease groups except PSP-Other, which showed evidence of no difference. For cortical thickness, there was evidence of global cortical thinning in CBS compared to controls, but for no other group. For subcortical volume all groups showed evidence of volume loss compared to controls. Patterns of regional atrophy were identified in keeping with previous literature, with the largest effect observed in the left pre-motor thalamus (30% reduction in CBS). There was greater loss of subcortical volume in PSP-RS compared to other PSP subgroups. Bayesian hierarchical modelling provides a feasible framework for quantifying regional brain atrophy, with interpretable effect size estimates and uncertainty measures. This approach complements conventional statistical methods, particularly in the assessment of rare neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric disorders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究评估贝叶斯分层建模能否用于量化进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）和皮质基底节综合征（CBS）患者相对健康对照的区域性脑萎缩，基于FreeSurfer提取的皮层与皮层下结构指标进行组间比较。结果显示，除PSP-Other亚组外，各疾病组均存在全脑灰质体积下降的证据；CBS组表现出整体皮层变薄，其他组则无此证据；所有疾病组的皮层下体积均低于对照。区域萎缩模式与既往文献一致，其中CBS组左侧运动前区丘脑的效应最大。作者认为，该方法能给出可解释的效应量与不确定性度量，可作为传统统计方法的补充，尤其适用于罕见神经退行性疾病的评估。

papers.title: Cortical P1 Latency, Sound Field Audiometry, and Speech Audiometry in Children with Sequential Bilateral Cochlear Implants: A Comparative Pilot Study.
papers.authors: Waśniewska-Włodarczyk A, Rosiak O, Pepaś R, Niewiadomska K, Konopka W.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Objective assessment of auditory rehabilitation in children with cochlear implants (CIs) is challenging, as behavioral tests require cooperation that young children cannot always provide. The P1 component of the cortical auditory evoked potential (CAEP) is a marker of central auditory maturation, but few studies have compared it directly with behavioral measures in children with sequential bilateral CIs. Methods: Eight children (median age 8.4 years) with prelingual profound sensorineural hearing loss treated with sequential bilateral CI underwent CAEP (speech tokens/m/,/g/,/t/at 55 and 65 dB sound pressure level (SPL)), sound field audiometry and speech audiometry. An a priori physiological plausibility criterion excluded all detected responses in one child and one further response in a second child; correlations were therefore based on seven children and were assessed by Spearman rank correlation with exact permutation p -values. Results: P1 latency showed a frequency-specific association with sound field thresholds, strongest for the high-frequency/t/stimulus at 4 kHz (rho = 0.836, exact p = 0.056), which remained between +0.70 and +0.92 in leave-one-out analysis. Longer P1 latency tended to accompany poorer speech reception (mean latency at 65 dB SPL, rho = 0.679, exact p = 0.110), but this association was unstable, and no consistent relationship with duration of implant use was found Two coefficients reached nominal significance at 55 dB SPL but did not persist at 65 dB SPL, no other association was significant. Conclusions: In this pilot study P1 latency was associated with to frequency-matched aided thresholds, whereas its relationship with speech reception was directional but unconfirmed. CAEP may complement behavioral testing in this population, but larger longitudinal studies using sensation-level-matched stimulation are required.

papers.title: Polygenic Risk Scores in Alzheimer's Disease: A Cross-Scale View from Genes to Brain and Behavior.
papers.authors: Angelopoulou E, Stamelos I, N Sampatakakis S, Papageorgiou S, Scarmeas N, Hatzimanolis A, Proukakis C, Villa C.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a genetically complex disorder in which inherited susceptibility is distributed across rare high-impact variants, the apolipoprotein E (APOE ) locus, and a broad polygenic background of common risk alleles. Polygenic risk scores (PRSs) provide a quantitative framework for summarizing this distributed genetic liability and have become increasingly important tools for risk stratification, cohort enrichment, and biological interpretation. In this review, we synthesize evidence on AD PRSs across multiple biological and clinical scales, moving from genes and molecular pathways to biomarkers, brain structure and function, cognition, behavior, and clinical translation. Genome-wide PRSs capture aggregate inherited risk, whereas pathway-, tissue-, cell-type-, and biomarker-specific PRSs may help clarify the biological routes through which genetic susceptibility is expressed, including amyloid and tau metabolism, lipid homeostasis, endosomal trafficking, immune regulation, glial activation, proteostasis, and mitochondrial quality control. Evidence indicates that AD PRSs are most consistently associated with amyloid-related biomarkers, while associations with tau, neurodegeneration, brain atrophy, functional connectivity, cognitive decline, and neuropsychiatric manifestations are more heterogeneous and often depend on APOE, disease stage, biomarker context, and variable computation methodologies. Although PRSs show promise for research enrichment and mechanistic stratification, their individual-level clinical utility remains limited by modest predictive performance, ancestry-related transferability, calibration challenges, and ethical considerations. Future progress will require multi-ancestry cohorts, integration of common and rare variation, multi-omic annotation, longitudinal modeling, and multimodal prediction frameworks. Ultimately, PRSs are best viewed not as stand-alone diagnostic tools, but as cross-scale instruments for linking inherited susceptibility to the heterogeneous biological and clinical manifestations of AD.

papers.title: Maturational constraints on tracking of temporal attention in infant language acquisition.
papers.authors: Snijders TM, Menn K.
papers.abstract: Children are active learners: they selectively attend to important information. Rhythmic neural tracking of speech is central to active language learning. This chapter evaluates recent research showing that neural oscillations in the infant brain synchronise with the rhythm of speech, tracking it at different frequencies. This process predicts word segmentation and later language abilities. We argue that rhythmic neural speech tracking reflects infants’ attention to specific parts of the speech signal (e.g., stressed syllables), and simultaneously acts as a core mechanism for maximising temporal attention onto those parts. Rhythmic neural tracking of speech puts a constraint on neural processing, which maximises the uptake of relevant information from the noisy multimodal environment. We hypothesise this to be influenced by neural maturation. We end by evaluating the implications of this proposal for language acquisition research, and discuss how differences in neural maturation relate to variance in language development in autism.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了婴儿语言习得中节律性神经追踪的研究证据，指出婴儿脑内神经振荡会与言语节律同步，并在不同频率上追踪言语，这一过程可预测词汇切分及后续语言能力。作者认为，这种节律性追踪既反映婴儿对言语信号中特定成分（如重读音节）的注意，也作为核心机制将时间注意集中于这些成分，从而在嘈杂的多模态环境中限制并优化相关信息的摄取。作者进一步假设神经成熟会影响这一过程，并讨论了神经成熟差异与自闭症儿童语言发展差异之间的可能联系。

papers.title: Ketogenic Diet and Neurological Health: A Narrative Review with Natural Language Processing-Assisted Thematic Mapping Using BERTopic.
papers.authors: Jin B, Chen Z, Xie R, Liu Y.
papers.abstract: Background The ketogenic diet (KD) is an established therapy for drug-resistant epilepsy and is increasingly investigated across other neurological disorders. Objective To provide an updated narrative synthesis of recent mechanistic and clinical evidence on KD across neurological disorders, including its therapeutic applications, potential mechanisms, and current evidence gaps, and to use BERTopic as a supplementary natural language processing tool to characterize major research themes and temporal changes in research emphasis. Methods Literature published from 2021 to early 2026 was retrieved from Scopus, Web of Science, and PubMed. After deduplication and eligibility screening, 1017 records were included in BERTopic analysis. PubMedBERT, UMAP, HDBSCAN, and c-TF-IDF were used for thematic mapping; interpretation and evidence synthesis remained expert-guided. Temporal analyses were restricted to 2021-2025. Results Seven thematic clusters were retained, with increased representation of gut-brain-axis-related publications after 2023. Narrative synthesis highlighted energy metabolism, mitochondrial function, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, neurotransmitter regulation, and the gut-brain axis as major mechanistic domains. Clinical evidence was strongest for drug-resistant epilepsy, while findings for Alzheimer's disease and migraine were less mature and those for Parkinson's disease remained preliminary. Conclusion KD is an established therapy for drug-resistant epilepsy and shows potential across other neurological disorders, particularly Alzheimer's disease and migraine. Its effects may involve energy metabolism, mitochondrial function, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, neurotransmitter regulation, and the gut-brain axis. BERTopic-assisted mapping complemented the narrative synthesis by summarizing major research themes and temporal trends.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了2021年至2026年初生酮饮食在神经系统疾病中的机制与临床证据，并借助BERTopic对筛选出的文献做补充性主题映射，以刻画研究主题及其时间变化。作者归纳出能量代谢、线粒体功能、氧化应激、神经炎症、神经递质调节和肠脑轴等主要机制领域，并指出2023年后肠脑轴相关文献增多。临床证据以药物难治性癫痫最为充分，阿尔茨海默病和偏头痛的证据尚不成熟，帕金森病则仍属初步；因此生酮饮食在这些疾病中的潜在作用需谨慎看待。

papers.title: Effects of primary somatosensory cortex high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation combined with core stability training on pain and glutamate levels and neuromuscular function in chronic low back pain: a randomized controlled trial.
papers.authors: Li K, Ou L, Zhang X, Zhang S, Huang Z, Yu Q, Yang J, Cheng X, Yan T, Ding M, Wang H, Wang C.
papers.abstract: Chronic low back pain (CLBP) involves pain-related changes in sensory processing, motor control, and broader neurobiological function. The primary somatosensory cortex (S1) is a relevant neuromodulation target because it contributes to sensory-discriminative pain processing and exhibits maladaptive plasticity in chronic pain states. However, S1-targeted high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) has been insufficiently studied in CLBP. To determine whether S1-targeted HD-tDCS combined with core stability training reduces pain intensity and pain-related disability in adults with CLBP, and to explore associated changes in paraspinal muscle biomechanical properties, resting-state EEG activity, and serum metabolites. In this randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial, 36 adults with CLBP received active or sham S1 HD-tDCS combined with a standardized 4-week core stability training program. Pain-related scale was assessed using the VAS, ODI, RMDQ and FABQ. Secondary outcomes included biomechanical properties of the lumbar erector spinae and multifidus measured using MyotonPRO. Exploratory outcomes included resting-state electroencephalographic alpha-band power spectral density (PSD) and phase-locking value (PLV) connectivity, as well as untargeted serum metabolomics in a subset of participants. Compared with sham stimulation, active S1 HD-tDCS was associated with greater reductions in VAS, ODI, RMDQ and FABQ scores after treatment. The active group also showed larger decreases in lumbar erector spinae and multifidus tone and stiffness, along with greater improvement in elasticity. Resting-state EEG demonstrated increased alpha-band PSD across frontal, central, and parieto-occipital regions and reduced alpha-band PLV connectivity after active stimulation. In the metabolomics subset, active treatment was associated with greater reductions in circulating L-glutamate and enrichment of ferroptosis-related pathways. Changes in pain intensity were correlated with changes in paraspinal muscle stiffness, central alpha-band PSD, and L-glutamate levels. S1-targeted HD-tDCS combined with core stability training may improve short-term pain intensity and pain-related disability in adults with CLBP. The accompanying muscular, electrophysiological, and metabolomic findings were consistent with the clinical changes. These findings support S1-targeted HD-tDCS as a potential adjunct to exercise-based rehabilitation in CLBP. Chinese Clinical Trial Registry, ChiCTR2300076620 (Registration date 2023-10-13).

papers.title: Prevalence and impact of cerebral small vessel lesions in mild cognitive impairment and mild dementia due to Alzheimer's disease patients in memory clinic: Preparation for anti-amyloid therapy in Thailand.
papers.authors: Smitasiri T, Pongpitakmetha T, Thanprasertsuk S, Likitjaroen Y.
papers.abstract: BackgroundAlzheimer's disease (AD) raises global concern with its impact on daily living. Anti-amyloid therapy (AAT) are specific treatments used in mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and mild dementia stage of AD (mild AD). Severe cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) lesions such as microbleeds, superficial siderosis, lacunes, white matter hyperintensities are listed as exclusions criteria for AAT. In Thailand, there is no prevalence study of SVD lesions specifically in these patient groups.ObjectiveThe purpose of this study is to report the prevalence of SVD burdens which are excluded in AAT, in MCI and mild AD patients in Thailand.MethodsThe study was carried out at Memory Clinic in King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital. Patients with amnestic MCI and mild AD were diagnosed using clinical criteria, cognitive tests and brain MRI. Visual rating scales were used to evaluate SVD burden based on STRIVE-2 criteria. Baseline characteristics and cognitive tests were retrieved from electronic medical records.ResultsThe study involving 102 patients, 73.5% had MCI, and 26.5% had mild AD. Twenty-one individuals (20.6%) had either more than 4 microbleeds, more than 2 lacunes, or Fazekas score of 3. There was no evidence of superficial siderosis. Individuals without microbleeds had a higher TMSE score (25.4 versus 23.5; p = 0.009).ConclusionsAmong patients with MCI and mild AD, 20.6% met the exclusion criteria for AAT, in part of SVD lesions. These findings provide important information for evaluating the cost-effectiveness of AAT, which become a treatment option for Thai AD patients.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在泰国一家记忆门诊开展，旨在了解因阿尔茨海默病导致的轻度认知障碍和轻度痴呆患者中，脑小血管病病灶的患病情况，因为这些病灶（如微出血、脑微梗死、白质高信号等）是抗淀粉样蛋白治疗的排除标准。研究依据临床标准、认知测验和脑MRI诊断患者，并用视觉评定量表评估小血管病负担。结果显示，约两成患者存在达到排除标准的严重小血管病负担，且无微出血者的认知筛查得分相对更高。作者认为，这一患病比例可为评估抗淀粉样蛋白治疗的成本效益提供参考，但研究为单中心观察性设计，相关发现尚不能直接推及治疗效果。

papers.title: Interaction of physical fitness and resting state functional connectivity on global cognitive function in older adults with mild cognitive impairment.
papers.authors: Gu Y, Liu-Ambrose T, Falck RS, Nagamatsu LS, Tam RC, Hsiung GR, Ten Brinke L, Bullock A, Grant S, Hsu CL.
papers.abstract: BackgroundMild cognitive impairment (MCI) represents a prodromal stage of Alzheimer's disease. Physical fitness, including cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular strength, is associated with cognitive function in older adults. Resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) is also linked to cognitive function; however, whether physical fitness modifies the association between rsFC and cognitive function remains unclear.ObjectiveTo examine associations of cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular strength with rsFC and their interaction on global cognitive function in older adults with MCI.MethodsA cross-sectional study of 95 older adults with MCI. Cardiorespiratory fitness was estimated by the 400-m walk; muscular strength was indexed using grip strength measured by hand dynamometer. Global cognitive function was indexed by the 13-item Alzheimer's Disease Assessment Scale-Cognitive (ADAS-Cog-13). Using the Yeo 7-network atlas, we computed rsFC within and between seven canonical networks. Significant rsFC-fitness associations were entered into moderation analyses (X = rsFC, Y = ADAS-Cog-13) with cardiorespiratory fitness or grip strength as moderator, adjusted for covariates. Simple slopes were examined at ±1 SD from the mean of moderator.ResultsParticipants had a mean age of 73.49 years, and 53.7% were female. Cardiorespiratory fitness interacted with rsFC in relation to ADAS-Cog-13, whereas grip strength did not. Specifically, greater limbic-visual (standardized b = -0.22, p = 0.009), limbic-somatomotor (b = -0.20, p = 0.049), and limbic-ventral attention (b = -0.19, p = 0.020) rsFC were associated with better global cognitive function among individuals with higher cardiorespiratory fitness.ConclusionsHigher between-network rsFC is generally associated with worse cognitive function. Thus, higher cardiorespiratory fitness may attenuate the negative association between higher between-network rsFC and global cognitive function in MCI.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究以95名轻度认知障碍老年人为对象，考察心肺适能和握力所代表的肌肉力量是否调节静息态功能连接与整体认知功能之间的关联。结果显示，心肺适能与功能连接的交互作用显著，而握力没有；具体而言，在心肺适能较高的个体中，边缘系统与视觉、躯体运动及腹侧注意网络之间较高的功能连接反而与更好的整体认知功能相关。作者据此提出，较高的网络间功能连接通常与较差的认知功能相关，而较高的心肺适能可能减弱这种负向关联。由于研究为横断面设计，上述结果反映的是关联与调节关系，而非因果或干预效果。

papers.title: Retinal Microvascular Abnormalities, White Matter Injury, and Cognitive Impairment in Carotid Stenosis or Occlusion.
papers.authors: Cao L, Chen Y, Wang H, Kwapong WR, Zhou S, Lan T, Liu R, Pan R, Yan Y, Tao W, Liu G, Zhao Y, Wu B.
papers.journal: Journal of the American Heart Association
papers.abstract: Background Severe carotid artery stenosis or occlusion (CASO) is associated with white matter injury and cognitive impairment, but markers of accompanying microvascular dysfunction remain incompletely characterized. We investigated the relationships among retinal microvascular abnormalities on optical coherence tomography angiography, white matter hyperintensities (WMH), and cognitive impairment in severe unilateral CASO. Methods In this multicenter cross-sectional study, 860 participants were included: 566 patients with severe unilateral CASO without acute cerebral infarction and 294 control participants with similar age and sex distributions. All participants underwent multimodal imaging, including automated WMH segmentation on brain magnetic resonance imaging and macular optical coherence tomography angiography. Cognitive function was assessed using the Montreal Cognitive Assessment. Results Compared with controls, patients with CASO showed lower vessel length density across retinal layers and greater WMH burden. Within the group with CASO, the retina ipsilateral to the stenosis showed lower vessel length density and greater vessel dilation, paralleling the greater burden of deep WMH in the ipsilateral hemisphere (all adjusted P <0.05). Retinal microvascular abnormalities and greater WMH burden were both associated with worse concurrent cognitive performance. Adding optical coherence tomography angiography metrics to clinical and WMH-based models provided modest additional discrimination for identifying concurrent cognitive impairment in internal cross-validation, increasing the area under the curve from 0.652 to 0.695 (Δarea under the curve, 0.043 [95% CI, 0.021-0.064]). Conclusions In severe unilateral CASO, retinal microvascular abnormalities were associated with ipsilateral white matter injury and lower cognitive performance. Optical coherence tomography angiographymetrics provided modest complementary discriminatory information beyond conventional clinical variables and WMH for identifying concurrent cognitive impairment, although external validation is required. Registration URL: https://www.chictr.org.cn/. Unique identifier: ChiCTR2300074640.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面多中心研究探讨严重单侧颈动脉狭窄或闭塞（CASO）患者视网膜微血管异常、白质高信号与认知障碍之间的关系，比较了无急性脑梗死的CASO患者与年龄性别相近的对照者，并结合脑磁共振白质高信号自动分割、黄斑光学相干断层扫描血管成像和认知评估进行分析。结果显示，CASO患者视网膜各层血管长度密度较低、白质高信号负担更重；在CASO组内，狭窄同侧视网膜血管长度密度更低、血管扩张更明显，与同侧半球深部白质高信号负担更重相平行，且视网膜微血管异常和更重的白质高信号均与较差的同期认知表现相关。将光学相干断层扫描血管成像指标加入临床和白质高信号模型后，对识别同期认知障碍仅提供有限的增量区分能力，作者指出仍需外部验证。

papers.title: Sociodemographic and clinical factors associated with seven domains of digital health literacy: A cross-sectional study (NORFAST).
papers.authors: Linnestad AM, Larsen MH, Gay CL, Skogestad IJ, Indredavik B, Stubberud J, Lerdal A.
papers.abstract: Introduction Due to limited digital health literacy (DHL), stroke survivors frequently face barriers in using digital health tools essential for post-stroke rehabilitation and self-management. DHL is a multidimensional construct, encompassing several distinct skill domains. Although sociodemographic and clinical characteristics may influence overall DHL, their associations with specific DHL domains remain poorly understood. This study therefore explores how individual DHL domains relate to patient characteristics in stroke survivors. Methods In this cross-sectional NORFAST study, stroke survivors aged 18-80 years with a first-ever stroke in 2021 or 2022 were recruited through the Norwegian Stroke Registry. Registry data included diagnosis, stroke type, aphasia, and scores on the National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS), modified Rankin Scale (mRS), and Barthel Index for Activities of Daily Living. Cognitive function was assessed before inclusion using the Mini/5min MoCA, a brief telephone-administered cognitive screening tool. Participants also completed self-report questionnaires (telephone or electronic), assessing sociodemographics, self-rated health status (EQ-VAS) and fatigue interference (Fatigue Severity Scale, FSS-7). The primary outcomes were DHL dimensions, assessed with the 7-domain eHealth Literacy Questionnaire (eHLQ). Linear regression models examined unadjusted and adjusted associations between patient characteristics and each DHL domain. Results Among 177 stroke survivors (mean age 69), most had experienced minor strokes and cerebral infarction. Patients scored highest on the domain "feel safe and in control", and lowest on "digital services that suit individual needs". In multivariable regression models, older age was associated with lower scores on Using technology, Engage, Motivation, and Needs; female sex with lower scores on Motivation and Needs; college/university education with higher scores on Understanding, Engage, Motivation and Needs; and better health status with higher scores on domains Using technology, Understanding, Motivation, Access and Needs. Living alone, aphasia, cognitive function, and fatigue interference were not significantly associated with any DHL domain after multivariable adjustment. Conclusion This study demonstrates considerable variation in DHL across domains among stroke survivors. After adjustment, age, education level, and self-rated health status were the factors most consistently associated with DHL dimensions. These findings suggest that older stroke survivors, those without college or university education, and those with lower self-rated health may warrant particular attention when designing, implementing, and evaluating digital health interventions. Co-creation with stroke survivors, healthcare professionals, and technology designers may support the development of accessible and clinically meaningful digital solutions.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究基于挪威卒中登记数据，考察卒中幸存者的社会人口学与临床特征如何与数字健康素养的七个领域分别相关。参与者完成电话认知筛查和自评问卷，研究者用线性回归分析各特征与各素养领域的关联。结果显示，患者对“感到安全可控”评分最高，对“契合个体需求的数字服务”评分最低；校正后，年龄较大与多个领域得分较低相关，女性在动机和需求领域得分较低，大学教育程度和较好的自评健康则与多个领域得分较高相关，而独居、失语、认知功能和疲劳干扰与各领域均无显著关联。作者据此提示，设计数字健康干预时应关注年长、教育程度较低和自评健康较差的卒中幸存者，并强调共同创造的重要性。

papers.title: The role of white matter microstructure in the association between childhood maltreatment and adult post-traumatic symptoms.
papers.authors: Berger L, Rojczyk P, Seitz-Holland J, Zhang F, Pankatz L, Sollmann N, Kaufmann E, Carrington H, Puri T, Coleman MJ, Pasternak O, Bouix S, Rathi Y, Cetin-Karayumak S, O'Donnell LJ, Falkai P, George MS, McAllister TW, Zafonte R, Stein MB, Shenton ME, Koerte IK.
papers.abstract: Childhood maltreatment (CM) is a risk factor for adult post-traumatic symptoms and white matter (WM) alterations. It remains unknown how WM microstructure is affected alongside two common military conditions, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI). Data from 299 participants (53% male, 35.69 ± 12.23 years of age) of the Injury and Traumatic Stress (INTRuST) clinical consortium was analyzed. The study included 56 individuals with PTSD (41 with comorbid mTBI), 107 with mTBI, and 136 controls (no PTSD and/or mTBI). Diffusion parameters (mean, axial, and radial diffusivity, MD, AD, RD; fractional anisotropy, FA) in major WM tracts were extracted from diffusion MRI. CM was assessed using the Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ). Multiple regression models examined associations between CM severity and WM diffusion. Moderation analyses assessed the effect of PTSD and/or mTBI on these associations. Mediation analyses examined how WM diffusion affects the associations between CM and both PTSD and post-concussive symptom severity. Greater CM severity was associated with lower MD and AD, independent of PTSD and/or mTBI. WM diffusion, particularly in the corpus callosum and the superior longitudinal fasciculus, mediated the associations between CM severity and both PTSD (MD bab = 0.022, AD bab = 0.019-0.034) and post-concussive symptoms (MD bab = 0.028-0.040, AD bab = 0.032-0.047). Findings suggest that WM alterations are more strongly associated with CM itself than with either PTSD and/or mTBI. Mediating effects in regions critical for sensory integration highlight the role of WM microstructure as a neurobiological pathway through which CM might predispose to post-traumatic symptoms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注童年虐待经历、白质微结构与成人创伤后症状之间的关系，并考察创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）和轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）是否影响这一关联。研究分析了临床联盟参与者的弥散磁共振指标、童年创伤问卷及症状评估，用回归、调节和中介模型检验关联。结果显示，童年虐待越严重，白质平均弥散率和轴向弥散率越低，这一关联不依赖PTSD或mTBI；胼胝体和上纵束等区域的白质弥散还在童年虐待与PTSD及脑震荡后症状之间起中介作用。作者据此认为，白质改变与童年虐待本身的联系强于与PTSD或mTBI的联系，白质微结构可能是童年虐待易化后续创伤症状的一条神经生物学路径。

papers.title: Sex differences in response to neurosteroid therapy after preterm birth.
papers.authors: Hirst JJ, Palliser HK, Glover R, Pavy CL, Shaw JC, Moloney RA.
papers.abstract: Progesterone production by the placenta leads to elevated levels of neurosteroids in both the maternal and fetal circulations during late gestation. Among these, allopregnanolone is critical for fetal brain development, providing neuroprotective and trophic support by limiting excessive neuronal excitation and promoting oligodendrocyte development and myelination. Pregnancy complications, particularly preterm birth, can substantially reduce or eliminate this neurosteroid support, increasing vulnerability to hypoxic and excitotoxic injury. Reduced neurosteroid support is also associated with alterations in oligodendrocyte maturation and myelination, which may contribute to subsequent neurodevelopmental and behavioural abnormalities. This in turn contributes to the onset of behavioural disorders including attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Importantly, often experience poorer outcomes following preterm birth and other perinatal insults. Increasing allopregnanolone action using the synthetic analogue, zuranolone, markedly improved myelination after premature delivery in an animal model. Treatment with the mitochondrial translocator protein (TSPO) ligand etifoxine, which promotes endogenous allopregnanolone production, provided protective effects in primary cell cultures following oxygen-glucose deprivation in vitro. Prematurely delivered male offspring showed markedly increased hyperactive behaviour which was also reversed by zuranolone therapy. Female offspring exhibited reduced myelination following preterm birth, without evidence of oligodendrocyte maturational arrest, and this hypomyelination was restored by zuranolone therapy. In contrast, males showed oligodendrocyte maturational arrest and a hyperactive behavioural phenotype. Together, these findings suggest that the effects of preterm birth on white matter development may differ between males and females. These findings support further investigation of allopregnanolone replacement therapy after preterm birth, including pharmacokinetic, safety, toxicology and efficacy studies in neonatal populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早产后神经类固醇支持缺失对白质发育的影响是否存在性别差异，并检验合成类似物zuranolone的干预效果。作者在早产动物模型中发现，雄性子代出现少突胶质细胞成熟停滞和多动行为，而雌性子代表现为髓鞘化减少但无成熟停滞证据；zuranolone治疗可改善两性的髓鞘化，并逆转雄性的多动表现。这些结果提示早产对白质发育的影响可能因性别而异，作者据此认为有必要在新生儿人群中进一步开展药代动力学、安全性、毒理学和疗效研究，但目前尚属动物与体外证据，不能直接推及临床治疗。

papers.title: Sex differences in functional connectivity in individuals with internet gaming disorder: a resting-state fMRI Study.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Xu X, Cui S, Dong GH.
papers.abstract: Objective Sex differences may help explain the heterogeneity of internet gaming disorder (IGD), but their neural basis remains unclear. This study examined sex-related alterations in functional connectivity (FC) in IGD. Methods 373 participants (85 males with IGD, 62 females with IGD, 141 male recreational game users [RGUs], and 85 female RGUs) underwent resting-state fMRI. The study used a 2 (group: IGD/RGU) × 2 (sex: male/female) between-subjects design. ReHo and FC were analyzed under this design with age as a covariate. ReHo interaction clusters served as seed ROIs for whole-brain FC analyses, followed by simple effect analyses for significant FC interactions. Results ReHo showed significant sex-by-group interactions in the bilateral postcentral gyrus, right middle cingulate cortex, and right fusiform gyrus. Seed-based FC showed significant interactions involving these regions. Simple effects indicated that, relative to same-sex RGUs, males with IGD predominantly showed lower FC, whereas females with IGD more often showed higher FC in connections involving perceptual processing, sensorimotor integration, behavioral regulation, self-related processing, and executive control. Conclusions IGD-related brain functional abnormalities may exhibit sex differences across multiple inter-regional FC patterns, providing new evidence for the sex-related heterogeneity in IGD. Given the cross-sectional design, these findings reflect associations rather than causal effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注网络游戏障碍（IGD）者功能连接改变是否存在性别差异，以解释该障碍的异质性。研究纳入IGD与娱乐性游戏使用者男女共373人，采集静息态fMRI，采用2（组别）×2（性别）设计分析局部一致性与全脑功能连接。结果显示，多个感觉运动、视觉及执行控制相关区域存在显著的性别与组别交互：相对于同性别娱乐性游戏使用者，男性IGD者多表现为连接降低，女性IGD者则更多表现为连接升高。作者认为，IGD相关脑功能异常在多种区域间连接模式上呈现性别差异，为IGD的性别相关异质性提供了新证据；但研究为横断面设计，结果反映的是关联而非因果。

papers.title: Using data-driven, lesion-symptom mapping to study the relationship between neural and theoretical components of numeracy.
papers.authors: Duricy E, Durisko C, Fiez JA.
papers.abstract: Numeracy, the ability to understand and manipulate numbers, is a crucial foundational ability for many daily life skills. Numeracy tasks have been categorized using different taxonomic approaches, and understanding of the relationship between tasks categories and neural models of numeracy remains poor. In this study, we use the lesion method to address this key gap. The study employs a data-driven approach with support vector regression lesion-symptom mapping (SVR-LSM) of extracted factors from two left hemisphere chronic stroke survivor datasets: one with data from a battery of math and language tests (N = 100) and the other with data from the EC301 math battery (N = 64). We find that our data best support a separation of number tasks requiring verbal vs. magnitude number knowledge, aligning with a broad theme that emerges across theories in different variations. This is supported by distinct neuroanatomical correlates that link verbal coding of number to the language-centered regions including left perisylvian area and insula, and that link magnitude coding to the parietal lobe, as described in prior models. Our findings indicate that these two different sources of representation variously contribute to a range of math tasks, including different types of arithmetic calculation tasks, in ways which cannot be cleanly defined by one singular theoretical model of math cognition.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注数感任务分类与脑损伤部位之间的关系，采用数据驱动的支持向量回归损伤-症状映射，分析两组左半球慢性卒中幸存者的数学与语言测验数据。结果显示，数据最支持将数字任务区分为依赖言语编码与依赖数量大小知识两类：言语编码对应左侧外侧裂周区及岛叶等语言相关区域，数量编码对应顶叶，这与既有模型相符。作者据此指出，这两类表征以不同方式参与多种数学任务（包括不同类型的算术计算），其贡献模式无法由单一数学认知理论模型清晰界定。

papers.title: Characterizing hippocampal activation during pattern separation with multi-echo fMRI in cognitively normal older adults.
papers.authors: Solar KG, Kashyap S, Deom N, Uludağ K, Zotovic L, Lanctôt K, Black SE, McAndrews MP.
papers.abstract: Hippocampal hyperactivity, detected with mnemonic similarity task (MST) fMRI, is both a promising marker of risk and a probable driver of degeneration in Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, implementation of such fMRI in interventional research is limited by long scan times and the absence of a framework for identifying prospective participants with hyperactivity who could be targeted with therapeutic approaches aimed at reducing this activity. We used multi-echo fMRI during the MST, an episodic memory task previously shown to engage hippocampal subfields CA3 and dentate gyrus (DG), to characterize activity profiles in 33 cognitively normal older adults. We compared MST-related CA3 and DG activation and behavioural performance across subsets of eight task runs. Behavioural and activation effects were equivalent for the first set of four runs (Runs-A) and the second set (Runs-B), suggesting that robust data can be obtained with four runs. Left and right CA3 + DG activation did not differ. We provide an exemplar framework for the derivation of a threshold for single-participant classification of elevated hippocampal activation as an indicator of AD risk in cognitively normal older individuals. Scalable (~22 min) multi-echo MST fMRI robustly captures hippocampal activation and provides a framework for individual-level characterization of hippocampal function in cognitively normal older adults. This enables individualized detection of elevated hippocampal activation as a modifiable risk factor and may guide enrolment into prevention trials targeting preclinical AD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在认知正常老年人中评估多回波功能磁共振结合记忆相似性任务能否稳定测量海马CA3与齿状回激活，并比较前后各四段任务数据的行为与激活结果。结果显示两组任务段的效果相当，提示约四段即可获得可靠数据，且左右侧激活无差异。作者据此提出一个用于单被试判定海马激活升高的示例性阈值框架，将其作为临床前阿尔茨海默病风险的个体化指标，并认为这种约二十余分钟的方案可用于筛查和预防试验入组；不过该框架目前只是示例，其分类效用尚待验证。

papers.title: Neurophysiological Correlates of Target-Related Visual Attention Processes as a Function of Reward in Connection with Schizotypy.
papers.authors: Hübner N, Lockhofen D, Debnath R, Mulert C.
papers.abstract: In everyday life, we constantly select and perceive relevant information while suppressing irrelevant sensory input. This selection process is governed by the interaction between bottom-up and top-down attention mechanisms. Recent studies also highlighted the influence of reward on attention, with monetary rewards shown to enhance task performance and modulate stimulus salience. Schizotypy, conceptualized as a continuum ranging from healthy states to schizophrenia symptoms, provides a framework for the investigation of these mechanisms in non-clinical populations. This study investigated the behavioral and neurophysiological correlates of visual attention and reward processing, and their relationship with schizotypy traits. Thirty-six healthy participants were divided into two groups which performed a visual attention task with salient distractors and rewarded (target reward group, TR) or not rewarded (no reward group, NR) target stimuli while EEG was recorded. Additionally, schizotypy was assessed using the Schizotypal Personality Questionnaire (SPQ). The results showed that salient, but task-irrelevant distractors increased response times compared to target-only trials irrespective of reward. On the neurophysiological level, distractors decreased target prioritization in the NR group. Furthermore, participants with higher scores on the negative schizotypy dimension showed stronger target prioritization, especially in the absence of salient distractors. These findings suggest that monetary rewards can modulate attentional control mechanisms and that negative schizotypy traits are linked to altered attentional prioritization.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察视觉注意与奖赏加工的行为和神经生理相关特征及其与分裂型人格特质的关系，36名健康被试被分为目标奖赏组和无奖赏组，在记录脑电的同时完成含显著分心刺激的视觉注意任务，并用分裂型人格问卷评估特质。结果显示，显著但与任务无关的分心刺激延长了反应时，且不受奖赏影响；在神经生理层面，分心刺激削弱了无奖赏组对目标的优先加工，而负性分裂型维度得分较高者表现出更强的目标优先化，尤其在缺乏显著分心刺激时。作者据此认为，金钱奖赏可调节注意控制机制，负性分裂型特质则与注意优先化的改变有关。

papers.title: EEG Microstates are Not Associated with Psychotic Symptoms, Neurocognitive Domains or Psychosocial Functioning in Adolescents and Young Adults with Clinical High Risk for Psychosis.
papers.authors: Liebrand M, Wedekind C, Katsarakis A, Diezig S, Michel C, Schultze-Lutter F, Kaess M, Hubl D, Koenig T, Kindler J.
papers.abstract: EEG microstates are brief and discrete topographic patterns of electrical brain activity. Microstates last for 60-120 milliseconds, are thought to represent transient, quasi-stable neural networks, and traditionally four distinct classes (A-D) are distinguished. One of the core concepts of present neuroscience is that neuroimaging is able to capture meaningful networks of brain activity, which can be translated into specific cognitive functions. Following this idea, each microstate might correspond to specific core brain functions. Importantly, these cognitive functions are impaired in mental disorders. Clinical high-risk (CHR) refers to a state associated with an increased risk of developing psychosis. Previous research has demonstrated consistent microstate alterations in CHR individuals (especially in class D), as well as in psychosis. However, the neurobiological and functional meaning of microstate alterations in CHR populations is still elusive. Since the CHR state is associated with reduced neurocognition (e.g., processing speed, verbal memory, executive functions) in combination with specific clinical symptoms and impairments in psychosocial functioning, relationships between resting-state microstates and these domains were examined in a large cross-sectional cohort of CHR individuals (n = 100). Contrary to our expectations, no significant correlations were found for these clinical measures. The finding suggests that while microstate parameters may differ between CHR individuals and controls, these alterations do not seem to directly reflect the neurobiology of clinical symptoms or neurocognitive and psychosocial functions. EEG microstate deviations as candidate trait biomarker therefore require further investigation and validation in longitudinal studies to establish their stability and predictive value.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在临床高危精神病（CHR）青少年和年轻成人中考察静息态脑电微状态是否与精神病性症状、神经认知领域及心理社会功能相关。作者采用横断面设计，对较大样本的CHR个体进行脑电微状态分析与上述临床测量，结果未发现显著相关，与预期不符。作者据此指出，微状态参数虽可能在CHR个体与对照之间存在差异，但这些改变似乎并不直接反映临床症状、神经认知或心理社会功能的神经生物学基础；微状态偏离作为候选特质生物标志物仍需纵向研究进一步验证其稳定性和预测价值。

papers.title: Cerebellar Network Organization in Parkinson's Disease: Functional Connectivity across Motor and Cognitive Circuits.
papers.authors: Lin CR, Magalhães TNC, Yonce SS, Rampalli I, Mahabir R, Bernard JA, and the Parkinson's Precision Medicine Initiative.
papers.journal: Movement disorders : official journal of the Movement Disorder Society
papers.abstract: Background The cerebellum is increasingly recognized as a key contributor to cognitive reserve and network organization in Parkinson's disease (PD). However, the relationship of cerebello-cortical and cerebello-basal ganglia connectivity with cognitive status and nigrostriatal integrity remains incompletely understood. Methods Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data from 172 participants with PD in the Parkinson's Precision Medicine Initiative were analyzed. Cerebello-basal ganglia and cerebello-cortical connectivity were investigated using region of interest (ROI)-to-ROI and seed-to-voxel approaches. Cerebellar connectivity was examined in relation to cognitive status, age, disease duration, motor severity, dopaminergic medication exposure, and contralateral putaminal striatal binding ratio (SBR). Results PD participants demonstrated robust positive cerebello-basal ganglia connectivity, particularly between lobule VI/vermis VI and the pallidum. Greater age was associated with widespread reductions in cerebello-basal ganglia coupling. Longer disease duration was associated with stronger connectivity within cerebellar and basal ganglia circuits, and among cognitively unimpaired participants, stronger lobule V connectivity with temporal regions. After adjustment for contralateral putaminal SBR, cognitively unimpaired participants generally demonstrated greater connectivity between left cerebellar regions and frontal networks, whereas cognitively impaired participants showed greater connectivity from posterior cerebellar and vermal regions, including regions implicated in cognitive processing, to temporal, parahippocampal, occipital, parietal, and somatosensory regions. Conclusions Cerebellar functional connectivity in PD shows region-specific differences across cognitive status rather than uniform network loss with cognitive impairment. These findings support further investigation of cerebellar functional connectivity as a candidate biomarker of cognitive resilience and network adaptation in PD. © 2026 The Author(s). Movement Disorders published by Wiley Periodicals LLC on behalf of International Parkinson and Movement Disorder Society.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于帕金森病患者的静息态功能磁共振数据，考察小脑与基底节、小脑与皮层之间的功能连接，并分析其与认知状态、年龄、病程及多巴胺能系统完整性的关系。结果显示，患者小脑与基底节（尤其小脑叶VI/蚓部VI与苍白球）存在稳定的正连接；年龄增长与这类连接普遍减弱相关，病程较长则与更强的小脑及基底节环路内连接相关。校正纹状体多巴胺摄取后，认知未受损者更多表现为左侧小脑与额叶网络的连接增强，而认知受损者则表现为后部小脑和蚓部区域向颞叶、海马旁回、枕叶、顶叶及躯体感觉区的连接增强。作者据此指出，帕金森病中的小脑功能连接随认知状态呈现区域特异性差异，而非认知受损时网络连接的普遍丧失，并认为其作为认知韧性与网络适应候选标志物值得进一步研究。

papers.title: An adaptive, variable-length test for certifying electroencephalographic spike-detection skill: A retrospective feasibility study.
papers.authors: Zhang T, Nascimento FA, Karakis I, Keldsen EW, Sun C, Jing J, Westover MB.
papers.abstract: Objective Determining whether an individual reader has sufficient electroencephalographic (EEG) spike-detection skill is challenging due to limited expert agreement. We evaluated whether modeling skill in interpretable signal-detection terms-discrimination ability separate from response tendency-could power an adaptive, variable-length test that can reliably and efficiently assess reader competence. Methods We analyzed a multirater dataset containing 20 521 EEG segments and 2574 rater sessions. Case signal was estimated from multirater labels, and each reader was modeled using signal-detection parameters: discrimination skill σ and response bias t . Among 368 calibration-eligible raters across five skill tiers, we used a stratified 50/50 train-validation split to select a certification threshold σ⋆ in training and to apply it in validation. We replayed an adaptive test on each rater's historical responses, using sequential stopping to issue pass, fail, or retest decisions. Results The training-derived threshold was σ⋆=.815 (95% bootstrap confidence interval = .663 - 1.018 , Youden J=.828 ). In validation, pass rates preserved the expected tier ordering: experts 100% ( 14/14 ), experienced 100% ( 4/4 ), novices 14% ( 1/7 ), residents 0% ( 0/11 ), and crowd raters 7% ( 11/150 ). In the 81-rater adaptive replay, clear failures stopped near 20 trials, and passing experts required a median of 95 trials. Split-half replay showed intraclass correlation coefficient 3,1=.87 for σ̂ at stopping; there were no hard pass-fail reversals among raters whose two halves both reached decisive verdicts. Significance A signal-detection framework quantified spike-identification skill in EEG readers, and adaptive testing estimated this skill reliably with fewer than 100 short EEG segments. This approach could provide a practical, scalable method for assessing EEG reading competence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何可靠评估脑电图阅读者的棘波识别能力，并检验一种自适应变长测试能否高效判定其是否达标。作者利用多评分者标注的脑电片段数据，将阅读者的判别能力与反应倾向分开建模，在部分评分者中确定认证阈值并在另一部分中验证。验证结果显示，通过率基本保持了预期的技能层级顺序，专家通过率最高，新手和住院医师较低；在自适应回放中，明显不合格者较早停止，而合格专家所需题目更多，分半回放也显示停止时的能力估计具有较高一致性。作者认为，这种信号检测框架结合自适应测试，可在较少脑电片段内较可靠地估计棘波识别技能，为阅读能力评估提供可扩展的实用途径，但结论仍需在更多场景中进一步验证。

papers.title: Cerebral Hemodynamic Changes in Older Adults With Cognitive Complaints According to the Presence of Peripheral Artery Disease.
papers.authors: Noh S, Shin HE, Shim Y.
papers.abstract: Objective As a systemic expression of atherosclerosis, peripheral artery disease (PAD) has the potential to alter cerebral hemodynamics in elderly individuals presenting with cognitive concerns. However, how PAD status shapes the longitudinal trajectory of cerebral hemodynamics has not been well characterized. Methods We conducted a single-center longitudinal observational study enrolling 132 participants (21 controls, 39 mild cognitive impairment, 72 mild Alzheimer's disease). All participants underwent transcranial Doppler (TCD) ultrasonography, ankle-brachial index (ABI) measurement, brain MRI, and cognitive assessments at baseline and follow-up (~13.45 months). PAD was defined as ABI < 0.90. Bilateral mean flow velocity (MFV), pulsatility index (PI), and resistance index (RI) of the middle cerebral artery (MCA) were tracked longitudinally across both time points. Results PAD was identified in 13 participants (9.8%). Baseline TCD parameters, vascular risk factors, white matter lesions on brain MRI, and cognitive measures were comparable between groups. At follow-up, the PAD group showed significantly higher MCA MFV after age adjustment (left p < 0.001; right p = 0.005). MFV increased in the PAD group (left +16.45 cm/s) but decreased in the non-PAD group (left -3.37 cm/s), with a significant between-group difference. PI and RI did not change in either group. Cognitive and functional outcomes were similar across groups throughout the study. Conclusion These findings identify PAD as a condition associated with progressive MCA MFV elevation in the context of preserved cognition, implying that subclinical cerebrovascular changes are detectable by TCD before overt clinical worsening. Future research involving larger cohorts and extended follow-up is required to determine whether such hemodynamic changes forecast eventual cognitive deterioration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注外周动脉疾病（PAD）是否会影响伴有认知主诉的老年人的脑血流动力学纵向变化，采用单中心纵向观察设计，对参与者进行经颅多普勒超声、踝臂指数测量、脑MRI和认知评估的基线与随访追踪。结果显示，基线时PAD组与非PAD组在脑血流参数、血管危险因素、白质病变和认知表现上相近；随访时PAD组大脑中动脉平均血流速度显著高于非PAD组，且PAD组血流速度上升而非PAD组下降，搏动指数和阻力指数两组均无变化，认知与功能结局在整个研究期间也保持相似。作者据此认为，PAD与认知尚保留状态下大脑中动脉血流速度的逐渐升高相关，提示经颅多普勒可在明显临床恶化前检出亚临床脑血管改变，但这些血流变化能否预测后续认知衰退仍需更大样本和更长随访验证。

papers.title: Complementing Engel Classification: Postoperative Scalp EEG as an Objective Indicator in SEEG-Guided Radiofrequency Thermocoagulation-A Seizure-Onset Pattern-Based Stratified Analysis.
papers.authors: Yang YQ, Zhang R, Ma H, Yang L, Qu X, Chen Q, Zhang Y.
papers.journal: Annals of clinical and translational neurology
papers.abstract: Background Stereoelectroencephalography-guided radiofrequency thermocoagulation (SEEG-RFTC) is a minimally invasive therapy for drug-resistant focal epilepsy. However, the relationship between specific seizure-onset patterns (SOPs), particularly low-voltage fast activity (LVFA), and postoperative scalp EEG normalization remains inadequately characterized. This study investigates whether LVFA predicts RFTC efficacy and whether postoperative EEG serves as an objective complement to clinical outcome measures. Objective To evaluate LVFA-dominant SOPs as predictors of seizure freedom and scalp EEG normalization after SEEG-RFTC, and to assess their interaction with MRI findings. Methods In a retrospective cohort of 25 patients, seizure-onset patterns (SOPs) were classified as LVFA-present (n = 13) or LVFA-absent (n = 12). Outcomes included Engel classification and 6-month postoperative scalp EEG. Seizure freedom and EEG normalization rates were compared, with MRI-stratified analysis. Results The seizure-free rate was 92.3% (12/13) in the LVFA-present group versus 33.3% (4/12) in the LVFA-absent group (p = 0.004). EEG normalization was more frequent in LVFA-present patients (7/8, 87.5%) than in LVFA-absent patients (4/12, 33.3%; p = 0.028); all but one patient with EEG normalization was seizure-free, the sole exception being an LVFA-absent patient who remained Engel III. In MRI-negative patients, LVFA-present had 100% (6/6) seizure freedom versus 20.0% (1/5) without LVFA (p = 0.015). Scalp EEG normalization may serve as a relatively objective marker of complete disintegration of the epileptic network, whereas some patients with persistent EEG abnormalities may still achieve seizure freedom with the aid of antiseizure medications. Conclusion In this cohort, LVFA-present SOPs are strongly associated with favorable RFTC outcomes and may represent a prerequisite for postoperative scalp EEG normalization. Postoperative EEG is a sensitive objective endpoint that complements Engel classification. Systematic PET evaluation in larger cohorts may further refine candidate selection in MRI-negative patients.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注立体脑电图引导射频热凝术后，以低电压快活动（LVFA）为特征的发作起始模式能否预测无发作及术后头皮脑电图正常化，并比较其与Engel分级的互补关系。回顾性分析显示，LVFA存在者的无发作率和脑电图正常化比例均明显高于LVFA缺失者，MRI阴性亚组中这一关联同样突出；脑电图正常化者几乎均无发作，但少数脑电图仍异常者也可在药物辅助下无发作。作者据此认为，LVFA模式与较好预后相关，术后脑电图可作为较客观的补充指标，但样本量有限，结论需更大队列验证。

papers.title: Motion matters: visual perception and motor functioning in children and youths with spastic cerebral palsy
papers.authors: Ericson A, Hellgren K, Benassi M, Bolzani R, Lidbeck C.

papers.title: Microstructural heterogeneity of white-matter aging and its age-dependent coupling to cognition
papers.authors: Chin R, Hu X, Ranieri J, Kim J, Oh H.
papers.abstract: Brain white matter (WM) microstructure undergoes extensive changes with age, yet the regional and cellular heterogeneity of age-related WM alterations and their impact on cognition remain unclear. Leveraging Neurite Orientation Dispersion and Density Imaging (NODDI), an advanced microstructural modelling to capture specific WM cellular properties, we investigated age-dependent relationships between advanced microstructural markers and cognitive performance, indexed by six cognitive domains derived from principal component analysis. Using a suite of standard diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) and NODDI techniques in eighty-six cognitively normal adults (Young: n=33, Older: n=53), we show that age group differences are widespread across whole brain white matter, with converging region-based and voxel-level evidence implicating commissural, association, and limbic pathways. Older adults exhibited significant and widespread reductions in global fractional anisotropy (FA) and neurite density index (NDI), concomitant with increases in mean diffusivity (MD), orientation density index (ODI), and free water fraction (FWF). Critically, age moderated WM-cognition associations in a domain- and tract-specific manner: younger adults exhibited stronger coupling between commissural and association tract microstructure and language and visual memory, whereas older adults showed greater dependence on projection and limbic tracts for executive and language function. The observed age-dependent coupling between specific microstructural metrics and cognition underscores the value of advanced diffusion models for capturing heterogeneity in brain aging, reveals age-specific biomarkers of cognitive health. These patterns align with phylogenetic and ontogenetic patterns of white matter vulnerability in callosal, long-range association, and limbic pathways, and suggest cellular specificity in white matter changes associated with cognitive decline. Significance Statement Aging affects brain white matter in complex and regionally specific ways, yet the biological bases of these changes and their relevance to cognition remain challenging to disentangle. Using multi-parameter diffusion MRI modeling, we found that age-related decline follows organized spatial patterns, with the greatest vulnerability in long-range association, callosal, and limbic pathways. These regional effects arise from distinct microstructural processes, including widespread extracellular alterations and more localized changes in neurite density and fiber organization. The strength and direction of white matter–cognition relationships differ between younger and older adults, revealing age-dependent shifts in how brain structural connections support behavior. Together, these findings identify biologically meaningful dimensions of white-matter vulnerability that may explain individual differences in cognitive aging.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注白质微结构的衰老变化是否存在区域与细胞层面的异质性，以及这些变化与认知的关系是否随年龄而不同。作者用多参数扩散磁共振建模，在认知正常成人中比较年轻与年长组的白质微结构指标，并考察其与多个认知域表现的关联。结果显示，衰老相关的白质差异在全脑广泛存在，尤其集中于连合、长程联络和边缘通路，且涉及细胞外改变、神经突密度和纤维组织等不同微结构过程。更重要的是，白质与认知的关联在年龄组间呈现领域和纤维束特异的差异：年轻人中连合与联络通路微结构同语言和视觉记忆联系更强，年长者中投射与边缘通路对执行和语言功能更为重要。作者据此指出，这些结果揭示了白质脆弱性的生物学维度，并提示与认知健康相关的年龄特异性标志物；但作为横断面关联证据，尚不能说明因果关系或临床效用。

papers.title: Sex Differences in Human Subcortical Anatomy are Robust and Replicable in Adulthood, Already Evident Prepubertally, and Aligned with Sex Chromosomal and Gonadal Influences
papers.authors: Lee HM, Liu S, Lalonde FM, Clasen L, Guma E, DeCasien A, Moraczewski D, Thomas A, Lerch JP, Devenyi GA, Chakravarty MM, Berman KF, Delaney A, Raznahan A.
papers.abstract: The existence and mechanistic bases of sex effects on human subcortical anatomy remain unclear. To address these gaps, we combined structural neuroimaging of sex differences in subcortical volume and shape across three independent cohorts (combined N=2,886) with neuroimaging maps of sex chromosomal and endocrine effects from three clinical cohorts (combined N=313, including sex chromosome aneuploidies and isolated gonadotropin-releasing hormone deficiency). We found that human subcortical anatomy shows focal sex differences of moderate-strong effect size during young adulthood (male-biased surface area overlying lateral/ventral putamen and pallidum, nucleus accumbens, ventral posterior complex of thalamus, anterior hippocampus, and medial and central nuclei of amygdala; female-biased surface area overlying caudate head, posterior/dorsal pallidum, mediodorsal, lateral dorsal, lateral geniculate, and medial geniculate nuclei of thalamus, posterior hippocampus, and basolateral and lateral nuclei of amygdala). These regional sex differences show strong within-sample reproducibility at modest sample sizes (N≥200) and are replicable in a fully independent mid-adulthood cohort. Strikingly, we find that the topography of adult subcortical sex differences is already established by pre/early puberty (age 9 years), and the same holds for cortical sex differences. Comparison with neuroimaging data from rare disorder cohorts reveals that subcortical sex differences show a statistically significant spatial and directional congruence with the anatomical effects of X-chromosome dosage in the striatum and effects of testicular hormones in the amygdala. Together, these findings provide a reference map for the fine-grained spatial patterning of sex differences in adult subcortical shape, demonstrating its replicability, establishment before pubertal progression, and spatial concordance with potentially causal sex chromosomal and gonadal effects.

papers.title: How auditory rhythm perception shapes speech production: The influence of neural synchronization and rhythmic patterns.
papers.authors: Tan C, Yan Q, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: Auditory rhythm perception facilitates language processing, yet it remains unclear how neural synchronization to external rhythms contributes to speech production. The present study examined whether individual differences in neural synchronization modulate rhythmic priming effects during speech production and whether such effects depend on the rhythmic structure of the target utterance. Eighty-six native Mandarin speakers performed a speech production task involving two four-syllable rhythmic patterns as targets: the dominant [2+2] pattern (boundary after the second syllable) and the less common [1+3] pattern (boundary after the first syllable). Each target was preceded by a rhythmically congruent or incongruent pure-tone prime. Neural synchronization to the primes was quantified using cerebral-acoustic coherence (CACoh) between EEG activity and the temporal envelope of the auditory rhythms, and rhythmic priming was assessed using response latencies. K-means clustering of CACoh measures identified two participant groups characterized by relatively high and low levels of neural synchronization.
