Here, we found that lack of the circadian photoreceptor cryptochrome (cry ) leads to increased sleep under short winter-like days in the fruit fly Drosophila , reminiscent of the hypersomnolence in SAD. CRY functions in neurons that synthesize the major inhibitory neurotransmitter GABA, including the small ventral lateral neurons, which are known to be circadian pacemakers, and downregulates the GABAergic tone. This, in turn, leads to increased neural activity of the wake-promoting large ventral lateral neurons, a subset of circadian neurons that are inhibited by GABA-A receptors. CRY protein is known to be degraded by light, thus rendering CRY to be functional within this GABAergic circuitry to enhance wakefulness only under short-day length. Taken together, we demonstrate a mechanism that specifically regulates wakefulness under short winter-like days, which may provide insights regarding the winter sleepiness in SAD.

papers.title: Vibrotactile transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) during working memory: convergent electrophysiological evidence for cortical efficiency
papers.authors: Tan G, Demarest P, Kardashina T, Adams J, Willie JT, Roland J, Gorlewicz JL, Brunner P, Leuthardt EC.
papers.abstract: Background Working memory, the cognitive ability to maintain and manipulate a finite amount of information, is fundamental in reasoning, learning, and decision-making. Working memory erodes in conditions from Alzheimer’s disease to stroke to healthy aging. Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) is a promising neuromodulation method for improving working memory. By stimulating the auricular branch of the vagus nerve, taVNS is thought to engage ascending arousal systems such as the locus coeruleus-norepinephrine (LC-NE) system. However, the physiological link between LC-NE system modulation via taVNS and improved working memory remains largely unknown. This mechanistic gap limits the rational optimization of the stimulation protocol and the identification of the cognitive functions and patient populations that are likely to benefit. Objective We test two competing hypotheses for how taVNS may improve working memory: sensory amplification or enhancement of cortical efficiency. The sensory-amplification hypothesis predicts increased cortical responses to stimuli, whereas the cortical-efficiency hypothesis predicts reduced cortical responses. Methods Twenty healthy adults completed N-back working memory tasks during three counterbalanced sessions: baseline, active vibrotactile taVNS (vtaVNS), and sham stimulation, while we simultaneously recorded electroencephalography, electrocardiography, eye-tracking, and behavioral responses. To study the effect of vtaVNS on neuronal activity, we also recruited 20 patients with epilepsy undergoing invasive monitoring. Of these, 19 fully completed the spatial working-memory task. We quantified cortical responses to visual stimuli using event-related potentials (ERPs) in scalp EEG and high-gamma activity in intracranial local field potentials. To examine prediction of the cortical-efficiency hypothesis, we further explored the effect of vtaVNS on distance to criticality and heartbeat-evoked potentials. Results Active vtaVNS reduced both scalp-recorded visual ERP and high-gamma response in temporal cortices, relative to sham stimulation. Moreover, smaller visual event-related potentials were associated with successful encoding during the most demanding working-memory condition (i.e., 4-back task). Exploratory analyses showed that vtaVNS shifted cortical dynamics closer to criticality. Conclusion Our results converge on the conclusion that vtaVNS does not uniformly amplify cortical responses to external stimuli. Instead, vtaVNS enhances cortical efficiency, supporting more effective allocation of cognitive resources between exteroceptive and mnemonic processes. These findings provide a framework for predicting when taVNS will be most beneficial and for optimizing stimulation protocols across cognitive and clinical applications. Highlights Consistent visual event-related potential in human subjects during an N-back working memory task Vibrotactile taVNS reduced stimulus-evoked cortical responses in both scalp EEG and intracranial high-gamma activity (70-150 Hz). Reduced visual event-related potentials are associated with successful encoding in the 4-back task. Vibrotactile taVNS shifted cortical dynamics toward a near-critical regime.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）改善工作记忆的机制，比较“感觉放大”与“皮层效率”两种假说，并结合健康成人头皮脑电与癫痫患者颅内记录，在N-back任务中考察刺激对视觉诱发皮层反应的影响。结果显示，主动触觉式taVNS相对假刺激降低了视觉事件相关电位和颞叶高伽马活动，且较小的视觉诱发电位与高负荷工作记忆条件下的成功编码相关；探索性分析还提示刺激使皮层动态更接近临界状态。作者据此认为，taVNS并非普遍放大对外部刺激的皮层反应，而是提升皮层效率，促进外部感知与记忆过程间认知资源的更有效分配，为预测其适用情境和优化刺激方案提供了框架。

papers.title: Sense and Sensibility: Sensible Quality Control and Data Decision-Making in Passive Sensing Data for Adolescent Substance Use Risk Prediction
papers.authors: Hong A, Diaz JL, Kennedy TM, Wang FL.
papers.abstract: Background Passively collected smartphone and wearable data, combined with genomic information, may enable scalable early identification of youth who are at risk for substance use disorder. However, heterogeneous data collected in naturalistic settings limit researcher control over data quality, requiring substantial preprocessing. Data cleaning and feature engineering decisions can meaningfully influence analytic outcomes yet are often minimally described or omitted in published work. Objectives We provide rationales and recommendations for common preprocessing challenges in passive sensing research, including establishing inclusion criteria when “outliers” may reflect true behavioral variability, analyzing differences across smartphone operating systems, handling observations collected outside protocol windows, and engineering features for machine learning applications. Methods We illustrate principled approaches to these challenges using smartphone and Fitbit data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development SM Study (ABCD). The sample was drawn from the available half of the year-4 follow-up (data release 5.1; N = 4,754; ages 13–14). Results Extreme outlying observations were concentrated among low-engagement participants with few observed days. Smartphone usage among Apple users appeared under-recorded relative to Android users when compared with self-report measures. Fitbit-derived behavior differed systematically between observations collected within versus outside protocol windows. We also identified potential errors in the study’s default preprocessing pipeline. Conclusion We recommend prioritizing person-level inclusion criteria that preserve meaningful behavioral variability, examining temporal distributions rather than assuming observations are exchangeable, and thoroughly investigating and reporting data quality issues. Although illustrated using the ABCD Study, these principles broadly apply to research using smartphones, wearables, and other digital data sources.
papers.summary_zh: 该文聚焦被动感知数据用于青少年物质使用风险预测时的预处理决策问题，结合ABCD研究中青少年智能手机与Fitbit数据，说明数据清洗和特征工程会实质影响分析结果。作者发现，极端离群值多集中在观测天数很少、参与度低的个体；与自报使用相比，苹果手机用户的使用记录似乎被低估；Fitbit行为指标在方案规定时间窗内外存在系统差异，并指出研究默认预处理流程可能存在错误。文章据此建议优先采用能保留真实行为变异的个体层面纳入标准，考察数据的时间分布而非假定观测可互换，并充分调查和报告数据质量问题；这些原则可推广至其他数字数据研究，但结论属于方法学建议，并非干预效果。

papers.title: Effects of cognitive-behavioural therapy for insomnia on cognitive and emotional functioning in adults with insomnia: behavioural and neuroimaging evidence
papers.authors: Gong K, Phillips E, Perrault AA, Borgetto F, Walsh NA, Reyt M, Maltezos A, Garneau J, Tarelli L, McGrath JJ, Savard J, Schwartz S, Gouin J, Dang-Vu TT.
papers.abstract: Study Objectives To characterize neural correlates of memory and emotion reactivity in individuals with insomnia disorder (INS) compared to good sleepers (GS) and to investigate associated short- and long-term changes following cognitive-behavioural therapy for insomnia (CBTi). Methods This randomized controlled trial included 56 INS and 20 GS. At baseline, participants underwent resting-state and task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging, including working memory, emotion reactivity, and face-name associative memory tasks. They filled out sleep diaries and self-report questionnaires about sleep, cognition, and emotions, and underwent in-lab polysomnography. Subsequently, participants with INS were randomized to either the 3-month treatment group (TX) or wait-list control group (WL). Both TX and WL groups repeated baseline assessments at three months post-randomization and completed sleep diaries and questionnaires one year after finishing CBTi. Results At baseline, the INS group reported higher insomnia severity, greater subjective cognitive impairment, and perceived sleep-related stimuli as more negative than GS. Contrasting with these subjective evaluations, no group differences were found in memory performance, task-based brain activity, or resting-state functional connectivity. At three months post-randomization and one-year follow-up, CBTi significantly improved subjective, but not objective, cognitive functioning and sleep in adults with INS. No significant treatment-related changes were observed in valence ratings of sleep images, task-based brain activity, or resting-state functional connectivity. Conclusions Beyond its primary role in improving insomnia symptoms, CBTi may have long-term benefits for individuals with INS who experience concerns about their cognitive functioning, even in the absence of objective changes in neural processing of cognitive and emotional tasks. Clinical trial Impact of Insomnia Treatment on Brain Responses During Resting-state and Cognitive Tasks. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT04024787 ; https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04024787 Statement of Significance Insomnia disorder impairs sleep, cognitive, and emotional functioning, imposing a significant clinical burden and highlighting the need for effective interventions to address these impairments. Our study used self-reports, task performance, and neuroimaging techniques to comprehensively investigate the effectiveness of cognitive-behavioural therapy for insomnia on subjective and objective measures of sleep, cognitive, and emotional functions in adults with insomnia disorder. Our findings show that this treatment has long-lasting benefits on subjective, but not objective, cognitive functioning and sleep measures. No changes were found in valence ratings of sleep images, memory performance, or brain function. Future research should identify neural substrates and psychological processes underlying these subjective cognitive deficits as well as the dissociation between subjective and objective cognitive functioning in insomnia.
papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验比较了失眠障碍成人（INS）与睡眠良好者（GS）在记忆和情绪反应性上的神经相关特征，并考察认知行为疗法（CBTi）后的短期与长期变化。基线时，INS组报告失眠更重、主观认知损害更明显，且对睡眠相关刺激的负性评价更强；但在记忆表现、任务态脑活动和静息态功能连接上，两组未见差异。三个月及一年随访时，CBTi显著改善了INS成人的主观认知功能和睡眠，但客观指标未见相应改善，睡眠图片效价评分、任务态脑活动及静息态功能连接也无显著治疗相关变化。作者据此提示，CBTi可能对担忧自身认知功能的失眠者具有长期主观获益，即便认知与情绪任务的神经加工未见客观改变。

papers.title: Defining a subgroup within autism leads to potential enrichment criteria in investigational therapeutic development: Comparing resting state gamma band power to a fragile X syndrome reference sample
papers.authors: Westerkamp GC, Sarraf ST, Vanderklish P, Gargosky S, Elmaghraby R, Pedapati EV, Erickson CA.
papers.abstract: Background Elevated resting gamma power is a reproducible, robust neurophysiology marker across species in fragile X syndrome (FXS), a major known cause of autism spectrum disorders (ASD). In FXS, this neurophysiological phenotype is well described and particularly prominent in males harboring fully methylated full CGG repeat expansions [1,4,16–20]. However, gamma power evaluations in idiopathic ASD have yielded variable results. As a single-gene model of ASD, FXS hold promise to biologically model some of the autism spectrum. Exaggerated gamma power in FXS is thought to reflect increased cortical excitability, a common feature of ASD, and has been shown to correlate with symptoms in both human FXS individuals and the Fmr1 knockout mouse model of FXS [1,19,20]. A recent clinical trial of the BK channel positive modulator, Codabakalner, provided encouraging signs that normalization of gamma power in FXS may provide therapeutic benefit [14]. Interventional and biomarker studies in ASD provide support that this may also be the case in ASD [15]. We utilized gamma band power to evaluate neurophysiological overlap between ASD and FXS seeking to determine the prevalence and clinical characteristics of those with ASD who exhibit a FXS-like elevated resting state gamma phenotype. Methods This cross-sectional resting EEG analysis included 159 individuals with non-syndromic ASD and 41 males with fully methylated full mutation FXS. Relative gamma power was calculated as 30– 100 Hz power divided by 1–100 Hz power across 10–20-equivalent electrodes, excluding 55–65 Hz. We defined the cutoff for elevated resting gamma band power in ASD as relative gamma power of greater than or equal to the median minus one standard deviation of gamma power in our FXS male sample. Results A FXS-derived relative-gamma threshold of 0.185 or greater was met by 22% of participants with ASD (n=35). As expected, the mean ASD group resting state gamma was lower than the male FXS sample (p < 0.001). ASD participant threshold proportions by age group were 3/37 (8.1%) below 13 years, 9/50 (18.0%) age 13-18 years, and 23/72 (31.9%) in the 18+ years group. Within the ASD group, there were no observable clinical characteristics that readily differentiated participants with an elevated gamma phenotype from those without this phenotype. Conclusions Approximately one fifth of all participants and slightly over 30 percent of adults with ASD met the FXS-derived elevated resting gamma band power criterion. This represents the first investigation using a translational brain neurophysiology marker in a syndromic form of autism to parse a clinical idiopathic ASD sample to identify potential overlapping brain features. The results will work to support potential targeting of ASD subgroups in the future utilizing therapeutic approaches initially established in a single-gene form of developmental disability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用静息态脑电比较非综合征性自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）个体与脆性X综合征男性患者的伽马波段功率，试图找出ASD中具有类似脆性X综合征伽马功率升高特征的亚组。结果显示，约五分之一的ASD参与者达到了由脆性X综合征样本推导出的相对伽马功率阈值，且这一比例随年龄组升高，成年组略超三成；但ASD组内未见能区分该特征有无的明显临床特点。作者认为，这是首次用源自单基因自闭症的转化性神经生理指标来划分特发性ASD样本，提示部分ASD个体可能存在与脆性X综合征重叠的脑电特征，为未来针对ASD亚组的干预研究提供线索，但该特征与临床症状的关系及治疗意义尚待验证。

papers.title: Large language model consensus for reliable research cohort construction from radiology reports: a retrospective cohort study
papers.authors: Rui W, Ma J, Stepanov V, Bunnell A, Lan M, Chen J, Patel RR, Novikov DS, Fieremans E, Shen Y.
papers.abstract: Background Large-scale retrospective studies often require researchers to adjudicate outcomes or cohort eligibility from unstructured clinical records. Manual review can provide reliable labels but is difficult to scale. We developed and evaluated a consensus workflow using multiple large language models (LLMs) to automatically assign high-confidence outcome labels while deferring ambiguous cases for manual review. Methods We included 6,718 brain MRI reports from 5,856 patients. The expert-adjudicated reference set included 680 reports from 675 patients: 372 normal (age-appropriate without significant intracranial pathology), 90 white matter hyperintensity-only (WMH-only; isolated nonspecific WMHs potentially ambiguous for binary classification), and 218 abnormal (other intracranial pathology) reports. We evaluated proprietary-inclusive (Qwen3/Kimi-Linear/GPT-5) and open-source (Qwen3/Kimi-Linear/DeepSeek-R1) ensembles against individual LLMs. Ensembles assigned a normal or abnormal label only when all models agreed; all other reports were classified as uncertain and deferred for manual review. Individual LLMs assigned normal or abnormal predictions and classified WMH-only predictions as uncertain. In the full cohort, we compared the prevalence of active central nervous system (CNS)-related International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) diagnoses across the normal, uncertain, and abnormal groups generated by each ensemble. Results In the expert-adjudicated reference set, both ensembles achieved 100% precision for automatically assigned normal and abnormal reports. GPT-5 was the strongest individual LLM but had lower precision than either ensemble, with normal and abnormal precision of 98.9% and 94.1%, respectively, and 17 expert-label mismatches versus none for the consensus ensembles. In the full cohort, 1.6% of reports classified as normal were associated with CNS-related ICD-10 diagnoses, compared with 29.7% of uncertain and 51.3% of abnormal reports for the proprietary-inclusive ensemble; corresponding rates were 1.6%, 31.1%, and 51.6% for the open-source ensemble. Conclusions Requiring unanimous agreement across multiple LLMs enabled high-precision automatic adjudication while directing ambiguous cases to manual review. This strategy may reduce the burden of manual adjudication and support scalable construction of high-purity research cohorts from unstructured clinical text.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对从非结构化影像报告中构建研究队列时人工判读难以规模化的问题，开发并评估了多模型一致性工作流：仅当多个大语言模型判断一致时才自动赋予正常或异常标签，其余病例转人工复核。在专家判读的参考集中，两种模型组合自动分配的标签精确率均达100%，高于表现最好的单个模型；在全队列中，被自动判为正常的报告伴随中枢神经系统相关诊断的比例远低于不确定和异常组。结果表明，要求多模型一致可在保证高精确率的同时筛出模糊病例交由人工处理，有望减轻人工判读负担，但该策略的实际应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Resting-State Functional Connectivity and Cognitive Performance in Long COVID: A Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: O’Connor D, Watson E, Reich DL, Carnavali F, Mcveety M, Gwalani P, Wisnivesky JP, Becker JH.
papers.abstract: Cognitive impairment is a prevalent, disabling manifestation of Long COVID, but whether cognitive rehabilitation alters neural network organization is unknown. We examined whether a 12-week cognitive rehabilitation intervention modified resting-state connectivity within the central-executive (CEN), default-mode (DMN), and salience (SN) networks, and whether connectivity changes associated with cognitive performance. Participants were adults with prior SARS-CoV-2 infection, persistent Long COVID symptoms (≥3 months), and objectively confirmed mild-to-moderate cognitive impairment. Of 58 participants randomized, 39 (mean age 46.4; 69% women) completed neuroimaging (19 intervention, 20 control). The 12-week intervention combined virtual cognitive rehabilitation and small-group and individual sessions with computerized cognitive training. No significant group, time, or group-by-time interaction effects were observed for within- or between-network connectivity (all P > 0.22). Exploratory analyses identified nominal associations (P < 0.05) between connectivity changes and cognition; improved processing speed associated with increased CEN-DMN connectivity, greater SN-DMN connectivity associated with worse performance across processing speed, working memory, and executive function. None survived correction for multiple comparisons. Cognitive rehabilitation was not associated with detectable changes in resting-state network connectivity in long COVID–related cognitive impairment. SN-DMN connectivity may represent a marker of reduced network segregation underlying cognitive dysfunction, warranting study in larger, multimodal trials. Trial registration: NCT05498493 .
papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验考察为期12周、结合线上认知康复与计算机化认知训练的干预，能否改变长新冠伴轻中度认知障碍成人静息态下中央执行网络、默认模式网络和突显网络内部及网络间的连接，并检验连接变化与认知表现的关系。结果显示，干预组与对照组在网络连接上未见可检测的组间、时间或交互差异。探索性分析中，连接变化与认知成绩仅呈名义相关，例如加工速度改善与中央执行—默认模式连接增强相关，突显—默认模式连接增强则与多项认知表现较差相关，但均未通过多重比较校正。作者据此认为，认知康复未伴随可检测的静息态网络连接改变，突显—默认模式连接或可作为网络分离减弱、认知功能受损的候选标记，仍需更大规模的多模态研究验证。

papers.title: Social feedback structures stay/switch decision-making in Drosophila
papers.authors: Aragon MJ, Murthy M.
papers.abstract: Within natural environments, different sensory stimuli can drive mutually-exclusive behaviors such as fighting, feeding, or courting. When experiencing competing cues, how do animals decide to continue executing the current behavior or to switch to a new behavior? To address this question, we developed a closed-loop behavioral paradigm that presents actively courting male Drosophila with a fictive heat stimulus, forcing the male to choose between two competing behaviors: continue courting (stay) or escape the heat (switch). By modeling the sensorimotor transformations underlying this decision process, we discovered that male flies continually evaluate social cues—including the female’s speed and her distance—in order to make a stay/switch decision. We investigated the neural correlates of stay/switch decision-making via brain-wide calcium imaging in head-fixed male flies presented with both fictive female visual cues and heat stimuli. We built models that predicted stay/switch decisions from neural data, which revealed that activity in a small number of brain regions, including the anterior optic tubercle, predicted decision outcomes up to 4 seconds prior to stimulus onset, whereas after stimulus onset, distributed activity across the brain was correlated with the behavioral decision. Together, these results demonstrate that Drosophila continually evaluate social feedback to inform decisions about how to respond to environmental cues, and that brain activity changes prior to presentation of the environmental cue can inform upcoming decisions. Overall, this study provides new insight into the processes underlying naturalistic decision-making in Drosophila .
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注动物面对竞争性线索时如何在维持当前行为与切换行为之间做出选择，以正在求偶的雄性果蝇为对象，结合闭环行为范式和全脑钙成像，让雄蝇在继续求偶与躲避热刺激之间抉择。行为建模显示，雄蝇会持续评估雌蝇的速度和距离等社会反馈，以此决定留下还是切换；神经层面，少数脑区（包括前视结节）的活动可在刺激出现前数秒预测决策结果，而刺激出现后则与全脑分布式活动相关。作者据此认为，果蝇会不断整合社会反馈来指导对环境线索的应答，且线索呈现前的脑活动变化已能预示即将做出的决定，为理解自然情境下的决策过程提供了线索。

papers.title: Glia-enriched human brain organoids for studying developmental alterations in leukodystrophies
papers.authors: Mangiameli E, Kok LM, Rosato C, Cenini G, Cupaioli FA, Alfieri R, Vitchanthangal Prathivathibayankaram S, Oberst P, Peitz M, Dooves S, Merelli I, Gritti A, Brüstle O, Heine VM.
papers.abstract: Leukodystrophies (LKD) comprise mostly inherited white matter disorders whose developmental origins and underlying pathomechanisms remain poorly understood. Progress has been limited by restricted access to human primary tissue and by the inability of animal models to fully recapitulate human neurodevelopment. Human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural organoids provide an alternative approach, but most culture systems do not capture later, glia-rich developmental stages relevant to these diseases. Recent studies have shown that appropriate patterning cues and long in vitro differentiation can generate neuroglial spheroids comprising multiple neuronal and macroglial populations, including mature oligodendrocytes. Here, we adapt the human oligodendrocyte (hOLS) spheroid platform to establish 3D models of globoid cell leukodystrophy (GLD), 4H leukodystrophy (4H), and Canavan disease (CD). Here we adapt this organoid platform to establish 3D models of globoid cell leukodystrophy (GLD), 4H leukodystrophy (4H), and Canavan disease (CD). Across 150 days of differentiation, hOLS from different genetic backgrounds displayed largely comparable growth kinetics and developmental trajectories, comprising multiple neuroglial cell types with predominantly ventral forebrain and midbrain identities. Comparison of LKD and control hOLS revealed both shared and disease-specific alterations, with prominent transcriptional changes in lysosomal, metabolic, and stress-response pathways. Lineage-resolved pathway analysis further identified signatures across individual LKDs, including mitochondrial and translational stress in GLD glial lineages, disruption of RNA metabolic and cell-cycle pathways in 4H, and prominent astrocyte-centered metabolic dysregulation in CD. Our results establish hOLS as a human 3D in vitro platform for studying the impact of LKD-associated genetic variants on early neural development and for dissecting lineage-specific disease vulnerability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑白质营养不良（LKD）发育起源和病理机制不清、缺乏合适人类模型的问题，将人少突胶质细胞球体平台改造为球形细胞脑白质营养不良、4H脑白质营养不良和Canavan病三种疾病的3D模型，并在长期分化中比较其与对照的发育轨迹。结果显示，不同遗传背景的球体生长和分化大体相当，但疾病模型呈现共同及特异的转录改变，集中于溶酶体、代谢和应激反应通路；按谱系分析还发现各病特有的通路异常。作者据此提出，该平台可用于研究LKD相关遗传变异对早期神经发育的影响及谱系特异的疾病易感性。

papers.title: Distilling Trial-Level EEG Variability into Participant Representations: Neurophysiologically Constrained Graph Learning in ADHD
papers.authors: Tiwari R, Beste C, Gholamipourbarogh N.
papers.abstract: Extracting stable individual-level representations from noisy and variable trial-wise EEG remains a major challenge in computational cognitive neuroscience. We developed a spatiotemporal graph attention network to analyze Go/NoGo EEG from children and adolescents with and without ADHD. The framework combines ERP-informed temporal windows, phase-synchrony graph priors, and trial-to-participant transfer learning, making both information routing and representation geometry explicitly testable. The model learned reproducible attention trajectories, yet ADHD and control participants did not differ reliably in spatial attention allocation. Instead, group-related structure emerged in compact participant-level embeddings that distilled trial-level variability and retained discriminative information beyond convolutional representations. Performance exceeded a convolutional neural network comparison, but the central advance is methodological: neurophysiologically constrained graph learning can reveal where diagnostically relevant information emerges within the analytical pipeline. This provides a framework for developing auditable cognitive-neurophysiological markers of neurodevelopmental variation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对逐试次脑电噪声大、变异高、难以提取稳定个体表征的问题，开发了时空图注意力网络，并结合事件相关电位（ERP）引导的时间窗、相位同步图先验和试次到参与者的迁移学习，分析ADHD儿童青少年与对照者的Go/NoGo脑电。模型学到了可重复的注意轨迹，但ADHD组与对照组在空间注意分配上未见可靠差异；组间相关信息主要体现在紧凑的参与者水平嵌入中，这些嵌入压缩了试次间变异，并保留了卷积表征之外的判别信息。模型性能优于卷积神经网络对照，但作者强调核心进展在方法学层面：受神经生理约束的图学习能揭示诊断相关信息在分析流程中何处出现，为开发可审计的认知神经生理标记提供了框架。

papers.title: cyto7: an open, vertex-level cortical type atlas of the human cortex
papers.authors: Salvador R, Mercadal B, Castaldo F, García-Cabezas MÁ, Ruffini G.
papers.abstract: The cerebral cortex is organized along a gradient of laminar complexity, indexed principally by the emergence and granularity of layer IV and by the size of layer III neuron somata, and cortical types are the ordered categories along it. The Structural Model builds on that gradient to predict laminar connectivity, plasticity and disease vulnerability 1,2 . Existing digital cortical-type maps are area-level: they assign one type per classical area and cannot represent a type boundary that runs through an area. We release cyto7, an open, vertex-level, seven-type cortical-type atlas delineated on the fsaverage surface following the García-Cabezas protocol and revised by the protocol’s authors. We distribute the atlas with a reusable quality-control and support framework. A topological audit reports the map against four spatial rules that follow from cortical type analysis and the dual origin of the neocortex theory: neighbouring vertices differ by at most one type, the least complex cortex forms one continuous limbic belt, eulaminate II forms a single matrix enclosing a few holes, and eulaminate III and koniocortex form isolated islands. These were imposed during construction rather than tested, and the audit reports what imposing them cost. A vertex-wise benchmark against the existing area-level map, one type per von Economo–Koskinas area, shows exact agreement at 52.5% of vertices, with disagreement almost always a single level and concentrated inside the large, heterogeneous areas that a single areal label cannot resolve. Where the two maps disagree, cyto7’s label better matches the independent multimodal profile in 60.1% of pooled feature-by-vertex comparisons, against 46% under a rotation null and 54% under granularity-matched alternative partitions ( p = 0.020), the harder of the two. A per-vertex anatomical support score, computed from anatomy alone, states how strongly each hand-drawn label is backed by the anatomical evidence, and is deliberately not a calibrated error probability. We then validate cyto7 against independent brain measures not used to define it, under a spatial-autocorrelation (spin) null with FDR control. Intracortical myelin (T1w/T2w) increases, cortical thickness decreases, and the principal functional-connectivity gradient reverses along the type axis (all q ≲ 0.006). Source-reconstructed resting-state MEG dynamics also track the axis: the intrinsic timescale shortens toward koniocortex ( ρ ≈ − 0.46) and survives the null, as do the spectral centroid and the slow/fast band-power ratio, whereas the aperiodic 1/f exponent does not. The laminar marker genes are where cyto7 differs most from a quantisation of a continuous map: it shows a larger absolute correlation with the layer-IV marker RORB ( ρ = +0.78) and the layer-V marker FEZF2 ( − 0.59) than seven-level septiles of myelin, of the functional gradient or of a histological gradient, on four of five markers, while tying or losing to those septiles on the macroscale proxies. These are larger observed associations against three tested quantisations, not a test that the differences between maps are reliable, and they do not establish the accuracy of any individual boundary. Defined from anatomy alone, cyto7 recovers the sensorimotor-to-association hierarchy and, on these markers, some of the laminar signal underlying it. It is released with its full pipeline and an uncalibrated anatomical support score as a reusable substrate for structure–function and modelling studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究发布了cyto7——一个在fsaverage表面上按García-Cabezas方案绘制的开放、顶点级七类皮层类型图谱，旨在突破以往区域级图谱每个经典脑区只能标一种类型、无法刻画跨脑区类型边界的局限。拓扑审计显示，图谱满足相邻顶点类型至多相差一级、最不复杂皮层构成连续边缘带等空间规则，但这些规则是构建时施加的而非检验所得；与既有区域级图谱相比，顶点完全一致率约52.5%，分歧多集中在单个等级且位于大而异的脑区内。作者用未参与定义的独立指标验证：髓鞘、皮层厚度、功能连接主梯度及MEG时间尺度等沿类型轴呈系统变化，层标记基因相关也较强，但作者强调这些是观察到的关联，不证明单个边界准确，解剖支持分数亦非校准的错误概率。

papers.title: Objective markers of altered neural gain dissociate tinnitus and self-reported listening problems in individuals with exceptional hearing thresholds
papers.authors: O’Donohue MP, Mikiel-Hunter J, Hernández-Peréz H, McAlpine D, Faúndez-Astudillo J.
papers.abstract: Many individuals experience problems that are undetected by standard hearing tests, such as persistent tinnitus and difficulties understanding speech in background noise. Here, we report evidence of altered neural gain in young adults with self-reported listening problems despite exceptional hearing thresholds. Individuals reporting persistent tinnitus—the daily percept of sound in the absence of an external source—exhibited elevated thresholds of the middle ear muscle reflex, suggestive of altered gain in brainstem reflexive circuits, and reduced cortical responses to auditory spatial cues conveyed in the temporal fine structure of low-frequency sounds. Moreover, in both groups, greater self-reported speech-in-noise difficulties were associated with higher magnitude cortical responses—particularly at the highest stimulus intensity—consistent with elevated neural gain. Using a conceptual model, we demonstrate how damage to high-threshold auditory nerve fibres innervating cochlear nuclei can account for reduced activity of binaural neurons sensitive to the temporal fine structure of low-frequency sounds, generating a compensatory increase in neural gain in higher brain centres that impacts listening in complex environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注听力阈值优异但自述存在聆听困难的年轻人，考察其神经增益是否发生改变。研究发现，自述持续耳鸣者中耳肌反射阈值升高，提示脑干反射回路增益改变，同时其皮层对低频声时间精细结构中空间线索的反应减弱；而在两组人群中，自述噪声下言语理解困难越重，皮层反应幅度越大，尤其在高强度刺激下，符合神经增益升高的表现。作者据此提出概念模型，认为支配耳蜗核的高阈值听神经纤维受损可解释双耳神经元活动降低，继而引发高级中枢的代偿性增益升高，影响复杂环境中的聆听。这些结果将耳鸣与自述聆听问题区分开来，但相关机制仍属模型推断。

papers.title: Contextualizing the polygenic basis of human brain shape
papers.authors: Casas-Riu J, Boeckx C.
papers.abstract: As the most recently evolved neuroanatomical trait of our species, our globular head shape (‘globularity’) constitutes a promising point of entry to probe possible associations between brain morphology and cognitive traits that may be distinctive of Homo sapiens . To shed additional light on the underlying biology of globularity and its cognitive consequences, we capitalize on data pairing genetic variation to brain shape differences from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans of 34,595 adults of European ancestry, and embed genome-wide associations of globularity within genetic variation underpinning up to 75 brain-related traits. Through extensive hypergeometric tests, we observe significant associations between globularity and white matter traits at the gene level, but stronger associations with cerebellar volume, ventricular size, and the fornix at the genomic variant level. Combining conjunctional false discovery rate (FDR) with genetic correlations, we notice homogeneously concordant relations between globularity and the volume of the brain ventricles, and homogeneously discordant relations with glymphatic function. We also unravel more selective, spatially organized relations between globularity and cerebellar volume, white matter connectivity and sulcal width. Spatial permutation tests reveal that sulcal width associations are systematically distributed along a sensorimotor-association gradient of cortical organization. Additionally, correlations of brain - and lifespan -wise gene expression patterns linked to globularity and the brain ventricles highlight recurrent associations with the pentose phosphate metabolic pathway. Finally, deploying an open repository of genetic variant age estimations and an extensive catalog of single nucleotide changes distinguishing hominins, we uncover a coincidence between the establishment of globularity and the time of emergence of modifications in the cerebrospinal fluid proteome. Overall, we provide a finer-grained genetic architecture for globularity, with novel biological associations to traits across evolutionary and developmental timescales, leading us to draw implications for the early development of cognitive networks but also for liabilities to neurodegeneration late in life.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用数万名欧洲裔成年人的遗传变异与脑部磁共振成像数据，考察人类特有的球状头形（globularity）的多基因基础及其与脑相关性状的遗传关联。作者将球状头形的全基因组关联信号嵌入多种脑相关性状的遗传变异背景中，发现其与白质、小脑体积、脑室大小及穹窿等存在关联，其中与脑室体积呈一致的正向关系，与类淋巴功能呈一致的负向关系，并与小脑体积、白质连接和脑沟宽度存在更具选择性的空间组织化联系。研究还提示球状头形相关基因表达与磷酸戊糖途径反复相关，且球状头形的确立时间与脑脊液蛋白质组的演化改变时间相吻合。作者据此讨论了这些关联对认知网络早期发育及晚年神经退行性风险的潜在含义，但相关结果尚属遗传关联层面，不能直接推断因果或临床效应。

papers.title: Spontaneous slow waves index multiple dimensions of recovery in Disorders of Consciousness
papers.authors: Ruyant Belabbas A, Boullet A, Manasova D, Le Coz A, Valente M, Lejeune F, Sitt JD, Naccache L, Rohaut B, Andrillon T.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Whether and how residual awareness is expressed in patients with Disorders of Consciousness (DoC) depends on the severity of brain damage and the transient functional state of the cortex at assessment. Classically, DoC are associated with electroencephalographic (EEG) slowing, marked by high-amplitude slow waves, even during the day. Yet, slow waves are also a hallmark of healthy sleep, where they are thought to serve restorative functions and to help maintain network homeostasis. Here, we asked whether slow waves in DoC can provide insights into the severity of cortical dysfunction or, conversely, into the preservation of residual awareness and recovery potential, by characterizing their spatial, temporal and morphological properties. We analyzed 256-channel EEG recorded during the ‘Local-Global’ auditory paradigm in 236 DoC patients, including 123 in Unresponsive Wakefulness Syndrome (UWS), 62 in a Minimally Conscious State minus (MCS-) and 29 in MCS plus (MCS+). High-amplitude slow waves were detected as local events, and their density, amplitude and slopes were quantified scalp-wide and channel-wise, by mean level and temporal variability across the recording. Slow-wave features were related to concurrent (Coma Recovery Scale-Revised - CRS-R, ‘Local-Global’ paradigm) and follow-up (one-year Glasgow Outcome Scale-Extended - GOS-E) assessments of consciousness and functional recovery. Associations with MRI-derived measures of cortical integrity and structural connectivity, and differences between anoxic and traumatic etiologies, were also examined. Slow waves were more frequent in less severe DoC patients (i.e., MCS) compared to UWS. Slow-wave slopes were also steeper frontally and increased at a faster rate in patients exhibiting higher levels of consciousness and/or markers of conscious access during the ‘Local-Global’ paradigm. More frequent and steeper slow waves at baseline further predicted recovery of consciousness and of functional independence at one year. At the individual level, slow-wave features classified states of consciousness above chance (AUC = 0.62 and 0.71 for MCS- and MCS+ versus UWS), whereas outcome prediction remained modest (0.56-0.58). These clinical associations had a structural basis: slow-wave occurrence was greater after traumatic than anoxic injury and scaled with the integrity of subcortico-cortical projection fibers and consciousness-related cortical networks. Contrary to the classical view of delta activity as a non-specific marker of impaired consciousness, prominent spontaneous slow waves indexed behavioral and neurophysiological signs of awareness and better recovery. Beyond reflecting a propensity for pathological bistability, they may also signal the integrity of the networks required to generate them, together with their residual capacity for dynamic regulation. Highlights Spontaneous slow waves were detected as discrete local events in 236 DoC patients, moving beyond time-averaged spectral measures of cortical slowing. Slow-wave properties carried diagnostic information about the state of consciousness, whether defined behaviorally (CRS-R) or neurophysiologically (conscious access to auditory information in ‘Local-Global’ ERP paradigm). Slow wave frequency and slope during the acute phase in the ICU predicted improvement of consciousness state and recovery of functional independence at one year. Within-session ‘fatigue-like’ temporal modulation of slow waves increased with the level of consciousness recovery, being more pronounced in MCS+ than in UWS and MCS-patients. Slow-wave expression scaled with subcortico-cortical fibers and cortical network integrity, and was greater after traumatic than anoxic injury, suggesting they signal preserved network integrity rather than damage alone.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析236名意识障碍患者在“局部-全局”听觉范式下的高密度脑电，把高幅慢波作为局部事件刻画其密度、波幅与斜率，并考察其与意识状态、一年后功能恢复及皮层结构完整性的关系。结果发现，慢波在微意识状态患者中比无反应觉醒综合征患者更频繁，额区斜率更陡，且与行为学和神经生理学的意识指标相关；基线慢波越频繁、越陡，越能预测意识与功能独立的恢复。慢波表现还与皮层下-皮层投射纤维及意识相关网络完整性相关，创伤性病因者多于缺氧性病因者。作者据此提出，自发慢波并非单纯的意识受损标志，也可能反映生成慢波所需网络的保留及其动态调节能力，但个体层面的结局预测能力仍有限。

papers.title: The effects of temporal smoothing and interpolation on EEG microstate parameters, syntax, and our view of resting-state brain dynamics
papers.authors: von Wegner F, Hermann G, Tödt I, Todtenhaupt IK, Laufs H.
papers.abstract: Microstate analysis studies dynamic brain activity through a discrete representation of electroencephalographic (EEG) signals and their topography. While the body of literature describing findings in diverse experimental and clinical settings is growing rapidly, the effects of several core components of the microstate algorithm are still insufficiently understood. This study systematically investigates how two common temporal smoothing algorithms, parametric smoothing and GFP peak interpolation, influence a wide range of microstate sequence parameters, and how they shape the integrated picture of brain dynamics inferred from these metrics. We study eyes-closed resting-state EEG recordings from N = 201 healthy subjects from a public EEG database. For the elementary temporal metrics, we find that widening smoothing windows markedly increase microstate duration, reduce occurrence rates, but leave coverage mostly unaffected. In terms of simple syntax properties, smoothing windows above 30 ms yield an inconsistent picture with a memoryless, first-order Markov structure at short time scales, but a positive Hurst phenomenon suggestive of long-range correlations at long time scales. Evidence of asymmetry and non-equilibrium dynamics are suppressed by smoothing. At intermediate time scales, microstate periodicity was only observed up to a window size of 28 ms. Smoothing had a strong impact on the complexity metrics entropy rate and excess entropy, decreasing the former and increasing the latter. For most metrics, the effects of GFP peak interpolation were comparable to those of smoothing windows in the range between 28 ms and 44 ms. In conclusion, elementary and higher-order microstate parameters must be interpreted in the context of preprocessing, as many parameters change continuously with smoothing intensity. This limits the comparability of microstate parameters obtained with different preprocessing settings. Strong smoothing with a window size above 30 ms or GFP peak interpolation yields a fundamentally different picture of resting state brain dynamics, i.e. that of a memoryless, aperiodic, time-reversible first-order Markov chain. Since insights from other neurophysiological modalities suggest that time series memory and time-irreversibility are markers of normal brain activity, our recommendation is to avoid intense smoothing to minimize alterations of the initial sequences.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注脑电微状态分析中预处理步骤对结果的影响，系统考察参数化时间平滑与GFP峰值插值如何改变微状态序列的各项参数。基于健康人闭眼静息态脑电数据，作者发现加宽平滑窗口会明显延长微状态持续时间、降低出现率，而覆盖率基本不变；平滑还会削弱序列的不对称性和非平衡动力学，并改变熵率与超额熵等复杂度指标。较强平滑或峰值插值会使静息态脑动力学呈现为无记忆、非周期、时间可逆的一阶马尔可夫链，与较弱平滑下观察到的长程相关等特征不同。作者据此强调微状态参数须结合预处理条件解读，并建议避免过强平滑以减少对原始序列的改动。

papers.title: Dual ecological-cultural pathways of sociocultural environment and resting state functional connectivity among Hispanic adolescents in the ABCD Study
papers.authors: Laird AR, Hampson CL, Lembo M, Bottenhorn KL, Sukumaran K, Cardenas-Iniguez C, Thompson E, Adise S, Sanchez M, Gonzalez R, Herting MM, Meca A.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hispanic Americans face persistent health disparities rooted in complex sociocultural and bioecodevelopmental dynamics. Identifying early neurodevelopmental trajectories that confer risk or resilience during adolescence is critical for developing targeted health equity interventions. Grounded in the NIMHD Research Framework and bioecodevelopmental theory, data from 12- to 14-year-old Hispanic adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study were analyzed (n=236). Partial least squares correlation (PLSC) was used to evaluate multivariate associations between sociocultural measures—spanning individual, family, and community levels—and resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) networks. Post hoc linear mixed-effects models examined how derived sociocultural-rsFC patterns predicted measures of physical and mental health, linking bioecodevelopmental patterns to adolescent well-being. PLSC revealed dual community- and family-level neural pathways of biological embedding, diverging from traditional nested bioecodevelopmental assumptions. The community pathway linked child opportunity and neighborhood disadvantage to connectivity across Cingulo-Opercular, Default, Dorsal Attention, Visual Networks. This community-rsFC profile was associated with lower respiratory functioning, reflecting an allostatic load marker of environmental stress. The family pathway linked caregiver ethnic identity and heritage acculturation to Default, Ventral Attention, Sensorimotor-Mouth, and Visual Networks connectivity, suggesting that the family system shapes neural systems underlying social attunement and identity formation. Structural community factors and familial culture impose distinct neurobiological demands on the adolescent connectome among Hispanic youth. Findings highlight respiratory health as a biological marker of environmental adversity and underscore the necessity of structural and culturally sustaining interventions to promote health equity among Hispanic youth.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ABCD研究中12至14岁西班牙裔青少年的数据，用偏最小二乘相关分析考察个体、家庭和社区层面的社会文化指标与静息态功能连接之间的多变量关联，并用混合效应模型检验由此得到的模式与身心健康的关系。结果发现两条并行的“生物嵌入”路径：社区路径将儿童机会和邻里劣势与多个网络连接联系起来，该连接特征与较低的呼吸功能相关，被视为环境压力的稳态负荷标志；家庭路径则将照护者民族认同和传统涵化与涉及社会调谐和身份形成的网络连接联系起来。作者据此指出，结构性社区因素与家庭文化对青少年连接组提出不同的神经生物学要求，并强调呼吸健康可作为环境不利的生物标志，以及结构性干预和文化支持性干预对促进健康公平的必要性。需注意这些是关联性发现，不能据此推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Alternating hemiplegia of childhood - a systematic review.
papers.authors: Brzozowska M, Tobiasz A, Jaunich A, Paprocka J.
papers.abstract: Introduction Alternating hemiplegia of childhood (AHC) is a rare ATP1A3-related neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by recurrent hemiplegic episodes, paroxysmal neurological symptoms, and progressive motor and cognitive impairment. This systematic review summarizes current evidence on its clinical course, comorbidities, diagnostic findings, and treatment options. Material and methods A PubMed search (2015-2025) identified 233 records. Following PRISMA-guided screening, 31 original studies on human subjects were included. Results Alternating hemiplegia of childhood typically presents in infancy and evolves into persistent interictal motor dysfunction, including impaired balance and reduced coordination. Behavioral and social impairments, such as aggression, self-injury, and severe autism spectrum traits, occur in more than half of patients. Epilepsy affects approximately 50-60%, with p.Glu815Lys variants linked to higher risk of status epilepticus. Sleep disturbances, including frequent arousals and central or obstructive apnea, are common and contribute to morbidity. Neuroimaging frequently demonstrates white matter loss and cerebellar volume reduction, occasionally accompanied by hippocampal or insular atrophy. Cardiac abnormalities, especially QTc shortening in ATP1A3-D801N carriers, represent an emerging risk factor for ventricular arrhythmias and SUDEP. Flunarizine remains the primary treatment, while cannabidiol shows additional benefit for seizures and behavioral symptoms. Conclusions Alternating hemiplegia of childhood is a complex multisystem disorder requiring early diagnosis, continuous monitoring, and multidisciplinary care. Disease-modifying treatments remain urgently needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了儿童交替性偏瘫的临床病程、共病、诊断发现与治疗选择，纳入2015至2025年间发表的31项人类原始研究。综述指出，该病多在婴儿期起病，并逐渐发展为持续存在的发作间期运动障碍；行为与社交损害、癫痫、睡眠障碍较为常见，神经影像常显示白质丢失和小脑体积减小，心脏异常则被视为新的风险因素。治疗方面，氟桂利嗪仍是主要药物，大麻二酚对癫痫发作和行为症状显示出额外益处。作者强调该病累及多系统，需要早期诊断、持续监测和多学科照护，而能够改变疾病进程的治疗仍亟待开发。

papers.title: A Pilot Study of the Feasibility of In-Ear EEG for Long-Term Temporal Lobe Brain Wave Monitoring.
papers.authors: Chan AHW, Emadi RC, Lin A, Schroeder MJ, Singh R, Shaik R, George MC, Gomberg J, Eka O, Kavanagh T, Yoo JYJ, Jen JC, Tajer A, Singh A, Serruya M, Bhowmik AK, Parvaz MA.
papers.abstract: Background: Traditional scalp electroencephalography (EEG), though clinically validated, presents significant limitations, including lengthy setup, patient discomfort, and limited mobility. These factors hinder its utility for long-term ambulatory monitoring. In-ear EEG offers a promising alternative by leveraging the ear canal's anatomical proximity to the temporal lobes and natural mechanical stability. To address this, we developed SeizEAR, a standardized, three-size in-ear EEG system using paste-based electrodes with cross-ear referencing. Methods: This pilot study evaluated SeizEAR devices featuring small, medium, and large earpieces with superior and inferior paste-based electrodes in each ear, configured in a cross-ear reference scheme. It included five healthy adults who underwent recording sessions of approximately three hours (2.4 to 3.3 h). Electrode impedance was monitored against the acquisition system's threshold indicator, with simultaneous scalp EEG from T7/T8 electrodes serving as the reference. Participants rated comfort on a 0-5 Likert scale every 30 min. Results: In-ear recordings showed moderate, band-dependent correspondence with ipsilateral temporal scalp electrodes, strongest in the delta and alpha bands and weakest in beta, and correspondence was consistently higher against a geometrically matched T7-T8 bipolar derivation than against a single referenced electrode. In-ear alpha reactivity to eye closure was present but attenuated relative to scalp. Comfort ratings remained high over the final two hours of wear, with no reported adverse events. Conclusions: SeizEAR acquired in-ear EEG that corresponded moderately with temporal scalp EEG and was well-tolerated over multi-hour wear in healthy adults. These preliminary findings support further development of a standardized in-ear EEG system and require confirmation in an adequately powered sample.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究检验标准化入耳式脑电系统SeizEAR用于长时间颞叶脑电监测的可行性，在五名健康成人中开展约三小时的佩戴记录，并与头皮T7/T8电极同步对照。结果显示，入耳记录与同侧颞叶头皮电极呈中等程度、随频段变化的对应，以delta和alpha频段较强、beta频段较弱，且与几何匹配的双极导联对应更高；闭眼引起的alpha反应存在但较头皮减弱。佩戴后段舒适度评分保持较高且无不良事件，作者据此认为该系统耐受性良好，但对应关系仅为中等，结论尚需更大样本验证。

papers.title: From Pattern Recognition to Abstract Representation: Visual Search and Neural Mechanisms of Structured Pattern Processing in Skilled Basketball Players.
papers.authors: Xu N, Wang X, Miao X, Song J, Zhang X, Ren P, Zhang Y, Chi L.
papers.abstract: Objective This study employed eye-tracking and ERP to investigate structured pattern processing in basketball players of different skill levels. Methods A skill-level comparison (skilled vs. less-skilled) was adopted. Participants viewed static point-light displays depicting basketball half-court configurations, with structured (typical tactical formations) and unstructured (random positions) conditions randomly presented. Participants predicted offensive actions while behavioral, eye-tracking, and ERP data were simultaneously recorded. Results Skilled players showed higher decision accuracy than less-skilled players under structured conditions but not under unstructured conditions, whereas they responded significantly faster under both conditions, with a larger group difference under structured conditions. For pupil diameter, skilled players showed smaller pupil diameters than less-skilled players under both conditions, while within the skilled group pupil diameter was larger under structured than unstructured conditions. Eye-tracking revealed fewer total fixations and a distinct gaze distribution in skilled players-more fixations on opponents and the ball, fewer on open space-along with larger pupil diameters under structured conditions, suggesting enhanced cognitive engagement. ERP data showed that skilled players exhibited larger P300 and LNC amplitudes under structured conditions, reflecting enhanced semantic mapping and schema-based retrieval. Conclusions These findings are consistent with a theoretical perspective in which expertise may involve a shift from "pattern recognition" toward "abstract representation," rather than a reduction in neural activity. However, abstract representation, neural information density, and semantic encoding were not directly measured in the present study. The Transformer architecture is therefore offered as a conceptual analogy-its multi-head self-attention corresponds to skilled players' hierarchical visual sampling, its encoder to semantic mapping (P300 enhancement), and its memory integration to schema-based retrieval (LNC enhancement). These findings provide a basis for structured situational training in sport decision-making.

papers.title: Regional Brain Injury Burden on Term-Equivalent MRI Is Associated with Neurodevelopmental Outcome in Extremely Preterm Infants with Intraventricular Hemorrhage.
papers.authors: Buchmayer J, Fuiko R, Kasprian G, Klebermaß-Schrehof K, Stummer S, Berger A, Goeral K.
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Extremely preterm infants remain at high risk of adverse neurodevelopmental outcomes, particularly in the presence of intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) and associated brain injury. Term-equivalent cerebral magnetic resonance imaging (cMRI) provides a detailed assessment of structural brain injury and may provide anatomical information not captured by conventional IVH grading. We aimed to investigate whether the extent and regional distribution of cMRI-detected brain injury are associated with neurodevelopment at two years corrected age. Methods This retrospective cohort study included extremely preterm infants born before 28 weeks' gestation with IVH, term-equivalent cMRI, and neurodevelopmental follow-up at two years corrected age. Regional brain injury was assessed on T2-weighted cMRI using a Bassan-derived anatomical approach. Associations with neurodevelopment were examined using multivariable regression models. Results A total of 137 infants were included in the regional cMRI analysis. The regional injury score ranged from 0 to 10. Each additional affected cerebral region was independently associated with lower cognitive (β -3.62; 95% CI -5.09 to -2.14), language (β -3.13; 95% CI -4.90 to -1.36), and motor scores (β -4.70; 95% CI -6.08 to -3.32), all p < 0.001, after adjustment for prespecified clinical and demographic covariates. Associations remained significant after adjustment for conventional IVH classification. Inclusion of the regional cMRI injury score significantly improved model fit for cognitive (p = 0.019), language (p = 0.006), and motor outcomes (p < 0.001). In exploratory region-specific analyses, frontal injury, particularly posterior frontal involvement, showed the largest effect estimates. Conclusions Higher regional cMRI injury burden was associated with poorer cognitive, language, and motor outcomes in extremely preterm infants with IVH. Exploratory regional assessment suggested that frontal injury was associated with adverse neurodevelopmental outcomes. These findings support the value of considering both the extent and anatomical distribution of brain injury on term-equivalent cMRI when characterizing neurodevelopmental risk.

papers.title: Label-Free Acoustic Wave Detection of Myelin Basic Protein for Monitoring of Neurodegenerative Disease.
papers.authors: Spagnolo S, Mikuličová S, Davoudian K, Sontakke K, De La Franier B, Thompson M, Hianik T.
papers.abstract: Myelin basic protein (MBP) is released into cerebrospinal fluid during demyelination and is therefore a promising biomarker for the detection of neurodegenerative diseases such as multiple sclerosis. For the label-free detection of MBP, we developed an antifouling aptasensor based on thickness shear mode sensing. DNA aptamers were immobilized on gold-coated piezoelectric crystals functionalized with an engineered antifouling self-assembled monolayer based on 3-(2-mercaptoethoxy)propanoic acid (HS-MEG-COOH) combined with either 2-(2-mercaptoethoxy)ethanol (HS-MEG-OH) or dithiothreitol (DTT) as spacers. The binding of recombinant human MBP to the aptamer was confirmed with a corresponding decrease in resonance frequency in both phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) and artificial cerebrospinal fluid (aCSF). The aptasensor achieved a limit of detection of 11 ng mL-1 in PBS and 2 ng mL-1 in aCSF. PBS measurements were primarily applied to determine the aptasensor functionality, whereas experiments in aCSF evaluated MBP detection at concentrations relevant to reported levels in biological CSF. Selectivity was assessed with aptamer-free surfaces, cytochrome c, and human serum albumin (HSA) with much lower responses, while concentration-dependent MBP detection was maintained in aCSF despite the increased complexity of the matrix. The antifouling performance of the modified sensing surface was further demonstrated in aCSF by the significantly reduced frequency and dissipation responses compared to bare gold. With future validation in human cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) samples, the developed biosensor has the potential to enable sensitive, label-free detection of MBP in CSF for the identification and monitoring of neurodegenerative diseases.

papers.title: Altered body representation in chronic non-specific low back pain: a testable framework linking body-schema-related disturbance, corticomotor alterations, and altered pain processing.
papers.authors: Xie Z.
papers.abstract: Low back pain is a leading contributor to disability worldwide; in chronic non-specific low back pain (CNSLBP), the processes sustaining pain and disability in the absence of identifiable structural pathology remain incompletely understood. Three partially overlapping research lines have documented altered body representation, corticomotor alterations of trunk musculature, and altered pain processing in this population, but these domains have rarely been measured concurrently within the same cohort. This Hypothesis and Theory article proposes that, once the measurement structure of candidate indicators has been established, body-representation-related measures will provide reproducible incremental explanatory information for prespecified corticomotor and pain-processing outcomes beyond relevant clinical, psychological, and nociplastic-feature variables. Within this multidimensional domain, body-schema-related sensorimotor disturbance is examined as one candidate interacting mechanism that may be coupled to corticomotor and pain-processing abnormalities; it is not assumed to be a privileged or causally primary organizer. Currently available assessments do not directly measure body schema but rely on indirect and theoretically heterogeneous proxies, including self-reported back perception, tactile acuity, and implicit laterality or motor-imagery processing. We synthesize evidence from neuroimaging, transcranial magnetic stimulation, psychophysical pain assessment, and behavioral paradigms, using predictive coding as a heuristic framework for deriving testable predictions concerning trunk-state estimation, motor regulation, and pain-processing indices. The proposed framework suggests that altered trunk-state representation may interact with altered motor regulation and altered pain processing in a mutually reinforcing loop. However, the directional architecture remains untested; models in which altered pain processing, corticomotor alteration, or a shared upstream process contributes to representational disturbance remain viable. The framework specifies a construct-validity prerequisite and four predictions concerning incremental cross-domain association, nociplastic-feature enrichment, intervention-linked cross-domain change, and temporal ordering and model comparison. Current evidence supports several measurable body-representation-related phenomena associated with clinical features in CNSLBP; however, the incremental explanatory value of the broader domain and the mechanistic independence of the narrower body-schema-related component remain empirical questions requiring discriminant, longitudinal, and experimental validation.

papers.title: Epilepsy as a consequence of infantile vitamin B12 deficiency: observations from a prospective cohort study and a review of the literature.
papers.authors: Kumar P, Manjunathan S, Vyas S, Sahu JK, Sankhyan N.
papers.abstract: Introduction Symptomatic infantile vitamin B12 deficiency has far-reaching neurological consequences for affected children. Development of epilepsy is one such consequence whose incidence and characteristics have been scarcely studied and reported in the literature. Objective To describe the incidence, characteristics, and outcomes of epilepsy in a prospective cohort of children treated for infantile vitamin B12 deficiency and to briefly review the published literature on the topic. Methods A hospital-based prospective cohort study enrolling consecutive children with symptomatic infantile vitamin B12 deficiency was conducted from January 2021 to June 2023 to study the neurological consequences of deficiency. The cohort was followed through March 2026 to determine the incidence of epilepsy during follow-up. Those who developed epilepsy were evaluated for seizure and epilepsy types, neuroimaging and electroencephalography findings, treatment, response to treatment, and outcomes. Multivariable Cox proportional hazards modeling was performed using baseline predictors identified through univariate screening to determine independent associations with epilepsy. Results A total of 141 children with infantile vitamin B12 deficiency were part of the original cohort. Four died, 25 were lost to follow-up. Among the rest of the 112 children, at a median follow-up of 51 months (IQR: 45-55), 31 (28, 95% CI 19-36%) developed epilepsy. In those with epilepsy, the mean age at diagnosis of infantile vitamin B12 deficiency was 12.39 ± 3.9 months, and epilepsy developed after a mean interval of 4.7 ± 3.2 months after treatment. Epileptic spasms were the most common seizure type (15/31, 48.4%), while other forms of epilepsy were observed in 16. Of the 31, at last contact, 21 (68%) had either resolved or well-controlled epilepsy, 8 (26%) had drug-refractory epilepsy, and 2 (6%) died. In the multivariate model, acute-phase seizures were strongly associated with increased epilepsy risk (pooled HR 4.27, 95% CI:1.6-11.5, p = 0.004). Higher follow-up DQ was protective (pooled HR 0.94, 95% CI:0.89-0.99, p = 0.015). There was an early clustering of epilepsy, with all events occurring within 10 months of follow-up. Conclusion Epilepsy is a significant neurological outcome of vitamin B12 deficiency in infants. There is early clustering of epilepsy risk after treatment for deficiency, and acute-phase seizures are the strongest independent predictor of later epilepsy.
papers.summary_zh: 这项前瞻性队列研究关注症状性婴儿维生素B12缺乏患儿日后发生癫痫的风险、特点与结局，并对相关文献作了简要回顾。在中位约四年的随访中，相当比例的患儿出现癫痫，且多在治疗后较短时间内集中发生；痉挛发作是最常见的发作类型，多数患儿癫痫最终缓解或控制良好，少数为难治性癫痫或死亡。多因素分析提示，急性期出现惊厥与后续癫痫风险升高相关，而随访时发育商较高与风险降低相关。作者据此认为，癫痫是该人群值得重视的神经系统结局，治疗后早期是风险集中的阶段。

papers.title: A neuro-inspired computational framework for AGI: predictive coding, active inference and free energy minimisation.
papers.authors: Berndt LCS, Shaw AD.
papers.abstract: This paper offers a conceptual synthesis of foundational principles from theoretical neuroscience [i.e., predictive coding, the Free Energy Principle (FEP) and variational inference] as a biologically grounded framework for artificial general intelligence (AGI). We adopt this predictive-coding and FEP perspective as our organising framework. It is one of several current accounts of neural computation and not all available evidence is consistent with it. These approaches characterise the brain as a hierarchical inference system that continuously updates beliefs and selects actions to minimise uncertainty and surprise. In contrast to conventional AI systems, biological agents engage in active, generative inference within dynamic, uncertain environments. We argue that this inference-based architecture and not behavioural outputs alone, plausibly underlies the adaptability, generalisation and resilience of natural intelligence. We outline a neuro-inspired computational framework built on hierarchical generative models, scalable variational inference (i.e., Variational Laplace) and Active Inference. Finally, we contrast this approach with dominant deep learning paradigms and discuss its hypothetical implications for building interpretable, adaptive and autonomous machine intelligence.

papers.title: Cenobamate in super-refractory status epilepticus: current evidence from a patient-level synthesis.
papers.authors: Falcicchio G, Francavilla T.
papers.abstract: Background Super-refractory status epilepticus (SRSE) represents a challenging neurological emergency, with limited therapeutic options after conventional intravenous antiseizure medications (ASMs) and continuous anesthetic therapy have failed. Cenobamate has shown remarkable efficacy in drug-resistant focal epilepsy, but its role in SRSE is currently supported only by isolated case reports. Methods We performed a patient-level synthesis of published cases of cenobamate-treated SRSE, focusing on treatment latency, titration strategy, electroclinical response, concomitant therapies, safety, and functional outcomes. Results Three publications reporting six patients were identified. Cenobamate was introduced between 13 and 103 days after SRSE onset, following failure of multiple intravenous and oral ASMs, anesthetic agents, and, in most cases, immunomodulatory therapies. Although the timing of treatment initiation varied substantially, electroencephalographic improvement generally occurred within two weeks after cenobamate initiation and was usually accompanied by clinical recovery, successful withdrawal of anesthetic therapy, and liberation from the intensive care unit. Most patients initiated cenobamate at the recommended dose of 12.5 mg/day but underwent individualized dose-escalation schedules compared with the approved outpatient regimen. No cases of drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms, severe cardiac adverse events, or treatment discontinuation attributable to cenobamate were reported. Conclusions Although the available evidence remains limited to a small number of observational reports, this patient-level synthesis identified consistent clinical patterns that support further investigation of cenobamate as an adjunctive therapy for SRSE. At present, no conclusions regarding treatment efficacy can be drawn. Prospective multicenter studies are needed to clarify cenobamate optimal timing, titration strategy, safety, and potential role within SRSE treatment algorithms.

papers.title: Research on dynamic functional connectivity and graph theoretic features of different motor subtypes in Parkinson's disease based on ICA.
papers.authors: Tang J, Gao S, Lv Y, Wang H, Liu Y, Zhou H, Yuan J, Lin X, Hu M, Cong Y, Wang X.
papers.abstract: Objective This study combined independent component analysis (ICA)-derived dynamic functional connectivity (dFNC) with dynamic graph theory analysis methods to analyze the changes in dFNC and dynamic graph theoretic indicators in different motor subtypes of Parkinson's disease (PD)-tremor-dominant (TD) subtype and postural instability/gait difficulty (PIGD) subtype-and healthy controls (HC). We aimed to explore the neural circuitry abnormal mechanisms and differences between the two subtypes. Methods Using a prospective observational study design, from January 2021 to May 2024 at Northern Jiangsu People's Hospital, we enrolled 36 diagnosed PD patients according to inclusion criteria-19 patients with PIGD subtype and 17 patients with TD subtype-along with 19 healthy subjects matched for age, sex, and education level. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), demographic information, and clinical motor function assessment data were collected from all participants. The ICA and dynamic functional network connectivity (dFNC) analysis were performed using the GIFT toolbox platform based on MATLAB. Combined with dynamic graph theory analysis, features such as characteristic path length, clustering coefficient, and node degree were extracted. The dFNC and dynamic graph theoretic indicators of the PIGD group, TD group, and HC group were compared horizontally to clarify the common and specific dynamic abnormalities of brain networks between the two subtypes. Results Nine functional brain networks were identified through ICA. Significant differences among the three groups were observed in five brain networks: auditory network, left frontoparietal network, right frontoparietal network, ventral attention network, and sensorimotor network. Based on network-to-network functional connectivity analysis using these nine functional brain networks, after strict FDR correction, only inter-network coupling strength between the auditory network and sensorimotor network showed significant group differences (T = 7.548, FDR-corrected p = 0.00137). Four recurring functional connectivity states were identified through dFNC analysis. Across all participants, State 2 and State 3 accounted for 38 and 23% of total time, respectively. PIGD patients tended to spend more time in these two low-connectivity states. In terms of temporal properties, only the occurrence frequency of state 4 showed significant differences among the three groups (F = 4.855, FDR-corrected p = 0.047). Post-hoc test results showed that HC groups were significantly higher than PIGD groups and presented a trend higher than TD groups, while there was no statistically significant difference between the two PD subtypes. One-way analysis of variance was performed on whole-brain node-to-node functional connectivity and graph theoretic attributes of the three groups; no significant differences were found after FDR correction. Conclusion Compared with the HC group, PD patients (both TD and PIGD groups) exhibited spatial distribution abnormalities in multiple brain networks. Nominally significant alterations suggestive of compensatory activation of the motor cortex were observed at the uncorrected statistical level, alongside weakened functional connectivity in specific networks.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究结合独立成分分析衍生的动态功能连接与动态图论分析，比较帕金森病震颤主导型和姿势不稳/步态困难型两种运动亚型患者与健康对照的静息态脑网络动态特征。结果识别出多个功能脑网络，组间差异主要体现在听觉网络与感觉运动网络之间的耦合强度，以及动态功能连接状态的分布和时间属性上；姿势不稳/步态困难型患者倾向于更多处于低连接状态。全脑节点间功能连接和图论指标经校正后未见显著组间差异，作者据此提示帕金森病患者存在多网络空间分布异常，并提及运动皮层可能存在代偿性激活的线索，但相关发现尚属初步。

papers.title: Advances in artificial intelligence-driven MRI research in Alzheimer's disease.
papers.authors: Deng L, Zeng Y, Ou P, Zhou S, Gou Y, Huang C.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD), the most prevalent neurodegenerative disorder, poses substantial challenges for early diagnosis and longitudinal monitoring-two cornerstones of effective clinical management and therapeutic intervention. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), owing to its non-invasiveness and high spatial resolution, has emerged as an indispensable tool in AD research. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) techniques, has demonstrated remarkable potential for automating MRI analysis, extracting subtle imaging features, and supporting objective disease prediction. This review comprehensively summarizes the latest advances in AI-driven MRI applications for AD diagnosis, staging, prognosis, and adjuvant therapeutic monitoring. It highlights key progress in AI model development, multimodal data processing, and clinical translational value. Furthermore, current bottlenecks, including data heterogeneity, model interpretability, and real-world deployment, are systematically discussed, and future directions are outlined to enhance the precision and clinical utility of AI-assisted MRI in AD. Overall, AI-MRI has evolved from laboratory validation toward early clinical adoption, with explainability and multi-center generalizability identified as critical priorities in the next research phase.

papers.title: Independent association of SOT-composite with berg balance scale scores in Chinese stroke patients: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
papers.authors: Zheng W, Shen W, Li M, Ma G, Xie M, Leng Q, Zhang R, Liu C, Zeng X, Chen H.
papers.abstract: Objective Stroke-related balance dysfunction affects 61-83% of patients, yet the quantitative relationship between sensory integration capacity and functional balance remains inadequately characterized. This study investigated the association between Sensory Organization Test (SOT) composite scores and Berg Balance Scale (BBS) performance in Chinese stroke patients. Methods This retrospective cross-sectional study analyzed data from 339 stroke patients who received treatment at Guangdong 999 Brain Hospital between January 2021 and December 2023. Exposure variable was SOT-Composite score (0-100 points, measured via NeuroCom Smart EquiTest within 48 h). Outcome variable was Berg Balance Scale total score (0-56 points, assessed within 48 h). Two models were constructed: a Core model adjusting for age, gender, diagnosis, and disease duration, and a Sensitivity model additionally adjusting for Brunnstrom lower-extremity stage and weight symmetry index. Tertile stratification of SOT-Composite scores was performed descriptively to explore dose-response patterns. Results In the Sensitivity model, each 1-point increase in SOT-Composite score was associated with a 0.2745-point higher Berg Balance Scale score (95% CI: 0.171-0.386, p < 0.001; Core model: β = 0.2471, 95% CI 0.137-0.357, p < 0.001). Standardized coefficient analysis in the Sensitivity model showed Brunnstrom lower-extremity stage had the strongest association (standardized β = 0.4562, p < 0.001), followed by SOT-Composite score (standardized β = 0.2527, p < 0.001). Among sensory subsystems, visual, somatosensory, and vestibular processing ratios were all significantly associated with balance performance (unstandardized β = 0.18, 0.16, and 0.15 BBS points per unit ratio change, respectively). Conclusion SOT-Composite score was independently associated with Berg Balance Scale performance in stroke patients, even after adjustment for multiple covariates. Whether targeted sensory training can improve balance outcomes warrants evaluation in future prospective intervention studies.

papers.title: Cortical circuits linking peripheral inflammation to affective states.
papers.authors: Jun DJ, Tang S, Favuzzi E.
papers.abstract: Affective disorders, such as anxiety and depression, are more prevalent in individuals with inflammatory diseases than in the general population. This comorbidity suggests biological links between immune activation and affective dysregulation. Indeed, there is extensive literature on the impact of inflammation on brain function. Peripheral immune challenges activate subcortical and brainstem regions that regulate emotions and physiological homeostasis. However, cortical regions are also engaged during peripheral inflammation, and cortical dysfunction is a central feature of affective pathology. Drawing primarily on mechanistic work in rodents, we review how peripheral inflammation reaches the cortical circuits that govern emotion and how it is translated into affective changes. This communication begins with two complementary routes by which immune signals reach the brain: neural and humoral pathways. In the neural pathway, cytokine-selective vagal afferents preserve the anatomical origin of inflammation and relay it to the brainstem and downstream regions. In the humoral pathway, circulating mediators act on circumventricular organs and across the blood-brain barrier. Cortical regions, such as the prefrontal cortex, insular cortex, and primary somatosensory cortex, transform these signals into altered behavior. This occurs through shifts in excitatory/inhibitory balance, top-down control of the amygdala, and interoceptive predictions of bodily state. We integrate these studies into a circuit-level model in which inflammation biases cortical processing toward threat, driving the transition from adaptive responses to maladaptive affective dysregulation. Defining which immune signals engage which circuits, and with what specificity, remains a central open question and a promising route toward targeting the affective consequences of inflammatory disease.

papers.title: Immediate anxiety-reducing effects of multisensory virtual reality reminiscence therapy in older adults with a wide range of cognitive functions: a pilot study using electrophysiological measures.
papers.authors: Ueno K, Niki K, Tanaka H, Okuda T, Iwai D, Sato K, Naito Y, Ito T, Ishii R.
papers.abstract: Introduction Anxiety is a prevalent behavioral and psychological symptom of dementia (BPSD) in older adults with cognitive impairment, severely diminishing their quality of life. Although reminiscence therapy (RT) is a promising non-pharmacological intervention, objective neurophysiological methods to evaluate its immediate emotional impact remain unexplored. This pilot study proposed "Smart Reminiscence Therapy (SRT)" - a novel virtual reality (VR) system integrated with synchronized multisensory stimuli - and evaluated its immediate anxiety-reducing effects and the utility of electrophysiological measures. Methods A single-session, single-arm pre-post exploratory design was adopted. Twenty older adults (aged 65 years or older) at a day service center, with Mini-Mental State Examination-Japanese (MMSE-J) scores of 11-30, participated. The intervention consisted of a 10-min SRT session featuring a 1960s Japanese townscape. The primary outcome was objective resting-state eye-closed frontal alpha asymmetry (FAA) via a wearable EEG device, while subjective state anxiety via the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI) was evaluated as a secondary outcome. Results After excluding three participants with excessive artifacts, 17 participants (mean age: 85.9 ± 5.9 years; mean MMSE-J: 23.8 ± 3.8, with 64.7% clustered in the MCI-to-mild-dementia range) were analyzed. Subjective STAI scores showed a non-significant decreasing trend with a moderate effect size (p = 0.088, r = 0.414). Conversely, the FAA index significantly increased post-intervention (p = 0.038, Cohen's d = 0.55). No significant correlation was found between changes in STAI and FAA (r = -0.15, p = 0.562). Conclusion A single session of SRT was associated with an increase in FAA; however, the uncontrolled design precludes causal attribution to the intervention. The dissociation between subjective reports and neurophysiological changes suggests that FAA may complement self-reported measures by capturing aspects of acute emotional change that may be difficult to verbalize in people with cognitive impairment. The non-significant but moderate-sized reduction in STAI scores warrants confirmation in larger controlled studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究考察了同步多感官虚拟现实怀旧疗法对认知功能范围较广的老年人是否具有即时缓解焦虑的作用，并检验脑电指标能否用于评估这种即时情绪变化。研究采用单次、单组前后测设计，在日间照料中心对老年人进行干预，以闭眼静息态额叶alpha不对称性为主要指标，状态焦虑量表为次要指标。结果显示，干预后额叶alpha不对称性显著升高，主观焦虑评分呈不显著的下降趋势且效应量中等，两者变化之间未见相关。作者指出，非对照设计无法将变化归因于干预，主观报告与神经生理指标之间的分离提示脑电指标可能补充自我报告，捕捉认知受损者难以言说的急性情绪变化，而焦虑评分的下降趋势仍需更大规模的对照研究确认。

papers.title: The fixed cortical fraction assumption in Hip Structure Analysis produces systematic, sex- and age- dependent errors in femoral neck morphology estimates.
papers.authors: Richards MS, Bigelow EMR, Goulet RW, Brooker-Nolan BT, Franklin KJ, Jepsen KJ, Bredbenner TL.
papers.abstract: Hip Structure Analysis (HSA) estimates femoral neck morphology from dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) images using simplifying assumptions, including that cortical bone accounts for a fixed 60% of total bone mineral content at the narrow neck (cortical fraction, fc = 0.6). The empirical basis of this assumption is poorly established, and its effect on HSA-derived structural parameters has not been systematically evaluated. PseudoDXA images were generated by direct projection of nanoCT volumes from cadaveric proximal femurs from 32 White female (ages 24-89+ years) and 30 White male (ages 18-89 years) donors. Cortical and trabecular bone were segmented separately, enabling direct measurement of fc and comparison of HSA estimates using fixed versus measured fc against nanoCT-derived reference values. Measured fc ranged from 0.23 to 0.67 and averaged 0.48 for females and 0.42 for males, both substantially below 0.6. In females, fc increased significantly with age; in males, fc decreased significantly with body weight. Using fixed fc produced large, systematic errors in HSA-derived cortical area and buckling ratio that were sex- and age-specific, reaching up to 36% for cortical area in younger individuals.
