Replacing fixed fc with measured fc significantly reduced errors for cortical area in both sexes and for buckling ratio in males, with significantly greater improvement in concordance for cortical area and inner radius in males. Buckling ratio errors remained large in females even with measured fc , consistent with an additional departure from the uniform cortical thickness assumption, which is hypothesized to be more pronounced in females due to the disproportionately thick inferior cortex. These findings demonstrate that the fixed fc assumption introduces systematic, sex- and age-specific errors into HSA-derived structural estimates, and that development of DXA-derived individualized fc estimation represents a meaningful step toward improving the clinical reliability of HSA for fracture risk assessment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究检验髋结构分析（HSA）中“皮质骨占股骨颈总骨矿含量固定60%”这一假设是否成立，以及它对结构参数估计的影响。作者用尸体股骨近端的nanoCT体数据生成模拟DXA图像，分别分割皮质骨与松质骨，直接测得皮质分数并与HSA估计值对照。实测皮质分数明显低于0.6，且随性别和年龄呈现不同趋势；沿用固定值会使皮质面积和屈曲比产生系统偏差，偏差方向和幅度因性别、年龄而异，改用实测值后部分误差减小，但女性屈曲比误差仍较大，提示还存在均匀皮质厚度假设的问题。研究据此认为，固定皮质分数假设会带来系统性误差，个体化估计有望提高HSA评估骨折风险的可靠性。

papers.title: Noninvasive diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease: a review of emerging biomarkers and multimodal approaches.
papers.authors: Zhao J, Nie C, Gao R, Hu Z, Lin Y.
papers.journal: Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
papers.abstract: Noninvasive biomarkers are expanding access to biological assessment of Alzheimer's disease (AD). This review evaluates blood-based, neuroimaging, retinal, electrophysiological, digital, and behavioral measures alongside structured cognitive and functional assessment, and examines multimodal and machine-learning approaches for detection, differential diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment monitoring. Plasma phosphorylated tau, particularly p-tau217, currently offers the strongest scalable evidence for identifying amyloid and advanced tau pathology, whereas PET and MRI retain complementary roles in pathological confirmation, regional staging, exclusion of alternative causes, and characterization of atypical phenotypes. Retinal, electrophysiological, speech, sleep, and eye-tracking measures remain promising but require greater standardization and external validation. Across modalities, biomarker trajectories are temporally staggered, assay and platform differences affect interpretation, and pathology-phenotype mapping is modified by disease stage, cognitive reserve, copathology, vascular factors, and population characteristics. We therefore propose a phenotype-anchored, stepped pathway that begins with patient and informant history, objective cognitive and functional assessment, structural imaging, and routine laboratory evaluation; adds validated blood biomarkers when they resolve a defined uncertainty; and reserves CSF or PET for unresolved, atypical, or treatment-relevant cases. Discordant findings should prompt reassessment rather than automatic reclassification. We describe the literature-search and descriptive evidence-categorization approach used to select and categorize the evidence reviewed, and we place the findings within the emerging regulatory context of blood-based testing. Clinical translation will depend on harmonized thresholds, representative prospective cohorts, calibration, independent validation, and evidence that multimodal systems improve decisions and patient outcomes rather than benchmark accuracy alone.

papers.title: A light-responsive engineered probiotic system to alleviate anxiety via gut-brain axis.
papers.authors: Chang Y, Hang Z, Zhang Y, Zhu Y, Li X, Wang X, Zhang D.
papers.abstract: Anxiety disorders are highly prevalent worldwide, yet effective treatment strategies remain limited. Overactive gut-brain communication has been linked to anxiety-like behaviors, and modulation of this signaling offers a promising approach for anxiety reduction. Leveraging the controllable release and biocompatibility of engineered bacteria, we developed a near-infrared (NIR)-responsive probiotic system that releases gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) to directly modulate gut vagal sensory input, thereby alleviating anxiety-like behavior. The system was constructed using Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 (EcN) carrying a thermosensitive GABA synthesis plasmid (EcN-Gadabc), coated with polydopamine (pDA), and further conjugated with a pepT1 targeting peptide for small-intestinal targeting. This design enabled precise NIR-triggered GABA release in the gut, improved bacterial survival under simulated gastrointestinal conditions, and enhanced intestinal retention following oral administration. In mice subjected to repeated restraint stress, treatment with the engineered bacteria under NIR irradiation alleviated anxiety-like behaviors, remodeled the gut microbiota, reduced the relative abundance of Clostridium, decreased serum IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α, increased IL-10, and reduced c-fos-positive neurons in the amygdala, nucleus tractus solitarius, and locus coeruleus. Transcriptomic analysis further indicated alterations in pathways associated with neuronal excitability, ion channel activity and calcium signaling. These findings support a non-invasive and remotely controllable strategy for gut-brain axis modulation using engineered probiotics and highlight its potential for precision bacteriotherapy in anxiety-related disorders.

papers.title: Tractography-Based Predictors of Poststroke Aphasia: A Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Narimani M, Kiani I, Ghorani H, Seraj P, Cho A, Tsang D, Lalwani K, Hillis A, Lakhani DA, Dmytriw AA, Hui F, Luna L, Yedavalli V.
papers.abstract: Background Poststroke aphasia is a common and disabling consequence of ischemic stroke, affecting communication and quality of life. Early identification of patients at risk is essential for prognosis and rehabilitation planning. Diffusion tractography has recently been used to map white matter pathways implicated in language processing and to evaluate their predictive value for poststroke aphasia. Purpose In this study, we aimed to evaluate the prognostic value of DTI characteristics of key white matter tracts. Data sources A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, Embase, and Scopus until April 2025. Study selection We considered studies eligible if they used diffusion MRI tractography to assess structural language pathways in patients with stroke and investigated their association with poststroke aphasia occurrence or severity. Data analysis Extracted data included study characteristics, tractography methodology, language assessment tools, and key imaging findings, including tract specific diffusion metrics and tractography derived measures. Because of data insufficiency, qualitative synthesis was conducted. Data synthesis Twenty-one studies comprising 550 patients with poststroke aphasia were included. Participants were predominantly older adults, with mean/median ages generally in the late 50s to early 70s. Baseline NIHSS values were commonly in the ∼5-14 range. The timing of diffusion/DTI acquisition varied substantially, spanning hyperacute/acute imaging, early subacute assessments, and later evaluations in the chronic phase. Studies identified left arcuate fasciculus integrity, fractional anisotropy, axial diffusivity, or reconstruction status as the strongest single predictor of aphasia severity and recovery. Loss of arcuate fasciculus reconstruction was associated with markedly lower follow-up Western Aphasia Battery Aphasia Quotient. Ventral stream involvement added prognostic value in several studies. Right hemisphere contributions were inconsistent, although higher callosal anisotropy predicted comprehension gains in 1 cohort. Overall, tract specific microstructure improved prognostic models beyond lesion volume or NIHSS, accounting for an additional 12%-29% of outcome variance in several multivariate analyses. Limitations Methodologic variability limited cross-study comparability and precluded quantitative pooling and, as a result, generalizability. Conclusions Tractography provides valuable insights into the structural substrates of poststroke aphasia, with the arcuate fasciculus emerging as the most robust predictor. Standardization of tractography protocols and multicenter validation are needed before routine clinical translation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统检索并定性汇总了利用弥散磁共振纤维束成像评估卒中后失语结构语言通路预后价值的研究。纳入研究多显示，左侧弓状束的完整性、各向异性及重建状态是与失语严重程度和恢复相关的最稳健预测指标，腹侧通路可提供额外预后信息，右半球贡献则不一致；部分多变量分析中，纤维束特异性微结构指标在病灶体积或卒中量表之外改善了预后模型。作者同时指出，方法学差异限制了研究间可比性和结论推广，纤维束成像方案标准化及多中心验证仍是常规临床应用前的必要步骤。

papers.title: Portable MRI in Pediatrics: Weighing the Costs and Benefits. Revolution or Novelty?
papers.authors: Hill-Horowitz TA, Bases B, Wang J, Liriano G, John S, Kobets A.
papers.abstract: Portable MRI (pMRI) addresses several limitations of conventional MRI (cMRI): it can be operated at the bedside and is less expensive. However, its lower magnetic field strength produces lower-quality images, limiting the reliable detection of subtle brain injury. This review examines pMRI utility within a pediatric hospital. Current evidence suggests that pMRI offers advantages for hospital care. Bedside imaging eliminates the need to transport critically ill patients to MRI suites, expanding access for children who cannot undergo cMRI. pMRI also reduces equipment costs and energy use per scan. pMRI performs well in identifying large intracranial processes (hydrocephalus, cerebral edema, intraparenchymal hemorrhage, and midline shift). However, it is less reliable for detecting small parenchymal injuries, subtle white-matter changes, infarcts, and small-volume hemorrhages. Motion artifact is a key limitation in pediatrics, where patient stillness is difficult. Because an advantage of MRI over CT is detecting small-scale pathology, defining the clinical role of pMRI is important. Overall, pMRI is a valuable complement to cMRI and CT in hospitals with bedside monitoring needs, critical care imaging demands, or limited MRI access. However, due to lower spatial resolution and SNR, pMRI cannot yet replace cMRI for evaluating subtle pediatric brain injuries.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了便携式磁共振成像（pMRI）在儿科医院中的应用价值与局限。作者指出，pMRI可在床旁操作、成本较低，便于危重患儿成像并扩大检查可及性，对脑积水、脑水肿、脑实质出血和中线移位等较大颅内病变识别较好；但其场强较低、图像质量有限，对细小实质损伤、轻微白质改变、梗死和小量出血的检出不够可靠，且儿童难以保持静止带来的运动伪影是重要限制。作者据此认为，pMRI是常规MRI和CT的有益补充，适用于有床旁监测、危重成像需求或MRI资源有限的医院，但因空间分辨率和信噪比较低，尚不能替代常规MRI评估细微的儿科脑损伤。

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Physician-Generated Acupuncture Treatment Protocols Across Chinese and English Language Settings: Cross-Sectional Evaluation Study.
papers.authors: Liu X, Guo Z.
papers.abstract: Background Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) has received increasing attention in evidence-based medicine. However, its largely experience-based and practice-oriented nature has slowed modernization and standardization. Advances in AI provide new opportunities for integrating AI with TCM. Objective This study evaluates the application of large language models (LLMs), including ChatGPT (OpenAI) and DeepSeek, in generating acupuncture treatment protocols. We compare the validity and clinical effectiveness of physician-generated protocols with those produced by LLMs, examine differences in outputs across language corpora (Chinese and English), and establish a standardized assessment framework for systematically assessing the effectiveness of acupuncture point selection. Ultimately, this research aims to support the standardization of acupoint selection and promote greater consistency, reliability, and evidence-based development in acupuncture practice. Methods Qualified acupuncture treatment cases published in Acupuncture in Medicine were identified and translated from English into Chinese to create a bilingual case dataset. Standardized case prompts were independently input into DeepSeek and ChatGPT to generate acupuncture treatment protocols. Ten senior TCM physicians evaluated the AI-generated and physician-generated protocols using 7 criteria: local point selection, distal point selection, syndrome-based point selection, meridian-tracing point selection, neuroanatomical point selection, core acupoint selection, and synergistic effects. Repeated-measures ANOVA with sphericity assessment was used to examine differences across LLMs, language corpora, and protocol groups. Results Blinded expert evaluations revealed significant differences among the 5 acupuncture groups for local point selection (P=.006), syndrome-based point selection (P=.005), neuroanatomical point selection (P<.001), and core acupoints coverage principle (P=.03). For local point selection, DeepSeek Chinese output received higher scores than the other evaluated outputs, while ChatGPT English output scored higher than ChatGPT Chinese output. For syndrome-based point selection, the journal physician-generated protocols received lower scores than the DeepSeek Chinese, DeepSeek English, and ChatGPT Chinese outputs. For neuroanatomical point selection, DeepSeek English output achieved the highest scores among the 5 groups. For core acupoints coverage, the journal physician-generated protocols received lower scores than the DeepSeek Chinese, DeepSeek English, and ChatGPT English outputs. No significant differences were observed among the 5 groups for distal point selection, meridian-tracing point selection, or therapeutic synergy. Overall, DeepSeek performed better in the Chinese-language setting, whereas ChatGPT performed better in the English-language setting. Conclusions AI has demonstrated substantial progress in encoding explicit acupuncture knowledge and performing systematic acupoint selection. However, challenges remain in individualized treatment and consistency across linguistic contexts. Enhancing bilingual or multilingual training corpora and developing syndrome-specific reasoning modules may improve the clinical applicability of AI-assisted TCM systems.

papers.title: Novel Sensors and Data-Driven Approach to Support Prevention, Diagnosis, and Treatment Planning of Cerebrovascular Accidents: Protocol for a Multimodal Data Collection Study With Novel Sensors.
papers.authors: Immonen M, Liedes H, Degerli A, Ruotsalainen I, Pajula J, Hilvo M, Similä H, Umer A, van Gils M, Jansson M, Rasmus KM, Pikkarainen M, Huhtinen P, Kärppä M, Francis Gomes J, Ferdinando H, Bordallo López M, Myllylä T, Kiviniemi V, von Und Zu Fraunberg M, Jäkälä P.
papers.abstract: Background Stroke is the second leading cause of death worldwide. Cerebrovascular diseases (CVDs), including strokes and transient ischemic attacks (TIAs), cause long-term disabilities and economic burdens. Strokes can be ischemic, caused by blood clots; or hemorrhagic, caused by bleeding in the brain. Immediate diagnosis and treatment are crucial. Proper management of TIAs is essential due to the high risk of subsequent strokes. Currently, wearable sensors, AI-based prediction, and automatic video analysis are not used in CVD diagnosis and recovery estimation. Objective This paper describes the design, cohort characteristics, and multimodal dataset of the Stroke-Data study conducted at 2 university hospitals in Finland. Although findings from individual components of the study have been reported elsewhere, this paper provides the first comprehensive description of the overall study design, cohort, and multimodal data collection protocol. The study collected a unique multimodal dataset comprising sensor data, video recordings, clinical assessments, questionnaires, and health record data from healthy controls and patients with stroke and TIA to support the development of AI, sensor-based, and video-based methods for CVD diagnosis and recovery estimation. Methods Stroke-Data was a prospective national multicenter study conducted at Oulu University Hospital and Kuopio University Hospital from October 2021 to December 2022. A rich multimodal dataset from patients with stroke and TIA and healthy controls was collected by study nurses and a research assistant. Inclusion criteria for patients were age >18 years and a diagnosis of cerebrovascular accident or TIA within the previous 3 days. Healthy control participants were aged 18 years and older and had no major chronic diseases, although blood pressure and cholesterol medications were permitted. Data collection included electroencephalogram; electrocardiogram; near-infrared spectroscopy; accelerometers to analyze gait and balance; retinal fundus images; video recordings of neurological examinations to analyze the face, body movements, and speech; clinical assessments; questionnaires; and electronic health records. Results In total, 263 participants were recruited, of whom 123 were controls (median age 59, IQR 45-72 years; female: 84/123, 68.3%), 31 were patients with TIA (median age 71, IQR 60-80 years; female: 8/31, 25.8%), and 103 were patients with stroke (median age 70, IQR 59-76 years; female: 42/102, 41.2%, sex data missing from 1 participant). A total of 6 participants were excluded (5 had diagnoses other than TIA or stroke and 1 control participant had a previous CVD). Conclusions We successfully conducted a multicenter multimodal data collection study on healthy controls and patients with stroke and TIA. This protocol paper provides a comprehensive methodological description of the Stroke-data study, serving as a reference for previously published and future analyses based on the dataset. The protocol is unique in combining physiological sensor data, video recordings, clinical assessments, questionnaires, and health record data from patients with stroke and TIA and healthy controls in a multicenter setting. International registered report identifier (irrid) DERR1-10.2196/86930.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在建立一套多模态数据采集方案，为脑血管意外（包括卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作）的预防、诊断与治疗规划提供传感器和人工智能方法所需的数据基础。研究在芬兰两家大学医院前瞻性招募健康对照者及近期发生卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作的患者，采集脑电、心电、近红外光谱、步态与平衡加速度、眼底图像、神经检查视频，以及临床评估、问卷和健康记录等多类数据。作者报告已成功完成多中心采集，并指出该方案的特点在于将生理传感器、视频、临床与问卷数据整合于同一队列，可作为后续分析的方法学参考；但本文为研究方案描述，未报告基于这些数据的诊断或预测效能。

papers.title: Profiling Transcriptomic Changes Across Frontal Cortical Subregions in Major Depressive Disorder
papers.authors: Iatrou A, Gigliotta A, Balakundi V, Bharadwaj R, Chatzinakos C, Matosin N, Nagy C, Snijders C, Turecki G, Leng B, Project PPB, Weinberger D, Hyde T, Nemeroff C, Ressler K, Kleinman J, Daskalakis N.
papers.abstract: Abstract Major depressive disorder (MDD) involves frontal cortical dysfunction, with emerging evidence implicating gliovascular and immune mechanisms, yet its transcriptional signatures across subregions, cell-types, and molecular layers remain poorly defined. Here, we integrated bulk-tissue RNA-seq data from dlPFC, mPFC, and dACC (n = 286) to identify a conserved core transcriptional profile, anchored in downregulated interneuron markers, and upregulated immune and vascular genes, spatially enriched in leptomeninges and white matter. Concordantly, multiomic factor analysis revealed immune activation, stress-response, and accelerated aging in MDD. Analysis of snRNA-seq data from dlPFC, mPFC, and oFC (863,511 nuclei; n = 204) revealed most pronounced MDD signatures in excitatory neurons, accompanied by coordinated disruption of glucocorticoid receptor machinery across cell-types, including FKBP5 upregulation. Glial, immune, and perivascular populations exhibited signatures of oxidative stress, ECM remodeling, and reduced neuronal support, and greater concordance with bulk-tissue MDD signals than neurons. A global reduction in cell-to-cell communications in MDD revealed a shift from homeostatic neuronal signaling toward endothelial and myelination-associated pathways. Ephrin-Eph signaling was consistently dysregulated, implicating disrupted axonal guidance, synaptic remodeling, and neurovascular integrity. Notably, MDD signatures were shared between MDD-only and PTSD comorbid cases at bulk-tissue analyses, while diverging at single-cell resolution. Together, these findings reframe MDD as a distributed frontal cortex disorder, driven by disrupted neuroglial and neurovascular communication.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究整合多个额叶皮层亚区的批量组织转录组数据，并结合单核RNA测序，考察重性抑郁障碍在额叶皮层不同亚区、细胞类型和分子层面的转录特征。结果显示，抑郁障碍存在一个跨亚区保守的核心转录谱，表现为抑制性神经元标志物下调、免疫与血管相关基因上调，并伴随免疫激活、应激反应和加速衰老信号；单细胞层面则以兴奋性神经元的变化最明显，同时糖皮质激素受体相关机制在多类细胞中协同紊乱，胶质、免疫和血管周围细胞呈现氧化应激、细胞外基质重塑及支持神经元功能减弱等特征。研究还发现细胞间通讯整体减少，信号由稳态神经元通路转向内皮和髓鞘相关通路，Ephrin-Eph信号持续失调。作者据此提出，抑郁障碍应被理解为一种由神经胶质与神经血管通讯受损驱动的分布式额叶皮层障碍。

papers.title: Xanthine Oxidase Inhibition as a Neurovascular Therapeutic Target After Stroke: A Systematic Review
papers.authors: Jesudason D, Nguyen D, Bacchi S, Kleinig T, Psaltis PJ.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hyperuricaemia is a potentially modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular disease. Xanthine oxidase inhibition via allopurinol may reduce oxidative stress and improve vascular function, however its role in cerebrovascular disease is unclear. Given the overlap in pathophysiology, allopurinol may mitigate secondary injury following stroke. Methods A systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines and prospectively registered with PROSPERO. We searched PubMed, Scopus, and CENTRAL from inception to 1st January 2026 for studies evaluating uric acid-lowering therapies in adult stroke populations. Eligible studies evaluated clinical, biochemical, vascular, or neuroimaging outcomes. Meta-analysis was not performed due to heterogeneity. Risk of bias and certainty were assessed using study-specific validated tools. Results Six eligible trials, all evaluating allopurinol in predominantly ischaemic stroke populations, were included. Allopurinol dose (100–600 mg/day), treatment duration (6-104 weeks), and timing (< 24 hours to several years post-stroke) varied substantially. No consistent benefit was observed for neurological impairment, recurrence, or mortality. Early treatment was associated with dose-dependent reductions in endothelial activation, while other studies demonstrated improvements in vascular measures potentially independent of urate reduction. Subacute and chronic trials found no effect on cerebrovascular reactivity or white matter hyperintensity progression. Conclusions Xanthine oxidase inhibition with allopurinol demonstrates heterogeneous biological and vascular effects following stroke, without consistent clinical benefit. Any therapeutic signal appears concentrated in studies evaluating earlier treatment initiation, without definitive conclusions regarding optimal timing or dose. Current evidence does not support routine allopurinol use following stroke but may indicate a plausible early therapeutic window for further investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA规范系统检索并评估了成人卒中人群中降尿酸治疗的研究，纳入的六项试验均使用别嘌醇，且以缺血性卒中为主。各试验在剂量、疗程和用药时机上差异很大，未观察到神经功能缺损、卒中复发或死亡率方面的一致获益；早期治疗与内皮活化呈剂量依赖性降低相关，部分血管指标改善可能不依赖尿酸下降，而亚急性期和慢性期试验未见对脑血管反应性或白质高信号进展的影响。作者认为现有证据不支持卒中后常规使用别嘌醇，但提示早期治疗窗口值得进一步研究，最佳时机和剂量尚无定论。

papers.title: The Internal Dynamics of Decisions: From Rats and Primates to AI
papers.authors: Thornhill NM.
papers.abstract: Whether the dynamics that carry a decision to commitment differ between the recurrent circuits of the brain and the transformer networks of large language models is a question about internal dynamics. For any recurrent network there is a feedforward network with matched behavior, so claims resting on internal dynamics must be tested directly. A dynamics demix separates input-driven change from change generated by a population’s own dynamics. Validated first on synthetic systems and checked against the mean-field variance theory of driven echo-state networks, it was applied to cortical populations in perceptual and value-based decisions and to five feedforward transformer language models constructing multi-step answers. Every neural dataset was autonomous-dominated and the five language models were input-dominated; under inference, orbitofrontal cortex recruited its autonomous component on both read-outs (24 of 31 rats on the variance partition), whereas four of the five models did not. For the two models and the cortical dataset re-examined at a matched input dimension of eight, the direction of that difference held. The models’ regime label, however, depends on the dimension of the input basis, so the difference is reported as one of regime at matched input dimension rather than as categorical. After commitment to a perceptual decision the cortical autonomous dynamics became more persistent, more sharply when aligned to the inferred commitment time than to stimulus onset (a specificity supported rather than established); this recovers a transition already reported for these recordings. In the two language models probed layer by layer the correct answer, when detected, first became top-ranked before the output layer, under the read-out used; across generated tokens, no commitment-locked rise in autonomous persistence was found in any model. In a pre-registered control varying only architecture at matched accuracy, the eigenvalue measure separated recurrent from feedforward networks, most cleanly when no input followed the evidence; that control, not the cortex–model comparison, carries the architectural claim. Pre-specified negative tests in orbitofrontal cortex found no commitment signal of the predicted sign in trial-averaged or scalar read-outs. Conclusions are limited to the systems tested. No claim is made about phenomenal experience or machine sentience.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种“动力学解混”方法，将群体活动中的输入驱动变化与系统自身动力学产生的变化分开，并在合成系统、驱动回声态网络的均值场方差理论以及知觉和价值决策中的皮层群体活动上加以检验，同时应用于五个前馈Transformer语言模型。结果显示，各神经数据集均以自主动力学为主，而五个语言模型均以输入驱动为主；在推断阶段，眶额皮层在两种读出上都调动了自主成分，五个模型中则有四个未表现出这一点。在匹配输入维度后，这一差异方向仍然成立，但模型的动力学体制标签依赖输入基的维度，因此作者将其表述为匹配输入维度下的体制差异而非类别差异。知觉决策承诺后，皮层自主动力学变得更持久，且与推断的承诺时间对齐时更明显；而在所检验的语言模型中，未发现承诺锁定的自主持久性上升。作者强调，架构层面的结论主要来自匹配准确率下仅改变架构的预注册控制，而非皮层与模型的比较，结论仅限于所测试的系统，不涉及主观体验或机器意识。

papers.title: Energy landscape and dynamic state modeling for schizophrenia biomarker extraction in task-based fMRI.
papers.authors: Allen JD, Hong E, Choa FS.
papers.abstract: Task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) examines how the brain dynamically responds to cognitive and perceptual demands, offering complementary insight beyond traditional activation-based analyses in schizophrenia. Prior task-based fMRI studies have identified reduced functional connectivity within auditory and associated cortical areas. In this study, we investigated task-evoked functional connectivity and brain state dynamics in 25 healthy controls, 23 patients with schizophrenia experiencing auditory verbal hallucinations (AVH+), and 23 patients without hallucinations (AVH-). Participants completed multiple auditory paradigms, including word lists, sentence lists, and reverse speech. The most robust connectivity differences emerged during the word list task, where cluster-level analyses revealed distinct network interaction patterns differentiating controls, AVH + , and AVH-patients. Energy landscape modeling further demonstrated altered stability and organization of brain states in both patient groups, with the largest deviations observed in AVH+ individuals. These alterations point to dysregulated neural dynamics linked to hallucination vulnerability. Overall, the results show that task-based fMRI sensitively captures disruptions in functional connectivity and brain state stability relevant to auditory hallucinations, underscoring its value for characterizing network-level mechanisms underlying perceptual disturbances in schizophrenia.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症患者在任务态功能磁共振成像中表现出的功能连接与脑状态动态异常，比较了健康对照、伴听幻觉患者和不伴听幻觉患者在执行多种听觉任务时的脑活动模式。结果显示，词语列表任务最能区分三组人群的网络交互模式；能量景观建模进一步表明，两组患者的脑状态稳定性和组织方式均发生改变，且伴听幻觉者的偏离最大。作者据此认为，任务态功能磁共振成像能够敏感捕捉与听幻觉相关的功能连接紊乱和脑状态稳定性下降，有助于刻画精神分裂症感知障碍的网络层面机制。

papers.title: Acute Imbalance Syndrome vs Acute Vestibular Syndrome: Clinical and Topographical Differentiation.
papers.authors: Möhwald K, Hadzhikolev H, Eberle L, Jaufenthaler P, Strupp M, Jahn K, Conrad J, Zwergal A.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Stroke is a major differential diagnosis in patients with acute vertigo/dizziness or imbalance. Current diagnostic algorithms such as head impulse test, gaze-evoked nystagmus, and test of skew are optimized for presentations with spontaneous nystagmus (SPN), traditionally called acute vestibular syndrome (AVS). However, in recent studies, a relevant proportion of patients with stroke-related vertigo/dizziness had no SPN, but rather postural or gait imbalance, a phenotype lately termed acute imbalance syndrome (AIS). We aimed to outline the pathoanatomical differences of stroke-related AIS vs AVS and its clinical implications. Methods Patients with MRI-proven stroke-related acute vertigo/dizziness or imbalance were included in this emergency department (ED) cohort study at LMU Hospital prospectively. Vestibular, ocular motor, and postural signs were documented (including SPN presence/intensity by video oculography, postural imbalance by posturography). Patients were classified as suffering from AIS or AVS based on the presence of SPN. Stroke lesion distribution was depicted in Montreal Neurological Institute space and supplemented by structural disconnectome mapping from the lesion cores. Multivariate lesion symptom-mapping based on support-vector regression and disconnectome mapping was applied for SPN intensity and sway path as surrogate markers for AVS and AIS. Results Of 75 patients (age: 65.7 ± 13.3 years, 40% female), 58.7% were diagnosed with AIS, 38.7% with AVS, and 2.7% with central positional vertigo. In AIS, the lesion core was located in the anterior cerebellar lobe and deep cerebellar nuclei (superior cerebellar artery/posterior inferior cerebellar artery territory) connecting to the bilateral pontomesencephalic tegmentum through the superior cerebellar peduncle. AVS stroke lesions were mostly located in the posterior cerebellar/flocculonodular lobe (posterior inferior cerebellar artery/anterior inferior cerebellar artery territory) and connected to the ipsilesional vestibular nucleus (VN) and bilateral medial longitudinal fascicle (MLF) through the inferior cerebellar peduncle. SPN intensity correlated with voxels in the cerebellar lobules VI-IX connecting to VN and MLF. Postural sway was associated with a small local cluster in the cerebellar Crus I. Discussion AIS accounts for more than half of patients with stroke-related vertigo/dizziness or imbalance. AIS lesions were located in the anterior cerebellar lobe, disturbing cerebellar-pontomesencephalic networks for posture and gait control. AVS lesions affected the posterior cerebellar/flocculonodular lobe and associated vestibulo-ocular reflex networks. Recognition of both clinical phenotypes is essential to identify all strokes among patients with vertigo/dizziness in the emergency setting. Trial registration information DRKS00008992; U1111-1172-8719.

papers.title: Scalp acupuncture coupled with speech-language therapy modulates the ventral-dorsal structural brain network in patients with post-stroke anomia: a randomized clinical and DTI neuroimaging trial.
papers.authors: Song J, Nan R, Ni J, Chai L, Zhang L, Wang M, Wang N, Lin B, Huang J.
papers.abstract: Background Scalp acupuncture (SA) is used as adjunctive rehabilitation for post-stroke aphasia, but its effect on naming recovery and structural language-network changes remains unclear. We evaluated SA coupled with speech-language therapy (SLT) in patients with post-stroke anomia and explored diffusion tensor imaging markers of ventral-dorsal structural language networks. Methods This randomized controlled trial recruited 85 patients with post-stroke anomia and randomly assigned them to SA or control. Both groups received conventional stroke treatment and SLT; the SA group additionally received scalp acupuncture synchronously with SLT during needle retention. Treatment was delivered once daily, 5 days/week for 4 weeks. The primary outcome was WAB naming total score. Diffusion tensor imaging assessed white matter integrity and topological properties before and after treatment. Results Compared to the control group, the SA group showed greater improvements in the WAB naming total score (P = 0.009), object naming, sentence completion, responsive speech, BNT spontaneous naming, and SAQOL-39 communication. In the ventral-dorsal structural network, the SA group showed smaller changes in the area under the curve (AUC) of small-worldness properties (P = 0.008) and normalized clustering coefficient (P = 0.017), and greater changes in clustering coefficient and local efficiency. In the SA group, the change in small-worldness was negatively correlated with the change in the WAB naming total score (r = -0.451, P = 0.027). The SA group also showed smaller axial diffusivity (AD) changes in the left uncinate fasciculus (P = 0.003, Bonferroni corrected), which correlated negatively with the WAB naming total score change (r = -0.440, P = 0.031). Exploratory adjusted regression showed that SA-group assignment was associated with greater naming improvement after adjustment for baseline naming and clinical covariates. Conclusions SA coupled with SLT was associated with greater naming recovery in patients with post-stroke anomia. The benefit was accompanied by changes in structural language-network topology and white matter integrity, particularly involving the left UF. These findings support further evaluation of scalp acupuncture as an adjunct to language rehabilitation and suggest structural network plasticity as a relevant imaging correlate.
keywords: Ventral And Dorsal Structural Language Network
papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验纳入卒中后命名障碍患者，比较在言语语言治疗基础上同步加用头皮针与单纯言语语言治疗对命名恢复及腹侧-背侧结构语言网络的影响。结果显示，头皮针组在命名总分及多项命名相关指标上改善更明显，同时结构网络的拓扑属性和白质完整性出现组间差异，主要涉及左侧钩束，且部分网络指标变化与命名改善相关。作者据此认为，头皮针作为语言康复辅助手段与更好的命名恢复相关，结构网络可塑性可能是相应的影像学关联，但相关关系不等于因果，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Structural and metabolic imaging after mechanical thrombectomy for acute ischemic stroke: A hybrid 18F-FDG PET/MRI pilot study.
papers.authors: Aparici-Robles F, Puig J, Morales-Caba L, Sopena-Novales P, Martínez-Sanchís B, Sanchís-García JM, Vázquez-Añón V, Teruel R, Comas-Cufí M, Ginés S, Ten A, Carot-Sierra JM, Martí-Bonmatí L.
papers.abstract: Hybrid 2-[18F]-fluoro-2-deoxy-D-glucose positron emission tomography/magnetic resonance imaging (18F-FDG PET/MRI) enables simultaneous, single-session assessment of structural and metabolic stroke damage. We prospectively studied 10 consecutive patients (6 women; mean age 71.6 ± 11.2 years) with anterior-circulation stroke due to middle cerebral artery (MCA) occlusion who underwent successful mechanical thrombectomy (MT). Structural damage was graded with the Alberta Stroke Program Early CT Score (ASPECTS) on admission and 24-h non-contrast CT and on diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) at 72 hours; metabolic damage was graded with a PET-adapted ASPECTS on simultaneously acquired 18F-FDG PET at 72 hours. A between-modality difference of ≥3 ASPECTS points was considered significant. Baseline ASPECTS was 10 in 9 patients, and all achieved successful recanalization (modified Thrombolysis in Cerebral Infarction 2c-3). 18F-FDG PET showed severe hypometabolism in every infarcted territory, often extending beyond structural changes: ASPECTS differences were present in 7/10 patients for CT, 6/10 for DWI and 6/10 for FLAIR versus 18F-FDG PET/MRI, reaching the predefined 3-point threshold in 3/10 for CT versus PET/MRI. Because DWI, FLAIR and PET were acquired simultaneously at 72 hours (CT at 24 hours), the DWI/FLAIR-versus-PET comparisons are free of temporal confounding. Ipsilateral thalamic and crossed cerebellar diaschisis were each identified in 4/10 patients at 72 hours. Despite this more extensive hypometabolism, 9/10 patients achieved a favorable outcome (modified Rankin Scale ≤2) at 3 months. Hybrid 18F-FDG PET/MRI maps metabolic abnormality and remote network dysfunction invisible to structural imaging alone, adding a physiological dimension to ASPECTS-based evaluation of the reperfused brain.
keywords: Alberta Stroke Program Early Ct Score
papers.summary_zh: 这项前瞻性初步研究探讨机械取栓成功再通后，急性缺血性卒中脑组织的代谢损伤是否超出结构影像可见范围，对前循环大脑中动脉闭塞患者同期进行18F-FDG PET与MRI检查，并以PET适配的ASPECTS评估代谢损伤。结果显示，所有梗死区域均出现严重代谢减低，且常超出结构改变范围；结构影像与PET的ASPECTS差异在部分患者中达到预设阈值，同侧丘脑和对侧小脑的远隔性代谢改变也可见于部分患者。尽管代谢异常更广泛，多数患者三个月功能结局仍良好，提示混合PET/MRI能为再灌注脑的评估补充结构影像之外的生理信息。

papers.title: Serial qEEG as a Neurophysiological Profiling and Treatment Monitoring Tool in dTMS-Treated Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Oh H, Lee J.
papers.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurobiologically heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition, yet current treatment approaches - predominantly behavioral and communicative - pharmacological option limited to symptomatic relief, with limited benefit for individuals with more severe presentations. Here we report an 8-year-old male with ASD presenting with social withdrawal, anxiety, and self-injurious behavior (SIB), who underwent quantitative electroencephalography(qEEG)-guided deep transcranial magnetic stimulation (dTMS) over 40 sessions. Baseline qEEG demonstrated generalized cortical hyperexcitability - characterized by elevated absolute power across most frequency bands and diffuse coherence elevation - consistent with a maturational lag pattern previously described in ASD. We hypothesized that this profile might offer a neurobiological rationale for BDNF-activating neuromodulatory approach via dTMS. Serial qEEG assessments every 10 sessions enabled quantitative monitoring of treatment response; introduction of the H7 coil from the 21st session associated with subsequent delta reduction and partial resolution of central/posterior high-beta activity. CARS-2 scores decreased from 34 at baseline to 20 at treatment completion - a 41% reduction, representing a shift to the non-autistic range - coinciding with reduced anxiety-related behaviors, improved language, and overall reduction in SIB. This case illustrates the potential dual utility of qEEG as a neurophysiological profiling tool and a quantitative biomarker of treatment response, contributing preliminary evidence for the clinical utility of dTMS in ASD and highlighting the value of neurophysiologically informed, precision-based approach to psychiatric care.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一名伴有社交退缩、焦虑和自伤行为的自闭症谱系障碍男童，接受以定量脑电图（qEEG）引导的深部经颅磁刺激（dTMS）治疗，并每10次治疗复查qEEG以监测反应。基线qEEG显示多数频段绝对功率升高和广泛相干性增强，提示皮层过度兴奋，作者据此推测dTMS可能通过激活BDNF相关神经调控机制发挥作用。治疗后期qEEG出现部分频段活动减弱，CARS-2评分由34降至20，同时焦虑相关行为、语言和自伤行为有所改善。作者认为qEEG兼具神经生理分型和治疗反应生物标志物的潜在用途，但作为单例报告，这些结果只能提供初步线索，不能据此推断因果关系或临床疗效。

papers.title: A randomized pilot trial of non-flickering 40 Hz light stimulation: EEG activity and cognitive outcomes in cognitively normal older adults.
papers.authors: Cheng CH, Lu H.
papers.abstract: BackgroundGamma-frequency (40 Hz) sensory stimulation is a promising non-pharmacological approach for modulating neural activity and cognitive function in aging and Alzheimer's disease. However, conventional flickering stimulation is often poorly tolerated, and evidence for non-flickering approaches remains limited.ObjectiveTo evaluate the neurophysiological and cognitive effects of 4-week (28-session) non-flickering 40 Hz light stimulation in cognitively normal older adults.MethodsIn this randomized, double-blind, active-controlled pilot trial, 33 cognitively normal older adults were assigned to receive either non-flickering 40 Hz light stimulation (n = 17) or a 70 Hz active-controlled condition (n = 16) over four weeks. Per-protocol analyses were conducted in 29 participants who completed the intervention. Resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) was acquired at baseline, immediately after the first intervention session, and after completion of the 4-week intervention. Neuropsychological assessments were performed at baseline and after the intervention. Prespecified primary outcomes were resting-state gamma-band power spectral density (PSD) and functional connectivity (FC).ResultsNo significant between-group differences were observed in resting-state gamma-band PSD or FC following either one-session or 28-session intervention. Unadjusted secondary analyses suggested potential improvements in selected episodic memory measures in the 40 Hz group. Exploratory analyses further identified a positive association between improvements in visuospatial memory and increases in occipital-temporal FC. Both interventions were well tolerated.ConclusionsA 28-session non-flickering 40 Hz light stimulation was well tolerated and may improve selected episodic memory measures in cognitively normal older adults. Although no measurable group-level EEG effects were observed, the exploratory cognitive findings warrant further investigation in larger randomized trials.ClinicalTrial.gov (ID: NCT06715995) https://clinicaltrials.gov/expert-search?term=NCT06715995.
papers.summary_zh: 该随机双盲主动对照预试验在认知正常的老年人中比较无闪烁40 Hz光刺激与70 Hz对照条件，评估四周干预对静息态脑电和认知的影响。预设主要指标即伽马频段功率谱密度和功能连接，在单次及28次干预后均未发现显著组间差异；未校正的次要分析提示40 Hz组部分情景记忆指标可能改善，探索性分析还发现视空间记忆改善与枕颞功能连接增加相关。两种干预耐受性均良好。作者据此认为无闪烁40 Hz光刺激安全可行，但脑电层面未见可测效应，认知方面的初步线索需在更大规模随机试验中验证。

papers.title: Association of stenosis and arterial remodeling with cerebral hemodynamics and cognition.
papers.authors: Tee M, Gutierrez J, Cui J, Chiang E, Venketasubramanian N, Chen C, Petr J, Mutsaerts HJMM, Hilal S.
papers.abstract: BackgroundAssociations between intracranial stenosis, arterial remodeling, cerebral hemodynamics, including cerebral blood flow (CBF) and arterial transit time (ATT), white matter hyperintensities (WMH), and cognition remain unclear.ObjectiveThis study investigates the relationships between MRA-derived vascular parameters, cerebral hemodynamics, WMH burden, and cognition. We hypothesized that greater stenosis or remodeling is associated with impaired hemodynamics, increased WMH burden, and poorer cognition.MethodsCross-sectional study of 452 memory clinic patients (median age 74 [IQR 68-78], 53% female) who underwent 3T MRI with time-of-flight MRA and pseudo-continuous ASL. Automated quantification derived global stenosis and brain arterial remodeling (BAR) scores. CBF and spatial coefficient of variation (sCoV) assessed hemodynamics; WMH volume from FLAIR; cognition from a validated neuropsychological battery. Structural equation modelling (SEM) evaluated associations, adjusting for demographics and cardiovascular risk factors.ResultsHigher sCoV was associated with higher BAR (β = 0.14, 95% CI:0.06-0.23). WMH was associated with stenosis (β = 0.20, CI:0.12-0.28) and BAR (β = 0.07, CI:0.001-0.140). Lower CBF (β = -0.26, CI:-0.36 to -0.15) and higher sCoV (β = 0.27, CI:0.17-0.36) were associated with greater WMH burden. Higher BAR was associated with better global cognition (β = 0.07, CI:0.00-0.14). SEM indicated indirect associations with cognition via WMH and CBF.ConclusionsVascular remodeling and stenosis are associated with cerebral hemodynamics, WMH, and cognition, with CBF and WMH as potential mediators, underscoring the importance of vascular health in Alzheimer's disease. These direct and indirect associations are not mutually exclusive: higher BAR was associated with better cognition directly, while also relating to poorer cognition indirectly through greater WMH burden and perfusion heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究以记忆门诊患者为对象，结合磁共振血管成像与动脉自旋标记灌注成像，考察颅内狭窄和脑动脉重塑与脑血流、动脉通过时间、白质高信号负荷及认知之间的关系。结果显示，动脉重塑程度较高与灌注异质性增大相关；狭窄和重塑均与白质高信号负荷相关，而脑血流较低和灌注异质性较高也与白质高信号负荷较大相关。结构方程模型提示，这些血管指标与认知之间可能存在经由白质高信号和脑血流的间接关联；同时，动脉重塑较高与整体认知较好存在直接关联，又可通过白质高信号负荷和灌注异质性间接关联较差的认知。作者据此强调血管健康在阿尔茨海默病中的潜在意义，但上述均为关联性结果，不能据此推断因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Neuroanatomical correlates of the CDT-14: A voxel-based morphometry study exploring incremental information beyond conventional clock drawing scores.
papers.authors: Sawada Y, Satoh T, Saba H, Kato Y, Kuwada T, Shima S, Murakami K, Sasaki M, Abe Y, Harano K.
papers.abstract: BackgroundThe Clock Drawing Test (CDT) is widely used for cognitive screening but lacks unified scoring standards and neuroanatomical validation.ObjectiveWe examined the neuroanatomical correlates and incremental validity beyond conventional CDT scoring of CDT-14, a psychometrically refined 14-item system with three subfactors (Circle, Numbering, and Hand), using voxel-based morphometry (VBM).MethodsWe analyzed 985 participants from a heterogeneous memory-clinic cohort. Whole-brain VBM compared CDT-14 total and subfactor scores with three conventional scoring systems. Models adjusted for age, sex, education level, and total intracranial volume. Incremental validity was assessed after controlling for a principal-component-derived conventional composite score, with sensitivity analyses adjusting for white matter lesion volume (WMLV).ResultsCDT-14 was associated with gray matter volume (GMV) in distributed clock-drawing regions, including the right anterior hippocampus, parahippocampal gyrus, bilateral precuneus, and prefrontal regions. Primary incremental analyses identified additional associations in bilateral ventral temporal, right occipito-temporal, and dorsal anterior cingulate regions after accounting for conventional CDT performance. These associations were attenuated after WMLV adjustment, and no clusters survived FWE correction in the WMLV-adjusted incremental model. Subfactor analyses suggested partially distinct but overlapping patterns involving frontostriatal and cingulate regions for Circle, thalamic and limbic-related regions for Numbering, and hippocampal, parietal, and occipital regions for Hand.ConclusionsCDT-14 showed cross-sectional GMV associations beyond conventional scoring in primary analyses. However, the incremental associations were not robust to WMLV adjustment at the FWE-corrected threshold and should be interpreted cautiously. Longitudinal, biomarker-informed, and externally validated studies are needed to establish predictive validity, disease specificity, and clinical utility.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于记忆门诊的异质性队列，用基于体素的形态学分析考察CDT-14总分及各子因子得分与灰质体积的关联，并与三种传统时钟画钟评分系统比较。结果显示，CDT-14与右侧前海马、海马旁回、双侧楔前叶及前额叶等区域的灰质体积相关；在控制传统评分后，初步分析还发现双侧腹侧颞叶、右侧枕颞区和背侧前扣带等区域的额外关联。但校正白质病变体积后这些增量关联明显减弱，且无簇通过FWE校正，说明其增量效度尚不稳健，需谨慎解读，并需纵向和外部验证研究进一步确认。

papers.title: Acculturation is associated with cognitive performance but not changes in cognition among middle-aged and older Hispanic/Latino adults: Findings from the HCHS/SOL and SOL-INCA.
papers.authors: Stickel AM, Tarraf W, Kuwayama S, Xue Y, Breton J, Medina LD, Morlett Paredes A, Gallo LC, Cai J, Lamar M, Pirzada A, Daviglus ML, Isasi CR, Kaplan R, Wassertheil-Smoller S, González HM.
papers.abstract: BackgroundHispanic/Latino adults are not a monolithic group. Individuals vary in a range of factors, including levels of acculturation (adoption of Anglo-American culture).ObjectiveTo investigate the relationships between acculturation with cognition, changes in cognition, and risk for mild cognitive impairment (MCI).MethodsWe included Hispanic/Latino adults (unweighted n = 5976) from the Study of Latinos - Investigation of Neurocognitive Aging (SOL-INCA), a Hispanic Community Health Study/Study of Latinos ancillary study. Three acculturation measures were collected at Visit 1 (Short Acculturation Scale for Hispanics (SASH) - Social and Language subscales and the MESA Acculturation score). Participants were grouped into quartiles per measure with higher scores reflecting greater acculturation. Outcomes included cognition and MCI prevalence 7-years after Visit 1 and 7-year change in cognition from Visit 1 to 2. Survey linear regressions were performed to model the associations between acculturation measures and cognitive outcomes, controlling for sociodemographic factors.ResultsThe lowest SASH Social and Language acculturation groups had lower global cognition scores than all other groups (all p -values<0.01). The lowest MESA Acculturation score group had lower global cognition scores relative to those in the highest quartile (b = 0.10; SE = 0.04; p < 0.05). However, there were no acculturation differences in cognitive change or MCI.ConclusionsThough low acculturation was associated with lower cognitive performance, it does not seem to be related to increased risk for cognitive decline or pathological cognitive aging (i.e., prevalent MCI).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于HCHS/SOL与SOL-INCA队列，考察西班牙裔/拉丁裔中老年人的文化适应水平与认知表现、认知变化及轻度认知障碍风险之间的关系。结果显示，文化适应程度较低者在整体认知得分上低于其他组，但文化适应与七年间的认知变化或轻度认知障碍患病率并无关联。作者据此指出，低文化适应虽与较差的认知表现相关，却似乎并不对应更高的认知衰退或病理性认知老化风险，提示这种关联可能更多反映当前表现而非变化轨迹。

papers.title: Melatonin as a potential biomarker for subclinical epileptiform activity in Alzheimer's disease: An exploratory study.
papers.authors: Nous A, Seynaeve L, Feys O, Wens V, De Tiège X, Van Mierlo P, Baroumand AG, Mangelschots S, Michiels V, De Witte S, Wittens MMJ, Bjerke M, Ceyssens S, Gordijn M, De Weerdt S, Van Eekchaut A, Nagels G, Smolders I, Engelborghs S.
papers.abstract: BackgroundMelatonin levels are altered in elderly people and might become even more disrupted in Alzheimer's disease (AD) patients. An inverse correlation between cerebrospinal fluid melatonin levels and severity of AD neuropathology has been described. There is an increased prevalence of subclinical epileptiform activity (SEA) in AD. Baseline melatonin levels have been described to be lower in epilepsy patients as compared to controls, suggesting antiepileptic effects.ObjectiveTo compare melatonin levels between AD participants and controls, to evaluate melatonin's potential use as biomarker for disease stage in AD and to evaluate the link between melatonin levels and SEA in AD.MethodsAD subjects (n = 20) and healthy volunteers (n = 8) underwent a 24-h-electro-encephalography (EEG), during which multiple blood and saliva samples were taken. Melatonin levels were analysed using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (plasma) and radioimmunoassay (saliva). A subset of participants underwent 50-min resting magnetoencephalography and/or high-density-EEG to detect SEA.ResultsPlasma melatonin levels were significantly lower in AD as compared to controls at 23:00PM. Melatonin levels were similar between patients with AD dementia, MCI due to AD and preclinical AD subjects. Plasma and saliva melatonin levels at 04:00AM and 01:00AM, respectively, were significantly higher in AD participants with SEA as compared to those without.ConclusionsNight-time melatonin levels might serve as a potential biomarker to identify AD patients at risk for SEA, based on exploratory findings. Whether this increase could be a compensatory feedback mechanism against SEA or whether melatonin rather has pro-epileptic effects, remains to be elucidated by further research.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究比较了阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者与健康对照的褪黑素水平，并考察其与亚临床癫痫样活动（SEA）的关联；受试者接受24小时脑电监测并多次采集血和唾液，部分人另做静息脑磁图或高密度脑电以检测SEA。结果显示，AD组夜间血浆褪黑素低于对照，但AD痴呆、AD所致轻度认知障碍和临床前AD之间水平相近；而在AD受试者中，伴有SEA者凌晨的血浆和唾液褪黑素反而高于无SEA者。作者据此提出，夜间褪黑素或可作为识别AD中SEA风险人群的潜在标志物，但这一升高究竟是针对SEA的代偿反馈还是褪黑素本身具有促癫痫作用，尚待进一步研究。

papers.title: Multimodal MRI insights into glymphatic clearance and blood-brain barrier integrity in healthy aging.
papers.authors: Bhattarai A, Zhu YD, Albuhwailah B, Maillard P, DeCarli C, Fan AP.
papers.abstract: Aging is associated with impaired CSF clearance in preclinical models, but its impact on blood-brain barrier (BBB) health and glymphatic function in humans remains unclear. The BBB and glymphatic functions are complementary and may partially overlap, yet their interaction is yet to be fully elucidated. In this study, we aimed to compare BBB integrity, extracellular free water, and glymphatic function between healthy young and older adults, and to examine mechanistic relationships among these measures using multimodal MRI techniques. 30 healthy participants with no known neurological or psychiatric disorders, including 12 younger (26 ± 3 years) and 18 older individuals (75 ± 7 years), underwent MRI scans on a 3T Siemens Prisma scanner. Multimodal MRI techniques were used, including diffusion-prepared arterial spin labeling to measure the water exchange rate (Kw) across the blood-brain barrier (BBB); free water (FW) imaging to quantify extracellular free water in white matter; and diffusion tensor imaging along perivascular spaces (DTI-ALPS) to assess glymphatic function. These measures were compared between younger and older individuals. Mediation analysis was performed to assess the mechanistic relationship between BBB integrity and glymphatic function and to test whether this relationship was mediated by free water. Older individuals showed reduced whole-brain Kw (p = 0.021), increased white matter FW (p = 0.002), and reduced DTI-ALPS (p < 0.001) compared to younger adults. Kw was positively associated with DTI-ALPS (β = 0.402 × 10-2 , p = 0.022) and negatively associated with FW (β = -0.676 × 10-3 , p = 0.008). DTI-ALPS was negatively associated with FW (β = -3.487, p = 0.001). Significantly reduced Kw was also observed in the cortical grey matter of older adults. Reduced Kw may reflect impaired BBB function, while reduced DTI-ALPS and increased FW indicate impaired glymphatic clearance. FW mediated the relationship between Kw and DTI-ALPS (95% CI [0.00014, 0.00404], p = 0.035), suggesting a potential mechanistic link between BBB function, extracellular water content, and glymphatic clearance efficiency. Overall, this study provides novel multimodal MRI insights into BBB and glymphatic alterations in healthy aging and may inform the development of MRI biomarkers to preserve cognitive health.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注健康衰老过程中血脑屏障完整性与类淋巴清除功能的变化及其相互关系，采用多模态MRI在健康年轻与老年人中比较血脑屏障水交换率、白质细胞外自由水和类淋巴功能指标。结果显示，老年人血脑屏障水交换率降低、白质自由水增多、类淋巴功能指标下降，且这些指标彼此相关；中介分析提示自由水可能介导血脑屏障功能与类淋巴清除效率之间的联系。作者据此提出，这些改变可能反映衰老中血脑屏障功能受损与类淋巴清除减弱，并为相关MRI生物标志物研究提供线索，但结论基于健康人群的横断面关联，尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Refractory Status Epilepticus Following Erroneous Intrathecal Injection of Tranexamic Acid: A Case Report and Long-Term Follow-Up and Narrative Review.
papers.authors: Yousfi H, Nobile L, Gaspard N, Taccone F.
papers.abstract: Introduction Accidental intrathecal injection of tranexamic acid (TXA) is a rare but catastrophic preventable adverse event associated with high mortality and severe neurological consequences. It represents a major neurological emergency that requires immediate specialized management. Case presentation A 32-year-old man erroneously received an intrathecal injection of 300 mg of TXA instead of bupivacaine during a saphenous vein stripping procedure. He rapidly developed refractory myoclonic status epilepticus, sympathetic hyperactivity, and rhabdomyolysis. Management included multiple antiseizure medications, continuous EEG-guided sedation, and targeted use of neuromuscular blockade. The patient recovered without immediate neurological deficit but developed persistent cognitive impairment and posttraumatic stress disorder at follow-up. Conclusions This case highlights the severe neurotoxicity of intrathecal TXA and the importance of early and aggressive intensive care management. It also underscores the need for long-term multidisciplinary follow-up for the assessment of anesthetic procedure-related complications.
papers.summary_zh: 该文报告一例32岁男性在静脉剥脱术中误将300 mg氨甲环酸注入鞘内而非布比卡因后，迅速出现难治性肌阵挛性癫痫持续状态、交感神经过度活跃和横纹肌溶解；处理包括多种抗癫痫药物、持续脑电图引导镇静及针对性神经肌肉阻滞。患者急性期未遗留明显神经功能缺损，但随访中出现持续认知损害和创伤后应激障碍。作者据此强调鞘内氨甲环酸的严重神经毒性、早期积极重症管理的重要性，以及对此类麻醉操作并发症开展长期多学科随访的必要性。

papers.title: Topographical Patterns of Slow Wave Activity in Sleep Talking: An Exploratory Polysomnographic Investigation.
papers.authors: Pellegrini E, Camaioni M, Mangiaruga A, Pumo D, Alfonsi V, Annarumma L, Scarpelli S, Sanguineti C, Castelnovo A, De Gennaro L, D'Agostino A, Gorgoni M.
papers.abstract: Sleep talking (ST) is a parasomnia characterized by the utterance of unaware linguistic activations during sleep. Electrophysiological evidence is scarce, and it remains unclear whether local electroencephalographic (EEG) alterations characterize the sleep of STs outside of parasomnia episodes. Findings from NREM parasomnias suggest that local slow-wave activity (SWA) abnormalities may characterize a full night's sleep beyond behavioural manifestations. Accordingly, this study investigates SWA topography and the spatial distribution of the single SWA bins across sleep stages in a group of 12 young STs compared to 10 healthy controls (HCs) matched for sex and age, who underwent overnight laboratory polysomnographic recordings. The relationship between SWA pattern and parasomnia frequency was explored, and the overnight decline in SWA was examined to assess the potential impact of homeostatic processes. Our findings point to a peculiar SWA pattern characterized by a substantially stable central increase across sleep stages and a frontopolar decrease primarily in N2 sleep, suggesting a local and frequency-specific (≥ 1 Hz) SWA regulation in STs that may interact with homeostatic processes. These results provide new insights into the sleep electrophysiology of STs and shed light on trait-like regional alterations in SWA that may facilitate parasomnia events. Our findings align with the concept of local sleep, which posits that distinct cortical regions may simultaneously exhibit diverse functional states. In this view, different parasomnias may be characterized by specific SWA topographical patterns reflecting the peculiar behaviours enacted during sleep.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究比较了12名年轻睡语者与10名性别年龄匹配的健康对照者的整夜多导睡眠图，考察睡语者在不发生睡语发作时是否也存在局部脑电改变，重点分析慢波活动的空间分布及其随睡眠阶段的变化。结果显示，睡语者表现出一种较稳定的慢波活动地形模式：中央区慢波活动在各睡眠阶段普遍偏高，而额极区活动主要于N2期降低，提示其慢波活动存在局部且频率特异的调控，并可能与稳态过程相互作用。作者据此认为，这类类似特质性的区域慢波改变可能为睡语事件的发生提供条件，也与“局部睡眠”的观点相符，即不同皮层区域可同时处于不同功能状态。

papers.title: Cross-Subject Localization of Epileptogenic Zone for Drug-Resistant Epilepsy Based on the Causal Brain Network.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Kong W, Liu Y, Shi Z, Li Q, Wang T, Chen W, Hu B.
papers.abstract: Objective While neurosurgical treatment is the primary intervention for Drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) patients, its success rate is limited to approximately 60%. Precise localization of epileptogenic zone (EZ) is a critical factor for surgical success. This study aims to achieve cross-subject localization of the EZ in DRE patients using causal brain network features extracted from stereotactic electroencephalography (SEEG). Methods We collected SEEG recordings from 12 DRE patients who achieved complete seizure freedom (Engel Class I). The causal coupling algorithm, full convergent cross mapping (FCCM), was applied to both ictal and interictal states to extract causal brain network features from SEEG recordings. We fed these features into multiple machine learning models to achieve automated identification of EZ within a leave-one-patient-out cross-validation framework. Under a unified evaluation protocol, FCCM was compared with directed information, frequency-domain convergent cross mapping (FD CCM),high-frequencyoscillation-based methods, source-sink con nectivity, and SEEGformer. Results At the individual level, the Mann-Whitney U test demonstrated that the raw FCCM values sig nificantly differentiated the EZ from the non-epileptogenic zones (NEZ) in 83.3% (10/12) of patients during the ictal state and in all patients (12/12) during the interictal state (p < 0.001). Per mutational multivariate analysis of variance on the 8 dimensional statistical features revealed significant global network variations in 83.3% (10/12) of ictal and 91.7% (11/12) of interictal states (p < 0.001). The combined model, which integrated both ictal and interictal features using the logistic regression classifier, achieved the best performance among all evaluated methods This approach achieved the highest accuracy (0.83 ± 0.10), recall (0.87 ± 0.09), and F1-score (0.80 ± 0.12), while the second-best baseline (FD CCM) yielded an accuracy of 0.79 ± 0.15, a recall of 0.81 ± 0.20, and an F1-score of 0.75±0.18. These results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Conclusion Causal brain network features extracted by FCCM are robust biomarkers for localizing the EZ. Significance This study could support the development of more personalized treatment strategies for DRE patients. It is expected to promote the development of precision medicine for DRE.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对药物难治性癫痫患者致痫区定位这一手术成功的关键问题，利用立体定向脑电提取因果脑网络特征，并在留一患者交叉验证框架下比较多种方法实现跨受试者自动识别。结果显示，基于全收敛交叉映射的因果耦合特征在发作期和发作间期均能区分致痫区与非致痫区，融合两种状态特征的逻辑回归模型在准确率、召回率和F1值上优于所比较的其他方法。作者认为这类因果网络特征可作为致痫区定位的稳健生物标志物，并有望为药物难治性癫痫的个体化治疗和精准医疗提供支持，但摘要未报告其临床应用的验证结果。

papers.title: A Structured Framework for Translation of the ACNS Standardized Critical Care EEG Terminology Into Spanish.
papers.authors: Rubinos C, San-Juan D, Alva-Diaz C, Beato M, Bender Del Busto JE, Balugo Bengoechea P, Bermudez R S, Bogantes S, Calle-Lopez Y, Cibils L, Contreras G, Cordero JC, Fernandez V, Florentín C, Galvez HH, Gaona I, Del Carmen Garcia M, Garofalo Gomez N, Gonzalez R, Gutierrez A, Hernandez L, Legnani M, Lizcano A, Magos D, Malpartida N, Mateos JA, Mendoza L, Milan A, Montenegro Lopez R, Martin Palomeque G, Paredes-Aragon E, Perassolo M, Ramirez E, Ramos A, Rivas V, Sanchez Ortiz N, Servin O, Silva-Soto S, Su H, Thompson A, Thonon V, Ulate-Campos A, Uribe-San-Martin R, Vergara JP, Vides-Rosales M, Viñan Vazquez I, Zavala-Reina ÁA, Daily J, Grant J, Frasso R, Fernandez A, Bruzzone MJ, Consorcio Hispano de Monitoreo Electroencefalográfico.
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neurophysiology : official publication of the American Electroencephalographic Society
papers.abstract: Purpose The American Clinical Neurophysiology Society (ACNS) Critical Care EEG Terminology provides standardized language for describing electroencephalographic (EEG) patterns in critically ill patients but has not been formally translated into Spanish. We aimed to develop a consensus-based Spanish translation of the ACNS Critical Care EEG Terminology using a multi-phase methodology involving physicians from Spanish-speaking countries. Methods This qualitative study aimed to establish a standardized Spanish ACNS Critical Care EEG terminology through a three-phase process: Phase 1: Initial iterative translation by 14 Spanish-speaking physicians working in subgroups. Discrepancies were documented for further discussion. Phase 2: Focus groups with specialists practicing in Spanish-speaking countries, guided by qualitative research experts. Sessions explored terminology preferences, implementation challenges, and regional variations. Phase 3: Qualitative analysis and final consensus using a modified Delphi methodology. Ranked choice voting analysis to achieve ≥75% consensus was used and when needed, a two-option runoff determined the final selected term. Results Forty-five physicians from all Spanish-speaking countries except Nicaragua participated in 10 focus groups to review 25 terms. Seven terms generated two possible Spanish translations, four generated three, five generated four, and nine generated five. A consensus-based Spanish terminology was established, prioritizing semantic fidelity to the ACNS terminology while also accounting for terms already in wide regional use. Examples of final consensus terms included: Generalized Periodic Discharges → Descargas Periódicas Generalizadas (98%, Round 1); Lateralized Rhythmic Delta Activity → Actividad Delta Rítmica Lateralizada (100%, round 1); and Sharp Wave → Onda Aguda (82%, round 1). The outdated term periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges remained widely used because of familiarity among intensivists. Conclusions This effort provides the first structured Spanish adaptation of the ACNS Critical Care EEG terminology. The resulting lexicon reflects linguistic diversity across regions and supports consistent communication, training, research, and broader adoption of evidence-based continuous EEG practices.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在为美国临床神经生理学会（ACNS）的重症脑电图术语建立首个结构化的西班牙语版本，通过多阶段流程组织多个西班牙语国家的医生参与翻译与共识讨论。经过分组翻译、焦点小组和改良德尔菲法投票，最终就25个术语达成共识译法，在贴近原术语语义的同时兼顾各地区既有用法；部分术语首轮即获高比例支持，而个别过时术语因重症医生熟悉仍在沿用。作者认为，这一兼顾区域语言差异的词表有助于统一沟通、培训、研究以及连续脑电图实践的推广。

papers.title: Cholinergic contributions to speech-in-noise processing in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: McCaslin DL, Roytman S, NeCamp T, Berri B, Brown T, Barr J, Kanel P, Carli G, Bohnen N.
papers.abstract: Speech perception performance in challenging listening environments declines with age and is particularly impaired in Parkinson's disease, leading to communication difficulties and cognitive strain. Although peripheral hearing loss contributes to these deficits, dysfunction of the central cholinergic system may play a key role. Parkinson's disease is characterized by early and widespread cholinergic degeneration. Accordingly, further describing the contribution of cholinergic integrity to functional hearing may offer better insight into the mechanistic link between sensory and cognitive decline and inform targeted therapeutic approaches. Twenty-nine individuals with Parkinson's disease (20 men, nine women; age range 60-76 years) were enrolled in a cross-sectional study conducted at the University of Michigan Functional Neuroimaging, Cognitive and Mobility Laboratory. Participants completed pure-tone audiometry, tympanometry and Quick Speech-in-Noise testing to assess peripheral and functional hearing. Cholinergic system integrity was quantified using [18 F]-fluoroethoxybenzovesamicol [18 F]-FEOBV positron emission tomography imaging, and magnetic resonance imaging was used for anatomical co-registration. Statistical parametric mapping identified regions where cholinergic binding correlated with speech-in-noise performance after adjusting for high-frequency pure-tone average thresholds. Multiple regression and hierarchical model comparisons tested independent and interactive effects of peripheral hearing and cholinergic integrity. High-frequency pure-tone average explained 21.6% of the variance in Quick Speech-in-Noise signal-to-noise ratio loss [β = 0.494 (0.151-0.838), P = 0.006]. After adjustment for hearing thresholds, reduced [18 F]-FEOBV binding in auditory, thalamic, temporoparietal and cerebellar regions was significantly associated with greater signal-to-noise ratio loss (cluster-level family-wise error corrected P < 0.01). Cholinergic integrity accounted for an additional 27.5% of the variance beyond peripheral hearing [F = 15.596, P < 0.001; β = -0.533 (-0.811 to -0.256), P = 0.001]. An interaction between hearing thresholds and cholinergic integrity explained a further 12.7% of the variance (F = 9.671, P = 0.005), showing that higher cholinergic integrity mitigated the detrimental effects of hearing loss on speech-in-noise understanding. Observed effects were found to be independent of age and global cognition in the post hoc confounder regression analysis. Central cholinergic integrity is a major determinant of speech-in-noise performance in Parkinson's disease, acting both independently and interactively with peripheral hearing function. These findings indicate that speech-in-noise deficits may reflect early subcortical and cortical cholinergic dysfunction rather than only peripheral auditory decline. Recognition of this relationship underscores the potential for cholinergic-enhancing or neurostimulation-based therapies to improve communication and cognitive outcomes in neurodegenerative disorders.

papers.title: Exercise and white matter hyperintensities: a randomized clinical trial.
papers.authors: Boa Sorte Silva NC, Tam RC, Alkeridy WA, Lam K, Dao E, Barha CK, Falck RS, Hsu CL, Hsiung GR, Madden KM, Field TS, Liu-Ambrose T.
papers.abstract: Subcortical vascular cognitive impairment (SVCI) is a risk factor for dementia. White matter hyperintensity (WMH) lesions are considered a hallmark of SVCI. We investigated the impact of progressive resistance exercise training (RT) on WMH in individuals with SVCI. This 12-month, single-blinded, proof-of-concept randomized clinical trial involved 89 community-dwelling individuals aged 55 years or older living with SVCI. Participants were randomized (1:1 ratio) to twice-weekly (60 min/day) RT (n = 44) or a balance and tone (BAT, n = 45) control intervention. Whole-brain and region-specific WMH volumes were measured using T2 - and proton density-weighted magnetic resonance imaging. Group differences in the 12-month change in WMH from baseline were determined via analysis of covariance, adjusting for baseline WMH, intracranial volume, age, sex and training format (remote versus in-person). Exploratory analyses tested associations between changes in WMH and changes in growth factors. Participants were mostly females (n = 58, 65.17%) with an average of 74.50 (SD 5.71) years. There were no differences between groups in whole-brain WMH volume after 12 months [estimated mean difference (95% CI): -0.016 (-0.052 to 0.019) log-transformed cm3 , P = 0.364]. Region-specific analysis showed main effects of training on WMH volume in the temporal lobe [-0.115 (-0.207 to -0.023), P = 0.015] and splenium of the corpus callosum [-0.120 (-0.215 to -0.025), P = 0.014], favouring the RT group. There was a significant group-by-sex interaction, indicating that intervention effects varied by sex [estimated mean difference-of-differences (95% CI) = -0.093 (-0.170 to -0.016), P = 0.019]. Post hoc contrasts showed that RT (versus BAT) significantly reduced whole-brain WMH volume in female [-0.049 (-0.093 to -0.005), P = 0.029] but not male [0.044 (-0.017 to 0.105), P = 0.152] participants. Exploratory analysis showed that increasing levels of vascular endothelial growth factor [standardized β (95% CI) = -0.503 (-0.838 to -0.167), P = 0.004] were associated with a reduction in whole-brain WMH volume. No associations between insulin-like growth factor 1 and WMH volumes were found (all P > 0.05). Based on these findings, we conclude that progressive RT may reduce WMH progression in community-dwelling individuals living with SVCI. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, number NCT02669394; submitted for registration on 1 February 2016; the first patient enrolment was on 26 May 2016.

papers.title: Tegmental atrophy in isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder: ex vivo MRI-informed in vivo imaging.
papers.authors: Hirose M, Yoshinaga K, Mori Y, Shima A, Sawamoto N, Wakasugi N, Imai H, Watanabe M, Beck G, Kajiyama Y, Nishiike U, Mochizuki H, Kawabata K, Hiraga K, Nakamura T, Katsuno M, Watanabe H, Hatano T, Kamagata K, Hattori N, Nishida A, Mukai Y, Minakawa EN, Takahashi Y, Takahashi R, Hanakawa T.
papers.abstract: Isolated rapid eye movement (REM) sleep behaviour disorder (iRBD) is an early-stage synucleinopathy characterized by brainstem pathology. In rodents, the pontine tegmentum contains a REM sleep centre, the sublaterodorsal nucleus, which expresses corticotropin-releasing hormone binding protein (CRHBP). While the involvement of brainstem pathophysiology is thus implicated in iRBD, its solid evidence remains scarce in humans due to the difficulty in identifying small brainstem nuclei with conventional MRI technology alone. Here, we aimed to detect tegmental atrophy in iRBD with voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis combined with a novel human brainstem atlas. Structural MRIs from 98 patients with iRBD and 114 controls were analysed to investigate grey matter volume using VBM. Our unique approach involved detailed assessments of the VBM results, guided by a high-resolution MRI-based atlas of the human brainstem. This brainstem atlas was founded on ex vivo MRI of 10 post-mortem human specimens. We validated it with CRHBP immunostaining, which aided in identifying putative REM sleep-regulating nuclei in humans. We applied this brainstem atlas to identify atrophy in specific brainstem regions in iRBD and correlate their volumes with clinical and polysomnographic measures. Voxel-based morphometry revealed a focal cluster of grey matter atrophy in the dorsal pontine tegmentum of iRBD patients, including the laterodorsal tegmental nucleus, ventral part (LDTgV) and the pedunculopontine tegmental nucleus (PTg). Our atlas-based analysis confirmed the LDTgV as the site of most conspicuous atrophy, revealing a significant volume reduction in iRBD patients compared with controls with a moderate effect size (Cohen's d = 0.44, Bonferroni-corrected P = 0.019). Furthermore, greater atrophy in the LDTgV and the PTg was associated with more severe autonomic dysfunction as measured by Scales for Outcomes in Parkinson's Disease-Autonomic dysfunction scores (partial r = -0.237, P = 0.021 and partial r = -0.236, P = 0.021, respectively). In 23 patients from whom quantitative polysomnographic data were available, LDTgV atrophy was correlated with the percentage ratio of REM sleep without atonia (partial r = -0.491, P = 0.028). Histological analysis confirmed that the LDTgV is selectively enriched with CRHBP-positive neurons, a putative marker for REM sleep-on neurons. We provided novel evidence for the involvement of LDTgV, the putative human homologue of the murine sublaterodorsal nucleus, in iRBD. The present findings advance our understanding of the neuroanatomical basis of iRBD and will contribute to the development of early biomarkers for α-synucleinopathies.

papers.title: Correlation of blood biomarkers with microstructural brain injury in survivors of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest.
papers.authors: Laaksonen MV, Posti JP, Hollmén CC, Blennow K, Zetterberg H, Rinne JK, Virtanen SM, Saunavaara JP, Parkkola RK, Laitio RM, Arola OJ, Hynninen MS, Ylikoski EK, Martola JA, Tiainen MS, Roine RO, Scheinin H, Maze M, Roine T, Vahlberg T, Laitio TT, Xe-HYPOTHECA Working Group, Xe-HYPOTHECA Working Group .
papers.abstract: In-hospital mortality among resuscitated out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) patients remains high. Identifying patients who will benefit from intensive care while avoiding prolonged, potentially unnecessary treatments is essential. Blood-based biomarkers provide a novel method for evaluating brain injury. The ability of glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), neurofilament light chain (NfL), neuron-specific enolase (NSE) and total-tau (t-tau) to measure white and grey matter injury is unestablished in comatose OHCA survivors treated with targeted temperature management (TTM) or xenon combined with TTM. We examined correlations between the biomarkers and white and grey matter injury assessed with diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). This was a randomized, single-blind, phase 2 clinical drug trial involving two multipurpose intensive care units in Finland. It was conducted between August 2009 and March 2015. One hundred and ten comatose OHCA patients aged 24 to 76 years were randomly assigned to either inhaled xenon treatment combined with 24-h TTM (33°C) (n = 55, xenon group) or TTM alone (n = 55, control group). MRI data were available from 96 patients, with a median imaging time of 53 h (interquartile range, 47-64 h) after OHCA. Biomarker data were obtained from 105 patients. In the control group of 48 patients, after adjusting for age, sex and site, a disruption of white matter microintegrity as measured by decreased fractional anisotropy (FA) of DTI, the primary endpoint of the trial, showed a significant negative correlation with NfL at 24, 48 and 72 h (ρ = -0.28 to -0.37; P < 0.05), NSE at 48 and 72 h (ρ = -0.30 to -0.35; P < 0.05) and t-tau only at 72 h (ρ = -0.30; P < 0.05). In the xenon group (n = 48), these correlations were absent at all timepoints. The NfL-FA partial correlations showed progressive divergence between the xenon and control groups, with a statistically significant between-group difference observed at 72 h (ρ = -0.37 versus ρ = 0.14; P = 0.016). Cortical or basal ganglia grey matter mean diffusivity did not have a consistent correlation with biomarker levels at different time points. No statistically significant differences were found between the xenon and control groups in the adjusted geometric mean levels of GFAP, NfL, NSE or t-tau at various time points following OHCA. In conclusion, NfL correlated with FA in controls but not in the xenon group. This between-group difference reached significance at 72 h, suggesting that xenon may modify the relationship between axonal injury and white matter microstructure after OHCA.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于一项在芬兰开展的随机单盲二期药物试验，考察院外心脏骤停后昏迷并接受目标温度管理的患者中，GFAP、NfL、NSE和t-tau等血液标志物与弥散张量成像所测白质和灰质损伤之间的相关性。结果显示，在单纯目标温度管理组中，白质微结构完整性下降（FA降低）与NfL、NSE及t-tau存在负相关，而吸入氙气联合目标温度管理组在各时间点均未出现这些相关；NfL与FA的关联在两组间随时间逐渐分化，并在72小时达到组间显著差异。灰质弥散指标与标志物无一致相关，两组各标志物水平也无显著差异。作者据此提示，氙气可能改变轴索损伤与白质微结构之间的关系，但这一解释仍属相关性观察，需进一步验证。

papers.title: White matter microstructural biomarkers predict cochlear implant outcomes in adults with postlingual deafness.
papers.authors: Grégoire AM, Delinte N, Dricot L, Deggouj N, Kupers R.
papers.abstract: Although cochlear implantation (CI) has been used for decades to restore hearing in sensorineural deafness, accurately predicting individual outcomes remains challenging-particularly in adults with postlingual deafness, a population that has been relatively understudied. In our previous work, we showed that speech comprehension after 6 months of CI use is better predicted when preoperative grey matter volume and cortical thickness in regions supporting language and cognition are considered alongside preoperative residual hearing and audiovisual abilities. In the present study, we investigated whether preoperative diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) metrics in subcortical white matter (WM) could account for individual variability in cochlear implant adaptation and enhance predictive accuracy. Thereto, we collected preoperative DWI and speech performance under auditory-only and audiovisual conditions in 65 adults with postlingual bilateral deafness. Improvement in speech comprehension with CI was evaluated at 6 and 12 months post-implantation. A whole-brain analysis revealed significant positive correlations between preoperative fractional anisotropy (FA) within a cluster in the left arcuate fasciculus and speech perception at 6 months in both auditory-only and audiovisual conditions. Incorporating FA from the arcuate fasciculus cluster into the multiple linear regression model developed in our previous study significantly improved prediction accuracy for CI outcomes at 6 months. We also identified FA clusters in the right inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus and the corpus callosum that showed positive relationships with audiovisual comprehension and mid-term cochlear implant performance. In contrast, mean FA values averaged across entire tracts did not show similarly strong associations with speech perception, as shown after tract reconstruction. Notably, sex modulated the relationship between age and FA values across multiple white matter clusters. These findings underscore the role of localized WM microstructural properties in shaping speech adaptation after CI. Identifying WM-based predictors of CI performance may aid clinicians in forecasting individual outcomes and tailoring rehabilitation strategies, particularly for patients at risk of delayed or limited benefit. Further research is needed to clarify the origins of regional FA variability.

papers.title: Efficient and robust control with spikes that constrain free energy.
papers.authors: Urbano A, Lanillos P, Keemink S.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Animal brains exhibit remarkable efficiency in perception and action, while being robust to both external and internal perturbations. The means by which brains accomplish this remains, for now, poorly understood, hindering our understanding of animal and human cognition, as well as our own implementation of efficient algorithms for control of dynamical systems.
