Long-term clinical follow-up of childhood-onset LCC progressing into adulthood is limited in the literature. Case presentation We present a 24-year-old woman whose neurological symptoms began at age 6 years with recurrent headaches and visual disturbances. Learning difficulties emerged at age 7 years. At age 22 years, she developed probable focal-onset seizures with bilateral tonic-clonic evolution, preceded by headache and blurred vision. At age 24 years, cognitive assessment showed a Mini-Mental State Examination score of 12, indicating significant impairment. Neuroimaging demonstrated the characteristic triad of diffuse white matter abnormalities, intracranial calcifications, and parenchymal cysts with fluid levels. Histopathological examination of a left frontal lobe biopsy demonstrated telangiectatic vessels, fibrinoid necrosis, hemosiderin deposition, and reactive gliosis, consistent with chronic cerebral microangiopathy. Whole-genome sequencing identified compound heterozygous SNORD118 variants, including the previously reported n.24C>T variant and the novel n.103G>C variant. Parental segregation confirmed that the two variants were inherited from different parents and were located in trans. The patient was treated with lacosamide 100 mg twice daily, with partial reduction in seizure frequency. Bevacizumab was discussed but declined for financial reasons. Conclusion This case illustrates the long-term clinical course of childhood-onset LCC extending into adulthood and highlights the value of integrating characteristic neuroimaging, histopathology, and genetic testing. The patient's longitudinal clinical history, together with pathological evidence of chro nic cerebral microangiopathy, is consistent with the progressive vascular phenotype previously described in LCC, although prospective radiological progression was not documented during the most recent follow-up. The novel SNORD118 n.103G>C variant was classified as Likely Pathogenic according to the applied ACMG/AMP framework; however, its pathogenic effect has not been experimentally validated.

papers.title: BVLab-analyzer: a unified visual toolbox for terabyte-scale whole-brain cell detection, neuron reconstruction, and vascular network extraction.
papers.authors: Hu Y, Wang X, Sun P, Shen Y, Quan T.
papers.abstract: BVLab-Analyzer is a standalone graphical software tool for end-to-end analysis of terabyte-scale whole-brain microscopy images. Operating through a zero-code interface, it handles data import (TIFF, BioImageVision, OME-Zarr), deep learning-based semantic segmentation, 3D skeleton reconstruction, and morphological statistical analysis within a unified pipeline. The software supports three target structures-cells, neurons and vasculature-and exports their morphological reconstructions in standard SWC format. To accelerate training data preparation, Smart Annotation tools provide sub-volume interference isolation, coarse-vessel ray tracing, and skeleton auto-interpolation. For inference, optimized block-wise strategies enable a standard 3D U-Net to predict whole-brain volumes up to 12 TB on a single consumer-grade GPU, while an interrupt-and-resume engine ensures fault tolerance during extended computations. By integrating these features, BVLab-Analyzer lowers the hardware barrier for whole-brain analysis and unifies previously fragmented toolchains-from annotation and segmentation to reconstruction and quantification-into a single, accessible software environment.

papers.title: Graded multisensory neurofeedback via the iNems system for comprehensive upper limb recovery after stroke: a multiple baseline study.
papers.authors: Kodama T, Kitai K, Mizomoto Y, Nishigaya K, Hashimoto S, Hiraga R, Shimizu S, Kawabata M, Hirabayashi Y, Ikesue K, Kako H, Yasui S, Ito H, Nishimoto K, Katayama O, Yamaguchi H, Nagano H, Inoue M, Murata S, Morita K.
papers.abstract: Introduction Post-stroke upper-limb recovery remains challenging, especially in the presence of sensory impairments. Conventional brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are constrained by binary feedback, single-modality stimulation, and exclusion of patients with sensory deficits. We developed the Imagery Neurofeedback-based Multi-sensory System (iNems), a neurofeedback system that provides graded multisensory (visual and electrical) feedback based on ERD magnitude. This study validated iNems' efficacy in motor function, self-reported numbness, and cognitive functions using a multiple-baseline design (MBD). Methods Four participants with post-stroke upper-limb motor and sensory impairments underwent a multiple baseline design. The baseline phase (phase A) used random feedback; the intervention (phase B) used adaptive iNems. iNems quantified motor intention via sensorimotor EEG event-related desynchronization (ERD) and delivered graded visual and electrical feedback. Primary outcomes were the Fugl-Meyer Assessment-Upper Extremity (FMA-UE) and Box and Block Test (BBT). Secondary outcomes included body cognition, numbness, and neurophysiological (ERD/ERS) changes. Results All participants demonstrated significant improvement during the intervention. FMA-UE increased by 6-16 points. The BBT showed large effects (integrated Tau-U = 0.75). Body cognition improved significantly in both sense of agency (Tau-U = 0.80) and ownership (Tau-U = 0.89). Numbness was reduced in affected cases (Tau-U = -0.85). Neurophysiological changes correlated with functional gains, with some patterns suggesting increased neural efficiency. Conclusion This first MBD-validated demonstration shows that graded, multisensory graded neurofeedback based on ERD magnitude can improve motor, self-reported numbness, and cognitive domains after stroke. These findings support adaptive closed-loop therapy as a promising, multifaceted rehabilitation strategy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对卒中后上肢运动与感觉障碍患者，开发了基于感觉运动脑电事件相关去同步化幅度提供分级视觉与电刺激反馈的iNems神经反馈系统，并采用多基线设计检验其效果。结果显示，干预期间所有参与者的上肢运动功能均有改善，体感认知中的能动感与归属感提高，部分病例麻木减轻，神经生理变化与功能获益相关，部分模式提示神经效率提升。作者认为，这种分级多感觉闭环反馈有望成为兼顾运动、感觉与认知的多维康复策略，但样本量小且为多基线验证，结论仍需更大规模研究确认。

papers.title: A brain functional network framework based on EEG connectivity for major depressive disorder recognition.
papers.authors: Fang M, Cao TA, Wu J, Liu H, Tong J, Chen Z.
papers.abstract: Introduction When the brain is regarded as a complex dynamic system, its abnormalities often show the overall network reorganization. Traditional analysis for major depressive disorder (MDD) based on single-channel features of electroencephalogram (EEG) mainly focuses on signal changes, while ignoring inter-regional functional connectivity and network topology. As a consequence, it is challenging to reveal the systemic abnormal mechanisms. Methods To address this problem, this study built a framework of multi-frequency brain functional network (BFN) construction and recognition based on resting-state EEG. Phase-locking value (PLV) and Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) were separately utilized to characterize phase synchronization and amplitude correlation. Abnormal BFNs in MDD were systematically evaluated from both connectivity patterns and node topology. Results Results suggest that MDD patients exhibit increased connectivity in the left frontal, central, and parietal regions in the low-frequency bands. In the mid-frequency bands, increased fronto-central connectivity and reduced posterior connectivity are observed. In the high-frequency band, the connectivity pattern is characterized by increased fronto-temporal and centro-temporal connectivity, together with reduced connectivity in the posterior regions. At the node level, the most prominent alterations are concentrated in the parietal region, particularly in the α band, where altered betweenness centrality (BC) is consistently identified across both PLV and PCC networks. On this basis, the support vector machine (SVM) classifier was employed to evaluate the discriminative capability of PLV-Edge, PCC-Edge, PLV-Node, and PCC-Node features for MDD identification. Among the four feature types, PLV-Node features achieve the highest mean classification balanced accuracy of 81.44%, and PCC-Node features achieve a mean balanced accuracy of 79.14%. Discussion All four feature types demonstrate discriminative potential for distinguishing patients with MDD from healthy controls (HCs). These findings suggest that functional connectivity-based brain network features may provide meaningful information for the auxiliary identification of MDD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对传统单通道脑电分析忽视区域间功能连接与网络拓扑的问题，基于静息态脑电构建多频段脑功能网络，并用相位锁定值与皮尔逊相关系数刻画相位同步和幅值相关，从连接模式和节点拓扑两方面评估抑郁症患者的网络异常。结果显示，患者在不同频段呈现左额、中央、顶区连接增强，中频段额中央连接增强而后部连接减弱，高频段额颞和中央颞连接增强、后部连接减弱；节点层面以顶区改变最突出，α频段介数中心性在两类网络中一致改变。基于支持向量机的分类评估表明，四类特征均具区分潜力，其中相位锁定值节点特征的平均平衡准确率最高。作者据此认为，基于功能连接的网络特征或可为抑郁症的辅助识别提供有意义的信息，但摘要未报告临床诊断效能，相关结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Stereotactic guidance for ventricular catheter placement in ventriculoperitoneal shunt surgery: a state-of-the-art review on technical rationale, clinical outcomes, and future directions.
papers.authors: Fonoff ET, Cardoso IB, Santos AM.
papers.abstract: Ventriculoperitoneal (VP) shunting remains the most frequently performed surgical treatment for hydrocephalus; however, shunt failure rates remain substantial despite technical refinements. Proximal catheter malfunction, often associated with malposition, ventricular wall contact, or choroid plexus obstruction, represents a common cause of shunt revision. Conventional freehand ventricular cannulation is based on surface anatomical landmarks and surgical experience, which may be unreliable in patients with small or distorted ventricles. Stereotactic guidance-including frame-based systems, frameless neuronavigation, and electromagnetic navigation-has been introduced to improve placement accuracy and reproducibility. Randomized and cohort studies consistently demonstrate improved radiographic accuracy and higher first-pass success rates with guided techniques. However, systematic reviews have not uniformly shown reductions in overall shunt revision rates, likely reflecting the multifactorial etiology of shunt failure. Hemorrhagic complications after VP shunt placement are uncommon but clinically important; evidence from VP shunt cohorts and from the broader stereotactic neurosurgery experience (notably deep brain stimulation) suggests that trajectory planning and vascular/sulcal avoidance may reduce bleeding risk. This review synthesizes epidemiological context, technical rationale, comparative outcomes, hemorrhage considerations, health economic implications, and future research priorities regarding stereotactic ventricular catheter placement.

papers.title: Cardiac troponin T and 28-day mortality in traumatic brain injury: a retrospective cohort study and machine learning prediction model.
papers.authors: Zhang L, Hu W, He W, Huang F, Zhang J.
papers.abstract: Background Traumatic brain injury (TBI) frequently induces cardiac dysfunction via the brain-heart axis, yet the prognostic value of cardiac troponin T (cTnT) in TBI remains incompletely characterized. This study investigated thye association between cTnT levels and 28-day all-cause mortality in TBI patients and developed a machine learning-based prediction model. Methods This retrospective cohort study included 837 adult TBI patients from the MIMIC-III/IV databases (development cohort) and 121 patients from a single Chinese center (external validation cohort). The first cTnT measurement within 24 h of ICU admission was analyzed. Restricted cubic spline (RCS) regression was used to explore nonlinear relationships. cTnT was categorized into quartiles (Q1 ≤ 0.03, Q2 0.03-0.06, Q3 0.06-0.17, Q4 > 0.17 ng/mL). A two-step Boruta plus LASSO feature selection identified 13 robust predictors. Five machine learning algorithms (Random Forest, BART, GBM, CTREE, SVM) were trained. The primary outcome was 28-day all-cause mortality. Results Among 837 patients, 217 (25.9%) died within 28 days. RCS revealed a significant nonlinear association (P for nonlinearity < 0.001). In multivariable Cox regression adjusted for the 12 LASSO-selected covariates (excluding cTnT quartile itself), patients in Q3 and Q4 had nearly twofold higher mortality risks compared with Q1 (HR = 2.01, 95% CI: 1.37-2.95, p < 0.001; and HR = 1.96, 95% CI: 1.31-2.93, p = 0.001, respectively). Random Forest achieved the best discriminative performance, with an internal AUC of 0.783 and an external validation AUC of 0.706 (95% CI: 0.584-0.828). The model also demonstrated good calibration (Brier score = 0.155) and favorable clinical utility across clinically relevant threshold probabilities as shown by decision curve analysis. Conclusion Elevated cTnT is independently associated with 28-day mortality in TBI patients, with a potential risk threshold of ≥0.06 ng/mL. The Random Forest model integrating cTnT with clinical variables provides moderate mortality prediction. cTnT may serve as an integrative marker of systemic stress and multi-organ dysfunction in TBI.

papers.title: Management of fragile X-associated tremor ataxia syndrome: a review for clinicians.
papers.authors: Hall DA, González DA, Klusek J, Todd PK, O'Keefe JA, Maltman N, Montanaro FAM, Protic D, Scorr L, Malik R, Turcano P, Meyers MS, Seritan A.
papers.abstract: Fragile X-associated tremor ataxia syndrome (FXTAS) is a multi-faceted and progressive neurodegenerative disorder that manifests clinically with action tremor, gait ataxia, parkinsonism, peripheral neuropathy, and cognitive and psychiatric features. The disease is highly heterogeneous and there are no FDA approved medications for FXTAS as a specific indication. As such, treatment is symptomatic and must be tailored to the specific needs of a given patient. This review provides expert opinion-based treatment recommendations for the core and ancillary clinical features of FXTAS. Movement disorders, such as tremor, ataxia and parkinsonism may respond to symptomatic medications and therapies, but caution is required when considering surgical interventions such as deep brain stimulation. Cognitive decline can be responsive to medications developed for other cognitive disorders, but these medications work best when combined with non-medication based approaches and all patients should be screened for other reversible causes of memory decline. Psychiatric symptoms, including anxiety, depression, and psychosis, can be treated with psychotherapy and medications; but caution is required to avoid exacerbating clinical and subclinical movement disorder features with psychotropic medications. Rehabilitative therapies, such as speech therapy, occupational, and physical therapy, often enhance patient function and quality of life. Exercise and good nutrition are recommendations that are common to other cerebellar ataxias and adult neurodegenerative disorders and may have a positive impact on general health. A multi-disciplinary approach is recommended to address all components of FXTAS.

papers.title: Interpretable model using serum biomarkers and intra-/peri-aneurysmal CTA radiomics for discriminating ruptured from unruptured intracranial aneurysms: an external validation retrospective study.
papers.authors: Liu J, Chen Z, Wang K, Yan C, Wang F, Sun X.
papers.abstract: Objective To develop an interpretable model that integrates diverse machine learning algorithms, fusion strategies, intra-/perianeurysmal CTA radiomics, and serum biomarkers to differentiate ruptured from unruptured intracranial aneurysms (IAs), and to investigate the underlying biological features associated with rupture status. Methods Totally, 744 IAs patients who underwent CTA were retrospectively enrolled. Data from Center 1 (N = 423) served as the training set, and data from Center 2 (N = 321) served as the external validation set. Volumes of interest were delineated in intra-aneurysmal and peri-aneurysmal 1 mm regions. The serum inflammation score (SIS) was constructed using serum biomarkers. Seven machine learning classifiers were employed to develop models, and the optimal fusion model was developed by combining all classifiers using arithmetic mean, geometric mean, weighted mean, and logistic regression (LRSLM). Model performance was assessed by the area under the curve (AUC) and decision curve analysis (DCA), while interpretability was evaluated via SHAP, correlation, and restricted cubic spline (RCS) analyses. Results Among the 11 models, LRSLM exhibited robust performance in the external validation set, achieving an AUC of 0.9177 with good calibration. It also demonstrated high accuracy (0.8847), recall (0.8171), and a low Brier score (0.0999), alongside greater clinical net benefit across a wide range of threshold probabilities (10-85%). Correlation analyses revealed strong positive associations between intra-aneurysmal and peri-aneurysmal radiomic features (Spearman's r = 0.62, 0.72, and 0.84, respectively; all p < 0.001), as well as significant positive correlations between the intra-/perianeurysmal radiomics and SIS (Spearman's r = 0.32, 0.29, 0.32, and 0.34; all p < 0.001). RCS analysis further demonstrated a significant non-linear relationship between the intra-aneurysmal (IRSIAs) and peri-aneurysmal (PRSIAs) radiomic features and an increased incidence of IAs rupture (Non-linear p < 0.05; Overall p < 0.05). SHAP analysis highlighted key radiomics features contributors to the fusion model and supported model interpretability. Conclusion The LRSLM model achieves robust discriminative performance for differentiating ruptured from unruptured IAs. SHAP analysis enhances the interpretability of the model and may assist in identifying high-risk phenotypic features, although prospective validation is required before predictive clinical application can be considered.

papers.title: Chronic post-traumatic stress disorder-related behavioral traits develop in female rats exposed to repetitive low-level blast injury and are reversible with (2R,6R)-hydroxynorketamine.
papers.authors: Perez Garcia G, Perez GM, De Gasperi R, Gama Sosa MA, Zhu CW, Yeung S, Khalique S, Toro CA, Hof PR, Elder GA.
papers.abstract: Introduction Many military Veterans who experienced blast-related injuries during military service suffer from chronic cognitive and mental health problems. Women constitute more than 15% of active-duty U. S. military personnel and are the fastest-growing population of U. S. Veterans. For more than a decade, we have studied a rat model of repetitive low-level blast exposure designed to mimic the type of blast-related exposure that is common in military settings. Male rats develop chronic cognitive and post-traumatic stress disorder-related traits that appear in a delayed fashion and persist for more than 1 year after exposure. These traits can be reversed with a single dose of (2R,6R)-hydroxynorketamine [(2R,6R)-HNK]. This study aimed to determine whether female rats develop a similar set of neurobehavioral alterations. Methods Ten-week-old female rats were exposed to 75.1 kPa blast overpressures delivered once per day for three consecutive days. We tested female rats behaviorally between 1 and 4 weeks after blast exposure and again at 28 and 29 weeks. Rats were tested in an elevated zero maze, light-dark emergence task, and novel object recognition task, as well as contextual and cued fear learning and a Barnes maze. We tested how females would respond to a single dose of 20 mg/kg (2R,6R)-HNK administered intraperitoneally. Results Following blast exposure, female rats developed chronic cognitive and behavioral traits. The full behavioral phenotype developed with a delay. Treatment with a single dose of (2R,6R)-HNK reversed behavioral changes in female rats, and beneficial effects on behavior were sustained for 4 weeks without additional drug administration. As in male rats, female rats showed elevated metabotropic glutamate receptor mGluR2. Elevations of mGluR2 were reversed by (2R,6R)-HNK treatment. Similar to male rats, the serotonin receptor 5-HT2AR was decreased in blast-injured female rats but levels were not affected by (2R,6R)-HNK treatment. Conclusion These studies show that female rats develop a similar behavioral profile as previously observed in male rats using the same blast exposure conditions. They further support (2R,6R)-HNK as a promising therapeutic candidate for treatment of blast-induced neurobehavioral effects, even when administered after traits are well established.

papers.title: Voxelwise degree centrality alterations and cognitive performance in severe unilateral M1-segment middle cerebral artery stenosis with ipsilateral watershed infarction.
papers.authors: Huang Z, Liang X, Li L, Wei Y, Zhang Y, Wei W, Quan X, Li K, Yao K, Tang J, Zhang Y, Huang J, Zhang J.
papers.abstract: Purpose To characterize voxelwise degree centrality (DC) alterations and their exploratory clinical associations in severe unilateral M1-segment middle cerebral artery stenosis with ipsilateral watershed infarction. Methods This cross-sectional study included 40 patients with left-sided disease, 47 with right-sided disease, and 44 healthy controls. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging-derived weighted DC (r > 0.25) was compared using analysis of covariance with adjustment for educational attainment, Tukey-Kramer testing, and Gaussian random field-corrected patient-control contrasts (two-tailed voxel P < 0.001; cluster P < 0.05). Exploratory clinical associations were assessed using Spearman rank correlation. Results Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scores differed among groups (P < 0.001), with both patient groups scoring lower than controls; Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) scores also differed (P < 0.001), with the left-sided group lowest, the right-sided group intermediate, and controls highest. The left-sided group showed lower DC predominantly in left temporal-opercular and postcentral-inferior parietal regions and higher DC in right medial/subcortical and posterior-midline regions; the largest lower-DC cluster peaked at MNI coordinates -48, -18, 39 (Z = -5.5420). The right-sided group showed lower DC in right putaminal/insular, temporal, and parietal-sensorimotor regions and higher DC in the left cerebellum; the largest lower-DC cluster peaked at MNI coordinates 48, -27, 36 (Z = -6.0021). In the right-sided group, exploratory nominal associations were observed between MMSE scores and DC in the left cerebellar, right superior temporal-pole, and right parietal-sensorimotor clusters (r = -0.300 to 0.421; nominal P = 0.003-0.040). No nominal cognitive-DC correlations were observed in the left-sided group, and no MoCA-DC correlations in the right-sided group. Conclusion Distributed DC alterations accompanied cognitive performance differences, with selective exploratory nominal MMSE associations in right-sided disease. DC may merit further evaluation as a candidate imaging feature of BOLD-based functional alterations associated with cognitive differences.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察重度单侧大脑中动脉M1段狭窄伴同侧分水岭梗死患者的全脑体素度中心性改变及其与认知表现的探索性关联，比较了左侧病变、右侧病变患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振加权度中心性。结果显示，两组患者的认知评分均低于对照，且左侧病变组最低；左侧病变组以左颞岛盖及中央后回-顶下区域度中心性降低为主，右侧病变组则见右侧壳核/岛叶、颞叶及顶叶感觉运动区降低、左侧小脑升高。仅右侧病变组观察到MMSE与少数脑区度中心性的名义相关，左侧病变组未见认知相关，提示度中心性可作为与认知差异相关的候选影像特征，但关联为探索性，尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: Targeting the gut-brain axis: novel strategies for disease intervention from mechanisms to clinical practice.
papers.authors: Lele F, Yuying G, Jin L, Shuwen H, Jing Z.
papers.abstract: The gut-brain axis is a bidirectional communication network linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system (CNS), in which the gut microbiota and its metabolites have emerged as important modulators. Alterations in the gut microbiota have been reported in a range of neurological, psychiatric, and metabolic disorders, but their underlying mechanisms and causal relevance in humans are still unclear. This review examines the major neural, endocrine, immune, and metabolic pathways involved in microbiota-gut-brain communication and discusses how their disruption may affect neurotransmitter signaling, inflammation, barrier function, and host metabolism. We also review current intervention strategies, including microbiota modulation, dietary and metabolic approaches, neural and immunomodulatory interventions, and behavioral and traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) approaches. Particular attention is given to the strength of the available evidence, its clinical relevance, and the limitations and safety considerations that need to be addressed before gut-brain-axis-based strategies can be more widely applied.

papers.title: Multimodal MRI of choroid plexus volume, DTI-ALPS, and white matter microstructure in type 2 diabetes mellitus.
papers.authors: Mao M, Chen L, Xia J, Zeng T, Huang H, Chu J, Fu L.
papers.abstract: Objective To investigate differences in choroid plexus volume (CPV), diffusion tensor image analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) indices, peak width of skeletonized mean diffusivity (PSMD), and Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scores between patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and healthy controls, and to explore pairwise associations among diabetes duration, PSMD, normalized total CPV, total DTI-ALPS, and MMSE within the T2DM group. Methods This retrospective cross-sectional study included 31 patients with T2DM and 31 healthy controls (HCs). All participants underwent 3.0-T MRI and MMSE assessment. General linear models were used to compare normalized CPV, DTI-ALPS indices, PSMD, and MMSE scores between groups, adjusting for age, sex, body mass index, and years of education. Within the T2DM group, exploratory partial correlations were performed among diabetes duration, PSMD, normalized total CPV, total DTI-ALPS, and MMSE, controlling for the same covariates. The resulting 10 pairwise associations were corrected together using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) procedure. Results Compared with HCs, patients with T2DM showed greater normalized total and bilateral CPV, lower total DTI-ALPS, higher PSMD, and lower MMSE scores (all PFDR < 0.05). Among the 10 exploratory associations, only the positive association between diabetes duration and PSMD remained significant after FDR correction (partial r = 0.566, P = 0.002, PFDR = 0.021). The inverse association between normalized total CPV and total DTI-ALPS was nominally significant (partial r = -0.412, P = 0.033) but did not survive FDR correction (PFDR = 0.163). Conclusion Patients with T2DM showed differences in CPV, DTI-ALPS, PSMD, and MMSE scores. Longer diabetes duration was associated with higher PSMD after FDR correction, whereas the CPV-DTI-ALPS association did not survive multiple-comparison correction. These findings highlight the value of multimodal MRI for characterizing brain involvement in T2DM.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究比较了2型糖尿病患者与健康对照者的脉络丛体积、DTI-ALPS指数、白质微结构指标和认知评分，并分析了患者组内糖尿病病程与这些指标之间的关联。结果显示，患者组脉络丛体积增大、DTI-ALPS降低、白质微结构指标升高且认知评分更低；在患者组内，仅糖尿病病程与白质微结构指标的正向关联经多重比较校正后仍显著，而脉络丛体积与DTI-ALPS的负向关联未通过校正。作者据此认为，多模态MRI有助于刻画2型糖尿病的脑部受累情况，但上述关联为横断面观察，不能推断因果。

papers.title: Cholesterol dysregulation and microglial NLRP3 inflammasome activation after ischemic stroke: implications for neuroinflammation and functional recovery.
papers.authors: Wang J, An P, Fu C, Su X, Sun Y, Ma D, Shi X, Hong X.
papers.abstract: Secondary neuroinflammation is an important determinant of tissue injury, repair, and neurological recovery after ischemic stroke, yet the lipid-metabolic environment in which this response develops remains incompletely integrated into current mechanistic models. This narrative review synthesizes PubMed-indexed, peer-reviewed literature published between 2010 and 2026 on post-stroke cholesterol metabolism, microglial lipid handling, NLRP3 inflammasome signaling, immunometabolic remodeling, therapeutic intervention, and recovery-related outcomes. Ischemic injury substantially remodels the local lipid environment through neuronal membrane disruption, myelin breakdown, oxidative lipid modification, altered cholesterol turnover, and blood-brain barrier dysfunction, generating a heterogeneous pool of free cholesterol, cholesteryl esters, lipid droplets, cholesterol crystals, oxysterols, and oxidized lipids. Stroke-specific studies increasingly support the emergence of cholesterol- and lipid-loaded microglial states and show that microglial lipid-processing capacity, including TREM2- and SREBP2-related mechanisms, can influence inflammatory and reparative responses. However, the causal connection between cholesterol dysregulation and NLRP3 activation remains only partly resolved. Direct stroke evidence supports the coexistence of microglial cholesterol overload and NLRP3-associated inflammatory changes, whereas detailed mechanisms involving cholesterol crystal-induced lysosomal injury, metabolic remodeling, and intracellular lipid stress remain partly dependent on cross-model evidence. Oxysterol effects are context dependent, and recent cholesterol-mobilization experiments identify mitochondrial DNA leakage-STING signaling as an alternative, more directly validated downstream pathway. Post-stroke microglia are also functionally heterogeneous, with distinct populations contributing to debris clearance, white matter repair, and neurological recovery. Therapeutically, systemic lipid management should be distinguished from experimental strategies that modify brain cholesterol handling or suppress inflammasome-associated inflammation, and no integrated cholesterol-microglia-NLRP3 treatment strategy has yet been clinically validated. Collectively, current evidence supports a proposed, evidence-stratified framework in which cholesterol-related lipid stress, microglial state, inflammasome susceptibility, and tissue repair partially converge rather than forming a single validated linear causal axis.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了缺血性卒中后胆固醇代谢紊乱与小胶质细胞NLRP3炎症小体激活之间的关系，整合了卒中后脂质环境重塑、小胶质细胞脂质处理及免疫代谢改变等方面的文献。作者指出，卒中后局部脂质环境显著改变，可出现负载胆固醇和脂质的小胶质细胞状态，但胆固醇紊乱与NLRP3激活之间的因果关系仅获部分证据支持，部分机制依赖跨模型推断，氧化固醇的作用亦具情境依赖性。文章据此提出一个按证据强度分层的框架，认为脂质应激、小胶质细胞状态、炎症小体易感性与组织修复只是部分汇聚，而非单一线性因果轴，并强调目前尚无整合性的胆固醇—小胶质细胞—NLRP3治疗策略获临床验证。

papers.title: Cellular senescence in multiple sclerosis: hallmarks, immunosenescence, and therapeutic implications.
papers.authors: Yousef A, Seubert JM, Power C, Nathoo N.
papers.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an immune-mediated neurodegenerative disease where chronological aging predicts the conversion to progressive MS (PMS), a phase defined by compartmentalized inflammation and accelerated neurodegeneration. While current disease modifying therapies (DMTs) are effective for managing the inflammatory aspect of MS, treatments remain inadequate. It is imperative to understand the biology of aging including an important hallmark of aging, cellular senescence. Cellular senescence is a state of cell cycle arrest where cells remain in their senescent state and produce a distinctive senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), characterized by the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and growth factors. Growing experimental and clinical evidence suggests that the accumulation of senescent cells and SASP secretion perpetuates a pathological feedback loop linking age-related processes with accelerated neurodegeneration observed in PMS. Whether senescence drives PMS or accompanies it remains unresolved. In this Review, we outline the biology of aging, senescence pathway markers, and SASP components. We evaluate studies of cellular senescence and SASP markers in MS, including immunosenescence, T- and B-cell changes; the contributions of Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, and herpes simplex virus-1; and the relationship between senescence burden, brain atrophy, and DMT response. Lastly, we outline the available senotherapeutic approaches aimed at mitigating MS and other neurodegenerative diseases.

papers.title: Follicular development impairment in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome: multidimensional pathophysiological networks and frontier therapeutic targets.
papers.authors: Jia Q, Zhang S, Zhang L, Zhao G, Zhu Q, Ge H.
papers.abstract: Polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) is a prevalent endocrine-metabolic disorder characterised by follicular arrest, anovulation, and elevated androgen levels. This review transcends single-dimensional analyses of PMOS pathology from neuroendocrine or metabolic perspectives, proposing an integrated multi-layered network model to systematically elucidate the pathological mechanisms underlying follicular arrest. Post-pubertal dysfunction of the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis interacts with systemic metabolic dysregulation, jointly establishing an ovarian microenvironment characterised by hyperandrogenism, hyperinsulinaemia, and chronic inflammation. This environment further induces self-reinforcing vicious cycles within follicles, manifesting as impaired granulosa-oocyte communication, immunometabolic reprogramming (e.g., M1 macrophage polarisation), and organelle stress (including mitochondrial dysfunction and endoplasmic reticulum stress). This localised cycle is consolidated and amplified by higher-level regulatory factors-including developmental epigenetic programming, the gut-brain-ovary axis, and circadian rhythms-ultimately establishing a pathologically entrenched state. Finally, this network-based understanding informs future research pathways, focusing on how emerging strategies-such as multi-omics integration, artificial intelligence, and stem cell secretome studies-can advance phenotype-directed precision interventions. This review aims to provide a systematic, dynamic theoretical framework for understanding the complex pathogenesis of PMOS and its potential therapeutic targets.

papers.title: The Semantic Shift in Autobiographical Memory and Aging: Do Retrieval Goals Contribute to Age-Related Memory Differences?
papers.authors: Cohen DE, Puig Rivera VA, Andrews-Hanna JR, Grilli MD.
papers.abstract: Relative to young adults, cognitively healthy older adults typically include more semantic details when narrating remembered, personal events. This age difference in autobiographical memory is mostly interpreted in the literature as a sign of cognitive and brain decline, and the consequences are largely assumed to be negative. Complementing decline-based accounts, the current perspective builds on a recent proposal that developmental changes in memory-guiding motives may help shape how and why older adults reflect on their personal past (Grilli & Sheldon, 2022). We identify theoretical support and accumulating empirical evidence suggesting that young and older adults may pursue distinct goals when retrieving autobiographical memories. A closer examination of these goals raises the possibility that young adults’ goals may be especially well served by episodically specific memories, whereas older adults’ goals may be better aligned with semantic autobiographical knowledge. Although experimentally causal evidence remains limited and an important direction for future research, the reviewed literature identifies age-related changes in retrieval goals as a plausible contributor to the semantic shift and yields testable predictions for distinguishing this account from decline-based explanations.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇视角性综述，关注健康老年人自传体记忆叙述中语义细节多于年轻人的现象，并追问这种年龄差异是否只能归因于认知与脑功能衰退。作者梳理理论与逐渐积累的实证证据，提出年轻人和老年人在提取自传体记忆时可能追求不同目标：年轻人的目标或更适合情节具体的记忆，老年人的目标则可能与语义性自传知识更契合，因此提取目标的年龄变化可能是语义偏移的一个合理来源。作者同时强调，实验性因果证据仍然有限，这是未来研究的重要方向，并提出可检验的预测，以区分这一解释与基于衰退的解释。

papers.title: Large Language Model-Based Identification of Subjective Cognitive Decline in Electronic Health Records Among Older Adults With Normal Cognitive Testing: Retrospective Cohort Study.
papers.authors: Wang L, Amariglio RE, Varghese S, Tian J, Seger D, Zhou L, Marshall GA.
papers.abstract: Background Subjective cognitive decline (SCD) typically refers to self- or informant-reported decline in cognition despite the absence of objective impairment on standardized testing. Older adults with documented normal cognitive test performance provide a pragmatic anchor cohort for electronic health record (EHR)-based SCD phenotyping. However, cognitive concerns are primarily recorded in unstructured notes and are inconsistently documented, making it unclear how often and in whom concerns are captured in routine care. Objective This study aims to operationalize EHR-based SCD phenotyping in an objectively normal-testing cohort using a large language model (LLM)-based natural language processing approach and to examine the frequency and clinical and sociodemographic correlates of cognitive concern documentation. Methods We conducted an EHR-based observational study of patients aged 65 years or older with a first normal cognitive test recorded in EHR flowsheets between January 2019 and April 2024 in a large health care system. We developed and iteratively refined a 2-stage LLM-based natural language processing pipeline to identify documented cognitive concerns in unstructured notes during the 12 months prior to the index date, and evaluated performance against manual review. We quantified the frequency of documented concerns within this normal-testing cohort and used multivariable logistic regression to assess associations with sociodemographic factors (age, marital status, insurance, and neighborhood Area Deprivation Index), sequentially adjusting for clinical comorbidities and relevant medications. Results Among 15,750 older adults with normal cognitive test scores, 13.8% (n=2175) had at least 1 documented cognitive concern in the prior year, captured in 1.2% (7394/605,177) of notes. On manual validation, the 2-stage pipeline (Med42-v2-8B screening followed by GPT-4o confirmation) achieved a sensitivity of 0.957, positive predictive value of 0.935, specificity of 0.985, and F 1 -score of 0.945 for cognitive concern identification. Documentation was more likely in older individuals, those with commercial (vs Medicare) insurance, and those with neurological and psychiatric conditions. In fully adjusted models, Parkinson disease (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 5.29, 95% CI 3.60-7.77), traumatic brain injury (aOR 4.63, 95% CI 3.15-6.81), stroke or transient ischemic attack (aOR 3.46, 95% CI 3.15-4.18), epilepsy (aOR 2.52, 95% CI 1.83-3.49), depression (aOR 1.54, 95% CI 1.36-1.75), and excessive alcohol use (aOR 1.48, 95% CI 1.06-2.06) were among the strongest correlates of cognitive concern documentation. In contrast, obesity (aOR 0.73, 95% CI 0.65-0.82), hyperlipidemia (aOR 0.59, 95% CI 0.51-0.67), and residence in more deprived neighborhoods (higher Area Deprivation Index) were associated with lower odds of documented cognitive concerns. Conclusions A 2-stage LLM pipeline enabled accurate identification of documented cognitive concerns consistent with SCD among older adults with normal cognitive testing. Documentation was uncommon and selectively captured by clinical and sociodemographic factors, with implications for equity and the validity of EHR-based phenotypes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在客观认知测试正常的老年人中，如何从电子健康记录中识别主观认知下降（SCD），并考察认知担忧被记录的频率及其相关因素。作者开发并验证了一个两阶段大语言模型自然语言处理流程，用于从非结构化病历中识别认知担忧。结果显示，该流程识别准确度较高，但在认知测试正常者中，认知担忧的记录并不常见，且更常见于高龄、有商业保险以及患有帕金森病、脑外伤、卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作、癫痫、抑郁和过量饮酒的人群，而肥胖、高脂血症和居住于更贫困社区者记录认知担忧的几率较低。作者指出，这种选择性记录可能影响电子健康记录表型的公平性和有效性。

papers.title: Feasibility and Safety of Transcranial Focused Ultrasound on Language Impairment in a Patient with Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Yan C, Zhu G, Liang S, Zhao Y, Chen W, Xia Q, Jian J, Wang Z, Zhang B, Ao L.
papers.abstract: Background Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is defined by persistent difficulties with social communication and language, and a subset of children stay minimally verbal despite intensive interventions. The left amygdala and ventral-anterior superior temporal sulcus (STSva) form a key circuit for social-language integration, but how transcranial focused ultrasound (tFUS) might modulate in minimally verbal ASD has not been explored. Case presentation An 11-year-old minimally verbal ASD boy received 4 weeks of sequential tFUS stimulation (0.5 MHz). The treatment targeted the left amygdala and STSva, five times per week. Outcome assessments included the Mandarin Clinical Evaluation of Language for Preschoolers' Core Scale (MCELP-CS), Autism Behavior Checklist (ABC), and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) at pre-tFUS, post-tFUS, and a 4-week follow-up. The boy tolerated the intervention well, with no adverse events. Significant improvements in key language skills (vocabulary naming +10%, sentence structure imitation +22%) and reduced ASD symptoms (ABC language -40%, social interaction -26%) were observed post-tFUS and sustained at follow-up. fNIRS confirmed altered cortical activation and reorganized functional connectivity in language-related brain regions. Conclusion This single-case observational report describes acceptable tolerance to sequential tFUS targeting the left amygdala-STSva circuit in a minimally verbal child with ASD, alongside concomitant behavioural and neuroimaging changes. These preliminary observations provide descriptive, hypothesis-generating data for this circuit-directed intervention strategy and highlight the necessity of larger controlled trials to further evaluate its potential clinical utility.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告探讨经颅聚焦超声（tFUS）能否调节一名极少言语自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）男孩的语言相关脑环路，并观察其可行性与安全性。患儿接受为期四周、以左侧杏仁核与腹前颞上沟为靶点的序贯tFUS刺激，并在治疗前后及随访时进行语言量表、行为评估和功能近红外成像检查。结果显示患儿耐受良好、未见不良事件，词汇命名和句式模仿等语言表现有所改善，ASD相关语言与社交症状评分下降，随访时仍维持，影像也提示语言相关脑区激活与功能连接发生变化。作者强调这只是单例观察，相关变化不能视为因果或疗效证据，仅用于提出假设，仍需更大规模对照试验验证。

papers.title: The Eye-Brain Axis in High Myopia: From Retinal Deformation to Cortical Network Reorganization.
papers.authors: Yuan D, Yang W, Zhong H, Chen Q.
papers.abstract: High myopia is a major cause of irreversible visual impairment and is increasingly recognized as a condition involving interactions between ocular remodeling and central neural systems. This scoping review synthesizes current evidence on structural, functional, genetic, and regulatory links between the eye and brain in high myopia. We systematically searched PubMed and Web of Science from database inception to August 2026, identifying 54 eligible primary studies. The available evidence indicates that high myopia is associated with retinal and optic nerve abnormalities, altered white matter microstructure, occipital cortical changes, and functional reorganization across visual and higher-order brain networks. However, most neuroimaging evidence is cross-sectional, and Mendelian randomization analyses have not provided evidence for a clear causal effect of myopia on brain volumes. Genetic studies suggest modest overlap between refractive error and cognitive traits, whereas educational exposure appears to contribute causally to myopic refractive development. Experimental and observational evidence also supports reciprocal regulation of ocular growth through circadian, dopaminergic, autonomic, and behavioral pathways, although several proposed mechanisms remain incompletely established in humans. Overall, the eye-brain axis provides a useful integrative framework for understanding high myopia, but longitudinal and interventional studies are required to determine causal relationships and evaluate whether neural or behavioral targets can improve clinical outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦高度近视中眼与脑之间的结构、功能、遗传及调控联系，系统检索文献后纳入相关原始研究进行梳理。现有证据提示，高度近视与视网膜和视神经异常、白质微结构改变、枕叶皮层变化以及视觉和高级脑网络的功能重组相关，但多数神经影像证据为横断面设计，孟德尔随机化分析也未支持近视对脑容量存在明确因果作用。遗传研究显示屈光不正与认知特质仅有有限重叠，而教育暴露似乎对近视性屈光发展有因果贡献；实验和观察证据还支持昼夜节律、多巴胺能、自主神经及行为通路对眼轴生长的双向调控，但部分机制在人类中尚未完全确立。作者据此提出眼-脑轴可作为理解高度近视的整合框架，并强调需纵向和干预研究来厘清因果关系及神经或行为靶点能否改善临床结局。

papers.title: The "FRAIL" scale scores do not predict frontal electroencephalographic features during awake baseline or remimazolam-induced loss of consciousness in elderly patients: a pre-planned secondary analysis of a prospective observational cohort study
papers.authors: Wu^ J, Li^ H, Xie^ J, Zhong T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Frailty predicts adverse postoperative outcomes, but its association with electroencephalographic (EEG) features during remimazolam-induced loss of consciousness (LOC) in elderly patients is unknown. This pre-planned secondary analysis tested whether frailty, defined by the “FRAIL” (Fatigue, Resistance, Ambulation, Illness, Loss of weight) scale, is associated with frontal EEG features during awake baseline and at LOC. Methods We enrolled 49 elderly patients (≥ 65 years) undergoing surgery with remimazolam induction. Frailty was preoperatively assessed using the “FRAIL” scale; patients were categorized as non-frail (n = 25) or frailty-prone (n = 24). Frontal EEG was recorded during awake baseline and at LOC. We analyzed conventional band powers, quantitative EEG parameters, and aperiodic (offset and exponent) and periodic components via spectral decomposition. Mixed-design repeated-measures analysis of variance evaluated Group (frailty status) and State (awake/LOC) effects. Results No significant Group main effect or Group × State interaction was observed for any EEG metric (all P > 0.05). In contrast, significant State effects were found for most parameters (P < 0.001). Despite substantial differences in American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) physical status between the two groups (P < 0.001), their EEG characteristics remained indistinguishable. Conclusions Preoperative "FRAIL" scale scores did not predict differences in frontal EEG features between non‑frail and frailty‑prone elderly patients during awake baseline or remimazolam‑induced LOC. These findings suggest that somatic frailty and brain vulnerability are dissociable. Thus, perioperative brain risk prediction should rely on direct indicators of brain reserve, such as cognitive assessments, resting‑state EEG, or neuroimaging, rather than frailty scales alone. Registration: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR2500113571; December 1, 2025).
papers.summary_zh: 这项预先计划的二次分析考察术前“FRAIL”衰弱量表评分能否预测老年患者在清醒基线和瑞马唑仑诱导意识消失时的额区脑电特征，研究对象为接受瑞马唑仑诱导手术的老年患者，比较非衰弱与衰弱倾向两组的常规频带功率、定量脑电参数及非周期和周期成分。结果显示，所有脑电指标均未出现显著的组间主效应或组别与状态的交互作用，而清醒与意识消失之间的状态效应在多数参数上显著；尽管两组ASA身体状况差异明显，脑电特征仍无法区分。作者据此认为，躯体衰弱与大脑脆弱性可能是可分离的，围术期脑风险预测不宜仅依赖衰弱量表，而应结合认知评估、静息态脑电或神经影像等直接反映脑储备的指标。

papers.title: Sustained-attention slowing and trial-level P3-reaction time coupling in university students with generalized anxiety disorder and self-reported habitual short sleep: a secondary cross-sectional study
papers.authors: Shi C, Li H, Wu L, Li S, Wang M, Guo Y, Wen J, Gao J, Fu W, Chen X, Wu Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Generalized anxiety disorder and habitual short sleep commonly coexist. Sustained attention is clinically relevant, but objective performance and electroencephalographic correlates in young adults with this combined presentation remain insufficiently characterized. Methods This secondary cross-sectional analysis used baseline data from a parent study. Sixty-nine university students (32 healthy controls and 37 with clinically diagnosed generalized anxiety disorder and self-reported habitual short sleep) completed a 10-min psychomotor vigilance test during 32-channel electroencephalography. Analyses included participant-level behavior, averaged event-related potentials and time-frequency measures, and single-trial P3-reaction time models. Unadjusted analyses were primary; age- and sex-adjusted models were sensitivity analyses. Results Median reaction time was 33.00 ms longer in the combined clinical group (95% CI 12.35–53.65; Hedges' g = 0.745; p FDR = 0.00873). The age- and sex-adjusted difference was 31.48 ms (95% CI 3.46–59.50; p = 0.0283; sensitivity-family p FDR = 0.0449). Participant-level reaction-time progress slopes differed, but the trial-level group × progress interaction did not, providing inconsistent evidence for a differential vigilance decrement. None of 42 principal averaged electroencephalographic group contrasts survived the relevant family and global multiplicity corrections. Across 3,231 trials with complete model data from 60 participants, larger within-participant P3 amplitudes predicted faster responses (β = -0.02384; SE = 0.00593; p = 5.89 × 10 − 5 ; p FDR = 0.000648). The adjusted association remained negative (β = -0.02332; 95% CI -0.03929 to -0.00736; p = 0.00420), while the P3 × group interaction was nonsignificant (β = 0.01595; p = 0.144). Conclusions University students with generalized anxiety disorder and self-reported habitual short sleep showed slower sustained-attention responses than healthy controls. Within-person P3 amplitude tracked trial-level response speed across groups, but no corrected averaged electroencephalographic group marker or group-specific P3 relationship was identified. The design cannot separate effects of generalized anxiety disorder from those of habitual short sleep.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注同时患有广泛性焦虑障碍并自报习惯性睡眠不足的大学生，其持续注意表现及脑电相关特征是否与健康对照不同。研究为横断面二次分析，比较两组在持续注意任务中的行为表现、平均事件相关电位和试次水平P3-反应时关系。结果显示，合并临床组的中位反应时明显更长，提示持续注意反应变慢；但试次水平上未发现组别与任务进程的交互，因而对警觉性下降差异的证据不一致。校正多重比较后，平均脑电的组间对比均不显著；而在个体内，P3波幅越大预测反应越快，这一关系未表现出组别差异。作者指出，该设计无法区分广泛性焦虑障碍与习惯性短睡眠各自的作用。

papers.title: Barriers to disclosure of diagnoses and diagnostic testing in families affected by X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy
papers.authors: Schäfer L, Deibler L, Lier J, Ponleitner M, Köhler W, Bergner C.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (X-ALD) is a rare hereditary white matter disorder with diverse manifestations, including adrenal insufficiency, myeloneuropathy, and life-threatening cerebral disease. Although treatments can halt severe progression, they require early diagnosis and monitoring. In settings without newborn screening, open communication about diagnosis and carrier risk within families is crucial. This cross-sectional study assessed potentially affected family members (PAFMs) in X-ALD-positive families who were neither informed nor tested and identified barriers to disclosure and family communication. Methods The prevalence of uninformed or untested PAFMs was calculated from pedigree charts of 51 adults with X-ALD (30 women [58.8%], mean age = 51.4 ± 12.9 years, range: 30–74). Semi-structured interviews assessed disease understanding and motivations for informing or not informing relatives. Pearson correlations examined relationships between uninformed/untested PAFMs and participant characteristics. Independent t -tests and χ² tests compared factors between informed and uninformed PAFMs. Results Of 639 PAFMs, 40.5% (259) had not been tested for X-ALD. One third of participants (17/51; 33.3%) reported at least one uninformed PAFM. In 80.4% of family trees (41/51), at least one PAFM was informed but untested. Decisions to inform were influenced by knowledge of inheritance, degree of relation, emotional closeness, contact frequency, symptom presence, and (grand-)parental status. Conclusions Significant deficiencies exist in family communication and the testing cascade for X-ALD. Healthcare providers can support patients by improving disease understanding and facilitating information sharing with PAFMs, promoting earlier diagnosis and treatment where newborn screening is unavailable.
papers.summary_zh: 这项横断面研究关注X连锁肾上腺脑白质营养不良（X-ALD）家庭中可能受累亲属未被告知诊断或未接受检测的情况，通过家系图统计和半结构化访谈分析告知障碍。结果显示，在639名可能受累亲属中约四成未接受检测，三分之一的受访者至少有一名亲属未被告知，而多数家系中至少有一名亲属虽被告知却未检测。告知决定受遗传知识、亲属关系远近、情感亲近程度、联系频率、症状有无及是否为人父母或祖父母等因素影响。作者指出，在缺乏新生儿筛查的情况下，家庭沟通和检测链条存在明显缺口，医疗提供者可通过增进患者对疾病的理解、协助向亲属传递信息来促进早期诊断和治疗。

papers.title: A Machine Learning-Based Framework for differential screening of Neurodegenerative Dementias using routine clinical data
papers.authors: Vilella D, Tafuri B, Urso D, Rollo E, Giannoni-Luza S, Gigli G, Tartaglione B, Logroscino G.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The increasing prevalence of neurocognitive disorders (NCDs), including Alzheimer’s disease (AD), vascular dementia (VaD), dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB), primary progressive aphasia (PPA), and behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD), highlights the need for accessible tools to support early diagnosis. Machine learning (ML) may enhance diagnostic accuracy by leveraging routinely collected clinical information. We evaluated an ML pipeline based exclusively on first-visit neurological assessments to support differential diagnosis of major NCDs. Methods We retrospectively analysed clinical data from 932 patients. A CatBoost multiclass classifier was trained using 43 routinely available variables, including demographic characteristics, neurological signs, and symptom chronology. Bayesian optimization (Optuna) was used to maximize the macro-averaged F1-score while addressing class imbalance. Model interpretability was assessed through SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), enabling patient-level and global feature attribution. Performance was evaluated on a held-out test set using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Results The model achieved 73.8% overall accuracy, with a macro F1-score of 0.646 and a weighted F1-score of 0.743. Diagnostic performance was highest for AD (F1 = 0.821), followed by DLB (0.704), bvFTD (0.681), PPA (0.667), and VaD (0.357). SHAP analysis identified first symptom, age at diagnosis, and language symptom chronology as the most influential predictors, closely reflecting established clinical diagnostic criteria. Conclusions Symptom chronology emerged as a robust diagnostic discriminator, underscoring the clinical value of temporal disease trajectories. The prototype Streamlit interface demonstrated practical clinical deployment by providing probabilistic predictions with transparent explanations. These findings support clinically driven, biomarker-free ML models as scalable first-line decision-support tools, particularly in resource-limited settings, while emphasizing the need for prospective multicenter external validation before clinical implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于患者首次就诊时常规采集的临床资料，构建机器学习多分类模型，用于阿尔茨海默病、血管性痴呆、路易体痴呆、原发性进行性失语和行为变异型额颞叶痴呆的鉴别筛查。模型整体区分能力中等，对阿尔茨海默病的识别表现最好，血管性痴呆最弱；症状出现顺序、诊断时年龄和语言症状的时间线被识别为影响判断的主要因素，与既有临床诊断思路相近。作者据此认为，症状时间演变具有鉴别价值，这类不依赖生物标志物的模型有望作为资源有限环境中的初筛辅助工具，但应用于临床前仍需前瞻性多中心外部验证。

papers.title: Diffusion Tensor Imaging of Auditory Pathway Fiber Bundles in Children with Hearing Impairment from Bilirubin Encephalopathy: Alterations in Fractional Anisotropy and Diffusion Coefficient
papers.authors: Deng M, Zheng C, Wei W, Yi T, Deng Z.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To investigate changes in diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) parameters of auditory pathway fiber bundles in children with hearing impairment caused by bilirubin encephalopathy. Methods A total of 36 children with bilirubin encephalopathy and 36 control children were examined using a 3.0T superconducting magnetic resonance scanner (Siemens 3.0T Skyra, Siemens, Germany). DTI parameters, including fractional anisotropy (FA) and radial diffusivity (RD), were measured in the lateral lemniscus and inferior colliculus along the auditory pathway. These data were analyzed using independent samples t-test, and linear regression. Results Compared to the control group, children with hearing impairment demonstrated a significant decrease in FA(P < 0.0001) and a significant increase in RD(P < 0.0001). Additionally, a linear negative correlation was observed between FA values (R 2 = 0.7582, p < 0.0001) and auditory threshold in the inferior colliculus. However, no linear correlation was found between auditory threshold and other DTI parameters. Conclusion DTI-based fiber bundle imaging provides direct insight into the structure of white matter fiber bundles in the brain. The observed significant changes in DTI parameters among children with hearing impairment suggest damage or underdevelopment of the myelin sheath in white matter fiber bundles, although the overall integrity of fiber bundles and axons appears to remain intact.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注胆红素脑病所致听力障碍儿童听觉通路纤维束的弥散张量成像参数变化，比较了患儿与对照组在侧丘系和下丘的FA与RD。结果显示，患儿FA显著降低、RD显著升高，且下丘FA与听阈呈线性负相关，其他DTI参数与听阈未见线性相关。作者据此推测，患儿白质纤维束的髓鞘可能存在损伤或发育不足，而纤维束和轴突的整体完整性似乎仍然保留；DTI纤维束成像可为观察脑内白质纤维束结构提供直接线索。

papers.title: Corpus Callosum Macrostructure and Microstructure in Relation to Interhemispheric Cortical Thickness Symmetry
papers.authors: Assari S.
papers.abstract: Background: Although the corpus callosum is the principal commissure connecting the cerebral hemispheres, it remains unclear whether its macrostructure and microstructure are associated with greater structural symmetry between the hemispheres. Objective: To examine associations of callosal macrostructure and microstructure with left–right symmetry of cortical thickness in healthy developing children. Methods: In 8,131 children aged 9 to 10 from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (ABCD), we related 16 callosal measures to per-child hemispheric similarity indices computed across 75 paired cortical regions. Degree-of-symmetry indices are based on the mean absolute left-minus-right difference, reversed so that higher values denote greater symmetry; pattern indices express the correlation between the two hemispheric profiles. Results: All 16 callosal measures were positively associated with cortical thickness symmetry and 15 reached significance, the strongest at r = −.096. The probability that 16 measures would share a direction by chance is 3.1 × 10⁻⁵. Across 128 tests of callosal structure against hemispheric similarity, 51 reached significance against 6.4 expected. The yield was concentrated in magnitude indices rather than pattern indices. Conclusions: A larger and more myelinated corpus callosum accompanies hemispheres whose cortical thickness is more symmetrical. The association concerns the degree of symmetry rather than its regional pattern.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注胼胝体的大体结构与微观结构是否与健康发育儿童左右半球皮层厚度的对称性有关，利用大样本儿童影像数据，将多项胼胝体指标与逐人的半球相似性指数进行关联分析。结果显示，胼胝体各项指标普遍与皮层厚度对称程度呈正向关联，且这种关联主要体现在对称程度（幅度）上，而非半球间的区域模式；换言之，胼胝体较大、髓鞘化程度较高的儿童，其两半球皮层厚度也更为对称。作者据此认为，胼胝体结构可能与半球间结构对称的程度相伴随，但这是关联性证据，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: The Cost of Scrutiny: Subclinical Social Anxiety and Performance Context Reshape Frontal-Midline Theta Network Reconfigurations during Probabilistic Learning.
papers.authors: Liu H, van der Molen MJW.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Social anxiety is reliably characterized by biases toward avoidance and aversive learning. Frontal-midline theta (FM-theta) oscillations have been implicated as a key neural mechanism underlying these learning biases. Here, we combined a dynamic network neuroscience approach with computational modeling to investigate how FM-theta oscillatory activity coordinates large-scale functional network interactions on a trial-to-trial basis during feedback-guided learning. Additionally, we examined how these neural dynamics are associated with social anxiety across different social contexts. A sample of 146 human participants (124 female; mean age, 20.4 years) with varying levels of social anxiety completed a probabilistic selection task while performing alone and under scrutiny. Using non-negative matrix factorization, we identified two functional neural subgraphs supported by FM-theta. Frontoparietal connectivity increased following aversive outcomes and scaled with positive prediction errors, consistent with error-monitoring and belief-updating. Fronto-occipital connectivity scaled with prediction errors when participants performed alone but not under scrutiny, indicative of context-sensitive disruption of belief-updating. Participants with elevated social anxiety showed increased fronto-occipital connectivity, as well as stronger subgraph coupling, indexing cross-network integration. This latter effect facilitated learning of simple stimulus-reward associations but hampered learning of difficult stimulus-reward associations. Together, these findings reveal that social anxiety amplifies fronto-occipital FM-theta connectivity and cross-network integration, facilitating learning under low task demands while hampering learning under high task demands.

papers.title: Habit Learning Shapes Activity Dynamics in the Central Nucleus of the Amygdala.
papers.authors: Amaya KA, Carmichael JE, Stott JJ, Townsend ES, Bien EA, Palmer JA, Smith KS.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Habits develop as motivated behaviors that are strengthened by extended experience and feedback. While the performance component of a habit is relatively well studied, being linked to action-related neural dynamics in the basal ganglia and beyond, neural mechanisms for outcome feedback during habit formation, the reinforcement component, remain unknown. One candidate for this feedback mechanism is in the central nucleus of the amygdala (CeA). Here, we identify CeA neural firing dynamics in male and female rats that serve to promote habit formation. We used a novel maze task with rewards of differing identity and value to show that habits arise with task overtraining. After showing that overtraining engages CeA as shown through elevated cFos expression, we recorded in vivo CeA activity across learning and after outcome devaluation when habitual behavior is most identifiable. Neuronal activity changes tracked with habit formation. During learning, a group of recorded cells were significantly responsive at the choice point of maze trials while others encoded outcome consumption. By late training, neural activity exhibited a rapid depression at the choice point of the maze and excitation during reward receipt. In both cases, outcome magnitude, but not identity, was a significant modulator of neural activity. Additionally, a population of neurons tracked instantaneous changes in animal run speed. These speed cells dramatically decreased in number as habits formed. Together, these findings support the role of the CeA in providing reinforcement for habitual behavior, offering a signal that marks successful performance while identifying speed representations in the CeA.

papers.title: Two Words Are Faster Than One: Neural Dynamics of Accelerated Meaning in Phrases.
papers.authors: Wang S, Kim S, Binder JR, Lin N, Pylkkänen L.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Although we increasingly understand how the brain processes phrase-level meaning, the role of semantic content remains underexplored. Recent models grounded in componential experiential features offer a principled framework for linking conceptual representation to the neurobiology of semantic composition. Here we used MEG to test whether experiential semantic features are retrieved and composed during two-word phrase comprehension and whether lexical and phrase-level representations show temporally overlapping or strictly serial activation. Participants (16 women, 12 men) read two-word phrases and their component words in a rapid parallel visual presentation paradigm, equating the temporal dimension of the two types of stimuli. The phrases spanned six linguistic relations. All words and phrases were independently rated on 65 experiential features across 14 experiential domains, and representational similarity analysis was used to relate neural and semantic structure. Rather than emerging after or in parallel with single-word meanings, phrase-level meanings arose earlier, outpacing single words in isolation. Phrasal contexts also elicited earlier activation of word-level meaning: a word such as "cake" showed semantic activation at ∼312 ms in isolation, but at ∼236 ms in "green cake." Experiential feature representations of both component words were detectable during phrase processing, with partially overlapping temporal windows. The magnitude of composition-related effects varied systematically across phrasal relation types and experiential domains. Together, these findings show that experiential semantic features are integrated during composition in ways that vary across phrasal relations and that combining words into phrases speeds semantic access, accelerating both phrase- and word-level meaning relative to isolated words.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑磁图考察两词短语理解中经验语义特征的提取与组合，并检验词汇与短语表征是时间重叠还是严格串行。结果显示，短语层意义比孤立单词意义出现得更早，短语语境也使词义激活提前，如“cake”在“green cake”中比单独出现时更早激活。组成词的特征表征在短语加工中可检出，时间窗部分重叠，组合效应随短语关系类型和经验域系统变化。这表明将词组合成短语会加速语义通达，且语义组合方式因关系类型而异。

papers.title: Evolutionary Reorganization of the Self-Processing Network across Primates.
papers.authors: Ruan J, Ma C, Qiao Y, Dong X, Qiu M, Klar P, Wang J, Fan L, Northoff G, Liu N.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Understanding the evolutionary origins of the structural substrates underlying self-processing is central to elucidating the neural basis of human cognition. Although self-related behaviors differ markedly across primates, the extent to which the underlying neural architecture is conserved or reorganized remains unclear. Here, we investigated shared and species-specific characteristics of the self-processing network (SPN) across humans (n = 46, 19 males), chimpanzees (n = 46, 18 males), and macaques (n = 43, 22 males) using a comparative connectomic framework. We mapped a meta-analysis-derived human SPN onto nonhuman primates within a shared homologous connectivity space defined by conserved white-matter tracts. We compared local microstructural properties and gene expression signatures between humans and macaques and further included chimpanzees as an intermediate evolutionary reference for large-scale structural connectivity. SPN regions exhibited highly similar myelin-sensitive contrast profiles in humans and macaques, accompanied by shared expression patterns of related genes, which were also enriched for human-accelerated brain genes. Large-scale connectivity revealed pronounced species differences, with chimpanzees occupying an intermediate position between humans and macaques. Importantly, evolutionary modifications of the SPN were domain-specific: interoceptive-processing subnetworks showed greater similarity between macaques and chimpanzees; exteroceptive-processing subnetworks showed closer correspondence between chimpanzees and humans; and mental-self-processing subnetworks exhibited greater interspecies differentiation. Moreover, these changes were accompanied by a progressive reorganization of network hubs from insular regions in macaques to cingulate regions in humans. Together, these findings reveal a scale-dependent evolutionary organization of SPN structural substrates and provide a framework for understanding the conservation and reorganization of self-processing architectures across primates.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自我加工网络的结构基础在灵长类进化中究竟保守还是重组，采用比较连接组框架，将基于元分析得到的人类自我加工网络映射到人类、黑猩猩和猕猴共有的同源连接空间中进行比较。结果显示，该网络的局部微结构特征及相关基因表达在人与猕猴间高度相似，但大规模连接存在明显物种差异，黑猩猩处于人与猕猴之间。更重要的是，进化改变具有领域特异性：内感受子网络在猕猴与黑猩猩间更接近，外感受子网络在黑猩猩与人间更接近，而心理自我子网络种间分化更大，网络枢纽也由猕猴的岛叶区域逐渐转向人类的扣带区域。作者据此提出，自我加工网络的结构基础呈现尺度依赖的进化组织方式。

papers.title: Flexible Modulation of Premotor mu Rhythm Waveform Shape Predicts Human Motor Sequence Learning.
papers.authors: Suresh T, Khatri U, Hussain SJ.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Motor sequence learning recruits a distributed sensorimotor network. Within this network, the premotor cortex (PMC) encodes and represents sequence information while the primary motor cortex (M1) executes movement sequences. Like M1, PMC neuronal populations exhibit mu (8-13 Hz) rhythms, which are typically nonsinusoidal. Previous studies showed that mu rhythm phase gates corticospinal transmission, sensitivity to LTP-like plasticity, and learning-related corticospinal plasticity. However, these studies treated mu peak and trough phases as discrete functional states and focused exclusively on M1. Here, we characterized mu phase-dependent mechanisms of motor sequence learning by measuring waveform shape, which is a more holistic measure that treats peak and trough phases as continuous components of the same oscillatory cycle. Using cycle-by-cycle analysis of resting EEG, we quantified the peak-trough symmetry of mu rhythms recorded over premotor regions during, before, and after healthy adults (25 females, 11 males) practiced a serial reaction time task containing a repeating, embedded sequence (sequence group) or no sequence (no-sequence group). As learning progressed, premotor mu rhythms became more symmetric in the sequence than the no-sequence group; these symmetry increases were also more positively correlated with skill acquisition in the sequence than the no-sequence group. Furthermore, premotor mu asymmetry before task exposure predicted sequence acquisition, such that participants with longer baseline trough phases acquired greater skill and showed larger learning-related increases in mu peak-trough symmetry. Overall, these findings provide first evidence that motor sequence learning reshapes premotor mu rhythms, consistent with learning-related redistribution of cortical excitability across the mu cycle.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察前运动皮层mu节律的波形形状是否与人类运动序列学习相关，用静息脑电的逐周期分析量化健康成人完成序列反应时任务前后mu节律的峰-谷对称性。结果显示，随着学习推进，序列组前运动mu节律比无序列组更趋对称，且这种对称性增加与技能获得的关联在序列组更正向；任务前的mu不对称性还能预测序列习得，基线谷相较长者学得更好、学习相关的对称性增幅也更大。作者据此认为，运动序列学习会重塑前运动mu节律，提示学习伴随mu周期内皮层兴奋性的重新分布；这属于预测性关联证据，尚不能说明因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Neurological tissue dissection techniques in mouse models for reproducible scientific results: Brain, spinal cord, cerebrospinal fluid, and sciatic nerve.
papers.authors: Crew L, Seerley A, McElroy S, Panter AG.
papers.abstract: Biomedical research studies, specifically regarding human neurodegenerative diseases, are bound by ethical challenges, and have limited diagnostic and treatment options. Transgenic mouse models provide the opportunity to conduct feasible and practical research with the ability to precisely define the progression of neurodegenerative disease over a well-controlled dosage and timeline. The use of transgenic mouse models has been extensive and is critical to advancing research in many ways, including understanding brain morphology and general tissue changes caused by neurological diseases. Often, these studies require specific brain regions or other neurological tissues which may be difficult to obtain. Unfortunately, specific extraction and dissection protocols are few and far between, leading to inconsistent results and a lack of reproducibility. A well-defined protocol, for dissection and extraction, is instrumental for acquisition of reproducible experimental results. Five mouse-specific protocols are described here: brain extraction, brain microdissection, spinal cord extrusion, cerebral spinal fluid collection, and sciatic nerve dissection. Each protocol was completed under biosafety level 2 (BSL-2) guidelines, similar to the sterility precautions required in human surgery. Each protocol also includes a required materials list that defines proper instruments and usage. The protocols were refined based on feedback from numerous research studies in transcriptomics and pharmaceutical development. These protocols minimize tissue damage, increase dissection accuracy, and increase reproducibility of results while developing skills directly transferable to clinical settings. This study provides well-defined, succinct, accessible protocols that support advancements in many cross-disciplinary areas.
papers.summary_zh: 针对神经退行性疾病研究中转基因小鼠组织取材缺乏规范、结果难以重复的问题，本文介绍了一套小鼠神经组织解剖与提取的操作流程，涵盖脑组织提取、脑显微解剖、脊髓挤出、脑脊液采集和坐骨神经分离五项。各流程均在生物安全二级条件下完成，并附有器械与使用说明，且经转录组学和药物开发等多项研究反馈修订。作者强调，这些流程能减少组织损伤、提高解剖准确性并增强结果可重复性，所训练的技能也可迁移至临床环境，从而为相关跨学科研究提供清晰易行的取材规范。

papers.title: Alexander Disease Diagnosed in an Obstetrics Patient: A Case Report and Review of the Literature.
papers.authors: Saez-Calveras N, Warncke K, Schnorr J, Amin A, Nelson DB.
papers.abstract: Alexander disease (AxD) is a rare autosomal dominant leukodystrophy due to pathogenic variants in glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) . Adult-onset AxD type II presents with heterogeneous neurologic and neuropsychiatric symptoms. We report a unique case diagnosed in the postpartum period that mimicked posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES). A 33-year-old gravida 2 para 1 at 36 weeks gestation presented with 10 days of progressive restlessness, delusions, insomnia, dysarthria, weight loss with inability to feed herself, and urinary/fecal incontinence. She underwent induction of labor due to concern for severe pre-eclampsia (elevated liver enzymes and creatine kinase, elevated blood pressure), received magnesium sulfate, and required emergent cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal status. However, her symptoms persisted postpartum. Brain magnetic resonance imaging revealed extensive bifrontal, periventricular, and pontine non-enhancing hyperintensities. Cerebrospinal fluid analysis was normal including negative infectious, autoimmune, and paraneoplastic studies. Electroencephalography showed mild background slowing but no epileptiform activity. Empiric methylprednisolone and acyclovir had limited effects. Given the imaging findings, a leukodystrophy panel was ordered, which identified a heterozygous pathogenic GFAP variant (Arg79Leu), confirming a diagnosis of AxD type II. She improved with rehabilitation, with mild residual dysarthria at the 2-month follow-up. This is the first case report to describe an onset of AxD in the peripartum period. In peripartum patients with neurological symptoms whose course and MRI findings are atypical for PRES or other more common disorders, adult-onset neurogenetic disorders such as AxD should be considered. This diagnosis has important reproductive implications and warrants genetic counseling.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述了一名在围产期出现进行性神经精神症状的孕妇，其表现最初类似后部可逆性脑病综合征（PRES），但产后症状持续，脑磁共振显示双额、脑室周围及脑桥广泛非强化高信号，最终经白质营养不良基因检测发现GFAP致病性变异，确诊为成人起病的Alexander病II型。作者指出，这是首例报道的围产期起病Alexander病，提示对围产期出现非典型PRES病程和影像表现的患者，应考虑此类成人神经遗传病；该诊断对生育有重要影响，需进行遗传咨询。

papers.title: Loss of Selenot in POMC Neurons Disrupts ER Homeostasis and Induces A Senescent-like Phenotype.
papers.authors: Jehan C, Drissa I, Cartier D, Bucharles C, Abgrall A, Prieur A, Chan P, Burel C, Walet-Balieu ML, Alexandre D, Bardor M, Dubessy C, Anouar Y, Lihrmann I.
papers.abstract: Aims Selenoprotein T (SELENOT) is an endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-resident thioredoxin-like oxidoreductase implicated in redox and calcium (Ca2+ ) homeostasis and protein quality control. Although SELENOT is highly expressed in the brain, its role in hypothalamic pro-opiomelanocortin (POMC) neurons, which regulate energy balance, remains poorly understood. We investigated whether SELENOT is required for maintaining ER homeostasis and neuronal integrity in POMC neurons. Results Using CRISPR-edited and siRNA-silenced POMC neuronal models together with a POMC-specific SELENOT knockout mouse, we demonstrated that SELENOT loss induces a senescent-like phenotype including cellular hypertrophy, loss of neurite outgrowth, senescence-associated β-galactosidase activity, increased P16 and P21 expression, and acquisition of senescence-associated secretory phenotype. Senescence markers were elevated not only in SELENOT-deficient POMC neurons but also throughout the surrounding arcuate nucleus in vivo , suggesting propagation of a pro-inflammatory microenvironment. Mechanistically, prolonged SELENOT deficiency produced selective activation of the ATF6α arm of the unfolded protein response, depletion of ER Ca2+ stores, and profound alterations in N -glycan maturation. Notably, leptin-induced POMC processing and secretion were spared. Glycomics revealed a shift toward immature glycans, whereas thiol-trapping proteomics identified candidate SELENOT interactors linked to ER Ca2+ regulation. Innovation and conclusions This study provides the first evidence that SELENOT deficiency is sufficient to trigger cellular senescence in POMC neurons, acting as a central regulator integrating ER proteostasis, Ca2+ homeostasis, redox adaptation, and glycosylation. These results reveal a previously unrecognized mechanism potentially linking neuronal senescence to hypothalamic dysfunction and suggest that SELENOT-dependent pathways may represent therapeutic targets for obesity, metabolic disease, and age-related neuroendocrine disorders. Antioxid. Redox Signal. 00, 000-000.

papers.title: White matter hyperintensities moderate neuropsychiatric response to N-acetylcysteine and exercise therapy in vascular mild cognitive impairment.
papers.authors: Mah E, Gallagher D, Kang Y, Gao F, Ramirez J, Ismail Z, Black SE, Cao X, Herrmann N, Marzolini S, Oh P, Chen JJ, Survilla K, Swardfager W, Vieira D, Rapoport MJ, Lanctôt KL.
papers.abstract: BackgroundVascular mild cognitive impairment (vaMCI) is frequently accompanied by neuropsychiatric symptoms (NPS), particularly apathy, which are associated with white matter hyperintensities (WMH). N-acetylcysteine (NAC) combined with exercise may provide neuroprotective benefits.ObjectiveWe hypothesized that baseline frontal and global WMH burden would moderate the neuropsychiatric response to NAC plus exercise. We further hypothesized that the strongest domain-specific effects would be observed for apathy and affective dysregulation.MethodsParticipants with vaMCI were randomized to NAC (2400 mg daily) or placebo plus exercise for 6 months. WMH volumes were quantified using structural MRI. NPS were assessed using the Mild Behavioral Impairment Checklist (MBI-C) at baseline, 3 months, and 6 months. Negative binomial generalized linear mixed models examined WMH × time × treatment interactions. False discovery rate (FDR) correction was applied.ResultsFifty-one participants were included. Lower baseline frontal (β = 0.229, SE = 0.070, FDR-adjusted p = 0.007) and global (β = 0.258, SE = 0.080, FDR-adjusted p = 0.007) WMH volume was associated with greater reductions in NPS over 6 months in the NAC plus exercise group. This effect was driven by improvements in apathy (frontal: β = 0.186, SE = 0.076, FDR-adjusted p = 0.048; global: β = 0.207, SE = 0.089, FDR-adjusted p = 0.049).ConclusionsBaseline WMH burden moderates neuropsychiatric treatment response in vaMCI. These findings support the importance of optimizing care for cerebrovascular risk factors in this vulnerable population.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨基线白质高信号负荷是否调节血管性轻度认知障碍患者对N-乙酰半胱氨酸联合运动疗法的神经精神症状反应，研究对象为随机接受N-乙酰半胱氨酸或安慰剂并配合运动的血管性轻度认知障碍患者，通过结构MRI量化白质高信号体积并追踪神经精神症状变化。结果显示，在联合治疗组中，基线额叶和全局白质高信号体积较低者，其神经精神症状在6个月内下降更明显，这一效应主要由淡漠症状的改善所驱动。作者据此认为，基线白质高信号负荷可调节该人群的治疗反应，提示在这类易感人群中优化脑血管危险因素管理可能具有重要意义；但作为调节因素分析，结果尚不能直接等同于临床疗效证据。

papers.title: Multidimensional Cognitive and Linguistic Profiles in Adolescent Schizo-Obsessive Presentations: A Machine Learning and Explainable Artificial Intelligence Approach.
papers.authors: Guney O, Eyrikaya E, Gurel Ficicioglu IE, Kiziltan K, Kinay Ermis D, Kasar N, Tanyolac D.
papers.abstract: Schizo-obsessive presentations in adolescence remain insufficiently characterized, particularly with respect to their cognitive, linguistic, and social-cognitive features. This study explored clinical, neurocognitive, social-cognitive, and thought-language characteristics associated with schizophrenia, obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), and schizo-obsessive presentations in adolescents using a Support Vector Machine-based explainable machine learning framework. A total of 182 adolescents were included: schizophrenia with comorbid OCD (n = 27), schizophrenia without obsessive-compulsive symptoms (n = 55), and OCD without psychotic symptoms (n = 100).
