The model demonstrated high discriminative performance overall, although classification performance was lower for the schizo-obsessive group, suggesting partial overlap with both schizophrenia and OCD presentations. Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analyses indicated that obsessive-compulsive symptom burden and negative symptom burden were the primary dimensions associated with classification, while social cognition, verbal fluency, verbal memory, executive functioning, processing speed, thought-language organization, and prosodic features also contributed to group differentiation. The findings suggest that schizo-obsessive presentations may involve broader cognitive and linguistic characteristics beyond symptom-level overlap and support a multidimensional approach to their clinical evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年精神分裂症伴强迫症状（精神分裂-强迫）表现，试图刻画其认知、语言和社会认知特征。研究纳入青少年精神分裂症伴强迫症、单纯精神分裂症和单纯强迫症三组，采用支持向量机结合可解释人工智能分析临床、神经认知、社会认知和思维语言指标。模型总体区分能力较高，但精神分裂-强迫组的分类表现较低，提示其与精神分裂症和强迫症均有部分重叠；强迫症状负担和阴性症状负担是与分类最相关的主要维度，社会认知、言语流畅性、言语记忆、执行功能、加工速度、思维语言组织和韵律特征也有贡献。作者据此认为，精神分裂-强迫表现可能涉及超出症状重叠的认知与语言特征，支持对其进行多维临床评估。

papers.title: Beyond chemobrain: A stepwise approach to identifying cognitive impairment in non-CNS cancer survivors.
papers.authors: Pulze M, Losa M, Buonopane S, Alì P, Caneva S, Pardini M.
papers.abstract: Cancer-related cognitive impairment (CRCI) is common in patients with non-central nervous system malignancies, but its identification remains difficult because symptoms are heterogeneous, may predate treatment, and are not captured by a single measure. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on epidemiology, clinical phenotype, risk factors, neuropsychological assessment, neuroimaging, and practical pathways for identifying CRCI in oncology care. Emerging literature highlights subjective-objective discordance and self-awareness as clinically relevant dimensions. Prevalence varies by timing and method, with higher estimates from self-report than from screening tools or formal batteries. Identification is more reliable when assessment combines patient-reported outcomes (PRO), brief objective screening, and focused neuropsychological testing within baseline vulnerability and concurrent symptom burden. Older age, lower cognitive reserve, pretreatment cognitive impairment, systemic illness, fatigue, insomnia, mood symptoms, pain, and medication effects are major modifiers. In clinical settings, neuroimaging is useful primarily for differential diagnosis: conventional brain MRI excludes competing neurologic disorders, while volumetric MRI, diffusion imaging, resting-state functional MRI, and [18F]FDG-PET currently provide group-level evidence rather than individual diagnostic signatures. At present, CRCI is best identified through a stepwise clinical strategy integrating PRO evaluation, objective testing, risk profiling, and selective imaging, considering individual patient modifiers rather than a single diagnostic test.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了非中枢神经系统恶性肿瘤患者癌症相关认知障碍的识别问题，指出症状异质、可能早于治疗出现且单一测量难以捕捉，因此识别仍较困难。文章综合流行病学、临床表型、危险因素、神经心理评估、神经影像和临床路径方面的证据，强调主观报告与客观表现的不一致及自我觉察具有临床意义，并指出自报患病率高于筛查工具或正式测验的估计。作者提出，较可靠的识别应在基线易感性和并存症状负担背景下，结合患者报告结局、简短客观筛查和针对性神经心理测验；影像主要用于鉴别诊断，结构和功能影像目前仅提供群体层面证据而非个体诊断标志。总体而言，当前宜采用整合患者报告、客观测验、风险分层和选择性影像的分步临床策略，并考虑个体化影响因素，而非依赖单一诊断检测。

papers.title: Specific expertise from diffuse feedback: A feedforward-gated mechanism.
papers.authors: Guo R, Yan A, Chen M, Li W, Yan Y.
papers.abstract: Perceptual learning improves sensory sensitivity through practice but is typically specific to trained stimuli. Two contrasting accounts have been proposed: fine-tuning of feature-selective neurons in early sensory cortex, which raises a stability-plasticity dilemma, and reweighting of stable sensory inputs by higher-level readout. To reconcile these views, we recorded neuronal populations in macaque visual area V4 during training on a camouflaged collinear contour detection task. Behavioral improvements were strictly orientation specific, yet learning-related neural enhancements were unexpectedly widespread, regardless of neuronal tuning. Critically, these enhancements were confined to late, feedback-influenced response components, whereas early feedforward activity remained stable. These results support a feedforward-gated feedback mechanism: Learning potentiates higher-order representations that deliver diffuse feedback, broadly recruiting early cortical neurons, while behavioral specificity arises because this modulation is gated by feature-selective feedforward inputs associated with the trained stimulus. Rather than being sequestered in a single locus or process, perceptual expertise emerges from hierarchical, bidirectional interactions that enable learning while preserving core sensory stability.

papers.title: Dopamine release-associated striatal blood oxygenation and whole-brain dynamics during associative learning.
papers.authors: Lawen A, Succi IK, Lichtman D, Peterka DS, Abdus-Saboor IJ, Kahn I.
papers.abstract: Dopaminergic signaling in the nucleus accumbens (NAc) is central to reward-based learning, but its relationship to brain-wide hemodynamics remains unclear. Using concurrent fMRI and dopamine photometry in awake, behaving mice, we reveal that associative learning induces a gradual temporal shift in NAc blood oxygenation responses that mirrors dopamine release dynamics. This shift emerges with cue-reward learning and extends across a distributed network encompassing the lateral septal complex, as well as prefrontal, insular, and hypothalamic regions. Further, dopamine transients tightly correspond with local blood oxygenation level dependent (BOLD) signals, and variations in reward value modulate delayed BOLD responses in both the NAc and additional subcortical structures. Regressing out the measured dopaminergic signal abolishes this reward-related modulation, suggesting that BOLD signals track dopaminergic reward prediction. These findings reveal a close relationship between dopamine signaling and widespread changes in brain activity during learning.

papers.title: Cognitive, Learning, and Executive Function Behaviors in Children With Cochlear Implants.
papers.authors: Illg A, Schipper M, Kronenberger W, Kral A.
papers.abstract: Objectives Hearing loss in early childhood can affect the development of language, cognition, and executive functions (EF). Although cochlear implantation (CI) restores auditory input, considerable variability in cognitive and academic outcomes remains. This study investigated everyday EF, learning, and academic behaviors in children with CIs compared with typically hearing peers. Design Parents of 279 children aged 6 to 18 yr (119 children with CIs, 160 typical hearing) completed the Learning, Executive, and Attention Functioning (LEAF) questionnaire. Subscales were analyzed using Wilcoxon tests and generalized linear modeling to compare cognitive domains (Cognitive-Executive, Cognitive-Learning, Academic) and to explore associations with speech recognition outcomes. Results Children with CIs showed significantly higher LEAF scores across most domains, indicating greater EF and academic difficulties, even after excluding participants with additional comorbidities. The strongest group differences occurred in comprehension, conceptual learning, and academic skills (reading, writing, and mathematics). While overall EF performance (composite cLEAF) was not correlated with speech recognition, the Cognitive-Learning domain-particularly comprehension and conceptual learning-was negatively associated with speech-in-noise performance. Children with CIs also exhibited greater intraindividual variability across cognitive subdomains. Conclusions Children with CIs, despite good speech recognition, demonstrate domain-specific and heterogeneous challenges in EF and academic performance. These difficulties are not fully explained by auditory or speech recognition abilities, underscoring the importance of addressing broader neurocognitive factors in clinical assessment and intervention. Targeted cognitive and educational support may help reduce cognitive scatter and improve functional outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人工耳蜗儿童在日常执行功能、学习和学业行为上是否与典型听力同龄人存在差异，并由家长填写问卷对两组儿童进行比较。结果显示，人工耳蜗儿童在多数认知与学业领域报告出更多困难，理解、概念学习及阅读、写作、数学等学业技能上的组间差异最明显；即便排除伴有其他共病的参与者，这一模式仍然存在。研究还发现，总体执行功能表现与言语识别无关，但认知学习领域（尤其理解和概念学习）与噪声下言语表现呈负相关，且人工耳蜗儿童在各认知子领域内的个体内波动更大。作者据此指出，即使言语识别良好，这些儿童仍面临领域特异且异质的认知与学业挑战，其困难不能完全由听觉或言语识别能力解释，提示临床评估与干预需关注更广泛的神经认知因素。

papers.title: Auditory- and Visual-Speech Evoked Activation of the Superior Temporal Gyrus Contralateral to the Cochlear Implant Predicts Speech Recognition Outcomes.
papers.authors: Peng T, Henshall KR, Esmaelpoor J, Haneman M, McDonald L, Shader MJ, Luke R, McKay CM.
papers.abstract: Objectives Speech recognition outcomes vary widely in cochlear implant recipients, but the reasons for this variability are not well explained by patient history factors alone. Neuroplastic reorganization after both deafness and cochlear implant switch-on can affect how new recipients adapt to electrical hearing. In this study, we evaluate the associations between speech recognition outcomes and stimulus-evoked activation of cortical language processing areas. Design Forty-three newly implanted post-lingually deaf adult cochlear implant recipients (17 female, mean age at implantation: 58.5 yr, SD: 14.4 yr) were recruited for the longitudinal study. Participants attended two research visits: the first conducted within 1 mo of device switch-on, and the second conducted 1 yr after device switch-on. At each visit, we evaluated speech recognition outcomes in noise and cortical activation using functional near-infrared spectroscopy during a passive listening task, during which a story was told in either an auditory- or visual-speech (lipreading) condition. Results We found consistent negative correlations between speech understanding outcomes at 1 yr and activation of the superior temporal gyrus at 1 mo in response to both auditory and visual speech. These associations were not observed for activation measured at 1 yr. Subgroup regression analysis revealed that these correlations were most consistently seen in the superior temporal gyrus contralateral to the cochlear implant. Activation in the superior temporal gyrus contralateral to the implant at 1 mo also explained additional variance in speech outcomes at 1 yr beyond clinical factors alone. However, longitudinal analysis showed no association between within-subject changes in activation and changes in speech understanding outcomes within this first year of implant use. Conclusions Our evidence highlights that neuroplastic changes which occur following adult-onset deafness play an important role in how cochlear implant recipients adapt to their devices after switch-on. The relationship between neuroimaging measures made within 1 mo after device switch-on and speech recognition outcomes at 1 yr can potentially enable triaging of recipients to improve clinical management of implant recipients.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察成人语后聋人工耳蜗植入者开机早期的皮层语言区激活能否预测一年后的噪声下言语识别表现，采用纵向设计，在开机后一个月和一年分别用功能性近红外光谱记录被动听故事时的脑活动。结果显示，开机一个月时，对侧于植入侧的上颞回在听觉言语和视觉言语条件下的激活越强，一年后的言语理解成绩越差；这一关联在一年时不再出现，且个体内激活变化与言语成绩变化无关。作者认为，成人语后聋后的神经可塑性重组影响植入者对新设备的适应，早期影像指标或有助于对患者进行分诊，但相关关系不等于因果，其临床价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Episodic memory retrieval with increasing task demand: associations with age, APOE4 genotype and Alzheimer's disease pathology.
papers.authors: Askevold F, Schumann-Werner B, Behrenbruch N, Schwarck S, Molloy EN, Peelle JE, O'Leary RM, Wingfield A, Behnisch G, Seidenbecher C, Schott BH, Morgado B, Esselmann H, Wiltfang J, Düzel E, Maass A, Fischer L.
papers.abstract: Episodic memory declines early with ageing, reflecting reduced neural resources and diminished memory specificity. However, few studies have created a cognitive challenge with multiple levels of task demand to investigate this early, subtle decline. Furthermore, it is unclear whether the genetic Alzheimer's disease risk factor APOE4 and early Alzheimer's pathology constrain the neural resources required to cope with increasing task demands. In this preregistered behavioural study named EMCOMP (Episodic Memory & COMPensation), we conducted a sentence-based episodic memory retrieval task where we manipulated retrieval difficulty by varying the required degree of memory specificity, thereby increasing task demands on episodic retrieval with five demand levels at recognition (novel foils, 'old' target sentences and three lure levels) and two demand levels at free and cued recall (gist and details). We collected data from 100 cognitively unimpaired adults [37 young (mean age 24 years), 63 older (mean age 72 years)] with additional neuropsychological testing and blood-based measures available for the older group. First, we investigated differences in EMCOMP episodic memory retrieval accuracy and confidence between young and older adults in linear mixed-effects models. Second, we investigated differences associated with the APOE4 genotype and plasma-derived Alzheimer's pathology. Third, we assessed correlations between EMCOMP recognition and recall and established cognitive tests. Young adults showed higher recognition accuracy and confidence as well as a higher recall score and a lower recall error rate compared to older adults. As target-lure similarity increased, there was a steeper decline in recognition accuracy and a steeper increase in high-confidence errors in older compared to younger adults and in older APOE4 carriers compared to older non-carriers. However, we found no associations with Alzheimer's pathology. EMCOMP performance was positively correlated with established cognitive tests. Our study demonstrates age- and APOE4 -related differences in episodic memory retrieval under increasing retrieval difficulty-differences that may not be detectable in paradigms with only one or two levels of variation. By manipulating sentence-based retrieval specificity, we provide a novel approach to detect subtle cognitive deficits and potential functional compensation in cognitively unimpaired older adults with risk factors or early Alzheimer's pathology. Future research should extend this work to more diverse samples and combine behavioural assessment with functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to examine underlying brain activation patterns and functional connectivity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察情景记忆提取在任务需求递增时与年龄、APOE4基因型及阿尔茨海默病病理的关联，采用基于句子的情景记忆提取任务，通过变化记忆特异性设置多个难度水平，并比较年轻与年长认知未受损成人的表现。结果显示，年轻成人的再认准确性和信心更高、回忆成绩更好且错误率更低；随着目标与诱饵相似度增加，年长成人以及年长APOE4携带者的再认准确性下降更陡、高信心错误上升更明显，但未发现与阿尔茨海默病病理的关联，任务表现与既有认知测验正相关。作者据此认为，多级难度操纵有助于检出常规范式难以发现的细微记忆差异，未来需在更多样样本中结合功能磁共振考察其脑活动基础。

papers.title: Nerve growth factor metabolic dysfunction in Down's syndrome brains.
papers.authors: Iulita MF, Do Carmo S, Ower AK, Fortress AM, Flores Aguilar L, Hanna M, Wisniewski T, Granholm AC, Buhusi M, Busciglio J, Cuello AC.
papers.abstract: Basal forebrain cholinergic neurons play a key role in cognition. This neuronal system is highly dependent on nerve growth factor (NGF) for its synaptic integrity and the phenotypic maintenance of its cell bodies. Basal forebrain cholinergic neurons progressively degenerate in Alzheimer's disease and Down's syndrome, and their atrophy contributes to the manifestation of dementia. Paradoxically, in Alzheimer's disease brains, the synthesis of NGF is not affected and there is abundance of the NGF precursor (proNGF). We have shown that this phenomenon is due to a deficit in NGF's extracellular metabolism which compromises proNGF maturation and exacerbates its subsequent degradation. We hypothesized that a similar imbalance should be present in Down's syndrome. Using a combination of quantitative reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, western blotting and zymography, we have investigated signs of NGF metabolic dysfunction in post-mortem brains from the temporal (n = 14), frontal (n = 34) and parietal (n = 20) cortex obtained from Down's syndrome subjects and age-matched controls (age range 31-68 years). We further examined primary cultures of human fetal Down's syndrome cortex (17-21 gestational age weeks). We report a significant increase in proNGF levels in human Down's syndrome brains, with a concomitant reduction in the levels of plasminogen and tissue plasminogen activator mRNA as well as an increment in neuroserpin expression; enzymes that partake in proNGF maturation. Down's syndrome brains also exhibited elevated zymogenic activity of MMP9, the major NGF-degrading protease. Our results indicate a failure in proNGF maturation in Down's syndrome brains and a likely enhanced proteolytic degradation of NGF, changes which can compromise the trophic support of basal forebrain cholinergic neurons. The alterations in proNGF and MMP9 were also present in cultures of Down's syndrome fetal cortex; suggesting that this trophic compromise may be amenable to rescue, before frank dementia onset. Our study thus provides a novel paradigm for cholinergic neuroprotection in Alzheimer's disease and Down's syndrome.

papers.title: Spectrally-resolved transfer entropy in resting-state SEEG reveals epileptogenic and non-epileptogenic communication in adults and children with refractory epilepsy.
papers.authors: Okoroafor F, Makhoul GS, Lerma BHM, Reda A, Qiang Z, C Cavender A, Wang K, Liao E, Chari A, Piper RJ, Denison T, Scott RC, Morgan VL, Baldeweg T, Tisdall MM, Englot DJ.
papers.abstract: Objective . To characterise directed, frequency-resolved communication between seizure onset zone (SOZ) and non-involved zone (NIZ) regions in resting-state stereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) from adults and children with drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE).Approach . We analysed retrospective SEEG from 21 adults and 18 paediatric patients who underwent focal resective surgery. Channels were grouped into four link classes (SOZ → SOZ, NIZ → SOZ, SOZ → NIZ, NIZ → NIZ). Signals were decomposed into delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma, and broadband bands, and transfer entropy (TE) was estimated with a Gaussian estimator. For each source-target channel pair, an optimal temporal delay was selected by scanning delays from 2-200 ms and choosing the delay that maximised broadband TE. Significance testing used 100 phase-randomised surrogates per source and per target; Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction (α = 0.05) was applied within each band-to-band TE grid (separately for source- and target-surrogatep -values).Main results . In NIZ → SOZ links median communication delays were longer in adults than children (median 87.9 ms vs 68.0 ms; Mann-Whitneyp < 1 × 10-10 ; Kolmogorov-Smirnovp < 1 × 10-10 ). Across most link classes, dominant source frequencies were broadband, delta, and theta. A distinct SOZ → SOZ pattern emerged: adults showed broadband, alpha, and beta source dominance with prominent broadband → gamma transfer, whereas children showed broadband, delta, and theta dominance while retaining broadband → gamma contribution. Cross-link-class source and target frequency distributions differed significantly in both cohorts (p < 0.05). While intra-regional SOZ-SOZ communication revealed unique multiplex signatures, inter-regional NIZ → SOZ interactions did not show a distinct spectral profile from non-involved connectivity.Significance . Resting-state SEEG communication in DRE exhibits multiplex, cross-frequency directed interactions. Spectrally resolved TE reveals conserved and cohort-specific shifts in SOZ-NIZ communication motifs. While these differences are confounded by pathology and site variations, they provide a frequency-specific characterization of the epileptogenic network that may support grounded interpretation of resting-state dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用静息态立体脑电（SEEG）数据，分析成人及儿童难治性癫痫患者中致痫区（SOZ）与非受累区（NIZ）之间按频率划分的有向信息传递，比较不同连接类型下的传递熵特征。结果显示，NIZ→SOZ连接的通信延迟在成人中长于儿童；多数连接类型以宽带、δ和θ频段为主要源频率，而SOZ→SOZ连接呈现独特的频谱模式：成人以宽带、α和β为主并伴有明显的宽带→γ传递，儿童则以宽带、δ和θ为主但仍保留宽带→γ贡献。跨连接类型的源和目标频率分布在两队列中均存在显著差异，但NIZ→SOZ的频谱特征与未受累区连接并无明显区别。作者指出，这些差异受病理和记录部位等因素混杂，结果提供的是致痫网络的频率特异性刻画，而非临床疗效证据。

papers.title: Synbiotic supplementation leads to gut microbiome communities with functional capacity linked to better brain white matter development in preterm infants.
papers.authors: Voulgari-Kokota A, Janson E, Heikamp de Jong I, Knol J, van Elburg R, van der Aa NE, Hortensius LM, Dudink J, de Theije CGM, Schipper L, Kozior M, van de Lagemaat M, Groenendaal F, van Bel F, Wildt-Grootendorst A, Drost-Verhoef S, Hennink A, Obihara CC, van Hillegersberg-Schilder JLAM, Dassel CM, Oudshoorn JH, Meijssen CB, de Boer IP, Illy KE, Claessens N, Viergever MA, Isgum I, Shetty S, Wopereis H, Benders M, Belzer C.
papers.abstract: Preterm birth, a major cause of brain injury, is often linked to dysregulated gut microbiome development. This association underscores microbial metabolic function as a modifiable target to support neurodevelopment. In this secondary analysis of data derived from a randomized controlled trial (Trial Registration: ISRCTN96620855), we tested whether daily nutritional supplementation with Bifidobacterium breve M-16V, short- and long-chain oligosaccharides, and L-glutamine could steer the gut microbiome of very and extremely preterm infants toward communities that support brain maturation. The gut microbiome was profiled with longitudinal shotgun metagenomics at nine time points during the intervention, which started at 48-72 h after birth and continued until 36 weeks postmenstrual age. Additionally, MRI scans were conducted when infants reached term-equivalent age to evaluate brain maturation. Supplementation promoted the early establishment of Bifidobacterium -rich communities in the test group, with enhanced capacity for amino acid biosynthesis and pyruvate fermentation towards acetate and lactate production. Integration of microbiome data with brain developmental markers post hoc showed that the same functions were markedly reduced in infants with delayed white-matter myelination. By integrating microbiome functional capacity profiling and evaluation of brain maturation via MRI, this study demonstrated that early microbial modulation could influence brain development, positioning the preterm gut microbiome as a clinically actionable target.
papers.summary_zh: 这项研究基于一项随机对照试验的二次分析，探讨早产儿每日补充短双歧杆菌M-16V、寡糖和谷氨酰胺能否引导肠道菌群向支持脑成熟的方向发展；研究者用纵向宏基因组测序分析干预期间的菌群，并在婴儿达到足月等效年龄时用MRI评估脑成熟。结果显示，补充促进了双歧杆菌富集菌群的早期建立，并增强了氨基酸生物合成以及向乙酸和乳酸方向的丙酮酸发酵能力；事后整合分析发现，在白质髓鞘化延迟的婴儿中，这些功能明显减弱。作者据此认为，早期微生物调节可能影响脑发育，早产儿肠道菌群或可作为临床可干预的靶点，但相关证据来自二次分析和事后关联，尚不能确立因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: HLA-DRB1*15:01 Paediatric Uveitis: Ophthalmological Presentation and Follow-Up.
papers.authors: Hendrikse J, Ayuso VK, Ossewaarde-van Norel A, de Boer JH.
papers.abstract: Purpose The purpose of this study is to describe the clinical presentation of the HLA-DRB1*15:01 positive non-anterior uveitis phenotype in paediatric uveitis and to determine if early markers that may indicate a possible risk of MS, white matter lesions on brain MRI and OCT RNFL or GCL thinning, are present in this subgroup. Methods In a cohort of 65 patients with non-infectious non-anterior paediatric uveitis patients we retrospectively characterized the uveitis phenotype based on underlying HLA-DRB1*15:01 genotype and described the clinical parameters on OCT and FA of 87 HLA-DRB1*15:01 negative and 37 HLA-DRB1*15:01 positive eyes. Results HLA-DRB1*15:01 positive patients had intermediate uveitis almost three times as often as HLA-DRB1*15:01 negative patients with uveitis (70.0% versus 24.4% respectively, p = 0.001). Cells in the anterior chamber were seen less often in HLA-DRB1*15:01 positive patients compared to in HLA-DRB1*15:01 negative patients (55.0% versus 90.7% respectively, p = 0.001). Meanwhile, vitreous floaters were found more frequently in HLA-DRB1*15:01 -positive compared to -negative cases (80.0% versus 53.3% respectively, p = 0.041). Also, fern-like capillary leakage was almost twice as common in HLA-DRB1*15:01 positive compared to HLA-DRB1*15:01 negative patients (64.7% versus 34.1% respectively, p = 0.032). Multiple sclerosis developed in one HLA-DRB1*15:01 positive patient (5.0%), 15 years after intermediate uveitis was diagnosed. Conclusion The HLA-DRB1*15:01 allele is associated with intermediate uveitis in children, with absence of anterior chamber cells, presence of vitreous floaters and peripheral capillary fern-like leakage as distinct clinical features. At this point the usefulness of HLA-DRB1*15:01 typing for predicting the risk of multiple sclerosis is yet to be determined.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究回顾性分析了儿童非感染性非前部葡萄膜炎患者，按HLA-DRB1*15:01基因型分组，比较其葡萄膜炎表型及OCT和荧光血管造影表现。结果显示，HLA-DRB1*15:01阳性者患中间型葡萄膜炎的比例明显更高，前房细胞较少见，而玻璃体漂浮物和周边毛细血管蕨样渗漏更常见，提示该等位基因与儿童中间型葡萄膜炎及特定临床特征相关。随访中仅一例阳性患者在中问型葡萄膜炎诊断多年后发生多发性硬化，作者因此指出，目前尚不能确定HLA-DRB1*15:01分型对预测多发性硬化风险的实用价值。

papers.title: Profile of Michael N. Shadlen.
papers.authors: Viegas J.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Neuroscientist and neurologist Michael N. Shadlen is a world leader in the neurobiology of decision-making, a field of study he helped establish. His research explores higher brain functions-memory retrieval, reasoning, and multitasking, among others-that he theorizes share underlying mechanisms. His work suggests that a holy grail of neuroscience-the "hard problem" of consciousness, or the mechanism(s) by which physical brain operations are translated into lived experiences-could be resolved. Shadlen's Inaugural Article explains what distinguishes conscious from nonconscious thought.

papers.title: Microbiota-derived urolithins and cortical thickness in cognitively healthy older adults: a longitudinal MRI analysis of the WAHA trial.
papers.authors: Galkina P, Domínguez-López I, Cofán M, Pozzoli C, Vallverdú-Queralt A, Serra-Mir M, Chiva-Blanch G, Rajaram S, Sabaté J, Sala-Vila A, Ros E, Lamuela-Raventós RM.
papers.abstract: Cortical thickness, assessed by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), is a biomarker of age-related neurodegeneration. Walnut ellagitannins may influence brain structure via gut microbiota-derived urolithins. We examined whether longitudinal changes in urinary urolithins are associated with concurrent changes in cortical thickness in cognitively healthy older adults. This longitudinal MRI sub-study was conducted within the Walnuts and Healthy Aging study, a two-center (Barcelona, Spain and Loma Linda, California) randomized controlled trial testing the effects of 2-year daily walnut consumption vs . a control diet on age-related health outcomes in older individuals. A subset of participants from the Barcelona center underwent structural MRI at baseline and after 2 years. Urinary urolithin concentrations were quantified by liquid chromatography-high-resolution mass spectrometry, and their changes were related to concurrent changes in cortical thickness using multivariable-adjusted linear regression models, with analyses stratified by urolithin metabotype to account for inter-individual variability. A total of 104 participants were included. Among those allocated to the walnut diet (n = 55), greater increases in urolithin A (β = 0.023 [95% CI, 0.003-0.043] per 1-SD), urolithin C (β = 0.015 [95% CI, <0.001-0.029] per 1-SD), and its glucuronide conjugate (β = 0.017 [95% CI, 0.002-0.031] per 1-SD) were associated longitudinally with preservation of cortical thickness, predominantly in right-hemisphere regions. Associations were more pronounced among metabotype B individuals. These findings provide novel clinical evidence linking microbiota-derived (poly)phenol metabolites to brain aging and support a precision nutrition framework. Trial registration: Clinical trials.gov as NCT01634841.
papers.summary_zh: 这项纵向MRI子研究基于核桃与健康老龄化随机对照试验，在认知健康的老年人中考察尿液中微生物来源的尿石素变化是否与同期皮层厚度变化相关。结果显示，在核桃饮食组中，尿石素A、C及其葡萄糖醛酸结合物升高越多，皮层厚度越倾向于保持，关联主要见于右半球区域，且在代谢型B个体中更明显。作者认为，这为微生物来源多酚代谢物与脑老化之间的联系提供了初步临床证据，并提示精准营养框架的潜在价值；但作为关联性分析，尚不能说明因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Trait-relevant movies amplify neuroticism-associated brain responses.
papers.authors: Popp JL, Weiß M, Faskowitz J, Hilger K.
papers.abstract: High neuroticism is a risk factor for mental disorders. Understanding whether individuals share a common foundation in brain function underlying neuroticism is therefore an essential goal of neuroscience. We applied Inter-Subject Representational Similarity Analysis on data from 174 Human Connectome Project participants to investigate if their similarity in neuroticism is reflected in their similarity of fMRI-recorded brain activity during movie watching. To test behavioral personality theories that consider trait expression as dependent on situational context, we examined whether brain-trait representational similarity varied between trait-relevant and trait-irrelevant movie scenes (independently rated, N = 86). Higher neuroticism was associated with greater heterogeneity in brain responses, a pattern that was particularly pronounced during trait-relevant scenes. Our study informs dimensional conceptualizations of psychopathology viewing neuroticism as risk factor and extends behavioral personality theories to the level of brain function. Broadly, it highlights the value of naturalistic imaging and underscores the importance of stimulus selection when investigating brain-behavior associations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注神经质是否存在共享的脑功能基础，以及这种脑—特质关联是否随情境变化。作者对174名人类连接组计划参与者在观看电影时的fMRI数据进行受试者间表征相似性分析，并用独立评定区分与特质相关和无关的场景。结果显示，神经质越高，脑反应在个体间越异质，这一模式在特质相关场景中尤为明显。作者据此认为，研究将行为人格理论延伸到脑功能层面，支持把神经质视为精神病理风险因素的维度化理解，同时提示自然情境成像中刺激选择对脑—行为关联研究的重要性。

papers.title: Target-dependent routing of sensory information in the olfactory system.
papers.authors: Le-Jahns K, Sireci S, Mayland J, Richter F, Chamero P, Schwarz MK, Brunert D, Rothermel M.
papers.abstract: Parallel processing, the ability to split the information content of sensory stimuli and handle them simultaneously, is essential for sensory perception in many systems. Mitral (MCs) and tufted cells (TCs) in the olfactory bulb (OB), with their separate but overlapping projection areas, provide an ideal anatomical basis for parallel processing. Whether they convey different information to distinct areas of the olfactory cortex remains unclear. Here, we separated mouse OB output neurons by innervation area using retrograde tracing from the anterior olfactory nucleus (AON) or the anterior piriform cortex (APC). In vivo 2-photon calcium imaging in the OB revealed projection area-dependent differences, with APC-projecting neurons coding more strongly for odor concentration and more selectively for odor identity. This separation became more pronounced when differentially traced populations were split by cell type, with APC TCs displaying the strongest concentration-dependent changes in response and AON TCs showing very promiscuous odor tuning. Purely cell-type-derived properties did not explain the projection target-dependent differences in odor representation, as both mitral and tufted cells showed similar changes, and SVM classifier analysis demonstrated that classification by projection target outperformed classification by cell type. Our data suggests a prominent projection-defined separation of sensory information in the OB.

papers.title: LSD reconfigures cortical dynamics through faster brain rhythms and increased fractal dimension.
papers.authors: Subramani V, Nest T, Pascarella A, Brunel J, Mantilla Ramos YJ, Harel Y, Muthukumaraswamy S, Carhart-Harris R, Lioi G, Farrugia N, Jerbi K.
papers.abstract: Lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) profoundly alters conscious experience, yet the electrophysiological mechanisms by which it reshapes neural dynamics remain incompletely understood. A hallmark of psychedelic states is widespread cortical desynchronization, typically inferred from reductions in spectral power, but whether such effects reflect genuine weakening of neural oscillations or are confounded by shifts in oscillatory peak frequencies remains unresolved. We combine source-resolved magnetoencephalography (MEG), spectral parameterization, temporal complexity metrics, and interpretable machine learning in an LSD versus placebo design, with and without music. We show that LSD induces robust, spatially structured increases in alpha and beta peak frequencies alongside genuine attenuation of oscillatory power, with partly dissociable cortical patterns. Beyond rhythmic activity, LSD is associated with flattening of the aperiodic 1/f spectral slope and increased neural signal fractality and complexity, preferentially affecting sensory, language, emotion, and imagery-related networks while sparing motor cortex. Machine-learning analyses identify peak-frequency shifts, aperiodic parameters, and complexity measures as key discriminators of the psychedelic state. Music does not robustly amplify these neural signatures and instead shows a trend toward attenuation. These findings provide an electrophysiological account of how LSD reorganizes large-scale human brain dynamics and highlight features that may differentiate its neural signature from other psychedelics.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注LSD如何改变人脑大规模电生理动态，并试图厘清皮层去同步化究竟反映振荡真实减弱，还是受振荡峰值频率偏移干扰。作者结合源分辨脑磁图、频谱参数化、时间复杂性指标和可解释机器学习，在LSD与安慰剂对照（含音乐与无音乐条件）中比较神经活动。结果显示，LSD既使alpha和beta峰值频率升高，也真实降低振荡功率，两者皮层分布部分分离；同时非周期1/f斜率变平，信号分形维度和复杂性增加，主要涉及感觉、语言、情绪和想象相关网络，而运动皮层相对不受影响。机器学习表明峰值频率偏移、非周期参数和复杂性指标是区分迷幻状态的关键特征；音乐未稳健增强这些特征，反而呈减弱趋势。作者据此提出LSD通过更快脑节律和更高分形维度重组皮层动态，并提示这些特征或有助于区分其与其他迷幻药的神经印记。

papers.title: Prenatal stress reprograms placental signaling and opposes maternal immune activation effects in the fetal brain.
papers.authors: Verosky BG, Chen HJ, Anderson JL, Rajasekera TA, Neidhart M, Halaharvi S, Worly BL, Fischer AJ, Gur TL.
papers.abstract: Prenatal psychosocial stress and maternal immune activation (MIA) increase risk for overlapping offspring psychiatric disorders, but whether they influence fetal neurodevelopment through shared or distinct mechanisms is unclear. Positioned at the interface of maternal and fetal physiology, the placenta has a critical role in regulating fetal brain development. Here, we combine mouse placental single-cell RNA sequencing, transcriptomics of matched placentas and fetal brains, maternal cytokine profiling, and human placental RNA-seq to dissect this axis. In mice, chronic stress suppressed interferon signaling across placental immune cells and downregulated oxidative phosphorylation pathway expression in trophoblasts. Stressed dams also mounted a blunted type I interferon response to poly(I:C), resulting in attenuated placental antiviral signaling. Weighted gene co-expression analysis of fetal brains revealed that prenatal stress and MIA regulate overlapping DNA repair, synaptic, and translational networks in opposite directions, with stress promoting signatures of premature maturation and MIA driving replication stress. In human placentas, higher perceived stress was associated with chromatin-regulatory, RNA-metabolic, and extracellular-matrix modules that mirrored the murine stress signature. These findings identify a conserved placental stress-associated transcriptional program and suggest that stress and MIA affect shared neurodevelopmental pathways in opposing directions.

papers.title: Hemp-Derived Cellulose/NiFe<sub>2</sub>O<sub>4</sub> Biocomposite Hydrogels for Flexible Optoelectronics.
papers.authors: Yalçın O, Al-Dala Ali AMJ, Coşkun R, Uslu H.
papers.abstract: This study presents a systematic investigation into the optical and broadband dielectric behaviors of sustainable biocomposite hydrogels, synthesized from hemp biomass-derived cellulose and a poly-(AMPS/IA) network reinforced with varying concentrations of NiFe2 O4 nanoparticles, hereafter denoted as NiFe2 O4 biocomposite hydrogels (NiFH). The primary objective was to determine the suitability of these eco-friendly materials for flexible optoelectronic applications by elucidating the influence of filler loading on charge transport mechanisms. Structural and morphological characterizations via X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) confirmed the successful formation of a densely cross-inked amorphous matrix. The dispersion of the inorganic phase, without severe microscale agglomeration, was evidenced by the electron-dense domains resolved in the STEM images, while the characteristic spinel-type metal-oxygen vibrations identified by FTIR were consistent with the retention of the NiFe2 O4 ferrite phase. Optical characterization revealed that the hydrogels exhibit tunable semiconductor properties, with direct band gap energies (E g d ) modulated between 2.75 and 3.57 eV. While the NiFH2 formulation (0.5% NiFe2 O4 ) showed the highest structural order, increasing the NiFe2 O4 content to 1.0% (NiFH4) induced localized interfacial disorder, as evidenced by an elevated Urbach energy and a corresponding narrowing of the forbidden gap. Broadband dielectric spectroscopy demonstrated that the frequency-dependent response is governed by Maxwell-​Wagner-Sillars interfacial polarization and Koops' phenomenological models. Unlike conventional trends, the NiFH4 sample emerged as the optimal formulation, exhibiting peak dielectric permittivity and enhanced parallel capacitance due to the expanded electroactive surface area. This impedance analysis conclusively demonstrated that charge carriers encounter their primary impedance barriers at the microstructural interfaces and grain boundaries, which consistently exhibit significantly higher resistance than the bulk material. Moreover, increasing the NiFe2 O4 concentration systematically diminished these internal resistances, thereby simultaneously enhancing both bulk and interfacial conductivity. The modeling further elucidated the capacitive dynamics of the system, revealing strong nonideal capacitive effects driven by interfacial polarization at low frequencies, which transitioned into highly stable dielectric behavior at higher frequencies. Ultimately, the synergistic combination of biomass-derived cellulose and magnetic nanoparticles positions these hydrogels as highly promising candidates for high-performance "green" energy storage systems and flexible bioelectronic sensing platforms.

papers.title: Molecular mechanisms of electroconvulsive therapy modulates excitation-inhibition balance in major depression disorder.
papers.authors: Yu X, Yang F, Shang W, Cheng B, Wang L, Xia X, Chen M, Tian Y, Wang J.
papers.abstract: Background The excitation-inhibition (E/I) imbalance is a major pathological characteristic of major depressive disorder (MDD). However, whether/how electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) modulates neuronal homeostasis or E/I balance in MDD and its molecular basis is still largely unknown. Methods In this study, longitudinal rs-fMRI data from 46 patients with MDD receiving ECT and 46 healthy controls were included. The Hurst index was used to characterize the E/I balance, and mixed-effects model was constructed to assess the interactive effects of ECT on the Hurst index and functional connectivity (FC). Moreover, spatial correlation analyses were conducted by integrating cortical myelination pattern, glucose metabolism distribution, neurotransmitter density maps, and transcriptomic data to reveal the underlying molecular basis. Results ECT significantly reduces the Hurst index in the middle cingulate cortex (MCC) and induces functional decoupling between the MCC and the posterior cingulate cortex. Furthermore, changes in the Hurst index were closely associated with cortical myelination, glucose metabolism, and the distribution maps of dopamine and histamine. Spatial transcriptomic association analysis revealed that genes regulating the effects of ECT on Hurst index or FC are specifically enriched in cell types such as excitatory neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes, and are primarily involved in biological processes including synaptic signal transduction, neuronal projection regulation, and glutamatergic synapses. Conclusion These findings suggest that ECT may regulate the processes of myelin remodelling through neurons and glial cells by influencing the expression levels of relevant genes, thereby modulating the E/I balance and functional network activity in a synergistic manner to improve depressive symptoms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注电休克治疗是否以及如何调节重性抑郁障碍的兴奋-抑制平衡及其分子基础，纵向追踪患者治疗前后的静息态功能磁共振数据，并与健康对照比较，用Hurst指数刻画兴奋-抑制平衡。结果显示，电休克治疗显著降低中扣带皮层的Hurst指数，并引起该区与后扣带皮层之间的功能解耦；这些变化与皮层髓鞘化、葡萄糖代谢以及多巴胺和组胺分布相关。空间转录组关联分析进一步提示，相关基因富集于兴奋性神经元、星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞，涉及突触信号转导、神经投射调控和谷氨酸能突触等过程。作者据此推测，电休克治疗可能通过影响相关基因表达，经神经元和胶质细胞参与髓鞘重塑，协同调节兴奋-抑制平衡与功能网络活动，从而改善抑郁症状；这属于基于关联和空间转录组数据的机制推测，尚非因果验证。

papers.title: Every (slow) breath you take, every choice you make.
papers.authors: Kwon SJ, Dennis NJ, Delgado MR.
papers.abstract: Huang and colleagues investigated how slow-paced breathing shapes physiological and brain-related signals during financial decisions under risk. Their findings elucidate neurovisceral pathways linking prolonged exhalation to increased risk-taking, whereby heightened cardiac parasympathetic modulation increases reward sensitivity and neural activity in brain regions involved in valuation and interoception.

papers.title: Altered pain processing and associated neural circuitry disruptions in adolescents with early-onset psychosis.
papers.authors: van der Heijden H, Cao A, van Gool R, Yekedüz MK, Vrolix L, Barrett T, Randall ET, Golden M, Goldman M, Lu B, Chang JC, Glahn DC, Fogler JM, Sethna N, Gonzalez-Heydrich J, Upadhyay J.
papers.abstract: Background Abnormal pain processing and somatosensory aversions are underappreciated clinical features of early onset psychosis (EOP). We aimed to identify their clinical, neurobehavioral, and brain circuit level correlates. Methods Clinical assessments and child (ages 12-18 years) and parent-reported outcomes were administered to adolescents with EOP (N = 31) and compared to chronic pain (CP, N = 27), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD, N = 30), and healthy control (HCs, N = 20) cohorts. Adolescents with EOP and HCs were additionally phenotyped using quantitative sensory testing (QST), cognitive tasks, and structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The EOP cohort also completed a questionnaire battery at baseline and 6 months. Results Adolescents with EOP showed more severe pain and somatosensory aversions than those with ADHD or HCs, but less than CP patients; these reports remained stable at follow-up. Among patients with EOP, thermal sensitivities on QST were associated with negative symptom severity and self-reported cognitive difficulties. Functional MRI revealed increased pain-evoked responses in the striatum and elevated cortico-striatal-thalamic connectivity in EOP relative to HCs. Striatal connectivity patterns, spatially corresponding to dopamine transporter density, were linked to negative symptoms and pain-related parameters. Structurally, individuals with EOP showed reduced striatal and paracentral volumes. More reduced nucleus accumbens volume associated with greater frequency of pain episodes. Conclusions This study shows a preliminarily association between disruptions in cortico-striatal-thalamic circuitry, pain processing, and somatosensory disturbances in EOP. Upon further longitudinal validation in a larger cohort, markers of altered pain processing may provide a clinically accessible index of neurobiological disturbances underlying psychopathology in EOP.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早发精神病青少年中常被忽视的疼痛加工异常及其神经环路关联，将患者与慢性疼痛、注意缺陷多动障碍青少年及健康对照进行比较，并结合临床评估、定量感觉测试、认知任务和结构及功能磁共振成像。结果显示，早发精神病青少年的疼痛与躯体感觉厌恶比多动障碍组和健康对照更严重，但轻于慢性疼痛组，且随访时保持稳定；患者的热敏感性与阴性症状及自报认知困难相关，疼痛诱发反应在纹状体增强，皮质-纹状体-丘脑连接升高，纹状体连接模式与阴性症状和疼痛指标相关，同时存在纹状体及旁中央区体积减小。作者据此提出，皮质-纹状体-丘脑环路紊乱可能与早发精神病的疼痛加工和躯体感觉异常存在初步关联，但强调这尚属初步发现，需在更大样本中纵向验证，不能据此推断因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Exploring the reconfiguration effects of physical fatigue on the gradient space of brain function based on EEG.
papers.authors: Yang G, Chi P, Zhao S.
papers.abstract: Objective This study examined how physical fatigue reorganizes the low-dimensional structure of EEG functional connectivity using three embedding approaches. Method Thirty male participants completed a Bruce treadmill test to exhaustion, with resting-state EEG recorded before and after exercise. Frequency-specific wPLI connectivity matrices were analyzed using PCA, Laplacian eigenmaps, and diffusion maps with common-reference alignment. Regional G1-G3 scores, G1-G2 displacement, λ1-λ3 eigenvalues, and their associations with exercise duration were assessed. Results PCA showed increased beta-band G1 scores over the central scalp region and decreased scores over the occipital region, together with reduced alpha-band G3 over the central region. LE showed increased theta-band G3 over the central region. PCA displacement exhibited a significant frequency band × scalp region interaction, driven by greater alpha-band occipital displacement. Theta-band λ1-λ3 increased with PCA but decreased with DM, whereas LE showed no significant eigenvalue changes. The PCA-derived beta-band central ΔG1 was positively correlated with exhaustive exercise duration (r = 0.50, p = 0.004). Conclusions Physical fatigue induces frequency-, region-, component-, and method-specific reorganization of the low-dimensional structure of scalp-level EEG functional connectivity. PCA was particularly sensitive to spatially differentiated gradient changes, while LE and DM captured complementary aspects of fatigue-related reorganization. The association between central beta-band ΔG1 and exercise duration further suggests potential behavioral relevance of gradient.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电功能连接的低维嵌入方法，考察体力疲劳如何重组大脑功能梯度空间。30名男性完成力竭跑台测试，比较运动前后静息态脑电。结果显示，疲劳引起的梯度变化因频段、头皮区域、成分和嵌入方法而异：主成分分析对空间分化较敏感，拉普拉斯特征映射和扩散映射则捕捉到互补的重组特征；中央区β频段梯度变化还与力竭运动时长呈正相关，提示其可能具有行为相关性。

papers.title: Multisite evaluation of BrainNetCNN for ADHD classification from static and dynamic rs-fMRI functional connectivity.
papers.authors: López CQ, Vera VDG, Ospina López JP, Rodríguez Torres CE, Gallego A.
papers.abstract: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) has been associated with altered integration across large-scale brain networks. Temporal fluctuations in functional organization and differences between acquisition centers complicate classification based on resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI). This study used BrainNetCNN as the reference architecture to examine how region-of-interest (ROI) dimensionality, connectivity representation, network design, window configuration and acquisition site influence ADHD discrimination. The sample included 465 participants from four ADHD-200 centers: New York University (NYU; n = 177), Peking University (Peking; n = 183), NeuroIMAGE (n = 39) and Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU; n = 66). Functional connectivity was derived from regional blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) time series using prespecified 12, 18, 39 and 116-ROI panels from the Automated Anatomical Labeling atlas (AAL116). The reference window was 120 s with an approximately 12-s step. Within each center, classification was assessed through participant-level stratified 10-fold cross-validation repeated five times, with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) as the primary metric. BrainNetCNN was configured using NYU data and then kept fixed for evaluation at the remaining centers. Across site-by-ROI combinations, AUC ranged from 50.1% to 64.5%. The 12-ROI configuration reached 63.6% in both NYU and Peking, while the strongest panel differed across centers. Comparisons involving static connectivity, long short-term memory (LSTM), gated recurrent unit (GRU), DeepSets, logistic regression and alternative window settings revealed no consistent advantage. Leave-one-site-out analyses yielded AUCs from 44.4% to 63.9%, with 14 of 16 pointwise 95% confidence intervals including 0.50. Overall, the models showed modest site-dependent discrimination and limited cross-site transportability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以BrainNetCNN为参考架构，考察感兴趣区维度、连接表示、网络设计、窗口设置和采集中心如何影响基于静息态功能磁共振的ADHD分类，数据来自四个ADHD-200中心，采用参与者层面的交叉验证并以AUC为主要指标。结果显示，各中心与感兴趣区组合的AUC仅在50.1%至64.5%之间，12-ROI配置在纽约大学和北京大学均达到63.6%，但表现最好的配置因中心而异；与静态连接、多种替代模型及其他窗口设置的比较未显示一致优势。留一中心分析中多数置信区间包含0.50，说明模型区分能力有限且依赖采集中心，跨中心可迁移性不足。

papers.title: Age-related compression of posterior cingulate-retrosplenial connectivity gradients and its association with allocentric navigation.
papers.authors: Liu J, Zhang Y, Xue Y, Yang Y, Zhao H, He Q, Liao C.
papers.abstract: Allocentric spatial navigation declines with age, but the underlying neural mechanisms remain unclear. The posterior cingulate/retrosplenial cortex (PCC/RSC) is an integrative navigation hub and is also among the earliest regions affected by aging. We investigated whether the PCC/RSC is organized along continuous functional connectivity gradients, and how these gradients relate to age and spatial navigation ability. Using an adult-lifespan sample from the Southwest University Adult Lifespan Dataset (SALD; n = 479; age range = 19-80 years), we characterized functional connectivity gradients within the PCC/RSC complex and examined their associations with age. Two dominant functional connectivity gradients (G1 and G2) were identified within the PCC/RSC complex. The ranges of both gradients decreased significantly with age. In an independent navigation sample comprising 19 younger and 19 older adults, participants underwent resting-state fMRI and task-based fMRI while performing an allocentric object-location memory task. We examined whether age-related gradient compression was also evident in this independent navigation sample and whether gradient range was associated with navigation performance. Older adults showed smaller task-state left G1, task-state right G2, and resting-state right G2 ranges, with the largest reduction in task-state left G1 (approximately 65%). Among older adults, greater task-state left G1 range was associated with lower drop error. These findings provide novel evidence that age-related compression of PCC/RSC functional organization is behaviorally relevant to allocentric navigation decline.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注衰老过程中异我中心空间导航能力下降的神经机制，考察后扣带/压后皮层（PCC/RSC）是否沿连续的功能连接梯度组织，以及这些梯度与年龄和导航表现的关系。作者在成人毕生样本中识别出两条主要功能连接梯度，发现其范围随年龄增长而缩小；在一个独立的导航样本中，老年人任务态和静息态下的梯度范围同样减小，其中任务态左侧梯度缩减最明显。在老年人中，任务态左侧梯度范围较大者导航误差较小，提示PCC/RSC功能组织的年龄相关压缩与异我中心导航衰退存在行为关联。

papers.title: Evolutionary conservation of MECP2 and its relevance to neuronal stability and behavioral adaptation.
papers.authors: Braun M, Tabach Y.
papers.abstract: MECP2 encodes a methyl-DNA-binding chromatin protein whose dosage is critical for nervous system function: loss-of-function variants cause Rett syndrome, whereas increased dosage causes MECP2 duplication syndrome. Despite extensive research on MECP2 in neurodevelopmental diseases, its unexplored evolutionary history, which we derived from comparative genomic analysis of hundreds of species, provides a novel evolutionary framework for understanding the profound consequences of MECP2 perturbation on brain and behavior. In this review, we analyze the phylogenetic profile of MECP2 and discuss how comparative, molecular, and developmental evidence supports the idea that MECP2 gained significant importance in vertebrate nervous systems. This is because broad CpG methylation, postnatal accumulation of neuronal non-CpG methylation, and long-lived post-mitotic circuits created a growing need for stable yet flexible interpretation of methylation states. We further discuss evidence that MECP2 is functionally anchored to a conserved chromatin-repression axis, particularly the NCoR/SMRT corepressor machinery, while also showing signs of more lineage-restricted integration with mammalian dosage-sensitive regulatory networks. We propose that MECP2 is best understood as a vertebrate-specialized regulator that helps preserve transcriptional homeostasis in mature neurons while allowing experience-dependent plasticity. This framework links methylome interpretation to behavioral adaptation and may help explain why MECP2 dysregulation produces such profound and dosage-sensitive consequences for brain function and behavior.

papers.title: ROI-informed cross-modal supervised contrastive learning for multimodal depression classification using rs-fMRI and T1-weighted MRI.
papers.authors: Byeon J, Lee H, Jang M, Yoon S, Lee H.
papers.abstract: Neuroimaging-based classification of depression-related symptom and diagnostic groups remains challenging because of clinical and neurobiological heterogeneity. Structural MRI and resting-state functional MRI provide complementary information, but most multimodal approaches rely on global fusion and do not incorporate region-level (ROI) information into cross-modal alignment. We propose a two-stage multimodal framework for depression classification based on ROI-informed cross-modal supervised contrastive learning (RCSCL), which does not require explicit ROI-to-ROI correspondence. Utilizing the Schaefer 200 atlas, we extracted ROI tokens using a MedicalNet-pretrained 3D ResNet-18 for structural MRI and a graph attention network for resting-state fMRI. The tokens were aggregated with attention pooling and the resulting modality-level representations were aligned in a shared embedding space using class-conditional supervised contrastive learning. Global features were then fused using self-attention, and the classification model was optimized using focal loss to address class imbalance. The framework was evaluated on an in-house single-center dataset of 500 subjects and the publicly available SRPBS multi-site MDD dataset. In the primary attention-based implementation, RCSCL significantly increased AUC/AUPRC from 0.805/0.326 to 0.855/0.410 in the in-house dataset and from 0.736/0.704 to 0.766/0.744 on SRPBS, numerically exceeding those of all evaluated fusion baselines without RCSCL; extending RCSCL to these backbones produced further but backbone-dependent gains. Hierarchical visualization analyses identified default mode, limbic, and prefrontal regions as recurrently salient, consistent with prior depression neuroimaging findings, although these attention-derived importance values are model-internal indices. These results suggest that ROI-informed multimodal contrastive learning improves class-discriminative representation learning for multimodal depression classification.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对抑郁症多模态神经影像分类中临床与神经生物学异质性带来的困难，提出一种基于感兴趣区（ROI）信息引导的跨模态监督对比学习框架，将结构MRI与静息态功能MRI的ROI特征在共享嵌入空间中对齐后再融合分类，并在单中心自建数据集和多站点公开数据集上评估。结果显示，引入该对比学习后分类的AUC与AUPRC均有提升，且数值上高于所比较的未使用该方法的融合基线；迁移到其他骨干网络时增益存在骨干依赖。可视化分析反复凸显默认网络、边缘系统和前额叶区域，但作者强调这些仅为模型内部的重要性指标，提示该方法有助于改善类别判别性表征学习。

papers.title: Beyond replication: Technological transmission and adaptive organization of modern human populations during the terminal Pleistocene at Fenghuangling, North China.
papers.authors: Cao Y, Yi M, Sun Q, Xing Z, Ren J, Li G, Ge J, Chen F, Zhang X.
papers.abstract: How technological knowledge is transmitted and transformed remains a central topic in human evolution and behavioral ecology. During the Last Glacial Maximum and the subsequent deglaciation, climatic instability and associated demographic shifts provide an ideal window for understanding these processes. To investigate the behavioral mechanisms of technological transmission, this study analyzes the lithic assemblage from the Fenghuangling site (19-15 ka BP) in North China. By combining three-dimensional geometric morphometrics, Gaussian mixture modeling, scar pattern analysis, and chaîne opératoire analysis, we systematically evaluated microblade core morphology, operational sequences, and raw material organizational strategies. Model-based geometric morphometrics revealed substantial morphological admixture between the Northern Microblade Industry and the boat-shaped core tradition of lower-latitude North China, demonstrating technological fusion rather than wholesale replication. While the volumetric concept of the Northern Microblade Industry was reproduced, complex and skill-intensive procedural stages were simplified-a pattern that is interpretable within the transmission-cost frameworks. Cortex and debitage analyses further revealed a three-tier raw material organizational structure incorporating curated personal toolkits and expedient flake production, reflecting deliberate raw material diversification in response to deglacial instability. These findings demonstrate that the technological diffusion was not a process of passive replacement but a dynamic mechanism involving selective knowledge transmission and local adaptation, offering novel perspectives on hunter-gatherer resilience during deglacial ecological restructuring.

papers.title: Mapping reproducible brain-based depression stratification across clinical, cognitive, and neurotransmitter dimensions.
papers.authors: Colombo F, Fortaner-Uyà L, Cazzella T, Martone A, Monopoli C, Colombo C, Zanardi R, Carminati M, Fabbri C, Serretti A, Poletti S, Benedetti F, Vai B.
papers.abstract: Identifying reproducible brain-based stratifications across independent cohorts is critical for parsing heterogeneity in Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), yet robust profiles spanning micro- and macroscales remain poorly defined. We applied stability-based clustering to cortical thickness (CT) data from 1531 MDD individuals in UK Biobank (UKB), with replication in 144 inpatients from IRCCS San Raffaele Hospital (HSR). Two stable clusters emerged (normalized stability = 0.125) that generalized to a hold-out UKB sample with 96.5% accuracy (majority-cluster baseline = 59.5%). The clusters differed in widespread CT, largely reflected in global CT, with one showing cortical thinning, childhood trauma, and diabetes comorbidity. A two-cluster structure was independently replicated in HSR (normalized stability = 0.29), with a broadly similar cortical topography, although systematic CT differences between cohorts limited direct cross-cohort comparability. The clinical correlates identified in UKB did not replicate after correction for multiple comparisons. In UKB, mapping the CT differences between strata onto Neurosynth meta-analytic activation patterns revealed a ventral-dorsal gradient linked with emotion regulation, interoceptive, and motivational processes. Spatial correlations with 19 neurotransmitter receptors and transporters obtained from positron emission tomography identified the dopamine transporter as the dominant contributor in UKB, and the histamine H3 receptor in HSR. These findings provide a reproducible framework linking CT-based clusters in MDD to multiscale biological organization, although their clinical relevance warrants further investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍的脑结构分层能否在独立队列中稳定重现，并对英国生物银行抑郁个体的皮层厚度数据做稳定性聚类，在医院住院患者样本中进行重复验证。两个稳定亚型在留出样本中具有较高的归类一致性，主要差别体现在广泛的皮层厚度上，其中一个亚型表现为皮层变薄，并伴有童年创伤和糖尿病共病。该分层结构在独立样本中得到重复，皮层地形大体相似，但队列间系统性厚度差异限制了直接比较；英国生物银行中识别的临床相关因素经多重比较校正后未获重复。作者进一步将亚型间厚度差异对应到情绪调节、内感受和动机相关脑区模式，并发现与多种神经递质受体和转运体空间分布相关，但主导递质在两队列中不同。总体而言，研究提供了可重复的皮层厚度分层框架，其临床意义仍需进一步检验。

papers.title: The fetal heart-brain axis as a new frontier for long-term outcomes in children with congenital heart disease.
papers.authors: Hou S, Wang J, Mao B, Zhou Y, Wang J.
papers.abstract: Survival among children with congenital heart disease (CHD) has improved substantially with advances in prenatal screening, perioperative care and cardiac surgery. However, neurodevelopmental, cognitive-behavioural and health-related quality-of-life outcomes remain major determinants of long-term morbidity. Recent work using fetal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), fetal cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), Doppler haemodynamic assessment and placental studies suggests that CHD-related alterations in brain development do not arise solely after postnatal surgery or intensive care, but may already be present before birth. In normal fetal circulation, finely tuned coupling between the placenta, heart and brain preferentially directs oxygen-rich blood towards the cerebral and coronary circulations. Complex CHD can disrupt this streaming physiology, leading to reduced cerebral perfusion, oxygenation and metabolism. Placental dysfunction, genetic variation, inflammation and oxidative stress may further amplify heart-brain imbalance, making reduced brain volume, delayed white-matter maturation and abnormal brain-network development important intermediate phenotypes for later neurodevelopmental risk. This review discusses the normal physiology of the fetal heart-brain axis, mechanisms of fetal heart-brain-axis disruption in CHD, links with long-term outcomes, prenatal assessment tools and potential intervention strategies. We also identify key knowledge gaps and emphasise the need for multicentre longitudinal cohorts and multimodal prediction models, with the aim of shifting CHD care from cardiac repair alone towards continuous neuroprotection before and after birth.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦先天性心脏病（CHD）儿童长期神经发育结局，提出“胎儿心-脑轴”这一视角，梳理胎儿期心、脑与胎盘之间的血流耦合如何在CHD中被扰乱。作者综合胎儿MRI、胎儿心血管磁共振、多普勒血流评估和胎盘研究等证据指出，CHD相关的脑发育改变可能出生前就已存在，而非仅源于出生后手术或重症监护；脑灌注、氧合与代谢下降，加之胎盘功能异常、遗传变异、炎症和氧化应激，可能共同加剧心脑失衡，使脑体积减小、白质成熟延迟和脑网络发育异常成为日后神经发育风险的中介表型。文章据此讨论产前评估工具与潜在干预策略，并指出需开展多中心纵向队列和多模态预测模型研究，以推动CHD照护从单纯心脏修复转向出生前后的持续神经保护。

papers.title: Representation of fear memory features in the ventral hippocampus.
papers.authors: Milentijevic A, Cerquetella C, Nevian T, Ciocchi S, Forro T.
papers.abstract: Fear memories are essential for adaptive behavior, as they encode salient and emotionally valenced information that enables organisms to anticipate and avoid future threats. Fearful events are experienced as unified representations, even though they consist of multiple features with distributed sensory inputs across space and time that are integrated and imbued with emotional valence. Whether these features are jointly or separately represented by the memory networks in the brain and how such memories guide behavior during novel experiences remains unclear. Here, we use a virtual reality paradigm to disentangle spatial, temporal, and emotional memory features in the mouse ventral CA1 hippocampus. We show that distinct spatial and temporal representations emerge for context- and cue-related features, with temporal features transferring to novel experiences. The preservation of neural geometry, but not of individual neural identities, is prominent in pyramidal neurons and may, alongside dynamic modulation of interneuron activity, reflect a general principle by which selective memory features are maintained and adaptively exploited.
keywords: Temporal And Spatial Emotional Memory Features

papers.title: Multidimensional semantic activation in children's discourse reading is associated with their reading ability.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Zhou W, Wang X, Huang L, Wang S, Lin N.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Around fourth grade, children transition from learning-to-read to reading-to-learn, yet how their multidimensional semantic representation during discourse reading differs from that of adults and relates to reading ability remains unclear. This study investigated multidimensional semantic activation in 42 fourth-to sixth-grade children (mean age 10.3 years) and 44 adults (mean age 25.1 years) during story reading using fMRI. Children were stratified by reading ability using inverse efficiency scores from comprehension questions. Semantic activation across six dimensions (visual, motor, social, emotional, spatial, temporal) was modeled using the Six Semantic Dimension Database. Results showed that high-reading-ability children exhibited significantly stronger temporal but weaker social semantic activation compared to adults, whereas low-reading-ability children showed adult-like patterns. Brain-behavior association analyses revealed that multidimensional semantic activation patterns were linked to reading performance in children (explaining 25.0% of variance), whereas no such relationship was evident in adults. Additionally, high-reading-ability children demonstrated enhanced activation in cognitive control networks relative to both low-ability peers and adults. These findings suggest that high-reading-ability children may strategically modulate multidimensional semantic processing through cognitive control to compensate for limited reading experience, highlighting the flexible, strategy-dependent nature of multidimensional semantic representation during developmental reading.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注小学中高年级儿童在语篇阅读中的多维语义激活是否与成人不同、又与阅读能力有何关联，用fMRI比较儿童与成人阅读故事时的语义加工，并按阅读能力对儿童分组。结果显示，高阅读能力儿童在时间维度上的语义激活强于成人、社会维度上弱于成人，而低阅读能力儿童的模式反而接近成人；多维语义激活模式与儿童阅读表现相关，在成人中未见这种关系，高阅读能力儿童还表现出更强的认知控制网络激活。作者据此推测，高阅读能力儿童可能借助认知控制策略性调节多维语义加工，以弥补阅读经验不足，提示发展期语义表征具有策略依赖的灵活性。

papers.title: Patients with hemispheric epilepsy: Electroclinical characteristics and factors associated with intractability.
papers.authors: Kishk NA, Shamloul R, Mughazy K, Heikal ES, Nawito A, Baghdadi M, Rizkallah M, Khalil AS, Magdy R.
papers.abstract: Background Hemispheric epilepsy has diagnostic and therapeutic challenges and is frequently complicated by drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE). This study aimed to characterize the electroclinical and radiological profile of hemispheric epilepsy and evaluate factors associated with intractability to support individualized management. Methods A retrospective observational study at the Cairo University Epilepsy Unit included 83 patients with a strictly unilateral hemispheric structural lesion on MRI epilepsy protocol, with disease duration ≥ 1 year. All patients had a comprehensive clinical assessment (including QuickDASH), video-EEG evaluation (background, interictal/ictal findings, and concordance), neuroimaging review, and treatment outcome. Logistic regression was used to determine factors associated with DRE. Results In this cohort, the median age was 22 years (IQR= 14-31) with a near-equal sex distribution. About half had abnormal development, 36% had intellectual disability, and most had mild functional disability. Seizures started at a median age of 9 years (IQR= 4-16). DRE was identified in 54.2%. EEG showed hemispheric slowing in 32.5%. Interictal discharges were ipsilateral in ~75%, and ictal onset (when captured) was ipsilateral in 84.4%. MRI showed mostly left-sided lesions (95%). Etiologies were split between malformations of cortical development (MCDs) -mainly heterotopia/FCD- and acquired (notably post-injury and Rasmussen). Single-domain developmental delay, MCDs, and progressive acquired etiology are associated with DRE (OR ≈7.6, 31.8, and 193.8, respectively). Conclusions The outcome of hemispheric epilepsy is largely determined by the type of brain lesion, with MCDs and Rasmussen encephalitis conferring the highest risk for intractability. In contrast, static acquired lesions were more often associated with better seizure control.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在单中心回顾性分析了严格单侧半球结构性病变的癫痫患者，结合临床评估、视频脑电图和影像学资料，考察半球性癫痫的电临床与影像特征及难治相关因素。结果显示，多数患者存在同侧发作间期放电和发作起始，病变以左侧为主，病因主要分为皮质发育畸形与获得性病变；单域发育迟缓、皮质发育畸形和进展性获得性病因与药物难治相关，其中后两者风险更高。作者据此认为，半球性癫痫的预后很大程度上取决于病变类型，静态获得性病变的发作控制相对较好，而皮质发育畸形和Rasmussen脑炎最难治。上述关联来自回顾性观察，尚不能直接推及治疗因果。

papers.title: Resting-state functional connectivity alterations and neurodevelopmental outcomes in neonates at high risk of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury.
papers.authors: Li Y, Peng C, Liu L, Niu F, Yang J, Ji Y, Hou X.
papers.abstract: Background High risk of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury during the neonatal period may disrupt early brain maturation, yet its impact on large-scale functional network organization and later neurodevelopment remains insufficiently understood. Methods Resting-state functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) was used to characterize cortical functional connectivity in neonates at high risk of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury and controls. Functional connectivity, multivariate pattern analysis, and graph-theoretical approaches were applied to examine group differences in network organization and their associations with developmental outcome. Results Compared with controls, high-risk neonates showed reduced functional connectivity predominantly within the frontoparietal network. Seed-based multivariate pattern analysis identified the left parietal lobe as the strongest discriminator between groups. Within the frontoparietal subnetwork, the high-risk group showed reduced clustering coefficient and increased global efficiency, suggesting reduced local segregation and atypical network reorganization. Clustering coefficient was positively associated with later Ages and Stages Questionnaire (ASQ-3) scores in both groups, consistent with a general developmental relationship. In contrast, higher global efficiency and lower nodal clustering in the left prefrontal cortex were associated with poorer developmental outcomes only in the high-risk group. Conclusions Neonates at high risk of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury show early alterations in frontoparietal functional organization, some of which are associated with later neurodevelopment. Resting-state fNIRS-derived connectomic measures may therefore have potential for early risk characterization, although further validation in larger independent cohorts is needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注新生儿期缺氧缺血性脑损伤高风险是否会影响早期大规模功能网络组织及其后续神经发育，采用静息态功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）比较高风险新生儿与对照组的皮层功能连接，并结合多变量模式分析和图论方法考察网络组织差异及其与发育结局的关联。结果显示，高风险组的功能连接降低主要出现在额顶网络内，左侧顶叶在区分两组时贡献最大；额顶子网络内聚集系数降低而全局效率升高，提示局部分离减弱和非典型网络重组。聚集系数与两组 later ASQ-3 得分均呈正相关，而左前额叶皮层较高的全局效率和较低的节点聚集系数仅在高风险组与较差发育结局相关。作者认为，这些早期额顶功能组织改变部分与后续神经发育相关，fNIRS 连接组指标或有助于早期风险刻画，但尚需在更大独立队列中验证。

papers.title: A Hierarchical-Dynamic integration model for the formation of interpersonal neural synchrony during spoken communication.
papers.authors: Bai Y, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: Interpersonal neural synchrony (INS) is widely observed during spoken communication, yet the cognitive and neural processes through which it emerges remain incompletely understood. This review synthesizes evidence on the functional significance, representational organization, and neural implementation of INS and proposes a Hierarchical-Dynamic Integration Model (HDIM) of its formation. HDIM conceptualizes INS as the cross-brain manifestation of ongoing coordination between two interdependent processes: multilevel linguistic alignment and contextual-intentional integration. The hierarchical organization of linguistic alignment encompasses functionally differentiated yet interacting phonological/prosodic, lexical-syntactic, semantic, and higher-order representational levels, without assuming a fixed bottom-up sequence. Its dynamicity arises from recurrent processes of prediction, imitation, and adaptation that continuously regulate interpersonal coordination as communication unfolds. At the neural level, HDIM proposes that linguistic alignment engages distributed bilateral language systems, whereas contextual-intentional integration recruits coordinated activity across language-related and social-cognitive/mentalizing systems. The model yields four empirically testable predictions concerning partial dissociation among representational levels, functional dependencies across levels, temporally differentiated yet interacting regulatory processes, and partner-sensitive integration of linguistic and non-linguistic information. We further identify uneven empirical support across components of the model, together with causal and methodological challenges and limitations in its current scope. We conclude by outlining priorities for causal and interaction-specific testing, computational formalization, and evaluation of the model's boundary conditions and generalizability across communicative contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了口语交流中人际神经同步（INS）的形成机制，并提出层级-动态整合模型（HDIM）。作者将INS视为多层次语言对齐与情境-意图整合这两个相互依赖过程在脑间的协调表现，其中语言对齐涵盖功能分化又相互作用的语音/韵律、词汇-句法、语义及高阶表征层次，其动态性来自预测、模仿和适应的反复调节；神经层面上，语言对齐涉及双侧语言系统，情境-意图整合则调动语言相关系统与社会认知/心理化系统的协同活动。模型给出四条可检验预测，并指出各成分证据支持不均、因果推断和方法学挑战及适用范围局限，呼吁开展因果与互动特异性检验、计算形式化以及边界条件和跨情境推广性评估。

papers.title: Normative clinical language data and task specific effects.
papers.authors: Stark BC, Themistocleous C.
papers.abstract: Language production in clinical populations varies by both neurological condition and discourse task. This study analyzes connected speech from 1394 individuals with left or right hemisphere damage, Traumatic Brain Injury, Mild Cognitive Impairment, dementia, or no neurological diagnosis. Participants completed narrative, procedural, and picture-based tasks. Using Open Brain AI to extract linguistic features across phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, lexicon, and readability, we applied mixed-effects models to examine effects of diagnosis, task, and their interaction. Results showed that task type strongly shapes linguistic output and interacts with diagnostic group across nearly all domains. Narrative tasks elicited more complex syntax and aspectual morphology, while procedural tasks prompted simpler grammatical structures and picture-based descriptions produced greater lexical diversity. Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection further revealed clear clustering by task type, reflecting a continuum of contextual constraint ranging from structured picture descriptions and procedural instructions to free speech and open-ended narratives. This gradient illustrates a shift in linguistic scaffolding: highly structured tasks tightly constrain the target lexicon and syntax, whereas open-ended tasks require speakers to independently generate and organize narrative content. These findings show that clinical language tasks are not interchangeable. Treating them as equivalent may reduce diagnostic accuracy and weaken comparisons with healthy norms. We propose an Open Brain AI task-specific framework for clinical language assessment to improve identification of linguistic impairments and guide targeted intervention.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析不同神经疾病人群在多种语言产出任务中的连接言语，用自动化工具提取多层面语言特征并比较诊断、任务及二者交互。结果显示任务类型强烈塑造语言输出，且与诊断分组在几乎所有语言层面发生交互：叙事任务引出更复杂的句法和体貌形态，程序性任务语法更简单，图片描述词汇更多样；降维分析还显示话语按任务类型清晰聚类，形成从高度结构化到开放叙事的语境约束梯度。作者据此强调临床语言任务不可互换，混用可能降低诊断准确性并削弱与健康常模的比较，并提出任务特异的评估框架。

papers.title: Recall of overlearned speech in noise: Developmental ERP findings and an episodic buffer frame for culturally situated brain activity.
papers.authors: D'Angiulli A, Sheculski M, Morrow A.
papers.abstract: How does extensively practiced speech memory remain dependent on momentary sensory input, and how does this interaction shape brain activity during development? This perspective integrates exploratory behavioral and event-related potential (ERP) findings from a culturally situated spoken-sequence recognition paradigm with a working memory episodic-buffer account. We reanalyzed data from children and young adults who had memorized Quranic passages despite limited Arabic comprehension. Participants heard incomplete passages with or without static noise and selected the missing final word from phonologically plausible alternatives. Noise reduced recognition accuracy, and children generally responded more slowly. Descriptive ERP patterns revealed larger, more spatially distributed responses in children, spanning early auditory processing, mid-latency positivity, and later negative activity. We propose that recognition requires temporary binding of acoustic input, serial and rhythmic expectations, visual response cues, and consolidated sequence knowledge within an episodic buffer under executive control. Noise may impair perceptual fidelity and matching between transient input and stored representations. Developmental ERP differences may reflect representational coordination rather than neural efficiency. These preliminary findings motivate testable predictions concerning cross-modal congruence, familiarity, comprehension, and independently measured expertise. Culturally embedded learning practices provide informative contexts for examining interactions among working memory, long-term knowledge, and developing neural systems supporting cognition.
papers.summary_zh: 该视角文章将一项文化情境下的口语序列识别范式的探索性行为与事件相关电位（ERP）结果，与工作记忆的情景缓冲模型相结合，考察经过大量练习的语音记忆为何仍依赖当下感觉输入，以及这种交互在发育中如何体现。研究对象为已背诵古兰经段落但阿拉伯语理解有限的儿童和青年；他们听带或不带噪声的不完整段落，并从语音上合理的选项中选出缺失的末词。噪声降低了识别正确率，儿童总体反应更慢；描述性ERP显示儿童反应更大且空间分布更广，涉及早期听觉加工、中潜伏期正波和较晚的负波。作者据此提出，识别需要在执行控制下由情景缓冲临时绑定声学输入、序列与节奏预期、视觉反应线索及巩固的序列知识，噪声可能损害知觉保真度及输入与存储表征的匹配，发育差异或反映表征协调而非神经效率。这些初步发现尚属探索性，作者据此提出关于跨通道一致性、熟悉度、理解及独立测量专长的可检验预测。

papers.title: Progression of White Matter Hyperintensities in older adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Liu J, Raz N.
papers.abstract: White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are ubiquitous on magnetic resonance images (MRI) in older adults. However, the rate and mechanisms of their proliferation remain unclear, as they are inferred mainly from cross-sectional studies and imperfect single indicators of theoretical constructs. To assess the magnitude of WMH change and its modifiers, we conducted a meta-analysis of 54 longitudinal studies. We found the increase in WMH burden over time (pooled effect size) even in the studies with rigorous participant health screening. WMH proliferation was faster in the samples with higher mean age but independent of sample's sex or ethno-racial composition. Higher prevalence of vascular disease in the sample and lower sample average of diastolic or mean arterial pressure at baseline yielded faster mean WMH progression. Lower baseline cognitive status in samples with healthiest participants was associated with faster WMH increase. Automatic and manual methods produced equivalent results, but manual intervention in automatic methods yielded higher estimates. We found no evidence of publication bias. To better quantify the WMH progression and the influence of moderators in future studies, we recommend increasing the number of assessment occasions, applying uniform protocols and instruments, using multiple indicators of risk factors and cognitive outcomes, adding assessment of metabolic, energetic, and hemodynamic properties of the brain, applying state-of-the-art statistical modeling methods, providing comprehensive sample descriptions, and reporting the results in greater detail.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述与荟萃分析关注老年人脑白质高信号随时间进展的程度及其调节因素，汇总了纵向研究以估计变化幅度。结果显示，即便在参与者健康筛查较严格的研究中，白质高信号负担仍随时间增加；样本平均年龄较高、血管疾病患病率较高以及基线舒张压或平均动脉压较低时，进展更快，而样本性别或族裔构成未见关联。在健康人群中，基线认知状态较低与更快的白质高信号增长相关；自动与人工测量方法结果相当，但人工干预自动方法会得到更高估计，且未发现发表偏倚证据。作者据此建议未来研究增加评估次数、统一方案与工具，并更全面地报告结果。

papers.title: Infant Attention to Eyes Versus Mouth Varies With Mouth Movement Speed, Family History of Autism and Language Development.
papers.authors: Agyapong M, Mason L, Begum Ali J, Johnson MH, Charman T, Jones EJH, STAARS Team.
papers.journal: Journal of autism and developmental disorders
papers.abstract: Purpose Patterns of visual attention to faces are mixed in infants with a family history of autism relative to controls. Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) often co-occurs with autism and could represent one source of variance in findings. Heterogeneity in language skills may represent another source of variance. We investigated longitudinal patterns of attention to eyes and mouths in infants with and without an elevated familial likelihood (EL) of autism and/or ADHD, and examined associations with language development. Methods The sample included 160 infants (EL-autism = 79, EL-ADHD = 31, EL-autism+ADHD = 21, Typical Likelihood (TL) of autism and/or ADHD = 29). We measured eye-to-mouth looking ratios of 5, 10 and 14 month olds who viewed pairs of faces with mouths moving at low (1 Hz), medium (6 Hz) and high (10 Hz/15 Hz) temporal frequency. Language skills were measured throughout infancy and at 36 months.
