Results Eye looking (relative to mouth) decreased as a function of age and was reduced for speech-like frequencies (6 Hz) compared to slower frequencies. Infants with EL-autism looked more to the eyes than TL infants, but this effect was attenuated in the presence of familial ADHD. Controlling for 14 months word acquisition, higher receptive language at 36 months was associated with greater eye looking. Conclusion Our findings confirm age-related changes in eye-to-mouth looking across development and suggest that variability in familial ADHD and heterogeneity in language skills influence attentional differences in infants with a family history of autism. Future family history studies should investigate this heterogeneity using neurophysiological methods.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究追踪有或无自闭症及注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）家族史的婴儿，考察其注视面孔眼睛与嘴巴的比例如何随年龄和嘴部运动速度变化，并分析其与语言发展的关联。结果发现，婴儿相对更少看眼睛的现象随年龄增长而减弱，且在接近言语节奏的嘴部运动速度下更明显；有自闭症家族史的婴儿比典型婴儿更多注视眼睛，但这一差异在同时有ADHD家族史时被削弱。控制14个月词汇量后，36个月时接受性语言更好的婴儿此前更多注视眼睛。作者据此认为，家族性ADHD和语言能力差异可能解释自闭症家族史婴儿注意模式的异质性，相关关联不等于因果。

papers.title: Depression and anxiety in vascular dementia: an update.
papers.authors: Jellinger KA.
papers.abstract: Depression with a prevalence between 20% and 86% and anxiety with a prevalence up to 72% most frequently coexist with vascular dementia (VaD) and reciprocally increase disease risks. Both psychopathological disorders are usually more frequent and more severe in patients with VaD than in those with Alzheimer disease (AD). Although there is a significant association between depression and all-cause dementia, VaD with depression has more comorbidities and higher mortality than without depression. A history of depression prior to dementia is more common than in AD, while its pre-disease state is a matter of discussion. Although the diagnosis of depression related to cerebrovascular disorders is based on the criteria of DSM-V, VaD/depression has been suggested to be a distinct subtype differing from late-life depression and major depressive disorder, whereas others reported broadly similar depressive symptom profiles across VaD, AD, and AD plus VaD. Depression in the course of VaD, which is frequently underdiagnosed and undertreated, has been related to a variety of pathogenic mechanisms, in particular cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD), cerebral white matter lesions, damage to fronto-subcortical brain circuits, neuroinflammation, impaired neurotrophic support, and imbalance of neurotransmitter/kynurenine pathways. Multimarkers, like high CSVD and white matter hyperintensity burden, the presence of visible perivascular spaces, inflammatory markers, neurofilament light chain levels, and other biomarkers may support clinical diagnosis of VaD/depression. Treatment planning should consider a modest response to antidepressants, while treatment of vascular and metabolic comorbidities may provide promising targets for its prevention and treatment. Electroconvulsive therapy and transcranial direct current stimulation as augmentation treatment of an adequate pharmacotherapy are potential strategies in the management of VaD/depression that is known to be often unresponsive to antidepressants only. However, their effectiveness needs further investigation to assess which interventions are appropriate and effective in clinical practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了血管性痴呆（VaD）中抑郁与焦虑的患病情况、诊断争议及可能机制。作者指出，抑郁和焦虑在VaD患者中相当常见，且通常比阿尔茨海默病患者更频繁、更严重；VaD合并抑郁者共病更多、死亡率更高，病前抑郁史也比阿尔茨海默病更常见。文章提到，VaD相关抑郁是否应视为独立亚型尚存争议，其发生与脑小血管病、白质病变、额叶-皮层下环路损伤、神经炎症及神经递质通路失衡等多种机制有关，而多标志物可能辅助临床诊断。治疗上抗抑郁药反应有限，控制血管和代谢共病或为防治提供有希望的靶点，电休克和经颅直流电刺激作为增效手段的有效性仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Cortical thickness signature of early-onset Alzheimer's disease across clinical stages and A/T1 biomarker profiles.
papers.authors: Zilioli A, Mohanty R, Rosenberg A, Matton A, Granberg T, Hagman G, Spallazzi M, Kivipelto M, Westman E.
papers.abstract: Background The cortical thinning signature of early-onset Alzheimer's disease (EOAD) is well established in dementia, but its emergence during earlier disease stages remains unclear. We investigated when it becomes detectable and whether it differs according to fluid amyloid and phosphorylated-tau (A/T1) biomarker profiles. Methods We studied 292 individuals <65 years who underwent 3T structural MRI and cerebrospinal fluid assessment of Aβ42/40 and p-tau181. Participants were classified as A-T1- subjective cognitive decline (SCD; reference group), A+T1-, or A+T1+. Cortical thickness and hippocampal volume were measured using FreeSurfer. EOAD signature regions were defined by comparing biomarker-confirmed AD dementia with the reference group and subsequently examined across A/T1 profiles in SCD and mild cognitive impairment (MCI). Brain-cognition associations were assessed. Results The cohort comprised 107 reference and 185 amyloid-positive participants (76 A+T1- and 109 A+T1+). EOAD dementia was characterized by marked cortical thinning in posterior parietal and lateral temporal regions. In MCI, cortical thinning was focal in A+T1-, but more extensive in A+T1+ who also showed hippocampal atrophy. At the SCD stage, focal thinning of the EOAD signature, precuneus, and banks of the superior temporal sulcus was observed in A+T1+, whereas no structural alterations were detected in A+T1-. Cortical thinning was associated with episodic and visuospatial memory performance in MCI, while no brain-cognition associations were observed in SCD. Conclusion EOAD-related cortical thinning is detectable before dementia and varies across A/T1 profiles, with combined amyloid and p-tau181 positivity associated with earlier and more extensive structural involvement.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早发型阿尔茨海默病（EOAD）的皮层变薄特征在痴呆前各临床阶段何时出现，以及是否随脑脊液淀粉样蛋白和磷酸化tau（A/T1）生物标志物谱不同而变化。研究对65岁以下、接受结构MRI和脑脊液Aβ42/40与p-tau181检测的个体，按A/T1状态分组，比较EOAD特征区皮层厚度和海马体积。结果显示，EOAD痴呆期以后部顶叶和外侧颞叶明显变薄为特征；在轻度认知障碍阶段，A+T1-者变薄较局限，A+T1+者更广泛并伴海马萎缩；在主观认知下降阶段，仅A+T1+者出现EOAD特征区、楔前叶和颞上沟岸的局灶性变薄，A+T1-者未见结构改变。皮层变薄在轻度认知障碍中与情景记忆和视空间记忆表现相关，在主观认知下降阶段则未见脑-认知关联。作者据此认为，EOAD相关皮层变薄在痴呆前即可检出，且淀粉样蛋白与p-tau181双阳性对应更早、更广泛的结构受累。

papers.title: Neural substrates of knowledge integration: differential effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) on angular gyrus and ventrolateral prefrontal cortex.
papers.authors: Zhang X, Lochner M, Joseph K, Gilboa A.
papers.abstract: Background Humans develop extensive knowledge systems throughout their lives, which are continuously updated in response to new information. One way in which prior knowledge is updated is through semantic integration, where related semantic facts are integrated to support derivation of new information. Methods This study investigates how anodal high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) applied to the left angular gyrus (AG; Experiment 1) or to the left ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (vlPFC; Experiment 2) influences semantic integration and the derivation of novel information. In both studies, participants were first randomly assigned to a stimulation or sham group. Following the stimulation protocol, they were presented with a series of intermixed pairs of related facts and asked to rate their familiarity with each. Participants then completed a semantic integration test following a brief delay, answering questions about novel information that could be derived by integrating the related facts. Participants' integration scores (primary outcome) and their correlations with general intelligence (IQ) (secondary outcome) were measured. Building on exploratory findings from Experiment 1, Experiment 2 was pre-registered to test the impact of stimulation on the correlation between IQ and integration. Results There was no overall mean difference in integration scores between stimulation groups and their sham stimulation counterparts (all p s > 0.10). Stimulation to the left AG resulted in significantly lower variance in integration scores compared to sham stimulation (p < 0.05), reflecting fewer stimulation participants scoring very low on integration. Conversely, stimulation to the left vlPFC reduced the correlation between participants' IQ and their integration scores (p < 0.05). Conclusion Self-derivation of new knowledge is a complex, multifactorial process that was not uniquely enhanced by stimulation of the left AG or vlPFC. However, these regions appear to differentially modulate performance by reducing variability for lower-performing individuals (AG) or decoupling the dependence of performance on baseline cognitive capacity (vlPFC).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察左侧角回和腹外侧前额叶的高清经颅直流电刺激如何影响语义整合与新信息推导，采用随机分组的真刺激与伪刺激对照，并在刺激后让参与者阅读相关事实对、进行整合测试。结果显示，两个脑区的刺激均未提高整合成绩的总体均值；但角回刺激降低了整合分数的个体差异，表现为极低分者减少，而腹外侧前额叶刺激则削弱了智商与整合成绩之间的关联。作者据此认为，新知识的自主推导是多因素过程，这两个脑区并非单独提升成绩，而是分别通过减少低表现者的波动、解耦成绩对基线认知能力的依赖来调节表现。

papers.title: Scanning and active sampling behaviours emerge from conserved insect neural circuits.
papers.authors: Freas CA, Wystrach A.
papers.abstract: Navigating insects often pause and rotate to sample their surroundings, behaviours termed scanning. These and other active sampling behaviours embody navigational uncertainty and are key for spatial learning, yet their neural basis remains unclear and existing models impose scanning behaviours rather than explaining its emergence. Here, we show that desert ants' scanning dynamics can emerge spontaneously from the same conserved neural circuits used for goal-directed navigation, without requiring a specialised scanning module. We built a biologically grounded model combining central complex steering and lateral accessory lobe oscillators and added a downstream stochastic inhibition of forward speed. This minimal system produced diverse, realistic scan dynamics; saccades, fixations, and reversals, whose features were qualitatively compared to high-speed video recordings of Melophorus bagoti scanning. Detailed analysis of these natural scans confirmed model predictions, including how scan structure depends on oscillator phase, goal-heading deviation, and navigational uncertainty. Furthermore, the model reveals that simple modulation of forward speed unifies a broad range of behaviours across ant species, from dashes to smooth oscillatory trajectories to pirouettes and voltes. Crucially, this model suggests a distributed control principle where forward speed acts as a single adjustable parameter, for both individuals and through evolution, to regulate the balance between goal-driven exploitation and information-seeking exploration.

papers.title: Multiscale Network Disruption of Auditory-Language Circuits Underlying Auditory Hallucinations in Schizophrenia
papers.authors: Murphy AC, Martinez A, Chen Y, Avissar M, Yalçınkaya BH, Sanchez-Pena J, Patel GH, Javitt DC.
papers.abstract: Background Auditory verbal hallucinations (AVH) are among the most disabling symptoms of schizophrenia, yet the network-level mechanisms linking auditory dysfunction to hallucination severity remain poorly characterized, limiting targeted therapeutic development. Methods Using resting-state fMRI and high-resolution surface-based parcellation (HCP-MMP), we examined auditory-language functional connectivity and mesoscale network organization in 56 patients with schizophrenia and 22 healthy controls (primary dataset, N=78). Pairwise auditory-language connectivity associations with hallucination severity (PANSS P3) were examined alongside auditory network community structure, assortativity, hub organization, and routing efficiency. To further characterize these parcel-level findings at the vertex level, we applied a region-growing approach to identify auditory-frontal connectivity patterns maximally associated with severity. In silico perturbation analyses tested the causal role of belt cortex connectivity. Key findings were independently replicated in 93 patients from the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCP-EP), for a combined total of 171 participants. Results Auditory-language connectivity disruptions were concentrated in belt cortex and specifically implicated ventral what-stream connections, with a vertex-wise analysis converging on the same anatomy. Auditory network segregation scaled with hallucination severity, with belt cortex emerging as the primary integrative hub governing auditory-to-language routing efficiency. Perturbation analyses showed that strengthening earlier-hierarchy auditory regions reduced network segregation more than strengthening later-hierarchy regions. Reduced belt cortex coupling and elevated network segregation replicated independently in the HCP-EP sample. Conclusions Auditory network disorganization scales with hallucination severity and replicates across independent samples, with belt cortex as the critical locus of connectivity disruption and network integration failure, identifying it as a candidate neuromodulatory target.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症患者听幻觉严重程度背后的网络层面机制，结合静息态功能磁共振与基于高分辨率脑图谱的听觉—语言连接及网络组织分析，并在独立样本中重复验证。结果显示，听觉—语言连接异常主要集中在belt皮层及腹侧“what”通路，belt皮层成为影响听觉向语言区路由效率的关键整合节点；听觉网络分离程度随幻觉严重程度升高，而增强较早层级听觉区比增强较晚层级区域更能降低网络分离。作者据此认为，belt皮层连接减弱与网络整合失败是听幻觉的重要相关特征，并将其视为潜在的神经调控候选靶点；这些发现来自相关性与计算扰动分析，尚不能直接推及临床疗效。

papers.title: Thalamic Dysconnectivity and Negative Symptoms in Schizophrenia Spectrum Disorder
papers.authors: Kunitoki K, Adhikari BM, Ankeeta A, Gao S, Ma Y, Straub K, Dos Santos Alves Maria G, Pagán AF, Warner A, Du X, Kochunov P, Hong LE.
papers.abstract: Background and Hypothesis Negative symptoms in schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SSD) are associated with poor functional outcomes and reduced quality of life; however, effective treatments remain limited. A better understanding of the underlying brain mechanisms is needed to develop better treatments. Neuroimaging studies implicate multiple brain networks in negative symptoms, though findings remain heterogeneous, potentially reflecting the multidimensionality of both symptoms and brain networks. Larger, more systematic dissections are required to identify the key hub(s) underlying negative symptoms. Study Design Structural MRI data from 394 participants (210 SSD, 184 healthy controls [HC]) were analyzed to identify cortical thickness and subcortical volume demonstrating both SSD-HC differences and associations with negative symptoms measured by the Brief Negative Symptom Scale (BNSS). Regions meeting both criteria were selected as seeds for resting-state functional connectivity analyses in 143 SSD patients to examine association with negative symptoms and their subdomains. Study Results The thalamus was the only region demonstrating significant structural abnormalities both in SSD and an association with BNSS total score (p-FDR<0.05). Functional-network-defined thalamic subregions were subsequently examined. Several thalamic hypoconnectivities were significantly corresponded with negative symptoms, involving thalamic subregions associated with the cortical default mode, somatosensory, medial temporal, and dorsal attention networks (p=0.001, a corrected <0.05). Blunted affect showed the most extensive thalamic connectivity alterations, involving the striatum, cerebellum, and temporoparietal junction/superior temporal sulcus (TPJ- STS). Thalamic hypoconnectivity with TPJ-STS was also associated with overall negative symptoms and anhedonia. Conclusions This study identifies the thalamus as a central hub of negative symptom-related dysfunction in SSD and highlights specific thalamic subnetworks as potential targets for circuit-based interventions. Keyword: Schizophrenia, Negative Symptoms, Structural MRI, Functional Connectivity, Thalamus
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症谱系障碍中阴性症状的脑机制，先以结构MRI比较患者与健康对照，找出既存在结构异常又与阴性症状相关的脑区，再以其为种子分析静息态功能连接。结果显示，丘脑是唯一同时满足这两项条件的结构区域；进一步分析发现，丘脑与默认模式、躯体感觉、内侧颞叶及背侧注意等网络相关亚区的连接减弱与阴性症状相关，其中情感迟钝涉及最广泛的丘脑连接改变，丘脑与颞顶交界/颞上沟连接减弱还与总体阴性症状及快感缺失相关。作者据此认为丘脑是阴性症状相关功能失调的核心枢纽，并提出特定丘脑亚网络可作为环路干预的潜在靶点，但这属于关联性发现，尚非治疗证据。

papers.title: Functional deficits of the inhibitory control system in children with ADHD: A task-based fMRI meta-analysis
papers.authors: Kammer E, Patil S, Huynh H, Gao Z, Cai W.
papers.abstract: Inhibitory control deficits have long been proposed as a central neurocognitive mechanism underlying childhood Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). However, neuroimaging findings remain heterogeneous, partly due to methodological variability across developmental samples and experimental paradigms. The present study aimed to characterize the neural architecture of motor response inhibition in typically developing (TD) children and identify reproducible functional abnormalities associated with pediatric ADHD using stringent, developmentally specific inclusion criteria. We conducted two coordinate-based meta-analyses using Activation Likelihood Estimation (ALE). Following a systematic literature search (up to August 2026), we identified 23 task-based fMRI studies reporting inhibitory-control-related activation in TD children (237 foci) and 17 studies comparing children with ADHD and TD peers (114 foci) during the Stop-Signal Task or Go/No-Go Task. \ Statistical significance was determined using cluster-level family-wise error (FWE) correction. In TD children, ALE revealed a robust inhibitory-control network encompassing the bilateral anterior insula (AI), inferior frontal gyrus (IFG), and the midline pre-supplementary motor area (preSMA) and anterior cingulate cortex (ACC). This spatial organization closely resembled the canonical inhibitory-control network consistently observed in adults, suggesting that the core neural architecture supporting motor inhibition is already detectably organized during development. In the between-group analysis, children with ADHD exhibited hypoactivation within the preSMA. Notably, this region demonstrated striking spatial overlap with the preSMA cluster reliably recruited in TD children during motor inhibition. These findings provide convergent support for inhibitory-control models of ADHD and identify altered preSMA recruitment as the key functional abnormalities associated with pediatric ADHD. While the neural infrastructure supporting inhibitory control is broadly established during childhood, children with ADHD exhibit reduced recruitment of a key cortical node within this network during motor inhibition demands.

papers.title: Contribution of cerebrovascular lesions to neurodegeneration and cognitive decline
papers.authors: Chen Z, Raeesi S, Metz A, Moqadam R, Chadwick K, the Consortium for the early identification of Alzheimer’s disease–Quebec (CIMA-Q), Zeighami Y, Dadar M.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Introduction Cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) lesions, including white matter hyperintensities (WMHs), lacunar infarcts, cerebral microbleeds (CMBs), and enlarged perivascular spaces (PVSs) are associated with increased risk of dementia. In this study, we aimed to examine their associations with risk factors, neurodegeneration, and cognition over a follow-up period of ten years. Methods 289 participants (183 females, mean age: 73.7 ± 5.7) with multi-modal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and clinical assessments from the Consortium for the Early Identification of Alzheimer’s Disease (CIMA-Q) were included. CSVD lesions and neurodegeneration were quantified using automated tools. Linear regression and mixed effects models examined the cross-sectional and longitudinal associations between lesions, risk factors, neurodegeneration, and cognitive decline. Results Risk factors showed the strongest cross-sectional associations with PVS number and CMB presence, and the strongest longitudinal associations with WMH and PVS volume progression (p < 0.05) . WMH and PVS volumes significantly increased over time (p < 0.01), with faster WMH progression among participants who experienced cognitive decline during study follow-ups. Higher WMH volume was associated with poorer global cognition and executive function, and presence of lacunae was associated with faster decline in executive function. Finally, both WMH and PVS were associated with longitudinal atrophy across several cortical regions. Conclusions Vascular risk factors were associated with CSVD burden and progression, and WMH and PVS progression were further associated with cortical atrophy and cognitive decline, underscoring the interconnected contributions of vascular risk, CSVD, and neurodegeneration to cognitive aging and dementia risk. HIGHLIGHT White matter hyperintensities (WMHs) and perivascular spaces (PVS) showed significant longitudinal increases over up to 10 years of study follow-ups. Vascular risk factors were associated with CSVD burden (PVSs, cerebral microbleeds, and WMHs) and progression (PVSs and WMHs). Greater WMH burden was associated with poorer global cognition and executive function, while lacunar infarcts were associated with faster longitudinal decline in executive function. WMH and PVS progression were associated with longitudinal cortical atrophy, linking CSVD progression with neurodegenerative changes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于CIMA-Q队列中同时具备多模态MRI与临床评估的参与者，考察脑小血管病病灶与血管风险因素、神经退行性变及认知在十年随访中的关联。结果显示，血管风险因素与病灶负担及其进展相关；白质高信号和血管周围间隙体积随时间增加，且白质高信号进展在随访期间出现认知下降者中更快。较高的白质高信号负担与较差的整体认知和执行功能相关，腔隙性梗死则与执行功能更快下降相关；白质高信号和血管周围间隙还与多个皮层区域的纵向萎缩相关。作者据此强调血管风险、脑小血管病与神经退行性变在认知老化和痴呆风险中相互关联，但上述均为关联性发现，不能据此推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: NOTCH3 cysteine variants alter the white matter lesion-brain volume link in the general population
papers.authors: Pluntz M, Lebenberg J, Chabriat H, Leutenegger A.
papers.abstract: White matter hyperintensities on brain magnetic resonance imaging are established markers of cerebral small vessel disease and typically associate inversely with brain volume in the general population, reflecting irreversible tissue loss. In Cerebral Autosomal Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts and Leukoencephalopathy, a monogenic small vessel disease caused by NOTCH3 cysteine-altering mutations, white matter hyperintensities may instead reflect tissue water accumulation and perivascular space dilation rather than net structural damage. Whether this distinct pathophysiological relationship is detectable at population level among carriers of NOTCH3 cysteine-altering variants without clinically manifest disease remains unknown. We conducted a cross-sectional neuroimaging study using UK Biobank data acquired between 2014 and 2023. Among 44,943 participants with complete brain magnetic resonance imaging data (mean age 64 years ± 8 years), 96 carried heterozygous NOTCH3 cysteine-altering variants within epidermal growth factor-like repeat domains 7 to 34 and 44,847 were non-carriers. White matter hyperintensity volume was automatically quantified and normalized to total intracranial volume. Brain parenchymal fraction was defined as combined gray and white matter volumes divided by total intracranial volume. Lacunes were manually assessed in all carriers. Linear regression and generalized additive models examined the association between white matter hyperintensity volume and brain parenchymal fraction stratified by genotype, adjusting for age, sex, lacune count, and vascular risk factors. NOTCH3 variant carriers showed markedly higher normalized white matter hyperintensity volume than non-carriers (0.83% versus 0.36%; P<10⁻⁸) but only marginally higher brain parenchymal fraction (81.1% versus 80.5%; P=0.03). In non-carriers, white matter hyperintensity volume was inversely associated with brain parenchymal fraction (β=-0.116% per 1% increase; P=3×10⁻⁶). In contrast, NOTCH3 variant carriers demonstrated a positive association (β=+0.51%; P=0.019), strengthened after adjusting for lacune count (β=+0.61%; P=0.006). A significant genotype-specific interaction confirmed this divergence (P=0.036), persisting across age groups and after vascular risk factor adjustment. NOTCH3 cysteine-altering variant carriers identified at population level exhibit a fundamentally distinct white matter hyperintensity-brain volume relationship compared with non-carriers, consistent with lesions reflecting tissue water accumulation rather than irreversible structural loss at this early, predominantly preclinical disease stage. These findings establish that genetic context modifies neuroimaging biomarker interpretation in cerebral small vessel disease and underscore the need for genotype-aware approaches when evaluating white matter hyperintensities as markers of disease severity or progression.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于英国生物银行的一般人群神经影像数据，比较携带与不携带NOTCH3半胱氨酸改变变异者的白质高信号体积与脑实质分数之间的关系。携带者白质高信号明显更多，但脑实质分数仅略高；非携带者中白质高信号与脑实质分数呈负相关，而携带者中却呈正相关，且在调整腔隙计数和血管危险因素后依然存在，并得到基因型交互作用的支持。作者据此认为，在这一以临床前阶段为主的人群中，携带者的白质高信号可能更多反映组织水分积聚而非不可逆的结构丢失，提示遗传背景会影响小血管病影像标志物的解读。

papers.title: Late-Pregnancy Immune and Kynurenine Signatures Predict Postpartum Depression and Brain Morphology
papers.authors: Harrington YA, Shin HK, Milano C, Mauri MC, Marano A, Maggioni E, Squarcina L, Tassi E, Enrico P, Persico N, Conte G, Melloni EM, Agnoletto E, Spadini S, Lorenzi C, Nasini S, Dall’Acqua S, Comai S, Poletti S, Origoni M, Brambilla P, Benedetti F, Milano PPDINFLAME Study Group.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Pregnancy involves profound immune adaptations that may contribute to the development of postpartum depression (PPD); however, the relevant biomarkers and critical time window remain unclear. Therefore, we investigated whether third-trimester and postpartum cytokines and kynurenine pathway (KP) metabolites predict PPD and whether these biological signatures are related to postpartum brain morphology. Methods Circulating cytokines and KP metabolites were assessed in 140 pregnant women during the third trimester and postpartum. Partial least squares (PLS) regression models were used to identify multivariate biological profiles predictive of PPD, followed by classification and regression tree (CART) analyses to evaluate predictive performance. In a neuroimaging subsample (n=61), voxel-based morphometry examined associations among PPD status, significant PLS-derived components, selected individual biomarkers, and postpartum grey matter volume. Results A third-trimester cytokine signature including 21 cytokines significantly predicted PPD with high specificity. A third-trimester KP profile, driven primarily by the kynurenic acid/quinolinic acid ratio, also predicted PPD, and the combination of cytokine and KP components improved overall predictive performance to 93.3%. Postpartum biomarkers showed substantially weaker associations with PPD. The cytokine component was differentially associated with postpartum grey matter volume according to PPD status, with opposite associations observed in occipital regions between women who did and did not develop PPD. KP measures also showed distinct associations within sensorimotor regions based on PPD status Conclusions Late pregnancy immune-inflammatory alterations are associated with subsequent PPD and postpartum brain morphology, supporting the potential utility of pregnancy-derived biological signatures for identifying women at increased risk for PPD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注妊娠期免疫与犬尿氨酸通路变化能否预测产后抑郁及其与产后脑形态的关系，在孕晚期和产后检测孕妇外周血细胞因子与犬尿氨酸代谢物，并结合部分参与者的脑影像分析。结果显示，孕晚期一组细胞因子特征可较特异地预测产后抑郁，以犬尿氨酸/喹啉酸比值为主的代谢特征同样具有预测作用，两者结合后整体预测表现进一步提升；相比之下，产后生物标志物与产后抑郁的关联明显较弱。细胞因子特征与产后灰质体积的关联因是否发生产后抑郁而异，代谢指标在感觉运动区的关联也有所不同。作者据此认为，孕晚期免疫炎症改变与后续产后抑郁及产后脑形态相关，提示孕期生物特征或有助于识别高风险孕妇，但预测价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: A Modality-Invariant Measure of Neural Health
papers.authors: Sanchez LA, Niebur E, Kang JY, Onyike CU, Sarma SV.
papers.abstract: Quantifying neural health with a single measure remains a major unmet challenge. Here, we report a physiological marker based on the spatial distribution of signal-derived energy correlates in the resting brain. We hypothesize that energy organization in the healthy brain approaches an entropy-maximizing, homeostatically regulated state characterized by five properties: lognormal energy distributions, balanced spatial allocation, statistical independence between regions, low energy variance, and temporal stability. Together, these properties define an energetic profile that the Neural Health Index (NHI) summarizes as a single score, computable from (scalp/intracranial) electroencephalography, magnetoencephalography, or functional magnetic resonance imaging. Across 808 participants spanning neurological, psychiatric, neurodevelopmental, and neurodegenerative disorders, NHI distinguished healthy from clinical populations with sensitivity and specificity exceeding 95% in internal and external validation, scaled with disease severity, tracked pharmacological treatment exposure, and generalized to unseen diagnoses. These findings support NHI as a disease-agnostic, modality-invariant candidate biomarker for disease stratification and treatment monitoring.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出并检验了一种基于静息脑内信号能量空间分布的单指标神经健康度量——神经健康指数（NHI），其假设健康大脑的能量组织接近熵最大化且受稳态调节的状态，并由能量分布、空间分配、区域间独立性、能量方差和时间稳定性等特征共同刻画。NHI可由脑电、脑磁或功能磁共振数据计算，在涵盖神经、精神、神经发育和神经退行性疾病的参与者中，能区分健康人群与临床人群，且与疾病严重程度、药物治疗暴露相关，并可推广到未见过的诊断。作者据此认为NHI是疾病无关、模态不变的候选生物标志物，可用于疾病分层和治疗监测，但其临床效用仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Onset–Rime Orthographic Representations in Early Literacy Development: A Neural Link Between Spelling and Reading
papers.authors: Wang F, Hasak LR, Dewan V, McCandliss BD.
papers.abstract: Abstract Visual orthographic knowledge plays a critical role in early literacy development and may provide a shared foundation for reading and spelling, yet the nature of its underlying representations remains debated. Behavioral measures offer indirect evidence and may be influenced by other metalinguistic processes. It remains unclear whether beginning readers encode larger orthographic structures, such as onset–rime units, beyond individual letters and smaller letter combinations but below the whole-word level. It is also unknown whether neural sensitivity to these structures helps explain the relationship between spelling and reading. To address these questions, we used a fast periodic visual stimulation (FPVS) paradigm in first- and second-grade children to contrast pseudowords constructed with the typical ordering of onset followed by rime elements (i.e., onset–rime) against matched strings in which the same elements appeared in the reverse order (i.e., rime–onset). Neural sensitivity to on-set–rime orthographic structure was associated with both spelling ability and word-reading efficiency and, critically, statistically mediated the relationship between these two literacy skills. These relationships remained significant after controlling for age and removing influential observations, and sensitivity to onset–rime orthographic structure explained additional variance in word-reading efficiency beyond spelling ability and age. Together, these findings provide neurophysiological evidence for onset–rime structure as an important sublexical orthographic unit in beginning readers, highlighting its potential role in linking spelling with efficient word recognition during early reading development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注初学阅读的儿童是否在字母之上、整词之下编码了首音—韵脚这类较大的正字法结构，以及这种神经敏感性是否有助于解释拼写与阅读之间的关系。研究者用快速周期性视觉呈现范式，在一、二年级儿童中对比首音—韵脚顺序的假词与相同元素逆序的字符串。结果显示，对首音—韵脚正字法结构的神经敏感性与拼写能力和词读效率均相关，并在统计上中介了二者关系；控制年龄并剔除影响点后结果仍成立，且该敏感性在拼写能力和年龄之外还解释了词读效率的额外变异。作者据此认为，首音—韵脚结构可能是初学阅读者重要的亚词汇正字法单元，并可能连接拼写与高效单词识别。

papers.title: Resolution-aware spectral parameterization reveals robust context-dependent aperiodic EEG dynamics during real-world table tennis
papers.authors: Guchait A, Chen C, Muggleton NG.
papers.abstract: Mobile EEG can link neuroimaging to natural behavior, but effects recorded during movement, and sport in particular, are difficult to interpret because neural activity overlaps with signals from movement, muscle activity, and cable movement artifacts. We analyzed the OpenNeuro Real World Table Tennis dataset to test whether peri-hit spectral activity could be analyzed and how it differed between human-opponent and ball-machine play. Data from 25 participants comprising EEG, noise-layers, EMG and motion recordings was analyzed with pre-hit, impact, and post-hit windows. EEG power bands were residualized using trial-level root mean square from noise-layer, EMG, and motion/miscellaneous channels. Spectral parameterization modeled spectra as an aperiodic component plus periodic peaks. The principal short-window model was resolution-aware; sensitivity analyses reduced model complexity, used a 2.0-s peri-hit subwindow (−1.0 to +1.0 s), or disabled periodic fitting. Results showed residualized alpha and beta power was lower during ball-machine play, including pre-hit posterior alpha power. The clearest context difference was a higher ball-machine aperiodic exponent over posterior and parietal sensors, corresponding to a steeper broadband spectral slope. Posterior post-hit means were 0.451 and 0.606 for human-opponent and ball-machine play, respectively. A focal parietal effect persisted across specifications. The results support artifact-informed, resolution-aware spectral analysis as an effective approach for detecting robust spectral differences between naturalistic visuomotor contexts and suggest that EEG may provide useful information about the processes engaged by different practice environments, without establishing a single cognitive or physiological mechanism or demonstrating a training outcome.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析公开的真实乒乓球移动脑电数据集，考察击球前后频谱活动能否在运动伪迹干扰下被可靠解析，并比较人对人与发球机两种对打情境的差异。作者用噪声层、肌电和运动信号对试次水平的功率进行残差化，再以频谱参数化分离非周期成分与周期峰。结果显示，发球机对打时残差化后的α和β功率较低，最清晰的差异是后部及顶叶传感器的非周期指数更高、宽带频谱斜率更陡，且顶叶的局部效应在不同模型设定下保持稳定。作者据此认为，结合伪迹信息并考虑频率分辨率的频谱分析有助于识别自然视动情境间的稳健差异，但未确立单一认知或生理机制，也未证明训练效果。

papers.title: An Adaptive Technical and Behavioral Approach for Biomarker Acquisition in Autism with Intellectual Disability
papers.authors: Stevens C, Eberle S, Carrow C, Tsheringla S, Cukar-Capizzi C, Wolf J, Naples A, McPartland JC.
papers.abstract: Autistic individuals with intellectual disability (ASD+ID) and profound autism are rarely studied in neuroscience research due to barriers including communication challenges, sensory sensitivities, anxiety, and elevated behavioral support needs. Consequently, biomarker development in autism fails to include the portion of the autistic population with highest support needs and greatest potential to benefit from treatments derived from imminent advances in personalized medicine. Here we present a multimodal, participant-centered protocol for simultaneous electroencephalography (EEG) and eye-tracking (ET) acquisition to advance clinical trial readiness research in this underserved population. The protocol combines individualized behavioral supports and an adaptive EEG-ET acquisition platform. Pre-visit caregiver interviews informed participant-specific research plans, including customized visual supports, reinforcement strategies, and EEG net desensitization procedures. A gaze-contingent stimulus presentation system used participant-preferred videos to support attention to experimental stimuli and behavior consistent with data acquisition (e.g., refraining from movement) while dynamically adapting stimulus delivery based on visual engagement with the assay and real-time assessment of data quality. By quantifying attended trials in real time and prioritizing unattended stimulus classes, the paradigm maximizes acquisition efficiency to minimize participant burden. This approach was utilized to deploy candidate biomarkers with demonstrated replicability in the Autism Biomarkers Consortium for Clinical Trials (ABC-CT): the N170 event-related potential to faces, resting-state EEG, and visual attention to human faces (measured with ET). Feasibility was evaluated in 76 children with ASD+ID (M age = 8.76 years; IQ = 32.4) and a small comparison sample of 8 children with intellectual disability without autism (M age = 8.91 years; IQ = 45.9). Usable EEG data (>7 minutes) were acquired in 61% (ASD+ID) and 88% (ID) of participants, respectively. Sufficient ET data were obtained from 67% (ASD+ID) and 63% (ID) of participants, respectively. Findings demonstrate the feasibility of inclusive biomarker acquisition and provide a framework for expanding participation of individuals with ASD+ID and profound autism in neuroscience research. Ongoing research seeks to evaluate this approach in larger samples and to demonstrate feasibility in multisite research studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对伴有智力障碍的自闭症及重度自闭症人群在神经科学研究中参与不足的问题，提出了一套结合个体化行为支持与自适应脑电—眼动同步采集的多模态方案，并以在临床试验中已有可重复性的候选生物标志物（面孔N170、静息态脑电、面孔视觉注意）进行可行性检验。在伴有智力障碍的自闭症儿童及少量无自闭症的智力障碍儿童中，部分参与者获得了可用的脑电和眼动数据，说明这一以参与者为中心、按实时参与度和数据质量调整刺激呈现的范式，有望让高支持需求人群纳入生物标志物研究。作者同时指出，目前仅为可行性证据，仍需在更大样本和多中心研究中验证。

papers.title: SAIL: Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretable Alignment of Human Vision and Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Gao T, Zhang L, Wang Y, Wang Y, Zhou H, Xue M, Yang G.
papers.abstract: Alignment between human high-level visual representations and those of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers a quantitative framework for understanding information processing in human vision. However, similarities between model and brain representations do not directly reveal the semantic content underlying their correspondence, as this content is difficult to isolate in entangled MLLM representations. Here, we introduce SAIL, an interpretable framework that formulates voxel interpretation as a multi-unit sparse semantic correspondence problem between MLLMs and human vision. First, we train unified crosslayer sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on MLLM representations of Natural Scenes Dataset images and captions, and align each brain voxel with multiple SAE units. Second, we quantify semantic similarity between their top-response image sets to map semantic alignment across the cortex. We project multiple semantic labels back onto the cortex to interpret the content of this alignment. Finally, we assess these correspondences using category responses measured in independent fLoc experiments. Compared with SAEs trained independently at each layer, SAIL exhibits lower redundancy in SAE unit response profiles and higher semantic alignment. We find that semantic alignment is organized along the human ventral visual pathway across the models and subjects examined. The projected labels reveal semantic preferences within canonical visual regions, while fLoc experiments show agreement between predicted and measured category response patterns. Exploratory analyses further reveal cortical distributions of action-related semantics consistent with established functional accounts of lateral occipitotemporal and posterior parietal cortex. Overall, SAIL provides an interpretable account of the semantic correspondences between MLLM representations and human visual responses.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出SAIL框架，将多模态大模型与人类视觉表征之间的对应关系转化为可解释的多单元稀疏语义匹配问题：先在模型表征上训练跨层稀疏自编码器，把每个脑体素与多个语义单元对齐，再通过比较图像集的语义相似性把语义标签投射回皮层。结果显示，相比逐层独立训练的稀疏自编码器，SAIL的单元响应冗余更低、语义对齐更高，且这种对齐沿人类腹侧视觉通路组织；投射标签揭示了经典视觉区内的语义偏好，独立fLoc实验也显示预测与实测的类别响应模式相符。探索性分析还发现动作相关语义在枕颞外侧和顶后皮层的分布与既有功能描述一致。总体而言，该框架为模型表征与人类视觉反应之间的语义对应提供了可解释的刻画。

papers.title: The Walking Brain: Mapping feature-specific cortical responses to naturally unfolding sensory experience in the real world
papers.authors: Altınkaynak M, Carlton LB, Topkoç E, Boas DA, Yücel MA.
papers.abstract: Understanding how the brain processes the everyday world is fundamental, yet laboratory paradigms exclude self-generated movement, unscripted events, and a continuously evolving multisensory environment. Wearable neuroimaging enables real-world measurement, but linking neural activity to uncontrolled sensory information remains challenging. Here, we extend a feature-based framework from naturalistic movie viewing to everyday behavior using wearable whole-head high-density fNIRS and participant-specific audiovisual recordings during movies and outdoor walking with no explicit task or scripted audiovisual sequence. Luminance- and sound-related cortical maps showed significant spatial correspondence, particularly in visual and auditory regions, whereas face-related correspondence was weaker. Luminance- and face-related maps were reproducible within individuals across repeated walks. Additional exploratory analysis demonstrated, to our knowledge, the first out-of-sample encoding of continuous environmental features during unconstrained real-world fNIRS, predicting cortical activity during held-out walking periods. Together, these findings establish a feature-based framework for linking cortical activity to naturally unfolding sensory experience in everyday behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何在无任务、无脚本的真实户外行走中，把连续变化的视听环境特征与皮层活动对应起来。作者用可穿戴全头高密度fNIRS结合参与者自身的视听记录，将自然电影观看中建立的基于特征的框架推广到日常行为。结果显示，亮度和声音相关皮层图在视觉与听觉区域呈现显著空间对应，面孔相关对应较弱；亮度与面孔相关图在个体重复行走中可重现，探索性分析还实现了对留出行走时段皮层活动的样本外编码。这些发现为在真实行为中连接皮层活动与自然展开的感觉经验提供了可行框架，但面孔相关结果较弱，且编码预测不等于因果或临床应用。

papers.title: Tri-Stream Disentangled Network with Adaptive Dual-Space Fusion for Electroencephalography-Based Image Reconstruction on THINGS-EEG2.
papers.authors: Zhou Y, Li J, Zhao K, Zhu H, Zhu L, Jiang H, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: Reconstructing visual stimuli from non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) requires mapping short, noisy neural responses to meaningful visual representations despite limited spatial sampling. Existing EEG-to-image approaches employ diverse neural representations and generative strategies, necessitating reproducible workflows that disentangle structural and semantic contributions. This protocol presents the Tri-stream Disentangled Network (TDE-Net), a computational framework for EEG-based image reconstruction. The protocol uses preprocessed THINGS-EEG2 recordings and organizes EEG information into a raw EEG anchor, a sample-specific functional graph stream, and a multi-scale temporal semantic stream. The graph stream captures frequency-domain relationships among EEG channels via graph convolution and cross-trial contrastive learning, while the semantic stream extracts task-relevant features via adaptive spatial weighting and multi-scale temporal convolutions. Structural and semantic features are mapped separately to variational autoencoder (VAE) and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) latent spaces, combined using development-set-selected fusion weights, and decoded using Stable UnCLIP. Across 10 participants, TDE-Net achieved a mean CLIP pairwise identification accuracy of 0.8135, with complementary metrics demonstrating structural and feature-space correspondence. Ablation and representation-level analyses further characterized the contributions of individual streams. This protocol provides a reproducible framework for investigating complementary EEG representations and diffusion-based visual reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对非侵入式脑电空间采样有限、信号短促且含噪的问题，提出一种用于脑电图像重建的三流解耦网络（TDE-Net），并在THINGS-EEG2数据集上以10名被试的预处理记录进行验证。该框架将脑电信息组织为原始脑电锚定、基于图卷积与跨试次对比学习的通道频域关系流，以及经自适应空间加权和多尺度时间卷积提取的任务相关语义流，再分别映射到VAE和CLIP潜空间，按开发集选定的融合权重合并后用Stable UnCLIP解码。结果显示，该网络取得平均0.8135的CLIP成对识别准确率，其他指标也反映结构与特征空间的对应关系；消融与表征分析进一步刻画了各流的贡献。作者据此将该流程定位为可复现的研究框架，用于考察互补的脑电表征与基于扩散模型的视觉重建，而非临床治疗应用。

papers.title: Leveraging Longitudinal DBS Recordings to Probe Pharmacological Mechanisms: Investigating the Role of Orexin Antagonists on Extended Amygdala Activity.
papers.authors: Raj J, Anderson E, Ray S, Fan JM, Moses Lee A.
papers.abstract: Advances in deep brain stimulation (DBS) technology now allow electrophysiological signals to be recorded from implanted electrodes in addition to providing stimulation. These intracranial recordings provide a rare opportunity to measure brain activity in human subjects over time in relation to symptoms and naturalistic behaviors. Objective biomarkers can be used to identify the circuit-level mechanisms of action of treatment interventions, such as pharmacological agents, in human subjects. Here, the authors describe methods for conducting long-term electrophysiological recordings in naturalistic settings during pharmacological interventions to characterize the neural effects of psychotropic medications. The authors present an illustrative case of a patient receiving DBS for their severe, refractory OCD with co-morbid insomnia in which beta activity was being longitudinally monitored from the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BNST). The authors find that dose reductions of a sleep-promoting orexin antagonist for insomnia, taken at night, significantly elevated the BNST beta biomarker of arousal overnight. This case study demonstrates a role for orexin signaling in regulating arousal-related BNST activity and highlights the utility of DBS recordings for identifying circuit-based mechanisms of action of pharmacologic agents.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨如何利用深部脑刺激（DBS）电极在自然情境下长期记录颅内电生理信号，以刻画精神药物的神经作用机制。作者以一例因严重难治性强迫症接受DBS、并伴失眠的患者为例，纵向监测终纹床核的β活动，发现夜间减少促睡眠食欲素拮抗剂剂量后，该唤醒相关β生物标志物在夜间显著升高。这一个案提示食欲素信号可能参与调控终纹床核的唤醒相关活动，也说明DBS记录可用于识别药物的环路层面作用机制；但结果来自单一病例，尚不能推广为临床结论。

papers.title: Association Between Domestic Water Hardness and MRI-Based Measures of Brain Volume: Evidence from the UK Biobank.
papers.authors: Sun Q, Yu L, Liu R, Zhu X, Qu J, Wang Z, Zhao L, Lv H.
papers.abstract: Background: While water hardness is a known factor in cardiovascular health, its influence on brain structure is not well understood. This study aimed to investigate the association between water hardness and brain volume. Methods: This prospective cohort study was performed with data from the UK Biobank. To assess the associations between water hardness and standardized volumes of total brain volume (TBV), white matter, and gray matter, generalized linear models were utilized. Potential nonlinear association between water hardness and brain volume were indicated by restricted cubic splines. Results: Compared with soft water (0 to 60 mg/l), hard water (>180 mg/l) correlated with reduced TBV (β: -0.06, 95% confidence interval [CI]: -0.09 to -0.04), white matter (β: -0.07, 95% CI: -0.09 to -0.04), and gray matter (β: -0.04, 95% CI: -0.06 to -0.02), with all P < 0.001. Restricted cubic spline analysis revealed linear relationships between water hardness and TBV. Conclusions: Elevated water hardness is associated with reduced brain volume. These findings suggest that optimizing drinking water mineral content might be a strategy for neuroprotection.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于英国生物银行数据，考察家庭用水硬度与脑总体积、白质和灰质标准化体积之间的关联。与软水相比，硬水与脑总体积、白质和灰质体积偏低相关，且限制性立方样条提示水硬度与脑总体积呈线性关系。作者据此认为，较高的水硬度与脑体积减小相关，并推测优化饮用水矿物质含量可能成为神经保护策略；但这只是观察性关联，不能说明因果，也不能据此推断改善水质具有保护作用。

papers.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of GPT-5 in Detecting and Localizing Acute Ischemic Stroke on Isolated Diffusion-Weighted Imaging: A Retrospective Case-Control Study.
papers.authors: Gökçen E, Kuşdoğan M, Erkoc MF, Albayrak L, Albayrak GS, Tanrıverdi D.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Multimodal large language models are emerging tools for medical image interpretation, but their performance on isolated diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) for acute ischemic stroke remains largely unexplored. We evaluated GPT-5 for stroke detection and vascular territory classification on preselected representative DWI images using a structured two-step prompting protocol. Methods: This single-center, retrospective, balanced case-control study included 220 cases (110 stroke patients and 110 stroke-negative controls). Four representative axial DWI slices per case were provided without apparent diffusion coefficient maps. Step 1 queried stroke presence and vascular territory; Step 2 queried the middle cerebral artery (MCA) segment-associated territory (M1-M4) following an MCA response. The reference standard was radiologist-neurologist consensus based on full multimodal magnetic resonance imaging, blinded to GPT-5 outputs. Diagnostic performance metrics and Cohen's kappa (κ) were calculated. Results: Stroke detection showed a sensitivity of 100% (95% confidence interval [CI], 96.6-100%), specificity of 83.6% (95% CI, 75.6-89.4%), accuracy of 91.8%, and κ = 0.836. Accuracy was 93.6% for anterior/posterior circulation (κ = 0.838) and 90.9% for vascular territory (κ = 0.799). Conditional MCA segment-associated territory accuracy was 71.6% (53/74; κ = 0.602); end-to-end accuracy was 66.3% (53/80). Exploratory analysis of the 18 false-positive cases identified four overlapping error categories: artifactual and physiologic signal misinterpretation (72.2%), chronic lesion misclassification (27.8%), terminological inconsistency or unsupported report statements (77.8%), and etiological scenarios or unhedged definitive diagnoses (38.9%). Conclusions: GPT-5 achieved high sensitivity and a specificity of 83.6% for stroke classification on preselected representative DWI images using a vascular territory-based diagnostic framework. However, the 16.4% false-positive rate indicates that positive findings require radiologist confirmation. These findings support further evaluation of GPT-5 as a potential clinician-assisted image-interpretation tool but do not establish a clinical decision-support role.
papers.summary_zh: 该回顾性病例对照研究评估了GPT-5在仅凭弥散加权成像（DWI）图像时检测急性缺血性卒中并判定血管供血区的诊断表现，以放射科与神经科医师基于完整多模态磁共振的共识为参照标准。结果显示，GPT-5对卒中的检出敏感性很高，特异性约为八成余，前循环与后循环区分及血管供血区判定的准确率也较高；但在已判定为大脑中动脉供血区后进一步细分相关节段时，准确率明显下降。作者指出，假阳性提示阳性发现仍需放射科医师确认，这些结果支持将GPT-5作为潜在的临床辅助图像解读工具进一步评估，但尚不足以确立其临床决策支持作用。

papers.title: Priming the Brain Before Chemotherapy: Chronic Stress and HPA-Axis Dysregulation in Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment.
papers.authors: Andrews L, El Khaldi Y, George T, Abuhamdah T, Knezevic NN.
papers.abstract: Cancer-related cognitive impairment (CRCI) is often attributed to chemotherapy, yet cognitive deficits are detectable in some patients before systemic treatment begins. This review examines a proposed two-hit framework in which cancer-related psychological and physiological stress contributes to pretreatment neural vulnerability, followed by superimposed chemotherapy-associated neurotoxicity. The review focuses on adults with non-central nervous system cancers. This narrative review synthesizes epidemiologic, neuroendocrine, neuroimaging, neuroimmune, autonomic, preclinical, and clinical evidence addressing chronic stress biology, pretreatment cognitive and brain changes, chemotherapy-related neurotoxicity, hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis interactions, and potential interventions. Pretreatment cognitive impairment has been reported in approximately one-quarter of patients, accompanied by elevated inflammatory cytokines, altered neurotrophic signaling, and changes in amygdala-hippocampal connectivity. The first hit may reflect interacting cancer- and host-related factors, including systemic inflammation, distress, sleep disruption, fatigue, pain, and HPA-axis/circadian dysregulation. The second hit occurs when chemotherapy inflicts superimposed neurotoxic injury, including white matter degradation, suppressed hippocampal neurogenesis, and blood-brain barrier disruption. The relationship may also be bidirectional: chemotherapy can perturb HPA-axis function, while glucocorticoid signaling may influence treatment response and antitumor immunity. Behavioral, autonomic, and circadian interventions are mechanistically promising, although neuroprotective efficacy remains uncertain. CRCI is likely multifactorial and may begin before chemotherapy. The two-hit framework integrates pretreatment stress-related vulnerability with treatment-associated neurotoxicity but remains hypothesis-generating rather than causally established. Prospective studies beginning at diagnosis and incorporating serial cognitive, psychological, endocrine, inflammatory, autonomic, and neuroimaging measures are needed to test this model and identify patients at greatest risk.

papers.title: Spatiotemporal feature-based investigation of major depressive disorder and emotion recognition using functional near infrared spectroscopy.
papers.authors: Chao J, Yang R, Peng H, Shi J, Shi Q.
papers.abstract: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) remains one of the most prevalent psychiatric conditions worldwide, with a marked increase in incidence and severity following the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite its rising burden, clinical diagnosis continues to rely on subjective assessments, lacking objective and reproducible neurobiological markers. Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS) has emerged as a promising non-invasive imaging technique capable of capturing the spatiotemporal dynamics of cerebral hemodynamics, particularly within the prefrontal cortex-a key region involved in emotional regulation and cognitive control. In this study, we propose a spatiotemporal feature-based framework for MDD classification and emotion-related brain state recognition. Thirty MDD patients and thirty demographically matched healthy controls underwent fNIRS recording while exposed to emotional auditory stimuli. By analyzing group-level differences in oxyhemoglobin concentrations and β _values derived from a general linear model (GLM), we identified significant prefrontal abnormalities in the MDD group, particularly under negative emotional conditions. These alterations were most prominent in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC), a region consistently implicated in emotion dysregulation. The classification model, based on fNIRS-derived activation features, achieved 90% accuracy for MDD detection and 85% for emotion recognition. These results demonstrate that integrating spatial and temporal features improves sensitivity to depression-related cortical dysfunction, offering a potential objective biomarker for diagnosis and novel insight into emotion-specific neurocircuitry in MDD. This work supports the clinical feasibility of fNIRS-based biomarkers and advances understanding of affective brain processing in depression.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注抑郁症缺乏客观神经生物学标记的问题，尝试用功能性近红外光谱结合时空特征分析来区分抑郁症患者与健康对照，并识别情绪相关脑状态。研究比较了两组在情绪听觉刺激下的前额叶血氧活动，发现抑郁症组在负性情绪条件下存在明显的前额叶异常，尤以背外侧前额叶最为突出。基于这些激活特征构建的分类模型在抑郁症识别和情绪识别上均表现出较高准确率。作者认为，融合空间与时间特征能提高对抑郁相关皮层功能异常的敏感性，为客观诊断标记和情绪特异性神经环路研究提供了线索，但结论仍属初步，临床可行性有待进一步验证。

papers.title: Auditory sustained potential as a biomarker of language functioning in children with autism and its implication in clinical trials.
papers.authors: Arutiunian V, Davoudi S, Gaougaou G, Knoth IS, Buckser R, Marcil V, Lippé S.
papers.abstract: Objective Most children with autism have language impairment, however, its neural mechanisms are not well understood. A potential biomarker associated with language in autism is a 40Hz Auditory Steady-State Response (ASSR) triggered by periodic click-trains which in electroencephalogram (EEG) evokes two types of responses - 40Hz steady-state gamma response (ASSR) and sustained potential (SP). Although these responses represent low-level auditory processing, they correspond to different stages of sound perception/analysis and are essential in processing of spectrally/temporally complex sounds. However, until now there were no studies focusing on the potentials of these responses in clinical trials. Methods The present open-label pilot study evaluated the effects of the probiotic beverage supplement Bio-K+ in children with autism (N = 19). Participants were assessed at three timepoints: T0 (baseline), T14 (14 weeks after intervention), and T22 (8 weeks after intervention, post-supplementation follow-up assessment), including EEG 40Hz ASSR and behavioral phenotyping. Results First, at T0 we showed a reduction of SP amplitude in children with autism compared to controls, and this reduction was associated with lower speech/language/communication scores. Second, the amplitude of SP became significantly more negative during the probiotic supplementation period and, by T14, was no longer significantly different from the observed in TD controls. Finally, these changes in the amplitude of SP were associated with improvement in speech/language/communication scores. Conclusions This study showed that the SP as well as its change was related specifically to speech/language/communication but not to other behavioral measures and has a potential to be used in future clinical trials.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自闭症儿童语言障碍的神经标记，以40Hz听觉稳态反应中的持续电位（SP）为切入点，在一项开放标签试点研究中结合脑电与行为评估，考察益生菌饮料补充前后的变化。基线时自闭症儿童的SP波幅低于对照组，且波幅降低与较差的语言交流得分相关；补充期间SP波幅变得更负，至第14周已与典型发育儿童无显著差异，且这一变化与语言交流得分的改善相关。作者指出SP及其变化特异性地对应语言交流而非其他行为指标，提示其有望用于未来临床试验，但作为小样本开放标签试点，结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Gray matter volume moderates the effect of acute physical activity on cognitive load and relates to reading comprehension in adolescents: the Cogni-Action Project.
papers.authors: Cristi-Montero C, Martínez-Flores R, Supèr H, Sanchez-Martinez J, Solis-Urra P, Tari B, Ibáñez R, Herold F, Paas F, Mavilidi M, Zou L.
papers.abstract: Background Acute physical activity reduces cognitive load (CL) and improves reading comprehension; however, the role of gray matter volume in these effects is unknown. This study examined how gray matter volume moderates the effects of physical activity on cognitive load, and explored its association with reading comprehension. Methods A total of 13 male adolescents (aged 12-13 years), a neuroimaging subsample of a larger cohort, completed a randomized crossover trial that involved three energy-matched conditions: sedentary condition (SC), moderate-intensity continuous training (MICT), and cooperative high-intensity interval training (C-HIIT). We measured gray matter volume in the hippocampus, pars opercularis, and brainstem using MRI. The primary outcome cognitive load (pupil dilation) was analyzed using within-subject permutation with max-T correction and bootstrapping. Reading comprehension served as a secondary, exploratory outcome. Results Physical activity was a significant predictor of cognitive load (p < 0.001). Comprehension improved for the C-HIIT condition compared to SC; gray matter volume alone did not predict these results. Volume significantly moderated cognitive load in a region-specific pattern: hippocampal volume amplified the cognitive load increases associated with C-HIIT [β = 0.26, 95% CI (0.21, 0.30)], while pars opercularis and brainstem volumes reduced the cognitive load (β = -0.30 to -0.32, p < 0.001); C-HIIT resulted in the lowest absolute cognitive load. Reading comprehension was higher under C-HIIT compared to SC (g = 0.87) and MICT (g = 0.50), with gains exploratorily associated with the pars opercularis volume (rho = 0.53-0.59). Conclusion Gray matter volume influenced cognitive load through its interaction with physical activity modality, with C-HIIT producing the lowest cognitive load. Comprehension gains under C-HIIT were exploratorily associated with pars opercularis volume, suggesting that specific neuroanatomical characteristics may complement activity modality for cognitive benefits in school settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察青少年灰质体积是否调节急性体育活动对认知负荷的影响，并探索其与阅读理解的关系。13名男性青少年完成静坐、中等强度持续训练和合作性高强度间歇训练三种能量匹配条件的随机交叉试验，同时用MRI测量海马、岛盖部和脑干的灰质体积。结果显示，体育活动能显著预测认知负荷，且灰质体积的调节作用具有脑区特异性：海马体积放大了合作性高强度间歇训练相关的认知负荷上升，而岛盖部和脑干体积则降低了认知负荷；合作性高强度间歇训练条件下绝对认知负荷最低，阅读理解成绩也高于静坐和中等强度持续训练条件，其提升在探索性分析中与岛盖部体积相关。作者据此认为，灰质体积通过与活动方式的交互影响认知负荷，特定神经解剖特征可能补充活动方式对学业认知益处的贡献，但阅读理解相关结果仅为探索性，样本量小，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Subject-independent classification of ADHD from pediatric EEG: a leakage-aware deep learning framework with interpretable neurophysiological mapping.
papers.authors: Geethapriya M, Pattabiraman K.
papers.abstract: Background The use of electroencephalography (EEG) in automated screening of Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) has created a large body of literature that suggests promising outcomes, with reported classification accuracies often above 90%. A major methodological issue suggests that a substantial part of these results are actually due to data leakage, whereby EEG epochs pertaining to the same subject end up in both training and testing sets, allowing classifiers to capitalize on features specific to the individual rather than on genuine disorder-related biomarkers. Methods We assessed the performance of three classical machine learning algorithms, namely, Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), and Support Vector Machine (SVM), as well as three deep learning models: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and CNN-BiLSTM, on a standard pediatric EEG dataset containing 121 children and 4,173 epochs. The performance of each model was compared in terms of both segment-wise cross-validation (Protocol A) and subject-wise cross-validation (without any data leakage, Protocol B).To evaluate neurotopographic plausibility without making unsupported causal assertions, we applied Deep SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to the best-generalizing architecture. Results The performance discrepancy was substantial. Under segment-wise evaluation, the SVM operating on power spectral density (PSD) features reached 90.0% accuracy (95% CI: [89.1%, 90.9%], AUC = 0.96). However, the same model dropped to 65.6% (95% CI: [62.1%, 69.1%], AUC = 0.72) under subject-wise evaluation-a statistically significant 24.4 percentage point collapse (p < 0.001, Wilcoxon signed-rank). In contrast, deep architectures learning directly from raw EEG were resilient: the stand-alone CNN lost only 2.5 percentage points, achieving 72.7% accuracy (95% CI: [66.0%, 79.4%], AUC = 0.72, recall = 88.0%) on completely unseen participants. Post-hoc SHAP attribution identified the highest relative contributions in frontal (F3, Fz, F4) and central (Cz) electrodes, aligning with established ADHD neurophysiology. Conclusion Hand-engineered spectral features are highly vulnerable to identity leakage, whereas end-to-end convolutional models generalize across subjects with realistic, uninflated performance. Strict subject-wise validation is strongly recommended as standard practice for translational EEG research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）脑电自动分类中因数据泄漏导致性能虚高的问题，在包含121名儿童的标准儿科脑电数据集上，比较了三种经典机器学习模型与三种深度学习模型在按片段划分和按被试划分两种交叉验证下的表现。结果显示，基于功率谱密度特征的SVM在片段划分下准确率可达90%，但改为按被试划分后骤降至65.6%，而直接从原始脑电学习的卷积网络仅小幅下降，在未见被试上仍保持约72.7%的准确率。作者据此指出，手工频谱特征容易利用个体身份信息，端到端卷积模型跨被试泛化更稳健，并建议将严格按被试划分的验证作为脑电转化研究的标准做法；SHAP归因显示额区和中央电极贡献较高，与已知ADHD神经生理相符，但这只是模型解释而非因果证据。

papers.title: Hierarchical reorganization of cortical and cerebellar functional gradients in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Liu Q, Zheng Z, Zhang M, Zhou S, Cheng Q, Cui L, Mei S, Hou R, Chen T, Xiao Y, Meng F.
papers.abstract: Introduction Parkinson's disease (PD) is a common movement disorder with heterogeneous clinical manifestations, and its tremor-predominant presentations may overlap with essential tremor (ET), complicating clinical differentiation in some patients. Functional gradient analysis provides a continuous framework for characterizing macroscale brain hierarchical organization and may offer candidate imaging features for disease characterization. Methods We first investigated surface-based resting-state functional measures and cerebral perfusion in 50 patients with idiopathic PD and 33 healthy controls. We subsequently incorporated functional MRI data from 17 patients with ET to examine alterations in cortical and cerebellar functional gradients in PD and ET and to evaluate their potential utility for distinguishing the two disorders. Group comparisons, gradient range and variance analyses, network-level analyses, and multiclass support vector machine classification were performed. Results Patients with PD showed widespread abnormalities in both cortical and cerebellar Gradient 1 and Gradient 2, whereas patients with ET exhibited fewer cortical alterations and no significant cerebellar gradient abnormalities. At the group level, both PD and ET showed broader cortical gradient ranges; however, only PD demonstrated significantly increased individual-level gradient range and variance. Network-level analyses further revealed pronounced hierarchical redistribution between sensorimotor and higher-order associative systems in PD, while ET displayed relatively limited alterations. The combined use of cortical and cerebellar Gradient 1 and Gradient 2 features showed discriminatory performance within the present dataset, with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve values of 1.000 for healthy controls, 0.960 for PD, and 0.889 for ET. Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) analysis indicated that both cerebral and cerebellar gradient features contributed to classification, with broader feature involvement in PD than in ET. Discussion These findings suggest that PD is characterized by extensive disruption of cortical-cerebellar functional hierarchy, exceeding the relatively limited alterations observed in ET. Functional gradients may therefore provide candidate imaging features for characterizing PD-related hierarchical reorganization and for exploratory differentiation of PD from ET.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病（PD）与特发性震颤（ET）在皮层和小脑功能层级组织上的差异，采用静息态功能磁共振与脑灌注指标，并结合梯度分析与多类分类模型进行比较。结果显示，PD患者在皮层和小脑的多个功能梯度上均出现广泛异常，而ET患者的皮层改变较少，小脑梯度未见显著异常；PD还表现出个体层面梯度范围和变异的增加，以及感觉运动系统与高阶联合系统之间更明显的层级重分布。作者据此认为，PD涉及超出ET范围的广泛皮层—小脑功能层级破坏，功能梯度或可作为刻画PD层级重组并探索性区分PD与ET的候选影像特征；但分类表现仅基于本数据集，尚不能视为临床诊断效用。

papers.title: Impact of motor guided imagery therapy on stroke patients with pain symptoms: a three-level meta-analysis and systematic review of randomized controlled trials.
papers.authors: Li X, Ni H, Cui G, Wei C, Zhu Y.
papers.abstract: Background Post-stroke pain is a common and intractable complication that hinders neurorehabilitation progress. Motor Guided Imagery (MGI), an emerging rehabilitation technique based on brain-computer interaction principles, has shown potential in relieving post-stroke pain, yet high-quality evidence on its multi-dimensional efficacy remains insufficient. This study aimed to systematically evaluate the effects of MGI on pain, sensorimotor function, sleep quality, life status, and psychological mood in stroke patients using a three-level meta-analysis. Objective This study aimed to quantitatively assess the therapeutic effects of Motor Guided Imagery for stroke-related pain and explore potential intervention moderators using a three-level meta-analysis framework. Methods Eight Chinese and English databases were searched from inception to June 29, 2025, to collect randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of MGI for stroke patients with pain. A three-level random-effects model was adopted to pool Hedges' g effect sizes, accompanied by heterogeneity testing, moderator analysis, influence analysis, and publication bias assessment. Influence-based outlier detection was implemented; analyses retaining all effect-size observations were treated as the primary main analysis, while outlier-removed analyses were reported only as supplementary sensitivity checks. Results Motor-guided imagery training significantly relieved pain (g = -0.524, 95% CI -0.779 to -0.269, p = 0.0006; negative Hedges' g indicates clinical improvement for this outcome) and improved sleep quality (g = -1.658, 95% CI -2.115 to -1.201, p < 0.001; negative Hedges' g indicates clinical improvement for this outcome) in stroke patients. Meanwhile, it significantly enhanced motor function (g = 1.395, 95% CI 0.963 to 1.826, p < 0.001), life status (g = 1.757, 95% CI 0.966 to 2.549, p = 0.0012), and psychological-emotional status (g = 1.729, 95% CI 1.045 to 2.413, p = 0.0002); positive Hedges' g indicates clinical improvement for the latter three outcomes. Moderator analysis indicated that acute-phase intervention (≤4 weeks) and high-frequency regimens (>5 sessions/week) tended to produce better analgesic effects, while age, gender, single-session duration, and pain location had no significant moderating effects. Conclusion MGI may produce beneficial rehabilitation effects that can alleviate post-stroke pain and synergistically improve motor function, sleep, daily-living ability, and psychological state of stroke patients. Exploratory subgroup trends indicated potentially larger effects for early implementation within the acute phase and high-frequency short-duration regimens. However, these observations should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating clues given non-significant overall moderator tests. Further high-quality research is required to confirm these findings. Registration The systematic review protocol was retrospectively registered with PROSPERO under registration ID CRD420261278812, after literature search and full-text screening had been completed. Systematic review registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261278812; identifier: CRD420261278812.

papers.title: Efficacy of acupuncture for sleep disorders in amnestic mild cognitive impairment: a randomized controlled trial with fMRI.
papers.authors: Qiu D, Li R, Yang J, Ding L, Deng J, Liu Y, Zhang J.
papers.abstract: Objective To access the efficacy of acupuncture in improving sleep disorders in patients with amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment (aMCI) and to investigate its mechanisms. Methods Thirty aMCI patients with sleep disorders and fifteen healthy controls (HC) were enrolled. Patients were randomly assigned to verum acupuncture group (VA) or sham acupuncture group (SA) for a 12-week treatment. Assessments included the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), and resting-state Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI). Results At baseline, patients with aMCI exhibited aberrant brain activity in temporal, frontal, parietal, and cerebellar regions compared with HCs. After treatment, the VA group, but not the SA group, showed significant improvements in both MoCA and PSQI scores. Rs-fMRI analyses revealed significant VA-related changes in the amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF) in the left calcarine sulcus and regional homogeneity (ReHo) in the cerebellar vermis. Changes in these imaging indicators were significantly correlated with changes in MoCA scores but not with changes in PSQI scores. Moreover, changes in MoCA scores were negatively correlated with changes in PSQI scores in the VA group (r = -0.536, p = 0.039). Conclusion Acupuncture could effectively improve sleep and cognitive function in aMCI patients. The treatment-related alterations in brain function may be associated with changes in the dermatome layer and the brain-cerebellar cortex circuitry. Clinical trial registration https://itmctr.ccebtcm.org.cn/mgt/search, Identifier ITMCTR2026000708.
papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验考察针刺能否改善遗忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）患者的睡眠障碍及其脑功能机制，将患者分为真针刺组与假针刺组进行12周干预，并设健康对照，结合认知与睡眠量表及静息态功能磁共振评估。结果显示，真针刺组在认知和睡眠评分上均有显著改善，假针刺组则未见，且真针刺伴随左侧距状沟低频波动振幅和小脑蚓部局部一致性的变化。这些影像指标变化与认知评分变化相关，而与睡眠评分变化无关；真针刺组中认知与睡眠改善之间呈负相关。作者据此认为针刺可改善该类患者的睡眠与认知，相关脑功能改变可能涉及特定皮层及脑-小脑环路，但影像变化与睡眠改善缺乏对应关系，机制解释仍需谨慎。

papers.title: The role of histamine in narcolepsy type 1: a narrative review.
papers.authors: Liang W, Yan X, Zhao Y, Zhang D, Fu Y, Sui G, Zhang W.
papers.abstract: Narcolepsy type 1 (NT1) is a chronic neurological disorder characterized mainly by impaired wakefulness maintenance and dysregulated rapid eye movement (REM) sleep, which markedly affects patients' daytime functioning and quality of life. The core pathological basis of NT1 is the selective loss of orexinergic neurons. The orexinergic system regulates histaminergic neurons in the tuberomammillary nucleus (TMN) through anatomical projections and functional excitation, while the histaminergic system contributes to cortical activation, arousal maintenance, and attention regulation. Therefore, the orexinergic and histaminergic systems can be regarded as interconnected and functionally complementary components of the arousal network. Previous studies have suggested alterations in histaminergic signaling in NT1, although the specific mechanisms underlying its role in NT1 remain incompletely understood. Current evidence suggests that histamine may play a modulatory role in NT1-associated phenotypes. This review summarizes the physiological functions of the histaminergic system in arousal regulation and discusses its interaction with the orexinergic system. It further analyzes the role of HA in NT1, its influence on clinical phenotypes, and related therapeutic strategies, with the aim of providing insights for mechanistic research and precision treatment of NT1.

papers.title: Hippocampal GluN2A knockdown differentially alters spatial exploration and behavioral performance in male and female rats.
papers.authors: Acutain MF, Silva FM, Castellari L, Baez MV.
papers.abstract: The hippocampus is the brain structure responsible for spatial information processing, map formation, spatially guided behavior, and memory consolidation. Although these processes are often treated as overlapping or even unitary, emerging evidence suggests that they depend on partially dissociable mechanisms. All these processes depend on hippocampal plasticity; more specifically, on NMDA receptor (NMDAR) function and signaling. NMDARs are tetramers containing two obligatory GluN1 subunits and two regulatory subunits whose expression is tightly regulated. Among them, GluN2A, the regulatory subunit mainly expressed in mature structures, is considered a key determinant of synaptic plasticity. Constitutive GluN2A-knockout models have shown impairments in spatial tasks, contextual fear conditioning, and object location memory. However, these models are limited because compensatory mechanisms could be activated during development. To overcome this limitation, we developed an AAV-mediated shRNA knockdown of GluN2A (GluN2A-kd) targeted to the hippocampus in adult Wistar rats, avoiding developmental confounds and enabling the specific assessment of GluN2A function in mature neurons. Our results show that hippocampal GluN2A-kd in adult rats selectively alters spatial exploration and the ability to update spatially guided behavior across tasks, revealing a previously uncharacterized role for GluN2A in the organization of spatial performance rather than in general memory processes. Additionally, we identified a sex-dependent effect of reduced GluN2A expression, suggesting that GluN2A-kd females may exhibit impaired spatial learning or rely on alternative or less efficient spatial strategies to solve the tasks. Together, these findings position GluN2A as a key modulator of the precision and flexibility of spatial behavior required for successful performance in the adult hippocampus.

papers.title: Seizures and epilepsy in MOG antibody-associated disease: from cortical neuroimmunology to clinical practice.
papers.authors: Li C, Hao L, Liu X, Zhou J, Ma W.
papers.abstract: Myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease (MOGAD) is an inflammatory demyelinating disorder distinct from multiple sclerosis (MS) and aquaporin-4-IgG-positive neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (AQP4-NMOSD). Seizures are an important but incompletely characterized manifestation. Their reported prevalence is strongly age-dependent-approximately 30% in pediatric-onset versus 7% in adult-onset cohorts, although these estimates are influenced by referral and publication bias-and clusters around cerebral cortical encephalitis (CCE) and FLAIR-hyperintense lesions in anti-MOG-associated encephalitis with seizures (FLAMES). This raises a mechanistic question: why is cortical MOGAD particularly ictogenic, and how does demyelination interact with lesion anatomy and inflammatory composition to promote cortical hyperexcitability? This review places the neuroimmunology of MOGAD-related seizures at its center. We summarize the epidemiology, age gradient and clinical spectrum-CCE/FLAMES, acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM)-associated seizures, isolated sentinel seizures, status epilepticus, new-onset refractory status epilepticus (NORSE), and MOG-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) overlap-together with the distinction between acute symptomatic seizures and autoimmune-associated epilepsy. We then examine MOG-IgG effector biology, the CD4+ T-cell- and macrophage-predominant pathology, B-cell compartmentalization, the meningo-cortical axis, and the Th17/interleukin-6-weighted cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) milieu. Candidate downstream pathways of inflammatory ictogenesis are presented with an explicit separation between MOGAD-specific associations and mechanisms extrapolated from epilepsy. Finally, we translate this framework into differential diagnosis, assay interpretation, electroencephalographic evaluation, immunotherapy-first management, antiseizure medication (ASM) review, neuropsychological follow-up and testable research priorities.

papers.title: The Dynamic Vasoactive Response of Cerebral White Matter Under Hemodynamic Provocation.
papers.authors: Zhu Y, Gee JM, Wang X, Dogra S, Veraart J, Ishida K, Dehkharghani S.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose The dynamics of white matter cerebrovascular reactivity (CVR) are affected by macrovascular steno-occlusive disease (SOD), but may further vary between normal-appearing white matter (NAWM) and microangiopathic white matter hyperintensities (WMH). Here, we assess the temporal dynamics of the white matter vasoactive response, including interactions between WMH and SOD using a dedicated computational pipeline to isolate transient maximal (CVRmax ) and terminal (CVRend ) CVR and newly isolated time-to-maximum (CVRTmax ) of the pharmacologic response to acetazolamide-augmented dynamic BOLD (ACZ-BOLD) hypothesizing differential temporal responses and hemodynamic phenotypes. Materials and methods Nineteen adults with angiographically-confirmed unilateral, chronic intracranial SOD underwent a total of 25 twenty-minute ACZ-BOLD examinations. Normal-appearing (NAWM) and microangiopathic (WMH) white matter voxels were manually segmented and classified into four tissue groups based on laterality to SOD, i.e.: NAWMcontra , WMHcontra , NAWMipsi , and WMHipsi . Median CVRmax and CVRend were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models. The time-to-maximum of the CVR (CVRTmax ) and the terminal-to-maximum CVR ratio (CVRend /CVRmax ) were additionally constructed and compared. Results Among the full cohort, ipsilateral WMH demonstrated the lowest estimated CVRmax . The laterality effect was in the hypothesized direction but did not reach statistical significance (β=-0.211; 95% CI:[-0.445, 0.023]; P=0.08). The tissue-by-laterality interaction also suggested an additional reduction in ipsilateral WMH but did not reach statistically significant differences (β=-0.293; 95% CI:[-0.624, 0.038]; P=0.08). Eight examinations from 8 different subjects exhibited paradoxical reverse-steal profiles, and upon their exclusion differences were amplified including significantly lower CVRmax ipsilateral to SOD (β=-0.579; 95% CI:[-0.794, -0.36]; P<0.001). Reverse-steal examinations demonstrated notably altered dynamics with delayed ipsilateral CVRTmax (P=0.004) and higher CVRend /CVRmax ratios (P=0.03). Conclusions The dynamics of the CVR response can reveal differential and previously occult temporal signatures in the pharmacologic response of white matter to ACZ, suggesting potential interactions between macrovascular and microvascular hemodynamic impairment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性颅内大血管狭窄闭塞性疾病下白质脑血管反应性的时间动态，并比较正常表现白质与微血管性白质高信号在病变同侧与对侧的差异。19名患者接受乙酰唑胺增强动态BOLD检查，通过计算流程分离峰值、终末反应及达峰时间。总体上同侧白质高信号的峰值反应最低，但侧别效应和組織与侧别的交互作用均未达到统计显著；排除出现反常“逆向窃血”表现的检查后，同侧反应显著降低，且这类检查的达峰时间延迟、终末与峰值比值升高。作者据此认为，反应的时间特征可揭示白质对乙酰唑胺药物反应中此前未被察觉的差异，提示大血管与微血管血流动力学损害之间可能存在交互作用。

papers.title: Resting-state microstate dynamics predict behavioral and neural efficiency during working memory processing in healthy aging
papers.authors: Frei V, Ebner NC, Maraver MJ, Treadway H, Kunath J, Rossi E.
papers.abstract: Abstract Working memory performance declines with age, yet substantial variability exists among cognitively healthy older adults. Although task-evoked electrophysiological responses such as the P300b are sensitive to working memory load, it remains unclear how they relate to stable characteristics of intrinsic brain organization and individual differences in working memory performance.
