In this study, we investigated the effect of TT on cognitive function in relation to hippocampal neurogenesis, myelination, key markers for neuroinflammation, oxidative stress and cell death in the brain of twelve-month-old mice. The treatment group exhibited higher levels of immunoglobulin gamma (IgG) and increased lymphocyte count in the blood sample. Results from the novel object recognition (NOR) test, cued radial arm maze (cued RAM), and Morris water maze (MWM) revealed that TT administration enhanced learning and memory in ageing mice. These cognitive improvements were associated with an increased number of doublecortin (DCX)-positive immature neurons and a higher proportion of bromodeoxyuridine (BrdU)/neuronal nuclei (NeuN) double-positive new neurons in the hippocampus. In addition, TT treatment resulted in enhanced myelination in the corpus callosum, hippocampal hilus and striatum as evidenced by increased intensity of luxol fast blue (LFB) staining and myelin basic protein (MBP) expression. Moreover, TT treatment induced a phenotypic shift in microglial phenotype from the pro-inflammatory M1 state to the neuroprotective M2 state. TT-treated animals showed a significant reduction in the levels of an oxidative stress marker, malondialdehyde (MDA), and a lower number of terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick end labeling (TUNEL) cells, suggesting that TT alleviates oxidative stress and prevents neuronal apoptosis. Overall, these findings demonstrate TT as a potential modulator of neuroregeneration, remyelination and neuroprotection, emphasizing its therapeutic potential for enhancing cognitive function.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在12月龄小鼠中考察破伤风类毒素（TT）对认知功能的影响及其与海马神经发生、髓鞘化和神经保护的关系。行为学结果显示，TT处理组的学习与记忆表现增强，同时海马内未成熟神经元和新生成神经元增多，胼胝体、海马门区和纹状体的髓鞘化增强。此外，TT使小胶质细胞由促炎表型向神经保护表型转变，并伴随氧化应激和细胞凋亡指标下降。作者据此提出，TT可能通过促进神经再生、再髓鞘化和神经保护来改善衰老过程中的认知功能，但其治疗潜力仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Longitudinal associations between screen time activities and working memory neural signatures in adolescents: Sex differences and contextual moderation.
papers.authors: Arekatla S, Barrows A, Cioffredi LA, Albaugh MD, Allgaier N, Allred M, Baranger D, Potter A, Garavan HP, Chaarani B.
papers.abstract: Introduction Adolescent screen media activity (SMA) has increased, yet its longitudinal associations with neurocognitive development and mental health remain unclear across activities and contexts. Methods This longitudinal cohort study used data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study (release 6.0) with four assessments (baseline, year 2, year 4, and year 6). Participants were recruited across 21 U.S. sites to reflect demographic diversity. Children with valid neuroimaging and behavioral data were included, adjusting for demographic, behavioral, and psychiatric confounders. Working memory (WM) neural signature (NS) scores were derived using elastic net classification of EN-back fMRI activation during 0-back and 2-back conditions. SMA included time spent video gaming, watching television, texting, and social media. Cognitive performance was measured using EN-back accuracy, and mental health symptoms using Child Behavior Checklist internalizing and externalizing scores. Moderation analyses examined family conflict, sleep disturbance, and physical activity. Results The analytic sample included 9931 participants (47.2% female). Higher NS scores were associated with better 0-back and 2-back accuracy. Greater video gaming, texting, and television watching were associated with lower NS scores. Sex-stratified analyses showed among males, more screen time was associated with lower NS scores, a multivariate measure of how separable neural activation patterns are between the 2-back and 0-back conditions. These associations were specific to the EN-back task and were adjusted for general cognitive ability. Higher degrees of family conflict increased the association between NS with texting, and video gaming and externalizing symptoms among males. Sleep disturbance and physical activity also moderated associations with internalizing and externalizing symptoms, with sex-specific patterns. Conclusions WM-related neural function was associated with cognitive performance and SMA engagement, differing by sex and environmental context, highlighting complex associations between neurocognitive development, media use, and mental health.

papers.title: Puberty, not age, marks the start of adolescent brain structural remodeling.
papers.authors: Chad JA, Klukas OC, Ghasoub M, Lebel C.
papers.abstract: Many studies have shown that pubertal changes are associated with brain changes, but there lacks a clear understanding of what happens to the brain at puberty, and whether it opens the brain structural remodeling that characterizes adolescence. In this study, we used three longitudinal waves of structural MRI data from thousands of participants of the ABCD study aged 9-14 years to compare brain changes between age-matched children who had either reached or not reached a major pubertal milestone: menarche in females and fonarche (voice drop) in males. We found that only the children who had reached the milestone exhibited widespread contraction of cortical surface area and subcortical volume. The contraction was more pronounced in females, in line with previous evidence of how gonadal hormones regulate neuronal fine-tuning. Our findings suggest that reaching puberty, rather than reaching a particular age, begins the adolescent phase of structural brain development.

papers.title: Developmental variation in resting-state EEG spectral correlates of response inhibition in children and adolescents.
papers.authors: Xu Y, Yang Z, Ouyang G, He Q, Xu M.
papers.abstract: Identifying electrophysiological markers of response inhibition in children and adolescents is of substantial importance. Although previous studies have examined associations between resting-state electroencephalography (rs-EEG) power and response inhibition, findings across frequency bands have been inconsistent, and evidence regarding band-ratio indices remains limited. To address these issues, the present study examined the associations between rs-EEG spectral indices and response inhibition in a large sample of 1654 children and adolescents aged 6-18 years, and further tested whether these associations varied as a function of age. Based on eyes-open rs-EEG recordings, relative power was extracted for the delta, theta, alpha, and beta bands, and three band-ratio indices were calculated: the theta/beta ratio (TBR), alpha/theta ratio (ATR), and beta/theta ratio (BTR). Response inhibition was assessed using the stop-signal task. Correlation analyses showed that higher delta power, theta power, and TBR were associated with poorer response inhibition, whereas higher alpha power, beta power, ATR, and BTR were associated with better response inhibition. Moderation analyses further indicated that age significantly moderated the associations of delta power, beta power, ATR, and BTR with response inhibition, whereas no significant age-moderating effects were observed for theta power, alpha power or TBR. Taken together, these findings suggest that the electrophysiological correlates of response inhibition are developmentally dynamic across childhood and adolescence. The present study provides a psychophysiological account of developmental variation in response inhibition and underscores the importance of age when interpreting resting-state EEG-behavior associations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察儿童青少年静息态脑电频谱指标与反应抑制的关系，并检验这些关系是否随年龄变化；研究基于大样本静息态脑电记录提取各频段相对功率及频段比值，用停止信号任务评估反应抑制。结果显示，较高的delta、theta功率和theta/beta比值与较差的反应抑制相关，而较高的alpha、beta功率及alpha/theta、beta/theta比值与较好的反应抑制相关。年龄显著调节delta功率、beta功率及两个比值指标与反应抑制的关联，但对theta功率、alpha功率和theta/beta比值未见显著调节。作者据此认为，反应抑制的电生理相关在儿童青少年期具有发展动态性，解释静息态脑电与行为关联时需考虑年龄。

papers.title: Neurocognitive development and its relationship to brain structure and function: Findings from the ABCD study.
papers.authors: Banich MT, Smolker HR, Barch DM, Luciana M.
papers.abstract: This paper reviews findings on neurocognitive development provided by the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development® study to date. It explores the structure of cognitive processes during the late childhood to early adolescent developmental time frame as well as associations with brain regions and systems that may support such processes. Also reviewed are findings from a wide variety of cognitive processes including general cognitive abilities, memory, inhibitory control, risk and reward processing, language, non-verbal abilities, executive functioning, and cognitive flexibility. The relationships of these aspects of cognition are examined with regard to morphological features of both white and grey matter, and with regard to brain function, more specifically activation and connectivity measures derived from functional MRI, during rest and during tasks. Section summaries and potential future directions are provided at the end of each section. The paper concludes with broad lessons learned from the ABCD® study so far as well as consideration of how future exploration of the data could illuminate a variety of outstanding issues with regard to neurocognitive development.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了青少年脑认知发展（ABCD）研究迄今关于神经认知发展的发现，关注童年晚期至青春期早期认知过程的结构及其与可能支持这些过程的脑区、脑系统的关联。文章涵盖一般认知能力、记忆、抑制控制、风险与奖赏加工、语言、非言语能力、执行功能和认知灵活性等多种认知过程，并考察这些认知方面与白质和灰质形态特征的关系，以及与静息和任务态功能磁共振所测激活和连接的关系。各节末尾给出小结和未来方向，全文最后总结已有教训，并讨论未来数据探索如何阐明神经认知发展中的若干未决问题。

papers.title: Impulsivity during adolescent development: Insights from a decade of ABCD study longitudinal analyses.
papers.authors: Gebru NM, Gonçalves PD, Adams F, Anand N, Haygood LN, Johnson ME, Cohen AO.
papers.abstract: Background The Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study provides an unprecedented opportunity to examine how impulsivity develops and predicts health outcomes. This review synthesized longitudinal findings from the study's first decade and identified priories for future research. Methods Following Cochrane's guidelines, we systematically searched for peer-reviewed papers published through July 2025. Eligible studies included self-reported or task-based measures of impulsivity and used two or more data waves. Fifty-one studies met inclusion criteria. Results Impulsivity was predominantly operationalized using self-report trait measures, particularly the UPPS-P or urgency-specific measures (k = 42) and BIS/BAS scales (k = 23); task-based measures used less often (k = 20). Across health domains, urgency, sensation seeking, and lack of premeditation (impulse control) showed recurring prospective associations, although findings varied across outcomes and studies. Findings involving task-based measures also varied across studies. Several studies examined impulsivity as an outcome of environmental exposures, supporting its developmental malleability, but few explicitly modeled changes in impulsivity over time. Few eligible studies examined neuroimaging measures, precluding firm conclusions about the magnitude or consistency of their associations. Conclusions Findings from ABCD extend prior impulsivity research by demonstrating that multiple self-reported impulsivity facets are early-emerging prospective correlates of health risk in a large preadolescent cohort. Divergence between self-report and task-based findings may reflect the multi-dimensionality of impulsivity and related constructs and highlights the need for standardized scoring across ABCD studies. The most important gap is the underutilization of ABCD's longitudinal design to model trajectories of impulsivity itself. As additional waves become available, the field is well-positioned to move from establishing associations to characterizing developmental trajectories, mechanisms, and modifiable influences.

papers.title: Anti-inflammatory activities of extracellular vesicles-derived from rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) plasma.
papers.authors: Edirisinghe SL, Nikapitiya C, De Zoysa M.
papers.abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are nanoscale, lipid bilayer membrane-bound particles that carry bioactive cellular cargo such as proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids. They are considered key mediators of intercellular communication, potential biomarkers, and play a role in numerous pathophysiological processes, including the modulating innate and adaptive immune responses. In this study, plasma-derived EVs were isolated from rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), and determined the physicochemical-molecular properties to investigate their anti-inflammatory activities. Isolated EVs had cup-shaped morphology with an average particle diameter of 106.5 nm, and negative surface charge (zeta potential) of -24.2 mV. The purity of EVs was confirmed through immunoblot detection of EVs markers (ALIX, HSP90, HSP70, CD63, and TSG101), and highly enriched acetylcholinesterase (AChE). Transcriptional analysis demonstrated that EVs treatment up-regulated the Il-6 and Il-8 expression and down-regulation of Isg15, Isg20, Ifnβ1, and Tnf-α expression in RAW 264.7 cells. Moreover, flow cytometry results revealed EVs-treated RAW 264.7 cells have decreased the reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation upon lipopolysaccharide (LPS) induction. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) results evidenced that EVs role on the suppression of Inf-α and Ifn-β, and induction of Il-6 proteins in LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cells. LPS-induced neuroinflammation was lowered through suppression of inflammatory (tnfα and il1β) genes and inducing pro-inflammatory (il6 and il8) genes in EVs-treated zebrafish brain. Thus, we suggest that plasma-derived EVs from rainbow trout have potential to regulate inflammatory and antioxidant responses and may serve as an-anti-inflammatory agent to mitigate cellular damage associated with inflammatory conditions.

papers.title: Association among white matter lesions, rsEEG rhythms, amyloid tau markers, and cognitive status in mild cognitive impairment patients.
papers.authors: Del Percio C, Lizio R, Noce G, Carpi M, Lopez S, Carducci F, De Bartolo M, Afragola AP, Soricelli A, Salvatore M, Giubilei F, Güntekin B, Yener G, Massa F, Arnaldi D, Famà F, Pardini M, Ferri R, Lanuzza B, Stocchi F, Vacca L, Coletti C, Infarinato F, Marziali S, Marizzoni M, Taylor JP, Hanoğlu L, Yırıkoğulları H, Frisoni GB, Cuoco S, Cappiello A, Barone P, Bonanni L, Biundo R, Cauzzo S, Fiorenzato E, Antonini A, De Pandis MF, D'Antonio F, Bruno G, Babiloni C.
papers.journal: Clinical neurophysiology : official journal of the International Federation of Clinical Neurophysiology
papers.abstract: Objective Abnormalities in posteriorly dominant resting-state eyes-closed electroencephalographic (rsEEG) alpha rhythms are associated with cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) tau neuropathology and Mini-Mental Status Examination (MMSE) score, reflecting global cognition, in patients with mild cognitive impairment due to Alzheimer's disease (MCI-AD). The present study examined the relationships between white matter cerebrovascular lesions (WMLs) and CSF amyloid-tau markers, posterior rsEEG alpha rhythms, and cognitive status in patients with MCI-AD versus those with mild cognitive impairment not due to Alzheimer's disease (MCI-noAD). Methods An international database provided clinical, demographic, CSF amyloid-tau, rsEEG, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) datasets for 68 MCI-AD and 44 MCI-noAD patients. The WMLs were segmented from T2-weighted and FLAIR MRI images. Cortical rsEEG sources at individual delta, theta, and alpha frequencies were estimated using eLORETA freeware. Results In MCI-AD patients, greater WMLs were not associated with increased AD neuropathology, greater alterations in rsEEG alpha or other source activities, or worse MMSE scores. In contrast, higher WMLs were associated with lower MMSE scores in patients with MCI-noAD. Conclusions These results suggest that WMLs had a limited role in prodromal AD, while it affects global cognitive status in patients with MCI-noAD. Significance These findings highlight the stage-dependent, region-specific, and pathology-specific nature of cerebrovascular-neurodegenerative interactions. The limited role of WMLs in MCI-AD may indicate that synergistic neurotoxic effects between vascular burden and AD pathology require more advanced disease stages or higher thresholds of vascular burden to manifest clinically.
keywords: Exact Low-resolution Brain Electromagnetic Source Tomography (Eloreta)
Mild Cognitive Impairment Due To Alzheimer’s Disease (Mci-ad)
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了阿尔茨海默病所致轻度认知障碍（MCI-AD）与非阿尔茨海默病所致轻度认知障碍（MCI-noAD）患者，结合脑白质病变的MRI评估、脑脊液淀粉样蛋白- tau标志物、静息态脑电源活动及认知状态，考察白质脑血管病变与这些指标的关系。结果显示，在MCI-AD患者中，白质病变程度与AD神经病理负担、静息态alpha等源活动改变及整体认知表现均无关联；而在MCI-noAD患者中，白质病变较重者认知得分较低。作者据此认为，白质病变在AD前驱期作用有限，却与MCI-noAD的整体认知状态相关，并提示脑血管与神经退行性病变的交互可能具有阶段和病理类型依赖性，其临床显现或需更晚阶段或更高血管负担阈值。

papers.title: Structural connectivity between the retrosplenial cortex and hippocampus in the healthy human brain: A diffusion tensor tractography study.
papers.authors: Yun SH, Cho IH.
papers.abstract: Background/purpose The retrosplenial cortex (RSC) and hippocampus are important regions involved in spatial navigation by integrating vestibular information into spatial representations. Although functional interactions between these regions have been demonstrated, there is currently a lack of evidence regarding the structural connectivity between the RSC and hippocampus in the human brain. This study aimed to reconstruct and characterize a tractography-derived pathway between the RSC and hippocampus in healthy adults using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) tractography. Methods Thirty healthy adults were recruited. The seed region of interest (ROI) was defined in the RSC with reference to both sagittal and axial planes, and the target ROI was placed within the hippocampus on the axial plane. The structural characteristics, including fractional anisotropy, mean diffusivity, and tract volume were analyzed. Results A tractography-derived RSC-hippocampal pathway was identified bilaterally in all participants. Conclusion This study characterized a tractography-derived RSC-hippocampal pathway in the healthy human brain. Our findings provide insight into RSC-hippocampal structural connectivity and suggest a potential structural substrate for interactions between these regions in spatial information processing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注健康人脑中压后皮层与海马之间是否存在可重建的结构连接，采用弥散张量成像纤维束成像，在健康成人中设定压后皮层为种子区、海马为目标区进行追踪。结果显示，所有参与者双侧均可识别出一条压后皮层—海马纤维通路，并对其各向异性、平均弥散率和纤维束体积等结构特征进行了分析。作者据此指出，这为两区域间的结构连接提供了成像证据，并提示该通路可能是二者在空间信息处理中相互作用的潜在结构基础；但研究仅描述健康成人中的通路存在与特征，未涉及功能或临床效应。

papers.title: Multiband ALFF in patients with major depressive disorder treated with esketamine and sertraline: A preliminary study.
papers.authors: Hua Z, Shu Y, Li L, Xia S, Xiao J, Li J, Ji Y, Li H, Peng D, Wan A, Wu G.
papers.abstract: Introduction This study investigated changes in multiband amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations in patients with major depressive disorder following a 2-week combination treatment regimen of esketamine and sertraline, and examined the associations between ALFF changes and clinical symptom improvement. Methods Forty patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) received esketamine (0.25 mg/kg, intravenous infusion, three times per week) combined with sertraline (50-150 mg/day, oral) for 2 weeks. The Hamilton Anxiety Scale, the Hamilton Depression Scale, the Beck Scale for Suicide Ideation, and the Montreal Cognitive Assessment were administered at baseline and week 2, and resting-state functional MRI data were collected. ALFF values were calculated for the typical band (0.01-0.08 Hz), the slow-4 band (0.027-0.073 Hz), and the slow-5 band (0.01-0.027 Hz) using DPABI 5.1. Clinical scores were compared between baseline and week 2 with paired t-tests or Wilcoxon signed-rank tests according to the Shapiro-Wilk test. Whole-brain ALFF maps were compared with voxel-wise two-tailed paired t-tests in all participants (Gaussian random field correction; voxel-level p < 0.001, cluster-level p < 0.05), and the extracted mean ALFF value of each surviving cluster was then compared between time points at the region level with a paired t-test or Wilcoxon signed-rank test according to normality; normality was therefore assessed only for the extracted regional values, not at the voxel level. Partial correlation analyses, with sex, age, education, baseline clinical scores, and mean framewise displacement as covariates, were conducted to examine associations between ALFF measures and clinical outcomes. Three families of ROI × frequency-band × clinical-outcome tests were defined according to the question addressed (baseline ALFF versus week-2 outcome; post-treatment ALFF versus concurrent outcome; change in ALFF versus change in clinical score; 32 tests per family, 96 tests in total), and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction within each family (q < 0.05) was the primary multiplicity control, with Bonferroni correction within family (adjusted α =0.0016) and FDR across all 96 tests treated as a single family as sensitivity analyses. Results After treatment, HAMA, HAMD, and BSI scores decreased and MoCA scores increased (all p < 0.001). ALFF values in the left inferior frontal gyrus increased in the typical and slow-4 bands, whereas ALFF in sensorimotor and visual cortical regions decreased across multiple bands (GRF-corrected, voxel p < 0.001, cluster p < 0.05). Treatment-related increases in L-IFG ALFF in the typical band were negatively correlated with reductions in BSI scores (partial r = -0.500, uncorrected p = 0.004); however, this association did not remain significant after FDR correction across the 32 ΔALFF-Δscore tests (q = 0.114) or after Bonferroni correction (adjusted α =0.0016), and no ROI-clinical correlation survived correction in any family. It is therefore reported as a nominal, exploratory finding. Post-treatment ALFF in the L-IFG, right precentral gyrus, and right middle occipital gyrus showed nominally significant partial correlations with concurrent symptom scores; none of these remained significant after FDR correction within the corresponding family (smallest q = 0.153). Baseline L-IFG ALFF was not independently associated with treatment outcome after covariate adjustment. Conclusion A 2-week combination treatment regimen of esketamine and sertraline was associated with frequency-specific ALFF changes in prefrontal, sensorimotor, and visual cortical regions in patients with major depressive disorder. No ROI-clinical correlation survived correction for multiple comparisons across the three families of tests; the nominal association between L-IFG ALFF change and suicidal-ideation reduction is exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and requires independent replication before prefrontal ALFF modulation can be considered a candidate marker for monitoring treatment-related neurofunctional changes.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究考察了40名重性抑郁障碍患者接受两周艾司氯胺酮联合舍曲林治疗后，多频段低频涨落振幅（ALFF）的变化及其与症状改善的关联。结果显示，治疗后焦虑、抑郁和自杀意念量表得分下降、认知得分上升，左侧额下回ALFF在典型频段和slow-4频段升高，而感觉运动和视觉皮层区域ALFF在多个频段降低。左侧额下回ALFF升高与自杀意念减轻存在名义上的负相关，但经多重比较校正后不再显著，作者将其视为探索性、需独立重复的发现；基线ALFF与治疗结局也无独立关联。

papers.title: Biomechanical insights into traumatic brain injury in Females: Current understanding and future directions.
papers.authors: Abdi H, Sánchez-Molina D, García-Vilana S, Rahimi-Movaghar V, Haghighi M.
papers.abstract: The incidence of traumatic brain injury (TBI) in females has increased in recent decades, driven by socioeconomic changes and greater participation in high-risk activities. This rise, combined with the historically limited availability of experimental data from female subjects, highlights the pressing need to improve both the quantity and quality of sex-specific data. Research has identified systematic differences between males and females in brain volume, tissue stiffness, and gray/white matter composition. While differences in brain size are often linked to body dimensions, sex-specific disparities in biomechanical properties, such as viscoelasticity and regional stiffness, may influence TBI susceptibility. Imaging-based techniques, particularly Magnetic Resonance Elastography (MRE), have revealed that female brains tend to exhibit higher stiffness in regions like the occipital and temporal lobes, suggesting a differential biomechanical response to TBI. These regional differences may also serve as potential biomarkers for the diagnosis, monitoring, and tracking the progression of neurodegenerative diseases such as multiple sclerosis, aiding in the assessment of disease progression and therapeutic response. Despite these insights, most current finite element head models (FEHMs) rely on population-averaged parameters that may not adequately represent female-specific tissue mechanics. This review highlights the need to incorporate sex-specific mechanical properties into numerical simulations to improve the accuracy of TBI risk assessments and injury prediction. We emphasize the need for future studies using imaging, experimental methods, and computational modeling to better understand the biomechanical behavior of female brain tissue. Such efforts are essential for advancing personalized approaches to brain injury prevention, diagnosis, and treatment in females.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦女性创伤性脑损伤（TBI）的生物力学研究现状，指出女性TBI发生率上升，而针对女性的实验数据长期不足。文章梳理了男女在脑体积、组织硬度及灰白质构成上的系统性差异，并提到磁共振弹性成像显示女性枕叶和颞叶等区域硬度较高，可能影响TBI易感性，这些区域差异也可能作为多发性硬化等神经退行性疾病诊断与进展监测的潜在生物标志物。作者同时指出，现有有限元头部模型多采用人群平均参数，未必能代表女性特有的组织力学，因此强调未来需结合影像、实验与计算建模，将性别特异性力学属性纳入模拟，以改进风险评估和损伤预测，推动女性脑损伤的个体化预防与诊疗。

papers.title: Structural and metabolic reprogramming by docosahexaenoic acid in neuronal cell models of Alzheimer's disease.
papers.authors: Rana A, Mélanie P, Amanda LV, Nathalie BH.
papers.abstract: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA; 22:6n-3) is the most abundant omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid in the mammalian brain and an essential structural component of neuronal membranes. Several research studies indicate that DHA plays critical roles in maintaining membrane lipid composition, synaptic integrity, mitochondrial function, and metabolic homeostasis, processes that are disrupted in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and other neurodegenerative disorders. Because brain DHA availability depends largely on systemic metabolism and liver-brain communication, alterations in DHA homeostasis have been proposed as contributing factors to AD pathogenesis. In vitro neuronal culture models have been pivotal in investigating the molecular and biochemical mechanisms underlying DHA-mediated neuroprotection under disease-related conditions. This mini review summarizes how DHA treatment modulates cellular membrane organisation, synaptogenesis and cytoskeletal integrity, and its neuroprotective role in in vitro neuronal models of AD. Collectively, the literature supports DHA as a key modulator of the structure and metabolic mechanisms at the cellular level and supports the hypothesis that its greatest benefit may occur as a preventive or early-stage intervention. Although effective therapeutic interventions are still lacking, and more investigations integrating next-generation cellular models are still needed, these models provide crucial insights for developing targeted therapeutic applications in AD.

papers.title: Domain-general multitasking strategy developed from language experience: Neurobehavioral evidence from student interpreters.
papers.authors: Yang C, Dong Y, Gao S, Hu M.
papers.abstract: Multitasking as a cognitive ability is significant, and yet few studies have investigated how to improve multitasking, especially by language experience. To investigate how language multitasking may enhance domain-general multitasking, this fMRI study compared interpreting students and matched bilingual controls in a non-linguistic dual-task (auditory Task 1, visual Task 2) and examined how their neural data may relate to behavioral performance. Behaviorally, interpreting students showed higher response-time costs in Task 1 but lower costs in Task 2, resulting in faster responses to dual-task trials. At the neural level, interpreting students exhibited greater dual-task-specific activation in the left postcentral gyrus, SMA, and cerebellum (areas subserving sensory processing, response selection, and motor-cognitive integration). Notably, greater engagement of these regions was correlated with greater Task 1 accuracy decrements in interpreting students but not in controls. These findings, together with slower Task 1 responses, indicate that interpreting students may have strategically activated task-set information from both tasks at trial onset. This strategy, while increasing load on motor-cognitive brain regions and coming at a cost to Task 1 performance, accelerated Task 2 responses by pre-activating subsequent task-set information. Hyperactivation was also observed in the left STG and bilateral MTG, with left STG activity negatively correlated with Task 2 time costs only in interpreting students, suggesting that interpreting may enhance recruitment of language-related networks for faster switching. The selectivity and consistency of these brain-behavior correlations demonstrate the significant effects of interpreting on domain-general multitasking, wherein interpreting students strategically trade initial response speed for overall efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语言经验能否提升跨领域的多任务能力，用fMRI比较了口译学生与匹配的双语控制组在非语言双任务中的表现及其与脑活动的关系。行为上，口译学生在任务一上反应时代价更高、在任务二上代价更低，双任务试次总体反应更快；脑层面，他们在左侧中央后回、辅助运动区和小脑等感觉加工、反应选择与运动—认知整合区域表现出更强的双任务特异性激活，且这些区域的参与程度与任务一正确率下降相关。作者据此推测，口译学生可能在试次开始时策略性地同时激活两个任务的任务集信息，以任务一成绩为代价预激活后续任务信息、加快任务二反应；语言相关网络的选择性参与也可能支持更快的切换。这些相关结果提示口译经验对一般多任务加工有影响，但并非因果或干预证据。

papers.title: Large-Scale Cerebellar-Cerebral Network Alterations Underlying Impaired Social Predictive Processing in Cerebellar Neurodegeneration.
papers.authors: Siciliano L, Urbini N, Olivito G, Pisu M, Tanieli M, Ciricugno A, Oldrati V, Giove F, Borgatti R, Cattaneo Z, Urgesi C, Leggio M.
papers.abstract: The cerebellum is a key node for detecting and adjusting social-prediction internal models. Yet social prediction has been scantly investigated in neurodegenerative cerebellar patients (CB). Thus, we examined CB social-prediction abilities and related cerebellar-cerebral networks, using tailored tasks and resting-state fMRI. Thirteen adult CB and twenty-six matched controls completed three computerized prediction tasks, where contextual priors activate specific internal models setting expectations which may influence recognition of ambiguous targets (emotion expressions, personality-traits, non-social objects). Accuracy and response times were analysed through 2 × 2 × 2 mixed-effects ANOVAs. A congruency index (CI) reflecting whether response was driven by contextual influence was derived from performance efficiency scores and analysed through a 2 × 2 mixed-effects ANOVA. Participants underwent 3T brain MRI, including T1-weighted and resting-state fMRI sequences. Posterior and vermian cerebellar lobules were chosen a-priori as regions of interest and used in a Seed-Based fMRI analysis examining cerebellar-cerebral functional connectivity (FC). FC values from patients' altered connectivity clusters were extracted and correlated with CIs. CB performed worse in the personality-traits task, showing higher reliance on contextual cues. Cerebellar-cerebral underconnectivity was found within networks involved in mentalizing and learning. In CB, higher CI in the personality-traits task, reflecting greater contextual influence and failure to revise behavioural responses, significantly correlated with right lobule VIII-right putamen underconnectivity. These findings indicate reduced flexibility in updating higher-order social predictions when contextual expectations conflict with incoming information, accompanied by altered cerebellar-cerebral FC. Exploratory findings further point to cerebellar-basal ganglia connectivity as a potentially relevant network component of predictive social cognition, warranting further investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察小脑神经退行性变患者的社会预测能力及其与小脑—大脑网络的关系，采用定制预测任务和静息态功能磁共振成像，比较患者与匹配对照在情绪、人格特质和非社会对象判断中的表现。结果显示，患者在人格特质任务中表现更差，更依赖情境线索，并在涉及心理化与学习的网络中表现出小脑—大脑功能连接减弱；人格特质任务中情境影响更强、行为调整不足的倾向，与右侧小脑小叶VIII与右侧壳核间连接减弱相关。作者据此认为，当情境预期与输入信息冲突时，患者更新高阶社会预测的灵活性下降，并伴有小脑—大脑连接改变；探索性结果还提示小脑—基底节连接可能是预测性社会认知的相关网络成分，有待进一步研究。

papers.title: Integrating resting-state functional connectivity, mismatch negativity, and auditory steady-state responses reveals convergent neurophysiological biomarkers of schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Abdullah SS, Hameed TT, Baig MR, Nematov O, Sapaev I, Ismail SM, Bani Younes ZB, Arora V, Sharma R, Mohammadi Y, Khasawneh MAS.
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia is a heterogeneous neuropsychiatric disorder characterized by abnormalities in large-scale brain connectivity, auditory prediction-error processing, and cortical gamma-band synchronization. Although resting-state electroencephalography (EEG), mismatch negativity (MMN), and auditory steady-state responses (ASSRs) have each been proposed as candidate biomarkers, they are often investigated separately, limiting the characterization of convergent neurophysiological abnormalities. This study evaluated whether integrating these complementary EEG paradigms could improve the biological characterization and predictive classification of schizophrenia within a unified multi-paradigm electrophysiological framework. A retrospective secondary analysis was performed using the publicly available African Schizophrenia EEG Dataset (ASZED), comprising 153 participants (76 individuals with schizophrenia and 77 healthy controls). Resting-state functional connectivity was quantified using the weighted Phase Lag Index and graph-theoretical analysis, while MMN peak amplitude, mean amplitude, latency, and 40-Hz ASSR gamma-band evoked power and inter-trial phase coherence were extracted as stimulus-evoked biomarkers. Multimodal classification was performed on 145 participants with complete resting-state, MMN, and ASSR recordings using a Graph Attention Network-based framework. Model interpretability was evaluated using SHAP and GNNExplainer, and predictive performance was assessed using nested stratified five-fold cross-validation with permutation testing. Participants with schizophrenia exhibited disrupted resting-state functional network organization, attenuated MMN responses, and impaired gamma-band synchronization compared with healthy controls. The integrated framework achieved the highest internally validated classification performance, with a balanced accuracy of 91.8% and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.96, exceeding the performance of the individual resting-state, MMN, and ASSR models within the matched complete-case cohort. Explainability analyses identified global efficiency, MMN peak amplitude, and ASSR inter-trial phase coherence as the most influential predictive features across validation folds. These findings indicate that resting-state connectivity, MMN, and ASSR provide complementary electrophysiological information that can be integrated into a coherent predictive representation of schizophrenia-related brain dysfunction. The findings should be interpreted as internally validated associations within a single public dataset rather than as evidence of clinically validated diagnostic biomarkers. Independent external validation and longitudinal studies will be required to determine whether these multi-paradigm EEG signatures have broader prognostic, treatment-response, or translational utility.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于公开数据集，将静息态功能连接、失匹配负波和听觉稳态反应三种脑电范式整合到一个多范式框架中，考察它们能否共同刻画精神分裂症的神经生理异常并提升分类表现。结果显示，精神分裂症患者在静息态网络组织、失匹配负波反应和伽马同步上均存在异常；整合模型的内部验证分类表现优于各单独模型，可解释性分析提示全局效率、失匹配负波峰幅和试次间相位一致性贡献较大。作者强调，这些结果只是单一公开数据集内的内部验证关联，并非临床验证的诊断标志物，仍需独立外部验证和纵向研究。

papers.title: The neurobiology of binge eating disorder: a systematic review of studies using functional magnetic resonance imaging.
papers.authors: Park JJ, Zhang K, Lee G, Potenza MN.
papers.abstract: Binge eating disorder (BED) is a prevalent public health concern associated with significant medical and psychosocial burden. To better understand the mechanisms underlying this concern, the present systematic review aimed to synthesize findings from resting-state and task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) studies of the neurobiology of BED. PubMed, MEDLINE, PsycInfo, Embase, and Web of Science were searched, the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal Tools were used, and the PRISMA guidelines were followed. The review identified 24 studies, comprising approximately 1,689 non-independent participants from an estimated 17 unique cohorts. These included task-based fMRI studies (n = 14), resting-state fMRI studies (n = 6), and BED treatment-outcome fMRI studies (n = 4). Key findings of the review included: (i) differences in neural responsivity to palatable food cues involving reward- and salience-related circuitry (e.g., orbitofrontal cortex, ventral striatum, and insula), alongside reduced recruitment of inhibitory-control regions during cognitive-control tasks; (ii) evidence suggesting reward-related differences in BED may be more food-specific than generalized across reward types, although some findings indicate broader frontostriatal hyporesponsivity during monetary reward processing; and, (iii) findings indicating that BED may share neurobiological overlap with, but remain distinguishable from, obesity and bulimia nervosa. However, these findings/interpretations are preliminary, given limitations in the current evidence base, including small samples, methodological heterogeneity, and the underrepresentation of males. Future neuroimaging studies should prioritize large-scale, longitudinal, efforts that include more representative (e.g., greater inclusion of males) and developmental (e.g., more children and adolescents) samples and consider socioenvironmental contexts relevant to BED. Such efforts may help inform individual-level personalized interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了暴食症神经生物学的功能磁共振成像研究，涵盖任务态、静息态及治疗结局三类。主要发现包括：暴食症患者对可口食物线索的奖赏与显著性相关环路反应存在差异，认知控制任务中抑制控制脑区招募减少；奖赏相关差异可能更多是食物特异性的，而非泛化的奖赏加工异常，但部分证据提示金钱奖赏加工中也存在额纹状体反应减弱。此外，暴食症与肥胖和神经性贪食症在神经生物学上既有重叠又可区分。作者强调这些结论仍属初步，受样本小、方法异质和男性代表性不足等限制，未来需大规模纵向研究并纳入更具代表性和发育阶段的样本。

papers.title: Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation in drug-resistant epilepsy: A randomized, sham-controlled crossover trial with exploratory EEG and MRI response phenotyping.
papers.authors: Hong SJ, Yang SY, Bok EK, Lee JC, Kim Y, Min K, Shon YM.
papers.abstract: Objective Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) is a noninvasive neuromodulation strategy for drug-resistant epilepsy, but clinical response is heterogeneous. We examined whether electroencephalographic (EEG) and structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) phenotypes were associated with active-specific clinical benefit from taVNS. Methods In this single-center, randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled crossover exploratory pilot trial, 14 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy received 8 weeks of active taVNS and 8 weeks of sham stimulation, separated by a 4-week washout, in randomized sequence. The primary clinical outcome was seizure reduction ratio (SRR) during active versus sham stimulation. Active-specific clinical benefit was defined as ΔSRR = SRR_active - SRR_sham. Resting-state EEG was obtained at baseline and at the end of the protocol. Changes in regional relative band power were correlated with ΔSRR, with a focus on the β band based on prior evidence of vagal stimulation-related desynchronization. Baseline structural MRI findings were explored by active-phase responder status. Results Active taVNS did not significantly outperform sham stimulation. Mean SRR was 46.26 ± 40.96% during active stimulation and 48.62 ± 37.27% during sham stimulation, with a mean within-subject difference of -2.37 ± 16.64% (p = 0.604). Greater β-band attenuation was associated with larger active-specific clinical benefit in the occipital (ρ = -0.723, p = 0.003, q = 0.017) and frontal regions (ρ = -0.657, p = 0.011, q = 0.027). Parietal β-band attenuation showed a nominal association (ρ = -0.552, p = 0.041, q = 0.068). Bilateral structural abnormalities and limbic involvement were more frequent among nonresponders (both p = 0.021, uncorrected). Significance Although primary clinical efficacy was not demonstrated, EEG β-band modulation and limbic structural network burden may help explain interindividual variability in taVNS benefit. The substantial sham response underscores the need for rigorous sham-controlled taVNS trials. Plain language summary About one-third of people with epilepsy keep having seizures despite medication. taVNS is a noninvasive treatment that stimulates a nerve at the outer ear. In this small, carefully blinded trial, active taVNS did not reduce seizures more than an inactive (sham) treatment, and the sham response was large. However, people whose EEG β brain waves decreased during the study tended to benefit more, and those with more widespread limbic or structural brain changes tended to benefit less. If confirmed in larger studies, these EEG and MRI markers might help identify who is most likely to respond to taVNS.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性随机双盲假对照交叉试验在耐药局灶性癫痫患者中比较了经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）与假刺激的疗效，并结合静息态脑电和结构磁共振探索与个体疗效差异相关的特征。结果显示，主动刺激并未显著优于假刺激，两阶段发作减少比例相近，且假刺激反应明显，提示需更严格的对照试验。脑电方面，研究期间β频段功率下降越明显，主动刺激相对假刺激的额外获益越大，枕区和额区尤为突出；结构影像则提示双侧结构异常和边缘系统受累者在无应答者中更常见。作者认为，脑电β频段调制和边缘系统结构负担可能有助于解释taVNS获益的个体差异，但这些关联尚需更大样本验证。

papers.title: Stereoelectroencephalography-guided radiofrequency thermocoagulation in drug-resistant focal epilepsy: Results from more than 20 years of experience.
papers.authors: Spessatto Pesente F, Sampaio MG, Catenoix H, Morizet D, Montavont A, Rheims S, Ostrowsky-Coste K, Boulogne S, Jung J, Haegelen C, Guenot M.
papers.abstract: Objective This study was undertaken to present more than 2 decades of experience with stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG)-guided radiofrequency thermocoagulation (RF-TC) in focal drug-resistant epilepsy and to identify clinical, electrophysiological, and procedural predictors of treatment response. Methods We retrospectively studied 244 consecutive patients treated with SEEG-guided RF-TC at our center between 2001 and 2024. All had at least 2 months of follow-up, and 240 (98.4%) completed 1 year. Outcomes were assessed at 2, 6, and 12 months. The primary endpoint was seizure freedom at 2 months and 1 year without additional surgery, and the secondary endpoint was ≥50% seizure reduction. Demographic and epilepsy-, imaging-, and procedure-related variables were analyzed. Results At 2 months, 160 patients (65.6%) were responders, including 63 (25.8%) seizure-free. At 1 year, among 135 patients treated exclusively with SEEG-guided RF-TC, 64 (51.2%) were responders, including 19 (14.1%) seizure-free. At 5 years, 6.1% treated exclusively with SEEG-guided RF-TC remained seizure-free. Magnetic resonance imaging was negative in 40.6%, and focal cortical dysplasia was the most frequent imaging finding (20.1%). A higher number of contacts was associated with lower seizure-free rates at 1 year (p = .046). Pathology and electrode number were the only variables associated with 1-year outcomes. The positive predictive value of being a responder at 2 months for favorable surgical outcome was 83%, and the negative predictive value was 44%. Recoagulation within the first year was strongly associated with clinical improvement (p < .00001). Neurological complications occurred in 2.9%, including .8% permanent deficits. Significance SEEG-guided RF-TC is a safe diagnostic option with some therapeutic implication (6% seizure freedom in 5 years) for selected patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy. Early response predicts favorable long-term outcomes, and repeated coagulation can enhance clinical results. Pathology and the number of contacts used in thermocoagulation may serve as potential prognostic factors.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于单中心二十余年的回顾性经验，分析立体脑电图引导射频热凝（SEEG-guided RF-TC）治疗药物难治性局灶性癫痫的疗效及其预测因素。结果显示，治疗后短期内有相当比例患者发作减少，但仅接受该治疗者一年时无发作比例较低，五年时更低；早期应答与后续较好结局相关，一年内再次热凝也与临床改善相关，而病理和电极触点数量可能与一年结局有关。作者认为，该手段对部分患者是安全的诊断性选择并具有一定治疗意义，早期反应有助于判断长期预后，但总体无发作率有限，结论需结合回顾性设计理解。

papers.title: Glymphatic system in temporal lobe epilepsy associated with encephalocele.
papers.authors: Di Giacomo R, Biancheri D, Burini A, Doniselli FM, Rossini L, Visani E, Cuccarini V, Marucci G, Parente A, Didato G, Deleo F, Pastori C, Battaglia G, Maccanti G, Cereda GS, Rizzi M, de Curtis M, Garbelli R.
papers.abstract: Objectives Temporal lobe encephaloceles (ENCs) are underdiagnosed causes of drug-resistant temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE), frequently associated with idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH). Emerging evidence suggests glymphatic system dysfunction in both IIH and TLE. We investigated glymphatic markers in TLE associated with ENC compared with seizure-free postoperative TLE controls of different etiology. Methods Surgical specimens from 13 patients with TLE-ENC and 12 TLE-control patients were analyzed. Histological glymphatic markers included aquaporin-4 (AQP4), glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), podoplanin, perivascular space (PVS) enlargement, and vessel density. High-resolution magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was used to assess a global PVS score. Results Compared with specimens TLE controls, TLE-ENC specimens showed increased white matter AQP4 expression and AQP4/GFAP ratio, whereas the AQP4/GFAP ratio was reduced in gray matter. Podoplanin expression was significantly elevated in both gray and white matter in TLE-ENC cases. MRI demonstrated greater supratentorial PVS enlargement in ENC patients. Radiological features suggestive of IIH were identified in 46.1% of TLE-ENC patients. Compared with controls, TLE-ENC patients had shorter disease duration and lacked association with previous febrile seizures. Surgical treatment achieved seizure freedom in 70% of ENC patients at a median follow-up of 32 months. Significance This study provides the first characterization of glymphatic-associated pathways in TLE-ENC-related epilepsy. Dysregulation of AQP4 and podoplanin, together with increased PVS burden, suggests a distinct alteration of perivascular and astroglial homeostasis in TLE-ENC, supporting a potential pathophysiological link among ENC formation, IIH, and epileptogenesis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了颞叶脑膨出相关颞叶癫痫患者与不同病因的无发作术后对照者的手术标本，并结合影像评估类淋巴系统标志物。结果显示，脑膨出组白质AQP4表达及AQP4/GFAP比值升高、灰质该比值降低，podoplanin在灰白质均升高，影像上幕上血管周围间隙扩大更明显，部分患者有提示特发性颅内高压的影像特征。作者据此提出，AQP4与podoplanin失调及血管周围间隙负担增加提示脑膨出相关癫痫存在独特的血管周围与星形胶质稳态改变，可能连接脑膨出形成、颅内高压与致痫过程；这些发现属关联性描述，尚不能说明因果或治疗作用。

papers.title: Clinical characteristics and semiological pitfalls in patients with focal epilepsy and functional/dissociative seizures: A comparative analysis of correct and incorrect initial diagnoses.
papers.authors: Gillinder L, Lehn A, Hartel G.
papers.abstract: Objective Both epilepsy and functional/dissociative seizures (FDS) can present with a wide variety of event manifestations which can appear similar in nature and contribute to misdiagnosis. Whereas many studies have addressed the misdiagnosis of FDS as epilepsy, research into the inverse, where epilepsy is mistaken for a functional disorder, remains limited. Accurate differentiation is vital, because management differs greatly, ranging from antiseizure medications and surgery to specialized mental health interventions. Methods A retrospective review was conducted of patients undergoing video-electroencephalographic monitoring (VEM) at a level 4 advanced epilepsy center between 2015 and 2023. VEM reports rather than video were reviewed. Patients were categorized into three primary groups: correctly diagnosed focal epilepsy, correctly diagnosed FDS, and misdiagnosed epilepsy (patients initially diagnosed with FDS but confirmed to have epileptic seizures). A fourth group of cases with FDS that were misdiagnosed as epilepsy were excluded. Results Epilepsy cases that were misdiagnosed as FDS represented 6% of the total cohort. Fifty percent (n = 13) were male, and the mean age was 33.3 (range = 10-62). Compared to correctly diagnosed epilepsy, the misdiagnosed cases were significantly more likely to have semiological features, consisting of complex motor movements (p = .0009), hyperkinetic activity (p = .0095), and affective symptoms like fear (p = .0001). Notably, frontal lobe epilepsy was proportionally more common in misdiagnosed cases. In contrast, events in cases with correctly diagnosed FDS were characterized by unresponsiveness (p = .0001), hypotonia (p = .0001), and eye closure (p = .019), alongside prolonged duration (p = .0001) and fluctuating semiology (p = .0001). These features were almost entirely absent in the misdiagnosed group. FDS cases also had a significantly higher number of distinct event types but fewer semiological features per event (p = .03). Lateralizing signs were also an indicator of an epilepsy diagnosis, appearing in 58% of misdiagnosed cases compared to only 17% of FDS cases (p < .0001). Significance Sole reliance on individual signs of FDS can lead to diagnostic errors, particularly in frontal lobe epilepsy. To improve diagnostic certainty, clinicians should analyze the temporal evolution of semiology over isolated motor manifestations. When hyperkinetic or affective symptoms are present, a thorough clinical history and assessment of the temporal evolution of semiology should improve diagnostic certainty and reduce the chances of misdiagnosis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注局灶性癫痫被误诊为功能性/分离性发作（FDS）这一较少被探讨的方向，回顾性分析了在一家四级癫痫中心接受视频脑电监测患者的监测报告，比较正确诊断的癫痫、正确诊断的FDS与被误诊为FDS的癫痫在临床和发作学表现上的差异。结果显示，被误诊为FDS的癫痫病例占队列的6%，其发作更常出现复杂运动动作、过度运动活动和恐惧等情感症状，额叶癫痫所占比例也相对更高；而正确诊断的FDS则多表现为无反应、肌张力低下、闭眼、持续时间较长及发作学表现波动，这些特征在误诊组中几乎不出现。作者据此指出，仅凭个别提示FDS的征象容易导致误诊，尤其对额叶癫痫而言；临床应重视发作学表现随时间的演变，而非孤立地看待某一运动表现，以降低误诊风险。

papers.title: Serum Chitotriosidase Links to Activated Glia at Chronic Active Lesion Rims in Multiple Sclerosis Brain.
papers.authors: Ahola V, Saraste M, Pedrini E, Tuomaala J, Buchholz L, Matilainen M, Lindenberg J, Brockmann EC, Martire MS, Sandgren S, Leppert D, Kuhle J, Kuhlmann T, Absinta M, Airas L.
papers.abstract: Objective The objective of this study was to explore the association between 18 kDa translocator protein (TSPO)-positron emission tomography (PET)-measurable glial activation and serum chitotriosidase (CHIT1) in people with multiple sclerosis (pwMS), and its expression in postmortem MS brain tissue. Methods In this cross-sectional study, 89 pwMS (19 progressive MS [PMS] and 70 relapsing-remitting MS [RRMS]) and 16 age- and sex-matched healthy controls underwent [11 C]PK11195 TSPO-PET. Serum CHIT1 concentration was measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). T1-weighted hypointense lesions were phenotyped as rim-active, overall-active, or inactive based on [11 C]PK11195-binding in lesion centers and edges. Spearman correlation was used to analyze associations between CHIT1 and study variables. Postmortem CHIT1 and TSPO expressions were assessed immunohistochemically and by re-analyzing spatial transcriptomics as well as single-nucleus and pseudobulk RNA-sequencing datasets. Results CHIT1 correlated positively with the number (ρ = 0.33, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.01-0.58, p = 0.038), volume (ρ = 0.39, 95% CI = 0.08-0.63, p = 0.013), and percentage (ρ = 0.31, 95% CI = 0.003-0.57, p = 0.046) of rim-active lesions and with TSPO-binding in the T1-weighted perilesional area (ρ = 0.36, 95% CI = 0.05-0.61, p = 0.020) in the exploratory CHIT1-high cohort divided based on median CHIT1 concentration in pwMS (22.1 ng/ml). CHIT1 correlated with GFAP (ρ = 0.23, 95% CI = 0.003-0.44, p = 0.042) and neurofilament light chain (NfL; ρ = 0.26, 95% CI = 0.03-0.46, p = 0.022) in the pwMS cohort. Spatial transcriptomics demonstrated significantly higher CHIT1 expression in active lesions and at the edge of chronic active lesions than in white matter (ANOVA p < 0.0001; post hoc multiple comparison analysis p < 0.0001). Interpretation High serum CHIT1 correlated with the presence of TSPO-PET-identified chronic active lesions. The potential utility of serum CHIT1 as a biomarker for concomitant detrimental glial activation at the edge of chronic active lesions in MS brain warrants further validation. ANN NEUROL 2026.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究探讨多发性硬化患者血清几丁质酶1（CHIT1）与TSPO-PET所测胶质活化的关联，并结合死后脑组织分析其表达。在按血清CHIT1中位数划分的高值组中，CHIT1与边缘活跃病灶的数量、体积和比例以及病灶周围T1区域的TSPO结合呈正相关，并与GFAP和神经丝轻链相关；空间转录组显示活动性病灶和慢性活动性病灶边缘的CHIT1表达高于白质。作者认为高血清CHIT1与TSPO-PET识别的慢性活动性病灶相关，其作为反映病灶边缘有害胶质活化的生物标志物潜力尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: A Hypothalamic Oxytocinergic-Sympathetic Axis Couples Anxiety Dysregulation With Impaired Tendon-Bone Repair.
papers.authors: Wan L, Huang T, Zeng L, Du R, Zhang H, Liu S, Zhang T, Hu J, Lu H.
papers.abstract: Rotator cuff injury (RCI) is frequently accompanied by psychological comorbidities, particularly anxiety-related symptoms, which predict poor functional recovery, yet the central mechanisms linking affective disturbance to impaired tendon-bone healing remain unclear. Here, by integrating clinical neuroimaging, imaging transcriptomics, and mechanistic animal experiments, we identify hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus (PVN) oxytocinergic (OXT) neurons as a critical central node coordinating emotional regulation and bone-tendon interface (BTI) repair. In patients with RCI, resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) revealed reduced hypothalamic spontaneous activity that was inversely correlated with anxiety severity. Imaging transcriptomic analyses further linked these functional alterations to spatially concordant gene expression programs enriched in oxytocin signaling. In mouse models, retrograde viral tracing and spatial transcriptomics identified PVNOXT neurons as the predominant labeled population within a polysynaptic PVN-IML-SCG sympathetic pathway connected to the subchondral bone region of the rotator cuff enthesis. In vivo local field potential recordings confirmed a reduction in PVN neuronal activity that peaked at four weeks post-injury and recovered thereafter, paralleling the behavioral time course. Chemogenetic inhibition of PVNOXT neurons induced anxiety-like behaviors and impaired BTI healing, whereas their activation alleviated anxiety and enhanced structural and biomechanical recovery. Together, these findings support a working model in which a PVNOXT- sympathetic-shoulder axis links anxiety dysregulation to musculoskeletal healing through a hypothalamic-sympathetic pathway, providing a framework for integrated neuromodulatory and tissue-targeted interventions in RCI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注肩袖损伤后焦虑失调与腱骨愈合受损之间的中枢机制，结合临床神经影像、影像转录组学和小鼠实验进行探究。患者静息态fMRI显示下丘脑自发活动降低且与焦虑严重程度负相关，相关基因表达富集于催产素信号；小鼠中鉴定出连接肩袖附着处骨区的PVN催产素能神经元-交感通路，损伤后其活动先降后恢复。化学遗传学抑制该群神经元可诱发焦虑样行为并损害骨腱界面愈合，激活则缓解焦虑并促进结构与生物力学恢复。结果支持下丘脑催产素能-交感-肩轴将焦虑失调与肌肉骨骼愈合联系起来的模型，但临床转化仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Volumetric Integrity of Frontotemporal and Perisylvian Regions for Predicting Behavioral and Language Impairment in Behavioral FTD: A Structural MRI Study
papers.authors: Zare AH, Kiani I, Zeinalzadeh L, Taghilou A, Mirsepasi Z, Aghamollaii V.
papers.abstract: Background Behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) is clinically defined by progressive changes in personality, executive function, and language, yet the structural neural correlates of symptom severity remain unclear. This study aimed to assess the association between clinical findings and neuroimaging biomarkers. Methods We included 87 patients with bvFTD. Clinical functioning was covering behavior and language. Spearman’s rank correlations were used to assess univariate associations, and Bonferroni correction was applied for multiple comparisons. Principal component analysis (PCA) was conducted on regional volumes, and multivariable logistic regression was used to model high behavioral impairment (FBI total ≥30), adjusting for age, sex, and education. Results No individual regional volume was significantly correlated with clinical scores after Bonferroni correction (all adjusted p>0.05), and PCA-derived imaging components failed to predict behavioral severity in multivariable models. Age emerged as the only significant predictor (OR=1.11 per year; p=0.009). Model discrimination was modest (AUC=0.735) and did not improve with the inclusion of imaging features (p=0.453 vs. demographics-only model). Conclusions In this bvFTD cohort, structural volumes of key frontotemporal and perisylvian regions did not predict behavioral or language impairments after correction for multiple comparisons. These findings show the limitations of regional volumetric analysis in isolation and stress the need for network-based, multimodal, and longitudinal approaches.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注行为变异型额颞叶痴呆患者的结构影像指标能否解释行为与语言症状的严重程度，对87名患者的额颞叶及外侧裂周围区域体积与临床评分进行了相关分析，并用主成分分析和多变量模型检验预测能力。结果显示，经多重比较校正后，没有任何单个区域体积与临床评分显著相关，影像成分也无法预测行为损害程度；年龄是唯一显著的预测因素，且加入影像特征并未提升模型区分度。作者据此指出，单独依靠区域体积分析存在局限，需要转向网络层面、多模态和纵向的研究思路。

papers.title: Multimodal macroscopic brain abnormalities in schizophrenia converge on insular, mediofrontal, and sensorimotor cortices and link with glial cell expression but not with recent evolutionary change
papers.authors: Thalhammer M, Roßmüller P, Meng C, Priller J, Sorg C, Brandl F.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia is characterized by widespread structural and functional brain abnormalities, yet it remains unclear whether these alterations converge across imaging modalities and whether such convergence is associated with underlying cellular distribution and evolution of the human cortex. Methods We performed coordinate-based meta-analyses of seven whole-brain neuroimaging modalities, including cortical thickness, gyrification, voxel-based morphometry, amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations, regional homogeneity, regional cerebral blood flow (all based on magnetic resonance imaging), and glucose metabolism based on [ 18 F]-Fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography. The analyses included 200 studies (209 datasets) comprising 11,794 patients with schizophrenia and 10,342 healthy controls. After single-modality meta-analyses using seed-based d-mapping, the meta-analytic result maps were integrated using orthonormal projective non-negative matrix factorization. Finally, the resulting component maps were related to maps of cortical cell type-specific gene expression and human-specific cortical evolution. Results Multimodal integration identified a robust convergence pattern centered in bilateral insular, mediofrontal, and lateral sensorimotor cortices, with the strongest contributions from regional homogeneity, cerebral blood flow, and amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations. The convergence pattern showed significant spatial correspondence with cortical gene expression profiles of astrocytes, microglia, and oligodendrocyte progenitor cells. In contrast, we found no evidence for a preferential localization to regions of human-specific cortical expansion or connectivity. Conclusions Structural and functional brain abnormalities in schizophrenia converge on an insular-mediofrontal-sensorimotor pattern that aligns with glial gene expression profiles. These results support glia-related regional vulnerability as an organizing principle of multimodal brain abnormalities in schizophrenia.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过坐标元分析整合了精神分裂症患者七种全脑影像模态的结果，考察不同模态的结构与功能异常是否在空间上汇聚，并将汇聚模式与皮层细胞类型基因表达及人类皮层进化信息关联。研究发现，多模态异常汇聚于双侧岛叶、内侧额叶和外侧感觉运动皮层，其中局部一致性和脑血流等指标贡献较强；该汇聚模式与星形胶质细胞、小胶质细胞及少突胶质前体细胞的基因表达谱存在空间对应，但未显示与人类特异性皮层扩张或连接偏好定位的证据。作者据此提出，胶质细胞相关的区域易感性可能是精神分裂症多模态脑异常的组织原则，但这一解释基于空间关联，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Escaping the Negative Attentional Bias in Depression with Real-Time Neurofeedback
papers.authors: Lubianiker N, Woods B, Nitchie F, Batzdorf A, Mennen A, Lin Q, Norman KA, Turk-Browne NB, Sheline YI.
papers.abstract: Individuals with major depressive disorder (MDD) show an attentional bias toward negatively valenced stimuli and thoughts. In this study, we applied a closed-loop neurofeedback procedure designed to reduce this bias. Participants were shown composite negative faces and neutral scenes with variable opacity and were instructed to attend to the neutral scene while ignoring the negative face. Internal attentional states were decoded in real time from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. When a participant’s decoded attentional state indicated a failure to ignore the negative faces, the faces became more visible (higher opacity), thus externalizing the brain’s attentional lapse in that moment. Forty-eight individuals with MDD were randomly assigned to a real neurofeedback training group (N = 24) or a sham control group (N = 24); the control group received feedback yoked to a participant in the real group. All participants completed three fMRI neurofeedback sessions. The main outcome quantified the extent to which participants got “stuck” in the most negative attentional state of focusing strongly on the negative faces. We hypothesized that the real neurofeedback group would learn to escape that state by the end of training, relative to the sham control group. Consistent with our hypothesis, neurofeedback training reduced the probability of getting stuck in the most negative attentional state. In offline analyses, training reduced fMRI activity in the precuneus/posterior cingulate and the medial prefrontal cortex when participants successfully attended to scenes and ignored faces. These results demonstrate the efficacy of remediating the negative attentional bias in depression with closed-loop neurofeedback from real-time fMRI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨实时功能磁共振神经反馈能否减轻抑郁症患者对负性刺激的注意偏向。研究将48名抑郁症患者随机分为真实神经反馈组和伪反馈对照组，通过闭环解码注意力状态，在受试者未能忽略负性面孔时提高其可见度，以此将注意失误外显化。结果显示，与对照组相比，真实神经反馈训练降低了受试者陷入最强负性注意状态的概率；离线分析还发现，训练后成功关注场景、忽略面孔时，楔前叶/后扣带皮层及内侧前额叶活动减弱。作者据此认为，闭环神经反馈可改善抑郁症的负性注意偏向，但样本量有限，其临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Shared Fine-Scale Functional Organization in the Human Subcortex Revealed by Connectivity Hyperalignment
papers.authors: Tu JC, Feilong M, Zhang Y, Gobbini MI, Haxby JV.
papers.abstract: Subcortical structures are central to cognition, emotion, and social processing, and their dysfunction underlies a wide range of neurological and psychiatric conditions. Yet subcortical fine-scale functional organization has remained largely inaccessible to group-level fMRI analysis: nuclei are small and low-SNR, and their functional topography varies idiosyncratically across individuals in ways that anatomical alignment cannot resolve. This idiosyncrasy carries real stakes. For example, deep brain stimulation targets with more variable functional connectivity across individuals show correspondingly less consistent clinical outcomes. Here we show that this seemingly idiosyncratic subcortical organization in fact reflects shared, fine-grained structure that can be recovered by modeling each individual’s connectivity in a common functional space (connectivity hyperalignment, CHA), rather than relying on anatomical correspondence. Applying CHA to fMRI data collected during naturalistic movie viewing, we found that aligning subcortical voxels by their cortical connectivity, rather than their anatomical location, sharply increased cross-subject correspondence in both stimulus-evoked response and connectivity profiles. Critically, this alignment sharpened rather than blurred local structure: neighboring voxels became more functionally distinct from one another, and cortical connectivity targets became substantially more decodable across subjects. These results indicate that human subcortical nuclei possess a common fine-scale functional architecture that is masked by anatomical variability but recoverable at the individual level. This reframes a central methodological constraint in subcortical neuroimaging: rather than trading spatial resolution for signal quality via smoothing, group-level analyses can achieve voxel-level precision by aligning function rather than anatomy, opening a path to studying cortical-subcortical circuit organization in greater detail.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注皮层下核团精细功能组织在群体fMRI分析中难以刻画的问题：核团体积小、信噪比低，且个体间功能拓扑差异无法靠解剖对齐解决。作者用连接性超对齐（CHA），在自然观影fMRI数据中按皮层连接而非解剖位置对齐皮层下体素。结果显示，对齐后个体间在刺激诱发反应和连接剖面上的对应性明显提高，且局部结构更清晰而非被模糊，相邻体素功能更可区分，皮层连接目标在个体间的可解码性也增强。这表明人类皮层下核团存在共有的精细功能架构，只是被解剖变异掩盖，并提示群体分析可通过按功能对齐获得体素级精度。

papers.title: An information-borrowing Bayesian method for inferring high-dimensional population-level brain connectivity from small samples
papers.authors: Pu Z, Zeng C, Ge S.
papers.abstract: Estimating population-level dependence between brain regions is challenging when the number of regions greatly exceeds the number of individuals. We introduce an information-borrowing generalized Bayesian method for high-dimensional covariance estimation from region-level brain measurements. A divide-and-conquer parameterization separates marginal variances from correlation calibrations: an empirical pilot correlation matrix–by default, obtained by standardizing a sample covariance matrix (SCM)–provides a reference structure that is adaptively calibrated through region-specific parameters shared across pairwise correlations, reducing the number of free parameters from O ( d 2 ) to O ( d ) ( d is the number of regions) while guaranteeing a positive-definite covariance through the inclusion of a ridge term. Horseshoe priors on the calibration parameters enable selective borrowing and shrinkage of pilot information. Under suitable conditions on pilot accuracy, we establish theoretical guarantees for covariance estimation while retaining scalability in ultra-high-dimensional settings via a low-rank likelihood representation and a Woodbury-accelerated Hamiltonian Monte Carlo algorithm. Simulations showed lower estimation error than the SCM, bagging and iteratively refined principal orthogonal complement thresholding (POETRY). Applications to a semi-synthetic cortical-thickness and ADHD resting-state fMRI data revealed significant group differences in the default-mode–visual network and somatomotor network–limbic network blocks after Benjamini–Hochberg correction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑区数量远多于个体数时难以估计群体水平脑区间依赖关系的问题，提出一种借用信息的广义贝叶斯高维协方差估计方法。方法将边际方差与相关校准分离，以试点相关矩阵为参照结构，通过区域共享的校准参数和马蹄先验实现选择性借用与收缩，并用低秩似然表示和加速采样保持超高维情形的可扩展性，同时给出协方差估计的理论保证。模拟显示其估计误差低于样本协方差矩阵、bagging和POETRY；在皮层厚度半合成数据与ADHD静息态fMRI数据中，经多重比较校正后发现默认网络—视觉网络及感觉运动网络—边缘网络区块存在显著组间差异。这些结果提示该方法可在小样本下支持群体脑连接推断，但组间差异属关联性发现，尚不涉及临床效用。

papers.title: Cortical organoid diffusion MRI reveals protocol-associated spatial reproducibility and increasing apparent diffusivity with diffusion time
papers.authors: le Boeuf Fló A, Taskin E, Lavielle O, Grigoriou A, Pierzchala K, Lê TP, Jelescu I, Krsnik Z, Ribierre T, Thiran J, Rafael Patiño J, Canales Rodríguez EJ, Fischi Gómez E.
papers.abstract: Early human cortical development involves rapid cytoarchitectural changes that are difficult to study non-invasively. Diffusion MRI can probe developing microstructure and membrane water exchange, but model assumptions are difficult to validate in human tissue. Cortical organoids provide a tractable platform for relating diffusion measurements to tissue architecture. We scanned six fixed cortical organoids at 9.4 T, three grown under directed and three under undirected differentiation protocols, at three diffusion times and b-values up to 7000 s/mm 2 Center-to-periphery profiles of diffusion kurtosis imaging (DKI) metrics were reproducible across directed organoids but more variable across undirected organoids, consistent with nuclear staining. Unexpectedly, DKI-derived apparent mean diffusivity (MD) increased with diffusion time in more than 80% of tissue voxels in both batches, opposite to previous organoid measurements. Across 12,348 analytically simulated two-compartment substrates and Monte Carlo diffusion simulations in sphere packings, this trend emerged in permeable substrates with a marked contrast between extracellular and apparent intracellular diffusivities. Detailed Monte Carlo trajectory analysis of a representative substrate showed that fitted MD increased despite decreases in displacement-derived and second-cumulant diffusivities, revealing an exchange-sensitive finite-b effect involving higher-order signal contributions. These findings support using cortical organoids to probe early microstructure, test diffusion models, and investigate potential emerging diffusion biomarkers.

papers.title: Simultaneous multi-area recordings in macaque frontoparietal cortex during a manual object-interaction task
papers.authors: Liu K, Guan S, Luo S, Li Y, Dong Y, Chen W, Chen M, Zhang D, Chen L, Huang S, Chen Y, Jiang H, Wu L, Li R, Zhu F, Xie Y, Sui Y, Min B, Guan S, Li CT, Wang T, He T.
papers.abstract: Dexterous hand control is essential for daily activities and a top restoration priority for people with tetraplegia, yet neurophysiological datasets suitable for studying and decoding naturalistic hand behavior remain scarce. Most available recordings constrain movements to a small number of degrees of freedom or cover only a single stereotypical grasp-and-hold structure. Moreover, previous brain-computer interface (BCI) studies have largely relied on signals from a single cortical area, even though dexterous hand control is distributed across an interconnected frontoparietal network. To address these limitations, we designed a paradigm that elicits rich hand movements across 40 distinct hand-object interaction conditions. We recorded simultaneous frontoparietal activity with hand kinematics from a rhesus macaque performing them. Neural activity was recorded from the primary motor cortex, anterior intraparietal area, and ventral premotor cortex using microelectrode arrays spanning 1,920 channels, while a multi-camera markerless motion-capture system acquired video from which kinematics were extracted offline. The dataset comprises data from 20 sessions, including processed neural features, synchronized 3D coordinates of hand and elbow keypoints, and trial-level metadata including task conditions and event timing. We further provide technical validation, including a neural decoding benchmark with multiple algorithms for continuous keypoint coordination reconstruction. We found that cross-day and cross-task decoding performance varied among algorithms. Variation in channel availability leads to different performance degradation curves in different algorithms. This task-rich dataset offers a valuable resource for investigating the neural mechanisms of dexterous hand control and for advancing the performance of motor BCIs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对灵巧手部控制的多脑区神经数据稀缺、既往脑机接口多依赖单一皮层信号的问题，设计了一项涵盖多种手-物体交互条件的手部运动任务，在猕猴执行任务时同步记录前顶叶网络活动与手部运动学数据，并据此构建了包含神经特征、手肘关键点三维坐标和试次元数据的数据集。作者还以连续关键点协调重建为基准，比较了多种解码算法，发现跨天和跨任务解码表现因算法而异，且通道可用性变化会使不同算法呈现不同的性能下降曲线。该数据集为研究灵巧手控制的神经机制和改进运动脑机接口提供了资源，但解码结果属于基准验证，尚不代表临床治疗效果。

papers.title: Structural integrity moderates the cognitive bearing of dopamine clearance in aging
papers.authors: Esmaeili A, Preti G, Bittner N, Woodman MM, Caspers S, Hashemi M, Petkoski S, Marinazzo D, Jirsa V.
papers.abstract: Age-related cognitive decline in humans is well established, yet how neurobiological variations influence brain dynamics, and subsequently behavioral performance, remains insufficiently explored. Microscale accounts of cognitive aging revolve around attenuations in dopamine (DA) receptors and transporters (DAT). In contrast, macroscale accounts associate individual declines in cognitive performance with functional brain networks’ reorganization and white-matter tracts’ deterioration. We endeavor to bridge this gap with an amortized dopaminergic aging model (ADAM) which assembles aging brain twins by coupling dopaminergic modulation with structural connectomes to constrain emergent whole-brain dynamics. ADAM thereby augments established DAT decline with personalized estimates, through a reusable and generalizable estimator capable of disentangling neuromodulatory from structural contributions to age-related decline within each individual. To that end, we embed structural connectomes into a low-dimensional space exhibiting high reconstruction fidelity and —pseudonymized— individual identifiability. The spectrum of structural embeddings is subsequently updated with fMRI observations to estimate DA clearance timescales in 3,650 adults aged 36 to 95 years across five independent aging cohorts. Our analysis reveals an age-related elevation of DA clearance timescales. Critically, low performers exhibit elevated clearance in adults with marked structural degradation, and only within sliding age windows centred between 56 and 76 years. This supports a contribution of dopamine to aging, and reveals a structure- and age-conditional association between its clearance and cognitive performance. Our findings suggest that structural connectivity gates the macroscale reach of dopaminergic modulation, thus rendering the gain-control framework of neuromodulation mechanistically explicit across individuals and cohorts. ADAM therefore provides a biologically plausible framework that anchors interindividual variability in cognitive aging to perturbations in the dopaminergic system by learning cohort-scale mappings which can be shared across sites, establishing a transferable testbed for precision neuromodulation and future in-silico pharmacological trials.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种可 amortized 的多巴胺能老化模型（ADAM），将多巴胺调节与个体结构连接组耦合，用结构嵌入结合fMRI观测估计多巴胺清除时间尺度，并在多个独立老化队列的成年人中检验其与认知表现的关系。结果显示，多巴胺清除时间尺度随年龄升高；只有在结构退化明显且年龄处于特定滑动窗口内的成年人中，低认知表现者才表现出清除时间尺度升高。作者据此认为，结构连接可能限制多巴胺调节在宏观层面的作用范围，多巴胺清除与认知表现的关联受结构和年龄条件约束，而非普遍存在。

papers.title: Distinct EEG microstate signatures across different pain types
papers.authors: Rabiei P, Champagne A, Barrette L, Fakhry N, Massé-Alarie H, Coll M.
papers.abstract: Pain is associated with dynamic brain reorganization. Electroencephalographic microstates can characterize transient large-scale brain states, yet findings across pain studies are inconsistent. Two features may contribute: conditions have been studied in isolation, and analytical pipelines vary widely. We applied a harmonized analysis pipeline across three pain conditions: capsaicin-induced pain, assessed within participants against a pain-free baseline, and non-chronic and chronic back pain, each compared with matched controls. Using a five-minute resting-state electroencephalographic recordings we examined microstate topography, temporal expression and transition probabilities, and directly compared pain-related differences across pain states. We identified five microstates (A-E), corresponding to auditory, visual, salience, and attentional networks. Capsaicin pain showed increased expression of microstate C and reduced expression of microstates A, D and E. Transitions were redistributed towards microstate C, indicating a shift toward salience-related processing at the expense of sensory and attentional dynamics. In clinical back pain, effects were smaller and diverged by pain type: non-chronic back pain showed lower microstate C occurrence, opposite in direction to the capsaicin effect, whereas chronic back pain showed lower microstate D global explained variance, suggesting salience and attentional differences in clinical pain. Direct comparisons showed weaker pain-related increases in microstate C expression in both clinical back pain groups than capsaicin pain, with additional differences involving microstates A, D and E. These findings argue against a unitary EEG microstate signature of pain and instead reveal pain-type-specific patterns of large-scale brain dynamics, with microstate C providing the clearest distinction between experimental and clinical pain.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注不同疼痛状态是否具有一致的脑电微状态特征，并针对既往研究因条件孤立和分析流程不一而结果不一致的问题，采用统一分析流程比较了辣椒素诱导痛、非慢性背痛和慢性背痛。结果显示，辣椒素痛表现为微状态C表达增加、A、D、E表达减少，状态转换也偏向微状态C，提示显著性相关加工增强而感觉与注意动态受抑；临床背痛效应较小且方向分化，非慢性背痛微状态C反而降低，慢性背痛则表现为微状态D全局解释方差下降。作者据此认为不存在单一的疼痛微状态标志，疼痛类型决定了大尺度脑动态的不同模式，微状态C最能区分实验性痛与临床痛。

papers.title: Psychedelics Restructure the Global Workspace of Consciousness
papers.authors: Yousefi P, Shinozuka K, Vizeli P, Holze F, Becker AM, Müller F, Liechti ME, Hasler G, Rodríguez CI, Luppi A, Mediano PA.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Psychoactive drugs profoundly alter consciousness, but the neural mechanisms by which they do so remain poorly understood. Global workspace theory may provide a framework for investigating these mechanisms. The global workspace, a candidate neural substrate of consciousness, is a set of brain regions that integrate and disseminate information to the rest of the brain. According to a recent model, the integrators, or “gateways,” are characterized by synergistic interactions with other brain regions, while the disseminators, or “broadcasters,” exhibit redundant interactions. Here, we measured the effects of various psychoactive drugs, including “classic” psychedelics like LSD, mescaline, and psilocybin, “atypical” psychedelics (entactogens) like MDMA, and the stimulant D-amphetamine, on the global workspace. In a secondary analysis of resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data on all these drugs, we found that classic psychedelics are associated with significant increases in the number of gateways in the frontoparietal control and dorsal attention networks. Meanwhile, MDMA and amphetamine reduced the number of gateways in the visual and somatomotor networks. The regional topographies of both synergy and redundancy distinguished classic psychedelics from other drugs. Finally, drugs producing similar changes in synergy and redundancy also produced similar profiles of subjective effects. Overall, our findings provide the first direct evidence that psychedelics may alter the synergistic and redundant interactions that characterize the global workspace of consciousness.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注经典致幻剂等精神活性药物如何改变意识相关的全局工作空间，基于多类药物静息态功能磁共振数据的二次分析，考察脑区间协同与冗余交互所刻画的“门户”和“广播”结构。结果显示，经典致幻剂与额顶控制网络和背侧注意网络中门户数量增加相关，而MDMA和苯丙胺则减少视觉与躯体运动网络中的门户数量；协同与冗余的区域分布也能区分经典致幻剂与其他药物。作者还发现，在协同和冗余上产生相似变化的药物，其主观效应谱也相似，并据此提出致幻剂可能通过改变全局工作空间的协同与冗余交互而发挥作用，但这一证据仍属关联性观察。

papers.title: Communication as a Two-Person Neural Process: fNIRS Hyperscanning in Adults with and without Post-Stroke Aphasia
papers.authors: Magee G, Colwell J, Kelley S, Mohammad Y, Zhang Y, Boas D, Kiran S, Varkanitsa M, Meier E, Yücel M.
papers.abstract: Communication is inherently interactive, yet most neuroimaging studies examine individuals in isolation. Here, we used functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) hyperscanning to investigate interbrain synchrony (IBS) during naturalistic communication. In Study 1, 13 healthy familiar dyads completed Joint Singing, Joint Reading, and Picture Guessing tasks. IBS was quantified using wavelet transform coherence across bilateral frontal and temporoparietal regions. Joint Singing produced higher IBS than the other tasks in several regions, including the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and temporoparietal junction, and selected effects were greater in true than pseudo-dyads. In Study 2, we applied the same paradigm to five individuals with chronic post-stroke aphasia interacting with trained speech-language pathologists. IBS could be estimated in all dyads after lesion-informed channel exclusion, although regional coverage varied with lesion location. These findings demonstrate that fNIRS hyperscanning can capture task-dependent interpersonal neural coupling during spoken interaction and can be extended to communication involving individuals with aphasia. This approach provides a foundation for studying how neural coordination between communication partners relates to functional communication and partner-supported interaction.
