papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然交流中交流双方的大脑活动如何协调，采用功能性近红外光谱超扫描技术，在健康熟悉配对和慢性卒中后失语者与言语治疗师的配对中测量脑间同步。健康配对完成联合唱歌、联合朗读和看图猜词任务，结果显示联合唱歌在多个额叶和颞顶区域引起的脑间同步高于其他任务，部分效应在真实配对中强于伪配对。研究还将同一范式用于失语者交流配对，在排除病灶相关通道后仍能估计脑间同步，但区域覆盖随病灶位置而异。作者据此认为，该方法能捕捉口语互动中任务依赖的人际神经耦合，并可推广到失语者参与的交流研究，为考察交流伙伴间的神经协调与功能性沟通的关系提供基础。

papers.title: Lifespan Trajectories of Resting State Bipolar EEG Power
papers.authors: Chorlian DB, Kamarajan C, Meyers JL, Anokhin A, Pandey AK, Zhang J, Kinreich S, Porjesz B.
papers.abstract: Normative trajectories of resting state bipolar EEG power over the lifespan were derived from a sample of 5781 participants from the Collaborative Study on the Genetics of Alcoholism (COGA), a large multi site study, using 12,906 observations from ages 12 through 70. Trajectories were analyzed using the means, variances, and correlations of data in seven frequency bands (from low theta to high beta) and 24 bipolar channels obtained from 17 electrodes of the 10-20 system. In order to make the study more useful for understanding EEG in the general population, only subjects never having an alcohol use disorder (AUD) diagnosis were included in the study. Bipolar EEG data is derived from the differencing of the signals in adjacent electrodes, either in a lateral (left-right) or sagittal (anterior-posterior) orientation; each difference is called a channel. The power values for the individual observations were calculated by standard Fourier transform based methods. In all cases there are sharp decreases in EEG power from ages 12 to the early 20s after which there are number of divergent patterns: general increases in the beta frequencies, and mixed patterns of increase and subsequent decrease in the theta and alpha frequencies. In these characteristics the lifespan trajectories presented here are similar to the monopolar trajectories described in our previous study Chorlian et al. (2026). Sagittal and lateral bipolar trajectories are similar within each sex and between sexes; the primary difference is the much lower degree of regional difference in the sagittal trajectories as compared to the lateral trajectories. The pairwise inter-frequency (within channel) correlation trajectories between the four theta and alpha frequency bands and the four high alpha and beta frequency bands at each channel show striking sex differences unlike the corresponding monopolar correlations. There are a number of features in the bipolar power trajectories that suggest that the differencing procedure reduces not only local phase synchrony, but also effects of global and regional phase synchrony present in the monopolar data from which the bipolar signals are derived. The inter-frequency correlations at the individual channels are much higher in the bipolar data than the monopolar data, suggesting that global and regional phase synchrony components retained in the monopolar data have greater frequency specificity than the more purely local components in the bipolar data. Further analyses to examine many other features of the data will be undertaken in our subsequent work.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于大型多中心样本的静息态双极脑电数据，刻画了从青春期到成年晚期的毕生功率变化轨迹，并仅纳入从未被诊断为酒精使用障碍的参与者，以更贴近一般人群。结果显示，各频段功率在12岁至20岁出头均急剧下降，此后出现分化：β频段总体上升，θ和α频段则呈升降混合模式，整体与作者此前的单极导联结果相似。矢状与横向双极轨迹在同一性别内及两性间大体相近，主要差别是矢状轨迹的区域差异更小；而θ、α频段与高α、β频段之间的通道内频率间相关轨迹表现出明显的性别差异，这一点与单极数据不同。作者据此推测，双极差分不仅削弱局部相位同步，也削弱单极数据中的全局和区域相位同步成分，使双极数据的频率间相关更高，提示单极数据保留的同步成分具有更强的频率特异性。

papers.title: Functional near infrared spectroscopy-based dual-stream adaptive language mapping in adults with and without post-stroke aphasia
papers.authors: Meier E, Fletcher V, Hung C, Andraos EA, Ugent L, Wei G, Lin D, Yücel M.
papers.abstract: In aphasia, variability in lesion location and post-stroke network reorganization complicates efforts to identify the regions that support semantic versus phonological processing. In prior work, researchers have often examined these domains in separate patient cohorts, further limiting direct comparison of their neural substrates within aphasia. To address this gap, we investigated the degree of overlap and specialization within semantic and phonological networks in adults with and without aphasia and examined how neural activity relates to task performance and lesion profiles. Sixteen neurologically healthy adults and 15 participants with aphasia following left hemisphere stroke completed adaptive Semantic Matching and Rhyme Judgment tasks during functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) recording. Changes in oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin were measured within regions of interest, and activation was related to standardized task performance and damage to left ventral and dorsal language pathways in participants with aphasia. Controls showed largely distinct activation patterns consistent with prior fMRI findings: Semantic Matching preferentially recruited ventral stream regions, particularly left temporal cortex, whereas Rhyme Judgment more strongly recruited dorsal regions, including left inferior frontal and inferior parietal cortex. Participants with aphasia showed greater inter-individual variability and no clear group-level segregation of dorsal and ventral activity. Better Semantic Matching performance was associated with less left ventral stream damage and greater left dorsal activation, whereas better Rhyme Judgment performance was associated with lower right hemisphere ventral and dorsal activation. These findings suggest that post-stroke language performance reflects residual specialization, lesion-dependent constraints, and flexible recruitment of surviving tissue. Overall, fNIRS shows promise as an alternative to fMRI for language mapping in post-stroke aphasia, although replication in larger samples with more extensive cortical coverage is warranted.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）结合自适应语义匹配和押韵判断任务，比较健康成人（16人）与左半球卒中后失语者（15人）在语义和语音加工中的脑区激活模式。健康组表现出与既往fMRI研究一致的分离模式：语义匹配主要激活左颞叶等腹侧通路区域，押韵判断则更强激活左额下回和顶下小叶等背侧区域；失语组个体差异更大，未出现清晰的腹侧/背侧分组分离。在失语者中，语义匹配成绩较好与左腹侧通路损伤较轻及左背侧激活较强相关，押韵判断成绩较好则与右半球腹侧和背侧激活较低相关。作者据此认为，卒中后语言表现反映了残余特化、病灶相关约束以及对存活组织的灵活募集，并提示fNIRS有望作为fMRI之外的语言映射替代手段，但尚需更大样本和更广皮层覆盖的研究验证。

papers.title: Resection of highly functionally connected glioma regions predicts long-term cognitive preservation
papers.authors: van Lingen MR, Jaiswal A, Nagajaran SS, Jayabal V, Klein M, Verburg N, de Witt Hamer P, Hillebrand A, Douw L.
papers.abstract: Background Glioma surgery requires balancing maximal tumor resection against preservation of neurological and cognitive function. Intraoperative direct electrical stimulation guides this balance but is invasive and not always feasible. Preoperative magnetoencephalography (MEG) can identify tumor regions with high functional connectivity (HFC) to the rest of the brain. These HFC areas contain more malignant glioma cells and relate to poorer short-term outcome when resected. We aimed to determine whether HFC voxel resection relates to postoperative neurological and cognitive outcomes. Methods In this preregistered analysis, 54 adults with diffuse glioma underwent resting-state MEG before resection. Imaginary coherence identified voxels with significantly higher connectivity against their contralateral controls, and these HFC voxels within the resection cavity were counted. Neurological status was assessed at short-term (∼1 week) and long-term (∼1 year) follow-up, and neuropsychological assessment took place at baseline and long-term follow-up. Logistic regressions related resected HFC voxels to decline at each timepoint, adjusting for Karnofsky performance status, sex and resectability index. Results Resected HFC voxels were not associated with neurological decline at short-term (48% declined; odds ratio [OR] 0.98, P = .50) or long-term follow-up (27% declined; OR 0.99). For cognition, more resected HFC voxels were associated with less long-term decline (48% declined; OR 0.85, P = .02); a binarized analysis was consistent (OR 0.076, P = .01), indicating that tumor volume did not drive this result. Conclusions Resecting more HFC voxels associates with preserved long-term cognition, without apparent neurological cost. Non-invasive MEG connectivity mapping may help optimize the onco-functional balance in glioma surgery. Key points Resecting more highly functionally connected tumor voxels relates to preserved long-term cognition in glioma. Connectivity did not predict postsurgical neurological outcome. Preoperative MEG connectivity mapping may help inform the onco-functional balance. Importance of the Study Achieving the optimal onco-functional balance in glioma surgery means resecting as much tumor as possible, while preserving neurological and cognitive function over the long term. Intraoperative direct electrical stimulation helps guide this balance but is invasive, time-consuming, and not always feasible. This study extends preoperative, non-invasive MEG functional connectivity mapping to neurological and cognitive outcomes up to one year after surgery, using a different MEG system, cohort, and center than used in prior work. We show that resecting more high functionally connected voxels associates with preserved long-term cognition, at no neurological cost. Preoperative MEG connectivity could therefore complement stimulation mapping to guide safer, more effective resections, particularly in IDH-mutant glioma, whose longer survival makes long-term cognitive preservation especially important.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在弥漫性胶质瘤切除中，切除与全脑功能连接较高的肿瘤区域是否与术后神经和认知结局相关。54名成人患者在术前接受静息态脑磁图检查，以虚相干指标识别高功能连接体素，并结合切除腔统计其被切除的数量，随后在短期和长期随访中评估神经状态，在基线和长期随访中评估认知。结果显示，切除更多高功能连接体素与长期认知下降更少相关，且未观察到明显的神经功能代价；短期和长期神经结局均未见显著关联。作者据此认为，术前无创脑磁图连接图谱可能有助于把握肿瘤切除与功能保留之间的平衡，但这是关联性证据，尚不能证明其临床效用。

papers.title: Multidimensional Neuroprotective Effects of Combined Ubisol-Q10 and Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) in Male and Female 5XFAD Mice.
papers.authors: Dube K, Stoinescu A, Sadler J, Truong M, Malakoti-Negad N, Chaudhry M, Talukdar R, Cohen J, Pandey S.
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a multifactorial neurodegenerative disorder characterized by interconnected pathological processes including mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, impaired autophagic processes, neuroinflammation, neuronal degeneration, and progressive functional decline. Natural health products (NHPs), coenzyme-Q10 (CoQ10) and Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera ) (ASH), have been previously reported to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, mitochondrial-supportive, neuroprotective, and neurotrophic properties. This work investigates the neuroprotective effects of a bioavailability-enhanced formulation, Ubisol-Q10 (UQ), and ethanolic ASH extract, combined as a "Tonic," across multiple domains of AD pathology. Methods The effects of long-term administration were evaluated in male and female 5XFAD mice from 2.5 to 11 months of age. Longitudinal magnetic resonance imaging assessed hippocampal and white matter volumes, a frailty index assessed physiological resilience, Novel Object and Novel Location Recognition testing assessed spatial and non-spatial memory, while post-mortem Nissl, Golgi-Cox, and immunofluorescence evaluated cellular density, dendritic morphology, amyloid pathology, neuroinflammation, autophagy-associated signaling, and astrocytic activity. Results Across these measures, Tonic treatment preserved brain volumes, reduced amyloid pathology and inflammation, and modulated autophagy-associated pathways. Treatment also preserved dendritic architecture, frailty progression, and novelty-recognition behavior. Females demonstrated particularly pronounced preservation of white matter structure and increased dendritic density, whereas males showed strong modulation of inflammatory and autophagy-associated markers. Astrocytic immunoreactivity also demonstrated sex- and region-specific patterns, suggesting that glial responses may contribute differently to structural preservation in males and females. Conclusions Together, these findings support that UQ + ASH may provide diverse protection against AD neurodegeneration. The observed sex-specific responses emphasize the importance of incorporating sex into preclinical evaluation of novel interventions for neurodegenerative diseases.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在雄性和雌性5XFAD阿尔茨海默病模型小鼠中长期给予生物利用度增强的Ubisol-Q10与印度人参（Ashwagandha）乙醇提取物组合，并综合影像、行为与组织学指标评估其神经保护作用。结果显示，该组合处理可维持脑体积，减轻淀粉样病理与炎症，调节自噬相关通路，并保留树突结构、延缓衰弱进展、维持新异识别行为。雌雄小鼠反应存在差异：雌性白质结构和树突密度的保留更明显，雄性炎症与自噬相关标志物的调节更突出，星形胶质细胞反应也呈性别和脑区特异性。作者据此认为该组合可能对AD神经退行性变提供多层面保护，并强调性别因素应纳入此类干预的临床前评价。

papers.title: Metabolic Dysregulation and Metabolite-Targeted Interventions in Autism Spectrum Disorder: Mechanisms and Translational Perspectives.
papers.authors: Fang Y, Dou Z, Liu Y, Zong Y, Wang S, Li S, He N, Li N.
papers.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental disorder marked by impaired social communication and restricted repetitive behaviors. Metabolic dysregulation is increasingly recognized as a key intermediate mechanism linking genetic and environmental factors to abnormal neurodevelopment in ASD. This review summarizes ASD-related metabolic abnormalities involving gut microbial metabolites, energy metabolism, neurotransmitter pathways, and immune-metabolic crosstalk. Such metabolic disturbances affect neurodevelopment via immune activation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and disrupted neurotransmitter homeostasis, ultimately impairing synaptic plasticity and neural connectivity. We also outline the preclinical and clinical progress of metabolite-targeted interventions, which show potential to modulate relevant metabolic pathways. However, it should be noted that improvements in specific metabolic biomarkers may only be associated with, rather than definitively drive, behavioral changes. However, current studies are constrained by inconsistent trial designs, small cohorts, and inadequate mechanistic verification; furthermore, interindividual metabolic heterogeneity limits universal intervention efficacy. We discuss clinical translation barriers and propose future priorities: defining metabolic subtypes, validating biomarkers, and developing precision metabolic interventions. Elucidating these metabolic mechanisms will advance targeted, personalized therapies to improve neurodevelopmental outcomes in ASD.

papers.title: Effectiveness of Native and Enhanced Extracellular Vesicle Preparations Assessed in Animal Models of Multiple Sclerosis: A Meta-Analysis.
papers.authors: Magercu M, Ristoiu V, Amuzescu B, Dulămea AO.
papers.abstract: Extracellular vesicle (EV) preparations have emerged as potentially useful therapeutic tools for various inflammatory or neurodegenerative CNS disorders. Compared to mesenchymal stem cell preparations, they feature enhanced blood-brain barrier permeability and access to injured brain tissue, and better quality assessment and dosing options. A particular case where such therapies may prove beneficial is multiple sclerosis (MS), an autoimmune disease likely triggered by cross-reactivity with some viral antigens, producing an extended demyelinating encephalomyelitis with multiple patchy lesions. Several animal models of MS have been developed, including experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) via injection of myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein (MOG) 35-55, inoculation with Theiler's murine encephalomyelitis virus (TMEV), and the Cuprizone model. Via literature search we retrieved 24 experimental studies on rodent (rat or mouse) MS models with therapeutic administration of native or enhanced EV preparations suitable for this meta-analysis. We found statistically significant mean differences between experimental and control groups for clinical scores (normalized to a 0-5 scale) (-1.21, 95% confidence interval (CI) [-1.49,-0.93] (native EVs); -1.67, CI [-2.28,-1.05] (enhanced EVs)), for pathological scores of inflammation and demyelination, and for several molecular markers of inflammation and myelin repair. These results point to the need for clinical translation of the encouraging preliminary results obtained using such MS animal models.

papers.title: Spectral-Distribution Uncertainty Modeling for Robust Cross-Domain Medical Image Segmentation.
papers.authors: Xin C, Chen Z, Huang Z, Wang J, Lin L.
papers.abstract: Domain generalization (DG) for medical image segmentation is commonly approached by simulating domain shifts through deterministic image transformations or feature perturbations. However, such methods implicitly assume that unseen domains can be approximated by predefined appearance variations. In this work, we challenge this assumption and hypothesize that medical domain shifts are more fundamentally characterized as uncertainty in spectral distributions. While anatomical structures are largely preserved across institutions, scanners, and acquisition protocols, substantial variations arise in image appearance, texture, and artifacts, which are predominantly manifested in the spectral domain. To test this hypothesis, we propose Spectral-Distribution Uncertainty (SDU), a frequency-aware DG framework that explicitly models uncertainty in the Fourier amplitude distributions of intermediate representations. By decomposing Transformer features into amplitude and phase components, SDU disentangles domain-specific spectral characteristics from domain-invariant anatomical semantics. Instead of imposing handcrafted frequency perturbations, SDU estimates spectral-distribution uncertainty during training and injects stochastic variations into the amplitude space, synthesizing diverse yet anatomically consistent representations that emulate potential unseen domains. Consequently, SDU expands the support of spectral feature distributions, enabling the model to learn representations that are robust to uncertainty-induced spectral shifts. Extensive experiments on retinal fundus and prostate MRI benchmarks demonstrate that SDU consistently outperforms state-of-the-art DG methods. Beyond empirical gains, these findings provide evidence that medical domain shifts are more appropriately characterized as uncertainty in spectral feature distributions, offering a principled perspective for generalizable medical image segmentation.

papers.title: EEG signature in psychiatrist's subjective experience: a pilot study.
papers.authors: Videtta G, Bondi E, Colli C, Enrico G, Sperti L, Pallagrosi M, Fonzi L, Barone Y, Schiena G, Maggioni E, Picardi A, Brambilla P.
papers.abstract: Introduction The Assessment of Clinician's Subjective Experience (ACSE) is a self-report questionnaire developed to evaluate clinicians' subjective experiences during patient interactions. While its psychometric properties and clinical validity have been supported, its neurobiological correlates have not yet been investigated. Methods In this pilot study, two clinicians and ten patients participated in a three-phase protocol comprising: (1) a first clinical interview, (2) ACSE administration, and (3) listening to the audio recording of the first clinical interview. EEG activity was recorded from clinicians during both the first clinical interview and questionnaire administration. Neural data were analyzed in terms of relative power spectral density, node strength, and global efficiency computed from imaginary coherence. Results Clinicians were psychiatrists, one male and one female. Seven patients were diagnosed with mixed anxiety and depressive disorder, and three with unspecified anxiety disorders. ACSE scores were highest for the Difficulty in attunement and Engagement dimensions, consistent with previous literature. EEG findings revealed dimension-specific and topographically distinct oscillatory patterns for only two ACSE dimensions: Difficulty in Attunement and Engagement. More limited evidence emerged for Disconfirmation. Functional connectivity analyses indicated different network profiles, characterized by differences in global efficiency patterns. Correlational analyses further identified significant associations between ACSE dimensions and EEG-derived features. Discussion These preliminary findings provide initial evidence that clinicians' subjective experiences during clinical encounters could be associated with measurable neural signatures, offering a novel perspective on the neurobiological basis of intersubjective processes in clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh: 这项初步研究探讨精神科医生在临床访谈中的主观体验是否具有可测量的脑电关联，采用脑电记录结合自评问卷，在医生进行访谈和填写问卷时采集数据，并分析振荡功率与功能连接指标。结果显示，仅“难以协调”和“投入”两个维度呈现维度特异且空间分布不同的振荡模式，“否定确认”维度的证据较有限；功能连接分析也显示不同维度对应不同的网络效率特征，且问卷得分与脑电特征存在关联。作者据此提出，医生在临床互动中的主观体验可能与可测量的神经特征相关，为临床情境中主体间过程的神经生物学基础提供了初步线索，但样本很小，结论仍是探索性的。

papers.title: Transcutaneous vagus nerve stimulation during semantic verbal fluency tasks: a high-density diffuse optical tomography study.
papers.authors: Illingworth CH, Baig SS, Swalwell J, Holowacz M, Dorney SL, Burr SDL, Butters E, Blackburn D, Ali A, Majid A, Su L.
papers.abstract: Introduction Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) is a promising adjunct for post-stroke language recovery. There are no established biomarkers for the neuromodulatory effects of taVNS. High-density diffuse optical tomography (HD-DOT) offers a non-invasive marker of task-related cortical activation. We explore HD-DOT in determining the effects of taVNS during a semantic verbal fluency task (VFT). Methods Twenty-four healthy adult participants performed a semantic VFT in a block design, whilst HD-DOT was recorded across the bilateral prefrontal cortex. Participants received sham (earlobe) taVNS followed by active (tragus) taVNS. Statistical analysis was performed at a group level within condition (task-baseline) and between conditions (active taVNS vs. sham taVNS) using node-level and parcellation approaches. Results Twenty-one participants (87.5%) met the signal quality threshold. At the uncorrected level, significant increases in task-related activity were seen in the triangular part of the left inferior frontal gyrus, during both the active and sham taVNS. Correcting for multiple comparisons, significant increases were seen in the left lateral orbitofrontal cortex during sham stimulation. No significant differences in oxygenated haemoglobin concentration increase were seen between active and sham taVNS. Discussion Simultaneous recording of brain activity to taVNS during a semantic VFT was feasible and well tolerated. Task-related activation was seen in brain regions associated with language production and decision-making. Through this exploratory work, healthy adults do not demonstrate any significant enhancement of frontal cortical activation from taVNS. Future studies should combine whole-brain HD-DOT and taVNS in clinical cohorts.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究考察经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）能否在语义言语流畅性任务中增强前额叶皮层激活，并检验用高密度弥散光学断层成像（HD-DOT）同步记录这一效应的可行性。健康成人先后接受假刺激与主动刺激，同时用HD-DOT记录双侧前额叶活动。结果显示，同步记录可行且耐受良好，任务相关激活出现在与语言产生和决策有关的区域；但在校正多重比较后，主动与假刺激之间未见氧合血红蛋白浓度增加的显著差异，即健康成人中未观察到taVNS对额叶皮层激活的明显增强。作者据此认为，该范式可用于后续在临床人群中结合全脑HD-DOT与taVNS的研究，但现有结果尚不能支持taVNS的临床疗效。

papers.title: Neuromelanin-sensitive magnetic resonance imaging in the diagnosis and assessment of Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Zhang D, Yusufujiang A, Li H.
papers.abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized primarily by the progressive loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc); noradrenergic neurons in the locus coeruleus (LC) are also frequently affected. Because clinical motor symptoms usually emerge only after substantial neurodegeneration has occurred, there is a compelling need for noninvasive imaging biomarkers capable of detecting early pathological changes. Neuromelanin-sensitive magnetic resonance imaging (NM-MRI) generates neuromelanin-related image contrast in the SNpc and LC and can indirectly reflect the structural integrity of these catecholaminergic nuclei. Current evidence suggests that NM-MRI may be useful for distinguishing patients with PD from healthy controls, supporting the differential diagnosis of selected atypical parkinsonian syndromes and essential tremor, assessing disease stage, monitoring longitudinal change, and evaluating high-risk individuals in the prodromal phase. This review provides an updated account of recent advances in the use of NM-MRI for diagnostic support, differential diagnosis, prodromal assessment, longitudinal monitoring, multimodal imaging, and artificial intelligence-based analysis, and discusses its clinical role relative to other imaging and fluid biomarkers. Combining NM-MRI with complementary imaging measures, such as quantitative susceptibility mapping and diffusion MRI, and with automated analytical methods may further enhance pathological characterization and quantitative assessment. However, the available evidence is derived largely from single-center or case-control studies with limited sample sizes. Substantial variability may arise from differences in scanners, magnetic field strengths, acquisition protocols, and analytical methods, while independent external validation and prospective multicenter longitudinal evidence remain limited. The biological basis of the NM-MRI signal has not been fully established, and artificial intelligence models developed for NM-MRI remain vulnerable to overfitting, limited interpretability, and limited cross-center generalizability. Accordingly, NM-MRI cannot currently serve as a stand-alone diagnostic tool for PD or replace diagnosis based on comprehensive clinical assessment. It is better regarded as a promising complementary imaging biomarker and research tool. Before NM-MRI can be widely used for routine clinical diagnosis, disease monitoring, or as a clinical trial outcome measure, acquisition and analytical methods must be further standardized, and its performance must be evaluated in large, prospective, multicenter longitudinal studies.

papers.title: The cerebellum in migraine: a narrative review of anatomical, imaging, and clinical evidence.
papers.authors: Zhang R, Huang J, Fan X, Hu W, Dong L, Zhou J.
papers.abstract: Migraine is usually framed through trigeminovascular pathways and interactions among the brainstem, hypothalamus, and cortex. The cerebellum has received less attention, although human studies place it within circuits that process trigeminal nociception and vestibular signals. This narrative review examines anatomical and experimental work together with imaging, genetic, and clinical studies, giving greatest weight to direct human migraine evidence. Repeated-measures imaging suggests that cerebellar connectivity changes across the migraine cycle, but the cohorts are small. Structural findings vary with analytic method, and population based testing does not show a general cerebellar deficit in common migraine. Evidence is more coherent in defined contexts: trigeminal stimulation recruits lobules VI/VIIIa and Crus I, vestibular migraine involves posterior cerebellar and wider vestibular-sensory networks, and treatment imaging shows cerebellar changes without localizing the site of CGRP-directed action. Findings in medication-overuse headache and familial hemiplegic migraine provide additional state-related and mechanistic clues. Taken together, the cerebellum is best viewed as a modulatory component of distributed migraine networks, with possible roles in sensory gain and vestibular integration. It is neither a demonstrated attack generator nor a validated treatment target. The next step is to test whether within-person cerebellar measures reproduce across attacks and whether intervention changes a prespecified circuit-level endpoint.

papers.title: A simplified Fazekas scale for efficient assessment of white matter hyperintensities.
papers.authors: Liu P, Liu S, Xu C, Zhu M, Liu X, Zhao X, Wei B, Li Q, Han G.
papers.abstract: Background White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are key neuroimaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) and are associated with neuropsychiatric symptoms in older adults. Although the Fazekas visual rating scale is widely used in research, its clinical adoption remains limited. Therefore, we developed a simplified Fazekas visual rating scale (sFazekas) for overall WMH assessment to facilitate clinical application. Methods We randomly selected 900 participants from three MRI scanners and evaluated the reliability and scoring efficiency of sFazekas versus the Fazekas scale. Then, all participants were grouped according to the sFazekas scores, and intergroup differences among the different scores were analyzed. Next, we examined correlations among the sFazekas, the Fazekas, and WMH volume. Finally, we explored associations between the sFazekas and vascular risk factors related to CSVD. Results The sFazekas demonstrated excellent inter-rater reliability (κ = 0.851) and required significantly less time to complete than the conventional Fazekas (p < 0.01). Significant differences in age, WMH volume, and vascular risk factors were observed across sFazekas score groups (p < 0.01). The sFazekas scores were strongly correlated with Fazekas scores for both deep and periventricular white matter, as well as with WMH volume (p < 0.001). Ordinal logistic regression indicated that age, hypertension, diabetes mellitus, and a history of stroke were independent predictors of higher sFazekas scores (p < 0.001). Conclusion The simplified Fazekas visual rating scale (sFazekas) demonstrates reliability comparable to the conventional Fazekas scale, with the practical advantage of shorter scoring time, suggesting its potential utility in the clinical assessment of overall white matter hyperintensity burden in patients with cerebral small vessel disease.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对传统Fazekas量表在临床推广中受限的问题，开发了一种用于整体评估白质高信号负荷的简化Fazekas视觉评定量表（sFazekas），并在随机抽取的900名参与者中比较其信度与评分效率。结果显示，sFazekas的评分者间信度良好，评分所需时间显著短于传统量表，且其得分与传统Fazekas深部及脑室旁评分、白质高信号体积均呈较强相关；不同sFazekas得分组在年龄、白质高信号体积和血管危险因素上存在差异，年龄、高血压、糖尿病和卒中史是较高sFazekas得分的独立预测因素。作者据此认为，sFazekas在保持与传统量表相当信度的同时可缩短评分时间，提示其可能有助于临床评估脑小血管病患者的整体白质高信号负荷，但摘要未报告其临床应用的直接验证结果。

papers.title: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease risk is associated with AT(N)V neuroimaging biomarkers and cognitive impairment in the health and aging brain study-health disparities cohort.
papers.authors: Espejo K, Rulkens R, Hayes CA, Contreras JA.
papers.abstract: Background Cardiovascular risk is increasingly recognized as relevant to cognitive aging and dementia-related brain changes, yet its relationship to multimodal neuroimaging biomarkers of amyloid, tau, neurodegeneration, and vascular injury (AT(N)-V) remains incompletely understood in racially and ethnically diverse cohorts. We examined whether ten-year atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) risk was associated with AT(N)-V neuroimaging biomarkers and cognitive domain scores. Methods This cross-sectional study included 1,626 Health and Aging Brain Study-Health Disparities (HABS-HD) participants without cardiovascular disease or dementia who had amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) imaging linked to visit 1. Ten-year ASCVD risk was estimated using the Pooled Cohort Equations and modeled continuously. Neuroimaging outcomes included global florbetaben amyloid PET standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR), medial temporal lobe (MTL) PI-2620 tau PET SUVR, cortical thickness, hippocampal volume, and white matter hyperintensity (WMH) volume. Cognitive domain outcomes included memory, executive function, processing speed, and language. Multivariable linear regression models accounted for apolipoprotein E (APOE ) ε4 status, relevant neuroimaging biomarkers, and imaging scanner/protocol covariates as appropriate, with Holm adjustment for multiple comparisons. Amyloid-status-stratified analyses were also conducted using a global amyloid PET SUVR threshold of 1.08. Results Increasing ten-year ASCVD risk was associated with increasing global amyloid and MTL tau PET SUVR, smaller cortical thickness, smaller hippocampal volume, and increased WMH volume. Increasing ten-year ASCVD risk was also associated with lower memory, executive function, processing speed, and language scores after accounting for APOE ε4 status, amyloid burden, neurodegeneration, vascular injury, and scanner covariates. Associations between ten-year ASCVD risk and structural and vascular injury markers were observed in both amyloid-positive and amyloid-negative participants, whereas associations with amyloid and MTL tau PET were modest and statistically significant only among amyloid-negative participants. Conclusion In this diverse HABS-HD sample, increasing ten-year ASCVD risk was associated with greater AT(N)-V biomarker burden and poorer cognitive performance across multiple domains. These cross-sectional findings suggest that ten-year ASCVD risk may serve as a marker of co-occurring cardiovascular and brain health burden, but they do not establish causality or temporal direction.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究在无心血管疾病和痴呆的多元族裔队列中，考察十年动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）风险是否与淀粉样蛋白、tau、神经退行性变和血管损伤（AT(N)-V）多模态影像标志物及认知表现相关。结果显示，ASCVD风险越高，整体淀粉样蛋白和内侧颞叶tau摄取越高，皮层越薄、海马体积越小、白质高信号体积越大，且记忆、执行功能、加工速度和语言得分越低；结构和血管损伤标志物的关联在淀粉样蛋白阳性和阴性者中均可见，而淀粉样蛋白与tau的关联仅在阴性者中较弱地显著。作者据此提出，十年ASCVD风险或可作为心血管与脑健康共同负担的标志，但横断面设计不能确立因果或时间方向。

papers.title: Utility and limitations of 18F-fluciclovine PET for biopsy targeting in a nonenhancing diffuse glioma with a gliomatosis cerebri-like growth pattern: illustrative case.
papers.authors: Matsueda S, Higa N, Makino R, Akahane T, Kirishima M, Yonezawa H, Tanimoto A, Hanaya R.
papers.abstract: Background Contrast-enhanced MRI reflects blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption rather than tumor biological activity, whereas 18F-fluciclovine (18F-FACBC) PET reflects amino acid metabolism independent of BBB integrity. The authors compared regional 18F-FACBC uptake with histopathological and molecular findings in a diffuse astrocytoma, IDH-wildtype, not elsewhere classified, with a gliomatosis cerebri (GC)-like infiltrative growth pattern. Observations A woman in her 50s presented with headache. MRI revealed a nonenhancing, diffusely infiltrating right parietal white matter lesion. 18F-FACBC PET showed focal uptake that guided stereotactic biopsy. Six weeks later, progression caused left uncal herniation requiring emergency decompression, during which PET-negative left temporal tissue was resected. The PET-positive region showed a high Ki-67 index, high-level PDGFRA amplification, and CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion, with a methylation profile matching pediatric-type diffuse high-grade glioma, RTK1 subclass. The PET-negative region was predominantly gliotic, with only low-level PDGFRA amplification. Thus, uptake marked a more proliferative, molecularly altered component. However, both the fatal mass effect and out-of-field recurrence following chemoradiotherapy occurred in regions without corresponding uptake. Lessons 18F-FACBC PET identified an aggressive, high-risk tumor component, supporting its use for biopsy targeting in nonenhancing gliomas. However, because life-threatening progression occurred without corresponding uptake, 18F-FACBC uptake reflects proliferative burden rather than the full infiltrative extent. https://thejns.org/doi/10.3171/CASE26761.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告对比了一名弥漫性星形细胞瘤（伴类大脑胶质瘤病样浸润生长）患者的18F-FACBC PET局灶摄取与组织病理及分子结果，并用PET引导立体定向活检。摄取阳性区显示更高的增殖活性和PDGFRA扩增、CDKN2A/B缺失等分子改变，提示该示踪剂有助于定位更具侵袭性的肿瘤成分以指导活检。但致死性占位效应和放化疗后野外复发均出现在无相应摄取的区域，说明18F-FACBC摄取反映的是增殖负荷而非完整浸润范围，其靶向活检价值有限定。

papers.title: Loneliness is reflected in the sub-second temporal dynamics of the resting brain: an EEG microstate study
papers.authors: Ono K.
papers.abstract: Loneliness, a subjective state of perceived social isolation characterized by chronic social hypervigilance, is a profound risk factor for physical and mental health conditions. While functional neuroimaging studies link loneliness to altered salience network connectivity, the sub-second temporal dynamics of the resting lonely brain remain unexplored. We investigated the relationship between trait loneliness and resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) microstates. Sixty-one healthy young adults completed the UCLA Loneliness Scale and Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) and underwent 3-minute resting-state EEG recording. A criterion-based five-class microstate solution identified a topography corresponding to the canonical Class C/E, associated with both self-referential and salience-related processing. Higher loneliness scores were significantly associated with reduced Class C/E occurrence, which remained significant after controlling for depressive symptoms, age, and sex. Exploratory source localization revealed that lonelier individuals showed reduced current density in the middle cingulate cortex (MCC). These findings suggest that chronic social hypervigilance suppresses the spontaneous mobilization of the salience network at rest, with reduced MCC engagement reflecting a dispositional attenuation consistent with chronic relational threat.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察特质孤独感与静息态脑电微状态亚秒级时间动态的关系，61名健康年轻成人完成孤独感与抑郁量表并接受短时静息脑电记录。结果发现，孤独感得分越高，与自我参照和凸显加工相关的Class C/E微状态出现次数越少，控制抑郁症状、年龄和性别后该关联仍显著；探索性源定位还显示更孤独者中扣带皮层电流密度降低。作者据此提出，慢性社会过度警觉可能抑制静息时凸显网络的自发动员，中扣带参与减弱或反映一种与长期关系威胁相符的倾向性衰减；这属于关联性发现，尚不能说明因果或临床意义。

papers.title: Identifying attentional control mechanisms related to the performance of high- and low-skilled First-Person Shooter game players: With exploratory data on expert older-adult esports players
papers.authors: Jeong I, Takeda A, Shimane D, Takeda M.
papers.abstract: High-skilled First-Person Shooter (FPS) game players are known to have superior attentional control—the ability to select information relevant to a task (selective attention) and maintain an appropriate response (sustained attention). However, it is unclear whether the attentional control strategies between high- and low-skilled FPS players differ, and whether these differences are related to FPS performance. Therefore, we investigated differences in attentional control between low- and high-skilled FPS players using electroencephalography, as well as correlations between gaming performance and attentional control. In addition, as an exploratory aim, we examined the characteristics of older FPS players. We recruited 11 high- and 11 low-skilled FPS players (under 25 years) and five older FPS players (over 65 years). Participants completed a task responding to colors regardless of the semantic meaning (Stroop task), clicked on targets quickly and accurately (aiming task), and played an FPS (esports task), respectively. We measured event-related potentials (ERPs) during the Stroop task to evaluate attentional control. In addition, we examined the relationship between ERP components and performance on the aiming and esports tasks. As a result, high-skilled players showed significantly smaller ERP amplitude in the 150-250 ms time window and greater ERP amplitude in the 280-380 ms time window (parietal region) during the Stroop task. These results suggest that high-skilled FPS players allocated attentional resources to relatively later stages of stimulus evaluation and processing. Furthermore, ERP amplitude showed a significant correlation with performance on aiming and esports tasks. Notably, older adults performed comparably to highly skilled young players on the FPS task, despite exhibiting smaller ERP amplitudes than young adults. These results suggest that attentional control is related to FPS performance and may be different with age.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电事件相关电位考察高技能与低技能第一人称射击（FPS）玩家在Stroop任务中的注意控制差异，并分析其与瞄准和游戏表现的关系，另探索性地纳入老年FPS玩家。结果显示，高技能玩家在刺激呈现后较早时间窗的脑电波幅较小，而在较晚时间窗（顶区）波幅较大，提示其将注意资源更多分配到刺激评估与加工的较晚阶段；这些脑电成分与瞄准和电竞任务表现存在相关。老年玩家在FPS任务上的表现可与高技能年轻玩家相当，尽管其脑电波幅小于年轻成人，提示注意控制与FPS表现相关，并可能随年龄而变化。

papers.title: White matter hyperintensities partly mediate genetically predicted blood pressure effects on vascular dementia
papers.authors: Hwang S.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background White matter hyperintensities (WMH) mark cerebral small vessel disease and sit on the path from hypertension to vascular dementia (VaD). Prior Mendelian randomization in European ancestry has linked blood pressure (BP) to WMH. We tested whether that association replicates in Japanese ancestry and whether WMH captures part of the genetically predicted BP effect on VaD after a priori APOE exclusion. Methods Two-sample Mendelian randomization used European genome-wide association studies of BP, WMH, and VaD, with Japanese replication of BP residual to WMH residual. The primary estimator was random-effects inverse-variance weighted analysis. Two-step Mendelian randomization multiplied each APOE -excluded BP to WMH estimate by the APOE -excluded WMH to VaD log-odds ratio. Results Genetically predicted diastolic and systolic BP associated with higher WMH in Europeans (β = 0.176 and 0.091 WMH SD per 10 mm Hg). The same direction replicated in Japanese ancestry on a residual-SD scale. Pulse pressure did not. Diastolic and systolic BP associated with VaD (odds ratios 1.36 and 1.12). Both had an indirect path through WMH (indirect odds ratios 1.10 and 1.05). The descriptive mediated proportion was 0.31 for diastolic BP. The systolic proportion interval included 0. Conclusions Genetically predicted BP raises WMH in European and Japanese ancestry. Diastolic and systolic BP have an indirect path through WMH to VaD. A descriptive mediated proportion whose interval excludes 0 is limited to diastolic BP.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用两样本孟德尔随机化检验遗传预测的血压是否经白质高信号影响血管性痴呆，并在日本血统中重复血压与白质高信号的关联。结果显示，遗传预测的舒张压和收缩压与欧洲人群白质高信号升高相关，这一方向在日本血统中同样成立，而脉压未见此关联；舒张压和收缩压也与血管性痴呆相关，且均存在经白质高信号的间接路径。作者据此认为白质高信号可能部分介导血压对血管性痴呆的影响，但中介比例区间排除零的描述性结果仅见于舒张压，提示该中介作用有限且需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Resting-State QEEG Differences between Borderline and Antisocial Personality Disorders: A Supervised Machine Learning Approach
papers.authors: Ghalebin SSA, Bashrpoor S, Mikaeili N, Hajloo N, Gholipour F.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction: Borderline personality disorder (BPD) and antisocial personality disorder (ASPD) pose substantial clinical challenges. Due to overlapping features such as impulsivity and emotional dysregulation, differential assessment between these conditions can be difficult. This study compared resting-state quantitative electroencephalography (QEEG) profiles between BPD and ASPD and examined whether supervised machine learning could distinguish the two groups based on neurophysiological features. Method Thirty age-, gender-, and education-matched participants (15 BPD, 15 ASPD) underwent eyes-closed resting-state EEG recording. After artifact removal, three minutes of clean data were retained for analysis. Absolute power spectra (1.0–30.0 Hz) across standard frequency bands were extracted from 19 channels. Seven classifiers were evaluated using stratified 10-fold cross-validation, with preprocessing performed within training folds to reduce data leakage. Results Univariate analyses revealed distinct regional electrophysiological patterns. Relative to the ASPD group, the BPD group showed higher absolute power across several frontal/frontopolar slow-wave measures, centro-parietal delta/theta measures, and temporal delta/theta measures, with additional between-group differences in selected alpha and beta features. Among the evaluated models, the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) showed the strongest internal cross-validated performance (accuracy = 89%, balanced accuracy = 92%, F1-score = 90%). Conclusion BPD and ASPD were associated with distinguishable resting-state QEEG patterns in this sample. These findings suggest that QEEG features, combined with supervised machine learning, may serve as candidate neurophysiological markers and as a potential adjunct to differential clinical assessment, pending replication in larger independent samples.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较边缘型人格障碍（BPD）与反社会型人格障碍（ASPD）患者的静息态定量脑电特征，并检验监督学习能否据此区分两组；两组各15人，在年龄、性别和教育程度上匹配，分析闭眼静息态脑电的绝对功率谱。单变量分析显示，BPD组在多个额区/额极慢波、中央-顶区delta/theta及颞区delta/theta指标上的绝对功率高于ASPD组，部分alpha和beta特征也存在组间差异。在评估的分类器中，多层感知机的内部交叉验证表现最好。作者认为，两组在本样本中呈现可区分的静息态脑电模式，脑电特征结合监督学习或可作为候选神经生理标记和临床鉴别评估的辅助手段，但尚需在更大独立样本中重复验证。

papers.title: Learning from Adaptive Oscillatory Modes: An Interpretable Synchrosqueezing Transformer for Patient-Independent Seizure Detection
papers.authors: Alanazi A, Khaldi K, Almaghrabi S, Alshammari H.
papers.abstract: Transformer-based analysis of physiological signals depends critically on how input tokens are constructed, yet conventional tokens derived from raw temporal windows or spectrogram patches may overlook the intrinsic oscillatory organization of electroencephalographic (EEG) activity. To address this limitation, we propose AMST-Former, an adaptive mode-wise synchrosqueezing Transformer for patient-independent epileptic seizure detection. Each EEG channel is first decomposed into oscillatory modes using Adaptive Local Iterative Filtering (ALIF), after which the Synchrosqueezing Transform (SST) is applied independently to each mode. This decomposition-before-synchrosqueezing strategy reduces cross-component interference in instantaneous-frequency estimation while preserv- ing mode-specific time–frequency dynamics. The resulting time–frequency patches are embedded together with channel, mode-frequency, and positional information. A hierarchical factorized-attention mechanism then models token relevance across time–frequency regions, oscillatory modes, and EEG channels before a Transformer encoder captures their interactions. Evaluation using a repeated patient-independent five-fold cross-validation protocol on the CHB-MIT database (22 subjects) yielded an F1-score of 70.76% and an area under the precision–recall curve (AUPRC) of 0.870. At the event level, AMST-Former achieved a sensitivity of 81.4% at one false detection per 24 h. Ablation experi- ments showed that mode-wise SST provided more effective representations than direct SST, per-mode Hilbert spectra, and fixed filter-bank decomposition. Furthermore, the factorized-attention mechanism provides mode, time–frequency, and channel-level explanations, whose faithfulness was assessed through deletion analysis. These results support adaptive mode-wise time–frequency tokenization as a promising strategy for interpretable, patient-independent EEG seizure detection.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对癫痫检测中Transformer输入标记难以反映脑电内在振荡组织的问题，提出一种按振荡模式构建时频标记的可解释模型。方法上先用自适应局部迭代滤波把各导联分解为振荡模式，再对每个模式分别做同步压缩变换，并以分层因子化注意力建模时频区域、模式与导联间关系。在CHB-MIT数据库的跨患者重复交叉验证中，模型取得中等偏上的F1和较高的AUPRC，事件级灵敏度在低误报率下仍有一定水平；消融结果显示按模式同步压缩优于直接同步压缩等替代表示，注意力还能给出模式、时频和导联层面的解释。作者据此认为，自适应模式化时频标记是面向可解释、跨患者脑电癫痫检测的有前景策略，但结果仍属方法验证阶段。

papers.title: The ADHD advantage: Comorbid attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder is associated with earlier diagnosis and better academic outcomes in children with specific language disorder.
papers.authors: Soongprasit M, Tiachunpun N, Jongrakthanakij N, Tongpoung P, Thongpan M.
papers.abstract: Specific learning disorder (SLD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by difficulties in reading, writing, and mathematics despite normal intelligence. One of the most common comorbidity of SLD is attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). However, differences between patients with SLD alone and SLD with ADHD remain underinvestigated. This study aims to compare clinical and psychosocial characteristics between these two groups. This retrospective study analyzes pediatric psychiatric patient data from Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) at the Learning Disorder Outpatient Clinic, Ramathibodi Hospital, Thailand from 2017 to 2023. Chi-square tests, t-tests, and mediation analyses were used to examine group differences and causal relationships among significant factors. Among 251 patients, the SLD with ADHD group exhibited less severe delays in reading (p = 0.003), writing (p = 0.001), and math (p = 0.007). This group also visited the clinic earlier (median: grade 3) than the SLD alone group (median: grade 5). Mediation analysis revealed that ADHD had a direct impact on reading and math delays (coefficients: 0.47, 0.38). No significant differences were found in gender, IQ, birth risks, parental education, or family income. Early detection explained the advantage in writing skills but not fully for reading and math, suggesting that other neurocognitive factors may be involved. Therefore, early recognition and referral should be encouraged to promote better academic outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了单纯特定学习障碍儿童与共患注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的特定学习障碍儿童在临床和心理社会特征上的差异，基于泰国一家学习障碍门诊的回顾性患者数据，采用组间比较和中介分析。结果显示，共患ADHD的儿童在阅读、书写和数学方面的延迟程度较轻，且更早就诊；中介分析提示ADHD对阅读和数学延迟有直接影响，而较早发现只能解释书写方面的优势，阅读和数学的优势可能还涉及其他神经认知因素。作者据此认为，应鼓励早期识别和转介，以促进更好的学业结果；但这是回顾性关联分析，不能据此推断ADHD本身具有因果性的保护作用。

papers.title: A generalized scaling law reveals synchrony-driven reorganization of brain dynamics across human lifespan.
papers.authors: Saha S, Hens C, Chakraborty P, Kapitaniak T, Deco G, Banerjee A, Dana SK, Roy D.
papers.abstract: Ecological systems obey universal scaling laws such as Taylor's law, which links population variance to the sample mean. Whether other complex systems with integrated and segregated network topology, the human brain, in particular, follow analogous scaling laws, and how these laws behave under synchronized neural activity, remains unknown. To address this question, our initial attempt to implement the Taylor's law, has been hindered because neural signals at all measurement scales contain both positive and negative values, whereas Taylor's law was restricted to non-negative ecological data. To circumvent this limitation, we extend spatial Taylor's law by replacing the sample mean with the root-mean-square (RMS) of the measurements, and apply this generalized law to detrended multivariate neural time series. The detrending operation has been performed as a necessary step to remove the trends and temporal mean from the data. Within this framework, we address our next question how synchronous or coordinated activity of the brain network influences the scaling law. We quantify synchrony using a dedicated metric of functional coordination and show analytically, and via numerical simulations using multivariate Poisson, negative binomial, uniform and gamma distributions, that the scaling exponent is inversely related to synchrony. Applying this approach to human fMRI data from three large cohorts (N = 840, ages 18-88 years) reveals distinct age-related trajectories of the scaling exponent, with healthy aging characterized by a substantial synchrony-induced reduction in this exponent. The synchrony-scaling relationship remains stable during resting-state activity but progressively shifts during naturalistic tasks across the lifespan, and is pronounced in limbic, subcortical, and cerebellar subnetworks, indicating preservation at subnetwork levels. Finally, individuals with ADHD exhibit altered synchrony-scaling coupling, highlighting the potential clinical and translational utility of this generalized scaling metric.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种广义缩放律，用均方根替代样本均值以适用于含正负值的神经信号，并考察同步活动如何影响缩放指数。解析推导与数值模拟显示，缩放指数与同步程度呈反向关系。应用于三个大型队列的人类功能磁共振数据后发现，缩放指数随年龄呈现不同轨迹，健康老化表现为同步诱导的指数明显下降；这种同步—缩放关系在静息态下保持稳定，但在自然任务中随生命周期逐步变化，并在边缘、皮层下和小脑等子网络中较为突出。注意缺陷多动障碍个体的同步—缩放耦合出现改变，提示该指标可能具有临床转化价值，但相关发现尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Moral and perceptual conflict processing are implemented by distinct brain activation and functional connectivity patterns.
papers.authors: Zhu R, Grueschow M, Moisa M, Liu C, Ruff CC.
papers.abstract: While humans resemble other primates in terms of motor and perceptual abilities, our behavior is uniquely characterized by morality-the ability to choose our actions based on specific ethical values. The evolutionary origins and neurobiological basis of moral behavior are debated intensely, with opposing proposals about whether moral decisions rely on domain-general decision-making neural circuitry (neural common currency hypothesis) or on unique neural processes that were shaped by evolutionary pressures associated with life in groups (social brain hypothesis). Here we examine the potential overlap between moral and perceptual decision-making, by combining functional magnetic resonance imaging with computational modeling of behavior in a novel task requiring human participants to make alternating moral and perceptual choices on identical stimuli. At the algorithmic level, we found that moral and perceptual choices were well fit by the same sequential sampling model, which allowed us to quantify and directly compare conflicts between the choice alternatives for both types of decision-making. At the implementational level, moral and perceptual choice conflicts were represented by distinct neural activity patterns; in fact, neural signals in some brain areas (e.g., temporoparietal junction) encoded the strength of the two types of conflict in opposite directions. Our findings suggest that while similar computational decision mechanisms underlie both moral and perceptual choices, their neural implementation is fundamentally different, supporting the social brain hypothesis.

papers.title: EEG-Based Inner Speech Decoding Using Phase-Locking and Spatial Features with a Dual-Branch Deep Learning Model
papers.authors: Elnoor M. Abdalla H, Basri H, Aris I, Yusof Khan AHK, Natarajan S, Adha MS, Abbasa WF, Zakaria SH, Al-Haddad SAR.
papers.abstract: Background: Decoding inner speech from electroencephalogram signals presents a promising direction for advancing brain-computer interface technologies. However, this remains a highly challenging task because of factors such as the inherently low signal-to-noise ratio, significant inter-subject variability, and the complex, non-stationary nature of neural activity captured in EEG data. Methods This study presents a novel classification framework that combines instantaneous phase-locking value and common spatial patterns for feature extraction. The dimensionality of the instantaneous phase-locking features was reduced using principal component analysis. The two feature types are processed independently using Recurrent Neural Networks and Deep Neural Networks and then concatenated for the final classification. The model was evaluated under both subject-dependent (S-d) and subject-independent (S-Ind) settings on two publicly available EEG dataset. The first dataset includes imagined speech from five individuals in two categories: social and numerical, while the second dataset includes inner speech from ten participants performing four Spanish-word commands. Results The proposed model demonstrated strong performance in the S-d setting, achieving average accuracies of 95.16 ± 3.50% for social words and 95.96 ± 2.40% for numerical words, with macro F1-scores exceeding 95.19%. For the second dataset, the mean S-d accuracy was 90.23 ± 10.61%, while S-Ind accuracies were 64.09 ± 3.20% and 52.19 ± 2.64% for the second and first datasets, respectively, highlighting the challenge of cross-subject generalization in EEG-based inner speech decoding. Notably, the proposed method outperformed previously reported approaches on both datasets, achieving relative improvements of up to 226.21%. Conclusion The proposed approach shows strong performance in subject-dependent inner speech decoding and provides additional validation across two publicly available EEG datasets with different participants and task configurations. While the method shows practical potential, the results also highlight the ongoing challenge of generalizing across individuals, motivating further evaluation on larger, more diverse, and multi-session datasets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电信号解码内隐言语困难的问题，提出一种结合瞬时锁相值与共空间模式特征、并用双分支深度学习模型分类的框架，在两个公开脑电数据集上分别测试了被试依赖和被试独立两种设置。结果显示，被试依赖条件下分类表现较强，而跨被试条件下准确率明显下降，说明跨个体泛化仍是主要难点。作者据此认为，该方法在被试依赖的内隐言语解码上具有潜力，但尚需在更大、更多样和多 session 的数据上进一步验证。

papers.title: Quantitative Relationship Between Lumipulse G Measures of pTau217 in Plasma and the Temporal Cortex.
papers.authors: De Meyer S, Tomé SO, Lahaije B, Vanbrabant J, Lambrechts C, Goossens J, Vanmechelen E, Sleegers K, Von Arnim CAF, Tousseyn T, Poesen K, Thal DR, Vandenberghe R.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Phosphorylated tau217 (pTau217) plasma assays have shown high diagnostic accuracy for Alzheimer disease (AD). However, validation of plasma pTau217 as a direct marker of brain-based pTau pathology requires understanding of its quantitative relationship with cortical pTau217. The primary objective of this postmortem validation study was to determine the quantitative relationship of plasma pTau217 levels and the pTau217/β-amyloid (Aβ)1-42 ratio with cortical pTau217 levels measured using Lumipulse G immunoassays. Methods In this retrospective study, patients with dementia were recruited from an academic memory clinic (University Hospitals Leuven) based on the joint availability of an antemortem plasma sample and postmortem brain tissue. An N-terminal pTau217 (pTau217NT ) immunoassay was used to measure pTau217 in plasma and inferior temporal neocortex homogenates. In plasma, midregion pTau217 (pTau217Mid ) and the pTau217Mid /Aβ1-42 ratio were also measured. Generalized additive models and partial Spearman correlations were used to evaluate the relationship between blood and cortical pTau217. CIs were estimated using bootstrapping (5,000 iterations). Results Thirty-two patients with dementia (mean age 66 [SD 10] years, 38% female) were included, of which 19 had an AD diagnosis and 13 had a diagnosis of frontotemporal lobar degeneration with either TDP-43 or tau inclusions, as determined at autopsy. Plasma pTau217NT , pTau217Mid , and the pTau217Mid /Aβ1-42 ratios were strongly correlated with pTau217NT in the temporal cortex (partial Spearman ρ = 0.73-78, all p < 0.0001). However, models using plasma pTau217NT or the pTau217Mid /Aβ1-42 ratio as independent variable provided a better fit to cortical pTau217NT than models using plasma pTau217Mid (ΔAkaike information criterion = 2.5 and 1.1, ΔBayesian Information criterion = 3.6 and 2.1, respectively). All markers showed excellent diagnostic performance in distinguishing AD patients from non-AD disease control patients (area under the curve = 0.88-0.94). Plasma pTau217NT , pTau217Mid , and the pTau217Mid /Aβ1-42 ratios were correlated with neocortical Aβ plaque (4G8) of pTau (AT8) aggregate densities with comparable strength (partial Spearman ρ = 0.57-0.69, p < 0.0012). For all plasma markers studied, only the correlation with pTau aggregate density (partial Spearman ρ = 0.39-0.45, p < 0.05) and not with Aβ plaque density (partial partial Spearman ρ = 0.17-0.25, p > 0.19) remained significant after correction for the other pathology. Discussion Plasma pTau217NT levels as well as the pTau217Mid /Aβ1-42 ratio strongly relate to postmortem pTau217NT levels in the temporal cortex.

papers.title: The Philadelphia Theta Burst Project: A novel fMRI-guided electric field modeling dataset with reliability metrics.
papers.authors: Gregory DF, Sun I, Teferi M, Gura H, Patel M, Casalvera A, Chandrashekar S, Lynch KG, Schultz DH, Jeyapratap A, Tate Q, Makhoul W, Deng ZD, Oathes DJ, Sheline YI, Balderston NL.
papers.abstract: Recent neuromodulation studies suggest that theta burst stimulation (TBS) applied to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) can influence neural circuits involved in cognitive control and emotion-related processing, with relevance for psychiatric disorders. However, large-scale datasets characterizing variability, reliability, and multimodal neural responses to TBS remain limited. To address this gap, we established the Philadelphia Theta Burst Project, a dataset of 100 healthy participants who completed 4 fMRI sessions following cumulatively increasing doses of intermittent or continuous TBS, with participants randomized to one protocol or the other. Each session includes multiband, multi-echo resting-state (16 minutes) and task-based fMRI (16 minutes) during a Sternberg working memory paradigm. TMS targeting was guided by task-evoked activation in the left dlPFC. Structural T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and diffusion-weighted imaging were also acquired. Here, we describe the dataset design, acquisition protocol, and data characteristics, and report initial measures of data quality and reliability. The completed dataset can be accessed at https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds008893, providing an open resource for future investigations of TBS mechanisms and individualized neuromodulation strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该数据集研究旨在弥补间歇或连续θ爆发刺激（TBS）作用于背外侧前额叶后，个体差异、测量可靠性和多模态神经反应方面大规模数据不足的问题。研究招募健康参与者并随机分配至两种TBS方案之一，在累积递增剂量下完成多次fMRI会话，采集静息态与Sternberg工作记忆任务态功能影像，并结合结构像和弥散加权成像；刺激靶点由任务诱发激活引导。作者描述了数据集设计、采集流程与数据特征，并报告了初步的数据质量和可靠性指标，为后续研究TBS机制及个体化神经调控策略提供开放资源。需注意，该文是数据集描述，未报告TBS的临床疗效或因果效应。

papers.title: Development of a Simple MRI Scoring Tool in Severe Pediatric Traumatic Brain Injury: Secondary Analysis of the 2014-2017 "Approaches and Decisions in Acute Pediatric TBI Trial (ADAPT)" Multicenter Study.
papers.authors: Janas AM, Camci F, Broman AT, Rebsamen S, Field AS, LaRovere KL, Rosario BL, Bell MJ, Alexander AL, Ferrazzano PA, ADAPT MRI Investigators.
papers.journal: Pediatric critical care medicine : a journal of the Society of Critical Care Medicine and the World Federation of Pediatric Intensive and Critical Care Societies
papers.abstract: Objectives We aimed to describe the frequency, depth, and co-occurrence of different intracerebral injury types detected on the first clinical brain MRI in children with severe traumatic brain injury (TBI) and to derive a simple MRI scoring system associated with 12-month functional outcome. Design Secondary analysis of the Approaches and Decision in Acute Pediatric TBI (ADAPT) multicenter 2014 to 2017 study. Setting A total of 24 ADAPT sites in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia. Patients Children (< 18 yr) with severe TBI who received intracranial pressure monitoring and clinical brain MRI within 30 days of injury. Interventions None. Measurements and main results MRI was evaluated for lesion type and location, and maximal depth of any lesion was determined for each subject (grade 1, lobar gray and white matter; grade 2, deep gray matter and corpus callosum; grade 3, brainstem). The primary outcome was Glasgow Outcome Scale Extended Pediatric version (GOSE-P) at 12 months, dichotomized to favorable (GOSE-P 1-3) vs. unfavorable (GOSE-P 4-8). In the cohort of 279 patients, we found that the three most frequent lesion types were contusion (78.5%), diffuse axonal injury (70.3%), and ischemia (38.0%). When evaluating maximal injury grade, grade 1 was present in 48 children (17.2%), grade 2 in 103 children (36.9%), and grade 3 in 113 children (40.5%). Injury grade and presence of ischemia were associated with increased odds of unfavorable outcome. Injury depth and ischemia on MRI (IDIOM) were incorporated into a novel six-category MRI Injury Scale, with scores ranging from 1 to 3+ (injury grades 1-3, + indicates presence of any ischemia). We found that score 3+, that is, brainstem injury with ischemia in any location, increased the risk of unfavorable outcome 22.3-fold (95% CI, 6.81-87.37; p < 0.0001) compared with score 1 (injury isolated to lobar gray and white matter, without ischemia). Conclusions Increased depth of injury and presence of ischemia on MRI are important risk factors for unfavorable outcome in children with severe TBI. We propose a simple MRI scoring system (IDIOM) that incorporates depth of injury and presence of ischemia that may be useful for neuroprognostication, but further validation is required.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ADAPT多中心试验数据，对279例接受颅内压监测并在伤后30天内完成临床脑MRI的重度创伤性脑损伤患儿进行二次分析，旨在描述首次MRI所见脑内损伤的类型、深度与共现情况，并构建与12个月功能结局相关的简易评分。结果显示，挫伤、弥漫性轴索损伤和缺血是最常见的损伤类型，损伤深度达脑干及存在缺血与不良结局风险升高相关。作者据此提出纳入损伤深度与缺血的六分类IDIOM评分，其中脑干损伤合并任意部位缺血者不良结局风险显著高于仅累及脑叶灰白质且无缺血者。作者认为该评分或有助于神经预后判断，但尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Evoked alpha oscillatory activity is suppressed by prolonged elbow pain and modulated by repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation.
papers.authors: Chowdhury NS, Hoddinott JD, Chang WJ, Cheng D, Manivasagan N, Schabrun SM, Seminowicz DA.
papers.abstract: Abstract Alpha-band oscillatory activity, assessed using electroencephalography (EEG), is among the most widely studied neurophysiological markers of pain. However, the literature has focused predominantly on resting-state measures, leaving unclear whether pain also alters evoked alpha-band dynamics, measured via cortical perturbation using transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS). Here, we examined whether prolonged pain alters TMS-evoked alpha event-related spectral perturbation (ERSP) and intertrial coherence (ITC), reflecting cortical reactivity and phase consistency, and whether 10-Hz repetitive TMS (rTMS) modulates these responses. We performed a secondary analysis on 2 previous experiments, which used nerve growth factor (NGF) injection to induce prolonged elbow muscle pain. In experiment 1, participants underwent primary motor cortex (M1) TMS-EEG at baseline (day 0) pre-NGF injection and day 2 (peak pain) and day 7 (pain resolution) post-injection. In experiment 2, M1-TMS-EEG was assessed on day 0 before NGF injection and again on day 4 after injection, with active or sham 10-Hz rTMS delivered to M1 between these assessments. In experiment 1, M1 TMS-EEG showed reductions in alpha ERSP (P = 0.014) and alpha ITC (P = 0.041) from day 0 to day 2. In experiment 2, active rTMS produced a more positive pre-to-post change in alpha ERSP (P = 0.006) relative to sham but did not alter alpha ITC (P = 0.804). Our findings suggest that prolonged experimental pain is associated with diminished evoked alpha oscillatory activity, whereas high-frequency rTMS modulates this activity in the positive direction. These findings suggest that perturbation-evoked alpha metrics warrant further investigation as candidate biomarkers of pain state and response to neuromodulation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注持续疼痛是否会改变经颅磁刺激（TMS）诱发的alpha振荡活动，以及重复TMS能否调节这一活动。作者对两项使用神经生长因子注射诱导肘部持续疼痛的实验数据做了二次分析，在初级运动皮层施加TMS并记录脑电。结果显示，疼痛高峰期诱发的alpha事件相关谱扰动和试次间一致性均较基线下降；而主动10 Hz重复TMS相较伪刺激使alpha扰动出现更正向的变化，但未改变试次间一致性。作者据此认为，持续实验性疼痛与诱发的alpha振荡活动减弱相关，高频重复TMS可对其产生正向调节，并提示这类扰动诱发指标值得作为疼痛状态和神经调控反应的候选标志物进一步研究。

papers.title: COVID-19 pleiotropy with brain imaging-derived phenotypes highlights novel insights into the biology shared between immune function and brain variation.
papers.authors: Chen Q, He J, Cabrera-Mendoza B, Xu Z, Qiu D, Polimanti R.
papers.abstract: This study investigated the pleiotropy and the underlying biology linking COVID-19 outcomes to brain variation, leveraging genome-wide data from the COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative and multimodal brain-wide magnetic resonance imaging from the UK Biobank. In our analyses, COVID-19 outcomes showed evidence of polygenic overlap with respect to 11 imaging-derived phenotypes (IDPs) related to brain structure (e.g. parahippocampal and entorhinal cortical thickness) and connectivity (e.g. Broca's area and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex). Among these, the genetic liability to COVID-19 hospitalization and SARS-CoV-2 infection was inversely related to the area of pars opercularis. We also identified local genetic correlations between COVID-19 outcomes and brain IDPs within five loci mapping genes involved in inflammatory response, immune regulation, brain development, and neuropsychiatric disorders (e.g. LAMP3 , SOX2 , and TSHZ2 ). Additionally, we uncovered colocalized variants linking COVID-19 outcomes to brain structural variation (rs13107325 with entorhinal mean thickness) and brain transcriptomic regulation of immune-related genes (e.g. IL6R in brain cortex and HLA-C in caudate basal ganglia). Our drug-repurposing analysis based on gene ontologies shared between COVID-19 outcomes and brain IDPs uncovered 41 compounds, including psychiatric medications that appear to also have antiviral and immunomodulatory activity. Overall, the present findings contributed to dissecting the biological mechanisms shared between COVID-19 and brain variation, highlighting the systemic nature of their relationship.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用COVID-19宿主遗传学计划的基因组数据和英国生物银行的多模态脑影像，考察COVID-19结局与脑变异之间的多效性及其共同生物学基础。分析发现，COVID-19结局与部分脑结构及连接影像表型存在多基因重叠，住院和感染的遗传易感性与岛盖部皮层面积呈负相关；并在涉及炎症反应、免疫调节、脑发育和神经精神疾病的基因位点上识别出局部遗传相关，还发现与内嗅皮层厚度及脑内免疫相关基因表达调控共定位的变异。基于共享基因本体进行的药物重定位分析提示部分精神科药物可能兼具抗病毒和免疫调节活性。作者据此强调二者关系具有系统性，但结果来自遗传与影像数据的关联分析，尚不能说明因果关系或临床效果。

papers.title: Time after time: neural codes of speech comprehension.
papers.authors: Gwilliams L.
papers.abstract: The acoustic signal of speech is fleeting and unfolds linearly; yet listeners must derive temporally extended and hierarchically organized linguistic structures to comprehend it. This article reviews evidence that the human brain transforms the transient auditory signal into neural representations that are persistent, parallel, and time-stamped. First, neural persistence allows information to remain available after it has disappeared from the acoustic input. Second, parallel encoding of recent inputs across multiple levels of language structure enables composition and interactions across the speech hierarchy. Third, dynamic neural representations encode both content and elapsed time, providing a flexible mechanism for preserving sequence order. Together, these representational properties reveal how the human brain transforms a continuously disappearing signal into temporally extended linguistic structures.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕人脑如何从转瞬即逝的语音信号中提取可延展、层级化的语言结构这一问题，梳理了相关神经表征证据。作者提出，大脑将短暂的听觉输入转化为持续、并行且带有时间标记的神经表征：持续性使信息在声学输入消失后仍可被利用，并行编码让不同语言层级的近期输入得以组合与交互，动态表征则同时编码内容与流逝时间，从而保留序列顺序。这些性质共同揭示了连续消失的信号如何被转化为时间上延展的语言结构。

papers.title: Longitudinal associations of obstructive sleep apnea with clinical disorders relevant to school functioning in school-aged children: A multicenter cohort study.
papers.authors: Chang YP, Wang JJ, Tsai CY, Tseng JJ.
papers.abstract: Background Pediatric obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) has been associated with difficulties in school functioning, but evidence has largely relied on neurocognitive, behavioral, academic, and educational assessments. We examined whether these concerns are also reflected in clinically recognized disorders across learning, communication, and emotional domains during longitudinal care. Methods This retrospective multicenter cohort study included children aged 6-12 years with polysomnography-supported OSA without adenotonsillectomy (AT) and propensity score-matched healthy controls. Risks of learning disorders, speech and language disorders, childhood-onset emotional disorders, and anxiety disorders were evaluated over 1, 2, 3, and 5 years. Secondary comparisons examined 5-year patterns involving children who subsequently underwent AT. Results The primary analysis included 7136 matched pairs. OSA without AT was associated with higher risks of all four outcomes across all follow-up periods. At 5 years, hazard ratios were 1.86 (95% CI, 1.56-2.23) for learning disorders, 2.25 (1.82-2.77) for speech and language disorders, 1.45 (1.04-2.04) for childhood-onset emotional disorders, and 1.41 (1.26-1.56) for anxiety disorders. Secondary comparisons showed more favorable 5-year patterns among children who subsequently underwent AT. Primary findings remained consistent after excluding documented snoring from healthy controls. Conclusions PSG-supported OSA without AT was longitudinally associated with subsequently documented disorders across multiple domains relevant to school functioning. These findings suggest that school-functioning concerns associated with pediatric OSA may also be reflected in clinically recognized disorders during longitudinal care.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）是否与学业功能相关临床障碍的长期风险有关，采用多中心回顾性队列设计，比较经多导睡眠图确诊且未接受腺样体扁桃体切除术的学龄儿童与倾向评分匹配的健康对照。结果显示，未手术的OSA儿童在学习障碍、言语和语言障碍、儿童期情绪障碍及焦虑障碍四类结局上风险均持续升高，且这一关联在随访各时点均存在；后续接受手术的儿童在5年内的模式相对较好。作者据此提示，与OSA相关的学业功能担忧也可能体现在临床记录的障碍中，但这是纵向关联而非因果或疗效证据。

papers.title: Impact of multisequence MRI on deep learning-based dose prediction for glioblastoma radiotherapy: A comparative evaluation of CT-only and CT+MRI models.
papers.authors: Singh S, Sen S, Singh AK, Dipesh, Pal S, Mahipal, Vikram, Bhushan M.
papers.abstract: Introduction Deep learning-based dose prediction has emerged as a promising approach for supporting automated radiotherapy planning workflows by estimating three-dimensional dose distributions from patient imaging. Although planning CT remains the standard imaging modality, multisequence MRI provides anatomical and tissue-characterization information that may improve prediction accuracy in glioblastoma (GBM) radiotherapy. This study investigated the incremental value of multisequence MRI by comparing CT-only and CT + MRI models using an identical framework. Methods A retrospective cohort of 140 patients with GBM treated with conventionally fractionated radiotherapy (60 Gy in 30 fractions) was analyzed. Two 3D Attention U-Net models were developed: CT-only and CT + MRI incorporating T1-weighted gadolinium-enhanced (T1GD), FLAIR, and T2∗ MRI sequences. Patients were divided into training (n = 100), validation (n = 20), and test (n = 20) cohorts. Models were trained for 130 epochs using Adam optimizer with a composite loss function of 70% mean absolute error (MAE) and 30% mean squared error. Results The CT + MRI model achieved lower MAE than CT-only (5.99 ± 1.45 Gy vs. 6.92 ± 1.74 Gy, p = 0.006). D2 error decreased from 3.51 ± 1.61 Gy to 1.53 ± 1.53 Gy. SSIM improved from 0.564 ± 0.102 to 0.599 ± 0.134 (p = 0.017), and PSNR increased from 16.84 ± 2.17 dB to 18.01 ± 1.92 dB (p = 0.009). Pearson correlation coefficients were 0.929 and 0.937 for CT-only and CT + MRI models, respectively. Conclusion Multisequence MRI improved deep learning-based dose prediction for GBM radiotherapy, particularly spatial dose agreement and high-dose region estimation. Further multicentre validation is required. Implications for practice MRI-enhanced dose prediction may support automated planning workflows by improving predicted dose distributions.

papers.title: Communication strategies in medical imaging departments for autistic patients. A systematic review exploring person-centred care practices.
papers.authors: Ukaji N, Malamateniou C, Potts B, Meertens R, Skelton E.
papers.abstract: Introduction Communication barriers are one of the major contributors to inaccessible healthcare for autistic people. Literature highlights the need for autism-informed care in medical imaging settings, but evidence on communication interventions in imaging is limited. This review aimed to synthesise communication interventions used in imaging departments to support autistic service users' accessibility to imaging. Methods The protocol was registered on PROSPERO and followed PRISMA guidelines. Literature searches were performed across six databases using keywords such as "medical imag∗", "communication strateg∗", "Autis∗", and "improv∗ access∗". In total, 5531 articles were screened by title and abstract, with 26 full-text articles reviewed against pre-determined eligibility criteria. Six studies were included in the review. Risk of bias was assessed using relevant CASP tools. Studies were synthesised using the Pillar Integration Process. Results Most interventions were explored in an MRI setting (n = 3) and paediatric population (n = 5). Common interventions included picture schedules, at-home procedural videos, and iPad app social scripts. Three central themes were developed: 1) employing flexible approaches to communication can foster acceptance; 2) optimising communication can improve patients/caregivers' imaging experience, and 3) defining positive outcomes requires a balance of patients' perspectives and quantitative results. Conclusion The findings suggest that flexible, multimodal approaches to communication adjustments can meaningfully improve imaging experiences and scan completion rates for autistic individuals. It highlighted the importance of co-production studies and the need for adequately powered, more inclusive research to improve generalisability and transferability across a wide range of imaging modalities. Implications for practice Further research on communication interventions for autistic adults is necessary to enhance imaging accessibility for this population. Imaging-specific guidelines are required to ensure standardised practice and better care experiences for autistic people.

papers.title: Oral fish oil gavage alters relative fatty acid composition across brain regions in broiler chickens.
papers.authors: Eltahan HM, Chowdhury VS, Ben-Qasem NSS, El-Tahan HM, Kim IH.
papers.abstract: Long-chain omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (n-3 PUFA), particularly eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), play important roles in brain structure and function, but their short-term regional distribution in the avian brain remains unclear. This study evaluated whether oral fish oil (FO) administration alters relative fatty acid composition and neuropeptide Y (NPY) mRNA expression in different brain regions of broiler chickens. Forty 30-day-old Ross 308 male broilers were assigned to receive either corn oil (CT) or FO (2 mL/kg body weight/day) by oral gavage for 10 consecutive days. At the end of the experiment, the diencephalon, brainstem, telencephalon, cerebellum, and mesencephalon were collected for fatty acid and gene expression analyses, and serum biochemical variables were determined. Fish oil did not affect feed intake, body weight gain, serum glucose, triglycerides, HDL cholesterol, calcium, phosphorus, or interleukin-6 concentrations (P > 0.05). In contrast, FO was associated with region-dependent shifts in relative brain fatty acid composition. The telencephalon showed higher relative proportions of EPA, DHA, and total PUFA, whereas the cerebellum showed a higher relative EPA proportion and a nonsignificant tendency toward a higher DHA proportion. Relative EPA and DHA proportions were lower in the brainstem and unchanged in the diencephalon and mesencephalon. Fish oil altered relative fatty acid composition and NPY expression in a brain-region-dependent manner; however, the NPY responses did not consistently parallel EPA/DHA changes and were not associated with altered feed intake.

papers.title: Brain and cognitive correlates of FKBP5: methylation patterns in schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Latorre-Guardia M, Almodóvar-Payá C, París-Gómez I, Guardiola-Ripoll M, Canales-Rodríguez E, Fuentes-Claramonte P, García-León MÁ, García-Ruiz B, Sotero-Moreno A, Guerrero-Pedraza A, Torres L, Salavert J, Sarró S, Penadés R, Arias B, Pomarol-Clotet E, Fatjó-Vilas M.
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia (SZ) is a neurodevelopmental disorder influenced by genetic and environmental factors. The stress-related gene FKBP5 shows genetic, epigenetic, and expression variability associated with SZ. Although FKBP5 methylation has been related to brain structural changes in psychiatric conditions, its role in the cortical thinning and cognitive deficits distinctive of SZ remains unexplored. We examined whether case-control differences in FKBP5 methylation are associated with cortical thickness and cognitive performance. In a case-control study (35 SZ, 35 HC), we assessed FKBP5 methylation (EpiTYPER), cortical thickness (FreeSurfer), and intelligence quotient (IQ). A sparse PLS-DA approach identified a latent component (LC1) capturing methylation differences. We tested the effect of LC1 on cortical thickness (brain clusters showing group differences) and IQ scores, using linear regressions. Next, we examined the relationship among methylation, neuroanatomical, and cognitive changes through a mediation analysis. LC1 was associated with reduced cortical thickness in the right pars opercularis (β = -2.15, pFDR =0.011). Thickness in this region was positively associated with IQ (β = 35.14, p = 0.011), but there was no direct LC1-IQ association.
