Mediation analysis revealed a significant indirect effect of methylation on IQ via cortical thickness (ACME = -62.96, p = 0.046; ∼40% of the total effect), which was not significant after adjusting for diagnosis. Our results represent the first analysis of the effect of FKBP5 methylation on neuroanatomical and cognitive variability in SZ, highlighting that methylation-related differences associated with the disorder are connected to structural and cognitive alterations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨精神分裂症中FKBP5甲基化差异是否与皮层厚度及认知表现相关，采用病例对照设计，比较患者与健康对照的FKBP5甲基化、皮层厚度和智商，并用稀疏偏最小二乘判别分析提取甲基化差异成分。结果显示，该甲基化成分与右侧岛盖部皮层变薄相关，而该区域厚度又与智商正相关；甲基化本身与智商无直接关联，中介分析提示甲基化可能通过皮层厚度间接影响智商，但校正诊断后该间接效应不再显著。作者称这是首次分析FKBP5甲基化与精神分裂症神经解剖和认知变异的关系，提示与该病相关的甲基化差异可能连系结构与认知改变，但关联性质及诊断因素的影响仍需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Brain structural covariance networks in co-occurring PTSD and alcohol use disorder: An ENIGMA PTSD and ENIGMA addiction working group collaboration.
papers.authors: Towers EE, Garavan HP, Dali G, Wannan C, Logge W, Haber P, Pancholi D, Juliano A, Hussain A, Haswell CC, Sun D, Baird CL, Olff M, Frijling JL, Veltman DJ, Koch SBJ, Nawjin L, van Zuiden M, Dennis EL, Tate DF, Cifu DX, Walker WC, Wilde EA, Baugh LA, Scholl JL, Simons RM, Simons JS, Magnotta VA, Fercho KA, van Holst RJ, Goudriaan AE, Li CR, Walter H, Claus ED, Witkiewitz K, Morey RA, Morley KC.
papers.abstract: High rates of comorbid posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and alcohol use disorder (AUD) may stem from a shared neurobiological basis; however, research exploring this overlap remains limited. We examined whole-brain structural covariance (SC) across PTSD, AUD, comorbid PTSD & AUD, trauma-exposed controls, and trauma-naïve controls to identify shared and unique SC profiles. Structural brain scans were acquired from individuals across 14 sites (N = 1565), and cortical thickness estimates were extracted to compute SC. Group differences in SC between pairs of cortical regions were examined using the Network-Based statistic and quantified using local and global graph theory (GT) measures. Clinical groups showed consistent alterations in SC compared with trauma-naïve controls, characterised by lower SC involving frontal regions, particularly the inferior frontal gyrus and frontal pole, which also demonstrated high centrality in local GT analyses. In contrast, higher SC was observed in temporal regions, with the fusiform gyrus consistently emerging as a central region. Comparisons involving PTSD & AUD also showed increased SC in occipital regions, suggesting a potentially distinct pattern of structural organization in this group. Global GT analyses demonstrated altered network organization in clinical groups, including increased clustering and path length, and reduced global efficiency relative to trauma-naïve controls. Local efficiency was increased in PTSD and PTSD & AUD, but not AUD alone. Together, these findings indicate that alterations in frontal and temporal regions are implicated across PTSD, AUD, and their comorbidity. However, the PTSD & AUD group also exhibited additional occipital lobe alterations, suggesting a broader distribution of structural covariance alterations in the comorbid group.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）与酒精使用障碍（AUD）共病是否具有共享的脑结构基础，利用多站点结构磁共振数据计算全脑结构协方差网络，比较PTSD、AUD、共病组及两类对照组的网络特征。结果发现，各临床组相对无创伤暴露对照均表现出一致的结构协方差改变：额叶（尤其额下回和额极）连接降低且局部网络中心性较高，颞叶（如梭状回）连接升高；共病组还额外出现枕叶连接升高，提示其结构组织模式可能更为广泛。全局图论指标显示临床组网络聚集性和路径长度增加、全局效率降低，局部效率仅在PTSD和共病组升高。作者据此认为，额颞区域改变为PTSD、AUD及其共病所共有，而枕叶改变可能是共病组特有的分布特征。

papers.title: Frontal aperiodic activity and sensorimotor theta clustering are differentially modulated by tDCS during proprioceptive training in Parkinson's disease: An EEG study.
papers.authors: Heydarpour H, Ashtiani MN, Bahrpeyma F, Tafakhori A.
papers.abstract: Proprioceptive deficits are a core feature of Parkinson's disease (PD), but the neural mechanisms by which transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) may augment proprioceptive learning remain unknown. This study investigated whether six sessions of anodal tDCS combined with proprioceptive training modulates EEG‑derived aperiodic activity, Lempel‑Ziv complexity (LZC), and theta clustering in individuals with PD. Twenty‑four participants with mild‑to‑moderate PD were randomly assigned to active (2 mA, 20 min) or sham tDCS over the supplementary motor area, combined with a proprioceptive exercise protocol (three sessions/week for two weeks). EEG was recorded during quiet standing with eyes closed before and after the intervention. Aperiodic exponent, aperiodic offset, LZC, and theta clustering were extracted from frontal and central lobes. Significant group×time interactions were observed in the frontal lobe for aperiodic exponent (p=0.022), aperiodic offset (p=0.005), and LZC (p<0.001). The sham group showed flattening of the aperiodic exponent, reduced offset, and increased LZC (+108%), while the active tDCS group remained stable or decreased. In the central lobe, significant interactions were found for LZC (p=0.035) and theta clustering (p=0.014), with the sham group increasing and the active group decreasing on both metrics. No significant interactions were observed in parietal, temporal, occipital, or global parameters. tDCS may serve as a valuable adjunct to proprioceptive rehabilitation in PD by accelerating the transition from effortful, compensatory processing to automatic, efficient sensorimotor control potentially enhancing balance and gait training, reducing fall risk, and informing mechanism-based neurorehabilitation. EEG-derived aperiodic and complexity metrics may serve as biomarkers of intervention response.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨在帕金森病患者接受本体感觉训练时，阳极经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）是否调节脑电的非周期活动、Lempel-Ziv复杂度与theta聚类，将轻中度患者随机分为真刺激组和伪刺激组，在干预前后采集闭眼静立脑电。结果发现，额叶非周期指数、偏移量和复杂度存在显著的组别×时间交互：伪刺激组非周期指数变平、偏移量降低、复杂度明显升高，而真刺激组保持稳定或下降；中央区复杂度和theta聚类也呈类似交互，伪刺激组升高、真刺激组降低，其他脑区及全局指标未见显著交互。作者据此提出，tDCS可能作为本体感觉康复的辅助手段，促使患者从费力补偿性加工转向更自动高效的感觉运动控制，脑电非周期与复杂度指标或可作为干预反应的生物标志物；这些结果来自小样本短期干预，其临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Real-time fMRI neurofeedback of left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex to enhance emotional cognitive control: A randomized controlled trial.
papers.authors: McDermott TJ, Tsuchiyagaito A, Ramirez S, Cannon MJ, Akeman E, Touthang J, Kirlic N, Misaki M, Paulus MP, Aupperle RL.
papers.abstract: Real-time fMRI neurofeedback (rt-fMRI-nf) is an endogenous neuromodulation approach whereby individuals are taught to self-regulate their own neural activity in the moment. Cognitive control in emotional contexts is related to risk for or protection against mental health disorders, such as depression, anxiety, or posttraumatic stress disorder. The left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) has been shown to be centrally important in facilitating emotional cognitive control (ECC). Using a double-blind randomized controlled trial design, the present study tested a novel rt-fMRI-nf protocol to increase left dlPFC activity during ECC and improve ECC measured by self-report and behavioral task performance. Seventy healthy adult participants were enrolled and randomized to either active (n = 37; left dlPFC) or sham [n = 33; left postcentral gyrus (PCG)] neurofeedback. Linear mixed effects models tested for effects of time (practice/run 1/run 2/run 3/transfer), feedback target (active/sham), and their interaction on left dlPFC activity, left PCG activity, and ECC measures (self-report and behavior). Results showed a significant time-by-feedback interaction on left dlPFC activity (p = .031). This interaction was such that active feedback led to greater left dlPFC activity in run 1 (p = .030; d = .66) and run 2 (p = .042; d = .62), but not for run 3 nor the transfer run (when no feedback was provided). There were no significant effects of feedback on ECC measures. These findings demonstrate that rt-fMRI-nf had an initial but not a sustained effect on left dlPFC activity, providing evidence of neural target engagement. However, the lack of a sustained effect on neural activity nor any observed effects on ECC highlight the complexity of identifying the optimal design and dosing for novel rt-fMRI-nf protocols.

papers.title: Addressing the between-group comparison problem: Detecting differences between correlation matrix populations due to single-variable perturbations for resting state fMRI.
papers.authors: Faran I, Peer M, Arzy S, Benjamini Y.
papers.abstract: Resting-state fMRI (RS-fMRI) has been known for decades as a promising method for evaluating cognitive and mental states, both in health and especially in disease, due to its ease of implementation as a short, standard MRI protocol. In clinical settings, a group of patients with a given disorder is typically compared to a group of healthy controls. This poses an inherent challenge of between-group comparison. We propose a new efficient model for characterizing changes to the temporal synchronization of brain activity measured using RS-fMRI between groups, summarized as individual correlation matrices. Our model posits that the between-group differences are the product of single-region effects describing the increase or decay of synchronization with the rest of the brain. This parsimonious model pools the correlation coefficients of each region with all others, and therefore can detect differences between groups even in small samples. Inference for this model accounts for the variability in individual correlation matrices, the within-group differences across individuals, and for the approximation error of the single-region model. This results in per-region estimates and confidence intervals for the parameters governing the difference between groups. In simulations, our model shows increased power to detect model-aligned alternatives compared with competing approaches. To demonstrate feasibility of the method in a clinical application, we use the model to analyze RS-fMRI correlation matrices in patients with transient global amnesia and healthy controls. Our model detects significant decreases in synchronization for the patient population in the amygdala after multiplicity correction as well as borderline decreases in memory-related brain regions that were not detected using mass-univariate tests without prior knowledge, suggesting its usefulness in the application of RS-fMRI in clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对静息态fMRI研究中常见的组间比较问题，提出一种新的高效模型，用于刻画两组个体相关矩阵所反映的脑活动时间同步性差异。模型假设组间差异源于单脑区效应，即某一脑区与其余脑区同步性的增强或减弱，并通过汇总该脑区与所有其他脑区的相关系数来提高小样本下的检测能力，推断时考虑个体相关矩阵变异、组内个体差异及模型近似误差。模拟显示该模型对符合其假设的差异检测效力更高；在一项短暂性全面遗忘症患者与健康对照的分析中，模型在多重校正后发现患者杏仁核同步性显著下降，并在记忆相关脑区呈现边缘性下降，而这些变化未被无先验知识的质量单变量检验检出，提示该方法可能有助于静息态fMRI的临床应用。

papers.title: How does adolescent neurodevelopment impact substance use? The substance use neuroplasticity and peer (SNAP) model: A novel neurodevelopmental model of adolescent substance use.
papers.authors: Dash GF, Lichenstein SD, Cheng A, Prieto S, Rømer Thomsen K, Yip SW, Leventhal AM, Feldstein Ewing SW.
papers.abstract: Substance use among adolescents age 13-18 remains a significant societal concern, yet contemporary neuroscience models of addiction have been grounded in the chronic, cyclic stage model developed for adult presentations of substance use disorder (SUD). Relative to adults, adolescents exhibit distinct patterns of substance use, and many structural and functional findings garnered from studies of addiction in the adult brain have not been reliably observed or replicated in adolescent samples. Thus, contemporary models of adult addiction do not readily translate to adolescents, resulting in downstream developmental incongruities in how substance use is conceptualized, measured, and treated in this age group. Here, we present a review of the current state of human and preclinical models of neurobiological risk factors and mechanisms specific to substance use in adolescents. Grounded in this literature, we present the Substance use Neuroplasticity And Peer (SNAP) model, a novel neurodevelopmental model of adolescent substance use that captures the differentiated nature of substance use initiation and escalation in this high-need, yet undertreated population.

papers.title: Muscle oxygen saturation (SmO<sub>2</sub>): An upstream metabolic link connecting peripheral muscle metabolism to central neurobiological adaptations.
papers.authors: Regmi K, Kohli E.
papers.abstract: Physical activity (PA) and neuropsychology have been associated, although the peripheral mechanisms that connect skeletal muscle activity to central nervous system remain unclear. Various muscle derived signaling molecules, including myokines and metabolites, are released due to PA. Lactate is one of the signaling molecules released via muscle during PA and it may serve as an intermediatory metabolite which links peripheral muscle metabolism to central neurobiological adaptations. Along with it, PA also induces alterations in muscle oxygen saturation (SmO2 ), reflecting changes in local metabolic stress and mitochondrial demand. SmO2 plays a vital role in exercise physiology but still how it impacts neuropsychology has not received attention. Reductions in muscle oxygenation due to PA has been associated with elevated lactate production, while lactate itself acts as an energy substrate, signaling molecules, and epigenetic modulators within the brain, promoting BDNF expression and neuroplastic processes. In this review, we propose that SmO2 can act as an upstream physiological signal within a SmO2 -lactate-brain axis, translating peripheral metabolic stress into positive neuropsychological outcomes. Establishment of SmO2 as a non-invasive biomarker of neuropsychology could act as a novel model to understand the interactions between PA and brain. This can help to optimize interventions based on PA aiming to enhance cognition, emotional resilience and neurological health.

papers.title: Mental health risk stratification using heart rate variability and prefrontal electroencephalography: eXtreme gradient boosting-based classifier and latent class analysis-based subtyping.
papers.authors: Yun JY, Kwon G, Shim M, Kim SM, Lee SH, Park S.
papers.abstract: Heart rate variability (HRV) and electroencephalography (EEG) are reflective of cardiac autonomic modulation/emotional regulation and cortical brain activity/psychopathology, respectively. This study aimed to determine the key HRV/prefrontal EEG classifiers of healthy controls (HC) versus patients with psychiatric disorders (PT) and to identify the subtypes of these features. A simultaneous 5-min-long acquisition of earlobe photoplethysmography and resting-state prefrontal EEG signals was performed in 147 HC and 123 PT [major depressive disorder (MDD; N = 107) and panic disorder (N = 16)]. A mixed graphical model (MGM) was constructed using the 9 HRV-related features, 11 prefrontal EEG-related features, depressive symptoms and anxiety, and psychiatric diagnosis by licensed psychiatrists. Top 12%-ranked nodes in regards of the betweenness centrality or expected influence were defined as hubs to be employed in the eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) classifier model and the latent profile analysis (LPA): 2 HRV-related features [total power (TP), absolute power in low frequency band (LF)], 4 prefrontal EEG-related features [relative powers in frequencies of theta (THETA), low-alpha (L_ALPHA), low-beta (L_BETA), middle-beta (M_BETA)], and anxiety. The XGBoost model had an accuracy of 74.9 ± 5.6%. The SHapley Additive explanation values demonstrated that lower anxiety and M_BETA were indicative of a higher probability of being a HC. A lower LF indicated a greater possibility of being a PT. The LPA identified 3 PT subgroups of (1) hyperarousal [severe depression and moderate anxiety; higher M_BETA and lowered HRV], (2) relatively stable [minimal depressive symptoms and anxiety; no marked frontal EEG deviation and lowered HRV], and (3) frontal EEG slowing [moderate depression and mild anxiety; higher THETA and markedly lowered HRV in TP and LF]. Future studies to determine the results of risk indicators for patients with psychiatric disorders using HRV and prefrontal EEG features derived by the combined use of network-based feature selection, machine learning-based classifiers, and latent class subtyping in diverse populations are warranted. TRIAL REGISTRATION: N/A.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究同时采集健康对照与精神科患者的心率变异性及前额叶静息态脑电信号，结合网络分析筛选特征，再用机器学习分类和潜在类别分析区分人群并识别亚型。分类模型对健康对照与患者的区分准确率约为七成半，其中焦虑水平和前额叶中β相对功率较低更倾向于健康对照，而低频功率较低更倾向于患者。潜在类别分析在患者中识别出三类亚型：高唤醒型、相对稳定型和前额叶脑电减慢型，三者在抑郁焦虑症状、脑电功率和心率变异性上各有不同表现。作者据此提出，将网络特征筛选、机器学习分类与潜在类别分型结合，或有助于用生理指标刻画精神障碍的风险分层，但结论仍需在更多样人群中验证。

papers.title: Deep white-matter tracts link docosahexaenoic acid status to cognitive performance in human adolescents.
papers.authors: Figueroa-Vargas A, Valenzuela R, Soto-Icaza P, Zamorano F, Larraín C, Silva C, Guevara P, Navarrete S, Almagià A, Arancibia V, Barrera C, Ivanovic D, Billeke P.
papers.abstract: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) is a polyunsaturated fatty acid enriched in neuronal membranes and myelin, linked to cognitive performance. Yet, nutritional interventions show inconsistent cognitive benefits due to a limited understanding of the neural pathways connecting DHA status to human cognition. We studied 99 adolescents selected from both extremes of performance on a national scholastic examination. Participants completed assessments of intellectual ability, provided erythrocyte DHA samples, and underwent multimodal MRI. Using independent component analysis and Bayesian multivariate least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) models, we identified brain components jointly associated with DHA and cognition. Across four MRI modalities, a single deep white-matter component consistently emerged as the strongest shared pathway. Tract-resolved analyses highlighted predominant contributions from the fornix and thalamus-temporal fasciculus, with additional subcortical and cortical involvement. These components predicted cognitive measures beyond DHA and other fatty acids, outlining a plausible neural pathway through which a modifiable dietary factor relates to adolescent learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注红细胞DHA水平与青少年认知表现之间可能经由脑结构连接的中介路径，对象为按全国学业考试成绩两端选取的青少年，结合血液DHA测定与多模态MRI，用独立成分分析和贝叶斯多元LASSO寻找与DHA和认知共同相关的脑成分。结果显示，在四种MRI模态中，一个深部白质成分始终是最强的共享通路，其中穹窿和丘脑-颞束贡献突出，并伴有皮层下和皮层参与。这些成分对认知指标的预测超出DHA及其他脂肪酸，提示一条可改变的膳食因素与青少年学习相关的可能神经通路；但研究为横断面关联，不能据此推断因果或干预效果。

papers.title: Single-nucleus transcriptomics reveals chronic GenX exposure-induced neurotoxicity and predicted alterations in microglia-neuron communication networks in mouse brain.
papers.authors: Xu Z, Xiang K, Yang Y, Fang Z, Zhuo L, Dai C, Lin X, Liu J, Sun J.
papers.abstract: GenX (hexafluoropropylene oxide dimer acid, HFPO-DA), an emerging replacement for legacy per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), has raised increasing concerns regarding its potential health risks. However, the neurotoxic effects and underlying mechanisms of chronic GenX exposure remain poorly understood. In the present study, we established a chronic oral gavage mouse model of GenX exposure and combined targeted UPLC-MS/MS analysis, molecular biological validation, and single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) to systematically investigate GenX exposure-induced significant motor and memory deficits in mice. Targeted UPLC-MS/MS analysis revealed accumulation of GenX in blood, liver, and brain tissues. In addition, GenX exposure disrupted both the intestinal barrier and blood-brain barrier, as evidenced by increased Evans blue extravasation and reduced expression of tight junction proteins. snRNA-seq analysis revealed broad transcriptional alterations across multiple brain cell populations. Neuronal populations exhibited enrichment of neurodegeneration- and apoptosis-related pathways, and abnormal expression of apoptosis-associated proteins. Moreover, microglia displayed inflammatory activation characterized by increased expression of activation-related genes, activation of NLRP3/Caspase-1 signaling, and altered pseudotime trajectories marked by decreased P2ry12 and increased Apoe expression. CellChat analysis further predicted alterations in microglia-neuron communication networks involving NRXN, NCAM, Cx3cl1-Cx3cr1, and Gas6-Mertk signaling pathways. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that chronic GenX exposure induces broad neurotoxic alterations involving barrier dysfunction, neuronal apoptosis, microglial inflammatory activation, and disrupted intercellular communication, providing new insights into the neurotoxic mechanisms of emerging PFAS substitutes.

papers.title: Routine pelvic MRI-derived marrow markers for predicting lumbar QCT-defined bone status using chemical shift-encoded fat quantification and radiomics.
papers.authors: Wang Q, Dai X, Li Y, Xu K, Xu J, Chen Y, Ji X, Feng L, Zhang Y, Lang N.
papers.abstract: Objectives To evaluate whether pelvic MRI-derived IDEAL-IQ parameters and T1-weighted radiomics can predict lumbar QCT-defined bone status in cancer survivors undergoing routine pelvic oncologic MRI. Materials & methods This secondary analysis within a prospective surveillance cohort included 123 patients with pelvic malignancies who underwent MRI (with IDEAL-IQ) and lumbar QCT within three months. QCT-derived volumetric BMD at T12-L2 served as the reference standard to classify subjects as normal, osteopenia, or osteoporotic. Pelvic MRI-derived PDFF and R2* were measured at the femoral head, femoral neck, and ilium; a radiomics pipeline was built on T1-weighted images. Inter-reader reliability used absolute-agreement intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs). Discrimination was evaluated with one-vs-rest ROC analysis, and clinical utility was assessed by decision-curve analysis using out-of-fold probabilities from five-fold internal validation for two decisions: osteoporosis versus non-osteoporosis and low bone mass versus normal bone status. Results PDFF increased and R2* decreased with worsening BMD at all sites (P < 0.05), with good inter-reader agreement (single-measurement ICCs, 0.756-0.988; mean-of-three-reader ICCs, 0.903-0.996). In internal validation, T1-weighted radiomics and IDEAL-IQ demonstrated comparable discrimination for three-class bone status (AUC 0.73-0.78). Class-wise analysis showed near-chance discrimination for osteopenia, indicating that the overall macro-AUC was mainly driven by normal-versus-osteoporosis separation. Models incorporating MRI-derived markers showed higher validation macro-AUCs than the simplified age-and-sex clinical baseline. Decision-curve analysis showed positive net benefit for both imaging-based approaches, but between-modality differences were small and should be interpreted cautiously because confidence intervals overlapped. Conclusion Pelvic MRI-derived IDEAL-IQ and radiomics markers showed modest and comparable performance for predicting lumbar QCT-defined bone status. Their discrimination was mainly driven by separation between normal bone status and osteoporosis, whereas osteopenia remained poorly distinguished. These findings support exploratory opportunistic risk flagging rather than complete three-class risk stratification.

papers.title: Perinatal maternal distress and neurobehavioural development in toddlers.
papers.authors: Jaffer A, Manning KY, Giesbrecht GF, Oberlander TF, Tomfohr-Madsen L, Lebel C.
papers.abstract: Background Maternal perinatal psychological distress (e.g., anxiety, depression) is common and has been linked to adverse child behavioural outcomes. Altered brain function provides a potential mechanism through which perinatal distress may impact child behaviour, but specific associations remain unclear. This study investigated associations between perinatal distress, child brain functional connectivity at 2 years, and child behaviour at 2 and 3 years. Methods Neuroimaging and behavioural data were obtained from the Pregnancy during the COVID-19 Pandemic (PdP) study. Maternal distress (anxiety and depression symptoms) was self-reported throughout the perinatal period; analyses included measures from intake survey and 2 years postpartum. Child behaviour at 2 and 3 years was parent-reported using the Ages and Stages Questionnaire (ASQ-3). Resting-state fMRI data was collected at 2 years (n = 62) to quantify connectivity within the default mode, executive control, frontoparietal, and sensorimotor networks. Associations between maternal prenatal and postnatal distress, child functional connectivity, and child behaviour were examined using regression models. Results Postnatal, but not prenatal, distress was associated with lower gross motor scores at 2 years (B = -0.5, T = -2.8, p = 0.005, df = 3517, q = 0.01). Higher distress both prenatally and postnatally was associated with lower ASQ-3 scores at 3 years across all domains (q < 0.05). Child brain connectivity was not related to maternal distress or behaviour. Conclusions Perinatal distress was associated with worse behaviour at 2 and 3 years, although no associations with connectivity were observed, suggesting other pathways may underlie these effects. Nonetheless, these findings highlight the importance of supporting mental health during pregnancy and postnatally to promote healthy child development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于孕期新冠大流行队列，考察母亲围产期焦虑和抑郁症状与幼儿2岁、3岁行为发展及2岁时脑功能连接的关系，行为由家长报告，脑连接来自静息态功能磁共振。结果显示，产后而非产前痛苦与2岁粗大运动得分较低相关；产前和产后痛苦均与3岁时各领域行为得分较低相关。儿童脑功能连接与母亲痛苦或行为均未见关联，提示围产期痛苦影响幼儿行为可能并非通过所测连接通路，作者据此强调孕期和产后心理健康支持的重要性。

papers.title: Stage-specific contributions of dorsal and ventral premotor cortices to the acquisition of arbitrary visuomotor associations.
papers.authors: Turrini S, Amadori A, Arcara G, di Pellegrino G, Avenanti A.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: The acquisition and consolidation of arbitrary visuomotor mappings (AVMMs) engage premotor regions, yet the distinct contributions of the dorsal (PMd) and ventral (PMv) premotor cortices remain unclear. Here, we applied continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) immediately before AVMM learning to transiently disrupt PMd, PMv, or an occipital control site (V1) in 19 healthy young adults, using a within-subjects design. Participants learned arbitrary stimulus-response associations through trial-and-error feedback and completed a 24-h delayed recall test. Trial-by-trial accuracy and response times were modeled using state-space and Rescorla-Wagner frameworks to quantify learning dynamics, prediction errors, and stabilization across days. Disruption of both PMd and PMv slowed early acquisition of AVMMs to a comparable extent relative to V1. However, only PMd disruption additionally impaired next-day recall, rendering recall performance dependent on sleep quality and decoupled from learning-day performance, whereas recall following PMv disruption remained comparable to the control condition. These findings indicate that PMd, but not PMv, contributes to the stabilization of newly learned visuomotor associations, providing causal, stage-specific evidence for a functional dissociation within the human premotor cortex: PMd and PMv support early rule formation and exploratory learning, whereas only PMd contributes to subsequent stabilization of newly learned visuomotor associations. Furthermore, they emphasize the modulatory influence of sleep on memory retention when consolidation processes are compromised, advancing mechanistic models of premotor contributions to associative sensorimotor learning.

papers.title: Stimulating current direction produces depth-dependent spatial selectivity in cortical activation.
papers.authors: Shumkova D, Jiang X, Price NSC, Wong YT.
papers.abstract: Objective Intracortical electrical stimulation is used to modulate brain activity. However, non-selective neuronal activation limits its efficacy. A biphasic electrical stimulation pulse has cathodic (negative) and anodic (positive) phases; swapping them changes current direction. In computational models, different current directions selectively recruit distinct neuronal populations. Whether this occurs in intracortical stimulation is unknown. We tested in vivo whether current direction affects the recruitment of neuronal populations in the cortex. Approach We implanted 20 anaesthetized rats with multichannel silicon probes in the visual cortex to simultaneously stimulate and record across all cortical layers. Stimulation used either cathodic-first or anodic-first biphasic pulses. Models also predict that current direction effects strengthen when the second phase is lengthened relative to the first; therefore, in 7 animals, we tested scaled pulses. Results Cathodic-first pulses evoked stronger responses than anodic-first pulses in input and deep layers. Extending the pulse's second phase transformed cathodic-first magnitude advantage into selective recruitment by collapsing anodic-first neuronal response. This anodic-first deficit was layer- and axis-dependent. Namely, anodic-first activation spread was weakened specifically in input and deep layers in the horizontal dimension, but not superficially. Conclusion Although cathodic-first pulses are generally more effective, this advantage is not uniform across cortical depth, indicating current direction-dependent spatial selectivity. Computational models suggest preferential activation of passing fibers by cathodic-first pulses. Given the abundance of horizontal passing fibers in input and deep layers, we hypothesize that this may explain the layer- and axis-dependent activation we observed. Overall, current direction may be useful as a stimulation parameter in cortical prostheses for achieving depth-dependent spatial selectivity.

papers.title: Brain mechanisms supporting movement-evoked chronic low back pain: an observational brain imaging study.
papers.authors: Gianola M, Dean J, Chen C, Barrows D, Riegner G, Liu T, Zeidan F.
papers.abstract: Background Chronic low back pain (cLBP) is the most prevalent chronic pain condition and the leading cause of disability worldwide. Acute movement-evoked pain strongly predicts cLBP exacerbation, reflecting maladaptive amplification of nociceptive input, yet the neural mechanisms supporting movement-evoked cLBP flares remain poorly characterised. Methods A total of 114 participants with cLBP performed the cLBP-evoking leg raise test during perfusion-based arterial spin labelling functional MRI. Leg raise test-based pain intensity and unpleasantness ratings were assessed with an 11-point visual analogue scale (VAS; 0=no pain, 10=worst pain imaginable). The Brief Pain Inventory (BPI) measured chronic pain severity and interference. Whole-brain cerebral blood flow changes from supine to LRT and their relationship with VAS pain intensity were analysed. Analyses assessing default mode network-whole-brain resting-state functional connectivity supporting BPI severity were also conducted. Results The LRT significantly increased pain intensity by 23% (P<0.001) and unpleasantness by 26% (P<0.001). Compared with supine, movement-evoked pain increased cerebral blood flow in the medial prefrontal and posterior cingulate cortices, core default mode network nodes, and nociceptive centres including the thalamus, primary motor cortex corresponding to the back, and parietal operculum. Higher leg raise test-evoked pain intensity ratings were associated with greater superior parietal lobule, supramarginal, and bilateral sensorimotor cortical activity. Higher BPI pain severity was associated with stronger default mode network-somatosensory cortex (back representation) resting-state functional connectivity. Conclusions Unlike the default mode network deactivation characteristically observed during experimental pain provocation, movement-evoked cLBP reflects maladaptive coupling between self-referential (default mode network) and somatosensory (nociceptive) networks. These findings provide mechanistic insight into the neurobiological processes supporting cLBP flares. Clinical trial registration NCT03354585.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注运动诱发慢性腰痛加重的脑机制，让慢性腰痛患者在灌注功能磁共振扫描中完成可诱发疼痛的抬腿试验，并分析全脑血流变化与疼痛评分的关系。结果发现，抬腿诱发的疼痛伴随内侧前额叶、后扣带等默认网络核心节点以及丘脑、对应背部的初级运动皮层等伤害性加工区域血流升高；抬腿诱发疼痛越强，感觉运动相关皮层活动越明显，而慢性疼痛严重程度越高，默认网络与躯体感觉皮层间的静息态功能连接越强。作者据此提出，与实验性疼痛通常引起默认网络去激活不同，运动诱发的慢性腰痛加重可能反映自我参照网络与躯体感觉伤害性网络之间的适应不良耦合，为理解腰痛发作提供了神经生物学线索。

papers.title: Cross-phenotype and cross-species integrative genomic prioritization of FOXF2 and FOXC1 at a cerebral small vessel disease locus.
papers.authors: Liu Y, Tong S, Peng Y.
papers.abstract: Cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) is genetically heterogeneous, and translating regional association signals into biologically plausible effector-gene hypotheses remains challenging. We performed a cross-phenotype and cross-species integrative genomic analysis of the FOXF2-centered proximal chromosome 6 region using publicly available genome-wide association study summary statistics for lacunar stroke, small-vessel disease ischemic stroke subtype and white matter hyperintensity volume. The chr6:0-2.5 Mb interval was treated as the primary regional analysis, whereas FOXF2 ± 1 Mb and FOXF2 ± 500 kb were examined as nested sensitivity windows. Linkage disequilibrium, regional gene annotation, quantitative trait locus evidence, colocalization, fine-mapping, GWAS Catalog records and human and mouse brain vascular transcriptomic data were integrated within a predefined candidate-prioritization framework. Lacunar stroke showed the strongest regional evidence, with rs7766042 meeting the predefined broad-window local correction threshold, although no signal reached conventional genome-wide significance. The SVD ischemic stroke subtype and WMH signals did not meet their corresponding local correction thresholds. Phenotype-specific lead variants showed low pairwise linkage disequilibrium, a pattern consistent with regional signal heterogeneity but not sufficient to establish distinct causal signals. FOXF2 and FOXC1 were prioritized as leading neurovascular candidates, whereas EXOC2 and GMDS were retained as secondary positional candidates. Several regional variants overlapped FOXF2 eQTL annotations; however, formal colocalization showed little evidence for a shared causal variant (PP.H4 = 0.0604), and fine-mapping did not resolve a single causal variant. Human and mouse brain vascular transcriptomic analyses provided cross-species expression-based cellular context for FOXF2 and FOXC1. These findings support regional candidate-gene prioritization at the proximal chromosome 6 locus while emphasizing that the available evidence does not establish a definitive multi-signal or multi-gene causal architecture.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对6号染色体FOXF2附近区域，整合腔隙性卒中、小血管病缺血性卒中亚型和白质高信号体积的公开GWAS汇总数据，并结合连锁不平衡、基因注释、eQTL、共定位、精细定位及人鼠脑血管转录组信息，进行跨表型、跨物种的候选基因优先排序。腔隙性卒中在该区域证据最强，rs7766042达到预设的宽窗口局部校正阈值，但未达常规全基因组显著性；另两个表型的信号未达各自局部校正阈值。FOXF2和FOXC1被列为领先的神经血管候选基因，EXOC2和GMDS作为次要位置候选保留；然而共定位和精细定位均未支持单一共享因果变异。作者据此强调，现有证据支持区域候选基因排序，但尚不足以确立明确的多信号或多基因因果结构。

papers.title: Sex-differences in resting state dorsolateral prefrontal cortex: comparing motion correction methods in resting state functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS).
papers.authors: Jha A, Singh V.
papers.abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a low cost, non-invasive alternative for studies comparing task-based activity of prefrontal cortex regions for cognitive studies with clinical relevance. However, motion correction algorithms are a major source of methodological variability in fNIRS studies, obscuring neurobiological variability in prefrontal hemodynamic response and leading to irreproducible findings. Further, motion correction fNIRS studies disregard sex-differences in hemodynamic response at resting state dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, especially fewer studies are carried out in non-western population. Although resting state brain activity is used for comparing task-based hemodynamics changes especially in tasks that show consistent sex differences (working memory & decision-making tasks) and are associated with affective disorders. Hence, we examined sex-differences in signal variability across eight motion correction approaches and HbO-HbR correlation in fNIRS data of resting state dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Next, we investigated how right-lateralized resting state DLPFC activity relates with sex-differences in depression-anxiety scores. Resting-state fNIRS data were acquired from 99 healthy adults (47 males, Mean age: 19.75 ± 1.27) Depression-anxiety comorbidity was assessed using Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) and Beck Anxiety Inventory (BAI) scores. Raw fNIRs signals were processed through eight motion correction pipelines for comparing No Correction, PCA, tPCA, Spline, SplineSG, Wavelet, Hybrid (SplineSG + Wavelet), and TDDR. These were evaluated on peak/minima amplitudes (ΔHbO, ΔHbR, ΔHbT, ΔHbD), HbO-HbR correlation, and signal variability. Hybrid and TDDR motion correction methods yielded the strongest negative HbO-HbR correlation, and lowest signal variability. Independent of motion correction methods, women exhibited stronger HbO-HbR correlation and lower ΔHbO variability, while men showed higher ΔHbT peaks and ΔHbR minima. Sex differences in right-lateralized hemodynamic activity in resting state DLPFC was observed in the form of interaction of sex, depression-anxiety comorbidity and ΔHbD peaks put through motion correction methods. Results indicate that choice of motion correction algorithm might impact our understanding of sex-differences in hemodynamic activity in dorsolateral prefrontal cortex. Sex-differences in affective disposition might be evident even in resting state right-lateralized activity in DLPFC.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察静息态背外侧前额叶的性别差异是否会随运动校正方法的选择而变化，并进一步分析右偏侧化活动与抑郁—焦虑得分的关系。研究采集健康成人静息态fNIRS数据，比较八种运动校正流程下的信号变异性、HbO-HbR相关及峰值/谷值幅度。结果显示，Hybrid与TDDR校正后HbO-HbR负相关最强、信号变异性最低；无论采用哪种校正方法，女性的HbO-HbR相关更强、ΔHbO变异性更低，男性则表现出更高的ΔHbT峰值和更低的ΔHbR谷值。右偏侧化血流动力学活动与性别、抑郁—焦虑共病及ΔHbD峰值之间存在交互。作者据此指出，运动校正算法的选择可能影响对前额叶血流活动性别差异的理解，而情感倾向相关的性别差异在静息态右偏侧化活动中即可能有所体现。

papers.title: External validation of an integrative model of functional impairment in early-stage behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD).
papers.authors: Chatzidimitriou E, Moraitou D, Ioannidis P, Aretouli E, Chen Y, Rosen HJ, Gorno-Tempini ML, Seeley WW, Miller BL, Rankin KP.
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Functional decline in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) emerges early and significantly disrupts quality of life, yet its determinants remain incompletely understood. Integrative models capturing key disease manifestations may better explain its complexity but require validation in independent samples. This study aimed to examine whether a previously proposed model of functional impairment could be supported in a larger cohort and characterize the interrelationships among its cognitive, behavioral, personality, and neuroanatomical components. Methods A total of 146 individuals with mild-stage bvFTD underwent structural MRI, neuropsychological assessment, and informant-based evaluation of behavioral symptoms, personality traits, and functional status. Penalized Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) regression identified the strongest correlates of functional impairment (Functional Activities Questionnaire/FAQ), while structural equation modeling examined their interrelationships. Results LASSO identified conscientiousness, apathy, global cognition, executive functioning, sarcasm perception, and semantic verbal fluency as significant correlates of functional status. The resulting path model demonstrated excellent fit and supported both neural-cognitive and behavioral-personality pathways. Reduced right superior frontal gyrus volume was associated with poorer executive and global cognitive performance, and through these variables, with greater functional impairment. In parallel, apathy demonstrated both direct and indirect associations with functional decline through conscientiousness. Conclusions Two partially distinct yet complementary processes appear to contribute to functional impairment in bvFTD: one reflecting the impact of frontal neurodegeneration on cognitive abilities essential for independent functioning, and another involving motivational and personality changes that directly undermine everyday engagement, thereby providing support for a multidimensional model of functional disability in bvFTD.

papers.title: Neuroimaging signatures of facial onset sensory and motor neuronopathy (FOSMN).
papers.authors: Rosenbohm A, Herrera-Angeles F, Huppertz HJ, Haeusler KG, Weishaupt JH, Müller HP, Kassubek J.
papers.abstract: Facial onset sensory and motor neuronopathy (FOSMN) is an exceptionally rare condition characterized by progressive facial paresthesia and the subsequent appearance of bulbar symptoms with rostro-caudal motor and sensory deficits sometimes extending to the hand muscles. The pathophysiological understanding of this disorder is very limited. In order to identify patterns of neuroanatomical involvement within the brain, we applied advanced magnetic resonance imaging-based techniques to a group of six patients with the diagnosis of FOSMN, using unbiased analysis techniques with atlas-based volumetry of volume-rendering T1-weighted data and whole brain-based spatial statistics of diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). The volumetric data showed significant global atrophy with prominent involvement of the medulla oblongata, while DTI demonstrated significant decreases in the right-hemispheric frontal lobe and bilaterally along the superior and inferior longitudinal fasciculi. In summary, this application of volumetry and DTI to a group of FOSMN patients demonstrated, beyond global brain atrophy as a correlate of a systemic disease process, regional atrophy in the brainstem/medulla oblongata, together with tract alterations of polymodal frontotemporoparietal interconnections. Future neuroimaging studies in larger patient groups of FOSMN are needed for detailed phenotype-neuroimaging correlations.
keywords: Facial Onset Sensory And Motor Neuronopathy
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对极罕见的面部起病感觉运动神经元病（FOSMN），对一组确诊患者采用基于磁共振的图谱体积测量和弥散张量成像全脑空间统计，考察脑内神经解剖受累模式。体积分析显示存在显著的整体脑萎缩，并以延髓受累突出；弥散张量成像则显示右侧额叶及双侧上、下纵束出现显著改变。作者据此认为，除整体脑萎缩可能反映系统性病变过程外，FOSMN还伴有脑干/延髓的区域性萎缩以及连接额颞顶叶的多模态纤维束改变，但样本量小，尚需更大规模研究以明确表型与影像的对应关系。

papers.title: Glymphatic dysfunction as a potential mechanistic link to cognitive ımpairment in Behçet's disease: a hypothesis.
papers.authors: Sahin MZ, Yerkebayeva SK, Gokcen N.
papers.abstract: Behçet's disease (BD) is a chronic multisystem inflammatory disease in which cognitive impairment is increasingly recognized but remains incompletely understood. Although cognitive dysfunction is more common in patients with Neuro-Behçet's disease (NBD), it has also been reported in patients without clinically apparent neurological involvement, suggesting that mechanisms beyond focal inflammatory lesions may contribute to cognitive impairment. The glymphatic system is a brain-wide perivascular clearance pathway that maintains cerebral homeostasis by facilitating the exchange of cerebrospinal and interstitial fluid and the removal of inflammatory mediators and metabolic waste products. Previous neuroimaging studies have demonstrated white matter microstructural abnormalities in both NBD and neurologically asymptomatic BD, with more extensive alterations in NBD. Furthermore, studies in systemic lupus erythematosus have identified an increased burden of enlarged perivascular spaces, choroid plexus enlargement, and lower diffusion tensor imaging along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) indices, providing preliminary imaging evidence of alterations putatively related to glymphatic function in systemic inflammation and neuropsychiatric involvement. However, the relationship between glymphatic dysfunction and cognitive impairment has not yet been directly investigated in BD. We hypothesize that chronic neuroinflammation, endothelial dysfunction, blood-brain barrier disruption, vascular inflammation, and sleep disturbance may impair glymphatic clearance in BD, leading to persistent neuroinflammation, white matter injury, and cognitive dysfunction. This proposed relationship has not yet been directly tested in BD. We further propose that glymphatic dysfunction may occur not only in patients with NBD but also in a subset of BD patients without overt neurological involvement, although it is likely to be more pronounced in NBD. If validated, this hypothesis could provide a novel mechanistic framework for cognitive impairment in BD and support the development of imaging biomarkers and adjunctive therapeutic strategies targeting glymphatic function.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇假说性文章，未开展实证研究，聚焦白塞病（BD）中认知损害的机制问题。作者提出，慢性神经炎症、内皮功能障碍、血脑屏障破坏、血管炎症和睡眠障碍可能损害类淋巴清除功能，继而导致持续性神经炎症、白质损伤和认知功能障碍；这一关系在白塞病中尚未被直接检验。作者进一步推测，类淋巴功能障碍不仅见于神经白塞病（NBD）患者，也可能出现在无明确神经系统受累的部分BD患者中，但后者程度可能较轻。若该假说得到验证，或可为BD认知损害提供新的机制框架，并支持影像生物标志物及靶向类淋巴功能的辅助治疗策略的研发。

papers.title: A case of acute lithium encephalopathy associated with elevated myelin basic protein levels in cerebrospinal fluid.
papers.authors: Yokoyama T, Hashimoto T, Moriyama Y, Yoshino A.
papers.journal: PCN reports : psychiatry and clinical neurosciences
papers.abstract: Background Acute lithium intoxication can cause severe central nervous system (CNS) manifestations, sometimes leading to long-term sequelae known as the syndrome of irreversible lithium-effectuated neurotoxicity (SILENT). However, its underlying pathophysiology remains unclear. We report a case of acute lithium encephalopathy presenting with elevated myelin basic protein (MBP) levels in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), offering insights into its pathogenesis. Case presentation A 50-year-old man with schizophrenia developed coma following acute lithium intoxication. Two days prior to symptom onset, his serum lithium concentration had reached a toxic level of 3.95 mEq/L, prompting immediate drug discontinuation. Electroencephalography (EEG) demonstrated generalized rhythmic delta activity (GRDA) with triphasic morphology, characteristic of lithium encephalopathy, but not fulfilling the criteria for non-convulsive status epilepticus. A lumbar puncture on Day 6 revealed an elevated CSF MBP level of 141 pg/mL (normal, <102 pg/mL) without pleocytosis or an elevated IgG index. Although his serum lithium concentration dropped below 0.1 mEq/L by Day 8, his altered mental status was prolonged. His consciousness gradually improved from Day 10, but neurological deficits including dysarthria, gait instability, and intention tremor persisted until Day 40 before fully resolving. Conclusion The elevated CSF MBP level suggests that toxic lithium exposure may induce CNS demyelination. While the clinical symptoms were reversible in this patient, such a mechanism may underpin the prolonged or permanent neurological deficits seen in SILENT.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告关注急性锂中毒所致脑病的病理机制。一名精神分裂症患者在血锂浓度达中毒水平后出现昏迷，脑电图呈锂脑病特征性的广泛节律性δ活动，脑脊液髓鞘碱性蛋白升高但无细胞增多或IgG指数升高，提示毒性锂暴露可能引起中枢神经系统脱髓鞘。尽管该患者症状最终完全可逆，作者认为这一机制或可解释SILENT中迁延或永久性的神经功能缺损，但基于单例观察，结论仍属推测。

papers.title: Distinct Patterns of Cortical Reorganisation Accompany Behaviour-Specific Development in Freely Behaving Infants
papers.authors: Burke CJ, de Zeeuw TJ, Grimm D, Hofer N, Jensen A, Mullin C, Karl JM.
papers.abstract: A central premise of developmental neuroscience is that mature behaviour emerges through reciprocal interactions between infants’ spontaneous actions, neural activity, and environmental experience. Yet, much human neuroimaging research relies on highly controlled, repetitive paradigms designed to minimize behavioural variability, obscuring the very brain-behaviour dynamics that drive developmental change. Here, we introduce a naturalistic functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) paradigm that exploits, rather than suppresses, natural variability in infants’ behaviour to investigate cortical changes associated with behavioural development. Continuous video coding of spontaneous infant behaviour was combined with finite impulse response (FIR) modelling to estimate behaviour-specific hemodynamic responses associated with reach-to-grasp, hand-to-mouth, and vocalization behaviours while accounting for temporally overlapping hemodynamic responses by treating extraneous behaviours as nuisance regressors. From 6 to 13 months of age, reach-to-grasp and vocalizations increased in frequency, while all three behaviours shortened in duration. Critically, developmental changes in cortical activation were behaviour-specific. During reach-to-grasp movements, bilateral posterior parietal activity decreased with age. In contrast, during hand-to-mouth and vocalizations, somatomotor and premotor activity increased with age. Cortical activity was also related to individual variation in the frequency and duration of these behaviours, indicating that cortical recruitment remained coupled to behavioural variation independent of age. These findings reveal behaviour-specific patterns of cortical reorganisation during infant development and establish a methodological framework for linking spontaneous behaviour to cortical activity in freely behaving infants. More broadly, this approach enables direct investigation of cortical development as it unfolds through naturalistic interactions among behaviour, neural activity, and experience. Significance Statement Continuous self-generated interactions with the environment play a critical role in driving infant brain development, yet neuroimaging research often examines infants while sleeping or in highly constrained and repetitive tasks. Here, we show that spontaneous infant behaviour can instead be leveraged to provide the temporal variability needed to resolve behaviour-specific cortical responses in freely behaving infants. By combining continuous behavioural coding with data-driven finite impulse response (FIR) modelling of overlapping hemodynamic responses, we identified behaviour-specific developmental differences in cortical recruitment without tightly constraining the infant’s behaviour. This novel approach expands developmental neuroimaging beyond sleeping or trial-based paradigms and demonstrates how naturally occurring behavioural variability can become a useful feature of fNIRS experimental design. More broadly, it generates new opportunities to directly test theories of neurobehavioural development in more ecologically valid settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注婴儿自发行为与皮层活动在发展中的关系，采用自然情境下的功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）记录，结合连续视频行为编码和有限脉冲响应模型，在自由活动的婴儿中区分抓握、手到口和发声三类行为对应的血流动力学反应。结果显示，从6到13个月，抓握和发声频率增加、三类行为持续时间缩短，而皮层激活的变化具有行为特异性：抓握时双侧后顶叶活动随年龄下降，手到口和发声时躯体运动与前运动区活动随年龄上升；皮层活动还与个体行为频率和持续时间的差异相关，且这种关联不随年龄消失。作者据此提出，婴儿发展中的皮层重组按行为类型分化，并展示了利用自然行为变异性研究自由活动婴儿脑—行为联系的方法框架。

papers.title: Dispelling the Plateau Assumption: Case-Based Evidence for Language Recovery in Chronic-Post Stroke Aphasia
papers.authors: Chang EH, Laks AB, Shattuck K, DeMarco AT, Turkeltaub PE.
papers.abstract: Objective Recovery from post-stroke aphasia is traditionally thought to plateau within a year after stroke. As such, no studies have characterized long-term recovery using comprehensive behavioral assessment and longitudinal functional MRI. We sought to characterize behavioral and neuroplastic changes over nearly six years in a patient with chronic post-stroke aphasia. Methods A patient with chronic left hemisphere stroke underwent behavioral assessment and task-based fMRI at 9, 22, 33 and 71 months after stroke. Testing assessed auditory comprehension, semantic and phonological processing, naming, reading, spelling, motor speech, and executive function. Task-related activation during an adaptive semantic matching paradigm was quantified within language and semantic regions of interest. Results Behavior improved across multiple language domains. WAB-R Aphasia Quotient increased from 49.2 to 69.2, along with the large gains in word finding, connected speech, reading and spelling, whereas auditory comprehension remained relatively stable. fMRI demonstrated progressively increasing activation within left-hemisphere language regions, reaching normative range by the final assessment, along with increasing activation in semantic/executive regions. Discussion Recovery of language production abilities can continue for years after stroke, supported by neuroplastic changes in the brain. Neurologists should inform stroke survivors that aphasia recovery can continue indefinitely after stroke.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以一位慢性左半球卒中后失语患者为对象，结合行为评估与任务态功能磁共振，追踪其卒中后近六年的语言表现与脑活动变化。结果显示，患者在词语提取、连贯言语、阅读和拼写等多个语言领域持续改善，失语商明显提高，而听觉理解相对稳定；同时左半球语言区及语义、执行相关区域的激活逐步增强，最终接近常模范围。作者据此指出，语言产生能力的恢复在卒中多年后仍可继续，并伴随神经可塑性变化，因此临床人员应告知卒中幸存者失语恢复可能长期持续。该结论来自单例个案证据，尚需更大样本验证。

papers.title: Larger Pre-Speech Auditory Modulation Is Associated With Smaller Corrective Responses To Auditory Errors
papers.authors: Basciano A, Chao S, Rogalsky C, Daliri A.
papers.abstract: Purpose During speech planning, the brain predicts the auditory consequences of its movements and modulates the auditory system—a process called pre-speech auditory modulation (PSAM). We investigated the link between PSAM and behavioral error correction and determined how aging influences these mechanisms. Methods Seventeen young adults (18–32 years) and 13 older adults (50–85 years) performed a speaking task involving auditory feedback perturbations and a silent reading control. We measured electrophysiological responses (N1/P2) to auditory probes during speech planning and correlated these modulations with the magnitude of participants’ subsequent behavioral corrective responses. Results Both groups showed significant modulation of N1 and P2. However, N1 modulation correlated with corrective responses only in young adults. Older adults showed reduced behavioral corrections and smaller, delayed P2 components. Despite these age-related behavioral differences and the loss of the modulation-correction correlation, older adults maintained modulation magnitudes comparable to those of younger adults. Conclusions N1 modulation serves as a neural index of the brain’s predictive processes during speech planning. Aging appears to selectively disrupt the integration of these signals into motor output rather than the internal generation of the predictions themselves.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察说话计划阶段的听觉预测性调制（PSAM）与随后对听觉误差的行为纠正之间的关系，并比较年轻人和老年人的差异。被试在听觉反馈受扰的说话任务和默读控制条件下完成测试，同时记录听觉探针诱发的电生理反应。结果显示，两组都出现N1和P2调制，但N1调制只在年轻成人中与纠正反应相关；老年人行为纠正减弱、P2成分更小且延迟，调制幅度却与年轻人相当。作者据此认为，N1调制可作为说话计划中预测过程的神经指标，而老化可能选择性地影响将预测信号整合进运动输出，而非预测本身的生成。

papers.title: Longitudinal Visual Recovery and Exploratory Neuroimaging Findings in Pediatric Deprivation Amblyopia Following Unilateral Congenital Cataract Extraction: A Prospective Cohort Study.
papers.authors: Ni S, Tang X, Li M, Li J, Leng F, Zheng P, Shi W, Li L.
papers.abstract: Objectives : Visual outcomes after unilateral congenital cataract (UCC) extraction remain variable, and the neuroanatomical changes accompanying subsequent visual improvement are poorly understood. This study characterized longitudinal changes in visual function and explored hemispheric asymmetry, longitudinal neuroimaging changes, and their associations with visual recovery in children after UCC extraction. Methods : This prospective observational cohort study enrolled 55 children aged 5 to <9 years with unilateral deprivation amblyopia receiving optical correction, passive occlusion, and dichoptic training. We analyzed 6-month changes in central visual field (CVF; mean sensitivity [MS], mean defect [MD]) and corrected distance visual acuity (CDVA). To assess structural alterations along the posterior visual pathways, a strictly controlled, exploratory subgroup of 18 right-handed patients (aged 5 to <8 years) with left-eye amblyopia underwent 3-Tesla (3T) MRI. Multiple comparisons in the neuroimaging and structure-function analyses were controlled using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) procedure. Results : At 6 months, CDVA and CVF improved significantly from baseline across all amblyopia severity groups (all p < 0.05). Greater CDVA improvement was associated with larger increases in MS (β = 3.36, 95% CI, 1.37 to 5.35; p = 0.001) and greater reductions in MD (β = -2.80, 95% CI, -4.82 to -0.79; p = 0.007). Exploratory longitudinal neuroimaging analyses showed decreases in ipsilateral secondary visual cortex (V2) volume (Cohen's d = -0.75, PFDR = 0.042) and cortical thickness (Cohen's d = -0.77, PFDR = 0.042). Interhemispheric differences in V2 and middle temporal visual area (MT) cortical thickness were also observed at the 6-month follow-up (all |Cohen's d| > 0.75, PFDR < 0.05). Nominal structure-function associations were observed for CVF and CDVA changes (all |r| > 0.54, all p < 0.05). No serious adverse events were observed. Conclusions: Children with unilateral deprivation amblyopia following UCC extraction showed improvements in CDVA and CVF over 6 months of routine care. CVF perimetry may provide complementary functional information during longitudinal assessment. Exploratory neuroimaging findings suggested potentially distinct structural correlates of CDVA and CVF recovery, requiring validation in larger controlled longitudinal studies to clarify the clinical significance of CVF and its associated neuroimaging changes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究追踪单侧先天性白内障术后弱视儿童在常规治疗下视觉功能的纵向变化，并探索性地考察后视觉通路结构改变及其与视力恢复的关联。结果显示，患儿矫正远视力与中心视野在6个月内均较基线改善，且视力提升幅度与中心视野敏感度增加、缺损减少相关；探索性影像分析提示部分视觉皮层体积和厚度出现变化，并观察到两半球间差异，但结构-功能关联仅为初步发现。作者强调影像结果属探索性质，需更大规模对照研究验证，中心视野检查或可为纵向评估提供补充信息。

papers.title: The cerebral correlates of visceral pain in irritable bowel syndrome: An activation -likelihood estimation meta-analysis of functional neuroimaging studies
papers.authors: Müller C, Maxeiner H, Printz H.
papers.abstract: In irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), chronic visceral pain without underlying abdominal disease is the main symptom causing repeated in-hospital treatment and resulting in reduced quality of life in 5-10% of the general population. The multifactorial pathophysiology of visceral pain in IBS can be explained within the concept of visceral hypersensitivity in which biopsychological stressors lead to a reduced sensory threshold by the mechanism of central sensitization in predisposed individuals. This can be measured psychophysically with balloon distension experiments in which IBS is associated with both the sensation of pain induced by normally non-painful stimulus intensity (allodynia) and a subjectively stronger pain sensation compared to healthy controls (hyperalgesia). Visceral pain can be characterized by sensory-discriminative and affective-motivational qualities correlating with the activation of distinguishable neuronal pathways which can be visualized using functional neuroimaging. An ALE (activation likelihood estimation) meta-analysis including a total of 32 studies with balloon distention experiments during either PET or fMRI was performed to demonstrate the neuroanatomical correlates of visceral pain in IBS. ALE maps for patients with IBS and healthy controls were calculated separately and a contrast analysis between both groups was conducted. The ALE meta-analysis was performed using the GingerAle software version 3.0.2 and was displayed with the Mango software version 4.1 on an anatomical MNI template. Experimentally induced visceral pain correlated with bilateral activation in the thalamus, the insula, the cingulate cortex and the right postcentral gyrus inferior parietal lobe in healthy controls. For patients with IBS, bihemispheric activation of the insula and medio-frontal gyrus/cingulate cortex, left thalamus and parahippocampal gyrus/amygdala was observed. Contrast analysis revealed statistically significant stronger activation of the bilateral thalamus, the left insula, the right inferior parietal lobe/postcentral gyrus and the right precentral gyrus/inferior frontal gyrus in healthy controls. Patients with IBS showed stronger activation of the bilateral insula, the left superio-medial frontal gyrus, the left inferior frontal gyrus and the left parahippocampal gyrus/amygdala. Conjoint analysis showed statically significant overlapping activation in the bilateral insula and left thalamus. This ALE meta-analysis substantiates the idea of two distinguishable neuronal pathways of pain processing. The observed activity patterns are consistent with an enhanced sensitivity to pain in patients with IBS which is associated with neuronal activation in the insula and cingulate cortex. Visceral hypersensitivity may therefore be related to a sensitization of the homeostatic-autonomous pathway of pain processing resulting from convergence of peripheral input as well as cognitive and emotional modulation.

papers.title: Transdiagnostic patterns of electroencephalography (EEG)-derived aperiodic activity across schizophrenia-spectrum, bipolar, and depressive disorders: A systematic review.
papers.authors: Le GH, Wong S, Di Luch S, Orsini DK, Vasudeva S, Agarwal SM, Llach CD, Rosenblat JD, McIntyre RS.
papers.abstract: Aperiodic electroencephalographic activity is proposed as a scalable marker of cortical population dynamics relevant to excitation-inhibition balance. However, it remains unclear whether aperiodic parameters represent disorder-specific abnormalities or context-sensitive indices of clinically relevant brain states. Consistent with systematic-review guidelines and a prospectively registered protocol, Ovid databases and PubMed were searched from inception through February 9, 2026, with updated manual searching conducted through July 14, 2026. Peer-reviewed studies reporting electroencephalography-derived aperiodic parameters in adults with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders, major depressive disorder, treatment-resistant depression, and/or bipolar disorder were eligible. Studies lacking aperiodic outcomes or separable findings for eligible diagnoses were excluded. Two reviewers independently conducted study screening, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessments. Findings were synthesized narratively by diagnosis, recording context, and parameter. Thirty articles (N = 2298 aggregate participants) spanning cross-sectional, longitudinal, and interventional designs were included. Findings in schizophrenia-spectrum disorders were heterogeneous, with several studies reporting steeper slopes, higher offsets, or reduced temporal flexibility relative to healthy controls. Task-related and dynamic measures often showed greater clinical relevance than static resting-state parameters. Studies of major depressive disorder and treatment-resistant depression more consistently reported flatter slopes and reduced offsets, particularly in central and posterior regions, with evidence from sleep and intracranial recordings. Aperiodic parameters were sensitive to treatment-related modulation, although the direction of change differed across interventions. Bipolar disorder evidence was limited, and methodological heterogeneity precluded quantitative synthesis. Aperiodic electroencephalographic activity may be more informative as a context-sensitive, within-subject marker of cortical state and treatment-related change than a fixed diagnostic signature. Methodological harmonization and direct physiological validation remain necessary before clinical implementation.
keywords: Schizophrenia Spectrum And Other Psychotic Disorders
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了精神分裂症谱系、双相障碍和抑郁障碍中脑电非周期活动的跨诊断证据，共纳入横断面、纵向和干预设计的研究，并按诊断、记录情境和参数进行叙述性整合。结果显示，精神分裂症谱系障碍的发现较为异质，部分研究报告更陡的斜率、更高的偏移或降低的时间灵活性；抑郁障碍及难治性抑郁则较一致地表现为斜率更平、偏移降低，且任务相关和动态指标往往比静态静息参数更具临床相关性。非周期参数对治疗调节敏感，但不同干预下变化方向不一；双相障碍证据有限，方法学异质性使定量合并无法进行。作者据此提出，非周期脑电活动或许更适合作为反映皮层状态和治疗相关变化的、情境敏感的被试内指标，而非固定的诊断特征，临床转化前仍需方法学统一与直接的生理验证。

papers.title: Public involvement in the Brazilian Cerebral Palsy Register: An exploratory, sequential, mixed-methods study.
papers.authors: da Silva LC, Kerr C, Jahan I, Pinho RFF, Silveira AL, Badawi N, Khandaker G, Pauletti GL, Longo E, Ruiz Brunner M, Chagas PSC, Leite HR.
papers.abstract: Aim To describe the implementation of a public involvement strategy based on the UK Standards for Public Involvement in Research within the Brazilian Cerebral Palsy Register (BrCPR). Method We conducted a participatory, exploratory, sequential, mixed-methods study. Eleven partners (five adults with cerebral palsy and six mothers) from different Brazilian states participated in a four-phase online process: partner integration; knowledge building; exploring public involvement standards and identifying barriers and facilitators; and action plan development and co-creation of an implementation process of a public involvement group. Results Partners selected WhatsApp as their primary communication method and were satisfied with meeting the dynamics and content, except meeting duration (1 hour 30 minutes). Reported barriers included language inaccessibility, researcher attitudes, limited family empowerment, time constraints, and lack of researcher flexibility. Facilitators included researcher flexibility, varied knowledge-sharing formats, plain language use, qualitative impact measures, governance council creation, and revised public involvement implementation steps. Partners proposed a seventh standard: continuous review (of standards, co-responsibility, and research aspects). A 26-action implementation plan and a 6-stage public involvement implementation model for cerebral palsy registries were co-created. Interpretation The UK Standards for Public Involvement in Research proved an adequate guide for the BrCPR public involvement group. Identified barriers and facilitators guided group actions, leading to a public involvement implementation process grounded in partners' needs and perspectives.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在描述在巴西脑瘫登记系统中实施公众参与策略的过程，采用参与式、探索性、顺序混合方法，由脑瘫成人和患儿母亲作为合作伙伴共同参与在线流程。合作伙伴选定了主要沟通方式，并对会议安排总体满意，但指出语言可及性、研究者态度、家庭赋权不足、时间限制和研究者灵活性欠缺等障碍，同时确认研究者灵活性、多样化知识分享形式、通俗语言、定性影响评估和治理委员会等促进因素。在此基础上，他们共同制定了包含多项行动的实施方案和适用于脑瘫登记系统的分阶段公众参与模型，并提出增加“持续审查”标准。作者认为英国公众参与研究标准可为该登记系统的公众参与提供适当指导，相关障碍与促进因素有助于形成贴合合作伙伴需求与视角的实施过程。

papers.title: Precision cognitive neurorehabilitation: dose, adaptivity, digital therapeutics and implementation.
papers.authors: Sander FW, Sallard É, Silva M, Schneider L, Diserens K, Graf C, Serino A, Sokolov AA.
papers.abstract: Introduction Cognitive deficits are determinants of long-term disability and socio-professional reintegration across neurological disorders, including stroke, traumatic brain injury, multiple sclerosis, and neurodegenerative diseases. Despite evidence supporting cognitive neurorehabilitation, its implementation remains heterogeneous, and therapeutic parameters are insufficiently defined. Areas covered The authors reviewed the published literature from PubMed and Google Scholar from 1 January 2015 to 30 June 2026, supplemented by seminal publications. Clinical trials, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and observational and proof-of-concept studies were prioritized. This brief narrative review examines restorative and compensatory cognitive neurorehabilitation for deficits of attention, executive functions, language and disorders of consciousness in people after stroke and traumatic brain injury (TBI), older adults, and those with neurological and neurodegenerative conditions, including multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. Emphasis is placed on dose, frequency, adaptivity, personalization, and digital and technology-assisted interventions. Methodological challenges include heterogeneity of protocols, limited use of active control conditions, insufficient long-term follow-up, and the gap between cognitive test improvements and meaningful effects on participation. Expert opinion Advancing cognitive neurorehabilitation requires precision-driven approaches integrating digital therapeutics with clinical frameworks. Large-scale pragmatic trials, meaningful endpoints, and implementation strategies across the continuum of care will be essential to transform cognitive neurorehabilitation into a component of neurological practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了卒中、创伤性脑损伤及多发性硬化、阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经与神经退行性疾病人群认知神经康复的文献，重点关注注意、执行功能、语言及意识障碍的恢复性与代偿性干预。文章围绕剂量、频率、自适应性和个体化，讨论了数字化及技术辅助干预的作用，并指出方案异质性、主动对照使用不足、长期随访缺乏，以及认知测验改善与参与度实际获益之间的落差等方法学挑战。作者提出，应将数字疗法与临床框架整合，走精准化路径，并通过大规模实用性试验、有意义的终点指标和贯穿照护全程的实施策略，推动认知神经康复成为神经科实践的组成部分。

papers.title: Stereoelectroencephalography-based anatomo-electro-clinical subtyping reveals network-specific organization in parietal lobe epilepsy.
papers.authors: Song X, Hu T, Zhao X, Zhang D, Sun Y, Ma Z, Gao X, Li H, Cui X, Li W.
papers.abstract: Aims This study aimed to use stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) to delineate the anatomo-electro-clinical correlations between seizure semiology and Brodmann area-based functional subregions in parietal lobe epilepsy (PLE), so as to improve the precise localization of seizure onset and the accuracy of presurgical diagnosis. Methods Patients with PLE who underwent SEEG were retrospectively included. Intracranial electrode contacts were localized based on Brodmann area (BA) anatomical divisions. Seizure semiology and ictal SEEG evolution were systematically quantified using a predefined scoring system. Hierarchical cluster analysis and principal component analysis (PCA) were applied to identify correlations between clinical signs, involved anatomical subregions, and early propagation networks. Results Four distinct subtypes of PLE were identified based on the analysis of 23 patients: (1) an autonomic symptoms subtype involving BA43 and the insulo-opercular region; (2) a posterior parietal subtype centered on BA7 with contralateral versive sign and absence of autonomic symptoms; (3) a BA39-dominant subtype characterized by staring/behavioural arrest and automatisms; (4) a somatosensory subtype involving BA3.1.2 with localized somesthetic aura and no automatisms. Correlation analysis revealed a posterior-anterior gradient between semiology and BA subregions. Conclusion SEEG-based subtyping reveals network-organized seizure semiology and improves the localization precision of the seizure onset zone (SOZ) in PLE.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于立体脑电图（SEEG）数据，探讨顶叶癫痫发作症状学与Brodmann分区功能亚区之间的解剖-电-临床对应关系，以提升致痫区定位和术前诊断精度。作者回顾性分析接受SEEG评估的顶叶癫痫患者，对发作症状学和发作期SEEG演变进行量化评分，并通过聚类分析和主成分分析识别症状、受累亚区与早期传播网络之间的关联。结果识别出四种不同的顶叶癫痫亚型，分别以自主神经症状、后顶叶表现、BA39主导的凝视与自动症以及局限躯体感觉先兆为特征，并发现症状学与BA亚区之间存在后-前梯度。作者据此认为，基于SEEG的分型揭示了网络化的发作症状组织方式，有助于提高顶叶癫痫致痫区定位的精确性。

papers.title: Normative modeling of intrinsic brain activity reveals multiscale heterogeneity in autism spectrum disorder.
papers.authors: Guo X, Wang J, Wang Y, Zhou R, Gao L.
papers.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is characterized by profound clinical and biological heterogeneity, which limits the reproducibility and individual specificity of findings from traditional case-control studies. However, quantitative characterization of individualized patterns of spontaneous neural activity and their biological correlates remains limited in ASD. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data, including 349 individuals with ASD and 459 typical controls, from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange database were used to characterize spontaneous neural activity via the amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF). Non-negative matrix factorization was applied to extract latent functional factors from ALFF patterns. Normative modeling was then employed to construct normative trajectories and quantify individual-level deviations in ASD relative to typical development. Subsequently, clustering was utilized to identify neurobiological subtypes based on individualized deviation profiles, and representational similarity analysis was used to examine their clinical associations. Finally, spatial correlations with transcriptomic data, neurotransmitter maps, and cognitive functional domains were explored to delineate the multiscale biological correlates of functional factors. Five latent factors spanning socio-sensorimotor integration, action-related processing, executive control, emotional processing, and attentional processing domains were successfully identified, revealing two neurobiologically distinct subtypes of ASD. Subtype-specific associations were found between individualized functional deviation profiles and clinical symptoms. Furthermore, distinct spatial associations between functional factors and gene expression profiles as well as neurotransmitter systems were observed. This study maps individualized functional heterogeneity in ASD and provides multiscale insights into the biological correlates underlying functional alterations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注孤独症谱系障碍个体自发脑活动的异质性，利用静息态功能磁共振数据，以低频涨落振幅刻画活动模式，并通过规范建模量化个体相对于典型发育的偏离。研究从活动模式中提取出涵盖社会感觉运动整合、动作加工、执行控制、情绪和注意等领域的潜在功能因子，并据此识别出两种神经生物学上不同的孤独症亚型，亚型特异的个体偏离谱与临床症状相关。功能因子还与基因表达和神经递质系统呈现不同的空间关联。这些结果提示孤独症的自发脑活动异质性具有多尺度生物学对应，但相关发现属于关联性刻画，尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Reduced perivascular diffusion in multiple sclerosis is associated with aging, disease duration, and mobility impairment.
papers.authors: Sato SD, Richmond SB, Fling BW, Seidler RD.
papers.abstract: Background The glymphatic system supports brain homeostasis by facilitating perivascular fluid transport and metabolic waste clearance. Diffusion-tensor imaging along the perivascular space (ALPS-index) provides a non-invasive surrogate marker of glymphatic activity. The objectives of this study were to: (1) compare the ALPS-index between individuals with relapsing-remitting MS (RRMS) and non-MS controls, (2) examine the role of age in the association between ALPS-index and disease duration, and (3) examine the relationship between ALPS-index and walking speed in RRMS. Methods Individuals with RRMS and age‑ and sex-matched controls underwent 3T MRI, including diffusion‑weighted imaging. ALPS‑index was calculated using standardized regions of interest. Walking function was assessed using a two‑minute walk test. Results Individuals with RRMS have significantly lower ALPS‑index compared to controls (p = 0.001). Across participants, older age was associated with lower ALPS‑index (p < 0.001), with no evidence that age effects differed by group (group effect: p = 0.311, group x age: p = 0.954). In RRMS, a lower ALPS‑index was associated with longer disease duration (p = 0.028); however, mediation analyses showed that chronological age largely explained this relationship (p = 0.012). In a multivariable model, both lower ALPS‑index and slower gait speed were independently associated with longer disease duration, with an interaction effect (p = 0.032) suggesting functional compensation between perivascular diffusion and mobility. Conclusions These findings highlight the interconnected roles of aging, perivascular fluid transport, and mobility in MS and support the ALPS‑index as a feasible, non‑invasive imaging marker of age‑related vulnerability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了复发缓解型多发性硬化患者与非多发性硬化对照者的血管周围间隙弥散指标（ALPS指数），并考察其与年龄、病程及步行速度的关系。结果显示，患者的ALPS指数显著低于对照者；年龄越大，该指数越低，且这一年龄效应在两组间无差异。在患者中，较低的ALPS指数与较长病程相关，但中介分析提示这种关系在很大程度上可由实际年龄解释；同时，较低的ALPS指数与较慢步速均独立关联于较长病程，二者间还存在交互作用，提示血管周围弥散与运动功能之间可能存在功能补偿。作者据此认为，该指标可作为反映年龄相关易感性的无创影像标记，但相关发现属关联性证据，尚不能推断因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Exploratory synergistic diagnostic value of CSF neurofilament light chain and topographic cortical atrophy in differentiating cerebral amyloid angiopathy from Alzheimer's disease - a pilot study.
papers.authors: Jansen R, Arndt P, Brüggemann J, Dörner M, Mattern H, Meuth SG, Lee JI, Gliem M, Schreiber S.
papers.abstract: Background Differentiating Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy (CAA) from Alzheimer's disease (AD) in vivo is challenging due to overlapping amyloid pathology and limited availability sensitivity of hemorrhagic markers in memory clinic settings. We investigated whether integrating regional cortical atrophy with cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) neurofilament light chain (NfL), a marker of axonal injury, might have a diagnostic value. Methods In this pilot study (n = 30, n = 12 CE and n = 18 probable CAA), cortical thickness was quantified via FreeSurfer MRI analysis and standardized into regional Z-scores. We applied a hypothesis-driven dual-region approach (entorhinal cortex vs. precuneus). Classification was performed using firth's penalized logistic regression because of sample size and validated via Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOOCV). Results AD exhibited widespread atrophy involving both medial temporal (entorhinal) and posterior parietal (precuneus) structures. In contrast, probable CAA presented with relative temporal preservation despite posterior involvement. CSF NfL was numerically higher in CAA (median 2830 pg/ml) than in AD (2105.5 pg/ml). A combined model (entorhinal, precuneus, and CSF NfL) achieved the highest in-sample discrimination (AUC = 0.86, 95% CI: 0.64-1.00), while LOOCV yielded an AUC of 0.61. Conclusion The multimodal integration of temporal neurodegeneration and axonal injury captures the divergent pathophysiological signatures of AD and CAA, serving as an exploratory, hypothesis generating pathophysiological profile rather than a generalized diagnostic algorithm.
papers.summary_zh: 这项初步研究探讨能否将区域皮层萎缩与脑脊液神经丝轻链（NfL）结合，用于区分脑淀粉样血管病（CAA）与阿尔茨海默病（AD）。研究基于少量受试者的MRI皮层厚度分析和脑脊液NfL检测，采用假设驱动的内嗅皮层与楔前叶双区域比较，并用惩罚回归建模。结果显示，AD在内侧颞叶和后顶叶均出现广泛萎缩，而很可能CAA在后部受累的同时相对保留颞叶；CAA的脑脊液NfL数值上高于AD。联合内嗅皮层、楔前叶和NfL的模型在样本内区分度较高，但交叉验证后明显下降。作者强调，这一多模态组合更多是探索性的病理生理特征，而非可直接推广的诊断算法。

papers.title: Integrating structural and functional connectivity to optimize ecological security patterns at multiple levels in the Yellow River Delta, China.
papers.authors: Wen L, Bai J, Ren W, Qiu J, Xu Y, Zhang G, Guan Y.
papers.abstract: Improving ecological connectivity is essential for optimizing ecological security patterns (ESPs) to conserve biodiversity and support regional sustainability. However, the synergistic quantitative evaluation and optimization of ESP connectivity integrating structural and functional dimensions remain poorly understood. Here, we developed an integrated framework coupling structural and functional connectivity to optimize ESPs at multiple hierarchical levels in the Yellow River Delta (YRD). The results showed that the numbers of ecological sources in the YRD declined from 91 in 1990 to 23 in 2020, while ecological corridors decreased from 181 to 31, with a spatial shift from inland to coastal areas. The α, β, and γ declined by 57.30%, 32.24%, and 27.41%, respectively, and the connectivity robustness was also weakened over time. In 2020, 19 ecological pinch points (1.06 km2 ) and 10 barrier points (0.41 km2 ) were identified as restoration priorities. Three restoration scenarios exhibited contrasting outcomes. Structural optimization increased the selected topological connectivity metrics but did not reduce modeled movement resistance, whereas functional optimization reduced corridor length and cost-weighted distance (CWD) but resulted in lower values of some structural metrics. The coupled scenario increased the selected structural metrics while reducing corridor length, suggesting the potential for coordinated improvements in network structure and landscape permeability under the model assumptions. A spatial strategy of "three cores, two zones, two belts, and multiple points" was proposed to guide targeted protection and restoration. This study highlights the necessity of multi-perspective ESP optimization and provides guidance for coastal ecological restoration and sustainable management.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对黄河三角洲生态安全格局优化中结构与功能连通性缺乏协同量化评估的问题，构建了一个整合两类连通性的多层次分析框架。结果显示，研究期内生态源地与廊道数量大幅减少，连通性指标和稳健性随时间减弱，空间分布由内陆向沿海转移，并识别出需优先修复的生态夹点与障碍点。三种修复情景效果不同：结构优化提升了拓扑连通性指标但未降低模拟移动阻力，功能优化缩短了廊道长度和成本加权距离却使部分结构指标下降，而耦合情景在提升结构指标的同时缩短了廊道长度，提示在模型假设下网络结构与景观通透性有望协同改善。作者据此提出空间保护修复策略，强调多视角优化生态安全格局的必要性。
