papers.summary_zh: 该研究在60岁及以上有主观认知减退或轻度认知障碍的老年人中，考察快速眼动睡眠期脑电变慢与基底前脑Meynert基底核体积的关系，并结合多导睡眠监测与磁共振成像进行分析。结果显示，快速眼动睡眠期脑电变慢越明显，Meynert基底核体积越小，而这一关联未见于相邻的Ch1-3区域，也未见于非快速眼动睡眠期，提示其具有解剖和睡眠阶段的双重特异性。作者认为，这种脑电变慢可能反映Meynert基底核的早期退变，有望作为评估基底前脑完整性的无创指标；但该研究为横断面关联，其预后价值仍需纵向研究确认。

papers.title: Temporal organization of shared brain states characterizes heterogeneity in major depressive disorder
papers.authors: Pan C, Tu Y, Wang F, Lin K, Qiu S, Zhang W, the REST-meta-MDD Consortium.
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is biologically heterogeneous, but how this variability is expressed in the temporal organization of brain activity remains unclear. Using resting-state functional MRI from 2,225 participants, we applied hidden Markov modeling to identify recurrent brain states and quantify their temporal organization. Five states formed a shared repertoire across individuals with MDD and healthy controls, while MDD-related alterations were distributed across states, functional systems, and temporal properties. Within MDD, unsupervised clustering of state occupancy, persistence, and switching delineated two prototype neurodynamic architectures characterized by preferential deployment of ACS/VSS or MAS/DMS states within a preserved state repertoire and broadly similar transition backbone. The architectures showed different within-group brain–symptom associations and symptom-network patterns. Connectome transcriptome analyses organized architecture–state imaging patterns into three transcriptomic state families shared across architectures, and contrasting group-level deployment patterns were recovered in an independent MDD cohort. These findings suggest that MDD heterogeneity is expressed not only through spatially distributed neural alterations, but also through differences in how a common repertoire of recurrent brain states is organized over time.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍的生物学异质性如何体现在脑活动的时间组织上，利用静息态功能磁共振数据，通过隐马尔可夫模型识别反复出现的脑状态并量化其时间特征。结果显示，抑郁患者与健康对照共享五种脑状态，但抑郁相关改变分散于不同状态、功能系统和时间属性中；在患者内部，依据状态占用、持续和切换特征可聚类出两种神经动力学架构，二者在保留共同状态库和相似转换骨架的前提下偏好部署不同状态，并呈现不同的脑—症状关联和症状网络模式。连接组—转录组分析进一步将这些架构—状态影像模式归为三类转录组状态家族，并在独立抑郁队列中重现了相反的组水平部署模式。作者据此提出，抑郁异质性不仅表现为空间上分散的神经改变，也表现为共同脑状态库在时间组织方式上的差异。

papers.title: Causal event structure shapes convergent reactivation signatures in human cortex and language model
papers.authors: Zhang Z, Chen Y, Liu Q, Zhao X, Ding X, Fei X, Du J, Bao Y, Gao J, Huang X, Cai B, Liang X, Qin B, Liu T.
papers.abstract: Humans adapt to changing environments by understanding the latent causal structure of events, and modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit analogous abilities. However, elucidating how causal knowledge is represented and integrated in the human brain and in LLMs poses a substantial challenge for cognitive science. To address this, we combine topological analysis of representational manifolds with neuroscientific analyses of reactivation. We find that event-level causal relations modulate temporally structured neural reactivation in the human brain, particularly in the angular gyrus, precuneus and prefrontal cortex. By contrast, LLMs express these relations through positionally structured representational reactivation. Despite these differences, the resulting reactivation patterns exhibit similar intrinsic manifold structure across the two systems. Together, these findings suggest that the human brain and LLM share a common principle for organizing causal knowledge.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑与大型语言模型如何表征和整合事件的因果结构，结合表征流形的拓扑分析与神经再激活分析，比较二者在加工事件级因果关系时的组织方式。结果显示，人脑中的因果关联会调节具有时间结构的神经再激活，涉及角回、楔前叶和前额叶等区域；语言模型则通过位置结构的表征再激活表达这些关系。尽管动态形式不同，两者最终形成的再激活模式具有相似的内在流形结构，提示人脑与语言模型在组织因果知识上可能共享某种共同原则。

papers.title: Electrical stimulation of the human pulvinar generates visual percepts
papers.authors: Kemball-Cook WS, Bader ER, Boro AD, Eskandar EN, Killian NJ.
papers.abstract: Visual prostheses have targeted early structures in the visual pathway, including the retina, optic nerve, lateral geniculate nucleus, and visual cortex, to generate visual percepts. Stimulation of higher-order visual regions, which may better encode complex visual features, remains relatively unexplored. We tested whether electrical stimulation of the medial and inferior pulvinar elicits visual percepts in a patient with medically refractory epilepsy undergoing invasive seizure monitoring with intracranial electroencephalography. Bipolar stimulation (30 biphasic pulses, 0.5 ms per phase, 3 mA, 1 Hz) was delivered between adjacent pulvinar contacts while eye movements were tracked. Stimulation of different electrode pairs elicited visual percepts at distinct retinotopic locations (p = 0.010). Stimulation also altered cortical activity, producing an early power increase followed by gamma desynchronization in occipital and parietal regions (p < 0.001) and beta desynchronization in the lateral temporal region (p < 0.01). These findings suggest that pulvinar stimulation can generate visual percepts and modulate distributed cortical networks, supporting further investigation of the pulvinar as a target for vision restoration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在一名接受颅内脑电监测的药物难治性癫痫患者中，测试电刺激丘脑枕内侧部和下部能否诱发视觉知觉，并同步追踪眼动、记录皮层活动。结果显示，刺激不同电极对可在不同视网膜拓扑位置引出视觉知觉，同时改变枕叶、顶叶和外侧颞叶的皮层活动，表现为早期功率升高后出现伽马去同步化及贝塔去同步化。作者据此认为，丘脑枕刺激既能产生视觉知觉，也能调节分布式皮层网络，值得进一步研究其作为视觉修复靶点的可能，但该结论来自单例患者，尚属初步证据。

papers.title: Electroencephalography research in neuropathic pain (Review).
papers.authors: Zhou L, Liao N, Wang H, Zhao J, Jiang H, Dang S, Yu S, Shu H, Chen X.
papers.abstract: Neuropathic pain (NP), arising from lesions or dysfunction of the somatosensory system, remains a major clinical challenge due to its subjective and multidimensional nature. Traditional pain assessments rely on self‑report scales, which lack objectivity and reproducibility. Electroencephalography (EEG), with its high temporal resolution and accessibility, provides a promising avenue for identifying candidate neurophysiological biomarkers of pain. The current narrative review integrates mechanistic insights and electrophysiological evidence to delineate EEG alterations in NP. Resting‑state θ increases and dominant‑frequency slowing are relatively recurrent in chronic NP, whereas α‑, β‑ and γ‑band findings remain heterogeneous. Network analyses further reveal aberrant prefrontal‑limbic and sensorimotor connectivity, as well as altered cross‑frequency coupling, but the direction and topology of these findings remain dependent on the patient population, recording configuration and analytical metric. Advances in computational EEG analysis, graph theory and machine learning are facilitating exploration of objective, individualized pain assessment frameworks. Emerging portable EEG and multimodal approaches may provide opportunities for future clinical translation. Overall, EEG offers a feasible and dynamic method to bridge subjective pain perception with measurable neurophysiological signatures, paving the way toward precision diagnostics and neuromodulation in NP.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕神经病理性疼痛缺乏客观评估工具这一问题，梳理了脑电图在识别疼痛神经生理标志物方面的证据。文章指出，慢性神经病理性疼痛中静息态θ活动增强和主导频率减慢较为一致，而α、β、γ频段的结果仍不一致；网络分析提示前额-边缘系统及感觉运动连接异常和跨频率耦合改变，但其方向与拓扑受患者群体、记录配置和分析指标影响。作者认为，计算分析、图论和机器学习的发展有助于探索客观、个体化的疼痛评估框架，便携脑电图和多模态方法可能为未来临床转化提供机会，但现有证据尚不足以支持临床应用。

papers.title: Longitudinal White Matter Diffusion Alterations in Medication Overuse Headache Before and After Medication Withdrawal: A Diffusion Tensor Imaging Study.
papers.authors: Polat M, Kizilates-Evin G, Aslan K, Sahin HA, Ozbenli T.
papers.abstract: Background and Objectives : The pathophysiology of medication overuse headache (MOH) remains incompletely understood, and advanced neuroimaging methods such as Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI) may help clarify the structural white matter (WM) changes associated with chronic analgesic overuse. The objective of this study was to identify WM microstructural alterations in patients with MOH, both before and after discontinuation of the overused medication, compared with healthy controls (HC), utilizing whole-brain and region-of-interest (ROI)-restricted tract-based spatial statistics (TBSS). Materials and Methods : Twenty-three patients with MOH, diagnosed according to ICHD (3rd edition) criteria, and 23 demographically matched HC underwent 3-Tesla DTI. Whole-brain and ROI-restricted TBSS analyses of fractional anisotropy (FA), axial diffusivity (AD), mean diffusivity (MD) and radial diffusivity (RD) were performed to assess global and tract-specific white matter microstructural alterations. In the MOH group, DTI was repeated at follow-up after withdrawal of the overused medication, initiation of alternative treatment, and clinical improvement (MOH-DW). Sixteen patients and 16 controls were included in the final analysis after exclusions for pregnancy, loss to follow-up, or technical issues. Results : Whole-brain TBSS revealed no statistically significant group differences. ROI-restricted analysis revealed a marked increase in fractional anisotropy (FA) and axial diffusivity (AD) in the MOH group relative to the HC group within the left anterior limb of the internal capsule, the body of the corpus callosum, and the right superior corona radiata. Concurrently, higher mean diffusivity (MD) was observed in the left anterior limb of the internal capsule. At the follow-up assessment, FA and AD remained significantly higher than in healthy controls in the anterior limb of the internal capsule and superior corona radiata, whereas the group difference in the corpus callosum was no longer statistically significant. As the direct within-subject comparison between pre- and post-withdrawal measurements did not reach significance in any region, this may reflect the loss of a detectable group difference rather than confirmed within-subject reversibility. Conclusions : MOH may be associated with WM microstructural changes characterized predominantly by increased, rather than decreased, diffusion anisotropy and axial diffusivity in tracts relevant to pain processing. The disappearance of the significant group difference in the corpus callosum at follow-up raises the hypothesis that this may be compatible with a dynamic and potentially reversible microstructural process; however, because medication withdrawal occurred concurrently with the introduction of alternative treatment, this finding cannot be attributed specifically to withdrawal. Given the modest sample size and the absence of correction across the 27 ROI analyses tested, these exploratory findings are preliminary and warrant confirmation in larger, independent longitudinal cohorts.

papers.title: Beyond Local Gating: Toward Network-State-Dependent Neuromodulation.
papers.authors: Belardinelli P, Mongiardini E, Turrini S, Avenanti A.
papers.abstract: Brain stimulation is progressively evolving from anatomically targeted interventions toward individualized, adaptive, and network-oriented approaches. Recent developments in brain-state-dependent stimulation have demonstrated that neuromodulation can be optimized by synchronizing stimulation with ongoing neural activity, while adaptive cortico-cortical paired associative stimulation (ccPAS) has extended this principle to distributed cortical networks. However, current approaches continue to define brain state primarily through local electrophysiological features, such as oscillatory phase or power, even though ccPAS is specifically designed to modify communication between interconnected cortical regions. In this opinion paper, we argue that the endogenous variable guiding ccPAS should instead describe the instantaneous physiological state of the targeted cortico-cortical pathway. We propose that online source-space functional connectivity provides a biologically meaningful and technically feasible estimate of this pathway state, thereby enabling a new framework of network-state-dependent neuromodulation. As illustrative applications, we consider pathways spanning different levels of experimental characterization, from established sensorimotor interactions to the less-characterized ventral premotor cortex (PMv)-posterior superior temporal sulcus (pSTS) pathway within the action-observation network (AON). This distinction highlights that the proposed framework is pathway-general, while its experimental implementation requires pathway-specific characterization of stimulation parameters and appropriate physiological readouts. In this framework, resting-state EEG is rapidly reconstructed in source space to estimate pathway connectivity, which is subsequently used to personalize stimulation targets and guide state-dependent ccPAS of a functionally defined cortico-cortical circuit. Finally, we discuss the technological prerequisites, methodological challenges, biological rationale, and open scientific questions that must be addressed before pathway-state-guided neuromodulation can be experimentally validated. We argue that redefining brain state as the instantaneous physiological state of the communication pathway targeted by stimulation may represent the next conceptual step in brain stimulation.

papers.title: Longitudinal changes in resting-state EEG eyes-closed/open delta differentiation during an Antarctic expedition.
papers.authors: Yang W, Tian H, Xie G, Xu Y, Wang Q, Yin Y, Liu W, Jiang Y.
papers.abstract: Antarctic polar night brings extreme light deprivation, prolonged isolation and severe circadian disruption, yet longitudinal resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) signatures reflecting neurophysiological alterations in this harsh environment remain poorly characterized. In this exploratory longitudinal research, resting-state EEG recordings with eyes open (EO) and eyes closed (EC) were acquired from 16 Antarctic expeditioners at four mission stages: pre-departure, pre-polar-night, early post-polar-night, and austral summer. Linear mixed-effects models with false discovery rate correction were applied to analyze delta eyes-closed/open differentiation (the EC-EO delta log-power difference), delta sub-bands, aperiodic spectral features, entropy, EEG microstates and delta-band functional connectivity. The delta EC-EO difference exhibited consistent, progressively negative shifts in parietal, frontal, whole-brain and occipital regions across the expedition timeline, with the most pronounced shifts observed in recordings obtained during and after the polar-night period; this effect spanned all slow, mid and fast delta sub-bands. Secondary mild temporal variations were observed in aperiodic spectral metrics, occipital sample entropy and global delta connectivity, whereas EEG microstates displayed no significant longitudinal alterations. Collectively, the delta EC-EO difference emerges as a candidate EEG index of resting-state condition differentiation in the low-frequency range, pending validation in larger studies with synchronized behavioral, physiological, and environmental measures.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性纵向研究考察南极科考期间极端光照剥夺、长期隔离与昼夜节律紊乱环境下静息态脑电的变化，对16名队员在出发前、极夜前、极夜后早期和南半球夏季四个阶段采集睁眼与闭眼静息态脑电，并分析delta频段睁闭眼差异等指标。结果显示，顶叶、额叶、全脑和枕叶的delta睁闭眼差异随任务进程持续向负向偏移，在极夜期间及之后的记录中最为明显，且覆盖慢、中、快各delta子频段；非周期频谱指标、枕叶样本熵和全局delta连接仅有轻微时间变化，脑电微状态未见显著纵向改变。作者据此提出，delta睁闭眼差异可作为低频静息状态区分的一个候选脑电指标，但尚需在更大样本并结合行为、生理与环境同步测量的研究中验证。

papers.title: An explainable machine learning model based on multidimensional task-state electroencephalography for identifying attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder comorbid developmental dyslexia.
papers.authors: Huang K, Zuo P, Luo X, Ji C, Yang F, Huang Y, Wang X.
papers.abstract: Background Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and developmental dyslexia (DD) are highly comorbid, yet objective differentiation from individual disorders remains challenging due to the lack of neurophysiological biomarkers. This study aimed to develop an interpretable machine learning model leveraging multidimensional task-state EEG features to distinguish ADHD-DD comorbidity from ADHD and typical development (TD). Methods Ninety children (27 ADHD-DD, 40 ADHD, 23 TD) underwent EEG during a VSWM task. Five feature categories were extracted: event-related potentials, time-frequency characteristics, functional connectivity, graph-theoretic metrics, and nonlinear dynamics. Three feature-processing strategies and nine classifiers were compared within a nested cross-validation framework. Feature contribution was quantified by coefficient back-projection of the optimal PCA-LR mode. Sensitivity and permutation analyses were performed. Results The PCA-LR model achieved a balanced accuracy of 80.5%, a Macro-F1 of 0.799, and a Macro-AUC of 0.912. Class-wise AUCs were 0.905 for ADHD-DD, 0.904 for ADHD, and 0.927 for TD. Left temporal α-band functional connectivity was a shared high-contribution feature in both disorder groups. ADHD-DD was distinguished by widely distributed cross-regional connectivity spanning θ and α bands and by P200 amplitude. ADHD was characterized primarily by α-band network metrics and α-ERD, whereas TD relied mainly on θ and α bands functional connectivity and graph-theoretic metrics. Conclusion Our findings suggest that multidimensional task-state EEG features may help differentiate children with ADHD-DD comorbidity from those with ADHD or typical development. They also indicate that machine-learning approaches may be useful for identifying neurodevelopmental comorbid conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在利用多维任务态脑电特征构建可解释的机器学习模型，以区分注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）与发育性阅读障碍（DD）共病、单纯ADHD及典型发育儿童，研究对象为完成视空间工作记忆任务的儿童。模型在区分三类儿童时取得了较好的整体分类表现，其中共病组与单纯ADHD组共享左侧颞区α频段功能连接这一高贡献特征，而共病组还表现出跨θ和α频段的广泛跨区域连接及P200波幅特征，单纯ADHD组主要依赖α频段网络指标和α事件相关去同步，典型发育组则主要依赖θ和α频段功能连接与图论指标。作者据此认为，多维任务态脑电特征或有助于识别ADHD-DD共病，机器学习方法也可能为识别神经发育共病提供线索，但上述判别能力仍需进一步验证，尚不能直接推及临床诊断应用。

papers.title: Structural and dynamic functional controllability: shared variance between network control metrics limits attribution to distinct domains of intelligence.
papers.authors: Ng J, Feusner JD, Hawco C.
papers.abstract: Introduction Fluid and crystallized intelligence have recently been hypothesized to reflect the brain network's capacity to facilitate transitions into hard-to-reach, high-energy states, measured via modal controllability, and easy-to-reach, low-energy states, measured via average controllability, respectively. Controllability is typically measured for the structural connectome, but dynamic functional connectivity may better capture temporally varying processes relevant to cognition. Methods Using data from the Human Connectome Project, we compared the prediction of crystallized and fluid intelligence from controllability metrics measured in both structural and dynamic functional connectivity. We hypothesized dynamic functional connectivity would outperform structural connectivity, and modal and average controllability would differentially predict fluid and crystallized intelligence. Results As expected, dynamic functional connectivity outperformed structural connectivity in predicting cognitive performance. However, modal and average controllability displayed similar predictive power for fluid and crystalized intelligence, and performed comparably to regional (or node) strength, a simpler graph metric reflecting the strength of immediate regional connections that strongly covaries with both controllability measures. Furthermore, controllability most strongly predicted general intelligence, the shared factor between crystallized and fluid intelligence. General intelligence was associated with higher average controllability (and greater node strength) in transmodal regions and higher modal controllability (and lower node strength) in unimodal regions in dynamic functional connectivity. Discussion These findings clarify how network control maps onto cognitive ability across the cortical hierarchy, while suggesting that shared variance between controllability metrics hinders specific attribution to crystallized and fluid intelligence, challenging prior hypotheses.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用人类连接组计划数据，比较结构连接与动态功能连接上的网络可控性指标对晶体智力和流体智力的预测能力，并检验模态可控性与平均可控性是否分别对应这两种智力。结果显示，动态功能连接整体上比结构连接更能预测认知表现，但两类可控性对晶体智力和流体智力的预测力相近，且与更简单的节点强度指标表现相当，说明这些指标间的共享方差限制了对不同智力成分的具体归因。可控性对一般智力（两种智力的共同因子）预测最强，并与跨模态区和单模态区呈现方向不同的关联，提示网络控制与认知能力的关系需放在皮层层级中理解。

papers.title: Neurovascular uncoupling in type 2 diabetes mellitus: multimodal MRI reveals the association between hippocampal and subcortical structures dysfunction and cognitive decline.
papers.authors: Chen W, Li M, Liu WV, Zheng Y, Zhang Z, Huang W, Huang S, Zhou H.
papers.abstract: Objective To investigate the efficiency of neurovascular coupling (NVC) in hippocampal and subcortical structures in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and its relations with cognition and glycemic control, and to characterize multimodal MRI features of T2DM-related cognitive decline. Methods Forty-nine T2DM patients and 43 healthy controls underwent montreal cognitive assessment (MoCA), digit span (DST), clock drawing (CDT), and fasting blood glucose (FBG)/glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) measurement. High-resolution T1-weighted structural images, three-dimensional arterial spin labeling (3D-ASL) perfusion images, and resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) were acquired on a 3T scanner. Volumes, cerebral blood flow (CBF), fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF), regional homogeneity (ReHo), degree centrality (DC), and NVC were calculated for bilateral hippocampus, amygdala, anterior thalamus, caudate, nucleus accumbens, putamen, and globus pallidus. Partial correlations assessed associations between imaging metrics, glycemic parameters, and MoCA scores. Results T2DM had significantly lower MoCA (P < 0.05) but no differences in DST or CDT. Right anterior thalamic volume was reduced. CBF decreased in bilateral hippocampus, bilateral anterior thalamus, and right amygdala. ReHo reduced in right anterior thalamus and left amygdala. NVC decreased in left hippocampus and left amygdala. No basal ganglia differences were found. MoCA negatively correlated with FBG (r = -0.405) and positively with right thalamic volume (r = 0.311). HbA1c and FBG negatively correlated with left anterior thalamic CBF (r = -0.344 and -0.367, P < 0.05). Conclusions T2DM shows decreased perfusion, reduced regional synchronization, and neurovascular uncoupling in limbic-subcortical structures including hippocampus, anterior thalamus, amygdala, while basal ganglia motor circuits are preserved. Multimodal MRI metrics may provide imaging targets for early identification and intervention.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注2型糖尿病患者的认知下降是否与海马及皮层下结构的神经血管耦合异常有关，采用多模态MRI结合认知量表和血糖指标，比较患者与健康对照。结果显示，患者总体认知评分较低，右侧前丘脑体积缩小，双侧海马、双侧前丘脑和右侧杏仁核血流灌注下降，右侧前丘脑和左侧杏仁核局部同步性减弱，左侧海马和左侧杏仁核出现神经血管解耦；基底节未见明显差异。认知评分与空腹血糖负相关、与右侧丘脑体积正相关，血糖指标与左侧前丘脑灌注负相关。作者据此提出，糖尿病相关认知下降可能涉及边缘-皮层下结构的灌注与耦合异常，而基底节运动环路相对保留，这些影像指标或有助于早期识别，但相关关系尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: Whole-brain cortical morphometry and structural covariance network disruption in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis.
papers.authors: Mukherjee A, Vyas K, Shah A, Saini J, Asranna A, Padmanabha H, Raghavendra K, Mundlamuri RC, Sinha S, Viswanathan LG.
papers.abstract: Background Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a progressive, fatal encephalitis caused by persistent measles virus infection. Quantitative cortical imaging in SSPE remains poorly characterised, and the topology of the cortical structural covariance network (SCN) has not been examined. Objective To characterise whole-brain cortical structural alterations in SSPE using surface-based morphometry (SBM) and voxel-based morphometry (VBM), evaluate their clinical correlates, and describe the topology of the cortical SCN. Methods Twenty-eight patients with SSPE and 48 age- and sex-matched healthy controls underwent 3.0 T volumetric T1-weighted MRI. SBM was performed in FreeSurfer using the Desikan-Killiany (DK) atlas, adjusted for age and sex; VBM used the FSL-VBM pipeline with threshold-free cluster enhancement, adjusted for age, sex and total intracranial volume. Clinical associations used Pearson correlation with false discovery rate (FDR) correction and Spearman sensitivity analyses; severity was quantified with the Neurological Disability Index. Group-level SCNs were constructed from age- and sex-adjusted regional thickness correlations; graph metrics were computed across 16 network densities and summarised as the area under the metric-versus-density curve, so that findings do not depend on a single arbitrary threshold. Group differences were assessed by subject-label permutation testing with bootstrap confidence intervals. Results VBM identified widespread bilateral grey matter volume reduction extending from cortex into deep grey matter and cerebellum, with additional right-lateralised clusters in the planum temporale and frontal pole. Vertex-wise SBM demonstrated 35 bilateral cortical thickness clusters and 21 cortical volume clusters; in the covariate-adjusted regional analysis, 38 of 68 DK regions showed significant thinning after FDR correction, and 18 of 68 regions showed significant volume reduction, most prominently the bilateral frontal pole and posterior cortices. Cortical thickness and volume correlated negatively with disease duration across most regions, but not with clinical severity. SCN metrics differed consistently in direction across all densities - longer characteristic path length, higher modularity and local efficiency, and loss of degree assortativity in patients - but no metric difference survived subject-label permutation testing after FDR correction (smallest adjusted p = 0.24); SCN findings are therefore reported as descriptive. Conclusions SSPE produces widespread, duration-dependent cortical thinning and grey matter volume loss involving association, limbic and primary cortices. Group-level SCN topology showed a consistent directional pattern of network reorganisation that did not reach corrected statistical significance at this sample size. Prospective, longitudinal and multi-centre studies are required before any clinical application of these measures can be considered.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注亚急性硬化性全脑炎（SSPE）患者全脑皮层结构改变及皮层结构协方差网络拓扑，对患者与健康对照进行结构磁共振成像，并结合基于表面的形态学、基于体素的形态学和图论分析。结果显示，患者存在广泛的双侧灰质体积下降和皮层变薄，涉及联络皮层、边缘系统及初级皮层，且皮层厚度和体积多与病程负相关，但与临床严重程度无关；网络指标虽呈现特征路径长度延长、模块度升高等一致方向，却未通过校正后的统计检验，作者因此仅作描述性报告。总体而言，SSPE 的皮层结构损害广泛且随病程进展，而网络拓扑改变在本样本量下尚不确定，相关指标距离临床应用仍需前瞻性、纵向和多中心研究验证。

papers.title: Use of structure-function coupling to assess compensatory motor cortex flexibility and predict postoperative motor outcomes in patients with motor area gliomas.
papers.authors: Wang X, Yu T, Zhang X, Zhao X, Li M, Li H, Zuo Z, Cui Y, Ren X, Lin S, Zhou D.
papers.abstract: Objective The objective of this study was to investigate the mechanisms of motor compensation in glioma patients by quantifying both the structural decoupling index (SDI) value and the integrity of transcallosal white matter tracts. The authors aimed to evaluate their individual and combined utility in predicting long-term postoperative motor outcomes. Methods Seventy patients with motor area gliomas and 23 healthy controls were retrospectively included. All participants underwent preoperative 3T resting-state fMRI and diffusion MRI. The SDI value was computed using a graph signal processing approach to quantify the decoupling between functional activity and structural connectivity. White matter integrity and disconnection severity of the corpus callosum were assessed using TractSeg and tractography. Motor function was evaluated using the Medical Research Council scale preoperatively and at the 3-month follow-up. Statistical analyses included group comparisons, correlation analyses, and multivariate logistic regression to identify predictors of severe motor impairment (SMI). Results Glioma patients exhibited altered SDI values in motor-related regions, including the precentral gyrus and thalamus. A higher SDI value in the contralateral precentral gyrus was associated with better motor recovery (p = 0.00025), while greater disconnection severity in the anterior midbody of the corpus callosum (CC4) correlated with poorer motor function (p = 0.00041). Multivariate analysis identified IDH-wildtype status, higher CC4 disconnection severity, and lower contralateral precentral gyrus SDI value as independent predictors of SMI. A nomogram integrating these factors showed excellent predictive accuracy (C-index = 0.914). Conclusions The SDI captures adaptive functional decoupling in the contralateral motor cortex, which may be associated with compensatory mechanisms in glioma patients. Combined with callosal integrity, the SDI enhances the prediction of postoperative motor outcomes, offering a novel biomarker for preoperative risk stratification and personalized rehabilitation planning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对运动区胶质瘤患者，用静息态功能磁共振与弥散磁共振计算结构解耦指数（SDI），并结合胼胝体白质纤维束完整性，考察二者对术后远期运动结局的预测价值。结果显示，患者运动相关脑区的SDI发生改变；对侧中央前回SDI较高与运动恢复较好相关，而胼胝体前中体部离断越严重，运动功能越差。多因素分析中，IDH野生型、胼胝体离断严重程度和对侧中央前回SDI共同预测严重运动障碍，整合这些因素的列线图预测准确性较高。作者认为，SDI可能反映对侧运动皮层的代偿性功能解耦，与胼胝体完整性结合有助于术前风险评估和康复规划；上述关联的因果性质尚不明确。

papers.title: Cortical development in patients with metopic craniosynostosis.
papers.authors: Tio PAE, Tjaberinga MC, Wijnbergen DC, Gaillard L, Dremmen MHG, Pleumeekers MM, van Veelen MC, Vrooman HA, Mathijssen IMJ.
papers.abstract: Objective Patients with metopic synostosis have an increased risk of neurodevelopmental disorders, despite a minimal risk of intracranial hypertension. While mechanical constraint due to premature suture fusion has been proposed as a contributing factor, evidence suggests intrinsic brain malformations may play a more significant role. Cortical thickness, volume, and surface area alterations have been implicated in neurodevelopmental disorders, yet their role in metopic synostosis remains unclear. In this retrospective study, authors investigated whether these cortical parameters are altered in patients with metopic synostosis compared with those in healthy controls. Methods 3D T1-weighted MRI brain scans from patients 0-2 years of age with metopic synostosis were reviewed. Children born preterm or with a syndromic condition were excluded. MRI brain scans of patients and age-matched controls were processed using the Infant FreeSurfer pipeline to quantify cortical thickness, cortical volume, cortical surface area, and intracranial volume. Linear regression models adjusted for age, sex, and intracranial volume were used to compare global cortical thickness, cortical volume, and cortical surface area between the groups, with secondary analyses of these metrics at the lobular level. Results Sixty-four patients with metopic synostosis and 32 controls (median age at MRI 8.4 months [IQR 4.84] and 12.4 months [IQR 9.68], respectively) were eligible for inclusion. Patients with metopic synostosis had a significantly increased cortical surface area compared to that in controls (p = 0.029). No significant differences were found in global cortical thickness (p = 0.281) or total cortical volume (p = 0.141) between patients and controls. Conclusions Increased cortical surface area is observed in patients with metopic synostosis; however, there are no significant differences in cortical thickness and volume. Similar developmental trajectories have been observed in infants with neurodevelopmental disorders. These findings shift the focus from mechanical deformation to fundamental brain development pathways in patients with metopic synostosis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注额缝早闭患者是否存在皮层厚度、体积和表面积等皮层参数的改变，回顾性比较了0至2岁额缝早闭患儿与年龄匹配健康对照的3D T1加权脑MRI，并用婴儿FreeSurfer流程量化上述指标。结果显示，患儿整体皮层表面积较对照组显著增大，而整体皮层厚度和总皮层体积未见显著差异。作者据此认为，额缝早闭相关的神经发育风险可能更多与皮层表面积增大所反映的脑发育路径有关，而非单纯机械压迫；这一模式与神经发育障碍婴儿中观察到的发育轨迹相似，但研究为横断面关联，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Distinct Patterns of Reward-Related Neural Activation and Dopamine Neurophysiology in Adolescent Depression with and without Mixed Manic Features
papers.authors: Gonçalves SF, Ojha A, Lindenmuth M, Karim HT, Henry TR, Diler R, Ladouceur CD.
papers.abstract: Adolescents with depression are at elevated risk for maladaptive risk behaviors, underscoring the importance of understanding neurobiological alterations in reward function in this population. However, reward function alterations associated with depression, particularly in the presence of co-occurring manic symptoms (i.e., mixed manic features), remain poorly understood. In this study, 154 12–18-year-olds (ndepression without mixed manic features = 65; ndepression with mixed manic features = 56; nhealthy controls = 33) and their primary caregiver completed questionnaires, clinical interviews, and fMRI during the monetary incentive delay task. Neural response during monetary reward anticipation, as well as tissue iron concentrations, important for dopamine neurophysiology, were derived from the striatum and used to predict group membership and severity of mixed manic features. Exploratory whole brain functional activation analyses were also conducted. Lower caudate activation (in the outlier-excluded analysis) was associated with membership in the depression with mixed manic features group. Across both depression groups, higher caudate and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) activation was associated with greater mixed manic feature severity. In addition, lower tissue iron concentration in the putamen and higher tissue iron concentration in the caudate were each associated with membership in the depression without mixed features group. These findings suggest that reward-related neural activation differentiates mixed manic features, whereas alterations in tissue iron characterize adolescent depression more broadly.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年抑郁症中伴或不伴混合躁狂特征时奖赏相关神经活动的差异，对象为青少年及其主要照护者，结合问卷、临床访谈与金钱激励延迟任务下的fMRI，并从纹状体提取奖赏预期时的神经反应及组织铁浓度。结果显示，尾状核激活较低与伴混合躁狂特征的抑郁组相关，而在两个抑郁组中，尾状核和背外侧前额叶激活越高，混合躁狂特征越严重；壳核组织铁较低和尾状核组织铁较高则分别与不伴混合特征的抑郁组相关。作者据此认为，奖赏相关神经激活有助于区分混合躁狂特征，而组织铁的改变则更广泛地刻画青少年抑郁。

papers.title: The Effect of a Neuroeducation Program on L2 Automatization and Acquisition for Intermediate Young Adult Learners
papers.authors: Yusuf NH.
papers.abstract: Abstract Almost without exception, adult second language (L2) learners fail to acquire an L2 to a comparable level of proficiency as their first language (L1). In part, traditional teaching approaches fail to address this issue or adapt to the equipotential brain. In light of this, this research attempted to explore language acquisition from a neuroeducation perspective. Accordingly, a neuroeducation program was developed which draws on concepts from neuroscience. The neuroeducation program was developed based on the LIRRA neuroeducational model which was proposed to automatize L2 and improve language acquisition for late learners. The program hinged on reiterative implicit exposure of lexical phrases in an attention- and reward- stimulating setting. This was to allow for procedural memory processing (like in L1) where L2 becomes automatized. In this regard, in a pre-post design, 30 English intermediate-level undergraduates were enrolled to the study. The program was a computerized online one encompassing 23 sessions and was implemented using a variety of engaging techniques such as games, riddles, and interactive readings. The outcomes were measured using a pre/post-test comprising three sections: a lexical-phrases production test, a reading proficiency test, and a writing test. The results revealed that the students showed a significant speed-up performance and considerable automaticity gains. Additionally, students showed a significant improvement in their acquisition of L2 lexical phrases and their reading proficiency. This research holds a promising future for the implementation of neuroeducation programs in language learning and for self-directed learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从神经教育视角出发，基于LIRRA神经教育模型开发了一套计算机化在线课程，通过游戏、谜语和互动阅读等方式对中级英语学习者反复进行词汇短语的隐性接触，并营造注意与奖励刺激的环境，旨在促进程序性记忆加工和第二语言自动化。研究采用前后测设计，考察学习者在词汇短语产出、阅读水平和写作方面的变化。结果显示，学习者的加工速度明显加快，自动化程度有相当提升，词汇短语习得和阅读能力也显著改善。作者据此认为，神经教育课程在语言学习和自主学习中有应用前景，但摘要未报告写作方面的结果，相关效果仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The Developing Injured Brain is Not Quiet: Rapid Region Specific Axonal Injury and Microglia Activation Within the First Day Following a Diffuse Traumatic Brain Injury in a Pediatric Rat Model
papers.authors: Patrick MB, Ekanem NB, Patrick MB, Cho M, Lantzy MK, Jose J, Miller-Ferguson N, Lafrenaye A.
papers.abstract: Pediatric traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a leading cause of death and disability in children, especially toddlers (~2-3 years old). Despite pediatric TBI’s prevalence, its underlying progression of cellular outcomes are largely extrapolated from adult studies. Notably, axonal injury and acute microglial activation following pediatric TBI remains under-characterized. We addressed this gap by utilizing a central fluid percussion injury (cFPI) model in postnatal day 16-18 male and female rats to investigate axonal injury burden, microglia morphological and Iba-1 fluorescence intensity changes acutely following sham or cFPI in the lateral cortex (CTX), subcortical white matter (SCWM) and thalamus (THAL). Microscopic assessment revealed diffuse axonal injury within the CTX, SCWM, and THAL with different temporal progressions that largely resolved within 1d post-injury. Microglial morphology changed significantly 1h post-injury in the CTX and THAL and 3h post-cFPI in the SCWM. Interestingly, microglial changes generally preceded peak axonal injury burden. These findings demonstrate rapid, region-specific, and temporally distinct microglia activation following diffuse TBI. Additionally, utilizing high-dimensional morphological profiling can define microglia responses in the developing brain, potentially revealing novel therapeutic windows for pediatric TBI intervention.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童弥漫性创伤性脑损伤后早期轴突损伤与小胶质细胞激活的时程特征，采用幼年大鼠中央液压冲击损伤模型，在伤后急性期观察外侧皮层、皮层下白质和丘脑。结果显示，轴突损伤在上述区域均出现，但时间进程不同，且大多在伤后一天内基本消退；小胶质细胞形态则在伤后数小时内即发生区域特异性的显著变化，且这些变化通常早于轴突损伤负担的峰值。作者据此指出，发育中脑损伤后小胶质细胞激活迅速、具有区域和时间特异性，并提示高维形态学分析有助于刻画发育脑中的小胶质细胞反应，或为儿童脑损伤干预提供潜在时间窗。

papers.title: Comprehensive Multimodal Diagnostics and Rehabilitation in Persistent Post-Concussion Syndrome Following Motor Vehicle Collision.
papers.authors: Jay K, Shaya M, Walker J.
papers.abstract: Motor vehicle collisions (MVCs) are among the most common mechanisms of mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI), and a meaningful proportion of affected individuals develop persistent post-concussion syndrome (PPCS) characterized by prolonged multidomain dysfunction. Conventional neuroimaging frequently fails to capture the underlying pathophysiology, leaving clinicians without objective diagnostic evidence. We describe a 57-year-old woman who sustained mTBI in a rear-end MVC in March 2023. Head computed tomography (CT) performed at the emergency department and a subsequent brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) with susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI) and diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) were both unremarkable. Despite normal structural neuroimaging, comprehensive multimodal functional assessment identified functional abnormalities across eight domains: vestibular function (videonystagmography (VNG)), cortical electrophysiology (quantitative electroencephalography (qEEG)), pupillary autonomics (automated infrared pupillometry), postural stability (computerized dynamic posturography (CDP)), oculomotor control (saccadometry), cardiac autonomic regulation (24-h heart rate variability (HRV)), olfaction (University of Pennsylvania Smell Identification Test (UPSIT)), and computerized concussion assessment (C3 Logix). Standardized psychological assessments confirmed moderate depression (Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) = 14), moderate anxiety (Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) = 12), clinically significant post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms (PTSD Checklist for Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition (DSM-5) (PCL-5 = 38)), and substantial headache impact (Headache Impact Test-6 (HIT-6) = 58). The patient underwent a 10-modality individualized rehabilitation program. Concussion Symptom Checklist (CSC) scores declined from 92 at initial presentation to 0 by July 2023 (17 weeks post-injury), with near-complete re-resolution to 8 by February 2024 following a transient stress-related exacerbation. When conventional neuroimaging is unremarkable, comprehensive multimodal functional testing may provide evidence consistent with mTBI pathophysiology and help guide targeted rehabilitation. This case illustrates the potential value of a systematic, multimodal approach in PPCS management, while acknowledging that definitive attribution of findings to the index injury is constrained by the single-case design and absence of a pre-injury functional baseline.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例57岁女性在追尾车祸后发生轻度创伤性脑损伤、并持续存在脑震荡后综合征的个案。急诊头颅CT及后续脑MRI（含SWI和DTI）均未见异常，但综合多模态功能评估在前庭功能、皮层电生理、瞳孔自主神经、姿势稳定性、眼动控制、心脏自主调节、嗅觉及计算机化脑震荡评估等方面发现异常，心理评估也提示中度抑郁、焦虑及创伤后应激症状。患者接受多模式个体化康复后，症状评分明显下降并在一次应激相关加重后接近完全缓解。作者认为，常规影像无异常时，多模态功能检查可提供与轻度脑损伤病理生理相符的证据并辅助康复，但单例设计和缺乏伤前功能基线限制了将发现归因于本次损伤。

papers.title: Medium-Term Cognitive Outcome in Patients With CNS Lymphomas Treated With Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy.
papers.authors: Mersali S, Chapelle R, Ribeiro M, Weiss N, Psimaras D, Le Guennec L, Birzu C, Hoang-Xuan K, Boussen I, Baron M, Morel V, Uzunov M, Friser V, Choquet S, Houillier C.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy has demonstrated promising efficacy results in CNS lymphomas, with reassuring rates of acute neurotoxicity. However, the neurologic outcome of these brain-injured patients remains unknown beyond the short term. Our objective was to report on the medium-term neurocognitive evolution. Methods We retrospectively selected isolated CNS lymphomas treated with CAR T cells (June 2021-April 2024) at Pitié-Salpêtrière Hospital who had neuropsychological follow-up as part of routine care (various tests evaluating main cognitive domains: language, memory, executive functions, visuospatial abilities, and overall functioning). We collected the results of the various cognitive tests from the patients' medical records at baseline, in the absence of tumoral progression; 6 weeks (W6); 6 months (M6); and 12 months (M12) after CAR T-cell therapy. We used paired Student t tests to compare follow-up values of neurocognitive variables with their baseline values. The primary outcome was the difference in Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) scores between baseline and M12. Results Thirty patients (43% female, 57% male) were included, of whom 21 had neuropsychological assessment up to M12. Their median age was 61 years (range 30-82). At baseline, MoCA score was 23.5 (range 11-29) and 34%-80% of patients had abnormal scores in the main cognitive domains. Nineteen (63%) patients experienced acute neurotoxicity (6 (20%) of grade ≥3). Twenty-one patients (70%) maintained or improved their MoCA score at W6, while 9 (30%) worsened theirs. The occurrence and severity of neurotoxicity were significantly associated with these 2 types of initial trajectories (p = 0.003, 95% CI 1.78-1,227.01). There was a significant improvement of MoCA score at M6 (mean 24.7 vs 22.6, p = 0.002, 95% CI 0.92-3.37) and M12 (mean 25.4 vs 22.1, p < 0.001, 95% CI 2.12-4.92) compared with baseline. Language score significantly improved between baseline and M12 (mean Z -score of -0.6 vs -0.1; p = 0.02, 95% CI 0.08-0.9). Scores addressing memory, executive functions, visuo-spatial functions, and anxiety/depression were stable or improved, although not significantly. Discussion Midterm neurocognition follow-up in patients with CNS lymphoma treated by CAR T cells seems reassuring, with no significant cognitive worsening, and even an improvement in general cognitive functioning, even in patients who experienced severe acute neurotoxicity. These results should be confirmed with longer follow-up.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注中枢神经系统淋巴瘤患者接受CAR T细胞治疗后，认知功能在中期如何变化。作者回顾性分析了在该院接受治疗并有常规神经心理随访的患者，比较治疗前与治疗后多个时间点的认知测验结果。总体上，患者的一般认知功能在治疗后6个月和12个月较基线有所改善，语言表现也见提高，记忆、执行功能、视空间能力及焦虑抑郁评分保持稳定或改善但未达显著；急性神经毒性的发生及严重程度与治疗后早期认知轨迹的差异相关。作者认为中期认知结局总体令人安心，未出现明显认知恶化，但结论仍需更长期随访确认。

papers.title: EXPRESS: Association between Neurovascular Network Dysfunction and Poor Sleep Quality in Patients with Cerebral Small Vessel Disease.
papers.authors: Guo T, Gao Z, Yang Q, Lu Y, Zhao M, Hu G, Li X, Wang T, Wang D, Wang Y, Collet JP, Guan L.
papers.journal: Journal of cerebral blood flow and metabolism : official journal of the International Society of Cerebral Blood Flow and Metabolism
papers.abstract: Background/hypothesis Poor sleep quality is frequently reported among patients with cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD), but its neurovascular correlates remain unclear. We examined exploratory associations between multidomain neurovascular network (NVN) measures and poor sleep quality in patients with CSVD. Methods In this cross-sectional analysis nested within a prospective CSVD registry, 102 patients with CSVD underwent heart rate variability, cerebral haemodynamic and resting-state electroencephalography assessments. Poor sleep quality was defined as a Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) global score >5. Analyses were primarily adjusted for age and sex, with false discovery rate (FDR) correction applied across all evaluated NVN variables. Results Fifty-three participants had poor sleep quality. Among 108 evaluated NVN variables, 12 showed nominal unadjusted between-group differences and 13 showed nominal age- and sex-adjusted associations with poor sleep quality. Neither crude nor adjusted associations survived FDR correction. In secondary exploratory model analyses, the multidomain NVN model showed an apparent area under the curve (AUC) of 0.795 and a bootstrap optimism-corrected AUC of 0.758. Conclusion/interpretation PSQI-defined poor sleep quality in CSVD was accompanied by exploratory differences across autonomic, haemodynamic and neuroelectrical NVN domains. Longitudinal studies with non-CSVD controls and objective sleep assessments are needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注脑小血管病患者的睡眠质量差是否与神经血管网络功能异常相关，采用横断面设计，对患者的自主神经、脑血流和静息脑电等多域指标与主观睡眠质量进行了探索性关联分析。结果显示，虽然部分神经血管网络指标在粗分析或校正年龄性别后与睡眠质量差存在名义关联，但均未通过多重比较校正，提示这些关联尚不稳健。多域模型对睡眠质量差的区分表现仅为探索性，作者强调需纵向研究、非脑小血管病对照和客观睡眠评估来验证，不能据此推断因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Understanding Understanding: Reconnecting Theories of Human Semantic Knowledge.
papers.authors: Rogers TT.
papers.abstract: At the close of the twentieth century, human semantic memory was thought to be organized around dedicated, domain-specific modules operating independently of one another and of perception, action, and much of language. The intervening years have marked a transition toward a more holistic view in which semantics emerges from learned mappings among sensory, motor, and language representations, with recent work beginning to integrate semantic representation with theories of cognitive control and attention. This article reviews the reasons for this remarkable change in perspective, provides a snapshot of our current understanding of semantics in the mind and brain, and considers how this understanding may change in light of new innovations in artificial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了语义记忆理论从二十世纪末到近年的转变：语义知识曾被视为由彼此独立、且与知觉、动作和语言相对分离的专门领域模块组织，如今则转向更整体的观点，认为语义来自感觉、运动和语言表征之间习得的映射，近期研究还开始把语义表征与认知控制和注意理论结合起来。文章回顾了这一视角转变的原因，概述了当前对心智与大脑中语义的理解，并讨论了人工智能的新进展可能如何改变这种理解。

papers.title: Engineering neurovascular thrombosis: Light-based bioprinting for patient-specific modeling and women's cerebrovascular health.
papers.authors: Dei-Awuku L, Yap NA, Zhao YC, Wang Z, Kavurma MM, Li J, Xu X, Quon J, Huang YYS, Lim KS, Nguyen KL, Hsiai TK, Ju LA.
papers.abstract: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis (CVST) and carotid web (CW) are distinct cerebrovascular disorders where vascular geometry, disturbed hemodynamics, and endothelial activation interact to drive thrombosis. Both conditions disproportionately affect women, yet remain understudied because of the inability of traditional platforms to replicate complex three-dimensional lumen profiles. This perspective positions light-based lithography as a powerful biofabrication strategy for patient-specific modeling. Digital light processing and volumetric bioprinting render enclosed, perfusable hydrogel networks with high-fidelity surface topography. When integrated into dynamic vessel-on-chip perfusion loops guided by clinical imaging and computational fluid dynamics, these platforms simulate pathological flow stasis and recirculation zones, heterogeneous shear-stress gradients, and site-specific cellular aggregation. This biofabrication approach enables personalized disease modeling and translationally relevant risk assessment, providing a critical platform for advancing women's cerebrovascular health.

papers.title: Brain gray matter changes across chronic pain trajectories: MRI evidence from 35,000 individuals.
papers.authors: Zorina-Lichtenwalter K, Bango CI, Petre B, Rader L, Čeko M, Lindquist MA, Friedman NP, Wager TD.
papers.abstract: Abstract Chronic pain affects brain gray matter structure, but the magnitude, pattern, and reversibility of brain changes upon pain recovery remain unclear because of inconsistent findings from small-scale studies. We analyzed data from 35,052 UK Biobank participants who completed chronic pain assessments at 2 time points, approximately 9 years apart, evaluating pain lasting 3 months or more, across 8 body sites. Brain magnetic resonance imaging data were available from the second time point. Participants were grouped into 4 categories: Pain-free controls, New chronic pain, Persistent chronic pain, and Resolved chronic pain. We examined relationships between these categories and 313 brain-wide measures across cortical surface area, cortical thickness, and subcortical volume. New chronic pain was associated with surface area reductions in sensorimotor, temporo-parietal, and medial and lateral prefrontal cortices. Persistent chronic pain showed larger and more widespread area reductions and mixed changes in cortical thickness and subcortical volumes, including cerebellar atrophy and hypertrophy in the thalamus and basal ganglia. Resolved pain demonstrated reversibility of most brain changes, except sustained surface area reductions in the primary somatosensory cortex. No areas showed effects consistent with a predisposition to pain. Brain structural changes in chronic pain reflect adaptive neuroplasticity rather than irreversible damage or preexisting vulnerability. Most changes appear reversible with pain resolution, underscoring the importance of effective pain treatment to alleviate symptoms and support recovery of brain structure and function.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于大型人群的脑磁共振数据，考察慢性疼痛不同转归轨迹与全脑灰质结构的关系，比较无痛、新发、持续和已缓解四类人群的皮层表面积、皮层厚度及皮层下体积。结果显示，新发慢性疼痛伴随感觉运动、颞顶及前额皮层表面积减小；持续疼痛者改变范围更广，并出现皮层厚度和皮层下体积的混合变化；疼痛缓解后多数改变可逆，仅初级躯体感觉皮层的表面积减小持续存在。作者据此认为，慢性疼痛的脑结构变化更符合适应性神经可塑性，而非不可逆损伤或疼痛易感性，且多数变化随疼痛缓解而恢复，提示有效镇痛治疗对脑结构恢复的意义。

papers.title: EEG-based mental workload recognition during multi-tasking scenarios: the role of resting-state normalization and brain region of EEG features.
papers.authors: Ji Y, Liang Z, Huang J, Tao D.
papers.abstract: EEG-based mental workload (MWL) recognition is challenged by inter-individual variability and limited model interpretability. This study investigated MWL recognition in long-term multi-tasking scenarios using resting-state EEG normalisation and regional feature analysis. Participants performed multi-tasking operations at three difficulty levels, while resting-state and task-state EEG, behavioural performance, and NASA-TLX ratings were collected. The best whole-brain model achieved 93.78% ± 0.45% accuracy under standard normalisation, while the parietal configuration retained substantial recognition capability with fewer electrodes. Resting-state normalisation changed EEG feature-importance patterns, but its effects on classification were classifier-dependent rather than uniformly beneficial. SHAP analysis identified prominent frontal and parietal contributions. The findings support interpretable and lightweight EEG-based MWL monitoring in complex operational environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电识别心理负荷时个体差异大、模型可解释性有限的问题，在长时间多任务操作场景中考察了静息态归一化和脑区特征分析的作用。被试在多任务条件下完成三个难度水平的操作，同时采集静息态与任务态脑电、行为表现和主观负荷评分。全脑模型在标准归一化下取得较高识别准确率，顶区配置用更少电极仍保留较强识别能力；静息态归一化会改变特征重要性模式，但其分类效果因分类器而异，并非普遍有益。SHAP分析显示额区和顶区贡献突出，作者据此认为结果支持在复杂操作环境中开展可解释、轻量的脑电心理负荷监测。

papers.title: Machine learning-based source-level EEG functional network biomarkers of antidepressant treatment response in major depressive disorder.
papers.authors: Song YW, Lee HA, Kim S, Kim JS.
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is highly prevalent, yet antidepressant selection remains largely trial and error because of limited predictive biomarkers. Resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) combined with graph theory-based functional networks offers a noninvasive approach to probing brain dysconnectivity. This study aimed to delineate source-level functional network differences between antidepressant responders and non-responders, and to evaluate whether machine learning models using nodal network features can discriminate treatment outcome. Resting-state EEG was recorded at baseline from 47 patients with MDD and 41 healthy controls (HCs). After 12 weeks, patients were classified as responders (n = 20) or non-responders (n = 27) based on a ≥ 50% reduction in Hamilton Depression Rating Scale scores. Source-level networks were assessed using path length (PL), strength, clustering coefficient (CC), and eigenvector centrality (EC). Machine learning with nested cross-validation classified responders and non-responders using nodal features. At the global level, non-responders showed lower strength and CC and higher PL in the high beta band than responders. Responders showed higher theta-band CC than HCs. A support vector machine achieved 82.98% accuracy (95% CI, 72.34%-93.62%; p < 0.001), 85.19% sensitivity (95% CI, 70.37%-96.30%; p < 0.001), and 80.00% specificity (95% CI, 60.00%-95.00%; p < 0.001). In responders, theta-band EC in the precuneus and pars orbitalis correlated significantly with psychological assessment scores. Source-level functional network analysis combined with machine learning may identify pretreatment EEG features associated with subsequent antidepressant response.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在刻画重性抑郁障碍患者中抗抑郁药应答者与不应答者在源水平脑功能网络上的差异，并检验基于节点网络特征的机器学习模型能否区分治疗结局。研究采集患者基线静息态脑电，结合图论指标构建功能网络，并用嵌套交叉验证的分类模型进行判别。结果显示，不应答者在高β频段表现为全局网络强度与聚类系数较低、路径长度较高；基于节点特征的模型对应答与不应答具有较好的区分表现。作者认为，源水平功能网络分析结合机器学习或有助于识别与后续抗抑郁治疗反应相关的治疗前脑电特征，但样本量有限，结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Electroconvulsive therapy shifting brain dynamics toward more adaptive and integrated states in treatment-resistant depression based on a hidden markov model.
papers.authors: Li T, Zhang L, Han Y, Guo Z, Yao P, Chen L, Yuan Y, Zhao J, Ou Y, Lv D, Guo W.
papers.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the American Society for Experimental NeuroTherapeutics
papers.abstract: Treatment-resistant depression (TRD) is characterized by persistent symptoms and poor response to conventional therapies, yet its dynamic neural mechanisms and treatment-related changes remain incompletely understood. This study applied a hidden Markov model (HMM) combined with neurotransmitter atlas mapping to investigate whole-brain spatiotemporal dynamics in TRD and their modulation by electroconvulsive therapy (ECT). Resting-state fMRI data were collected from 72 TRD patients (52 completing follow-up) and 63 healthy controls. HMM identified six recurring brain states defined by distinct patterns of functional connectivity and averaged functional activity. At baseline, TRD patients showed reduced occupancy and stability of globally coordinated states and increased engagement of subcortical-dominant states, indicating impaired global stability and disrupted cortical-subcortical balance. After ECT, clinical symptoms improved significantly, accompanied by increased occupancy of states characterized by higher activity within the default mode and frontoparietal networks, as well as a highly integrated whole-brain state. These changes suggest improved overall brain coordination and cortical engagement rather than full normalization of baseline abnormalities. In contrast, subcortical-dominant states persisted after treatment, consistent with trait-like features of TRD. Neurotransmitter mapping showed that treatment-responsive states were associated with serotonergic, dopaminergic, and glutamatergic systems, whereas persistent subcortical states were linked to noradrenergic and cholinergic markers. Overall, these findings suggest that ECT improves symptoms by shifting brain dynamics toward more adaptive and integrated states, rather than fully restoring baseline function. This dynamic perspective provides new insight into the neural mechanisms of TRD and its treatment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注难治性抑郁症患者全脑时空动态及其受电休克治疗调节的机制，采用隐马尔可夫模型结合神经递质图谱映射，分析患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振数据。基线时患者整体协调状态的出现比例和稳定性下降，皮层下主导状态参与增多，提示全局稳定性受损及皮层—皮层下平衡紊乱；治疗后临床症状改善，默认网络和额顶网络活动较高的状态及高度整合的全脑状态出现增多，但皮层下主导状态持续存在。作者据此认为，电休克治疗是推动脑动态向更适应、更整合的状态转变，而非完全恢复正常，并将治疗响应相关状态与血清素、多巴胺和谷氨酸系统联系起来。

papers.title: A systematic review of the maturation of selected cortical auditory event-related potentials in passive paradigms: Developmental changes from infancy to early adulthood.
papers.authors: Martin I, Arora J, Hamill L, Cho E, Scanavini G, Radanovic A, Shaukat L, Hill NJ, Shah SA, Alkhoury L.
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers a unique window into the neural dynamics of cognition, particularly through event-related potentials (ERPs) that index sensory, attentional, and cognitive processes. EEG and ERP measures are widely used to study atypical neurodevelopment in children due to their sensitivity to disruptions caused by genetic and acquired brain disorders. We conducted a systematic review of the literature on the typical presentation of four core cortical auditory and language-related ERP components, extracted during passive paradigms, from infancy to early adulthood. These components reflect neural responses to the passive perception of discrete stimuli (N100), the automatic detection of deviant stimuli (Mismatch Negativity (MMN), sometimes in children referred to as the Mismatch Response (MMR)), the allocation of attention to deviant stimuli (P3a), and language processing of discrete stimuli (N400). Drawing from 61 studies, many of which reported on a single component within a specific age range, we chart developmental trajectories of ERP latencies, amplitudes, and scalp topographies. Across all components, latency tended to decrease with increasing age. Amplitude trajectories varied: N100 amplitude tended to decrease; MMN amplitude remained relatively stable or showed a slight decline; P3a amplitude typically increased during early childhood before decreasing in early school age; N400 amplitude consistently declined. Scalp topographical reports, among all components, revealed a shift toward increased focal activation with increasing age. Together, these findings provide a normative foundation for acoustic and auditory language processing in the context of the selected components in typical development, serving as a necessary reference point for understanding and assessing atypical development.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了婴儿期至成年早期被动范式下四种皮层听觉与语言相关ERP成分的典型发育表现，包括N100、失匹配负波（儿童中有时称失匹配反应）、P3a和N400，共纳入61项研究，其中不少仅报告特定年龄段内的单一成分。总体来看，各成分的潜伏期随年龄增长趋于缩短；波幅变化则因成分而异：N100波幅倾向下降，失匹配负波波幅相对稳定或略有降低，P3a波幅在幼儿期通常上升、学龄早期后下降，N400波幅持续降低。头皮地形报告还显示，随年龄增长激活趋于更加集中。作者据此勾勒出各成分的发育轨迹，为典型发育中的声学与听觉语言加工提供常模基础，并作为理解和评估非典型发育的参照。

papers.title: Altered neural prioritization of auditory information during cross-modal attention in children with ADHD.
papers.authors: Yang L, Wang Y, Yin W, Xu X, Yuan X, Yang H, Zhang S, Jiang S, Guo Y, Wang Y, Yang C, Zhou Y, Li D, Song Y, Dang CP.
papers.abstract: Efficient auditory attention requires prioritizing target over nontarget information. Although attention deficits are a core feature of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), the neural mechanisms underlying auditory prioritization during cross-modal attention remain unclear. We examined neural differentiation between target and nontarget auditory information in children with ADHD. Ninety-five school-aged children (mean age = 10.81 years), including 46 children with ADHD and 49 typically developing (TD) children, performed a visually cued auditory spatial attention task during electroencephalography (EEG) recording. Auditory selective attention was assessed using the N2-anterior-contralateral (N2ac) component and multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA). TD children showed enhanced MVPA decoding of target locations and reduced decoding of nontarget locations. Greater target-nontarget neural differentiation was associated with larger N2ac amplitudes. In contrast, children with ADHD showed reduced target lateralization, smaller N2ac amplitudes, weaker target decoding, and enhanced decoding of nontarget locations, resulting in diminished neural differentiation between relevant and irrelevant auditory information. Reduced target-related lateralization was associated with greater response-time variability, whereas reduced target decoding accuracy was linked to more severe hyperactivity-impulsivity symptoms. Together, these findings indicate that children with ADHD show altered neural prioritization of auditory information within a visually cued attention context. Altered neural prioritization was associated with behavioral variability and symptom severity, providing new insights into the neurocognitive mechanisms underlying attentional dysfunction in ADHD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察ADHD儿童在跨通道注意中如何对听觉信息进行神经优先化，用脑电记录视觉线索引导的听觉空间注意任务。典型发育儿童对目标位置神经解码更强、对非目标解码较弱，目标与非目标区分明显；ADHD儿童目标侧化与解码减弱、非目标解码增强，二者神经区分下降。这种优先化异常与反应时变异性增大及多动冲动症状更重相关，提示其可能涉及ADHD注意功能障碍的神经认知机制。

papers.title: 40 Hz transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation enhances verbal free recall in healthy adults by modulating frontal theta oscillations.
papers.authors: Luo Y, Yin S, Chen L, Gao H, Zhao P, Wen H.
papers.abstract: Background Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) is a non-invasive neuromodulation approach that may influence memory-related brain activity. Theta oscillations are closely related to episodic memory processing, but it remains unclear whether taVNS modulates memory-related theta activity in a frequency-specific manner and how these effects change after stimulation. Objective This study investigated the sustained effects of 20 Hz and 40 Hz taVNS on free recall and resting-state EEG theta oscillations in healthy young adults. Methods Forty-four participants were enrolled in this randomized, single-blind, sham-controlled, three-arm parallel-group study. They were randomly assigned to the sham stimulation group, the 20 Hz taVNS group, or the 40 Hz taVNS group. Free recall performance was assessed before and after stimulation, and resting-state EEG was recorded at baseline and multiple time points after stimulation. Results The results showed that participants receiving 40 Hz taVNS exhibited better free recall performance than those receiving sham stimulation or 20 Hz stimulation. 40 Hz taVNS increased the relative power of theta waves, particularly in the frontal region. This enhancement was an immediate increase followed by a gradual decrease over time. Frontal theta activity and stimulation-induced theta changes were positively correlated with free recall performance. Furthermore, exploratory Bayesian mediation analysis supported a theta-dependent model. Conclusion This study suggests that 40 Hz taVNS may promote verbal free recall performance by inducing transient enhancement of frontal theta wave activity, providing preliminary evidence for the modulation of memory-related neural oscillations by frequency-specific taVNS.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康年轻成人中考察不同频率经皮耳迷走神经刺激对词语自由回忆及静息态脑电θ振荡的影响，采用随机、单盲、假刺激对照的三组设计，比较假刺激、20 Hz与40 Hz刺激。结果显示，仅40 Hz组在刺激后表现出优于假刺激组和20 Hz组的自由回忆成绩，并伴随额区θ相对功率的即时升高，随后逐渐回落；额区θ活动及其刺激诱发变化与回忆成绩正相关，探索性贝叶斯中介分析支持θ依赖模型。作者据此提出，40 Hz刺激可能通过短暂增强额区θ振荡促进词语自由回忆，为频率特异性调控记忆相关神经振荡提供了初步证据，但样本与设计仍属初步，尚不能推及临床疗效。

papers.title: Effects of regularization on the stability and behavioral relevance of VAR-based functional connectivity.
papers.authors: Masaoka K, Li R, Kasagi A, Matsui T.
papers.abstract: Vector autoregressive modeling (VAR) is a powerful method for estimating dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. However, VAR-based dFC can become unstable when only limited data are available. We compared multiple regularization approaches (PLS, PCA, Ridge, and Lasso) to examine whether they can stabilize VAR-based dFC without substantially compromising behaviorally relevant information. All regularization methods improved stability. Behavioral measure prediction improved and reached a level comparable to Pearson correlation-based FC, except Lasso. These findings suggest that regularized VAR-based dFC can provide behaviorally relevant information about temporal dynamics not represented in Pearson correlation-based FC.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注向量自回归建模在静息态功能磁共振数据中估计动态功能连接时，因数据有限而出现不稳定的问题，并比较了偏最小二乘、主成分分析、Ridge和Lasso等正则化方法能否在稳定动态连接的同时保留与行为相关的信息。结果显示，各正则化方法均提升了稳定性；除Lasso外，行为指标的预测表现也有所改善，并达到与基于Pearson相关的功能连接相当的水平。作者据此认为，经正则化的VAR动态连接可提供Pearson相关功能连接未能体现的、与行为相关的时间动态信息。

papers.title: Analyzing multisensory integration: Do's and don'ts.
papers.authors: Zhu H, Beierholm U, Shams L.
papers.abstract: Multisensory perception is a cornerstone paradigm for understanding how the brain constructs coherent representations of the world from noisy, fragmented sensory inputs. For decades, researchers have used the magnitude of crossmodal illusions, the width of the temporal binding window, and related behavioral indices as direct proxies for 'integration strength,' and have leveraged these measures to compare multisensory function across developmental, clinical, and aging populations. Here we argue that this descriptive practice is frequently compromised: behavioral readouts of multisensory integration are composite measures jointly shaped by unisensory precision, amodal priors, and the binding process itself, and cannot be interpreted in isolation. Drawing on simulations within a Bayesian Causal Inference framework, we show how identical behavioral patterns can arise from very different underlying causes, leading to systematic misattribution of group differences to 'deficits' or 'enhancements' in integration. We review complementary computational frameworks, including coupling priors, drift diffusion, multisensory correlation detection, and statistical facilitation models, and outline their respective explanatory limits. Finally, we provide a model-based inference pipeline, from experimental design and unisensory baselines to parameter estimation and interpretation, that aims to help disentangles sensory fidelity, prior expectations, and integrative tendency. Adopting this normative approach can facilitate cumulative progress in basic multisensory research and for its translation to neuropsychiatric assessment, lifespan research, and artificial perceptual systems.

papers.title: The neural architecture of social threat: A meta-analytic comparison of indirect and direct social threat.
papers.authors: Bonacina G, Wagels L, Habel U, Wilkin-Krug LCM, O'Leary A, Boccadoro S.
papers.abstract: Indirect and Direct Social Threat (IST and DST) are related but partially distinct forms of interpersonal adversity defined along two dimensions: threat perception, the explicitness and salience of harm, and behavioural reciprocity, the extent of bidirectional contingency and response opportunity. IST involves ambiguous or socially devaluing contexts with limited reciprocity, whereas DST entails overt hostility, clear antagonism, and reciprocal engagement. This distinction shows conceptual parallels with findings from rodent models of social interaction. We tested this framework using a coordinate-based Activation Likelihood Estimation (ALE) meta-analysis of human neuroimaging studies comprising 28 IST contrasts (N = 1081) and 28 DST contrasts (N = 855), with cluster-level family-wise error correction (p<.05). Findings were interpreted alongside passive and agonistic animal paradigms. Conjunction analysis identified shared spatial convergence in the left anterior insula (AI) extending into the inferior frontal gyrus (IFG), consistent with salience-detection and regulatory processes. ALE contrast analysis showed stronger convergence for DST than IST in the right AI, bilateral claustrum, and anterior and mid-cingulate cortices, regions implicated in motivational salience and action preparation; no clusters emerged for IST relative to DST. Predicted IST-specific convergence in the temporoparietal junction and posterior cingulate cortex, and DST-related convergence in the amygdala and ventral striatum, were not observed. This pattern is conceptually consistent with animal evidence associating reciprocal threat with defensive readiness and action selection. Overall, findings partially support the framework: threat perception and behavioural reciprocity may help organize neural responses to social threat, while correspondence with passive-agonistic animal models remains provisional.

papers.title: Frontal lead in preterm functional brain maturation.
papers.authors: Mader J, Hartmann M, Klebermass-Schrehof K, Werther T, Dressler A, Koren J, Kasprian G, Schmidbauer V, Fuiko R, Oberdorfer L, Pointner N, Berger A, Kluge T, Giordano V.
papers.abstract: Understanding how brain maturation unfolds in preterm neonates is critical for both neuroscience and clinical care. Structural MRI suggests that the frontal cortex develop late, yet EEG offers a direct window into functional activity that follows a different trajectory. We analysed 211 EEG recordings from 62 preterm neonates (25-40 weeks postmenstrual age, PMA) using convolutional neural networks trained on single channels to estimate functional brain age (FBA). We introduced the spatial difference in FBA (sd_FBA) metric, which quantifies the relative maturity of each channel compared with all others within a recording. sd_FBA revealed a consistent maturation gradient, frontal regions exhibited the highest sd_FBA, followed by central regions, whereas occipital and temporal regions showed lower values. With increasing PMA, central maturation converged with frontal values, while occipital regions remained significantly lower. Functional maturation in preterm infants follows a clear frontal-occipital gradient, in contrast to structural MRI findings. The sd_FBA metric provides a novel, normalized index for tracking regional maturation, offering a new tool to understand functional brain development and potentially improve neurodevelopmental risk stratification.

papers.title: The macaque IT cortex but not current artificial vision networks encode object position in perceptually aligned coordinates.
papers.authors: Yakubovskaya E, Ramezanpour H, Dunnhofer M, Kar K.
papers.abstract: Efficient interaction with the visual world requires not only object identification but also localization of where objects are in space. While spatial ("where") processing has classically been attributed to dorsal stream pathways, recent work has shown that object position can also be decoded from ventral stream responses, including the inferior temporal (IT) cortex. However, because object position in these paradigms is coupled to pixel-based location, it has remained unclear whether ventral stream position signals are perceptually meaningful or instead reflect incidental inheritance from retinotopic inputs. Here, we address this question by leveraging a visual illusion, the motion aftereffect, to dissociate perceived object position from retinal location while holding visual input constant. Combining intracortical recordings in macaque IT with matched human psychophysics, we show that motion adaptation induces direction-opponent biases in IT population codes for object position that mirror human perceptual reports, despite unchanged pixel-level input. Motion adaptation reshapes IT representational geometry that likely contributes to these perceptual biases. Extending these findings to artificial vision systems, we observe that feedforward, recurrent, and state-of-the-art video-based neural networks fail to exhibit adaptation-induced position shifts, despite accurately encoding object position. Interestingly, imposing empirically derived IT-based transformations on model features is sufficient to simulate the effect, revealing adaptation-driven representational warping as a missing computational ingredient in artificial vision systems. Together, these results identify IT as a candidate locus of perceptually aligned spatial coding, reveal adaptation-driven representational restructuring as a mechanism linking neural dynamics to perception, and expose a principled gap between biological and artificial vision.

papers.title: Obstructive sleep apnea severity associates with reduced phase-lag index functional connectivity during N2 sleep.
papers.authors: Lee H, Lee E.
papers.abstract: Purpose Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is increasingly recognized as a risk factor for cognitive impairment and dementia. We investigated stage- and frequency-specific associations between OSA severity and both conventional spectral measures and phase-lag index (PLI)-based functional connectivity. Methods We retrospectively analyzed polysomnography data from 50 patients (mean age 51.7 ± 14.3 years, 70% male) diagnosed with OSA or primary snoring. Six-channel EEG data were analyzed using conventional spectral power ratios (alpha+beta/theta+delta) and PLI-based functional connectivity across delta, theta, alpha, and beta bands. Pearson correlations assessed associations between apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) and EEG parameters across wakefulness, N2 sleep, and REM sleep. Results Median AHI was 25.7 [IQR: 7.2-48.3]. Conventional spectral measures showed no significant AHI correlations in any sleep stage. PLI analysis revealed stage- and frequency-specific associations: during N2 sleep, AHI negatively correlated with delta-band PLI (r = -0.335, 95% CI -0.588 to -0.021, p = 0.037) and theta-band PLI (r = -0.326, 95% CI -0.582 to -0.012, p = 0.043). No significant associations were observed during wakefulness or REM sleep. Conclusion Functional connectivity analysis identified stage-specific associations with OSA severity that were not observed with conventional spectral measures, suggesting that PLI-based connectivity may provide complementary information on OSA-related neural network alterations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）严重程度是否与不同睡眠阶段和频段的脑电功能连接相关，回顾性分析了50名确诊OSA或单纯打鼾患者的睡眠脑电数据，比较常规频谱指标与基于相位滞后指数的功能连接。结果显示，常规频谱指标在各睡眠阶段均与呼吸暂停低通气指数无显著相关；而在N2睡眠期，OSA严重程度越高，delta和theta频段的相位滞后指数连接越低，清醒期和REM期则未见此类关联。作者据此认为，基于相位滞后指数的功能连接可能提供常规频谱分析未捕捉到的、与OSA相关的神经网络改变信息，但这一关联性发现尚需进一步研究验证。

papers.title: MRI Assessment of the Accessory Anterolateral Talar Facet in Pediatric Patients: Morphometric Features and Associated Subtalar Pathologies.
papers.authors: Yılmaz Ş, Uçan B.
papers.abstract: Objective To assess the frequency and morphometric characteristics of AALTF on pediatric ankle MRI, its associations with the Gissane angle and subtalar abnormalities, and the incremental value of zero-echo-time (ZTE) imaging for detecting tarsal coalitions. Materials and methods We retrospectively reviewed ankle MRI examinations of patients aged 0-18 years performed between September 2022 and January 2026. We randomly selected one ankle from each patient with bilateral examinations. Two pediatric radiologists independently assessed AALTF. For comparative analyses, 129 AALTF-negative controls were selected by simple random sampling from 712 AALTF-negative examinations. We performed age-stratified comparisons and age- and sex-adjusted multivariable regression analysis of the Gissane angle. Results Among 841 patients, 129 (15.3%) had AALTF. Mean facet length was 6.36 ± 2.20 mm, and cartilage coverage was present in 62.0%. The Gissane angle was lower in patients with AALTF than in controls (109.66° ± 6.74° vs. 117.43° ± 8.21°; p < 0.001). This association remained significant after adjustment for age and sex (B = - 8.02; 95% CI, - 9.88 to - 6.16; p < 0.001). ROC analysis yielded an AUC of 0.764 and an optimal cutoff of 112.5° (sensitivity, 68.2%; specificity, 70.5%). Bone marrow edema, subtalar degeneration, tarsal coalition, and joint effusion were more frequent in patients with AALTF. Bone marrow edema and joint effusion remained more frequent in both age strata. Conventional MRI detected all coalitions, and ZTE detected no additional lesions. Interobserver agreement and measurement reliability were excellent. Conclusion AALTF is relatively common on pediatric ankle MRI and is independently associated with a lower Gissane angle and several concomitant abnormalities. A Gissane angle ≤ 112.5° may prompt closer evaluation for AALTF.

papers.title: A cortical-hippocampal communication undergoes rebalancing after new learning.
papers.authors: Hall AF, Wang DV.
papers.abstract: The brain's ability to consolidate a wide range of memories while maintaining their distinctiveness across experiences remains poorly understood. Sharp-wave ripples, neural oscillations that occur predominantly within CA1 of the hippocampus during immobility and sleep, have been shown to play a critical role in the consolidation process. More recently, evidence has uncovered functional heterogeneity of pyramidal neurons within distinct sublayers of CA1 that display unique properties during ripples, potentially contributing to memory specificity. Despite this, it remains unclear exactly how ripples shift the activity of CA1 neuronal populations to accommodate the consolidation of specific memories and how sublayer differences manifest. Here, we studied interactions between the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and CA1 neurons during ripples and discovered a reorganization of their communication following learning. Specifically, using a generalized linear model decoder, we demonstrated the pre-existence of ACC-to-CA1 communication, which is weakened during post-training sleep following learning, suggesting that ACC activity reallocates the contribution of CA1 neurons during memory formation. Interestingly, the reorganization appeared unique for a subset of CA1 superficial (CA1sup) neurons that were task inactive, whereas communication between the ACC and CA1deep neurons remained largely stable across pre- and post-training sleep. Consistent with this sublayer-selective reorganization, we found that optogenetic stimulations of the ACC preferentially suppressed CA1sup neurons while activating a unique subset of CA1 interneurons. Overall, these findings highlight an important role of the ACC in rebalancing CA1 neuronal populations' contribution in learning and memory consolidation.

papers.title: [A white matter hyperintensity segmentation model combining 2.5-dimensional spatial context and frequency-domain prior information].
papers.authors: Bai P, Wang Y, Liu Q, Chen X, Ren Y.
papers.journal: Sheng wu yi xue gong cheng xue za zhi = Journal of biomedical engineering = Shengwu yixue gongchengxue zazhi
papers.abstract: Imaging studies indicate that white matter hyperintensities (WMHs) are closely associated with various cerebrovascular and neurodegenerative diseases, and their accurate segmentation is of great significance for the clinical diagnosis and treatment of related brain diseases. However, affected by factors such as insufficient inter-slice resolution caused by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) voxel anisotropy, blurred boundaries of tiny lesions, and multi-center data heterogeneity, the performance of existing methods still needs to be improved.
