Results The analysis of 15,788 documents shows that the global volume of articles is on a continuous growth trend, mainly dominated by China and the United States. Keyword co-occurrence analysis shows that "magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)" is the most core topic. The analysis of keyword burst and co-citation reveals a major paradigm shift: this field is gradually moving away from open surgery (such as laminoplasty) and traditional measurement, turning to minimally invasive neurodecompression and artificial intelligence, and paying more attention to specific pathologies such as patient-reported outcomes (PROs) and degenerative cervical myelopathy (DCM). Conclusion This bibliometric study reveals that minimally invasive neural decompression, intelligence and precision methods are the primary research hotspots of recent progress. This field is changing from traditional surgery to a new paradigm combining endoscopic surgery, artificial intelligence decision-making and personalized elderly neuroprotection. However, readers must differentiate that these represent current academic research hotspots rather than definitively proven clinical evidence. Future research should integrate artificial intelligence, new robots, endoscopic technology and translation.

papers.title: The application progress of artificial intelligence in the diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease.
papers.authors: Liu E, Cheng M, Ju Y, Ru Y, Liu Y, Min D.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder, where traditional diagnostic methods are constrained by limited sensitivity and restricted clinical utility. This review synthesizes recent applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in AD diagnostics, focusing on machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) across neuroimaging modalities and multi-omics research. AI algorithms can automatically extract subtle microstructural, metabolic, and molecular features, enabling high-precision classification of AD stages, patient stratification, and non-invasive early screening through multimodal data integration. However, translating AI into routine clinical practice still faces critical challenges, including high equipment costs, insufficient model generalizability across real-world cohorts, data class imbalance, and complex cross-platform standardization barriers. Future research should prioritize cost-effective surrogate modeling, robust multi-center validation, dynamic longitudinal integration, and mechanistic interpretability to accelerate the standardized clinical translation of AI-driven AD diagnostics.

papers.title: Dynamic reconfiguration of directed effective connectivity between attention networks and the default mode network in knee osteoarthritis: a combined resting-state and non-noxious thermal stimulation functional magnetic resonance imaging study.
papers.authors: Luo W, Zhou J, Cheng S, Dong X, Chen Y, Tang C, He W, Wang Z, Zeng F, Li Z, Liang F.
papers.abstract: Background Chronic pain is understood as a disturbance of large-scale brain-network organization involving systems that coordinate internally and externally oriented processing. In knee osteoarthritis (KOA), altered connectivity involving attention networks and the default mode network (DMN) has been reported, but directed organization and reconfiguration during non-noxious somatosensory input remain unclear. Methods In this cross-sectional neuroimaging study, 148 patients with KOA and 36 healthy controls (HCs) underwent resting-state fMRI followed by non-noxious knee thermal-stimulation fMRI. Directed effective connectivity (EC) was estimated separately for the resting-state and thermal-stimulation runs using regression dynamic causal modeling and summarized within the Yeo 7-network framework. Between-group analyses assessed directed network organization at rest and stimulation-related reconfiguration, defined as thermal-stimulation minus resting-state connectivity (ΔEC = ECthermal - ECrest). Network in-degree, out-degree, and exploratory clinical associations were examined. Results Compared with HC, KOA patients exhibited reduced directed inputs to the dorsal attention network (DAN) from multiple networks and increased directed drive toward the DMN at rest. During thermal stimulation, KOA patients showed greater increases in directed connectivity toward the DAN but attenuated DAN→DMN connectivity changes. Core edge-level effects were robust in sensitivity analyses. Degree analyses supported altered input-output profiles of the DAN and DMN. Exploratory associations with pain severity and functional impairment did not survive false-discovery-rate correction. Conclusions KOA was characterized by altered directed interactions between attention networks and the DMN at rest, together with atypical reconfiguration from rest to non-noxious somatosensory stimulation. These findings are consistent with altered coordination between externally oriented attention and internally oriented processing.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面神经影像研究考察膝骨关节炎患者注意网络与默认模式网络之间的有向有效连接，以及非伤害性热刺激下这种连接如何重配置；患者与健康对照均接受静息态和膝关节热刺激fMRI，并用回归动态因果模型估计有效连接。结果显示，患者静息时多个网络对背侧注意网络的有向输入减少、对默认模式网络的驱动增强；热刺激时，指向背侧注意网络的连接增幅更大，而背侧注意网络到默认模式网络的连接变化减弱。作者据此认为，患者在外向注意与内向加工之间的协调存在异常，但探索性临床关联未通过多重比较校正，结论不宜作临床推断。

papers.title: Large-Scale and Local Functional Connectivity Changes following Psilocybin Administration in Methamphetamine Use Disorder.
papers.authors: Chaganti J, Siefried KJ, Vyakaranam VS, Acheson L, Brett J.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Methamphetamine (MA) use disorder is associated with widespread disruption of large-scale brain networks involved in cognitive control, attention, and salience processing. Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) provides a means to characterize these alterations; however, little is known about the capacity for functional network reorganization following targeted intervention. The purpose of this study was to evaluate changes in large-scale and local functional connectivity following psilocybin administration in individuals with MA use disorder. Materials and methods In this exploratory prospective longitudinal study, participants with MA use disorder underwent rs-fMRI before and after psilocybin administration alongside psychotherapy. Large-scale functional connectivity was assessed across canonical resting-state networks, including the default mode, salience, dorsal attention, and executive control networks. Local connectivity was evaluated using regional homogeneity (ReHo). Connectivity changes were examined in relation to clinical measures of MA use, craving, and psychological distress. Results Following intervention, reorganization of functional connectivity was observed within and between attentional, default mode, and salience networks. Improvements in network integration were accompanied by complementary shifts in local neural synchrony, with postintervention increases in ReHo observed within frontal and sensorimotor regions. Greater MA reductions in use were associated with recovery of frontostriatal and attentional connectivity, whereas reductions in psychological distress correlated with strengthened integration of attentional and prefrontal-striatal circuits. Conclusions Psilocybin administration was associated with measurable reorganization of both large-scale network connectivity and local functional coherence in individuals with MA use disorder. These findings provide preliminary evidence for the distributed nature of brain network dysfunction in stimulant addiction and support the potential utility of multimodal rs-fMRI metrics as imaging biomarkers of network-level plasticity.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性纵向研究考察甲基苯丙胺使用障碍者在裸盖菇素给药并配合心理治疗后，大尺度与局部功能连接的变化。参与者接受静息态fMRI前后测，分析默认模式、突显、背侧注意和执行控制等网络间连接，并用局部一致性指标评估局部神经同步。结果显示，干预后注意、默认模式和突显网络内部及网络间出现连接重组，额叶和感觉运动区的局部一致性升高；甲基苯丙胺使用减少较多者伴随额纹状体与注意连接的恢复，心理痛苦减轻则与注意及前额-纹状体环路整合增强相关。作者据此认为，裸盖菇素给药与可测量的大尺度网络和局部功能一致性重组相关，为刺激物成瘾的分布式网络功能障碍提供了初步证据，并提示多模态静息态指标可能作为网络层面可塑性的影像标志物，但研究为探索性设计，相关发现尚不能说明因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: NeuroAIHub: An AI-Driven Framework for Automated Curation and Discovery of Neuroradiology Data Sets.
papers.authors: Gheiji B, Moradi S, Vatanparast M, Shokrani S, Bagherzadeh MA, Elyassirad D, Akinmuleya OI, Goodarzi S, Heidari-Foroozan M, Moassefi M, Rudie JD, Calabrese E, Jain R, Faghani S.
papers.abstract: Neuroradiology data sets have significant potential for advancing neuroimaging research, yet identifying relevant and up-to-date resources remains challenging. NeuroAIHub is an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven framework designed to automate data set discovery, improve accessibility, and support structured exploration of neuroradiology data sets. A foundational database was constructed through a multireviewer extraction process with standardized metadata harmonization. To maintain and expand the registry, an AI-based updating workflow performs monthly Web searches, extracts structured metadata from heterogeneous sources using large language models, and submits candidate entries for developer validation before integration. A large language model-powered conversational agent enables natural language data set retrieval, analytical queries, and visualizations, while a structured Web interface supports reproducible filtering. NeuroAIHub currently hosts 180 data sets across 6 diagnostic domains and is available as a Web application (https://neuroai.streamlit.app/) and an open-source Python package (https://github.com/NeuroAIHub-Registry/NeuroAIHub; https://pypi.org/project/neuroaihub). The platform provides a continuously curated resource designed to improve reproducibility, transparency, and efficiency in neuroradiology data set discovery.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对神经放射学数据集分散、难以查找和更新的问题，开发了名为NeuroAIHub的人工智能驱动框架，用于自动发现、整理和结构化探索相关数据集。该框架先通过多审阅者提取和标准化元数据建立基础数据库，再利用大语言模型每月检索网络、抽取异构来源的元数据，经开发者验证后纳入登记库，并提供对话式检索和可视化界面。目前平台收录了覆盖多个诊断领域的数据集，以网页应用和开源Python包形式开放，旨在提升数据集发现的可重复性、透明度和效率。

papers.title: Susceptibility-Weighted Imaging in Patients with Corticobasal Syndrome or Progressive Supranuclear Palsy: Distribution of Iron Deposits Reflects Clinical Symptoms in 4-Repeat Tauopathies.
papers.authors: Migaleddu G, Del Prete E, Donatelli G, Frosini D, Ceravolo R, Cosottini M.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Patients with corticobasal syndrome (CBS) and progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) often show the loss of the swallow tail sign, which reflects degeneration of dopaminergic neurons and iron accumulation in the substantia nigra pars compacta, and peculiar neuroradiologic signs that are, respectively, asymmetrical frontoparietal atrophy and midbrain atrophy. A T2* hypointense rim likely reflecting presence and distribution of neuroinflammation has been recently reported in the frontal cortex of patients with CBS. Here we investigated: 1) the frequency of conventional radiologic signs associated with CBS and PSP and 2) presence, distribution, and frequency of the T2* signal hypointensity in the frontal cortex in patients with CBS and PSP. In addition, we explored possible associations between T2* hypointensity in the frontal cortex and clinical symptoms. Materials and methods Sixty-two patients were retrospectively included in the study (14 CBS and 48 PSP). Two neuroradiologists inspected the 3T MR data sets and recorded the presence/absence of: asymmetric frontoparietal atrophy, midbrain atrophy, loss of the swallow tail sign, and T2* hypointensity of the frontal cortex. Results Asymmetrical frontoparietal atrophy and T2* hypointensity in the frontal cortex were more frequent in patients with CBS (P < .001), whereas midbrain atrophy and the loss of the swallow tail sign were more frequent in patients with PSP (P < .001). The T2* signal hypointensity in the frontal cortex was detected in 14 patients with CBS (100%) and 5 patients with PSP (10%) and had 3 possible patterns of distribution associated with specific symptoms: 1) involvement of the hand knob only (3 patients with CBS and none with PSP) in patients with unilateral ideomotor apraxia; 2) involvement of the primary motor cortex that extended beyond the hand knob (2 patients with CBS and 5 with PSP; both patients with CBS had bilateral ideomotor apraxia); and 3) involvement of the primary motor cortex, the superior frontal gyrus, and/or the middle frontal gyrus (9 patients with CBS and none with PSP); all but 1 of these patients had ideomotor limb apraxia and all had speech/language impairment. Conclusions The T2* signal hypointensity in the frontal cortex may be an additional radiologic sign to be assessed in patients with atypical parkinsonism. Its distribution across the frontal gyri likely reflects clinical symptoms. The pathologic assessment of CBS cases would support the robustness of these results.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究回顾性分析了皮质基底节综合征（CBS）与进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）患者的3T磁共振影像，由两名神经放射科医生评估常规影像征象及额叶皮质T2*低信号的出现与分布，并探索其与临床症状的关联。结果显示，不对称额顶叶萎缩和额叶皮质T2*低信号在CBS患者中更常见，而中脑萎缩和燕尾征消失则在PSP患者中更常见；额叶T2*低信号呈现三种分布模式，分别与单侧观念运动性失用、双侧失用及言语语言障碍等表现相对应。作者认为，额叶皮质T2*低信号或可作为非典型帕金森综合征的补充影像征象，其分布可能反映临床症状，但尚需病理评估加以验证。

papers.title: Radiologic Phenotyping in Patients with SOX10 Pathogenic Variants: Insights into Neck, Brain, and Temporal Bone Abnormalities.
papers.authors: Gentile F, Clement E, Rajput K, Biswas A, Sudhakar S, Nash R, Ugga L, Juliano A, D'Arco F.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose The SOX10 gene is essential for developing neural crest-derived tissues, including the temporal bone, peripheral and central nervous systems, and melanocytes. Pathogenic SOX10 variants are linked to a broad clinical spectrum, including Waardenburg syndrome (WS) in isolation, Kallmann syndrome (KS), as well as an entity characterized by the combination of peripheral demyelinating neuropathy, central dysmyelinating leukodystrophy, Waardenburg syndrome, and Hirschsprung disease (PCWH). This study aims to characterize the full spectrum of abnormalities in the brain, temporal bone, and neck regions, and their syndromic associations. Materials and methods Fifteen pediatric patients with genetically confirmed SOX10 germline pathogenic variants were included. All underwent MRI, and 9 also had CT of the temporal bone. Imaging and clinical data were systematically analyzed by 2 pediatric neuroradiologists. Results Phenotypic analysis revealed bilateral temporal bone abnormalities in all patients, mainly characterized by a specific combination of semicircular canal dysplasia/hypoplasia (with high prevalence of severely hypoplastic or absent posterior semicircular canal) and a very reproducible form of cochlear hypoplasia called flattened cochlea. Olfactory bulb agenesis or hypoplasia was identified in all but 2 patients. Other abnormalities include white matter changes suggestive of a hypomyelination pattern or deficient myelination in 4 patients and neck findings typically characterized by parotid gland aplasia/hypoplasia (15/15, 100%) or lacrimal gland aplasia/hypoplasia (13/15, 86%). Clinical phenotypes ranged from sensorineural hearing loss to WS type II or IV and PCWH. Conclusions These results confirm the strong correlation between pathogenic SOX10 variants and characteristic temporal bone malformations, which, in association with other radiologic abnormalities, represent highly specific diagnostic markers. The constellation of findings reflects the shared neural crest origin of the affected tissues and should always be investigated to support appropriate genetic testing. Early identification of these features via MRI can aid diagnosis, especially in children without classic syndromic signs, and support the patients' management.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在刻画SOX10致病性变异患者脑、颞骨和颈部异常的全谱及其与综合征类型的关联，由两名儿科神经放射科医生系统分析患儿的MRI及部分颞骨CT与临床资料。结果发现所有患者均存在双侧颞骨异常，主要表现为半规管发育不良（以后半规管严重发育不良或缺失多见）与一种形态高度一致的“扁平耳蜗”式耳蜗发育不良的组合；多数患者还有嗅球发育不全或缺失，部分出现提示髓鞘化不足的白质改变，腮腺和泪腺发育不良也较常见。作者认为这些影像特征与SOX10变异高度相关，反映受累组织共同的神经嵴起源，可作为支持基因检测和辅助诊断的特异性标志，尤其有助于缺乏典型综合征表现的儿童。

papers.title: Improved Reliability of Resting-State fMRI Connectivity Using Multi-Echo Acquisition: Implications for Personalized Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Targeting.
papers.authors: Hassanzadeh E, Tariq R, Palm S, Chiulli N, Lawson D, Khosravani S, Barbour T, Kong R, Yeo BTT, Fox MD, Siddiqi SH.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Multi-echo (ME) fMRI acquisition improves the separation of signal from noise relative to single-echo (SE). We tested whether this enhances the reliability of functional connectivity (FC), with a focus on personalizing transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) targets in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) in patients with depression. Materials and methods Resting-state fMRI scans were acquired from adult patients with major depression (20 women, 15 men) presenting for clinical TMS using either SE (n =21) or ME (n =31). Each subject's fMRI time-series was split in half, and voxelwise seed-based FC was computed for 100 general ROIs and for 2 TMS-specific ROIs: subgenual cingulate cortex (SGC) and a previously published depression circuit (DEP). Reliability was assessed using 1) spatial correlation between split-half connectivity maps and 2) intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) for each ROI's connectivity to the DLPFC. Results In general ROI analysis, ME showed significantly higher whole-brain split-half correlations than SE (P = .006) and higher ICC (ΔICC = 0.16; P = .03). In TMS-specific ROI analysis, ME showed higher split-half correlations for both the SGC-DLPFC (P = .04) and DEP-DLPFC (P = .01). TMS-specific ICC values were numerically higher for ME (SGC-DLPFC: 0.47; DEP-DLPFC: 0.75) than for SE (0.02 and 0.40, respectively), although these differences were not statistically significant. Conclusions ME fMRI improves general FC reliability over SE, with suggested advantages for TMS-specific measures. Future work is needed to determine whether these gains meaningfully improve TMS targeting.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在成年抑郁症患者中比较了多回波与单回波静息态fMRI采集对功能连接可靠性的影响，重点关注个体化经颅磁刺激靶点定位。结果显示，多回波采集在全脑通用感兴趣区的分半相关和组内相关系数上均优于单回波，在与背外侧前额叶相关的抑郁回路靶区上也表现出更高的分半相关；靶区组内相关系数数值上更高，但差异未达统计显著。作者据此认为多回波采集可提升一般功能连接可靠性，对TMS相关测量可能有优势，但这些改善能否真正优化TMS靶点定位尚需进一步研究。

papers.title: Microcephaly with Simplified Gyral Pattern in Children: Quantitative Morphometric Assessment on Brain MRI and Correlation with Clinical Outcome.
papers.authors: Chambers S, Esmeraldo MA, Kravutske Y, Haider L, Kasprian G, Geraldo AF, Soares BP.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Microcephaly with simplified gyral pattern (SGP) represents an often subtle subtype of malformation of cortical development that is commonly accompanied by epilepsy and neurodevelopmental delay. However, whether gyral simplification scales to reduced brain volume and whether MRI features predict clinical outcome still remain unclear. The aims of this study are therefore to apply a quantitative morphometric approach to distinguish a simplified gyral pattern from microcephaly-related effects and to correlate quantitative MRI-derived features with clinical outcome. Materials and methods From a single-center cohort of 34 patients with microcephaly and visually confirmed SGP (shallow sulci, normal cortical thickness), 18 subjects (mean age 7.1 ± 6.5 years) who fulfilled the eligibility criteria were retrospectively included for final analysis. Twenty-six age- and sex-matched healthy controls were included. GM/WM volumes (GMVs/WMVs) and surface-based measures were derived using FreeSurfer. Scaling corrections based on log-log robust regression and cortical folding analyses were subsequently analyzed. Principal component analyses clustered along morphometric phenotypes. ANCOVA, Kendall τ correlations, and logistic regression were applied to evaluate group differences and clinical outcome predictors. Results Compared with healthy controls, patients showed significantly reduced WMV, cortical surface area, local gyrification index (LGI) (all Q < 0.003), and mildly increased cortical thickness. Allometric modeling indicated that, although WMV and LGI scaled proportionally to total brain volume, cortical surface area was disproportionately reduced, suggesting deviation beyond microcephalic scaling. Spectral folding analysis showed loss of specifically macroscale (primary) folding power. Morphometric clustering separated 4 subtypes differing in cortical thickness and area, of which the cluster with the lowest surface area and LGI exhibited universal developmental delay and included both early deaths. Across the cohort, neurodevelopmental delay correlated negatively with surface area. Logistic regression suggested lower surface area, WMV, and LGI as predictors of adverse clinical outcome (Q < 0.02). Conclusions The presence of SGP may reflect additional disturbance of primary sulcation and tangential cortical expansion beyond scaling to microcephaly alone. Our results suggest reduced cortical surface area as a key morphometric marker and a strong MRI feature predictive of neurodevelopmental delay, underscoring the clinical value of quantitative morphometry for stratifying disease severity in microcephaly with an SGP.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对伴简化脑回模式的小头畸形患儿，用脑MRI定量形态学方法区分简化脑回本身与小头畸形导致的整体缩放效应，并分析影像特征与临床结局的关系。结果显示，患儿白质体积、皮层表面积和局部脑回化指数均降低，皮层厚度轻度增加；其中皮层表面积的减小超出小头畸形比例缩放所能解释的范围，并伴有宏观尺度折叠成分的丢失。形态学聚类可分出不同亚型，皮层表面积和局部脑回化指数最低的亚型均出现发育迟缓；表面积越小，神经发育迟缓越重，低表面积、低白质体积和低局部脑回化指数与不良临床结局相关。作者据此认为，简化脑回模式可能反映原发沟回形成和皮层切向扩张的额外异常，定量形态学有助于评估病情严重程度。

papers.title: An Infant Brain MR Image Segmentation Method with Attention Mechanism, Multi-Resolution Deep Supervision and Class Weight Tuning Strategy.
papers.authors: Akbarzadeh Lari MR, Danyali H, Kazemi K.
papers.abstract: Background Infant brain tissue segmentation is critical for understanding early brain development and detecting neurodevelopmental abnormalities. However, accurate segmentation remains challenging due to partial-volume effects, imaging noise, and low contrast between tissues in isointense regions. Objective This study aimed to automatically segment infant brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) images into white matter, gray matter, and cerebrospinal fluid. Material and methods In this analytical study, we addressed the challenges of infant brain tissue segmentation. We proposed a deep, lightweight dense backbone architecture incorporating transition blocks. The backbone was enhanced with a spatial-channel attention mechanism to capture global dependencies and emphasize task-relevant features, as well as multi-resolution deep supervision to mitigate vanishing gradients and reduce overfitting. Moreover, we used class weighting strategy to deal with class imbalance and low contrast between brain tissues. Results Our method attains Dice similarity scores of 91.80%, 92.07% and 94.58% for white matter, gray matter, and cerebrospinal fluid, respectively. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations show that the proposed approach accurately segments infant brain MR images and reduces errors in isointense regions. Conclusion The results demonstrate that the proposed method precisely delineates infant brain tissues and effectively overcomes common segmentation challenges.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对婴儿脑部磁共振图像中因部分容积效应、成像噪声以及等强度区组织对比度低而导致的组织分割困难，提出了一种自动分割白质、灰质和脑脊液的深度学习方法。方法上采用轻量级密集骨干网络并结合空间-通道注意力机制、多分辨率深度监督和类别加权策略，以捕捉全局依赖、缓解梯度消失与过拟合，并应对类别不平衡和低对比度问题。定量与定性评估显示，该方法对三类组织均取得较高的分割精度，并能减少等强度区域的错误，表明其可较准确地勾画婴儿脑组织并应对常见分割挑战；不过摘要未报告与现有方法的对比结果，其相对优势仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Dynamic Semantic–Prosodic Integration in Emotional Speech Perception: From Channel Dominance to Precision-Weighted Predictive Coding
papers.authors: Lin Y, Zhang Y.
papers.abstract: Emotional speech is an important carrier of affective information in spoken communication. Its perception depends on the joint processing of emotional semantics and prosody, yet the relative contribution of these two information sources varies across individuals and contexts. However, a unified account is still lacking of why their processing weights change and how the brain dynamically adjusts them according to the reliability of incoming information. This review synthesizes evidence on emotional semantics and prosody, from relatively independent processing to interactive integration, and argues that their relationship is best understood in terms of dynamic weight allocation. On this basis, we propose a Precision-Weighted Predictive Coding Model (PW-PC), which integrates Bayesian inference, cue precision, and prediction error within a unified framework. The model assumes that semantic and prosodic information are continuously reweighted according to current evidence and its estimated precision, while incorporating sensory reliability, experience-based expectations, contextual diagnosticity, and reweighting flexibility. This framework shifts the focus of emotional speech research from identifying which channel dominates to explaining when, why, and how the brain dynamically reallocates weight across multiple affective information sources, thereby providing a unified theoretical perspective linking behavioral performance, neural dynamics, and computational mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了情绪言语知觉中情绪语义与韵律从相对独立加工走向交互整合的证据，认为二者关系更适合用动态权重分配来理解，而非固定由某一通道主导。作者据此提出精度加权预测编码模型，将贝叶斯推断、线索精度与预测误差纳入统一框架，假设语义和韵律信息会依据当前证据及其估计精度被持续重新加权，并受感觉可靠性、经验预期、情境诊断性和重加权灵活性的约束。文章由此把研究重点从判断哪一通道占优转向解释大脑何时、为何以及如何动态调整多类情绪信息的权重，为连接行为表现、神经动态与计算机制提供了统一的理论视角。

papers.title: Modality-Independent Core Brain Network for Language as Proved by Sign Language
papers.authors: Trettenbrein PC, Meister N, Slivac K, Finkbeiner TA, Steinbach M, Friederici AD, Zaccarella E.
papers.abstract: The human brain has the capacity to automatically compute the grammatical relations ofwords in sentences, be they spoken or written. This species-specific ability for syntax lies atthe core of our capacity for language and is primarily subserved by a left-hemispheric fronto-temporal network consisting of the posterior inferior frontal gyrus (pIFG), as well as theposterior middle temporal gyrus and superior temporal sulcus (pMTG/STS). To date, itremains unclear whether this core network for syntactic processing identified for spoken andwritten language in hearing people also holds for the processing of the grammatical structureof a natural sign language in deaf people. Using functional magnetic resonance imaging, asign language paradigm that systematically varied the presence of syntactic and lexical-semantic information, and meta-analytically defined functional regions-of-interests derivedfrom a large dataset of syntactic processing in hearing non-signers, we demonstrate that deafnative signers of German Sign Language (DGS) also recruit left pIFG and pMTG/STS forcomputing grammatical relations in sign language—indicating the universality of the corelanguage network. These findings suggest that the human brain evolved a dedicated neuralnetwork for processing the grammatical structure of natural languages independent oflanguage modality, which flexibly interacts with different externalization systems dependingon the modality of language use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注听觉人群口语和书面语中已识别的左半球额颞句法核心网络，是否同样适用于聋人加工自然手语的语法结构。研究者用功能磁共振成像，结合系统变化句法与词汇语义信息的手语范式，并采用基于听觉非手语者句法加工数据定义的感兴趣区，考察以德国手语为母语的聋人。结果显示，这些聋人手语者也招募左侧后部额下回和后部颞中回/颞上沟来计算手语中的语法关系，提示核心语言网络具有跨语言通道的普遍性。作者据此认为，人脑演化出了独立于语言通道、专门加工自然语言语法结构的神经网络，该网络会依语言使用通道与不同外化系统灵活互动。

papers.title: Functional Neuroanatomy of Sign Language Production: An ALE Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Wiernik L, Friederici AD, Emmorey K, Trettenbrein PC.
papers.abstract: Sign languages are natural languages expressed by a distinct set of linguistic articulators: the hands, face, and body. Several neuroimaging studies of the neural substrates underlying sign production have observed the recruitment of brain regions previously identified as being involved in speech production, despite the difference in production channels. However, no prior work has provided a statistical synthesis of this available literature. Here, we report a pre-registered meta-analysis of the published positron emission tomography (PET) and functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) literature on sign language production (N experiments = 15, N participants = 168). Combining an Activation Likelihood Estimation (ALE) approach with jackknife re-sampling to validate the robustness of our findings, we identify four clusters consistently associated with the production of single signs across studies in the literature located in (1) left inferior frontal gyrus including BA 45 and extending into (2) left anterior insula, (3) the left superior frontal gyrus, and (4) the medial and right cerebellum. Meta-analytic connectivity modelling using data from a large-scale database of neuroimaging studies confirmed that the IFG, insula, and SFG clusters observed for sign language production are also recruited for spoken language production and comprehension. Moreover, our results also highlight the importance of the cerebellum during sign production and indicate modality-dependent convergence patterns in cerebellar subregions. In sum, our findings complement prior work on sign language comprehension and spoken language production, suggesting substantial overlap in the neural substrates of language processing and production-related mechanisms between sign and spoken language.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对手语产出（以手、面部和身体为发音器官）的脑功能解剖，对已发表的PET和fMRI研究进行了预注册的激活似然估计元分析，并用刀切重采样检验结果稳健性。结果发现，单手势产出稳定涉及左侧额下回（含BA45并延伸至左侧前岛叶）、左侧额上回以及内侧和右侧小脑；元分析连接建模进一步显示，额下回、岛叶和额上回这些簇在口语产出与理解中同样被招募，而小脑的参与及其亚区汇聚模式则表现出与语言通道相关的差异。作者据此认为，手语产出与口语产出在语言加工及产出相关机制上存在相当程度的神经基础重叠，同时提示小脑在手语产出中具有重要作用。

papers.title: Mind-Motor Mat Training as an Early Adjunct to Antihypertensive Therapy for Cognitive Preservation.
papers.authors: Bashir S, Bashir A, Baig M.
papers.journal: Journal of the College of Physicians and Surgeons--Pakistan : JCPSP
papers.abstract: Hypertension affects over 1.28 billion adults globally and remains a critical contributor to cardiovascular complications, mortality, and cognitive decline. Its prevalence approaches 25% in Pakistan, with many cases remaining undiagnosed or uncontrolled. Chronic elevation in blood pressure damages cerebral vasculature, disrupts the blood-brain barrier, and accelerates white matter degeneration, leading to impairments in attention, memory, and executive functions, enhancing dementia risk. This commentary synthesises the current evidence linking hypertension-related cerebrovascular pathology with cognitive deterioration, exploring mind-motor mat training (MMMT) as a potential early, non-pharmacological adjunct to antihypertensive therapy. It integrates structured stepping sequences with concurrent cognitive challenges-such as memory recall, pattern recognition, and decision-making-to enhance neurovascular coupling, neuroplasticity, and functional balance. Based on the reviewed literature, this practice proposal supports integrating MMMT into routine hypertension management to promote cognitive preservation, reduce fall risk, and improve overall quality of life. Such an approach extends hypertension care beyond pharmacological control toward comprehensive neuroprotective and rehabilitative strategies. Key Words: Hypertension, Cognitive decline, Mind-motor mat training.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇评论，梳理高血压相关脑血管病理与认知衰退之间的证据，并在此基础上提出将心智-运动垫训练（MMMT）作为降压治疗早期非药物辅助手段的设想。作者认为，这种把结构化踏步序列与记忆回忆、模式识别和决策等认知挑战结合起来的练习，可能改善神经血管耦合、神经可塑性和功能性平衡。文章据此建议把MMMT纳入常规高血压管理，以帮助保护认知、降低跌倒风险并提升生活质量，使高血压照护从单纯药物控制扩展到神经保护与康复策略。需要说明的是，文中主张基于文献综述和实践设想，并非原始实验验证。

papers.title: The Ambiguity Advantage in Hemispheric Specialization and Interhemispheric Cooperation: A Central and Lateralized Lexical Decision Study of Homonym Recognition
papers.authors: Hwang J, Kim S.
papers.abstract: Abstract Previous studies demonstrate that homonyms with multiple unrelated meanings are recognized faster and more accurately than unambiguous words, a phenomenon termed the ambiguity advantage. However, how the left and right cerebral hemispheres contribute to this facilitation remains unclear. To address this, the present study investigated hemispheric specialization and interhemispheric cooperation across two lexical decision task (LDT) experiments using homonymous and unambiguous words. Experiment 1 measured response times and accuracy in central vision. Experiment 2 applied a divided visual field (DVF) paradigm across left (LVF), right (RVF), and bilateral (BVF) visual field conditions, evaluating three derived behavioral indices: the ambiguity advantage, the right visual field advantage (RVFA), and the bilateral redundancy gain (BRG). In Experiment 1, homonymous words were processed significantly faster and more accurately than unambiguous controls. In Experiment 2, the LVF/RH condition yielded a significantly greater ambiguity advantage in accuracy than the RVF/LH condition. Furthermore, the RVFA was more pronounced for unambiguous words, whereas the BRG was significantly larger for homonyms. These findings indicate that the right hemisphere excels in utilizing the "blend state" of co-activated meanings as a familiarity cue during lexical decisions. Furthermore, cumulative experience with unrelated meanings across diverse contexts may strengthen bihemispheric network interactions, potentially establishing distributed transcortical cell assemblies as the neural foundation for an amplified BRG.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注歧义词（多义词）识别中的“歧义优势”如何由左右半球分工与半球间协作实现，采用中央视野和分视野词汇判断任务比较多义词与无歧义词的行为表现。结果发现，多义词在中央视野下识别更快更准；分视野条件下，左视野/右半球在正确率上的歧义优势更强，而无歧义词的右视野优势更明显，多义词的双侧冗余增益也更大。作者据此推测，右半球可能把多个共激活意义的“混合状态”当作熟悉性线索，而跨语境积累的多重意义经验或可强化双半球网络互动，为更强的双侧协作提供神经基础。

papers.title: A multidisciplinary diagnostic approach to thoracic endometriosis syndrome: Insights from CT imaging, surgery, and pathology.
papers.authors: Marjański T, Szczepańska N, Niedzielska J, Ciarka A, Pęksa R, Czapla A, Świątkowska-Stodulska R, Milnerowicz-Nabzdyk E.
papers.journal: Advances in clinical and experimental medicine : official organ Wroclaw Medical University
papers.abstract: Background Thoracic endometriosis syndrome (TES) is the most common extrapelvic manifestation of endometriosis, yet its classification, diagnosis, and treatment remain debated. Thoracic endometriosis syndrome has recently been proposed to be categorized into 3 types: pleural, bronchopulmonary, and diaphragmatic. Objectives Our study aims to propose a 3-step approach - computed tomography (CT) imaging, careful intraoperative assessment, and targeted pathology - to enhance the diagnostic process and optimize the management of TES-related pneumothorax. Material and methods We retrospectively analyzed 3 cases of recurrent right-sided catamenial pneumothorax in female patients with a history of pelvic endometriosis, managed surgically at the Department of Thoracic Surgery, Medical University of Gdansk, between 2021 and 2024. All included patients underwent video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS), with comprehensive preoperative CT imaging, intraoperative lesion mapping, and postoperative histopathological examination, improving diagnostic accuracy in TES, with a possible impact on therapeutic results. Results Chest CT is essential for detecting bullous lesions, aiding in intraoperative identification and surgical treatment. Immunohistochemistry (IHC), assessing estrogen receptor (ER) and CD10 for stromal identification, improves pathological accuracy. Conclusions This study underlines the diagnostic value of integrating imaging, intraoperative assessment, and targeted histopathology, as well as clear communication between surgeons, radiologists, and pathologists to ensure accurate diagnosis and an improved therapeutic process for patients in clinical practice.

papers.title: Opposing manipulations of insular projections to the bed nuclei of the stria terminalis converge on behavioral passivity.
papers.authors: Hinz DC, Schulz EN, Schaefer A, Mohamed AA, McDole B, Pham MG, Romig-Martin SA, Hardie J, Radley JJ.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Adaptive stress coping involves flexible coordination of behavioral and neuroendocrine responses, yet how cortical regions orchestrate these outputs remains poorly understood. The insular cortex (IC) integrates interoceptive signals and projects to extended amygdala nuclei implicated in threat responses, including the anteroventral subdivision of the bed nuclei of the stria terminalis (avBST) and central amygdala (CeA). Here we used pathway-specific chemogenetics to bidirectionally manipulate IC-avBST projections in male rats during the shock probe defensive burying test (SPDB), which naturalistically measures active versus passive coping. Inhibition of avBST-projecting neurons resulted in a passive coping phenotype of increased immobility and elevated corticosterone levels. Excitation of these neurons unexpectedly shifted behavior in the same direction, reducing defensive burying without altering immobility or corticosterone responses. This convergence suggested that the effects might not be mediated by the avBST projection itself, prompting us to examine collateral targets. Anatomical tracing revealed that avBST-projecting IC neurons send dense collateral axons to CeA, and ex vivo recordings confirmed functional synaptic connectivity. Chemogenetic excitation of CeA-projecting IC neurons also reduced defensive burying, as did optogenetic stimulation of IC terminals in CeA but not avBST, implicating IC input to CeA. These findings suggest that reducing IC excitatory drive on avBST promotes behavioral and hormonal features of passive coping, consistent with avBST's established role in constraining stress responses. By contrast, excitatory influences operate through collateral CeA projections suppress active defensive behavior without engaging neuroendocrine output, indicating that a projection's collaterals, not its defining target, can determine its functional impact.Significance statement Adaptive stress coping requires coordinated behavioral and hormonal responses, yet the neural circuits orchestrating these outputs remain poorly understood. We show that insular cortex neurons projecting to the bed nuclei of the stria terminalis (BST) send dense collateral axons to the central amygdala, enabling distributed control of stress responses. Inhibiting these neurons increases both behavioral passivity and adrenocortical activation- hallmark features of passive coping. Conversely, exciting these neurons suppresses active defensive behavior without affecting hormonal output, an effect mediated by collateral projections to the amygdala rather than the projection to BST itself. These findings demonstrate that insular cortex regulation of stress coping operates through a collateral architecture rather than simple point-to-point connectivity.

papers.title: Near-optimal P300 speller performance using large language models: A multi-model analysis with performance bounds.
papers.authors: Parthasarathy N, Soetedjo J, Panchavati S, Parthasarathy N, Lee D, Arnold C, Pouratian N, Speier W.
papers.abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a progressive neurodegenerative disease, severely impairs communication, requiring assistive technologies that restore interaction. The P300 speller brain-computer interface (BCI) enables communication by translating EEG responses into text; however, its practical adoption is limited by slow typing speed and the need for subject-specific calibration. Recent work has demonstrated that large language models (LLMs), such as GPT-2, can significantly improve the performance of the P300 speller by predicting words. However, it remains unclear whether these gains are model-specific or represent a broader trend across language models. Furthermore, the framework-specific performance bounds of LLM-assisted P300 spellers have not been systematically characterized within a unified decoding framework. In this study, we address these gaps through a systematic multi-model theoretical analysis framework. We evaluate a wide range of language models and introduce an idealized LLM to establish upper bounds on achievable performance. In addition, we incorporate cross-subject classifier training to reduce calibration requirements and assess generalization across subjects. Using extensive simulations on EEG data from 78 subjects, we demonstrate that the evaluated models consistently achieve substantial improvements in typing speed, with gains of up to ~45% (within-subject training) and ~75% (across-subject training) over conventional approaches. More importantly, we show that several high-performing models, despite architectural differences, operate within 5% of the theoretical performance bound, indicating diminishing returns from further model scaling. These improvements generalize across both within-subject and across-subject classifiers. Our results suggest that LLM-assisted P300 spellers are approaching oracle-based upper bounds within the considered decoding framework, shifting the primary bottleneck from language modeling to neural signal decoding. This work provides both a practical framework for improving BCI communication and a theoretical perspective on its achievable limits.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对大语言模型辅助P300拼写器打字速度提升是否具有模型普遍性、以及性能上限如何的问题，采用多模型理论分析框架，在统一解码框架下评估多种语言模型并引入理想化模型设定性能上界，同时考察跨被试分类器训练的泛化表现。基于对78名被试脑电数据的模拟，所评估模型在个体内和跨个体训练条件下均较传统方法显著提升打字速度，且若干高性能模型虽架构不同，其表现已接近理论性能上界，提示继续扩大模型规模收益递减。作者据此认为，在该解码框架内，主要瓶颈正从语言建模转向神经信号解码。

papers.title: Effects of spatial constraints of inhibitory connectivity on the dynamical development of criticality in spiking networks.
papers.authors: Kern FB, Date T, Chao ZC.
papers.abstract: Neural systems are hypothesized to operate near criticality, enhancing their capacity for optimal information processing, transmission and storage capabilities. Criticality has typically been studied in spiking neural networks and related systems organized in random or full connectivity, with the balance of excitation and inhibition being a key determinant of the critical point of the system. However, given that neurons in the brain are spatially distributed, with their distances significantly influencing connectivity and signal timing, it is unclear how the spatial organization of excitatory and inhibitory connectivity influences the network's development towards criticality. Here, we systematically constrain the distance and density of inhibitory connectivity in two-dimensional spiking networks and allow synaptic weights to develop with activity-dependent excitatory and inhibitory plasticity in the presence of a low level of stochastic intrinsic activity. We then investigate the relationship between inhibitory connectivity, synaptic weights, and the resulting network activity during and after development. We find that networks with longer-range inhibitory synapses tend towards more supercritical behavior compared to networks with a similar number of shorter-range inhibitory synapses. We show that this distance dependence is a consequence of weaker long-range synapses after development due to the presence of synaptic delays, which shift most spike pairs outside of the potentiation window of the inhibitory learning rule.

papers.title: Bilateral Medial Medullary Syndrome Following Anterior Odontoid Screw Fixation for a Type II Fracture: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Raj S, Kumar D, Kumar V, Sen AK, Kumar SR, Goni VG.
papers.abstract: Introduction Medial medullary syndrome is an uncommon brainstem stroke, and bilateral involvement is rarer still. It has not, to our knowledge, been described as a complication of anterior screw fixation for a type II odontoid fracture. Case report A 28-year-old man sustained a posteriorly displaced type II odontoid fracture with an associated C2 spinous process fracture in a road traffic accident. He was neurologically intact at admission. Surgery was briefly postponed after a transient episode of anisocoria during induction that resolved without deficit and with a normal computed tomography (CT) angiogram. Halo-ring traction was applied preoperatively for 3 days to achieve gradual fracture reduction, and anterior fixation with two cannulated lag screws was performed uneventfully. Weaning from ventilation was prolonged and complicated; cerebral CT was unremarkable, but magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) showed acute bilateral medial medullary ischemia. He developed a bilateral incomplete tetraparesis, predominantly left-sided, with pyramidal signs and a right hypoglossal palsy (American Spinal Injury Association [ASIA] C)]. Tracheostomy, gastrostomy feeding, anticoagulation, antiplatelet therapy, and early rehabilitation were instituted. Severe atherosclerosis of the bilateral vertebral and basilar arteries, in a patient with hypertension, dyslipidemia, and long-standing smoking, was the only etiological factor identified. At 6-month follow-up, he had improved to ASIA D and was ambulating short distances with a cane. Conclusion Postoperative brainstem ischemia should be suspected whenever weaning fails or new deficits appear after upper cervical spine surgery, even with a normal CT; MRI with diffusion-weighted sequences is required to confirm the diagnosis. Perioperative manipulation of the cervical spine in a patient with underlying atherosclerosis may be an under-recognized mechanism for this rare complication.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一名28岁男性在车祸致II型齿突骨折后接受前路螺钉固定术，术后出现罕见的双侧延髓内侧综合征。患者术前神经系统完好，术后脱机困难并出现以左侧为主的双侧不完全性四肢瘫、锥体束征及右侧舌下神经麻痹，MRI扩散加权成像证实急性双侧延髓内侧缺血，而脑CT未见异常。作者指出，在合并椎基底动脉严重粥样硬化的患者中，围手术期颈椎操作可能是这一罕见并发症的潜在机制，并强调上颈椎术后脱机失败或新发神经功能缺损时应怀疑脑干缺血，需借助MRI确诊。

papers.title: The Mechanical Penumbra in Intracerebral Hemorrhage.
papers.authors: Koch S, Romano JG, Zhao W, Alkhachroum A.
papers.abstract: Penumbral imaging has profoundly changed acute ischemic stroke care by improving patient selection for acute intervention. No such innovation has occurred in intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH), despite a long debate about the existence of a penumbra in the tissue surrounding the hemorrhage. Different types of penumbrae, including an ischemic and metabolic penumbrae, have been proposed; however, we would like to draw attention to the likely existence of a mechanical penumbra that is, perilesional tissue compressed by the physical forces of the hematoma, that remains structurally intact, but recovers if the compression is relieved in a timely manner. Many ICHs occur in deep subcortical structures and compress adjacent white matter tracts. Axonal integrity is measured with diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), which may be able to estimate penumbral tissue in ICH. We propose the presence of a core and penumbra surrounding each ICH. DTI could potentially differentiate irreversibly damaged axons (core axons) from axons that remain salvageable (penumbral axons) and define the extent of a mechanical penumbra. We advocate for developing imaging biomarkers of perihematomal tissue viability to optimally select patients for surgical evacuation.

papers.title: Clinical Factors Associated With Discordant Plasma P-Tau217 and Established Alzheimer Disease Biomarkers.
papers.authors: Shir D, Algeciras-Schimnich A, Piura YD, Bornhorst JA, Figdore DJ, Elgenidi A, Lachner C, Graff-Radford NR, Day GS.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Plasma phosphorylated tau (p-tau) 217 is increasingly used for Alzheimer disease (AD) diagnosis and treatment decisions but may be discordant with established AD biomarkers. False-positive (FP) plasma results may lead to overtreatment and false-negative (FN) results to missed or delayed disease-modifying therapies. We evaluated factors associated with discordant results. Methods This retrospective study included participants enrolled in memory and aging studies at Mayo Clinic with "positive" (>0.324 pg/mL) or "negative" (<0.186 pg/mL) plasma p-tau217 results and confirmatory AD biomarkers. Plasma results were classified as true positive (TP), true negative (TN), FP, or FN, referencing amyloid-PET and CSF p-tau181/β-amyloid (Aβ) 42. Clinical and laboratory variables were compared using univariate analyses; multivariable logistic regression evaluated independent associations with discordance. Results Among 706 participants (median 70.0 [interquartile range 15.8] years; 54% male), 60 (8.5%) had discordant plasma p-tau217 results. FN results (5.6%) were more frequent than FP results (2.8%; p = 0.007). Discordance was associated with older age (odds ratio [OR] 1.61 per decade, 95% CI 1.23-2.14) and obstructive sleep apnea (OR 1.94, 95% CI 1.08-3.49). FN (vs TP) results were associated with milder clinical stage (global Clinical Dementia Rating [CDR] ≤0.5 vs CDR ≥1; p < 0.001), higher Mini-Mental State Examination scores (OR 1.20 per point, 95% CI 1.05-1.36), obstructive sleep apnea (OR 2.01, 95% CI 1.01-4.3), higher body mass index (OR 1.11/kg/m2 , 95% CI 1.03-1.20), and higher estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR: OR 1.33/10 mL/min/1.73 m2 , 95% CI 1.05-1.69). In age-adjusted models, body mass index (OR 1.14, 95% CI 1.03-1.25), eGFR (OR 1.63/10 mL/min/1.73 m2 , 95% CI 1.22-2.16), and earlier clinical stage (CDR ≤0.5) were independently associated with FN results. FP (vs TN) results were associated with older age (OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.36-4.09), thyroid disease (OR 4.41, 95% CI 1.36-14.3), lower eGFR (OR 0.48/10 mL/min/1.73 m2 , 95% CI 0.31-0.66), and advanced disease stage (CDR ≥1). In age-adjusted models, eGFR (OR 0.54/10 mL/min/1.73 m2 , 95% CI 0.35-0.82) and advanced disease stage (CDR ≥ 1 vs CDR 0: OR 11.11, 95% CI 2.0-50.0; vs CDR 0.5: OR 4.55, 95% CI 1.12-16.67) were independently associated with FP results. Discussion Plasma p-tau217 results and established AD biomarkers were discordant in 8.5% of participants. Clinical stage and factors related to brain amyloid clearance, renal clearance, and volume of distribution were associated with discordant results. These insights may inform mechanisms of discordance and identify patients requiring confirmatory biomarker measures.

papers.title: Hippocampal volume and white matter impairments in patients with congenital adrenal hyperplasia.
papers.authors: Savoia A, Kancsar D, Nordenström A, Van't Westeinde A, Lajic S.
papers.journal: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism
papers.abstract: Context Patients with congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) have lifelong imbalances in adrenal hormones that may result in changes in structure and function of the brain that can impair cognitive performance. The hippocampus might be especially sensitive to cortisol and androgen disturbances but has not been systematically investigated in this patient group. Objective In this study, we assessed hippocampal subfield volumes, mean diffusivity, and resting-state functional connectivity along with memory performance in patients with CAH and healthy controls using structural magnetic resonance imaging. Design Cohort study; patients were recruited and tested as part of the PREDEX study. Setting Single research institute. Participants Twenty-nine patients with CAH (20 females, 9 males) and 33 healthy controls (19 females, 14 males). Intervention(s) No intervention was performed. Main outcome measure(s) Hippocampal subfield volumes, mean diffusivity, resting-state functional connectivity, and memory performance. Results Patients with CAH had reduced left CA4 and left and right subiculum volumes. In the group by sex interaction analyses, males presented higher mean diffusivity in left CA3 and CA4 compared to controls. When looking at males and females separately, it was identified that females had reduced volumes of the bilateral subiculum, CA1, and left CA3 and CA4. Hippocampal structural alterations were not associated with memory performance. Conclusions Patients with CAH had structural alterations in several hippocampal subfield volumes, but there might be a discrepancy between males and females in sensitivity to white or gray matter impairments. The findings warrant further investigation into sex-specific differences in treatment sensitivity to optimize brain health in both men and women with CAH.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注先天性肾上腺皮质增生症（CAH）患者的海马亚区体积、白质微结构、静息态功能连接与记忆表现，采用结构磁共振成像比较患者与健康对照。结果显示，患者左侧CA4及双侧下托体积减小；按性别分析时，男性患者左侧CA3和CA4的平均弥散率高于对照，女性患者则表现为双侧下托、CA1及左侧CA3和CA4体积减小，提示男女在灰质或白质受损敏感性上可能存在差异。海马结构改变与记忆表现未见关联，作者据此强调需进一步研究性别特异的治疗敏感性，以维护CAH患者的脑健康。

papers.title: Connectomic Determinants of Subcallosal Cingulate Deep Brain Stimulation for Depression.
papers.authors: Song HN, Choi KS, Kopell BH, Figee M, Bruin J, Cha J, Riva-Posse P, Boutet A, Elias G, Germann J, Kennedy SH, Himes L, Gross RE, Lozano AM, Cheeran B, Mayberg HS.
papers.abstract: Objective Subcallosal cingulate (SCC) deep brain stimulation (DBS) has shown promise for treatment-resistant depression. This study retrospectively evaluated a large curated SCC-DBS dataset to identify connectomic factors associated with sustained clinical improvement across patients, focusing on the white matter bundles consistently implicated in patient-specific connectome-based targeting. Methods A total of 131 patients (mean age=46.67 years, SD=9.79; 60.31% female) with treatment-resistant depression from three independent cohorts received bilateral SCC-DBS using site-specific targeting methods. Clinical improvements were assessed using the 17-item Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HAM-D). Based on individual DBS settings, volumes of tissue activated were reconstructed, and voxel-wise stimulation mapping and normative fiber-wise analyses were performed to assess contributions of white matter bundles to therapeutic response. Results Responders (patients with ≥50% reduction in HAM-D score) exhibited a less variable spatial distribution of volumes of tissue activated than nonresponders. Probabilistic stimulation mapping identified a focal cluster associated with clinical improvement. Fiber-wise analyses showed that stimulation of predefined white matter tracts targeted by connectome-based SCC-DBS contributed to clinical efficacy. Notably, failure to activate the left cingulum bundle and medial uncinate fasciculus decreased the therapeutic effects of SCC-DBS. Conclusions This study highlights the significance of stimulating critical white matter bundles for effective SCC-DBS. Available evidence supports the idea that precisely targeting the lateralized cingulum bundle and medial uncinate fasciculus is essential for sustained clinical improvement. These findings suggest potential advantages of connectome-based targeting for SCC-DBS over targeting based solely on anatomical landmarks or normative atlases, using a method that is precise, reliable, and scalable for future use in individual patients.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于三个独立队列的难治性抑郁症患者数据，回顾性分析胼胝体下扣带回脑深部刺激（SCC-DBS）的疗效与连接组学因素的关系，通过重建刺激组织体积并进行刺激映射和纤维束分析来考察白质束的作用。结果显示，应答者的刺激体积空间分布比非应答者更集中，刺激映射识别出与临床改善相关的局灶区域，纤维束分析表明刺激连接组靶向的特定白质束有助于疗效；未激活左侧扣带束和内侧钩束会降低治疗效果。作者据此认为，精准靶向这些偏侧化白质束对持续临床改善至关重要，并提示基于连接组的靶向可能优于仅依据解剖标志或标准图谱的定位，但该结论来自回顾性分析，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Multimodal Retinal Imaging Correlates With Brain Atrophy and Plasma Biomarkers in Alzheimer's Disease.
papers.authors: Luan X, Shen J, Wang Y, Qiu H, Cheng H, Zheng C, Hu S, Wen C, Cao G, Kwpaong WR, Wang Z.
papers.abstract: Purpose To investigate retinal structural and microvascular changes in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and evaluate their associations with neuroimaging markers, plasma biomarkers, and cognitive impairment. Methods This cross-sectional study included 181 participants (95 with AD and 86 cognitively unimpaired controls). AD diagnosis was established according to National Institute on Aging-Alzheimer's Association criteria with positive amyloid-β positron emission tomography imaging. Retinal structure and microvasculature were assessed using swept-source optical coherence tomography (OCT) and OCT angiography (OCTA). Cortical thickness and gray matter volume were quantified using structural magnetic resonance imaging. Plasma Aβ42 and phosphorylated tau-217 (p-tau217) were measured, and cognitive function was evaluated using the Mini-Mental State Examination and Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA). Results Compared with controls, patients with AD demonstrated reduced retinal nerve fiber layer, ganglion cell-inner plexiform layer (GCIPL), inner nuclear layer, and outer retinal layer thicknesses, together with lower superficial vascular complex (SVC) and deep vascular complex densities (all P < 0.001). GCIPL thickness and SVC density were associated with cortical atrophy in AD-vulnerable regions, including temporal, parietal, and occipital cortices. Lower plasma Aβ42 levels were associated with reduced retinal layer thickness and vascular density, whereas higher p-tau217 levels were associated with reduced outer retinal layer thickness and SVC density. GCIPL thickness showed the strongest association with cognitive performance, while lower SVC density was associated with poorer MoCA scores. APOE ε4 carriers exhibited greater GCIPL thinning, reduced retinal vascular density, and more extensive cortical abnormalities despite similar plasma Aβ42 and p-tau217 levels. Conclusions Retinal neuronal and microvascular alterations are associated with AD-related molecular pathology, cerebral neurodegeneration, APOE ε4-related vulnerability, and cognitive impairment. OCT/OCTA may provide a noninvasive adjunct approach for characterizing neurodegenerative and neurovascular changes in AD. Translational relevance Retinal imaging may provide a scalable and noninvasive approach for detecting and monitoring AD pathology.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者视网膜结构与微血管改变，并分析其与神经影像、血浆生物标志物及认知功能的关系；研究纳入AD患者与认知正常对照，采用OCT/OCTA评估视网膜，结合结构磁共振、血浆Aβ42与p-tau217检测及认知量表。结果显示，AD患者多层视网膜变薄、浅层与深层血管复合体密度降低，其中神经节细胞-内丛状层厚度和浅层血管密度与颞顶枕等易损脑区皮层萎缩相关；血浆Aβ42较低与视网膜层厚度和血管密度下降相关，p-tau217较高则与外层视网膜变薄和浅层血管密度降低相关。神经节细胞-内丛状层厚度与认知表现关联最强，APOE ε4携带者视网膜和皮层异常更明显。作者据此认为，视网膜成像或可作为无创辅助手段刻画AD相关神经退行与神经血管改变，但相关关系不等同于因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Detailed Analysis of Intraretinal Layers and Their Correlation to Brain Structures in Normal Healthy Aging.
papers.authors: Cipolla JA, Gameiro GR, Tackett W, Morgan J, Aguirre G, Pattany P, O'Brien R, Jiang H, Detre JA, Wang J.
papers.abstract: Purpose The purpose of this study was to investigate the relationships between intraretinal layer volumes and visual cortical thickness in healthy individuals and determine the influence of age on these associations. Methods Fifty-three subjects were recruited. One eye per subject was imaged using optical coherence tomography (OCT) to quantify volumes of total retinal thickness (TRT), retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL), ganglion cell-inner plexiform layer (GCIPL), inner nuclear layer (INL), outer nuclear layer (ONL), outer plexiform layer (OPL), and photoreceptor (PR) layer. Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was performed, and cortical thickness was quantified in 13 visual cortex regions using the Schaefer 2018 atlas. Results TRT, RNFL, and GCIPL volumes were significantly correlated with cortical thickness in multiple visual regions (r = 0.34-0.59, all P < 0.05). These associations were largely attenuated after adjusting for age. In contrast, selected RNFL and INL associations remained significant after age adjustment. OPL, ONL, and PR layer showed no significant correlations with cortical thickness. PR layer volume increased with age (r = 0.38, P < 0.01), unlike the age-related thinning observed in other layers. Conclusions Distinct retinal layers exhibit differential relationships with the visual cortex, with some associations predominantly mediated by age and selected RNFL and INL associations persisting independently of age. Translational relevance Distinguishing age-mediated from age-independent retinal-cortical relationships may help identify OCT-derived retinal measures that differentiate normal aging from cerebral pathology and support their investigation as noninvasive biomarkers of central nervous system (CNS) integrity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康人群中考察视网膜各内层体积与视觉皮层厚度的关系，并分析年龄对这些关联的影响，采用光学相干断层扫描测量视网膜分层体积、磁共振成像量化视觉皮层厚度。结果显示，总视网膜、视网膜神经纤维层和神经节细胞-内丛状层体积与多个视觉皮层区域厚度相关，但这些关联在调整年龄后大多减弱；部分神经纤维层和内核层关联则独立于年龄仍显著，而外丛状层、外核层和光感受器层未见显著相关。光感受器层体积随年龄增加，与其他层随年龄变薄的趋势不同。作者认为，不同视网膜层与视觉皮层的关系存在差异，区分年龄介导与年龄无关的关联或有助于将视网膜指标用于区分正常衰老与脑病理的无创生物标志物研究。

papers.title: Decoding object categories from electroencephalography during free viewing reveals early information evolution compared to passive viewing.
papers.authors: Auerbach-Asch CR, Vishne G, Wertheimer O, Deouell LY.
papers.abstract: Object processing is central to visual perception, and its neural substrates inform cognitive and computational models of vision. Electroencephalographic (EEG) research has increasingly adopted multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) to decode distributed neural representations, moving beyond average signal changes and predefined electrodes. Yet, most MVPA studies use passive viewing paradigms that constrain eye movements and evoke brain activity by external stimuli presentation, creating an artificial dissociation between perception and action. Here, we examine object category representations during active vision by combining MVPA with a deconvolution method for overlapping fixation-related responses. By decoding category information from single fixations, we compare the temporal dynamics of object processing between free viewing (active) and rapid serial visual presentation (passive) conditions. We find that categorical information, across multiple levels of abstraction, can be decoded from individual fixations during natural viewing, and that object representations generalize across passive and active conditions. Notably, representational dynamics time-locked to fixation onset emerge earlier than those time-locked to stimulus onset. We discuss the possibility that object processing begins parafoveally, aligned with saccade onset, rather than foveally at fixation. Thus, information about what and when to expect new information, available in free viewing, facilitates processing. These findings underscore the importance of studying vision in naturalistic settings and highlight key methodological considerations for combining MVPA with deconvolution in overlapping neural data. Object processing is fundamental to visual perception and to cognitive and computational models of vision. Although MVPA has advanced EEG research by enabling the decoding of distributed neural representations with high temporal precision, it has been applied primarily in passive viewing paradigms that constrain natural eye movements. The current study bridges the gap between passive and active vision research by combining MVPA with overlap deconvolution to decode object category information from EEG during natural fixations in free viewing. This approach reveals that category-specific representations emerge earlier in active viewing, likely reflecting processing that begins during saccade planning or execution. The findings underscore the importance of studying vision under ecologically valid conditions and introduce a novel methodological framework for capturing neural dynamics during active perception.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然观看与被动观看下物体类别加工的时间动态差异，将多变量模式分析与重叠注视相关反应的解卷积方法结合，从脑电中解码单个注视期间的类别信息。结果显示，自然观看中单个注视即可解码多层次的类别信息，且物体表征能在被动与主动条件间泛化；值得注意的是，锁定于注视起始的表征动态比锁定于刺激呈现的更早出现。作者据此提出，物体加工可能在副中央凹、与眼跳起始对齐时便已开始，而非在注视时于中央凹启动，自由观看中关于“看什么、何时期待新信息”的可用信息因而促进了加工。这些发现强调了在自然情境中研究视觉的重要性，也提示了将多变量模式分析与解卷积结合处理重叠神经数据时的方法学考量。

papers.title: Dual Mechanisms of Impaired Visual Processing in Glaucoma: Insights From Resting-State and Task-Related EEG.
papers.authors: Mei X, Chen L, Chan LH, Lyu A, Tsang C, Leung C, Thompson B, Cheong AMY.
papers.abstract: Purpose To examine both resting-state and task-related electroencephalography (EEG) changes associated with visual processing in glaucoma. Methods Thirty glaucoma patients (mean age, 63 ± 8.26 years; visual field mean deviation, -15.41 ± 6.34 dB) and 28 age-matched controls (62.86 ± 9.19 years) underwent resting-state EEG for 3 minutes under eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions. Alpha suppression, calculated as the difference between conditions, was assessed as a measure of cognitive state transition capacity. Visual evoked potentials (VEPs) were recorded using a 64-channel EEG system during a checkerboard reversal task under monocular and binocular viewing. Results Resting-state EEG revealed that significantly reduced alpha suppression was highly specific to a high-alpha subband (10.0-12.9 Hz; P < 0.001), and low-alpha (7.0-9.9 Hz) modulation remained intact in the glaucoma group. Task-related EEG showed delayed latency and reduced amplitude in both P100 and N75-P100 components in the glaucoma group, indicating impaired visual processing. Effect size analysis indicated that P100 amplitude and N75-P100 latency showed the largest group differences, highlighting these as the most prominent cortical changes. Notably, alpha suppression deficits showed no significant correlation with glaucoma severity or VEP parameters, suggesting distinct neurophysiological mechanisms beyond direct visual pathway damage. Conclusions Both resting-state and task-related EEG measures differed between the glaucoma and control groups, indicating alterations in cortical activity and visual-pathway responses. Specifically, the localized high alpha modulation deficit suggests altered top-down visual network dynamics in glaucoma.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较青光眼患者与年龄匹配对照在静息态和任务态脑电上的视觉加工变化，结合静息态α抑制与棋盘格翻转诱发的视觉诱发电位进行考察。结果显示，患者仅在较高α频段的α抑制明显减弱，较低α频段调制仍保留；任务态下P100和N75-P100成分潜伏期延迟、波幅降低，其中P100波幅与N75-P100潜伏期的组间差异最突出。α抑制缺陷与青光眼严重程度及视觉诱发电位指标均无显著相关，提示除视觉通路直接损伤外，还存在相对独立的皮层机制，可能涉及自上而下视觉网络动态的改变。

papers.title: Viewpoint on Hierarchical Organization of Multisensory Integration and Segregation.
papers.authors: Kayser C, Noppeney U, Rohe T.
papers.abstract: In this viewpoint, Christoph Kayser, Uta Noppeney, and Tim Rohe highlight the central role of normative Bayesian frameworks, in particular Bayesian causal inference, for explaining how the brain decides whether sensory signals should be integrated or segregated and how they are weighted by their reliabilities. In parallel, the Multisensory Correlation Detector model is emphasized as a mechanistic proposal for how the brain computes spatial and temporal relations across sensory channels. Together, these developments have shifted the field from merely locating multisensory processing in the brain to characterizing the specific computations implemented across cortical hierarchies. The authors outline current trends, such as model-based analyses of neuroimaging and neurophysiological data, increasing use of artificial neural networks to study multisensory processing at larger scales, and emerging work in naturalistic, real-world settings. They discuss ongoing controversies surrounding the influence of attention and tasks on multisensory integration, the limits of Bayes optimality, and the role of neural oscillations, especially alpha rhythms, in shaping multisensory binding. They further advocate for stronger open-science practices and systematic replication of influential findings to consolidate the empirical and theoretical foundations of the field. Finally, they encourage early-career scientists to develop strong methodological skills, cultivate their own conceptual 'angle', and actively engage with the multisensory community.
papers.summary_zh: 该观点文章由Kayser、Noppeney和Rohe撰写，重点讨论多感觉整合与分离的层级组织。作者强调，规范性贝叶斯框架尤其是贝叶斯因果推断，在解释大脑如何决定感觉信号应被整合还是分离以及如何按可靠性加权方面具有核心作用；同时指出多感觉相关检测器模型为大脑如何计算跨通道的时空关系提供了机制性解释。这些进展推动该领域从定位多感觉加工的脑区转向刻画皮层层级上实现的具体计算。作者还梳理了基于模型的神经影像与神经生理数据分析、人工神经网络用于更大规模多感觉加工研究以及自然情境下研究等趋势，并讨论了注意与任务对多感觉整合的影响、贝叶斯最优性的局限以及神经振荡特别是α节律在多感觉绑定中的作用等争议，同时倡导加强开放科学实践和系统重复重要发现。

papers.title: Diagnostic Images for Mild Cognitive Impairment Are Sensitive to Alzheimer's Disease Biomarkers and Reveal Abnormal Scene Processing.
papers.authors: Bai Y, Peters O, Freiesleben SD, Fenski F, Priller J, Spruth EJ, Schneider A, Fliessbach K, Wiltfang J, Bartels C, Rostamzadeh A, Glanz W, Teipel S, Kilimann I, Laske C, Spottke A, Roy-Kluth N, Brosseron F, Wagner M, Frommann I, Lüsebrink F, Ramirez A, Dechent P, Hetzer S, Scheffler K, Yakupov R, Jessen F, Düzel E, Bainbridge WA.
papers.abstract: Research on visual episodic memory impairment in Alzheimer's disease often focuses on memory processes rather than the specific content of the images being remembered. We previously showed that patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), a transitional stage that may precede Alzheimer's disease, can memorize certain images well, indicating that episodic memory is not uniformly impaired. Conversely, other specific images could not be memorized by MCI patients and were instead diagnostic for distinguishing MCI from healthy older adults. In this study, we investigate whether poor memory for these diagnostic images relates to impaired neural processing in specific brain regions and Alzheimer's biomarker pathology. We assessed 64 healthy controls and 48 MCI participants from the DZNE Longitudinal Cognitive Impairment and Dementia Study. Participants performed a visual scene memory task during fMRI and provided cerebrospinal fluid biomarker data for amyloid and tau. Diagnostic images demonstrated significantly larger behavior-biomarker correlations (total tau, phospho-tau, Aβ42/Aβ40, and Aβ42/phospho-tau) compared with nondiagnostic images. This suggests memory for these specific diagnostic images is more affected by Alzheimer's disease pathology. The fMRI data revealed an interaction effect between group membership (healthy control/MCI) and image diagnosticity (diagnostic/nondiagnostic). MCI participants exhibited higher activation in scene-processing regions (parahippocampal place area, retrosplenial cortex, and occipital place area) for diagnostic compared with nondiagnostic images. Healthy controls, however, showed no processing differences between diagnostic and nondiagnostic images. These findings suggest MCI individuals may engage in inefficiently heightened encoding activation for diagnostic images. Our results show that special "diagnostic" images exist that can reliably reveal underlying amyloid and tau pathology alongside altered neural activity in scene regions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注轻度认知障碍患者对特定图片的记忆缺陷是否与阿尔茨海默病生物标志物及脑区加工异常相关，结合功能磁共振场景记忆任务与脑脊液淀粉样蛋白、tau标志物数据，比较了健康老年人与轻度认知障碍参与者。结果显示，对“诊断性”图片的记忆与tau和淀粉样蛋白指标的相关性明显强于非诊断性图片，提示这类图片的记忆更易受阿尔茨海默病病理影响；轻度认知障碍者在场景加工相关脑区对诊断性图片表现出更高的激活，而健康对照未见此种差异。作者据此认为，轻度认知障碍者可能对诊断性图片进行了低效的过度编码激活，这类图片或可同时反映潜在的淀粉样蛋白与tau病理及场景相关脑活动的改变。

papers.title: Stimulation of Right Temporal Cortex Enhances Talker Typicality Judgments.
papers.authors: Luthra S, Mechtenberg H, Olson HE, Zaharchuk HA, Myers EB.
papers.abstract: Listeners are exquisitely sensitive to the ways that different talkers produce speech sounds, and such sensitivity may allow listeners to condition speech perception on talker information. A growing body of neuroimaging data suggests that although phonetic processing is largely supported by the brain's left hemisphere, the integration of talker information during speech perception recruits the right hemisphere, especially right temporal cortex. However, an open question is whether recruitment of the right hemisphere is strictly necessary for integrating talker information and phonetic detail or simply incidental. Here, we leverage TMS to test for a causal role of the right middle temporal gyrus (RMTG) in accessing a listener's beliefs about a talker's phonetic signature. During an initial exposure phase, participants heard pairs of talkers, one of whom produced voiceless stop consonants (e.g., /k/) with a relatively short voice onset time (VOT) and one who employed relatively long VOTs; listeners learned what variation was typical of each talker without disruption from TMS. During a subsequent test, TMS was administered to the RMTG, left middle temporal gyrus (LMTG), or a control site (scalp vertex) before listeners judged whether VOT variants were typical of a learned talker. We found that listeners were best able to determine what phonetic variation was typical of a talker following RMTG stimulation; stimulation of the LMTG did not influence performance relative to vertex stimulation. Overall, results indicate that the balance of activation across the two hemispheres is critical for accessing talker-specific phonetic detail.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用经颅磁刺激（TMS）考察右半球在整合说话人信息与语音细节中是否起因果作用。参与者在无干扰条件下先熟悉两位说话人各自的嗓音起始时间（VOT）特征，随后在测试阶段接受右侧、左侧颞中回或头顶对照位点的刺激，再判断VOT变体是否符合所学说话人的典型特征。结果显示，右侧颞中回受刺激后，判断说话人典型语音变异的成绩最好；左侧颞中回刺激与对照位点相比未见影响。作者据此认为，两半球激活的平衡对提取说话人特异的语音细节具有关键作用，而右半球的作用并非单纯的伴随现象。

papers.title: Working Memory Facilitates Event Segmentation Via Boundary-triggered Reactivation and Partial Accumulation during Events.
papers.authors: Güler B, Karahamza S, Şentürk YD, Bein O, Clewett D, Günseli E.
papers.abstract: Event segmentation is the cognitive process of dividing continuous experiences into meaningful units. Although working memory (WM) is believed to play an instrumental role in event segmentation, its specific contribution remains under debate. Here, we used two electroencephalography indices of WM load, alpha-band suppression and contralateral delay activity amplitude, to test the extent to which WM representations reflect gradually accumulating information during unfolding events, boundary-triggered reactivation at event transitions, or both. Participants viewed object images paired with sounds that both remained in the same category for six consecutive items to form a stable event, followed by two items from another category, creating an event boundary. Temporal order and sequential memory were used to assess event segmentation. We found increased alpha-band suppression following event transitions, supporting the reactivation account. Evidence for the accumulation was mixed, with no evidence for increased alpha-band suppression and moderate evidence for increased contralateral delay activity during events. These results indicate that WM contributes to event segmentation primarily through boundary-triggered reactivation, with only limited evidence for within-event accumulation.

papers.title: Retrieval-related Eye Movements Are Predictive of Memory Precision.
papers.authors: Hou M, Pezanko LR, Srokova S, Hill PF, Ekstrom AD, Rugg MD.
papers.abstract: Eye movements are predictive of successful episodic memory encoding and retrieval, but it is unclear whether they reflect the precision of retrieved memory content. Here, we examined relationships between eye fixations, memory precision, and fMRI BOLD activity. At study, participants were presented with object images, each placed at a random location on a circle. At test, both studied and new images were presented. Participants were instructed to recall and signal the studied location of each image, guessing if necessary. They then indicated if the image had been studied. Simultaneous fMRI and eye-tracking data were acquired during the test phase. For correctly recognized images, trial-wise angular distances between the studied and reported locations were fitted to a two-component mixture model. On the basis of model-derived parameters, correctly recognized images were categorized as those associated with successful location retrieval (location hits) or guesses. Location hits were further divided into high- and low-precision trials. At retrieval, fixation location predicted both successful retrieval and the precision of the retrieved location memory. In addition, across-trial fixation patterns were more similar for location hits than for guesses and for high- than for low-precision trials. The association between retrieval success and fixation precision was evident across almost the entire recall phase, whereas memory precision effects emerged around 1-1.5 sec after image onset. Fixation precision and pattern similarity each predicted trial-wise memory precision independently of hippocampal BOLD activity, which also predicted memory precision. Taken together, the findings indicate that eye movements during retrieval track the fidelity of retrieved mnemonic content.

papers.title: Memory Reactivation Levels Remain Unaffected by Anticipated Interference.
papers.authors: Ataseven N, Algın IE, Yücel D, Güler B, Todorova L, Fukuda K, Günseli E.
papers.abstract: Most daily tasks require frequent information exchange between working memory (WM) and long-term memory (LTM). However, the factors that modulate the reactivation of LTMs in WM remain to be explored. Here, we tested the effects of anticipated perceptual interference (in Experiment 1) and anticipated interference task (in Experiment 2) on reactivation of LTMs in WM using contralateral delay activity (CDA) in the EEG. On each trial, participants saw one or three previously studied or novel objects that were tested after a brief retention interval. In half of the blocks, the retention contained perceptual distractors (Experiment 1) or an interference task (Experiment 2). The CDA prior to the interference period was lower for studied than for novel items and was unaffected by anticipated interference, with no interaction between interference expectation and memory type. Additionally, we measured contralateral alpha power suppression as an index of spatial attention. We found that spatial attention allocated to the memorized objects' locations also was not modulated with anticipated interference. These findings indicate that anticipating interference does not influence the extent to which WM is engaged in representing information stored in LTM.

papers.title: Simultaneous Cortical Responses to Multiple Written Words.
papers.authors: Chauhan V, McCook K, Latif M, White A.
papers.abstract: We have learned much about the brain regions that support reading by measuring neuronal responses to single words, but we know little about how the brain processes multiple words simultaneously. This fMRI study fills that gap by varying the number of English words presented while holding the amount of visual stimulation constant. We adapted the "simultaneous suppression" paradigm, which has demonstrated that the response to multiple stimuli presented simultaneously is typically smaller than the sum of responses to the same stimuli presented sequentially. On each trial, participants viewed a rapid sequence of three frames. Each frame contained two character strings, most of which were pseudoletters with visual features matched to familiar letters. The experimental conditions differed in the number of words in the sequence: zero words, one word, two words sequentially, or two words simultaneously. Behavioral task accuracy was worse for detecting two words presented simultaneously than sequentially. BOLD responses increased linearly with the number of words presented in several reading-related regions of the left hemisphere: text-selective occipito-temporal regions, the STS, the intraparietal sulcus, and the inferior frontal sulcus. In all of those regions, responses did not differ between sequential and simultaneous presentation of two words. Nonetheless, the sensitivity of ventral temporal text-selective regions to the lexical frequencies of two words was attenuated by simultaneous presentation. To account for these patterns of activity and task performance, we suggest that the reading network can detect two strings of letters simultaneously, but there is interference during lexical access.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用fMRI考察大脑如何同时处理多个书面词，通过保持视觉刺激总量不变、改变序列中英文词的数量（零个、一个、顺序呈现两个或同时呈现两个），并借鉴“同时抑制”范式比较顺序与同时呈现的差异。结果发现，左半球多个阅读相关区域的BOLD反应随词数线性增加，但两个词顺序呈现与同时呈现在这些区域的总体反应无差异；然而，同时呈现削弱了腹侧颞叶文本选择区对两个词词汇频率的敏感性，且行为上同时检测两个词的准确率低于顺序呈现。作者据此提出，阅读网络能够同时检测两串字母，但在词汇通达阶段存在干扰。

papers.title: Investigating the Effects of Acute Stress on Neural Mechanisms of Self-controlled Decision-making.
papers.authors: Stein J, Kirschbaum C, Korb FM, Goschke T, Zwosta K.
papers.abstract: Successfully exerting self-control is an important prerequisite for adaptive decision-making in daily life.
