CSF showed mild pleocytosis (17 WBC/µL) and raised protein (67.6 mg/dL). Serum treponemal screening was positive with an RPR titre > 1:32. Neurosyphilis was confirmed by a reactive CSF non-treponemal test (RPR 1:2) in a patient with compatible clinical and CSF findings; the CSF TPHA titre was >1:10,240, which is supportive but not in itself a diagnostic criterion.Levetiracetam was started on admission and intravenous penicillin G on day 2, after the diagnosis was confirmed. Because EEG and MRI suggested possible focal status epilepticus, valproate and phenytoin were added. The patient developed respiratory failure needing mechanical ventilation and deep vein thrombosis. After extended ICU stay and rehabilitation, he recovered with mild residual critical illness myopathy and cognitive deficits. Conclusion Neurosyphilis is not intrinsically difficult to diagnose, provided it is considered, including outside the classically recognised risk groups such as men who have sex with men.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例以癫痫持续状态为首发表现的晚发性神经梅毒病例：一名45岁男性因意识混乱、言语困难和左侧肢体无力就诊，随后出现局灶继发双侧强直阵挛发作，脑脊液和血清梅毒检测支持神经梅毒诊断。影像和脑电图提示可能存在局灶性癫痫持续状态，抗癫痫及青霉素治疗后患者仍出现呼吸衰竭、深静脉血栓等严重并发症，经重症监护和康复后遗留轻度肌病和认知缺陷。作者据此强调，神经梅毒本身诊断并不困难，关键在于临床是否想到该病，尤其在不典型表现及不属于经典高危人群的患者中应保持筛查意识。

papers.title: Neuroimaging and neurophysiological changes following structured interventions in children with developmental coordination disorder: a scoping review.
papers.authors: Domke Molina F, Lopez-Espejo M.
papers.abstract: Background Longitudinal neuroimaging and neurophysiological studies can indicate whether structured interventions in developmental coordination disorder (DCD) are accompanied by neurobiological change, but this literature has not been synthesized across modalities, follow-up intervals, and analytic approaches. Objective To map longitudinal neurobiological outcomes after structured interventions in children and adolescents with DCD or probable DCD and the analytic approaches used, including neurobiological-clinical/functional linkage analyses. Methods We conducted a scoping review following JBI methodology, reported in accordance with PRISMA-ScR and PRISMA-S. Eligible sources included participants aged 0-18 years with confirmed or probable DCD, a structured intervention, and neurobiological assessment at baseline and ≥1 post-intervention time point. Two reviewers independently screened records and charted data. We searched six databases, two trial registries, and preprint platforms on January 10, 2026 (updated August 21, 2026), without date or language restrictions. Formal critical appraisal was not undertaken; methodological and reporting features were charted descriptively. Results Of 747 records identified, 13 sources (eight independent cohorts) published between 2012 and 2025 met the inclusion criteria. Neurobiological sample sizes ranged from 20 to 88 (median 49). Designs included randomized controlled, non-randomized controlled, and quasi-experimental pre-post studies. Interventions clustered into Cognitive Orientation to daily Occupational Performance (CO-OP; 6 sources), exercise/motor-learning programs (4), and neuromuscular/biomechanical approaches (3). Modalities included diffusion tensor imaging, resting-state functional MRI, structural MRI/voxel-based morphometry, functional near-infrared spectroscopy, electroencephalography/event-related potentials, and surface electromyography. MRI-based longitudinal outcomes were reported exclusively in CO-OP cohorts, with several publications arising from shared registered trials and partial cohort overlap. Six sources included neurobiological follow-up beyond the immediate post-intervention assessment. Analytic approaches varied in pre-post versus group-by-time contrasts, region-of-interest versus whole-brain analyses, and correction for multiple comparisons. Seven sources reported neurobiological-clinical/functional linkage analyses; five tested change-based associations, and statistically significant findings were limited to individualized movement-quality outcomes. Conclusions The evidence base is small, heterogeneous, and unevenly distributed across intervention categories and modalities. Priorities include independent replication, longitudinal neuroimaging of non-CO-OP interventions where scientifically justified, more consistent follow-up, and prespecified, adequately powered linkage analyses.
papers.summary_zh: 该范围综述梳理了发育性协调障碍儿童和青少年接受结构化干预后，纵向神经影像与神经生理指标的变化及相关分析方式。纳入的文献数量少、异质性大，干预集中在CO-OP、运动学习及神经肌肉/生物力学方法，MRI纵向结果仅见于CO-OP队列，且部分研究来自同一注册试验、队列存在重叠。仅少数研究在干预结束后继续追踪，分析策略在前后对比与组间时间交互、感兴趣区与全脑分析等方面差异明显；报告神经生物学与临床/功能关联的研究中，显著结果仅限于个体化运动质量结局。作者据此指出，现有证据基础尚不足以支持明确结论，需独立重复、对非CO-OP干预开展有科学依据的纵向影像研究、统一随访，并预先设定有足够检验效能的相关分析。

papers.title: Quantifying the diagnostic contribution of neuropsychological evaluation using natural language processing.
papers.authors: Wolff B, Umfleet LG, Drane DL, Gullett JM, Bauer RM, Cavanagh L, Strutt AM, Reise SP, Widaman KF, Bell DS, Thames AD.
papers.abstract: Objective: Diagnostic clarification is regarded as a core function of neuropsychological evaluation, yet its impact has rarely been quantified because diagnoses are typically embedded within unstructured narrative reports. This pilot study quantified the diagnostic contribution of neuropsychological evaluation by examining diagnostic reclassification and diagnostic clarification using a novel natural language processing (NLP) pipeline. Method: A retrospective observational study was conducted using 220 adult outpatient neuropsychological evaluation reports from the National Neuropsychology Network. A rule-based NLP pipeline extracted and harmonized pre-evaluation referral diagnoses and post-evaluation clinician diagnoses from reports in the UCLA electronic health records into structured diagnostic profiles. Diagnostic reclassification, diagnostic specificity gain, and changes in diagnostic category distributions were quantified. Exploratory analyses examined demographic correlates of diagnostic clarification. Results: Diagnostic reclassification was common following neuropsychological evaluation. Overall, 87.7% of patients received at least one new diagnosis, 55.0% had at least one preexisting diagnosis not retained, and 84.5% demonstrated increased diagnostic specificity. Among patients with nonspecific cognitive symptom codes, 90.1% transitioned to formal psychiatric, neurological, or neurocognitive diagnoses. Collectively, these changes shifted diagnostic profiles away from nonspecific cognitive diagnoses toward more specific formal psychiatric and neurocognitive diagnoses (all p < .001). Exploratory demographic associations were modest. Conclusions: Neuropsychological evaluation provides substantial incremental diagnostic information beyond referral documentation by increasing diagnostic specificity and refining diagnostic formulation. These pilot findings establish diagnostic clarification as a measurable clinical outcome and demonstrate the potential of NLP to transform routine neuropsychological reports into scalable metrics for evaluating the clinical impact of neuropsychological services.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究关注神经心理评估在诊断上的实际贡献，采用基于规则的自然语言处理流程，从成人门诊评估报告中提取并统一评估前后的诊断信息，量化诊断重分类和诊断特异性变化。结果显示，评估后诊断重分类相当常见：多数患者获得至少一个新诊断，部分原有诊断未被保留，且大多数患者的诊断特异性提高；原本仅有非特异性认知症状编码的患者，多数转为正式的精神科、神经科或神经认知诊断，整体诊断谱由模糊认知诊断转向更具体的诊断。作者据此认为，神经心理评估在转诊资料之外提供了可观的增量诊断信息，并将诊断澄清确立为可测量的临床结局，同时展示了自然语言处理把常规报告转化为可扩展评估指标的潜力；不过这只是初步观察性研究，相关人口学关联较弱，结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Comparison of recommendations for initial adult traumatic brain injury management across clinical practice guidelines and consensus statements: a scoping review.
papers.authors: Arias-Obando A, Casanova-Cadavid S, Cardona-Collazos S, Delgado-Caicedo MG, Piragauta-Barrera LG, Santaella-Tenorio J, Villarreal-Mondragón A, Rubiano-Escobar AM.
papers.abstract: Objective Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a leading cause of mortality and disability worldwide. We conducted a scoping review to identify, map, and compare recommendations for the initial medical management of adult TBI. Methods Following Joanna Briggs Institute methodology and PRISMA-ScR, we searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, guideline repositories, and gray literature for English or Spanish language documents published from 2010 to 2026. Two reviewers independently screened records, charted recommendations across domains, and rated agreement using a priori categories; discrepancies were resolved by consensus or third reviewer. Results Sixteen documents met inclusion criteria, including guidelines, consensus statements, and best-practice recommendations. Broad agreement existed for early neurological assessment, airway protection, avoidance of hypotension and hypoxemia, and timely neuroimaging. Heterogeneity remained in blood pressure and cerebral perfusion pressure targets, repeat imaging, definitions of neurological deterioration, escalation criteria, observation protocols, and discharge processes. Anticonvulsant prophylaxis and venous thromboembolism prevention were inconsistently addressed. Blood-based biomarkers appeared in only three documents and were limited to computed tomography decision-making. Conclusions Although the fundamental principles of care were largely consistent, important differences remain in their operational implementation. Greater harmonization of clinical definitions and management pathways may facilitate more consistent application of evidence-based recommendations across healthcare settings.

papers.title: Graph diffusion convolution on multivariate weighted joint recurrence networks for seizure-state classification in intracranial EEG.
papers.authors: Cai Q, Hao Y, An J, Ma C, Li M, Gao Z.
papers.abstract: Discriminating interictal and ictal brain states is important for both seizure-state classification and the characterization of seizure-related network reorganization in drug-resistant epilepsy. Intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) provides high-resolution recordings of brain activity, but its sparse, irregular, and patient-specific electrode geometry requires models that go beyond Euclidean representations. In this work, we propose a multivariate weighted joint recurrence network coupled with a graph diffusion convolution network for binary interictal/ictal classification. Each iEEG segment is first embedded into a reconstructed phase space and transformed into a recurrence-based functional network, in which weighted edges quantify nonlinear dynamical coupling between implanted contacts. A graph diffusion convolution mechanism is then applied to capture higher-order dependencies across the implanted brain topology. On a nine-patient subset of the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania iEEG Epilepsy Dataset, the proposed framework achieved an average accuracy of 93.4% and outperformed standard graph convolutional and Euclidean deep-learning baselines. In addition, recurrence networks derived from ictal and interictal periods showed state-dependent differences in weighted topological organization, suggesting seizure-related reconfiguration of nonlinear brain-network dynamics. These results indicate that recurrence-based graph diffusion provides an effective and interpretable nonlinear framework for seizure-state classification and for modeling ictal network reorganization in iEEG.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对耐药性癫痫颅内脑电电极几何稀疏且个体化的问题，提出一种结合多变量加权联合递归网络与图扩散卷积的分类框架，用于区分发作间期与发作期脑状态。在九名患者的颅内脑电数据子集上，该框架的平均分类准确率高于标准图卷积和欧氏深度学习方法；同时，发作期与发作间期的递归网络在加权拓扑组织上呈现状态相关差异，提示癫痫发作伴随非线性脑网络动力学的重组。作者据此认为，基于递归的图扩散为癫痫状态分类和发作网络重组建模提供了一种有效且可解释的非线性途径。

papers.title: Phonological Skills Mediate the Association Between Left Beta/Gamma Oscillation and Reading Ability in Chinese Children.
papers.authors: Jia Y, Zhang L, Li Y, Zhao J.
papers.journal: Journal of speech, language, and hearing research : JSLHR
papers.abstract: Purpose This study aimed to investigate whether Chinese children with dyslexia exhibit atypical left-hemispheric beta/gamma oscillatory patterns during nonverbal auditory processing and to examine whether phonological skills mediate the relationship between these oscillations and reading ability. Method Forty-two Chinese children with dyslexia and 47 typically developing controls underwent electroencephalography recording while listening to amplitude-modulated white noise (1-80 Hz). Event-related spectral perturbation (ERSP) was quantified over the left- and right-hemisphere regions of interest. Behavioral assessments measured reading accuracy, phonological awareness, and rapid automatized naming. Results Compared to controls, children with dyslexia showed significantly reduced left-hemispheric beta/gamma oscillations and altered hemispheric asymmetry. Left-hemispheric ERSP was associated with reading accuracy in the dyslexia group. Mediation analysis confirmed that phonological skills partially mediated the relationship between left-hemispheric oscillations and reading accuracy. Conclusions The results provide electrophysiological evidence that Chinese children with dyslexia show reduced left-hemispheric beta/gamma responses and altered hemispheric asymmetry during nonverbal auditory processing. They further suggest that variation in left-hemispheric auditory oscillatory responses may be associated with literacy partly through phonological skills. Supplemental material https://doi.org/10.23641/asha.34024734.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察汉语阅读障碍儿童在非言语听觉加工中是否表现出左半球beta/gamma振荡异常，并检验语音技能是否在其中起中介作用。研究比较了阅读障碍儿童与典型发展儿童在听调幅白噪声时的脑电活动，并结合阅读准确性、语音意识和快速命名等行为测评。结果显示，阅读障碍儿童左半球beta/gamma振荡减弱、半球不对称性改变，且左半球振荡与阅读准确性相关；中介分析表明语音技能部分中介了左半球振荡与阅读准确性之间的关系。作者据此提出，左半球听觉振荡反应的个体差异可能部分通过语音技能与读写能力相关联，但这一关联并非因果结论。

papers.title: Different functional connectivity gradients reflect aging and Alzheimer's disease.
papers.authors: Rittmo J, Franzmeier N, Strandberg O, Chauveau L, Satterthwaite TD, Wisse LEM, Spotorno N, Behjat HH, Dehsarvi A, van Westen D, Anijärv TE, Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, Landau SM, Palmqvist S, Janelidze S, Stomrud E, Ossenkoppele R, Mattsson-Carlgren N, Hansson O, Vogel JW.
papers.abstract: Aging and Alzheimer's disease (AD) are accompanied by alterations to large-scale communication patterns in the brain, which can be tracked in vivo using functional connectivity. The location, direction and relevance of these changes remain widely debated, although they are rarely studied in the context of whole-cortex communication dynamics. Here, in two independent cohorts (BioFINDER-2, N = 973; Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, N = 129), we show that functional connectivity changes associated with aging and AD are strongly aligned with separate fundamental axes of hierarchical brain communication. Early accumulation of AD pathology and subsequent cognitive decline are both linked to functional change along the sensory-association axis. Meanwhile, age-related functional changes occur along the representation-executive axis consistently throughout the adult lifespan. These findings together suggest that both AD and aging alter major but orthogonal functional pathways in the brain. More broadly, our findings position whole-brain connectivity dynamics as a unifying framework for interpreting functional changes across the adult lifespan.

papers.title: Amygdala beta bursts modulate hippocampal neuronal dynamics during human emotional processing.
papers.authors: Zhou Y, Huang Y, Pittaro GF, Zareian B, Aljishi A, Toro AP, Zibly Z, Obaid S, Sivaraju A, Harpaz-Rotem I, Kaye A, Krystal J, Sheth K, Gu X, Pittenger C, Damisah EC.
papers.abstract: The amygdala and hippocampus are key structures in emotional processing, yet the transient neural dynamics coordinating their interaction remain poorly understood. We simultaneously recorded single-neuron activity and local field potentials from these regions in epilepsy patients performing an emotional image-rating task. Neurons in both regions exhibited firing rate changes predictive of subjective emotional valence. While conventional spectral analysis revealed no valence-specific patterns, beta bursts (13-30 Hz)-transient, high-power events-were selectively modified by task features. In both regions, beta bursts were associated with increased gamma amplitude and enhanced phase coherence, with beta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling capturing emotion-related dynamics. Critically, amygdala beta bursts were associated with valence-dependent, bidirectional modulation of hippocampal interneuron firing - decreased during very unpleasant/highest arousal processing and increased during high-arousal very pleasant processing - while putative pyramidal-cell firing did not change significantly. Hippocampal bursts showed no reciprocal influence. These findings suggest that beta bursts may represent a temporally precise neural correlate of emotional appraisal and a potential target for neuromodulation in mood disorders.

papers.title: Prenatal exposure to hypertensive disorders and adolescent brain white matter development.
papers.authors: Rebello V, Xia Y, Talge NM, Ahmadi H, Odegaard AO, Vieira VM, Gonzalez MR, Kan E, Boden-Albala B, Uban KA.
papers.abstract: Background Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) are associated with altered in utero neurodevelopment, yet long-term impact on adolescent white matter architecture remains unclear, particularly by HDP subtype and sex. While preeclampsia/eclampsia (P/E) is clinically more severe, pregnancy-related hypertension (PR-HTN) may involve longer in-utero exposure to hemodynamic stress. This study examined how distinct HDP exposures influence longitudinal white matter measures in adolescents. Methods Using a longitudinal cohort with two MRI timepoints (baseline ages 9-11 years; 2-year follow-up ages 11-13.8 years), we modeled fiber volume (FV) and fractional anisotropy (FA) using linear mixed-effects models. Analyses were sex-stratified and adjusted for prenatal exposures, maternal age, race/ethnicity, and income. False discovery rate (FDR) correction was applied. Results In female adolescents, PR-HTN was significantly associated with lower FV across bilateral association, projection, and limbic pathways, alongside reduced FV and FA in the corpus callosum and forceps major/minor (q < 0.05). Conversely, P/E exposure showed no FDR-significant associations. No significant associations were observed in males for either HDP subtype. Conclusion Chronic in-utero exposure to PR-HTN, rather than acute P/E, is associated with widespread reductions in white matter structural integrity in females. These findings support subtype-specific and developmentally sensitive associations between HDP exposure and offspring brain development. Impact This study demonstrates that pregnancy-related hypertension, a traditionally "milder" disorder, has more pronounced long-term impacts on adolescent white matter scaffolding than preeclampsia/eclampsia. The results highlight a female-specific vulnerability to chronic prenatal hypertensive stress, manifesting as reduced volumetric and microstructural integrity in critical commissural and association white matter tracts. These findings shift the clinical focus toward the neurodevelopmental risks of chronic gestational hypertension, suggesting that maternal cardiovascular health throughout the entire pregnancy is a vital determinant of offspring brain development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于纵向队列的两次脑MRI，考察孕期高血压障碍不同亚型与青少年白质发育的关联，并按性别分层分析。结果显示，在女性青少年中，妊娠相关高血压（而非子痫前期/子痫）与多条联络、投射和边缘纤维通路的纤维体积降低相关，胼胝体及大/小钳的纤维体积和分数各向异性也降低；男性中两种亚型均未见显著关联。作者据此认为，孕期慢性高血压暴露可能比临床更重的子痫前期/子痫对女性后代白质结构完整性影响更广，提示关联具有亚型特异性和性别特异性，但作为观察性关联尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: Teen depression and anxiety predicted by childhood brain development.
papers.authors: Kozlov M.

papers.title: Individual differences in motor and auditory activation in second language speech learning: Roles of domain-general auditory processing.
papers.authors: Saito-van Poeteren K, Tierney A, Takizawa K, Dardon DE, Liu C, Kachlicka M, Sugiura M, Jeong H.
papers.abstract: While existing models emphasize the critical roles of auditory and motor systems in speech perception, it remains unclear how individual learners differentially rely on these systems and how their relative weighting relates to language learning. This study investigates the neural mechanisms through which individual differences in domain-general auditory processing influence reliance on these networks during second language (L2) phonetic learning. Focusing on the acquisition of English [æ] and [ʌ] by 207 Japanese learners, we examined participants with varying auditory precision profiles using both behavioral and functional magnetic resonance imaging analyses as they performed discrimination tasks for speech and nonverbal sounds. The findings revealed a pattern consistent with a triangular relationship among learners' auditory precision, brain activation in motor-related regions, and L2 speech development. Learners with lower auditory precision tended to show less advanced L2 vowel proficiency and exhibited higher levels of sensorimotor activation during discrimination of English [æ] and [ʌ], but not during discrimination of nonspeech counterparts with comparable second formant variation. In light of theoretical accounts of adult L2 speech learning (Best & Tyler, 2007), one possible interpretation is that greater reliance on articulatory processing among less auditory-precise and less experienced or proficient L2 learners reflects the processing of L2 sounds through first language articulatory routines. In contrast, learners with higher auditory precision attained not only more advanced L2 vowel proficiency but also lower levels of sensorimotor activity, comparable to that observed during nonverbal processing, suggesting more balanced spectrotemporal and articulatory analyses of sounds, which optimize both the process and outcomes of L2 speech learning. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注一般听觉加工能力的个体差异如何影响第二语言语音学习中对听觉与运动系统的依赖。研究以日语学习者为对象，结合行为测量与功能磁共振成像，考察其在辨别英语元音及非言语声音时的表现。结果呈现出听觉精度、运动相关脑区激活与二语语音发展之间的三角关系：听觉精度较低者二语元音水平较差，且在辨别英语元音时感觉运动激活更高，而对非言语声音则无此差异；听觉精度较高者二语元音水平更好，感觉运动激活也更低。作者据此推测，前者可能更多借助母语发音习惯加工二语语音，后者则对声音的频谱时间与发音分析更为均衡，从而有利于二语语音学习的过程与结果。

papers.title: Getting off-tract: Correlational tractography of white matter integrity and cognitive intraindividual variability in a large sample of community-dwelling older adults.
papers.authors: Campbell IA, Hawley NA, Reames C, Renicks B, Aita SL, Del Bene VA, Hill BD, Health and Aging Brain Study (HABS-HD) Study Team.
papers.abstract: Objective Cognitive intraindividual variability (IIV), or the dispersion across neuropsychological task performance, is a sensitive marker of neurocognitive aging, but its tract-specific white matter correlates are not well characterized. This study used correlational tractography to identify pathways whose microstructural integrity relates to IIV in older adults. Method Participants were a diverse sample of 510 community-dwelling older adults (M age = 66.6 years, SD age = 8.4) from the Health and Aging Brain Study-Health Disparities cohort. IIV was computed as the intraindividual standard deviation of demographically normed performance T scores across a multidomain battery. Diffusion MRI connectometry in DSI Studio tested partial Spearman associations between IIV and quantitative anisotropy, adjusting for sex and intracranial volume, with permutation testing and false discovery rate adjustment (0.01). Results Higher IIV was associated with lower quantitative anisotropy primarily in commissural corpus callosum, fronto-subcortical, and interhemispheric long-range connection fibers. Tracts of the forceps minor were the most robust to sensitivity analyses. Effects were small in magnitude, with the primary connectometry threshold corresponding to an effect size of 0.09, but spatially specific, accounting for 7.57% of total whole-brain tract volume. Conclusions Overall, we found that IIV maps onto distributed, tract-specific differences in white matter microstructure. Findings support IIV as a marker linked to structural network-level white matter integrity and should motivate longitudinal work to further clarify its neuroanatomical substrates. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察社区居住老年人的认知个体内变异（即多项神经心理任务成绩的离散程度）与白质微结构完整性之间的关联，采用相关纤维束成像在较大样本中检验两者关系。结果显示，个体内变异较高主要与胼胝体、额叶-皮层下及半球间长程连接纤维的定量各向异性较低相关，其中小钳纤维束的结果在敏感性分析中最稳健；效应量较小但空间上具有特异性，仅占全脑纤维束体积的少部分。作者据此认为，认知个体内变异与分布式、纤维束特异的白质微结构差异相联系，可作为反映结构性网络层面白质完整性的标志，但这一关联的因果方向尚不明确，仍需纵向研究澄清其神经解剖基础。

papers.title: Altered voxel-based and surface-based morphometry in insomnia with short and normal objective sleep duration.
papers.authors: Zhang H, Lv Z, Chen H, Tang Z, Lei X.
papers.abstract: Objective Two subtypes of insomnia, classified by objective sleep duration, exhibit distinctly different clinical presentations. However, the brain morphological differences between subtypes remain poorly understood. This study aimed to compare the morphological differences between the objective short sleep duration (ISSD) and normal sleep duration (INSD) subtypes, using both voxel-based and surface-based morphometry analyses. We sought to determine whether morphological differences could serve as valid biomarkers to differentiate the subtypes. Method Forty ISSD and 39 INSD were included in the study. T1-weighted images were acquired. Both voxel-based and surface-based morphological metrics, including gray matter volume, cortical thickness, cortical gyrification, cortical complexity, and sulcus depth, were compared between the two subtypes. The identified structural differences were then used as features to train a support vector machine model to distinguish the two subtypes. Results No significant differences were found in cortical thickness, cortical gyrification, or cortical complexity between the ISSD and INSD subtypes. However, ISSD showed a significant reduction in gray matter volume in the bilateral putamen, while INSD exhibited a significant reduction in gray matter volume in the bilateral cerebellum. In terms of sulcus depth, the right superior temporal gyrus showed a significant reduction in ISSD when compared with INSD. Using the support vector machine, the model correctly classified the two subtypes with an accuracy of 76.9%, sensitivity of 70.2%, specificity of 83.8%, and an area under the curve of 0.835. Conclusions ISSD and INSD differ in specific brain morphological features, and these findings may provide preliminary discriminative information at the group level. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了客观短睡眠时长型失眠（ISSD）与正常睡眠时长型失眠（INSD）在脑形态上的差异，并检验这些差异能否用于区分两种亚型。研究对两组受试者进行基于体素和基于表面的形态学分析，结果显示两组在皮层厚度、皮层脑回化和皮层复杂度上无显著差异，但灰质体积减少的部位不同：ISSD主要在双侧壳核，INSD主要在双侧小脑；ISSD右侧颞上沟深度也较INSD减小。以这些结构差异为特征训练的支持向量机模型在组水平上对两种亚型具有一定区分能力，作者据此认为这些形态特征可提供初步的鉴别信息，但尚不能推广为临床诊断依据。

papers.title: From microstates to network connectivity: Age-related differences in resting-state electroencephalography and their implications for cognitive abilities in adulthood.
papers.authors: Cui Y, Bai Y, Tan C, Bao L, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: The relationship between resting electroencephalography brain characteristics and cognitive abilities, particularly in the context of aging, remains unclear. In this study, we analyzed dynamic microstates, power spectrum, and functional connectivity in electroencephalography resting-state data collected from 123 younger individuals (17-32 years) and 99 older adults (60-81 years) experiencing normal aging, under both eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions. We also examined correlations between these brain features and cognitive abilities, including working memory, processing speed, and inhibition. Our results revealed age-related differences in the balance between microstates C' and D, as well as in power across the delta, theta, and alpha bands, and in intra- and interhemispheric connectivity patterns. Older adults also exhibited an anterior shift and decreased asymmetry in power. Notably, significant associations emerged between these brain features and cognitive abilities, particularly in forward and backward working memory, with the effects being more pronounced in the older group. Our findings indicate a decline in overall resting-state electroencephalography brain activity with age, along with a shift in the balance between attentional and default mode networks, emphasizing the strong connection between these neural changes and cognitive abilities. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察正常衰老过程中静息态脑电特征与认知能力的关系，分析了年轻人和老年人在睁眼、闭眼条件下的微状态、功率谱和功能连接。结果显示，老年人在微状态C'与D的平衡、多个频段功率以及半球内和半球间连接模式上均存在年龄差异，并表现出功率分布前移和不对称性降低。这些脑电特征与工作记忆等认知能力相关，且在老年组中关联更明显。作者据此认为，静息态脑电活动随年龄下降，注意网络与默认模式网络之间的平衡发生偏移，并强调这些神经变化与认知能力的密切联系。

papers.title: Targeting the Immune-Neurovascular Interface to Ameliorate Pericyte Dysfunction with a Multifunctional Peptide-Drug Conjugate Nanoprodrug for Multiple Sclerosis Therapy.
papers.authors: Mu Y, Wen K, Zhou L, Gu Z, Wang T, Li Y, Yang X, Liu X, Zhang X, Chi W, Zhang N, Yang P, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: Pericyte dysfunction triggers blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption and subsequent aberrant immune infiltration in multiple sclerosis (MS), yet targeted interventions remain lacking. Here, we engineered a dual-functional fusion peptide (VLC) for pericyte targeting and therapeutic intervention and subsequently conjugated it with luteolin to construct a peptide-drug conjugate (PDC)-based ROS-responsive nanoprodrug (VLC@Lut-NPs). This system significantly suppressed MMP-9 overactivation and mitigated neuroinflammation. To optimize the pharmacokinetic profile of the PDC nanotherapeutic, we adopted subcutaneous administration, achieving a prolonged circulation half-life and enhancing brain drug accumulation (AUCbrain) by 2.65-fold compared with intravenous injection. In two MS models, VLC@Lut-NPs restored pericyte homeostasis, reinforced BBB integrity, attenuated aberrant peripheral immune infiltration, and ultimately promoted myelin repair and regeneration. Notably, a once-every-other-day subcutaneous regimen outperformed daily intravenous administration. By bridging peripheral immunity and the neurovascular unit, this work identifies pericytes as a central regulatory node and establishes a pericyte-targeted PDC nanoplatform for durable MS treatment, highlighting its translational potential as a complementary strategy to conventional immunomodulatory approaches.

papers.title: ZnBr2-Assisted Br-Rich Regulation of Blue-Emitting CsPbBr3 Nanoplatelets Synthesized at Low Temperature.
papers.authors: Wen Z, Kang Y, Liang G, Xu M, Zhu Q, Zhai Y, Kang J, Wu T, Wang L.
papers.abstract: All-inorganic CsPbBr3 nanoplatelets (NPLs) have attracted considerable interest for light-emitting, wavelength-conversion, and flexible photonic applications owing to their high color purity, tunable bandgap, and excellent luminescence performance. However, their large specific surface area makes them highly susceptible to surface halide vacancies, which introduce abundant nonradiative recombination centers and thereby compromise both emission efficiency and thermal stability. Herein, CsPbBr3 NPLs with varying Br/Pb ratios were synthesized through a low-temperature hot-injection route, with ZnBr2 introduced as an additional Br source to elucidate the effects of Br-rich regulation on the microstructure, surface chemistry, and optical properties of the NPLs. The results show that ZnBr2 effectively passivates bromine-vacancy defects and optimizes the Pb-Br coordination environment while preserving the original crystal framework and ligand environment, thereby promoting radiative recombination. Under optimized conditions, the photoluminescence quantum yield increased from 26.7% at Br/Pb = 2 to 87.5% at Br/Pb = 6, while the average lifetime reached 11.78 ns. Temperature-dependent PL spectra further reveal that Br-rich regulation suppresses deep-trap-assisted nonradiative recombination and mitigates thermally activated energy dissipation. The resulting composite film not only exhibits efficient wavelength conversion but also enables direct visualization of ultraviolet optical paths on complex optomechanical components through robust interfacial adhesion. This work provides mechanistic insights into defect engineering and thermal stability enhancement in CsPbBr3 NPLs, while broadening their potential for flexible photonic integration.

papers.title: Flower-like NiMn LDH Microstructures as a Promising Cathode for High-Performance Hybrid Supercapacitors with Exceptional Energy Density.
papers.authors: Li Z, Wang G, Tu C, Tian F, Hu Y, Zhang X, Xu C, Chen H.
papers.journal: Langmuir : the ACS journal of surfaces and colloids
papers.abstract: The practical application potential of supercapacitors can be enhanced through designing high-performance electrode materials. In this work, NiMn layered double hydroxides (NiMn LDHs) were prepared through a hydrothermal method using hexamethylenetetramine (HMTA) as an alkaline source. The morphology of NiMn LDHs was regulated by controlling the amount of HMTA, and two kinds of flower-like NiMn LDH microstructures with large open voids (NiMn LDH-6) and dense smaller petals (NiMn LDH-10) were respectively synthesized using 6 and 10 mmol HMTA. When employed as electrode material in electrochemical energy storage, such three-dimensional structure helps to increase the surface area and expose more active sites, thereby promoting efficient electrolyte access and ion transport. These NiMn LDHs exhibited battery-type electrochemical behavior, and NiMn LDH-6 delivered the highest specific capacity of 795.3 C g-1, exceeding NiMn LDH-10 with 672.6 C g-1. Furthermore, LDH and activated carbon (AC) were employed as the cathode and anode, respectively, to assemble the hybrid supercapacitor (HSC) device. At 964.55 W kg-1, the NiMn LDH-6//AC delivered an exceptional specific energy of 60.94 W h kg-1, and even at higher power density of 8653.42 W kg-1, it remained 38.24 W h kg-1. Under a current load of 10 A g-1, both HSCs showed a slight capacity decay over 3,000 cycles. These findings indicate that the flower-like NiMn LDHs prepared through the current hydrothermal strategy possess promising potential in high-performance supercapacitor applications.

papers.title: Head Group-Induced Interfacial Water Rearrangement during Demulsification: A Study at the Molecular Level.
papers.authors: Zhao L, Ma Z, Xiang P, Chen Y, Zhou Y, Ye H, Gu F, Zhong C.
papers.journal: Langmuir : the ACS journal of surfaces and colloids
papers.abstract: Tight oil emulsions produced in tertiary oil recovery display ultrahigh stability, whereas conventional block polyether demulsifiers show inadequate demulsification performance under harsh high-temperature and high-salinity conditions. However, the relationship between the microstructure of demulsifiers and their demulsification performance remains inadequately understood at the molecular level. In this work, 12 anionic-nonionic and nonionic triblock polyether demulsifiers with distinct block sequences (PO-EO-PO, EO-PO-EO) and diversified head groups were rationally designed, and their demulsification performance and microscopic interaction mechanisms were systematically investigated by integrating molecular dynamics simulations and quantum chemical calculations. The results demonstrate that the type of head group imposes a more decisive effect on demulsification efficiency than the block sequence. Potential of mean force calculations reveal that demulsifiers functionalized with anionic head groups universally exhibit a low free energy barrier during the demulsification process. Analysis of the number and binding energy of hydrogen bonds between demulsifier molecules and water molecules validates that hydrogen bonding interactions dominate the entire demulsification process. Moreover, electrostatic potential analysis of demulsifier molecules verifies that the strength of such hydrogen bonding is not directly correlated with the electronegativity extremum of the head group, but with the area of the electrostatic potential region of the whole demulsifier molecule. Specifically, a larger regional area corresponds to more exposed hydrogen-bond acceptor sites and stronger hydrogen-bonding interactions. Calculations of the radius of gyration and solvent-accessible surface area confirm that demulsifier molecules adopt a more extended conformation in aqueous solution, resulting in higher interfacial coverage at the oil-water interface and more sufficient displacement of asphaltenes. More importantly, two-dimensional water density distribution profiles clearly visualize that anionic-nonionic block polyethers can induce the formation of multilayer ordered hydration layers around their head groups, which is distinctly different from the featureless uniform water distribution observed for nonionic demulsifiers. Finally, we define the concepts of interfacial water and bulk water in the demulsification process, and find that a higher proportion and greater thickness of interfacial water accelerate the rearrangement of the hydrogen bond network and the construction of water channels between droplets, thereby facilitating water droplet coalescence. These theoretical findings are highly consistent with reported experimental results showing that strongly electronegative functional groups in demulsifiers reconstruct the interfacial hydrogen bond network and break the rigid interfacial film, achieving a dehydration rate of up to 98.3% for tight oil emulsions. This study reveals the regulatory mechanism of head group type on demulsification performance at the molecular level and enriches the microscopic understanding of demulsification behaviors.

papers.title: Dietary Vitamin K2 Isoforms Restore Redox Balance, Organelle Integrity, and Genomic Stability under Streptozotocin-Induced Oxidative Stress in Differentiated SH-SY5Y Cells.
papers.authors: Shandilya S, Ruokolainen J.
papers.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
papers.abstract: Among the two dietary vitamin K2 isoforms, MK-4 is abundantly found in the brain, and MK-7 is well absorbed and has a longer half-life. Beyond canonical functions, these dietary vitamin K2 vitamers have emerged as bioactive nutrients with potential cytoprotective properties. However, their presence in the brain and their functional relevance in modulating oxidative-stress-associated organelle damage, genomic instability, and neurite integrity remain insufficiently characterized. Streptozotocin led to impaired cellular bioenergetics, followed by organelle damage and genotoxicity. Post-treatment with MK-4 and MK-7 significantly attenuated ROS accumulation, enhanced antioxidant capacity, and preserved mitochondrial functional integrity, as evidenced by improved mitochondrial footprint, reduced mitochondrial ROS, restored ATP levels, and regulated mitophagy. Furthermore, vitamin K2 isoforms mitigated endoplasmic reticulum/Golgi stress, significantly reduced DNA damage, and improved neurite growth. Thus, vitamin K2 isoforms function as multifunctional dietary bioactive compounds with potential relevance for maintaining cell homeostasis during oxidative-stress-associated neuronal dysfunction.

papers.title: Brain structure correlates of circulating endocannabinoids and related lipids in early adolescents.
papers.authors: Baacke KA, Kaiver CM, Shankula CA, Sullivan RM, Stinson EA, Hanchon Z, Hillard CJ, Lisdahl KM.
papers.abstract: The endocannabinoid (eCB) system underlies many biological processes and is thought to be critical in adolescent brain development. However, the eCB system's contributions to brain morphometry during adolescence remains understudied. Here we investigated cross-sectional associations between brain structure and circulating eCBs and related lipids in a subsample of adolescents (N = 294, ages 10-14, 44.5% female, 65.3% White) from the Adolescent Brain and Cognitive Development (ABCD) study utilizing a structural equation modeling approach. After accounting for sex and age, significant covariance between circulating eCBs and related lipids and cortical thickness, surface area, and volume in brain regions throughout the cortex were revealed. While the mechanisms underlying these associations need further research, these results suggest that the eCB system likely plays a critical role in early-adolescent brain development. Future work should determine underlying mechanisms, evaluate these associations longitudinally, and consider sex differences and the modulatory effects of pubertal hormones.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青春期早期循环内源性大麻素及相关脂质与脑形态结构之间的关系，利用ABCD研究中一部分青少年的横断面数据，采用结构方程模型进行分析。在控制性别和年龄后，研究发现循环内源性大麻素及相关脂质与大脑皮层多个区域的皮层厚度、表面积和体积存在显著协变。作者指出，这些关联背后的机制尚待进一步研究，但结果提示内源性大麻素系统可能在青春期早期大脑发育中发挥重要作用；未来需通过纵向研究检验关联方向，并考察性别差异和青春期激素的调节作用。

papers.title: Neuroimaging in the era of biologically defined Alzheimer's disease and disease-modifying therapy.
papers.authors: Benzinger TLS, Cogswell PM, Arani A, Chaney AM, Hutson K, Glasser MF, Graff-Radford J, McConathy J, Raji CA, Teunissen C, Vemuri P, Zaharchuk G, Jack CR.
papers.abstract: Disease-modifying therapies and biomarker-based diagnostic frameworks will fundamentally altered the clinical diagnosis and management of Alzheimer's disease. Diagnosis is increasingly anchored in the biological evidence of pathology rather than clinical presentation alone, with implications for treatment eligibility, prognosis, and monitoring. In clinical practice, patients with memory complaints can present with complex mixed pathologies that develop across the lifespan. Brain imaging, particularly MRI and PET, plays a crucial role in visualising these cumulative abnormalities. With Alzheimer's disease-specific therapies now available in many regions of the world, amyloid PET plays a central role in establishing Alzheimer's disease diagnosis, determining eligibility for amyloid-targeting therapies, and quantifying treatment-related amyloid clearance. In settings where available, tau PET informs biological stage, prognosis, and clinical heterogeneity. MRI remains indispensable for differential diagnosis, the assessment of comorbid and vascular pathology, and monitoring for complications, particularly amyloid-related imaging abnormalities. Technological advances-including quantitative imaging, artificial intelligence, accelerated acquisition, and workflow optimisation-are improving reliability, efficiency, and access to these tools. Neuroimaging is now a cornerstone of Alzheimer's disease care and a crucial discriminator tool for characterising brain injury across the lifespan. With emerging fluid biomarkers, neuroimaging supports accurate diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment monitoring.

papers.title: Childhood maltreatment and the developing brain: toward individualized models of psychiatric risk.
papers.authors: Wang HR, Bearden CE, Ho TC.
papers.abstract: Childhood maltreatment shapes brain development in ways that vary by adversity type, developmental timing, and genetic vulnerability to psychiatric illness-a heterogeneity that conventional approaches capture poorly. We contend that normative modeling, multivariate methods, and polygenic risk scores offer complementary frameworks for parsing this variability and advancing mechanistic insights and clinical stratification.

papers.title: Depression: higher temporal variability of the functional connectivity of the ventromedial prefrontal cortex and hippocampal system.
papers.authors: Chen Y, Rolls ET, Yu Y, Huang CC, Luo Q, Cheng W, Wang X, Zhang T, Feng J.
papers.abstract: It is important to understand the brain differences found in depression in the first episode untreated state, to ensure that differences related to depression and not to the treatments or long-term effects of being depressed are identified. Resting state functional connectivity was measured in 172 patients with not yet treated first-episode major depressive disorder (MDD) with a mean age of 22 years, and 237 healthy controls (HC), using the Human Connectome Project Multimodal Parcellation atlas. Higher temporal variability of resting state functional connectivity was found in depression of ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC) and medial orbitofrontal cortex regions including 10r, 10v and OFC implicated in reward, and the medial temporal lobe / hippocampal memory system, and for some lateral orbitofrontal cortex regions, in the right hemisphere. These functional differences in depression were found with only two significant differences between the MDD patients and the controls in the volumes of cortical regions, and no significant differences in the weighted streamline numbers between cortical regions measured with diffusion tractography, so functional measures of cortical function are more revealing in this first-episode cohort about brain differences in depression than anatomical differences. The results greatly extend by use of a young first-episode cohort not yet receiving medication our understanding of how a ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC) reward-related region with major connectivity with orbitofrontal cortex emotion systems and hippocampal memory systems have increased temporal variability and reduced stability in depression, and have implications for treatment, including that this vmPFC reward system should be treated.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注未用药的首发抑郁症患者在脑功能上的差异，比较了患者与健康对照的静息态功能连接，并结合皮层体积和弥散示踪纤维束指标。结果显示，患者腹内侧前额叶、内侧眶额皮层及内侧颞叶/海马记忆系统的功能连接时间变异性升高，部分右侧外侧眶额区域也如此；而皮层体积和纤维束数量上两组差异很少或无显著差异。作者据此认为，在这一年轻首发队列中，功能指标比解剖指标更能揭示抑郁相关脑差异，提示涉及奖赏与情绪、记忆系统的腹内侧前额叶网络稳定性下降，并讨论了其对治疗的潜在意义。

papers.title: [<sup>18</sup>F]-flutemetamol across acquisition timeframes: clinical interpretability combining visual read and Centiloids.
papers.authors: Bollack A, Buckley C, Battle M, Smith R, Stromrud E, Mattsson-Carlgren N, Palmqvist S, Hansson O, Takemoto S, March A, La Joie R, Schwarz AJ, Farrar G.
papers.abstract: Background Quantification is now in the prescribing information of amyloid-PET tracers allowing its use to support visual read. As Centiloid (CL) scaling is increasingly used for decision-making, its robustness to scanning parameters is essential. We aim to examine the impact of timing on the interpretability of [18 F]-flutemetamol PET scans, combining visual read and quantification. Methods We analysed two datasets: (1) real-world static scans from the IDEAS study (N = 499), and (2) 'dynamic' data reconstructed into pseudo-static frames in the same individual at varying start times (N = 89). Visual reads were performed by local and expert readers. Linear models were used to assess the impact of acquisition start time and duration on CL quantification. Measurement variability was compared to test-retest repeatability. Results Visual interpretation was robust across start times, with no significant impact on the ability to classify scans as amyloid positive/negative. Some amyloid-negative scans acquired earlier (60-80 min start-time) exhibited lower grey-white matter contrast, which could reduce expert reader confidence. Quantitative analysis showed that CL values increased with later acquisition times, especially for amyloid-positive scans. In the intermediate CL range (10-30), differences between acquisitions starting at 60 vs 90 min were within expected test-retest variability (<6CL). Group-level adjustment factors can partially mitigate timing effects, but substantial individual variability remains. Discussion With the presently available data, the individual-level effect of acquisition start time on CL cannot be reliably and accurately estimated from static imaging. Combined visual and quantitative assessment of [18 F]-flutemetamol PET scans across the recommended timeframe supports reliable clinical interpretation. Consistency in acquisition parameters is recommended for repeat scans.

papers.title: Cumulative burden of mild TBI in Veterans: Accelerated age-related regional white matter deterioration along major white matter pathways.
papers.authors: Robinson TD, Van Etten EJ, Hao S, Milberg WP, Fortier CB, Salat DH.
papers.abstract: Veterans experience mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) at significantly higher rates than civilians, alongside high rates of comorbid conditions such as PTSD, mood disorders, and alcohol abuse. These conditions have documented impacts on brain health that compound with age. Prior work has demonstrated reduced white matter (WM) integrity and greater age-related trends in WM deterioration in Veterans with mTBI compared to Veterans without mTBI. These studies provide important insights, yet were limited in their ability to differentiate mTBI effects from those of common comorbid conditions. It remains unclear whether specific WM tracts are more vulnerable to mTBI overall or if effects are limited to specific portions of tracts. This study assessed the impact of cumulative mTBI burden on WM aging in U.S. Veterans [n = 710, ages = 19-80, mean age = 37]. Associations between age, mTBI burden, and WM integrity measured via fractional anisotropy, and mean, axial, and radial diffusivity were analyzed using multivariate regression of whole-tract means and along-tract effect clustering via Freesurfer's TRACULA package. Whole-tract interactions by mTBI on age-related deterioration were found in the ventral cingulate bundle and optic radiation. Along-tract analysis identified interactions clusters along these and five additional tracts. In all cases, higher mTBI burden was associated with steeper cross-sectional relationships between age and microstructural integrity. mTBI differentially impacted specific sections of affected WM tracts. These results suggest greater age-related WM deterioration with higher mTBI burden after acute injury recovery extending into later age.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注美国退伍军人中累积轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）负担是否与白质老化加速有关，并试图在常见共病背景下区分mTBI本身的影响。研究对退伍军人样本的白质完整性指标与年龄、mTBI负担进行关联分析，同时考察整条白质纤维束和沿纤维束的局部效应。结果显示，mTBI负担越高，年龄与白质微结构完整性之间的横断面关系越陡，即与更明显的年龄相关白质退化相关；这种影响出现在部分纤维束及其特定节段，而非均匀分布于所有白质。作者据此提出，急性损伤恢复后较高的mTBI累积负担可能与延续至晚年的白质老化加速相关，但研究为横断面关联，尚不能确立因果。

papers.title: Extracellular vesicles: Multi-source regulatory mechanisms in hippocampal homeostasis.
papers.authors: Liu Q, Guo L.
papers.abstract: Hippocampal health is pivotal for memory, emotional regulation, and cognition. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) facilitate intercellular and inter-organ communication by transporting bioactive cargos; however, traditional research often overlooks systemic influences on the hippocampus in favor of local microenvironmental changes. This review synthesizes evidence demonstrating that hippocampal homeostasis is modulated by the organism's systemic state-including aging, obesity, and immune status-via EVs. We detail mechanisms by which EVs from peripheral organs (adipose tissue, gut/microbiota, lung, bone, muscle, liver, kidney, heart, and spleen) and central nervous system resident cells (neurons, microglia, astrocytes, neural stem cells, and endothelial cells) regulate hippocampal function. These multi-source EVs precisely modulate neurogenesis, inflammatory responses, and synaptic plasticity. Furthermore, we highlight the emerging role of migrasomes as a specialized subset of EVs in this regulatory landscape. By mapping this comprehensive EV-mediated network, we provide a holistic perspective on the crosstalk between the systemic environment and the hippocampus, offering novel insights and therapeutic strategies for diseases associated with hippocampal dysfunction.

papers.title: Advanced neuroimaging in rare diseases: The paradigm of quantification in the era of personalized medicine.
papers.authors: Moreno-Higueras M, Fatoul-Del Pino G, Piñar-Morales R, Martín-Noguerol T.
papers.abstract: Rare diseases frequently involve the central nervous system, posing significant diagnostic and monitoring challenges. Recent advances in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and neuroradiology have expanded the tools available for RD assessment, encompassing improvements in image acquisition, postprocessing techniques, and functional MRI sequences. Advanced postprocessing methods allow radiologists to derive additional quantitative information from conventional morphological images, including the segmentation and volumetric analysis of brain structures such as gray matter. Functional MRI techniques, such as Diffusion Weighted Imaging, Perfusion Weighted Imaging, or Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, further contribute objective metrics reflecting underlying pathophysiological processes, including water diffusion and tissue perfusion. Within the framework of personalized medicine, integrating these advanced neuroimaging approaches may improve diagnostic precision and support treatment monitoring, follow-up, and disease surveillance. This review highlights the application of advanced neuroimaging tools across a range of clinical scenarios relevant to rare diseases, including cranial and structural abnormalities, white matter disorders, tumor assessment, and vascular conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦罕见病累及中枢神经系统时诊断与监测困难的问题，梳理了磁共振成像及神经影像学在图像采集、后处理和功能序列方面的进展。作者指出，先进后处理可从常规形态学图像中提取脑结构分割与体积等定量信息，扩散加权成像、灌注加权成像和磁共振波谱等功能技术则提供反映水扩散、组织灌注等病理生理过程的客观指标。文章认为，在个体化医疗框架下整合这些工具可能提升诊断精度，并辅助治疗监测、随访和疾病管理，但相关应用仍属综述性梳理，实际临床效益尚待验证。

papers.title: Independent risk factors for new ischemic brain lesions on diffusion-weighted imaging after carotid artery stenting: A retrospective study.
papers.authors: Chen R, Jiang B, Zhu X, Liu Q, Sun J, Zhao Y, Xie D, Zhang Y.
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
papers.abstract: Background New ischemic brain lesions detected by diffusion-weighted imaging are common after carotid artery stenting, but factors independently associated with their occurrence remain incompletely defined. Methods This single-center retrospective study included 97 patients with ischemic stroke and moderate-to-severe atherosclerotic extracranial carotid artery stenosis, contributing 104 treated carotid arteries that underwent carotid artery stenting. Clinical characteristics, stenosis features, laboratory parameters, and imaging data were collected. Diffusion-weighted imaging was performed before and within 72 h after the procedure. Treated arteries were classified into NIBL and non-NIBL groups. Univariate analysis was followed by multivariable logistic regression to identify factors independently associated with post-CAS NIBLs. Results A total of 97 patients with 104 treated carotid arteries were included, of which 68 (65.38%) were associated with new ischemic brain lesions within 72 h after CAS. Univariate analysis identified several associated factors, including coronary heart disease, HDL-C, abnormal total cholesterol, serum albumin, antithrombin III, fibrinogen degradation products, and heart rate-related parameters. Multivariable logistic regression identified coronary heart disease, HDL-C, abnormal total cholesterol, and perioperative heart rate change as factors independently associated with NIBLs. These factors were summarized as the "3C-H" combination. Conclusion New ischemic brain lesions were frequently detected after carotid artery stenting. Coronary heart disease, HDL-C, abnormal total cholesterol, and perioperative heart rate change were independently associated with post-CAS NIBLs. Further prospective studies are needed to validate these findings.
papers.summary_zh: 该回顾性研究关注颈动脉支架置入术后扩散加权成像上新发缺血性脑病灶的独立相关因素，纳入因缺血性卒中合并中重度颅外颈动脉狭窄而接受支架治疗的颈动脉。术后短期内新发缺血性脑病灶较为常见，多因素分析提示冠心病、高密度脂蛋白胆固醇、总胆固醇异常及围术期心率变化与病灶发生独立相关，作者将其概括为“3C-H”组合。这些结果来自单中心回顾性关联分析，尚需前瞻性研究验证，不能据此推断因果或临床效果。

papers.title: A scientometric study on research trends and characteristics of Kimura disease.
papers.authors: Lv Z, Luo Y, Liu W, Yuan J.
papers.abstract: Background/purpose Kimura disease (KD) is an idiopathic condition that presents as a chronic, benign inflammatory disorder, typically affecting the head and neck region. The purpose of this study was to analyze the scientometric characteristics and research trends of KD. Materials and methods All the papers on KD were comprehensively retrieved from the Scopus database. The years of publication were divided into before 2012 and after 2012 in the analysis of research trends. Results There were 925 papers on KD, with total citations of 10,821 and the h index of 47. Eosinophilia, lymphadenopathy, nephrotic syndrome, angiofollicular lymph node hyperplasia, swelling, pruritus, proteinuria, eosinophilic granuloma, hypereosinophilia, subcutaneous nodule, asthma, edema, membranous glomerulonephritis were KD-related conditions. The trend of investigations has changed to CD20 antigen, creatinine, cheek, excisional biopsy, diagnostic imaging, positron emission tomography-computed tomography (PET-CT), abscess, erythema, membranous glomerulonephritis, IgG4 related disease, exophthalmos, hypertension, and complication after 2012. The trend of treatment has changed to adrenal cortex hormones, methylprednisolone, mycophenolate mofetil, methotrexate, cetirizine, monoclonal antibody, dupilumab, and drug withdrawal after 2012. There have always been common keywords such as pathology, immunoglobulin blood level, IgE, IgG, interleukin-4, eosinophil count, computer assisted tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, cervical lymph node, and head and neck. Conclusion This scientometric study for the first time elucidated the current scenario and research trends of KD, and would help in improving in reciprocal collaboration and communication for investigations on this disease.

papers.title: Biphasic remodeling and trabecular-cortical uncoupling in the jawbone during antiresorptive therapy and medication-related osteonecrosis: A quantitative imaging analysis.
papers.authors: Wei LY, Lee JC, Chiu CM, Kok SH, Lin HY, Chiu WY, Chang HH, Cheng SJ, Lee JJ.
papers.abstract: Background/purpose Although antiresorptive therapy (ART) is crucial for managing oncology-related skeletal complications, it carries a risk of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ). Because conventional radiography relies on subjective interpretation, detecting early necrotic transition remains challenging. This study aimed to establish objective, quantitative imaging criteria for jawbone remodeling and MRONJ onset by evaluating 2D fractal dimension (FD) and 3D CBCT cortical thickness under zoledronic acid or denosumab therapy. Materials and methods Panoramic radiographs and CBCT scans of cancer patients receiving zoledronic acid (ZA, n = 155) or denosumab (Dmab, n = 168), and healthy controls (n = 95) were analyzed. Longitudinal FD and contralateral and lesion-site cortical thicknesses were quantified to differentiate systemic remodeling from localized necrosis. Results Systemic ART induced widespread jawbone osteosclerosis, characterized by significant longitudinal FD increases (ZA: P < 0.05; Dmab: P < 0.001) and contralateral cortical thickening (P < 0.05). Conversely, MRONJ onset triggered a distinct trabecular-cortical uncoupling: a paradoxical reduction in FD (osteolysis) at the necrotic site (P < 0.05) concurrent with reactive periosteal cortical thickening, most pronounced on the lingual aspect (P < 0.001). ZA induced diffuse sclerosis, whereas Dmab-induced changes were localized to the anterior mandible. Conclusion Jawbone trabecular and cortical compartments exhibit distinct remodeling patterns during ART and osteonecrosis. Combining quantitative assessments of these compartments provides an objective, non-invasive method for monitoring skeletal burden and detecting early necrotic transitions before clinical bone exposure occurs.

papers.title: High resolution EEG microstate framework in fibromyalgia: An integrated multivariate and source localization approach to pain-related dynamics.
papers.authors: Soldic D, Martín-Buro MC, Rubio-González C, Peláez I, Ueda M, Ishii R, Yamada K, Ueno K, García-Montes M, Ferrera D, Fernandes-Magalhaes R, Mercado F.
papers.journal: International journal of psychophysiology : official journal of the International Organization of Psychophysiology
papers.abstract: Fibromyalgia (FM) is a nociplastic pain syndrome associated with altered central nervous system processing consistent with central sensitization, leading to enhanced pain perception. Despite its prevalence, the underlying neurophysiological mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we characterized resting-state EEG (RS-EEG) dynamics in FM using a high resolution microstate (MS) framework combined with multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) and source localization. 5-min eyes-closed RS-EEG was recorded from 57 female participants (29 FM patients and 28 healthy controls), and an 11-MS template was determined using the KL-GEV criterion. To assess the discriminative value of MS spatiotemporal features, we applied linear discriminant analysis with leave-one-out cross-validation. MS features were correlated with clinical measures, and source-level group differences were estimated using exact low-resolution electromagnetic tomography (eLORETA). MVPA identified MS G as the most discriminative state (AUC = 0.63), although it remained below commonly used thresholds for clinical interpretability (AUC > 0.75). Source-level analyses revealed significant differences in the insula (MS B and G), and in the middle frontal and postcentral gyri (MS E). No clinical associations survived correction for multiple comparisons, although exploratory trends suggested relationships between pain- and fatigue-related symptoms and MS B and E features. Overall, MVPA and eLORETA findings indicated altered spatiotemporal MS dynamics within somatosensory, salience, and executive networks in FM, consistent with central sensitization and dysfunction across large-scale pain networks. These findings highlight the potential of RS-EEG MS as candidate markers of pain-related neurophysiological heterogeneity within established FM, while their diagnostic utility remains to be established.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注纤维肌痛患者静息态脑电微状态动力学是否改变，以及这些特征能否区分患者与健康对照。作者对女性参与者记录闭眼静息脑电，结合微状态分析、多变量模式分析和源定位进行比较。多变量分析中微状态G的区分能力最突出，但未达到常用临床可解释阈值；源水平上，患者在内岛叶、额中回和中央后回等涉及躯体感觉、显著性和执行网络的区域表现出差异。临床症状与微状态特征之间未发现经多重比较校正后仍存活的相关，仅呈探索性趋势。作者认为结果提示纤维肌痛存在大尺度疼痛网络相关的时空动力学改变，静息态微状态有望成为刻画疼痛相关神经生理异质性的候选标记，但其诊断价值尚待确立。

papers.title: Exploring Auditory Attention Decoding to go with mobile and portable hardware.
papers.authors: Haupt T, Straetmans L, Adiloglu K, Bleichner MG, Debener S.
papers.abstract: Auditory attention decoding (AAD) has emerged as a promising approach for neuroadaptive hearing technology. However, its feasibility in naturalistic, mobile settings remains underexplored. In this study, we investigated AAD using a minimal and wearable setup comprising of around-the-ear EEG and portable hearing aid research hardware. Participants performed an auditory attention task under both controlled (seated) and naturalistic (walking) conditions with varying auditory scene complexity (single- and dual-speaker conditions, cafeteria background noise). We applied both backward (decoding) and forward (encoding) models to assess attention-dependent neural tracking of continuous speech. Decoding results replicated established trends, with the highest reconstruction accuracy for the single speaker, followed by dual-speaker attend, and then ignored. These trends were extended to the seated and walking contexts, initially demonstrating the potential of cEEGrids for mobile AAD. Post hoc forward modeling revealed an artifactual response in the walking condition, biasing the reconstruction and prediction accuracy. Further analysis indicated that this effect could reflect hardware-related interference, possibly from contact between hearing aid cables and electrodes. Importantly, the artifact, while speech-locked, was detectable only through the forward model. Despite these constraints, our results demonstrate the feasibility of decoding auditory attention using a lightweight, unobtrusive EEG system in stationary scenarios. This work emphasizes the need for robust hardware integration, real-time validation, and user-centered design in future AAD applications. Our findings add a critical step towards practical brain-computer interface solutions for hearing support in everyday environments and highlight the importance of interpretable methods in application-driven research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察听觉注意解码（AAD）能否在自然移动场景下用轻量可穿戴设备实现，采用耳周脑电（cEEGrids）与便携助听器研究硬件，让参与者在坐姿和行走条件下完成不同复杂度的听觉注意任务，并用解码与编码两类模型评估对连续语音的注意相关神经追踪。解码结果复现了既有趋势：单说话者条件重建准确率最高，其次是双说话者中注意目标，再次是被忽略语音，这一趋势也延伸到坐姿和行走情境，初步显示耳周脑电用于移动AAD的潜力。但事后前向建模发现行走条件存在伪迹，会偏倚重建与预测准确率，分析提示可能与硬件干扰有关，例如助听器线缆与电极接触，且该伪迹虽与语音锁时却只能通过前向模型检出。作者据此认为，在静止场景下用轻便、不显眼的脑电系统解码听觉注意是可行的，但未来应用需重视稳健的硬件集成、实时验证和以用户为中心的设计，并强调应用驱动研究中可解释方法的重要性。

papers.title: Identification of novel CDK19 variants and Drosophila-based in vivo functional evidence supporting pathogenicity in neurodevelopmental disorders.
papers.authors: Koh HY, Sahu RK, Kim SD, Tanaka T, Grewal KS, Liao JZ, Shim YK, Garg R, Krey I, Bothe V, Szczałuba K, Fosbinder E, Patat O, Lines MA, Leeuwen L, Frazier L, Hannibal M, Starks C, Verheyen EM, Zarate YA, Chung HL.
papers.journal: Genetics in medicine : official journal of the American College of Medical Genetics
papers.abstract: Purpose CDK19 (HGNC:19338) is a Mediator-associated kinase that regulates transcription during neurodevelopment. Although CDK19 variants have been linked to neurodevelopmental disorders, the full phenotypic spectrum and the underlying pathogenic mechanisms remain incompletely defined. We aimed to further characterize clinical-genetic correlations and to elucidate disease mechanisms through integrative functional and transcriptomic approaches. Methods Through an international collaboration, 28 individuals with CDK19 variants (12 newly identified and 16 previously reported) were evaluated using systematic clinical phenotyping. To assess the functional consequences of the variants identified in affected individuals, Drosophila models expressing CDK19 alleles were generated and examined for viability, lifespan, motor behavior, and seizure susceptibility. Protein stability, subcellular localization, tissue morphology, and transcriptomic alterations were assessed by western blot, immunofluorescence, and RNA sequencing of larval brains. Results All individuals demonstrated global developmental delay, with speech delay as a consistently prominent feature; 8 of 12 (67%) had epilepsy, most commonly infantile epileptic spasms syndrome. Hypotonia was present in 6 of 12 (50%) individuals, and craniofacial dysmorphisms and abnormal brain magnetic resonance imaging findings were also frequent. Several pathogenic alleles exhibited reduced protein stability, aberrant nuclear localization, and tissue toxicity, with associated structural abnormalities, including elongated mitochondria, thickened myofibrils, and shortened sarcomeres. Behavioral assays revealed motor incoordination and allele-specific seizure susceptibility. RNA sequencing identified consistent downregulation of synaptic and neuromuscular genes, including GluRIIA, VGAT, nAChRβ1, and Syn, implicating disrupted neurotransmission and impaired neuromuscular junction integrity. These findings, obtained in an overexpression-based allele-comparison system, are interpreted as supportive functional evidence of variant pathogenicity. Conclusion These findings corroborate and further refine the clinical spectrum of CDK19-related neurodevelopmental disorders and provide in vivo functional evidence that pathogenic CDK19 variants are associated with the disruption of transcriptional programs relevant to synaptic and neuromuscular function, supporting CDK19 dysfunction as part of the emerging spectrum of Mediator complexopathies.

papers.title: How School-Based Interventions Shape the Developing Brain during 3-12 Years: A Systematic Review and Exploratory Meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Li J, Huang R, Li H.
papers.abstract: The effects of school-based interventions (SBIs) on children's neurodevelopment are poorly synthesized. This systematic review integrates neuroscientific evidence on how structured educational activities influence brain development in children aged 3-12 years. Following PRISMA guidelines, we identified 17 empirical studies (published 2014-2025) using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), electroencephalography (EEG), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), or magnetoencephalography (MEG). Of these, 8 studies were included in a random-effects meta-analysis and all 17 in a thematic synthesis. The meta-analysis revealed a preliminary association between SBIs and reduced amygdala activity during stress regulation tasks (r = -.28, 95% CI [-.50, -.02]), based on two studies, which should be interpreted as exploratory rather than confirmatory. No significant pooled effect for executive function, likely due to high heterogeneity. Thematic analysis distinguishes between mechanisms of plasticity and markers of intervention effectiveness: the first three characterize intra-individual mechanisms of experience-dependent plasticity, including (1) executive function interventions engaged prefrontal networks through both increased recruitment and enhanced neural efficiency; (2) socio-emotional programs modulated limbic-prefrontal circuits; (3) language and auditory programs shaped sensory-specific electrophysiological markers and cortical specialization; and the fourth theme identifies a neural marker of the effective process of intervention delivery, demonstrating that (4) teacher-child inter-brain synchrony was positively correlated with learning outcomes. By integrating findings across neural, cognitive, and affective domains, this review provides a conceptual framework linking pedagogical practices to neural plasticity and advances the understanding of the neurofunctional pathways through which educational experiences shape the developing brain.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述与探索性元分析整合了3至12岁儿童中基于学校干预的神经科学证据，纳入采用fNIRS、EEG、MRI或MEG的实证研究，并区分可塑性机制与干预有效性标记。元分析仅提示学校干预与压力调节任务中杏仁核活动降低存在初步关联，但该结果基于少量研究，应视为探索性而非确证性；执行功能未见显著合并效应，可能源于高异质性。主题分析进一步归纳出执行功能干预调动前额网络、社会情绪项目调节边缘—前额回路、语言与听觉项目塑造感觉特异性电生理标记，以及师生脑间同步与学习结果正相关等路径，为理解教育经验如何经神经可塑性影响发展提供了概念框架。

papers.title: Chunking: What working memory gains and loses.
papers.authors: Xie Y, Zhang H, Wang L.
papers.abstract: Chunking compresses information into fewer meaningful units, reducing working memory demands. During chunking, neural representations in the prefrontal cortex exhibit reduced dimensionality and are biased toward chunk centers, suggesting lossy compression that improves overall retention while reducing precision within chunks.

papers.title: Real-time fMRI feedback guides self-generated cognition toward upregulation of hippocampal activity.
papers.authors: van de Langenberg SCN, Gurevitch G, Markovits T, Singer N, Ben-Yakov A, Hendler T, Schwabe L.
papers.abstract: The hippocampus is crucial for mental time travel and visuospatial processing, with dysfunction having major implications for aging, stress resilience, and mental health. While external neurostimulation methods can modulate hippocampal activity, effective real-world interventions require flexible, self-guided approaches. Building on recent demonstrations of endogenous hippocampal control in rodents, we show in two real-time fMRI neurofeedback studies (n = 141) that human participants can harness self-generated mental states to upregulate hippocampal activity within a single training session. Crucially, engagement in hippocampus-relevant mental strategies did not predict upregulation capacity in a yoked sham-control group that received similar task instructions but no feedback correlated with hippocampal state fluctuations. This suggests that contingent feedback is required to identify or refine cognitive content that effectively upregulates hippocampal activity. Training with contingent feedback significantly enhanced upregulation capacity across all hippocampal subfields compared with the sham protocol, and this effect was absent in the untargeted yet functionally connected entorhinal cortex. Across both studies, successful hippocampal upregulation was associated with co-activation of medial temporal and default-mode network regions. Additionally, successful hippocampal upregulation during later training runs was associated with multivariate pattern shifts in this hippocampal-upregulation network at event boundaries during subsequent movie viewing, suggesting that neurofeedback training may alter boundary-related neural representations during naturalistic experience. These findings reveal that contingent hippocampal feedback can facilitate the acquisition of self-neuromodulation via mental strategies, with potential implications for interventions targeting hippocampus-dependent functions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人能否通过自我生成的心理状态在单次训练内上调海马活动，并比较了实时fMRI神经反馈与接受相同任务指令但无海马相关反馈的对照方案。结果显示，只有与海马状态波动相关的反馈才有助于识别或精炼有效的认知策略，反馈训练提升了所有海马亚区的上调能力，而功能相连但未作为靶点的内嗅皮层未见同样效果。成功的海马上调伴随内侧颞叶和默认模式网络区域共同激活，且后续训练中的成功上调与自然观影时事件边界处该网络的多变量模式变化相关，提示反馈训练可能改变自然体验中的边界相关神经表征。

papers.title: Serotonin biology as a basis for explaining psychedelic drug action.
papers.authors: Knox CA, Li-Wu A, Kwan AC.
papers.abstract: Psychedelics exert their effects primarily through the serotonergic system. Like the endogenous neuromodulator, the drugs bind to many serotonin receptor subtypes. However, their receptor selectivity profiles and spatiotemporal patterns of action differ from those of serotonin and vary across compounds. In this review, we summarize studies that have established roles for serotonin in three domains: reward learning, visual processing, and cerebrovascular function. We contrast the neurophysiological and behavioral consequences of endogenous serotonin release with those produced by exogenous psychedelic administration. We propose that several major effects of psychedelics can be understood as perturbations to serotonergic signaling, while also noting some drug actions that remain difficult to explain by existing serotonin biology. Viewing psychedelic drug action through the lens of serotonin provides a mechanistic framework for linking molecular pharmacology to circuit dynamics and behavior.

papers.title: Integrative EEG/fMRI evidence for a multi-scale network underlying self-face and personal-object recognition.
papers.authors: Kotlewska I, Panek B, Bielski K, Asanowicz D.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: The sense of ownership of our faces and possessions shapes our visual perception. While the neural basis of self-face recognition has been well-studied, the neural basis of recognizing personally owned objects remains poorly understood. The main aim of this study was to investigate brain activity underlying self-face and personal object recognition, with a particular focus on the extent to which the ownership processing can be characterized as either domain-general and/or stimulus-specific. We first review the relevant literature and then report findings from two experiments - one using EEG and the other fMRI - in which the same 30 participants categorized images of faces and objects as either "mine" or "others". EEG results revealed ownership-related visuo-midfrontal activity, reflected in event-related potentials (visual P1 and N170, and midfrontal N150 and SMN), frequency-specific inter-source phase coherence (in theta band), and brain-wide time-frequency power dynamics (in alpha, beta, and theta bands). fMRI results identified ownership-related activity in four right hemisphere regions: the inferior temporal gyrus, middle frontal gyrus, inferior frontal gyrus, and superior parietal lobule; each of which formed distinct ownership-related subnetworks. The findings support "a hybrid model" in which stimulus-specific visual pathways (e.g., face-sensitive regions) interact with domain-general frontal activity encoding self-relevance. This integrative evidence clarifies how a dynamic, multi-scale network underlying ownership perception is constructed across time, frequency, and brain space.

papers.title: Epileptic hub in MRI-negative focal cortical dysplasia using advanced dynamic statistical parametric mapping and magnetoencephalography.
papers.authors: Hiramatsu Y, Nakajima M, Takeuchi F, Narugami M, Yamada S, Nakakubo S, Goto T, Kimura S, Ueda Y, Fujima N, Hirata K, Ishida Y, Aburakawa Y, Iijima K, Iwasaki M, Enatsu R, Mikuni N, Shiraishi H, Manabe A, Egawa K.
papers.abstract: Objective Localization of epileptogenic MRI-negative focal cortical dysplasia at the bottom of the sulcus (FCDB) is challenging. This study evaluated the utility of advanced dynamic statistical parametric mapping (AdSPM), a magnetoencephalography (MEG)-based source analysis method, for detecting epileptic MRI-negative FCDB. Methods We retrospectively analyzed MEG data using AdSPM in four patients with pathologically confirmed MRI-negative FCDB, whose seizure onset zones were identified by intracranial video-EEG (IVEEG). The most active area identified by the AdSPM was designated as the AdSPM spike source. We compared the spatial concordance of the AdSPM spike source, single moving dipole (SMD) findings, and 18 F-FDG PET/MRI findings with seizure onset and resection areas. An additional MRI-negative patient without seizures during IVEEG monitoring was analyzed separately for concordance with the resection area. Results The AdSPM spike source localized to the seizure onset zone and was included in the resection area in all four patients with an identified seizure onset zone. SMD findings were mislocalized relative to the seizure onset zone and resection area. PET/MRI was concordant with the seizure onset zone in one of three evaluable patients and with the resection area in three of four patients. In the patient without seizures during IVEEG, AdSPM and PET/MRI were concordant with the resection area; however, the SMD findings were mislocalized. Conclusions AdSPM noninvasively and neurophysiologically localizes epileptic MRI-negative FCDB and may provide useful information for presurgical evaluations. Significance This is the first diagnostic application of AdSPM for MRI-negative FCDB.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨了基于脑磁图的高级动态统计参数映射（AdSPM）能否在MRI阴性的局灶性皮质发育不良（位于脑沟底部）患者中定位致痫区，回顾性分析了经病理证实的病例，并以颅内视频脑电图确定的发作起始区和切除范围作为参照。结果显示，AdSPM识别出的棘波源在所有可确定发作起始区的患者中均与发作起始区一致，并落在切除范围内；相比之下，单移动偶极子定位出现偏差，PET/MRI的一致性则较为有限。作者认为，AdSPM可无创地从神经电生理角度定位此类MRI阴性病灶，或有助于术前评估，但结论基于少量病例，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Clinical validation of autoSCORE: A human-in-the-loop AI tool for interpretation of long-term EEG recordings.
papers.authors: Tveit J, Aurlien H, Husain AM, Tarazi A, Diehl B, Gallentine W, Tatum WO, Hahn CD, Schulze DG, Terney D, Schomer DL, Aanestad E, Gardella E, Westhall E, Gonzalez-Giraldo E, Catenaccio E, Cox F, Fahoum F, Tankisi H, Hjelland I, Brøgger J, Hébert J, Xiong K, Nilsen KB, Goldstein L, Ulvin L, Henning OJ, Kaplan PW, Omland P, Pearl PL, Arya R, Wennberg R, Markhus R, Massey SL, Schuele S, Kessler SK, Pang T, Frauscher B, Beniczky S.
papers.journal: Clinical neurophysiology : official journal of the International Federation of Clinical Neurophysiology
papers.abstract: Objective To validate autoSCORE, a convolutional neural network (SCORE-AI) implemented into a commercially available EEG reader, for analysis of long-term EEG (LT-EEG) recordings, and to evaluate it within the human-in-the-loop approach. Methods autoSCORE automatically divides LT-EEG into 2-hour segments, labeling each as normal or as containing one or more of four abnormality categories: focal epileptiform, generalized epileptiform, focal non-epileptiform, or diffuse non-epileptiform.
