The diffusion tensor imaging-analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) has been proposed as a non-invasive MRI marker of glymphatic flow, although its biological specificity remains uncertain. This study aimed to identify the determinants of DTI-ALPS and evaluate whether it primarily reflects white-matter (WM) microstructure rather than glymphatic flow in the context of neurodegeneration. We examined 100 individuals referred to the Memory Clinic of the Policlinico Hospital in Milan for suspected dementia. All participants underwent a 3T-MRI protocol including 3D-T1-weighted and 3D-FLAIR imaging, double-shell diffusion-weighted imaging (b = 1000/2000 s/mm2 ), and multi-echo gradient-echo sequences for quantitative susceptibility mapping. Within standard DTI-ALPS ROIs, we extracted DTI-ALPS values together with fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD), and mode of anisotropy (MA) at both b-values, as well as neurite orientation and density imaging (NODDI) metrics, particularly the orientation dispersion index (ODI). WM microstructure was further characterized using the T1/FLAIR ratio and diamagnetic component of susceptibility (DCS). DTI-ALPS correlated inversely with MA (r = -0.84 at b = 1000; r = -0.86 at b = 2000) and positively with ODI (r = 0.73). Moderate correlations with the T1/FLAIR ratio and DCS supported sensitivity to WM alterations. Factor analysis indicated that DTI-ALPS clustered with MA and ODI rather than forming a distinct factor, suggesting that DTI-ALPS primarily reflects WM diffusion dispersion and heterogeneity rather than glymphatic flow in the context of neurodegeneration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在疑似痴呆的记忆门诊转诊人群中，结合多模态MRI考察DTI-ALPS这一常用类淋巴流标志物的生物学决定因素。结果显示，DTI-ALPS与各向异性模式指标呈强负相关、与神经突方向离散指数呈正相关，并与白质微结构改变指标存在中等关联；因子分析中它与这些白质指标归为同一因子，而非独立因子。作者据此认为，在神经退行性背景下，DTI-ALPS主要反映白质扩散离散度和微结构异质性，而非类淋巴流，提示将其直接解释为类淋巴清除功能需谨慎。

papers.title: Theory of mind: A cognitive endophenotype of juvenile myoclonic epilepsy?
papers.authors: Crespo-Pimentel B, Rainer LJ, Braun M, Kronbichler M, Langthaler P, Kronbichler L, Said-Yürekli S, Zamarian L, Jokeit H, Winds K, Legat E, Trinka E, Höfler J, Kuchukhidze G.
papers.abstract: Objective Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy (JME), the most common idiopathic generalized epilepsy, is associated with neuropsychological and psychiatric comorbidities, including social cognition and theory of mind (ToM) deficits. The interplay between clinical features, social cognition, and their neural and genetic substrates remains poorly understood. We investigated social cognition in individuals with JME and their unaffected siblings to explore its potential as a disease endophenotype. Methods In this prospective cross-sectional study, 52 individuals with JME (age = 29 ± 11 years, 56% female), 13 unaffected siblings (age = 26 ± 7 years, 38% female), and 64 healthy controls (age = 28 ± 11 years, 55% female) completed neuropsychological tests and self-report questionnaires assessing social cognition. Test scores were assigned to previously defined theoretical social cognition domains and averaged into domain-specific composite z-scores. Participants underwent functional magnetic resonance imaging using a ToM paradigm. Social cognition performance was compared between groups, and associations with clinical variables were explored. Results Compared with healthy controls, individuals with JME showed reduced performance in tasks requiring mentalizing about beliefs (e.g., Faux Pas Test, Reading the Mind in the Eyes Test). Domain-level analyses confirmed selective impairment in mentalizing about beliefs, whereas other ToM components showed no consistent group differences. Unaffected siblings did not differ significantly from either individuals with JME or healthy controls on any measure. Significance Our study aligns with previous literature expanding the extent of ToM impairment in individuals with JME. An endophenotypic role of ToM in JME could not be established in the present sample and remains a hypothesis to be tested in adequately powered studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年肌阵挛癫痫患者及其未患病同胞的社会认知表现，探讨心智理论能否作为该病的认知内表型。患者、同胞与健康对照完成了神经心理学测验、自评问卷和心智理论任务的功能磁共振成像。结果显示，患者仅在涉及推断他人信念的心智化任务上表现下降，其他心智理论成分未见一致组间差异；未患病同胞在各指标上与患者和健康对照均无显著差异。作者据此认为，结果支持患者存在选择性心智化损伤，但未能在本样本中确立心智理论的内表型作用，该假设仍有待更大样本研究检验。

papers.title: Syndromic Autism in Helsmoortel-Van der Aa Syndrome: From Clinical Suspicion to Genetic Diagnosis.
papers.authors: Kılıçaslan F, Öz Ö, Carık C, Mutlu MB, Gürler Aİ.
papers.abstract: Syndromic autism refers to autism spectrum disorder (ASD) occurring as part of an identifiable genetic syndrome. Helsmoortel-Van der Aa syndrome (HVDAS/ADNP syndrome) is a rare autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder caused by heterozygous pathogenic variants in the ADNP gene. We report a 10-year-old boy with ASD and intellectual disability who exhibited delayed motor and language development, characteristic facial dysmorphism, early tooth eruption, endocrine abnormalities, electroencephalography (EEG) abnormalities, and urogenital findings. Following unremarkable karyotyping and chromosomal microarray analysis (CMA), whole-exome sequencing identified a heterozygous pathogenic de novo frameshift variant, c.1239_1240del, p.(Gln414Valfs*25) in ADNP. This case emphasizes the importance of considering a syndromic etiology in children with ASD accompanied by developmental delay, dysmorphic features, neurological findings, or multisystem involvement, and supports comprehensive genetic evaluation when first-tier testing is unrevealing.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一名10岁男孩的临床与遗传诊断过程，该男孩表现为孤独症谱系障碍和智力障碍，并伴有运动与语言发育迟缓、特征性面部畸形、早期萌牙、内分泌异常、脑电图异常及泌尿生殖系统表现。在核型分析和染色体微阵列分析均未发现异常后，全外显子组测序检出ADNP基因的新发杂合致病性移码变异。作者据此指出，当孤独症儿童同时存在发育迟缓、面部畸形、神经系统异常或多系统受累时，应考虑综合征性病因；若一线遗传检测未获阳性结果，支持进一步开展全面的遗传学评估。

papers.title: Age-Related Changes in E/I Balance Estimated With Hurst Exponent and Links With Developmental Skills in Preschool Children.
papers.authors: Chen B, Boxberger A, Mahmalji J, Arantes de Oliveira Campos G, Herrera M, Linke A, Fishman I.
papers.abstract: Cortical excitation-inhibition (E/I) balance regulates sensitive periods of plasticity and is critical for brain development. Yet, neuroimaging studies characterizing E/I dynamics in early childhood are rare. The Hurst exponent (H), derived from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), provides a noninvasive proxy for E/I balance. We investigated age-related changes in H using longitudinal rs-fMRI from 55 typically developing children aged 1.5-5 years (78 sessions during natural sleep). Linear mixed-effects models revealed significant age-related increases in H, signifying greater inhibition or more balanced E/I, in three right-hemisphere regions: inferior frontal gyrus (IFG) pars opercularis and triangularis, and middle temporal pole. Whole-brain maps showed positive age effects across most cortical areas, though the most robust increases occurred in higher order association cortices rather than primary sensory regions, consistent with hierarchical network maturation. Higher H in right IFG opercular was associated with better expressive language skills and fewer behavioral/emotional problems, controlling for age and sex. These findings suggest that E/I balance maturation during toddlerhood and preschool years is most pronounced in regions supporting language development and cognitive control. Our results characterized normative developmental trajectories of H during an important neurodevelopmental window and its associations with emerging behavioral competencies, potentially informing future investigations of atypical E/I maturation in neurodevelopmental disorders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注幼儿期皮层兴奋—抑制平衡的发育变化，利用纵向静息态功能磁共振数据，以Hurst指数作为兴奋—抑制平衡的无创代理指标，追踪通常发育儿童在1.5至5岁间的变化。结果显示，Hurst指数随年龄增长而升高，提示抑制增强或兴奋—抑制更趋平衡，这一趋势在多数皮层区域可见，并在高级联合皮层比初级感觉区更明显，符合层级网络成熟的特点。右侧额下回岛盖部的Hurst指数较高还与更好的表达性语言能力和较少的行为情绪问题相关。作者据此认为，兴奋—抑制平衡的成熟在支持语言发展和认知控制的区域尤为突出，为理解非典型兴奋—抑制发育提供了参考，但相关结果尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Cerebellar Continuous Theta Burst Stimulation for Insomnia Disorder: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
papers.authors: Liu XY, Dong D, Song CG, Ma YX, Wu DW, Wang X, Hao JM, Li H, Zhao JJ, Hu GY, Xia F, Jiang W.
papers.abstract: Objective To evaluate the effects of cerebellar continuous theta burst stimulation (cTBS) in insomnia disorder (ID). Methods In this randomized sham-controlled trial, patients with ID received 2 weeks of active or sham cerebellar cTBS. The primary outcome was a ≥ 3-point improvement in Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) score after treatment. Secondary outcomes included changes in sleep, mood, and resting-state fMRI. Results Seventy-two patients (51 women; mean age, 44.3 ± 11.6 years) were included in the intention-to-treat analysis. More patients in the active than sham group achieved a ≥ 3-point PSQI improvement after treatment (75.0% vs. 33.3%; adjusted OR, 6.06; 95% CI, 2.17-18.50; p < 0.001). Active cTBS reduced PSQI scores versus sham both post-treatment (adjusted mean difference, -3.34; 95% CI, -4.57 to -2.12; p < 0.001) and at 1 month (-3.70; 95% CI, -4.93 to -2.48; p < 0.001), and also improved Insomnia Severity Index, Hamilton Anxiety Scale, and Hamilton Depression Scale at both time points (all p < 0.01). Exploratory fMRI analyses identified several post-treatment connectivity differences between groups, but only right amygdala-right orbitofrontal connectivity showed a significant group-by-time interaction (FDR-adjusted p = 0.038). No serious adverse events occurred. Conclusion Cerebellar cTBS was well tolerated and promising for ID. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05992285).

papers.title: Multimodal Characterization of APOE ε4-Associated Neurovascular Heterogeneity Using Retinal, Plasma, and Neuroimaging Biomarkers in Alzheimer's Disease.
papers.authors: Cheng H, Xia H, Wang Y, Cao L, Hu S, Wang H, Kwapong WR, Wang Z, Wen C.
papers.abstract: Background Biological heterogeneity remains a major challenge in Alzheimer's disease (AD), even among individuals with biomarker-confirmed disease. The apolipoprotein E (APOE) ε4 allele is associated with greater amyloid burden, neurodegeneration, and vascular dysfunction. We investigated whether retinal microvascular imaging provides complementary information beyond plasma and neuroimaging biomarkers for characterizing APOE ε4-associated neurovascular heterogeneity in biologically defined AD. Methods Eighty-four amyloid-positive patients with AD underwent color fundus photography, swept-source optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA), plasma biomarker assessment, amyloid positron emission tomography, and magnetic resonance imaging. Retinal vascular parameters were compared between APOE ε4 carriers and non-carriers using generalized estimating equations. Candidate multimodal biomarkers were identified using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression, followed by multivariable logistic regression to evaluate the incremental contribution of retinal biomarkers within a multimodal phenotyping model. Results Compared with non-carriers, APOE ε4 carriers demonstrated significantly lower retinal superficial vascular complex (SVC) and deep vascular complex densities, reduced retinal vascular fractal dimension, higher amyloid PET standardized uptake value ratios, increased peak width of skeletonized mean diffusivity, and smaller hippocampal volumes (all p < 0.05). Following penalized feature selection, retinal SVC density remained independently associated with APOE ε4 status alongside amyloid burden, hippocampal volume, and white matter microstructural injury. Incorporation of SVC modestly improved discrimination and calibration of the multimodal model compared with neuroimaging biomarkers alone. Conclusions Retinal microvascular alterations are associated with APOE ε4-related biological heterogeneity in biomarker-confirmed AD. Retinal vascular imaging provides complementary information beyond established plasma and neuroimaging biomarkers and may enhance multimodal characterization of neurovascular phenotypes rather than serve as a surrogate for genetic testing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在生物标志物确诊的阿尔茨海默病患者中，APOE ε4等位基因相关的神经血管异质性能否通过视网膜微血管成像得到补充刻画。作者对淀粉样蛋白阳性的患者同步采集眼底照相、光学相干断层扫描血管成像、血浆标志物、淀粉样蛋白PET和磁共振数据，比较ε4携带者与非携带者的视网膜血管参数，并检验视网膜指标在多模态表型模型中的增量贡献。结果显示，携带者的视网膜浅层和深层血管复合体密度及血管分形维数较低，同时伴有更重的淀粉样负荷、白质微结构损伤和海马体积缩小；其中浅层血管复合体密度在特征筛选后仍与ε4状态独立相关，纳入该指标可使多模态模型的区分度和校准略有改善。作者据此认为，视网膜微血管改变与ε4相关的生物学异质性相关，可为此类多模态刻画提供补充信息，但并非基因检测的替代手段。

papers.title: Cerebral Artery Stenosis, Glymphatic Dysfunction, and Cognitive Trajectories: A Longitudinal Cohort Study of Community-Dwelling Older Adults.
papers.authors: Yuan W, Niu X, Lan L, Chen X.
papers.abstract: Aims We aimed to investigate the role of glymphatic dysfunction in the association between stenosis and cognition. Methods Older adults from a longitudinal cohort underwent magnetic resonance angiography to quantify cerebral artery stenosis burden. Glymphatic function was evaluated using diffusion tensor imaging-analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) and free water in white matter (FW-WM). Global cognitive performance was assessed using the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) and the Clinical Dementia Rating-Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB). Mediation analyses examined indirect effects, and longitudinal cognitive outcomes were analyzed using linear mixed-effects and Cox proportional hazards models. Results Among 346 participants, 87 (25.1%) had at least one stenotic cerebral artery. Stenosis burden was associated with a lower DTI-ALPS index (β = -0.04, p = 0.003) and higher FW-WM (β = 0.01, p = 0.022). Both DTI-ALPS and FW-WM significantly mediated the association between stenosis burden and baseline MMSE, accounting for 13.06%-17.19% of the total effect. In longitudinal analyses, participants with stenosis and impaired glymphatic function had a higher risk of CDR-SB worsening relative to those with stenosis but preserved glymphatic function (hazard ratios 1.35-2.96) and those without stenosis (hazard ratios 3.27-4.70). Conclusion These findings suggest that glymphatic dysfunction may contribute to the association between cerebral artery stenosis and cognitive deterioration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于社区老年纵向队列，考察脑动脉狭窄负担与认知变化的关系，并检验类淋巴功能障碍是否在其中起作用。结果显示，动脉狭窄负担与反映类淋巴功能的指标变差相关，且这些指标能部分解释狭窄负担与基线整体认知表现之间的关联。纵向来看，在已有动脉狭窄的老年人中，类淋巴功能受损者后续认知评分恶化的风险高于类淋巴功能保留者，也高于无动脉狭窄者。作者据此提出，类淋巴功能障碍可能参与动脉狭窄与认知衰退之间的关联，但这一中介路径属于观察性关联，尚不能确立因果关系。

papers.title: Connectivity-Guided Individualized iTBS of the Posterior Parietal Cortex in Enduring Anorexia Nervosa: Network-Level Target Engagement and Multimodal Response in a Single Case.
papers.authors: Collantoni E, Gentili S, Menardi A, Vallesi A, Librizzi G, Tenconi E, Serino A, Risso G, Olivo D, Sambataro F, Favaro A, Meregalli V.
papers.abstract: Aims Anorexia nervosa (AN) is a severe, often enduring disorder with scarce biological treatments, largely unable to address its core implicit features: habit-like food restriction and body-experience disturbances. We report a single-case application of resting-state connectivity-guided intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS) to the posterior parietal cortex (PPC), a hub for body representation, peripersonal space, and affordance-based action. Methods A 31-year-old woman with 12 years of treatment-resistant restricting AN, enrolled in an ongoing sham-controlled feasibility trial, underwent 20 active iTBS sessions to an individualized left-PPC site maximally coupled with a body-representation × affordance reference network, assessed at baseline, post-treatment, and four-month follow-up. Results The protocol was fully feasible and well tolerated, without significant adverse events. Clinical change was gradual, with most of the weight gain occurring after the stimulation period: BMI rose from 15.65 to 16.01 at four-month follow-up and 16.40 over subsequent clinical follow-up. Blinded global improvement was minimal; anxiety fell below threshold, whereas eating-disorder and body-shape scores remained at floor. Target-reference connectivity increased in the a priori direction, toward the healthy-control mean. Exploratory measures changed heterogeneously, only partly tracking engagement. Conclusion This case supports the feasibility and mechanistic plausibility of individualized parietal targeting in enduring AN, motivating a controlled trial to test its efficacy. Trial registration The parent trial is registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07106645).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报告了一例病程长达12年、治疗抵抗的 restricting 型神经性厌食症患者，接受基于静息态功能连接引导的个体化左侧后顶叶皮层间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS），并在基线、治疗后及四个月随访时评估。方案完全可行且耐受良好，无显著不良事件；临床变化缓慢，体重增加主要出现在刺激期之后，盲法总体改善轻微，焦虑降至阈值以下，而进食障碍和体形评分仍处于最低水平。靶点与参考网络的功能连接按预期方向增强，向健康对照均值靠拢，但探索性指标变化异质、仅部分与靶点 engagement 同步。作者认为该个案支持个体化顶叶靶向在难治性厌食症中的可行性和机制合理性，但尚不能据此推断疗效，需开展对照试验验证。

papers.title: Deanna Protocol Ameliorates the Deficits in Human iPSC-Cortical Neurons Carrying Familial Alzheimer's Mutation.
papers.authors: Keler Soares L, Srivastava G, Dwelle C, Waggoner B, Tedone V, Hickman JJ, Guo X.
papers.abstract: Aims Deanna Protocol (DP) is an anaplerotic, mechanism-based therapy designed to address impaired cellular energy flux. The present study aims to investigate the effects of DP in treating Alzheimer's disease (AD) by using cortical neurons derived from AD patient iPSCs carrying a PSEN1 mutation, while cortical neurons differentiated from iPSCs of a healthy subject serve as control. Methods PSEN1 cortical neurons were treated with DP acutely (24 h) and chronically (1-3 weeks). The effect of DP was assessed by utilizing TMRE assay for mitochondrial function, immunofluorescent staining for AD neuron morphological pathology, whole cell patch clamp for neuron electrophysiological property, and microelectrode array (MEA) analysis of long-term potentiation (LTP) for neurocircuit function. Results PSEN1 cortical neurons demonstrated impaired mitochondrial function, elevated pathological biomarkers, reduced neurite complexity, altered electrophysiology, and decreased LTP. DP treatment significantly ameliorated all these phenotypes. Conclusion This study, while confirming iPSC-PSEN1 cortical neurons as a valid AD model, demonstrated the efficacy of DP on ameliorating structural and functional pathologies in AD neurons. It highlights that targeting energy production could be an effective approach in treating neurodegeneration in AD and suggests its potential efficacy in other neurodegenerative diseases.

papers.title: Ictal Epileptogenic Network Differences in Posterior Cingulate Epilepsy Subtypes Based on SEEG.
papers.authors: Yan Z, Yang Y, Wang J, Deng QQ, Wang M, Yang H, Pan J, Zhou J, Guan Y, Luan G, Wang M.
papers.abstract: Aims To compare differences in ictal propagation between epileptogenic networks between posterior cingulate cortex (PCC) epilepsy and retrosplenial cortex (RSC) epilepsy and to elucidate their network-level pathophysiological characteristics. Methods A total of 18 patients with confirmed PCC or RSC-related epilepsy were enrolled in this study. We calculated directed functional connectivity across preictal, ictal onset, and propagation phases based on pairwise nonlinear regression (h2 coefficient). Using graph theory and linear mixed-effects models, we quantified network topology and dynamic propagation patterns of epileptogenic networks. Results Neuropsychological tests showed significantly poorer visual recall in patients with RSC epilepsy (p = 0.030). During the propagation phase, the ipsilateral mesial temporal structures showed significantly greater node out-strength than in-strength, acting as a secondary driver of seizure spread (p = 0.004). The lateral temporal cortex acted as a signal receiver with dominant in-strength (p = 0.015). RSC epilepsy also showed stronger directional propagation toward ipsilateral mesial temporal areas than PCC epilepsy (p = 0.022), whereas PCC epilepsy lacked consistent directional connectivity across key regions. Conclusion RSC and PCC epilepsy display inherent differences in visuospatial memory performance and ictal network dynamics. The preferential propagation toward ipsilateral mesial temporal structures in RSC epilepsy may represent a potential electrophysiological correlate for distinguishing posterior cingulate epilepsy subtypes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于立体脑电图，比较后扣带皮层癫痫与压后皮层癫痫在发作期致痫网络传播上的差异，并分析其网络层面的病理生理特征。结果发现，压后皮层癫痫患者的视觉回忆表现较差；在传播期，同侧内侧颞叶结构更多表现为传出强于传入，成为发作扩散的次级驱动源，而外侧颞叶皮层则以接收信号为主。压后皮层癫痫向同侧内侧颞叶的方向性传播强于后扣带皮层癫痫，后者在关键脑区之间缺乏一致的方向性连接。作者认为，压后皮层癫痫优先向同侧内侧颞叶传播，可能为区分后扣带癫痫亚型提供潜在的电生理线索。

papers.title: Compound Ciwujia Granules Attenuate Stress-Induced Anxiety- and Depression-Like Behaviors via Inhibition of TNF-α-Associated Neuroinflammation in the dmPFC.
papers.authors: Tian F, Li Y, Dai M, Guo Y, Liao B, Zhang Y, Gong X, Liu L, Shi D, Wang Z.
papers.abstract: Aims Compound Ciwujia Granules (CWJ) have shown antidepressant-like effects, but the neural and molecular mechanisms underlying these effects remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the mechanisms by which CWJ ameliorates anxiety- and depression-like behaviors. Methods A 6-week chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS) model was established in rats, and behavioral tests were performed to assess the antidepressant-like effects of CWJ. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), in vivo fiber photometry, and chemogenetic manipulation were used to identify the brain region and neuronal population involved in the effects of CWJ. Transcriptomic analysis combined with network pharmacology was used to predict candidate molecular pathways, which were further validated by quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, immunofluorescence, western blotting, and pharmacological interventions. Results CWJ increased the open-arm ratio in the EPM, reduced FST immobility, and lowered serum corticosterone (CORT) levels in CUMS rats. Convergent rs-fMRI, c-Fos immunostaining, and fiber photometry identified that the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex (dmPFC) was a key brain region involved in the antidepressant-like effects of CWJ. CWJ increased glutamatergic neuronal activity and reduced neuroinflammatory responses associated with TNF-related inflammatory signaling in the dmPFC. Moreover, pharmacological activation of TNF-related inflammatory signaling partially attenuated the behavioral benefits of CWJ, supporting the involvement of TNF-related inflammatory signaling in mediating its antidepressant effects. Conclusions These findings suggest that CWJ attenuated CUMS-induced anxiety- and depression-like behaviors by restoring dmPFC glutamatergic neuronal activity and suppressing TNF-related neuroinflammation in the dmPFC.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在探究复方刺五加颗粒改善焦虑和抑郁样行为背后的神经与分子机制，采用慢性不可预知温和应激大鼠模型，并结合行为学测试、静息态功能磁共振、在体光纤记录、化学遗传学操控及转录组与网络药理学分析。结果显示，复方刺五加颗粒能减轻应激大鼠的焦虑和抑郁样行为并降低血清皮质酮水平，其作用与背内侧前额叶皮层（dmPFC）密切相关：药物提高了该区域谷氨酸能神经元活动，并抑制了与TNF相关的神经炎症信号。药理学激活该炎症通路可部分削弱药物的行为学获益，提示dmPFC中TNF相关神经炎症的抑制是其发挥抗焦虑抑郁作用的重要环节。

papers.title: Residual Language Abilities Correlate With Diagnosis and Prognosis in Patients With Disorders of Consciousness.
papers.authors: Xu C, Gao J, Zheng J, Yu J, Gao J, Li J, Ding N, Luo B.
papers.abstract: Background Evaluating residual consciousness and predicting outcomes in unresponsive patients pose significant clinical challenges. Language assessment is crucial for these patients, and language-based EEG paradigms have shown promise in aiding diagnosis and prognosis in patients with disorders of consciousness (DoC). However, current language-based EEG paradigms either require higher-order cognitive functions, thereby misidentifying some conscious patients as unconscious, or rely on automatic processing, which fails to capture residual consciousness in DoC. Methods Newly developed, simple phrase sequences combined with neural frequency tagging were used to explore a language paradigm tailored to a critical processing threshold. This paradigm was designed to reflect the dynamic process of consciousness in DoC, while requiring minimal cognitive load. Results Our results showed that significant phrase-level EEG responses were observed in healthy subjects, MCS patients, and UWS patients in three conditions. Neural tracking of phrase structure showed a progressive decrease across three groups (healthy > MCS > UWS). Among the UWS patients, 52.38% (11 out of 21) and among the MCS patients, 45.83% (11 out of 24) exhibited significant ITPC at the syllable rate in at least one of the three conditions. Additionally, 38.10% (8 out of 21) of UWS patients and 33.33% (8 out of 24) of MCS patients demonstrated significant ITPC at the phrase rate. The language paradigm performance in this study was superior to that of other paradigms in detecting the proportion of residual language ability in DoC patients. Furthermore, cortical tracking at the phrase rate significantly correlated with 12-month outcomes and effectively classified patients according to their 12-month prognosis. Conclusions The simplified language assessment demonstrates strong potential to detect residual language ability in DoC patients and could potentially be used to detect residual consciousness and determine prognosis in unresponsive patients.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对意识障碍患者残余意识评估与预后预测的临床难题，采用简单短语序列结合神经频率追踪的脑电范式，考察健康人、微意识状态（MCS）患者和植物状态（UWS）患者对短语结构的神经追踪。结果显示，短语结构的神经追踪在三组间呈健康人、MCS、UWS依次递减，部分UWS和MCS患者仍在音节率和短语率上表现出显著响应，且该范式检测残余语言能力的比例优于其他范式。短语率皮层追踪与12个月结局显著相关，并能据此对患者预后进行分类，提示简化语言评估有望用于检测残余语言能力、辅助判断意识水平与预后。

papers.title: The Role of Glymphatic Clearance in Affective Decision-Making in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury.
papers.authors: Wang H, Zhang J, Pan R, Ye X, Wang R, Lv K, Yu Y, Li Q, Zhang T, Wu D, Zhang D, Tian Y.
papers.abstract: Background Adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) frequently exhibit severe sleep disturbances and heterogeneous cognitive impairments, yet the underlying neurophysiological basis remains unclear. The glymphatic system, a sleep-dependent macroscopic clearance network, is critical for metabolic waste removal and neurocognitive homeostasis. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the physiological role of glymphatic function in linking sleep burden to distinct cognitive performances in adolescents with NSSI. Methods We assessed 44 NSSI adolescents and 33 healthy controls (HCs). Using resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), glymphatic function was quantified by calculating the coupling strength between global blood-oxygen-level-dependent (gBOLD) signals and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) flow. To capture the heterogeneity in their cognitive profiles, we evaluated "hot" affective decision-making via the Iowa Gambling Task (IGT) and "cold" executive function via the Wisconsin Card Sorting Test (WCST). Subjective sleep quality was assessed using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI). Results In the NSSI group, poorer sleep quality was positively correlated with stronger gBOLD-CSF coupling (r = 0.317, p = 0.036), and stronger gBOLD-CSF coupling predicted better IGT performance, especially during the high-load strategy phase (Block 3) (r = 0.447, p = 0.002). Furthermore, glymphatic function fully mediated the relationship between sleep quality and affective decision-making performance (indirect effect = 0.682, 95% CI [0.062, 1.515]). Interaction analyses confirmed this physiological-behavioral coupling was disease-specific (present only in NSSI; interaction p = 0.011) and domain-specific (supporting "hot" affective cognition rather than "cold" executive function). Conclusions In NSSI adolescents, sleep-associated glymphatic upregulation reflects a stress-induced compensatory response. This mechanism domain-specifically preserves high-load affective decision-making against severe psychopathological stress. These findings highlight brain metabolic clearance as a novel physiological target for bolstering cognitive resilience in high-risk youth.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注非自杀性自伤青少年的睡眠负担、类淋巴清除功能与认知表现之间的关系，比较了自伤青少年与健康对照，并用静息态功能磁共振测量脑血氧信号与脑脊液流动的耦合强度，同时评估睡眠质量及情感决策和执行功能。结果显示，在自伤组中睡眠质量越差，该耦合越强，而耦合越强则情感决策表现越好，且类淋巴功能完全中介了睡眠质量与情感决策之间的联系；这种关联仅见于自伤组，并主要指向情感性而非执行性认知。作者据此提出，睡眠相关的类淋巴功能上调可能是一种应激补偿反应，在特定认知领域维护高负荷下的情感决策，但这一解释基于横断面关联，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Exosomal let-7c-5p From AMI Patient Plasma Modulates Neuronal PANoptosis via ZBP1 In Vitro.
papers.authors: Zhang Z, Zhang S, Shao Y, Wang Z, Yan L, Wang X, Li W, Gong K, Fu G, Yan J, Yang W, Shao G.
papers.abstract: Acute myocardial infarction (AMI) significantly elevates the risk of ischemic stroke (IS), yet the molecular mechanisms linking cardiac and cerebral injury remain unclear. Emerging evidence highlights the role of circulating exosomes in mediating inter-organ communication via microRNAs (miRNAs). In this study, plasma exosomes from AMI patients were isolated at three time points (before, 2 hours after, and 24 hours after reperfusion therapy (RT)), and the exosomal let-7c-5p level was measured. The effects of plasma exosomes on neuronal SH-SY5Y cells under normoxic and oxygen-glucose deprivation (OGD) conditions were evaluated by assessing cell viability and the Z-DNA binding protein 1 (ZBP1)/PANoptosis pathway using CCK-8 assay and western blot analysis. let-7c-5p was overexpressed to clarify its role in the ZBP1/PANoptosis pathway. Exosomal let-7c-5p from AMI patients showed differences at three time points. Exosomes collected before reperfusion therapy induced the most PANoptosis under normal conditions, whereas those collected 2 hours post-reperfusion therapy had the greatest effect under OGD. These effects correlated with dynamic changes in exosomal let-7c-5p levels and the expression of ZBP1. Let-7c-5p overexpression reduced ZBP1 and PANoptotic markers, suggesting a neuroprotective role under ischemic stress. Our study suggested that the exosomal let-7c-5p/ZBP1/PANoptosis axis may contribute to AMI-related brain injury, offering potential therapeutic targets for intervention.

papers.title: Conventional MRI Markers and Cognitive Dysfunction in Multiple Sclerosis: An Exploratory Pilot Study.
papers.authors: Khorshidian F, Aghamollaii V, Noroozian M, Rassa S.
papers.abstract: Background Cognitive impairment is a common and disabling manifestation of multiple sclerosis (MS), yet its structural correlates remain incompletely understood in routine clinical practice. Although advanced neuroimaging has improved our understanding of the underlying mechanisms, its limited accessibility restricts widespread clinical implementation. We aimed to investigate whether conventional MRI markers are associated with domain-specific cognitive impairment in patients with MS. Methods In this exploratory cross-sectional study, 25 adults with clinically confirmed multiple sclerosis underwent cognitive assessment using the standard Persian Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), version 7.1, and conventional 1.5-T brain MRI. Conventional MRI measures included lesion burden, lesion topography, and visually rated cortical atrophy. Associations between MRI markers and MoCA-derived cognitive domains were assessed using Spearman rank correlation with false discovery rate adjustment for multiple testing. Findings Twenty-five patients with clinically confirmed MS completed cognitive and MRI assessments. Mean age was 42.4 ± 9.1 years, 56% were women, and the mean MoCA score was 22 ± 7. Periventricular (88%) and juxtacortical/cortical (84%) lesions were the most frequent MRI findings, total T2/FLAIR lesion burden showed only weak correlations with cognitive performance (ρ range -0.02 to 0.29; all FDR-adjusted p > 0.65). The largest lesion-based association was observed between infratentorial lesions and concentration (ρ = -0.48, unadjusted p = 0.018; FDR-adjusted p = 0.405). Among atrophy measures, GCA showed the strongest association with visuospatial performance (ρ = 0.51, unadjusted p = 0.012; FDR-adjusted p = 0.405), with additional moderate trends for concentration (ρ = 0.40, p = 0.052) and executive function (ρ = 0.40, p = 0.052). No MRI marker remained statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. Interpretation Although no MRI-cognitive association remained statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons, several unadjusted associations showed moderate effect sizes and may warrant further investigation. The strongest exploratory associations involved infratentorial lesions and concentration (ρ = -0.48) and global cortical atrophy and visuospatial performance (ρ = 0.51). The absence of consistent relationships between overall lesion burden or individual regional MRI markers and cognitive performance suggests that focal structural measures alone may not fully capture the neural substrates of cognitive dysfunction in MS. This pattern provides a rationale for further investigation of distributed, network-level mechanisms of cognitive dysfunction, while the present findings should be considered hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory. Conventional MRI may therefore provide complementary structural information in the clinical assessment of cognitive dysfunction in MS. Larger, adequately powered studies using comprehensive neuropsychological assessment and quantitative, network-sensitive MRI measures are needed to determine whether these observed patterns are reproducible and clinically meaningful.

papers.title: Association of Glymphatic Imaging Markers With Clinical Outcomes and Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Burden After Intracerebral Hemorrhage.
papers.authors: Hu X, Li Z, Wang Z, Zhang Y, Zhang M, Liu S, Chen F, Shao J, Wang L, Li Q.
papers.abstract: Objective The glymphatic system plays a critical role in cerebral metabolite clearance and white matter injury. However, its clinical relevance in intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) remains poorly understood. This study aimed to investigate imaging-based glymphatic markers in relation to functional outcomes and cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) burden in patients with ICH. Methods We included 70 patients with acute supratentorial ICH who underwent diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). Glymphatic-related imaging parameters were derived using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), including DTI-ALPS, free water (FW) fraction, and relative perivascular space (PVS) volume. CSVD burden was assessed using relative white matter hyperintensity (WMH) volume and number of lacunes. Functional independence was defined as a 3-month modified Rankin Scale score of 0-2. Results In fully adjusted logistic regression models, higher FW in deep WM was associated with a lower likelihood of functional independence at 3 months (OR = 0.59; 95% CI, 0.36-0.98; p = 0.041), with consistent findings across sequential models. Linear regression analyses further demonstrated that greater relative WMH volume was significantly associated with increased FW in deep WM (β = 0.143; 95% CI, 0.008-0.277; p = 0.038) and with smaller relative PVS volume in fully adjusted models. Neither FW association remained statistically significant after FDR correction. The FW-outcome association was also nonsignificant after adjustment for WMH burden, and the exploratory mediation analysis showed no statistically significant indirect effect. Interpretation Contralateral FW showed nominal associations with functional outcome and WMH burden and may reflect diffuse CSVD-related white matter injury. Its independent prognostic and mediating roles remain unestablished and require validation in larger longitudinal studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注脑出血后类淋巴系统影像标志物与临床结局及脑小血管病负担的关系，纳入急性幕上脑出血患者，基于弥散张量成像等MRI指标进行分析。结果显示，深部白质游离水分数较高与3个月功能独立可能性较低相关，且与白质高信号体积较大相关；但经多重比较校正后这些关联不再显著，校正白质高信号负担后游离水与结局的关联亦不显著，探索性中介分析未发现显著间接效应。作者认为，对侧游离水可能反映弥漫性小血管病相关白质损伤，但其独立预后和中介作用尚未确立，需更大样本的纵向研究验证。

papers.title: Machine Learning in Dementia Research: Trends, Biomarkers, Prediction Goals, and Data Modalities.
papers.authors: Wang YC, Yeh HC, Islam MM, Kung WM.
papers.abstract: Objective Machine learning (ML) is increasingly used in dementia research for diagnosis, early detection, prognosis, biomarker characterization, and disease phenotyping. This study aimed to provide a bibliometric and thematic overview of ML applications in dementia, emphasizing biological mechanisms, prediction goals, data modalities, collaborative networks, and emerging computational approaches. Methods A title-field search of the Web of Science Core Collection identified 3,833 records related to ML and dementia. After restricting publications to 2000 onward and excluding non-analytic document types, 3,479 records were included in the bibliometric analysis. A subset of 3,223 original articles was used for thematic analyses. Publication trends, authorship, institutional collaboration, keywords, biomarker themes, ML objectives, data modalities, methods, shared research resources, and large language model (LLM) applications were evaluated. Results ML-related dementia research increased substantially over time. Diagnostic classification was the predominant ML objective (55.0%), followed by early detection or screening (10.3%), progression or cognitive-decline prediction (6.8%), and biomarker or feature discovery (4.7%). Structural magnetic resonance imaging was the most frequently identified modality (42.6%), followed by clinical or cognitive data (22.4%), positron emission tomography/single photon emission computerized tomography (10.3%), and genetic or genomic data (10.2%). Prominent biological themes included hippocampal measures, amyloid/Aβ, electroencephalogram, tau/p-tau, and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers. Institutional networks showed distinct international collaboration clusters and frequent use of shared infrastructures. Transformer-based and LLM approaches emerged in recent years. Conclusions ML research in dementia has expanded beyond diagnostic neuroimaging toward multimodal, biomarker, prognostic, and language model applications, although diagnostic classification and structural imaging remain dominant. Emphasis on biological integration, longitudinal validation, and clinical translation are needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过文献计量与主题分析，梳理了机器学习在痴呆研究中的应用格局。结果显示，相关研究数量持续增长，但诊断分类仍是主要目标，结构磁共振成像是最常用数据模态，早期筛查、进展预测和生物标志物发现所占比例较小。海马指标、淀粉样蛋白、脑电和脑脊液标志物等构成重要生物学主题，机构间合作呈现不同国际集群，近年还出现了基于Transformer和大语言模型的新方法。作者据此指出，该领域虽已从诊断影像扩展到多模态、预后和语言模型应用，但仍需加强生物学整合、纵向验证与临床转化。

papers.title: Multi-Metric EEG Connectivity and Graph Analysis Reveal Altered Resting-State Networks in Major Depressive Disorder.
papers.authors: Rose SJ, Imon AHMR, Bushra R, Ahmed N, Warid MTH.
papers.abstract: Purpose EEG functional-connectivity studies in major depressive disorder (MDD) have produced inconsistent findings, partly because different estimators capture distinct aspects of neural coupling. We implemented a multi-metric resting-state EEG approach combining linear, phase-based, nonlinear, and graph-theoretical measures to characterize frequency-dependent sensor-level connectivity alterations and identify sensor-level network patterns relevant to depression-related dysconnectivity. Method Resting-state EEG from 30 DSM-IV MDD participants and 28 healthy controls was analyzed using a 19-channel 10-20 montage. After MNE-Python preprocessing, including filtering, ICA-based artifact removal, current source density (CSD) transformation, and symmetric orthogonalization, coherence, PLV, PLI, and MI were computed across theta, alpha, and beta bands. Edge-wise differences were tested using Brunner-Munzel with Holm correction, confirmed with Westfall-Young maxT correction, and summarized using Hedges' g and graph measures. Finding MDD showed frequency- and metric-dependent sensor-level connectivity alterations. Theta coherence, PLV, and PLI were dominated by lower connectivity across frontal-to-posterior, fronto-central, temporal/posterior-temporal, parieto-occipital, and central-to-occipital sensor pairs, whereas theta MI showed few increased frontal/fronto-temporal effects. Alpha findings were more selective, with mainly lower coherence and PLV across frontopolar/frontal-to-central, fronto-midline, and posterior links, while alpha MI showed a limited mixed pattern. In beta, coherence, PLV, and PLI showed sparse robust reductions, whereas beta MI showed widespread increased statistical dependence. Graph-theoretical summaries at 20% proportional density showed mainly lower mean weighted strength and global efficiency in theta- and alpha-band networks. Conclusion These findings indicate frequency- and metric-dependent resting-state EEG sensor-level connectivity alterations in MDD. The dominant pattern was lower theta/alpha connectivity across distributed sensor pairs, alongside increased beta MI-based dependence. The results provide corrected, effect-size-informed evidence of altered inter-sensor coordination without establishing dysfunction of specific cortical regions or named networks. This framework may support future hypothesis-driven research in independent, clinically annotated, higher-density EEG or multimodal datasets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对重性抑郁障碍患者静息态脑电功能连接研究结果不一致的问题，采用多指标脑电连接与图论分析，比较患者与健康对照在多个频段上的感觉器层面连接模式。结果显示，改变具有频率和指标依赖性：theta和alpha频段以多个分布传感器对之间连接降低为主，beta频段则在部分指标上呈现连接降低、在互信息指标上呈现广泛升高，图论指标也提示theta和alpha网络整体强度与全局效率偏低。作者据此认为，抑郁障碍表现为跨传感器协调的改变，但尚不能据此确定特定皮层区域或命名网络的功能障碍，相关发现仍需在独立、临床信息更完整的高密度脑电或多模态数据中验证。

papers.title: Resting-State EEG Aperiodic Activity and Negative Affective Vulnerability: The Mediating Role of Big Five Personality Traits.
papers.authors: Lin J, Dai Z, Feng S, Song R, Jiang X, Xu H, Zhao Z, Lv H, Jia H.
papers.abstract: Introduction Resting-state EEG aperiodic parameters characterize the broadband background component of neural activity. The offset reflects overall broadband power and has been linked to population-level firing, whereas the exponent is often interpreted, within a theoretical framework, as an indirect proxy for cortical excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance. These measures may therefore provide candidate neurophysiological trait markers of negative affective vulnerability, but it remains unclear whether their associations with trait anxiety and trait depression are direct or are statistically accounted for by stable personality traits. Methods A total of 164 healthy adults completed measures of the Big Five personality traits, trait anxiety, and trait depression and underwent eyes-closed resting-state EEG recording. Aperiodic exponent and offset were estimated at the whole-brain and regional levels using spectral parameterization. Partial correlations, hierarchical regression analyses, and bootstrap mediation analyses were conducted controlling for sex, age, and years of education. Results Neuroticism showed the strongest and most spatially widespread positive associations with the aperiodic exponent. Trait anxiety showed more limited associations, mainly with whole-brain and frontal aperiodic parameters. The association between whole-brain exponent and trait anxiety was no longer significant after the Big Five personality traits were entered into the model. Bootstrap mediation analyses identified significant indirect effects in this association through personality traits, with neuroticism showing the largest indirect effect and conscientiousness also showing a significant indirect effect. Trait depression was not directly associated with aperiodic parameters, although significant indirect effects through personality traits were observed. Conclusions Resting-state EEG aperiodic activity, particularly the exponent, was more consistently associated with stable personality dispositions than with negative affective vulnerability directly. Personality traits, especially neuroticism, may statistically account for part of the association between aperiodic exponent and trait anxiety. Because the data were cross-sectional, the temporal and causal direction of these associations cannot be determined.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察静息态脑电非周期活动（指数与偏移）是否与特质焦虑和特质抑郁相关，以及这种关联是否可由大五人格特质在统计上解释。164名健康成人完成人格与情绪问卷并接受闭眼静息态脑电记录，分析在控制性别、年龄和教育年限后进行。结果显示，非周期指数与神经质呈最强且分布最广的正相关；特质焦虑仅与全脑和额区参数有有限关联，且在纳入人格特质后全脑指数与特质焦虑的关联不再显著，中介分析提示神经质和尽责性承载了显著间接效应。特质抑郁与这些参数无直接关联，但存在经人格特质的间接效应。作者据此认为，非周期活动尤其是指数更多反映稳定人格倾向而非直接的负性情绪易感性，并因横断面设计而无法判断因果方向。

papers.title: Hemispheric Contributions to Figurative Language Comprehension After Unilateral Brain Damage: A Meta-Analysis of Lesion Side and Conventionality Interaction.
papers.authors: Shen L, Fu M, Wang M, Tang X, Chang H.
papers.abstract: Introduction Previous studies revealed that individuals with brain damage exhibit distinctive patterns in figurative language comprehension. However, a systematic investigation of the mechanisms between figurative language deficits and moderating factors such as lesion side remains lacking. Moreover, while the right hemisphere has traditionally been emphasized in pragmatic processing, accumulating evidence now suggests that the contributions of the left and right hemispheres may depend on linguistic factors such as conventionality. A recent systematic review on idiom comprehension in aphasia has highlighted the critical role of stimulus characteristics, yet no quantitative synthesis has examined how conventionality modulates hemispheric contributions to figurative language processing after unilateral brain damage. This meta-analysis aims to: (1) quantify the overall difference between left- and right-hemisphere damaged (LBD and RBD) patients in figurative language comprehension accuracy; (2) examine whether conventionality moderates hemispheric differences; (3) explore potential moderators-including aphasia status, task type, and sample size-that may influence the LBD-RBD difference; and (4) compare impairment patterns of LBD and RBD patients relative to healthy controls across different conventionality levels. Methods Following PRISMA guidelines, a systematic literature search was conducted across Web of Science, PubMed, and ProQuest. Studies comparing LBD and/or RBD patients to healthy controls on accuracy in figurative language comprehension tasks were included. Multi-level meta-analyses were performed to estimate overall effect sizes, examine moderating effects of conventionality, and compare impairment patterns. Meta-regressions explored potential moderators including aphasia status, sample size, task types, and number of trials. Results Forty-five articles met inclusion criteria, with 13 articles providing direct LBD-RBD comparisons (516 LBD; 476 RBD patients). Overall, no significant main effect of hemisphere emerged. Although the interaction between conventionality and lesion side did not reach statistical significance, the pattern of effect sizes across conventionality levels revealed meaningful trends. At high conventionality, LBD patients showed greater deficits than RBD patients, while at low conventionality, RBD patients showed greater deficits. Moderator analyses further revealed that task type and sample size significantly modulated the overall LBD-RBD difference, whereas aphasia status and number of trials did not. Additional comparisons including 70 LBD versus HC studies (1120 LBD patients, 1342 HC) and 68 RBD versus HC studies (1135 RBD patients, 1291 HC) confirmed that both patient groups are significantly impaired relative to healthy controls across all conventionality levels. Conclusion Hemispheric contributions to figurative language comprehension are dynamic and conventionality-dependent. The left hemisphere is particularly crucial for highly conventionalized expressions, while both hemispheres contribute to novel expressions. These findings are further qualified by methodological moderators: task type and sample size significantly modulated the observed hemispheric differences, whereas aphasia status and number of trials did not. The results have implications for neurocognitive models of figurative language and for the design of clinical assessments, highlighting the need to consider both conventionality and task demands when evaluating figurative language abilities in brain-damaged populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该元分析整合单侧脑损伤患者的研究，考察左右半球在比喻性语言理解中的贡献差异，以及表达约定性是否调节这种差异。总体上左、右脑损伤患者之间未出现显著的主效应，但效应量随约定性呈现趋势：高约定性表达上左脑损伤者缺损更明显，低约定性表达上右脑损伤者缺损更明显；该交互未达统计显著。任务类型和样本量显著调节两组的总体差异，失语症状态与试次数则无调节作用。与健康对照的比较显示，两组患者在各约定性水平上均存在显著缺损。作者据此认为半球贡献随约定性动态变化，并提示评估时需同时考虑约定性和任务要求。

papers.title: Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Correlates of Cognitive Reappraisal of Negative Emotion: A Brain Activation and Generalized Psychophysiological Interaction Study.
papers.authors: Liu Y, Gui S, Ma L, Yang L, Liu Z, Zhou Y, Wang X.
papers.abstract: Background Cognitive reappraisal has been extensively investigated using fMRI, yet the neural mechanisms underlying up- versus down-regulation of negative emotion remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to examine brain activation and task-dependent functional connectivity for both regulatory goals. Methods A well-established cognitive reappraisal task was employed during an fMRI scan, with 21 participants instructed to up- and down-regulate negative emotions by mentally reinterpreting the stimuli. Whole-brain activation analyses included a conjunction-null analysis and differential contrasts to identify shared and goal-specific activation. Generalized psychophysiological interaction (gPPI) analyses were also performed to examine task-dependent functional connectivity. Results Down-regulation primarily engaged the ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (VLPFC) and middle temporal gyrus (MTG), whereas up-regulation recruited prefrontal regions and the left insula. The conjunction-null analysis revealed common activation in a predominantly left-lateralized frontoparietal-medial frontal network beyond viewing negative pictures. Differential contrasts showed that up-regulation specifically recruited the left postcentral gyrus, whereas down-regulation specifically recruited occipital regions and the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). In exploratory and uncorrected gPPI analyses, during down-regulation, the VLPFC was positively coupled with the right MTG, whereas during up-regulation, the left DLPFC was coupled with the left insula and dorsal striatum. Conclusion These findings suggest that up- and down-regulation share a common frontoparietal-medial frontal network, but differ in goal-specific activation and connectivity patterns. Down-regulation may rely more on cognitive and semantic processing, whereas up-regulation may involve reward-related and interoceptive mechanisms. Given the exploratory nature of the gPPI findings, the connectivity results should be considered preliminary.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用fMRI结合认知重评任务，考察上调与下调负性情绪时脑激活和任务相关功能连接的异同。结果发现，两种调节目标共享一个以左侧偏侧化为主的前额-顶叶-内侧前额网络，但各自招募不同区域：下调更多涉及腹外侧前额叶和颞中回，上调则涉及前额区域和左侧岛叶，差异对比还显示上调特异性招募左侧中央后回、下调特异性招募枕区与右侧背外侧前额叶。探索性且未校正的功能连接分析提示，下调时腹外侧前额叶与右侧颞中回正耦合，上调时左侧背外侧前额叶与左侧岛叶及背侧纹状体耦合。作者据此认为下调可能更依赖认知与语义加工，上调可能涉及奖赏与内感受机制，但连接结果仅为初步，需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Cerebral Lateralization for Language as a Potential Biomarker for the Broad Autism Phenotype: A Functional Transcranial Doppler Ultrasonography Investigation.
papers.authors: Mendrinou V, Papadopoulou AK, Panopoulou I, Vlachos F, Ocklenburg S, Ahtam B, Badcock NA, Phylactou P, Papadatou-Pastou M.
papers.abstract: Introduction Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is associated with language deficits, while growing evidence suggests that atypical cerebral lateralization for language could serve as a potential neural marker for ASD. The present study seeks to investigate cerebral lateralization for language not only in terms of ASD, but also as a potential biomarker for the broad autism phenotype (BAP)-a sum of subclinical traits similar to those of ASD. BAP is often observed in family members of individuals with ASD, and encompasses personality, linguistic, social, communicative, and behavioral challenges that fall short of the diagnostic threshold for ASD. We hypothesize that individuals with ASD will show atypical patterns of cerebral lateralization for language relative to neurotypical controls, with individuals exhibiting BAP characteristics expected to fall between these two groups. Methods To test this hypothesis, neurophysiological and behavioral assessments of cerebral lateralization for language, alongside cerebral lateralization of visuospatial functions-to confirm that the expected differences are specific to language lateralization-will be performed in at least 26 children and adults with high-functioning ASD, 26 BAP-positive siblings (BAP group), and 26 neurotypical controls. Behavioral lateralization, namely handedness, will be assessed through neuropsychological tools, while cerebral lateralization will be measured utilizing functional transcranial Doppler ultrasonography (fTCD), a validated and reliable tool specialized for cerebral lateralization assessment. Results This is a Stage-1 registered report; therefore, no results are available at this time point. Conclusion Findings are expected to inform improved understanding and, potentially, early identification and screening for both ASD and BAP.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究计划比较高功能自闭症个体、具有广泛自闭症表型（BAP）特征的同胞与神经典型对照在语言功能大脑偏侧化上的差异，并借助功能性经颅多普勒超声测量偏侧化，同时评估利手等行为指标，还纳入视空间功能偏侧化以检验差异是否语言特异。作者假设自闭症个体的语言偏侧化模式偏离典型，而BAP个体介于两者之间。由于这是第一阶段注册报告，目前尚无结果，上述假设是否成立、语言偏侧化能否作为自闭症及BAP的潜在生物标志物，均待后续数据检验。

papers.title: Altered Inter-Network Functional Integration Underlies Speech Impairment in Parkinson's Disease: A Resting-State fMRI Analysis.
papers.authors: Deng S, Xiao Y, Dong Z, Zhong C, Yu Y, Yang C, Pan L, Weng B, Chen Y, Ye Z, Liu Y, Qin C.
papers.abstract: Background Speech impairment is common in Parkinson's disease (PD) and lacks effective clinical interventions due to poorly understood underlying mechanisms. Therefore, this study aimed to explore the relationship between altered brain functional networks and speech impairments in PD, identifying neural correlates of abnormal brain activity linked to PD-related speech disorders (SD). Methods Baseline clinical characteristics, neurobehavioral assessments, and resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data were collected from three groups: PD individuals with SD (PD-SD group), PD individuals without SD (PD-NON-SD group), and healthy controls (HC group). Independent component analysis (ICA) was performed to identify resting-state networks (RSNs) using the Group ICA of fMRI Toolbox (GIFT) implemented in MATLAB. Functional network connectivity (FNC) was subsequently quantified by calculating Pearson correlation coefficients between the extracted RSNs. One-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to assess group differences in FNC, followed by post hoc pairwise comparisons for networks showing significant effects. Given the reported association between speech impairment and cognitive impairment in PD, correlation analyses were further performed to investigate the relationships between FNC alterations and clinical measures, including speech performance and cognitive function assessed by the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA). Results Significant differences in FNC were observed between the left frontoparietal network (LFPN) and auditory network (AUN) across the three groups (p = 0.0280). In particular, the FNC between LFPN and AUN was significantly stronger in the PD-SD group compared to the PD-NON-SD group (p = 0.0221) and the HC group (p = 0.0047). Spearman correlation analysis revealed significant positive correlation between LFPN-AUN functional connectivity and Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale part III (UPDRS-III) speech subscores (rs = 0.2624, p = 0.0466), as well as a significant negative correlation with MoCA scores (rs = -0.2847, p = 0.0249). Conclusion This study identifies disrupted functional connectivity between the LFPN and AUN in individuals with PD-SD. These findings suggest that altered integration of RSNs involved in motor, cognitive, and auditory processing may contribute to speech impairment in PD. Hyperconnectivity between LFPN and AUN may thus serve as a neural substrate for speech impairment in PD. Specifically, increased connectivity between the LFPN and AUN may represent a neural signature associated with speech dysfunction in PD. These results provide potential mechanistic insights and highlight candidate neural targets for future neuromodulation strategies aimed at improving speech function.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病言语障碍的脑功能网络机制，比较了伴言语障碍的帕金森病患者、不伴言语障碍的患者与健康对照的静息态功能网络连接。结果显示，左侧额顶网络与听觉网络之间的功能连接在伴言语障碍组中明显强于另外两组，且该连接强度与言语评分呈正相关、与认知评分呈负相关。作者据此提出，运动、认知与听觉加工相关网络之间的整合异常可能与帕金森病言语障碍有关，这种超连接或可作为候选神经标志，但相关分析本身不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Combined With Median Nerve Electrical Stimulation for Severe Traumatic Brain Injury.
papers.authors: Wang N, Li M, Zhang G.
papers.abstract: Background Severe traumatic brain injury (sTBI) often leads to prolonged coma and poor neurological outcomes. Noninvasive neuromodulation techniques such as repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) and median nerve electrical stimulation (MNS) have shown potential in promoting arousal. However, the efficacy of combining these two approaches remains unclear. Methods In this randomized controlled trial, 86 patients with sTBI-induced coma were assigned to rTMS (n = 29), MNS (n = 29), or combination therapy (n = 28) for 4 weeks. Outcomes included awakening efficacy, EEG grading, cerebral blood-flow parameters (Vm, Vd, Vs, pulsatility index [PI]), GCS, and MoCA. Safety events were recorded. Results At week 4, the combination group demonstrated significantly higher overall awakening efficacy (92.86%, 26/28) compared with the rTMS (65.52%, 19/29) and MNS (62.07%, 18/29) groups (p < 0.05; number needed to treat [NNT] ≈ 4 for combination vs. MNS). GCS scores improved significantly within all groups (all p < 0.05), with the greatest mean change observed in the combination group (baseline 5.19 ± 0.62 → week 4: 11.23 ± 1.12; Δ+6.04), followed by MNS (Δ+4.50) and rTMS (Δ+4.19); between-group differences favored combination therapy (p < 0.05). EEG grading shifted toward lower-severity categories in all groups, with the combination group achieving the highest proportion of Grade I-II normalization at week 4 (71.4%, 20/28) compared with rTMS (62.1%, 18/29) and MNS (37.9%, 11/29). Transcranial Doppler-derived cerebral blood-flow velocities (Vm, Vs, Vd) increased and the pulsatility index decreased across all groups, with the combination group demonstrating the most pronounced hemodynamic improvement relative to either monotherapy (all p < 0.05). In an exploratory analysis restricted to patients who regained sufficient responsiveness to undergo cognitive testing (combination: 26/28 [92.9%]; rTMS: 19/29 [65.5%]; MNS: 18/29 [62.1%]), MoCA scores at week 4 indicated mild-to-moderate cognitive impairment across all groups (combination: 21.35 ± 2.87; rTMS: 18.74 ± 3.26; MNS: 18.22 ± 3.41), with numerically highest scores in the combination group; however, given the differential testability rates-which corresponded directly to awakening status-these findings are subject to inherent selection bias and should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating only. No seizures were observed throughout the study period. Adverse events were infrequent and did not differ significantly among groups (combination: 10.7%; rTMS: 20.7%; MNS: 27.6%; all pairwise p > 0.05), with rates numerically lowest in the combination group. Conclusions In patients with severe traumatic brain injury and persistent coma, rTMS combined with right MNS significantly improves awakening efficacy, neurophysiological indicators (EEG grading), and cerebral hemodynamics compared with either modality alone. GCS improvement was greatest with combination therapy. Exploratory cognitive findings (MoCA in testable subsets) suggest potential additional benefits, though these require confirmation in future trials employing outcome instruments applicable to all randomized patients. Adverse event rates were low across all groups, with no seizures observed; the study was not powered for formal safety comparisons. These findings support the dual-pathway neuromodulation paradigm as a promising strategy for consciousness recovery in sTBI and warrant confirmation in multicenter, sham-controlled trials with extended follow-up.
papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验比较了重复经颅磁刺激、正中神经电刺激及两者联合用于重症颅脑外伤后持续昏迷患者的促醒效果。治疗4周后，联合组的总觉醒有效率高于任一单用组，格拉斯哥昏迷评分改善幅度更大，脑电图分级向低严重度类别偏移的比例更高，经颅多普勒显示脑血流速度升高、搏动指数下降也更为明显。仅在恢复足够反应性、可完成认知测试的患者中进行的探索性分析提示联合组认知评分数值较高，但作者指出这受选择偏倚影响，只能视为假设生成。各组不良事件少见且无显著差异，未观察到癫痫发作，但研究未针对安全性比较进行功效设计；作者认为双通路神经调控是有前景的促醒策略，仍需多中心、假刺激对照及更长随访验证。

papers.title: Glymphatic System Dysfunction and its Associated Factors in Wilson's Disease: A DTI-ALPS Study.
papers.authors: Zhu L, Wu T, Zhang LJ, Liu QY, Zhang LL, Song B, Zhu YL, Hua L, Zhang L, Li B, Sun Q, Xue BC, Xu Y, Han YZ, Han YS.
papers.abstract: Background Wilson's disease (WD) is a genetic disorder of copper (Cu) metabolism that causes Cu accumulation in multiple organs, particularly the liver and brain, resulting in progressive multisystem damage. This study investigated glymphatic system function and its associated factors in patients with WD. Methods Seventy-one patients with WD (19 hepatic, 52 neurological) and 15 healthy controls (HCs) were enrolled. The analysis along the perivascular space (ALPS) index was quantified using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI-ALPS). Comparisons were performed between patients and than HCs, and across WD phenotypes, and correlations with clinical characteristics were analyzed. Results Compared with HCs, patients with WD exhibited significantly reduced ALPS index (p < 0.001). Patients with neurological WD had a significantly lower ALPS index than those with hepatic WD (p = 0.018) and HCs (p < 0.001). No significant difference was observed between patients with hepatic WD and HCs (p = 0.077). In neurological WD, the ALPS index was significantly higher on the left side than that on the right (p < 0.001), whereas no significant interhemispheric differences were found in hepatic WD or HCs (p > 0.05). In neurological WD, the ALPS index correlated positively with albumin, fasting blood glucose, and the white matter volume-to-total intracranial volume ratio (V_WM/TIV ratio), and negatively with age, alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase (AST), and the unified WD rating scale-part I (UWDRS-I) score. Multiple regression identified age, AST, and the UWDRS-I score as independent predictors of reduced ALPS index. Conclusions Neurological WD was associated with impaired glymphatic system function and altered lateralization. Age, AST, and the UWDRS-I score were independently associated with dysfunction.Glymphatic function, assessed by DTI-ALPS index, was impaired in neurological WD compared with the hepatic phenotype and controls. Age, AST, and UWDRS-I score independently predicted dysfunction, linking neurodegeneration, liver injury, and altered glymphatic activity.
keywords: Analysis Along The Perivascular Space Index
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用弥散张量成像的ALPS指数评估Wilson病患者类淋巴系统功能，比较患者与健康对照及不同表型间的差异，并分析其与临床指标的关系。结果显示，患者整体ALPS指数低于健康对照，且神经型患者明显低于肝型和对照，肝型与对照间未见显著差异；神经型患者还出现左右侧ALPS指数不对称。在神经型患者中，ALPS指数与年龄、肝酶及神经症状评分等相关，年龄、AST和UWDRS-I评分为其降低的独立预测因素。作者据此认为，类淋巴功能受损主要与神经型Wilson病相关，并可能与神经退行性改变和肝损伤相联系，但相关分析尚不能确立因果关系。

papers.title: Neuropathologic features of cognitively defined Alzheimer's disease subgroups in the Adult Changes in Thought study.
papers.authors: Latimer CS, Walker RL, Bogdani M, Keene CD, Nolan AL, Child DD, Mukherjee S, Choi SE, Lee ML, Nakano C, Ehrlich K, McEvoy LK, Crane PK.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Background Individuals with Alzheimer's disease (AD) dementia can be subgrouped based on cognitive performance at diagnosis. We compared neuropathology across cognitively defined AD subgroups in the Adult Changes in Thought study. Methods Scores for memory, executive functioning, language, and visuospatial abilities were derived from the Cognitive Abilities Screening Instrument and a neurocognitive battery. Subgroups were defined by relative performance within domains. Standardized neuropathologic evaluation was performed post mortem. Associations were estimated using ordinal logistic regression, with odds ratios (OR) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) comparing neuropathology between the AD subgroups and relative to individuals without dementia. Results Of 885 participants with post mortem neuropathology, 370 had AD dementia: 54% AD-no domain, 15% AD-memory, 15% AD-visuospatial, 8% AD-language, and 7% AD-executive. Among AD subgroups, associations were detected for limbic-predominant age-related transactive response DNA binding protein 43 kDa encephalopathy neuropathologic change (LATE-NC; P = 0.019) and hippocampal sclerosis (HS; P = 0.006), with highest levels in AD-language (LATE-NC OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.03-5.46 and HS OR 2.19, 95% CI 0.88-5.50) and AD-memory (LATE-NC OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.02-3.46 and HS OR 3.11, 95% CI 1.56-6.20) relative to AD-no domain, and lowest levels in AD-visuospatial. AD-visuospatial tended to have lowest estimated Alzheimer's disease neuropathologic change (ADNC) burden across AD subgroups. Relative to participants without dementia, all AD subgroups expectedly had higher ADNC burden, and several AD subgroups had higher odds of Lewy body pathology (P = 0.017) and gross infarcts (P = 0.004), with broadly similar estimates across multiple AD subgroups. Discussion Neuropathologic patterns of ADNC and co-pathologies across AD dementia subgroups suggest cognitive phenotyping may inform clinicopathologic studies of AD dementia.

papers.title: Cerebral blood flow as a biomarker of resilience in cognitively unimpaired APOE ɛ4 carriers.
papers.authors: Quiring M, Kapoor A, Alitin JPM, Lashin B, Joyce JL, Engstrom AC, Lohman T, Gaubert A, Shenasa F, Law KW, Ferrer F, Wang DJJ, Head E, Malhas R, Rodgers K, Han SD, Nation DA.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Introduction It remains unclear whether medial temporal lobe (MTL) hyperperfusion in cognitively unimpaired apolipoprotein E (APOE) ɛ4 carriers reflects resilience or dysfunction. We examined whether cortical MTL cerebral blood flow (CBF) relates to cognition differently in APOE ɛ4 carriers and noncarriers with and without AD pathophysiological changes. Methods One hundred forty-eight cognitively unimpaired older adults underwent pseudo-continuous arterial spin labeling MRI to quantify MTL CBF and assessment of memory and executive function. In a subset (n = 126), AD pathology was indexed using plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (pTau217 ). Results APOE ɛ4 carriers showed higher MTL CBF than noncarriers. Higher MTL CBF was associated with better executive function only in pTau217 -negative APOE ɛ4 carriers. Interactions remained significant after adjusting for MTL cortical volume or white matter hyperintensities. Discussion Hyperperfusion in cognitively unimpaired APOE ɛ4 carriers may reflect a resilience biomarker related to better cognitive function in the absence of detectable AD pathophysiological changes. Highlights Apolipoprotein E (APOE) ɛ4 carriers show elevated medial temporal lobe (MTL) cerebral blood flow (CBF). Higher MTL CBF is linked to better executive function in APOE ɛ4 carriers. This association is only observed in APOE ɛ4 carriers who are pTau217 -negative. MTL hyperperfusion may mark resilience in APOE ɛ4 carriers at risk for AD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注认知未受损的APOE ɛ4携带者内侧颞叶高灌注究竟反映韧性还是功能异常，用动脉自旋标记MRI测量脑血流并结合记忆与执行功能评估，部分参与者还检测了血浆pTau217。结果显示，APOE ɛ4携带者的内侧颞叶脑血流高于非携带者；且只有在pTau217阴性的APOE ɛ4携带者中，较高的内侧颞叶脑血流才与更好的执行功能相关，调整内侧颞叶皮层体积或白质高信号后这一交互仍成立。作者据此提出，在尚未检出AD病理生理改变时，这种高灌注可能作为与较好认知功能相关的韧性标志物，而非功能受损的表现。

papers.title: Retinal microvasculature alterations are associated with mild behavioral impairment in Southeast Asian dementia-free older adults.
papers.authors: Liao Y, Sim MA, Cui J, Zhang H, Hilal S, Chong EJ, Toh A, Tan BY, Venketasubramanian N, Richards AM, Xu X, Tham YC, Chen C.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Mild behavioral impairment (MBI) is an important neurobehavioral marker of dementia. This study examined associations between retinal vascular measures, MBI, and its potential neurobiological correlates. Dementia-free older adults from a memory clinic cohort were followed for up to 5 years. MBI was evaluated using the Neuropsychiatric Inventory. Retinal vessel caliber measures were quantified from fundus photographs. Associations of retinal vascular measures with neuroimaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease and plasma proteomic profiles were further explored. Among 302 participants, reduced arteriole-to-venule ratio (AVR) and narrower arteriole caliber (central retinal artery equivalent) were associated with a greater likelihood of incident MBI. Lower AVR was associated with white matter hyperintensity volume and circulating proteins related to immune function and inflammatory processes. Retinal microvascular alterations are associated with MBI in the pre-dementia stage, with exploratory findings suggesting related vascular and inflammatory biological correlates that warrant further investigation.

papers.title: EEG-based brain effective and functional connectivity predict PET-defined amyloid positivity in cognitively normal individuals.
papers.authors: Sun B, Gu M, Maher A, DuBois KN, Kanaan NM, Bross J, Koeppe R, Persad CC, Murphey YL, Kavcic V, Ren J, Giordani B, Li T.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Introduction Early identification of amyloid-beta (Aβ) pathology is essential for timely intervention in Alzheimer's disease (AD), as Aβ accumulation precedes clinical symptoms by years. Methods We predicted positron emission tomography (PET) -defined Aβ status in cognitively normal individuals using non-invasive resting-state dry electroencephalography (EEG). Brain effective and functional connectivity were quantified to characterize dynamic information transfer between regions. Features derived from dynamic brain connectivity were used to train machine learning models for Aβ classification. Results EEG-based models can predict amyloid positivity with accuracy comparable to, or in some cases exceeding, that of plasma p-tau217 and previously reported predictors based on cognitive measures, demographics, and health factors, depending on the model. Discussion Beyond near real-time Aβ inference, the framework identifies the most affected brain regions and connections associated with neurodegeneration, offering complementary information to blood-based biomarkers and supporting its potential as an affordable tool for early AD detection in primary care and population screening.

papers.title: The underlying neurobiology of social isolation and loneliness in middle-older adults: A systematic review.
papers.authors: Guarnera J, Kenyon K, Joshi N, Caeyenberghs K, Wheeler M, Macpherson H.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Social isolation and loneliness are distinct but overlapping dementia risk factors, though their underlying neurobiological mechanisms remain unclear. A systematic search identified 42 studies examining social isolation, loneliness, and neurobiological outcomes in middle-aged and older adults, including structural and functional neuroimaging, neuroinflammatory, and neurodegenerative markers. Findings identified patterns of neurobiological associations that were reported exclusively for social isolation, exclusively for loneliness, and shared across both concepts. Social isolation was more frequently associated with temporal regions (middle temporal gyrus, temporal lobe), whereas loneliness demonstrated associations with subcortical structures (putamen, globus pallidus). Shared patterns of association were most evident in limbic regions (hippocampus, amygdala, thalamus, fusiform gyrus). Both constructs were also associated with greater white matter hyperintensity/lesion volume and elevated C-reactive protein. Several implicated regions are vulnerable in dementia, suggesting potential neurobiological pathways linking poor social health to neurodegenerative risk. However, substantial methodological heterogeneity and inconsistent measurement approaches limit conclusions and highlight important directions for future research.

papers.title: Network-dependent remote effects and local tau burden jointly shape neuronal dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease.
papers.authors: Frontzkowski L, Roemer-Cassiano S, Gnörich J, Janowitz D, Eyob H, Probst K, Dhoqina D, Dewenter A, Steward A, Zhu Z, Klonowski M, Hirsch F, Biel D, Paulus M, Vöglein J, Schönecker S, Rauchmann BS, Kurz C, Koriath C, Häckert J, Stöcklein S, Palleis C, Perneczky R, Levin J, Buerger K, Werner RA, Höglinger G, Brendel M, Franzmeier N.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Background Tau pathology in Alzheimer's disease (AD) propagates along the brain's connectome, yet the mechanisms by which tau drives neuronal dysfunction remain unclear. We hypothesized that dysfunction primarily emerges in regions close to tau-harboring epicenters. Methods One hundred thirty-one amyloid-positive individuals underwent dynamic [18 F]PI-2620 tau positron emission tomography. Kinetic modeling yielded distribution volume ratios (DVRs) and perfusion (R1). Tau epicenters were defined as top 10% DVR regions. Connectivity-based distance to epicenters was derived from normative resting-state functional connectivity. Results At the individual level, hypoperfusion was more closely related to distance from tau epicenters than to local tau deposition, particularly in early AD, consistent with diaschisis-like disconnection. With advancing biological disease severity, local tau deposition increasingly converged with hypoperfusion. Critically, hypoperfusion mediated the relationship between tau accumulation and cognitive decline. Discussion Tau epicenters shape the brain-wide pattern of neuronal dysfunction, while local tau burden determines the degree of damage driving cognitive decline.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨阿尔茨海默病中tau病理如何经脑连接网络引发神经元功能障碍，对淀粉样蛋白阳性个体进行动态tau PET并建模得到灌注指标，同时依据功能连接计算各脑区与tau核心区的连接距离。结果显示，在个体层面低灌注与tau核心区距离的关系比与局部tau沉积更密切，早期阶段尤为明显，提示类似失连接的功能障碍；随着疾病生物学严重程度增加，局部tau沉积与低灌注逐渐趋于一致。低灌注还介导了tau累积与认知下降之间的关联，作者据此认为tau核心区塑造全脑功能障碍的空间格局，而局部tau负荷决定损害程度并推动认知衰退。

papers.title: Excitation-inhibition imbalance links amyloid pathophysiology to cognition in non-demented individuals.
papers.authors: Zhang S, Roemer-Cassiano SN, Chong JR, Fang T, Li Y, Wang Z, Zeng T, Li X, Deco G, Venketasubramanian N, Zhou JH, Chen CL, Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, Lai MKP, Franzmeier N, Yeo BTT.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Introduction Excitation-inhibition (E/I) imbalance has been proposed as an early circuit-level mechanism in Alzheimer's disease (AD), but its relationship to molecular pathology and cognition in humans remains unclear. Methods We integrated biophysical modeling of resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging with cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and plasma biomarkers to examine whether E/I ratio links amyloid pathophysiology to memory in non-demented individuals across two cohorts from North America (N = 302; CSF amyloid beta 42 [Aβ42]) and Singapore (N = 240; plasma phosphorylated tau 217 [p-tau217]). Results Elevated E/I ratio was associated with lower CSF Aβ42 and higher plasma p-tau217, with greater sensitivity in sensory-motor regions. In contrast, elevated E/I ratio in association cortices was more strongly related to worse memory function. Mediation analyses indicated E/I ratio partially accounted for the AD biomarker-memory relationship. Discussion E/I imbalance represents an intermediate, systems-level circuit mechanism that links AD pathophysiology to cognitive impairment, offering novel insight into early neurophysiological changes along the AD continuum.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨兴奋-抑制平衡是否在非痴呆人群中连接淀粉样蛋白病理与记忆功能。作者结合静息态功能磁共振的生物物理建模与脑脊液、血浆生物标志物，在两个队列中分析兴奋-抑制比值与病理标志物及记忆的关系。结果显示，兴奋-抑制比值升高与淀粉样蛋白病理标志物异常相关，且这种关联在感觉运动区更敏感；而联合皮层中该比值升高则与更差的记忆表现关系更强。中介分析提示，兴奋-抑制比值可部分解释生物标志物与记忆之间的联系。作者据此认为，兴奋-抑制失衡可能是连接阿尔茨海默病病理与认知损害的中观系统层面回路机制，为理解疾病连续谱上的早期神经生理变化提供了线索。

papers.title: World Trade Center neurotoxicant exposure severity is associated with cortical thinning and regional brain atrophy: a neuroimaging study of general responders at midlife.
papers.authors: Clouston SAP, Huang C, Askarov T, Wang Y, Chaudhry Z, Carr MA, Yang Y, West S, Mann FD, Marquez R, Vaska P, Meliker J, Gandy S, Lucchini RG, Luft BJ, Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Introduction Exposure to aerosolized pollutants is a risk factor for cognitive impairment and dementia, but the specific features of exposure-related neurodegeneration remain unclear. Methods We measured the World Trade Center Neurotoxicant Exposure Severity Index (WTC-NESI) in 218 responders and unexposed controls aged 44-65 years. The main outcome was cortical thickness. Correlation analyses reported unadjusted associations and multiple linear regression to adjust for correlates. Vertex-wise analyses were used with threshold-free cluster enhancement to examine associations after adjusting for cross-vertex clustering in atrophy. Results Cortical thickness was associated with WTC-NESI (R = -0.38, p < 0.001) that survived multivariable adjustment. Vertex-wise analyses revealed reduced cortical thickness across much of the cortical surface that was associated with WTC exposure severity. Results were right-hemisphere asymmetric and focused in the precentral regions (partial η2 ≥ 0.07). Conclusion Our results provide an important reference for neurotoxicological investigators mapping the implications of airborne pollutant exposures. This study suggests that efforts to mitigate exposures in first responders might have long-term implications for cerebral health.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察世贸中心气溶胶污染物暴露严重程度与中年救援人员大脑结构的关系，比较了暴露救援人员与未暴露对照者的皮层厚度，并分析其与暴露严重度指数的关联。结果显示，暴露越严重，皮层越薄，这一关联在调整多种相关因素后仍然存在，且涉及较大范围的皮层表面，以右半球和前中央区域较为突出。作者认为，这为空气污染物暴露相关神经退行性变化提供了参考，并提示减少一线救援人员的暴露可能对长期脑健康有意义；但研究为横断面关联，不能据此推断因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Vascular brain injury modifies the relationship between sleep duration, cognition, and white matter hyperintensity burden in the Alzheimer's disease continuum.
papers.authors: Lahlou S, Ismail Z, Smith EE, Dang-Vu TT, Badhwar A.
papers.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
papers.abstract: Introduction Self-reported sleep duration is associated with dementia-risk and vascular brain injury markers, including white matter hyperintensities (WMHs), yet how additional cerebrovascular pathology alters these relationships remains unclear. Method In a deeply phenotyped cohort (735) including healthy and Alzheimer's disease (AD) continuum individuals (subjective and mild cognitive impairment [MCI], dementia [AD], MCI and AD with high vascular burden [+V]), sleep was assessed using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index. Individuals were classified as WMH-only or WMH+ (WMHs with microbleeds, infarcts, or cerebral amyloid angiopathy). Linear models tested interactions between sleep duration, WMH+ status, and diagnostic group on WMH burden and cognition. Results In MCI+V and AD, WMH+ significantly amplified the association between shorter sleep and greater WMH burden. In AD, longer sleep related to better cognition in WMH+ but worse cognition in WMH-only (exploratory). Discussion Additional vascular brain injury modifies how sleep relates to WMH burden and cognition across the AD continuum, highlighting the importance of moving beyond WMHs alone.
