These findings suggest that the neuroanatomical correlates of neighborhood disadvantage may be sex-specific, and that sex-stratified analyses may be necessary to fully characterize the relationship between the social exposome and brain morphometry in clinical neuroimaging research.

papers.title: Multivariate Resting-State EEG Organization in Autism: Shared Age-Related Structure and Diagnostic Context Dependent IQ Associations
papers.authors: WANG Y, Wang Y, Chan S.
papers.abstract: Resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) studies of autism have often sought categoricaldifferentiation between autistic and typical neurodevelopmental groups, with limited stabilityacross features or classifiers. A neurodiversity-informed perspective views autism as part ofhuman neurodevelopmental variation, while recognizing associated disability and support needs.In this view, overlap between autistic and non-autistic EEG distributions is not merelyclassification noise, but may reflect shared dimensions of neural organization. A complementaryquestion arise is whether position along these dimensions has different functional meaning acrossdiagnostic contexts. We conducted an exploratory secondary analysis of 726 eyes-open resting-state EEG features previously extracted in a published multi-site autism EEG study, with a finalanalytic sample of 767 children and adolescents: 344 controls (CON), 347 participants classifiedby the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule as Autistic Disorder (ADOS-A), and 76classified as Autism Spectrum (ADOS-S). Principal component analysis was applied once to thepooled sample without including age, sex, IQ, or diagnostic group. The dominant component(PC1) was interpreted post hoc by examining its EEG feature loading pattern, its association withchronological age, the consistency of this age association across diagnostic groups, and theconcentration of age-related variance across components. We then tested whether age-adjustedposition on this component was differentially associated with general cognitive performance(i.e., IQ) across groups. PC1 explained 15.94% of feature variance and was characterized by thestrongest positive loadings on delta-band power and the strongest negative loadings on sampleentropy. PC1 showed a significant negative association with chronological age (𝑟 = −0.846,𝑝 < .001), indicating that older age was associated with relatively lower delta power and highersample entropy along this component, consistent with previously reported developmental EEGchanges. Age-related EEG variance was concentrated primarily on PC1 rather than onsubsequent components, supporting its interpretation as a shared age-related EEG dimension.After removing PC1’s linear association with age, residual PC1 scores (PC1r) were negativelyassociated with IQ within the ADOS-A group (𝑏 = −0.612, 𝑝 < .001), but not within thecontrol or ADOS-S groups. Pairwise slope contrasts indicated that this association wassignificantly more negative in ADOS-A than in CON, whereas ADOS-A vs. ADOS-S andADOS-S vs. CON contrasts were not significant. These findings shift emphasis from categoricalEEG abnormality toward individual variation within a broadly shared age-related EEGorganization, in which brain–cognition coupling depends on diagnostic context.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究对自闭症与非自闭症儿童青少年的静息态脑电特征进行探索性二次分析，用主成分分析考察两组脑电分布是否存在共享的组织维度，以及这些维度在不同诊断背景下是否具有不同的认知含义。结果显示，主导成分主要反映与年龄相关的脑电变化，在自闭症组和对照组间表现一致，说明两组脑电分布存在大量重叠而非截然分开。去除年龄影响后，该成分的残余得分仅在经ADOS分类为自闭症障碍的组内与智商呈负相关，对照组和自闭症谱系组未见此关联，且该关联强度在自闭症障碍组与对照组之间存在显著差异。作者据此认为，脑电与认知的耦合关系取决于诊断背景，研究重点应从类别性异常转向共享神经组织框架下的个体差异。

papers.title: Diffusion MRI Metrics as Markers of Neuroinflammation in Mental Illness
papers.authors: Oestreich LKL.
papers.abstract: Neuroinflammatory mechanisms are increasingly implicated in mental illness, but their characterization in the living human brain remains challenging. Diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) is sensitive to tissue microstructure and offers a scalable approach for studying immune-related brain changes, yet it does not measure inflammation directly. Inflammatory processes alter the cellular and extracellular geometry that constrains water diffusion, and glial activation, edema, demyelination, and axonal injury may produce overlapping or opposing diffusion signatures. This review evaluates the extent to which commonly used and emerging dMRI metrics can support an inflammatory interpretation. It distinguishes signal representations, including diffusion tensor and kurtosis imaging, from biophysical models such as free-water imaging, neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging, diffusion basis spectrum imaging, and newer compartment models, and examines their mechanistic sensitivity and limitations. A review of studies combining dMRI with immune-related measures in psychiatric populations identified a heterogeneous literature dominated by small samples, peripheral biomarkers, and within-group associations. Free-water measures showed the most consistent associations with inflammatory markers, whereas tensor-derived findings were variable and large population studies indicated very small effect sizes. Evidence from compartment models, molecular imaging, and intervention studies remains sparse. Validation studies in experimental, histological, ex vivo, and cellular systems demonstrate that diffusion signals can reflect immune-related microstructural change but are not specific to inflammation. Future work should prioritize multimodal validation, mechanistically informed acquisition and modeling, and explicit testing of competing explanations. Once validated, dMRI could provide a scalable means of mapping immune-related microstructural change across the brain in mental illness.

papers.title: Neural representations of emotional working memory in athletes
papers.authors: Li L, Tang S, SunMeirong, Li Y, QiMengdi, Xie J, Li D.
papers.abstract: Research on athletic expertise often emphasizes performance differences, leaving less clear how athletes and non-athletes represent emotional information during working memory. We examined whether group differences involve the timing and content of neural representations as memory demands change. Two experiments used a sequential emotional working memory task with loads of two or four images. Experiment 1 compared 25 athletes (16 female, mean age: 20.16 years) and 25 non-athletes (16 female, mean age: 21.04 years) using positive and negative images; Experiment 2 used negative images and included 36 athletes (19 female, mean age: 19.92 years) and 37 non-athletes (19 female, mean age: 20.41 years) in the final electroencephalography (EEG) sample. EEG time–frequency analysis exhibited that athletes showed lower theta power during encoding and maintaining comparing to non-athletes. Representational similarity analysis (RSA) further revealed that athletes showed greater arousal representations, while non-athletes showed greater semantic representations. When memory demand increased, visual-model similarity suggested that athletes can keep the visual information precisely, but non-athletes showed a load-dependent decline of visual representations. These findings provide novel neural evidence that athlete-related differences in emotional working memory involve the timing and content of neural representations, rather than a uniform behavioral advantage.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察运动员与非运动员在情绪工作记忆中的神经表征差异，采用序列情绪工作记忆任务并结合脑电时频分析与表征相似性分析，比较不同记忆负荷下的表现。结果显示，运动员在编码和维持阶段的theta功率较低，且唤醒度表征更强，而非运动员的语义表征更强；记忆负荷升高时，运动员仍能较精确地保持视觉信息，非运动员的视觉表征则随负荷下降。作者据此认为，运动员与非运动员的差异体现在神经表征的时间进程和内容上，而非统一的行为优势。

papers.title: Genetic Evidence of Association Between Plasma Cathepsin L2 and Alzheimer's Disease: A Mendelian Randomization Study.
papers.authors: Tian W, Hao Y, Qiu S, Chen Z, Wu X, Yang Y.
papers.abstract: Background Recent studies have suggested cathepsins, lysosomal cysteine proteases, are associated with Alzheimer's DISEASE (AD). This study conducted Mendelian Randomization (MR) analysis to systematically assess the causal effect of genetically predicted plasma cathepsins levels on AD and AD endophenotypes (cognition and brain structure). Method Recent large-scale Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS) in Europe provided summary statistics on plasma cathepsins, AD, cognition, and brain structure. The primary statistical estimate was employed by Inverse Variance Weighting (IVW). Various sensitivity analysis was performed to draw robust results, including Cochran's Q test, MR-Egger intercept test, and MR PRESSO. Results Genetically predicted plasma cathepsin levels were not significantly associated with AD risk. Higher genetically predicted cathepsin L2 levels were associated with better fluid intelligence (β = 0.081, 95% CI 0.029 to 0.133, P = 0.00230, adjusted P = 0.0207). The associations of cathepsin L2 with general cognitive function (β = 0.081, 95% CI 0.010 to 0.152, P = 0.0247, adjusted P = 0.2226) and white matter hyperintensity volume (WMH, β = -0.068, 95% CI -0.134 to -0.002, P = 0.0433, adjusted P = 0.3898) were considered exploratory. Cathepsin L2 was also associated with monocyte count after correction across the three evaluated immune-cell traits (nominal P = 0.0133, FDR-adjusted P = 0.0285); the estimated indirect effect through monocyte count was -0.0016. Discussion These findings identify cathepsin L2 as the most consistently associated candidate with fluid intelligence and additional exploratory signals across cognitive, neuroimaging, and peripheral immune-cell phenotypes. The association with monocyte count raises a testable hypothesis regarding a peripheral immune-related pathway. Further studies using larger protein GWAS datasets, stronger genetic instruments, and independent populations are required to validate these findings. Conclusion Genetically predicted plasma cathepsin L2 levels were associated with fluid intelligence after multiple comparisons. Although the immune-cell analyses raised the possibility of a monocyte-related peripheral pathway, the present findings did not establish a statistically supported mediating effect or a direct protective effect of cathepsin L2 against AD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用孟德尔随机化方法，基于欧洲人群的大规模全基因组关联研究汇总数据，评估遗传预测的血浆组织蛋白酶水平与阿尔茨海默病及其认知和脑结构内表型之间的关联。结果显示，遗传预测的组织蛋白酶水平与阿尔茨海默病风险无显著关联；组织蛋白酶L2水平较高与较好的流体智力相关，经多重比较校正后仍成立，而它与一般认知功能及白质高信号体积的关联仅为探索性。组织蛋白酶L2还与单核细胞计数相关，提示可能存在外周免疫相关通路，但作者强调未建立有统计支持的中介效应，也未证明其对阿尔茨海默病有直接保护作用，结论仍需更大规模数据与独立人群验证。

papers.title: Healthy Aging Alters P300-Period EEG Microstate Topographies and Transition Flexibility During Cross-Modal Attention Shifting
papers.authors: Gupta S, Beuria J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Healthy cognitive aging is characterized by slowed stimulus evaluation and reduced attentional flexibility. While classically indexed by delayed P300 eventrelated potential (ERP) latencies and attenuated parietal amplitudes, singlechannel electrophysiology cannot distinguish whether these differences reflect altered scalp electric field configurations (topographies), delayed recruitment of macroscopic brain states, or disrupted transition routing between large-scale functional networks. Here, we used reference-free EEG microstate analysis to resolve the spatiotemporal dynamics of the P300 period during cross-modal attention shifting by re-analysing an open-access auditory–visual oddball dataset (OpenNeuro ds002893; 15 younger, 15 older adults) across focused and cued shift-focus conditions. Older adults exhibited pronounced P300 latency delays for visual targets (g > 0.96; FDR-corrected) and attenuated amplitude during auditory shifting (g = −0.94; FDR-corrected). Microstate back-fitting across the 300–700 ms post-stimulus interval revealed that the whole-scalp configuration corresponding to Class B emerged approximately 48 ms later in older adults (g > 1.0; FDR-corrected) alongside significantly diminished spatial template fidelity. Crucially, first-order Markov transition matrices revealed that older adults exhibited constrained directional transitions into target-evaluation states (Classes B and C) alongside elevated state-persistence self-loops (A → A), reflecting reduced flexibility and increased dynamical inertia during attentional set reconfiguration. Cross-domain analyses confirmed strong convergence between sensor-level P300 amplitude and multichannel Class-C Global Field Power (r = +0.90 to + 0.93). These findings demonstrate that age-related slowing during cross-modal attentional reconfiguration reflects constrained recruitment spatial degradation, and altered transition syntax of distributed whole-scalp electrophysiological states across the P300 period.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究重新分析公开的听觉—视觉oddball脑电数据，比较年轻与年长成人在集中注意和线索提示切换条件下的P300时段，用无参考微状态分析考察全头皮电场构型及其转换。结果发现，年长者对视觉目标的P300潜伏期延迟、听觉切换时波幅降低；与目标评价相关的微状态出现更晚且空间模板保真度下降，同时向目标评价状态的定向转换受限、状态自我维持增多，提示注意定势重组时灵活性降低、动态惯性增加。作者据此认为，年龄相关的跨模态注意重组变慢不仅涉及局部波幅或潜伏期变化，也反映分布式全脑电状态的招募延迟、空间退化与转换规则改变。

papers.title: A Resource-Constrained Evaluation of Fine-Tuned Deep Learning and Local Zero-Shot Vision-Language Models for Brain MRI Slice Classification
papers.authors: Wu Z, Yeh C.
papers.abstract: Abstract Fine-tuned deep learning (DL) classifiers report near-saturated performance on public brain MRI slice datasets, but dataset leakage, lack of patient-level metadata, and limited robustness evaluation restrict their interpretation. Concurrently, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable zero-shot image understanding, yet their unadapted zero-shot performance under local hardware constraints remains unverified. We conducted a paired evaluation comparing fine-tuned DL architectures (ResNet18, EfficientNet-B0, ConvNeXt-Tiny, ViT-B/16) across three seeds against local zero-shot MLLMs (Qwen3-VL-2B/8B, MedGemma-4B) on a locked, leakage-screened 260-image four-class evaluation set using a single NVIDIA RTX 3080 GPU (10 GB). We evaluated ImageNet pretraining on ResNet18, executed a 35,100-inference controlled corruption matrix across five synthetic transformations, and compiled a frozen 24-case Grad-CAM failure gallery. Fine-tuned ConvNeXt-Tiny achieved the highest mean Macro-F1 (0.9610 ± 0.0041), followed by EfficientNet-B0 (0.9531 ± 0.0069), pretrained ResNet18 (0.9476 ± 0.0024), and ViT-B/16 (0.9284 ± 0.0157). ImageNet pretraining exceeded scratch training by +0.0617 Macro-F1 (95% CI [0.0077, 0.1192]; scratch seed SD 0.0515), though scratch models exhibited marked seed-level initialization sensitivity. The strongest local zero-shot MLLM (Qwen3-VL-8B) reached Macro-F1 0.3991, yielding a large observed performance gap under the tested zero-shot, label-only setting (McNemar p < 0.001). Under corruptions, ConvNeXt-Tiny had the numerically lowest mean Macro-F1 drop (0.0253). Grad-CAM maps revealed spatial shifts during perturbation failures, though focal maps were also observed in misclassified cases. Under constrained local compute, which restricts deployable model parameter scale, the tested fine-tuned DL models substantially outperformed the unadapted zero-shot MLLMs evaluated without task-specific fine-tuning on this slice-level benchmark. High in-domain scores must be interpreted conservatively alongside dataset provenance, corruption sensitivity, and post-hoc explanation limits.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在单张消费级GPU的算力约束下，比较了微调深度学习模型与本地零样本多模态大模型在脑MRI切片四分类任务上的表现，使用经过泄漏筛查的固定评估集，并考察了ImageNet预训练的作用和合成图像扰动下的稳健性。结果显示，微调模型整体明显优于未经任务适配的零样本大模型，其中ConvNeXt-Tiny的平均Macro-F1最高，预训练也优于从零训练，但从零训练对初始化较敏感；在扰动条件下各模型性能均有下降。作者据此提醒，高域内分数需结合数据来源、扰动敏感性和事后解释的局限谨慎解读，且该比较仅反映特定零样本、仅标签设定下的差距，不能外推为临床效果。

papers.title: Chronic Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Burden and Acute Infarction in Relation to Functional Brain Network Efficiency: A Cross-Sectional Resting-State fMRI Study
papers.authors: Gao Y, Lu C, Liu Y, Zhao Y, Zheng L, Gu Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Chronic cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) and acute infarction frequently coexist, but their respective relationships with functional network integration remain uncertain. We examined whether cumulative CSVD burden and clinical acute infarction were independently associated with resting-state functional global efficiency and explored which lesion phenotypes and anatomical regions showed the strongest associations. Methods This hospital-based cross-sectional study included 166 patients aged 45 years or older with suspected cerebrovascular disease. Automated multisequence MRI segmentation quantified white matter hyperintensities, recent small subcortical infarcts, lacunes, perivascular spaces, and cerebral microbleeds. Resting-state functional networks were constructed using a 90-region anatomical parcellation, with global efficiency prespecified as the primary outcome. HC3 heteroskedasticity-robust multivariable linear regression adjusted for age, sex, hypertension, diabetes mellitus, mean framewise displacement, and clinical acute infarction. Regional markers were jointly evaluated within each lesion family, with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. Results Higher total CSVD burden was independently associated with lower global efficiency (B per 1-point increase = − 0.0055, 95% CI: −0.0086 − 0.0024; P < 0.001), whereas clinical acute infarction was not (B = 0.0008, 95% CI: −0.0071–0.0087; P = 0.850). The lacune regional block explained an additional 9.27% of variance (robust P = 0.00195). Parietal lacunes (B=-0.0130, FDR q = 0.026) and deep lacunes (B=-0.0132, FDR q = 0.021) were independently associated with lower global efficiency. Regional cerebral microbleed, perivascular-space, and white-matter-hyperintensity blocks were not statistically significant. Conclusions Greater cumulative CSVD burden, particularly parietal and deep lacunes, was associated with impaired functional network integration, whereas clinical acute infarction showed no independent association in this cohort. These cross-sectional findings identify anatomically informative correlates but do not establish causal or temporal relationships.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究纳入疑似脑血管病患者，结合多序列MRI病灶定量与静息态功能网络分析，考察慢性脑小血管病总负荷和临床急性梗死是否分别与全脑功能网络全局效率相关。结果显示，较高的脑小血管病累积负荷与较低的全局效率独立相关，而急性梗死未见独立关联；在各类病灶中，腔隙灶的解释力最突出，其中顶叶和深部腔隙灶与全局效率降低独立相关，微出血、血管周围间隙和白质高信号则无显著关联。作者据此认为，慢性脑小血管病负担，尤其是特定部位腔隙灶，与功能网络整合受损相关，但横断面设计尚不能确立因果或时间先后关系。

papers.title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Resting-State Criticality as a Neurophysiological Marker of Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) Performance in People with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) and Healthy Participants
papers.authors: Settgast T, Shriki O, Northoff G, Zilio F, Borgheai SB, Shahriari Y, Kübler A.
papers.abstract: Abstract This exploratory study investigates the relationship between resting-state brain dynamics (EEG) and subsequent brain-computer interface (BCI) performance in people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and healthy participants. Grounded in the critical brain hypothesis, we examined whether neurophysiological markers of criticality in resting-state EEG correlate with subsequent BCI performance. We analyzed neuronal avalanche dynamics, multiscale criticality measures, the spectral slope, and Lempel-Ziv complexity across two datasets: a longitudinal single-case study of a person in the locked-in state after a disease history with ALS (Dataset 1) and longitudinal data from 5 people with ALS and single sessions from 6 healthy participants (Dataset 2). Neuronal avalanche dynamics, the spectral slope, and Lempel-Ziv complexity consistently correlated with subsequent BCI performance in people with ALS. Conversely, healthy participants showed inverted correlation patterns for the neuronal avalanche dynamics. While group comparisons were not statistically significant, effect size analyses indicated supercritical brain dynamics in people with ALS. We integrate these findings into the B-ARC (BCI-Aptitude through Resting-State Criticality) framework proposing an inverted U-shaped relationship between the proximity of resting-state brain activity to criticality and BCI control. In this framework, healthy participants approach the critical optimum from a subcritical regime, while people with ALS appear to approach it from a putatively supercritical regime characterized by cortical hyperexcitability. These findings and the proposed framework provide potential resting-state predictors of BCI aptitude in people with ALS and may inform the detection of so-called Windows of Consciousness .
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究考察静息态脑电动力学与后续脑机接口（BCI）表现之间的关系，分析对象包括肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者和健康参与者，采用神经元雪崩动力学、多尺度临界性指标、频谱斜率及Lempel-Ziv复杂度等指标。结果显示，在ALS患者中，这些临界性指标与随后的BCI表现一致相关；健康参与者的神经元雪崩动力学则呈现相反的关联模式。组间比较未达统计显著，但效应量分析提示ALS患者存在超临界脑动力学。作者据此提出B-ARC框架，认为静息态活动接近临界点的程度与BCI控制能力呈倒U形关系，健康人从亚临界一侧接近临界最优，ALS患者则可能从超临界一侧接近，为ALS患者的BCI适配性预测提供了潜在静息态指标。

papers.title: Voided REM Sleep (V-REM): A Candidate Biomarker Linking Treatment-Resistant PTSD and Major Depressive Disorder
papers.authors: Ndiaye MO.
papers.abstract: A substantial proportion of patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and major depressive disorder (MDD) do not respond to ﬁrst-line treatment. Approximately 40% of PTSD patients do not respond to ﬁrst-line psychotherapy, and 30.9% of MDD patients meet criteria for treatment-resistant depression. Yet standard polysomnography in these patients frequently shows REM sleep that appears architecturally normal. I propose that this apparent normality may be masking a functional anomaly in which the ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC) node of the default mode network and the amygdala show abnormal connectivity during REM epochs, occurring despite intact brainstem-generated REM markers (muscle atonia, rapid eye movements, characteristic EEG activity). I term this pattern Voided REM sleep (V-REM), REM sleep that completes its brainstem-generated form without completing its forebrain-mediated emotional-processing function. I outline the anatomical and physiological rationale for distinguishing REM’s form from its function, review evidence consistent with the hypothesis in both PTSD and MDD, specify a falsiﬁability criterion, and propose a functional MRI protocol using four matched comparison groups to test the hypothesis directly. Establishing V-REM as a biomarker would not require resolving, at this stage, whether the anomaly is a cause or a consequence of treatment resistance. As history has shown with other biomarkers whose clinical value was established well before their causal role was understood, this would not diminish the potentially pivotal role such a discovery could play in identifying and treating this subgroup of patients.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出“空洞化REM睡眠（V-REM）”这一候选生物标志物假说，试图解释难治性PTSD与MDD患者常规多导睡眠图显示REM睡眠结构看似正常、却对一线治疗反应不佳的现象。作者认为，这类患者的REM期虽具备脑干生成的肌肉失张力、快速眼动和特征性脑电等标志，但默认网络腹内侧前额叶节点与杏仁核之间的连接可能异常，使前额叶介导的情绪加工功能未能完成。文章梳理了解剖与生理依据及PTSD和MDD中的相关证据，给出可证伪标准，并设计四组匹配的功能磁共振比较方案直接检验该假说。作者强调，确立V-REM作为生物标志物暂不依赖厘清其与治疗抵抗的因果方向，但这仍是假说，临床价值有待验证。

papers.title: Monosynaptic GABAergic projections from a subset of suprachiasmatic nucleus neuromedin S neurons suppress preoptic area kisspeptin neuron firing in female mice.
papers.authors: Abdulmajeed WI, Neuman PN, Jamieson BB, Thomas SX, Rim Y, Novak AG, Lehman MN, Campbell RE, Piet R.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Neural control of ovulation is critical for reproductive success. In spontaneous ovulators, this is achieved through hypothalamic neural circuits relaying ovarian follicle maturity cues to gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH)-secreting neurons to drive the preovulatory luteinizing hormone (LH) surge. Within these circuits, kisspeptin-expressing neurons in the rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle (RP3VKISS1 neurons) are thought to stimulate GnRH neurons for the LH surge. In female rodents, the central circadian clock in the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) regulates the timing of RP3VKISS1 and GnRH neuron activation, coordinating neuroendocrine control of ovulation and behavior. However, the mechanisms thereof are not fully understood. Here, we examined the potential regulation of RP3VKISS1 neuron activity by neuromedin S (NMS)-expressing SCN neurons - a neuronal population essential for circadian rhythms - using anatomical tract-tracing, optogenetics and electrophysiology in female mice. Our observations indicate that a subset of SCNNMS neurons, likely distinct from the canonical arginine vasopressin and vasoactive intestinal peptide SCN populations, projects to RP3VKISS1 neurons. Optogenetic activation of these projections evokes monosynaptic release of GABA onto ≈ 75% of RP3VKISS1 neurons. Whereas exogenous NMS only moderately affected RP3VKISS1 neuron activity, with no effect on firing and altered intracellular calcium concentration in subsets of cells, GABA release from SCNNMS fibers in the RP3V potently suppressed KISS1 neuron action potential firing, through activation of GABAA receptors. Together, these findings reveal additional complexity in the regulation of the GnRH neuronal network by the central circadian clock. Potential implications of these observations for the timing of the LH surge are discussed.Significance statement In females of multiple species, neuroendocrine circuits in the hypothalamus, which include preoptic area kisspeptin neurons and converge on the gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) neurons, integrate information about gonadal state with circadian cues to triggers ovulation. The mechanisms though which the central circadian clock in the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) relays timing cues to the GnRH neuronal network are, however, incompletely understood. Using anatomical and functional approaches, we found that a previously unsuspected subpopulation of SCN neurons projects to preoptic area kisspeptin neurons and, unexpectedly, suppresses these cells' activity through the release of the inhibitory neurotransmitter GABA. Our observations suggest that control of activity within the GnRH neuronal network for ovulation might extend beyond modulation by canonical SCN neuropeptides.

papers.title: Intrinsic timescale develops hierarchically from sensorimotor to association cortex in youth and stabilizes in adulthood.
papers.authors: Shafiei G, Bagautdinova J, Sydnor VJ, Bassett DS, Barch DM, Cieslak M, Fan Y, Flook E, Franco AR, Kiar G, Luo AC, Milham MP, Parkes L, Salo T, Somerville LH, Tong TT, Shinohara RT, Satterthwaite TD.
papers.abstract: Intrinsic timescale is a commonly used measure of spontaneous neural dynamics that quantifies the temporal window of processing of neuronal populations. Intrinsic timescale displays a hierarchical cortical organization across multiple species and imaging modalities, with shorter timescales in sensorimotor cortex compared to association cortex. However, less is known about how intrinsic timescale evolves during human brain development and whether its cortical maturation patterns generalize to independent developmental samples. Here we estimate the intrinsic timescale in two independent cross-sectional datasets of youth (HCPD: n = 565; HBN: n = 729; age range 8-22 years) and investigate its neurodevelopmental patterns. We find that developmental patterns in the intrinsic timescale follow a hierarchical pattern that recapitulates an axis spanning sensorimotor to association cortices (S-A axis). Our analysis of an independent healthy young adult dataset (HCPYA: n = 973, age range 22-37 years) underscores the specificity of these developmental findings, suggesting that the intrinsic timescale develops along the S-A axis in youth and stabilizes in adulthood. Together, these results reveal convergence between major axes of cortical organization and development, highlighting intrinsic timescale as a principled marker of hierarchical brain maturation in youth.

papers.title: Cerebellar Theta-Burst Stimulation Induces Distinct Functional Connectivity Patterns in Post-Stroke Aphasia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
papers.authors: Wang X, Xu X, Wang D, Huang G, Zheng K, Chen C, Jiang D, Gao F, Ren C, Zhao Z.
papers.abstract: Background Recent studies have identified the right cerebellar Crus I (rCrus I) as a promising target for rTMS in improving language rehabilitation. However, it remains unclear whether continuous theta burst stimulation (cTBS) over the rCrus I improves language outcomes in patients with subacute post-stroke aphasia (PSA). Objective To determine whether inhibitory cTBS over rCrus I improves language recovery in PSA and to explore underlying functional connectivity (FC) mechanisms. Methods Fifty-one PSA patients were randomized to receive either real cTBS (n = 25) or sham stimulation (n = 26) over rCrus I (10 sessions, 2 weeks) combined with speech-language therapy (SLT). Language assessments (WAB-AQ, BNT, BDAE) and resting-state fMRI were conducted before and after the intervention. Results Both groups showed significant language improvement post-intervention. No significant interaction was found for WAB-AQ (P = .058), but a significant interaction was observed for repetition (P = .034), favoring cTBS. Resting-state fMRI showed altered connectivity between rCrus I and right temporo-occipital regions, with FC changes negatively correlated with language gains in the cTBS group. Exploratory subgroup analyses identified 2 distinct FC response patterns (FC-increase and FC-decrease), indicating heterogeneous cerebello-cortical and intra-cerebellar connectivity modulation across participants. Conclusions Cerebellar cTBS did not confer a significant overall benefit on language recovery in PSA, but selectively improved repetition performance, suggesting domain-specific effects. Functional imaging indicated that rCrus I-centered connectivity changes were associated with behavioral outcomes, with marked inter-individual variability. These findings support a modulatory role of cerebellar cTBS on language networks, warranting further validation in larger, well-powered studies. Trial registration This trial was registered under the China Clinical Trial Registry (Registration No. ChiCTR2100049828).
papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验探讨抑制性连续θ爆发刺激（cTBS）作用于右侧小脑Crus I能否改善亚急性卒中后失语患者的语言恢复，并考察其功能连接机制；患者在接受言语语言治疗的同时接受真刺激或假刺激。结果显示，两组语言功能均有改善，cTBS未在总体失语商上带来显著额外获益，但复述成绩出现有利于cTBS的交互作用，提示效应具有领域特异性。静息态功能磁共振显示，cTBS组右侧小脑Crus I与右侧颞枕区的连接发生变化，且连接改变与语言进步呈负相关；探索性分析还发现连接升高与降低两种反应模式，个体差异明显。作者据此认为，小脑cTBS对语言网络具有调节作用，但整体疗效有限，需更大样本验证。

papers.title: How to Recognize and Manage Missing Key Electrodes in Defining the Epileptogenic Zone.
papers.authors: Shaker H, Medina Villalon S, Gonzalez-Martinez J, Trebuchon A.
papers.abstract: Identifying and localizing the epileptogenic zone (EZ) is the cornerstone of successful epilepsy surgery, as it directly determines surgical efficacy and patient outcomes. Stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) has emerged as a transformative tool for pinpointing the EZ, offering precise 3-dimensional recordings of seizure activity in individual patients. SEEG does not begin with electrode implantation, but with the formulation of a precise hypothesis regarding the epileptogenic networks involved. This hypothesis is based on data gathered during Phase I investigations, particularly the electroclinical correlations of seizure obtained from video-EEG monitoring. SEEG can be appropriately performed only when a prior estimation of EZ and propagation networks is available. The guiding principle of SEEG is therefore not exhaustive anatomical coverage, but rather the validation of a predefined hypothesis. Consequently, certain brain regions are deliberately not explored, there is always missing electrodes. However, in some cases, we encounter true "missing" electrodes, unanticipated gaps in electrode coverage, that can profoundly impact the diagnostic process. These missing electrodes may create critical gaps in the spatial sampling of epileptic networks, leading to incomplete localization of the EZ. This limitation can hinder the identification of seizure onset zone, propagation pathways, and network interactions, ultimately restricting surgical options and compromising patient outcomes. Current clinical practice highlights a significant knowledge gap in how to anticipate such issues during SEEG planning and how to optimally interpret data when electrode coverage is suboptimal. Key questions remain: How can electrode placement errors be identified early? And how can emerging technologies help compensate for these gaps? In this article, we aim to illustrate and discuss these critical issues.
papers.summary_zh: 本文聚焦立体脑电图（SEEG）中“缺失关键电极”的问题：当电极覆盖出现非预期的空间空白时，如何识别并处理，以免影响致痫区定位。作者指出，SEEG以验证术前癫痫网络假设为原则，本就存在有意未探查的区域，但真正的覆盖缺口会造成癫痫网络采样不足，使发作起始区、传播路径和网络交互的判定不完整，进而限制手术选择与患者结局。文章据此讨论了早期发现电极放置问题以及借助新兴技术弥补覆盖缺口的可能方向，并强调当前在SEEG规划与覆盖欠佳时的数据解读上仍存在明显知识空白。

papers.title: Feasibility and safety of repeated low-intensity ultrasound in amyloid PET-positive early Alzheimer's disease: A prospective pilot study.
papers.authors: Park BY, Jo SW, Park TY, Kim H, Kim MS, Kang SY, Cho SJ, Kim J, Kim S.
papers.abstract: BackgroundLow-intensity ultrasound (LIUS) is a potential noninvasive neuromodulatory approach for Alzheimer's disease (AD), but clinical evidence on repeated stimulation in biomarker-confirmed early AD remains limited.ObjectiveTo evaluate the feasibility, safety, and exploratory clinical effects of a 4-week repeated LIUS protocol in amyloid positron emission tomography (PET)-positive early AD.MethodsTwenty patients with amyloid PET-positive prodromal AD or mild AD dementia underwent LIUS targeting bilateral frontal and temporal regions three times weekly for 4 weeks. Safety was assessed by neurological examinations and brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Exploratory outcomes included the Trail Making Test-Black & White (TMT-B&W) parts A and B, Attention Questionnaire Scale (AQS), Korean version of Quality of Life (KQoL), Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE), and Neuropsychiatric Inventory (NPI). Resting-state functional MRI was analyzed in an exploratory subset.ResultsNo severe adverse events occurred, and post-treatment MRI showed no intracerebral hemorrhage, microbleeding, or brain edema. Completion times decreased on TMT-B&W part A (105.3 ± 63.3 versus 84.2 ± 46.6 s, p = 0.012) and part B (280.1 ± 139.9 versus 212.8 ± 59.7 s, p = 0.038). NPI scores also decreased (9.8 ± 14.7 versus 4.5 ± 8.8, p = 0.006). KQoL, AQS, and MMSE did not change significantly.ConclusionsRepeated LIUS over 4 weeks was feasible and well tolerated in amyloid PET-positive early AD. Exploratory changes in executive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms were observed; however, the single-arm design precludes causal inference. Randomized, sham-controlled studies are warranted to determine the therapeutic potential of LIUS.
papers.summary_zh: 该前瞻性先导研究评估了为期4周的重复低强度超声方案在淀粉样蛋白PET阳性的早期阿尔茨海默病人群中的可行性与安全性，并探索其临床效应。治疗未出现严重不良事件，治疗后MRI未见脑出血、微出血或脑水肿；探索性结果显示执行功能任务完成时间和神经精神症状评分有所下降，而生活质量、注意量表和MMSE未见显著变化。作者指出，单臂设计无法推断因果，这些探索性变化尚不能视为疗效证据，仍需随机假对照研究验证其治疗潜力。

papers.title: High burden and unique pattern of cerebral small vessel disease in antiphospholipid syndrome: MRI subtypes and risk profile in a large cohort.
papers.authors: Fan Y, Wang W, Kang Y, Liu X, Cai Q, Liu Z, Li C, Guo J.
papers.abstract: ObjectiveTo characterize the burden and MRI subtypes of cerebral small vessel disease (cSVD) in antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) and to identify clinical factors associated with cSVD.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 132 patients with APS and age- and sex-matched healthy controls. MRI markers for cSVD, including lacunes, enlarged perivascular spaces (EPVS), microbleeds, and white matter hyperintensities (WMH), were rated using validated scales. Total cSVD scores (0-4) were calculated. Logistic regression analyses adjusted for age, sex, and disease duration were used to identify risk factors.ResultsMore than half of patients with APS (51.5%) exhibited cSVD, whereas only 24.2% had a history of stroke. Lacunes were the predominant subtype (46.2%), followed by WMH (16.7%), EPVS (14.4%), and microbleeds (12.1%). Subclinical cSVD was present in 34.8% of patients with APS without neurological symptoms. Hypertension (OR 3.69, 95%CI 1.17-11.65, p = 0.026), prior thrombosis (OR 22.15, 95%CI 2.11-232.27, p = 0.010), and prior stroke (OR 10.71, 95%CI 2.47-46.36, p = 0.002) were independently associated with cSVD, while individual aPL profiles were not.ConclusioncSVD is a common feature in patients with APS and often occurs in the absence of neurological manifestations. The predominance of lacunes suggests a pattern of recurrent microvascular injury. Hypertension and thrombotic history are major contributors, underscoring the need for comprehensive vascular risk assessment. These findings highlight the potential value of MRI screening in selected patients with APS and call for longitudinal studies to clarify its prognostic significance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注抗磷脂综合征（APS）患者脑小血管病的负担与MRI亚型，回顾性比较了APS患者与年龄、性别匹配的健康对照的影像学表现。结果显示，超过半数APS患者存在脑小血管病，但仅约四分之一有卒中史，且相当比例无神经系统症状者已出现亚临床病变；腔隙灶是最主要亚型，提示反复微血管损伤的模式。高血压、既往血栓和既往卒中与脑小血管病独立相关，而单个抗磷脂抗体谱并非独立因素，作者据此强调对APS患者进行综合血管风险评估及在部分患者中考虑MRI筛查的意义，并指出需纵向研究明确其预后价值。

papers.title: Viewpoint on Computational Modeling of Multisensory Integration.
papers.authors: Beierholm UR, Colonius H, Shams L.
papers.abstract: This article presents a compiled interview with three prominent figures in multisensory research: Ulrik Ravnsborg Beierholm, Hans Colonius, and Ladan Shams. Through structured dialogue, the authors reflect on the evolution of computational modeling, from early mathematical psychology to the current dominance of Bayesian causal inference (BCI). The discussion highlights key paradigm shifts, specifically the transition from descriptive studies of illusions to normative, mechanistic explanations of perception. The authors identify the 2002 demonstration by Ernst and Banks of statistically optimal integration as a pivotal milestone in establishing how the brain weighs sensory reliability. Crucially, the authors discuss the subsequent development of BCI as the first framework to formally address the 'binding problem' - the computational challenge of determining whether sensory signals originate from a common source (integration) or distinct sources (segregation). Current trends and controversies are explored, including the application of computational phenotypes to clinical populations, the debate over the neural implementation of Bayesian computations, and the rising influence of deep neural networks. While artificial intelligence (AI) offers new avenues for analyzing high-dimensional data, the authors emphasize the need for biological realism and explainability. The dialogue also addresses the importance of open science, the challenge of accounting for individual differences, and the necessity of moving toward naturalistic environments. The article concludes with professional advice for early-career scientists, emphasizing interdisciplinary training in mathematics and statistics. Collectively, the authors argue that multisensory processing is not a 'special case' of perception but the default mode of brain operation, providing essential principles for understanding learning, plasticity, and memory.
papers.summary_zh: 本文是一篇观点性访谈汇编，三位多感官研究领域的学者以结构化对话回顾了计算建模从早期数学心理学到贝叶斯因果推断（BCI）主导的演变，并指出研究重心已从对错觉的描述转向对知觉的规范性、机制性解释。作者将Ernst与Banks关于统计最优整合的示范视为确立大脑如何权衡感觉可靠性的关键节点，并强调BCI首次形式化地处理了“绑定问题”，即判断感觉信号来自同一来源（整合）还是不同来源（分离）。对话还涉及计算表型在临床人群中的应用、贝叶斯计算的神经实现之争以及深度神经网络的影响，同时提醒人工智能虽有助于分析高维数据，仍需兼顾生物真实性与可解释性。作者主张多感官加工并非知觉的特例，而是大脑运作的默认模式。

papers.title: Oxygen extraction fraction mapping between normal cognition and mild cognitive impairment in older adults using quantitative BOLD.
papers.authors: Le LNN, Wheeler GJ, Blockley NP, Fletcher E, Jung Y, Farias SET, Gavett B, DeCarli C, Fan AP.
papers.abstract: Oxygen extraction fraction (OEF) represents the proportion of oxygen utilized by the brain from the blood and is a sensitive biomarker in understanding the vascular interplay between oxygen supply and demand. Alterations in OEF are increasingly recognized in normal aging and the pathophysiology of many neurological disorders, including Alzheimer's disease and cognitive impairment. Here, we aimed to assess regional OEF MRI in older adults and investigate its relationship with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and normal aging using a Variational Bayesian quantitative BOLD (qBOLD) framework. The qBOLD model leverages a biophysical relationship between OEF, deoxygenated blood volume (DBV), and the reversible transverse relaxation rate (R2 ' ) to extract parameter values from asymmetric spin echo (ASE) MRI scans. The reliability of these parameter estimates was enhanced by Variational Bayesian inference, which incorporates prior distributions that we optimized in numerical simulation. We then applied this model to a cohort of older adults (N = 70) from the Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (ADRC) at the University of California, Davis, including 58 cognitively normal (CN) and 12 amnestic mild cognitive impaired (MCI) participants. Our findings revealed a trend of elevated OEF across many cortical brain regions in the MCI group. Additionally, we identified regional positive associations between OEF and age in the MCI group, significantly in the left inferior parietal region ( β=0.88±0.23, T=3.75, P=0.0004 ). Furthermore, the relationship between OEF and episodic memory in the right parahippocampal region differed significantly between two diagnostic groups (negative for CN and positive for MCI) ( β=0.09±0.02, T=3.77, P=0.0004 ). This work adopts a novel qBOLD MRI framework for studying OEF changes in cognitive impairment as a potential biomarker for monitoring pathophysiology in aging and dementia.

papers.title: Language Access and Hemispheric Specialization: A Network Neuroscience Framework for Typical and Atypical Language Development.
papers.authors: Bortfeld H.
papers.abstract: Neural plasticity in early life underpins the emergence of hemispheric specialization, including left-lateralized networks commonly involved in language. In typical development, neural organization becomes progressively more efficient and specialized across hemispheres, with trajectories shaped by early sensory input and linked to later language outcomes. Because human neuroimaging evidence supports a role for language experience across sensory modalities in shaping neural organization, early sensorineural hearing loss provides a model system for disentangling how sensory and language environments independently influence experience-dependent plasticity. Even when overall brain organization is preserved, early sensory deprivation is associated with altered developmental trajectories of hemispheric specialization. Critically, sensory deprivation does not inevitably result in atypical language or neural development, underscoring an important theoretical distinction between auditory and language deprivation. This review integrates findings from neural, behavioral, and clinical research to propose a framework for understanding how early sensory and language experiences shape language-related developmental outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕早期经验如何塑造语言相关半球偏侧化这一问题，整合神经、行为与临床研究，提出一个理解典型与非典型语言发展的网络神经科学框架。作者指出，典型发展中脑组织逐渐变得更高效、更专门化，其轨迹受早期感觉输入影响并与日后语言结果相关；早期感音神经性听力损失则被用作区分感觉环境与语言环境各自作用的模型。综述强调，即使整体脑组织保持，早期感觉剥夺仍与半球专门化的发展轨迹改变有关，但感觉剥夺并不必然导致非典型的语言或神经发展，因此需要区分听觉剥夺与语言剥夺。

papers.title: Leadership in the mirror: Discovering dyslexic leadership as a strategic asset in healthcare integration.
papers.authors: Phillips JS.
papers.abstract: Background Healthcare integration demands leaders who can navigate complex multi-organisational environments, yet understanding of how cognitive diversity contributes to leadership effectiveness remains limited. Dyslexia, a specific learning difference affecting how the brain processes language, is often viewed through a deficit lens despite emerging evidence of cognitive advantages, including enhanced pattern recognition and systematic problem-solving. Aim To reflect on my personal journey of discovering how dyslexic cognitive patterns functioned as strategic assets in healthcare integration leadership, challenging deficit-based assumptions about neurodivergent leadership capabilities. Methods This Leadership in the Mirror reflection draws on a qualitative intrinsic case study conducted during my MSc in Healthcare Leadership. The study involved semi-structured interviews with eight leadership team members across three NHS organisations, complemented by reflective analysis and team effectiveness measures using the Affina Team Journey questionnaire. Thematic analysis revealed patterns in how dyslexic traits influenced leadership practices and team outcomes. Findings Four interconnected themes emerged: structured enablement (creating clear frameworks that enabled rather than constrained team development), reflective integration (using systematic analysis to bridge organisational boundaries), safe progress (building psychological safety through structured approaches), and measured transformation (enabling sustainable change through thorough planning). Team effectiveness improved across multiple dimensions, with role clarity increasing from 3.6 to 4.4 and inter-team working from 3.5 to 4.1 (on 5-point scales where 4.0+indicates effective team functioning). Conclusions Traits commonly viewed as dyslexic limitations-systematic processing, need for structure, methodical analysis-proved to be leadership capabilities that enhanced team effectiveness in complex healthcare integration contexts. This challenges traditional deficit-based approaches to neurodivergent leadership development and suggests that cognitive diversity may be essential for navigating healthcare transformation challenges outlined in the 2025 NHS 10 Year Health Plan.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以作者在医疗领导力硕士学习期间开展的内在定性个案研究为基础，结合对三家NHS机构八名领导团队成员的半结构化访谈、反思分析和团队效能问卷，反思阅读障碍相关认知特征如何影响医疗整合中的领导实践。主题分析归纳出结构化赋能、反思性整合、安全推进和审慎变革四个相互关联的主题，团队效能多个维度有所改善。作者据此提出，常被视为阅读障碍局限的系统化加工、对结构的需求和方法性分析，在复杂医疗整合情境中可成为提升团队效能的领导能力，从而挑战以缺陷为导向的神经多样性领导力发展观；但该结论来自单一反思性个案，尚需更多研究验证。

papers.title: Longest surviving patient with a homozygous splice-altering EGFR pathogenic variant presenting with skin autoinflammation and a Bartter-like salt-losing tubulopathy.
papers.authors: Youssefian L, Biglari S, Vahidnezhad F, Hossein Saeidian A, Samii R, Tavasoli AR, Kalamati E, Sotoudeh S, Bazargani B, Hosseinpour S, Pak N, Tabatabaiefar MA, Malekan Rad E, Mesdaghi M, Saffarian Z, Saffarian F, Guy A, Kariminejad A, McGrath J, Gudjonsson JE, Hakonarson H, Vahidnezhad H.
papers.abstract: Background Bartter syndrome (BS) is a salt-losing renal tubulopathy classically characterised by hypokalaemic metabolic alkalosis and hyperreninaemic hyperaldosteronism. Methods We investigated the genetic cause of a Bartter-like phenotype in an adolescent patient with progressive nephrocalcinosis, hypercalciuria, polyuria, metabolic alkalosis, hypokalaemia, significantly elevated urine chloride, failure to thrive, and a salt-losing tubulopathy. Additionally, the patient presented with hypergammaglobulinaemia, abnormal cerebral white matter signal changes, skin autoinflammation, and mild intellectual disability. Results No pathogenic variants were detected in known BS-related genes, and all recessive BS genes were outside regions of homozygosity (ROH) in this patient from a consanguineous family. Instead, exome sequencing and homozygosity mapping identified a homozygous splicing variant, c.2702-2A>G, in the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR ) gene within an ~28 Mb ROH on chromosome 7p. RNA-Seq and RT-PCR analysis of the patient's RNA confirmed the pathogenicity of this variant, demonstrating aberrant splicing resulting in an in-frame retention of 27 nucleotides from intron 22 of EGFR . Immunofluorescence analysis of the proband's skin revealed a reduced EGFR protein level, rather than a complete absence, supporting a hypomorphic effect and likely explaining compatibility with survival into adolescence. Whereas previously reported EGFR variants have been associated with severe neonatal epithelial inflammation, bowel disease, and early mortality, our findings demonstrate that a hypomorphic variant can be compatible with survival into the second decade of life. Conclusion These findings support an association between a syndromic Bartter-like salt-losing tubulopathy with epithelial autoinflammation and a homozygous splice-altering EGFR pathogenic variant, thereby expanding the phenotypic spectrum of EGFR -associated disorders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在一名近亲婚配家庭的青少年患者中探究类Bartter综合征表型的遗传病因，该患者除盐丢失性肾小管病、进行性肾钙质沉着和高钙尿外，还伴有皮肤自身炎症、高丙种球蛋白血症、脑白质信号异常及轻度智力障碍。外显子测序与纯合性定位未发现已知Bartter综合征相关基因的致病变异，而是在7号染色体纯合区域内检出EGFR基因的纯合剪接变异；RNA分析证实该变异导致异常剪接并保留内含子片段，皮肤免疫荧光显示EGFR蛋白水平降低而非完全缺失，提示为亚效等位基因效应。作者据此认为，该亚效变异可支持患者存活至青春期，拓展了EGFR相关疾病的表型谱，并提示类Bartter盐丢失性肾小管病与上皮自身炎症可能与该变异相关。

papers.title: Effectiveness of non-pharmacological therapies for poststroke aphasia: a protocol of a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Huang M, Huang X, Ni F, Huang L, Shen X.
papers.abstract: Introduction Poststroke aphasia is a common disabling complication following stroke, severely affecting patients' communication abilities and quality of life. Currently, various non-pharmacological therapies (eg, speech and language therapy, transcranial magnetic stimulation, computer-assisted therapy, etc) have been applied in clinical practice and show potential. However, the relative effectiveness and superiority among these interventions remain unclear. This study aims to systematically compare the effectiveness of different non-pharmacological therapies in improving language function in poststroke aphasia through a network meta-analysis and to rank their efficacy, thereby providing the best evidence for clinical decision-making. Methods and analysis The protocol will be reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis Protocols (PRISMA-P) guidelines. The subsequent completed systematic review and network meta-analysis will be reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) for network meta-analyses (an extension of the PRISMA 2020 statement) guidelines. We will systematically search PubMed, EMBASE, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Web of Science and China National Knowledge Infrastructure for randomised controlled trials on non-pharmacological therapies for poststroke aphasia published from inception to March 2026. Two researchers will independently conduct literature screening, data extraction and risk of bias (RoB) assessment using the Cochrane RoB tool. The primary outcome is overall language function; secondary outcomes include specific language domains and quality of life. We will employ a frequentist framework for network meta-analysis using random-effects models. The node-splitting model will assess inconsistency, and surface under the cumulative ranking curve will evaluate treatment ranking probabilities. Ethics and dissemination As this review will use only published aggregated data, ethical approval is not required. Findings will be disseminated through a peer-reviewed publication and presentations at relevant conferences. Prospero registration number CRD420261297981.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一项系统综述与网状Meta分析的研究方案，计划比较言语语言治疗、经颅磁刺激、计算机辅助治疗等非药物疗法对卒中后失语患者语言功能的改善效果，并对其疗效排序，为临床决策提供依据。方案拟检索多个数据库中的随机对照试验，由两名研究者独立完成筛选、数据提取与偏倚评估，主要结局为整体语言功能，次要结局包括具体语言领域和生活质量，并采用随机效应模型进行网状Meta分析。由于目前仅有方案、尚无结果，摘要未报告任何疗效发现，各疗法之间的相对优劣仍待该综述完成后才能回答。

papers.title: Machine learning methods and schizophrenia spectrum disorders: a scoping review.
papers.authors: Rivera LA, Costa-Dookhan KA, Raj V, Dissanayake J, Siddiqui I, Hahn M, Rotenberg M, Maslej M, Foussias G.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SSDs) are chronic conditions associated with profound functional impairment, disability and economic burden. Traditional approaches to diagnosis and management often struggle to capture the heterogeneity of SSD. In recent years, machine learning (ML) has expanded rapidly in mental health research, offering ways to analyse complex datasets, uncover subtle patterns and generate predictive models that could inform more individualised interventions. Objectives This scoping review aimed to map how ML has been applied to SSD research with emphasis on clinical and functional outcome trajectories. Eligibility criteria Peer-reviewed studies investigating any use (eg, predictive tool, treatment algorithm) of ML in determining outcomes in SSD were eligible. Non-English language studies, grey literature, systematic reviews and conference abstracts were excluded. Sources of evidence Following Arksey and O'Malley's framework and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) extension for scoping reviews, we searched three bibliographic databases (MEDLINE, APA PsycInfo, Embase) with input from a health sciences librarian. The initial search was completed on 28 July 2023 and re-run on 10 March 2025. Charting methods Two independent reviewers screened studies at title/abstract and full-text stages and extracted data using a standardised table in Covidence, capturing study design, ML techniques, data sources and outcomes. Methodological and reporting quality of included studies was appraised using the APPRAISE-AI instrument. Results 88 studies met inclusion criteria. For included studies, n=62 were cross-sectional, n=19 were cohort studies, n=5 were case-controls, n=1 was an evaluation study and n=1 carried out a secondary analysis of data from a randomised controlled trial. Overall, methodological and reporting quality were moderate (mean APPRAISE-AI score 47.4/100, range 31-65). ML applications were grouped into five domains: clinical, treatment, functional, behavioural and provider outcomes. Clinical outcome studies used electronic health records, clinical assessments, neuroimaging and mobile sensing to predict relapse, remission, symptom severity and suicide risk. Treatment studies modelled treatment response, resistance and adverse effects, with attention to clozapine and electroconvulsive therapy. Functional studies employed deep learning to analyse speech, social cognition and real-world functioning. Behavioural outcomes included prediction of aggression, self-harm and offending. Provider outcomes examined prescribing patterns using supervised learning. Across domains, integration of multimodal data and adoption of advanced approaches such as deep neural networks were evident. Conclusions ML in SSD research shows significant promise for advancing diagnosis, prognosis and treatment planning. However, methodological rigour, interpretability, fairness and clinical validation remain critical for future translation into practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了机器学习在精神分裂症谱系障碍研究中的应用，重点考察其与临床及功能结局轨迹的关系。纳入研究整体方法学和报告质量为中等，应用集中在临床、治疗、功能、行为和医疗服务提供者五类结局，涉及利用电子健康记录、临床评估、神经影像和移动感知预测复发、缓解、症状严重度与自杀风险，以及建模治疗反应、耐药和不良反应等。作者认为机器学习在诊断、预后和治疗规划上具有潜力，但方法严谨性、可解释性、公平性和临床验证仍是其走向实践的关键限制。

papers.title: Multimodality imaging for surgical decision-making in tricuspid regurgitation: from referral to intraoperative assessment.
papers.authors: Ghazy A, Humbert T, Albitar M, Elzomor H, Danesi TH, Refaey A, Duerr GD, Treede H, Zancanaro E.
papers.journal: European heart journal. Imaging methods and practice
papers.abstract: Tricuspid regurgitation (TR) is a clinical syndrome in which integrated multimodality imaging is central to diagnosis, timely referral, procedural selection, and assessment of treatment success. This narrative state-of-the-art review focuses on the imaging information that changes decisions along the surgical pathway while positioning surgery within contemporary transcatheter practice. Transthoracic echocardiography remains the gateway examination; three-dimensional transoesophageal echocardiography refines leaflet and annular anatomy; cardiac magnetic resonance provides the most reproducible assessment of right ventricular volumes and function; and cardiac computed tomography defines annular geometry, adjacent structures, device leads, and access. We distinguish guideline-endorsed thresholds from observational or consensus-derived decision aids and link mechanism, annular dilatation, leaflet tethering, right ventricular reserve, pulmonary haemodynamics, and end-organ risk to the choice of repair, replacement, transcatheter therapy, or surveillance. Particular emphasis is placed on perioperative imaging: the effects of anaesthesia and loading conditions, accurate septolateral annular measurement, the definition of an acceptable post-bypass result, and the significance of central vs. eccentric residual jets. A dedicated section compares imaging requirements for transcatheter edge-to-edge repair and transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement and summarizes post-procedural surveillance. The central message is that imaging does not replace clinical judgement; it provides the shared language through which the Heart Team selects the right intervention before irreversible right-heart and end-organ damage develops.

papers.title: Reproducible cortical links between functional hierarchy, structure, and metabolism.
papers.authors: Tomasi D, Volkow ND.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Large-scale functional connectivity gradients provide a compact description of cortical organization, capturing hierarchical transitions from unimodal sensory systems to transmodal association cortex. Although these gradients have become a central framework for studying macroscale brain organization, it remains unclear whether they systematically map onto regional cortical biology. Here we show that functional gradient position robustly predicts cortical thickness and regional glucose metabolism, measured with MRI and FDG-PET respectively. Modeling parcelwise cortical thickness and glucose metabolism as linear combinations of signed and amplitude components along functional gradients explained substantial variance in both measures across individuals, with signed gradient terms improving prediction in every subject. These relationships generalized across scanning sessions and independent cohorts and remained significant under spatial permutation testing. Gradient-based models outperformed classical graph-theoretic connectivity metrics, whereas nonlinear extensions did not improve performance. Cortical myelin was selectively associated with the signed component of the principal gradient, without an amplitude effect, and this pattern replicated across developmental, adult, and aging cohorts, supporting a microstructural basis for gradient-cortical thickness coupling. In contrast, gradient associations with glucose metabolism remained largely intact after controlling for myelination, indicating additional biological determinants. These findings establish functional gradients as a reproducible framework linking cortical hierarchy to structure and metabolism.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大规模功能连接梯度能否系统对应皮层厚度、葡萄糖代谢等区域皮层生物学特征，并结合MRI与FDG-PET数据，将各脑区的皮层厚度和葡萄糖代谢建模为功能梯度上带符号成分与幅度成分的线性组合。结果显示，梯度位置能稳定预测这两项指标，带符号梯度项在每名个体中都改善预测，且该关系可跨扫描场次和独立队列复现；梯度模型优于经典图论连接指标，非线性扩展未带来提升。皮层髓鞘仅与主梯度的带符号成分相关，而控制髓鞘后梯度与葡萄糖代谢的关联仍基本保留，提示后者还受其他生物因素影响。作者据此认为，功能梯度可作为连接皮层层级与结构、代谢的可复现框架。

papers.title: Functional brain networks underlying approach-avoidance conflict processing in humans and rats.
papers.authors: Stewart NR, Valenzano SL, Zhang J, Chu S, Wu Z, Khiabani Javid J, Lee ACH, Ito R.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Our ability to arbitrate between competing approach and avoidance motivations is thought to be an emergent property, arising from the coordinated activity of functional brain networks. Parallel lines of investigation in human and rodent research have identified candidate hub regions supporting approach-avoidance conflict (AAC) behavior, namely the anterior (ventral) hippocampus and prefrontal cortex; yet, a cross-species elucidation of the network dynamics supporting learned conflict processing has yet to be demonstrated. Here, we sought to bridge this translational gap by conducting a functional network analysis in humans and rats from brain-wide neural activity generated by learned motivational conflict. We found that the anterior hippocampus in humans and ventral hippocampus in rats occupied highly central hub-like positions in the network and were highly integrated with extrinsic functional communities. The insula, particularly the posterior insula in rats, was also identified as a putative cross-species hub. Finally, we identified shifts in network topology based on individual differences and sex in conflict preference. Our findings provide evidence for conserved network dynamics, particularly at the regional scale, supporting AAC processing in humans and rats.

papers.title: A neural architecture for imagined and overt speech motor dynamics.
papers.authors: Zhao Z, Wang Z, Liu Y, Qian Y, Yin Y, Gao X, Yuan B, Tong SX, Tian X, Chen G, Li Y, Lu J, Wu J.
papers.abstract: Mental imagery is a hallmark of human cognition, yet its neural mechanisms remain poorly understood. Speech imagery (the internal simulation of speech without overt articulation) has been proposed to partially share substrates with speech production, but its spatiotemporal dynamics remain controversial. Here, we leveraged high-resolution electrocorticography to investigate shared and modality-specific coding of articulatory kinematic trajectories during speech imagery and articulation. Linear modeling revealed robust articulatory kinematic trajectories encoding in frontoparietal cortex across modalities. Supramodal populations across middle premotor, subcentral and postcentral-supramarginal regions exhibited spatiotemporal stability during integrative planning. In contrast, modality-specific populations for speech imagery and articulation were somatotopically interleaved in primary sensorimotor cortex, revealing a distinct spatiotemporal organization. We further developed a generalized decoding framework that achieved high prediction accuracy for speech imagery (median 80.4%; chance 16.7%), comparable to speech articulation (78.3%). These findings uncover a somato-cognitive organization linking supramodal planning with modality-specific representations, informing imagery-based brain-computer interfaces.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用高分辨率皮层脑电记录，考察言语想象与出声发音时构音运动轨迹的共享和模态特异性编码。线性建模显示，额顶叶皮层在两种模态下均能稳健编码构音运动轨迹；中前运动区、皮层下区和中央后-缘上回区域的跨模态群体在整合规划阶段表现出时空稳定性，而言语想象和发音各自的模态特异性群体则在初级感觉运动皮层内按躯体定位交错分布。作者据此提出一种连接跨模态规划与模态特异性表征的躯体-认知组织方式，并开发出对言语想象预测准确率接近出声发音的通用解码框架，为基于想象脑机接口提供参考。

papers.title: Double-blind, randomized clinical trial targeting theta oscillations with transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) for cognitive control in male methamphetamine patients.
papers.authors: Tian Y, Jiang L, Gang X, Chen M, Tang S, Wang X, Zhang X, Wang D.
papers.abstract: Methamphetamine use disorder is associated with significant cognitive control deficits, and effective treatments remain limited. Frontal midline theta (FM-theta) oscillations are implicated in cognitive control, but whether theta-frequency transcranial alternating current stimulation (theta-tACS) can improve proactive and reactive control in this population remains unclear. This study initially enrolled 68 male participants diagnosed with methamphetamine use disorder according to DSM-5 criteria. Among them, 56 individuals completed all study procedures and were included in the final analysis. Cognitive control was assessed using a conditional stop-signal task with concurrent EEG recording. The stimulation protocol comprised 15 consecutive daily sessions, during which participants received either active theta-tACS or sham stimulation (2 mA, FCz - Pz montage) in a double-blind design. Following the 15-day theta-tACS stimulation, patients exhibited a significant improvement in preparation cost (p = 0.001) and an increased inhibition rate (p = 0.003). EEG analyses showed that tACS selectively enhanced late-stage proactive control-related theta power (p = 0.026), without significantly modulating theta activity associated with reactive control (p > 0.05). Importantly, the tACS stimulation restored the functional coupling between FM-theta activity and proactive control performance (p = 0.04), and baseline late-stage theta power at T0 positively predicted improvement in preparation cost (ΔT1 - T0) during proactive control (p = 0.01). Finally, a mediation analysis revealed that the tACS-induced improvement in inhibition rate was mediated by the enhanced preparation cost. These findings suggested theta-tACS enhances proactive control by restoring the functional coupling between FM-theta activity and proactive control, which in turn triggers a cascading improvement in reactive control.

papers.title: Network adaptability governs resilience and susceptibility to social defeat.
papers.authors: Ayash S, Koch SP, An J, Schmitt U, Mueller S, Foddis M, Candemir E, Tüscher O, Boehm-Sturm P, Müller MB.
papers.abstract: Stress resilience-the ability to maintain mental health after adversity-manifests in humans and rodents as efficient threat-safety discrimination and fear extinction. Although behavioral differences between resilient and susceptible individuals are well documented, the brain-wide structural signatures that distinguish resilience, susceptibility, and impaired threat learning remain poorly defined. Using a translational mouse model of chronic social defeat stress in male C57BL/6 J mice (n = 55), combined with preregistered multimodal magnetic resonance imaging with graph-theoretical analyses, we identify structural and network-level correlates of three behavioral phenotypes. Resilient animals exhibited greater microstructural complexity in prefrontal regions, and showed signatures consistent with enhanced inhibitory gating within amygdalar circuits. In contrast, susceptible animals-defined behaviorally by fear generalization and resistance to extinction-exhibited dentate gyrus alterations across all measures, suggesting diminished microstructural adaptability. A third phenotype, impaired threat learning-mice that failed to avoid individuals from a threatening strain-was associated with altered CA1/CA2 microstructure and reduced structural connectivity in pons, pointing to disrupted hippocampal-brainstem interactions during memory consolidation. These findings demonstrate that resilience, susceptibility, and impaired threat learning arise from dissociable patterns of brain organization, with resilience reflecting adaptive circuit-level organization and susceptibility and impaired threat learning exhibiting distinct forms of microstructural and network reorganization.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性社交挫败应激后，韧性、易感性与威胁学习受损三种行为表型各自对应怎样的全脑结构特征。作者用雄性小鼠的慢性社交挫败模型，结合多模态磁共振成像和图论分析，发现三者呈现可分离的脑组织模式：韧性动物在前额叶微结构复杂性更高，并表现出与杏仁核环路抑制性门控增强相符的特征；易感动物以恐惧泛化和消退抵抗为行为标志，其齿状回在多项指标上均出现改变，提示微结构可塑性下降；威胁学习受损则与CA1/CA2微结构改变及脑桥结构连接减弱相关，指向记忆巩固期海马—脑干交互受损。结果提示，韧性与易感并非同一维度的两端，而是由不同的微结构和网络重组方式支撑。

papers.title: Disrupted cortical hierarchy and delayed connectome-based propagation in the functional connectome of schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Joo SW, Lee J.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia is associated with widespread abnormalities in large-scale brain organization; however, the mechanisms linking altered cortical hierarchy to disrupted neural communication and clinical symptoms remain unclear. By integrating functional connectivity gradient analysis and stepwise functional connectivity (SFC), we aimed to clarify how alterations in cortical hierarchy translate into disrupted connectome-based propagation in schizophrenia. Methods Resting-state functional MRI data from 820 participants (310 healthy controls and 510 patients with schizophrenia) were analyzed across multiple cohorts. Cortical hierarchy was characterized using functional connectivity gradients, focusing on the principal unimodal-transmodal gradient (G1). Connectome-based propagation was examined using SFC, with step counts indexing propagation efficiency across predefined hierarchical levels. Associations with clinical symptoms were assessed, including mediation analyses. Results Global cortical hierarchy was preserved in schizophrenia; however, selective alterations were evident. Patients with schizophrenia showed significantly reduced G1 values in the dorsal attention network (DAN), with regional alterations primarily localized to dorsal attention and somatomotor regions. SFC analysis revealed delayed propagation toward higher-order association networks in schizophrenia, reflected by increased step counts to intermediate and transmodal hierarchical levels. Among patients with illness duration <5 years, delayed propagation to higher hierarchical levels was associated with greater positive and negative symptom severity. Mediation analyses demonstrated that delayed propagation significantly mediated the relationship between DAN hierarchical positioning and clinical symptoms. Conclusions These findings suggest that schizophrenia is characterized by selective disruption of cortical hierarchy within attentional control systems, leading to impaired large-scale connectome-based propagation that links cortical organization to clinical symptoms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症中皮层层级改变如何与神经通讯障碍及临床症状相联系，基于静息态功能磁共振数据，结合功能连接梯度分析与逐步功能连接，考察了患者皮层层级组织及连接组传播特征。结果显示，患者整体皮层层级基本保留，但背侧注意网络等区域出现选择性改变；向高阶联合网络的连接组传播延迟，表现为到达中间和跨模态层级所需步数增加。在病程较短的患者中，这种传播延迟与更严重的阳性及阴性症状相关，并中介了背侧注意网络层级位置与临床症状之间的关系。作者据此提出，注意控制系统内皮层层级的选择性破坏可能通过损害大规模连接组传播而连接皮层组织与临床症状，但这一中介关系仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Metabolic and microstructural brain alterations associated with occupational blast exposure.
papers.authors: Song C, Rhodes CS, Lippa SM, Yeh PH, Powell JR, Pickett TC.
papers.abstract: Repeated occupational exposure to low-level blast may pose a risk to the neurological health of service members. To date, no studies have specifically investigated the effects of such repetitive exposure using fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET). This study aims to characterize cerebral metabolic alterations associated with occupational blast exposure, accounting for confounding factors such as posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms and aging. Male service members with chronic mild TBI (mTBI) were categorized into high-risk (HR; n = 204) and low-risk (LR; n = 68) blast exposure groups based on their military occupational specialty. FDG-PET and diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) data were analyzed using region-of-interest (ROI) and voxelwise methods. Statistical models included age and PTSD symptom severity as covariates. Compared to the LR group, ROI analyses revealed higher FDG uptake in the left pallidum, caudate, and ventrolateral prefrontal cortex in the HR group. These elevations in metabolic activity may reflect compensatory mechanisms in response to neurophysiological disruption following blast exposure. Voxelwise analysis showed lower FDG uptake in the HR group within white matter, predominantly in the right hemisphere, including the corpus callosum, anterior thalamic radiation, inferior and superior longitudinal fasciculi. Corresponding DTI findings showed higher fractional anisotropy (p = 0.0025) and axial diffusivity (p = 0.024) in these regions. Furthermore, leftward metabolic lateralization was observed in the pallidum, with the HR group (Cohen's d = 1.36, 95% CI [1.14, 1.57]) exhibiting greater metabolic asymmetry than the LR group (Cohen's d = 1.16, 95% CI [0.79, 1.51]). Findings from this study reveal metabolic and microstructural alterations associated with occupational blast exposure in service members with mTBI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重复性职业性爆炸暴露是否与慢性轻度创伤性脑损伤军人的脑代谢改变有关，并纳入年龄和创伤后应激症状作为协变量，采用FDG-PET与弥散张量成像进行分析。结果显示，高风险暴露组在左侧苍白球、尾状核和腹外侧前额皮质的葡萄糖摄取较高，作者认为这可能反映爆炸暴露后神经生理紊乱的补偿机制；而在白质区域，高风险组摄取较低，主要位于右半球，并伴有相应区域各向异性与轴向弥散升高。研究还观察到苍白球的代谢左偏，高风险组的不对称程度更大。总体而言，这些发现提示职业性爆炸暴露与脑代谢及微结构改变相关，但属于关联性观察，尚不能说明因果关系或临床疗效。

papers.title: Use of purified cannabidiol as add-on therapy in children with non-self-limited focal epilepsies of childhood: A multicenter study.
papers.authors: Reyes Valenzuela G, Espeche A, Fortini S, Gamboni B, Adi J, Semprino M, Fasulo L, Galicchio S, Cachia P, Chacón S, Calvo A, Beltran L, Bautista C, Venegas V, Alvarez C, Ivarola P, Caraballo R.
papers.abstract: Objective Evidence for purified cannabidiol (CBD) in children with treatment-resistant non-self-limited focal epilepsies (non-SeLFEs) remains limited. We evaluated its long-term effectiveness and tolerability in a multicenter pediatric cohort. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 79 children with treatment-resistant non-SeLFEs treated with adjunctive purified CBD at 11 pediatric neurology centers in Argentina and Chile. All had previously received ≥ 4 ASMs. CBD dosing was individualized according to response and tolerability. Outcomes included changes in seizure frequency and interictal EEG abnormalities, and treatment tolerability. Results After a mean follow-up of 30 months (range, 6-44), 43/79 patients (54.4 %) achieved a ≥ 50 % reduction in seizure frequency, including four (5.1 %) who became seizure-free. The mean CBD dose was 34 mg/kg/day (range, 10-40). Response remained stable at 12, 18, 24, and 30 months. Responder rates did not differ significantly between patients with TSC and those with non-TSC focal epilepsies. No significant associations were found between response and seizure type, age at seizure onset, epilepsy duration, age at CBD initiation, or concomitant ASMs. Interictal epileptiform abnormalities improved among responders. Adverse events occurred in 23 patients (29.1 %), were predominantly mild and transient, and were generally manageable with dose adjustments; drowsiness was the most common. No serious treatment-related adverse events occurred. Conclusion Adjunctive purified CBD was associated with sustained seizure reduction and good long-term tolerability in children with treatment-resistant non-SeLFEs. Responses were observed across different focal epilepsy etiologies, supporting further evaluation of CBD in this population. Individualized dosing according to response and tolerability may be appropriate in this heterogeneous population.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注纯化大麻二酚（CBD）作为添加治疗对儿童难治性非自限性局灶性癫痫的长期效果与耐受性，采用多中心回顾性分析，纳入阿根廷和智利儿科神经中心的患儿。结果显示，经过较长随访，约半数患儿癫痫发作频率减少至少一半，少数达到无发作，且疗效在后续多个时间点保持稳定；伴结节性硬化与非结节性硬化局灶性癫痫的应答率无明显差异，应答者也见发作间期脑电图异常改善。不良事件以嗜睡等轻度、短暂反应为主，多可通过调整剂量处理，未出现严重治疗相关不良事件。作者认为，添加纯化CBD与持续性发作减少和较好的长期耐受性相关，值得在这一异质性人群中进一步评估，并根据反应和耐受性个体化给药。

papers.title: White matter microstructural integrity in SeLECTS: a diffusion tensor imaging study of cognitive and behavioral correlates.
papers.authors: Olculu CB, Yilmaz S, Kose S, Ozalay O, Kan OY, Tokmak SH, Islamli J, Kanmaz S, Kitis O, Ozbaran B, Tekgul H.
papers.abstract: Objective To investigate white-matter microstructure in children with self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes (SeLECTS) using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). Methods This comparative cohort included 26 patients with SeLECTS and 23 age-matched healthy controls. White-matter microstructure was analyzed using a multimodal approach, combining DTI (TRACULA-based tractography) with electroencephalography (EEG), neuropsychological, and psychiatric assessments. Cognitive and behavioral functions were assessed using the Bender-Visual-Motor-Gestalt Test (BVMG), Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children-Fourth Edition, Trail Making Test, verbal fluency test, Behavior Rating Inventory of Executive Function (BRIEF), and Turgay-ADHD scale. DTI data were acquired on a 3.0-T-MRI scanner. Group differences in DTI parameters and exploratory associations between DTI metrics-fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD), axial diffusivity (AD), and radial diffusivity (RD) -and neuropsychological or behavioral measures were examined. Results SeLECTS patients demonstrated nominally lower FA values in the superior longitudinal fasciculus (SLF) and arcuate fasciculus (AF) compared with controls. Nominal associations were observed between BVMG rotation and perseveration errors and FA values in the corpus callosum body. Although full-scale intelligence quotient was lower in the patient group, subscale differences were not significant. Nominal associations were also observed between BRIEF Organization of Materials scores and DTI measures, including FA and RD in the corpus callosum. However, none of the tract-behavior associations remained statistically significant after Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. Conclusion This study identified nominal differences in white-matter microstructure and exploratory tract-behavior associations in children with SeLECTS using a multimodal approach (DTI, EEG, and neuropsychological tests). These tract-behavior associations should be considered hypothesis-generating. Integrating DTI with neuropsychological assessments may help identify potential cognitive and behavioral correlates of SeLECTS and inform future longitudinal research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用弥散张量成像（DTI）结合脑电和神经心理评估，比较了伴中央颞区棘波的儿童自限性癫痫（SeLECTS）患儿与年龄匹配健康儿童的白质微结构，并探索其与认知行为表现的关系。结果显示，患儿在上纵束和弓状束的分数各向异性仅呈名义上的降低，视觉运动测验的旋转与持续错误、执行功能量表的材料组织得分也与部分白质指标存在名义关联；但经多重比较校正后，这些纤维束与行为之间的关联均不再显著。作者据此强调，这些探索性关联只能用于生成假设，提示将DTI与神经心理评估结合或有助于识别SeLECTS可能的认知行为相关因素，并需纵向研究进一步验证。

papers.title: Brain edema progression rate on serial CT predicts neurological outcome after cardiac arrest: a region-specific biomarker of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury.
papers.authors: Xu N, Cheong H, De Z, Li X, Wang Y, Zeng X, Du L.
papers.abstract: Objectives To evaluate the prognostic performance of the attenuation change rate on serial brain computed tomography (CT), a novel quantitative marker of temporal cerebral attenuation change, for predicting poor neurological outcome after cardiac arrest (CA). Methods This was a retrospective analysis of a prospective cohort. CA patients who underwent cranial CT both within 12 h and between 12 h and one week after return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC) were included. The attenuation change rate, calculated as the HU difference between paired scans divided by the time interval, was measured in 12 predefined brain regions. Neurological outcome was assessed using the Cerebral Performance Category (CPC) at discharge. Results Of 53 patients enrolled, 17 (32.1%) had favorable neurological outcomes at discharge. Patients with poor outcomes exhibited significantly greater attenuation decline rates in all gray matter regions except for gray matter at the centrum semiovale level, including the caudate nucleus (-0.01 vs. 0.02 HU/h), putamen (-0.02 vs. 0 HU/h), thalamus (-0.02 vs. 0.01 HU/h), gray matter of the high convexity (-0.02 vs. 0 HU/h), and cerebellar gray matter (-0.02 vs. 0.03 HU/h) (all P < 0.01), whereas no statistically significant differences were observed in any of the white matter regions. ROC analysis demonstrated AUCs ranging from 0.725 to 0.778, with cerebellar gray matter achieving the highest AUC (0.778; sensitivity, 75.0%; specificity, 76.5%). At the 100% specificity threshold, the caudate nucleus showed the highest sensitivity for predicting poor outcome (36.1% at a decline rate of -0.040 HU/h). Conclusion Serial CT-derived attenuation change rate may serve as an exploratory quantitative marker of cerebral edema progression after cardiac arrest. However, this single-center, small-sample study does not support its use for withdrawal of life-sustaining treatment decisions. Multicenter validation is warranted.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于一项前瞻性队列的回顾性分析，评估心脏骤停患者复苏后连续头颅CT所测脑衰减变化率（可视为脑水肿进展速度）对出院时神经功能预后的预测价值，在预设脑区分别计算配对扫描间的HU变化速率。结果显示，预后不良患者在多数灰质区（如尾状核、壳核、丘脑、大脑高凸面灰质及小脑灰质）的衰减下降速率显著大于预后良好者，而白质各区未见显著差异；各灰质区预测不良结局的ROC曲线下面积处于中等水平，以小脑灰质最高。作者认为该指标可作为心脏骤停后脑水肿进展的探索性定量标志物，但受单中心、小样本限制，尚不足以支持将其用于撤除生命支持治疗的决策，仍需多中心验证。
