papers.title: Only the real deal? Actual vs. virtual nature exposure and their effects on affect and cortical hemodynamics in health and major depression.
papers.authors: Kramer M, Winhard M, Gatermann S, Juckel G, Mavrogiorgou P.
papers.abstract: Exposure to natural environments promotes mental health, but access is often limited. Virtual nature-based interventions may offer an alternative, yet direct comparisons of their affective and neurobiological effects with actual nature remain scarce, particularly in depression. To elucidate these effects, thirty-two patients with major depressive disorder and thirty-two healthy controls participated in a quasi-experimental comparison of 10-minute natural and urban exposure in actual or virtual reality (immersive 360° videos via head-mounted display). Actual-exposure data were obtained from an earlier cohort and virtual-exposure data from subsequently recruited participants, with pseudorandom assignment to nature versus urban exposure within each modality. Affective and psychological outcomes were assessed using standardized questionnaires, cortical hemodynamics using portable functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), and salivary cortisol as a stress marker. We found that both actual and virtual nature induced positive psychological effects, but only actual nature significantly reduced negative affect. We observed significant region-dependent differences in cortical hemodynamics, with exploratory analyses suggesting reduced dynamics during actual nature exposure in prefrontal and temporal regions, which however did not survive multiplicity correction. Cortisol showed no differential nature-versus-urban trajectories. Exploratory analyses suggested that the affective benefits of virtual nature correlated with the subjective sense of presence. Effects did not significantly differ by diagnostic status. However, given the modest sample size, these findings should be regarded as exploratory. They provide preliminary evidence that actual nature exerts differential effects on affect and cortical hemodynamic responses, while optimizing presence may enhance the efficacy of virtual nature-based interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较真实与虚拟自然环境暴露对情绪和皮层血流动力学的影响，并考察这些效应在重性抑郁患者与健康对照间是否存在差异。参与者分别接受自然或城市环境的真实暴露或沉浸式虚拟现实暴露，结合问卷、便携式近红外光谱和唾液皮质醇进行测量。结果显示，真实与虚拟自然都能带来积极心理效应，但只有真实自然显著降低负性情绪；皮层血流动力学存在区域依赖差异，探索性分析提示真实自然暴露时前额叶和颞叶活动减弱，但该结果未通过多重比较校正，皮质醇也未表现出自然与城市环境间的差异轨迹。虚拟自然的情绪收益与主观临场感相关，效应未随诊断状态显著变化。作者强调样本量有限，结论应视为探索性，并提示提升临场感可能增强虚拟自然干预的效果。

papers.title: Heterogeneous neuroimaging findings in obsessive-compulsive disorder converge to a common brain network using coordinate network mapping.
papers.authors: Yan H, Han Y, Guo W, Guo W, Cao H.
papers.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the American Society for Experimental NeuroTherapeutics
papers.abstract: Neuroimaging studies in obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) have yielded heterogeneous findings, limiting efforts to localize OCD to specific brain regions or networks. This study applied coordinate network mapping (CNM) to test whether these distributed abnormalities converge onto a common brain network and to explore the biological substrates of this network through associations with neurotransmitter systems. We systematically reviewed and extracted coordinates of significant clusters from 66 Gy matter volume (GMV) and resting-state activity studies involving 3123 patients with OCD and 3116 healthy controls. Using CNM and functional connectome data from 1000 healthy individuals, we identified brain networks functionally connected to these abnormalities. Spatial correlations were examined between identified networks and 19 types of neurotransmitter maps acquired from over 1000 healthy subjects. The GMV and resting-state activity findings in OCD both converged to a common, functionally connected brain network involving the striatum, thalamus, cingulate, supplementary motor area, insula, and inferior frontal and superior temporal gyri. The identified networks derived from the two neuroimaging modalities were significantly correlated with the N-Methyl-D-Aspartate (NMDA) receptor distribution (r = 0.551 and r = 0.541, respectively; p < 0.001). Findings were robust across different methodological parameters and demonstrated good test-retest reliability. This study identifies a robust and reproducible brain network underlying the heterogeneous neuroimaging abnormalities in OCD, helping to interpret previous inconsistencies. Furthermore, the alignment of this network with the cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical circuitry and NMDA receptor distribution underscores its biological and clinical relevance, thereby illuminating potential targets for future neuromodulation and pharmacological interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对强迫症神经影像结果分散、难以定位到特定脑区或网络的问题，采用坐标网络映射方法，整合灰质体积与静息态活动研究的异常坐标，检验这些异质性改变是否汇聚到同一功能网络。结果显示，两类影像发现均收敛于一个涉及纹状体、丘脑、扣带、辅助运动区、岛叶及额下回和颞上回的共同网络，且该网络与NMDA受体分布显著相关，结果在不同方法参数下较稳健并具有较好的重测信度。作者据此认为，这一可重复的网络有助于解释既往不一致，并与皮质-纹状体-丘脑-皮质环路及NMDA受体分布相吻合，为未来神经调控和药物干预提示了潜在靶点；这些关联性发现尚不等同于临床疗效证据。

papers.title: Functional organization of the perirhinal cortex in natural scene processing and memory.
papers.authors: Bai Y, Coutanche MN.
papers.abstract: The perirhinal cortex (PRC) has long been implicated in object perception and recognition memory; however, its role in processing complex natural scenes and its internal functional organization are not well understood. In the current study, we investigated the relationship between object- and scene-related visual feature (faces, bodies, and place) representations in PRC and the visual cortex, and the spatial pattern within PRC for visual processing and memory. Utilizing fMRI data from a continuous recognition task involving natural scenes (from the Natural Scenes Dataset), we first quantified the trial-by-trial decoding accuracy for visual features across distributed visual cortical regions and within the PRC. Our results demonstrate that multivariate pattern feature decodability in the PRC increase significantly when visual features are broadly represented across distributed regions in visual cortex. The PRC exhibited a robust subsequent memory effect, though the memory outcome was not directly predicted by the level of distributed visual feature representation. Critically, left PRC showed a posterior bias for the multivariate decoding of the place feature. Vertex-level univariate analyses uncovered a posterior bias for face-feature-driven vertices and an anterior bias for memory-driven vertices, which is more consistent in the right PRC. Together, these findings suggest that the PRC may play a flexible role in scene processing that extends beyond object representation and highlights an anterior-posterior functional gradient within the human PRC that supports perceptual or mnemonic processes.

papers.title: Sulcal depth is correlated with phonological encoding during language processing in Broca's area.
papers.authors: Salgado-Pineda P, Barbosa L, Olmo-Encabo PD, de la Fuente AF, Aquino-Servín A, Inarejos Clemente EJ, McKenna PJ, Fuentes-Claramonte P, Pomarol-Clotet E.
papers.abstract: Background Language relies on a left-lateralized fronto-temporal network whose functional organization likely reflects structural factors that emerge early in neurodevelopment. One such factor is sulcal depth, which has been proposed as a key anatomical marker of functional specialization. Here, we investigated potential structure-function relationships with respect to phonological encoding, a core linguistic process linking lexical representations and articulatory planning. Methods Thirty-two healthy adults performed a rhyming judgment task, known to be sensitive to phonological coding, during fMRI. Activation during task performance was related to cortical morphology derived from structural MRI in the same subjects, focusing on sulcal depth and other standard measures (i.e. cortical volume, surface area and thickness). Results Rhyming task performance elicited predominantely left-lateralized activation in the inferior frontal cortex and other regions including the precentral, postcentral, supramarginal, and superior temporal cortex, as well as the supplementary motor area, the middle cingulate and calcarine cortex, the left cerebellum and the basal ganglia. A cluster in the left inferior frontal gyrus (pars opercularis, a subregion of Broca's area) showed a significant association between sulcal depth and activation during the rhyming task. No associations were observed for other regions or for other structural measures. Discussion These findings raise the possibility that phonological encoding may have an origin in early-emerging cortical folding patterns and support the view that core language functions are scaffolded by genetically driven neurodevelopmental processes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察语音编码这一连接词汇表征与发音规划的核心语言过程是否与皮层形态相关，32名健康成人在fMRI下完成押韵判断任务，并将任务激活与同一批被试的结构MRI皮层指标（重点为沟深）相联系。押韵任务主要引起左侧化激活，涉及额下皮层及多个感觉运动、颞顶和皮层下区域；其中左侧额下回岛盖部（Broca区的一个亚区）的沟深与任务激活显著相关，其他脑区及其他结构指标均未见此类关联。作者据此提出，语音编码可能植根于早期形成的皮层折叠模式，支持核心语言功能由遗传驱动的神经发育过程所支撑的观点；这属于结构-功能关联证据，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Emerging promise in artificial vision research: Unveiling transformative potential through brain-computer interfaces.
papers.authors: Ma Y, Li Y, Zhang S, Liang L, Li G.
papers.journal: Neural networks : the official journal of the International Neural Network Society
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interface (BCI) technology has driven revolutionary advancements in the field of artificial vision, presenting new opportunities for individuals with visual impairments. This review summarizes the key technological developments, clinical applications, and future challenges of BCI in artificial vision. In the domain of signal acquisition, both invasive techniques (such as MEA, ECoG, and DBS) and non-invasive techniques (including EEG, MEG, fMRI, and fNIRS) have significantly improved signal resolution and stability. Advances in visual encoding have facilitated the more efficient transmission of visual information. Input BCIs, including technologies based on SSVEP and P300, as well as output BCIs involving motor and speech decoding, are progressing rapidly. Clinically, third-generation retinal prostheses (such as Argus II and PRIMA) have helped patients with retinal degenerative diseases regain partial light perception. Based on closed-loop neural feedback, it is expected to help patients with cortical blindness achieve the remodeling of the optic nerve. Nevertheless, technical challenges remain, particularly regarding the long-term stability of neural signals and biocompatibility issues. Emerging solutions such as anti-scarring nanocoatings, self-powered wireless systems, neuromorphic spike encoding, and multimodal sensory integration are addressing several of these challenges. Looking ahead, advancements in neuro-augmented reality are expected to further propel progress in the field. The future of BCI development will depends on continued interdisciplinary collaboration and global cooperation to drive innovation and provide more efficient, accessible visual restoration solutions for patients.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了脑机接口在人工视觉领域的技术进展、临床应用与未来挑战。信号采集方面，侵入式与非侵入式技术均提升了信号分辨率与稳定性，视觉编码和输入、输出型脑机接口也在快速发展。临床上，第三代视网膜假体已帮助视网膜退行性疾病患者恢复部分光感，基于闭环神经反馈的方法有望用于皮质盲患者的视神经重塑。文章同时指出神经信号长期稳定性和生物相容性等难题，并介绍了抗瘢痕纳米涂层、自供电无线系统等新兴应对方案，认为未来进展有赖于跨学科与全球协作。

papers.title: Rethinking the role of animal models in adaptive deep brain stimulation: From feasibility to mechanistic and disease-modifying insights.
papers.authors: Guidetti M, Ali HAH, Loh A, Harmsen IE, Meoni S, Foffani G, Lozano AM, Moro E, Volkmann J, Signaroldi G, Priori A, Marceglia S.
papers.abstract: Background Adaptive deep brain stimulation (aDBS) has emerged as an advanced neuromodulation approach capable of dynamically adjusting stimulation parameters based on real-time biomarkers, thereby overcoming the limitations of conventional continuous DBS (cDBS). While early animal studies were instrumental in establishing the feasibility and symptomatic efficacy of aDBS, its availability in humans poses the question of whether animal studies are still needed in this field. Objective This review aims to critically reassess the role of animal models in the development and future evolution of aDBS, with particular emphasis on their contribution to mechanistic insights, potential disease-modifying effects, biomarker identification, and the integration of machine learning for next-generation adaptive neuromodulation systems. Findings Animal studies have provided the foundational evidence for closed-loop neuromodulation, demonstrating the feasibility of real-time sensing-stimulation systems and the initial superiority of aDBS over cDBS in modulating motor symptoms. Preclinical models have enabled the identification and causal validation of electrophysiological and neurochemical biomarkers while also serving as indispensable platforms for hardware innovation, causal circuit interrogation using optogenetics, and validation of machine learning-based adaptive control algorithms. Moreover, animal models offer a unique platform for investigating disease progression, neural plasticity, and stage-dependent effects of stimulation, which remain difficult to assess in human studies. In parallel, machine learning approaches have increasingly leveraged preclinical and clinical data to decode physiological states, optimize stimulation parameters, and dynamically adapt therapy, thus supporting the development of personalized aDBS systems. Conclusion The role of animal models in aDBS research is undergoing a conceptual transition, from demonstrating feasibility and symptomatic efficacy to addressing mechanistic and disease-modifying questions. By enabling causal investigation of neural circuits, hardware development, biomarker validation, and integration with machine learning frameworks, preclinical research remains essential for advancing aDBS toward more precise, adaptive, and potentially disease-modifying neuromodulation strategies.

papers.title: Agency as prediction: A cortico-subcortical framework.
papers.authors: Kaltwasser L, Hamker F.
papers.abstract: Agency refers to the experience and attribution of control over one's own actions and their consequences. However, the brain's solution to agency has so far not been discovered. Intentional binding, long considered an implicit measure of agency, does not primarily reflect the binding of a voluntary action and its sensory outcome. Instead, emerging evidence suggests that it arises from multisensory integration of causally related events. Moreover, attempts to localize the neural basis of agency have not yielded consistent results. We propose that the key explaining agency lies in predictive mechanisms of basic motor-outcome and event learning fundamental to brain function and outline a subcortical network centered on the intralaminar thalamic nuclei and their projections to the basal ganglia and associated cortical regions. This framework provides a biologically grounded account of a gated predictive selection mechanism that may constitute low-level processes underlying higher-level attributions of agency.

papers.title: Hierarchical multi-atlas fusion network for robust and interpretable cross-site analysis of functional connectomes in major depressive disorder.
papers.authors: Long H, Wu H, Guan Q, Fan M, Yang X, Xiao J, Ma G, Zhang Y, Liu S.
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is associated with distributed disruptions in functional brain networks, yet current connectome-based biomarkers often rely on a single parcellation and show limited cross-site robustness and biological interpretability. We propose a Hierarchical Multi-Atlas Fusion Network (HMAF-Net) for robust and interpretable cross-site analysis of functional connectomes in MDD. HMAF-Net reconciles heterogeneous anatomical and functional atlases by learning a small set of shared fusion nodes that serve as latent anchors for cross-atlas semantic alignment. For each atlas, it extracts node-wise descriptors and uses Transformer-based sparse soft assignment with a structure-aware contrastive objective to align atlas nodes in a common semantic space while retaining atlas-specific information. The resulting fusion-node embeddings support subject-level classification and spatial mapping for biomarker localization and imaging-transcriptomic association. We evaluated HMAF-Net on the multi-site REST-meta-MDD cohort (N = 1,611). Under 10-fold cross-validation, HMAF-Net achieved 72.28% accuracy and 71.49% AUC, showing the highest mean accuracy among representative atlas-fusion and graph-based baselines under identical splits. Under leave-one-site-out evaluation, it reached 77.48% mean accuracy, with site-wise analyses indicating residual variability associated with cohort size and head motion. External validation on two independent MDD datasets further supported cross-dataset generalizability. Fusion-node involvement shifts revealed reproducible fronto-limbic and default-mode-salience alterations. These spatial profiles were associated with Allen Human Brain Atlas expression gradients and enriched for synaptic and neurotransmission pathways, providing a molecularly grounded axis for interpretation. By integrating cross-atlas alignment, cross-site evaluation, and transcriptomic interpretation, HMAF-Net yields compact connectomic embeddings for reproducible and mechanistically informed MDD biomarker development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对抑郁症功能连接组生物标志物多依赖单一脑图谱、跨站点稳健性和可解释性不足的问题，提出分层多图谱融合网络HMAF-Net，通过跨图谱语义对齐生成紧凑的连接组嵌入，并在多站点队列上开展分类与跨站点评估。模型在交叉验证中取得较高分类表现，留一站点评估也保持一定准确率，但站点间仍存在与队列规模和头动相关的残余变异；两个独立数据集的外部验证支持其跨数据集泛化。融合节点涉及的前额-边缘及默认网络-突显网络改变具有可重复性，并与基因表达梯度和突触、神经传递通路相关，为标志物定位提供了分子层面的解释线索。整体而言，该工作将跨图谱对齐、跨站点评估和转录组解释结合，但结果属于分类与关联性证据，尚不能视为临床诊断或治疗依据。

papers.title: Cortex-grounded diffusion models for brain image generation.
papers.authors: Bongratz F, Li Y, Elbaroudy S, Grimmer T, Yakushev I, Hedderich DM, Wachinger C.
papers.abstract: Synthetic neuroimaging data can mitigate critical limitations of real-world datasets, including the scarcity of rare phenotypes, domain shifts across scanners, and insufficient longitudinal coverage. However, existing generative models largely rely on weak conditioning signals, such as labels or text, which lack anatomical grounding and often produce biologically implausible outputs. To this end, we introduce Cor2Vox, a cortex-grounded generative framework for brain magnetic resonance image (MRI) synthesis that ties image generation to continuous structural priors of the cerebral cortex. It leverages high-resolution cortical surfaces to guide a 3D shape-to-image Brownian bridge diffusion process, enabling topologically faithful synthesis and precise control over underlying anatomies. To support the generation of new, realistic brain shapes, we developed a large-scale statistical shape model of cortical morphology derived from over 33,000 UK Biobank scans. We validated the fidelity of Cor2Vox based on traditional image quality metrics, advanced cortical surface reconstruction, and whole-brain segmentation quality, outperforming many baseline methods. Across three applications, namely (i) anatomy-guided synthesis, (ii) simulation of progressive gray matter atrophy, and (iii) harmonization of in-house frontotemporal dementia scans with public datasets, Cor2Vox preserved fine-grained cortical morphology at the sub-voxel level. Notably, the proposed model exhibits inherent robustness to variations in cortical geometry and unseen dementia phenotypes without retraining, paving the way for disease progression modeling and robust data augmentation in rare neurodegenerative disorders.

papers.title: Frequency-specific gyro-sulcal functional differentiation in preterm neonates: Sulcal dominance and gene expression correlates.
papers.authors: Mao W, Ou X, Huang W, Jin X, Kendrick K, Jiang X.
papers.abstract: Preterm birth affects up to 10.6% of neonates and increases neurodevelopmental risks, yet functional brain alterations remain poorly understood. Using resting-state fMRI data from 437 neonates and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network, this study investigated frequency-specific functional differences between gyri and sulci across three groups: preterm-born neonates scanned at preterm age, preterm-born neonates scanned at term-equivalent age, and term-born neonates scanned at term age. Associations with gene expression were examined. Group differences in the model-derived frequency characteristics were observed predominantly in the frontal lobe across all frequency bands, and in the temporal and parietal lobes at high frequencies. These differences were more pronounced for sulcal than gyral characteristics, and sulcal dominance was more spatially extensive in neonates scanned at term-equivalent age than in preterm neonates scanned before term-equivalent age. Furthermore, model-derived gyro-sulcal frequency characteristics were significantly associated with regional cortical gene-expression patterns. This study bridges frequency-specific brain imaging with cortical gene expression, highlighting the prominent contribution of sulcal-related frequency characteristics to the observed group differences. These findings reveal regional associations between gyro-sulcal frequency characteristics and gene expression and suggest their potential relevance for early risk assessment, which requires further validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早产对新生儿脑功能的影响，用静息态fMRI结合一维卷积神经网络，比较早产儿在早产矫正年龄、早产儿在足月等效年龄以及足月儿三组的脑回—脑沟功能频率特征，并考察其与皮层基因表达的关系。结果显示，组间差异主要集中在额叶，高频段还涉及颞叶和顶叶；这些差异在脑沟特征上比脑回特征更明显，且足月等效年龄扫描的早产儿中脑沟优势的空间范围更广。模型得到的脑回—脑沟频率特征还与区域皮层基因表达模式显著相关。作者据此强调脑沟相关频率特征对组间差异的主要贡献，并提示其或可用于早期风险评估，但明确需要进一步验证。

papers.title: Language prediction in multimodal contexts: The contribution of iconic gestures to anticipatory sentence comprehension.
papers.authors: Hintz F, Emmendorfer AK, Strauß A, Khoe YH, Moonen L, Holler J.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Evidence shows listeners predict upcoming words, and iconic gestures in face-to-face dialogue often precede their spoken referents. A recent framework proposes that early-onset gestures can pre-activate the meaning of upcoming nouns. This pre-registered EEG study tested this proposal. 81 Dutch adults watched videos of an actress producing discourses ending with a target noun. The noun was either predictable or not from the discourse. Each noun was paired with an iconic gesture whose stroke began either 520 msec (earlier) or 130 msec (later) before the noun. Discourse predictability produced the hypothesized post-target N400 reduction for predictable versus non-predictable items (H1). In the pre-target window, earlier gestures in non-predictable discourses elicited more negative amplitudes than in predictable discourses (H2a), suggesting that earlier gestures modulated neural responses when predictability was low. No comparable interaction was found for the opposite contrast (early-predictable vs late-predictable & late-non-predictable; H2c). In the post-target window, earlier gestures yielded a modest N400-like positivity relative to late gestures (H2e), but the interaction between gesture timing and discourse predictability (H2f) was not supported. A follow-up indicated that, in non-predictable discourses, later gestures produced a larger N400 than earlier gestures. Thus, the data confirm H1 and support H2a (and partially H2e), while H2c and H2f were not supported, suggesting that when speakers produce monologic discourses, earlier iconic gestures can aid anticipatory processing when linguistic predictions are weak, but their effect is limited and context-dependent. Together with the exploratory follow-up, the findings highlight a nuanced role of the influence of gesture timing on comprehension.
papers.summary_zh: 该预注册脑电研究考察象似性手势出现的时间能否帮助听者在多模态语境中预测即将出现的名词，81名荷兰成年被试观看女演员讲述语篇并伴随手势的视频。结果显示，语篇可预测性本身降低了目标词后的N400，支持言语预测；在目标词出现前，当语篇可预测性低时，较早出现的手势比可预测语境下引发更负的波幅，说明手势时机在预测较弱时调节了神经反应。目标词后较早手势仅带来轻微的类N400正波，手势时机与语篇可预测性的交互未获支持，后续分析提示不可预测语篇中较晚手势的N400更大。作者据此认为，较早的象似性手势能在语言预测较弱时辅助预期加工，但作用有限且依赖语境。

papers.title: A head-mounted open-source light field microscope for large volumetric Ca<sup>2+</sup> imaging during exploratory and social behavior in mice.
papers.authors: Li H, Nöbauer T, Sarafraz H, Vaziri A.
papers.abstract: Capturing neuronal activity during natural behaviors in unrestrained animals is critical for understanding brain function, yet existing imaging systems struggle to combine volumetric field-of-view (v-FOV), high resolution, depth, and usability. We present MiniLFMv2, a lightweight, next-generation miniaturized light field microscope enabling volumetric imaging with a v-FOV of ⌀1 × 0.2 mm3 , volume rates of up to 30 Hz and depth to ∼350-400 μm. MiniLFMv2 achieves near-diffraction-limited performance, with a working distance of 1 mm. Its custom aspheric lenses and electrically tunable lens eliminate the need for GRIN optics, improving compatibility with cranial window imaging. Applying MiniLFMv2 in freely moving mice, we captured activity from hundreds of parietal cortex neurons at depths up to ∼400 μm with minimal impact on mobility. During exploratory and social behaviors, we identified subpopulations selectively tuned to locomotion, rearing, and social investigation. MiniLFMv2 offers a powerful tool for investigating neural dynamics during naturalistic and social behaviors.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对自由活动小鼠自然行为中难以兼顾大视野、高分辨率与深度的成像需求，开发了轻量化的头戴式开源光场显微镜MiniLFMv2，并在自由活动小鼠中验证其性能。该设备可在约400微米深度内同时记录数百个顶叶皮层神经元的活动，且对小鼠运动影响较小。在探索和社交行为中，作者识别出分别对运动、直立和社交探究表现出选择性反应的神经元亚群，表明该工具可用于研究自然及社交行为下的神经动态。

papers.title: Somatosensory gating of pneumatic stimuli in adults with chronic tic disorder.
papers.authors: Isaacs DA, Conley AC, Eckland MR, Key AP.
papers.abstract: Individuals with chronic tic disorder (CTD) frequently report sensory over-responsivity, defined as heightened awareness of and/or behavioral reactivity to stimuli that are non-aversive to most neurotypical individuals. Within CTD populations, sensory over-responsivity is associated with severity of tics and co-occurring psychiatric symptoms. Despite its prevalence and association with core facets of the phenotype, the neurobiological basis of sensory over-responsivity in CTD remains unclear. Sensory gating, the physiological process of filtering out repetitive stimuli in early perceptual stages to facilitate attention to more salient stimuli, is one potential mechanism underpinning sensory over-responsivity in CTD. The current study sought to quantify somatosensory gating of pneumatic stimuli in adults with CTD using dense-array EEG and to determine the relationship between somatosensory gating and self-reported tactile responsivity. Neurotypical adults (n = 34) and adults with CTD (n = 28) completed a self-report and rater-administered neuropsychiatric evaluation, followed by an event-related potential somatosensory gating paradigm. Contrary to our hypotheses, somatosensory gating, as quantified by gating differences and regression analysis marginal effects, did not differ between groups for P50, N140, or P300 components, and gating indices were not associated with tactile responsivity. However, relative to neurotypical adults, adults with CTD had significantly smaller P50 amplitudes following S1, the first of the paired pneumatic stimuli. Moreover, adults with CTD with smaller S1 P50 amplitudes reported greater tactile responsivity. No other component amplitudes differed between groups. Findings suggest that adults with CTD have altered pre-conscious processing of non-noxious tactile stimuli and that this is linked with tactile over-responsivity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性抽动障碍成人对重复触觉刺激的感觉门控是否异常，以及门控指标与自报触觉反应性的关系。研究用密集阵列脑电记录成人的体感事件相关电位，比较慢性抽动障碍组与神经典型成人组。结果未支持原假设：P50、N140和P300成分的门控差异及回归分析边际效应在两组间无差异，门控指标也与触觉反应性无关。不过，慢性抽动障碍组在第一个气动刺激后的P50波幅显著小于神经典型组，且该波幅越小者自报触觉反应性越高；其他成分波幅无组间差异。作者据此认为，慢性抽动障碍成人对非伤害性触觉刺激的前意识加工可能发生改变，并与触觉过度反应相关，但这一关联尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: Beyond Nerve Hyperexcitability: Potential Implications of Cerebrospinal Fluid CASPR2 Antibodies for Central Pain Processing in Isaacs Syndrome: A Case-Based Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Theologou R, Zis P.
papers.abstract: Introduction Isaacs syndrome (IS), or acquired neuromyotonia, is a rare immune-mediated neuromuscular disorder characterized by increased peripheral nerve excitability. Clinically, it manifests with fasciculations, cramps, excessive sweating, and the presence of CASPR2 autoantibodies in the serum. IS can occur as a paraneoplastic condition or may remain idiopathic. Methods We report an adult case of IS that prompted a case-based literature review investigating the association between cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) CASPR2 antibodies and IS. A systematic literature search of PubMed and Scopus was conducted on 7 July 2026, with reference-list screening of eligible articles for additional relevant studies. Eligible studies reported original data on adults with IS and CSF CASPR2 antibody testing; reviews, editorials, abstracts, letters, pediatric studies, and studies without relevant CSF testing were excluded. Discussion A 65-year-old man with a history of prostate cancer, treated with radiotherapy 4 years earlier, presented with a 3-year history of neuropathic pain and painful lower-limb cramps. Examination revealed fasciculations in all limbs and brisk tendon reflexes, with no Babinski sign. Neurophysiological studies demonstrated spontaneous doublet, triplet, and multiplet discharges. IS was supported by weakly positive serum VGKC-complex antibodies, low-positive LGI1 antibodies, and strongly positive CASPR2 antibodies, with strong CASPR2 positivity in cerebrospinal fluid, despite the absence of clinical features of Morvan syndrome. Our literature review identified six additional cases of IS in which CSF CASPR2 antibodies were tested. Of these, three had positive CSF CASPR2 antibody results. In two cases, IS remained idiopathic, whereas, in the third, it was associated with recurrent malignant thymoma. Including our patient, all reported cases of IS with CSF CASPR2 positivity presented with neuropathic pain. Conclusion IS should be considered in patients presenting with painful muscle cramps and electromyographic evidence of peripheral nerve hyperexcitability. The presence of CASPR2 antibodies in the CSF may be associated with neuropathic pain and could suggest involvement of pain pathway sensitization, potentially including central sensitization mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以一例65岁男性Isaacs综合征患者为引，结合病例的系统综述，考察脑脊液CASPR2抗体与本病的关系。患者表现为神经病理性疼痛和痛性下肢痉挛，血清及脑脊液CASPR2抗体均呈阳性。文献检索另找到6例接受脑脊液CASPR2抗体检测的Isaacs综合征病例，其中3例阳性；包括本例在内，所有脑脊液CASPR2阳性病例均出现神经病理性疼痛。作者据此提示，脑脊液CASPR2抗体可能与神经病理性疼痛相关，并可能反映疼痛通路敏化乃至中枢敏化机制，但这一关联尚属初步观察，不能据此推断因果关系或临床疗效。

papers.title: Default mode network functional connectivity is associated with intention interference in healthy aging.
papers.authors: Liang TJ, Huang SM, Tu MC, Kuo LW, Yang JJ, Hsu YH.
papers.abstract: Prospective memory (PM), the ability to fulfil an intended action, is important in daily life. However, completed intentions can interfere with subsequent behaviors, known as the aftereffect. The neural basis of this phenomenon remains unclear, particularly from a network perspective. Based on cognitive theories, the present study aimed to examine the underlying neural mechanisms, focusing on the default mode network (DMN) and the frontoparietal network (FPN) to resolve previously inconsistent findings. Thirty-six middle-to-older adults completed a memory-for-intention task, with outdated cues assessing aftereffects through commission errors and prolonged reaction time. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data were used to calculate functional connectivity (FC) between regions of interest within the DMN and the FPN. The results showed that FC between the left superior frontal gyrus and right middle temporal pole was associated with the late aftereffect reflected by prolonged reaction time. No significant associations were found within the FPN. The findings highlight the role of intrinsic connectivity in the DMN, suggesting that task disengagement and self-referential processing may contribute to the unintended activation of completed intentions, supporting the spontaneous retrieval account in the dual mechanism theory.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注健康中老年人完成前瞻记忆意图后，旧意图仍干扰后续行为这一“后效应”的神经基础，并比较默认模式网络与额顶网络的作用。36名中老年被试完成记忆意图任务，同时采集静息态功能磁共振数据，计算网络内功能连接。结果显示，默认模式网络内左侧额上回与右侧颞极中部的功能连接与反应时延长所反映的较晚后效应相关，而额顶网络内未见显著关联。作者据此认为，默认模式网络的内在连接可能通过任务脱离和自我参照加工促成已完成意图的非预期激活，为双机制理论中的自发提取观点提供了支持；但这是关联性发现，尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: The mediating effect of neuroticism on the association between brain signal variability in the prefrontal cortex and depression among healthy individuals.
papers.authors: Lu F, Pang Y, Li T, Liu M, Jia C, Gao J, Luo W, Yu Y, Wang L, Tang Q, Cui Q, Gao Q, He Z, Chen H.
papers.abstract: The personality trait of neuroticism has been recognized as a risk factor for depression. Research into the interplay between brain activity, neuroticism, and subclinical depressive symptoms could potentially uncover biomarkers capable of predicting the onset of depression. Brain intrinsic signal variability, a measure of system flexibility, is related to lifespan development, cognitive performance, and mental health disorders. Despite its importance, the link between signal variability and both neuroticism and depression has not been previously explored. This study, therefore, sought to investigate the correlation between brain signal variability, neuroticism, and depressive symptoms in individuals without clinical depression. The resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data were collected from 103 healthy right-handed individuals (63 males, 40 females; mean age 24.73 ± 8.34 years). Neuroticism and subclinical depressive symptoms were assessed by Eysenck Personality Questionnaire and Zung Self-Rating Depression Scale, respectively. To quantify brain signal variability, voxel-wise mean-squared successive difference (MSSD) was calculated. A mediation analysis was subsequently performed to explore the interrelationships among signal variability, neuroticism, and depressive symptoms. Neuroticism showed a significant negative correlation with MSSD in several brain regions, including the medial prefrontal cortex (MPFC), dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC), precentral gyrus, angular gyrus, and middle temporal gyrus. Additionally, MSSD in the MPFC and dlPFC were negatively associated with depressive symptoms, with neuroticism mediating this relationship. In sum, neuroticism and depressive symptoms were associated with reduced signal variability in the PFC regions. These effects suggested that dysfunctional activity within the PFC regions is linked to the etiology of depression, mediated by individual differences in neuroticism.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察健康个体静息态脑信号变异性、神经质与亚临床抑郁症状之间的关系，并检验神经质是否在其中起中介作用。研究者采集健康右利手参与者的静息态功能磁共振数据，以MSSD量化信号变异性，并结合神经质和抑郁症状量表得分进行中介分析。结果发现，神经质与内侧前额叶、背外侧前额叶等多个脑区的信号变异性呈负相关，且内侧和背外侧前额叶的变异性与抑郁症状负相关，神经质中介了这一关联。作者据此提出，前额叶区域信号变异性降低可能与神经质个体差异及抑郁易感性有关，但该研究为健康人群中的相关性分析，尚不能说明因果关系或临床应用价值。

papers.title: Severe neurodevelopmental phenotype with multisystem involvement in VPS16-related mucopolysaccharidosis-like syndrome.
papers.authors: Gür K, Uludağ Alkaya D, Güneş N, Onur H, Zübarioğlu T, Kılınç Sakallı AA, Saygılı SK, Kıykım A, Yalçınkaya C, Tüysüz B.
papers.abstract: Vacuolar protein sorting 16 (VPS16) functions in endolysosomal trafficking. Biallelic VPS16 variants cause a mucopolysaccharidosis-like syndrome reported in only four patients, with neurological involvement ranging from mild developmental delay to severe impairment with epilepsy and pyramidal signs. We report an additional patient biallelic for VPS16 NM_022575.4:c.2272-18 C > A, with profound developmental delay, early-onset epilepsy, and spasticity. Multisystem involvement included recurrent infections, neutropenia, serosal effusions, and tubular proteinuria. Brain MRI showed white-matter abnormalities, progressive cerebral and cerebellar atrophy, and symmetric signal changes in the globus pallidus and substantia nigra, suggestive of iron deposition, further expanding the neurological spectrum of this disorder.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述了一名携带VPS16双等位基因变异的患者，其表现为重度神经发育障碍，包括严重发育迟缓、早发性癫痫和痉挛。除神经系统受累外，患者还出现反复感染、中性粒细胞减少、浆膜腔积液和肾小管性蛋白尿等多系统表现；脑MRI显示白质异常、进行性大脑和小脑萎缩，以及苍白球和黑质对称性信号改变，提示铁沉积。作者据此认为，这一病例拓展了VPS16相关黏多糖贮积症样综合征的神经表型谱，但作为单例报告，其发现仍需更多病例验证。

papers.title: Preoperative brain injury and neurodevelopmental outcomes in syndromic and non-syndromic children with complex congenital heart disease: a single-centre cohort study.
papers.authors: Paolin C, Pozza A, Ancona C, Mezzalira L, Cogo P, Di Salvo G, Padalino M, Scattolin F, Vida V, Sartori S, Manara R.
papers.abstract: Children with complex congenital heart disease (CHD) are at high risk of brain lesions both before and after cardiac surgery. Preoperative brain injury reflects foetal and perinatal brain development and represents an independent predictor of neurodevelopmental outcome. This study aimed to characterize preoperative brain lesions and their correlation with clinical course and neurodevelopmental outcomes in children with complex CHD. The secondary objective was to compare findings between syndromic and non-syndromic patients, as preoperative brain injury in syndromic children remains underreported. A single-centre cohort study was performed at the University of Padova, Italy, involving children with complex CHD who underwent preoperative brain MRI between January 2020 and October 2024. Patients were categorized based on the presence or absence of a known or suspected genetic syndrome. Neurological and neurodevelopmental evaluations were conducted pre- and postoperatively, and at 6- and 18-months follow-up. Among 54 enrolled patients, 21 (39%) had a suspected or confirmed genetic syndrome. Preoperative brain lesions were present in 24 children (44%), including 16/33 (48%) non-syndromic and 8/21 (38%) syndromic patients (OR 0.65 [0.21-1.94], p = 0.5708). Arterial ischemic stroke was the most common lesion (20%), followed by subdural haemorrhage (11%), cerebral sinovenous thrombosis (9%), and white matter injury (6%). Despite similar lesion rates, syndromic children showed more complicated perinatal histories and greater neurodevelopmental impairment, particularly in motor and language domains. Conclusion Syndromic children with CHD do not have higher rates of preoperative brain injury but remain at greater neurodevelopmental risk. Further studies are warranted to confirm these findings. What is known • Children with complex congenital heart disease (CHD) are at high risk for preoperative brain injury and neurodevelopmental impairment. • Syndromic children with CHD are often excluded from neurodevelopmental studies. What is new • Preoperative brain lesions (44%), mainly arterial ischemic stroke (20%), are frequent in our cohort of syndromic and non-syndromic children with complex CHD. • Syndromic children with CHD do not show increased rates of preoperative brain injury compared to non-syndromic children, but remain a population at higher neurodevelopmental risk.
papers.summary_zh: 该单中心队列研究纳入接受术前脑MRI的复杂先天性心脏病患儿，比较综合征与非综合征患儿术前脑损伤及神经发育结局。结果显示，术前脑损伤总体常见，以动脉缺血性卒中居多，但综合征与非综合征患儿的损伤比例相近；尽管如此，综合征患儿围产期病程更复杂，神经发育受损更明显，尤其表现在运动和语言领域。作者据此指出，综合征患儿术前脑损伤率并未升高，却仍属于神经发育风险更高的人群，相关发现尚需进一步研究确认。

papers.title: Diffusion MRI Markers of Symptom Interference and Survival in Head and Neck Cancer Survivors
papers.authors: Bajaj S, Quarles C, Gilmore K, Qiao Y, Mokashi C, Wintermark M, Wefel J, Noll K, Zalles M, Roth M.

papers.title: Changes in Diffusion MRI-Based White Matter Metrics After a Dance Intervention in Individuals with Substance Use Disorders—A Pilot Study

papers.title: Understanding the Effects of Drishti Bheda, the Eye Movements in Indian Classical Dance, on Vision, Audition, and Cognition: A Cross-Sectional Study.
papers.authors: Sundarrajan R, M RM, S A, P R, M R.
papers.abstract: Introduction Bharatanatyam is one of India's oldest classical Indian art forms, which integrates the practice of Drishti Bheda, i.e., synchronized controlled scanning eye movements with head, neck, and body movements used to amplify visual articulation and communication. These ocular workouts repeated over time suggest that eye training might boost up information from sight and hearing to cognitive capacities, as well as control and ability to regulate motor imagery, which relates to one's ability to see/feel movement without physical acting, to stimulate mental clarity, mindfulness, and boost emotions via plasticity of neural networks. Although Drishti Beda is artistically relevant to culture and the world of art, it lacks sufficient research to determine the impact on sensorial and cognitive skills. Knowledge of these effects can provide the scientific rationale to include traditional eye movement meditation exercises in preventive healthcare protocols for the brain and the senses and cognitive rehabilitation. This research assessed long-term Bharatanatyam training with Drishti Bheda on visual, auditory, and cognitive performance in healthy young individuals to understand if longer participation in the demanding nature of Bharatanatyam translates into improved sensory processing and overall cognition. Methods A cross-sectional comparative study was conducted in 60 healthy young females aged 18-22 years after obtaining Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) clearance. Of the two groups involved, the 30 Bharatanatyam dancers had a formal training period of more than 10 years in dance, whereas their age-matched non-dancing counterparts formed the control group. Demographic and anthropometric assessments were performed on all subjects; the visual aspect of health was studied using critical flicker fusion frequency (CFFF-Maven Labs Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore, India), while the auditory aspect of health was determined using pure tone audiometry (PTA) (RS I digital portable diagnostic audiometer, Sounds Good Hearing Care Scientific Company, Madurai, India); the mental health aspects of health were assessed using the Mindful Attention Awareness Scale (MAAS), Movement Imagery Questionnaire-3 (MIQ-3), the Emotion Regulation Questionnaire (ERQ), and the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10). The groups were analyzed using independent-samples t tests. Results This study found that Bharatanatyam performers exhibited significantly higher CFFF values (visual temporal resolution; p < 0.0001) and PTA thresholds (auditory sensitivity) in the right ear (p = 0.0053) and left ear (p = 0.0006) compared with the control group. Similarly, statistically significant improvements in cognitive measures were observed in dancers in mindfulness (p≈0.0004), perceived stress (p < 0.0001), emotion regulation (p = 0.0013), and movement imagery (p < 0.0001). Conclusion Long-term Bharatanatyam training, along with Drishti Bheda, was associated with improved visual, auditory, and cognitive abilities in young adult brains. It is likely that the multisensory-training aspect of the performance might involve a variety of neural modifications or plasticity across and within different sensory modalities, and different functional brain areas or systems, involved with attentional control, motor imagination, and emotion-processing abilities.

papers.title: Pre-treatment EEG microstates and response to antipsychotic drugs in first episode psychosis
papers.authors: Rubio JM, Murphy M, Vodovozov W, Carrion R, Lencz T, Baradits M, Ongur D, Sadri M, Kane JM, Malhotra AK.
papers.abstract: Background and Hypothesis First-line antipsychotics are ineffective in ∼40% of people with first episode psychosis (FEP). Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based predictive biomarkers could be a scalable solution to reduce trial-and-error. Study Design We acquired EEG in 56 minimally treated FEP individuals before treatment initiation, and 34 matched healthy controls (HC). Treatment response was defined as >50% improvement in BPRS scores by 12 weeks of treatment. Modified k-means clustering of resting-state EEG yielded six microstates including canonical topographies (A-D). The first principal component (PC1) of microstate properties derived from HCs served as a normative reference onto which FEP patients were projected. Baseline PC1 was used to predict treatment response in adjusted regression analyses. To test stability of results, a second dataset of HCs (n=92) was fitted using the same microstate solution and compared to our native HC dataset. PC1 scores derived from this independent normative dataset were also used for predicting response in FEP. Study Results Individual microstates replicated established patient-control differences (e.g., higher presence of microstate C compared to D, p<0.001). PC1 explained 34.8% of variance. Baseline PC1 predicted subsequent treatment response (adjusted OR=0.63, p<0.001), yielding AUC=72.3% in leave-one-out cross-validation (p perm <0.001) when combined with clinical information. PC1 from our HC transported well to the second healthy control EEG dataset (n=92) (r=0.9,p<0.001; r=0.89,p<0.001 ). PC1 in FEP derived using PC1 weights from a second normative dataset also predicted response in FEP (OR=0.70, p=0.03). Conclusions EEG microstate architecture differing from the expected norm is associated with lower odds of treatment response in FEP.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨首发精神病患者治疗前的静息态脑电微状态能否预测抗精神病药疗效，比较了患者与健康对照的微状态特征，并以健康对照建立的常模成分量化患者偏离常模的程度。结果显示，患者偏离常模越明显，随后治疗应答的几率越低，结合临床信息后预测具有一定区分度，且该预测在另一套健康对照数据建立的常模下仍成立。作者据此认为，脑电微状态结构与预期常模的差异与较低的治疗应答几率相关，提示其作为可扩展预测指标的潜力，但尚属关联性预测，不能据此推断因果或临床效用。

papers.title: A Patient-Specific Framework for Separating Temporal Localization from Intracranial Waveform Reconstruction of Interictal Epileptiform Discharges from Scalp EEG
papers.authors: Matsubara T, Koda R, Richardson M, Stufflebeam S.
papers.abstract: Objective We developed a patient-specific framework to determine which information about interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs) can be recovered from scalp EEG, separating temporal localization (“where”) from event-specific intracranial waveform reconstruction (“what”). Methods Six subjects from a public simultaneous high-density scalp EEG and intracranial EEG (iEEG) dataset were analyzed using patient-specific dual-branch convolutional-attention models integrating waveform/topographic and time-frequency representations. For the where task, a 640-ms scalp EEG segment was divided into eight 80-ms bins, and the model predicted the bin containing the intracranial IED peak. For the what task, a 250-ms peak-centered iEEG waveform was represented as a fixed patient-specific template plus an event-specific residual predicted from scalp EEG. Direct scalp-input controls and event-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals were used to distinguish scalp-dependent information from template-driven performance. Results Where accuracy varied markedly across subjects (0.080–0.984), with an unweighted subject-level mean of 0.333 versus a chance level of 0.125; 95% confidence intervals were above chance level in three of six subjects. Input-control analyses supported a scalp-dependent contribution in subjects with successful localization. For the what task, mean waveform correlation was 0.752 for the model and 0.754 for the fixed patient-specific template (mean difference,-0.002), while residual correlations were generally modest (−0.020 to 0.378). Conclusion Scalp EEG contained recoverable temporal information in some subjects, but event-specific single-contact morphology was not consistently recovered beyond the patient-specific template. Separating temporal localization from template-based waveform reconstruction provides a more stringent framework for evaluating noninvasive-to-intracranial inference and reduces conflation of prior-driven similarity with input-dependent reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个患者特异性框架，用于区分头皮脑电图能提供发作间期癫痫样放电的哪类信息：放电的时间定位（“在哪里”）与事件特异的颅内波形重建（“是什么”）。作者用公共同步高密度头皮脑电与颅内脑电数据中的6名受试者，构建患者特异的双分支卷积-注意力模型，分别完成时间定位和波形重建任务，并设置直接头皮输入对照与事件聚类自助置信区间，以区分头皮依赖的信息与模板驱动的表现。结果显示，时间定位准确率在不同受试者间差异很大，受试者层面均值高于机会水平，但仅部分受试者的置信区间高于机会水平，输入对照分析支持这些受试者存在头皮依赖贡献；波形重建方面，模型预测与固定患者特异模板的表现相当，事件特异残差的相关性普遍较弱。作者据此认为，头皮脑电在部分受试者中包含可恢复的时间信息，但事件特异的单触点形态未能稳定地超越患者特异模板被重建；将时间定位与基于模板的波形重建分开，为评估无创到颅内的推断提供了更严格的框架，并减少将先验驱动的相似性误认为输入依赖的重建。

papers.title: Diffusion MRI abnormalities localise the epileptogenic zone in paediatric drug-resistant epilepsy
papers.authors: Veljanoski D, Chari A, Seunarine KK, D’Arco F, Mankad K, Tahir Z, Clark CA, Tisdall MM, Baldeweg T, Piper RJ.
papers.abstract: Objectives Seizure freedom follows surgery in 67% of children with drug-resistant epilepsy, but imaging biomarkers could improve patient selection, epileptogenic zone localisation, and outcome prediction. We assessed whether diffusion MRI abnormalities predicted seizure freedom when resected; aligned with stereo-EEG seizure-onset and interictal zones; distinguished patients with/without an identified onset zone; and localised the epileptogenic zone in MRI-negative cases. Methods We retrospectively studied children undergoing focal resection (n=110) or stereo-EEG (n=61) between 2015–2023, alongside healthy controls aged 6–18 (n=69), using identical 3T MRI diffusion protocols. Age- and sex-adjusted normative models generated mean diffusivity (MD) and fractional anisotropy (FA) voxelwise z-score maps to identify dominant abnormalities. In resection patients, abnormality–resection overlap was related to ≥12-month Engel outcome. In stereo-EEG patients, z-scores were compared across seizure-onset, interictal, and uninvolved grey-matter contacts. In lesion-negative patients, abnormalities were compared with PET hypometabolism and stereo-EEG findings. Results Greater resection of MD abnormalities predicted seizure freedom, especially with overlap >0 (mean differences 17%, 23%; P perm =0.0086, <0.001), and higher odds of Engel I (OR 1.31/10%; AUC 0.723; Youden threshold 36%). FA showed similar associations. Seizure-onset contacts had higher MD and lower FA z-scores than uninvolved grey matter (+0.65, −0.18; P perm <0.001, =0.001), with interictal contacts intermediate. Abnormalities were more widespread and contralateral in patients without an identified onset zone. In lesion-negative patients, abnormalities co-localised with PET (20/28 fully, 6/28 partially) and stereo-EEG (17/24 fully, 3/24 partially). Interpretation Diffusion MRI abnormalities aligned with invasive electrophysiology, predicted seizure freedom when resected, and co-localized with PET/stereo-EEG, supporting an important role in presurgical evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨扩散MRI异常能否在儿童耐药性癫痫术前评估中定位致痫区并预测术后无发作，回顾性分析了接受局灶切除或立体脑电图的患儿，并以健康儿童为参照建立规范模型。结果显示，切除范围覆盖更多平均弥散率异常与术后无发作相关，异常与切除区重叠越大，Engel I的比例越高；部分各向异性也呈类似关联。致痫区触点的平均弥散率更高、部分各向异性更低，发作间期触点居中；在未识别出起始区的患者中，异常更广泛且累及对侧。在MRI阴性病例中，异常与PET低代谢及立体脑电图结果多能共定位。作者认为，扩散MRI异常与侵入性电生理一致，切除后可预测无发作，支持其在术前评估中的作用。

papers.title: Regional and network-level resting state functional connectivity markers of pharmacological treatment resistance in obsessive-compulsive disorder
papers.authors: Chhabra H, Balachander S, Thimmashetty VH, Shivakumar V, Shukla L, Venkatasubramanian G, Reddy YJ, Narayanaswamy JC.
papers.abstract: Treatment resistance in obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is common, with 40–60% of patients failing to respond to pharmacotherapy. Identifying functional differences between responders and non-responders may guide alternative treatment strategies. We investigated resting-state brain differences between selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) responders and non-responders and compared them with healthy controls (HC). 3T MRI scans were acquired from 80 participants with OCD and 50 HCs. Structural and 5-minute resting-state data were processed using the CONN toolbox. Regions showing group differences in amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF) were identified for seed-based connectivity analysis. ANCOVA revealed significant ALFF differences among groups in the anterior middle temporal gyrus (R-aMTG) and temporal pole (R-TP). SSRI responders showed reductions in seed-to-voxel connectivity than non-responders between these regions and the left superior and inferior occipital cortices, left superior parietal lobule, and left temporo-occipital middle temporal gyrus. Responders also showed reductions in connectivity with the left superior parietal lobule compared with HCs. Across the OCD group, Y-BOCS scores positively correlated with ALFF in the R-aMTG (p=0.008) and R-TP (p=0.044). Altered temporal cortical activity and connectivity with posterior regions were associated with SSRI treatment response, supporting a role for temporal–posterior cortical networks in OCD treatment response.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注强迫症患者对选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂（SSRI）治疗反应差异的静息态功能连接基础，比较了SSRI应答者、非应答者与健康对照的脑活动及连接。结果发现，应答者与非应答者在颞叶区域的活动幅度存在差异，且应答者这些区域与多个后部皮层区的连接弱于非应答者；在强迫症组内，症状严重程度与颞叶活动呈正相关。作者认为，颞叶皮层活动及其与后部区域的连接改变与SSRI治疗反应相关，提示颞叶—后部皮层网络可能参与强迫症的治疗反应，但这一关联性发现尚不能说明因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Improving DASH adherence after midlife promotes better late-life cognition and brain health: the SG70 Study
papers.authors: Ng EKK, Lai JS, Ji F, Goh YLB, Chia PSQ, Loh WL, Tham JSY, Fong S, Koh W, Zhou JH.
papers.abstract: Healthier dietary patterns reduce cognitive impairment risks, but whether diet improvement after mid-life can benefit cognition and brain health, and how brain measures mediate diet–cognition associations, remain unclear, as few studies had long-term diet records alongside detailed neuroimaging and cognitive measures. We assessed adherence to the Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) in 892 SG70 participants, nested within the Singapore Chinese Health Study, between 1993–2025. Adherence during midlife (44–55 years) and early elderhood (61–73 years) were related to seven cognitive domains, brain morphometry, white matter hyperintensities (WMH), and free-water markers measured in late life (68–82 years). Higher adherence at both mid-life stages was associated with better verbal memory. Higher mid-life adherence was associated with greater white matter volume in association tracts, whereas higher early-elderhood adherence was associated with lower free water (frontal and occipital) and lower WMH (basal ganglia and anterior periventricular). Moreover, white matter volume and free water mediated the diet-verbal memory associations at their respective midlife stages. Importantly, participants with improved mid-to-late life diet trajectories showed better late-life verbal memory and brain health than those with persistently low adherence. Overall, ensuring mid-life diet quality and improving post-midlife diet may promote cognitive resilience through structural reserve and neurovascular health.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于SG70队列，考察中年至老年期饮食质量与晚年脑健康和言语记忆的关系，并检验脑指标是否在其中起中介作用。结果显示，中年和老年早期对DASH饮食的依从性较高均与晚年言语记忆较好相关；中年依从性较高与联合纤维束白质体积较大相关，老年早期依从性较高则与白质高信号较少及额叶、枕叶灰质自由水较低相关，提示神经血管和炎症负担可能较轻。中介分析表明，白质体积和皮层自由水分别解释了上述两阶段饮食与言语记忆关联的一部分；从中年低依从改善为晚年较高依从者，其言语记忆和脑完整性也优于持续低依从者。作者据此认为，中年及中年后饮食质量可能是与晚年认知韧性相关的可改变生命历程因素，但关联性设计尚不能确立因果。

papers.title: Single Cell Cytometry of Mouse Brain Tissue
papers.authors: Roe CE, Miller C, Calero N, Irish JM, Dingman AL.
papers.abstract: Suspension mass cytometry can measure 50 or more markers per cell and is not impacted by cellular autofluorescence, making it an appealing platform for comprehensive phenotyping of single cells in tissue with high innate fluorescence, such as brain. However, this organ is challenging to reduce to a single cell suspension: it is a deeply interconnected tissue rich in extracellular material and contains a wide variety of cell types including neurons, their supporting glia, and hematopoietic cells from peripheral circulation, any or all of which may have competing requirements for survival through the dissociation process. This study compares approaches for producing single-cell preparations from white and gray matter–enriched regions of adult mouse brain, testing simple mechanical dissociation, Accutase, and three gentle enzymes plus DNase: papain, collagenase II, and collagenase plus dispase, all with or without Percoll gradient centrifugation to separate intact cells from debris. Live cells were counted by hemocytometer and Trypan blue exclusion to assess yield and compare across enzyme conditions. Mass cytometry was used to assess cellular composition after representative dissociation, debris removal, and viable cryopreservation. Key proteins measured included βIII-tubulin for neurons, glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) for astrocytes, oligodendrocyte transcription factor (OLIG2) for oligodendrocytes, CD31 for endothelial cells, CD24 for ependymal cells, purinergic receptor P2Y12 (P2RY12) for microglia, and CD45 for leukocytes. Mechanical disaggregation paired with enzymatic dissociation by papain, Collagenase/Disapse, or Collagenase II plus DNase produced approximately 400,000 live cells per 100 grams of tissue. Cell yield was not significantly different between conditions and yields were similar between white and grey matter. Addition of Percoll gradient centrifugation substantially reduced the number of viable cells recovered (average decrease of 88%) and resulted in viable cell numbers that were insufficient for robust analysis of less common cell subsets. In addition to neurons, mass cytometry identified six major populations of non-neuronal cells: oligodendrocytes, astrocytes, endothelial cells, ependymal cells, microglia, and leukocytes. The relative abundance of these six populations was generally unchanged by cryopreservation in both grey matter ( r = 0.95), and white matter ( r = 0.90), though loss of oligodendrocytes did occur in both tissues. Proliferation, as measured by Ki67 positivity, was non-existent; consistent with this, levels of phosphorylated STAT1 (p-STAT1) and p-STAT3 proteins were low in all cell populations and unchanged by cryopreservation. A modest increase in p-S6(S235/236) after cryopreservation was consistently observed only in microglia. Together, these results establish standardized procedures for generating viable single cell suspensions for cytometry that preserve the cellular diversity of the adult murine brain with minimal perturbation of intracellular signaling cascades.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对成年小鼠脑组织难以解离为单细胞悬液的问题，比较了机械解离与多种酶解方案在富集白质和灰质区域制备单细胞悬液的效果，并用质谱流式检测细胞组成。结果显示，机械解离配合木瓜蛋白酶、胶原酶/中性蛋白酶或胶原酶II加DNase可获得相近的活细胞产量，白质与灰质间也无明显差异；而加入Percoll梯度离心会大幅降低回收的活细胞数，使少见细胞亚群难以可靠分析。质谱流式除神经元外还识别出少突胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞、内皮细胞、室管膜细胞、小胶质细胞和白细胞六类非神经元群体，冻存后各群体相对丰度总体保持稳定，但两组织中均出现少突胶质细胞丢失，小胶质细胞的p-S6信号则略有升高。作者据此提出一套可保留成年小鼠脑细胞多样性、且对胞内信号扰动较小的单细胞悬液制备流程。

papers.title: Spiral brain dynamics track the temporal unfolding of subjective intensity during the N,N -dimethyltryptamine experience
papers.authors: Sawicka G, Martínez-Marín M, Timmermann C, Carhart-Harris R, Kringelbach M, Sanz-Perl Y, Vohryzek J, Deco G.
papers.abstract: Psychedelic compounds such as N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT) induce rapid and profound changes in conscious experience, requiring neuroimaging measures that capture how brain dynamics evolve across space and time. Emerging evidence suggests that rotational (vortex-like) dynamics may contribute to the coordination of large-scale neural activity. Here, we introduce two vorticity-based metrics; spiral vorticity (SV) and spatial spiral vorticity dispersion (SSVD), to quantify the rotational organization and spatial heterogeneity of large-scale cortical phase dynamics. Using fMRI data acquired under placebo and DMT in a within-subject design, we assessed these measures globally, across resting-state networks, and regionally to examine their relationship to subjective intensity. DMT increased SV and SSVD and reduced temporal irreversibility, indicating stronger rotational organization, greater spatial heterogeneity, and altered directional structure of cortical dynamics. Effects were non-uniform across functional systems, with the largest changes in default mode, visual, frontoparietal, and dorsal attention networks. Both vorticity measures tracked the temporal evolution of subjective intensity globally, while network-level analyses revealed spatially heterogeneous brain–experience coupling. Spatiotemporally resolved analyses further showed that the strongest reorganization of spiral dynamics emerged during offset and recovery rather than at peak subjective intensity. These findings identify spiral dynamics as a time-resolved neural signature of the DMT experience. By quantifying the rotational structure and spatial heterogeneity of cortical phase flow, vorticity-based measures provide a framework for linking large-scale brain dynamics to evolving subjective experience.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注DMT体验中主观强度随时间展开的神经动力学基础，提出基于涡度的指标来量化皮层相位动力学的旋转组织与空间异质性，并利用同一批被试在安慰剂和DMT条件下的fMRI数据，在全局、网络和区域层面考察这些指标与主观强度的关系。结果显示，DMT增强了旋转组织和空间异质性，并改变了动力学的方向结构，且效应在不同功能系统间并不均匀。两种涡度指标在全局层面能追踪主观强度的时间演变，而网络层面的脑—体验耦合呈现空间异质性；时空分辨分析还表明，螺旋动力学最明显的重组出现在体验消退与恢复阶段，而非主观强度峰值时。作者据此认为，螺旋动力学可作为DMT体验的时间分辨神经标志，涡度指标为连接大规模脑动力学与动态主观体验提供了框架。

papers.title: Predicting the immediate and subsequent effects of commercials on product valuation using EEG and deep learning
papers.authors: Arie IG, Atad DA, Hakim A, Levy D.
papers.abstract: Neuromarketing mainly seeks to enhance the prediction of marketing stimuli success, such as commercials and movie trailers, by integrating neurophysiological measures with traditional behavioral measures. In the current study, the authors tested whether neural activity could predict consumer valuation and how preferences change after watching commercials, both immediately and over time. Participants (n=161) watched images of products followed by commercials advertising those products while their neural activity was recorded using electroencephalograph (EEG). They watched the product images again a week later without EEG recordings. Immediately after each stimulus exposure, participants stated their willingness to pay (WTP) for the product and how much they liked the commercial. Standard EEG measures showed weak and inconsistent relationships with behavior and yielded near-chance predictions. In contrast, deep learning models applied to the raw neural data achieved substantially higher predictive accuracy, successfully predicting both immediate and delayed WTP and ad liking. Importantly, the authors were able to successfully predict preferences for new participants and/or new products the models were not trained on. However, accuracy declined as generalization demands increased. Moreover, prediction performance declined as value differences narrow. Together, these findings show that neural responses carry reliable and temporally persistent information about consumer valuation and its evolution over time.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察观看广告时的脑电活动能否预测消费者对产品的支付意愿及广告喜好，并追踪这种偏好的即时与延迟变化。参与者观看产品图片和相应广告时接受脑电记录，随后报告支付意愿和对广告的喜好，一周后再次评价产品。结果显示，传统脑电指标与行为关系微弱且不一致，预测接近随机水平；而基于原始神经数据的深度学习模型预测准确率明显更高，能预测即时和延迟的支付意愿及广告喜好，并可推广到未参与训练的新参与者和新产品，但泛化要求越高、产品间价值差异越小，预测准确率越低。作者据此认为，神经反应携带关于消费者估值及其随时间演变的可预测信息。

papers.title: A whole-brain modeling framework for tDCS montage optimization in drug-resistant epilepsy
papers.authors: Mercadal B, Lopez-Sola E, Makhalova J, Pizzo F, Salvador R, Bartolomei F, Ruffini G.
papers.abstract: Objective Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) is a promising non-invasive therapy for drug-resistant epilepsy, but the montage optimization pipelines used to personalize it often rely on biophysical head models that capture only the induced electric field and ignore the network dynamics through which stimulation influences epileptogenic activity. We aimed to develop and evaluate a montage optimization framework that incorporates individualized network dynamics. Approach We introduce a framework based on a digital twin, or neurotwin , a personalized replica of a patient’s brain that couples a biophysical head model of the stimulation-induced field with a personalized whole-brain model (WBM) of seizure dynamics constrained by structural connectivity and intracranial recordings. We applied it to produce optimal montages in 12 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, compared them with conventional biophysics-based optimization, and assessed the framework retrospectively against the clinical outcomes of six treated patients. Main results Because the neurotwin optimization suppresses simulated spread by construction, the informative result is the divergence between pipelines: the network-informed and field-based optimizations produced substantially different montages despite delivering comparable inhibitory fields at the epileptogenic zone, and montages with nearly identical field distributions could yield markedly different network outcomes within the model. A minimum-replacement-set analysis traced these differences to field changes at a few propagation-zone and off-target parcels rather than to the overall field. The parcels whose inhibition most reduced spread tended to occupy highly connected (hub) positions in the structural connectome, a robust but partial association indicating that network structure shapes, but does not fully determine, where stimulation is most effective. In the retrospective analysis, model-predicted spread reduction tracked clinical seizure-frequency change in the expected direction, though not significantly ( n = 6). Significance We hypothesize that accounting for individualized network dynamics may improve seizure control, a hypothesis now being tested prospectively ( NCT06334952 ). Highlights A neurotwin couples a biophysical head model with a personalized whole-brain model (WBM) for tDCS optimization. neurotwin and field-based optimization yield divergent montages despite comparable EZ fields. Field differences at a few target and off-target parcels, not overall field magnitude, drive the simulated network outcomes. Parcels controlling simulated seizure spread tend to be structural network hubs (high nodal strength and centrality), an association that persists after adjusting for local dynamics. WBM-predicted spread reduction was directionally consistent with clinical seizure-frequency change (non-significant, n = 6).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对耐药性癫痫的经颅直流电刺激个体化方案优化，提出一个将刺激电场生物物理模型与受结构连接和颅内记录约束的个体化全脑癫痫动力学模型相耦合的“神经孪生”框架，并在患者中与常规基于电场的优化进行比较。主要发现是：两种优化在致痫区给出相近的抑制电场，却产生明显不同的刺激方案；电场分布几乎相同的方案在模型内也可导致差异很大的网络结果，差异主要来自少数传播区和靶外脑区的电场变化而非整体电场强度。最能抑制发作扩散的脑区倾向于位于结构连接网络的高连接枢纽位置，但这一关联只是部分性的。回顾性分析中，模型预测的扩散减少与临床发作频率变化方向一致但不显著，作者据此提出网络动力学信息或可改善发作控制的假设，并正在前瞻性检验。

papers.title: Enhanced cortical tracking of unfamiliar languages in both monolinguals and bilinguals
papers.authors: Zheng Q, Ahmed F, Chopra A, Lau BK.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Humans routinely encounter speech in languages they have never heard, yet how the brain responds to such input and whether bilingual experience shapes this response remains unknown. Here, we used electroencephalography (EEG) and temporal response function (TRF) modeling to examine cortical tracking of the speech envelope in 24 English-monolingual and 24 English-Mandarin bilingual adults. Participants listened to naturally produced continuous speech in three languages: English (familiar to all), Mandarin (familiar to bilinguals only), and Vietnamese (unfamiliar to all). We report two main findings. First, both monolinguals and bilinguals showed enhanced cortical tracking for unfamiliar relative to familiar languages, evidenced by higher EEG prediction accuracy (PA). Monolinguals showed enhanced tracking for both Mandarin and Vietnamese, whereas bilinguals showed enhancement only for Vietnamese, consistent with Mandarin being a familiar language for this group. This finding suggests that enhanced cortical encoding of unfamiliar speech is a general property of the listening brain, not a signature of listening to a non-native language or reduced language proficiency. Second, bilinguals strikingly showed stronger cortical tracking than monolinguals overall, in both PA and TRF peak weights, with the TRF peak weight advantage present across all three languages, suggesting a difference in how bilingual experience shapes the neural encoding of speech. These findings have implications for understanding how the brain navigates the linguistic diversity of everyday life in an increasingly global, multilingual world. SIGNIFICANT STATEMENT More than half the world speaks more than one language, and most people regularly hear speech they cannot understand. How the brain responds to such speech, and whether bilingualism matters, is unclear. We recorded brain activity from monolingual and bilingual adults listening to familiar and unfamiliar speech. Both groups showed enhanced tracking of unfamiliar speech compared to familiar speech and bilinguals showed stronger tracking than monolinguals overall, suggesting a potential difference in how bilingual brains process speech. These findings advance our understanding of how the brain navigates speech in a multilingual world.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电和时域响应函数建模，考察单语与双语成人聆听熟悉和不熟悉语言连续语音时皮层对语音包络的追踪。结果发现，单语者和双语者对不熟悉语言的追踪均强于熟悉语言，说明这种增强并非仅由非母语或语言熟练度降低所致；同时，双语者在整体追踪强度上高于单语者，且这一优势跨三种语言存在，提示双语经验可能改变语音的神经编码方式。

papers.title: Decoding natural scenes from patterned optogenetic responses in mouse visual cortex
papers.authors: Jia S, Xin T, Li C, Ji H, Wu R, Wang S, Guo Q, Yu Z, Liu JK, Li Y.
papers.abstract: A central challenge in developing visual cortical prostheses is to determine how visual stimuli should be transformed into effective patterns of cortical stimulation. Although advances in stimulation technologies, including optogenetics, provide increasingly precise control over cortical activity, it remains unclear whether artificially evoked activity can reproduce the information content of naturally evoked visual representations. Here we establish a quantitative framework for evaluating visual encoding strategies by decoding cortical responses evoked by natural vision and patterned optogenetic stimulation. We developed a novel dual-modal paradigm in awake mice to bridge the gap between endogenous photostimulation and artificial network driving. By co-expressing the high-performance calcium indicator GCaMP6s and the red-shifted, ultra-sensitive opsin rsChRmine-oScarlet in the primary visual cortex (V1), we successfully translated dynamic natural movie frames into patterned, spatiotemporal optogenetic stimulation. Quantitative comparisons of macro-scale dynamics demonstrated that this patterned optogenetic injection evokes cortical states highly comparable and representationally aligned with those driven by actual visual photostimulation. To systematically evaluate the fidelity of these responses, we developed STAR, a deep learning model featuring spatial and temporal attention mechanisms, and successfully reconstructed the frames of natural movies from V1 signals under both experimental modalities. Collectively, our results demonstrate that complex sensory information can be both naturally encoded and synthetically injected into V1 circuits with high decoding fidelity. This work provides an empirical and computational proof-of-concept for intelligent, closed-loop biomimetic encoders, establishing a robust framework for next-generation cortical visual neuroprostheses and bidirectional brain-machine interfaces.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人工皮层刺激能否复现自然视觉所携带的信息，在清醒小鼠初级视皮层中同时表达钙指示剂和光敏蛋白，将自然电影帧转换为时空模式化的光遗传刺激，并与真实视觉诱发反应进行比较。结果显示，这种模式化光刺激诱发的皮层状态与真实视觉驱动高度可比且表征对齐；作者还构建带时空注意机制的深度学习模型，从两种条件下的皮层信号中重建自然电影帧。这表明复杂感觉信息既可被自然编码，也可被人工注入视皮层回路并保持较高解码保真度，为闭环仿生编码器和皮层视觉假体提供了概念验证，但尚属动物实验层面的可行性证据。

papers.title: Attention Across Scales: From Individual Variation to Social Hierarchies and Brain Networks in Semi-Free-Ranging Macaques
papers.authors: Vaitekunaite S, Silvère S, Meunier H, Ballesta S, Sani I.
papers.abstract: Attention is a fundamental brain function supporting perception, decision-making, and social behavior, and its dysfunction profoundly impairs daily life. It is both dynamic and stable, varying across observations and individuals, changing across the lifespan, and being shaped by social and environmental experience. Yet capturing this complexity remains a central challenge in neuroscience. Here, we integrated longitudinal behavioral assessments of semi-free-ranging macaques living in naturalistic social groups with resting-state fMRI. We quantified performance across days, ages, and social hierarchies and related it to intrinsic brain organization. Distinct attentional phenotypes emerged, including individuals with reduced attentional control. Performance followed an inverted-U lifespan trajectory, improving from childhood to adulthood before declining. Social status modulated attentional performance. Critically, nonlinear lifespan trajectories and associations with individual attentional differences were most clearly expressed in frontoparietal connectivity. Together, these findings reveal how sustained attention is organized across scales, providing a biological framework for its individual diversity, social modulation, and neural basis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注注意如何在个体差异、生命周期和社会等级等多个尺度上组织，并将半自由放养猕猴在自然社会群体中的纵向行为评估与静息态功能磁共振成像相结合。研究发现，注意表现呈现不同的个体表型，其中部分个体的注意控制较弱；表现随年龄呈先升后降的倒U形轨迹，并受社会地位调节。与个体注意差异及年龄轨迹相关的关联在额顶连接中表现得最为清晰，提示持续注意的个体多样性、社会调节及其神经基础可能共同体现在这一网络组织上。

papers.title: Epigenetic age acceleration is associated with brain connectivity changes and the risk of major depression after trauma
papers.authors: Navarro-Flores A, Milla H, Linnstaedt SD, An X, Stevens JS, Huff L, Harnett NG, Roeckner AR, Oliver KI, Rubinow DR, Koenen KC, Heilbronner U, Schulze TG, Ressler KJ, McLean SA, Zannas AS.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Major depressive disorder (MDD) is associated with brain dysfunction and age-related diseases. Epigenetic clocks based on DNA methylation patterns estimate biological aging and aim to predict morbidity and mortality. Although MDD has been linked to epigenetic age acceleration (EAA) cross-sectionally, it is unknown whether EAA is associated with MDD after trauma. Methods We included 706 participants (66% non-white, 64% female) from the multi-ancestry AURORA study, enrolled at emergency departments (ED) within 72 hours after trauma, from whom three age-adjusted epigenetic clocks were measured at enrollment: PhenoAge, GrimAge, and DunedinPACE. Functional MRI and assessment for probable MDD were conducted two weeks and six months later, respectively. Logistic and linear regression models tested the association of EAA with MDD and functional neuroimaging endpoints. Results A total of 660 participants had available assessments of probable MDD six months after trauma, and from those 160 screened positively (24.2%) after trauma. EAA calculated by GrimAge (OR = 1.44, 95% CI = 1.12 – 1.85, p-adj= 0.012) and DunedinPACE (OR = 1.46, 95% CI = 1.15 – 1.85, p-adj = 0.005), but not PhenoAge (p-adj= 0.239), was significantly associated with MDD 6-months after trauma. Associations remained significant after adjusting for additional confounders, including prior trauma and disability (p= 0.008 for GrimAge, p= 0.010 for DunedinPACE). Subgroup analysis based on a median age split revealed these effects were only observed in participants 35 years of age or older. DunedinPACE was significantly associated with altered connectivity of fourteen brain network pairs after FDR correction (n = 217). Conclusions EAA is associated with a higher risk of MDD after trauma and with concomitant brain connectivity changes. Calculation of GrimAge and DunedinPACE at the time of ED presentation may help recognize patients at risk for MDD, potentially improving personalized care after trauma.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于多族裔急诊创伤队列，在创伤后72小时内测量三种表观遗传时钟，并在两周和六个月后分别进行功能磁共振与可能抑郁评估，考察表观遗传年龄加速与创伤后抑郁及脑连接变化的关系。结果显示，GrimAge和DunedinPACE所反映的年龄加速与创伤后六个月可能抑郁风险升高相关，且这一关联在调整既往创伤和残疾等混杂因素后仍存在，但主要见于35岁及以上参与者；PhenoAge则无显著关联。DunedinPACE还与多个脑网络对之间的连接改变相关。作者据此提出，急诊就诊时计算GrimAge和DunedinPACE或有助于识别创伤后抑郁高风险者，但这是关联性发现，尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Long-Term Neurocognitive Changes in Children With Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome: A Scoping Review.
papers.authors: Phillips CD, Carroll Q, Burnette SH, Keinath C, Hemphill JC.
papers.journal: Journal of psychosocial nursing and mental health services
papers.abstract: Purpose The current scoping review examined cognitive, behavioral, and developmental deficits in children aged 1 month to 17 years with neonatal abstinence syndrome (NAS), with implications for longitudinal outcomes, such as attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), language delay, and learning disabilities. Method A scoping review methodology was used to identify and analyze 36 studies from CINAHL, PubMed, ERIC, and PsycINFO to comprehensively capture nursing and psychology literature. Inclusion criteria focused on children with NAS and neurocognitive outcomes across five developmental stages. Results Nine subthemes of neurocognitive change were evaluated: cognition; behavior; emotion; motor activity; learning or intelligence; vision or visual perception; social interaction; language; and physiological developmental. Preschool and school-age children showed the highest prevalence of ADHD and language delays, whereas adolescents exhibited increased behavioral and emotional disturbances. Conclusion Findings have important implications for psychiatric-mental health nurse practitioners, principally in the early identification, planning, screening, and clinical integration for neurodevelopmental and mental health sequelae in children with NAS.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了1个月至17岁新生儿戒断综合征（NAS）儿童在认知、行为和发展方面的缺陷，并分析其与注意缺陷多动障碍、语言迟缓和学习障碍等长期结局的关联。作者纳入36项研究，归纳出认知、行为、情绪、运动、学习或智力、视觉或视知觉、社会互动、语言及生理发育九个神经认知变化亚主题。学龄前和学龄期儿童中注意缺陷多动障碍与语言迟缓最为常见，青少年则表现出更多行为与情绪困扰。作者据此强调，精神心理健康护理从业者应重视对NAS儿童神经发育和心理健康后遗症的早期识别、筛查与临床整合。

papers.title: Musical Instrument Practice as Sensorimotor and Motor-Cognitive Skill Training in Healthy Aging.
papers.authors: Greco G, Desantis D, Cataldi S, Fischetti F.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Playing a musical instrument requires precisely timed movements, bimanual or interlimb coordination, visuomotor mapping, auditory and somatosensory feedback, sequence learning, prediction, and executive regulation. This narrative review synthesizes motor, cognitive, and neuroplastic adaptations associated with active instrumental practice in predominantly healthy adults aged 60 years or older, interpreting practice as a complex sensorimotor and motor-cognitive skill activity. Methods: English-language literature from January 2016 through August 2026 was searched in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science Core Collection, supplemented by Google Scholar and citation chasing. Randomized and controlled interventions were prioritized, with longitudinal and observational evidence used contextually; earlier studies were included selectively for seminal or mechanistic context. Results: Direct motor evidence was less abundant than cognitive evidence. Both piano and mallet-percussion programs improved task-proximal bimanual synchronization, and one large active-control trial found greater improvement in untrained unimanual fine-motor control after one year of piano practice. Selective near transfer to continuation timing was also reported, whereas evidence for generalized dexterity, gait, balance, lower-limb coordination, and everyday motor function remained limited or mixed. Cognitive effects were selective, particularly for processing speed, verbal fluency or switching, and some working-memory measures. Neuroplastic findings included cortical-thickness increase, relative structural preservation, altered auditory-motor connectivity, reduced task activation, and oscillatory modulation.
