Conclusions: Instrumental practice may provide an engaging and adaptable form of sensorimotor and motor-cognitive skill practice in healthy aging, but broad transfer and neuroprotection are not established. Future trials should quantify skill acquisition, dose, retention, and transfer and compare instrument-specific demands.

papers.title: Electrophysiological signature of stroke recovery: investigating EEG biomarkers for prognostic insights.
papers.authors: Khalili-Ardali M, Sharma V, Mandahar TS, Páscoa Dos Santos F, Tiesinga P, Ramsey N.
papers.abstract: Introduction Stroke is a leading cause of long-term disability, often resulting in persistent motor impairments that reflect disruptions in large-scale brain networks. An integrated framework capturing spatiotemporal EEG dynamics would help clarify how these networks change during recovery. Methods We analysed resting-state EEG from stroke patients at 1 week (Session 1) and three months (Session 2) post-stroke to investigate electrophysiological biomarkers of motor recovery, indexed by change in the Fugl-Meyer scale (ΔFM ). We quantified relative alpha-band power, microstate metrics (mean duration, complexity, and transition probabilities), and measures of metastability and synchrony derived from the Kuramoto Order Parameter. Resultss Change in relative alpha power emerged as the strongest single correlate of motor improvement, accounting for the largest proportion of variance among the EEG measures examined. Metastability and synchrony did not individually reach statistical significance but showed moderate positive correlations with ΔFM , particularly in the alpha and theta bands, and added 26% explained variance in ΔFM when combined with alpha power. Microstate parameters did not explain additional variance once alpha power and network-level dynamics were accounted for. A hierarchical model combining alpha power, metastability/synchrony, and microstates explained over 78% of the variance in ΔFM . Discussion These findings indicate that stroke recovery involves restoring balanced alpha oscillations and flexible large-scale brain coordination. Larger samples and more frequent longitudinal assessments are required to confirm the prognostic utility of integrated EEG biomarkers for guiding personalised stroke rehabilitation strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析卒中患者发病一周和三个月时的静息态脑电，考察与运动功能恢复（以Fugl-Meyer量表变化衡量）相关的电生理指标。结果显示，相对alpha功率变化是与运动改善关联最强的单一指标；跨频段（尤其alpha和theta）的亚稳态与同步性单独未达显著，但与alpha功率联合后可额外解释部分恢复方差，而微状态参数在纳入前两者后不再提供增量信息。作者据此认为，卒中恢复可能涉及alpha振荡平衡与大规模脑网络灵活协调的恢复，但现有样本和随访频率尚不足以确认这些整合指标用于预后和个体化康复的可靠性。

papers.title: Efficacy and neural mechanisms of transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation for chronic insomnia: a study protocol for a randomized controlled trial.
papers.authors: Feng M, Liu Q, Chen X, Luo W, Zhang M, Zhu W.
papers.abstract: Background Traditional auricular therapy for chronic insomnia (Bu Mei in TCM) is used in clinical practice but is limited by insufficient standardization and poorly understood mechanisms. Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) provides a quantifiable and reproducible neuromodulatory approach by stimulating vagally innervated regions of the auricular concha, which overlap with auricular acupoints used in TCM. However, evidence in insomnia remains predominantly based on clinical outcomes, whereas longitudinal neuroimaging evidence is limited. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) may complement clinical assessments by characterizing spontaneous brain activity and treatment-related functional changes, thereby providing objective neuroimaging evidence relevant to the potential mechanisms of taVNS. Methods This protocol will recruit 60 patients with chronic insomnia disorder (CID) and 30 age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HCs). Patients with CID will be randomized 1:1 to receive 4 weeks of active or sham-taVNS. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) will be performed at baseline in all participants and repeated at Week 4 in patients with CID, within 24 hours after the final intervention session. Fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (fALFF) will serve as a prespecified exploratory neuroimaging measure, with amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF) included as a complementary exploratory measure. The neuroimaging analyses will examine baseline differences between patients with CID and HCs and between-group differences in baseline-to-Week-4 changes between the active and sham-taVNS groups to characterize brain functional alterations associated with CID and changes associated with active taVNS relative to sham-taVNS. The primary clinical outcome will be the change in Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) score from baseline to Week 4. Secondary and follow-up assessments will evaluate insomnia severity, daytime sleepiness, emotional status, cognitive function, pre-sleep arousal, and quality of life. Exploratory correlations between changes in neuroimaging measures and clinical outcomes will also be examined. Discussion This study will integrate clinical assessments with rs-fMRI to evaluate the clinical effects of taVNS in patients with CID and explore associated changes in spontaneous brain activity. The integration of clinical outcomes and exploratory neuroimaging measures may provide complementary evidence on treatment effects and associated brain functional changes, thereby informing future investigation of the potential neural mechanisms of taVNS in CID. Clinical trial registration https://www.chictr.org.cn/hvshowprojectEN.html?id=277442&v=1.0, identifier ChiCTR2500103157.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一项随机对照试验的研究方案，计划纳入慢性失眠障碍患者与年龄性别匹配的健康对照，患者随机接受为期4周的真或假经皮耳迷走神经刺激，并在基线和干预结束后进行静息态功能磁共振成像，以低频波动振幅相关指标探索自发脑活动变化。主要临床结局为匹兹堡睡眠质量指数从基线到第4周的变化，同时评估失眠严重程度、日间嗜睡、情绪、认知、睡前唤醒和生活质量，并考察影像指标变化与临床结局的探索性关联。研究旨在将临床评估与神经影像结合，为taVNS治疗慢性失眠的疗效及可能伴随的脑功能改变提供补充证据；由于目前仅为方案，实际结果尚不可知。

papers.title: Specific learning disorders and underlying processes: can WISC-IV subtests predict SLD neurocognitive profiles in Italian children aged 7-14 years?
papers.authors: Capobianco M, Faccio M, Giammarco C, Camplone D, Adriani W.
papers.abstract: Introduction Specific Learning Disorder (SLD) is studied via WISC IV, as well as via neurocognitive impairment profiles arising from clinical tests. However, state-of-the-art appears to be deficitary about the possibility of shared neurocognitive profiles within a given phenotype. Objectives We aim to fulfil this gap by investigating, in SLD, formal correlations between WISC IV subtests and nine impairment domains, with their own degrees of severity. Participants and methodology 160 Italian children, aged 7 to 14 years, have been divided in four groups (Males vs. Females; Primary vs. Lower Secondary School); scores obtained in nine specific domains of abilities have been confronted versus WISC IV scales, using Pearson R correlations, and obtaining 15 × 9 matrices for each group. Results The most relevant correlations have been found in the primary-school group only, and in the female group only. The primary-school children presented a strong correlation of WMI with handwriting and reading. On the other hand, in the female group, mental calculation abilities correlated to several subtest indexes, such as: IQ; VCI; WMI. Reading comprehension abilities also correlated to WMI. Interpretations A possible explanation to neurocognitive profiles in females is represented by fronto-parietal networks: anomalies in gray-to-white matter ratio, in gray-matter depth, and in white-matter tracts appear to be typical of young females. Results found in the primary-school group underline the developmental role of working memory in learning how to properly read and write. Thus, specific phenotypic areas are implicated in deficitary neurocognitive networks affected in children with SLD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨韦氏儿童智力量表第四版（WISC-IV）分测验能否预测意大利7至14岁特定学习障碍（SLD）儿童的神经认知损害特征，将160名儿童按性别和学段分组，用相关分析比较分测验得分与九个能力领域损害程度。主要相关仅出现在小学组和女生组：小学组的工作记忆指数与书写、阅读相关较强，女生组的心理计算能力与总智商、言语理解指数和工作记忆指数等多个指标相关，阅读理解也与工作记忆指数相关。作者据此推测女生组的特征可能与额顶网络及灰白质结构差异有关，小学组的结果则提示工作记忆在读写学习中的发展作用；这些均为相关性发现，尚不能说明因果或预测效力。

papers.title: Enhancing structural to functional brain network prediction using topological graph learning.
papers.authors: Rajakaruna SNK, Dey AK, Chatterjee S.
papers.abstract: Introduction Understanding the relationship between structural and functional brain connectivity remains a fundamental challenge in network neuroscience. While structural connectivity constrains neural interactions, functional connectivity emerges from complex, nonlinear dynamics that are not fully explained by anatomical wiring alone. Existing graph-based and deep learning approaches often focus on pairwise relationships, thereby overlooking higher-order topological organization in brain networks. Methods We propose TopoGCN, a topology-informed graph convolutional network that integrates topological data analysis (TDA) into structure-function prediction. Persistent homology is used to extract multiscale topological features from structural connectomes, which are incorporated as node-level inputs. Additionally, a topology-aware loss function is incorporated to enforce preservation of higher-order structures in predicted functional networks. The model is evaluated on Human Connectome Project data (n = 998) using both edge-wise metrics and topological measures, including motif distributions, Betti curves, and Wasserstein distances between persistence diagrams. Results TopoGCN achieves competitive accuracy in reconstructing functional connectivity while significantly improving the preservation of higher-order network organization. Compared to state-of-the-art models, it yields lower KL divergence for node strength and motif distributions, and smaller Wasserstein distances between persistence diagrams, indicating better recovery of multiscale topological structures. Furthermore, hypothesis tests on Betti curves show no significant differences between observed and predicted networks, demonstrating strong agreement in both connected-component and cycle-based topology. Discussion Our findings show that incorporating persistent-homology information into graph learning improves the modeling of structure-function relationships in the human brain. By preserving multiscale topological features beyond pairwise connections, TopoGCN provides an improved framework for topology-aware connectome prediction and offers new opportunities for studying brain organization and individual variability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何从结构连接预测功能连接，指出现有图学习和深度学习方法多聚焦成对关系，忽略脑网络的高阶拓扑组织。作者提出TopoGCN，将拓扑数据分析中的持续同调提取的多尺度拓扑特征作为节点输入，并引入拓扑感知损失函数，在人类连接组计划数据上以边级指标和多种拓扑指标评估。结果显示，该模型在重建功能连接上具有竞争力，同时明显更好地保留高阶网络组织，在节点强度和模体分布上的KL散度更低，持续同调图之间的Wasserstein距离更小，Betti曲线检验也未显示观测网络与预测网络存在显著差异。作者据此认为，将持续同调信息纳入图学习可改进结构—功能关系的建模，为拓扑感知的连接组预测提供框架。

papers.title: Irreversible functional network deformation induced by preprocessing scheme order in multivariate EEG recordings.
papers.authors: Arzate-Mena JD, Olguín-Rodríguez PV, Corsi-Cabrera M, López-Alvarado EA, Müller MF.
papers.abstract: Introduction The analysis of Electroencephalographic recordings is non-trivial, the order in which filtering and re-referencing are applied during multivariate signal preprocessing has a critical and underappreciated consequence for functional network estimation. Methods Using EEG sleep recordings from healthy subjects, synthetic data from controlled numerical models (Nf-Tori and IAAFT surrogates), and surrogate-based statistical testing, we provide a quantitative comparison of two preprocessing schemes that differ solely in the order of filtering and re-referencing (filtering followed by re-referencing-FR, and re-referencing followed by filtering-RF). Results We show that the RF scheme induces spurious cross-correlations that increase systematically with the frequency band and are strongly modulated by the power spectral exponent β of the signal. Critically, for signals with steep power spectra (β ≥2), a regime that characterizes slow-wave sleep, epileptic post-ictal periods, anesthesia, neonatal, and patients in vegetative states, the RF scheme produces artificial correlations that are irreversible. They cannot be eliminated post-hoc even when surrogate-corrected cross-correlations (SAC-matrix) are applied. The mechanism underlying this effect is due to the high-amplitude slow-frequency components that dominate the median reference signal over extended time intervals, embedding redundant information across all channels. In contrast, the FR scheme introduces only small, systematic negative shifts in cross-correlations that are not statistically significant and can be effectively corrected using surrogate-based methods. Conclusions We therefore recommend the FR scheme combined with surrogate-corrected cross-correlations for all applications involving signals with β ≥2. Although this finding is demonstrated in EEG, it applies to any multivariate recording where spatial re-referencing and band-pass filtering are applied sequentially.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注多变量EEG预处理中滤波与重参考的先后顺序如何影响功能网络估计，比较了先滤波后重参考（FR）与先重参考后滤波（RF）两种方案，并结合健康受试者睡眠EEG、数值模型合成数据和替代数据统计检验进行分析。结果显示，RF方案会引入虚假的跨通道相关，且随频段升高而增强，并受信号功率谱指数β强烈调节；在β≥2的陡峭功率谱情形下，这种人为相关不可逆，即使事后采用替代校正的互相关矩阵也无法消除，其机制在于高幅慢频成分主导中位参考信号，使冗余信息嵌入所有通道。相比之下，FR方案只带来小幅、系统的负向偏移，未达统计显著且可被替代方法有效校正。作者据此建议对β≥2的信号采用FR方案并结合替代校正，并指出该结论虽在EEG中展示，也适用于其他需依次进行空间重参考和带通滤波的多变量记录。

papers.title: NETs and the thrombo-immune microenvironment: immune heterogeneity in recanalization, reperfusion, hemorrhagic transformation, and antithrombotic strategies.
papers.authors: Zhu F, Wang F, Wang S, Wang F, Zhang F.
papers.abstract: Reperfusion therapies have revolutionized the treatment of acute ischemic stroke (AIS), but target-artery recanalization, downstream angiographic reperfusion, microvascular tissue reperfusion, and functional recovery are distinct endpoints. Patients may have persistent occlusion or early reocclusion, incomplete modified Thrombolysis in Cerebral Infarction (mTICI) reperfusion, microvascular no-reflow despite high-grade mTICI/eTICI reperfusion, hemorrhagic transformation (HT), or poor 90-day functional outcome. Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) form a mechanistic link between thrombus structure, innate immune activation, endothelial injury, and antithrombotic responses. NETs provide a DNA-histone scaffold that stabilizes fibrin-rich thrombi, recruits platelets and coagulation factors, and exposes the neurovascular unit to cytotoxic granular proteins. The biological characteristics of NETs nevertheless vary among patients. Differences in neutrophil priming, platelet activation, monocyte-endothelial signaling, thrombus composition, collateral status, concurrent inflammation, and reperfusion injury create distinct thrombo-immune microenvironments. This article reviews how NET-driven immunothrombosis affects arterial recanalization, angiographic and tissue reperfusion, HT, and emerging antithrombotic strategies. It also proposes an operational immune-phenotyping framework with candidate biomarkers, assay-dependent research thresholds, sampling time points, and trial-level decision rules.

papers.title: Development of a nomogram for predicting wall irregular pulsation and risk stratification in intracranial aneurysms.
papers.authors: Liu J, Zhou J, Zhang J, Li X, Li O, Zhao H, Zhang Y, Zhao B.
papers.abstract: Objective Accurate rupture risk stratification for unruptured intracranial aneurysms (UIAs) presents clinical challenges. Aneurysm wall irregular pulsation is an imaging biomarker of aneurysm vulnerability. This study aims to develop a nomogram for predicting wall irregular pulsation and risk stratification in intracranial aneurysms. Methods This was a consecutive cross-sectional observational study with prospective data collection for UIAs between 2017 and 2020. The irregular pulsation was defined as sequential morphological alterations observed in three or more consecutive phases by on four-dimensional CT angiography (4D-CTA). A generalized estimating equation (GEE) method identified independent predictors of the presence of wall irregular pulsation. A logistic regression-based predictive model was developed. Model performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic analysis. Results We included 202 patients with 262 unruptured aneurysms. Multivariable analysis revealed four independent predictors of the presence of wall irregular pulsation: aneurysm location at ACA/PCom/Posterior (OR: 2.17, 95% CI 1.21-3.88; p = 0.0099), presence of daughter sac (OR: 5.15, 95% CI 1.91-13.86; p = 0.001), aspect ratio (OR: 1.80, 95% CI 1.09-2.99; p = 0.022), and neck size (OR: 1.23, 95% CI 1.02-1.48; p = 0.030). The developed model demonstrated good discrimination, achieving a sensitivity of 88.5%, specificity of 71.2%, overall accuracy of 76.9%, and an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.808 (95% CI, 0.704-0.913). Further validation using an independent cohort yielded comparable performance, with a sensitivity of 76.9%, specificity of 88.9%, overall accuracy of 81.8%, and an AUC of 0.855 (95% CI, 0.694-1.000). A nomogram was constructed to visualize the model. Conclusion This study presents a logistic regression-based model for predicting aneurysm wall irregular pulsation. The nomogram visually assesses individualized risks, demonstrating potential for future clinical implementation in bedside decision-making.

papers.title: CSF drainage strategy and complication management of hydrocephalus.
papers.authors: Xia C, Lin Z, Wei X, Xu H.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Conventional CSF drainage strategies-using external ventricular drainage (EVD) for acute hydrocephalus and permanent shunts (ventriculoperitoneal [VP], ventriculoatrial [VA], lumboperitoneal [LP]) for chronic hydrocephalus-are often inadequate in complex clinical scenarios (e.g., patients with intracranial hemorrhage, active infection, or unstable conditions who cannot undergo permanent shunt surgery). This creates an urgent need to comprehensively review drainage modalities to address the core challenge of reducing surgical frequency while effectively controlling intracranial pressure (ICP) and avoiding complications. Methods This review systematically examines seven major CSF drainage methods: EVD, lumbar drainage (LD), Ommaya reservoir EVD, long-tunneled EVD (LTEVD), VP shunt, VA shunt, and LP shunt. It details each method's indications, contraindications, advantages, disadvantages, and typical application duration based on clinical evidence and literature. Additionally, the review covers key aspects of external drainage management and targeted strategies for handling common complications. Expected outcomes This review aims to provide neurosurgeons with a practical, evidence-based reference for selecting optimal CSF drainage strategies. It also proposes a stepwise clinical protocol to guide decision-making-from initial intervention for acute hydrocephalus to transition to long-term or permanent drainage solutions-with the goal of balancing reduced surgery numbers, effective ICP control, and complication prevention to improve patient prognosis. Discussion A practically feasible protocol with preliminary clinical evidence is proposed: initiate EVD for acute hydrocephalus; for shunt-dependent patients, use LD for communicating hydrocephalus or Ommaya reservoir EVD for obstructive hydrocephalus; if permanent shunts remain unfeasible after re-evaluation, switch to LTEVD; and finally transition to appropriate permanent shunts when conditions permit. This protocol optimizes drainage strategies, addresses gaps in traditional approaches, and supports neurosurgeons in personalized treatment selection.

papers.title: Case Report: Fabry cardiomyopathy associated with a novel truncating GLA variant, c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter).
papers.authors: Perretta F, Zurita E, Ortiz M, Politei J.
papers.abstract: We report the comprehensive clinical characterization of a woman with Fabry disease (FD) carrying a previously unreported truncating GLA variant, c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter). The patient, a 52-year-old woman with longstanding hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, was referred to a specialized Fabry Disease Program to investigate FD as the underlying etiology of her cardiomyopathy. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated diffuse left ventricular hypertrophy with extensive late gadolinium enhancement, indicating advanced replacement fibrosis and an increased arrhythmic risk. Biochemical evaluation revealed reduced α -galactosidase A activity and markedly elevated Lyso-Gb3 levels. Comprehensive systemic assessment identified bilateral cornea verticillata and nonspecific periventricular white matter hyperintensities on brain magnetic resonance imaging, while renal function remained preserved without clinically significant renal involvement. Molecular analysis identified the heterozygous truncating GLA variant c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter), which had not previously been reported. The patient received an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator following cardiovascular risk assessment and subsequently initiated enzyme replacement therapy with agalsidase beta. This case expands the known mutational spectrum of the GLA gene and illustrates the value of integrating molecular genetic analysis with multimodality cardiac imaging and comprehensive phenotyping in patients with unexplained hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This integrated approach not only supports the interpretation of previously unreported GLA variants but may also refine etiologic diagnosis, cardiovascular risk assessment, and individualized clinical management in FD.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一篇病例报告，报告了一名长期患肥厚型心肌病的女性，经多模态评估被确认为法布雷病心肌病，并携带此前未报道的GLA截短变异。心脏磁共振显示弥漫性左心室肥厚伴广泛延迟钆增强，提示晚期纤维化替代和心律失常风险升高；生化检查见α-半乳糖苷酶A活性降低、Lyso-Gb3显著升高，同时发现角膜涡状混浊和脑白质高信号，肾功能尚保留。分子分析确认该杂合截短变异，患者经心血管风险评估后植入心律转复除颤器并启动酶替代治疗。作者认为，该病例扩展了GLA变异谱，也说明将分子遗传分析与心脏影像及系统表型评估结合，有助于解释未报道变异并支持法布雷病的病因诊断、风险分层和个体化管理。

papers.title: Cognitive Impairment and Its Clinical and Neuroimaging Correlates in Fabry Disease: A Single-Center Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study
papers.authors: Chen S, Zhang Y, Yuan Y, Huang J, Yao L, Sun Y, Zhang W, Zhao Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background To characterize the prevalence and profile of cognitive impairment in Fabry disease (FD) and examine its clinical, neuroimaging, and biomarker correlates. Methods In this single-center retrospective cross-sectional study, we included 57 patients with FD who underwent standardized cognitive assessment; primary analyses were restricted to 50 adults. Clinical characteristics, neuroimaging (ARWML and Fazekas scores), and biomarkers (α-Gal A activity and plasma Lyso-Gb3) were evaluated in relation to cognitive impairment using age-adjusted and multivariable analyses. Results Cognitive impairment was present in 19 of 50 adults (38.0%), predominantly involving delayed recall, visuospatial/executive function, attention, and language. Subjective memory decline was strongly associated with objective cognitive impairment (82.4% vs. 42.9%; OR = 6.22, 95% CI 1.45–26.64). Cognitively impaired adults were older (46.7 vs. 37.3 years, P = 0.005), had longer disease duration (32.8 vs. 22.9 years, P = 0.033), and had higher Mainz Severity Score Index (MSSI) scores (21.0 vs. 10.0, P = 0.008). Greater white matter lesion burden was associated with poorer cognitive performance after age adjustment (r = − 0.40 to − 0.74; all q < 0.05), whereas α-galactosidase A activity and Lyso-Gb3 levels were not (all q = 0.83). Higher MSSI scores remained independently associated with cognitive impairment (OR = 1.08 per point, 95% CI 1.01–1.16). Conclusions Cognitive impairment was common in adults with FD, predominantly involving memory and executive-attentional domains. Systemic disease severity and white matter lesion burden were associated with cognitive impairment and poorer cognitive performance, whereas the measured biomarkers were not. Subjective memory complaints may provide a practical indication for formal cognitive assessment.
papers.summary_zh: 该单中心回顾性横断面研究考察法布里病成人患者认知障碍的患病情况及其临床与神经影像相关因素。在完成标准化认知评估的成人中，约四成存在认知障碍，主要涉及延迟回忆、视空间与执行功能、注意和语言；主观记忆下降与客观认知障碍关联较强。认知受损者年龄更大、病程更长、疾病严重度评分更高，白质病变负担在年龄校正后与较差认知表现相关，而所测酶活性与Lyso-Gb3水平未见关联；疾病严重度仍与认知障碍独立相关。作者据此提示，主观记忆主诉或可作为提示进行正式认知评估的实用线索，但横断面设计无法确立因果。

papers.title: Voided REM Sleep (V-REM)
papers.authors: Ndiaye MO.
papers.abstract: Roughly 40% of patients with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and roughly 31% of patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) fail to respond to first-line treatment, and the two disorders co-occur in approximately half of all cases. No objective, nocturnal biomarker currently distinguishes which patients will fail to recover, or why. This paper proposes that a subgroup of treatment-resistant patients, across both PTSD and MDD, shows rapid eye movement (REM) sleep that is architecturally normal on a standard sleep study (polysomnography) while exhibiting abnormal functional connectivity between the default mode network, particularly its ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC) node, and the amygdala, the circuit responsible for overnight emotional memory regulation. Standard REM markers (rapid eye movements, muscle atonia, and characteristic brainwave patterns) are generated autonomously by the brainstem and can appear entirely normal even when this regulatory function has failed. Because both disorders converge on the same vmPFC-amygdala circuit through independent lines of evidence, this failure, termed Voided REM Sleep (V-REM), is proposed as a shared, trans-diagnostic biomarker of treatment resistance rather than a disorder-specific one. The hypothesis is falsifiable: if the same connectivity anomaly appeared just as often in trauma-exposed or dysphoric individuals who never developed a treatment-resistant disorder, V-REM would be refuted. An overnight EEG-fMRI protocol is proposed to test it, with vmPFC-amygdala connectivity measured via the BOLD signal during polysomnographically confirmed REM epochs.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一个可检验的假说，而非报告已完成的实验：在创伤后应激障碍与重性抑郁障碍中，存在一部分对一线治疗无反应的患者，其标准睡眠检查中的快速眼动睡眠结构看似正常，但默认网络腹内侧前额叶节点与杏仁核之间的功能连接异常，导致夜间情绪记忆调节失效。作者将这一状态命名为“空转式快速眼动睡眠”，并认为它可能成为跨诊断的治疗抵抗生物标志物，而非某一疾病特有。文章还提出用整夜脑电—功能磁共振同步记录在快速眼动睡眠期测量该连接，并说明若同样的连接异常在未发展为治疗抵抗的个体中同样常见，该假说即被否定。

papers.title: A Critical Reading Model Based on the Brain's Natural Learning Systems and Metacognition: A Quasi-Experimental Study with Indonesian Fifth-Graders
papers.authors: Prasetyo T, Yufiarti Y, Supena A.
papers.abstract: Background: Critical reading — the capacity to interpret, evaluate, and reflect on texts — is an essential competency for lifelong learning, yet many education systems, including Indonesia, continue to report weak performance in the elementary years on international assessments such as PISA and PIRLS. Although Given’s Brain’s Natural Learning Systems (BNLS) theory has informed several instructional models, existing implementations position reflection as only one component of learning and do not integrate metacognitive regulation across all instructional phases or assess it as a distinct learning outcome. Methods This study developed and tested the Brain-Based Analytical-Metacognitive (BBAM) Model, which operationalizes BNLS together with metacognitive regulation through five sequential phases: Activation, Exploration, Analysis, Reflection, and Evaluation. Using a quasi-experimental pretest-posttest control group design, 54 fifth-grade students (experimental n = 29; control n = 25) in Bogor, Indonesia, were assessed using a researcher-developed 30-point instrument, with preliminary validity evidence, covering structural understanding, inference-making, evaluative thinking, author’s purpose identification, and reflective response. Results The experimental group demonstrated significantly greater improvement in critical reading than the control group (p < .001), with a large effect size (Cohen’s d = 1.45). The study contributes an instructional model, supported by preliminary evidence, that repositions metacognitive regulation from a reflective component to a cross-phase learning mechanism, while operationalizing BNLS into classroom practice, together with a five-dimensional framework for assessing critical reading at the elementary level.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对印尼小学高年级批判性阅读表现偏弱的问题，开发并检验了一个将脑自然学习系统理论与元认知调节相结合的BBAM教学模型，采用准实验前后测对照设计，在五年级学生中比较实验组与对照组的批判性阅读变化。结果显示，实验组的提升显著大于对照组，效应量较大，提示把元认知调节贯穿于激活、探索、分析、反思和评价各阶段，可能比仅将其作为反思环节更有利于批判性阅读发展。作者据此提出一个五维度的批判性阅读评估框架，但强调这仅是初步证据，样本和工具均有限，尚不能据此推断课堂推广效果。

papers.title: Subregion-specific temporal lobe EEG signatures in amnestic mild cognitive impairment: Evidence from high-density EEG.
papers.authors: Wen S, Liu J, Wang J, Mao L, Zhang Q, Wang X, Ding J.
papers.abstract: BackgroundAmnestic mild cognitive impairment (aMCI), a prodromal stage associated with an increased risk of Alzheimer's disease (AD), is characterized by early neural network dysfunction. The temporal lobe is among the earliest affected regions, yet conventional electroencephalography (EEG) provides limited information regarding subregional electrophysiological alterations.ObjectiveTo characterize temporal-subregional electrophysiological features in aMCI using high-density EEG (HD-EEG).MethodsFifty-five individuals with aMCI and 35 cognitively normal controls underwent neuropsychological assessment and resting-state 128-channel HD-EEG recording. Spectral power was quantified across the whole temporal lobe and its anterior, middle, and posterior subregions. Group differences were assessed using Welch's t-tests and Mann-Whitney U tests. Associations between EEG measures and cognitive performance were examined using Spearman correlation analyses. Exploratory receiver operating characteristic (ROC) and multivariable classification analyses were performed to evaluate discriminatory performance.ResultsCompared with controls, individuals with aMCI showed significantly poorer cognitive performance. HD-EEG analyses revealed increased gamma-band activity across bilateral temporal subregions, whereas elevated delta power and theta/beta ratios were primarily localized to right temporal subregions. Right temporal delta activity was negatively associated with memory performance. Connectivity analyses demonstrated enhanced fast-frequency coupling involving temporal regions, with particularly evident alterations in the left posterior temporal subregion. Classification analyses showed that gamma-band measures derived from left temporal subregions achieved discriminatory performance comparable to conventional whole-temporal measures.ConclusionsHD-EEG identified subregion-specific temporal-lobe electrophysiological alterations in aMCI. Temporal-subregional EEG profiling may provide additional electrophysiological information beyond conventional whole-lobe analyses and improve the characterization of aMCI-related neural alterations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注遗忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）患者颞叶各亚区的电生理特征，采用高密度静息态脑电结合神经心理评估，比较aMCI组与认知正常对照组的频谱功率及连接差异。结果显示，aMCI患者双侧颞叶各亚区γ活动普遍升高，而δ功率和θ/β比值的升高主要局限于右侧颞叶亚区，且右侧颞叶δ活动与记忆表现呈负相关；颞叶相关快速频率耦合增强，以左后颞亚区尤为明显。基于左颞亚区γ指标的分类表现与常规全颞叶指标相当。作者据此认为，颞叶亚区水平的脑电刻画可提供超出全颞叶分析的电生理信息，有助于更细致地描述aMCI相关神经改变；这些发现属组间关联与探索性分类结果，尚不能直接推及临床诊断或治疗。

papers.title: Synergistic effects of cerebrovascular reactivity and gray matter volume on executive function in aging.
papers.authors: Zhang J, Jia X, Zhang Y, Wang Q, Liu P, Jia X, Yang Q.
papers.abstract: BackgroundAge-related impairments in cerebrovascular reactivity (CVR) and gray matter volume (GMV) both contribute to cognitive decline, yet their regional interplay and joint impact on cognition remain unclear.ObjectiveTo investigate how CVR and GMV are coupled and interact regionally to influence cognition in normal aging.MethodsWe examined 181 healthy younger adults (18-34 years) and 120 older adults (60-89 years). CVR and GMV (% intracranial volume) in major brain lobes were quantified using resting-state multi-echo functional MRI and structural MRI, respectively. Age-related alterations were defined by standardizing older adults' values relative to the younger group. Spearman correlations, linear regression models, and interaction analyses were performed.ResultsCVR and GMV were not significantly correlated across frontal, temporal, parietal, or occipital lobes (ρ: -0.15 to -0.06; all p > 0.05). However, significant CVR × GMV interaction effects on executive function were found in parietal and occipital lobes (p -interaction=0.015 and 0.026). In the occipital lobe, compared with the "low CVR decline + low GMV loss" group, "high CVR decline + low GMV loss" (β=-0.47, p = 0.004) and "high CVR decline + high GMV loss" (β=-0.60, p < 0.001), but not "low CVR decline + high GMV loss" (β=-0.23, p = 0.127), were significantly associated with poorer executive function.ConclusionsCVR and GMV interacted to support executive function in parietal and occipital lobes. Occipital CVR decline linked to poorer executive performance irrespective of GMV status. These findings highlight the importance of multi-modal, cross-scale assessments and suggest CVR as a sensitive marker of executive decline beyond structural measures alone.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察正常衰老过程中脑血管反应性与灰质体积在脑区层面如何耦合并共同影响认知，比较了健康年轻人和老年人，用静息态多回波功能磁共振与结构磁共振分别量化各脑叶的脑血管反应性和灰质体积。结果显示，两者在额、颞、顶、枕叶均无显著相关，但在顶叶和枕叶存在对执行功能的显著交互作用；在枕叶，脑血管反应性下降明显者执行功能较差，且这一关联不随灰质体积丢失程度而改变。作者据此认为，脑血管反应性可作为超出结构指标的执行功能衰退敏感标记，并强调多模态、跨尺度评估的意义。

papers.title: Associations between systemic inflammation, neighborhood tree canopy, and white matter hyperintensities: The healthy brain initiative.
papers.authors: Toledo LG, Tourelle M, Galvin JE, Besser LM.
papers.abstract: BackgroundSystemic inflammation is associated with greater white matter hyperintensities (WMH), increasing risk of Alzheimer's disease. Neighborhood greenspaces (e.g., parks) have been associated with reduced inflammation and dementia risk and fewer WMH.ObjectiveTo examine whether systemic inflammation and neighborhood % tree canopy are independently associated with and interact to influence WMH.MethodsWe used cross-sectional data on 161 participants with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in University of Miami's Healthy Brain Initiative who were ≥ 50-years old with no to mild cognitive impairment. U.S. Forest Service tree canopy data (2021) were used to derive tree canopy percentage per Census tract. High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP), a marker of systemic inflammation, was categorized as low/moderate (0-3 mg/L) and high (>3 mg/L). Total WMH volume was derived from structural MRI. Multivariable linear regression examined independent associations of hs-CRP and WMH and % tree canopy and WMH, and the association between a four-category hs-CRP-tree canopy variable (based on median cut points) and WMH.ResultsParticipants were 68.7 ± 9.3 years old and 70% were female. Higher hs-CRP was associated with greater WMH, and greater neighborhood % tree canopy was associated with fewer WMH. Compared to those with higher hs-CRP and lower % tree canopy, those with higher hs-CRP and greater % tree canopy had fewer WMH.ConclusionsHigher systemic inflammation and greater neighborhood % tree canopy were independently associated with WMH, and our findings suggest that they interact to influence WMH (e.g., in those with higher inflammation, having greater neighborhood tree canopy associated with lower WMH).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于迈阿密大学健康大脑计划的横断面数据，考察系统性炎症与社区树冠覆盖率是否分别及共同影响白质高信号。结果发现，炎症标志物hs-CRP较高与白质高信号体积较大相关，而社区树冠覆盖率较高则与白质高信号较少相关；两者存在交互，在炎症较高者中，树冠覆盖率较高仍对应较少的白质高信号。作者据此提示，社区绿化和炎症水平可能共同参与白质病变过程，但横断面设计无法确立因果方向。

papers.title: Sub-second and multi-second dopamine dynamics underlie variability in human time perception.
papers.authors: Sadibolova R, DiMarco EK, Jiang A, Maas B, Tatter SB, Laxton AW, Kishida KT, Terhune DB.
papers.abstract: Aberrant interval timing in the millisecond-to-second range is a consistent feature of neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders involving striatal dysfunction, yet its neurochemical substrates in the human brain remain poorly characterised. Striatal dopamine has long been implicated in temporal processing, but evidence from animal models and human pharmacological studies has proved difficult to reconcile, in part because endogenous dopamine dynamics in humans have been inaccessible at relevant timescales. Patients with Parkinson's disease (N=5, 62-73 years; two women) completed a temporal bisection task (300 trials), judging whether visual stimulus intervals (500-1100 ms) were closer to a learned short (500 ms) or long (1100 ms) reference. Dopamine and serotonin concentrations were measured in the caudate nucleus during awake deep brain stimulation surgery using fast-scan cyclic voltammetry. Elastic net machine-learning models trained on in vitro voltammetry data were applied to human recordings to derive dopamine and serotonin time series at 10 Hz. We used cluster-based permutation analysis to identify stimulus-aligned time windows in which dopamine or serotonin differed between short and long judgements, and entered mean concentrations from these windows as predictors of temporal performance in trial-level hierarchical mixed-effects models. Slower, steady-state dopaminergic and serotonergic tone, quantified as the mean concentration within successive multi-minute periods, was also assessed as a predictor of temporal behaviour. Finally, behavioural performance was compared with a healthy control cohort (N=17, 50-66 years; seven women). Elevated phasic dopamine (625-670 ms after stimulus onset) increased the likelihood of short judgements and was associated with reduced temporal overestimation bias. This association was independent of objective clock time, with the identical analysis yielding non-significant results for the short versus the long stimulus intervals. By contrast, tonic dopamine levels covaried with sensitivity in discriminating stimulus intervals (temporal precision). Lower tonic dopamine was associated with poorer temporal precision both within patients over the experimental session and in patients relative to healthy controls. No corresponding effects were observed for serotonin, indicating dopamine specificity across phasic and tonic timescales. By resolving endogenous striatal dopamine with sub-second precision during conscious human behaviour, this study links temporally distinct dopaminergic dynamics to dissociable aspects of timing behaviour in Parkinson's disease. This challenges accounts of dopamine as a single modulatory influence and situates these findings within the literature on dissociable effects of phasic and tonic dopaminergic signalling, reconciling discrepancies between human and animal evidence and advancing understanding of the neurochemical basis of human time perception.

papers.title: Unlocking the complex interplay between epigenetics and epitranscriptomics in neuropsychiatric disorders.
papers.authors: Dwivedi Y, Roy B.
papers.abstract: Epigenetic and epitranscriptomic mechanisms work together to control gene expression, which is essential for brain development, synaptic plasticity, and the risk of neuropsychiatric disorders. Traditional epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation and histone modifications, alter chromatin structure to regulate gene accessibility. On the other hand, epitranscriptomic marks such as N6-methyladenosine (m6A) affect RNA metabolism after transcription. Studies in both neural and non-neural systems show that these layers of regulation interact in both directions and together shape gene expression. This review looks at how m6A-modified non-coding RNAs, including chromosome-associated regulatory RNAs (carRNAs), enhancer RNAs (eRNAs), microRNAs, and circular RNAs, work with chromatin to influence genome function, including chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, and the overall structure of the genome. It also covers recent discoveries about how eRNAs form R-loops, how m6A affects RNA stability, and how these processes are involved in neuronal signaling and plasticity. Many of these findings come from studies outside the nervous system and need more research in neuropsychiatric disease models. By bringing together established knowledge and new ideas, this review suggests that the interaction between epigenetic and epitranscriptomic mechanisms is a key factor in determining risk and resilience for neuropsychiatric disorders, and offers new directions for future research and therapy development.

papers.title: Next-generation brain organoids: neural complexity from cellular diversity to functional networks.
papers.authors: Duan CH, Wang YK, Tang TS, Jiao JW, Tang Y, Teng ZQ, Hu BY, Liu CM.
papers.abstract: Brain organoids, as pioneering three-dimensional (3D) in vitro platforms, have profoundly advanced our understanding of human brain development and disease mechanisms. This review summarizes recent progress in enhancing cellular diversity, structural organization, and functional complexity within brain organoids. A key application of these models lies in disease modelling, encompassing neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders as well as brain tumours, which enables personalized drug screening and mechanistic studies. Despite persistent challenges related to neuronal maturation, vascularization, reproducibility, and functional integration, we highlight emerging bioengineering strategies, multi-organ integration approaches, and ethical considerations that provide a roadmap for next-generation organoid platforms. Collectively, brain organoids hold transformative potential for both fundamental neuroscience and translational research, bridging critical gaps between conventional experimental models and human-specific pathophysiology.

papers.title: Exploring participation after traumatic brain injury: a qualitative meta-synthesis guided by the social ecological model.
papers.authors: Carrington H, Go HC, Pereira H, Agner JL, Cogan AM.
papers.abstract: Purpose Research on participation after traumatic brain injury (TBI) has focused predominantly on frequency-based, individual-level outcomes, overlooking how systemic and interpersonal contexts shape participation. While qualitative research has explored these influences, the literature remains fragmented. The purpose of this study was to synthesize qualitative literature on participation experiences of individuals with TBI, focusing on systemic, interpersonal, and individual influences. Materials and methods We conducted a meta-synthesis following ENTREQ guidelines, searching five databases from inception to July 2026. We included qualitative studies examining participation among adults with TBI. We synthesized results using Thomas and Harden's thematic synthesis, guided by the social ecological model. Results Of 3140 studies, 28 met inclusion criteria. Three themes emerged: (1) environmental challenges and adaptation described how systemic barriers placed adaptive burden on individuals, mediated by interpersonal support; (2) stigma and support in social participation examined how societal stigma shaped relationships, exacerbating symptoms and withdrawal; and (3) cultural narratives and identity highlighted how dominant narratives influence self-perception and participation satisfaction. Conclusions Participation after TBI is shaped by the interplay of systemic, interpersonal, and individual factors. Future research should address systemic and interpersonal influences, fostering environments, relationships, and narratives that promote meaningful participation and inform multi-level interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对创伤性脑损伤后参与研究多聚焦个体层面频率指标、忽视系统与人际情境的问题，对相关定性文献进行了主题综合，纳入探讨成人创伤性脑损伤患者参与体验的定性研究，并以社会生态模型为框架。综合提炼出三个主题：系统性障碍将适应负担转嫁给个体，而人际支持起中介作用；社会污名塑造人际关系，加剧症状并导致退缩；主流文化叙事影响自我认知与参与满意度。作者据此指出，脑损伤后的参与由系统、人际和个体因素共同塑造，未来研究应更多关注系统与人际层面的影响，营造有利于有意义参与的环境、关系与叙事，并为多层次干预提供依据。

papers.title: Longitudinal adaptations in neural and behavioral systems following hearing restoration using cochlear implants.
papers.authors: Mo S, Alain C, Dimitrijevic A.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Cochlear implants (CIs) restore hearing in people with severe-to-profound hearing loss, but how behavioral and neural adaptations unfold after implantation remains unclear, particularly during continuous speech processing. Most longitudinal studies of postimplant plasticity have used simple auditory stimuli, limiting insight into continuous-speech processing in complex environments. We followed 19 newly implanted adult CI users at activation and at 3, 6, and 12 mo after activation. At each session, participants completed speech recognition testing in quiet and noise, a spatial triple-digit test, hearing-related quality-of-life measures, and electroencephalography during an ecologically valid continuous-speech selective-attention task with competing distractors. Neural analyses focused on temporal response functions to task-relevant and task-irrelevant speech envelopes and changes in scalp field topography. Speech recognition improved over time, and spatial-separation benefits emerged by 6 mo. Neural tracking of task-relevant speech was stronger and emerged earlier than tracking of task-irrelevant speech, and scalp topographies changed significantly across sessions. Stronger task-relevant neural tracking was associated with better speech recognition, better spatial listening, and higher quality of life. The largest behavioral and neural gains occurred early after activation and plateaued by approximately 6 mo. These findings provide a functionally relevant account of postimplant adaptation and establish longitudinal continuous-speech neural tracking as a useful framework for studying rehabilitation after sensory restoration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究追踪新植入人工耳蜗的成人用户，在开机时及随后数月用连续语音选择性注意任务结合脑电，考察行为与神经适应如何随时间展开。结果显示，言语识别随使用时间改善，空间分离带来的聆听获益在约6个月时出现；对任务相关语音的神经追踪强于且早于对干扰语音的追踪，头皮地形也随 sessions 变化。任务相关神经追踪越强，言语识别、空间聆听和生活质量越好，且行为与神经获益多在开机后早期最大、约6个月后趋于平台。作者据此认为，连续语音神经追踪可作为研究感觉恢复后康复过程的框架。

papers.title: Identifying a structural brain network for social anxiety: connectome-based predictive modeling and network analyses in a transdiagnostic sample.
papers.authors: Meinert H, Gruber M, Brügge EDE, Brüwer L, Sindermann L, Winter A, Slump TM, Breuer F, Schrammen E, Meinert S, Goltermann J, Grotegerd D, Repple J, Redlich R, Bonnekoh LM, Bauer J, Dannlowski U, Böhnlein J, Leehr EJ.
papers.abstract: Trait social anxiety (SA) is continuous and can manifest across the entire spectrum of mental health, from subclinical levels in healthy controls to burdensome manifestations in major depressive disorder and finally full-blown disorders like social anxiety disorder (SAD). Although it has been proposed that SA is associated with deviations in the structural connectome, there is little research on the SA spectrum and its relation to abnormalities in brain structural networks. In this study, we aim to identify a structural brain network for SA across diagnostic groups using a transdiagnostic sample and connectome-based predictive modeling (CPM) to provide insight on neurostructural underpinnings of the SA spectrum. We collected magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and clinical data of N = 160 participants across an SA spectrum. Diffusion-weighted and T1-weighted structural images were used to reconstruct each participant's structural connectome. We applied CPM to identify a structural brain network that predicts SA across diagnostic groups. We further analyzed the structural connectome to investigate hubs and differences in global graph metrics between participants with and without SAD (noSAD n = 96, SAD n = 64). CPM revealed a brain network with 46 edges predicting SA across the SA spectrum with mean r = 0.141 (CI = [0.12, 0.2], p = 0.003). Hubs were located in the left pericalcarine, inferior-parietal, superior-parietal, right lateral-occipital cortex and pars orbitalis. This study provides first evidence for a shared neurobiological foundation of SA across diagnostic groups and points towards a transdiagnostic relevance of SA and the related brain network.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注特质社交焦虑是否具有跨诊断共享的结构脑网络基础，采用跨诊断样本，结合弥散加权与T1加权影像重建结构连接组，并用基于连接组的预测建模（CPM）识别可预测社交焦虑的网络。结果显示，一个包含46条边的结构网络能够跨诊断组预测社交焦虑，预测相关虽显著但强度较弱，提示该网络与社交焦虑谱系存在关联而非因果或临床效用证据。网络枢纽主要位于左侧距状沟周围、顶下、顶上皮层及右侧外侧枕叶和眶部。作者据此提出，社交焦虑在不同诊断群体间可能共享神经结构基础，并强调其跨诊断相关性。

papers.title: Decoupling of local activity and interhemispheric connectivity in late mild cognitive impairment: A resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging study.
papers.authors: Jin Z, Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative.
papers.abstract: Objective Mild cognitive impairment (MCI), a high-risk precursor to Alzheimer's disease, progresses through early (EMCI) and late (LMCI) stages. While distinct functional brain alterations between EMCI and LMCI have been reported, differences in regional brain activity and interhemispheric functional connectivity during resting-state remain incompletely characterized. The aim of the study was to systematically assess the differences in resting-state brain functional alterations between the LMCI patients and EMCI patients. Method We assessed resting-state functional alterations in EMCI and LMCI using fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) and voxel-mirrored homotopic connectivity (VMHC). Data from 35 EMCI patients, 28 LMCI patients, and 37 individuals with normal cognition were analyzed from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative-Phase 2. Results Compared to EMCI patients, LMCI patients exhibited increased fALFF in the left inferior temporal gyrus and left precentral gyrus, alongside decreased VMHC in the anterior cerebellar lobe and posterior cingulate cortex. Among MCI patients, Montreal Cognitive Assessment scores showed a significant negative correlation with fALFF in the left inferior temporal gyrus/left precentral gyrus but a significant positive correlation with VMHC in the anterior cerebellar lobe/posterior cingulate cortex. Conclusions These findings suggest that elevated regional activity (fALFF) may represent a compensatory mechanism, while reduced interhemispheric connectivity (VMHC) reflects a neuropathological basis underlying progression from EMCI to LMCI. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注轻度认知障碍早期与晚期阶段在静息状态下局部脑活动与半球间功能连接的差异，基于静息态功能磁共振数据比较了早期患者、晚期患者与认知正常者的fALFF和VMHC。结果发现，相比早期患者，晚期患者左侧颞下回和左侧中央前回的局部活动增强，而小脑前叶和后扣带皮层的半球间连接减弱；在轻度认知障碍患者中，认知评分与前者呈负相关、与后者呈正相关。作者据此提出，局部活动升高可能反映补偿机制，而半球间连接下降则可能构成从早期向晚期进展的神经病理基础，但相关分析本身不足以确立因果。

papers.title: Multimodal predictors of response to intravenous ketamine in treatment-resistant depression: toward personalized treatment in major depressive and bipolar disorders.
papers.authors: Malewska-Kasprzak M, Rybakowski F, Dmitrzak-Weglarz M.
papers.abstract: Intravenous ketamine is a rapid-acting intervention for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) in adults with major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder (BD). While efficacy is established, a comprehensive integration of clinical, neurophysiological, biomarker, metabolic, and cognitive predictors remains lacking, limiting precision CNS-targeted therapy. To synthesize recent evidence on multimodal predictors of intravenous ketamine response in TRD and propose a preliminary clinical framework to guide personalized treatment. Following PRISMA guidelines, Scopus, PubMed, EMBASE, and MEDLINE were searched for English-language, peer-reviewed studies published within the last 5 years. Eligible studies included adults receiving intravenous ketamine for depressive disorders. Data were descriptively synthesized to identify consistent predictors, evidence clusters, and research gaps. The review included 150 studies. Key predictors of ketamine response included baseline depressive severity, comorbid anxiety, atypical depression and sleep phenotypes, inflammatory and neuroplastic biomarkers (eg, monocyte count, BDNF), metabolic factors (BMI, vitamin B12), genetic/epigenetic variants, neurophysiological signatures (EEG, TMS, fMRI connectivity), cognitive performance, and early symptomatic improvement. Integrative analysis suggests that glutamatergic, circadian, and inflammatory mechanisms interact to shape interindividual variability. Limitations include methodological heterogeneity and scarce long-term outcome data. Intravenous ketamine response in TRD is multifactorial, reflecting clinical phenotype, CNS biomarkers, neurophysiology, metabolism, and genetics. This review proposes a preliminary research framework and pilot clinical questionnaire intended to facilitate future investigation of individualized treatment approaches. However, most proposed predictors remain exploratory and require prospective validation before clinical implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦难治性抑郁（含重性抑郁与双相障碍）患者对静脉氯胺酮反应的多模态预测因素，按PRISMA规范检索近五年文献并做描述性整合。作者归纳出与反应相关的因素涉及基线抑郁严重度、共病焦虑、非典型抑郁与睡眠表型、炎症和神经可塑性生物标志物、代谢指标、遗传与表观遗传变异、脑电与影像等神经生理特征、认知表现及早期症状改善，并认为谷氨酸能、昼夜节律与炎症机制可能交互影响个体差异。作者据此提出初步研究框架和试用临床问卷，但强调多数预测因素仍属探索性，需前瞻性验证后方可用于临床。

papers.title: Resting-State Functional Connectivity After Acquired Brain Injury: Patterns of Network Disruption, Reorganization, and Recovery - A Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Gannison L, Firdaus MH, Narayanan V.
papers.abstract: Background Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) provides a non-invasive method for assessing intrinsic connectivity changes associated with neurological recovery. This systematic review evaluated patterns of functional connectivity change after acquired brain injury (ABI), with a focus on network disruption, reorganization, and recovery-related change. Methods A systematic review was conducted according to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 recommendations using a Population-Intervention-Outcome framework. PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar were searched for studies published between January 2010 and March 2026 examining rs-fMRI connectivity following ABI. Screening was performed independently by 2 reviewers, and eligible studies were appraised using Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tools. Narrative synthesis was undertaken to evaluate connectivity disruption, compensatory reorganization, and recovery-related network changes. Results Twenty studies were included, predominantly involving stroke and traumatic brain injury populations. rs-fMRI identified alterations in functional connectivity, spontaneous activity, hub organization, and network efficiency associated with motor, cognitive, behavioral, language, and consciousness outcomes. Only 1 study included directly evaluated functional connectivity following cranioplasty, providing limited evidence of recovery-related changes in default mode and whole-brain network organization. Conclusions Resting-state fMRI demonstrates heterogeneous patterns of network disruption, reorganization, and recovery-related connectivity change following ABI. These findings support the use of rs-fMRI as a research tool for characterizing network-level recovery, while further prospective longitudinal studies using standardized imaging and outcome measures are needed to establish its clinical utility.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA 2020框架系统检索并叙述性整合了获得性脑损伤后静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）连接研究，纳入的研究以卒中和创伤性脑损伤人群为主。结果显示，rs-fMRI可捕捉到功能连接、自发活动、枢纽组织和网络效率的改变，这些改变与运动、认知、行为、语言及意识结局相关，但网络破坏、重组与恢复相关变化呈现异质性。仅有一项研究直接评估颅骨修补术后的功能连接，恢复相关证据有限。作者认为rs-fMRI可作为刻画网络层面恢复的研究工具，其临床效用仍需标准化影像与结局指标的前瞻性纵向研究确立。

papers.title: Distinct patterns of putative glymphatic function between early-onset and adult-onset first-episode schizophrenia: Evidence from DTI-ALPS.
papers.authors: Long X, Zhang M, Cheng P, Wang F, Wang Y, Liu X, Huang W, Chen G, Liu Z, Yang J, Palaniyappan L.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia exhibits high heterogeneity, with early-onset (EOS) and adult-onset (AOS) potentially involving distinct pathophysiological mechanisms. We investigated the patterns of putative glymphatic function in first-episode schizophrenia across different onset types to explore this heterogeneity, with a focus on differences in glymphatic-related perivascular diffusion characteristics. Methods This study enrolled 195 first-episode schizophrenia patients (EOS, n = 103; AOS, n = 92) and 191 matched healthy controls (younger controls [yHC], n = 62; older controls [oHC], n = 129). Diffusion tensor imaging indices along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) were computed as indirect markers of putative glymphatic-related fluid dynamics. We first explored the interaction effects of disease and onset-age on bilateral and mean ALPS. Further analyses included multiple linear regression models adjusting for confounding factors of illness duration and antipsychotic dosage, and partial correlation analyses with symptom subdimensions and cognitive function. Results Significant disease and onset-age interaction effects were observed in the right and mean ALPS indices. Simple effect analysis revealed that the interactions were primarily driven by the significant differences between AOS and both oHC and EOS. Specifically, AOS patients exhibited significantly lower right and mean ALPS indices compared to both oHC and EOS groups. Notably, lower right ALPS in AOS patients were associated with greater hallucination severity, whereas no significant associations between DTI-ALPS indices and cognitive measures survived multiple comparison correction. Conclusion Differences in DTI-ALPS indices in first-episode schizophrenia varied by onset-age, with more pronounced alterations occurring in AOS patients, particularly within the right hemisphere, partly explaining the onset-age heterogeneity of schizophrenia.
keywords: Diffusion Tensor Imaging Along The Perivascular Space
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早发型与成年起病型首发精神分裂症在假想类淋巴功能上的差异，用弥散张量成像沿血管周围间隙的指标（DTI-ALPS）作为间接标记，比较两组患者与相应健康对照。结果显示，疾病与起病年龄在右侧及平均ALPS指标上存在交互作用，主要源于成年起病型患者右侧和平均ALPS指标低于其健康对照及早发型患者；早发型患者则未见同样明显的改变。在成年起病型患者中，右侧ALPS较低与幻觉症状更重相关，而ALPS指标与认知测量之间未发现经多重比较校正后仍显著的联系。作者认为，首发精神分裂症的类淋巴相关指标改变随起病年龄而异，成年起病型尤其是右半球改变更明显，这在一定程度上解释了起病年龄相关的异质性；上述关联属横断面观察，不能推断因果。

papers.title: Reduced medial periventricular diffusion markers are associated with depressive symptoms and social deficits in ASD.
papers.authors: McKenna F, Hemmerling KJ, Molholm S, Zhu DC.
papers.abstract: The glymphatic system is a candidate mechanism in autism spectrum disorder (ASD), linked to altered cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) dynamics, perivascular space (PVS) enlargement, and neuroinflammation, yet its relation to brain structure and clinical outcomes remains unexamined. We analyzed multimodal MRI (T2 FLAIR, T1, diffusion) in 58 adult males (29 ASD, 29 TD) from ABIDE-II, quantifying regional DTI-ALPS indices, free water metrics, white matter hyperintensities, and PVS and CSF volumes. ASD showed a more pronounced anterior peak in the DTI-ALPS anterior-to-posterior profile (group × position: β = 0.0020, p < .001), though this attenuated under random slopes (p = .160); scalar indices showed no group differences. Within ASD, medial DTI-ALPS was the sole marker associating with both depression (r = -0.51) and social communication (r = -0.56), while tissue radial diffusivity was the strongest correlate of depressive symptoms (p < .001). Left basal ganglia PVS correlated negatively with medial DTI-ALPS (partial r = -0.58, p = .005), and mediation showed PVS related to social functioning only indirectly, via medial DTI-ALPS. Regional associations persisted after free-water correction, consistent with a tissue-microstructural basis. These ASD-specific findings suggest dissociable microstructural and neurofluid mechanisms in mood and social dysfunction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在成年男性样本中比较了自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）与典型发育者的多模态MRI指标，考察类淋巴系统相关扩散标记与脑结构及临床症状的关系。结果显示，ASD组在DTI-ALPS前后向分布上呈现更明显的前部峰值，但该差异在随机斜率模型下减弱，整体标量指标未见组间差异。在ASD组内，内侧DTI-ALPS是唯一同时与抑郁症状和社交沟通困难相关的标记，且基底节血管周围间隙与社交功能的关系似乎经由该标记间接体现。作者据此提出，ASD中情绪与社交功能障碍可能涉及可分离的微结构和神经流体机制，但相关发现属关联性证据，尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Resting-state functional connectivity in adolescents with binge eating disorder: An exploratory null study.
papers.authors: Arslan B, Ercan O, Arslan S, Tarakçıoğlu MC, Koyuncu Z, Öz A, Sarıahmetoğlu ÖF, Güneş Kaya D, Kırlangıç B, Seçen Yazıcı M, Serdengeçti N, Gemici E, Kadak MT.
papers.abstract: Objective Binge eating disorder (BED) commonly emerges during adolescence, yet little is known about intrinsic brain network function in this developmental period. This study examined resting-state functional connectivity (FC) in adolescents with BED. Method 19 adolescents with BED and 20 sex-, age-, and BMI Z-score-matched controls (12-18 years) underwent resting-state fMRI. FC was examined using an exploratory ROI-to-ROI analysis, and eating disorder symptoms were assessed using the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). Results No between-group differences in ROI-to-ROI functional connectivity survived false discovery rate correction for multiple comparisons. Discussion No robust alterations in resting-state FC were identified in adolescents with BED compared with healthy controls. However, given the modest sample size and limited temporal sampling, subtle connectivity differences cannot be excluded.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究考察青少年暴食障碍患者静息态功能连接是否存在改变，比较了暴食障碍青少年与在性别、年龄和BMI Z分数上匹配的对照组，并采集静息态fMRI及进食障碍症状问卷。经多重比较校正后，未发现两组在感兴趣区之间的功能连接上存在差异。作者据此认为，未识别出稳健的静息态功能连接改变，但受样本量较小和时间采样有限的制约，不能排除细微连接差异的可能。

papers.title: Superposition of distinct psychotic and affective axes explains affective psychosis: evidence from cross-diagnostic connectomics.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Wang F, Zhong M, Zhang M, Yang J, Liu Z, Yang J, Palaniyappan L.
papers.abstract: Background Whether affective and non-affective psychoses reflect a severity continuum or distinct neurobiological mechanisms remains unresolved. We compared whole-brain and subnetwork efficiency across this spectrum. Methods Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data were analyzed from 78 patients with affective psychosis, 197 with non-affective psychosis, 164 with non-psychotic primary affective disorders, and 165 healthy controls. Graph analysis quantified whole-brain and subnetwork global and local efficiency. We tested symptom and cognitive associations and performed sensitivity analyses stratifying schizophrenia by depressive-symptom status and affective psychosis by diagnosis. Results Non-affective psychosis showed lower whole-brain efficiency than controls and both affective groups, and lower sensory/somatomotor efficiency than controls. Conversely, whole-brain efficiency was preserved in both affective groups; affective psychosis showed higher cingulo-opercular, dorsal attention, and salience network efficiency, whereas the non-psychotic affective group showed higher dorsal attention and salience network efficiency. Sensitivity analyses identified shared increases in dorsal attention global efficiency and salience network local efficiency across psychotic major depression and psychotic bipolar disorder, and reduced sensory/somatomotor efficiency in schizophrenia regardless of depressive-symptom status. After false discovery rate correction, higher default mode network efficiency was associated with Positive Symptoms, while higher whole-brain, cingulo-opercular, salience, and sensory/somatomotor efficiency was associated with Activation symptoms; no cognitive associations survived correction. Conclusion These opposing, subgroup-robust patterns favor a dichotomous-mechanism framework comprising an affective axis of increased control-network efficiency and a psychosis axis of whole-brain and sensorimotor inefficiency. Affective psychosis predominantly expresses the affective axis with a partial shift toward the psychosis axis profile.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究想厘清情感性精神病与非情感性精神病究竟属于同一严重度连续谱，还是对应不同的神经机制，为此比较了不同诊断组静息态脑功能网络的整体与子网络效率。结果显示，非情感性精神病患者整体网络效率低于健康对照和两个情感障碍组，感觉运动网络效率也偏低；两个情感障碍组的整体效率则保持正常，并表现出控制相关网络效率升高，情感性精神病还兼有向精神病性特征偏移的迹象。作者据此提出情感轴与精神病性轴并存的二分机制框架，并提示情感性精神病主要表达情感轴特征。相关分析属关联性结果，不能据此推断因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Multiscale organization of amyloid-associated vulnerability across the hippocampal memory system.
papers.authors: Cui X, Yan Liang T, Adeyosoye M, Ezzati M, Simkhada B, Cabrerizo M, Curiel Cid R, Rosselli M, Barreto A, Rishe ND, Loewenstein DA, Adjouadi M.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) selectively affects interconnected components of the hippocampal memory system, yet most MRI biomarkers characterize neurodegeneration using whole-hippocampal or isolated regional measurements. We tested whether amyloid-associated structural vulnerability is selectively concentrated in the cornu ammonis 1 (CA1) and the dentate gyrus (DG), reproducible across independent 1Florida ADRC and ADNI cohorts, and spatially localized within these subfields. We integrated hippocampal subfield volumetry, covariate-adjusted amyloid-associated vulnerability scores, 10,000-resample bootstrap rank-stability analysis, complementary cross-sectional clinical-stage comparisons, exploratory diffusion MRI, and within-subfield occupancy mapping. The cornu ammonis 1 (CA1) region and the dentate gyrus (DG) retained the two highest covariate-adjusted amyloid-associated point rankings in both cohorts. In ADRC, the adjusted scores were 5.06% for CA1 and 4.38% for DG, with bootstrap Top-2 frequencies of 59.02% and 41.44%, respectively; in ADNI, the adjusted scores were 9.10% for CA1 and 9.37% for DG, with Top-2 frequencies of 73.60% and 76.40%, respectively. Bootstrap resampling quantified uncertainty in regional scores and rank positions and supported recurrent top two placement of CA1 and DG, while also demonstrating overlap in uncertainty among several ROIs. Complementary cross-sectional comparisons described CA1 and DG volume differences across clinical stages in ADRC and ADNI. Exploratory diffusion MRI identified effect-size differences in hippocampal-associated pathways, but none of the 20 region-metric comparisons survived Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction. Collectively, these findings support a reproducible cross-sectional pattern of amyloid-associated vulnerability within the hippocampal memory system, centered on CA1 and DG and accompanied by spatially heterogeneous within-subfield structural loss. The diffusion MRI findings are exploratory and provide anatomical context rather than evidence of temporal ordering. Longitudinal studies are required to determine the sequence in which these abnormalities emerge.

papers.title: Decoding obstructive sleep apnea phenotypes through integrated multimodal sleep EEG.
papers.authors: Zheng J, Yu Q, Qiu Y, Kuang G, Dong F, Zhu Y, Gao Y, Xiong N, Yuan Z.
papers.abstract: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a heterogeneous disorder poorly characterized by the apnea-hypopnea index (AHI), with current subtyping overlooking sleep neurophysiology. We aimed to identify objective neurophysiological phenotypes and mechanisms by integrating multimodal sleep EEG with clinical and biomarker data. We analyzed polysomnographic, demographic, and biomarker data from 309 OSA patients, extracting quantitative EEG (qEEG) features spanning spectral power and sleep microstructure. These were fused via a cascaded multimodal transformer, and phenotypes identified by consensus clustering. Three stable, clinically distinct phenotypes emerged, with the ten most discriminatory features being all qEEG-derived. Phenotype 0 (n = 52) was the youngest group and showed intermediate sleep architecture, with a numerical trend toward higher self-reported cardiovascular disease; Phenotype 1 (n = 131) exhibited marked N3 sleep deficit and the most aberrant EEG spectral profile; and Phenotype 2 (n = 126) showed preserved sleep architecture. Mean AHI did not differ significantly, yet the distribution of AHI severity categories differed across phenotypes, highlighting a dissociation between conventional severity metrics and neurophysiological subtypes. We introduce a physiology-driven OSA taxonomy decoupled from AHI, prioritizing brain signatures to enable biologically targeted diagnosis and therapy of OSA.

papers.title: Cerebral Oxygenation Is Associated with Neurodevelopmental Outcomes in Infants Born Preterm with Intraventricular Hemorrhage.
papers.authors: Elis J, Fuiko R, Giordano V, Kasprian G, Nöhammer C, Licandro R, Vierlinger K, Olischar M, Berger A, Goeral K.
papers.abstract: Objective To examine how cerebral oxygenation levels monitored by near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) are associated with neurodevelopmental trajectories in neonates with intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH). Study design In this prospective study, 95 neonates born at <34 weeks of gestation with IVH (63 males, median gestational age, 25+6 weeks) between 2013 and 2023 were included. Regional cerebral oxygen saturation (rScO2 ) was monitored from IVH diagnosis until term-equivalent age. The analysis included rScO2 levels, duration outside the normal range (<55% and >85%), fluctuations, and cerebral fractional tissue oxygen extraction (cFTOE). Neurodevelopment was assessed at 2-3 years. Results Analysis of >20 500 hours of NIRS data revealed that impaired cerebral oxygenation was consistently associated with a poorer outcome. Infants with severe cognitive, language, and motor impairment had significantly lower rScO2 (P = .001), spent more time with rScO2 <55% (P = .005), and exhibited higher cFTOE (P = .001) than those with milder or no impairment. Exposure-based analysis demonstrated a clear dose-response relationship: infants in the lowest oxygenation quartiles had significantly worse outcome scores than those in the highest. Conclusions Impaired cerebral oxygenation in the early postnatal period is associated with poorer neurodevelopmental outcomes in infants with IVH. Parameters such as rScO2 , time outside the normal range, and cFTOE were associated with long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes. These findings support further investigations of cerebral oxygenation metrics in prospective studies of infants with IVH.
papers.summary_zh: 该前瞻性研究考察早产儿发生脑室内出血后，近红外光谱监测的脑氧合水平与神经发育轨迹之间的关联。研究对95名胎龄小于34周的出血患儿，从确诊起持续监测至足月等效年龄，并在2至3岁时评估神经发育。结果显示，脑氧合受损与较差结局一致相关：存在严重认知、语言和运动障碍的婴儿区域脑氧饱和度更低、低于正常范围的时间更长、脑组织氧摄取分数更高，且氧合水平最低四分位组的结局评分明显更差，呈现剂量反应关系。作者据此认为，出生后早期脑氧合受损与脑室内出血婴儿较差的远期神经发育结局相关，相关指标值得在后续前瞻性研究中进一步检验。

papers.title: Network reorganization of anterograde thalamic connectivity during non-periodic patterned deep brain stimulation.
papers.authors: Johnson TD, Mohan B, Huang H, Cramer J, Drees C, Hoerth M, Crepeau A, Drazkowski J, Noe K, Baxter L, Mbonde AA, Harris C, Ince N, Miller K, Hermes D, Worrell G, Parker JJ.
papers.abstract: Deep brain stimulation (DBS) of the anterior nucleus of the thalamus (ANT) can reduce seizures in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy. However, seizure freedom is rare, and there is no early response biomarker to predict long-term seizure suppression. To evaluate a candidate short-term biomarker of therapeutic response to DBS, we studied 18-min trials of ANT stimulation in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing intracranial electroencephalography. We compared a standard high-frequency periodic versus a non-periodic pulse pattern. We found that short-term ANT stimulation within the clinically used amplitude range preferentially altered the first 150 ms of anterograde ANT to anterior cingulate and superior frontal connectivity. Non-periodic ANT stimulation selectively modified early cortico-cortical evoked potentials more than periodic stimulation, and these changes were driven by the response phase. These pattern-specific changes in connectivity between the ANT and spatially restricted cortical areas suggest differing mechanisms and are a promising candidate biomarker for patients being treated with ANT-DBS.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注丘脑前核脑深部电刺激治疗耐药性癫痫时缺乏早期疗效标志物的问题，在植入颅内电极的患者中比较了标准高频周期性与非周期性脉冲模式的短时刺激效果。结果显示，在临床常用幅度范围内，短时刺激主要改变刺激后早期丘脑前核向前扣带和上额区的前向连接，且非周期性模式对早期皮层-皮层诱发电位的调节更具选择性，这种差异由反应相位驱动。作者认为，不同脉冲模式对丘脑前核与局部皮层间连接的差异化影响提示机制可能不同，并有望成为接受该治疗患者的候选生物标志物，但尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Sleep and participation in extracurricular activities moderate associations between low SES and brain structure and functional connectivity.
papers.authors: Tinch J, Thomson P, Rakesh D.
papers.abstract: Household and neighborhood socioeconomic status (SES) have consistently been associated with both brain structure and functional connectivity in adolescence. However, there is considerable heterogeneity in brain outcomes among youth from disadvantaged backgrounds, which suggests that other factors-including aspects of one's lifestyle-likely play a role by moderating these associations. In a large sample of ~10,000 early adolescents from the baseline assessment of the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study (aged 9-10 years), we tested whether sleep and participation in physical and non-physical extracurricular activities moderate associations of household and neighborhood disadvantage with brain structure and functional connectivity. Higher sleep duration was linked to weaker associations between both household and neighborhood disadvantage and a range of structural and functional brain measures, whereas extracurricular engagement had more selective moderating effects on the structure of sensory regions. Our findings identify sleep duration and extracurricular engagement as markers of variability in SES-brain associations, underscoring the need for longitudinal and intervention studies to determine whether these factors can mitigate disparities in brain outcomes among youth from disadvantaged backgrounds.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于约一万名9至10岁早期青少年的大样本基线数据，考察睡眠时长与课外活动参与是否调节家庭和社区社会经济劣势与脑结构及功能连接之间的关联。结果显示，睡眠时间较长时，家庭与社区劣势同多种脑结构和功能指标的关联均较弱；课外活动参与的调节作用则较为局限，主要体现在感觉相关区域的结构上。作者据此将睡眠和课外活动视为社会经济地位与脑发育关联个体差异的标志，但强调这些是横断关联，能否缓解不利背景青少年的脑发育差异仍需纵向和干预研究检验。

papers.title: How right dorsomedial lesions lead to neglect: A functional network-level framework.
papers.authors: Grande E, Baldassarre A, Committeri G, Bartolo A, Esposito V, Ciavarro M.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Spatial neglect-a disorder characterized by impaired exploration of contralesional space-has only recently been reported following lesions to dorsomedial regions of the right hemisphere. Consequently, the mechanisms underlying the occurrence of neglect in this context remain largely unexplored. Here, we investigated whether alterations in functional connectivity could account for this phenomenon by longitudinally assessing resting-state fMRI in a patient before and after tumor resection. A 71-year-old male underwent resection of an oligodendroglioma involving the right superior frontal gyrus and cingulum. Neuropsychological assessment and resting-state fMRI were acquired before and after surgery. Peripersonal and personal neglect were assessed with two different cancellation tests and the Comb and Razor Test (CRT). System Segregation (SyS), i.e., the balance of within and between network functional connectivity, was computed at both whole-brain and network-specific levels and compared with 20 age-matched healthy controls using Crawford's modified t-test. While no sign of neglect was observed preoperatively, the patient exhibited both peripersonal and personal neglect after surgery. Compared to controls, postoperative data revealed a significant reduction in whole-brain SyS (p < .001). At the network level, the ventral attention network (VAN) showed preserved segregation preoperatively but a marked postoperative decrease (p < .001). These findings show, for the first time, that the clinical manifestation of neglect after right dorsomedial regions may be explained by lesion-induced alterations in large-scale functional connectivity. In particular, reduced VAN segregation may reflect impaired functional differentiation underlying deficits in spatial attention, thereby shedding light on the mechanisms underlying dorsomedial lesions neglect presentation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨右侧背内侧区域病变为何会引发空间忽视，通过纵向追踪一名接受右侧额上回及扣带区肿瘤切除术的患者，结合神经心理学评估与静息态功能磁共振，并与健康对照比较。结果显示，患者术前未见忽视，术后出现个人及近身空间忽视，同时全脑系统分离度显著下降，腹侧注意网络在术前保持分离、术后明显降低。作者据此提出，背内侧病变后的忽视表现可能与大规模功能连接改变有关，尤其是腹侧注意网络分离度降低所反映的功能分化受损，或可解释空间注意缺陷。该研究为个案设计，相关机制仍属初步推断。

papers.title: A ventral hippocampus-prefrontal circuit mediates the pro-extinction effects of adult hippocampal neurogenesis on contextual fear.
papers.authors: Planchez B, Kaci ML, Legrand M, Sakai Y, Mériau P, Pena L, Morel L, Picquet S, Frerot A, Brizard B, Le Guisquet AM, Ploux E, Hen R, Surget A, Belzung C.
papers.abstract: Background Adult hippocampal neurogenesis (AHN) contributes to hippocampal functions including contextual information processing and stress responses. Inhibiting AHN increases vulnerability to stress and hinders effects of therapeutic interventions for stress-related disorders, especially post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) characterized by maladaptive fear response to context, suggesting that promoting AHN may offer promising strategies. We therefore aimed to test whether experimentally enhancing AHN protects against persistent contextual fear memory and examine the underlying neural circuits. Methods Using inducible Cre-dependent iBax male mice, we enhanced AHN via tamoxifen pretreatment prior to a high-intensity contextual fear conditioning (footshocks, 1.5mA, 2×2s). We assessed defensive responses to both the conditioning context and a conditioning-associated object, together with spatial memory controls, and combined retrograde labeling with projection-specific optogenetic inhibition. Results AHN enhancement reduced the persistence of defensive responses to fear context: accelerating within-session decline of freezing and improving next-day extinction recall, while sparing other hippocampal-dependent memory. Circuit analyses revealed increased recruitment of a ventral hippocampus-prefrontal (infralimbic) cortex pathway in AHN-enhanced mice. Critically, optogenetic inhibition of this projection did not impair extinction per se but selectively abolished the pro-extinction effects induced by AHN enhancement; an effect not reproduced by inhibiting the projection to basolateral amygdala. Conclusions Ventral hippocampal input to the prefrontal cortex is not required for baseline extinction but is necessary to mediate the facilitating effects of enhanced AHN on contextual fear extinction in male mice. These findings identify a circuit mechanism through which adult neurogenesis constrains the persistence of contextual fear and promotes adaptive fear regulation.

papers.title: Ketamine Alters Tuning of Neural and Behavioral Spatial Working Memory Precision.
papers.authors: Rahmati M, Moujaes F, Suljic NP, Ji JL, Berkovitch L, Lee K, Fonteneau C, Schleifer CH, Adkinson BD, Savic A, Santamauro N, Tamayo Z, Diehl C, Kolobaric A, Flynn M, Camarro T, Curtis CE, Repovš G, Fineberg SK, Morgan PT, Preller KH, Krystal JH, Murray JD, Cho YT, Anticevic A.
papers.abstract: Background Working memory (WM) is a key element of cognition that depends on accurate internal representation of stimuli and often impaired in psychiatric disorders, including schizophrenia. Prior human neuropharmacological studies with ketamine suggest that glutamate N-methyl-D-aspartate receptors (NMDARs) are critical for spatial WM (sWM), with NMDAR antagonism attenuating task-evoked neural activation and reducing WM accuracy. Animal studies, at the cellular level, and cortical microcircuit models hypothesize that NMDAR antagonism impairs sWM by decreasing the specificity of neuronal responses to spatial locations through broadened spatial tuning. Testing the relevance of this mechanism in humans remains a vital gap in our understanding of sWM and is critical for designing better treatments for WM impairments.
