papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电与功能磁共振信号特征和表征空间差异大、难以有效融合的问题，提出可解释的自适应融合框架BrainMoE，用于计算机辅助脑部疾病诊断。方法上先将两种模态信号映射到统一的脑区感兴趣空间，再由图编码器提取模态特异的脑网络表征，并通过模态专家、共享神经状态专家和自适应路由机制进行样本特异的加权融合，同时借助模态状态掩码支持完整双模态及单一模态推理。在健康脑网络数据集的五类二分类任务上，该框架平均AUC优于现有对比算法，消融实验支持路由与专家融合组件的作用；可解释性分析给出的脑区贡献与既往神经影像报道一致。这些结果提示该框架在保持可解释性和缺失模态推理能力的同时，为异构脑电-功能磁共振表征的整合提供了一种可行方案，但其诊断价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Multidomain Electroencephalography Biomarker Fusion for Machine Learning-Based Dementia Classification.
papers.authors: Thomas J, Subhashree S, Mohanty SN, V S DP, Sanjesh R, Jibrin Musa M.
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) has been investigated as a noninvasive approach for characterizing brain activity in neurodegenerative conditions. This study evaluated whether multidomain EEG biomarkers could distinguish Alzheimer's disease (AD), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and healthy controls (HC). The publicly available dataset contained resting-state, eyes-closed EEG recordings from 88 participants, including 36 with AD, 23 with FTD, and 29 healthy controls. Multidomain EEG biomarkers and demographic features were extracted for machine learning classification. The EEG-derived features included root-mean-square (RMS), power spectral density (PSD), and entropy measures. A Random Forest classifier was trained using the combined feature set and interpreted using explainable artificial intelligence. Feature-stability and Cohen's d effect-size analyses were performed to evaluate feature contributions, followed by an ablation analysis. Entropy-based features showed the lowest contribution to classification. The complete multidomain model achieved 96% training accuracy and 92% test accuracy. After the removal of the entropy features, test accuracy increased to 94%. These results describe the classification performance of the selected multidomain EEG and demographic features within the Random Forest framework.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用静息闭眼脑电的多域生物标志物与人口学特征，训练随机森林分类器，考察其能否区分阿尔茨海默病、额颞叶痴呆与健康对照。结果显示，完整多域模型在训练集和测试集上分别达到较高准确率，而熵类特征对分类贡献最低，剔除后测试准确率反而有所提升。作者据此认为，这反映了所选特征组合在该分类框架下的表现，而非确立临床诊断效用。

papers.title: Tuberculous Meningitis Alters the Proteomic Landscape of Brain-Derived Extracellular Vesicles.
papers.authors: Rodriguez BV, Damiba NNL, Tak H, Beaubien N, Puca D, Foster DB, Das S, Tucker EW.
papers.abstract: Tuberculous meningitis (TB meningitis), the deadliest form of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection, causes devastating mortality and severe neurological disability despite standard therapy. Brain injury and microglial activation are major determinants of outcome, yet the molecular mechanisms linking infection, inflammation, and neuronal injury remain poorly understood. Extracellular vesicles (EVs), critical mediators of cell-to-cell communication, have been investigated in pulmonary TB, but their role in TB meningitis remains unexplored. We used a young New Zealand White rabbit model of TB meningitis to isolate and characterize brain-derived EVs from infected and uninfected rabbits employing nanoflow cytometry, transmission electron microscopy, proteomic profiling by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), and bioinformatic analysis of pathways, cell-type enrichment, and protein-protein interaction networks (DAVID, Enrichr, and STRING databases). EV recovery from flash-frozen brain tissue proved feasible, enabling future studies using biobanked samples. M. tuberculosis infection increased EV release in brain tissue and induced a selective proteomic shift characterized by enrichment of proteins associated with TB host defense, microglial activation, and stress-response pathways, coupled with a reduced representation of neuronal and neuroprotective EV-associated proteins. These findings suggest that infection reprograms the brain EV proteome toward inflammatory and injury-associated pathways. Collectively, this study provides the first comprehensive proteomic characterization of brain-derived EVs in TB meningitis and establishes a foundational atlas of EV-associated proteins altered during infection. These findings identify candidate proteins for future biomarker validation in accessible biofluids (e.g., plasma and CSF) and provide a framework for generating hypotheses about EV-mediated host-pathogen interactions in the CNS during TB meningitis.

papers.title: Multimodal Neurorehabilitation Including Auditory EEG Neurofeedback: A Proof of Concept Tested After Resection of a Giant Olfactory Groove Meningioma.
papers.authors: Romita A, Spina RP, Li Volsi N, Cacciapaglia C, Manippa V, Schiavariello MC, Soleto L, Fiore P, Speranzon L, De Trane S, Taurisano P, Lagravinese G.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Patients undergoing resection of large olfactory groove meningiomas may present with persistent cognitive, behavioral, motor, and functional impairments. Evidence regarding EEG neurofeedback as part of postoperative neurorehabilitation remains preliminary. This case report describes the feasibility and associated clinical and neurophysiological changes in a sensory-adapted multimodal rehabilitation program. Methods: A 53-year-old man underwent emergency resection of a giant olfactory groove meningioma and subsequently completed 20 inpatient rehabilitation sessions over four weeks. Each session included auditory SMR/theta EEG neurofeedback at Cz, individualized cognitive training, and physiotherapy. Neuropsychological, emotional, functional, and mobility outcomes were assessed before and after treatment. EEG outcomes included longitudinal single-channel recordings acquired during neurofeedback sessions and 19-channel resting-state recordings obtained under eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions before and after the program. Spectral power, spectral ratios, and weighted phase-lag index connectivity were analyzed descriptively. Results: Reliable or measurement-based improvements were observed in global cognition, executive functioning, immediate and delayed verbal recall, total and cognitive functional independence, and mobility. Across the 20 neurofeedback sessions, the conservative primary analysis retained 9936 of 10,261 epochs and showed reduced theta activity, increased SMR and beta activity, increased SMR/theta, and reduced theta/total-beta. Resting-state EEG showed lower relative theta power and higher SMR, beta-1, and beta-2 power under both recording conditions. Connectivity changes included reduced theta and posterior alpha coupling together with increased SMR connectivity across fronto-central and parieto-occipital networks. Conclusions: Sensory-adapted EEG neurofeedback was feasible within an intensive multimodal rehabilitation program and was accompanied by concurrent cognitive, functional, and neurophysiological changes. Because of the single-case, uncontrolled, multimodal design, the findings cannot establish treatment-specific efficacy and should be considered hypothesis-generating.

papers.title: Distinct Nodal Centrality and Connectivity Profiles Underlying Independent and Interdependent Self-Construal: A Graph-Theoretical Resting-State fMRI Study.
papers.authors: Xiao Z, Xiao X, Lu J, Yang Z, Jia Y, Zheng Y.
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Self-construal-the extent to which the self is construed as autonomous from or connected with others-shapes cognition and social behavior, yet its system-level neural architecture remains poorly understood. This study examined whether independent and interdependent self-construal are associated with distinct patterns of nodal centrality and connectivity in the resting brain and whether these patterns covary with in-group favoritism. Methods Graph-theoretical analyses were applied to resting-state fMRI data from 67 college students. Degree centrality (DC) was the primary analysis; seed-based static functional connectivity (sFC) and dynamic functional connectivity variability (FCV) from DC-derived seeds served as exploratory follow-ups. In-group favoritism was assessed with a minimal-group point-allocation task. Results Independent self-construal was positively associated with DC in the left inferior occipital gyrus and right lingual gyrus; exploratory sFC linked these occipital seeds to frontal, temporal, and parietal regions, with greater exploratory FCV in their coupling with frontoparietal control areas. Interdependent self-construal was positively associated with DC in the medial prefrontal cortex and thalamus, with exploratory sFC to occipital, temporal, and insular regions but no significant FCV effects. The self-construal difference score yielded convergent DC results and was negatively associated with in-group favoritism; occipital-postcentral coupling was positively associated with in-group favoritism in an exploratory correlation. Conclusions Independent and interdependent self-construal are associated with distinct nodal centrality profiles, linking independence to occipital perceptual hubs and interdependence to medial prefrontal-thalamic hubs. Exploratory connectivity analyses extend these findings to the coupling of these hubs with distributed brain regions and to in-group favoritism.

papers.title: Effects of Second-Generation Long-Acting Injectable Antipsychotics on Brain Structure in Schizophrenia: A Systematic Review of Neuroimaging Studies.
papers.authors: Martiadis V, Scognamiglio P, Raffone F, Olivola M, Iniziato V, Barlattani T, Pacitti F, De Berardis D.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Second-generation long-acting injectable antipsychotics (SGA-LAIs) are increasingly used to improve adherence and prevent relapse in patients suffering from schizophrenia. Beyond clinical efficacy, growing attention is being paid to their potential impact on brain structure. This systematic review aims to synthesize available evidence from neuroimaging studies investigating the effects of SGA-LAIs on grey matter (GM) and white matter (WM) in individuals with schizophrenia. Methods: A systematic search of PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials was run from database inception to 13 August 2026, supplemented by Google Scholar, trial registries, and backward and forward citation tracking of the included studies. Eligible studies were original reports assessing the effects of SGA-LAIs on brain structure or brain function with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in patients with schizophrenia. Study selection followed the PRISMA 2020 statement, and data extraction focused on sample characteristics, treatment, imaging outcomes, and main findings. Risk of bias was appraised with RoB 2 and ROBINS-I. Results: Of 687 unique records screened, nine studies met the inclusion criteria. The evidence base is narrow: the nine studies correspond to only five independent samples, with six of them acquiring both a baseline and a follow-up scan and five providing a randomized comparison with oral antipsychotics, and the only molecules studied were risperidone LAI and paliperidone palmitate. Five randomized reports compared an SGA-LAI with oral antipsychotics and described better preservation of intracortical myelin and of cortical thickness with the long-acting formulation, most often in frontal regions, although the between-group difference reached statistical significance in only two of them and diffusion measures in one cohort moved in the opposite direction. Two cross-sectional functional MRI studies comparing risperidone LAI with first-generation depot medication described activation patterns closer to those of healthy controls in the LAI group, and one longitudinal resting-state study documented changes in regional homogeneity during paliperidone palmitate treatment. In some cases, structural or functional changes correlated with clinical or cognitive improvement. However, all included studies were judged to be at high or serious risk of bias, and the nine studies correspond to only five independent samples, so that the apparent convergence of findings partly reflects repeated analyses of the same participants; the limited number of studies and their methodological heterogeneity prevent firm generalizations. Conclusions: Preliminary and low-certainty evidence suggests that SGA-LAIs may be associated with better preservation of intracortical myelin and cortical thickness in schizophrenia, with convergent but weaker functional data and with diffusion findings that do not fit this reading. These results are hypothesis-generating and do not establish a neuroprotective effect. Larger and independent longitudinal studies with standardized imaging protocols and prespecified clinical endpoints are needed before any structural advantage of LAI formulations can be considered established.

papers.title: Melanin Bias in Cerebral fNIRS: A Monte Carlo Study Toward Equitable Optical Brain Sensing.
papers.authors: Althobaiti M.
papers.abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is an optical biosensing modality that transduces cortical hemodynamics into a measurable near-infrared signal, underpinning wearable brain monitors and brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Because epidermal melanin is a strong near-infrared absorber, device sensitivity may depend on skin tone, raising an equity concern for optical neural biosensors. (1) Objective: We quantify, by Monte Carlo simulation, how epidermal melanin biases the cerebral sensitivity of continuous-wave fNIRS biosensors across the Fitzpatrick scale, and evaluate source-wavelength selection as a device-level mitigation. (2) Methods: Using a physically sourced melanin model and a two-stage design-an idealized layered slab for controlled sweeps and the Colin27 anatomical atlas for realistic-geometry confirmation-we computed gray-matter sensitivity for three skin tones, four wavelengths, and seven source-detector separations. (3) Results: Melanin acts as a surface gate that lowers absolute cerebral sensitivity by up to ~12.5-fold (at 690 nm) for dark skin-and by ~5-fold at the 850 nm optimum-while preserving depth selectivity; longer wavelengths reduce the penalty (dark-skin retained sensitivity rising from 8.0% at 690 nm to 29.6% at 940 nm) but never remove it; and 850 nm is a practical optimum for single-wavelength cerebral sensitivity, combining the highest absolute sensitivity with improved equity, whereas 940 nm gains relative equity only as absolute signal collapses through water absorption. Atlas simulations reproduce the 850 nm optimum in realistic anatomy under identical optical assumptions and show that idealized slabs overestimate sensitivity ~50-fold and that sensitivity varies ~19-fold with probe placement. (4) Conclusions: Skin tone and anatomy compound to disadvantage darker-skinned users of optical neural biosensors; wavelength selection and a sourced correction-factor framework offer concrete routes toward equitable device design.

papers.title: Glymphatic Dysfunction Across Neurological Disorders: Links to Neurodegeneration, Inflammaging, Gut-Brain Signaling, and Physiological Modulators.
papers.authors: Voumvourakis KI, Thomaidis NS, Sideri E, Papadimitropoulos GN, Liadinioti C, Tsivgoulis G, Tsiodras S.
papers.abstract: The glymphatic system is a brain-wide perivascular network that facilitates cerebrospinal-fluid-interstitial-fluid exchange and the clearance of metabolic waste. Growing experimental and clinical evidence suggests that glymphatic dysfunction may represent a convergent pathophysiological feature associated with aging, neuroinflammation, and neurodegeneration, although its causal position within these processes remains unresolved. In this narrative review, we synthesize human imaging, clinical, and translational evidence implicating glymphatic dysfunction across major neurodegenerative diseases and integrate these findings with emerging data supporting its role in chronic low-grade inflammation associated with aging ("inflammaging"). We further discuss how alterations in the gut microenvironment may remotely influence glymphatic function and contribute to neurodegeneration through the gut-brain axis. Although supported by extensive preclinical evidence, studies in humans increasingly demonstrate impaired glymphatic function in several neurodegenerative disorders, most assessed using diffusion tensor imaging along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) index. Glymphatic dysfunction is associated with cognitive decline, motor impairment, and disease progression. Aging-related alterations in astrocytic function, aquaporin-4 polarization, blood-brain barrier integrity, and perivascular fluid dynamics provide mechanistic links between inflammaging and glymphatic failure. Gut dysbiosis may further exacerbate these processes by promoting central nervous system inflammation and vascular dysfunction. Together, these findings identify the glymphatic system as a clinically relevant pathway in neurodegeneration that may be regulated by aging-associated neuroinflammatory mechanisms involving the gut-brain axis. Finally, we discuss physiological, behavioral, and pharmacologic modulators that influence glymphatic function and propose a unified framework positioning glymphatic dysfunction as a central integrator of impaired brain clearance, with potential implications for biomarker development, clinical assessment, and disease-modifying therapeutic strategies in neurodegenerative disorders.

papers.title: Sixty years of linguistic change in the poetry of a Zen practitioner: a longitudinal case study of Gary Snyder.
papers.authors: Guo P, Fan W.
papers.abstract: Can decades of Zen meditation leave measurable traces in the practitioner's natural language? Long-term contemplative practice is widely understood to reshape emotion regulation, self-referential processing, and perceptual engagement, yet empirical research on these transformations has been fundamentally constrained by two limitations: an observation window of weeks to months at most, and an almost exclusive reliance on self-report and neuroimaging measures that cannot reach the automated, prereflective dimensions of psychological life most directly reshaped by sustained practice. This study applies computational quantitative content analysis to nine major poetry collections by the American Zen practitioner-poet Gary Snyder, spanning six decades (1959-2015), to test three directional hypotheses derived from core Zen concepts: affective settling (ānxīn , H1), self-referential attenuation (anātman , H2), and perceptual despecification (ānimitta , H3). Each hypothesis is held against a rival explanation as a falsification reference. The results reveal career-long changes across three analytical domains: negative-emotion vocabulary declines monotonically while positive and neutral categories show no statistically detectable trend; first-person pronouns, somatic vocabulary, grammatical agency, and cognitive certainty converge in decline across four distinct linguistic layers; embodied sensory specificity thins systematically while vocabulary drifts toward greater abstraction. Changepoint detection offers descriptive corroboration of the periodization. A comparison with a contemporaneous non-practicing poet (Wendell Berry) is descriptive in evidential status: the affective and self-referential trends are significant in Snyder but not in Berry, direct tests of the between-poet differences do not yield differences that are robust across interval-construction methods, and sensory thinning appears in both poets and may reflect processes shared across long poetic careers. These findings constitute what is, to our knowledge, the longest longitudinal linguistic record of a verified long-term Zen practitioner-documenting career-long changes that are consistent with, though not attributable to, sustained practice-and demonstrate the distinctive methodological value of naturally produced creative texts as a comparatively non-reactive observational window for studying long-term contemplative transformation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以美国禅修诗人Gary Snyder跨越六十年的九部诗集为对象，用计算内容分析检验源自禅宗概念的三项方向性假设：情绪趋于平复、自我指涉减弱、知觉去具体化。结果显示，消极情绪词汇单调下降，而积极与中性类别无可检测趋势；第一人称代词、身体词汇、语法施事性和认知确定性在多个语言层面同步减少；感官具体性系统性变薄，词汇趋向抽象。与同期非修行诗人的比较仅具描述性质：情绪与自我指涉趋势在Snyder显著而在对照者不显著，但诗人间差异的直接检验不稳健，感官变薄在两人均出现。作者强调这些长期变化与持续修行一致但不可归因于修行，并说明自然创作文本作为低反应性观察窗口的方法学价值。

papers.title: Empathy and perspective-taking in literary fiction: a systematic review and meta-analysis of psychological evidence and theoretical insights.
papers.authors: Chang L.
papers.abstract: Background It has been argued over the years that fiction reading can be useful in making people know other people, but the empirical history is spotty and frequently contradictory. Investigations vary in their design, measurements and quality and there is still no clear vision of how powerful those effects are and in what circumstances they manifest themselves. Methods A systematic search was performed in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, PsycINFO, and ERIC of studies published within the past 20 years (2000-2025) that investigated literary or prosocial reading relative to empathy, perspective-taking, theory of mind, or prosocial behaviour. Twenty-one studies were eligible. Of these, 12 contributed enough statistical information to be included in the meta-analysis, yielding 14 independent effect sizes (standardized mean differences and correlations, transformed to Hedges' g and Fisher's z ). Random-effects models were used, and heterogeneity and potential publication bias was examined with standard tests. Results When all eligible outcomes were pooled, reading literary or prosocial texts was associated with a small but statistically reliable advantage in social-cognitive performance (overall g = 0.23, 95% CI [0.11, 0.35], z = 3.78, p < 0.001). For cognitive empathy and theory of mind specifically, experimental studies produced a pooled effect of g = 0.27, 95% CI [0.10, 0.44], z = 3.15, p = 0.002 and correlational work showed an association of r = 0.20, 95% CI [0.03, 0.36], z = 4.75, p < 0.001. Across the 21 primary studies, 10 (47.6%) reported positive or beneficial outcomes, 6 (28.6%) reported mediated or conditional effects, 5 (23.8%) reported null or weak effects, and 3 (14.3%) contributed neurocognitive evidence. Because these evidence descriptors were not mutually exclusive, percentages were not intended to form a partition of the study set. Conclusion Taken together, the findings suggest that reading literary fiction does not uniformly transform readers' empathy, but is linked to modest, context-sensitive gains, particularly in perspective-taking and theory of mind. These gains are most visible when readers are engaged with demanding narratives and are invited, by the text or by instructions, to actively simulate characters' minds, with affective empathy and prosocial responses emerging more selectively under such conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述与元分析系统检索了探讨文学阅读与共情、观点采择、心理理论及亲社会行为关系的心理实证研究，并汇总其中可提取统计信息的实验与相关研究。合并结果显示，阅读文学或亲社会文本与社交认知表现存在小幅但稳定的正向关联，在认知共情和心理理论上尤为明显，实验研究也呈现类似方向。纳入的原始研究结论并不一致，部分报告积极效果，部分为中介或条件性效果，也有研究结果为零或较弱。作者据此指出，文学阅读并不会普遍改变读者的共情，其作用温和且依赖情境，在读者投入复杂叙事并被引导主动模拟人物心理时更易显现，而情感共情与亲社会反应则更具选择性。

papers.title: Case Report: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizures as initial presentation of Lhermitte-Duclos Disease and Cowden Syndrome.
papers.authors: Kwok WT, Yaman Bajin I, Climans SA.
papers.abstract: Lhermitte-Duclos Disease is a rare, benign cerebellar tumour that is a manifestation of Cowden Syndrome, a hereditary tumour predisposition syndrome caused by germline mutations in the PTEN gene. Here, we report a 38-year-old female patient with no past medical history or family neurological history presenting to hospital with a new, unprovoked, bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with no apparent seizure focus. EEG showed no epileptiform activity, and 7T MRI demonstrated bilateral Lhermitte-Duclos Disease as well as several cortical meningoencephaloceles. Her seizures were controlled with levetiracetam, and given her cerebellar lesion was minimally symptomatic, no further interventions were pursued. PTEN germline testing identified a heterozygous c.1003C>T (p.Arg335*) variant known to be pathogenic for Cowden Syndrome, and we promptly referred this patient for cancer screening. She was diagnosed with ductal carcinoma in situ and thyroid atypia of undetermined significance, and she subsequently underwent bilateral mastectomy and total thyroidectomy respectively. Lhermitte-Duclos Disease and Cowden Syndrome may present initially in previously healthy patients with bilateral tonic-clonic seizures without clear epileptogenic foci. Recognition of the underlying hereditary cancer syndrome enables timely cancer detection, potentially improving treatment outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 这份病例报告描述一名既往健康、无神经系统病史的38岁女性，以新发无诱因的双侧强直-阵挛发作就诊，脑电图未见癫痫样活动，7T MRI显示双侧Lhermitte-Duclos病及多处皮质脑膜脑膨出。癫痫经左乙拉西坦控制，因小脑病灶症状轻微未进一步干预；PTEN胚系检测发现致病性变异，提示Cowden综合征，患者随即接受癌症筛查并检出乳腺导管原位癌和意义未定的甲状腺异型性，分别行双侧乳房切除和甲状腺全切。作者据此提示，Lhermitte-Duclos病与Cowden综合征可以无明确致痫灶的双侧强直-阵挛发作作为首发表现，识别其背后的遗传性肿瘤易感综合征有助于及时检出癌症，可能改善治疗结局。

papers.title: PRNP D178N-129MM prion disease: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease-like cortical ribboning without prominent early insomnia.
papers.authors: Wei W, Nan H, Chen Z, Li J.
papers.abstract: Background The PRNP p.Asp178Asn (D178N) mutation on a methionine-bearing codon-129 allele is classically associated with fatal familial insomnia (FFI), but some carriers develop a Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD)-like phenotype. Case presentation and findings We report a 59-year-old woman with two months of rapidly progressive cognitive-language decline, caregiver-observed nocturnal sitting-up and sleep talking, weight loss, extensive cortical diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) ribboning, positive cerebrospinal fluid 14-3-3, and positive multisite skin real-time quaking-induced conversion. Electroencephalography showed diffuse slowing without periodic sharp-wave complexes. PRNP sequencing identified D178N with methionine homozygosity at codon 129. A focused literature review identified six previously reported individual D178N-129MM cases with prion-compatible cortical or cortical-striatal DWI abnormalities. Because these reports were selectively ascertained by imaging and used heterogeneous clinical assessments, they were not treated as a clinical series or compared numerically with MRI-negative cohorts. Other D178N-129MM reports show normal DWI in non-insomnia cognitive or motor presentations, objective sleep abnormalities preceding insomnia, and occasional cortical DWI hyperintensity in FFI cohorts. Conclusion D178N-129MM disease shows substantial phenotypic and imaging heterogeneity. Marked CJD-like cortical ribboning can occur in an initially non-sleep-dominant presentation and should not exclude an FFI-associated genotype. MRI pattern alone should not be used to infer a specific clinical phenotype; PRNP sequencing and objective sleep assessment remain important when clinically appropriate.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例59岁女性PRNP D178N-129MM突变携带者，表现为快速进展的认知语言衰退和广泛皮层DWI缎带样高信号，初期并无突出的失眠症状，临床与影像均类似克雅氏病。作者结合文献复习指出，该基因型可呈现显著的临床与影像异质性，CJD样皮层缎带征不应排除FFI相关基因型，单凭MRI模式也不能推断具体临床表型，基因测序和客观睡眠评估在临床适当时仍很重要。

papers.title: Metabolic dysfunction associates with neuroimaging measures of brain structure and connectivity.
papers.authors: Green ZD, O'Bryant SE, Johnson LA, Burns JM, Vidoni ED, Morris JK.
papers.abstract: Introduction Metabolic syndrome (MetS) and insulin resistance are established risk factors for Alzheimer's disease (AD) and have been linked to alterations in brain structure and function, including within the Default Mode Network (DMN). Methods Here, we examined associations between metabolic dysfunction, brain structure, and DMN functional connectivity using data from the Health and Aging Brain Study: Health Disparities (HABS-HD) cohort. Participants were classified as being cognitively unimpaired (CU; n = 1,045; mean age = 66.1 years; 65% female), or having mild cognitive impairment (MCI; n = 186; mean age = 66.5 years; 52% female) or dementia (n = 76; mean age = 69.0 years; 47% female). Results Across diagnostic groups, cortical thickness in AD-vulnerable regions varied by both cognitive status and HbA1c grouping, with the strongest effects observed in the CU cohort. HbA1c grouping was also associated with white matter microstructure, including stepwise reduc tions in fractional anisotropy of the anterior corona radiata across glycemic cat egories (normoglycemia > prediabetes > diabetes) in CU individuals. Functional connectivity of the posterior DMN (pDMN) showed main effects of both cognitive status and HbA1c grouping. Using a continuous index of cardiometabolic risk (MetS-Z), pDMN connectivity decreased linearly with increasing cardiometabolic burden in the CU cohort, whereas other DMN subnetworks exhibited positive associations with MetS-Z. Discussion These findings suggest network-specific associations between cardiometabolic risk and DMN organization that are detectable in indi viduals with MCI, a clinical state preceding dementia, as well as in some degree within cognitively unimpaired individuals. Longitudinal analyses are needed to determine whether metabolic dysfunction predicts divergent trajectories of DMN connectivity over time.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于HABS-HD队列，考察代谢功能障碍与脑结构及默认模式网络功能连接之间的关联，并按认知状态分组比较。结果显示，在阿尔茨海默病易感脑区，皮层厚度随认知状态和糖化血红蛋白分组而变化，在认知未受损者中效应最明显；糖化血红蛋白分组也与白质微结构相关，认知未受损者的前放射冠各向异性随血糖状况恶化呈阶梯式下降。后部默认模式网络连接同时受认知状态和糖化血红蛋白分组影响，且在认知未受损者中，随着心血管代谢风险指数升高，该亚网络连接线性下降，而其他默认模式网络亚网络呈正向关联。作者据此提出，心血管代谢风险与默认模式网络组织之间存在网络特异性的关联，这种关联在轻度认知障碍阶段即可检出，在部分认知未受损者中也有一定体现；代谢功能障碍能否预测默认模式网络连接的长期分化轨迹，尚需纵向研究确认。

papers.title: Motion matters: visual perception and motor functioning in children and youths with spastic cerebral palsy.
papers.authors: Ericson A, Hellgren K, Benassi M, Bolzani R, Lidbeck C.
papers.abstract: Background Vision plays a crucial role in guiding and anticipating movements. In individuals with cerebral palsy (CP), a condition characterized by disorders of movement and posture attributed to disturbances of the developing brain, Cerebral Visual Impairments (CVI) are common. CVI involves difficulties with organizing and interpreting visual information. Gait alterations and activity limitations in children with CP such as reduced; walking speed, step length, and motor skill performance, may be over-attributed to the motor and musculoskeletal disorders. Knowledge of how visual perception influence motor functioning in individuals with CP is sparse. The aim of this study was to investigate global motion perception, the ability to interpret the coherent direction of visual motion, and reported features of CVI in children and youths (C&Y) with spastic CP at different levels of motor functioning. Methods C&Y aged 8-20 (mean age 14:4) years, CP; 37 (gross motor functioning classification system, GMFCS, I; 28, II-III; 9) and typically developing (TD); 36, performed a computer-based Visual Motion Coherence Test (VMCT) evaluating global motion perception at three velocities (score: 0.0-1.0, low scores indicate difficulties). Corrected visual acuity was normal/near normal in all C&Y. The Raven's CPM was used to evaluate fluid intelligence. Parents of C&Y with CP; 67 (GMFCS I; 37, II-IV; 30) and TD; 40, completed a questionnaire capturing features of CVI (CVIQ) (score: 0-156, high scores indicate CVI). Results Global mean (SE) VMCT score, controlled for age and fluid intelligence, was lower in the CP-group than the TD-group; 0.64 (0.03) vs. 0.70 (0.01), (p = 0.04), and lower at high and low velocities vs. medium, most pronounced at GMFCS II-III. The median CVIQ score was higher in the CP-group than the TD-group; 28.0 vs. 4.5 (p < 0.001), and in the GMFCS II-IV-group (n = 30) compared to the GMFCS I-group (n = 37); 45.5 vs. 24.0 (p = 0.003). Conclusions A velocity-dependent vulnerability in global motion perception and many reported features of CVI were found in the C&Y with spastic CP, more so in the group with greater limitations in motor functioning. Visual perception should be considered when evaluating functioning and supporting perceptual and motor development in children with spastic CP.

papers.title: The emerging role of brain-derived microparticles in trauma-induced coagulopathy after traumatic brain injury.
papers.authors: Cai X, She H, Mao Q.
papers.abstract: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is frequently complicated by trauma-induced coagulopathy (TIC), which contributes substantially to secondary brain injury and poor clinical outcomes. The mechanisms underlying traumatic brain injury induced coagulopathy (TBI-IC) are multifactorial and involve extensive cellular alterations in endothelial cells, neutrophils, and platelets. Brain-derived microparticles (BDMPs), a subgroup of extracellular vesicles derived from brain-associated cells, attracted increasing attention due to their potential involvement in coagulation regulation after TBI. This review summarizes current evidence regarding the biological characteristics of BDMPs, their proposed contributions to coagulation abnormalities, inflammatory responses, and vascular dysfunction following TBI, as well as their potential value as biomarkers and therapeutic targets. In addition, the limitations of current evidence, including methodological heterogeneity, insufficient clinical validation, and uncertainties regarding causal mechanisms, are discussed to provide a balanced perspective on the translational potential of BDMPs in TBI-IC.

papers.title: Clinical efficacy evaluation of combined central and peripheral repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for elbow flexor (biceps Brachii) spasticity and upper limb motor function after stroke.
papers.authors: Liu Q, Yang R, Li D, Wei L, Chu E, Bao Y, Liu Z, Jin L, Xue C, Wang Z.
papers.abstract: Objective This randomized controlled trial aimed to evaluate the efficacy and temporal dynamics of a combined central and peripheral magnetic stimulation protocol, combining central (M1) and peripheral (Erb's point) stimulation with conventional rehabilitation, for post-stroke elbow flexor spasticity and motor function. Methods One hundred eligible stroke patients with upper limb spasticity were randomly allocated to Group A (n = 50) or Group B (n = 50). In a 6-week delayed-start design, Group A received active combined central and peripheral magnetic stimulation during weeks 1-3, while Group B received it during weeks 4-6. Both groups received concurrent conventional rehabilitation throughout. Primary outcomes included the Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS) for spasticity and the Fugl-Meyer Assessment for Upper Extremity (FMA-UE) for motor function. Secondary neurophysiological outcomes comprised motor evoked potential (MEP) amplitude and the root mean square (RMS) of biceps brachii electromyography. Assessments were performed at baseline, after 3-weeks and 6 weeks. Results A clear phase-specific effect was observed. At 3 weeks, Group A demonstrated significantly greater reduction in MAS scores (2(2, 3) vs. 3(2, 3), p < 0.001) and greater improvement in FMA-UE scores (22.2 ± 5.63 vs. 19.2 ± 5.53, p = 0.010) compared to Group B. Neurophysiologically, Group A showed an earlier reduction in RMS (20.14 ± 6.71 μV vs. 27.48 ± 7.29 μV, p < 0.001) and a transient decrease in contralesional MEP amplitude at 3 weeks. These intergroup differences narrowed at 6 weeks after Group B received the delayed intervention, suggesting that delayed active stimulation may also confer benefit, although spontaneous recovery and concurrent rehabilitation may have contributed to this convergence. Furthermore, the MEP elicitation rate in the affected hemisphere increased more substantially after combined central and peripheral magnetic stimulation treatment, suggesting a significant enhancement of cortical excitability in the affected hemisphere. Conclusion A combined central and peripheral rTMS protocol integrated with conventional rehabilitation is effective in alleviating elbow flexor spasticity and improving motor function after stroke. The delayed-start design supports that the observed benefits are attributable to the rTMS intervention, although residual placebo effects cannot be fully excluded. The effects are phase-specific, with motor improvement maintained at 6 weeks and a complex temporal pattern of spasticity reduction, likely mediated by modulating cortical excitability and spinal motor neuron pool activity.

papers.title: Ferroptosis in vascular cognitive impairment: pathological mechanisms and traditional Chinese medicine interventions.
papers.authors: Zheng S, Ji X, Zheng S.
papers.abstract: Background Vascular cognitive impairment (VCI) encompasses a spectrum of cognitive deficits arising from cerebrovascular disease, representing a major cause of dementia worldwide. Ferroptosis, a recently identified form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation, has emerged as a potential contributor to neuronal and glial cell injury in cerebrovascular pathologies, although direct evidence in VCI itself remains limited. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) has demonstrated promising neuroprotective effects, with growing evidence suggesting that its therapeutic benefits may partly involve the modulation of ferroptosis pathways. Objective This narrative review aims to comprehensively summarize the pathological mechanisms of ferroptosis in VCI, elucidate the molecular crosstalk between ferroptotic cascades and cerebrovascular injury, and highlight the therapeutic potential of TCM interventions targeting ferroptosis in VCI. Methods A comprehensive literature search was conducted across PubMed, Web of Science, and CNKI databases for publications from January 2019 to June 2026 (final search performed on 15 April 2026), using predefined terms related to ferroptosis, vascular cognitive impairment, cerebrovascular disease, and traditional Chinese medicine; the full search strategy and evidence-classification scheme are described in Section 1.1. Results Preclinical evidence suggests that ferroptosis may contribute to VCI pathogenesis through multiple mechanisms, including iron overload-mediated oxidative damage, glutathione depletion, lipid peroxidation, blood-brain barrier disruption, neuroinflammation, and white matter injury. Several TCM compounds and formulas, including baicalein, salvianolic acid B, gastrodin, astragaloside IV, and Buyang Huanwu Decoction, have demonstrated anti-ferroptotic effects in experimental models through modulation of GPX4, Nrf2/HO-1, System Xc-, and iron metabolism pathways. These preclinical findings provide a preliminary mechanistic basis for the neuroprotective effects of TCM in VCI, although direct clinical evidence is still lacking. Conclusion Targeting ferroptosis represents a potential therapeutic strategy for VCI, and TCM offers a rich repository of multi-target, multi-pathway anti-ferroptotic agents. However, most supporting evidence is derived from related cerebrovascular or non-neurological models rather than from VCI itself. Future research should prioritize VCI-specific mechanistic studies, rigorous validation of ferroptosis-specific effects, and clinical translation of TCM-mediated ferroptosis regulation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕铁死亡在血管性认知障碍（VCI）中的作用及其作为中药干预靶点的潜力展开，梳理了铁过载氧化损伤、谷胱甘肽耗竭、脂质过氧化、血脑屏障破坏、神经炎症和白质损伤等可能机制。文章进一步总结了黄芩素、丹酚酸B、天麻素、黄芪甲苷及补阳还五汤等中药成分和复方在实验模型中通过调节GPX4、Nrf2/HO-1、System Xc-及铁代谢通路表现出的抗铁死亡作用。作者强调，这些支持性证据多来自相关脑血管或非神经系统模型，VCI本身的直接证据和临床证据仍然有限，因此靶向铁死亡目前只是潜在策略，尚需VCI特异性机制研究与严格验证。

papers.title: The association between greater age at surgery and increased developmental delays and therapy burden in craniosynostosis.
papers.authors: Salib A, Kong V, Glaeser-Khan S, Allam O, Kauke-Navarro M, Moscarelli J, Flores Perez P, Alperovich M.
papers.abstract: Objective Children with nonsyndromic craniosynostosis (NSC) are at risk for neurodevelopmental delays that often require rehabilitative therapies. Early surgical intervention (before 12 months of age) is believed to support more normal brain development, but prior studies have been constrained by small cohorts and limited follow-up. This study provides the first national, longitudinal analysis of the relationship between age at surgery and subsequent therapy utilization. Methods The authors performed a retrospective cohort study using the Merative MarketScan commercial database (2016-2022). Children with NSC who underwent cranial surgery were identified and stratified by timing of intervention (≤ vs > 12 months). Patients older than 3 years were excluded for surgery, in addition to those with comorbid neurological and genetic conditions. Outcomes included use of speech, occupational, and physical therapy, as well as gross provider payments. A multilevel logistic regression analysis assessed associations between surgical timing, Pediatric Comorbidity Index scores, sex, sociodemographic factors, and therapy utilization. Results Among 1523 patients with a median follow-up of 4 (interquartile range 2-8) years, 28.6% received speech therapy, 34.9% occupational therapy, and 30.1% physical therapy; 1301 patients (85.4%) underwent surgery under 1 year of age while 222 patients (14.6%) underwent surgery between 1 and 3 years of age. Patients undergoing later surgery had markedly higher therapy utilization across all domains, i.e., speech (48.2% vs 25.3%), occupational (56.3% vs 31.2%), and physical therapy (51.8% vs 26.4%; all p < 0.001). The median number of sessions and payments were also significantly greater in the late cohort for occupational and physical therapy. On multilevel regression, surgery after 12 months was independently associated with increased odds of therapy use (speech OR 1.72, occupational OR 1.61, and physical OR 1.55; all p < 0.05). Patients undergoing surgery after 12 months also had significantly higher rates of developmental delay, including speech delay (40.1% vs 28.1%), motor delay (20.7% vs 9.1%), and global delay (26.6% vs 7.8%) compared with those treated at ≤ 12 months (all p < 0.001). Conclusions Children undergoing surgery for NSC after 12 months of age demonstrated higher rates of documented developmental delay diagnoses and greater use of rehabilitative services. This work supports multidisciplinary rehabilitative therapy in the long-term management of children with craniosynostosis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于美国商业保险数据库开展回顾性队列分析，比较非综合征性颅缝早闭患儿在12个月前与12个月后接受颅骨手术与后续发育迟缓及康复治疗使用的关系。结果显示，较晚手术者在言语、作业和物理治疗上的使用率均明显更高，言语、运动和全面发育迟缓的诊断比例也更高；多因素分析中，12个月后手术与各类治疗使用增加独立相关。作者据此认为，较晚手术的患儿康复负担更重，提示长期管理中应重视多学科康复治疗，但作为观察性关联研究，尚不能据此推断手术时机与结局之间的因果关系。

papers.title: How Meaning Shapes a Rule: Neural Signatures of Morphological Learning and Generalization
papers.authors: Azar M, Marantz A.
papers.abstract: Rule generalization is one of the most useful tools our mind uses to facilitate learning. In language, we apply it to connect what words mean to what they are made of, such as their suffixes. This is a morphosemantic relation, and it helps us process words we already know and easily acquire new words by composing their meaning. How is this relation acquired, and how does it manifest into generalization for understanding new words? In this study, we investigated the brain basis of these questions through an English-based artificial language study, where learners read sentences to learn a suffix-meaning relation of new words like “thinkle”. Words were either meaningful (places or things) or had no clear meaning. Each suffix family had majority and minority meaning words that participants had to keep track of for testing. For meaningful words in training, we found that higher performance scores predicted higher selective engagement in the left inferior frontal gyrus, specifically the pars triangularis and pars opercularis. In testing, both learned and generalized words, both increased lateral prefrontal cortex engagement. Meanwhile, words with no clear meaning had a much more diffuse brain engagement, recruiting bilateral temporoparietal regions. This resembles the processing of abstract words from previous literature. We found no difference between majority and minority meaning words, especially with the variance in participants’ performance strategies, but found differences in what predicted significant brain activity based on strategy difference. This study grounds itself in the reality of word and affixal semantics with previous research on language learning and universals. Ultimately, it lends a learning paradigm that resembles natural language learning across many languages to carefully investigate its brain basis, while addressing an understudied aspect of rule generalization: ambiguity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用基于英语的人工语言学习任务，考察学习者如何习得词缀与词义之间的形态—语义关系，并将其推广到新词。结果显示，学习有明确意义的词时，成绩越好，左侧额下回（特别是三角部和岛盖部）的选择性参与越强；测试阶段，无论学过的词还是推广到的新词，都伴随外侧前额叶活动增强。而无明确意义的词则引发更弥散的脑活动，涉及双侧颞顶区域，作者认为这与以往抽象词加工的表现相似。研究未发现多数义与少数义词之间的差异，但提示不同学习策略对应不同的脑活动预测模式。作者据此强调，规则推广中的歧义问题值得进一步研究。

papers.title: Neuropsychiatric Systemic Lupus Erythematosus in Children: A Scoping Review.
papers.authors: Theisen A, Ogbu EA, Beil EF, Harry O, Appenzeller S, Kammeyer R, Van der Heijden H, Knight AM, Craven HJ, Rodriguez M.
papers.journal: Open access rheumatology : research and reviews
papers.abstract: Background Neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus (NPSLE) presents significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges, particularly in childhood-onset SLE (cSLE), as there is limited pediatric-specific evidence, lack of specific diagnostic tests, and heavy reliance on adult data. This scoping review, the first dedicated specifically to the pediatric population, aims to evaluate the current literature on NPSLE in cSLE (cNPSLE), grade the level of evidence, and identify knowledge gaps in knowledge related to its manifestations, diagnosis, predictors, treatment and outcomes. Methods A search was performed in MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane, and PsycINFO (PRISMA diagram). Articles were screened in Covidence. Clinical trials, systematic reviews, cohort, case-control and cross-sectional studies published between 2000 and 2023, involving patients aged ≤18 years diagnosed with NPSLE, and with original manuscript available in English were included. Five reviewers performed abstract and full-text screening. Eight reviewers performed full-text extraction. Quality of evidence was assessed using the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) methodology. Results Sixty-five articles met eligibility criteria. Prevalence of cNPSLE ranged from 4.4% to 99.8%. Sociodemographic information was based on individual study metrics. Predictive factors for cNPSLE development were the most studied but were contradictory from study to study. Most frequent clinical manifestations were cognitive dysfunction, headaches and seizures. Common imaging findings were cerebral and cerebellar volume loss and white matter hyperintensities, though up to 50% of patients with active cNPSLE had normal imaging in 4 included studies. No pharmacologic clinical trials for cNPSLE are published. Outcomes from cNPSLE were variable. Conclusion This scoping review highlights the scarcity of articles on cNPSLE and identifies significant knowledge gaps. The 1999 ACR NPSLE case definitions, while providing a framework for classifying NPSLE, are not formally validated in children, resulting in heterogeneity in existing cNPSLE research and diagnostic criteria. Per the GRADE methodology, most studies were retrospective, single center, with low quality of evidence. The range in prevalence and frequency of cNPSLE manifestations highlights the lack of consensus in cNPSLE definition and evaluation as well as the heterogeneity of study populations. We highlight the need for high quality studies and consensus regarding cNPSLE definition, diagnosis, and management - a critical first step to guide the development of an international, multi-center prioritized research agenda for cNPSLE.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦儿童期起病的神经精神性系统性红斑狼疮（cNPSLE），系统梳理了其临床表现、诊断、预测因素、治疗与结局方面的文献并评估证据质量。纳入研究显示，cNPSLE患病率报道差异极大，最常见表现为认知功能障碍、头痛和癫痫发作，影像学多见脑与小肠体积减小及白质高信号，但部分活动期患者影像可正常；预测因素研究最多却结论相互矛盾，且尚无药物临床试验，结局也不一致。作者指出，现有研究多为回顾性、单中心、证据质量低，儿童中沿用成人分类定义未获正式验证，导致定义与评估缺乏共识，亟需高质量研究和统一的诊断管理标准。

papers.title: The meaning and interpretation of ALFF and fALFF
papers.authors: Gore J, Lee T, Li M, Boschen WW, Schilling KG, Anderson AW, Ding Z, Gao Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract The amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF) and its fractional counterpart (fALFF) are widely reported measures of resting-state fMRI signals, but their precise physiological interpretation has not been established. We derive expressions for ALFF and fALFF using a closed-form hemodynamic transfer function which allows the resting-state BOLD spectrum to be expressed explicitly in terms of cerebral blood volume, venous transit time, oxygen extraction and the coupling between flow and oxygen consumption. We demonstrate that ALFF and fALFF do not reflect the same physiological phenomena. ALFF can be related to baseline metabolism via a power law, whereas fALFF is a bounded, saturating function that in practice largely reflects signal-to-noise ratio. fALFF is confined to lie between and , where is the fraction of the available signal bandwidth chosen for analysis and is the fraction of true BOLD signal power falling in it. Every reported fALFF value must lie between two bounds that are determined by the acquisition protocol as well as the hemodynamic response function. Both limits change with the acquisition parameters without changes in neural function, so, for example, fALFF is not comparable across studies that differ in repetition time or scan length. We evaluate the sensitivity of each measure to baseline metabolism, and show in an appendix that the alternative convention, in which Fourier amplitudes rather than powers are summed, gives different bounds and a stronger dependence on repetition time. We also examine how fALFF and ALFF behave when when signal fluctuations arise from fluctuations in vascular parameters without any accompanying metabolic change.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对静息态fMRI中ALFF与fALFF的生理含义尚不明确这一问题，借助闭式血流动力学传递函数，将BOLD频谱与脑血容量、静脉通过时间、氧摄取及血流—氧耗耦合联系起来。分析表明两者反映的并非同一生理现象：ALFF可通过幂律与基线代谢相关，而fALFF是有界饱和函数，实际更多反映信噪比，且其取值受采集协议和血流动力学响应函数共同限定的上下界约束。作者据此指出，采集参数变化即可改变这些界限，因此重复时间或扫描时长不同的研究之间fALFF不可直接比较，并进一步考察了两项指标对基线代谢的敏感性及血管参数波动情形下的表现。

papers.title: Brain-inspired cascaded EEG speech decoding with conformal calibration and adaptive exit: simulation validation and five-stage real-data assessment
papers.authors: chen d.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Online EEG-based speech decoding faces dual challenges: limited computational resources for real-time deployment, and unreliable early-exit decisions when models underestimate their own errors (silent dropping of speech segments). Existing deep decoding models lack statistically rigorous uncertainty quantification, and the exchangeability assumption of conformal prediction— commonly used for calibration—is questionable for strongly auto-correlated neural signals. Systematic evidence on when and why conformal guarantees fail on real EEG, and whether online repair is feasible, remains scarce. New method We propose a brain-inspired three-tier cascaded decoding architecture (linear baseline → MLP residual corrections), equipped with pinball quantile error heads (τ = 0.75) for conservative error estimation, split-conformal temperature calibration with a block-wise variant to mitigate exchangeability violation, and an adaptive exit controller that decouples computational budget (ρ- quantile) from precision safety (κ· ˆe ≤ ϵ). For online distribution shifts, we implement Gibbs–Candès adaptive conformal inference (ACI) to dynamically adjust κ without relying on error-head quality. The framework is validated through simulation and a five-stage real-data assessment on OpenNeuro ds004279 (3 subjects, speech-perception EEG), plus an extended three-method cross-validation (temporal TRF, CCA lag scan, word-onset ERP permutation) to adjudicate millisecond-scale speech tracking. Results Simulation confirms conformal coverage at 84.5% (target 85%), exit rate anchored at 39.5%±0.6%, and 18 non-dominated Pareto solutions all outperforming the full-run baseline. On square-wave event labels, coverage remains 85.0% across four scenarios, and adaptive exit beats both full-run and baseline in 3/3 subjects. Switching to real audio envelopes increases label information 3.4-fold (|r| 0.057→0.194) but collapses coverage to 7–29%. Block-conformal root-cause analysis identifies six-fold κ drift across subjects, strongly coupled to error-head calibration failure. ACI repairs coverage to ∼99% in 2/3 subjects (including one with negative calibration correlation), while the remaining case is diagnosed as “uncalibratable” due to test-segment error-structure collapse, necessitating data-quality gating. Extended experiment shows that crude pipelines yield all-negative results from dual technical failures (drift artifact, ERD normalization failure); after official preprocessing alignment, word-boundary β/γ ERD emerges (group p = 0.028, 3/9 individual significant) and temporal CCA shows group significance (t = 5.24, p = 0.0004) despite individual r < 0.03, while band-power CCA significance (p = 0.0065) is falsified as segment-level coupling artifact. Comparison with existing methods Unlike conventional deep decoders (CNNs, LSTMs) and recent attention-based models that provide only point estimates without uncertainty bounds, our framework delivers distribution-free coverage guarantees via conformal calibration. The adaptive exit mechanism offers flexible speed-accuracy trade-offs absent in fixed-architecture models. Critically, ACI maintains validity even when error-head ranking fails—a property not achievable by static conformal approaches. Our five-stage negative-result trajectory (including coverage collapse and rootcause diagnosis) provides an applicability boundary map for conformal prediction on real neural data, which prior studies have not systematically documented. The extended three-method cross-validation further reveals that band-power CCA, commonly used in the literature, can produce false positives due to segment-level coupling, whereas temporal CCA and word-onset ERP provide more reliable group-level speech-tracking signals. Conclusions The proposed cascaded framework with conformal calibration and adaptive exit is validated both in simulation and real-EEG scenarios, with ACI effectively repairing coverage under distribution shifts. The deployable profile defaults to TRF linear regression + ACI + quality gating, with cascaded MLP reserved for high-signal-to-noise conditions. The extended experiment establishes a methodological baseline requiring full preprocessing-chain alignment, temporal features, and threemethod cross-validation for speech-tracking studies. All code and results are released open-source for reproducible research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种受大脑启发的三级级联脑电解码架构，结合分位数误差头、分裂共形校准与自适应退出控制，并在仿真和OpenNeuro真实语音感知脑电数据上分五阶段检验其在线解码表现。仿真中校准覆盖率接近目标、自适应退出优于全程运行；但改用真实音频包络后标签信息增加而覆盖率骤降至7%–29%，块共形分析将原因指向误差头校准失败与受试间漂移，自适应共形推断可在多数受试者中修复覆盖率，剩余一例因测试段误差结构崩溃被判为不可校准，需数据质量门控。扩展交叉验证还提示常用频带功率CCA可能因分段耦合产生假阳性，而时间CCA与词起始事件相关电位提供更可靠的群体层面语音追踪信号，作者据此建议默认采用线性回归加自适应校准与质量门控的可部署方案。

papers.title: Canadian Preterm Brain Injury Consensus Classification for Cranial Ultrasound and Prediction of Neurodevelopmental Outcome in Preterm Infants
papers.authors: Leijser L, Hendson L, Tang S, Benlamri A, Scott JN, Momin S, Zein H, Mohannad K.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To determine whether classification of severe preterm brain injury using the Canadian cranial ultrasound (cUS) consensus improves prediction of adverse neurodevelopmental outcomes. Study Design Infants born < 29 weeks’ gestation (2010–2018) with ≥ 3 cUS examinations, any brain injury, and neurodevelopmental assessment at 18–24 months were studied. Brain injury was assessed from serial cUS using the Canadian consensus classification. Severe injury comprised high-grade intraventricular hemorrhage, severe post-hemorrhagic ventricular dilatation, cystic white matter injury, and/or moderate-large cerebellar hemorrhage. Associations with death and/or significant neurodevelopmental impairment were analyzed and compared with historical reporting. Results Among 231 infants, 45% had severe brain injury and 39% experienced adverse outcome. Severe injury was independently associated with adverse outcome (OR 5.44, 95% CI 2.85–10.74). Sensitivity was similar to historical reporting, but specificity for cerebral palsy and severe cognitive delay was higher. Conclusions The Canadian cUS consensus classification improves neurodevelopmental outcome prediction and may inform early intervention and neuroprotective strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察按加拿大颅脑超声共识分类对早产儿严重脑损伤进行分级，能否改善对不良神经发育结局的预测。研究对象为胎龄不足29周、接受过多次颅脑超声检查并在幼儿期完成神经发育评估的早产儿；研究依据系列超声图像判定脑损伤程度，并分析其与死亡或显著神经发育损害的关系。结果显示，严重脑损伤与不良结局独立相关，预测敏感性与既往报告相近，但对脑瘫和严重认知迟缓的特异性更高。作者认为，该共识分类有助于改进结局预测，并可能为早期干预和神经保护策略提供参考，但摘要未说明其能否直接指导临床决策。

papers.title: rTMS renews long-tract myelination to improve AD cognitive function predicted by baseline myelin and E-field
papers.authors: Zhu Z, Xu J, Wu N, Su Q, Zhu S, Jiang J, Zhang G, Wang L, Lin H.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Alzheimer's disease (AD) is more than a neuronal disease, as myelin damage actively drives its pathogenesis. Maintaining myelin integrity during aging may delay the progression of AD. Myelin repair is an emerging strategy for AD treatment; however, whether rTMS can drive myelin remodeling through neuronal excitation remains unclear. Methods AD patients received rTMS targeting the left DLPFC. Myelin-sensitive white matter measures were assessed pre- and post-treatment. Functional connectivity (FC) changes within and between the cognitive networks were evaluated. Baseline myelin characteristics and individualized E-field modeling were used to predict clinical response. Results rTMS increased myelin content (MyC) in several left-hemisphere white matter tracts, particularly the superior fronto-occipital fasciculus (SFOF), superior corona radiata, and cingulum (Cohen’s d = 0.59 ,0.57, 0.59, separately). These changes were associated with enhanced CEN-SN cross-network, interhemispheric CEN, and intra-CEN connectivity enhancements, contributing to clinical improvement (correlations between MOCA and MyC of SFOF_L (R = 0.56, p < 0.01)). Baseline MyC of SFOF-L and E-field jointly predicted post-treatment cognitive outcomes, with the strongest MoCA model explaining 44.4% of the adjusted variance and outperformed either metric alone. No direct correlation was found between myelin increase and E-field, highlighting the constraining role of structural reserve. Conclusions This study reveals a myelin-mediated mechanism of rTMS action in AD, demonstrating the potential of promoting myelination as a novel therapeutic strategy for alleviating AD-related cognitive impairment. These findings support individualized biological dosing combining E-field modeling and myelin features of key tracts to identify the E-field threshold that triggers myelin remodeling, replacing traditional physical dose measures.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）能否通过神经元兴奋驱动阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者的髓鞘重塑，对AD患者左侧背外侧前额叶施加rTMS，并结合髓鞘敏感的白质指标、认知网络功能连接及个体化电场建模进行分析。结果显示，rTMS提高了左侧半球多个白质束的髓鞘含量，这些变化与认知网络内及网络间连接的增强相关，并伴随认知改善；基线髓鞘特征与电场可共同预测治疗后认知结局，联合模型的解释力优于单一指标，但髓鞘增加与电场之间未见直接相关，提示结构储备的约束作用。作者据此提出，髓鞘介导可能是rTMS改善AD认知的机制之一，并支持将电场建模与关键白质束髓鞘特征结合用于个体化生物剂量设定。

papers.title: Longitudinal Clinical and MRI Changes Suggestive of Subclinical Disease Progression in Egyptian Patients with Relapsing-Remitting Multiple Sclerosis: A Prospective Observational Study
papers.authors: Zidan SH, El-Aziz AAEA, El-Nabil LM, El-Hafeez MAA, Shukry AM, Swelam MS.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Progression independent of relapse activity (PIRA) is increasingly recognized as a major contributor to disability accumulation in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS), reflecting ongoing neurodegeneration despite apparent control of inflammatory disease activity. However, longitudinal data integrating comprehensive clinical assessment with quantitative MRI biomarkers remain limited, particularly in North African populations. Methods This prospective observational cohort study included 50 patients with RRMS. Assessments at baseline, 6, and 12 months included the Expanded Disability Status Scale (EDSS), Symbol Digit Modalities Test (SDMT), Nine-Hole Peg Test (9-HPT), Timed 25-Foot Walk Test (T25-FWT), and Arabic Modified Fatigue Impact Scale (A-MFIS). Quantitative brain MRI, including regional volumetric analysis, cortical thickness measurements, and white matter lesion assessment, was performed at baseline and after one year. Results During the one-year follow-up, significant deterioration was observed in disability, cognitive performance, upper-limb function, and fatigue, whereas walking performance remained relatively stable. Clinically meaningful cognitive decline (≥ 4-point reduction in SDMT score) occurred in 24% of patients after 6 months and in 44% after one year. EDSS worsening was observed in eight patients at 6 months and seven patients at one year, including progression in 10.3% of patients without documented relapse during the second follow-up period. Quantitative MRI demonstrated significant longitudinal changes in multiple cortical and subcortical brain regions despite stable white matter lesion burden, and clinical deterioration was associated with regional brain volumetric alterations involving the thalamus, cortical and total gray matter, cerebellum, and temporal structures. Older age, longer disease duration, greater relapse burden, and delayed initiation of disease-modifying therapy (DMT) were associated with less favorable clinical outcomes and greater brain atrophy, whereas higher educational attainment and monosymptomatic disease onset were associated with better longitudinal cognitive performance. Conclusion One-year longitudinal follow-up demonstrated measurable changes across multiple clinical domains and regional brain structures consistent with early subclinical disease progression in RRMS despite limited inflammatory activity. Quantitative MRI combined with sensitive cognitive and functional assessments detected changes beyond those captured by conventional disability measures, supporting their complementary role in monitoring early neurodegenerative progression.
papers.summary_zh: 该前瞻性观察研究在埃及复发缓解型多发性硬化患者中，结合临床量表与定量脑MRI，追踪一年内独立于复发活动的疾病进展迹象。随访发现，患者残疾、认知、上肢功能和疲劳均出现恶化，而步行表现相对稳定；部分患者出现有临床意义的认知下降，少数在无记录复发的情况下残疾加重。MRI显示多个皮层和皮层下区域体积及皮层厚度发生纵向改变，而白质病灶负荷保持稳定，且临床恶化与丘脑、灰质、小脑及颞叶结构改变相关。作者认为，这些结果提示在炎症活动有限时仍存在早期亚临床神经退行性进展，敏感认知与功能评估可补充常规残疾指标的不足。

papers.title: Thalamocortical correlates of sleep spindle and slow oscillation dysfunction in Lewy body disorders
papers.authors: Matar E, Anderson J, Churchill L, Konuri A, Ignatavicius A, Cho G, Lam A, Naismith S, D'Rozario A, Grunstein R, Lewis S.
papers.abstract: Abstract Sleep disturbances are pervasive in Lewy body disorders (LBD), but their neurophysiological basis remains unclear. Non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep offers an objective window into thalamocortical circuit function, minimally confounded by the motor and cognitive fluctuations of wake. Sleep spindles, slow oscillations (SOs) and their coupling reflect complementary aspects of this system, and may be differentially affected in LBD. We characterised NREM microarchitecture in 109 participants (55 controls, 32 Parkinson's disease [PD], 22 dementia with Lewy bodies [DLB]), quantifying spindle density and morphology, SOs, spindle–SO coupling and spectral power, and related these to thalamic volumes and cortical thickness in the 77 participants with MRI, adjusting for age and sex. Macroarchitecture was broadly similar between groups. Slow and fast spindle densities were reduced in LBD and lowest in DLB (all p FDR <0.05), with PD reductions more prominent for fast spindles. Additionally, DLB showed reduced central and occipital SO density (p FDR ≤0.018), altered slow spindle–SO coupling, and increased frontal beta power (p FDR =0.004). Within LBD, reduced thalamic volume was associated with lower spindle density and weaker slow spindle–SO coupling. These dissociable abnormalities of spindle generation and thalamocortical coordination support sleep EEG as an accessible physiological readout of circuit dysfunction in LBD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注路易体谱系疾病（包括帕金森病和路易体痴呆）中睡眠纺锤波与慢振荡异常及其丘脑皮层基础，对参与者进行非快速眼动睡眠脑电微结构分析，并结合丘脑体积和皮层厚度测量。结果发现各组睡眠宏观结构大致相似，但路易体谱系疾病患者睡眠纺锤波密度降低，路易体痴呆最明显，且其慢振荡密度、纺锤波-慢振荡耦合及额区beta功率也出现改变；在患者中，丘脑体积较小与纺锤波密度较低和耦合较弱相关。作者认为，这些可分离的异常提示睡眠脑电或可作为反映路易体谱系疾病丘脑皮层环路功能障碍的生理指标，但相关发现尚不能说明因果关系或临床效用。

papers.title: Resting-state fMRI correlates of self-balancing robot-assisted lower-limb rehabilitation after stroke: a pilot randomized controlled neuroimaging study
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Zhai Q, Wang Y, Liu Z, Sun L, Li Y, Chu Y, Li Z, Deng L, Su B, Sun W, Hu Y, Ding L, Wang H.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Lower-limb weakness and poor balance are major barriers to independent walking after stroke. Self-balancing robot-assisted training permits supported upright practice, repeated weight shifting and task-oriented lower-limb loading, but its training-related neural correlates remain unclear. Methods In this pilot randomized controlled neuroimaging study, 24 patients with subcortical stroke received 4 weeks of REX-assisted training plus conventional rehabilitation or dose-matched active upright lower-limb training plus conventional rehabilitation (n = 12 per group). The Berg Balance Scale (BBS) was the primary clinical outcome, the Fugl-Meyer Assessment of the Lower Extremity (FMA-LE) was the key secondary outcome, and the Postural Assessment Scale for Stroke (PASS) and Functional Ambulation Category (FAC) were exploratory outcomes. Resting-state functional MRI was acquired before and after treatment; 20 participants were retained for imaging analyses (REX, n = 11; control, n = 9). Group-by-time analyses examined amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF), affected-side precentral-gyrus seed-based functional connectivity (FC), and interhemispheric correlation (IHC); local and global correlation measures were exploratory. Results Baseline-adjusted analyses favored REX for post-intervention BBS scores (adjusted difference, 12.75; 95% CI, 1.45–24.04; P = 0.029) and FMA-LE scores (adjusted difference, 7.19; 95% CI, 3.71–10.67; P < 0.001). FAC was also favorable in an exploratory analysis, whereas PASS did not show a statistically definitive between-group difference. Group-by-time effects were observed in ALFF, seed-based FC, and IHC analyses, involving the affected-side precuneus, non-lesioned-side association cortices, the affected-side precentral–middle temporal connectivity, and bilateral precuneus/posterior cingulate homotopic coordination. Local and global correlation interactions were not significant. Conclusion Four weeks of REX-assisted lower-limb rehabilitation was associated with favorable pilot clinical outcomes and selective resting-state fMRI changes involving posterior-midline, visual-association, frontal-control, and motor-association systems. These findings represent candidate training-related neural correlates and require confirmation in larger randomized studies. Trial registration: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry, ChiCTR2300079122; (registered on 26 December 2023, https://www.chictr.org.cn/)
papers.summary_zh: 这项初步随机对照神经影像研究探讨了卒中后下肢康复训练相关的静息态脑功能改变，将自平衡机器人辅助训练与剂量匹配的主动直立下肢训练进行比较，并同步采集治疗前后的静息态功能磁共振数据。结果显示，机器人辅助组在平衡量表和下肢运动功能评分上的改善优于对照组，探索性分析中步行能力也倾向有利，但姿势评估量表未见明确的组间差异。影像分析发现两组在低频波动振幅、种子点功能连接和半球间相关上存在交互效应，涉及后中线、视觉联合、额叶控制及运动联合系统，而局部与全局相关指标未见显著交互。作者将这些变化视为候选的训练相关神经关联，尚需更大样本的随机研究确认。

papers.title: High-frequency stimulation-induced secondary hyperalgesia shifts temporal order judgment and increases precuneus nodal degree in healthy adults.
papers.authors: Morikawa Y, Osumi M.
papers.abstract: Pain can influence attention and other higher-order cognitive processes. In experimental settings, acute pain has been linked to attentional prioritization of the painful body region. However, conventional experimental pain models often rely on brief, phasic nociceptive stimuli and are therefore less suited to examining spatial attention during a sustained, experimentally induced sensitized state. In this study, we examined whether high-frequency stimulation (HFS)-induced secondary hyperalgesia, as a model of acute experimental sensitization, was associated with changes in temporal order judgment (TOJ) and resting-state EEG-derived measures in healthy adults. Sixteen healthy adults (mean age, 28.5 years; seven women) underwent HFS of the forearm to induce secondary hyperalgesia. Spatial attention was assessed using a TOJ task, and resting-state EEG data were analyzed using source-level graph-theoretical measures. HFS increased pinprick pain sensitivity in the surrounding skin adjacent to the stimulation site. TOJ performance showed a significant shift in the point of subjective simultaneity (PSS) toward the HFS-treated side, indicating an attentional bias independent of subjective pain intensity. EEG analysis revealed a significant increase in nodal degree in the bilateral precuneus in the theta band, and this change was positively correlated with the PSS shift (ρ = 0.53, p = 0.036). These findings suggest that both behavioral attentional bias and short-term changes in resting-state EEG-derived measures can accompany acute experimentally induced sensitization. The present results should be interpreted within the scope of the HFS model as reflecting short-term modulation during an acute sensitized state rather than chronic pain-like reorganization.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康成人中考察高频电刺激诱发的继发性痛觉过敏是否伴随时间顺序判断和静息态脑电指标的变化，以探索持续敏化状态下空间注意的改变。结果显示，刺激提高了刺激部位周围皮肤的针刺痛敏，时间顺序判断的主观同时点向受刺激侧偏移，提示注意偏向，且这一偏移与主观疼痛强度无关；同时，双侧楔前叶theta频段的节点度升高，并与该偏移呈正相关。作者据此认为，急性实验性敏化可同时伴随行为层面的注意偏向和静息态脑电指标的短期改变，但强调这些结果限于高频刺激模型下的短期调制，不能等同于慢性疼痛样的重组。

papers.title: Decomposing response inhibition: A POMDP model.
papers.authors: Wang W, Kaufmann T, Dayan P.
papers.abstract: Inhibitory control is a core cognitive function whose competence varies across the population, with impairments often observed in psychiatric conditions such as attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). The Stop Signal Task (SST) is a widely used paradigm for assessing this ability. However, conventional formalizations of SST performance, such as the independent race model, rely on assumptions that are frequently violated in modern experimental designs. Furthermore, they typically fit only mean reaction times, overlooking crucial trial-by-trial dynamics. To address these limitations, we formalize the SST as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP). This framework characterizes inhibitory control with two components: noisy perceptual inference regarding stimuli and optimal control balanced against potential costs. To fit this model to the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study baseline cohort (N = 3,567), we introduce Transformer-encoded Simulation-Based Inference (TeSBI). This end-to-end architecture learns compact, sequence-aware embeddings from raw behavioral data. It enables efficient, amortized inference of individual-level posteriors. Extensive validation confirms it extracts reliable and identifiable parameters. We identify distinct latent computational attributes associated with scores on ADHD questionnaires. Controlling for sex, IQ, and medication status, children with higher ADHD scores exhibit subtle but robust shifts in computational attributes. They show a reduction in go cue directional precision, alongside a blunted sensitivity to stop error, go error and time costs. The learned embedding space reveals a continuous manifold in which children with higher ADHD scores are heterogeneously distributed, rather than forming distinct disorder clusters. This indicates that similar clinical characteristics can emerge from diverse combinations of computational mechanisms, supporting a dimensional perspective on neurodiversity. Our end-to-end framework can be extended to a broader range of cognitive tasks. It offers a scalable, theory-driven solution for analyzing large-scale behavioral data.

papers.title: Child Neurology: Transient Global Amnesia Precipitated by a Valsalva Maneuver in an Adolescent.
papers.authors: Groulx-Boivin E, Toban L, Carpineta L, Simard Tremblay E.
papers.abstract: Transient global amnesia (TGA) is a benign clinical syndrome characterized by the sudden onset of anterograde amnesia with preserved consciousness and no focal neurologic deficits, resolving within 24 hours. It predominantly affects middle-aged and older adults and is rarely reported in pediatric populations. In adults, TGA is often preceded by identifiable triggers, including Valsalva maneuvers. We describe a previously healthy, typically developing 16-year-old boy who presented with acute anterograde amnesia after an intentional Valsalva maneuver performed during a school video. He experienced several hours of repetitive questioning, inability to form new memories, and mild retrograde amnesia. The episode of anterograde amnesia resolved spontaneously after approximately 9 hours. He subsequently regained some memories of the period preceding symptom onset. Neurologic examination after symptom resolution was normal aside from amnesia for the episode itself. Laboratory investigations, head CT, electroencephalography, and brain magnetic resonance imaging were unremarkable aside from a hypoplastic left transverse sinus without evidence of thrombosis. The clinical presentation was therefore felt to be most consistent with TGA precipitated by a Valsalva maneuvers. This case highlights a rare presentation of TGA in an adolescent precipitated by a Valsalva maneuver. It underscores the importance of considering TGA in the differential diagnosis of acute anterograde amnesia in pediatric patients and suggests overlap between recognized triggers of TGA in adults and those observed in children.

papers.title: Genetic Insights Into Protective Effects of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists on Stroke and Alzheimer Disease Across Ancestries.
papers.authors: Caro-Châtelier I, Sargurupremraj M, Yang C, Akinleye C, Trégouët DA, Akinyemi RO, Shigemizu D, Coker M, Akinyemi JO, Tiwari HK, Chasman DI, Ovbiagele B, Chabriat H, Mooser V, Couffinhal T, Mishra A, Cruchaga C, Reitz C, Kunkle B, Kamatani Y, Owolabi MO, Mohammedi K, Debette S.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Stroke and dementia are leading causes of death and disability worldwide, requiring enhanced preventive strategies. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA), widely used for type 2 diabetes (T2D) and obesity, have demonstrated pleiotropic effects, including cardiovascular benefits, with mounting evidence also suggesting potential beneficial effects on brain health. The objective of this study was to investigate the genetically proxied effect of GLP-1RA on stroke, Alzheimer disease (AD), and related endophenotypes, in a cross-ancestry setting. Methods We conducted a 2-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) study using both a locus-based and a protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL)-based approach. The study leveraged summary statistics from large-scale genome-wide association studies (GWAS). These GWAS comprised participants of European, East-Asian, and African ancestry with and without T2D, stroke, and AD, and with measurements of fasting glucose, glycated hemoglobin, stroke, and AD endophenotypes. Sample size ranged from 3,026 to 1,812,017 individuals. Genetically proxied GLP-1RA exposure was instrumented using independent T2D-associated variants (p < 5 × 10-8 ) within GLP1R (locus-based MR) and pQTLs for circulating GLP-1R protein levels (pQTL-based MR). Instruments were validated for effects on glycemic traits and GLP1R gene expression. Primary outcomes were stroke (any, ischemic, cardioembolic, small vessel, large artery, and intracerebral hemorrhage) and AD. Secondary analyses included etiologic factors and endophenotypes of stroke and AD: heart failure, atrial fibrillation, MRI markers (white matter hyperintensity volume, perivascular space burden, and hippocampal volume), and CSF biomarkers (beta-amyloid, tau). Outcomes were stratified by ancestry and meta-analyzed. Results In Europeans, locus-based MR indicated significant protective associations of GLP-1RA with any stroke and ischemic stroke (p FDR < 0.05) and nominally (p < 0.05) with AD. Cross-ancestry meta-analyses strengthened protective effects of GLP-1RA on any stroke (OR, 0.75; 95% CI 0.63-0.89), ischemic stroke (0.72; 0.56-0.91), cardioembolic stroke (0.55; 0.35-0.86), and AD (0.51; 0.31-0.83), all with p FDR < 0.05. pQTL-based MR analyses suggested protective effects of genetically proxied GLP-1RA on atrial fibrillation (p FDR < 0.05) and, nominally (p < 0.05), on hippocampal perivascular space burden and CSF β-amyloid levels. Discussion GLP-1RAs may confer protective effects against stroke (especially ischemic and cardioembolic) and AD risk, across ancestries. These findings warrant further investigation in experimental models and clinical trials to confirm benefits on brain health and understand underlying mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用两样本孟德尔随机化方法，在跨欧洲、东亚和非洲人群的遗传数据中考察胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）对卒中和阿尔茨海默病的遗传代理效应。基于GLP1R位点和循环GLP-1R蛋白水平的分析显示，遗传代理的GLP-1RA与任何卒中、缺血性卒中、心源性栓塞性卒中及阿尔茨海默病风险降低相关，跨人群荟萃分析结果一致；蛋白水平分析还提示其对心房颤动有保护作用，对海马血管周围间隙负担和脑脊液β-淀粉样蛋白呈名义关联。作者认为这些结果提示GLP-1RA可能具有跨人群的脑健康保护作用，但尚需实验模型和临床试验验证。

papers.title: Role of the left intraparietal sulcus in the comprehension of action intensity described in sentences.
papers.authors: Shibata H, Takahashi K, Niida M, Ogawa K.
papers.abstract: From an embodied cognition perspective, semantic processing is assumed to involve sensorimotor representations. The present study used functional magnetic resonance imaging to investigate whether comprehension of action intensity described in sentences is associated with neural representations shared with action execution, particularly those related to grip force. In the execution task, participants gripped their right hand with either high or low force. In the language task, participants evaluated the action intensity described in the sentences. We examined four regions of interest (ROIs): the left primary somatosensory cortex, left primary motor cortex, left dorsal premotor cortex, and the left intraparietal sulcus (LIPS). Multivoxel pattern analysis was used to assess whether intensity information could be decoded within and across tasks. In the execution task, intensity differences were reliably decoded from multivoxel activity patterns across all four regions. In the language task, significant decoding of intensity was observed only in the LIPS. Cross-classification between the execution and language tasks did not reach significance in the primary analysis across the four regions and was associated with low effect sizes. However, exploratory analyses using smaller ROIs revealed significant cross-decoding and moderate effect sizes in the LIPS. These findings suggest that the comprehension of action intensity is associated with higher-level intensity-related representations rather than with neural representations that are closely tied to low-level motor execution. Overall, the results do not support strong embodied accounts, which assume the direct reinstatement of low-level motor execution processes during language comprehension. However, these findings suggest that partially shared higher-level representations of intensity may exist between action execution and language processing.
