papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注图雷特综合征中大脑网络与自主神经生理信号如何耦合，采用密集采样的静息态功能磁共振与同步脉搏血氧测量，对两对图雷特综合征不一致的同胞进行个体化精准功能网络分析。结果显示，个体间功能网络组织和自主神经指标差异明显，但最一致的观察是患病与未患病个体呈现相反的耦合方向：患病者的心率变异性指标与内部状态—注意网络及动作相关系统之间的连接呈正相关，而未患病同胞则在连接内部状态与动作控制的更广泛整合通路上呈正相关。作者将这些初步发现定位为生成性假设，提示个体化网络映射结合时间分辨生理测量可能有助于理解图雷特综合征中脑—心耦合的个体差异，尚不能据此推断因果或临床效果。

papers.title: A high-precision synchronization and centroid-based framework for single-trial decoding of perceived natural speech.
papers.authors: Olivares CY, Schettini N.
papers.abstract: Decoding natural speech from EEG is constrained by low signal-to-noise ratios, commonly addressed through event-related potential (ERP) grand averaging. However, this approach acts as a low-pass filter, obscuring trial-to-trial variability and high-frequency neural dynamics. To overcome these limitations, we propose an open-box, FPGA-synchronized framework for single-trial EEG analysis of Spanish vowels (/a/, /i/, /u/). The proposed architecture enforces sub-millisecond hardware determinism, eliminating software-induced temporal jitter and enabling robust extraction of high-frequency oscillatory features, including the Gamma band, without relying on averaged ERPs. This synchronization framework facilitates the separation of early exogenous sensory responses from late endogenous cognitive processing, while comprehensive ablation studies were performed to evaluate the effect of software-induced jitter on decoding performance. Results showed that introducing simulated jitter degraded classification performance to theoretical chance levels (33.20%), confirming hardware synchronization as a strict prerequisite for reliable single-trial decoding. The framework was further validated using a Centroid-PCA-SVM pipeline operating on a 16-channel spatial subset. Using the full proposed architecture, a grand mean classification accuracy of 67.70% was achieved, substantially exceeding the theoretical chance level of 33.33%. The across-participant mean of the maximum fold accuracies reached 83.00%, with individual validation folds achieving up to 90.00%. In contrast, zero-calibration leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) generalization remained at chance level (33.08%; κpooled = -0.0036), indicating limited cross-participant transferability and highlighting the current need for participant-specific calibration or alignment. Overall, these findings demonstrate that hardware-deterministic EEG acquisition enables the recovery of robust trial-by-trial brain dynamics that are typically obscured by conventional averaging approaches. By combining precise synchronization with low-latency algorithmic inference, the proposed framework establishes a foundation for real-time neural decoding and represents a stepping stone for practical brain-computer interfaces and advanced clinical monitoring applications.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电解码自然语音时信噪比低、传统平均化处理掩盖单试次变异的问题，提出一套基于硬件同步与质心分类的单试次解码框架，并以西班牙语元音为对象进行验证。结果显示，硬件级同步是可靠单试次解码的前提，模拟时间抖动会使分类性能降至理论随机水平；在完整框架下，受试者内分类准确率明显高于随机水平，但零校准的跨被试泛化仍停留在随机水平，说明当前仍需被试特异性校准或对齐。作者据此认为，硬件确定性采集有助于恢复被平均化掩盖的逐试次脑动态，为实时神经解码及脑机接口应用奠定基础。

papers.title: Structurally restricted message-passing within shallow architectures for explainable network-level brain decoding on small cohorts.
papers.authors: Marques Dos Santos JD, Ramos MB, Reis LP, Marques Dos Santos JP, Direito B.
papers.abstract: Introduction Applying artificial intelligence to functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has advanced the modelling of neural activity, but deep architectures such as graph neural networks (GNNs) require large samples, limiting their use in the small cohorts typical of task-based fMRI. Shallow neural networks (SNNs) are robust with few samples but treat brain regions independently, overlooking the brain's network organization. We propose a structurally constrained message-passing framework that integrates diffusion-based structural connectivity, from a previously published group connectome, with region-level fMRI signals in a shallow architecture. Methods The task is a binary classification of individual video trials as mentalizing or random, decoded from the fMRI response, in a Theory of Mind paradigm from the Human Connectome Project Young Adult dataset (30 subjects) under subject-wise 3-fold cross-validation. Two shallow classifiers are compared on the same data: the baseline classifies each trial from the regional fMRI signals as independent inputs, whereas the proposed model first applies one message-passing step, replacing each region's signal with a structurally connected combination of its neighbors' signals, so that classification operates at the level of anatomically defined networks. Interpretability is assessed using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations). Results Across folds, the proposed model matches the baseline (mean retrained accuracy 85.1%; 84.7% on the shared partition), the accuracy lost to pruning being recovered by retraining in every fold. The magnitude of the inputs' contributions is reproducible across folds, whereas their direction is not. Only about a quarter of the consistently retained inputs also preserve their sign, so a cross-fold sign-consistency criterion is applied to retain reliable explanations. This identifies seven networks contributing robustly to the mentalizing class, located in the temporo-parietal junction, inferior parietal, and medial temporal cortices and overlapping a literature-based mentalizing map (overlap coefficient 0.383). Within these networks, Cohen's D ranks the relative signal magnitude of the constituent regions. Discussion Overall, structural constraints improve biological interpretability without compromising classification performance, while cross-validation establishes which explanations are stable, offering a compact and interpretable approach to network-level brain decoding in small cohorts and a basis that may be applied to connectivity disorders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种结构受限的消息传递框架，将扩散式结构连接与区域fMRI信号结合于浅层网络，用于小样本下的网络级脑解码，并在心智化任务中与逐区域独立输入的基线分类器比较。结果显示，所提模型分类表现与基线相当，结构约束未损害解码性能；输入贡献的幅度可跨折复现，但方向不稳定，因此作者用跨折符号一致性筛选可靠解释，识别出若干稳定贡献于心智化类别的网络，并与文献中的心智化图谱部分重叠。作者据此认为，结构约束在保持分类表现的同时提升了生物学可解释性，为小队列网络级解码提供了紧凑且可解释的途径，并可能为连接障碍研究提供基础。

papers.title: Effects of different morphological types of enlarged vestibular aqueduct on clinical onset and cochlear implantation.
papers.authors: Zhu P, Ni K, Li XY, Chen ZN.
papers.abstract: Objective To investigate the influence of different morphological features of the enlarged vestibular aqueduct (EVA) on clinical onset and postoperative speech rehabilitation outcomes in pediatric patients undergoing cochlear implantation (CI) at our institution. Methods A retrospective analysis was conducted on children diagnosed with EVA who underwent primary CI at our hospital. Clinical data, audiological profiles, and imaging characteristics were reviewed. Patients were categorized based on hearing loss (HL) symmetry: symmetric HL group (interaural threshold difference < 20 dB) and asymmetric HL group (difference ≥ 20 dB). The symmetric HL group was further stratified by age of onset into early-onset and late-onset subgroups. Based on disease progression, patients were classified into sudden HL and fluctuating HL subgroups. Radiological measurements included the vestibular aqueduct (VA) aperture angle and length. Postoperative speech outcomes in the early-onset subgroup were followed up at 1-6 years post-CI and compared with a matched control group of children with normal inner ear structures undergoing CI during the same period. Results Eighty-one children with EVA were enrolled. Fifty-six cases presented with symmetric HL, while 25 cases exhibited asymmetric HL. Regarding progression patterns, 24 cases were classified as fluctuating HL and 25 as sudden HL. In the symmetric HL group, the early-onset subgroup demonstrated significantly larger bilateral VA aperture angles and shorter bilateral VA lengths compared to the late-onset subgroup. In the asymmetric HL group, the ear with worse HL had a larger VA aperture angle but a shorter VA length than the better-hearing ear. Postoperative speech performance improved over time in both groups; however, the early-onset subgroup consistently scored lower across all four speech evaluation metrics at 1-6 years post-CI compared to the control group. Conclusion A wide and shallow vestibular aqueduct appears to render children more susceptible to inner ear damage induced by intracranial pressure fluctuations. This morphological predisposition likely contributes to earlier onset, greater severity, and more sudden progression of hearing loss, ultimately compromising postoperative speech rehabilitation outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究回顾性分析了接受人工耳蜗植入的儿童大前庭导水管（EVA）患者，按听力损失对称性、起病年龄和进展方式分组，并测量前庭导水管开口角度与长度，以考察不同形态特征与临床起病及术后言语康复的关系。结果显示，早发起病者及听力较差一侧的导水管更宽、更短，提示宽而浅的形态可能使内耳更易受颅内压波动损伤，从而与更早起病、更重及更突然的听力下降相关。术后言语能力随时间改善，但早发组在多个言语评估指标上持续低于内耳结构正常的对照组，作者据此认为这种形态易感可能影响术后言语康复效果。

papers.title: Clinical efficacy and neural mechanisms of Tuina for primary dysmenorrhea with cold congestion and blood stasis pattern: a protocol for a randomized controlled fMRI trial.
papers.authors: Lin Y, Jiang C, You M, Chen S, Huang H, Zhang H, Chen L, Lin Z.
papers.abstract: Background Primary dysmenorrhea (PD) is one of the most common gynecological disorders in women of reproductive age and significantly impairs quality of life. Epidemiological data indicate that the cold congestion and blood stasis pattern accounts for a large proportion of PD cases. Tuina, a traditional Chinese external therapy, has unique advantages in pain management; however, its clinical efficacy and central mechanisms for PD remain unclear. Objective This study aims to conduct an assessor-blind, parallel-group randomized controlled superiority trial, integrating functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), to evaluate the clinical efficacy, safety, and central brain network modulation of Tuina therapy for primary dysmenorrhea with the cold congestion and blood stasis pattern. Methods This study employed a randomized controlled trial design. A total of 54 patients who met the diagnostic criteria were recruited and randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to either the treatment or control group. An additional 15 healthy women were included as the healthy group. Participants in the treatment group received standardized manipulation over two consecutive menstrual cycles. For each cycle, treatment began 7 days before menstruation and was administered once daily for 7 consecutive days. Participants in the control group received conventional oral ibuprofen, taken as needed for pain relief. The primary outcome was the change in the Visual Analog Scale score. Secondary outcomes included the COX Menstrual Symptom Scale, Traditional Chinese Medicine pattern score, sleep index, and psychological assessments. All outcomes were evaluated at three time points: baseline, after the first treatment cycle, and after the second treatment cycle. All participants underwent two fMRI sessions-both resting-state and task-state fMRI scans-during days 1-3 of their menstrual cycle: once before enrollment and once after the treatment period. All statistical analyses followed the intention-to-treat principle. Discussion This study aims to provide high-level clinical evidence on pain relief, symptom improvement, and brain functional network regulation for the treatment of cold congestion stasis type dysmenorrhea with Tuina therapy, using a randomized controlled trial design combined with functional magnetic resonance imaging. Clinical trial registration https://itmctr.ccebtcm.org.cn, International Traditional Medicine Clinical Trial Registry ITMCTR2026001387.
keywords: Cold Congestion And Blood Stasis Pattern
papers.summary_zh: 这是一项评估者盲、平行组随机对照优效性试验方案，拟结合功能磁共振成像，考察推拿对寒凝血瘀型原发性痛经的临床疗效、安全性及中枢脑网络调节作用。研究将符合诊断标准的患者随机分为推拿组和口服布洛芬对照组，并纳入健康女性作为参照，在多个月经周期前后比较疼痛及相关症状变化，同时采集静息态和任务态脑影像。由于目前仅为研究方案，摘要尚未报告实际疗效或脑机制结果，其预期贡献在于为推拿镇痛及脑功能网络调控提供随机对照证据。

papers.title: Writing is thinking: toward a neuropsychological model of scientific writing as knowledge construction.
papers.authors: Ríos-Flórez JA, Muñoz-Giraldo AJ, Rodríguez Bustamante A, Castañeda-Quirama T.
papers.abstract: Scientific writing has historically been conceptualized as a communicative act-the registration of knowledge elaborated through independent cognitive processes. This article challenges that assumption and proposes that scientific writing constitutes an active neurocognitive system of knowledge construction and a privileged domain for metacognitive self-regulation in advanced learning contexts. We present the Integrated Neuropsychological Model of Scientific Writing (MNIEC), a theoretical framework integrating four neurocognitive systems-the Constructive Executive System (CES), the Extended Working Memory System (EWMS), the Semantic Simulation System (SSS), and the Epistemological Metacognitive Monitoring System (EMMS)-within a unified functional architecture. The central mechanism is the Epistemological Construction Cycle (ECC), a recursive five-phase process-conceptual activation, working memory simulation, symbolic externalization, metacognitive evaluation, and conceptual reorganization-through which scientific writing can function as an active mechanism of knowledge construction, particularly when recursive metacognitive evaluation and conceptual reorganization are engaged. The model integrates evidence from executive function neuropsychology, working memory architecture, large-scale brain network dynamics, epistemological metacognition, and predictive coding, grounded in five nuclear principles. Four testable hypotheses and experimental paradigms are derived. Implications are discussed for metacognitive training in scientific education, academic impostor syndrome, and the cognitive impact of large language models. The MNIEC proposes a neuropsychological framework for a systematic research agenda on scientific writing as metacognitive knowledge construction.
papers.summary_zh: 该文挑战“科学写作只是把独立认知过程产出的知识记录下来的交流行为”这一传统看法，提出科学写作本身构成一个主动的知识建构神经认知系统。作者构建了整合神经心理学模型（MNIEC），将建构性执行、扩展工作记忆、语义模拟和认识论元认知监控四个系统纳入统一功能架构，核心是包含概念激活、工作记忆模拟、符号外化、元认知评估与概念重组五个阶段的递归循环，认为当递归的元认知评估和概念重组被调动时，写作才成为知识建构的主动机制。该模型整合了执行功能、工作记忆、大规模脑网络动力学、认识论元认知和预测编码等证据，并据此提出可检验假设和实验范式，讨论了对科学教育中的元认知训练、学术冒名顶替感及大语言模型认知影响的启示。需注意，这是理论框架而非实证研究，其假设尚待检验。

papers.title: Vision-language semantic guidance and topology refinement for robust retinal vessel segmentation and biomarker analysis in cerebral small vessel disease.
papers.authors: Hua S, Chen T, Mi Y, Shen Y, Li Y, Zhang J, Ji Y.
papers.journal: Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
papers.abstract: Background Retinal microvascular alterations observed in optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) have emerged as promising biomarkers for cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD). However, accurate quantification of OCTA-derived vascular biomarkers remains challenging due to imaging noise, projection artifacts, low contrast, and structural discontinuities, which often lead to unreliable vessel segmentation and distorted vascular topology. Purpose To address these challenges, we propose SemTopNet, a semantic-topology joint modeling framework for OCTA vessel segmentation. Methods The proposed framework integrates vision-language semantic guidance, centerline-guided topology refinement, and uncertainty-aware adaptive supervision within a unified architecture. Specifically, semantic embeddings are incorporated to enhance global structural representation, while a centerline-guided topology refinement module explicitly improves vascular continuity and suppresses fragmented predictions. In addition, Monte Carlo dropout-based uncertainty estimation is employed to improve robustness in ambiguous and low signal-to-noise regions. Results Extensive experiments on a CSVD OCTA dataset demonstrate that SemTopNet consistently outperforms existing convolutional and Transformer-based segmentation methods, achieving the best performance in Dice similarity coefficient (0.8931), clDice (0.9027), Recall (0.9293), and AUC (0.9567). Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of semantic modeling, topology-aware refinement, and uncertainty-aware supervision. Based on the obtained segmentation results, quantitative retinal vascular biomarkers were further analyzed, revealing significant layer-dependent microvascular alterations in CSVD patients, particularly in the deep vascular complex (DVC). Conclusion These findings demonstrate that topology-consistent OCTA vessel segmentation is essential for reliable retinal microvascular quantification. The proposed SemTopNet provides a robust framework for OCTA biomarker extraction and retinal-cerebral vascular association analysis in CSVD-related studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑小血管病（CSVD）OCTA图像中噪声、投影伪影和血管结构不连续导致血管分割与拓扑量化不可靠的问题，提出语义-拓扑联合建模框架SemTopNet，融合视觉-语言语义引导、中心线引导的拓扑细化与不确定性感知监督。在CSVD的OCTA数据集上，该框架在Dice、clDice、Recall和AUC等指标上优于现有卷积和Transformer分割方法，消融实验也支持各模块的作用。基于分割结果提取的视网膜血管生物标志物显示，CSVD患者存在层依赖的微血管改变，尤其见于深层血管复合体，提示拓扑一致的血管分割是可靠量化的前提。

papers.title: Structure and function of corpus callosum modified by common variation in the ROBO1 gene
papers.authors: Rinne N, Sahari E, Tolonen T, Einarsdóttir E, Salmitaival J, Alho K, Kere J, Wikman P.
papers.abstract: The corpus callosum (CC) connects the cerebral hemispheres and enables interhemispheric communication that supports numerous cognitive functions, including reading. ROBO1, a dyslexia susceptibility gene involved in axonal midline crossing, has previously been associated with CC structure, but its relationship with the functional organisation of cerebral reading networks remains unclear. Here, we examined associations between ROBO1 variation, CC structure, reading-related brain function, and reading performance in 178 typically reading adolescents and young adults. Variation across five ROBO1 single nucleotide polymorphisms was summarised using principal component analysis. The resulting PC1 score was examined in relation to fractional anisotropy (FA) and tract count across five CC subdivisions, as well as reading-related activation and functional connectivity in cortical regions connected by these pathways. A greater number of rare alleles across the examined variants was associated with lower FA in the central, middle posterior, and posterior CC. ROBO1 variation was also associated with activation in cortical regions corresponding to the endpoints of the CC tracts, as well as with reading-related functional connectivity between these endpoint regions and clusters in the left temporoparietal cortex and right temporal pole. However, neither ROBO1 variation nor CC structure explained reading performance, suggesting that ROBO1 may contribute to individual differences in the structure and function of interhemispheric language networks even in the absence of measurable behavioural differences.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在典型阅读发展的青少年和年轻成人中，考察了阅读障碍易感基因ROBO1的常见变异与胼胝体结构、阅读相关脑功能及阅读表现之间的关系，用主成分分析概括多个单核苷酸多态性变异，并结合弥散张量成像与功能成像指标进行分析。结果显示，携带更多罕见等位基因与胼胝体中央、中后及后部亚区的各向异性降低相关；ROBO1变异还对应胼胝体纤维端点所在皮层的激活，以及这些端点区域与左颞顶皮层、右颞极之间的阅读相关功能连接。不过，ROBO1变异和胼胝体结构均未解释阅读表现，提示该基因可能参与半球间语言网络结构与功能的个体差异，而这种差异未必伴随可测量的行为变化。

papers.title: Music Therapy for Reduction of Anhedonia: Protocol for a Sequential Mixed Methods Pre-Post Pilot Study.
papers.authors: McFerran KS, Jamieson AJ, Blunck Y, Glarin R, Elliott J, Hillman KB, Bolger LE.
papers.abstract: Background The transdiagnostic symptom of anhedonia, or the loss of pleasure in previously pleasurable things, is common across several chronic physical and mental illnesses. Music therapy has been effective in treating a range of conditions associated with anhedonia, but only 3 cases have been reported that targeted increasing hedonic capacity and all relied on descriptive data (qualitative and quantitative). Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) evidence demonstrates that pleasure is associated with increased activity in the limbic system, including the anterior cingulate cortex, as well as the prefrontal cortex. As such, changes within these regions may provide objective evidence to explore how music therapy acts to reduce anhedonia symptomatology. Objective Our primary aim is to examine the feasibility of a music therapy intervention to increase hedonic capacity among individuals with anhedonia. We also aim to examine congruence across psychometric results and interview data to generate estimates of effect size and explore participants' qualitative experiences. In addition, we aim to identify any correspondence between these outcomes and changes in brain activity associated with reward processing during targeted fMRI tasks. This study will generate hypotheses for testing in future studies. Methods This pilot study uses a sequential mixed methods design to first identify whether there are pre-post changes in the primary outcome measures and then to identify correlations between interview data, psychometric data, and objective measures of brain structure and functioning (fMRI). Participants were 13 adults with high cognitive function who scored within the clinical range for anhedonia on the Dimensional Anhedonia Rating Scale (DARS). Participants were engaged in a 4-month music therapy intervention developed through preliminary case studies, which involved daily independent pleasure-focused music activities and regular contact with a therapeutic guide. The fMRI data acquired include resting-state fMRI and task-based functional paradigms designed to probe musical pleasure (music listening task) and reward prediction (reversal reward learning task). Data will be analyzed using individual general linear models to identify associations with symptom improvement, as well as longitudinal changes in functioning. Results The study received internal funding support from the University of Melbourne in September 2024. Data collection commenced in August 2025 and was concluded by mid-2026. As of September 2026, 13 participants have been recruited, and data will be analyzed by the end of 2026, with results expected to be published in 2027. Conclusions The results of this pilot study will contribute to knowledge about the effects of this music therapy intervention on reducing anhedonia and introduce a study protocol that could be used in subsequent, more robust studies to explore potential mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究是一项序贯混合方法前后测预试验的方案报告，旨在考察音乐治疗提升快感缺失者愉悦能力的可行性，并探索心理测量、访谈数据与奖赏相关脑活动变化之间是否对应。研究招募了快感缺失评分处于临床范围的成年人，接受为期数月、以日常自主音乐愉悦活动结合治疗师定期联系为主的干预，同时采集静息态和任务态功能磁共振数据。摘要仅报告了招募与数据收集进度，尚未给出干预效果或脑活动变化的结果，因此目前无法判断该干预是否有效；作者预期这些发现将为后续更严格的研究提供假设和方案基础。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Gene Delivery Systems in Dementia: A Comprehensive Review of Mechanisms, Tools, and Therapeutic Strategies.
papers.authors: Wal A, Shukla M, Wal P, Singh S, Chaurasia B, Jayasingh Chellammal HS, Gasmi A.
papers.abstract: Introduction/objective The progressive nature of dementia is represented by a reduction in two or more cognitive functions, including language, memory, executive and visuospatial functioning, personality, and behavior. Only symptoms can be alleviated by traditional medication therapies. A strategy that shows promise for focused and customized interventions is gene therapy, especially when combined with artificial intelligence (AI).This review investigates the integration of AI with gene delivery technologies to enhance the accuracy, effectiveness, and personalization of dementia therapies. Method PRISMA guidelines were followed in conducting a systematic review. A literature search for English-language articles published between 2012 and 2026 was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar. Peer-reviewed original research, computational studies, or reviews; attention to AI in the context of gene delivery in dementia; and pertinence to biological mechanisms or therapeutic approaches were the inclusion criteria. Non-English papers, conference abstracts, letters, editorials, and research unrelated to gene delivery or dementia were among the exclusion criteria. The full texts, abstracts, and titles were vetted by two separate reviewers. Discussions or seeking advice from a third reviewer were used to settle disagreements. Results AI has proven to be very helpful in predicting therapeutic targets, optimizing gene vectors, and customizing dementia treatment plans. Using machine learning and deep learning approaches, it also makes gene-target prediction, nanocarrier optimization, and post-treatment monitoring easier. These methods improve vector design, find biomarkers, and decode complex genomic data. Precision gene delivery across the blood-brain barrier is now possible because to integration with (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic repeat) CRISPR/Cas9, adeno-associated virus vectors, and lipid nanoparticles, which has increased transfection efficiency and decreased cytotoxicity. Conclusion Precision medicine is becoming possible because of AI frameworks that integrate neuroimaging, multi-omics data, and patient-specific genomic profiles. Notwithstanding the potential, there are still issues including data security, ethical dilemmas, translational barriers, and legal limitations.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA流程系统检索文献，考察人工智能与基因递送技术结合用于痴呆治疗的可能性。作者指出，AI在预测治疗靶点、优化基因载体和个体化治疗方案方面具有价值，机器学习与深度学习可辅助基因靶点预测、纳米载体优化及治疗后监测；与CRISPR/Cas9、腺相关病毒载体和脂质纳米颗粒结合后，有望提升跨血脑屏障递送的精准性、转染效率并降低细胞毒性。作者据此认为，整合神经影像、多组学和患者基因组信息的AI框架正推动痴呆精准医学，但数据安全、伦理、转化和法律限制仍是障碍。

papers.title: Male Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Rare Case of Multisystem Involvement.
papers.authors: Alsaleh A, Alkanhal H.
papers.abstract: Background Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic autoimmune disease with diverse clinical manifestations. Although SLE predominantly affects women, male patients may present atypically, leading to diagnostic challenges and delays in treatment. Neuropsychiatric involvement and lupus nephritis represent severe manifestations associated with increased morbidity. Case presentation A 31-year-old man presented with fatigue, joint pain, fever, and a photosensitive skin rash. Laboratory investigations showed positive antinuclear antibodies and elevated anti-double-stranded DNA levels. Brain MRI demonstrated scattered T2-weighted and FLAIR hyperintensities suggestive of central nervous system vasculitis, while renal biopsy confirmed class IV lupus nephritis. The patient was treated with corticosteroids, hydroxychloroquine, and mycophenolate mofetil. Follow-up MRI and MRA performed after three weeks showed partial resolution of white matter lesions with stable vasculature. Clinical symptoms improved, and renal function stabilised. Conclusion This case highlights the importance of considering neuropsychiatric SLE in male patients presenting with neurological symptoms and multisystem involvement. MRI and MRA can play an important role in detecting central nervous system involvement and monitoring treatment response, while early recognition and prompt treatment may help prevent irreversible neurological complications.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例31岁男性系统性红斑狼疮病例，该患者以乏力、关节痛、发热和光敏性皮疹就诊，检查发现自身抗体阳性，脑MRI提示中枢神经系统血管炎可能，肾活检证实为IV型狼疮肾炎。患者接受糖皮质激素、羟氯喹和霉酚酸酯治疗后，临床症状改善、肾功能稳定，复查影像显示白质病灶部分消退。作者据此强调，男性患者出现神经系统症状和多系统受累时也应考虑神经精神性狼疮，影像学有助于发现中枢受累并监测治疗反应，早期识别和及时治疗或可减少不可逆的神经并发症。

papers.title: Artifact Removal Quality Assessment (ARQA): A Recording-Level Audit of EEG Artifact Removal Using Internal Preservation Controls
papers.authors: Bosch-Bayard JF, Chacón LM, Guerrero-Sauzameda J, García-Asensi A, Cubero L, Elvira RP, Chiarenza GA, Galán-García L, Mustafa MU, Mushtaq F, Rieger J, Ros T, Evans AC, Valdes-Sosa PA.
papers.abstract: Abstract Artifact-removal procedures are commonly judged by reductions in visible contamination or by diagnostics internal to the algorithm, neither of which guarantees preservation of physiological EEG. We present Artifact Removal Quality Assessment (ARQA), a method-agnostic post hoc audit that uses expert-marked artifact-free segments of the original recording as internal negative controls. Before comparison, ARQA harmonizes the channel set, units, polarity, reference, sampling rate, temporal alignment, and duration. It then reports three distinct domains: preservation in clean windows, artifact suppression in contaminated windows, and the coverage available to estimate each domain. Preservation is quantified using waveform correlation, normalized difference variance, amplitude-scaling ratio, and bandwise spectral change; suppression is evaluated using an artifact-specific marker. We applied ARQA to GEDAI v1.5 and v1.7 outputs from two de-identified, 19-channel, eyes-closed resting-state EEG recordings with contrasting artifact loads. In Recording A, 35.7% of the 2-s windows were available as clean controls. Within those windows, the mean correlation was 0.444 and the normalized difference variance was 82%; across the full recording, delta-band amplitude fell by 91.9%, but alpha-band amplitude also fell by 77.5%, indicating marked nonselective attenuation. In Recording B, 98.6% of the windows were clean controls, the correlation was 0.9973, the normalized difference variance was 0.64%, and clean-window band changes remained within ± 0.6 dB. Only 1.4% of the windows in Recording B were contaminated; thus, suppression efficacy was insufficiently challenged despite excellent preservation. Under GEDAI v1.7, Recording A showed markedly improved preservation (r₁clean 0.718, alpha attenuation at O1 reduced from − 10.1 to − 0.4 dB), while Recording B remained excellent with a small frontal regression; both versions produced identical internal SENSAI scores, confirming that external audit adds information beyond internal diagnostics. These cases show why recording-level quality cannot be inferred from algorithm identity or internal scores alone. ARQA is intended as an auditable profile rather than a universal ranking and complements rather than replaces established cleaning-quality metrics.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种与算法无关的事后审计方法ARQA，以专家标记的原始记录无伪迹片段作为内部阴性对照，在统一通道、单位、极性、参考、采样率、时间对齐和时长后，分别评估干净窗口中的信号保真、污染窗口中的伪迹抑制以及各评估域可用的数据覆盖。作者将其用于两段伪迹负荷不同的静息态脑电记录上GEDAI两个版本的输出：一段记录中干净对照窗口比例较低，虽伪迹频段振幅大幅下降，但alpha频段也明显衰减，提示非选择性削弱；另一段几乎全为干净窗口，保真度很高，却因污染窗口极少而未能充分检验抑制效果。GEDAI新版本改善了前者的保真度，而两版本内部诊断分数相同，说明记录层面的外部审计能提供内部指标之外的信息，但ARQA定位为可审计的质量剖面而非通用排名。

papers.title: Regularity–complexity trade-off of rhythmic auditory cueing in cerebellar ataxia: a single-case series
papers.authors: Bando K, Kodama K, Oba K, Todoroki K, Kato T, Hara T, Takahashi Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Rhythmic auditory stimulation (RAS) reduces gait variability but may attenuate the fractal dynamics underlying adaptive locomotor control. Whether this trade-off occurs in spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA) is unknown. Objectives To determine whether music-based RAS alters step-time regularity and correlation structure in SCA, and to explore correspondence with structural brain profiles. Methods Three patients with cerebellar SCA were studied in an AB single-case design. Each daily session comprised more than 512 consecutive overground steps; baseline sessions (4–10 per patient) were followed by music-based RAS sessions matched to baseline cadence (3–7 per patient). Step-time coefficient of variation (CV) indexed regularity, and the Hurst exponent (H), estimated using the Bayesian Hurst–Kolmogorov method, indexed temporal correlations. Effects were evaluated using Tau-U with 95% confidence intervals. Results CV decreased markedly in two cases (Case 1, 18.2% to 5.4%, Tau-U = − 1.00, p < 0.001; Case 2, 6.6% to 4.5%, Tau-U = − 1.00, p = 0.034). In Case 1, H fell in parallel from 0.87 to 0.34 (Tau-U = − 0.94, p < 0.001), shifting from persistent to antipersistent dynamics. In Case 2, H showed no detectable change, but the confidence interval spanned almost the entire attainable range (Tau-U = − 0.33, 95% CI − 0.87 to 0.56), leaving this comparison uninformative. Neither measure changed in Case 3. Descriptively, the case with the largest regularity improvement had relatively preserved parietal cortical thickness and the highest baseline CV and H. Conclusions In SCA, RAS may improve step-time stability while attenuating temporal correlation structure in some individuals, suggesting a trade-off between regularity and fractal complexity.
papers.summary_zh: 该单例系列研究探讨音乐节律性听觉刺激（RAS）在小脑性脊髓小脑共济失调（SCA）患者中是否会同时改变步时规律性与分形动态，并初步考察其与脑结构特征的对应关系。三名患者接受基线期与RAS期对比，以步时变异系数衡量规律性、以Hurst指数衡量时间相关性。结果显示，两例患者的步时规律性明显提高，其中一例的Hurst指数同步下降、从持续性转为反持续性动态，另一例该指标变化不确定，第三例两项指标均无变化。作者据此提出，RAS在部分SCA个体中可能以削弱步时序列的分形复杂性为代价换取步态稳定性，但这一权衡是否成立仍需更大样本验证。

papers.title: Reduced EEG Complexity and Its Association with Social Communication in Adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Multiscale Entropy Study
papers.authors: Naoe T, Shikauchi Y, Itahashi T, Tanaka K, Okimura T, Hashimoto R, Ohta H, Sato Y, Nakamura M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Brain functions emerge from temporally organized neural dynamics, and an appropriate level of neural complexity may support flexible information processing. Electroencephalographic (EEG) studies using multiscale entropy (MSE), which quantifies signal complexity across multiple temporal scales, have reported reduced MSE at longer scales in individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). However, most evidence comes from studies of infant and child samples, leaving adult data scarce, and the associations between reduced MSE, clinical symptoms, and social information processing are insufficiently understood. Methods We recorded and analyzed EEG data from adults with ASD (n = 47) and typically developing (TD) controls (n = 40) during eyes-closed rest and two movie viewing conditions: Inscapes , comprising dynamically changing abstract visual patterns, and Partly Cloudy , an emotionally engaging animated social narrative. Group and condition effects were assessed using cluster-based permutation tests, and associations between MSE and Social Affect (SA) scores from the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule, Second Edition (ADOS-2), as well as group differences in event-related MSE changes, were examined using linear mixed-effects models. Results Across conditions, adults with ASD showed lower MSE at longer scales (τ = 16–30), corresponding to effective sampling rates of 12.50–6.67 Hz in the coarse-grained time series, than TD adults. Longer-scale MSE within the ASD–TD difference cluster was negatively associated with ADOS-2 SA scores across diagnostic groups. The difference in event-related MSE change between Social and Non-Social conditions, comparing empathic-pain and mentalizing events in Partly Cloudy with temporally matched non-social windows in Inscapes , was smaller in ASD participants than in TD participants. No significant difference between Social and Non-Social windows was observed among ASD participants, whereas TD participants showed significantly greater MSE change during Social than Non-Social windows. Limitations: This study used a modest sample without an independent replication cohort, and the short event windows limited the precision of the MSE estimation. Conclusions Reduced longer-scale MSE extends to adults with ASD and is associated with higher ADOS-2 SA scores across diagnostic groups. Event-related findings further suggest attenuated differentiation of longer-scale MSE between socially relevant and matched non-social windows in ASD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注成人自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）者的大脑信号复杂度是否降低，以及这种降低与社交沟通症状和社交信息加工的关系。研究者采集ASD成人与典型发育成人在闭眼静息及观看抽象动态画面、情感性社交动画时的脑电数据，用多尺度熵衡量不同时间尺度上的信号复杂度。结果显示，ASD成人在较长尺度上的多尺度熵整体低于典型发育者，且该差异范围内较长尺度的熵值与跨诊断组的ADOS-2社交情感得分呈负相关。事件相关分析还提示，典型发育者在社交相关窗口的熵变化明显大于匹配的非社交窗口，而ASD者未见这种差异，组间差异也较小，说明ASD成人对社交与非社交情境的较长尺度熵区分有所减弱。作者指出样本量有限且缺乏独立重复队列，短事件窗口也限制了熵估计的精度。

papers.title: Accelerated Theta Burst Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation to Treat Anorexia Nervosa
papers.authors: Gorrell S, Ray S, Lambert D, Mehta A, Slepneva N, Khim S, Sugrue LP, Lee AM.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Anorexia nervosa (AN) has among the highest mortality rates of all psychiatric disorders. No evidence-based treatments have demonstrated efficacy in adults with AN, and many youth retain severe symptoms even after receiving first-line psychotherapy. Models of eating pathology highlighting the compulsive and habitual nature of AN implicate excessive orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) activity as a potential circuit-based target for neuromodulation. Methods We conducted an open-label accelerated inhibitory theta burst stimulation (TBS) transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) targeting right frontopolar-OFC (FP/OFC) to treat AN paired with pre-/post- functional magnetic resonance imaging (NCT06138782). Results All study participants ( N = 15) completed TMS with no severe adverse events with four subjects being lost to follow up at one month. The primary outcome measures, Eating Disorder Evaluation (EDE) global scores, were significantly decreased at one-month post-treatment compared to baseline ( n = 11; p =.031, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). There was a significant reduction in OCD symptoms as measured by the Y-BOCS-I ( p =.020, Wilcoxon signed-rank test) and depressive symptoms as measured by the MADRS before and after treatment ( p =.002, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). Improvement in Y-BOCS-I positively correlated with improvement in EDE global scores (r = 0.68, Pearson; p =.021, permutations test). We found that the FP/OFC TMS target site, a component of the default mode network (DMN), strongly connected with both the frontal and posterior nodes of the network. Following our accelerated TBS TMS protocol, there was a significant reduction in connectivity between the FP/OFC TMS target and the posterior node of the DMN in the precuneus and a significant reduction in intra-network DMN connectivity ( p =.005, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). The magnitude of the decrease in functional connectivity between the FP/OFC and posterior DMN node was correlated with the degree of improvement in the EDE global score ( p =.026, permutation test). Conclusions Findings suggest that hyperactive DMN circuitry in AN can be targeted using non-invasive neuromodulation to reduce eating disorder symptoms.
papers.summary_zh: 该开放标签研究探讨加速抑制性θ爆发刺激经颅磁刺激靶向右额极-眶额皮层治疗神经性厌食症是否可行并伴随症状与脑连接改变，15名参与者完成治疗且无严重不良事件。治疗后一个月，完成随访者的进食障碍评估全局分显著下降，强迫和抑郁症状也减轻，且强迫症状改善与进食障碍症状改善相关。影像上，靶点与默认网络后部节点的连接及网络内连接均下降，连接下降幅度与症状改善相关。作者据此提出，默认网络环路过度活跃可能是可调控靶点，但开放标签设计尚不能确立因果或疗效。

papers.title: Preserved Alcohol Cue Salience Despite Olfactory Dysfunction Is Associated with Multimodal Alterations in Olfactory–Reward Networks
papers.authors: Agarwal K, Kothekar R, Bassi T, Roy R, Jebel A, Majumdar S, Ahlawat J, Sarkar S, Balhara YPS, Sharma A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Chronic alcohol consumption is associated with olfactory dysfunction, but the neurobiological mechanisms linking impaired olfactory function with alcohol cue responsiveness remain unclear. Ninety-eight alcohol consumers underwent objective olfactory assessment, a behavioral odor-cue task, structural MRI, fixel-based diffusion MRI, and proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS), and were classified as having normal olfactory function (threshold–discrimination score ≥ 16; n = 54) or olfactory dysfunction (score < 16; n = 44). Greater alcohol consumption was associated with poorer olfactory function (r = − 0.28, p < 0.01). Despite olfactory dysfunction, familiarity with alcohol beverage odors was preserved, while alcohol cue-induced craving was greater at the highest alcohol concentration (42.8%; β = 0.67, p = 0.04). Compared to participants with normal olfactory function, those with olfactory dysfunction showed lower cognitive performance (Cohen's d = − 0.58, pFDR = 0.02), smaller thalamic and amygdala volumes (d = − 0.70 and − 0.67, p FDR = 0.01), reduced superior thalamic radiation fibre cross-section (d = − 1.30, p FDR < 0.001), and lower prefrontal glutamate concentration (d = − 0.78, p FDR = 0.01). The neurometabolite (MRS) composite was associated with alcohol consumption (β = 0.52, p < 0.01) and significantly mediated the association between olfactory dysfunction and alcohol consumption. Chronic alcohol consumption is thus associated with impaired olfactory function and coordinated neurometabolic, gray matter, and white matter alterations within an olfactory–reward network. Preserved familiarity and craving responses to alcohol-related odors despite impaired olfactory function suggest selective maintenance of alcohol cue salience and highlight olfactory dysfunction as a potential behavioral marker of alcohol-related brain dysfunction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在饮酒人群中结合嗅觉测评、气味线索行为任务、结构磁共振、弥散磁共振和磁共振波谱，考察嗅觉功能与酒精线索反应的关系。结果发现饮酒越多嗅觉表现越差；即便存在嗅觉功能障碍，对酒精气味的熟悉感仍保留，高浓度酒精气味诱发的渴求反而更强，同时伴有认知表现下降、丘脑和杏仁核体积减小、丘脑上辐射纤维截面减小及前额叶谷氨酸浓度降低，且神经代谢指标可中介嗅觉障碍与饮酒量的关联。作者据此认为慢性饮酒与嗅觉—奖赏网络内神经代谢、灰质和白质的协同改变有关，并提示酒精线索显著性可能被选择性保留，嗅觉障碍或可作为酒精相关脑功能异常的行为标志。

papers.title: Visual Semantics and Multimodal Perception of Digitally Reconstructed Garden Scenes of Jiucheng Palace
papers.authors: Gan J, Wen C, Xiao Y, Liu J, Zhang J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Jiucheng Palace is an important Sui–Tang imperial detached palace garden site, and digital reconstruction is key to understanding its lost spatial form. Existing evaluations emphasize historical evidence and morphological accuracy but lack empirical validation of how reconstructed scenes convey spatial relationships and experiential characteristics. This study established an integrated evaluation framework based on multimodal perception for reconstructed garden scenes. Basing the study on Jiucheng Palace reconstructions, we selected architectural, Mountain–water, and vegetation scenes, quantified features using deep learning–based semantic segmentation, integrated eye-tracking, electroencephalography, and semantic differential data, and conducted immersive validation. Results showed significant differences in multiple subjective ratings and Alpha power, but not eye-tracking measures; Spearman analysis revealed associations between visual semantic features, subjective evaluations, and perceptual responses. A comprehensive evaluation matrix, Perceived Garden Experience, and Perceptual Effectiveness Index extended assessment from morphological accuracy to spatial expression and experience conveyance, providing quantitative support for reconstruction comparison and presentation optimization.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对九成宫数字复原场景，提出一套基于多模态感知的综合评价框架，用以检验复原场景能否传达空间关系与体验特征。作者选取建筑、山水和植被三类场景，用深度学习语义分割量化视觉特征，并结合眼动、脑电与语义差异量表开展沉浸式验证。结果显示，主观评分和Alpha功率在场景间存在显著差异，眼动指标则未见显著差异；视觉语义特征、主观评价与感知反应之间存在关联。研究据此构建综合评价矩阵、感知园林体验与感知有效性指数，将评估从形态准确性扩展到空间表达与体验传达，为复原方案比较和展示优化提供量化依据。

papers.title: XAI-AttnFusionNet+: Explainable Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Early Screening of Pediatric Language Impairment Using rs-fMRI with Hierarchical Attention Fusion
papers.authors: Hasan MA, Abdullah Z, Nity FS.
papers.abstract: Pediatric Language Impairment requires timely and consistent screening to enable early intervention and to improve long-term developmental outcomes. Nevertheless, current methods struggle to extract clinically relevant biomarkers from high-dimensional and heterogeneous neuroimaging data, particularly when multimodal analyses and interpretable modeling are not involved. To address these limitations, this paper presents XAI-AttnFusionNet+, an explainable multimodal deep learning model for early-stage Language Impairment screening with early childhood resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI). The proposed model integrates spatial patterns of brain activation, dynamic functional connectivity, and clinical phenotypic characteristics through a hierarchical attention-based fusion mechanism enabling adaptive modality weighting and improved representation learning. To enhance transparency and clinical interpretability, post hoc explainability methods, such as attention visualization, Grad-CAM, and SHAP, were employed to identify discriminative brain regions and feature contributions. The framework was evaluated on a multicenter pediatric cohort of 255 subjects based on ABIDE II using a Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) validation protocol and further evaluated for cross-dataset generalization using ABIDE I. In the absence of Language Impairment annotations, proxy labels were constructed based on phenotypic language indicators. The performance of XAI-AttnFusionNet+ with an accuracy of 93.3% and an AUC of 0.968 outperforms the traditional unimodal baseline models and demonstrates strong cross-site generalization. The results indicate the potential of the proposed framework as a neuroimaging-based approach for early detection of Language Impairment risk. However, its deployment in real-world settings requires further validation using clinically annotated datasets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对儿童语言障碍早期筛查中高维多模态神经影像数据难以提取临床相关生物标志物的问题，提出了可解释的多模态深度学习框架XAI-AttnFusionNet+，利用静息态功能磁共振成像，通过分层注意力融合机制整合脑激活空间模式、动态功能连接与临床表型特征，并借助注意力可视化、Grad-CAM和SHAP等方法提升模型透明度。研究在多中心儿童队列上采用留一被试交叉验证，并在另一数据集上检验跨数据集泛化；由于缺乏语言障碍标注，研究以表型语言指标构建替代标签。结果显示该框架的筛查准确率和AUC优于传统单模态基线模型，并表现出较强的跨站点泛化能力，提示其作为基于神经影像的早期风险筛查方法的潜力，但作者强调真实场景部署仍需在具有临床标注的数据集上进一步验证。

papers.title: Localized Tuning Fields for 3D Hand Position in the Primary Motor Cortex and Premotor Cortex of Macaques.
papers.authors: Cao 曹盛浩 S, Tian 田凯茜 K, Yu 余山 S.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: A central question in motor neuroscience is how the brain represents the state of the limbs to guide volitional movements. While the primate motor cortex is known to encode movement kinematics, such as velocity and direction, whether it also maintains a direct and explicit representation of hand position in 3D space remains debated. To address this, we recorded the activity of single neurons in the primary motor cortex (M1) and dorsal premotor cortex (PMd) of two male rhesus macaques performing a naturalistic, self-paced 3D reach-and-grasp task. We found significant populations of neurons in both M1 (36.2%) and PMd (21.3%) that are robustly tuned to the instantaneous 3D position of the hand. In these neurons, the tuning for hand position-characterized by localized, elongated fields-coexists with tunings for other kinematic variables, reflecting the principle of mixed selectivity. Critically, the spatial organization of these representations differs between the two areas: M1 fields are systematically oriented along cardinal axes and exhibit multiscale spatial clustering, whereas PMd fields are more randomly organized. Furthermore, a small subset of these hand position-tuned cells is sufficient to decode the hand's 3D trajectory with high fidelity. Our findings demonstrate that an explicit and functionally organized representation of 3D hand position is a fundamental component of primate motor cortex, complementing dynamic motor signals to support high-fidelity motor control.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨灵长类运动皮层是否直接表征手在三维空间中的位置。研究者记录两只雄性猕猴在执行自然伸手抓握任务时初级运动皮层和背侧前运动皮层的单神经元活动，发现两区均存在对手的瞬时三维位置稳健调谐的神经元群体，且这种位置调谐与其他运动学变量的调谐共存，体现混合选择性。两区在空间组织上存在差异：初级运动皮层的位置调谐野沿基本轴系统排列并呈多尺度空间聚集，而前运动皮层则较为随机。少量位置调谐细胞即可高保真解码手的三维轨迹，提示明确且具功能组织的手位置表征是灵长类运动皮层的基本组成，与动态运动信号互补以支持精细运动控制。

papers.title: Tuft Dendrite Spikes Are Accompanied by Selective Input From Distinct Functional Networks.
papers.authors: Gable J, Newman ZL, Young S, Scheib J, Bliese S, Miller N, Kerlin A.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: The tuft dendrites of layer 5 (L5) neurons can support regenerative events-dendritic spikes-that have been proposed to coordinate context-specific engagement and plasticity within cortical networks. However, it remains unclear whether tuft spikes are accompanied by input activity with dynamics that could support these network-level functions. To address this, glutamatergic synapses and postsynaptic calcium signals were simultaneously imaged in the tuft dendrites of L5 extratelencephalic neurons within the premotor cortex of mice of either sex performing a cued directional licking task. Trial-to-trial, the generation of tuft spikes was associated with a multiphasic elevation in synaptic activity spanning hundreds of milliseconds. This activity was highly specific to the dendrite in which a spike was detected, suggesting the concurrent activation of select subnetworks. Synapses that were strongly coupled to the overall population were the most synchronized with tuft spikes and preferentially encoded the transition between the preparation and action epochs of the task. Even among these strongly coupled synapses, increases in activity were largely specific to synapses located on the spiking dendrite. Surprisingly, among synapses with the poorest population coupling, a second population of coactive synapses was discovered that was also associated with tuft spikes and functionally selective for task-outcome. These results suggest that tuft spikes may be particularly driven by inputs from neurons that are both embedded in sparse subnetworks and synchronized through coupling to larger-scale functional networks.

papers.title: Homeostatic Coupling of Cortical and Brainstem Delta Rhythms in Sleeping Infant Rats.
papers.authors: Ahmad M, Sokoloff G, Blumberg MS.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: The emergence of the cortical delta rhythm (1-4 Hz) during quiet sleep (QS) is a major milestone in brain development. In rats, this milestone is achieved between 8 and 12 d of postnatal (P) age. We previously reported an age-dependent increase in delta-rhythmic activity in the medullary parafacial zone (PZ) that is synchronized with cortical delta and entrained by breathing. Here, we ask whether this long-distance synchrony persists in response to perturbations to sleep homeostasis or respiration. Using male and female P12 rats, we investigated the coupling strength between the frontal cortex and PZ in response to a short but intense period of sleep deprivation. During recovery sleep, we observed similar rebounds in delta power in PZ and cortex, even in the absence of increased QS duration. Analyses of phase-locking and lagged cross-correlation revealed persistent temporal coupling between the two rhythms such that cortical delta reliably lagged PZ delta regardless of changes in sleep pressure. Curiously, we also observed an increase in the depth of breathing during recovery sleep, which we confirmed in a separate cohort of pups. Next, using moderate hypercapnia (5% CO2 ) to perturb the respiratory system, we observed similar decreases in cortical and PZ delta power along with QS-dependent decreases in the depth of breathing. These findings provide additional support for the hypothesis that, at the onset of their developmental emergence, PZ and cortical delta are interconnected components of a sleep-homeostatic system that is also intimately tied with the brainstem respiratory network.

papers.title: Cycle-by-Cycle Respiration Waveforms Are Coupled with the Shape of Neural Oscillations.
papers.authors: Kosik-Rose E, Zhou G, Sheriff A, Rosenow JM, Schuele SU, Oluigbo CO, Teti SA, Koubeissi M, Mowla MR, Rhone AE, Kumar S, Dlouhy B, Zelano C, Voytek B.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Beyond sustaining life, breathing is a vital physiological rhythm that shapes cognition, perception, emotional regulation, and mental health. Breathing has a direct effect on neuronal excitability and is coupled to neural oscillations across a variety of brain regions. Notably, both respiration and neural oscillations are asymmetric and not perfectly rhythmic: for example, every breath has a different shape and duration and is interspersed with variable pauses. Here, we examined the coupling between breathing and the brain by quantifying the nonsinusoidal features of each breath and comparing it to the shape of each corresponding neural oscillation cycle. By leveraging invasive human brain recordings from 16 participants (8 female, 8 male), we found respiration-neural waveform coupling on a breath-by-breath, cycle-by-cycle basis across limbic and cortical forebrain regions. For decades, the dominant perspective on cognition and mental health have focused on the brain, but recent work is highlighting the importance of brain-body interactions. Our results show that the coupling between breathing and neural activity is much richer than previously appreciated, and our approach opens new avenues for studying these peripheral-to-central nervous system interactions in a more robust, temporally precise manner.

papers.title: Task Context Modulates the Selectivity of Macaque Superior Temporal Sulcus Neurons for Partially Occluded Bodies.
papers.authors: Nejad GG, Bahrami A, Bognár A, Mukovskiy A, Giese M, Vogels R.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Most single-unit studies of animate object processing in the primate ventral visual stream rely on passive fixation, leaving it unclear whether neuronal selectivity for socially relevant stimuli depends on behavioral context. Here, we tested whether task demands alter the selectivity of neurons in the ventral bank of the superior temporal sulcus (STS) for body pose or viewpoint. Male rhesus monkeys viewed identical body stimuli (monkey avatars) under two conditions: a task in which body pose was behaviorally relevant and a condition in which the same stimuli were irrelevant for obtaining a reward. Task context modulated STS responses: neuronal responses were stronger and more selective when stimuli were task-relevant, yielding improved decoding performance compared with the task-irrelevant condition. These effects were most pronounced for partially occluded bodies, indicating that task demands enhance processing under challenging visual conditions. Despite these modulations, the overall impact of task context was modest relative to the neurons' intrinsic selectivity, and stimulus preference rankings remained largely stable across tasks. For partially occluded bodies, task-dependent effects were observed in both middle and anterior STS, with a tendency for earlier modulation in middle STS, consistent with hierarchical processing. These findings suggest that STS neurons maintain largely stable body selectivity across behavioral contexts, while task relevance enhances response gain and selectivity, particularly when visual information is degraded. More generally, this study helps reconcile previous conflicting reports of task context modulations in the macaque inferior temporal cortex by showing that task effects are present but relatively subtle and depend on stimulus conditions.

papers.title: Functional Distinctions between the Auditory Cortex and Frontoparietal Network in the Encoding of Speech Features.
papers.authors: Ou Y, Kay KN, Oxenham AJ.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Neural representations of acoustic features that are key to speech perception have been studied extensively within the auditory cortex (AC), but their representations in higher-order cortical regions remain poorly understood. This study investigates the cortical encoding of three acoustic features in spoken vowels to delineate the functional distinctions across different cortical regions. We used ultra-high-field functional magnetic resonance imaging while human participants of both sexes listened to vowels and were asked to identify three aspects: vowel identity (probing spectral content), speaker identity (probing primarily fundamental frequency), and pitch glide direction (probing spectrotemporal modulation). Three brain regions exhibited selectivity to these features: the AC, premotor cortex (PMC), and the intraparietal sulcus (IPS). The AC demonstrated an encoding hierarchy across features, with significantly stronger encoding robustness for vowel identity than for speaker identity or pitch glide direction. In contrast, both the PMC and IPS showed uniform encoding robustness across all three features, likely reflecting their equal relevance for the identification task. Furthermore, during silent trials when participants were queried about the identity of the prior sound, AC showed no activity, whereas the PMC and IPS exhibited robust activation that was modulated by behavioral performance. These findings indicate functionally distinct roles between sensory and higher-order cortical regions: the stimulus-driven AC encodes feature-specific acoustic information, whereas the domain-general frontoparietal network performs task-relevant cognitive processing that supports goal-directed behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语音关键声学特征在大脑皮层中的编码方式，比较听觉皮层与高级皮层区域的功能分工。研究者用超高场功能磁共振成像，让参与者在听元音时分别判断元音身份、说话者身份和音高滑动方向。结果发现，听觉皮层对元音身份特征的编码明显强于其他特征，呈现特征间的编码层级；而前运动皮层和顶内沟对三类特征的编码强度相近，可能反映这些特征对当前判断任务同等重要。在无声音、仅要求回忆先前声音的试次中，听觉皮层无明显活动，前运动皮层和顶内沟则出现与行为表现相关的激活。作者据此认为，由刺激驱动的听觉皮层负责编码特定声学信息，而领域一般性的额顶网络承担任务相关的认知加工，支持目标导向行为。

papers.title: Resolving the Abstract-Concrete Paradox in the Angular Gyrus: A Multimethod Investigation.
papers.authors: Chiou R, Branzi FM, Jefferies E.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Despite its well-established role in memory-guided cognition, whether and how the angular gyrus (AG) contributes to semantic processing remains unresolved. Connectomic work links the AG to abstract mentation, yet neuroimaging studies paradoxically show greater AG engagement for concrete than abstract semantics. To address this discrepancy, we conducted a multimethod investigation integrating neurostimulation, neuroimaging, and experience sampling across five studies (127 human participants; 53 males; 74 females). Using the contrast between concrete and abstract semantics as a diagnostic test case, we show that this apparent contradiction reflects multiple interacting neurocognitive factors shaping the AG's functional repertoire. In Study 1, causal disruption of the AG disproportionately impaired abstract semantics and temporary retention of task-relevant information, demonstrating its role in abstract and memory-guided cognition. In Study 2, the apparent concreteness effect was abolished after controlling for performance speed/accuracy, indicating that AG activity is more strongly associated with low-demand mental states than semantic concreteness. In Study 3, the AG showed enhanced functional coupling with regions in the semantic network for abstract words, suggesting sustained integration with the semantic system despite reduced activation. In Study 4, experience sampling showed that concrete words are associated with experiences of mental imagery and automaticity, providing a phenomenological account of heightened AG engagement under low-demand states. Finally, Study 5 clarified how baseline choices influence the interpretation and polarity of AG activity. Together, these findings show that AG engagement is best understood along a continuum of memory-guided cognition, clarifying when and why this region supports abstract versus concrete semantics across situations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对角回在语义加工中作用的一个矛盾现象展开：连接组研究将其与抽象思维相联系，而神经影像却常见具体语义引发更强角回活动。作者整合神经调控、神经影像与经验采样等多种方法，以具体与抽象语义的对比为切入点，提出这一矛盾源于多种神经认知因素的交互。结果显示，因果性干扰角回会不成比例地损害抽象语义及任务相关信息的短暂保持；控制反应速度与正确率后，表面的具体性效应消失，角回活动更多与低需求心理状态相关；抽象词条件下角回与语义网络的功能耦合增强；具体词则伴随心理意象和自动化体验。作者据此认为，角回参与应沿记忆引导认知的连续体来理解，这有助于说明其在何种情境下支持抽象或具体语义。

papers.title: Deterministic dynamics of distributional multi-agent reinforcement learning.
papers.authors: Bergerot C, Romanczuk P, Barfuss W.
papers.abstract: Understanding how cognition shapes behavior across contexts remains a fundamental challenge for many disciplines. In particular, for the optimism heuristic-i.e., the tendency to overweight positive (relative to negative) information-knowledge remains fragmented, with models developed in specific domains in isolation. Here, we present a unifying computational framework by deriving the deterministic dynamics of distributional multi-agent reinforcement learning. Our approach discretizes return distributions through a finite set of neurons, consistent with recent empirical findings on distributional coding in the brain. We validate our framework by reproducing established results across three iconic domains spanning individual bandit choice under resource variability, social coordination, and risky choice. Beyond validation, we uncover novel interactions among optimism, return discretization, and temporal discounting. Specifically, we identify conditions under which return discretization generates choice hysteresis and, in extreme parameter regimes, inescapable perseveration. We further reveal "individual dilemmas": circumstances where agents gravitate toward suboptimal yet stable strategies, offering a mechanistic explanation for incoherent choice patterns. Our framework bridges neuroscience, psychology, and collective behavior, enabling empirically testable hypotheses about how cognitive biases propagate from individual cognition to social outcomes in complex environments.

papers.title: A Scoping Review of Neurobiological and Brain Structural Alterations Following Child Exposure to Intimate Partner Violence.
papers.authors: Gregorini C, Sacchi C, De Carli P.
papers.abstract: Intimate partner violence (IPV) is one global issue that can lead to neurobiological consequences and affect brain development across the lifetime. However, evidence is scattered across domains and age groups, making it difficult to map the breadth of empirical findings regarding exposure to IPV. This scoping review aimed to map existing evidence in relation to the neuorbiological mechanisms and brain structural outcomes in child exposed to IPV, extending the focus to the potential stability of such consequences in adulthood. Searches were conducted in Scopus, PubMed, PsycINFO, and Web of Science for studies published between 2000 and 2025. Eligible studies included peer-reviewed quantitative research reporting measures of neurobiological mechanisms (stress physiology, inflammatory or cellular markers, autonomic or neurochemical profiles, genetic or epigenetic indicators), and brain development (structural or functional neuroimaging outcomes) related to child exposed to IPV and retrospectively in adults. After screening 2,514 records, 62 studies met the inclusion criteria and were organized by sample characteristics and outcome domains. Findings have shown that the largest body of evidence concerns stress-related biological mechanisms, with reports of significant alterations in hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis functioning, inflammatory processes, and related physiological systems. Neuroimaging studies also demonstrated substantial convergence, with most reporting trauma-related alterations in frontolimbic circuitry, white matter integrity, developmental brain, and functional connectivity. In conclusion, this scoping review reveals the overall neurobiological and brain structural consequences associated with child exposure to IPV and points out the need for further preventive interventions and treatment strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述旨在梳理儿童期暴露于亲密伴侣暴力后神经生物学机制与脑结构结局的现有证据，并将关注延伸至成年期的潜在持续性。作者检索多个数据库后纳入相关定量研究，按样本特征和结局领域进行整理。结果显示，证据最集中于应激相关生物学机制，涉及下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴功能、炎症过程及相关生理系统的改变；神经影像研究也较为一致地报告了额边缘环路、白质完整性、发育中脑及功能连接方面的创伤相关改变。综述据此指出需进一步开展预防干预与治疗策略研究。

papers.title: Neural integration of affective prosodic and semantic cues in non-literal forms of speech understanding.
papers.authors: Wittmann A, Ceravolo L, Mayr A, Grandjean D.
papers.abstract: Emotions in speech are conveyed through both semantics and prosody-voice 'melody', yet how listeners integrate these cues in the brain remains unclear. We investigated non-literal forms of speech, such as irony and sarcasm, where understanding beyond literal meaning relies on the dynamic interplay between affective prosodic and semantic cues, alongside the theory of mind (ToM). We used functional magnetic resonance imaging while participants listened to short dialogues between two characters, which varied in prosody and semantics to convey either literal or non-literal meanings. Behaviorally, semantics and prosody interacted in shaping participants' evaluations, although the data suggest a prosody dominance effect. Non-literal speech engaged a distributed network, including the bilateral inferior frontal gyrus, temporal speech regions, and ToM areas, with ROI analyses revealing heterogeneous prosody-semantics integration profiles across regions and tasks. Taken together, our data clarify the behavioral and neural underpinnings of the integration of prosody and semantics in non-literal speech and open new avenues in this field.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注听者理解反讽、讽刺等非字面言语时，大脑如何整合情感韵律与语义线索。研究者让被试听语义和韵律变化、表达字面或非字面含义的短对话，同时用功能磁共振成像记录脑活动。行为结果显示语义与韵律共同影响被试评价，但数据提示韵律可能占主导；非字面言语则调动了包括双侧额下回、颞叶言语区和心理理论相关区域在内的分布式网络，且各区域、各任务中韵律与语义的整合模式并不一致。这些结果有助于理解非字面言语中韵律—语义整合的行为与神经基础，但摘要未说明因果机制或临床应用。

papers.title: Interoception network in the rat brain.
papers.authors: Alkaabi FM, Wang X, Liu Z.
papers.abstract: The brain is never truly at rest. Even in the absence of external stimuli, the central nervous system continuously monitors and regulates visceral organs. However, it remains unclear to what extent this interoceptive signaling shapes the brain's resting state networks. Here, we tested the hypothesis that resting-state functional connectivity is actively sustained by visceral inputs. Using functional magnetic resonance imaging in 34 anesthetized rats, we identified a cohesive "interoception network" characterized by dense, reciprocal functional connectivity among the dorsal vagal complex, thalamus, hypothalamus, amygdala, insula, and cingulate cortex. The topology of this network was not static but dynamically coupled to the physiological state. Functional integration was robust in the digestive (fed) phase but significantly attenuated in the inter-digestive (fasted) phase. The network relied on the integrity of the vagus nerve. When vagal signaling was eliminated by bilateral cervical vagotomy, the network effectively disintegrated. These findings demonstrate that resting-state functional connectivity is not an intrinsic property of the isolated brain but an embodied phenomenon that relies on continuous neural signaling between the brain and viscera.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在大鼠中检验静息态功能连接是否依赖内脏输入，用功能磁共振成像识别出一个由迷走背复合体、丘脑、下丘脑、杏仁核、岛叶和扣带皮层等组成的内感受网络。该网络的整合程度随生理状态变化：消化（进食）阶段较强，消化间期（禁食）阶段明显减弱；双侧颈迷走神经切断消除迷走信号后，网络趋于解体。作者据此认为，静息态功能连接并非孤立大脑的固有属性，而是依赖脑与内脏之间持续神经信号的具身现象。

papers.title: Epilepsy in children with cerebral palsy: perinatal, clinical and neuroimaging correlates - a cross-sectional study from a tertiary care centre in North India.
papers.authors: Wander A, A R, Peer S, Gupta R, Vignesh D, Sharma R, Gaddigoudar MS, Sahoo SS, Saini V, Raj A.
papers.abstract: Background Cerebral palsy (CP) frequently coexists with epilepsy, amplifying disability through compounded neurological impairments. This cross-sectional study at a tertiary care centre in Northern India characterises seizure profiles, epilepsy severity, motor function, neuroimaging correlates and perinatal predictors in 95 children aged 1-13 years with CP and epilepsy. Methods Consecutive paediatric neurology patients underwent prospective evaluation with clinical, electroencephalographic and MRI assessments to characterise seizures in CP and examine their relation to Gross Motor Function Classification System (GMFCS) and MRI severity. Epilepsy severity was assessed using the Early Childhood Epilepsy Severity Scale (E-CHESS), CP severity using GMFCS and MRI severity using the scoring system by Trivedi et al . MRI findings and perinatal factors were analysed in relation to epilepsy severity in children with CP. Results Spastic quadriplegic CP was predominant (78.9%), and generalised tonic-clonic seizures were the most common seizure types. E-CHESS was weakly and non-significantly associated with GMFCS (r=0.079, p=0.12); MRI severity increased with E-CHESS scores (p=0.0427); grey matter injury was associated with severe seizures, while white matter lesions were more often associated with moderate severity. Low/moderate 5 min APGAR score was strongly associated with severe seizures (adjusted OR 47.4-52.1, p<0.013), and children with quadriplegic CP more often showed perinatal compromise, including low 5 min APGAR scores. Conclusion Epilepsy severity in CP was associated with grey matter MRI injury and low 5 min APGAR but showed less association with motor impairment. Low 5 min APGAR scores may serve as early clinical markers of increased risk of severe seizure in CP and may help prioritise MRI assessment and closer seizure surveillance. This study emphasises the need for parallel management strategies-addressing seizures and motor deficits separately but comprehensively.
papers.summary_zh: 这项在印度北部三级医疗中心开展的横断面研究，纳入95名1至13岁同时患有脑瘫和癫痫的儿童，结合临床、脑电图和MRI评估，考察癫痫发作特点及其与运动功能、MRI严重程度和围产期因素的关系。结果显示，痉挛型四肢瘫最为常见，全身强直-阵挛发作是最多见的发作类型；癫痫严重程度与运动功能分级仅呈弱且不显著的相关，但与MRI严重程度相关，其中灰质损伤更多见于严重发作，白质病变则多与中度严重程度相关。5分钟APGAR评分低或中等与严重发作强相关，四肢瘫患儿也更常出现围产期不良情况。作者据此认为，低5分钟APGAR评分或可作为脑瘫患儿严重发作风险的早期临床提示，帮助优先安排MRI评估和更密切的发作监测，并强调癫痫与运动障碍需并行管理。

papers.title: Long-term recovery and microbiota-gut-brain axis disruption after traumatic brain injury (OVERCOME-TBI): protocol for a prospective, observational clinical study.
papers.authors: Artosalo M, Östberg A, Tenovuo O, Roine T, Mohammadian M, Kallonen T, Salminen K, Stenholm T, Hakanen A, Sainio T, Hirvonen J, Dickens AM, Orešić M, Büki A, Hyötyläinen T, Menon D, Newcombe V, Chiollaz AC, Sanchez JC, Mondello S, Airas L, Posti JP.
papers.abstract: Introduction Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a major cause of long-term disability worldwide, but the pathophysiological mechanisms underlying its chronic sequelae remain incompletely understood. In addition to persistent neuroinflammation, evidence suggests that dysregulation of the gut microbiota influences brain recovery. The OVERCOME-TBI study investigates the long-term functional, cognitive, imaging, biochemical and gastrointestinal outcomes after TBI of all severities, with the aim of identifying biomarkers and microbiome signatures associated with progressive neurodegeneration and poor recovery. Methods and analysis This is a prospective, observational study with long-term follow-up of two previously established TBI cohorts-the Evidence-based Diagnostic and Treatment Planning Solution for Traumatic Brain Injuries (TBIcare; recruited 2011-2013) and the Pathophysiological Characterisation of Severe TBI (PACoS-TBI; recruited 2020-2023). The design combines prospectively collected acute and subacute data from the original cohorts with new cross-sectional assessments performed at chronic time points (2-5 and 12-15 years post-injury). Participants are re-contacted and re-consented for these chronic-phase assessments. Up to 160 patients with TBI and 30 orthopaedic injury controls will undergo multimodal examinations: neurological and neuropsychological testing, advanced MRI including multishell diffusion and resting-state functional MRI, positron emission tomography (PET) with the radioligand [11 C]PK11195, blood-based proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics, faecal and intestinal microbiome profiling and colonoscopy biopsies. Moreover, 10 patients with multiple sclerosis (as a positive control group) will undergo PET imaging and sampling for blood biomarkers. Primary outcomes include neuroinflammatory burden (biochemical and PET), longitudinal functional outcomes (Glasgow Outcome Scale Extended) and gut microbiota composition. Statistical modelling, including regression models and machine learning, will be applied to identify predictors of outcome and disease progression. Ethics and dissemination Ethical approval has been obtained from the Ethical Committee of the Wellbeing Services County of Southwest Finland. Written informed consent will be obtained from all participants. The results will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations and stakeholder engagement, with the aim of developing personalised diagnostics and novel therapeutic targets to alleviate the chronic consequences of TBI. Trial registration number NCT06927063.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一项前瞻性观察性研究的方案，旨在考察不同严重程度创伤性脑损伤后的长期功能、认知、影像、生化及胃肠道结局，并寻找与神经退行性变和恢复不良相关的生物标志物与微生物组特征。研究将重新联系两个既有TBI队列的参与者，在伤后慢性期进行多模态评估，涵盖神经心理测试、先进MRI、PET神经炎症成像、血液多组学以及肠道微生物组和结肠活检，并设置骨科损伤对照和作为阳性对照的多发性硬化患者。主要结局包括神经炎症负荷、纵向功能结局和肠道菌群组成，拟通过回归模型和机器学习识别结局与疾病进展的预测因素。由于目前仅为研究方案，尚无结果可报告，其关于微生物组-肠-脑轴与长期恢复关系的设想仍需该研究实际数据检验。

papers.title: An ASXL3-thyroid hormone axis in parvalbumin interneurons controls autism-like behaviors.
papers.authors: Ding C, Yuan Y, Hu Y, Zhang Y, Wu S, Du A, Qiu Z.
papers.abstract: Pathogenic variants in ASXL3 underlie autism spectrum disorder (ASD), but how they perturb neural circuits and whether defects are reversible remain unclear. Here we show that Asxl3 haploinsufficiency in mice reduces cortical thickness and upper-layer projection neurons while increasing parvalbumin (PV) interneuron number and producing ASD-like behavioral abnormalities. Mechanistically, Asxl3 loss derepresses the thyroid hormone (TH)-inactivating enzyme DIO3 via altered histone H2A monoubiquitination, depleting brain TH. Conditional deletion of the TH receptor Thra in inhibitory neuron progenitors phenocopies the PV interneuron expansion, linking impaired TH signaling to PV circuit remodeling. Neonatal, but not adolescent, TH supplementation restores PV interneuron numbers and rescues behavior in Asxl3+/- mice, defining a critical early window for intervention. An intein-based AAV system that reconstitutes full-length ASXL3 normalizes cortical architecture and behavior in Asxl3+/- mice and drives efficient ASXL3 expression in non-human primate brain, establishing an ASXL3-TH-PV interneuron axis as a targetable pathway in ASD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以Asxl3单倍不足小鼠为对象，探究ASXL3缺陷如何扰动神经环路以及能否逆转。研究发现，Asxl3缺失会通过改变组蛋白修饰解除对甲状腺激素失活酶DIO3的抑制，导致脑内甲状腺激素水平下降，进而引起皮层变薄、上层投射神经元减少、PV中间神经元增多及类似自闭症的行为异常；在抑制性神经元前体中条件性敲除甲状腺激素受体Thra可重现PV中间神经元扩增。新生期而非青春期补充甲状腺激素能恢复PV神经元数量并改善行为，提示存在早期干预窗口；基于内含肽的AAV系统重建全长ASXL3也可使皮层结构和行为正常化，并在非人灵长类脑中实现表达。这些结果将ASXL3-甲状腺激素-PV中间神经元轴确定为自闭症谱系障碍中可靶向的通路。

papers.title: Spatial organization of AQP4 water channel expression in the human brain.
papers.authors: Taheri T, Farahani A, Liu ZQ, Ceballos EG, Harroud A, Dagher A, Misic B.
papers.abstract: Aquaporin-4 (AQP4) water channels support the glymphatic system, a brain-wide pathway that clears cerebral waste products. Here, we use AQP4 gene expression to reconstruct a whole-brain glymphatic-related topography and link it to vascular physiology, glioma, and vulnerability to neurodegenerative diseases. We find that AQP4 expression is highly organized across the brain, peaking in subcortical, ventral, and periventricular territories, consistent with a clearance axis near cerebrospinal fluid reservoirs and perivascular interfaces. Linking AQP4 expression to vascular organization, AQP4 -enriched regions show lower normative blood perfusion, but lie close to areas commonly affected by cerebral small vessel disease. Turning to neurodegeneration, we find that atrophy patterns colocalize with AQP4 expression, most strongly for tau and TDP-43 proteinopathies, and high-atrophy regions lie close to AQP4 hotspots in anatomical and structural connectome space. Normative positron emission tomography markers of neuroinflammation strengthen the spatial alignment between AQP4 expression and disease atrophy. Last, we show that glioma is most frequent in AQP4 -enriched regions. Collectively, this work highlights how AQP4 expression relates to brain physiology and vulnerability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用AQP4基因表达数据重建人脑类淋巴相关空间分布图，并考察其与血管生理、胶质瘤及神经退行性疾病易感性的空间关系。结果显示，AQP4表达在皮层下、腹侧和脑室周围区域较高，与脑脊液储库和血管周围界面附近的清除轴相符；这些富集区基础血流灌注较低，但邻近脑小血管病常见受累区域。萎缩模式与AQP4表达存在空间共定位，在tau和TDP-43蛋白病中尤为明显，且高萎缩区在解剖和结构连接组空间中靠近AQP4热点；神经炎症的PET标志物也强化了这一空间对应。胶质瘤同样多发于AQP4富集区。作者据此提出，AQP4表达的空间组织可能与脑生理及疾病易感性相关，但相关关系不等于因果。

papers.title: Beyond statistical thresholds: Mapping sequential ATN cascade transitions via brain structural topography in Alzheimer's disease.
papers.authors: Wang D, Yan S, Zhou R, Li Y, Liu L, Wei Y, Wang D, Yao H, Zhou B, Lu J, Wang P, Liao Z, Chen Y, Zhang X, Han Y, Yu C, Zhao K, Liu Y, Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease is widely conceptualized as a biological continuum initiated by amyloid-β (Aβ) accumulation, followed by tau aggregation and neurodegeneration. Although the ATN framework is commonly used to define disease stages, its static biomarker categories may not fully capture the dynamic pathological transitions that determine the optimal window for anti-Aβ therapies. Here, we introduce a Biological Continuum framework that distinguishes dynamic pathological cascades from static biomarker categories. Using neuroimaging-derived brain network topology, we identify four reproducible subgroups that exhibit distinct biological processes, biomarker signatures, and longitudinal cognitive trajectories. Integrated proteomic analyses suggest that these subgroups reflect sequential molecular transitions corresponding to early vulnerability, initiation, amplification, and terminal stages. Post hoc analysis indicates that slower cognitive decline after amyloid-targeting treatment was observed mainly in the initiation stage group. These findings provide a biologically grounded stratification system that captures disease dynamics overlooked by threshold-based models and offers mechanistic insight into the timing of anti-Aβ therapies.

papers.title: Medial temporal default mode network selectively encodes autobiographical visual imagery.
papers.authors: Anderson AJ, Turnbull A, Lin FV.
papers.abstract: The human brain's capacity to imagine visual scenes from memory is thought to rely on the medial temporal subsystem of the default mode network (MT-DMN), yet the neural codes supporting this ability remain poorly understood. We combined functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) with vision and language artificial intelligence models to characterize neural codes during autobiographical imagination. Fifty participants imagined reexperiencing 20 natural scenarios while undergoing fMRI when cued by generic text prompts (e.g., wedding, exercising, and driving). Individual scenes were modeled using Stable Diffusion to generate personalized synthetic images from verbal descriptions of the scenarios imagined, collected beforehand. These depictions were then transformed into image recognition network hidden state representations. Representational similarity analysis revealed that the MT-DMN encoded the participant-specific representational structure of image representations, even when controlling for semantic features derived from a large language model. This effect was absent in other brain networks and during reading without active imagination, identifying the MT-DMN as a core substrate for the visual reconstruction of autobiographical experiences.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大脑如何编码自传体视觉想象，结合功能磁共振成像与视觉、语言人工智能模型，考察被试根据文字提示回忆并想象个人场景时的神经表征。结果显示，内侧颞叶默认网络子系统能够编码被试个体化的图像表征结构，且这一效应在控制语言模型提取的语义特征后仍然存在；其他脑网络以及仅阅读而不主动想象时则未出现该效应。作者据此认为，内侧颞叶默认网络是自传体经验视觉重建的核心基础，但该结论来自想象任务中的表征分析，并不涉及临床干预效果。

papers.title: Thalamofrontal synaptic weakening underlies short-term memory deficits from adolescent NMDAR hypofunction.
papers.authors: Yu J, Choi IS, Kim GH, Bahn S, Kim J, Bae S, Lee T, Choi JH, Kwon JS, Kim M, Choi JW, Lee KJ, Rah JC.
papers.abstract: Thalamofrontal (TF) dysconnectivity is one of the most consistent circuit-level abnormalities reported in patients with schizophrenia and is linked to deficits in short-term memory (STM). However, the biological mechanisms underlying TF weakening remain unclear.
