Multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) can integrate structural and functional MRI, positron emission tomography, diffusion imaging, electroencephalography, intracranial electrophysiology, and clinical information to support quantitative decision-making. This targeted narrative review synthesizes published evidence on three clinical tasks: prediction of antiseizure medication response, localization of epileptogenic zones, and prediction of surgical outcomes. We summarize machine-learning, deep-learning, and brain-network approaches, together with representative validation strategies and performance metrics. Current studies demonstrate promising task-specific performance, but their results should not be compared directly because cohorts, endpoints, modalities, and validation designs differ markedly. Major barriers include small single-center datasets, inconsistent acquisition and annotation, incomplete multimodal data, limited external validation, and insufficient interpretability. Future priorities include standardized multicenter datasets, prospective evaluation, privacy-preserving collaboration, interpretable fusion models, and clinically integrated human-AI workflows. At present, multimodal AI should be regarded as supervised decision support rather than a replacement for specialist interpretation.

papers.title: Exploratory radiomics analysis of T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI in relation to Parkinson's disease motor subtypes.
papers.authors: Lim H, Lee J, Park S, Gi Y, Baek SH, Kim BJ, Yoon M.
papers.abstract: Background Parkinson's disease motor subtypes, tremor-dominant (TD) and postural instability/gait difficulty (PIGD), differ in disease trajectory and prognosis, yet their classification depends on MDS-UPDRS-based clinical ratings that are susceptible to inter-rater variability and medication state. Purpose This exploratory study investigated whether T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI radiomics show differential associations with TD and PIGD motor subtypes in Parkinson's disease, and whether the two sequences contribute complementary subtype-relevant information when combined in a multimodal framework. Methods Baseline 3 T MRI data from 568 patients with Parkinson's disease in the PPMI cohort were analyzed (448 TD; 120 PIGD). Radiomics features were extracted from predefined basal ganglia and brainstem regions on T1-weighted and FLAIR images using PyRadiomics. Participants with only T1-weighted or only FLAIR MRI were used as sequence-specific development cohorts; those with both sequences formed a common evaluation cohort. ComBat harmonization was applied within each modality before cohort separation, followed by development-cohort-based feature selection and model fitting. L1-regularized logistic regression models were trained independently for each sequence and evaluated in the common cohort. A stacking model combined T1- and FLAIR-derived probability scores. Model performance was assessed using the area under the precision-recall curve (PR-AUC), balanced accuracy, and F1-score, and Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) analysis was used for interpretation. Results In the common evaluation cohort (n = 148; 118 TD, 30 PIGD), the T1-weighted model achieved a PR-AUC of 0.814, balanced accuracy of 0.829, and F1-score of 0.750. The FLAIR model achieved a PR-AUC of 0.858, balanced accuracy of 0.832, and F1-score of 0.650. The stacked model showed higher performance, with a PR-AUC of 0.928, balanced accuracy of 0.912, and F1-score of 0.818. The T1-weighted model showed relatively better TD classification, whereas the FLAIR model showed higher PIGD sensitivity. SHAP analysis showed that T1-weighted contributions were mainly concentrated in the putamen, while FLAIR contributions were more broadly distributed across basal ganglia and brainstem regions. Conclusion T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI radiomics showed distinct subtype-associated error profiles and preliminary evidence of cross-sequence complementarity in this PPMI-based exploratory analysis. These findings require external validation before clinical interpretation, but provide a hypothesis-generating framework for multimodal structural radiomics research in Parkinson's disease motor subtype characterization.

papers.title: Cognitive impairment after cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury: a neuroecosystem perspective.
papers.authors: Xie J, Zhang T, Zhang J, Zhang L, Huang T, Bi W, Zhao M.
papers.abstract: Post-stroke cognitive impairment (PSCI) is a common and debilitating neurological complication following cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI). The traditional neuron-centered view cannot fully explain its delayed onset, pathological heterogeneity, and functional plasticity. This review proposes a novel neuroecosystem framework based on the neurovascular-immune-glial (NIG) triad, including a systematic evaluation of the dynamic crosstalk among the neurovascular unit (NVU), neuronal networks, and glial-immune microenvironment. Pathological events, including ferroptosis, neuroinflammation, white matter damage, and gut-brain axis dysfunction, are reinterpreted as manifestations of neuroecosystem collapse, rather than isolated lesions. We further summarize cutting-edge tools, such as spatial omics and in vivo dynamic imaging for framework validation, and clarify how therapeutic strategies are shifting from single neuronal protection to overall ecosystem restoration. Finally, we discuss current limitations in knowledge and future research directions, aiming to provide new insights for mechanistic exploration and clinical intervention of PSCI.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述针对脑缺血再灌注损伤后认知障碍的延迟出现、病理异质性和功能可塑性，提出以神经血管—免疫—胶质三元组为基础的“神经生态系统”框架，系统评估神经血管单元、神经网络与胶质免疫微环境之间的动态交互。作者将铁死亡、神经炎症、白质损伤和肠脑轴功能障碍等事件重新解释为神经生态系统崩溃的表现，而非孤立病灶，并梳理空间组学和活体动态成像等可用于验证该框架的工具。文章进一步指出治疗策略正从单一神经元保护转向整体生态系统修复，同时讨论了现有知识局限和未来研究方向，为机制探索与临床干预提供新视角。

papers.title: Brain photobiomodulation therapy for acute sport-related concussion: a randomized, single-blinded, pilot clinical trial (RECOVERY study).
papers.authors: Chermann JF, Malafosse P, Champleboux G, Bisiaux J, Guillemin S, Benmerad M, Varet A, Cristofini P, Blivet G, Touchon J.
papers.abstract: Background The current standard of care for concussion relies on symptom management; there are almost no disease-modifying treatments. The RECOVERY study investigated the safety of RGn550 (REGEnLIFE), a novel neurostimulation device combining brain photobiomodulation with a static magnetic field, in sportspeople with acute concussion and described concussion-related parameters in patients receiving this therapy. Methods This prospective, randomized (central randomization, 1:1 ratio), single-blind, monocentric, pilot study compared two pulse frequencies (5 Hz and 10 Hz). Adult sportspeople with a concussion from a shock during sport practice occurring less than 72 h before inclusion were treated for 20 min at day 0 (D0) and D7 and followed up to D52. The primary outcome was the incidence of adverse device effects (ADEs). The secondary outcomes evaluated oculomotor, balance and executive function, concussion symptoms, and blood markers. The sample size was determined by the probability of observing at least one ADE, while all secondary analyses were exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity. Results Fifty patients were included, randomized, and treated at least once with 5 Hz (n = 26) or 10 Hz (n = 24); 49 (98.0%) of them completed the study. No difference was detected between the groups for primary or secondary outcomes. At least one ADE occurred in 38.5% (n = 10) [CI95 : 20.2; 59.4] in the 5 Hz group and 41.7% (n = 10) [CI95 : 22.1; 63.4] in the 10 Hz group. All ADEs were mild, non-serious (e.g., somnolence and medical device site discomfort), and resolved. Changes in several secondary outcomes were observed over the follow-up period, including within-visit changes in oculomotor measures. Conclusion No difference in tolerability was detected between the 5 and 10 Hz modalities, although the study was neither designed nor powered to establish equivalence. Both conditions were well tolerated. In the absence of a sham comparator, secondary outcome data are hypothesis-generating and cannot be described in terms of efficacy. However, these data still provide the feasibility and variability estimates required to design an adequately powered, double-blind, sham-controlled trial in an indication that currently lacks disease-modifying treatment. Clinical trial registration https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05647304, NCT05647304.

papers.title: Reconsideration of the DTI-ALPS index as a glymphatic surrogate: disease-specific findings in small vessel disease due to cerebral amyloid angiopathy or arteriolosclerosis.
papers.authors: Zhou Y, Pan X, Xia Z, Sha Y, Sun G, Han F, Yao M, Zhou L, Tu L, Feng F, Wardlaw JM, Zhu YC, Ni J.
papers.abstract: Objectives To explore the disease-specific performance of diffusion tensor imaging analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) index in cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA) and arteriolosclerosis CSVD (aCSVD). Methods We retrospectively enrolled probable CAA or aCSVD patients who underwent 5.0T MRI. Disease-specific DTI-ALPS characteristics and the correlations with clinical, imaging markers, and cognition were evaluated. Regression models were applied according to outcome distributions. Multiple comparisons were controlled using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) procedure. Results A total of 134 participants (56 probable CAA and 78 arteriolosclerosis, mean age 64.9 ± 10.0 years, 64.9% males) were enrolled. DTI-ALPS index was significantly lower in aCSVD than in CAA (p < 0.001). After adjustment for age and sex and FDR correction, no clinical factors remained significantly associated with DTI-ALPS index. In aCSVD, DTI-ALPS was significantly associated with cognitive performance, whereas these associations did not reach statistical significance in CAA. Across both groups, DTI-ALPS was significantly associated with white matter hyperintensity volume, skeletonized fractional anisotropy, skeletonized mean diffusivity, and peak width of skeletonized mean diffusivity (all FDR-adjusted p < 0.05). Associations with PVS burden and established CAA imaging markers did not reach statistical significance. Conclusion DTI-ALPS index is heterogenous across distinct angiopathies but consistently associated with white matter microstructural damage. These subtype-specific findings question the relevance of DTI-ALPS index and caution against using DTI-ALPS index as a universal glymphatic surrogate.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了扩散张量成像沿血管周围间隙分析（DTI-ALPS）指数在脑淀粉样血管病（CAA）与动脉硬化型脑小血管病（aCSVD）中的表现，并分析其与临床、影像标志物及认知的关联。结果显示，aCSVD患者的DTI-ALPS指数显著低于CAA患者，提示该指标在不同血管病理中并不一致；校正后未见临床因素与指数稳定相关，认知关联仅在aCSVD中显著，而在CAA中未达统计学意义。两组中该指数均与白质高信号体积及白质微结构损伤指标相关，但与血管周围间隙负担和既有CAA影像标志物的关联不显著。作者据此提醒，不宜将DTI-ALPS指数当作通用的类淋巴系统替代指标。

papers.title: Kinestesia: the prefrontal EEG response to a cognitive-motor intervention is graded by baseline cognitive status.
papers.authors: Bosch-Bayard JF, Guerrero-Sauzameda J, Navarrete-Torres L, Aguilar-Fabre L, Rodriguez-Valdes RF, Bosch-Bayard RI, Martinez-Finkelstein A, Castro-Luna G, Chiarenza GA.
papers.abstract: Background This is a companion neurophysiological study (N = 19) to a recently published exploratory pilot of the Kinestesia intervention - combining therapeutic videogames, rhythmic gait, and sensory stimulation - in older adults spanning the cognitively healthy (HC, n = 10) to mild cognitive impairment (MCI, n = 9) spectrum. That paper, published in Archives of Gerontology and Geriatrics, reported BH-corrected behavioural gains; here we ask whether the resting-state electrocortical response is graded by baseline cognitive status. Methods Resting-state EEG was recorded before and after 30 sessions in 19 participants (9 MCI, MoCA < 26; 10 HC, MoCA 26-29). Age-referenced Z-scores were computed for eleven pre-specified clinical EEG indices using the Harmonized Functional EEG Derived Phenotypes normative pipeline (HarFEDPNorms). The primary analysis treated the 19 participants as a single sample and correlated baseline MoCA with the pre-to-post change in each index (Spearman ρ), with Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) FDR correction. We assessed robustness to educational attainment using partial correlation. Results Eight of the eleven pre-specified indices showed a BH-corrected continuous association with baseline MoCA. The strongest were the Engagement Index (EI) and the Alpha/Beta Ratio (ABR) at Fp2 (EI: ρ = +0.704, q = 0.008; ABR: ρ = -0.687, q = 0.008): higher baseline cognitive status was associated with greater prefrontal activation after the intervention, and lower status with the reverse. MoCA and education were substantially correlated at the sample level (r = 0.596; 36% shared variance, driven by the HC/MCI contrast), and the primary prefrontal effect (EI Fp2) remained significant after adjusting for education (partial ρ = 0.50, p = 0.033). Conclusion In this small, uncontrolled sample, the electrocortical response to Kinestesia was graded by baseline cognitive status, with a robust prefrontal engagement effect (EI and ABR at Fp2; BH q < 0.01). Findings are exploratory and hypothesis-generating, pending a randomised controlled trial. The HarFEDPNorms pipeline offers a device-independent framework for individualised EEG tracking in intervention research.
papers.summary_zh: 这项小型神经生理学研究在19名认知健康到轻度认知障碍的老年人中，考察Kinestesia认知—运动干预前后静息态脑电反应是否随基线认知状态而变化。结果显示，多数预设脑电指标与基线认知水平呈连续关联，其中前额叶的参与指数和α/β比值关联最强：基线认知状态较高者干预后前额叶激活增强，较低者则相反，且主要前额叶效应在教育程度调整后仍存在。作者强调该样本小且未设对照，结果属探索性和假设生成性质，尚需随机对照试验验证。

papers.title: Aphasic Status Epilepticus as a Stroke Mimic: A Literature Review.
papers.authors: Inatomi Y, Nakajima M, Yonehara T.
papers.abstract: We reviewed the clinical features of previously reported cases of aphasic status epilepticus. In an analysis of medical information from 87 reported cases (92 attacks), the types of aphasia associated with aphasic status epilepticus were global aphasia in 44 (48%) of 92 attacks, motor aphasia in 29 (32%), and sensory aphasia in 11 (12%) attacks. The findings of diffusion and perfusion imaging, as well as electroencephalography, were often compatible with aphasia, although variations in the distribution and findings were observed in several cases. Furthermore, in 16 (32%) of 67 attacks, it took more than 1 week from the onset of the aphasic status epilepticus to treatment; therefore, the sequelae of aphasia were observed in 18 (20%) of 92 attacks. Aphasic status epilepticus should be considered a stroke mimic and it may cause sequelae due to delayed treatment. Patients suspected of having aphasic status epilepticus should be immediately treated with benzodiazepine without waiting for either electroencephalography or perfusion imaging.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了已报道的失语性癫痫持续状态病例的临床特征，基于87例病例（92次发作）的医学信息分析，发现全面性失语最为常见，其次为运动性失语和感觉性失语。弥散与灌注成像及脑电图结果常与失语表现相符，但分布和所见在部分病例中存在差异。值得注意的是，相当一部分发作从起病到治疗超过一周，部分病例遗留失语后遗症。作者据此指出，失语性癫痫持续状态应被视为卒中模拟病，治疗延迟可能导致后遗症，对疑似患者应不等脑电图或灌注成像结果即给予苯二氮䓬类药物。

papers.title: Brainana: an end-to-end preprocessing framework for macaque neuroimaging
papers.authors: Liu X, Zhang Y, Yin Z, Zhen Z, Arcaro M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Macaque MRI bridges non-invasive systems neuroscience with cellular and circuit-level mechanisms, but preprocessing remains fragmented across tools that are difficult to integrate, adapt to non-human primate acquisitions, and deploy reproducibly. We present Brainana, an automated, BIDS-compatible preprocessing framework for macaque neuroimaging. Brainana integrates structural and functional preprocessing, cortical surface reconstruction, quality control, transform tracking, and atlas projection within a containerized package, with cloud access for users without local compute. It incorporates macaque-trained deep learning models for brain extraction and tissue segmentation, conformation to standardize variable acquisitions, and surface reconstruction optimizations for macaque neuroanatomy. Across 23 imaging sites, Brainana processed data spanning heterogeneous scanners, protocols, species, and resolutions, yielding accurate anatomical correspondence across 130 monkeys, reliable native-space cortical surfaces, localized task-evoked activations, and reproducible brain-wide resting-state correlation structure. Brainana enables reproducible, scalable, and accessible macaque MRI preprocessing that supports cross-study comparison and multimodal integration across spatial scales, from neurons to networks.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对猕猴神经影像预处理工具分散、难以适配非人灵长类采集且不易复现的问题，提出了端到端自动化框架Brainana。该框架整合了结构与功能预处理、皮层表面重建、质量控制、变换追踪和图谱投影，并内置猕猴训练的深度学习模型用于脑提取与组织分割。在多个成像站点、扫描仪、协议、物种和分辨率的数据上，Brainana获得了准确的解剖对应、可靠的原生空间皮层表面、局部任务诱发激活以及可复现的全脑静息态相关结构，支持跨研究比较和从神经元到网络的多尺度多模态整合。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Alzheimer’s Disease Detection Across Neuroimaging and Speech: A Reproducible Cross-Modal Secondary Analysis
papers.authors: Tao J, Caggiano CC.
papers.abstract: Abstract Artificial-intelligence (AI) systems for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) increasingly use neuroimaging or spontaneous speech, but reported performance is difficult to interpret across studies because cohorts, endpoints, languages, preprocessing, and validation protocols differ. We applied a systematic coding framework to a predefined 51-reference evidence corpus and performed a conservative secondary quantitative synthesis. Twenty-six references met prespecified criteria for primary empirical AI studies: 7 neuroimaging and 19 speech/language studies. Fourteen studies contributed 15 model-level benchmark entries with extractable headline accuracy. Neuroimaging entries ranged from 66.25–99.95% (median 97.74%); speech/language entries ranged from 78.70–92.08% (median 83.81%). These values are descriptive and are not pooled diagnostic-effect estimates. Only 5/26 primary studies (19.2%) explicitly evaluated external, cross-domain, or cross-language generalization, 5/26 (19.2%) used explicit multimodal input, and 4/26 (15.4%) emphasized explainability or uncertainty. Multilingual or cross-lingual evaluation appeared in 3/19 speech/language studies (15.8%). The evidence therefore supports a distinction between high within-study accuracy and clinically credible transportability. Independent validation, patient-disjoint evaluation, calibrated uncertainty, representative cohorts, and linguistically diverse testing should be treated as core design requirements rather than optional extensions. The study-level coding table and benchmark extract are provided for reproducibility and updating.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对阿尔茨海默病AI检测中因队列、终点、语言和验证方案不同而难以横向比较的问题，对预设的51篇文献进行系统编码，并对其中26项原始实证研究（神经影像7项、言语/语言19项）做保守的二次定量综合。可提取准确率的模型级基准显示，神经影像类中位准确率高于言语/语言类，但作者强调这些数值仅为描述性，并非汇总的诊断效应估计。更关键的发现是，仅少数研究明确检验了外部、跨领域或跨语言泛化，采用多模态输入或强调可解释性与不确定性的研究也很少，多语言评估在言语研究中尤为缺乏。作者据此指出，研究内高准确率与临床可信的可迁移性之间存在差距，独立验证、患者不重叠评估、校准的不确定性、代表性队列和语言多样化测试应作为核心设计要求。

papers.title: Deterministic Probabilistic Projection for Hallucination-Free Judicial Inquiry: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Evidentiary Solidity Assessment
papers.authors: ElOuerkhaoui A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in legal technology often suffer from critical hallucinations and arbitrary reasoning, making them unreliable for sensitive criminal instruction tasks. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces a novel neuro-symbolic framework for automated evidentiary analysis and judicial decision-making, grounded in the Moroccan Penal Code. We propose a Deterministic Probabilistic Projection (PDP) operator that decouples factual semantic extraction from legal decision-making. By replacing unconstrained text generation with a strict deterministic mapping matrix based on boolean logical predicates, our architecture guarantees hallucination-free decisions. Furthermore, we formalize the system through advanced mathematical modeling, introducing an Evidentiary Density Index (ρi) regularized via Kneser-Ney and Good-Turing smoothing techniques to avoid the rigidity of traditional Laplace corrections. We also define a Relative Evidentiary Solidity Score (S PR ), a continuous logistic function integrating charge densities, discharge densities, and a cosine-similarity-based RAG normative grounding (S RAG ), mathematically weighted to respect the presumption of innocence (β > α). Asymptotic behavioral analysis validates the system's stability at boundary conditions. Extensive case-study evaluations demonstrate that this framework bridges the gap between probabilistic neural representations and deterministic statutory compliance, providing a robust, transparent, and legally sound AI tool for magistrates and legal analysts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对法律技术中大型语言模型易产生幻觉和任意推理的问题，提出一个基于摩洛哥刑法的神经符号框架，用于自动证据分析与司法决策。其核心是确定性概率投影算子，将事实语义提取与法律裁决分离，并以布尔逻辑谓词构成的确定性映射矩阵替代无约束文本生成，从而保证决策无幻觉。作者还引入经平滑技术正则化的证据密度指标和相对证据稳固性评分，后者整合指控与排除密度及基于检索增强生成的规范依据，并在数学上体现无罪推定。渐近行为分析考察了边界条件下的稳定性，案例研究评估显示该框架试图连接概率性神经表示与确定性成文法合规，为法官和法律分析人员提供透明、可审计的辅助工具。需注意，这些结果来自作者自建的案例评估，尚不能等同于真实司法场景中的临床或实践效果。

papers.title: The orbitofrontal-anterior temporal network complements the attention network for where to look in social situations.
papers.authors: Marek N, Meghanathan RN, Pollmann S.
papers.abstract: Human neuroimaging experiments have consistently found dorsal and ventral attention networks subserving spatial shifts of covert attention or eye movements. However, these experiments used abstract, artificial stimuli for better experimental stimulus control and clearly defined instructions about where to attend or what to search for. This clearly is not an adequate model of eye movement control in natural environments full of semantic and social information. Here, we show that during movie viewing, activation of the dorsal and ventral attention networks was complemented by activation patterns in orbitofrontal and anterior temporal cortex, previously not implicated in human eye movement control, supporting individual decisions where to look. This effect was largely driven by looking at faces. We compared similarity relationships between eye fixation patterns on the one hand and brain activity patterns on the other hand in human participants of either sex. Searching for between-scenes changes in activation patterns that mirrored changes in fixation patterns, we were able to identify the attention networks defined by previous experiments with artificial stimuli. In contrast, interindividual differences in fixation patterns, indicative of endogenous decisions about where to look, were mirrored by activation pattern differences in orbitofrontal and anterior temporal cortex, particularly for scenes presenting faces. Thus, we could precisely replicate the role of the attention networks in a more natural viewing environment. Crucially, we also showed that previous lab experiments, lacking the complexity of free viewing in a naturalistic environment, overlooked the importance of the orbitofrontal - anterior temporal network for individual differences in active vision. Our findings show that the orbitofrontal - anterior temporal network needs to be considered in studies of active vision, particularly in social situations.Significance Statement Human attention networks have been replicated in a naturalistic setting. The attention networks could be mapped by comparing the similarity of fixation patterns and local brain activation patterns between scenes of a movie. In contrast, searching for brain activation reflecting interindividual differences in fixation patterns yielded an orbitofrontal-anterior temporal network. This network showed the highest similarity of fixation and brain activation patterns during scens containing faces, in line with its known function for social communication.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然观影情境下，人脑如何决定“往哪里看”，并比较了注视模式与脑活动模式之间的相似关系。结果发现，以往用人工刺激实验确立的背侧和腹侧注意网络在自然观影中依然可被复现，主要对应场景间注视变化；而个体间注视差异所反映的内源性观看决策，则与眶额皮层和前颞叶皮层的活动模式差异相对应，这一效应在看人脸场景时尤为明显。作者据此指出，以往实验室研究因缺乏自然情境的复杂性，忽略了眶额-前颞网络在主动视觉个体差异中的作用，该网络在社交情境的主动视觉研究中需要被纳入考虑。

papers.title: Drift-diffusion dynamics of hippocampal replay.
papers.authors: Wu Z, Wei XX.
papers.abstract: Replay in the hippocampus during sharp-wave ripples is thought to play major roles in learning and memory. However, existing analysis methods often lead to inconsistent and inaccurate metrics for characterizing replay dynamics. We develop a novel computational framework that models the replay dynamics using a drift-diffusion process. Further, to capture the potentially rich population-level dynamics during sharp-wave ripples, our model allows switching between multiple well-motivated types of dynamics. Applications of our method to rat hippocampal recordings lead to a number of insights. First, our results reveal that a small fraction of SWRs are stationary, and those with drift-diffusion dynamics generally have a much higher speed than the animal's movement. Second, we find that replay dynamics are heterogeneous and inconsistent with a random walk model proposed previously. The mean-squared displacement of replay trajectories scales quadratically with time, supporting the presence of substantial drifts. Third, we find that only a tiny fraction of SWR events (less than 1%) exhibit sequential structure at the timescale of 100 ms before the animal had spatial experience in an environment. This suggests that, while neural activity in the hippocampus may be coordinated before the animal's spatial experience (i.e., preplay), the level of coordination is much weaker than that after spatial experience. Overall, our approach enables precise characterizations and unambiguous interpretations of population dynamics during sharp-wave ripples, which more broadly can provide a better understanding of the functions and underlying mechanisms of replay.

papers.title: Validation of Low-Frequency Oscillatory Activity as an Indicator of Post-Stroke Injury and Recovery.
papers.authors: Mark JI, Gangwani R, Snyder C, Cassidy JM.
papers.abstract: BackgroundThis study investigated the roles of delta (1-3 Hz) and beta (20-30 Hz) electroencephalography (EEG) oscillatory activity at rest in post-stroke recovery. Driven by previous work linking delta and beta activity with stroke-related injury and motor recovery, this study sought to validate these findings in an independent cohort, addressing the need for confirmatory studies in stroke biomarker development.MethodsIndividuals with stroke admitted to an inpatient rehabilitation facility along with a control group of unimpaired adults were recruited. Participants completed motor assessments and two EEG recordings near the time of facility admission and discharge. Coherence and power were computed, and structural imaging was obtained to assess stroke-related injury. Mixed-effects linear models and correlation analyses were employed to evaluate relationships between EEG measures and motor status, recovery, and injury.ResultsThis work replicated key EEG biomarker findings from previous work. Individuals post-stroke (n = 30) depicted elevated delta coherence between bilateral motor cortices at the time of IRF admission that decreased over time, paralleling motor recovery and resembling coherence observed in controls (n = 17) by IRF discharge. Greater corticospinal tract injury and lesion volume were associated with greater delta and beta coherence and delta power, respectively, in leads overlying bilateral sensorimotor regions.ConclusionsReplication of these findings in an independent cohort further substantiates resting-state low-frequency oscillatory activity as a marker of stroke-related injury and recovery. Collectively, these results support the validity of EEG-derived biomarkers in stroke and suggest that delta-band activity may represent a particularly relevant biomarker during early post-stroke motor recovery.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在独立队列中验证静息态脑电低频振荡活动能否作为卒中后损伤与恢复的标志物，比较了卒中患者与未受损成人在康复机构入院和出院前后的运动评估、脑电功率与相干性及结构影像。结果显示，患者入院时双侧运动皮层间delta相干性升高，随后随时间下降，与运动恢复平行，至出院时接近对照组水平；皮质脊髓束损伤和病灶体积分别与感觉运动区delta、beta相干性及delta功率相关。作者认为，这些结果重复了既往发现，进一步支持静息态低频振荡活动作为卒中相关损伤和恢复标志物的有效性，并提示delta频段活动可能是卒中后早期运动恢复中尤为相关的生物标志物。

papers.title: Awareness-dependent Attentional Templates: Neural Mechanism Differentiation Driven by Visual Working Memory Load.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Sun Y, Cai Y, Zhang X, Lu J.
papers.abstract: Visual working memory (VWM) guides attention via internal attentional templates, but whether this relies on a "single" or "multiple" templates and how awareness and VWM load regulate its neural mechanisms remain unclear. This study used a VWM-guided visual search paradigm with backward masking (awareness manipulation) and EEG. Behavioral results showed that aware VWM supported multi-template attention guidance, while subjectively unaware VWM only allowed single-template guidance. EEG revealed that alpha oscillations over posterior electrodes indexed attention allocation. Neural mechanisms differed by VWM load: Single-item maintenance relied on posterior alpha-alpha phase coupling, while multi-item maintenance depended on theta-alpha cross-frequency coupling between anterior and bilateral posterior regions. These findings clarify how awareness regulates VWM attentional template mode and reveal load-specific neural coupling, providing evidence for understanding working memory-attention-awareness interactions.

papers.title: Patterns of Alpha-band Power Reflect Prioritization of the Most Recently Encoded Location in a Working Memory Sequence.
papers.authors: Bendickson SL, Schmitz NR, McCraw A, Kavusturan I, Sutterer DW.
papers.abstract: Space and time play a critical role in working memory formation and maintenance relative to other object features. Particularly, covert spatial attention spontaneously tracks object locations in working memory and is thought to enable feature binding at those location markers. However, whether object locations are attended concurrently as multiple objects are presented in a sequence remains a topic of debate. Here, we investigated whether spatial attention contributes to sustained active memory maintenance when items are separated in both space and time. We report two experiments that differed in whether color or location was the tested feature. In each experiment, we measured EEG alpha-band power while participants memorized the target feature of two sequentially presented colored dots. We then applied an inverted encoding model to the topography of oscillatory alpha-band power (8-12 Hz) on the scalp to measure how long the location of each item was attended. In Experiment 1, participants performed a delayed color estimation task, and we found that patterns of alpha-band power tracked the location of the most recently presented item. In Experiment 2, participants performed a delayed spatial estimation task, and we found that patterns of alpha-band power tracked the location of Item 1 for longer than observed in Experiment 1. However, only the most recently presented item (Item 2) sustained until the end of the delay. Taken together, our results show that, although both items need to be remembered, covert spatial attention prioritizes items one at a time when they are displayed in a sequence.

papers.title: The Effect of Perceptually Challenging Conditions on Speech and Sign Language Perception.
papers.authors: Figuerola CT, Signoret C, Holmer E, Andin J.
papers.abstract: Language is often processed in perceptually challenging conditions. Although the neural correlates of speech processing in such conditions have been well studied, this is not the case for sign language. Thus, it is unknown whether the neural mechanisms involved in this process are comparable across language modalities. One reason for the lack of studies in sign language might be attributed to the difficulties in adapting perceptual manipulations from the context of speech to sign language. In the present study, we aim to address the gap in the literature by investigating whether the neural correlates for processing language presented in perceptually challenging conditions are similar across the visual and auditory modalities, using manipulations of background noise and spectral degradation that are comparable between languages and a within-subject design. We recruited 22 hearing signers who did a perceptual attention task while in an MRI scanner, in which the signal is either clear, presented in background noise, or spectrally degraded. Overall, our results suggest that language processing in perceptually challenging conditions relies primarily on modality-specific mechanisms rather than a shared, modality-independent neural system. Whereas speech processing appeared relatively robust to perceptual degradation, sign language recruited additional visual indicating modality-dependent compensatory strategies. These findings refine current neurobiological models of language by demonstrating that perceptual challenge interacts fundamentally with language modality.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在感知条件不利时，语音和手语加工是否依赖相似的神经机制，并让22名会手语的听人在核磁共振扫描中完成感知注意任务，比较清晰、背景噪声和频谱退化条件下的反应。结果显示，困难条件下的语言加工主要依赖各感觉通道特有的机制，而非共享的、与通道无关的神经系统；语音加工对感知退化相对稳健，手语则额外调动视觉相关资源，提示存在依赖通道的补偿策略。作者据此认为，感知挑战与语言通道存在根本性交互，这一结果有助于修正现有的语言神经生物学模型。

papers.title: Bilateral lingual epilepsy following traumatic brain injury.
papers.authors: Calvert G, Flynn P, McCarron MO.
papers.abstract: Lingual seizures are an uncommon form of focal motor epilepsy. Although classically associated with infective, neoplastic or vascular causes, it may follow traumatic brain injury. A 37-year-old man had sustained a severe brain injury when aged 2 years. Following a generalised tonic-clonic seizure at the age of 9 years, he subsequently had brief and recurrent episodes of bilateral lingual twitching that persisted into adulthood. These events were refractory to carbamazepine, lacosamide and valproate. MR brain imaging showed cystic encephalomalacia of the left frontal operculum. Electroencephalography showed irregular and sharpened left-sided slow waves but no epileptiform activity, even during episodes of lingual twitching. Bilateral lingual seizures in this patient implied that the left operculum cortex innervated both hypoglossal nuclei.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一名幼年遭受严重脑外伤的成年男性，其在全身性强直-阵挛发作后出现反复、短暂的双侧舌肌抽动，并持续至成年，且对多种抗癫痫药物耐药。影像学显示左侧额叶岛盖囊性软化灶，脑电图可见左侧不规则尖化慢波，但即使在舌肌抽动发作时也未记录到癫痫样活动。作者据此推断，该患者双侧舌肌发作提示左侧岛盖皮质支配了双侧舌下神经核，为外伤后双侧舌肌癫痫的定位与网络机制提供了一个临床观察线索。

papers.title: Fragile X-associated tremor/ataxia syndrome with autoimmune hepatitis requiring liver transplantation.
papers.authors: Viteri V, Parada MF, Santos ER, Biag HMB, Schneider A, Villarreal J, Trotter JF, Hagerman RJ.
papers.abstract: Fragile X-associated tremor/ataxia syndrome (FXTAS) is a neurodegenerative disorder that develops in some carriers of the FMR1 premutation. It starts with slight tremors or unsteadiness that progresses over time and includes cognitive decline. Here, we present the case of a man in his mid-60s with 88 CGG repeats in FMR1 who was diagnosed with FXTAS in his late 50s. In his early 60s, he was diagnosed with autoimmune hepatitis (AIH), confirmed by biopsy, and his liver function declined, requiring a transplant. Recovery was complicated by a bile duct leak, but he eventually stabilised. Neurologically, his symptoms gradually worsened before the transplant; he was falling 7 times a day, showed tremor, ataxia and mild rigidity. MRI demonstrated white matter disease in the middle cerebellar peduncle and the splenium in the corpus callosum. The individual showed improvement in ataxic symptoms after the transplant and is no longer experiencing falls. Although FXTAS is primarily a neurodegenerative disorder, increasing evidence suggests that carriers of the FMR1 premutation are also at higher risk for immune-mediated conditions. However, AIH has not previously been reported in individuals with FXTAS. This suggests a potential broader association between premutation and autoimmune diseases in fragile X premutation carriers. This case highlights the importance of monitoring autoimmune complications in these patients.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例伴有自身免疫性肝炎并需肝移植的脆性X相关震颤/共济失调综合征（FXTAS）病例：一名FMR1前突变携带者先被诊断为FXTAS，后经活检确诊自身免疫性肝炎，肝功能恶化后接受移植，术后虽出现胆管漏但最终稳定。移植前其神经系统症状逐渐加重，出现震颤、共济失调、轻度强直及频繁跌倒，MRI显示小脑中脚和胼胝体压部白质病变；移植后共济失调症状改善，不再跌倒。作者指出，FXTAS虽主要是神经退行性疾病，但前突变携带者可能更易患免疫介导疾病，此前未见FXTAS合并自身免疫性肝炎的报道，提示两者可能存在更广泛的关联，并强调对此类患者监测自身免疫并发症的重要性。

papers.title: Distinct pattern in bipolar depression and major depressive disorder: A multiscale imaging-transcriptomic analysis.
papers.authors: Sun G, Sun T, Yuan Y, Zhang Y, Zhou Y, Ye S, Yue Y, Guo W, Jiang W, Jiang C, Yuan Y.
papers.abstract: Aim Bipolar depression (BDD) and major depressive disorder (MDD) share similar depressive symptoms but differ in diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis. Clarifying their neurobiological distinctions may improve diagnostic characterization and mechanistic understanding. Methods We studied 453 participants, including 85 patients with BDD, 190 with MDD, and 178 healthy controls. Individual morphometric similarity networks (MSN) were constructed using seven structural and diffusion MRI features. Regional MSN differences between BDD and MDD were examined at the parcel level. To characterize the biological relevance of the distinct MSN pattern, we performed imaging-transcriptomic analysis using Allen Human Brain Atlas data, followed by gene enrichment, cell-type enrichment, receptor/transporter dominance analysis, and cognitive meta-analytic decoding. Sensitivity analyses evaluated the effects of medication exposure and demographic imbalance. Results Compared with MDD, BDD showed distinct MSN alterations mainly in parietal and occipital regions, including higher MSN in the left lateral occipital cortex and lower MSN in the right inferior and superior parietal cortices. The spatial transcriptomic pattern was enriched for ribosomal and protein synthesis/modification pathways. Cell-type enrichment analyses showed that the transcriptomic pattern associated with the MSN differences was enriched for microglial and inhibitory-neuron gene signatures, while receptor dominance analysis identified the 5-HT2A density map as having the largest relative contribution to the explained spatial variance. Conclusion Our findings identify distinct cortical morphometric organization in BDD and MDD, and these differences are linked to transcriptomic, cellular, and neurotransmitter-related annotations, providing multiscale insights into the neurobiological divergence between the two disorders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注双相抑郁与重性抑郁障碍在症状相似背景下如何区分其神经生物学差异，基于多模态结构MRI构建个体形态相似性网络，比较两组患者的皮层区域模式，并结合影像-转录组分析探讨其生物学关联。结果显示，双相抑郁在顶叶和枕叶区域表现出与重性抑郁障碍不同的形态相似性改变，相关空间表达模式富集于核糖体及蛋白质合成/修饰通路，并与小胶质细胞和抑制性神经元基因特征相关，5-HT2A受体密度图对空间方差的相对贡献最大。作者据此认为，两种抑郁在皮层形态组织上存在可区分的模式，并涉及转录组、细胞和神经递质层面的多重标注，为理解二者的神经生物学分歧提供了多尺度线索。

papers.title: Unsupervised Subtyping of Focal Epilepsy IEDs via Graph-Based MEG Networks.
papers.authors: Zheng Q, Liu Y, Xie Z, Dong K, Liu Z, Chen Y, Sun J, Cao C, Liu F.
papers.abstract: Objective Interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs) are clinically important biomarkers in focal epilepsy, yet their source-level network organization and subtype structure remain insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to identify reproducible IED network subtypes from source-level magnetoencephalography (MEG) connectivity and to examine whether these subtypes capture clinically meaningful information related to MEGIEDlocalization. Methods Fifty-five patients with focal epilepsy were retrospectively included. After manual IED identification, source-level MEG signals were reconstructed and converted into 148 × 148 phase-locking value connectivity matrices. These matrices provided the basis for graph-based representation learning, in which DeepWalk, Node2Vec, Graph Convolutional Network (GCN), Graph Attention Network (GAT), and Multi-View Graph Representation Learning (MVGRL) models were paired with K-means or spectral clustering to identify latent interictal epileptiform discharge (IED) network subtypes. The selected subtype structure was then examined in a downstream clinical prediction task. Specifically, a subtype enhanced model encoded each patient as a bag of IEDconnectivity matrices, summarized IED-level embeddings through attention based multiple-instance pooling, and integrated subtype composition through soft prototype routing for MEG IED localization classification. Results A total of 8,509 IEDs were identified. MVGRL combined with K-means achieved the best clustering performance and revealed four IED network subtypes. These subtypes differed in global network efficiency, nodal organization, and associations with MRI-derived cortical thickness. Overall network efficiency followed the order Subtype 4, Subtype 1, Subtype 2, and Subtype 3. Matrix-level validation showed that the four subtypes could be classified from graph theoretical features with an overall SVM accuracy of 93.90%. In patient-level validation, the subtype-enhanced model achieved 58.8% balanced accuracy for temporal-versus-other MEG IED localization classification, outperforming both the graph-feature random forest baseline and the deep multiple-instance baseline without subtype routing. Conclusion This study demonstrates that leveraging the spatiotemporal dynamics of IEDs through unsupervised clustering enhances the understanding of shared/unique network features across focal epilepsy types. Significance These findings provide an imaging-based framework for characterizing the heterogeneity of interictal epileptiform network states in focal epilepsy. Further validation against independently established clinical seizure-onset and epileptogenic zone labels is required before the framework can be interpreted as a clinical seizure-localization tool.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对局灶性癫痫患者发作间期癫痫样放电（IED），利用源水平脑磁图构建功能连接网络，并通过无监督图表示学习识别可重复的IED网络亚型。结果得到四种IED网络亚型，它们在全局网络效率、节点组织和与MRI皮层厚度的关联上存在差异，且可由图论特征以较高准确率区分。在患者水平的颞叶与其他部位IED定位分类中，引入亚型信息的模型表现优于不含亚型路由的基线。作者据此认为，利用IED时空动态的无监督聚类有助于刻画局灶性癫痫网络状态的异质性，但该框架尚需在独立临床发作起始区和致痫区标签上验证，才能视为临床定位工具。

papers.title: OrthoTSS: A Zero-Calibration Framework for Cross-Subject P300 Decoding Via Orthogonality-Guided Task-Subject Separation.
papers.authors: Du X, Xu X, Zeng H, Zhang H, Yu J, Deng H, Song A, Zhang W, Chen D.
papers.abstract: Objective Cross-subject P300 decoding remains challenging for zero-calibration brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), as inter-subject variability must be reduced while preserving weak task-relevant neural information. Methods We propose Orthogonality-guided Task-Subject Separation (OrthoTSS), integrating a multi-scale spatio-temporal frontend, dual bidirectional Mamba streams, and orthogonality regularization. The task stream performs target/non-target decoding, while an auxiliary domain stream models subject-related variability during training. The regularization reduces linear cross-stream coupling and promotes functional differentiation without assuming complete disentanglement. Results Under leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation, OrthoTSS achieved 76.35% balanced accuracy on PhysioNet ERP and 86.75% on Naturalistic Search FRP. It showed favorable performance against representative architectural, recent cross-subject, and domain-generalization baselines. Ablation and representation analyses further indicated reduced cross-stream similarity and relative branch specialization while preserving task-discriminative structure. Conclusion OrthoTSS improves cross-subject P300 decoding by promoting functional differentiation between task-related and subject-related representations while retaining discriminative neural information. Significance This task-preservation-oriented framework provides offline evidence toward practical zero-calibration P300 BCI decoding.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对零校准脑机接口中跨被试P300解码的难点，提出OrthoTSS框架，通过正交性引导将任务相关表征与被试相关变异分离，在减少个体差异的同时保留微弱任务信息。方法上结合多尺度时空前端、双向Mamba流与正交正则化，在训练中由辅助域流建模被试变异。留一被试交叉验证显示，该框架在两个数据集上取得较高平衡准确率，优于多种代表性基线；消融与表征分析提示流间相似度降低、分支功能趋于分化，同时任务判别结构得以保留。作者据此认为，这种以任务保留为导向的框架为零校准P300解码提供了离线证据，但尚需进一步验证其实际应用价值。

papers.title: Response to Electroconvulsive Therapy in a Patient With SCN2A-Variant Catatonia Is Associated With Postictal Spreading Depolarization.
papers.authors: Rosenthal Z, Lad K, Li R, Chaves J, Hosseini G, Cristancho M, Palmer C.
papers.abstract: An 18-year-old female patient with a history of autism spectrum disorder and SCN2A loss-of-function variant received a course of electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) for catatonia, which had been present and disabling for 1 year. After a partial lorazepam taper, bitemporal ECT was initiated. The patient had a rapid and robust response to ECT with improvement in the Bush-Francis Catatonia Rating Scale to 0 after 4 treatments and sustained catatonia remission even after lorazepam cessation. After the patient's family opted to discontinue ECT after the index course, she suffered a recurrence of her catatonia 2 months later, which remitted after a second index ECT course. The patient's brain physiology was highly stereotyped across treatments, with prominent EEG postictal suppression coinciding with cortical spreading depolarization (CSD). This case represents the fourth-ever reported case of SCN2A-associated catatonia and the oldest onset of catatonia in this population. In addition, it provides support for the emerging evidence for CSD as a potential contributor to both ECT postictal suppression and clinical response.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一名携带SCN2A功能缺失变异、并有孤独症谱系障碍史的青少年女性，因持续一年的紧张症接受双侧颞部电休克治疗。经部分减量劳拉西泮后开始治疗，患者在数次治疗后紧张症评分降至零，并在停用劳拉西泮后仍维持缓解；家属选择结束疗程后症状于两个月内复发，再次疗程后缓解。作者指出，各次治疗间脑生理表现高度一致，发作后脑电抑制与皮层扩散性去极化同时出现，提示后者可能参与电休克的发作后抑制及临床反应，但这一关联仍需更多研究验证。

papers.title: Impact of differences in kidney function estimation by creatinine compared to cystatin C on clinical outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation.
papers.authors: Krisai P, Mutti M, Aeschbacher S, Coslovsky M, Reichlin T, Rodondi N, Ammann P, Moschovitis G, Rigamonti E, Conte G, Haller ML, Stoecklin A, Bonati LH, Osswald S, Conen D, Mahfoud F, Kühne M.
papers.abstract: Aims Differences between cystatin C-based and creatinine-based glomerular filtration rate estimations (eGFRdiff) have been associated with adverse outcomes. We aimed to investigate the prevalence of eGFRdiff and its association with clinical outcomes and brain lesions in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Methods and results We analysed 3804 patients with AF enrolled in two prospective, multicentre cohort studies. The eGFRdiff was calculated by 'cystatin C-based eGFR-creatinine-based eGFR'. Patients were stratified into three groups: eGFRdiff >10, -10 to 10, and <-10 mL/min/1.73 m². Associations with high-sensitivity troponin T (hs-TnT), NT-proBNP, major adverse cardiovascular (CV) events (stroke/systemic embolism, myocardial infarction and CV death), first heart failure (HF) hospitalization, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-detected brain lesions were assessed. The mean age was 71 years, 28% were female, and 49% had paroxysmal AF. An eGFRdiff of >10, -10 to 10, and <-10 mL/min/1.73 m2 was present in 17.7%, 71.7%, and 10.6% of the patients, respectively. Incidence rates per 100 patient-years increased across these groups for major CV events (MACEs: 1.7, 3.9, 6.8) and HF hospitalization (1.2, 3.5, 6.1). Similarly, the prevalence of MRI-detected brain infarcts (28%, 39%, 42%) and moderate-to-severe white matter hyperintensities (38%, 55%, 63%) increased with greater eGFRdiff. The levels of hs-TnT and NT-proBNP were inversely correlated with eGFRdiff. In multivariable-adjusted linear models, lower eGFRdiff was associated with MACE (P = 0.006) and HF hospitalization (P = 0.015). Conclusion A substantial proportion of patients with AF exhibit clinically relevant eGFRdiff. More negative eGFR difference was associated with elevated cardiac biomarkers, greater burden of ischaemic brain lesions, and increased risk of CV events and HF hospitalization. Clinicaltrialsgov identifier NCT02105844.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于两个前瞻性多中心房颤队列，比较了以胱抑素C和肌酐估算的肾小球滤过率之差（eGFRdiff）与临床结局及脑部影像病灶的关联。结果显示，eGFRdiff明显偏负的患者，其心血管不良事件和心衰住院的发生率更高，核磁共振所见的脑梗死及中重度白质高信号也更常见，同时心脏生物标志物水平升高。作者据此认为，相当比例的房颤患者存在有临床意义的eGFRdiff，更负的差值提示心血管事件、心衰住院和缺血性脑损伤负担更重；但这是观察性关联，不能据此推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Identifying shared and personalized brain functional connectivity subspace across neuropsychiatric disorders.
papers.authors: Liu S, Wang Z, Wang Y, Yang Y.
papers.abstract: Objective. Neuropsychiatric disorders exhibit complex functional connectivity (FC) alterations, yet disentangling transdiagnostic mechanisms from disorder-specific network perturbations remains challenging due to clinical heterogeneity and multisite data confounds.Approach. We aggregated large-scale resting-state fMRI data from 1923 patients with major depressive disorder (MDD), autism spectrum disorder (ASD), or attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and site-matched controls from the REST-meta-MDD, ABIDE, and ADHD-200 consortia. We applied the established common orthogonal basis extraction algorithm to decompose individual FC matrices into shared and personalized subspaces following site-level normalization.Main results. We validated that shared subspaces captured robust pathological signatures capable of distinguishing patients from independent healthy controls from the human connectome project. A hierarchical analysis of these shared subspaces revealed a transdiagnostic core defined by widespread default mode network decoupling alongside divergent subcortical connectivity patterns: hyper-connectivity in MDD but hypo-connectivity in ASD and ADHD. Despite these conserved commonalities, we demonstrated a functional dissociation in clinical utility: personalized subspaces exhibited significantly higher utility for precision characterization, achieving superior performance in predicting individual symptom severity and in discriminating between diagnostic groups (macro-F 1: 77.6%)- tasks where shared features lacked sufficient specificity.Significance. These findings provide evidence consistent with a hierarchical neurobiological architecture wherein shared subspaces map conserved vulnerabilities, while personalized subspaces capture the heterogeneity underlying diagnostic distinctions and individual symptom expression. This work supports the value of modeling personalized neural signatures to advance precision psychiatry.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究整合了抑郁症、自闭症谱系障碍和注意缺陷多动障碍患者及站点匹配对照的静息态功能磁共振数据，用正交基提取方法将个体功能连接矩阵分解为共享与个体化子空间。共享子空间能稳健区分患者与独立健康对照，并呈现跨诊断核心特征：默认网络广泛解耦，而皮层下连接在抑郁症中表现为连接增强、在自闭症和多动障碍中表现为连接减弱。个体化子空间则在预测个体症状严重程度和区分诊断组别上表现更优，提示共享成分对应共同易感性，个体化成分承载诊断区分与症状表达的异质性，支持精准精神病学中对个体化神经特征的建模。

papers.title: System-level synchronization and subtype-specific modules govern brain-wide serotonin axon innervation.
papers.authors: Adams AMJ, Wu KLK, Li Z, Li P, Pan H, Huang Z, Migliarini S, Dear R, Sun B, Chan ZC, Liang J, Li H, Vértes PE, Pasqualetti M, Isakova A, Ren J.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: The serotonin system modulates nearly all neural circuits across development and adulthood and is a major pharmacological target for mood and anxiety disorders. Forebrain-projecting serotonin neurons are organized into projection-defined subsystems that align with molecular heterogeneity, but how these subsystems assemble during development remains unclear. We combined whole-brain developmental projection maps with single-cell transcriptomics to define the spatiotemporal and molecular logic of postnatal serotonin innervation. Using a deep-learning pipeline, we generated four-dimensional whole-brain maps of postnatal serotonin axon density and uncovered two coupled modes of regulation: region-specific trajectories of axon growth and refinement, and an early-postnatal, brain-wide synchronization of innervation. To link these dynamics to cell-intrinsic programs, we profiled single-cell transcriptomes of forebrain-projecting serotonin neurons from embryonic through postnatal stages and reconstructed developmental trajectories. We found that serotonin neuron heterogeneity was established embryonically and that the subtype taxonomy was largely conserved between mice and humans. Across serotonin subtypes, we observed a coordinated surge in wiring-molecule expression at mouse postnatal day 4 that aligned with the subsequent global innervation wave. Tracing subtypes defined by developmentally conserved markers at birth revealed complementary projection territories and engagement of distinct postnatal wiring modules that matched region-specific terminal maturation. Together, these results show that brain-wide serotonin innervation is built through embryonic subtype specification and two layers of postnatal control: system-level synchronization and subtype-specific terminal development.

papers.title: Calcium sensing by the C2A domain of Synaptotagmin 7 is required through the linker for both synaptic facilitation and memory.
papers.authors: Sakurai A, Fujii T, Yoshihara M.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: The earliest synaptic plasticity, called synaptic facilitation, is frequently observed at the beginning of any train of action potentials carrying information in the brain. During consecutive action potentials with short intervals, transmissions influence later ones, often enhancing neurotransmitter release. Facilitation is predicted to be controlled by a high-affinity Ca2+ sensor that responds to the presynaptic residual Ca2+ after the previous Ca2+ influx. While synapse strengthening via facilitation has been theoretically proposed to underlie instantaneously formed memory, the lack of experimental procedures to specifically manipulate facilitation has hampered attempts to establish a link from facilitation to memory. Through a genetic dissection of Synaptotagmin 7 (Syt7) in Drosophila , here we determine Syt7 as the high-affinity Ca2+ sensor for synaptic facilitation, showing close correlation from synaptic facilitation to memory. At the highly plastic neuromuscular synapses in Drosophila embryos, we found that facilitation was achieved by an intramolecular interaction of the two Ca2+ -binding domains C2A and C2B of Syt7 via the linker. C2B is responsible for the suppression, i.e., inhibiting fusion of a synaptic vesicle to the plasma membrane. Upon binding residual Ca2+ , C2A releases this suppression through the eight-amino acid intramolecular linker between C2A and C2B. Supporting this "suppression-release model," disrupting either the length of this linker or Ca2+ -binding to C2A led to specific defects in facilitation. These mutations also induced defects in memory, assayed by a Pavlovian conditioning scheme using Drosophila adults. This suggests that the Syt7 function required for facilitation is also required for memory.

papers.title: Linguistic information may compensate for age-related decline in attentional filtering.
papers.authors: Barchet AV, Bruera A, Rimmele JM, Obleser J, Hartwigsen G.
papers.abstract: As we age, understanding speech in social situations imposes an increasingly difficult challenge to the auditory system. However, the attentional mechanisms underlying age-related speech comprehension difficulties in multitalker situations remain unclear. We collected EEG signals while 63 normal hearing participants (35 women) from 19 to 71 years performed a speech comprehension task involving a multitalker paradigm at individually adjusted target-to-distractor ratios. Combining trial-resolved multivariate temporal response function modeling with detailed behavioral comprehension responses, we provide a window into lower-level impairments and possible higher-level compensatory mechanisms across the adult life span. We show that reduced behavioral performance in late adulthood is associated with increased distractor representation. This points towards increased distractibility as a potential mechanism underlying age-related speech comprehension deficits. Additionally, at the behavioral and neural levels, we show that older adults rely more on higher-level linguistic information. Finally, we show that an increased reliance on word-level linguistic information may compensate for increased distractor tracking and adaptively support comprehension performance across the adult life span. Thus, an increased reliance on higher-level processing could attenuate age-related impairments in attentional filtering.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注成年后言语理解能力下降背后的注意机制，采用多说话人范式，结合脑电信号与试次分辨的多变量时间响应函数建模，考察成年人在不同年龄阶段的言语理解表现。结果显示，晚成年期行为成绩下降与对干扰声的神经表征增强有关，提示更易受干扰可能是年龄相关言语理解困难的一个机制；同时，老年人在行为和神经层面都更依赖较高层级的语言信息。研究进一步表明，对词级语言信息的更大依赖可能补偿增强的干扰追踪，从而在整个成年期自适应地支持理解成绩，即更依赖高层加工或可减轻年龄相关的注意过滤缺陷。

papers.title: Patient-specific structural connectomic differences of deep brain stimulation targets in treatment-resistant obsessive-compulsive disorder patients.
papers.authors: Marquez-Franco R, Ruelas L, Loução R, Schmahl R, Cid Rodríguez FX, Heiden P, Kuhn J, Koy A, Visser-Vandewalle V, Andrade P.
papers.abstract: Deep brain stimulation (DBS) is an established therapy for treatment-resistant obsessive-compulsive disorder (trOCD), yet clinical outcomes vary. This is partly due to differential cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical networks (CSTC) engagement across stimulation in relevant anatomical regions. This study compared the structural and functional connectivity profiles of three relevant anatomical-regions that have also served as target for DBS in different centers for trOCD: the nucleus accumbens/anterior-limb of the internal-capsule (NAc/ALIC), the medial forebrain bundle (MFB), and the anteromedial subthalamic nucleus (amSTN). We analysed in a retrospective, observational, single-center cohort the structural connectivity on patient-specific space, using structural and diffusion MRI data from 22 trOCD patients treated with NAc/ALIC DBS at the University Hospital Cologne. For this end, Whole-brain probabilistic-tractography using single-shell-three-tissue constrained-spherical-deconvolution was applied to reconstruct patient-specific structural connectivity matrices. From whole-brain tractograms, target-specific streamline subsets were selected using ROI-based inclusion criteria using 2 mm radius spheric stereotactic ROIs representing clinically relevant trOCD-DBS target regions. Afterwards, Structural connectivity matrices were extracted using Spherical-deconvolution informed filtering of tractograms (SIFT) streamline count, fractional anisotropy (FA), and mean diffusivity (MD) across 13 cortico-subcortical regions implicated in OCD pathophysiology. Thereafter, we characterized each target's connectivity to key OCD functional networks derived from meta-analytic functional connectivity maps. NAc/ALIC demonstrated stronger structural fronto-limbic connectivity: medial-orbitofrontal cortex, anterior-cingulate, insula, and accumbens (p < 0.0001), associated with the affect (AN), salience (SN), default-mode (DMN), and reward-motivation (RMN) networks anatomical hubs. The MFB predominantly connected with reward-related regions: pallidum and rostral-middle-frontal cortex (p < 0.0001). The amSTN showed to be mainly connected to SN and the cognitive/motor control network (CMCN): precentral and paracentral gyri (p < 0.0001). These exploratory findings suggest that clinically relevant trOCD-DBS targets may engage distinct but partially overlapping tractography derived structural networks and meta-analytic functional networks. The observed connectivity profiles may help generate hypotheses about symptom-specific networks for future DBS planning. Overall, these results support the proof-of-concept value of patient-specific probabilistic tractography in trOCD. However, prospective validation in independent, multicentric trials remains necessary before clinical translation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注难治性强迫症深部脑刺激（DBS）不同靶点在患者个体结构连接上的差异，基于单中心回顾性队列的结构与弥散MRI数据，用概率纤维追踪比较了伏隔核/内囊前肢、内侧前脑束和丘脑底核前内侧部的连接特征。结果显示，伏隔核/内囊前肢与额-边缘区域连接更强，内侧前脑束主要连接奖赏相关区域，丘脑底核前内侧部则更多连接显著性和认知/运动控制网络，提示这些临床靶点可能各自卷入不同但部分重叠的结构与功能网络。作者强调这些探索性发现可为症状特异性网络假设和未来DBS规划提供线索，但尚需独立多中心前瞻性验证才能考虑临床转化。

papers.title: Cognitive effects of deep brain stimulation across targets in epilepsy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Halphen J, Chen H, Julca MM, Haneef Z, Modiano YA.
papers.abstract: Objective Drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) affects one-third of individuals with epilepsy and increases cognitive decline. Resective surgery carries focal cognitive risks and contraindications. Deep-brain stimulation (DBS) represents a promising alternative, although its cognitive effects remain understudied. Methods We searched PubMed, MEDLINE, EMBASE, Web of Science, and Cochrane for pre- and post-DBS neuropsychological scores in DRE with ≥ 3 months follow-up. Fifteen studies (16 cohorts, n = 270) were reviewed; 12 (13 cohorts, n = 209) were meta-analyzed. Targets were the anterior nucleus of the thalamus (ANT, k = 7), amygdalohippocampal region (AH, k = 6), centromedian nucleus of the thalamus (k = 2), and subthalamic nucleus of the thalamus (k = 1). Robust variance estimation computed Hedges' g by domain. Bias assessed with ROBINS-I and RoB 2; certainty with GRADE. Results No cognitive domain declined significantly. Executive functioning was the only domain approaching improvement (g = 0.12, 95% CI -0.08 to 0.33), most apparent with ANT (g = 0.15, CI -0.16 to 0.46). Anxiety declined significantly (g = -0.36, 95% CI -0.68 to -0.04). Memory, language, processing speed, visuospatial functions, and global intellect remained stable. Cognitive adverse events occurred in 15.8% of patients, highest with ANT (20.1%) and lowest with AH (9.24%). Significance Chronic DBS for DRE is cognitively well tolerated, with no decline across domains and emerging evidence of executive functioning and mood benefit, especially with ANT stimulation. Verbal memory and naming were preserved after AH stimulation, unlike dominant temporal resection. Plausible mechanisms exist for both cognitive improvement and decline, yet neither appears consistently on assessments. Whether this reflects true stability or insensitivity of current methods is unclear. A revised framework for assessment timing, domains, and metrics is recommended.

papers.title: On the nature of GABA<sub>B</sub> receptors and their plasticity in the mammalian brain.
papers.authors: Booker SA.
papers.abstract: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) is the principal inhibitory neurotransmitter of the mammalian CNS, essential for circuit function and behaviour. In the brain, GABA activates GABAA and GABAB receptors to modulate circuit activity on behaviourally relevant timescales. GABAB receptor signalling in pre- and postsynaptic domains of neurons is often overlooked, despite the strong inhibition it produces. Importantly, GABAB receptors are diversely phosphorylated and interact with various auxiliary subunits to modify function. This review compares the evidence for the expression and modulation of GABAB receptors, their effectors, and regulatory mechanisms between cell types, brain areas, and mammalian species, particularly focusing on the plasticity of these mechanisms and their relationship to neurological diseases such as epilepsy and dementia.

papers.title: Acute or developmental exposure of primary rat cortical cells to Emamectin Benzoate disrupts gene expression.
papers.authors: Jackson TW, Freeborn D, Winnik WM, Padgett WT, Herr DW, Kodavanti PRS.
papers.abstract: As the number of chemicals lacking neurotoxicity assessment increases, there is an increased demand for data and tools that can quickly prioritize and identify hazardous chemicals. Using sub-cytotoxic concentrations of Emamectin Benzoate (EMB), an avermectin class pesticide, we explored the use of transcriptomic assessment to provide foundational molecular data for understanding the modes of action for the toxic effects of these chemicals. Primary cortical cell cultures from Long Evans rats were exposed to varying concentrations of EMB and assessed for toxicity following a short-term exposure and a continuous exposure during a key developmental differentiation and synapse formation window. The goals of this study were to determine if EMB exposure disrupted gene expression, whether those changes varied across cortical cell development, compare with proteomic and phenotypic changes, and understand how these gene expression changes could provide critical information on molecular initiating and key events for developmental neurotoxicity. At acute exposure concentrations up to 2.5 μM, minimal transcriptomic effects were observed under the presented analysis framework. Following prolonged developmental exposure, concentration-responsive differential expression was observed across all timepoints, with notable overlap in some key pathways and distinct expression patterns in others. Gene expression changes occurred at similar concentration with proteomic and phenotypic changes. DIV7 emerged as the most sensitive developmental window, with strong dose-responsive effects affecting synaptic and myelin-related genes. These data link transcriptomic and multi-omic molecular changes to apical endpoints and support mechanisms related to GABA signaling, ribosomal protein disruption, inflammation, neurite outgrowth, and synaptogenesis.

papers.title: Dysfunctional neural processing of object-related speech with semantically unrelated vs related co-verbal gesture in schizophrenia spectrum disorders.
papers.authors: Leinweber K, He Y, Kircher T, Straube B.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SSD) are accompanied by impaired multimodal communication. This is particularly evident in production and comprehension deficits of both speech and gesture. Previous neuroimaging findings indicate reduced activation in sensorimotor regions, such as the left postcentral gyrus and right insula, during object-related speech processing in SSD (He et al., 2021). However, it remains unclear how semantic congruency of co-verbal gestures influences the neural processing of object-related speech. This study aims to investigate the effect of semantically related and unrelated gestures on the processing of social and object-related speech. Methods 45 patients with SSD and 43 healthy controls viewed short videos of an actor presenting social or object-related sentences, accompanied by semantically related or unrelated emblematic (social-related) and tool-use (object-related) gestures. Functional MRI data was acquired while participants performed a content-judgment task, deciding whether the observed stimuli contained social or object-related information. Results Object-related stimuli and semantically related gesture were associated with higher accuracy rates in the content-judgment task in both groups. When processing object-related content with unrelated gestures, patients displayed reduced neural activation in a cluster including the supplementary motor area and the precentral, superior frontal, posterior orbital and temporal gyri, as compared to healthy controls. Discussion These results extend findings on motor-simulation in object-related information, potentially reflected in motor cortex activation for object-related sentences in healthy controls. Patients with SSD demonstrated reduced premotor cortex activation especially when the object-related speech was accompanied by semantically unrelated gestures, suggesting a specific impairment in mental simulation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察精神分裂症谱系障碍患者在处理与物体相关言语时，语义相关与不相关共语手势如何影响其神经加工。研究者让患者与健康对照观看配以相关或不相关手势的社交或物体相关语句视频，并在内容判断任务中同步采集功能磁共振数据。结果发现，两组在物体相关刺激和语义相关手势条件下判断正确率更高；而在物体相关内容配不相关手势时，患者相比健康对照在辅助运动区及前中央、上额、后眶和颞回等区域激活减弱。作者据此认为，健康对照加工物体相关语句可能依赖运动皮层参与的心理模拟，而患者在不相关手势伴随下表现出前运动皮层激活降低，提示其心理模拟存在特定缺陷。

papers.title: Personalized and normative responsible gambling messages: Neural responses across gambling severity and prudence.
papers.authors: Özer İ, Sánchez-Fernández J, Casado-Aranda LA, Hernández-Vergara NM.
papers.abstract: This study examines whether the neural engagement of two message frames commonly used in responsible gambling communication -personalized messages (tailored suggestions based on gambling behaviors) and normative messages (which encourage behavior that aligns with socially acceptable standards) - varies according to gambling severity and self-perceived prudence. Particularly, using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), we explore brain activation patterns in response to such message frames among 42 predominantly male participants with varying levels of gambling severity and self-perceived prudence. Building on protection motivation theory, exploratory region-of-interest analyses suggested that mPFC engagement to personalized messages was nominally associated with higher gambling severity, and left angular gyrus engagement to normative messages was nominally associated with higher self-perceived prudence; neither association survived correction for multiple comparisons and both should be considered preliminary. Direct whole-brain contrasts further indicated that personalized and normative messages recruited partially dissociable activation patterns. These findings provide preliminary neurocognitive evidence that neural responses to responsible gambling messages are associated with the alignment between message framing and consumer characteristics in a young, predominantly male sample of low-to-moderate-risk gamblers. More broadly, they highlight the value of tailoring harm-minimization strategies to improve the targeting of responsible-gambling interventions.

papers.title: Effects of eccentric upper limbs exercises, added with virtual reality, on tremor and upper limbs function in people with Parkinson's disease: A randomized clinical trial.
papers.authors: Fidelis AL, Silva SSD, Silva ERDR, D'Amelio M, Weprajetzky VEA, Mendes FADS.
papers.journal: Journal of hand therapy : official journal of the American Society of Hand Therapists
papers.abstract: Background Parkinson's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder. Eccentric upper limb exercises can reduce tremors and improve strength, while virtual reality has shown promise in enhancing upper limb function. Purpose The study compared the effects of eccentric upper limb exercises, added to Nintendo Wii games, vs exclusive eccentric exercises, on upper limb tremor and function in Parkinson's disease. Study design Randomized clinical trial. Methods Twenty-five participants were allocated to eccentric exercises added to Nintendo Wii games (EWG) or an exclusive eccentric exercise (EEG). Both groups trained for eight weeks, twice a week, for a total of 16 sessions. Tremor, strength, and manual dexterity were assessed pre-training, post-training, and 1 month follow-up (FU) using MDS-UPDRS, StudyMyTremor, Manual Hydraulic Dynamometer, Box and Block Test, and Nine Hole Peg Test. ReBEC under code RBR-7p2jfnz. Results Eccentric training reduced kinetic tremor amplitude pre x post-training (X2 (1) = [4.5], p = [0.03] and (X2 (1) = [7.3], p = [0.007]) (p < 0.05), and between pre-training x FU (X2 (1) = [4.5], p = [0.03]) and (X2 (1) = [4.4], p = [0.03]) for EEG and EWG. EWG improved the fine manual dexterity by 4 seconds, surpassing the minimal detectable change of 2.6 seconds, between pre x post-training and between pre-training x FU (X2 (2) = [6.8], p =[0.03]). Handgrip strength increased in both groups between pre x post-training (p = [<0.001]; p = [0.02]) and between pre-training x FU (p = [0.02]; p = [0.04]) for EEG and EWG, respectively, with no ANOVA interaction effect (F(2) = 0.09; p = 0.91; ηp 2 < 0.001). Conclusions Eccentric exercises alone or added to Nintendo Wii games can mitigate tremors and improve strength and gross manual dexterity in Parkinson's disease. Adding virtual reality further benefits fine manual dexterity, suggesting a valuable role for gamified rehabilitation.
papers.summary_zh: 该随机临床试验比较了单纯离心上肢训练与离心训练联合Nintendo Wii虚拟现实游戏对帕金森病患者上肢震颤和功能的影响，两组均训练八周。结果显示，两种训练都能降低运动性震颤幅度，并在训练后及一个月随访时提高握力和粗大手动灵巧性；联合虚拟现实的一组还在精细手动灵巧性上取得超过最小可检测变化值的改善。作者认为，离心训练单独或结合游戏化虚拟现实均有助于缓解震颤和改善上肢功能，而加入虚拟现实对精细手动灵巧性有额外益处，提示游戏化康复可能具有应用价值。

papers.title: Altered Resting State Hippocampal Connectivity Associated With Amyloid and Tau in Older Adults Without Dementia From a Population-Based Cohort Study.
papers.authors: Roberts A, Andreescu C, Cohen A, Nadkarni NK, Minhas D, Laymon C, Lopresti B, Snitz B, Karim HT.
papers.journal: The American journal of geriatric psychiatry : official journal of the American Association for Geriatric Psychiatry
papers.abstract: Objective Default mode network (DMN) structures, including hippocampus, accumulate amyloid-beta and tau pathology in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and display connectivity changes prior to the onset of cognitive dysfunction. Methods We recruited cognitively healthy older adults who underwent PiB and AV1451 imaging and resting state functional imaging. We evaluated nonlinear associations between hippocampal DMN connectivity and amyloid-beta and tau in cross-sectional analyses. Results Left and right anterior hippocampal to DMN intranetwork connectivity was greater with greater amyloid and was lower with even greater levels of amyloid (inverted U-shape association). We found that inter-network hippocampal connectivity was greater with greater amyloid and tau. Greater intra and inter-DMN connectivity was associated with greater cognitive function especially memory and attention, consistent with protective association processes. Conclusion Intranetwork DMN connectivity was greater with low to moderate amyloid and was lower with greater amyloid and tau in preclinical AD-connectivity may help maintain cognitive function, especially memory. Functional connectivity may potentially offset the impact of early amyloid and tau accumulation and transitionally spare cognitive function.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在无痴呆的老年人群中考察海马默认网络连接与淀粉样蛋白、tau蛋白的关系，采用横断面静息态功能影像结合PiB和AV1451成像进行分析。结果显示，海马与默认网络内部连接随淀粉样蛋白负荷呈倒U形关联，即低至中等负荷时连接增强、更高负荷时减弱；而海马跨网络连接则随淀粉样蛋白和tau负荷升高而增强。内部与跨网络连接较强均与较好的认知功能相关，尤其涉及记忆和注意力，提示这种连接变化可能有助于在临床前阶段维持认知功能、暂时抵消早期病理积累的影响。

papers.title: A vector navigation and inference architecture can construct universal cognitive maps for abstract reasoning.
papers.authors: Bicanski A.
papers.abstract: The idea of cognitive maps in the hippocampal formation has its origins in decades of spatial cognition research. However, increasing evidence points to cognitive maps also supporting non-spatial tasks. It appears that the hippocampal-entorhinal system can map any combination of systematically varying stimulus dimensions onto the same neural manifolds that support spatial representations-grid cells. Here, I propose a model that shows how extant spatial navigation architectures can iteratively construct universal cognitive maps via non-local inference. The model exhibits noise tolerance congruent with behavior, and the mapping process accommodates discontinuous stimulus spaces. It is also shown that the model can support several types of abstract reasoning, including analogy-making, subspace construction, and perspective taking. Importantly, these capabilities are supported by the same computational modules that are used to build a map. Neural-level implementations for several model components are proposed, and it is shown how the (abstract) 1D attributes that are to be combined on a map can be isolated upstream of entorhinal cortex. The combination of mechanisms at play thus suggests how spatial navigation architectures can function as domain-general substrates of cognition.

papers.title: Early neonatal lipid intake is associated with verbal comprehension and supramarginal gyrus volume at school age in very low birth weight preterm infants: A longitudinal cohort study.
papers.authors: Uberos J, Carrasco-Solis M, Laynez-Rubio C, Nieto-Ruiz A, Ruiz-López A, Fernández-Marin E, Blanca-Jover E, Campos-Martínez A, Collaborative NeuroPrem group.
papers.abstract: Background and aims Early nutritional exposure may influence brain development in very low birth weight (VLBW) preterm infants, although its long-term relationship with specific cognitive domains remains unclear. The objective was to investigate the association between protein and lipid intake during the first week of life and verbal comprehension and brain regional volumes at school age. Methods This longitudinal cohort study included 157 VLBW infants (<1500 g, <32 weeks gestation). Nutritional intake during the first week of life was prospectively recorded. At school age (6-16 years), 157 children underwent neuropsychological assessment and 115 underwent brain MRI. Regional brain volumes were obtained using FreeSurfer. Multivariable regression models were adjusted for gestational age, intracranial volume, age at assessment, and parental socioeconomic status. Results Higher lipid intake during the first week of life was associated with better verbal comprehension scores and with larger left supramarginal gyrus volume. Protein intake was not associated with verbal comprehension but was associated with the volume of several frontal and temporal regions involved in language processing. Children with lower verbal comprehension exhibited smaller volumes in multiple regions, although after correction for multiple comparisons only the left rostral middle frontal gyrus, precentral gyrus, and temporal pole remained significant. Sensitivity analyses including CRIB II score attenuated the association between lipid intake and verbal comprehension, suggesting a possible influence of neonatal illness severity. Conclusions Higher lipid intake during the first week of life was associated with better verbal comprehension and larger supramarginal gyrus volume at school age in VLBW preterm infants, whereas protein intake was associated with the volume of several language-related cortical regions. Given the observational design and the attenuation of the association with verbal comprehension after adjustment for CRIB II score, these findings should be interpreted as associations rather than evidence of causality.
papers.summary_zh: 该纵向队列研究考察极低出生体重早产儿出生后第一周的蛋白质和脂质摄入与学龄期言语理解及脑区体积的关联，记录了营养摄入并开展神经心理评估和脑结构磁共振成像。结果显示，第一周脂质摄入较高与学龄期言语理解得分较好及左侧缘上回体积较大相关；蛋白质摄入与言语理解无关，但与多个参与语言加工的额叶和颞叶区域体积相关。言语理解较差的儿童多个脑区体积较小，但经多重比较校正后仅部分区域仍显著。作者强调，由于研究为观察性设计，且校正新生儿疾病严重程度评分后脂质摄入与言语理解的关联减弱，这些结果应理解为关联而非因果关系。

papers.title: Passive intraoperative motor fMRI under general anesthesia during open-craniotomy glioma surgery: a prospective technical feasibility study.
papers.authors: Wais J, Shawarba J, Zeiser V, Hangel G, Lazen P, Widhalm G, Fischmeister FPS, Mallouhi A, Kasprian G, Roessler K.
papers.abstract: Introduction Sensorimotor localization is important during peri-Rolandic glioma surgery. We assessed passive intraoperative motor functional MRI (pifMRI) under general anesthesia. Research question Can pifMRI provide useable sensorimotor maps before and after resection for neuronavigation and comparison with cortical stimulation? Material and methods Eight adults (24-72 years; median, 57.5) underwent pifMRI intraoperatively in a two-room 3-T intraoperative MRI setting. With cranium open, blood oxygen level-dependent signals were elicited by passive flexion-extension of digits II-V. Maps were integrated into neuronavigation and used for corticospinal tract tractography. Given the exploratory sample and absent systematic coordinate-level recording, analyses were descriptive. Results Useable activation in the primary sensorimotor region was obtained in all patients. Stimulation at pifMRI-defined regions elicited motor responses in all patients. However, negative sites and coordinate-level distances were not recorded, precluding diagnostic-accuracy and distance analyses. Post-resection pifMRI was obtained in seven patients.
