Clusters from patients with multiple clusters were less likely to be matched (p < .001). Tight clusters were more likely matched than loose clusters (p = .013). Cluster-resection mapping identified distinct propagation patterns, including anterior-posterior temporal and ipsilateral-contralateral opercular spread. Among 49 mismatched clusters sampled with ICEEG, 91% showed interictal discharges and 63% were involved in seizure propagation. Match rates did not differ by pathology. Significance Our findings support incorporating detailed analysis of MEG cluster characteristics into presurgical evaluation to refine EZ localization, especially for invasive evaluation. Cluster-resection mapping patterns may assist surgical hypothesis generation. Matched clusters in mild malformation of cortical development and negative pathology cases further highlight MEG's value in challenging pathological substrates.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究回顾性分析了101例接受颅内脑电评估和切除手术、术后一年无发作的局灶性癫痫患者，考察脑磁图偶极子簇的解剖位置、紧密程度和方向等特征能否提示哪些簇与致痫区相关。结果显示，额叶及脑叶交界区的簇较颞叶簇更少与切除区匹配，存在多个簇的患者匹配率更低，而紧密簇比松散簇更易匹配；未匹配的簇多数仍可见发作间期放电或参与发作传播，且匹配率不随病理类型变化。作者据此认为，术前评估中纳入脑磁图簇特征的细致分析有助于细化致痫区定位，尤其可为有创评估和手术假设提供参考。

papers.title: Transient White Matter Diffusion Restriction in a Pediatric Patient With Diffuse Axonal Injury.
papers.authors: Lazarte-Rantes C, Munayco C, Chirinos M.
papers.abstract: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a serious public health problem due to its high incidence worldwide and possible sequelae, especially in the pediatric population. Imaging studies play a leading role in evaluating pathologies requiring early surgical management and the prognosis of long-term sequelae. Diffuse axonal injury (DAI) is one of the most severe complications of TBI, and few reports in the literature are associated with cytotoxic edema. We present a case of a pediatric patient with DAI with extensive areas of transient diffusion restriction in the white matter, which we consider to be related to cytotoxic edema.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例弥漫性轴索损伤患儿，影像上出现白质内广泛的一过性扩散受限，作者认为这与细胞毒性水肿有关。该病例提示，儿童弥漫性轴索损伤除轴索损伤本身外，还可能伴随可逆的白质细胞毒性水肿表现，影像随访对识别这类改变具有意义。由于仅为个案报告，上述关联尚不能推广为普遍规律或临床结论。

papers.title: The Mask of Delirium: Uncovering a Presumed Cardioembolic Stroke Through Comprehensive Clinical Evaluation.
papers.authors: Velmurugan P, Mohan Kumar SK, Shahzad S, Chand RM, Paranjyothi V.
papers.abstract: Delirium and aphasia exhibit overlapping clinical features, complicating the diagnosis of acute neurological disturbances in older adults. Both conditions impair communication and orientation, leading to incoherence; however, they arise from distinct pathophysiological mechanisms and require different management strategies. This case concerns an 83-year-old woman with a 48-hour history of acute-onset confusion and abnormal speech. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed an acute infarct in the inferior division of the left middle cerebral artery (MCA) territory, with cardioembolism considered the likely cause. Initial assessment attributed her fluent but semantically meaningless speech, inattention, and fluctuating responsiveness to hyperactive or mixed delirium superimposed on probable pre-existing cognitive impairment. New-onset atrial fibrillation (AF) with a controlled ventricular rate was identified, along with elevated high-sensitivity cardiac troponin I concentrations (1026.3 and 1060.5 ng/L) and N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (7451 pg/mL) in the context of severe ventricular dysfunction. Treatment for possible acute coronary syndrome was initiated but discontinued after cardiology review. Persistent and stereotyped language abnormalities prompted systematic neurological re-evaluation, which identified a Wernicke-type aphasia profile. Computed tomography (CT) of the head demonstrated a left parietotemporal infarct. Given the 48-hour clinical presentation, MRI was performed to further characterise the lesion and revealed left temporal diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) hyperintensity with corresponding apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) hypointensity, confirming acute restricted diffusion in the left temporal lobe. The MRI abnormality corresponded anatomically with the left temporal component of the CT finding, although movement artefact prevented precise lesion co-registration. Echocardiography demonstrated severe biventricular dysfunction with a left ventricular ejection fraction of 15% to 20%. This case underscores the clinical risks of misattributing a structured language disorder to delirium and highlights the importance of focused neurological assessment, including systematic language evaluation, in all older adults presenting with acute confusion.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一位高龄女性急性起病的精神错乱与言语异常，最初被归因于谵妄叠加可能的既往认知障碍，影像学提示左侧大脑中动脉供血区梗死并考虑心源性栓塞。作者强调，持续且刻板的语言异常促使重新进行神经系统评估，识别出Wernicke型失语，并经影像学确认左侧颞叶急性梗死。文章由此提示，将结构化语言障碍误判为谵妄存在临床风险，对急性意识混乱的老年人应进行系统的语言评估。

papers.title: Larger language models better align with neural representations of natural language.
papers.authors: Hong Z, Wang H, Zada Z, Gazula H, Turner D, Aubrey B, Niekerken L, Doyle W, Devore S, Dugan P, Friedman D, Devinsky O, Flinker A, Hasson U, Nastase S, Goldstein AY.
papers.abstract: Recent research has used large language models (LLMs) to study the neural basis of naturalistic language processing in the human brain. LLMs have rapidly grown in complexity, leading to improved language processing capabilities. Here, we utilized several families of transformer-based LLMs to investigate the relationship between model size and their ability to capture linguistic information in the human brain. Crucially, a subset of LLMs were trained on a fixed training set, enabling us to dissociate model size from architecture and training set size. We used electrocorticography (ECoG) to measure neural activity in epilepsy patients while they listened to a 30 min naturalistic audio story. We fit electrode-wise encoding models using contextual embeddings extracted from each hidden layer of the LLMs to predict word-level neural signals. In line with prior work, we found that larger LLMs better capture the structure of natural language and better predict neural activity. We also found a logarithmic relationship where the encoding performance peaks in relatively earlier layers as model size increases. We also observed variations in the best-performing layer across different brain regions, corresponding to an organized language processing hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用多组基于Transformer的大语言模型，考察模型规模与其捕捉人脑自然语言加工信息能力之间的关系；其中部分模型在固定训练集上训练，从而将模型规模与架构、训练集大小区分开。研究以癫痫患者的皮层脑电活动为神经数据，记录其聆听自然叙事音频时的反应，并用各隐藏层上下文嵌入拟合电极级编码模型来预测词汇层面的神经信号。结果显示，更大的模型能更好地刻画自然语言结构，也更准确地预测神经活动；随着模型规模增大，编码表现峰值出现在相对更早的层，且最佳层在不同脑区存在差异，对应有组织的语言加工层级。这些结果提示，模型规模与语言神经表征的匹配程度相关，但属于预测性关联，不能理解为因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Unravelling the genetic basis of stuttering: GWAS meta-analysis highlights link with rare speech disorders
papers.authors: Jackson VE, Shin JJ, Horton S, Boyce JO, Eising E, van Reyk O, Parker R, Thompson-Lake DG, Evans M, Beilby J, Below JE, Boomsma DI, Bridges E, Corfield EC, Franken MJ, Gordon SD, Havdahl A, Koenraads SP, Kraft SJ, Luciano M, Moen G, Mountford HS, Musial A, Pennell CE, Polikowsky HG, Pool R, Rebattu VA, Rimfeld K, Scartozzi AC, St Pourcain B, Szilagyi IA, Valand SB, Viljoen KZ, Wang CA, Whitehouse AJ, Wren YE, van Bergen E, Gillespie NA, Vogel AP, Scheffer IE, Hildebrand MS, Sadleir LG, Liegeois F, Reilly S, Fisher SE, Martin NG, Morgan AT, Bahlo M.
papers.abstract: Developmental stuttering affects up to 11% of children, with around one-fifth developing a persistent stutter. Twin and family studies indicate a strong genetic contribution and comorbidity with other heritable traits, but the common genetic architecture of clinically ascertained stuttering, persistence and recovery remains poorly characterised. We performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) meta-analysis of 6,096 cases and 81,629 controls of European ancestries from 18 cohorts, including 2,953 cases from stuttering-specific collections with clinically confirmed or validated self-reported phenotypes. We additionally analysed persistence, severity and frequency, and integrated our results with an independent GWAS of self-reported stuttering. Our meta-analysis and the self-report GWAS showed high genetic correlation (r g = 0.66). A polygenic score from the self-report GWAS was associated with stuttering in our ascertained cases, with modest predictive value (ΔAUC = 0.067, p = 1.8 x 10 -23 ), and with greater severity and frequency among people who stutter. We replicated two self-report loci ( CAMTA1 , CTNND2 ), and combined analysis identified a genome-wide significant association at MPPED2 . Our 24 suggestive loci implicated genes with established roles in childhood apraxia of speech, including SETBP1 , CAMTA1 , PTBP2 , GRIN2A and KIRREL3 , with strong enrichment for apraxia genes (OR = 40.1, p = 1 x 10 -4 ). Within our meta-analysis, persistent stuttering was genetically near-identical to stuttering overall (r g = 0.97). Genetically predicted brain imaging nominally implicated basal ganglia and cerebellar motor circuitry. Common-variant liability to stuttering is shared across ascertainment approaches, relates to severity, and converges with rare-variant genes for speech disorders on circuits underlying speech motor control.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过跨多个队列的GWAS荟萃分析，考察口吃的常见遗传基础，并分析其持续性与严重程度的遗传关联。主分析未发现全基因组显著位点，但提示性位点所对应的基因与儿童言语失用症相关基因重叠，且与独立的自报口吃GWAS合并后出现显著关联。遗传风险评分与临床病例中的口吃易感性和严重程度相关，影像遗传分析还指向基底节—小脑运动环路。作者认为，口吃至少部分与其他言语和神经发育障碍共享生物学基础，但这些发现尚无直接治疗意义。

papers.title: Content-Sensitive Linguistic Representations in the Human Multiple-Demand Network
papers.authors: Havin M, Meshulam M, Karidi T, Tikochinski R, Hasson U, Goldstein A.
papers.abstract: Neuroimaging dissociates specialized language regions from the domain-general multiple-demand (MD) network, yet the functional contribution of MD regions to language processing remains unresolved. Because MD recruitment during linguistic tasks is conventionally attributed to domain-general cognitive load, prior research has largely prioritized activation magnitude over representational content. Consequently, it remains unclear whether MD cortices function merely as nonspecific amplifiers of effort or actively encode fine-grained linguistic structures. Here we show that the MD network reliably encodes content-sensitive linguistic representations during naturalistic comprehension independently of peak cognitive demand. Using a voxelwise encoding framework with architecturally identical language models trained on distinct semantic domains (BERT and SciBERT) across three naturalistic fMRI datasets, we find that multiple-demand regions track linguistic structure during both high-demand scientific lectures and low-demand narratives. Furthermore, comparative analyses reveal that these representations are sensitive to domain-specific semantic regularities rather than surface-level form alone. Finally, by evaluating relative model alignment alongside the language network, we demonstrate that the representational balance between these two systems shifts dynamically as a function of task context and domain relevance, revealing a complementary division of labor. Together, these findings reframe the multiple-demand network from a purely extrinsic control mechanism into an active, content-sensitive component of a distributed semantic architecture.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注域一般性的多需求网络在语言加工中究竟只起非特异性调控作用，还是也编码具体的语言内容。作者用体素级编码框架，在自然语言理解条件下比较了在不同语义领域训练的架构相同的语言模型与脑活动的对应关系。结果显示，多需求网络在高认知负荷的科学讲座和低负荷的叙事中都能稳定追踪语言结构，且其表征对领域特异的语义规律敏感，而不只是反映表层形式。与语言网络的相对模型对齐比较进一步表明，两个系统之间的表征平衡会随任务情境和领域相关性动态变化，提示二者存在互补分工。作者据此认为，多需求网络不只是外在的控制机制，也是分布式语义架构中具有内容敏感性的组成部分。

papers.title: Test-Retest Reproducibility of Single- and Cross-Population White Matter Atlases in Diffusion MRI Tractography
papers.authors: Li Y, Wang X, Sun J, Zhang W, Wu Y, Yin L, Chen Y, Rathi Y, Makris N, O’Donnell LJ, Zhang F.
papers.abstract: Diffusion MRI tractography enables noninvasive mapping of white matter fiber tracts. Atlasbased white matter parcellation supports automated tract identification by assigning individual streamlines to atlas-defined clusters and anatomical tract labels. Because clustering-based white matter atlases are constructed from cohort-specific tractography data, they capture common white matter organization represented in the atlas-construction population. Although major white matter anatomy is shared across populations, subtle population-related anatomical variability may influence atlas representation and test-retest correspondence. Therefore, the reproducibility and cross-population generalizability of tractography-based white matter atlases are important considerations for quantitative neuroimaging studies. In this study, we evaluated whether incorporating cross-population anatomical variability during atlas construction improves test-retest reproducibility. To do so, we compared a single-population ORG atlas constructed from a Western cohort with the cross-population East-West White Matter Atlas constructed from both Eastern and Western cohorts. Test-retest diffusion MRI scans from the Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP-YA) dataset and the Connectivity-based Brain Imaging Research Database (C-BIRD) were analyzed as independent Western and Eastern test-retest cohorts, respectively. Whole-brain tractography was reconstructed for each dMRI scan and parcellated using both atlases. Reproducibility was assessed using tract detection rate at both cluster level and anatomical tract level, weighted Dice coefficient, and the relative difference of mean fractional anisotropy (FA). Both atlases showed stable tract detection across test-retest scans in both cohorts. Compared with the ORG atlas, the East-West White Matter Atlas achieved higher overall spatial overlap and lower test-retest variability in mean FA, although atlas performance varied across individual tracts. These findings suggest that integrating crosspopulation information during atlas construction improves the reproducibility and generalizability of white matter atlas mapping across independent populations and imaging protocols.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注基于扩散MRI纤维束成像的白质图谱在重测中的可重复性，以及纳入跨人群解剖变异能否提升这一可重复性。作者用单一人群构建的ORG图谱与融合东西方队列的East-West白质图谱，分别对西方和东方独立重测队列的纤维束进行分区，并比较追踪检出、空间重叠与平均FA的重测差异。结果显示，两套图谱在两类队列中均能稳定检出纤维束；East-West图谱总体空间重叠更高、平均FA的重测波动更小，但具体纤维束的表现并不一致。作者据此认为，构建图谱时整合跨人群信息有助于提高白质图谱映射在独立人群和成像协议间的可重复性与泛化性。

papers.title: Acute head shaking precedes chronic corpus callosum deficits during repeated cocaine exposure in common marmosets
papers.authors: Gu SM, Lee CK, Yoo T, Lee JJ, Eom H, Son JP, Kim TH, Park C, Yoon SS, Lee D, Yun J.
papers.abstract: Background Stimulant exposure can induce acute stereotyped behaviors and chronic alterations in brain connectivity and white matter integrity. However, the temporal sequence and molecular changes linking these cocaine-induced phenotypes remain unclear. Methods We combined LabGym-based behavioral analysis, longitudinal brain imaging, and cross-species molecular analysis in 11 common marmosets ( Callithrix jacchus ; seven male, four female): four underwent behavioral and imaging studies, six provided molecular data, and one provided immunohistochemical data. Male Cryab knockout and wild-type mice underwent functional studies. Results Acute cocaine (5 mg/kg, intraperitoneally) induced rapid, repetitive lateral head movements, defined as head shaking. After 1 and 10 months of repeated exposure, resting-state functional connectivity was altered in sensory, parietal, prefrontal, motor, and hippocampal regions. Changes were detected at 1 month, whereas diffusion tensor imaging showed reduced fractional anisotropy and axial diffusivity in the corpus callosum splenium at 10 months, with no significant genu changes. Cross-species transcriptomic and proteomic comparison identified DPYSL2 and DNM3 as shared axon-associated molecules. Western blotting showed reduced DPYSL2 in brain tissue from cocaine-treated marmosets. CRYAB localized to O4-positive callosal oligodendrocytes and increased following chronic cocaine exposure. Cryab knockout mice had reduced corpus callosum thickness, increased forced-swim immobility, and reduced open-field distance traveled, supporting a role for CRYAB in corpus callosum integrity and depression-related behavior. Conclusions These findings show that acute cocaine-induced stereotyped head shaking precedes functional connectivity changes and later corpus callosum deficits. Reduced DPYSL2 may be associated with axonal dysfunction, whereas increased CRYAB may represent a response to cocaine-induced white matter stress.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在普通狨猴中结合行为追踪、纵向脑成像与跨物种分子分析，考察反复可卡因暴露后行为与脑结构变化的时间顺序。急性给药迅速诱发重复性侧向头部运动（摇头），反复暴露一个月时多个感觉、顶叶、前额、运动和 hippocampal 区域的功能连接已改变，而胼胝体压部的弥散指标下降直到十个月才出现，胼胝体膝部未见明显变化。跨物种分析提示 DPYSL2 和 DNM3 为共享的轴突相关分子，可卡因处理狨猴脑组织中 DPYSL2 降低，CRYAB 则定位于胼胝体少突胶质细胞并在慢性暴露后升高；Cryab 敲除小鼠表现出胼胝体变薄及抑郁样行为改变。作者据此提出，急性刻板摇头先于功能连接改变和较晚的胼胝体损伤，DPYSL2 下降可能与轴突功能障碍相关，而 CRYAB 升高可能是对白质应激的反应。

papers.title: Regional choroid plexus calcifications and their associations with aging, brain structure, and disease
papers.authors: Ba Gari I, Zhu A, Bhatt RR, Nir TM, Jahanshad N.
papers.abstract: The choroid plexus (CP) maintains brain homeostasis through cerebrospinal fluid production and formation of the blood-cerebrospinal fluid barrier, and its dysfunction has been linked with aging and neurological disease. CP dysfunction may involve both enlargement and calcific tissue change, which may reflect distinct processes; yet population neuroimaging has focused on lateral ventricle CP volume, which cannot directly identify calcified tissue. Using quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) in 30,012 UK Biobank participants, we conducted, to our knowledge, the first large scale multi-ventricular study of CP calcification (CPcal), quantifying the lateral (LV), third (3rdV) and fourth (4thV) ventricles. We examined associations with age and sex, endocrine, nutritional and metabolic, mental and behavioral, nervous system, and circulatory diagnoses; family history of Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD); cardiometabolic traits; and brain macrostructure, white matter microstructure, and subcortical susceptibility. CPcal increased with age (largest association: LV, r = 0.191) and was greater in males in the LV and 3rdV (d = 0.249-0.359) and more prevalent in the 4thV (OR = 1.274). Greater CPcal was associated with endocrine and metabolic, psychiatric, nervous system, and circulatory disorders, with the strongest and most consistent associations observed in the 3rdV (d = 0.097 - 0.125) and persisted after adjustment for ventricular volume, particularly for diabetes (d = 0.303) and tobacco use disorder (d = 0.314). Maternal ADRD family history was associated with greater LV CPcal (d = 0.063). CPcal was also associated with cortical and subcortical volumes (r = 0.033 - 0.046), white matter microstructure (r = 0.017 - 0.042), and subcortical susceptibility (r = −0.064 - 0.131). QSM-derived CPcal is a scalable, radiation-free imaging phenotype that complements volumetry by characterizing calcific CP tissue, which is associated with cardiometabolic health, brain aging, and neurodegenerative risk, particularly in the third ventricle.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用英国生物银行参与者的定量磁化率成像，首次在大规模人群中同时量化侧脑室、第三脑室和第四脑室的脉络丛钙化，考察其与年龄、性别、疾病诊断、家族史、心血管代谢特征及脑结构的关系。结果显示，脉络丛钙化随年龄增加，男性在侧脑室和第三脑室更明显，第四脑室也更常见；钙化程度与内分泌代谢、精神行为、神经系统和循环系统疾病相关，其中第三脑室的关联最强且最一致，调整脑室体积后仍存在，糖尿病和烟草使用障碍尤为突出。母系阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆家族史也与侧脑室钙化相关，钙化还伴随皮层和皮层下体积、白质微结构及皮层下磁化率的差异。作者认为，该方法可无辐射地刻画钙化组织，补充体积测量，并提示其与心代谢健康、脑老化和神经退行风险相关，但关联性尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: Reactive Compensation for Proactive Deficits in Parkinson’s Disease
papers.authors: Ficke J, Kricheldorff J, Debener S, Janitzky K, Witt K.
papers.abstract: The dual mechanisms of control (DMC) framework distinguishes between proactive (anticipatory) and reactive (post-conflict) adaptive cognitive control mechanisms. Evidence for proactive deficits in Parkinson’s disease (PD) is inconsistent, and the neurophysiological underpinnings remain poorly understood. We investigated adaptive control in 30 PD patients and 30 demographically similar healthy controls. Adaptive cognitive control was tested using a numerical Stroop test that included manipulations sensitive to proactive and reactive control. In both behavioral and EEG analyses, inducer items that trigger control adaptation were distinguished from diagnostic items, allowing adaptation to be assessed independently of learning effects. Event-related potentials (ERPs) derived from electroencephalography (EEG) captured signatures of proactive (N450) and reactive (Late Positive Complex, LPC) control. The HC group showed robust proactive control with faster responses compared to reaction times to reactive control condition, whereas PD revealed reduced proactive control, particularly for diagnostic items. ERP analysis indicated a clear N450 in the HC group, whereas the N450 was absent in the PD group. Both groups displayed LPC activity during reactive control, but PD also showed LPC activity in the adaptive proactive control condition, suggesting compensatory reliance on reactive mechanisms. Both, behavioural and ERP analyses provide insights into the dissociation of reactive and proactive control processes in PD. Our findings indicate selective impairments in proactive control, along with preserved reactive control, in patients with PD. Moreover, the presence of the LPC during proactive control trials suggests that the recruitment of reactive control mechanisms may compensate deficits in proactive control in PD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病患者的主动性与反应性认知控制是否分离，用数值Stroop任务结合行为测量和脑电事件相关电位，比较患者与健康对照在触发控制适应时的表现。结果显示，健康对照组表现出明显的主动控制优势和相应的N450成分，而患者组的主动控制减弱、N450缺失；两组在反应性控制条件下均出现晚正复合波，但患者组在主动控制条件下也出现该成分。作者据此认为，帕金森病存在选择性主动控制受损而反应性控制相对保留，患者可能通过招募反应性机制来补偿主动控制的不足。

papers.title: Plasma and Brain-Derived Extracellular Vesicle Biomarkers Following a Randomized Controlled Trial of Choline for Neurodevelopment in Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorder: A Pilot Analysis.
papers.authors: Tran PV, Maxim ZL, Eckerle JK, Zeisel SH, Georgieff MK, Wozniak JR.
papers.abstract: Background Postnatal choline supplementation improves memory, non-verbal IQ, executive function, and white-matter microstructure in children with fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD) across randomized controlled trials; however, peripheral and brain biomarkers of these effects are uncharacterized. Methods We measured eight immune and neurotrophic biomarkers (TNFα, transferrin receptor 1 [TfR1], BDNF, ferritin, MCP-1, RANTES, CRP, and Eotaxin) in plasma and brain-derived extracellular vesicles (BDEVs) from 24 children with FASD randomized to choline (n = 13; 7 male, 6 female) or placebo (n = 11; 7 male, 4 female), before and approximately nine months after treatment (23 with paired pre/post samples). Values were log10 -transformed to correct for non-normal distribution. We modeled Group × Time effects with linear mixed models, adjusted for age, sex, and sample storage duration, cross-checked with cluster-robust ordinary least squares, and tested plasma-to-BDEV concordance for each analyte with linear regression adjusted for age and sex. Multiplicity was corrected by Benjamini-Hochberg FDR. Results Plasma MCP-1 showed a nominally significant Group × Time interaction (p = 0.035, q = 0.28), rising over time in the placebo but not the choline group. Ferritin and CRP showed similar patterns that did not reach significance (interaction p = 0.099 and p = 0.118; q = 0.31 for both). RANTES and BDNF rose significantly in BDEVs over time, without evidence of a differential change by treatment group, and survived FDR correction (both q ≤ 0.02); ferritin also rose significantly (p = 0.021) but its Time effect did not survive FDR correction (q = 0.06). BDEV TfR1 was nominally lower in the choline group than placebo at both timepoints (p = 0.023; q = 0.13). Plasma levels were associated with BDEV levels for five markers (ferritin, TfR1, TNFα, Eotaxin, RANTES; all p < 0.05), independent of age, sex, time, and group; all five associations survived FDR correction (q ≤ 0.01). The plasma-BDEV association for MCP-1 became non-significant when adjusted for time and group (p = 0.134, q = 0.13). CRP and BDNF showed a between-person, but not within-person, plasma-BDEV association. Conclusions In this small, exploratory sample of children with FASD, a condition characterized by brain iron deficiency and inflammation, choline was associated with an attenuated rise in pro-inflammatory plasma MCP-1 relative to placebo, generating a new hypothesized candidate biomarker for further study. Most BDEV markers changed over time (Pre-to-Post), not with treatment. Plasma and BDEV BDNF were not significantly associated overall, although a between-person association was present without a corresponding within-person signal, suggesting that inferring central nervous system function from plasma BDNF should proceed with caution. These hypothesis-generating findings support further, larger-scale investigation of BDEV content analysis as a candidate complement to this trial program's cognitive and neuroimaging outcomes. Replication and expansion of the BDEV panel of analytes in a larger sample are needed. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.Gov [NCT02735473]; registered 2 April 2016.
papers.summary_zh: 这项先导分析在随机对照试验框架下，比较了胎儿酒精谱系障碍（FASD）儿童补充胆碱与安慰剂前后血浆及脑源性细胞外囊泡中多种免疫和神经营养标志物的变化。总体上，多数囊泡标志物随时间变化而非随治疗改变；血浆MCP-1在安慰剂组上升而胆碱组未见上升，但该组间差异经多重校正后不显著，仅提示一个待验证的候选标志物。血浆与囊泡标志物水平在部分指标上相关，但BDNF的关联主要体现于个体间而非个体内，作者因此提醒由血浆BDNF推断中枢功能需谨慎。这些探索性、假设生成性结果样本小，尚不能支持临床结论，需更大规模研究重复验证。

papers.title: Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy-Related Inflammation Mimicking Leptomeningeal Metastasis After Resected Lung Adenocarcinoma: A Case Report Highlighting Dynamic Diagnostic Reassessment.
papers.authors: Shigeyama K, Dotsu Y, Yoshimura S, Hiu T, Ueki N, Futsuki R, Koga S, Honda N, Akagi K, Matsuo M, Taniguchi H, Takemoto S, Mukae H.
papers.abstract: Cerebral amyloid angiopathy-related inflammation (CAA-ri) is a rare inflammatory subtype of cerebral amyloid angiopathy that may present with leptomeningeal enhancement on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), thereby mimicking leptomeningeal metastasis (LM) in patients with cancer. We report the case of an 82-year-old woman with a recently resected lung adenocarcinoma who underwent brain MRI following a fall. MRI revealed bilateral asymmetric white matter hyperintensities and multifocal leptomeningeal enhancement, which initially suggested LM. However, preserved neurological function, negative cerebrospinal fluid cytology, and the subsequent identification of numerous cortical and subcortical microbleeds on targeted reassessment with susceptibility-weighted MRI prompted diagnostic reassessment. Brain biopsy demonstrated vascular amyloid deposition with perivascular inflammatory infiltrates, confirming CAA-ri. Because the patient remained neurologically stable, she was managed conservatively, and spontaneous radiological improvement was observed during follow-up. This case highlights the fact that leptomeningeal abnormalities in patients with lung cancer do not invariably represent leptomeningeal metastasis. When clinicoradiological findings are discordant, prompt reassessment using appropriately selected MRI sequences should be integrated with cerebrospinal fluid analysis and multidisciplinary evaluation, with pathological confirmation considered when clinically consequential alternative diagnoses cannot be excluded. This approach may help avoid inappropriate LM-directed therapy.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一位近期接受肺癌切除术的老年女性在跌倒后行脑MRI，发现双侧不对称白质高信号和多灶性软脑膜强化，最初提示软脑膜转移。但患者神经功能保留、脑脊液细胞学阴性，复查磁敏感加权成像发现大量皮质及皮质下微出血，促使重新评估；脑活检显示血管淀粉样沉积伴血管周围炎性浸润，确诊为脑淀粉样血管病相关炎症。患者神经功能稳定，接受保守处理后随访中影像学自发改善。作者据此提示，肺癌患者的软脑膜异常并非必然为转移，当临床与影像不一致时应及时选用合适序列复查并结合脑脊液与多学科评估，必要时行病理确认，以避免不当的软脑膜转移治疗。

papers.title: FastSurfer-Based Brain Morphometry and Machine-Learning Classification Across the Alzheimer's Disease Spectrum.
papers.authors: Altun SN, Cetinok H.
papers.abstract: Background : This study aimed to quantitatively assess structural changes in the hippocampus, amygdala, entorhinal cortex, lateral ventricles, precuneus, and posterior cingulate using deep-learning-based FastSurfer morphometry and evaluate their contribution to classification across the Alzheimer's disease (AD) spectrum. Methods : Three-dimensional T1-weighted MRI data from the AD Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) were analyzed using FastSurfer. The study included 791 participants (425 female and 366 male): 365 cognitively normal (CN), 273 with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 153 with AD. Morphometric measures included hippocampal and amygdala volumes, lateral ventricular volume, entorhinal cortical thickness and surface area, and precuneus and posterior cingulate thickness and folding index. Volumetric measures were normalized to estimated total intracranial volume (eTIV). Principal morphometric comparisons were additionally adjusted for age, sex, and education. Six machine-learning classifiers were evaluated using participant-level training (n = 632) and held-out test (n = 159) sets, with an additional MMSE-ablation analysis. Results : Hippocampal and amygdala volumes were significantly lower and lateral ventricular volume was significantly higher in AD than in CN (all p < 0.001), with these differences persisting after eTIV normalization and remaining significant after adjustment for age, sex, and education (all adjusted p < 0.001). MCI generally showed intermediate volumetric values between CN and AD. Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scores correlated positively with total hippocampal (r = 0.495) and amygdala (r = 0.462) volumes and negatively with lateral ventricular volume (r = -0.256) (all p < 0.001). For three-class CN/MCI/AD classification, Logistic Regression with ElasticNet achieved a mean macro-F1 score of 0.706 ± 0.017 in five-fold cross-validation and a held-out macro-F1 score of 0.705 with MMSE included. Excluding MMSE reduced the held-out macro-F1 score to 0.531 and ROC-AUC to 0.735, compared with 0.857 when MMSE was included. Performance was higher for binary CN-versus-AD classification, with a held-out test macro-F1 score of 0.919 and ROC-AUC of 0.990. Conclusions : FastSurfer-based morphometry demonstrated medial temporal atrophy and lateral ventricular enlargement across the CN-MCI-AD spectrum, with the principal volumetric differences remaining robust after adjustment for age, sex, and education. The intermediate morphometric profile of MCI and the associations between medial temporal volumes and cognitive performance support the relevance of these structural measures. Machine-learning performance improved substantially when MMSE was incorporated, indicating that the combined models reflect integrated morphometric, demographic, genetic, and cognitive information rather than morphometry alone. External validation in independent cohorts is required before clinical application.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ADNI的T1加权MRI数据，用深度学习FastSurfer方法测量阿尔茨海默病谱系人群的脑结构，并评估这些形态学指标在分类中的贡献。结果显示，从认知正常到轻度认知障碍再到AD，海马和杏仁核体积下降、侧脑室体积增大，MCI多处于中间水平；这些主要体积差异在按颅内体积归一化并校正年龄、性别和教育后仍然存在，海马和杏仁核体积也与MMSE得分正相关。机器学习三分类在纳入MMSE时表现明显优于仅用形态学指标，提示模型反映的是形态、人口学、遗传和认知信息的综合，而非形态学单独作用；作者也指出临床使用前仍需外部验证。

papers.title: Peripheral Inflammatory Biomarkers in Chronic Autoimmune-Associated Epilepsy: An Exploratory Case-Control Study.
papers.authors: Serrano-Aguilar L, Fernandez-Hombrados C, Jimenez-Vargas M, López-Moreno Y, García-Martín G, Cabezudo-García P, Ciano-Petersen NL, Estivill-Torrús G, Narváez-Peláez M, Aguilar-Castillo MJ, Hernándo-Requejo V, Serrano-Castro PJ.
papers.abstract: Background Autoimmune-associated epilepsy (AAE) was recognized by the ILAE in 2017 as a distinct etiological category driven by chronic neuroinflammation rather than structural or genetic mechanisms. Reliable peripheral circulating inflammatory biomarkers to distinguish AAE from structural epilepsy remain lacking, potentially limiting timely recognition and evaluation for immunotherapy. In this observational case-control exploratory single-center study, plasma levels of 20 pro-inflammatory and 3 anti-inflammatory biomarkers, plus cerebrospinal fluid neurofilament light chain and HMGB1, were measured in 18 AAE patients, 33 non-autoimmune epilepsy patients and 16 healthy controls. AAE was defined using Dubey's APE2-based criteria. Univariate comparisons, ROC analysis, and binary logistic regression were performed. Results Among the 25 biomarkers analyzed, plasma IL-12 showed the lowest nominal p -value in the global between-group comparison (p=0.038), with lower concentrations in AAE. However, no biomarker remained statistically significant after Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction (IL-12 q=0.366). ROC analysis yielded an AUC of 0.670 for IL-12 alone for distinguishing AAE from the remainder of the cohort. In an exploratory primary multivariable model including plasma IL-12, drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) status, and EEG pattern, the apparent in-sample discriminative performance was higher than that of IL-12 alone (AUC = 0.771; 95% CI, 0.635-0.892). Discussion Lower plasma IL-12 levels may reflect a peripheral immune association in chronic AAE. These findings are exploratory and hypothesis-generating and require replication in larger, prospectively recruited, independent cohorts.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性病例对照研究关注慢性自身免疫相关癫痫（AAE）与结构性癫痫的鉴别，检测了患者和健康对照的血浆炎症标志物及部分脑脊液指标，并比较组间差异、做ROC分析和逻辑回归。在分析的25种标志物中，血浆IL-12的组间名义差异最明显，且在AAE中浓度较低，但经多重检验校正后无标志物保持显著，单独用IL-12区分AAE的判别能力有限。将IL-12、药物难治性癫痫状态和脑电图模式纳入探索性多变量模型后，样本内判别表现有所提高。作者认为低IL-12可能反映慢性AAE的外周免疫关联，但结果仅为探索性和假设生成性质，需在更大规模、前瞻性独立队列中验证。

papers.title: From brain drain to geopolitical talent competition: scientific diasporas and the future of Global South development.
papers.authors: Buyuktanir Karacan D, Tapia Takaki D.
papers.journal: Frontiers in research metrics and analytics
papers.abstract: Scientific diasporas have emerged as increasingly important actors in global science, technology, and innovation (STI) ecosystems. In the context of geopolitical fragmentation, technological competition, and intensifying global inequalities, talent mobility is no longer solely a migration issue but a strategic dimension of development, science diplomacy, and international influence. This policy review argues that Global South countries should move beyond traditional "brain drain" narratives and instead adopt long-term strategies that view scientific diasporas as transnational development partners and components of broader "networks of networks." Drawing on literature related to scientific diasporas, global talent competition, science diplomacy, and migration studies, this review analyzes how scientific diasporas contribute to development through knowledge transfer, institutional partnerships, capacity building, innovation ecosystems, and policy engagement. It also examines the implications of recent geopolitical shifts, including the growing global competition for talent, technological nationalism, changes in U.S. science and immigration environments, Europe's strategic talent policies, and the rise of emerging scientific hubs beyond the West. Particular attention is given to the Global South, South-South cooperation, reverse brain drain, and the importance of equitable and inclusive knowledge systems. The paper concludes with policy recommendations aimed at strengthening science, technology, and innovation ecosystems and integrating scientific diasporas into national and international development strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该政策综述讨论的是，在地缘政治分裂与全球人才竞争加剧的背景下，全球南方国家应如何重新定位科学侨民。作者梳理科学侨民、全球人才竞争、科学外交与移民研究相关文献，认为科学侨民可通过知识转移、机构合作、能力建设、创新生态和政策参与等途径促进发展，因此应被视为跨国发展伙伴，而非人才流失的损失。文章还分析了美国科研与移民环境变化、欧洲人才战略及西方以外新兴科学中心崛起等趋势对全球南方的含义，并关注南南合作、人才回流与包容性知识体系，最后提出将科学侨民纳入国家和国际发展战略的政策建议。

papers.title: Blarcamesine improves EEG biomarkers of cortical dysfunction in a mouse model of fragile X syndrome.
papers.authors: Jonak CR, Assad SA, Binder DK, Tran J, Missling CU, Kaufmann WE.
papers.abstract: Background Fragile X syndrome (FXS) is the most common inherited form of intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder. Previous studies in the Fmr1 knockout (KO) mouse model of FXS and affected individuals have identified common electroencephalographic (EEG) abnormalities, which constitute biomarkers of cortical dysfunction for drug treatments. Methods We evaluated the effects of three different doses of oral blarcamesine, a Sigma-1 receptor agonist (S1R), on FXS-relevant EEG biomarkers in Fmr1 KO mice utilizing a multielectrode array (MEA) on resting-state power (from delta to gamma frequencies) and network synchronization (inter-trial phase coherence [ITPC]) using three auditory stimulation paradigms (chirp, auditory steady-state response [ASSR] at 40 Hz and at 80 Hz). Results Blarcamesine-treated Fmr1 KO mice showed dose-dependent modulation of EEG biomarkers across cortical regions. Resting-state EEG power was reduced across multiple frequency bands, including suppression of the FXS-distinctive elevation in the gamma band. Significant improvements in ITPC were observed in all cortical regions for chirp stimulation and 40 Hz ASSR, while modest improvements were seen for 80 Hz ASSR. Conclusion Altogether, these data demonstrate that blarcamesine modulates multiple EEG biomarkers of cortical dysfunction in Fmr1 KO mice. Given that these biomarkers are associated with fundamental neurophysiological mechanisms underlying cognitive and behavioral abnormalities, and are shared between FXS mouse models and affected individuals, these findings are consistent with previously characterized S1R-mediated pharmacological effects of blarcamesine. These data support further investigation of blarcamesine's clinical potential in FXS and other neurodevelopmental disorders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在脆性X综合征的Fmr1敲除小鼠模型上，用多电极阵列记录静息态脑电功率和听觉刺激下的网络同步，考察口服Sigma-1受体激动剂blarcamesine对皮质功能异常脑电标志物的影响。结果显示，给药后小鼠多个频段的静息态功率下降，包括脆性X综合征特征性的伽马频段升高被抑制；在啁啾声和40 Hz稳态听觉响应下，各皮质区域的试次间相位一致性明显改善，80 Hz响应改善较有限，整体呈剂量依赖。作者据此认为blarcamesine可调节该模型的多项脑电标志物，且这些标志物与认知行为异常的神经生理机制相关、在模型与患者间共享，支持进一步研究其临床潜力，但尚不能据此推断治疗效果。

papers.title: EEG functional connectivity for Parkinson's disease diagnosis and non-motor symptom prediction: a machine learning approach.
papers.authors: Meng F, Liu S, Xiao X, Ma C, Huang F, Xu Z, Guo Z, Jiang W.
papers.abstract: Introduction Parkinson's disease (PD) is associated with severe non-motor symptoms, including mood disorders and sleep disturbances, whose neural mechanisms are linked to dysfunction in large-scale brain networks. Functional connectivity measured by electroencephalography (EEG) can noninvasively map abnormalities at the network level. Methods This study employed the debiased weighted phase lag index (dwPLI) to mitigate the effects of volumetric conductivity and investigated EEG functional connectivity in PD patients (n = 14) and healthy controls (n = 14) during resting and emotional states. Diagnostic performance was evaluated using L1-regularized logistic regression combined with a strict subject-level leave-one-subject-out cross-validation method. Results The accuracy of the beta band model combining the four states reached 82.14% (p < 0.05, permutation test), while the accuracy of the gamma band model under the eyes-open state reached 89.29% (p < 0.01). Furthermore, theta band connectivity during the sadness state significantly predicted PSQI scores in PD patients. Discussion These findings suggest that emotion-induced network dynamics may reflect sleep disturbances in PD, and establish EEG functional connectivity as a candidate neurophysiological biomarker for PD, with potential applications in both diagnostic classification and the assessment of non-motor symptoms, although validation in larger cohorts is still required.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨基于脑电功能连接的机器学习方法能否用于帕金森病诊断及非运动症状预测，比较了帕金森病患者与健康对照在静息和情绪状态下的脑电连接，并采用正则化逻辑回归结合被试级交叉验证评估分类效果。结果显示，多状态组合的beta频段模型和睁眼状态下的gamma频段模型具有较好的诊断区分能力，而悲伤状态下的theta频段连接可预测患者匹兹堡睡眠质量指数得分。作者据此认为，情绪诱发的网络动态可能反映帕金森病患者的睡眠障碍，脑电功能连接有望成为辅助诊断和评估非运动症状的候选神经生理标志物，但尚需在更大样本中验证。

papers.title: Integrative multimodal framework combining undercarboxylated osteocalcin and medial prefrontal cortex morphometry for prediction of cognitive decline in osteoporosis: a machine learning study.
papers.authors: Tong X, Zhou Y, Cao Y, Han C.
papers.abstract: Objective This study investigates the mechanistic link between age-related osteoporosis (OP) and cognitive decline, with a particular emphasis on the neuroprotective role of undercarboxylated osteocalcin (ucOC)-the biologically active form of osteocalcin-and its influence on brain structural integrity and cognitive performance. We further explored the translational potential of integrating neuroimaging features, and machine learning algorithms to develop predictive models for early identification of cognitive deterioration in OP patients. Methods We conducted a comprehensive voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis across two independent datasets. Voxel-wise comparisons between OP patients and healthy controls were performed to characterize grey matter volume (GMV) alterations. Correlation and mediation analyses were subsequently employed to elucidate the relationships among serum ucOC levels, GMV, and cognitive function. Brain regions exhibiting significant mediation effects were identified as ucOC-associated neuroimaging biomarkers in Dataset 1, and their GMV values were used as fixed features to develop machine-learning models for predicting 1-year cognitive decline in OP patients in the independent Dataset 2, evaluated through a leakage-free leave-one-out cross-validation procedure. Results OP patients exhibited significantly lower Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) scores and reduced GMV in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) relative to healthy controls. Notably, serum ucOC, but not carboxylated osteocalcin (cOC), demonstrated significant positive correlations with both MoCA scores and mPFC GMV in OP patients. Mediation analysis further confirmed that mPFC GMV statistically mediates the relationship between ucOC and cognitive function. Machine-learning models integrating mPFC GMV achieved good discriminative performance in leakage-free validation in Dataset 2 (XGBoost: AUC = 0.84, 95% CI [0.79, 0.88]), classifying OP patients at elevated risk of cognitive decline over a 1-year follow-up period. Conclusion Our study establishes undercarboxylated osteocalcin (ucOC) as a mechanistically relevant, circulating biomarker of cognitive resilience in osteoporosis, and identifies medial prefrontal cortex grey matter volume (mPFC GMV) as its structural neuroimaging correlate for ucOC. Importantly, XGBoost yields a promising predictive framework that achieved good discriminative accuracy for 1-year cognitive decline risk.

papers.title: Abnormal coordination of executive control network and default mode network in cognitive impairment after deep nuclei intracerebral hemorrhage.
papers.authors: Fan X, Lei Y, Deng Y, Xiang Y, Sun C, Yu X, Zhang J, Li C, Chen P.
papers.abstract: Objective This study investigated the macroscopic neural mechanisms of cognitive impairment after Deep Nuclei Intracerebral Hemorrhage (DNICH) from the dimensions of brain activity and brain networks, and further identified characteristic fingerprints of cognitive representation. Method Patients with cognitive impairment after DNICH and healthy controls (HC) were prospectively and consecutively enrolled. Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) data and the cognitive scale Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) were collected. Spontaneous brain activity measured by fractional Amplitude of Low-Frequency Fluctuations (fALFF) was used to identify hub brain regions of cognitive representation, which were then used as Regions of Interest (ROI) for Functional Connectivity (FC) analysis, in order to investigate the potential mechanisms after DNICH cognitive impairment and identify characteristic fingerprints for distinguishing patients with dementia (dementia was defined as MMSE ≤ 17). Result This study enrolled 139 patients with DNICH and 100 HC. There were no significant differences in baseline characteristics including age, gender, years of education, height, and weight between the two groups. Hematomas were predominantly located in the bilateral basal ganglia, more commonly on the left side, with varying degrees of thalamic and white matter involvement. Whole-brain zfALFF analysis showed that MMSE scores were significantly correlated with zfALFF values in brain regions including right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (R-DLPFC) and posterior cingulate cortex (PCC), with R-DLPFC positively correlated and PCC negatively correlated with cognition (AlphaSim correction, p < 0.01; cluster size >19). In addition, FC within the executive control network (ECN) and default mode network (DMN) was abnormally altered in patients with cognitive impairment and was closely associated with cognitive function (r = -0.29-0.51). FC fingerprints demonstrated stable predictive ability for dementia status (AUC = 0.70-0.73). Conclusion Abnormal coordination of intra-network and inter-network FC of ECN and DMN may represent a shared neural mechanism of cognitive impairment after DNICH. Modulating FC between these hub brain regions (R-DLPFC and PCC) may provide new therapeutic strategies for cognitive recovery after DNICH.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨深部核团脑出血后认知障碍的宏观神经机制，比较患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振指标及认知量表得分，并以自发活动定位关键脑区后分析功能连接。结果显示，患者执行控制网络与默认模式网络内部及网络间的功能连接出现异常，且与认知功能相关；基于连接特征对痴呆状态的判别具有中等且较稳定的预测能力。作者据此提出，这两个网络协调异常可能是深部核团脑出血后认知障碍的共同神经机制，调节相关枢纽脑区间连接或为认知恢复提供潜在干预方向，但这仍属关联性发现，尚非治疗证据。

papers.title: Exploring the potential of psychedelics in brain injury recovery: a thematic analysis of participant narratives.
papers.authors: Reed O.
papers.abstract: Individuals with traumatic brain injury (TBI) frequently experience persistent cognitive difficulties, emotional dysregulation, and trauma-related symptoms, yet few interventions effectively address these interconnected challenges. This exploratory qualitative study examined how people with TBI perceived the effects of psychedelic use on cognition, mental health, and trauma recovery. Five adults with a history of TBI who had used psychedelics post-injury participated in semi-structured interviews. Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. Three themes were identified: (1) Trauma Relief and Mood Stabilisation, describing reductions in anxiety, emotional reactivity, and trauma-related distress; (2) Perceived Post-Dose Cognitive 'Lift' particularly in memory, clarity, and coordination following macrodose experiences; and (3) Insight, Acceptance, and Self-Compassion, reflecting enhanced self-understanding, identity reconstruction, and gentler relationships with the self after injury. Participants reported that macrodose experiences produced the most noticeable effects, including perceived short-term improvements in memory, clarity, and coordination. Overall, participants described psychedelic experiences as associated with trauma relief and mood stabilisation, perceived cognitive changes, and greater insight, acceptance, and self-compassion following TBI, with potential implications for neurorehabilitation.
papers.summary_zh: 这项探索性定性研究关注创伤性脑损伤（TBI）患者如何看待伤后使用致幻剂对认知、心理健康和创伤恢复的影响，通过对五名有TBI史且伤后使用过致幻剂的成年人进行半结构化访谈并作反思性主题分析。研究归纳出三类主题：创伤缓解与情绪稳定（焦虑、情绪反应性和创伤相关痛苦减轻）、服药后主观认知“提升”（尤其在大剂量体验后记忆、清晰感和协调性有所改善），以及洞察、接纳与自我关怀（自我理解增强、身份重建、与自我的关系更温和）。参与者称大剂量体验带来的变化最明显，包括短期的记忆、清晰感和协调性改善。总体而言，参与者将致幻剂体验与创伤缓解、情绪稳定、主观认知变化及更多洞察和接纳联系起来，作者认为这对神经康复可能有潜在意义；但作为小样本定性研究，这些均为参与者自述，不能据此推断因果关系或治疗效果。

papers.title: Adult Epstein-Barr virus encephalitis: a retrospective case report series with metagenomic next-generation sequencing-based diagnosis.
papers.authors: Li Y, Yu Z, Shen M, Cui S, Yang X.
papers.abstract: Background EBV encephalitis is uncommon in adults, and its diagnosis and management remain challenging, particularly in patients with underlying medical conditions. Methods We retrospectively analyzed seven adult patients with EBV encephalitis confirmed through cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) between December 2021 and January 2024. Results Six patients (86%) were female, with a median age of 59 years. Five patients had significant underlying conditions, including malignancies (n = 2), systemic lupus erythematosus (n = 1), and EBV-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH, n = 2). Common clinical presentations included fever (86%), impaired consciousness (86%), neck stiffness (57%), headache (43%), and decreased muscle strength (43%). CSF analysis revealed elevated protein levels (57%) and leukocytosis (71%). Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) identified encephalitis-associated lesions in three of six patients (50%), whereas computed tomography (CT) was largely unremarkable. All patients received antiviral therapy, and five additionally received corticosteroids. Three patients recovered, whereas four died, with all deaths occurring in patients with concurrent malignancies or HLH. Conclusion MRI is the preferred imaging modality for suspected encephalitis, and CSF-mNGS is an essential pathogen detection assay. Underlying conditions such as malignancies and HLH are associated with poor clinical outcomes.

papers.title: Attenuated sensorimotor hemodynamic responses and altered cortical dynamics during passive proprioceptive-related stimulation after stroke: a multidimensional fNIRS study.
papers.authors: Sun H, Fu Q, Jiang Y, Zhu G.
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to use functional near-infrared spectroscopy to investigate abnormalities in cortical activity and dynamic network mechanisms associated with proprioceptive processing after stroke. We integrated conventional hemodynamic features, latent-state organization, directed connectivity, and recovery-phase complexity analyses to explore multidimensional changes in cortical dynamics. Methods Patients with stroke and healthy controls underwent baseline motor and sensory assessments and completed a block-designed proprioceptive task during fNIRS recording, consisting of six alternating 30-s stimulation and 30-s rest periods. After preprocessing, ROI-level oxygenated hemoglobin (HbO) time series were extracted. Conventional temporal features included area under the curve (AUC), onset latency, peak amplitude, post-stimulus residual activation, recovery slope, and time-to-peak. Latent state analysis was performed using a Gaussian mixture model to derive fractional occupancy (FO), mean dwell time (MDT), and transition characteristics. Directed connectivity during prestimulus, stimulation, and recovery phases was assessed using a sliding-window multivariate autoregressive model with partial directed coherence (PDC). Recovery-phase dynamics were further quantified using sample entropy, mean multiscale entropy, recurrence rate (RR), determinism (DET), and mean diagonal line length (Lmean). Results A total of 62 participants, including 30 patients with stroke and 32 healthy controls, underwent a passive thumb movement task during fNIRS recording. Conventional HbO analysis showed that between-group differences were mainly confined to the left sensorimotor cortex, where the stroke group differed significantly from healthy controls in AUC (p = 0.023), peak amplitude (p = 0.003), and recovery slope (p = 0.018). No other ROI showed significant between-group differences, although marginal trends were observed in the right prefrontal and right sensorimotor cortices. Latent state analysis identified six states. Healthy controls more frequently occupied State 1 and State 5, whereas the stroke group more frequently occupied State 3 and State 6, and showed longer MDT in State 2 and State 3. Directed connectivity analysis revealed phase-dependent shifts in both groups, with the stroke group showing stronger prefrontal-sensorimotor reorganization across prestimulus, stimulation, and recovery phases. Recovery-phase complexity analysis demonstrated significantly higher global RR, DET, and Lmean in the stroke group, whereas sample entropy and mean multiscale entropy did not remain significant after correction. ROI-level complexity differences did not survive multiple-comparison correction. Conclusion Abnormal proprioceptive processing after stroke is characterized not only by altered local activation, but also by dynamic state shifts, phase-specific reorganization of information flow, and increased regularity with reduced flexibility during recovery.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能性近红外光谱结合常规血流动力学、隐状态、定向连接和恢复期复杂度分析，考察卒中后本体感觉处理相关的皮层活动与动态网络异常。结果显示，组间差异主要体现在左侧感觉运动皮层，卒中组的激活幅度和恢复斜率等指标弱于健康对照；同时，卒中组在隐状态占用、各阶段信息流重组以及恢复期信号规律性上均表现出与健康人不同的模式。作者据此认为，卒中后本体感觉处理异常不仅表现为局部激活改变，还涉及动态状态转换、阶段特异的信息流重组以及恢复期灵活性下降，提示评估应超越静态激活指标。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence for white matter hyperintensity segmentation: performance, determinants, and clinical implications.
papers.authors: Hu J, Zhang Z, Lei P, Zhang J, Zhu X, Li B.
papers.abstract: Objective White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are key neuroimaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease, associated with cognitive decline and stroke risk. Accurate quantification is essential yet manual segmentation is time-consuming and variable. We systematically evaluated AI performance for automated WMH segmentation across disease contexts and identified factors influencing model performance. Methods Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, and IEEE Xplore from database inception to February 3, 2026 (PROSPERO: CRD420261355769). Studies employing AI-based WMH segmentation and reporting Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) were included. A random-effects meta-analysis was conducted, along with subgroup analyses, meta-regression, sensitivity analyses, and publication bias assessment. Results 26 studies comprising 4,288 participants contributed to quantitative syntheses: 13 evaluated WMH segmentation in general cohorts, and 13 evaluated AD or CSVD-specific cohorts. In the general cohort meta-analysis, the pooled DSC was 0.78 (95% CI, 0.74-0.82). Disease-specific pooled DSC estimates were 0.75 for AD and 0.78 for CSVD. Exploratory meta-regression suggested an association between scanning parameters and DSC (p = 0.042), whereas magnetic field strength showed a borderline association (p = 0.052). Conclusion AI demonstrates promising performance for automated WMH segmentation, with U-Net-based architectures showing superior accuracy. However, substantial heterogeneity highlights the need for standardized imaging protocols and robust external validation. Future multicenter studies are essential to improve model generalizability and facilitate clinical translation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过系统检索与随机效应荟萃分析，评估人工智能自动分割白质高信号（WMH）的表现，并考察影响模型性能的因素。纳入的26项研究覆盖一般人群及阿尔茨海默病或脑小血管病特定队列，合并Dice相似系数在一般队列约为0.78，疾病特定队列结果相近，基于U-Net的架构准确性更优。作者指出，各研究间存在较大异质性，扫描参数可能与分割表现相关，提示需统一成像协议并开展稳健的外部验证，未来多中心研究对提升模型泛化性和临床转化十分必要。

papers.title: White matter hyperintensity radiomics predicts 90-day diffusion-weighted imaging-confirmed acute ischemic stroke after diffusion-weighted imaging-negative transient ischemic attack: preliminary findings from a retrospective machine-learning study.
papers.authors: Liu L, Lyu Y, Li Z, Zhou Y.
papers.abstract: Objective To develop and internally validate a T2-fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (T2-FLAIR) white matter hyperintensity (WMH) radiomics model, alone and in combination with baseline clinical variables, for predicting diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI)-confirmed acute ischemic stroke (AIS) within 90 days after an index DWI-negative transient ischemic attack (TIA). Methods This single-center retrospective study included 398 patients initially diagnosed with DWI-negative TIA between January 2021 and May 2025 who underwent repeat brain magnetic resonance imaging with DWI within 90 days because of recurrent transient neurological symptoms and were classified into AIS (n = 125) and non-AIS (n = 273) groups according to follow-up DWI and apparent diffusion coefficient findings. Baseline WMH regions of interest were segmented on index T2-FLAIR images, and 1,781 radiomics features were extracted. Reproducible features were screened by least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression, and 21 features were retained to calculate a radiomics score. Clinical, radiomics, and combined models were constructed using a support vector machine, with AIS defined as the positive class. Results In the training cohort, the combined model achieved the highest area under the curve (AUC) (0.900, 95% CI: 0.860-0.940), followed by the radiomics model (0.862, 95% CI: 0.812-0.912) and the clinical model (0.775, 95% CI: 0.720-0.830). In the testing cohort, the radiomics model achieved the highest AUC (0.854, 95% CI: 0.757-0.950), followed by the combined model (0.841, 95% CI: 0.748-0.935) and the clinical model (0.696, 95% CI: 0.568-0.824). Conclusion These preliminary findings indicate that T2-FLAIR WMH radiomics may provide promising internal discrimination for predicting 90-day DWI-confirmed AIS after DWI-negative TIA in this selected high-risk cohort. The incremental value of adding clinical variables to radiomics was not confirmed in the internal testing cohort, and prospective multicenter validation is required.
papers.summary_zh: 该回顾性单中心研究基于398例初次DWI阴性的短暂性脑缺血发作患者，从基线T2-FLAIR图像的白质高信号区域提取影像组学特征，构建并内部验证预测90天内复查DWI确诊急性缺血性卒中的模型。结果显示，影像组学模型在测试集中区分能力较好，联合临床变量未在测试集中显示稳定增益，临床模型表现相对较弱。作者据此认为，白质高信号影像组学在该高危队列中具有初步预测价值，但结论尚属初步，需前瞻性多中心验证。

papers.title: Evaluating the compatibility of predictive coding as a model of linguistic predictability effects in reading.
papers.authors: Copeland A, Payne BR.
papers.abstract: Emerging work suggests that the computational architecture of predictive coding (PC), widely studied in visual perception, may be an appropriate model for understanding predictability effects in real-time reading (i. e., the influence of a preceding sentence context on current word processing via putative anticipatory mechanisms). We evaluated four hypotheses derived from PC models focused on: (1) bottom-up prediction error, (2) top-down sensory prediction, (3) biological plausibility, and (4) hierarchical inference. We argue that many empirical effects of predictability during reading are generally consistent with PC model hypotheses, such as ERP N400 context effects and facilitated recognition and reading times, while others are challenging to reconcile, such as the frontal positivity ERP effect to plausible prediction violations and emerging work examining brain-behavior dynamics in natural reading. Overall, we suggest that while PC applied to linguistic processing has some important explanatory utility, it likely does not reflect the sole core mechanism of the language architecture.
papers.summary_zh: 该文评估预测编码模型能否解释阅读中的语言可预测性效应，即前文语境如何通过预期机制影响当前词汇加工。作者围绕自下而上的预测误差、自上而下的感觉预测、生物合理性和层级推断四项假设展开论证，认为N400语境效应以及识别和阅读时间的促进等结果与预测编码基本相符，但合理预测违反引发的额区正波、自然阅读中脑与行为动态等证据较难纳入该框架。作者据此指出，预测编码对语言加工具有一定解释力，但可能并非语言架构的唯一核心机制。

papers.title: How Meaning Shapes a Rule: Neural Signatures of Morphological Learning and Generalization
papers.authors: Azar M, Marantz A.
papers.abstract: Rule generalization is one of the most useful tools our mind uses to facilitate learning. In language, we apply it to connect what words mean to what they are made of, such as their suffixes. This is a morphosemantic relation, and it helps us process words we already know and easily acquire new words by composing their meaning. How is this relation acquired, and how does it manifest into generalization for understanding new words? In this study, we investigated the brain basis of these questions through an English-based artificial language study, where learners read sentences to learn a suffix-meaning relation of new words like “thinkle”. Words were either meaningful (places or things) or had no clear meaning. Each suffix family had majority and minority meaning words that participants had to keep track of for testing. For meaningful words in training, we found that higher performance scores predicted higher selective engagement in the left inferior frontal gyrus, specifically the pars triangularis and pars opercularis. In testing, both learned and generalized words, both increased lateral prefrontal cortex engagement. Meanwhile, words with no clear meaning had a much more diffuse brain engagement, recruiting bilateral temporoparietal regions. This resembles the processing of abstract words from previous literature. We found no difference between majority and minority meaning words, especially with the variance in participants’ performance strategies, but found differences in what predicted significant brain activity based on strategy difference. This study grounds itself in the reality of word and affixal semantics with previous research on language learning and universals. Ultimately, it lends a learning paradigm that resembles natural language learning across many languages to carefully investigate its brain basis, while addressing an understudied aspect of rule generalization: ambiguity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用基于英语的人工语言学习任务，考察学习者如何习得词缀与词义之间的形态—语义关系，并将其推广到新词。结果发现，学习有明确意义的词时，成绩越好，左侧额下回（特别是三角部和岛盖部）的选择性参与越强；测试阶段，无论学过的词还是推广到的新词，都伴随外侧前额叶参与增强。而无明确意义的词则引发更弥散的双侧颞顶区域活动，类似以往对抽象词加工的观察。研究未发现多数义与少数义词之间的差异，但预测显著脑活动的因素随学习者策略不同而变化。作者据此强调，规则推广中的歧义问题值得进一步关注。

papers.title: Taking the speaker’s perspective? Investigating quantifier and implicature processing in an AI-language training paradigm using EEG-VR
papers.authors: Spychalska M, Reimer L, Dijkhuis M, Hagoort P.
papers.abstract: Interpreting speaker meaning requires taking into account the speaker’s epistemic perspective, i.e., their access to relevant information. The extent to which listeners integrate this perspective during comprehension is known as the perspective-taking problem. We present the first EEG study to investigate the role of perspective-taking in the processing of quantifiers and scalar implicatures. Using immersive virtual reality, we asked participants to assist an AI, represented by a virtual agent, in learning to use quantifiers appropriately. Critically, the agent had limited access to the reference domain compared to the participant.Our results show that when the speaker’s information access is restricted, listeners initially process the semantic content of quantified statements from an egocentric perspective. Effects of the speaker’s perspective emerge only later, reflected in a sustained anterior negativity. For pragmatically ambiguous sentences containing ``some", we observe neither an effect of speaker perspective nor evidence for scalar implicature processing. We argue that contexts requiring consideration of the speaker’s knowledge primarily support Gricean, weak implicatures, which are computed relatively late as post-propositional inferences.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电结合沉浸式虚拟现实，考察听者在理解数量词和级差隐含意义时是否采纳说话者的知识视角。参与者协助一个信息获取受限的虚拟AI代理学习使用数量词。结果显示，当说话者掌握的信息有限时，听者最初从自我视角加工数量陈述的语义内容，说话者视角的影响出现较晚，表现为持续的前部负波；而对含“some”的语用歧义句，既未发现说话者视角效应，也未发现级差隐含意义加工的迹象。作者据此认为，需要考虑说话者知识的语境主要支持较晚计算的后命题性弱隐含意义。

papers.title: The Functional Connectivity of Hallucinations in Psychiatric Disorders and Neurodegenerative Disorders: A Systematic Review
papers.authors: Ren Y, Pham HN, Xiong X, Wu SJ, Fernandez-Egea E, O’Brien JT, Murray G, suckling J.
papers.abstract: Background: Hallucinations span psychiatric and neurodegenerative disorders, yet unified neurobiological or consciousness-based explanations remain uncertain. Functional connectivity (FC) provides a network-level view with highly heterogeneous findings. Methods: Following PRISMA, we included studies with FC of hallucinations to ask whether it is sensitive to hallucinations, can distinguish different disorders, and if adopted theories are explanatory. Results: 198 studies were included, with far fewer studies in neurodegenerative (35) than psychiatric disorders (163). Across conditions, hallucinations consistently involved dysconnectivity among default mode (DMN), salience (SN), central executive (CEN), sensory systems, and subcortical circuits. Shared alterations included disrupted SN modulation of sensory gating, altered DMN-sensory coupling and within DMN coherence, limbic system involvement, and reduced CEN regulation of perceptual networks. Disorder‑specific patterns were evident: psychiatric hallucinations preferentially involved auditory-language networks, cortico‑striatal circuits, and salience hubs, whereas neurodegenerative hallucinations were characterised by visual and attentional network dysfunction, including dorsal and ventral attention systems and visual cortices. Conclusions: FC is sensitive to hallucinations and shows different disorder-linked patterns while revealing shared mechanisms, supporting the transdiagnostic nature of hallucinations at the level of functional brain networks. Despite the involvement of multiple transdiagnostic networks, the current literature does not converge on a unified cognitive or consciousness-based theory of hallucinations, underscoring a critical theoretical gap and the need for integrative models.

papers.title: Predictive coding unifies neural and behavioral signatures of contextual facilitation
papers.authors: Nour Eddine S, Yacovone A, Kuperberg GR.
papers.abstract: During comprehension, words that are primed or predictable are processed more quickly and elicit smaller N400 responses than words that are less consistent with their preceding context. Although these behavioral and neural effects are both commonly interpreted as evidence of facilitated processing, they have typically been explained within different computational frameworks that impose seemingly conflicting constraints: behavioral facilitation requires more activity to accumulate over expected representations, allowing a decision threshold to be reached earlier, whereas N400 facilitation requires less neural activity to be generated overall. Here, we show that an implemented model of predictive coding provides a unified mechanistic account of both phenomena and, in doing so, resolves three longstanding puzzles. First, it explains how facilitated processing can simultaneously produce faster behavioral responses and reduced neural activity: expected representations accumulate activity more rapidly in state units while generating less activity in error units. Second, an asymmetry between top-down priors and bottom-up evidence allows context to pre-activate multiple lexical candidates without inducing premature competition or misprediction costs. Third, it reconciles apparently conflicting claims about the timing of contextual facilitation by showing that behavioral and neural measures can reflect different phases along a single continuous trajectory of lexico-semantic processing, rather than distinct processing stages.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对语境促进效应中行为反应加快与N400波幅减小看似矛盾的问题，采用可实现的预测编码模型进行机制解释。模型表明，预期表征在状态单元中更快累积活动，同时在误差单元中产生更少活动，从而统一了行为促进与神经活动降低。自上而下先验与自下而上证据之间的不对称性，使语境能预先激活多个词汇候选而不引发过早竞争或错误预测代价；行为与神经指标也可反映同一词汇语义加工轨迹的不同阶段，而非不同加工阶段。这为长期存在的三个争议提供了统一解释。

papers.title: Clinical Characteristics and Long-Term Follow-Up of Leukoencephalopathy in Pediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia After Chemotherapy.
papers.authors: Feng J, Xiao X, Tang J, Zhang B.
papers.abstract: Purpose This study aimed to investigate the clinical characteristics and long-term outcomes of leukoencephalopathy (LE) in pediatric patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) after chemotherapy, with the goal of evaluating diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis. Methods We retrospectively analyzed the clinical data of 48 pediatric ALL patients diagnosed with LE after chemotherapy at the Children's Hospital of Soochow University (February 2010-December 2024). Data included general information, Clinical manifestations and diagnostic imaging results. Compared with a control group of 27 healthy children, the patients' cognitive function was assessed by using the Behavioural Rating Inventory of Executive Function-2 (BRIEF-2) and the Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children (WISC). Results Neurological symptoms were observed in 47.92% (23/48) of LE patients, including seizures (27.08%), paralysis (12.50%), limb numbness (10.42%), and speech impairment (10.42%). Brain MRI revealed white matter abnormalities, predominantly in the periventricular regions (47.92%), parietal lobes (37.50%), and frontal lobes (22.92%). Long-term follow-up demonstrated that 73.91% of symptomatic patients experienced rapid neurological improvement, and 83.33% of cases showed a significant reduction in MRI lesions within 12 months. Compared to controls, patients with LE exhibited higher BRIEF-2 scores (indicating executive dysfunction) for self-monitoring, emotional control, working memory, and planning/organization (all P < 0.05). The WISC scores were significantly lower for the total IQ, perceptual reasoning, working memory, and processing speed (P < 0.05). Conclusion Post-chemotherapy LE in pediatric ALL presents with diverse neurological symptoms and neuroimaging abnormalities accompanied by mild-to-moderate cognitive deficits. However, the prognosis appears favorable, with most patients showing symptom resolution and improved imaging findings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病化疗后白质脑病的临床特征与远期结局，回顾性分析了单中心患儿的临床表现、影像学结果，并与健康儿童对照评估认知功能。结果显示，部分患儿出现癫痫、肢体无力或言语障碍等神经系统症状，脑MRI可见以脑室周围及额顶叶为主的白质异常；多数有症状者神经功能较快改善，多数病例的影像病灶在一年内明显减轻。但与对照组相比，患儿在执行功能多个方面及总智商、知觉推理、工作记忆和处理速度上表现较差，提示存在轻至中度认知缺陷。作者据此认为，此类白质脑病症状和影像表现多样并伴认知损害，但总体预后较好。

papers.title: MDD-Explorer: A Multi-scale Visual Evolution Framework for Dynamic Functional Connectivity in Depression
papers.authors: Li S, Cheng Z, Chen L, Xu H.
papers.abstract: Abstract Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) is a prevalent psychiatric condition whose symptoms have been associated with time-varying changes in the statistical relationships among distributed brain regions, a property referred to as dynamic functional connectivity (dFC). However, the large sample sizes and high dimensionality of modern dFC datasets make it difficult for cliniciansto extract useful findings. We present MDD-Explorer, a multi-scale visualanalytics framework for examining dFC in large clinical cohorts. The systemcombines unsupervised state-transition modeling with a coordinated set ofinteractive visualizations. It allows users to navigate three analyticalscales: a macroscopic cohort view for comparing state transition probabilities and dwell times between patient and control groups, amesoscopic timeline view for tracking how each subject's brain statechanges over the scanning session, and a microscopic 3D connectome viewthat places high-dimensional connectivity features in their anatomical context. We demonstrate MDD-Explorer on a resting-state fMRI dataset of 1,642 subjects with 140 time steps per subject. Through case studies and expert feedback, we show that the framework supports the identification of MDD-associated patterns, such as reduced flexibility in switching between brain states and localized abnormalities in specific neural circuits, and that these patterns can be related to clinical interpretations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对重度抑郁症患者脑区间动态功能连接数据维度高、样本量大、临床难以解读的问题，提出了多尺度可视分析框架MDD-Explorer，将无监督状态转移建模与一组联动交互可视化结合，支持从队列、个体时间线和三维连接组三个尺度查看数据。作者在静息态fMRI数据上演示了该框架，案例与专家反馈显示其有助于识别患者状态切换灵活性降低及特定神经环路的局部异常，并可将这些模式与临床解释相联系。需要说明的是，这是可视化分析工具的演示性研究，所识别的组间模式属于关联性发现，并非治疗或诊断效果的验证。

papers.title: Search-period EEG signatures of confidence in naturalistic visual search
papers.authors: Zhou N, Catchpoole D, Lin C, Guo T, Wang Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Decision confidence is an individual’s subjective estimate that a decision is correct. Many EEG studies emphasise brief signals around choice, offering limited time for a brain-computer interface (BCI) to identify low-confidence states and support users before the decision-making response. Naturalistic visual search extends evidence sampling, allowing confidence-related EEG dynamics to be examined before that response and providing a candidate temporal window for future BCI assistance. Using time-resolved scalp EEG, we examined oscillatory activity associated with confidence across task stages. Single-trial band power regressions accounted for accuracy and reaction time (RT), with confidence slopes tested across participants. We also characterised the response-locked centro-parietal positivity (CPP). Confidence ratings reliably distinguished correct from incorrect decisions. After accounting for accuracy and RT, higher confidence was associated with lower theta- and alpha band power during late visual search. Theta effects extended into the pre-decision fixation interval, with the most robust associations over central and parietal sensor groups. A clear CPP was evident around the decision-making response, but neither its amplitude nor peak latency varied reliably with confidence. These findings identify extended pre-response EEG dynamics associated with confidence and motivate future tests of their utility for online decoding and decision support in BCIs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然视觉搜索中决策信心在反应前脑电活动上的表现，用时间分辨头皮脑电考察搜索与决策各阶段振荡活动，并在单试次分析中控制正确率和反应时后检验信心效应。结果发现，信心评分能可靠区分正确与错误决策；在控制正确率和反应时后，较高信心与搜索后期较低的theta和alpha频段功率相关，theta效应还延续到决策前注视阶段，以中央和顶叶传感器组最稳定。决策反应附近的顶中央正电位清晰可见，但其幅度和峰潜伏期均未随信心可靠变化。作者据此指出，信心相关信息可在反应前较长时间窗内体现，为未来在线解码和脑机接口决策支持提供了候选时间窗，但尚需进一步验证其实际效用。

papers.title: Simultaneous metabolic–functional coupling topology in disorders of consciousness
papers.authors: Xu L, He C, Sun Y, Ge Q, Xie Y, Chen X, Geng X, Ai L, Wang K, Li X, He J, Laureys S, Song M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Consciousness depends on coordinated cerebral metabolism and intrinsic brain activity, yet the spatial organization of this neurometabolic coupling across consciousness states remains incompletely understood. We studied 29 patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness (12 MCS, 17 UWS) and 10 preserved-consciousness clinical reference participants using simultaneous PET/MR-derived 18 F-FDG PET and resting-state fMRI data. PET-derived Z-standardized FDG uptake and fMRI-derived regional homogeneity (ReHo) and fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) were first compared between MCS and UWS. Cross-modal coupling was then quantified at two levels: within-subject whole-brain spatial coupling and group-level voxel-wise coupling topology. Z-standardized FDG uptake, ReHo, and fALFF showed distinct MCS–UWS difference topographies, whereas whole-brain coupling magnitude did not differ between MCS and UWS for any modality pair. Exploratory voxel-wise analyses identified candidate coupling patterns involving dorsal parietal, posterior midline, occipital, anterior insular, sensorimotor, and cerebellar territories, although none survived FDR or max-statistic FWER correction. These findings do not establish a independently validated clinical biomarker, but suggest that metabolic–functional relationships in prolonged disorders of consciousness may be spatially heterogeneous and not adequately characterized by a single whole-brain coupling measure, providing candidate topographies for future independent replication.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注持续意识障碍患者中脑代谢与内在功能活动的空间耦合组织，纳入不同意识水平的患者及意识保留的临床参照者，结合静息态功能磁共振与氟代脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层数据，比较代谢摄取与局部功能指标的空间关系。结果显示，不同意识水平之间在代谢与功能指标上呈现不同的差异分布，但全脑层面的跨模态耦合强度并未随意识水平变化；探索性的体素分析提示若干候选耦合模式，但均未通过多重比较校正。作者据此认为，持续意识障碍中的代谢—功能关系可能具有空间异质性，单一全脑耦合指标难以充分刻画，这些候选空间分布有待独立重复验证，尚不能视为经验证的临床生物标志物。

papers.title: The Impact of Topological Changes on Visual Working Memory in Schizophrenia: Evidence from Behavioral and EEG Measures
papers.authors: Chen L, Zhang Q, Chen K, Hu J, Tang Y, Meng S, Zhu C, Li N.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Visual working memory (VWM) deficits are a prominent feature of schizophrenia, but it remains unclear whether they involve altered processing of structural visual information. Methods Thirty-one clinically stable patients with schizophrenia and 32 healthy controls completed a change-detection task in which topology, contour, and color were manipulated independently. EEG analyses included 24 patients and 30 healthy controls. Behavioral and EEG measures were analyzed using mixed-design repeated-measures analyses of variance. Results Topological congruency affected both accuracy and reaction time, with a significantly attenuated accuracy effect in patients. Patients also showed altered topology-related beta-band modulation, particularly in the frontal region. Fronto-occipital alpha-band connectivity exhibited condition-dependent modulation in healthy controls but not in patients. Conclusions Schizophrenia was associated with attenuated use of topological information during VWM retrieval, accompanied by altered beta-band responses and reduced task-dependent modulation of fronto-occipital alpha-band connectivity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察精神分裂症患者的视觉工作记忆缺陷是否涉及结构视觉信息加工的异常，采用变化检测任务分别操纵拓扑、轮廓和颜色，并结合行为与脑电指标比较患者与健康对照。结果显示，拓扑一致性影响正确率和反应时，但患者在该效应上的正确率优势明显减弱；患者还表现出拓扑相关的β频段调制改变，尤其在前额区域，而健康对照的前额—枕区α频段连接会随任务条件调制，患者则缺乏这种调制。作者据此认为，精神分裂症患者在视觉工作记忆提取中对拓扑信息的利用减弱，并伴随β频段反应改变及前额—枕区α连接任务依赖性调制的下降，提示结构信息加工异常可能是其工作记忆缺陷的一个方面。

papers.title: "Unmasking Misinformation": Characterizing the Social Media Landscape of Disorders of Consciousness on X (formerly Twitter)
papers.authors: Ahmed W, Hardey M, Rao VM, Stern-Nezer SJ, Kass J, Wahlster S, Lim-Hing K, Dangayach NS, Sarwal A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To characterize the discursive landscape of public discussion related to disorders of consciousness (DoC) on the X social media platform, including its nature, prevalence, thematic structure, and contextual diversity. Methods Point-prevalence, observational study of social media content using a combined social network analysis and unsupervised topic-modeling approach. The setting was X (formerly Twitter), a global public microblogging platform. English-language posts published between January 1 and December 31, 2023 were retrieved using a curated set of nine DoC-related keyword phrases ("Disorders of Consciousness," "Coma Recovery," "Vegetative State," "Minimally Conscious State," "Brain Death," "Locked-In Syndrome," "Medically Induced Coma," "Coma Prognosis," "Dead Zone"). No interventions were applied. Results A total of 30,621 posts were retrieved. Social network analysis using the Harel-Koren Fast Multiscale layout and Clauset-Newman-Moore modularity-based clustering identified seven principal user communities. BERTopic transformer-based topic modeling yielded 50 coherent topics, which were grouped through structured thematic synthesis into three dominant discourse domains: (1) medical and clinical (vegetative state, brain death, locked-in syndrome, medically induced coma, and prominent named cases); (2) ethical, legal, and societal (organ donation/procurement, end-of-life and beginning-of-life debates, criminal justice cases involving vegetative outcomes); and (3) figurative and non-medical (the term "dead zone" used in technology, gaming, popular culture, and Stephen King's novel). Non-medical uses constituted a substantial fraction of total retrieval volume, and the unsupervised model was unable to algorithmically separate clinical from figurative uses of overlapping terms. Conclusions Public discourse about DoC on X is substantial in volume, thematically heterogeneous, and embedded within emotionally charged, legally complex, and figurative contexts that dilute clinical meaning and create fertile conditions for misinformation. These findings provide an evidence-based map of where targeted educational and public-health interventions are most needed and underscore the value of cross-platform, multilingual, and domain-specific NLP follow-up work.
