These findings identify MSB-centered theta network alterations as a disease-relevant and stimulation-sensitive brain-state phenotype in schizophrenia with prominent negative symptoms, suggesting that EEG microstate dynamics may serve as candidate markers for characterizing abnormal brain states and their modulation by theta-tACS.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注以阴性症状为主的精神分裂症患者脑状态动态组织异常，以及θ频段经颅交流电刺激（theta-tACS）能否调节这些异常。研究比较患者与健康对照的静息态脑电微状态，并将患者随机分为真刺激和伪刺激组，结合微状态分析与θ频段源成像考察刺激相关变化。基线时患者微状态B的时间动态减弱，其相关θ网络活动也发生改变；真刺激后微状态B动态增强，并调节右侧颞顶枕区相关的θ源活动。微状态B动态变化与情绪面孔识别表现相关，而其θ源活动变化与阴性症状严重度的纵向变化相关。作者据此提出，以微状态B为中心的θ网络改变是该亚型中与疾病相关且对刺激敏感的大脑状态表型，脑电微状态动态或可作为刻画异常脑状态及其受theta-tACS调节的候选标记。

papers.title: Acute sadness enhances human olfactory sensitivity with individual gains linked to right posterior alpha dynamics
papers.authors: You Y, Chen Y, Bao M, Wei Z, Ye Q, Mao R, Zhang L.
papers.abstract: Abstract Affective states alter perception, but whether a withdrawal-oriented affective state such as sadness changes sensory detection and which cortical dynamics accompany this change remain unclear. Here we show that experimentally induced acute sadness increases human olfactory sensitivity. Adults completed odor detection threshold tests before and after sad or neutral movie viewing while respiration and electrodermal activity were recorded. Sad movie viewing increased sensitivity to both pleasant and unpleasant odorants relative to neutral movie viewing, and this valence-general gain was not accounted for by sniffing behavior or electrodermal arousal. EEG revealed a sampling-specific post-movie increase in posterior alpha at the group level. Across individuals, right posterior alpha changes during movie viewing and subsequent odor sampling both predicted olfactory sensitivity gain. These findings extend affective modulation of sensory gain beyond threat-oriented states and identify right posterior alpha dynamics as a candidate marker of individual susceptibility to sadness-related olfactory sensitization.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨急性悲伤这一退缩取向的情绪状态是否会改变人的嗅觉检测能力，以及伴随的皮层动态。研究通过实验诱发悲伤或中性情绪，在观看影片前后测量成人气味检测阈，同时记录呼吸、皮肤电活动和脑电。结果显示，悲伤影片观看后，受试者对愉悦和不愉悦气味的敏感性均提高，且这一效价通用的增益不能由嗅闻行为或皮肤电唤醒解释；脑电上可见后部alpha的组水平变化，而个体在观影和随后气味采样期间的右侧后部alpha变化能预测嗅觉敏感性的提升。作者据此认为，情绪对感觉增益的调节不限于威胁相关状态，右侧后部alpha动态可能是悲伤相关嗅觉敏化的个体易感性标志。

papers.title: An 8-year follow-up on a child with intellectual disability and developmental delay due to a 5q14.3-q15 deletion 5q14.3-q15 deletion: 8-year pediatric follow-up
papers.authors: Zhu L, Ao M, Deng Q, Liu X, Gu R, Zhang S, Wang Y, Zhang X, Ma X.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Intellectual disability (ID)/developmental delay (DD) is a large group of early onset neurodevelopmental disorders that affects 1-2% of children worldwide. 5q14.3-q15 deletions have been described as a cause of variable degrees of ID/DD, absent speech, epilepsy, hypotonia, mild facial dysmorphism, brain and other anomalies. Case Report: Here we described a case of ID/DD related to 5q14.3-q15 deletion (7.2 Mb) with 8-year follow-up, who presented with DD, ID with speech/language disorder, learning disability, hypospadias, short stature, febrile seizure, epilepsy, minor facial dysmorphism, and mild cerebral malformation. We propose haploinsufficiency of NR2F1 to be the cause of the patient’s phenotype. Conclusion: This report may expand the phenotypic spectrum of chromosome 5q14.3-q15 deletion, underscore the neurodevelopmental genes associated with various phenotypes of 5q14.3-q15 deletions. We should emphasize the need for carefully clinical interpretation for ID/DD children with copy number variants (CNVs) deletions.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告对一名携带5q14.3-q15缺失（7.2 Mb）的智力障碍/发育迟缓患儿进行了为期8年的儿科随访，描述其发育迟缓、智力障碍伴言语语言障碍、学习障碍、尿道下裂、身材矮小、热性惊厥、癫痫、轻微面部畸形及轻度脑畸形等表现。作者提出NR2F1单倍剂量不足可能是该患儿表型的原因。报告认为这有助于扩展5q14.3-q15缺失的表型谱，并强调对携带拷贝数变异的智力障碍/发育迟缓儿童需进行审慎的临床解读。

papers.title: Reassessing bronchopulmonary dysplasia definitions: association between severity grading and brain injury on term-equivalent age MRI.
papers.authors: Xu SH, Li TT, Yan CB, Zhang HH, Gong XH, Cai C.
papers.abstract: Background This study aimed to evaluate the associations between severity classified by three bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) diagnostic criteria [2001 National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD), 2018 NICHD, and 2019 Jensen] and cerebral injury identified on term-equivalent age (TEA) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in infants born at <32 weeks' gestation. Methods This single-center retrospective cohort study included 222 preterm infants (mean gestational age 29.3±1.6 weeks) admitted to Shanghai Children's Hospital [2018-2022]. Brain injury was scored on TEA MRI using the Kidokoro system, yielding white matter (WM), cortical gray matter (GM), deep GM, and cerebellar scores; a global brain abnormality (GBA) score ≥6 defined moderate-to-severe global brain injury (msGBI). We compared brain injury across BPD severity groups for each criterion and analyzed associations between BPD severity and msGBI using Firth's penalized-likelihood regression, adjusting for gestational age and birth weight. Results WM abnormalities were the most frequent injury (70.3%); msGBI was present in 12.6% of infants. Applying the 2019 Jensen criteria revealed a severity-dependent increase in brain injury scores, with significant differences in GBA, WM, and cortical GM scores across severity groups (all P<0.05). Only grade 3 BPD by the 2019 Jensen criteria was independently associated with msGBI (adjusted odds ratio =8.54, 95% confidence interval: 2.04-37.72, P=0.004). No significant associations were found for the other criteria. Conclusions The 2019 Jensen criteria uniquely identify a high-risk subgroup (grade 3 BPD) with significantly increased odds of msGBI on TEA MRI, supporting its utility in neurological risk stratification.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注不同支气管肺发育不良（BPD）诊断标准划分的严重程度是否与早产儿矫正胎龄足月时MRI所见脑损伤相关，采用单中心回顾性队列，对胎龄小于32周的早产儿按三种标准分级并评估脑损伤。结果显示，白质异常最常见，整体中重度脑损伤占少数；按2019年Jensen标准分级时，脑损伤评分随严重程度升高，且仅3级BPD与中重度整体脑损伤独立相关，另两种标准未见显著关联。作者据此认为，Jensen标准能识别出脑损伤风险较高的亚组，或有助于神经发育风险分层，但关联性结论仍需谨慎看待。

papers.title: The Glial Coupling in the Developing Brain: Astrocytes, Oligodendrocytes and Myelin Formation
papers.authors: Canepa ME, Santucci C, Mariano D, Mangini S, Calandrino A, Gagliardi L, Petretto A, Striano P, Ramenghi LA.
papers.abstract: Myelination in the developing brain emerges from a dynamic interplay among oligodendrocytes, astrocytes, neurons, vascular components, and immune cells. Although astrocyte–oligodendrocyte interactions are increasingly recognized as critical for myelin formation, maintenance, and metabolic homeostasis, their developmental organization remains incompletely understood, particularly in extremely preterm infants, in whom mature astrocytic functions are not yet fully established. This narrative review examines how oligodendrocyte maturation and white-matter metabolism may be supported across development and how perinatal insults can perturb this evolving cellular cooperation. Evidence from experimental, neuropathological, metabolic, and neuroimaging studies indicates that oligodendrocytes are not passive recipients of astrocytic support but active metabolic, signaling, and immunological partners whose functions evolve alongside astroglial maturation. In the immature white matter, this relationship is further shaped by neuronal activity, vascular substrate delivery, inflammatory signaling, and the intrinsic vulnerability of pre-oligodendrocytes. Hypoxia–ischemia, oxidative stress, iron dyshomeostasis, ferroptosis, and glycemic instability may therefore interfere with multiple components of this developing network. Human and experimental evidence from perinatal white-matter injury is particularly informative, showing the coexistence of reactive astrogliosis, pre-oligodendrocyte injury and maturation arrest, and subsequent impairment of myelination. Quantitative neuroimaging, radiomics, proteomics, and lipidomics provide complementary observational scales through which these processes may be investigated, although imaging markers of myelin remain biologically non-specific. Taken together, the available evidence does not support a single cellular substitute for mature astrocytic function. Rather, oligodendrocyte maturation appears to depend on a developmentally changing division of metabolic, homeostatic, and signaling labour across multiple cellular compartments. We propose that glial coupling itself should therefore be considered a developmentally constructed process whose disruption may contribute to white-matter vulnerability in the preterm brain.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕发育中大脑的髓鞘形成，梳理星形胶质细胞与少突胶质细胞之间的相互作用，尤其关注极早产儿成熟星形胶质功能尚未完全建立的阶段。作者指出，少突胶质细胞并非被动接受星形胶质支持，而是与之共同演化的代谢、信号和免疫伙伴；在未成熟白质中，这一关系还受神经元活动、血管底物供应、炎症信号及前少突胶质细胞固有易损性影响。围产期缺氧缺血、氧化应激、铁稳态失衡、铁死亡和血糖波动可能干扰该网络的多个环节，围产期白质损伤证据显示反应性星形胶质增生、前少突胶质细胞损伤与成熟停滞及后续髓鞘化受损可同时存在。作者据此提出，胶质耦合本身是发育构建的过程，其紊乱可能参与早产脑白质易损性，且现有证据不支持用单一细胞替代成熟星形胶质功能。

papers.title: Pleistocene Pisolites as Archives of Hydrological Variability in Mediterranean Coastal Environments: Evidence from Eivissa (Balearic Islands, Spain)
papers.authors: Del Valle L.
papers.abstract: Pisolites are coated carbonate grains whose nucleus–cortex architecture may preserve evidence of changing hydrological conditions, yet their palaeoenvironmental significance remains poorly explored in Pleistocene Mediterranean coastal successions. This study investigates pisolite-bearing horizons from Eivissa (Balearic Islands, western Mediterranean) using field sedimentology, quantitative morphometry, petrography, and X-ray diffraction (XRD). The pisolites occur within fine-grained carbonate-cemented horizons associated with palaeosols and stabilized coastal dune systems, including interdune settings. Morphometric analysis of two closely spaced samples from the same Cala Compte horizon shows significant differences between matrix-associated and isolated fractions in maximum pisolite and nucleus diameters, while cortical thickness differs significantly only in CC2. Petrography reveals successive, locally discontinuous, asymmetric, and variably concentric cortexes, indicating polyphase accretion. XRD shows calcite-dominated pisolites and matrices with subordinate brushite, quartz, and minor unidentified phases. Integrated evidence supports local to near-local formation with limited redistribution under recurrent changes in water availability. The Eivissa pisolites therefore record episodic hydrological variability and polyphase carbonate formation during phases of Pleistocene coastal landscape stabilization.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以西班牙伊维萨岛（巴利阿里群岛）更新世海岸沉积中的豆粒石为对象，结合野外沉积学、定量形态测量、岩相学和X射线衍射，探讨其古环境意义。豆粒石产于与古土壤和稳定化海岸沙丘系统相关的细粒碳酸盐胶结层中；同一层位两个相邻样品的形态测量显示，基质伴生与孤立颗粒在豆粒石和核心最大直径上存在显著差异，而皮层厚度仅在其中一个样品中显著不同。岩相学显示皮层呈多期、局部不连续、不对称且同心程度不一的增生结构，指示多阶段形成；X射线衍射以方解石为主，含少量透钙磷石、石英及未识别相。作者据此认为豆粒石主要在局部至近局部形成、再搬运有限，记录了更新世海岸景观稳定化阶段中反复出现的水分条件变化和多期碳酸盐形成，但其古环境指示意义仍有待更多研究检验。

papers.title: Neurological and neuroimaging sequelae of lightning injury: a retrospective study and literature review.
papers.authors: Steinberg T, Lukas C, Schalke B, Wendl C, Linker R, Neumann B, Kleiter I.
papers.abstract: Background Lightning injuries (LI) can affect multiple organs, including the peripheral and central nervous system (CNS). Neuroimaging studies in LI are scarce, and it is unknown whether off-target changes in the CNS occur. Methods Retrospective review of patients who were treated in two neurology tertiary referral centers for sequelae of LI between 2004-2024 and had magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or computed tomography (CT) of the CNS. A narrative literature search was performed to identify other studies on neuroimaging after LI. Results Of 31 patients (39% female, median age 38 years), 30 had cranial neuroimaging (28 had cranial MRI, five cranial CT), and 14 spinal MRI. The median delay between LI and first neuroimaging was 67 days. Cranial MRI or CT showed two cases of brain edema, one accompanied by subarachnoid bleeding, one case of laminar cortical necrosis after resuscitation, and one case with hyperintensities in the hippocampi. 14 patients with cranial MRI had unspecific white matter lesions. In six of 14 patients who received a spinal MRI, intramedullary spinal cord lesions were found. A review of 54 published patients revealed pathological neuroimaging in 24 (44%) cases. Main findings were hypoxic encephalopathy after cardiac arrest, intracerebral bleeding, cerebral ischemia, brain edema and subarachnoid bleeding. Interpretation Typical neuroimaging findings after LI include brain edema, intracerebral or subarachnoid bleeding, ischemia, hypoxic encephalopathy, and intramedullary spinal cord lesions. Moreover, brain white matter lesions are common, which are of unknown significance, since clinical correlates are rare and pre-existing pathologies often cannot be ruled out.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注雷击伤后中枢神经系统的影像学后遗症，回顾性分析了两家三级神经专科医院收治的雷击伤患者，并辅以文献综述。头颅影像中可见脑水肿、蛛网膜下腔出血、复苏后层状皮质坏死及海马高信号等表现，非特异性白质病变也较常见；脊髓MRI则发现部分患者存在髓内病变。已发表病例的综述同样以缺氧性脑病、颅内出血、脑缺血、脑水肿和蛛网膜下腔出血为主。作者指出，白质病变的临床意义尚不明确，且难以排除既往病变，因此这些影像发现与症状之间的关联仍需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Recessive variants in ESCRT-II component VPS25 alter vesicular transport and small extracellular vesicle processing in lethal neonatal encephalopathy.
papers.authors: Isaioglou I, AlAbdi L, Tehseen M, de Los Santos YL, Aldehaiman M, Lopez-Madrigal G, Altuwaijri N, Aguayo VH, Pleyers A, Ayach M, Al-Amoudi A, Kai J, Raducanu VS, Alhaddad B, Hofstätter E, Al-Amodi A, Hashem MO, Alsaif HS, Fazelnia C, Abdulwahab F, Jaafar A, Alshidi T, Helaby R, Montaño AM, Klemp KC, Totten E, Kurdi W, Eltohamy S, Alrukban HAE, Alawam B, Selleri L, Lessel D, Kapogiannis D, Hamdan SM, Braddock SR, Alkuraya FS, Merzaban JS.
papers.abstract: Background The role of small extracellular vesicles (sEVs), such as exosomes, in cell-to-cell communication is increasingly recognized. Both during development and postnatally, sEVs have been shown to mediate a multitude of essential functions in the central nervous system. While abnormal sEV biogenesis has been observed in a number of neurodevelopmental disorders, a causal link has been largely lacking. Methods We clinically evaluated five families in which newborns presented with a novel neonatal-onset encephalopathy. Positional mapping, exome sequencing, and trio exome sequencing were utilized to identify the underlying genetic variants. Additionally, we utilized Vps25 hypomorphic mouse mutants and performed cellular assays to evaluate ESCRT-II interaction, cellular localization, and sEV secretion and cargo capacities. Results The observed lethal encephalopathy is characterized by severe hypotonia, brain anomalies, and epilepsy. In families 1, 4, and 5 (multiplex consanguineous), we identified a novel homozygous missense variant in VPS25 as the likely candidate. Family 2 comprises a simplex case with two missense variants in trans in VPS25, one of which impacts the same residue as in the other three families. Family 3 also comprises a simplex case where we revealed a homozygous missense variant. VPS25 is an essential component of ESCRT-II, itself required for sEV biogenesis. We show that Vps25 hypomorphic mouse mutants recapitulate the developmental brain malformation observed in patients. We also show that mutant VPS25 is associated with abnormal ESCRT-II interaction, abnormal cellular localization, and highly abnormal sEVs. Specifically, mutant cells displayed engorged multivesicular bodies and were significantly defective in their capacity to secrete sEVs such as exosomes, while secreted sEVs contained altered cargo, lacking vital proteins for axon protection and maintenance. Conclusions We report a novel neurodevelopmental disorder caused by biallelic hypomorphic variants in VPS25. The consistent impact of these variants on sEV biogenesis suggests a potential pathomechanism. While future cases will further delineate the phenotypic spectrum, these findings offer a new perspective on abnormal sEVs as drivers of human neurodevelopmental disorders.
mesh_terms: Endosomal Sorting Complexes Required for Transport

papers.title: Disorders of the Basal Ganglia and Cerebellum: A Comprehensive Review of Speech Sensorimotor Symptoms and Responses to Feedback Perturbations.
papers.authors: Wang H, Max L.
papers.abstract: Situated within critical cortical-subcortical sensorimotor circuits, the basal ganglia and cerebellum are thought to play important roles in both feedforward and feedback mechanisms of speech sensorimotor control. Motor speech impairments and speech-related sensory deficits are indeed common in disorders involving these two structures such as Parkinson's disease, dystonia, and cerebellar degeneration. Recently, several studies have also investigated the impact of these disorders on the feedforward and feedback components of speech sensorimotor control by examining immediate compensation to unexpected auditory perturbations (auditory-motor compensation) and across-trials adaptation to predictable auditory perturbations (auditory-motor adaptation). Additional studies have investigated how the speech of patients with these disorders is affected by pharmacological interventions and deep brain stimulation of neural substrates related to the basal ganglia or cerebellum. This review summarizes and integrates the growing body of literature based on these three lines of inquiry regarding speech sensorimotor control in basal ganglia and cerebellar disorders: (a) motor and sensory impairments, (b) auditory-motor compensation and adaptation, and (c) effects of pharmacological and deep brain stimulation interventions on symptoms and on auditory-motor compensation/adaptation. The review highlights areas of consistency and inconsistency in the obtained results, demonstrates an apparent dissociation between impact on the phonatory versus articulatory subsystems, and identifies several critical gaps in our knowledge to date. Taken together, these insights call for further studies on speech sensorimotor control in patients with basal ganglia and cerebellar disorders, in particular studies using more rigorous experimental controls as well as innovative neuroimaging and neurostimulation techniques.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕基底节与小脑疾病中的言语感觉运动控制，整合了运动与感觉障碍、听觉—运动补偿与适应、以及药物和深部脑刺激干预效应三条研究线索。作者指出，相关研究结果既有一致之处也存在矛盾，并发现干预对发声与构音子系统的影响似乎存在分离。文章据此强调，现有证据仍不足以厘清这些结构在言语前馈与反馈控制中的具体作用，呼吁在患者中开展控制更严格、并采用创新神经影像与神经调控技术的研究。

papers.title: Neural Coding of Multiple Linguistic Components During Reading Comprehension Across Development.
papers.authors: Chen J, Feng X, Zhang J, Tang C, Liu L, Fan S, Zhao N, Lei Y, Yang X, Meng X, Ding G.
papers.abstract: Understanding how multiple linguistic components are represented within the human language network, and how these representations change across development, remains an important open question. This study examines whether the language network integrates linguistic components through regions dedicated to single components (single-component coding) or through regions representing combined components (combination-based coding), and how these representational patterns differ across development. We recruited 64 participants (34 children and 30 adults) to complete a hierarchical reading task involving pseudowords, words, sentences, and stories, enabling assessment of neural substrates for individual language components (semantics, syntax, situation model) and their combinations. Based on this task structure, we constructed seven cognitive models targeting individual components and their combinations. Model-based multivariate regression revealed overlapping engagement of left frontal and temporal regions across all models in both groups, indicating multifunctional regions supporting combination-based coding. Compared to children, adults showed more spatially focal model correspondence within core language regions. Moreover, clustering based on model-fitting performance identified three functional clusters with marked developmental differences, broadly corresponding to right frontotemporal regions (Cluster 1), left anterior frontotemporal regions (Cluster 2), and left posterior frontotemporal regions (Cluster 3). Further statistical analyses showed that adults exhibited stronger Combination Code representations in Cluster 2, whereas children relied more on Single Code representations in Cluster 3, suggesting a developmental shift toward integrated coding in anterior networks. Together, these findings reveal that the language network supports combination-based coding through functionally organized clusters, and that the representational roles of anterior and posterior regions undergo reorganization from childhood to adulthood.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阅读时多个语言成分（语义、句法、情境模型）及其组合在语言网络中如何表征，以及这种表征随发育如何变化。儿童与成人完成从假词到故事的分层阅读任务，结合认知模型与多变量回归分析。结果显示，两组在左额颞区均出现跨模型的重叠激活，提示这些区域具有多功能性并支持组合编码；成人的模型对应更集中于核心语言区。基于模型拟合的聚类进一步区分出右额颞、左前额颞和左后额颞三个功能簇，成人在左前部簇中组合编码更强，儿童则更多依赖左后部簇的单成分编码，提示发育过程中表征由后部单成分编码向前部整合编码转变。

papers.title: Theta and Gamma Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (tACS) Modulate Mandarin Consonant and Lexical Tone Perception.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Yu K, Yin S, Liang B, Wang R.
papers.abstract: A theta/gamma neural activity mechanism has been postulated to explain the auditory sampling of hierarchical syllable-phoneme structure with corresponding speech rates or linguistic hierarchies (theta for syllable and gamma for phoneme). Yet, whether such a mechanism is generalizable to Mandarin Chinese, a tonal language, where lexical tones are at syllable length but function as phonemic cues, is unclear. In this study, we applied transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) with theta or gamma currents over bilateral temporal areas in healthy Mandarin-speaking participants during a consonant or tone identification task in quiet or noisy environments. Results showed that theta tACS impaired both consonant and tone identification in quiet and prolonged reaction times across tasks and environments. Moreover, it reduced the psychometric slope for consonant identification in quiet, indicating decreased perceptual sensitivity and less distinct category boundaries. Gamma tACS, however, only delayed tone identification in quiet. Besides, both theta and gamma tACS modulated perceptual decision-making parameters in quiet, leading to increased boundary thresholds (cautiousness of decision) and altered response biases in the perceptual decision of both consonants and tones, as evidenced by the hierarchical drift-diffusion model. These findings indicate that the perception of Mandarin consonants and lexical tones is causally supported by syllable-length theta activity, presumably reflecting syllable-level holistic representations, regardless of environment. Gamma activity, however, is presumably engaged in supporting fast-changing and fine-grained acoustic features in a modulatory manner. Theoretical explanations from historical linguistics and implications for clinical or educational applications are also provided.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨以θ/γ神经活动解释语音层级采样的机制是否适用于声调语言汉语普通话，采用经颅交流电刺激（tACS）结合辅音与声调识别任务，在健康普通话使用者中检验θ或γ刺激对感知的影响。结果显示，θ刺激在安静环境下损害辅音和声调识别并延长反应时，还降低辅音识别的心理测量斜率，提示知觉敏感性和范畴边界清晰度下降；γ刺激仅在安静环境下延迟声调识别。两种刺激还通过漂移扩散模型表现为决策边界阈值和反应偏差的改变。作者据此认为，汉语辅音和声调感知因果性地依赖音节长度的θ活动，可能反映音节层面的整体表征，而γ活动以调节方式支持快速变化的精细声学特征。

papers.title: Visuospatial working memory in Huntington's disease: behavioural and structural brain correlates.
papers.authors: Lunven M, Van Den Enden P, Gil Salcedo A, Pertzov Y, Bapst B, Youssov K, Morgado G, Busse M, Massart R, Rosser A, Bachoud-Lévi AC.
papers.journal: Journal of neurology, neurosurgery, and psychiatry
papers.abstract: Background Visuospatial working memory (VSWM) deficits are among the earliest cognitive impairments evident in Huntington's disease (HD). They often precede motor symptoms and likely reflect early disruption of cortico-striatal circuits. Both the cognitive components and brain correlates are, however, poorly delineated. Objectives This study aims to characterise the progression of VSWM deficits across HD stages and identify their structural brain correlates. Methods In this prospective international study, 92 HD mutation carriers (HDmc) (21 premanifest and 71 manifest) and 39 healthy controls underwent cognitive and clinical assessments and structural MRI at baseline; 49 manifest HD and 36 controls completed a 1-year follow-up. VSWM was assessed using the object-location task (OLT), providing continuous measures of location error, object recognition and object-location binding. MRI analyses included caudate, putamen and hippocampal volumes and cortical thickness. Results We found increased location error and spatial imprecision under high memory load, without binding errors in premanifest HD with an area under the curve of 0.731. Across all HDmc, these location deficits correlated with striatal atrophy and cortical thinning in parietal and middle cingulate regions. Manifest HD individuals exhibited swap errors and hippocampal atrophy. Both location and swap errors worsened over time alongside progressive striatal and hippocampal volume loss. Principal component analysis confirmed a dissociation between spatial location-related deficits (striato-cortically mediated) and binding errors (hippocampally mediated), supporting a hierarchical model of VSWM decline. Conclusions HD-related VSWM impairment follows a staged, anatomically dissociable trajectory. The OLT offers sensitive, mechanistic markers of cognitive decline with potential utility for early detection and clinical trial stratification.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在刻画亨廷顿病不同阶段视空间工作记忆缺陷的进展及其结构脑相关物，对亨廷顿病突变携带者与健康对照进行认知评估和结构MRI，部分完成一年随访。结果显示，前显症期已出现高记忆负荷下位置误差和空间不精确性增加，但无绑定错误；这些位置缺陷与纹状体萎缩及顶叶、中扣带区皮层变薄相关。显症期个体出现交换错误和海马萎缩，位置与交换错误随时间加重并伴随纹状体和海马体积进行性丢失。主成分分析支持空间位置缺陷（纹状体-皮层介导）与绑定错误（海马介导）的分离，提示视空间工作记忆衰退呈分阶段、解剖可分离的轨迹，相关任务指标或有助于早期识别和临床试验分层。

papers.title: Computerized Platform in Hindi Language: Exploring Its Use in Aphasia Screening.
papers.authors: Mitra P, Kethwalia S, Makkar R, Hazrati R, Chhatlani R, Singh GK, Nehra A, Lahiri U.
papers.journal: IEEE journal of translational engineering in health and medicine
papers.abstract: Objective Aphasia is a frequent sequela of stroke, affecting approximately 25%-40% of stroke survivors due to focal damage to language-related brain regions. In resource-constrained settings like India, timely screening is limited by the cost of neuroimaging and the time-intensive nature of conventional pen-and-paper assessments. This study presents a Computerized Hindi Aphasia Screening Platform offering various tasks (CHASP), a computer-based multimodal screening platform designed to objectively differentiate aphasic and non-aphasic post-stroke individuals from healthy controls. Methods CHASP integrates Acoustic, and Visual and Reading tasks with a sensor-enabled base station for response-time quantification and a physiology-based module for acquiring photoplethysmography-derived interbeat interval (IBI) as a biomarker of cognitive processing. Post-stroke participants were independently assessed using the Western Aphasia Battery (WAB), the gold-standard clinical tool. Performance scores from CHASP and relevant sections of WAB were compared for exploring clinical relevance. Results The CHASP task modules reliably differentiated post-stroke participants from healthy controls across performance scores, response times, and IBI. The Acoustic tasks could distinguish the aphasic and non-aphasic groups, particularly through task scores and IBI measures. Strong correlations were observed between CHASP performance scores and corresponding WAB scores, supporting the clinical validity of the proposed platform.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对印度资源有限环境下卒中后失语症筛查受神经影像成本高和传统纸笔评估耗时长限制的问题，开发了计算机化印地语失语症筛查平台（CHASP），整合声学、视觉与阅读任务，并借助传感器记录反应时、通过光电容积脉搏波获取心搏间期作为认知加工指标，以区分卒中后失语者、卒中后非失语者与健康对照。结果显示，CHASP各任务在得分、反应时和心搏间期上能可靠区分卒中后参与者与健康对照，其中声学任务尤其可通过任务得分和心搏间期指标区分失语与非失语组；CHASP得分与WAB相应部分得分呈较强相关，支持其临床效度。这些发现提示该平台有望作为客观的辅助筛查工具，但摘要未报告诊断准确性等指标，其临床应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Blood-brain barrier disruption in response to blood pressure changes in adults with hypertension: a serial MRI study.
papers.authors: Janssen E, de Jong JJA, Verburgt E, Ter Telgte A, van den Berg DTNA, Maas MC, Meijer FJA, Tuladhar AM, Riksen NP, Deinum J, Backes WH, de Leeuw FE.
papers.abstract: Background Loss of blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity is observed in patients with hypertension and is hypothesized to contribute to cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) pathogenesis. Blood pressure increase and decrease within individuals and the effects on BBB integrity have never been examined. Objectives To examine BBB leakage in middle-aged patients with hypertension following subsequent blood pressure increase and decrease. Methods The Hyperintense study included hypertensive adults who temporarily discontinued antihypertensive medication for diagnostic purposes. MRI was done at three timepoints: before medication withdrawal (visit 1), during withdrawal (visit 2) and after medication restart (visit 3). BBB integrity was measured with 3T dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE)-MRI. We assessed leakage rate Ki [min-1] and blood plasma volume Vp. Linear regression was used to examine association between changes in blood pressure and BBB leakage. Results Fourteen patients with hypertension (mean age 48.2 ± 4.5 years; 36% female) were included. After medication withdrawal, blood pressure increased in 11/14 participants (79%). Increase in blood pressure between visit 1 and visit 2 was associated with increased Ki in white (WM) (β = 0.683, P = 0.007) and grey matter (GM) (β = 0.587, P = 0.027) and Vp in the GM (β = 0.666, P = 0.009). Following medication restart, blood pressure decreased in seven participants, with Ki decreasing in four of them. There was no association between decrease in blood pressure and Ki or Vp between visit 2 and visit 3. Conclusions Blood pressure increase was associated with increased BBB leakage. Reduction in BBB leakage following medication restart was observed in most, but not all participants. This suggests that BBB leakage is dynamic and influenced by blood pressure.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨中年高血压患者在血压升高和降低时血脑屏障完整性如何变化，采用停药前后多个时间点的动态对比增强MRI测量渗漏率与血浆容量，并以线性回归分析血压变化与渗漏的关联。结果显示，停药后多数参与者血压升高，且血压升高与白质和灰质渗漏率增加以及灰质血浆容量增加相关；恢复用药后部分参与者血压下降，其中多数人渗漏率随之降低，但血压下降与渗漏指标之间未见关联。作者据此认为，血脑屏障渗漏具有动态性并受血压影响，但恢复用药后的改善并非见于所有参与者，相关发现仍需更大样本验证。

papers.title: Comparing Emotional Facial Expressions Produced During Personal Narrative Discourse by People With and Without Aphasia.
papers.authors: Houghton CK, Harmon TG, Blackett DS.
papers.abstract: Purpose This preliminary study aimed to (a) determine whether the frequency and intensity of emotional facial expressions during personal narrative discourse are different for people with aphasia (PWA) than for adults without aphasia and (b) explore the relationship between the frequency and intensity of emotional facial expressions and aphasia severity. Method Fifty-two participants, including 26 PWA and 26 control participants, were randomly selected from Aphasia Bank, a protocoled database with video recordings of both people with and without aphasia. Two video-recorded narrative discourse samples, a stroke/illness story and an important life event story, from each participant were used. Two human coders were trained utilizing a modified Facial Expression Coding System to identify emotional facial expressions according to valence (positive/negative) and intensity (perceptual scale from 1 to 4). Dependent variables included the frequency and intensity of positive and negative facial expressions. Results Linear mixed-effects models revealed that female participants produced more positive facial expressions per minute than did male participants. Overall, PWA produced less intense positive facial expressions compared with control participants. Pearson correlational analyses revealed no statistically significant correlation between the severity and frequency or intensity of emotional facial expressions. Conclusions During discourse, PWA may produce less intense emotional facial expressions compared with their peers due to allocating more attentional resources toward language production or simply as the result of left-hemisphere damage. Future research should replicate and expand on these findings while integrating tasks specifically designed to elicit emotional facial expressions during discourse.
papers.summary_zh: 这项初步研究比较了失语症患者与无失语症成人在个人叙事过程中情绪面部表情的频率和强度，并探讨其与失语症严重程度的关系；研究从Aphasia Bank数据库中随机选取两组参与者的叙事视频，由编码者按效价和强度进行评定。结果显示，女性每分钟产生的积极表情多于男性，失语症患者积极表情的强度整体低于对照组，而失语症严重程度与表情频率或强度之间未见显著相关。作者推测，患者表情强度较低可能与语言产出占用更多注意资源或左半球损伤有关，并强调这些发现需在专门诱发情绪表情的任务中进一步验证。

papers.title: Simultaneous speech and gesture decoding for multimodal communication in paralysis.
papers.authors: Brosler SC, Liu JR, Silva AB, Hallinan IP, Kurtz-Miott CM, Dunkel Wilker JFB, Tu-Chan A, Ganguly K, Chang EF.
papers.abstract: Stroke and neurodegenerative diseases can impair speech and nonverbal gestures, limiting natural communication. Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to restore these functions by translating neural activity into commands for external devices, although prior work has primarily focused on decoding speech or gestures in isolation. Here we show that neural signals recorded with a single high-density electrocorticography implant can support simultaneous decoding of speech and gestures in people with paralysis. We first show that isolated upper-limb and orofacial movements can be reliably decoded among three participants. Using parallel speech and gesture decoders, we then enabled participants to control a personalized virtual avatar by attempting speech and gestures simultaneously or in isolation. Training models on both isolated and simultaneous data improved performance across behavioral contexts. These findings demonstrate that one cortical implant can support multi-effector control and provide a step toward BCIs that enable more natural communication for people with paralysis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对瘫痪患者自然交流受限的问题，探索能否用单个高密度皮层脑电植入同时解码言语和手势。研究在瘫痪参与者中先验证了孤立的上肢与口面部动作可被可靠解码，随后用并行的言语与手势解码器让参与者通过单独或同时尝试言语和手势来控制个性化虚拟化身；在孤立与同时数据上共同训练模型，使不同行为情境下的表现均有提升。结果表明，一个皮层植入即可支持多效应器控制，为面向瘫痪者、更接近自然交流的脑机接口迈出一步。

papers.title: Overlapping representations in the ventral hippocampus support rapid fear memory retrieval.
papers.authors: Rozeske RR, Runtz L, Lee JQ, Keinath AT, Sossin A, Brandon MP.
papers.abstract: The dorsal and ventral hippocampus (dCA1 and vCA1) are critical for contextual fear conditioning. The canonical theory states that the hippocampus generates dissimilar context representations to prevent interference and facilitate discrimination between contexts. Here, to test this, we monitored dCA1 and vCA1 context representations as mice were instantaneously transitioned between threatening and neutral contexts. Fear conditioning induced representational changes in both subregions, but the change was larger in vCA1 and scaled with freezing. During discrimination testing, threatening and neutral context representations were more similar in vCA1, whereas dCA1 representations remained distinct. During retrieval, vCA1 reinstated the threatening context representation faster and more strongly than dCA1, and the relative dominance of the two representations in vCA1 predicted freezing. These results reveal an unrecognized coding strategy in vCA1: fear learning increases representational overlap, consistent with a shallower attractor landscape, which may permit rapid transitions between neutral and threatening memories.

papers.title: Learning reorganizes dendritic and stabilizes axon initial segment inhibitory synapses in CA1 pyramidal neurons.
papers.authors: Klimmt H, Kuhn F, Kappel D, Murthy B, Ulivi AF, Argunşah AÖ, Vieweg S, Huettl RE, Remy S, Attardo A.
papers.abstract: Structural synaptic plasticity underlies the changes in brain connectivity required for learning and memory. Inhibitory synapses target all subcellular domains of excitatory pyramidal neurons, including dendrites, somata and axon initial segments. These subcellular domains have distinct molecular, structural and physiological profiles which underlie their functions. How structural plasticity of inhibitory synapses supports these functions as well as emerging properties such as memory is largely unknown. To tackle these questions we tracked inhibitory synapses on basal dendrites, somata and axon initial segments of pyramidal neurons in the dorsal hippocampal CA1 area of mice over two weeks. Size and temporal dynamics of inhibitory synapses showed a strong compartmentalization. Trace fear conditioning led to reorganization of dendritic and to stabilization of axon initial segments' inhibitory synapses. Finally, mathematical modelling allowed us to probe the mechanisms underlying stabilization of inhibitory synapses upon learning.

papers.title: Prevalent and characteristic alterations in blood-brain transcriptomic-functional imaging coupling in schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Ji YS, Liu YF, Mu ZQ, Fang-Fang L, Liu MY, Liu M, Zhao JN, Wu WJ, Wu D, Zhang YH, Li XH, Wei YB, Guan FL, Zhang YL, Wang HN, Chen K, Cui LB, Yin AA, Wu YM.
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia (SCZ) is increasingly recognized as a multi-system disorder characterized by peripheral immunometabolic dysregulation. To investigate system-level blood-brain integration, we analyzed peripheral blood transcriptomics, resting-state fMRI (fALFF), and cognitive data from two cohorts (Discovery: 43 SCZ, 60 HCs; Validation: 41 SCZ, 29 HCs). Seven robust peripheral blood gene co-expression modules associated with SCZ were identified, enriched for immune and metabolic pathways. These modules showed reproducible disease associations in independent blood cohorts. Widespread alterations in functional coupling between these gene modules and intrinsic brain activity (fALFF) were observed in SCZ, characterized by a network-specific reconfiguration with an inverse pattern of correlation changes between limbic and frontoparietal/default mode networks. This dysregulated coupling pattern was highly reproducible across cohorts. We further identified putative core disease-associated module-network pairs: a downregulated metabolic module coupled with frontoparietal/default mode regions, and an upregulated ribosomal module coupled with limbic regions. Integration of these multimodal features yielded a proof-of-concept improvement in SCZ diagnostic classification (AUCs: 0.71-0.77 in an independent temporal but local validation cohort). Correlation and mediation analyses suggested that brain functional activity in these coupled regions may mediate the relationship between peripheral gene expression and cognitive impairment. Collectively, these findings reveal distinct, reproducible dysregulation of peripheral-central functional coupling in SCZ, offering a multi-scale framework for understanding its pathophysiology and highlighting the potential of trans-scale features as candidate biomarkers for diagnosis and mechanistic insight.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症患者外周血基因表达与脑自发功能活动之间的跨系统耦合是否发生改变，结合外周血转录组、静息态fMRI和认知数据，在两个独立队列中进行分析。研究发现与精神分裂症相关的血液基因共表达模块主要富集于免疫和代谢通路，这些模块与脑功能活动的耦合在患者中广泛改变，并呈现边缘系统与额顶/默认网络之间相关方向相反的网络特异性重组，该模式在队列间可重复。作者进一步锁定代谢模块下调与额顶/默认网络耦合、核糖体模块上调与边缘系统耦合等候选核心配对，并提示这些脑区活动可能中介外周基因表达与认知损害的关系；多模态特征在独立验证中仅显示概念验证性的分类提升，尚不能视为临床诊断工具。

papers.title: 'Multifunctional' brain implant translates speech and gestures in real time.
papers.authors: Naddaf M.

papers.title: Multimodal brain MRI abnormalities in systemic lupus erythematosus and their association with disease activity and neuropsychiatric involvement: a systematic review.
papers.authors: Santiago IB, Nóbrega ILP, Távora DGF, Pitombeira MS, Rodrigues CEM.
papers.abstract: Objective To systematically review conventional and advanced brain MRI abnormalities in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and evaluate their associations with clinical features, immunological markers, and disease activity. Methods A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines and prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261363662). PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science were searched on August 4, 2026, covering publications through July 31, 2026. Observational studies evaluating structural and/or advanced brain MRI findings in adults with SLE were included. Demographic, clinical, immunological, and neuroimaging data were extracted, and methodological quality was assessed using Joanna Briggs Institute tools. Results One hundred eighty-eight studies were included, comprising 37 conventional and 151 advanced MRI studies. Conventional MRI abnormalities were present in over half of patients, with white matter hyperintensities and cerebral atrophy being the most frequent findings. Advanced MRI demonstrated widespread microstructural, functional, perfusion, and metabolic alterations, including reduced white matter integrity, disrupted functional connectivity, regional perfusion abnormalities, and altered cerebral metabolites. Neuroimaging abnormalities were frequently associated with disease activity, cumulative damage, cognitive impairment, and antiphospholipid antibody positivity. Conclusion Brain MRI reveals diverse structural, microstructural, functional, and metabolic abnormalities associated with cerebral involvement in SLE. However, current evidence is insufficient to establish the incremental diagnostic, prognostic, or clinical management value of advanced or multimodal MRI techniques beyond conventional imaging, and prospective longitudinal studies are needed to determine their clinical utility.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了成人系统性红斑狼疮患者常规与高级脑MRI的结构、微结构、功能和代谢异常，并考察这些影像表现与疾病活动度、累积损伤、认知障碍及抗磷脂抗体阳性等临床和免疫特征之间的关联。纳入研究显示，常规MRI异常在过半患者中出现，以白质高信号和脑萎缩最常见；高级MRI则揭示白质完整性下降、功能连接紊乱、区域灌注异常和脑代谢改变等更广泛的变化。作者强调，现有证据尚不足以确认高级或多模态MRI在诊断、预后或临床管理上优于常规影像，其临床价值仍需前瞻性纵向研究验证。

papers.title: Functional brain abnormalities in panic disorder: A systematic review of functional magnetic resonance imaging studies.
papers.authors: Mehrtabar S, Ajdari A, Azinfar A, Karimi E, Sarallah R, Kahrizsangi ZE, Parsaei M, Mohammadian SM, Gorjestani O, Moghaddam HS, Cattarinussi G, Sambataro F.
papers.abstract: Panic disorder (PD) is a psychiatric condition marked by recurring, unexpected panic attacks characterized by intense fear and rapid-onset physiological symptoms. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) in individuals with PD has revealed abnormalities in several brain regions associated with fear processing, emotional regulation, and interoception. A systematic search was conducted in PubMed and Embase to review the fMRI changes associated with PD published until April 2024. Eighteen studies were included, primarily employing resting-state fMRI and examining functional connectivity. Consistent findings included amygdala and insula hyperactivity and reduced connectivity within the default mode network, particularly in the posterior cingulate cortex and precuneus. Altered connectivity patterns were also observed in the prefrontal cortex, anterior cingulate cortex, and hippocampus. Task-based fMRI studies revealed increased activity in fear-related regions that correlated with clinical measures of PD severity. This review consolidates the evidence of neural network disruptions in PD, emphasizing dysregulated fear processing, emotional regulation, and self-referential thinking. These findings highlight the potential of fMRI to elucidate the pathophysiology of PD and inform targeted interventions. However, the limited number of available studies, small sample sizes, and methodological heterogeneity, particularly among task-based fMRI studies, warrant cautious interpretation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统检索并梳理了惊恐障碍相关的功能磁共振成像研究，纳入的文献以静息态功能连接分析为主，也包含任务态研究。较一致的发现包括杏仁核与岛叶活动增强、默认网络内连接减弱，前额叶、前扣带及海马等区域也出现连接模式改变；任务态研究还显示恐惧相关区域活动增强与临床严重程度指标相关。作者据此强调惊恐障碍中存在恐惧加工、情绪调节与自我参照思维相关神经网络的失调，并指出可据此理解病理生理和探索干预靶点，但现有研究数量有限、样本较小且方法异质性明显，尤其任务态研究，结论需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Default mode network connectivity associated with rumination in major depressive disorder: A systematic review of resting-state fMRI studies.
papers.authors: Riaz S, Mitchell O, Fleury R, Roddy DW, Connaughton M.
papers.abstract: Background Rumination is a central cognitive mechanism in major depressive disorder (MDD) that contributes to symptom persistence, recurrence, and relapse. Although resting-state abnormalities of the default mode network (DMN) are widely reported in depression, it remains unclear which alterations are specifically associated with depressive rumination rather than broader MDD-related dysfunction. Objective To synthesise resting-state fMRI evidence on DMN functional connectivity associated with rumination in clinically diagnosed depression. Methods A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane databases was conducted in January 2025 in accordance with PRISMA guidelines (PROSPERO: CRD420251104487). Eligible studies included clinically diagnosed MDD, rumination using validated measures, and a healthy control group. Task-based fMRI studies were excluded. Owing to methodological heterogeneity, findings were synthesised narratively. Results Twelve studies comprising 314 depressed individuals and 308 controls met inclusion criteria. Rumination was associated with a distinct DMN-centred resting-state profile involving increased anterior DMN connectivity, altered connectivity between DMN subsystems, interactions between DMN regions and frontal-control or salience networks, and increased engagement of DMN-related functional states. Dynamic findings linked rumination to greater DMN-state entries, increased synchrony, and reduced metastability. Several abnormalities observed in MDD, including reduced posterior DMN connectivity, mPFC-parahippocampal and mPFC-PCC variability, were not consistently associated with rumination. Conclusion Rumination in clinically diagnosed depression is associated with a distinct DMN-centred resting-state connectivity profile rather than the broader pattern of DMN abnormalities observed in MDD. These findings may help refine neurobiological models of rumination in depression and identify connectivity markers relevant to symptom persistence, relapse risk, and treatment response.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了临床确诊抑郁症患者中默认网络（DMN）静息态功能连接与反刍思维相关的fMRI证据，纳入相关研究并以叙述性方式整合结果。总体来看，反刍思维对应一个以DMN为中心的特定静息态连接特征，涉及前部DMN连接增强、DMN子系统间连接改变、DMN与额叶控制及突显网络的交互，以及DMN相关功能状态参与增多；动态指标上也表现为更频繁进入DMN状态、同步性升高和亚稳定性降低。值得注意的是，部分在抑郁症中常见的DMN异常并未与反刍思维稳定相关，提示反刍相关连接模式有别于抑郁症更广泛的DMN改变。这些发现有助于细化抑郁症反刍的神经生物学模型，并提示与症状持续、复发风险和治疗反应相关的潜在连接标记，但其临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Evidence consistent with accelerated inhibitory build-up following stronger subliminal motor activation: An EEG trajectory-fitting analysis.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Dong M, Zhang P, Cao J, Wang Y.
papers.abstract: Subliminal motor inhibition is a crucial form of unconscious cognitive control that protects the sensorimotor system from interference to some extent. A large body of evidence has shown that this inhibition is strengthened in response to strong subliminal activation. Beyond inhibitory strength, the build-up rate of inhibition is another critical dimension of cognitive control. Nevertheless, it is unclear whether the build-up rate of inhibition varies. This study investigated this by using the mathematically derived slopes of lateralized readiness potential (LRP) waveforms as build-up rates. LRP trajectory-fitting analysis showed that the peak amplitude and slope of the inhibition-related phase in the LRP were significantly higher in the valid- than the invalid-compatible condition, but the latencies of all inflection points or the time interval between them did not differ significantly between the two cue validity conditions. Time-frequency analyses and computational modeling showed correlational patterns consistent with the accelerated inhibitory build-up. Specifically, the midfrontal theta oscillation, a neural marker linked to cognitive effort, significantly correlated with the LRP slope of the inhibition-related phase in the valid-compatible condition, even after statistically controlling for amplitudes of prime activation and inhibition. Computational modeling showed that the result for the drift rate parameter was consistent with the result for response time (RT). Taken together, these results were consistent with the hypothesis that increased subliminal activation is followed by strong inhibition at a high build-up rate, thereby preventing the strong interference signals from escaping or being delayed inhibition. This reflects the high degree of adaptability and flexibility of the unconscious cognitive system when interacting with the environment.

papers.title: Whole-brain millisecond-scale effective connectivity of auditory and visual naming.
papers.authors: Kochi R, Kanno A, Uda H, Hatano K, Sonoda M, Endo H, Cools M, Rothermel R, Luat AF, Asano E.
papers.abstract: Objective Clinical mapping studies in epilepsy and brain tumor surgery have informed neurobiological models of speech. However, a comprehensive model requires clarification of when, for how long, and in what directions cortical regions transmit information to support processes ranging from perception and comprehension to lexical retrieval and articulation. We aimed to characterize whole-brain patterns of directional neural information flow during auditory and visual naming. Methods We studied 127 patients who performed auditory and picture naming tasks during intracranial EEG recordings, analyzing 9526 artifact-free nonepileptic recording sites. We applied transfer entropy-based effective connectivity analysis to estimate information flow between brain regions. Information flow was classified as accelerating when increases in group-level high-gamma amplitude in one region predicted subsequent increases in another region connected by white matter, and decelerating when decreases predicted subsequent decreases in the downstream region. The functional relevance of these information flow patterns was evaluated using electrical stimulation mapping and behavioral response times. Results Following stimulus onset, accelerating flows emerged from modality-specific sensory cortices and propagated to higher-order regions before becoming bidirectional. These transient accelerating flows were typically followed by decelerating phases, during which new accelerating flows arose. Stronger accelerating flows at specific time points predicted a higher probability of stimulation-induced symptoms (Spearman's rho: 0.54-0.81; p < 0.00,001). During auditory naming, faster responses were associated with stronger accelerating flows within left perisylvian pathways, whereas during visual naming faster responses were associated with stronger accelerating flows within bilateral basal temporal pathways. Discussion Strong accelerating flows, followed rapidly by decelerating flows, predicted stimulation-induced symptoms and faster behavioral responses, indicating that information transfer through white matter supports sequential transitions from perception to lexical retrieval and articulation. By resolving the direction of neural propagation through white matter pathways, this study provides a whole-brain model of temporally precise, anatomically specific, and directional network interactions underlying human speech.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用颅内脑电记录，在癫痫和脑肿瘤手术患者执行听觉命名与图片命名任务时，采用基于转移熵的有效连接分析，刻画全脑方向性信息流的时间进程。结果显示，刺激后加速性信息流从感觉皮层向高级区域传播，随后转为减速阶段并伴随新的加速流出现；特定时刻较强的加速流可预测电刺激诱发的症状和更快的反应，且听觉与视觉命名分别涉及左半球外侧裂周和双侧基底颞叶通路。作者据此提出，经白质传递的加速与减速流交替支持从感知到词汇提取和发音的序列转换，为言语网络提供了时间精确、解剖特异且具方向性的全脑模型。

papers.title: Local and interregional thalamocortical dynamics show temporally dissociable changes during propofol induced loss of consciousness.
papers.authors: Fan L, Wen X, Lu F, Wang D, Chang Y, Zhao G, Shu W, Yu T, Liang Z.
papers.abstract: Whether propofol-induced loss of consciousness (LOC) reflects a single thalamocortical transition or involves temporally dissociable local and interregional dynamics remains unclear. Using stereo-electroencephalography recordings from the anterior nucleus of the thalamus, prefrontal cortex, and temporal cortex during anesthesia induction, we quantified permutation entropy, spectral power, directional connectivity, and phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) to determine the relative onset timing of significant changes across metrics, regions, and frequency bands. Here, we show that complexity in the anterior nucleus of the thalamus decreased before LOC and did so significantly earlier than in the prefrontal and temporal cortices. Spectral power changes likewise emerged earlier in the anterior nucleus of the thalamus than in the prefrontal cortex. Across brain regions, power changes at lower frequencies generally emerged earlier than those at higher frequencies, with the specific timing differences varying across regions. The temporal pattern of PAC was primarily frequency-dependent rather than region-specific. Changes in local directed connectivity were observed earlier in cortical regions than in the anterior nucleus of the thalamus, while thalamo-prefrontal connectivity showed earlier significant modulation than other interregional connections. Furthermore, local directed connectivity changes preceded interregional alterations; spectral, complexity, and connectivity shifts preceded local PAC. Propofol-induced LOC involves a reorganization of neural dynamics both within local regions and across directed interregional pathways. Rather than reflecting a single focal event or uniform global suppression, this transition unfolds as an ordered spatiotemporal cascade, characterized by temporally dissociable changes across neural markers and hierarchical network levels.

papers.title: A transdiagnostic framework for neurological intervention in maladaptive repetitive behaviors.
papers.authors: Jeon SJ, Mabunga DF, Shin CY.
papers.abstract: From daily rituals to pathological patterns of behavior and thought, a wide spectrum of habitual behaviors emerges through repeated reinforcement learning and becomes embedded in cortico-basal ganglia circuits. Once established, these behaviors operate automatically and resist conscious control. This review summarizes neurological intervention strategies for correcting pathological habits (e.g., addiction, obsessive-compulsive disorder) and restoring adaptive behavioral patterns. Pharmacological approaches target the plasticity of habit circuits via modulation of dopamine, serotonin, and glutamate systems. Non-invasive brain stimulation techniques-such as repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS), transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), and deep TMS-can modulate cortical control networks and indirectly influence connected subcortical circuitry. Behavioral interventions include extinction learning, reinforcement of alternative actions, contextual modification, cognitive strategies, and memory reconsolidation-based techniques. Recently, hybrid approaches combining AI-based digital therapeutics (DTx) with neuromodulatory devices have gained attention. Invasive techniques such as optogenetics and deep brain stimulation (DBS) enable direct modulation of specific neural circuits, allowing suppression of habitual responses or facilitation of alternative learning. Beyond clinical applications, these approaches elucidate the neural mechanisms underlying habitual behavior. Modulation of habits is most effective when employing multi-level, combinatorial interventions rather than a single technique. Integrating these strategies, this paper proposes a staged framework-habit circuit suppression → alternative learning → consolidation → sustained management-and a neuroscience-based, personalized model for behavioral treatment with implications for future clinical and research applications.

papers.title: Internal Bayesian precision modulates the neural representation of social attention: Disentangling implicit and explicit components via model-informed multivariate EEG analysis.
papers.authors: Chen Z, Zhao L, Wang C, Song Y.
papers.abstract: Social attention integrates sensory cues with high-level cognitive expectations, yet the generative mechanisms through which implicit orienting and explicit belief-driven modulation interact remain poorly understood. This ambiguity complicates the distinction between specialized social modules and domain-general attentional processes. We combined a dynamic cueing task with hierarchical Bayesian modeling and model-informed multivariate EEG decoding to address this. Behavioral results revealed a computational double dissociation: symbolic arrow cues elicited heterogeneous strategies, whereas averted gaze recruited a consistent, surprise-driven computational phenotype. At the neural level, time-resolved decoding and temporal generalization revealed a critical representational shift starting approximately 400 ms post-cue. Initial activity related to physical cue features was rapidly replaced by stable neural templates of predicted spatial intent. Crucially, topographical activation patterns showed that this intentional template, characterized by a lateralized temporo-occipital distribution, emerged exclusively under high internal certainty. Furthermore, partial representational similarity analysis demonstrated that late-stage neural manifolds were overwhelmingly organized around integrated spatial goals rather than isolated sensory or motivational signals. These findings suggest that social attention is a specialized generative process, where internal certainty modulates the transformation of social perceptions into actionable top-down intentions.

papers.title: Shared functional abnormalities within somatosensory cortex in obsessive-compulsive disorder and anxiety disorders: A comparative meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Wei X, He J, Li X, Gou D, Dong Q, Wang X, Yang H.
papers.journal: Biological psychiatry. Cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging
papers.abstract: Backgrounds Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) has been consistently associated with alterations in cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical (CSTC) circuits, as demonstrated by numerous resting-state fMRI studies. However, given the high prevalence of comorbid anxiety disorders and anxiety-related traits in OCD patients, previous research has not clearly established whether these neural alterations are specific to OCD or represent shared pathophysiology with anxiety disorders (ANX). Methods We conducted a coordinate-based meta-analysis using Signed Differential Mapping (SDM) of whole-brain resting-state fMRI studies in OCD (n = 1429 patients, n = 1509 healthy controls). To assess whether identified alterations were OCD-specific or shared with anxiety pathophysiology, we performed comparative meta-analyses including 15 ANX studies (n = 558 patients, n = 561 healthy controls) using conjunction and contrast analyses, and examined resting-state local brain activity as indexed by ALFF, fALFF, and ReHo. Results Compared to ANX, OCD patients showed increased spontaneous activity in the left anterior cingulate cortex extending to the medial prefrontal cortex (ACC/MPFC), right globus pallidus, and left putamen, alongside decreased spontaneous activity in the left middle frontal gyrus. Both disorders shared decreased spontaneous activity in the left postcentral gyrus. However, this meta-analysis did not identify significant differences in amygdala activity in within-group or between-group comparisons, nor in conjunction analyses. Conclusions Overall, this meta-analysis reveals shared reductions in spontaneous activity in the left postcentral gyrus across OCD and ANX, suggesting a potential role for the somatosensory cortex in transdiagnostic emotional processing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注强迫症与焦虑障碍的静息态脑活动异常究竟为强迫症特有还是两者共享，采用基于坐标的元分析比较两类患者的局部自发活动指标。结果显示，强迫症患者在左侧前扣带回至内侧前额叶、右侧苍白球和左侧壳核活动增高，左侧额中回活动降低；而左侧中央后回自发活动降低为两种障碍所共享，提示躯体感觉皮层可能参与跨诊断的情绪加工。作者同时指出，杏仁核活动在组内、组间及联合分析中均未见显著差异，因此上述共享发现主要限于中央后回，其临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Inter- and intra-hemispheric connectivity and language in children with autism spectrum disorder.
papers.authors: Knaus TA, Beaton EA, Gumpert J.
papers.abstract: Prior studies have demonstrated a role for the corpus callosum, the largest fiber bundle connecting the two hemispheres, in left lateralization of language and language abilities. Aberrant corpus callosum size and intra-hemispheric language connectivity via the arcuate fasciculus (AF), and reduced language lateralization have been found in autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The relationship, however, between inter- and intra-hemispheric connectivity of language regions has not been fully explored, particularly in ASD. Structural pathways were examined in 53 children with ASD and 49 typically developing children, 3-17 years. We examined inter- and intra-hemispheric pathways in relation to the neurocorrelates of language (i.e. connecting left and right inferior frontal gyrus and left and right posterior superior temporal gyrus and the AF) and language abilities. Inter-hemispheric pathway integrity was related to left and right AF in controls but showed a weaker relation with the right AF in ASD. However, there were no group differences in individual pathway integrity. In both groups, language was associated with left AF integrity. Further, differences in AF pathway integrity differed in the severely language impaired ASD subgroup. Our findings suggest possible decreased cohesiveness in the language network in ASD, with more studies needed examining the relation between various pathways, rather than just differences in individual pathways. Deficits in the integrity of the AF may be involved in prevention of typical development of language in ASD and should be further explored in individuals with ASD with severely impaired language.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自闭症谱系障碍儿童中语言相关脑区半球间与半球内连接的关系，比较了自闭症儿童与典型发育儿童的结构通路，并考察这些通路与语言能力及弓状束完整性的关联。结果显示，两组在单条通路的完整性上没有明显差异，但半球间通路与弓状束的联系在典型发育儿童中更紧密，而在自闭症儿童中与右侧弓状束的关联较弱；两组中语言能力均与左侧弓状束完整性相关。作者据此提出，自闭症中语言网络可能存在整体协调性下降，而非单条通路本身的差异，并提示弓状束完整性不足可能与语言发育受阻有关，尤其在语言严重受损的亚组中值得进一步研究。

papers.title: Differentiating Delirium Versus Dementia in Older Adults
papers.authors: Adsule P, Mohanaselvan A, Schoo C.
papers.abstract: As the population ages, clinicians increasingly encounter older adults with cognitive impairment. Older patients frequently present with confusion or “altered mental status,” particularly in emergency settings. New-onset primary psychotic disorders, including schizophrenia, remain uncommon in this population; an underlying medical etiology should therefore be presumed until excluded. Clinical manifestations often appear subtle or atypical, requiring a comprehensive and systematic evaluation. Dementia has more recently been termed “major neurocognitive disorder” in the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fourth Edition (DSM-5); however, the term dementia remains widely used in clinical practice and will be used here. Both delirium and dementia represent the 2 most common causes of cognitive impairment in older adults. Although diagnostically distinct, these conditions are interrelated and can be difficult to differentiate. Coexistence further complicates diagnosis, particularly in cases of delirium superimposed on dementia (DSD). Diagnostic inaccuracy may result in missed DSD or misclassification of delirium as dementia, a critical concern given the association of delirium with poorer clinical and functional outcomes, prolonged hospitalization, and increased mortality. Clinical teams miss up to 72% of delirium cases during hospital stays. This places increased importance on primary care follow-up evaluations after hospital discharge and on the primary care provider's heightened awareness to evaluate for delirium during post-hospitalization visits. Early and accurate differentiation remains essential, as management strategies and prognostic implications differ significantly among delirium, dementia, and DSD. Delirium is an acute confusional state characterized by disturbances in attention and cognition, and a fluctuating level of consciousness, that develops over days to weeks. Clinical subtypes include hyperactive, hypoactive, and mixed forms. Dementia, in contrast, involves an insidious, chronic, and progressive decline in acquired cognitive abilities. This decline results in global functional impairment, driven by memory deficits and dysfunction in other cognitive domains. Clinical presentation varies by subtype. Both conditions may broadly present with confusion; however, delirium may reverse, particularly with prompt treatment, underscoring the importance of early recognition. Meynert highlighted this distinction in 1890 by introducing the term “amentia” to describe delirium as a transient impairment.[9] Dementia serves as a major risk factor for delirium, while delirium independently increases the risk of subsequent dementia development. An acute, fluctuating confusional state developing over days to weeks generally suggests delirium, whereas a persistent and progressive decline in cognition or behavior more strongly indicates dementia. These distinctions may become less apparent in patients with underlying dementia who develop superimposed delirium. Diagnostic clarity may also diminish in cases of persistent delirium or reversible causes of cognitive impairment. Cognitive evaluation spans 6 domains: memory and learning, language, executive function, complex attention, perceptual-motor function, and social cognition. Although such assessments often improve diagnostic accuracy, clinical diagnosis does not always require comprehensive testing in either domain. Dementia constitutes a neurodegenerative disorder most commonly affecting older adults, with age of onset and clinical features varying by subtype. Delirium arises from acquired causes and may occur at any age, although prevalence increases in older populations due to multiple contributing risk factors.

papers.title: Delta rhythm and voice familiarity organize neural entrainment in the infant brain
papers.authors: Rambosson I, Benis D, Barcos-Munoz F, Kabdebon C, Ceravolo L, Grandjean D, Filippa M.
papers.abstract: The delta frequency band (∼0.5−3.5 Hz) represents a phylogenetically conserved tempo of biological communication, and neural entrainment to this timescale would be a key mechanism through which the brain might generate temporal predictions. While entrainment at different levels has been characterized in adults, the mechanisms of auditory temporal prediction remain poorly studied across developmental trajectories, particularly regarding the roles of stimulus rhythmicity, frequency specificity, and voice familiarity. Using high-density EEG, we examined neural entrainment in thirty 6-month-old infants exposed to vocally rhythmic syllables produced by their mother or a stranger at delta (2 Hz) or theta (4 Hz) rates, as well as a non-rhythmic control. Auditory temporal regularity elicited a broad frontotemporal entrainment response. Critically, delta-band entrainment was frequency-specific across frontal and temporal clusters, with right-frontal selectivity progressively strengthening throughout the entrainment period as expected if this region actively refines a temporal model of the input rather than passively resonating to it; no significant theta-band specificity was observed. Entrainment was further shaped by voice familiarity: the left temporal cortex entrained selectively to the mother’s voice, whereas the right frontal cluster responded selectively to the stranger’s voice. This is consistent with an implementation in which familiarity-based processing within mid-temporal language-related regions interfaces with novelty-sensitive frontal mechanisms, and reflects the ongoing updating of internal predictive models rather than passive sensory registration. The co-occurrence of frequency-specific delta entrainment and experience-dependent hemispheric asymmetries reveals a neural functional network for hierarchical temporal predictions, shaped by early auditory experience and already in place at 6 months. Significance Statement Across many species, including humans, communication unfolds at a slow rhythm of 0.5–3.5 cycles per second: the delta rhythm around 2.7 Hz. The developing brain already detects rhythmic regularities, but whether and how early experience shapes this remains unknown. Recording brain activity in 6-month-old infants listening to systematic and experimentally manipulated rhythmic syllables from their mother or a stranger, we show that neural tracking is selectively tuned to the delta rhythm, that this tuning sharpens over the session in the right frontal cortex, and that the maternal voice specifically engages the left temporal cortex, relevant for speech. Already at 6 months, the brain continuously updates its internal models based on experience to predict the temporal structure of the world.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用高密度脑电图考察6个月婴儿对母亲或陌生人发出的节律性语音的神经夹带，比较了delta与theta速率及非节律控制条件。结果显示，听觉时间规律性引发广泛的额颞夹带，其中delta频段的夹带具有频率特异性，右额叶的选择性随夹带进程逐渐增强，而theta频段未见显著特异性。语音熟悉度进一步塑造夹带模式：左颞叶选择性追踪母亲声音，右额叶则选择性响应陌生人声音。作者据此认为，频率特异的delta夹带与经验依赖的半球不对称共同构成层级时间预测的神经网络，且这一机制在6个月时已受早期听觉经验塑造。

papers.title: Neural tracking of surprisal and semantic distance in naturalistic movie viewing
papers.authors: O’Leary RM, Smith HC, Myers EB, Reilly J, Peelle JE.
papers.abstract: Understanding speech requires listeners to integrate incoming input with prior linguistic and thematic knowledge to access meaning, a task greatly aided by prediction. Surprisal and related phenomena (e.g., next word prediction) tend to be associated with broad activation of language regions during listening. A major challenge for interpreting the neural correlates of surprisal is that lexical expectancies are constrained both by syntactic and semantic information. In contrast, semantic distance yields more of a pure metric of relatedness between one language constituent (e.g., word, phrase, n-gram) and another within a high-dimensional semantic space. We contrasted surprisal and semantic distance in running discourse during naturalistic audiovisual language comprehension. We analyzed fMRI scans from 20 English-speaking adults who viewed the full-length film 500 Days of Summer . Our focus was on brain sensitivity to either surprisal or semantic distance as language unfolded word-by-word. To this end, we implemented a series of hierarchical voxelwise encoding models. After accounting for low-level auditory and visual features, the addition of either surprisal or semantic distance improved prediction in bilateral superior temporal gyrus (STG), left inferior frontal gyrus, and right cerebellum. Critically, both semantic distance and surprisal explained unique variation in bilateral temporal cortex after accounting for the other. These results support the notion that the brain tracks both broad probabilistic prediction as well as semantic integration. More generally, these findings extend previous work on auditory-only speech by demonstrating that surprisal and semantic distance predict meaningful neural variation even within a rich audiovisual context.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然视听语境下理解连续话语时，大脑如何分别追踪词汇的意外程度（surprisal）与语义距离。20名英语成人观看整部电影，研究者用逐体素编码模型比较两者对血氧信号的预测。在控制低级视听特征后，两者均提升双侧颞上回、左额下回和右侧小脑的预测；更重要的是，各自在控制对方后仍能解释双侧颞叶的独特变异。这表明大脑同时追踪概率性预测和语义整合，并将此前基于纯听觉言语的发现扩展到丰富的视听情境。

papers.title: A large language model for risk-of-bias assessment in systematic reviews of prognosis studies in clinical neurology
papers.authors: Kampman SL, Braun KP, Otte WM.
papers.abstract: Background Risk-of-bias (ROB) assessments represent an integral component of systematic reviews. However, this task is often highly repetitive, time-consuming, and may lack inter-rater consistency. Large language models (LLMs) offer opportunities for automation in systematic reviews, which may expedite and enhance the quality and consistency of research synthesis. Methods Using zero-shot prompting, we designed an LLM-based pipeline as a virtual mimic of a human reviewer for the Quality in Prognosis Studies (QUIPS) framework. Then, focusing on prognostic research in a single discipline (neurology), we applied this pipeline to articles included in previously published systematic reviews. We studied inter-rater agreement between both (1) the LLM and the original human ROB assessments and (2) between original human ROB assessments. Results 298 articles from 15 reviews across three domains (epilepsy, traumatic brain injury, stroke) were included. We demonstrate the feasibility of a tailored, prompt-engineered LLM pipeline for automating ROB assessments with the QUIPS tool. While LLM-human agreement was limited (Cohen’s weighted kappa; = 0.22, 95% CI, 0.12 - 0.33), our data tentatively suggest, based on a small sample (n=5), that it may not be inferior to human-human agreement (Cohen’s weighted kappa; = -0.25, 95% CI, -1.04 - 0.54). Wilcoxon signed-rank tests were statistically significant (p < 0.05) across four bias domains and for the overall risk scores, and rank-biserial correlations demonstrated human raters’ tendency to assign higher risk scores than LLM counterparts. Conclusions With targeted methodological refinements - including standardization of QUIPS implementation and validation against expert ratings - automated ROB assessments may meaningfully reduce time and cost of systematic reviews of prognosis studies in neurology and beyond.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨大语言模型能否自动完成系统综述中的预后研究偏倚风险评估，作者以零样本提示构建模拟人类评审者的流程，并应用于神经病学领域的预后研究文献。结果显示该流程在QUIPS框架下可行，但模型与人工评估的一致性有限，且初步提示其未必逊于人工评审者之间的一致性，后者样本很小。作者还发现人工评审者倾向于给出比模型更高的风险评分。结论认为，经方法学改进和专家评分验证后，自动化评估有望降低此类系统综述的时间与成本，但当前一致性水平尚不支持直接替代人工判断。

papers.title: HIPPOCAMPAL TAU-RELATED SIGNAL INDEXES HYPEREXCITABILITY AND NREM SLEEP–MEMORY DYSFUNCTION IN TEMPORAL LOBE EPILEPSY
papers.authors: Arafat T, Schiller K, Lam J, Von Ellenrieder N, Cai Z, DeKraker J, Fadaie F, Sziklas V, Crane J, Cruces RR, Hopewell R, Hsiao CH, Massarweh G, Soucy J, Erlandsson K, Hosseini SA, Chan T, Kobayashi E, Rosa-Neto P, Bernasconi A, Bernasconi N, Koepp M, Gotman J, Bernhardt BC.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Sleep and memory disturbances are common in temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE), yet their relationship with tau-targeted neuroimaging measures remains unclear. We investigated whether in-viv o temporal 18 F-MK6240 tracer retention relates to seizure burden, non–rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep microstructure, and memory performance in TLE. Methods This cross-sectional study was conducted from 2019 to 2024 at the Montreal Neurological Institute-Hospital. Eligible patients had unilateral TLE diagnosed according to International League Against Epilepsy criteria and underwent overnight electroencephalography (EEG) recordings, research-protocol 3T magnetic resonance imaging, and 18 F-MK6240 positron emission tomography. Regional 18 F-MK6240 standardized uptake value ratios (SUVRs), using the cerebellum as the reference region, were quantified in the ipsilateral hippocampus (defined a priori as the primary region of interest), as well as in peri-hippocampal and lateral temporal regions. Electroclinical and neuropsychological measures, including seizure burden (high vs low), N2 interictal epileptiform discharge frequency (frequent vs non-frequent), and memory performance (impaired vs intact), were classified according to predefined clinical criteria. N2 spindle rate and N3 slow-wave rate were quantified from overnight EEG recordings. Findings Of 70 eligible patients, 25 were included (eight [32%] females; mean age 35·2 years [SD 12·1]). Higher ipsilateral hippocampal 18 F-MK6240 uptake was observed in participants with greater focal seizure burden (median [IQR] 0·70 [0·67–0·78] vs 0·64 [0·58–0·65], rank-biserial correlation=−0·58, 95% CI −0·82 to −0·19; p=0·02), was associated with lower N2 spindle rate (r=−0·42, 95% CI −0·70 to −0·03; p=0·04) and higher N3 slow-wave rate (r=0·47; 95% CI 0·09 to 0·73; p=0·02), and was also higher in participants with impaired than intact memory performance (n=21; mean [SD] 0·80 [0·12] vs 0·68 [0·10], Cohen’s d=1·15, 95% CI 0·07 to 2·21; p=0·04). Associations outside the hippocampus were generally less consistent and less precise, with the largest non-hippocampal estimate observed in peri-hippocampal regions. Interpretation Higher hippocampal 18 F-MK6240 uptake was associated with greater focal seizure burden, altered NREM sleep microstructure, and impaired memory performance in TLE. These findings suggest that hippocampal 18 F-MK6240 uptake may represent a candidate marker of circuit vulnerability associated with NREM sleep-memory dysfunction in TLE, warranting validation in larger longitudinal studies. Funding Canadian Institutes of Health Research, Fonds de la Recherche du Québec – Santé, Wellcome Trust, Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada, Brain Canada, SickKids Foundation.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究在单侧颞叶癫痫患者中考察海马tau示踪剂18F-MK6240摄取与癫痫发作负担、非快速眼动睡眠微结构及记忆表现的关系，结合过夜脑电、磁共振成像和正电子发射断层扫描进行关联分析。结果显示，同侧海马摄取较高者局灶性发作负担更重，N2睡眠纺锤波率较低、N3慢波率较高，且记忆受损者摄取高于记忆完好者；海马以外区域的关联较不一致。作者据此提出，海马18F-MK6240摄取可能是与颞叶癫痫中非快速眼动睡眠—记忆功能障碍相关的环路易损性候选标志物，但尚需更大规模纵向研究验证，相关结果不能直接推为因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Clustering without clusters: the meta-criterion and centroid reliability mistake continuous dynamics for discrete states
papers.authors: von Wegner F, Hermann G.
papers.abstract: Microstate analysis starts with clustering and the meta-criterion is a heuristic to find an optimum cluster number. We address the following questions: (i) what number is found for non-cluster-forming dynamical systems, (ii) do centroids fall in random attractor regions, (iii) do EEG topographies form clusters or a single connected structure in sensor space? We find that (i) the meta-criterion suggests spurious optimal cluster numbers (4-8) with high confidence on different attractor geometries, (ii) cluster centroids reliably fall in the same attractor regions, (iii) topological analysis of dynamical systems and resting-state EEG suggests that all form a single connected structure in their respective phase space, not clusters. We conclude that the meta-criterion should be used with caution and its results should not be taken as representing a ground truth. Cluster numbers deviating from the meta-criterion should not be discarded. A more far-reaching implication is that evidence for the existence of clusters in resting-state EEG data is still lacking. Microstate clustering may correspond to the partitioning of a single connected structure.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电微状态分析中常用的聚类数启发式准则（meta-criterion）提出质疑，通过非聚类动力系统模拟与静息态脑电的拓扑分析进行检验。结果显示，该准则会在不同吸引子几何结构上以高置信度给出虚假的最优聚类数，聚类质心也稳定落在相同的吸引子区域，而动力系统和静息态脑电在各自相空间中均表现为单一连通结构而非离散簇。作者据此提醒该准则应谨慎使用、其结果不应被视为真实基准，偏离该准则的聚类数也不应被轻易舍弃，并指出目前仍缺乏静息态脑电存在聚类的证据，微状态聚类可能只是对单一连通结构的分割。

papers.title: Brain Regional Predictors of Surgical Response Are Dynamically Associated with Post-Surgical Pain Relief in Trigeminal Neuralgia.
papers.authors: Adhamidhis E, Srisaikaew P, Li J, Latypov TH, Noorani A, Hodaie M.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Trigeminal neuralgia (TN) is a severe chronic neuropathic facial pain condition. Although TN can be amenable to surgical treatments, ~25% of patients may have recurrence of pain. Understanding the role of the central nervous system (CNS) gray matter and its impact on surgical treatment effect remains unclear but is of increasing interest. Previous machine learning models identified 13 neuroanatomical regional predictors of TN surgical response. The implications of these regions and how they might relate to clinical status and surgical outcome are not clear. Here, we attempt to further understand CNS alterations in TN by investigating how these potential regional predictors of surgical response may change following surgical treatment, and whether this is related to the degree of pain relief achieved.
