Methods: Retrospective imaging was acquired from 115 surgically naïve TN patients who underwent Gamma Knife Radiosurgery at Toronto Western Hospital. Patients obtained magnetic resonance imaging scans and reported pain intensity scores before and 3-12 months after surgery. Patients were categorized as responders (≥75% pain relief), partial responders (50-74% pain relief), and non-responders (<50% pain relief). Results : Eight regions spanning default mode, visual, limbic, and dorsal attention networks had significant changes in cortical thickness. Responders demonstrated post-operative neuroplasticity in a greater number of regions with higher within-group statistical significance than both partial and non-responders. Thickening of the contralateral fusiform gyrus was correlated with the degree of pain reduction. Conclusions: Our findings identify key regions impacted by chronic neuropathic pain, which may be associated with pain relief in TN.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注三叉神经痛患者手术后中枢灰质变化与疼痛缓解之间的关系，回顾性分析了接受伽玛刀放射外科治疗患者的术前及术后磁共振影像与疼痛评分。结果显示，涉及默认模式、视觉、边缘和背侧注意网络的多个区域皮层厚度在术后发生显著变化，且疼痛缓解较好的患者出现变化的区域更多、组内统计显著性更高；对侧梭状回增厚与疼痛减轻程度相关。作者据此认为，这些受慢性神经病理性疼痛影响的区域可能与术后疼痛缓解有关，但相关发现尚不能说明因果关系或治疗机制。

papers.title: Electrophysiological Correlates of Maladaptive Daydreaming: An Exploratory Resting-State EEG Study
papers.authors: Atashrooz M, Kianimoghadam AS, Khosrowabadi R, Doosalivand H.
papers.abstract: Objective: Maladaptive daydreaming (MD) is characterized by extensive and immersive fantasy activity associated with distress or functional impairment, yet its neurophysiological correlates remain poorly understood. This study examined resting-state electrophysiological differences associated with probable MD. Methods: Resting-state EEG was recorded from 42 participants (20 probable MDer, 22 screen-negative) during eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions. Absolute and relative spectral power and sensor-level functional connectivity were examined using linear mixed-effects models with false discovery rate correction. Sensitivity analyses assessed robustness to demographic, imagery-related, and affective covariates. Results: Participants meeting the MDS-16 cutoff for probable MD (≥50) showed greater posterior alpha power than screen-negative participants (pFDR = .015), with estimated between-group differences of 0.83 dB during eyes-open (95% CI [0.06, 1.60]) and 1.38 dB during eyes-closed rest (95% CI [0.60, 2.15]). Significant group × condition interactions emerged for frontal theta and theta/beta activity (both pFDR = .007), reflecting stronger eyes-closed-related modulation in probable MD. Relative-power analyses similarly showed greater proportional alpha activity (both posterior and frontal pFDR = .005), with corresponding reductions in several non-alpha bands. These spectral findings remained robust to demographic, imagery-related, and affective covariates. Exploratory analyses also suggested greater sensor-level wPLI connectivity in probable MD. Conclusion: Probable MD was associated with greater posterior alpha power, condition-dependent frontal theta modulation, and preliminarily elevated functional connectivity. This pattern is consistent with a bias toward internally directed attention rather than heightened imagery vividness, but because ongoing thought content was not sampled during recording, and group classification relied on self-report rather than clinical diagnosis, these findings should be treated as an initial electrophysiological characterization rather than an MD-specific signature. Keywords: maladaptive daydreaming; resting-state EEG; quantitative EEG; posterior alpha; frontal theta; internally generated cognition; functional connectivity
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究考察了可能适应不良白日梦者在静息态脑电上的电生理特征，比较了符合筛查切分标准者与筛查阴性者在睁眼和闭眼条件下的频谱功率及感觉层面功能连接。结果发现，可能适应不良白日梦组的后部alpha功率更高，额区theta及其与beta的比值表现出随条件变化的组间差异，提示闭眼时调制更强；相对功率分析也显示alpha比例升高，探索性分析还初步提示功能连接增强。作者认为，这一模式更符合内部导向注意的偏向，而非想象生动性增强；但由于记录时未采样 ongoing 思维内容，分组依赖自评而非临床诊断，这些结果只能视为初步的电生理刻画，尚不能作为该障碍的特异性标志。

papers.title: Lifespan accumulated differences in semantic memory structure contribute to increases in episodic false memories
papers.authors: Henderson S, McCurdy R, Bhatia A, Devulapalli H, Polyn SM, Duarte A.
papers.abstract: Semantic memory grows across the lifespan with experience, scaffolding episodic memory processes while potentially contributing to memory errors when memory representations overlap. Prior work has attributed age-related increases in false recognition memory to executive dysfunction, but little is known about how lifelong semantic knowledge accumulation affects these episodic errors. In the current study, we recorded EEG while younger (n = 36) and older adults (n = 41) completed an episodic memory task in which study list-lure similarity was systematically varied using distributional model-derived measures of semantic similarity. We found older adults’ endorsement of lures was less dependent on semantic similarity than those of younger adults. Older adults also demonstrated reduced coupling of neural similarity to model-derived semantic similarity, and reduced encoding-retrieval reinstatement for accurate lure rejections. Together, these findings suggest that age-related increases in false memory reflect both altered semantic representational structure and reduced source monitoring, highlighting how semantic knowledge accumulated across the lifespan may simultaneously support episodic memory while increasing susceptibility to semantically driven distortions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察毕生积累的语义知识如何影响情景记忆中的虚假再认，并比较了年轻人和老年人的表现。研究者用分布模型量化语义相似度，在情景记忆任务中系统变化学习项目与诱饵的相似程度，同时记录脑电活动。结果显示，老年人对诱饵的认可较少依赖语义相似度，其神经相似性与模型语义相似度的耦合减弱，对诱饵的正确拒绝也表现出较低的编码—提取重现。作者据此认为，年龄相关的虚假记忆增加既涉及语义表征结构的改变，也涉及来源监控的下降，提示毕生积累的语义知识在支持情景记忆的同时，也可能增加语义驱动的记忆扭曲风险。

papers.title: Frontal midline theta tracks negatively biased affective updating in social anxiety from adolescence to young adulthood
papers.authors: Kortink E, Gürcan Ö, Topel S, Koban L, van der Molen MJW.
papers.abstract: Negative self-beliefs are a core feature of social anxiety, yet the neurocomputational processes that translate social-evaluative feedback into biased self-beliefs remain poorly understood. Here we examined whether frontal-midline theta (FM-theta) - an EEG signature of performance monitoring – governs how performance-based prediction errors (PEs) are incorporated into updating self-feelings based on performance feedback (i.e., affective updating). A sample of 216 adolescents and young adults (174 female; mean age 18.4 years) participated in a speech performance task during which participants provided a short speech that was evaluated by three judges. After the speech, participants were asked to appraise their own performance on the same evaluative items used by the judges. After their appraisal on each item, participants were provided with the judge’s evaluation and were subsequently asked to indicate how they felt based on the feedback received. We found that participants updated their self-feelings more strongly based on positive than negative feedback, and that this positive affective updating bias weakened with age. As hypothesized, participants with elevated social anxiety displayed more negative affective updating, and social anxiety fully mediated the age-related decline in positive affective updating. Critically, in individuals with elevated social anxiety, the magnitude of negative performance feedback was associated with stronger FM-theta modulated negative affective updating. These findings corroborate previous positive affective updating biases in healthy individuals and furthermore underscore a key role of FM-theta oscillations in feedback-guided affective updating, potentially reinforcing negative self-belief in individuals with elevated social anxiety.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注社交焦虑中负面自我信念的形成机制，考察额中线θ波（FM-theta）是否参与将他人评价反馈转化为自我感受更新的过程。研究让青少年和年轻成人完成演讲任务并接受评委评价，同时记录脑电活动。结果发现，人们总体上更倾向于依据正反馈而非负反馈更新自我感受，且这种正向更新偏向随年龄增长而减弱；社交焦虑较高者表现出更明显的负向情感更新，社交焦虑在其中完全中介了年龄相关的正向更新下降。更关键的是，在社交焦虑较高的个体中，负性表现反馈的强度与更强的FM-theta调制下的负向情感更新相关，提示FM-theta可能参与反馈引导的情感更新，并可能强化负面自我信念。

papers.title: Intravitreal Onchocerca sp. With Concomitant Cerebral MRI Lesion: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Supanji S, Felisha HF, Romdhoniyyah DF, Nursawitri S, Syahriza S, Farzana IAK, Basalamah YH, Rizqia Indrayanti S, Milastuti N, Amalia K, Setyawan NH, Diptyanusa A, Hadianto T, Satiti S, Prayogo ME, Wardhana FS, Sasongko MB, Astuti RRUNW, Ridwan Y.
papers.journal: The American journal of case reports
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Onchocerca lupi is a zoonotic filarial nematode that primarily infects canids. Human infection is rare and typically involves the eye or subcutaneous tissue. O. lupi infection should be considered in cases of unresolved uveitis or neurological symptoms. We report a diagnostically challenging case of human ocular O. lupi infection with possible neurological involvement. CASE REPORT A 24-year-old man from Jakarta, Indonesia, presented with a 1-month history of blurred vision, floaters, left ocular discomfort, and intermittent headaches. He did not respond to initial treatment for uveitis. Further examination revealed a mobile, thread-like, whitish worm in the left vitreous. Pars plana vitrectomy enabled removal of an intravitreal worm morphologically most consistent with adult male O. lupi, although definitive species-level confirmation was not possible in the absence of molecular testing. The patient's ocular inflammation resolved postoperatively, but his visual acuity remained poor. Due to persistent headaches, brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was performed; a T1-hypointense and T2-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR)-hyperintense white matter lesion was evident in the left parietal lobe. The lesion persisted on 9-month follow-up MRI, and its etiology was uncertain; a causal relationship with the parasitic infection could not be established. CONCLUSIONS We describe the first reported case of intravitreal O. lupi infection with a concurrent cerebral MRI lesion. This infection should be considered in the differential diagnosis of unresolved uveitis in endemic areas to facilitate timely diagnosis and help prevent irreversible visual damage.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例来自印尼雅加达的24岁男性病例，因持续一个月的视物模糊、飞蚊症、左眼不适和间歇性头痛就诊，对初始葡萄膜炎治疗无反应。经玻璃体切除术从玻璃体中取出虫体，形态学上最符合成年雄性O. lupi，但因未做分子检测无法确定虫种。术后眼部炎症消退，但视力仍差；因持续头痛行脑MRI，发现左顶叶白质病灶，9个月随访仍存在，病因不明，与寄生虫感染的因果关系无法确立。作者指出这是首例玻璃体内O. lupi感染合并脑部MRI病灶的报告，并提示在流行区对难治性葡萄膜炎应考虑该感染以争取及时诊断。

papers.title: The interacting language network: A framework for neuromodulation and clinical translation.
papers.authors: Preisig BC, Proix T, Borghesani V, Brem S, Marchesotti S, Guggisberg AG.
papers.abstract: Language disorders following stroke, neurodegeneration, or altered neurodevelopment markedly impair communication and quality of life. Despite advances in behavioural and neuromodulation therapies, treatment outcomes remain modest. Attempts to modulate local excitability in single brain regions have yielded limited benefits. We argue for a shift in neuromodulation for language, from interventions that target isolated regions to approaches that modulate distributed neural networks. To support this shift, we introduce the Interacting Language Network (ILN), a theoretical framework that integrates evidence for local functional specialisation with evidence for distributed processing. The ILN extends existing models by formalising how dynamic interaction between sensorimotor and heteromodal language circuits enables flexible communication. The ILN is grounded in evolutionary, neurobiological and clinical work showing that complex language abilities depend on the disproportionate expansion of association cortices and white matter pathways in humans, which enable long-range communication between specialised regions. Converging findings from neurotypical and clinical populations demonstrate that although specific regions make distinct contributions to language, their function depends critically on dynamic interactions, particularly between frontal and temporo-parietal areas. The ILN delineates current knowledge about the architecture and interaction principles of the language network, identifies important gaps that impede progress, and outlines concrete avenues to advance network-based neuromodulation for language disorders. Ultimately, targeting interacting language networks rather than isolated regions holds the potential to deliver more effective and personalised treatments for individuals with language impairment.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论框架文章，针对语言障碍的神经调控治疗现状，提出应从调控孤立脑区转向调控分布式神经网络。作者提出“交互语言网络”（ILN）框架，整合局部功能专门化与分布式加工的证据，强调感觉运动与异模态语言环路之间的动态交互是灵活语言交流的基础，并指出额叶与颞顶区之间的相互作用尤为关键。文章梳理了语言网络架构与交互原则的现有知识，指出阻碍进展的研究空白，并提出推进网络化神经调控的具体方向。作者认为，靶向交互语言网络而非孤立脑区，有望为语言障碍者带来更有效、更个性化的治疗，但这属于框架性主张，尚需实证检验。

papers.title: Auditory Brainstem Response: Clinical Applications and Interpretation
papers.authors: Singh R, Sutton AE, Vates E.
papers.abstract: Auditory brainstem response (ABR), also known as brainstem auditory evoked response (BAER), provides an objective electrophysiologic assessment of auditory function from the cochlea through the auditory nerve and brainstem pathways. The test records electrical activity generated in response to acoustic stimulation through surface electrodes positioned on the scalp. Because ABR does not require a voluntary behavioral response, the test offers particular value in the evaluation of infants, young children, and patients who cannot reliably participate in conventional behavioral audiometry. During testing, acoustic stimuli, typically clicks or frequency-specific tone bursts, are delivered through earphones while scalp electrodes record the resulting neural responses. These responses appear as a series of reproducible waveforms occurring within the first several milliseconds after stimulation. Analysis of waveform morphology, absolute latencies, interpeak latencies, interaural differences, and changes in response to stimulus intensity can provide information about auditory sensitivity and neural conduction through the auditory nerve and brainstem pathways. ABR was first characterized clinically by Jewett and Williston in 1971 and subsequently became an important component of pediatric hearing assessment. Today, ABR is widely used to estimate hearing sensitivity in newborns, infants, and other patients who cannot provide reliable behavioral responses. Frequency-specific testing can help estimate auditory thresholds and contribute to the characterization of hearing loss. However, electrophysiologic threshold estimates should be correlated with behavioral audiometry when developmentally and clinically feasible. ABR also plays an important role in the evaluation of auditory neuropathy spectrum disorder (ANSD). In ANSD, cochlear outer hair cell function may be preserved while neural transmission through the auditory nerve and brainstem pathways is dyssynchronous or otherwise impaired. Patients may therefore demonstrate present otoacoustic emissions or a detectable cochlear microphonic despite an absent or markedly abnormal ABR. Speech perception, particularly in background noise, may be disproportionately impaired relative to pure-tone hearing thresholds. Integrating ABR with otoacoustic emissions, cochlear microphonic assessment, behavioral audiometry, and speech testing is therefore important when ANSD is suspected. In adults and older children, ABR may provide additional information when auditory nerve or brainstem dysfunction is suspected. ABRs have also been hypothesized in numerous studies as a possible diagnostic tool for autism. Abnormal absolute or interpeak latencies, interaural differences, or waveform abnormalities may suggest impaired neural conduction. However, ABR does not independently establish the cause of an abnormality, and contemporary evaluation of suspected retrocochlear disease may require complementary audiologic testing and magnetic resonance imaging when clinically indicated. ABR has an additional role in intraoperative neurophysiologic monitoring. During procedures that place the auditory nerve or brainstem pathways at risk, particularly selected posterior fossa and cerebellopontine angle procedures, serial ABR recordings can provide real-time information about changes in auditory pathway function. Significant waveform changes can alert the surgical and neurophysiologic monitoring teams to possible neural compromise and may allow modification of operative factors when appropriate. ABR should be considered part of a broader audiologic and neurologic assessment rather than an isolated diagnostic test. Depending on the clinical indication, findings may be integrated with pure-tone and speech audiometry, tympanometry, acoustic reflex testing, otoacoustic emissions, electrocochleography, and imaging. Each modality assesses different aspects of auditory function, and the relationship among test results may provide more diagnostic information than any single study alone. Although ABR provides valuable objective information, several technical and physiologic factors can affect the recording. Conductive and cochlear hearing loss, patient age and state of arousal, stimulus type and intensity, stimulus rate, electrode placement and impedance, electrical and myogenic artifact, and other testing conditions can influence waveform morphology, amplitude, and latency. Appropriate technique and interpretation are therefore essential to avoid attributing abnormalities that are technically or peripherally induced to brainstem dysfunction. The relevant anatomy and physiology of the auditory pathway; the principles and techniques of ABR testing; waveform generation and interpretation; and clinical applications in pediatric and adult hearing assessment will be discussed, as well as examining the role of ABR in auditory neuropathy spectrum disorder and intraoperative monitoring; factors affecting test reliability; important diagnostic limitations and pitfalls; and the integration of ABR findings with complementary audiologic, electrophysiologic, and imaging studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕听性脑干反应（ABR）的临床原理与应用展开，梳理其作为客观电生理检查在婴幼儿及无法配合行为测听者中的听力评估价值，并说明通过波形形态、潜伏期及耳间差异等指标可推断听觉敏感性与神经传导情况。文章重点讨论ABR在听神经病谱系障碍识别和术中神经监测中的作用，同时强调其结果需与耳声发射、行为测听、言语测试及影像学等互补检查整合，且受传导性或耳蜗性听力损失、受试者状态、刺激参数与伪迹等多种因素影响，不能单独用于确定病因。

papers.title: Neuropsychological Assessment
papers.authors: Schaefer LA, Sharma NP.
papers.abstract: Although clinicians commonly use screening instruments to identify cognitive and psychological concerns in patients with various neurological etiologies, situations frequently arise in which referral to a neuropsychologist is needed for a more comprehensive assessment. Screening instruments, such as the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE), are sensitive to moderate to severe cognitive impairment but relatively insensitive to milder forms of impairment; they are also susceptible to the effects of lower educational attainment. Educational and literacy-related bias is not unique to the MMSE because low educational attainment and literacy may also affect performance on the Montreal Cognitive Assessment, Addenbrooke's Cognitive Examination, Clock Drawing Test, and Mini-Cog. Healthcare professionals administering and interpreting cognitive screening measures should understand and use standardized test administration procedures, know how the test was developed, and apply appropriate normative data and procedures when interpreting scores. Clinicians should also recognize that patient variables, including culture, language, and level of education, may render certain tests inappropriate for some patients and should understand the limitations of individual screening instruments. Clinical neuropsychologists are doctoral-level healthcare professionals who have specialized training in brain-behavior relationships and perform comprehensive evaluations in addition to providing selected forms of treatment. Their role can also include cognitive rehabilitation planning, tracking disease progression, providing feedback to families, and addressing functional or capacity questions, such as driving, independent living, and decision-making capacity. Therefore, cognitive screening tests can be useful for identifying patients who may benefit from a neuropsychological consultation for a more formal and comprehensive evaluation.

papers.title: Brain deviation scores derived from normative modelling identify dimensions of psychopathology in children and adolescents
papers.authors: Li Z, Ren B, Wu H, Wang Z, Zhang L.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Psychiatric diagnoses lack neurobiological grounding, and brain-based abnormalities correspond poorly to established diagnostic categories. While multivariate algorithms extract transdiagnostic dimensions from brain–behavior covariation, most studies rely on conventional structural morphometric measures such as cortical thickness and surface area, which fail to capture atypical developmental trajectories. Normative modeling (NM) quantifies individual-level brain deviation scores by contrasting brain structural features with population-derived percentiles, yielding continuous indices of atypical brain development. However, whether these scores can identify transdiagnostic dimensions remains unclear. We applied sparse canonical correlation analysis (sCCA) to investigate covariation between brain-deviation scores and psychiatric symptoms in 1095 children and adolescents from the Healthy Brain Network. We identified an emotion-dysregulation dimension (r = 0.33). When generalized to the independent cohort, this dimension showed nominal significance (r = 0.18, P FDR = 0.05, uncorrected P = 0.01, n = 198). By contrast, no significant dimension was detected using conventional structural brain features. Emotion dysregulation was primarily driven by deviations in cortical thickness and surface area, with distinct regional distributions; reductions in cortical surface area in the middle frontal gyrus, cingulate gyrus, superior temporal gyrus, and insula carried the highest weights. Latent brain scores for emotion dysregulation, computed using sCCA weights for brain deviation scores, showed specific correlations with out-of-model emotion dysregulation-related phenotypes. In addition, females exhibited significantly higher latent brain scores than males. Collectively, NM-based brain deviation scores were more sensitive than conventional structural metrics in identifying transdiagnostic psychiatric dimensions. Furthermore, latent brain scores derived from sCCA-estimated weights may serve as a straightforward metric that captures the degree of dimension-specific atypical brain deviation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注基于规范建模得到的脑偏差分数能否识别儿童青少年精神病理的跨诊断维度，并对1095名儿童青少年的脑结构偏差分数与精神症状做了稀疏典型相关分析。结果提取出一个情绪失调维度，并在独立队列中得到名义上的验证；而用传统脑结构指标未检出显著维度。该维度主要由皮层厚度和表面积偏差驱动，其潜脑分数与模型外的情绪失调相关表型存在特定关联，且女性高于男性。作者据此认为，规范建模的脑偏差分数比传统结构指标更敏感，其权重导出的潜脑分数或可作为刻画维度特异性非典型脑偏差的简便指标，但独立队列的验证仅为名义显著，结论仍需谨慎看待。

papers.title: Visual speech enhances phoneme separability in human superior temporal gyrus
papers.authors: Li Y, DeWitt I, Brennan JR, Wasade VS, Stacey W, Brang D.
papers.abstract: Visual speech, such as lipreading, facilitates spoken word recognition, but the neural mechanisms underlying audiovisual speech perception remain poorly understood. Visual cues may disambiguate fine-grained articulatory features during early perceptual stages or instead integrate with speech at more categorical, phoneme-level stages. To test how speech representations are modulated by visual input, we analyzed intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) signals recorded from 12 epilepsy patients performing an audiovisual speech perception task. Participants perceived 16 monosyllabic words presented in auditory-only, visual-only, or congruent audiovisual formats. Words were constructed from four onset consonants (/b/, /g/, /m/, /n/) and four rimes (vowel nucleus and any coda consonants). We examined event-related potentials (ERP) in superior temporal gyrus (STG) and trained support vector machine (SVM) classifiers to decode word identity from neural activity at individual electrodes. Discrete and continuous confusion matrices captured complementary changes in classification accuracy and normalized inverse classification loss, a continuous proxy for classifier confidence. Decoding performance was hierarchically evaluated at the word, phoneme, and phonetic feature levels to determine the representations affected by visual speech. Congruent audiovisual speech increased classifier confidence for phoneme-level representations and improved decoding accuracy at both the word and phoneme level, without corresponding effects on phonetic features. Time-resolved analyses further revealed earlier successful decoding for audiovisual than auditory-only speech, with audiovisual enhancement primarily observed for onset consonants rather than rimes. Together, these findings suggest that visual speech sharpens primarily categorical phoneme representations in STG, with accelerated speech processing and improved word recognition emerging as downstream consequences of phoneme-level enhancement. Significance Statement Seeing a speaker’s face improves speech perception, especially in noise, but the neural representations altered by visual speech remain unclear. Using intracranial recordings from human superior temporal gyrus, we show that congruent visual speech does not simply amplify all speech-related information. Instead, visual input selectively enhances the separability of confusable phoneme-level representations and improves word identity decoding, while leaving the robust phonetic-feature organization largely intact. These findings clarify the distinction between what visual speech modulates and the representational structure of speech in auditory cortex, suggesting that audiovisual facilitation primarily acts on categorical speech representations that more directly support word recognition.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注视觉言语（如唇读）如何调节听觉言语表征，利用癫痫患者执行视听言语知觉任务时的颅内脑电信号，并在颞上回电极上解码词、音素和语音特征层面的信息。结果显示，一致的视听言语提高了音素层面表征的分类置信度，并改善了词和音素层面的解码准确率，但对语音特征没有相应影响；时间分析还发现视听条件下的成功解码早于纯听觉条件，且增强主要体现在声母而非韵母上。作者据此认为，视觉言语主要锐化颞上回中类别化的音素表征，言语加工加速和词识别改善可能是音素层面增强的下游结果，而非视觉输入笼统放大所有言语信息。

papers.title: Continuous theta-burst stimulation to a lesion network in cervical dystonia: a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled, pilot trial
papers.authors: Morrison-Ham J, Younger EFP, Ellis EG, Parsons N, Hart T, Speranza B, Dipnall L, Do M, Perellón-Alfonso R, Pecoraro PM, di Biase L, Bertram KL, Agius PA, Morgante F, Joutsa J, Hill AT, Enticott PG, Corp DT.
papers.abstract: Background The mechanisms driving cervical dystonia remain unclear, limiting effective, non-invasive treatment development. Lesion network mapping previously localized a brain network derived from lesions causing cervical dystonia, with a network hub in the somatosensory cortex, a viable target for non-invasive brain stimulation. Objectives We conducted a randomized, sham-controlled, crossover trial administering continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) to the S1 lesion network hub, testing whether modulating this network reduces CD symptoms. Methods Thirteen idiopathic cervical dystonia patients (57.85 ± 10.85 years) received two 10-session blocks of bilateral somatosensory cortex cTBS (active or sham; counterbalanced). The primary outcome was change in cervical dystonia symptoms, measured by the Toronto Western Spasmodic Torticollis Scale (TWSTRS). A wearable motion sensor objectively measured change in head and neck movement patterns. Motor evoked potentials and resting-state fMRI assessed cTBS-induced changes in corticospinal excitability and functional connectivity, respectively. Results Active cTBS did not significantly reduce cervical dystonia symptoms compared to sham (condition × timepoint interaction: p = .149). Range of motion significantly increased with active, versus sham, cTBS ( p = .015). Corticospinal excitability decreased following sham ( p = .042), but not active, cTBS. No significant connectivity changes were seen from the somatosensory cortex stimulation site after active cTBS; however, significant changes emerged from the globus pallidus interna. Conclusion This study prospectively tested the effects of neuromodulation on a lesion network mapping-derived target. Active cTBS did not significantly improve TWSTRS scores relative to sham. The intervention was well tolerated by all patients, and future studies could consider higher-dose or alternative protocols to this target.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步试验针对特发性颈部肌张力障碍患者，采用随机、双盲、假刺激对照的交叉设计，对基于病灶网络定位的感觉运动皮层网络枢纽施加连续θ爆发刺激，检验其能否减轻症状。结果显示，与假刺激相比，主动刺激并未显著改善颈部肌张力障碍症状量表评分，但客观运动传感器记录的头颈活动范围在主动刺激后显著增加；皮层脊髓兴奋性仅在假刺激后下降，而刺激部位的功能连接未见显著变化，却在内侧苍白球出现显著改变。作者指出，该干预耐受性良好，但主要症状终点未达显著，提示后续研究可考虑更高剂量或替代方案；这些结果尚不能支持其作为临床治疗手段。

papers.title: Caregiver-Rated Inappropriate Speech and Post-cTBS Motor Cortical Facilitation in Autism: A Pilot Biomarker Study
papers.authors: Smith JR, Bonnee M, Marler S, Atwood R, Lewis B, Lim S, Baldwin I, Wu H, Liu J, Cascio C, Joshi G, Croarkin PE.
papers.abstract: Transcranial magnetic stimulation can provide noninvasive measures of cortical excitability and plasticity, but relationships between these measures and clinically observable features of autism are not fully characterized. Nineteen autistic participants aged 15 to 40 years were included in the analysis of a left primary motor cortex continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) biomarker protocol. Motor evoked potentials were measured at baseline and at seven assessments from 5 to 60 min after stimulation. Linear mixed-effects models evaluated whether clinical measures moderated the post-stimulation motor evoked potential log-response ratio over time. Aberrant Behavior Checklist (ABC) and Attenuated Behavior Questionnaire (ABQ) analyses were restricted to the same 15 participants with caregiver-informant assessments. Catatonia severity, social impairment, ABQ Motor Total, ABQ Total, and cognitive ability did not significantly moderate the post-stimulation response. ABC Inappropriate Speech was associated with progressively greater post-stimulation facilitation (standardized Time × Inappropriate Speech interaction: β = +0.688, SE = 0.210, 95% CI +0.276 to +1.099; Holm-adjusted P = .008 across eight informant-rated models). Two individual speech-related items (“Talks excessively” and “Talks to self loudly”) survived false-discovery-rate correction. An exploratory eight-item ABC phenotype showed a large descriptive in-sample association (β = +0.904, SE = 0.200, P < .001) and directionally positive held-out performance. However, full-pipeline permutation tests were nonsignificant for both Pearson (r = .357, two-sided empirical P = .360) and Spearman correlations (ρ = .446, two-sided empirical P = .261). Caregiver-rated inappropriate speech may be associated with altered post-cTBS motor cortical facilitation in autism. The candidate phenotype remains hypothesis-generating and requires independent validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步生物标志物研究考察自闭症谱系人群中，照护者评定的临床特征是否与左侧初级运动皮层连续θ爆发刺激（cTBS）后的运动皮层兴奋性变化相关。研究对自闭症参与者进行cTBS，并在刺激前后多次测量运动诱发电位，用线性混合效应模型检验临床量表评分是否调节刺激后的反应。结果显示，多数临床指标（包括紧张症严重度、社交损害、运动相关评分和认知能力）未见显著调节作用；而照护者评定的“不当言语”与刺激后运动皮层易化随时间逐渐增强相关，其中两个与言语相关的条目在多重比较校正后仍显著。作者据此提出，照护者评定的不当言语可能与自闭症患者cTBS后运动皮层易化改变有关，但该候选表型仍属假设生成性质，探索性关联分析未通过置换检验，需独立样本验证。

papers.title: Conversation in fMRI: DMN Activates During Live Mentalizing
papers.authors: Torubarova E, Arvidsson C, Pereira A, Uddén J.
papers.abstract: Although language might have evolved in a conversational setting, neural language processing is rarely studied in this setting. It is also important to delineate the roles of networks interacting with the language network, such as the default mode network and networks subserving social cognition or cognitive control. We studied the fundamental question of how conversational production and comprehension processes may differ. By acquiring fMRI data of participants engaging in conversations on ethical dilemmas with a confederate, we aimed to study extra-linguistic areas during live mentalizing, crucially with long (10 min) conversations. A subject-specific network analysis was used to complement group-averaged whole-brain analysis. The results replicate asymmetries between production and comprehension already observed using short conversations. This included left inferior frontal gyrus preferences for production and superior and middle temporal gyri preferences for comprehension. Activation in the posterior dorsal medial prefrontal cortex was specific to production, a result that is stable across conversational durations. Notably, we found preferential activity of the default mode network (DMN) during comprehension, specifically during longer conversations. The frontoparietal network for control (FPN) showed the same pattern, although it was less robust. This might indicate simultaneous self-reflective, Theory of Mind, and/or situational processing during comprehension, potentially due to lower conversational pressures, compared to production. The subnet-work DN-B was more strongly activated than DNA, across both comprehension and production, suggesting that Theory of Mind remains continuously active throughout conversation. Our findings thus advance the understanding of how several networks contribute to production vs comprehension during conversation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注真实对话中语言产生与理解的神经差异，让被试与实验助手围绕伦理困境进行较长对话，同时采集fMRI数据，并结合个体化网络分析与组平均全脑分析。结果复现了短对话中已见的产生与理解不对称：左侧额下回更偏向产生，颞上回和颞中回更偏向理解；后部背侧内侧前额叶的活动为产生所特有，且在不同对话时长下保持稳定。值得注意的是，默认模式网络在理解时活动更强，尤其在较长对话中，额顶控制网络呈现类似但较弱的模式，作者推测这可能反映理解时同时进行自我反思、心理理论或情境加工。默认模式网络子网络DN-B在产生和理解中均强于DN-A，提示心理理论在对话全程持续参与。这些发现推进了对多个网络如何分别支持对话产生与理解的理解。

papers.title: Predictive coding unifies neural and behavioral signatures of contextual facilitation
papers.authors: Nour Eddine S, Yacovone A, Kuperberg GR.
papers.abstract: During comprehension, words that are primed or predictable are processed more quickly and elicit smaller N400 responses than words that are less consistent with their preceding context. Although these behavioral and neural effects are both commonly interpreted as evidence of facilitated processing, they have typically been explained within different computational frameworks that impose seemingly conflicting constraints: behavioral facilitation requires more activity to accumulate over expected representations, allowing a decision threshold to be reached earlier, whereas N400 facilitation requires less neural activity to be generated overall. Here, we show that an implemented model of predictive coding provides a unified mechanistic account of both phenomena and, in doing so, resolves three longstanding puzzles. First, it explains how facilitated processing can simultaneously produce faster behavioral responses and reduced neural activity: expected representations accumulate activity more rapidly in state units while generating less activity in error units. Second, an asymmetry between top-down priors and bottom-up evidence allows context to pre-activate multiple lexical candidates without inducing premature competition or misprediction costs. Third, it reconciles apparently conflicting claims about the timing of contextual facilitation by showing that behavioral and neural measures can reflect different phases along a single continuous trajectory of lexico-semantic processing, rather than distinct processing stages.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对语境促进效应中行为反应加快与N400波幅减小看似矛盾的问题，采用可实现的预测编码模型进行机制解释。模型表明，预期表征在状态单元中更快累积活动，同时在误差单元中产生更少活动，从而统一了行为促进与神经活动降低两种现象。作者还指出，自上而下先验与自下而上证据之间的不对称性可使语境预先激活多个词汇候选而不引发过早竞争或错误预测代价，并将行为与神经指标对应到同一词汇语义加工轨迹的不同阶段，而非不同加工阶段。

papers.title: Resting-state fMRI correlates of acupuncture in migraine: a coordinate-based meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Liu GY, Li LH, Cao ZM, Chen Z, Wang ZC, Yuan YK, Yan CQ, Wang J.
papers.journal: Journal of oral & facial pain and headache
papers.abstract: Background Although acupuncture has shown prophylactic benefits for migraine, its neural mechanisms remain elusive. This study systematically synthesized whole-brain resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) evidence to characterize changes in spontaneous brain activity after acupuncture treatment in patients with migraine. Methods We systematically searched eight databases for resting-state fMRI studies that used whole-brain analyses to compare patients with migraine before and after acupuncture. Only studies reporting amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF) or regional homogeneity (ReHo) were eligible for quantitative meta-analysis. Seed-based d Mapping with Permutation of Subject Images (SDM-PSI) was used to conduct the coordinate-based meta-analysis. Meta-regression analyses explored associations between regional brain changes and clinical outcomes. Results Thirteen studies comprising 19 datasets and 312 patients were included. At the prespecified uncorrected SDM-PSI threshold, acupuncture treatment was associated with increased ALFF in the right middle frontal gyrus and increased ReHo in the left angular gyrus and right superior temporal gyrus, together with decreased ReHo in the right precuneus. Exploratory meta-regression suggested that greater pain reduction was associated with smaller ReHo increases in the right superior temporal gyrus, whereas greater reduction in attack frequency was associated with greater ReHo increases in the left angular gyrus. Conclusions Acupuncture may be associated with altered spontaneous neural activity in regions of the executive control network, default mode network, and multisensory processing regions. These findings provide preliminary neuroimaging evidence for the central correlates of acupuncture in migraine. However, they should be interpreted cautiously given the limited evidence base, methodological heterogeneity, and exploratory nature of the meta-regression analyses. The prospero registration The review was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251145641).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过坐标元分析整合全脑静息态功能磁共振研究，考察针刺治疗偏头痛后自发脑活动的变化。结果显示，针刺与右侧额中回低频波动振幅升高、左侧角回和右侧颞上回局部一致性升高以及右侧楔前叶局部一致性降低相关，涉及执行控制网络、默认模式网络和多感觉加工区域。探索性元回归提示疼痛缓解程度与右侧颞上回局部一致性升高幅度呈反向关联，发作频率下降则与左侧角回局部一致性升高相关。作者认为这些发现为针刺的中枢相关提供了初步影像学证据，但受证据基础有限、方法异质性及元回归探索性质所限，需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Assessing glymphatic role in the association between choroid plexus enlargement and white matter lesions load: The uncertain path through diffusion tensor imaging along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS).
papers.authors: Sacchi L, Veronesi V, Bocca G, Schmid L, D'Agata F, Campisi C, Örzsik B, Arcaro M, Fenoglio C, Carandini T, Pintus M, Pietroboni AM, Ghezzi L, Schubert J, Conte G, Rigoni M, Lanzarotti R, Dolci C, Triulzi F, Turkheimer F, Galimberti D, Cercignani M, Bozzali M, Arighi A.
papers.abstract: BackgroundThe choroid plexus (CP) is involved in cerebrospinal fluid production, immune surveillance, and brain fluid homeostasis. CP enlargement has been linked to neuroinflammation, glymphatic dysfunction, and white matter lesion (WML) burden, but the mechanisms underlying these associations remain uncertain. ObjectiveTo investigate the relationships among CP volume, glymphatic function estimated using diffusion tensor imaging along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS), WML burden, and global cognitive performance in individuals with suspected neurodegenerative conditions, and to assess whether DTI-ALPS mediates the association between CP enlargement and white matter damage.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 104 participants, including 63 individuals with neurodegenerative conditions and 41 without neurodegeneration, who underwent multimodal MRI with 3D-T1-weighted, 3D-FLAIR, and diffusion-weighted sequences. CP volume was segmented using ASCHOPLEX and normalized to total intracranial volume. DTI-ALPS indices were derived from diffusion imaging, WML burden was quantified by automated segmentation, and global cognition was assessed using the Mini-Mental State Examination. Associations were tested using linear and quantile regression models. Mediation analysis evaluated indirect effects through DTI-ALPS.ResultsGreater CP volume was associated with lower DTI-ALPS values and higher WML burden. DTI-ALPS partially mediated the relationship between CP volume and WML burden, although the magnitude of mediation was modest. No significant mediation effect was observed for global cognitive performance. DTI-ALPS also showed strong associations with white matter integrity metrics, suggesting possible sensitivity to non-glymphatic microstructural changes.ConclusionsCP enlargement is associated with reduced DTI-ALPS and greater WML burden, but the contribution of glymphatic impairment remains uncertain. Alternative mechanisms, including neuroinflammation, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, and white matter microstructural damage, may contribute to these findings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在疑似神经退行性疾病人群中考察脉络丛体积、基于DTI-ALPS估计的类淋巴功能与白质病变负荷之间的关系，并检验DTI-ALPS是否在其中起中介作用。结果显示，脉络丛体积较大者DTI-ALPS值较低、白质病变负荷较高，DTI-ALPS对二者的关联仅起幅度有限的部分中介作用，对整体认知则未见显著中介效应。作者指出，DTI-ALPS也与白质完整性指标密切相关，可能反映非类淋巴的微结构改变，因此类淋巴功能受损在脉络丛增大与白质损伤关联中的作用仍不确定，神经炎症、血脑屏障障碍等机制亦可能参与。

papers.title: Time-resolved aperiodic dynamics in event segmentation in attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.
papers.authors: Zhou X, Ghorbani F, Hommel B, Roessner V, Beste C, Prochnow A.
papers.abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is associated with difficulties in organizing behaviour over time, yet the neurophysiological mechanisms underlying these temporal control deficits remain poorly understood. The brain continuously segments ongoing experience into discrete events to guide prediction and adaptive action. In our study, we examined whether adolescents with ADHD differ from neurotypical (NT) peers in how they behaviourally and neurally structure continuous experience. Seventy-three adolescents with ADHD and 73 adolescent NT controls viewed a movie while indicating perceived event boundaries. Concurrent EEG recordings were analysed using time-resolved spectral parameterization to track moment-to-moment changes in aperiodic neural activity. Both groups detected meaningful transitions, but NT adolescents segmented more sensitively to situational changes, particularly social and spatial cues. Across the entire recording window, ADHD participants exhibited steeper aperiodic exponents than NT participants across boundary and no-boundary intervals. Time-resolved analyses revealed that, around event boundaries, ADHD participants showed exaggerated pre-boundary steepening and attenuated post-boundary flattening of the aperiodic exponent-signifying over-stabilization before, and insufficient re-engagement after, event transitions. In ADHD only, behavioural segmentation sensitivity correlated with post-boundary aperiodic modulation. Although counterintuitive given common assumptions about increased neural 'noise' in ADHD, this pattern indicates that ADHD is characterized by an imbalance between neural stabilization and re-engagement when parsing continuous experience. Steeper aperiodic activity reflects a restricted neural state space that limits adaptive updating, leading to less context-sensitive segmentation. These findings link everyday temporal disorganization in ADHD to alterations in aperiodic neural dynamics and impaired temporal cognition in ADHD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）青少年在将连续经验切分为事件时，其行为与神经活动是否与神经典型同龄人不同，采用观看影片并标记事件边界的行为任务，同时用脑电时频参数化分析非周期性活动。结果显示，两组都能识别有意义的情境转换，但ADHD青少年对情境变化（尤其社会与空间线索）的分段敏感性较低；其非周期性指数整体更陡，并在事件边界前后表现出过度稳定与转换后重新投入不足的模式。作者据此提出，ADHD在解析连续经验时存在神经稳定与重新投入之间的失衡，较陡的非周期性活动反映受限的神经状态空间，可能限制适应性更新并导致情境敏感性较低的事件分段，从而将日常时间组织困难与非周期性神经动力学改变联系起来。

papers.title: Associations between brain phenotypes and temporomandibular disorders: An integrative multi-omics investigation.
papers.authors: Jiang Y, Wang Y, Huang Y, Chen X, Shen J, Lin Y, Zhang Z.
papers.journal: Cranio : the journal of craniomandibular practice
papers.abstract: Objective We proposed that overlooked neuropathological mechanisms involving brain phenotypes play a critical role in the pathogenesis of temporomandibular disorders (TMD). Methods We employed an integrative multi-omics approach combining bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR) - a genetic method to infer causal relationships - applied to 3,935 brain imaging-derived phenotypes, transcriptomic analysis (examining gene activity) of a TMD rodent model, and cell-type-specific MR using single-cell expression quantitative trait loci. Results Bidirectional MR identified 85 putatively causal brain phenotypes for TMD, predominantly white matter tracts (50/85). Transcriptomics yielded 197 medullary and 22 trigeminal differentially expressed genes. Cell-type MR implicated C1S in excitatory neurons and ARHGAP45 in microglia as risk genes. Conclusion This study supports the role of brain phenotypes in TMD neuropathology, suggesting a neural (medulla-trigeminal) pathway, and provides preliminary evidence for potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注脑表型是否参与颞下颌关节紊乱（TMD）的神经病理机制，采用整合多组学策略，将双向孟德尔随机化、TMD动物模型的转录组分析以及基于单细胞表达数量性状位点的细胞类型特异性分析结合起来。双向孟德尔随机化提示多种脑影像表型与TMD存在推定的因果关联，其中以白质纤维束为主；动物模型转录组分析则发现延髓和 trigeminal（三叉神经）区域存在差异表达基因，细胞类型分析进一步指向兴奋性神经元中的C1S和小胶质细胞中的ARHGAP45。作者据此认为结果支持脑表型在TMD神经病理中的作用，并提示可能存在延髓—三叉神经通路，同时为潜在的生物标志物和治疗靶点提供了初步线索，但相关证据仍属初步，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Global brain activity links subcortical degeneration to cortical tau progressively across Braak regions over early Alzheimer's disease stages.
papers.authors: Mao Y, Pan B, Liu X.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is characterized by early tau pathology in subcortical neuromodulatory nuclei, followed by progressive cortical tau accumulation; however, the mechanisms linking subcortical dysfunction to cortical tau pathology remain unclear. Using multimodal neuroimaging data from the ADNI cohort, we examined how infra-slow ( < 0.1 Hz) global brain (i.e., gBOLD) activity is related to the volume of the nucleus basalis of Meynert (NbM) and cortical tau accumulation in the early stages of AD. NbM degeneration was associated with reduced gBOLD activity and spatially co-localized tau accumulation, appearing in early Braak regions during the preclinical stage, i.e., cognitively unimpaired participants with abnormal CSF markers, and extending to more advanced Braak areas during the prodromal stage, i.e., mild cognitive impairment (MCI) subjects. Our findings suggest that infra-slow gBOLD activity serves as a functional neural mediator linking subcortical degeneration to cortical tau pathology, highlighting a potential functional pathway linking subcortical and cortical pathology in early AD.

papers.title: Huntington's disease vasculopathy is barrier-type-selective and arteriolar-dominant with spatially-coupled astrogliosis and reversible by S1pr1 stimulation.
papers.authors: Kucharz K, Soylu-Kucharz R, Saint-Pierre M, Alpaugh M, Qvist FL, Björkqvist M, Skotte NH, Cicchetti F, Lauritzen MJ.
papers.abstract: Brain vascular barriers are dysfunctional in many neurological disorders, including Huntington's disease (HD), but which vessels are affected and how remains unclear. Using in vivo two-photon microscopy in R6/2 HD-model mice, we reveal a striking divergence in barrier dysfunction. Surface vessels of the blood-cerebrospinal fluid barrier (BCSFB) drive pathology in HD by paracellular leakage, while parenchymal vessels forming the blood-brain barrier (BBB) exhibit increased vesicular transport and adsorptive-mediated transcytosis (AMT), with arterioles representing the most critically impacted vascular segment. The pathology of both barriers was spatially-matched with astrocyte activation pattern localized to affected vessels both in R6/2 mice and in brains of HD patients. Sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor 1 (S1pr1) agonist treatment reversed BCSFB leakage and partially restored BBB function, selectively reducing AMT in arterioles, with no effect in capillaries and venules. These findings redefine HD vascular pathology, demonstrating heterogeneous, vessel-type-specific barrier failure beyond generalized "disruption," uncovering mechanistic vulnerabilities and the therapeutic potential of S1pr1 modulation.

papers.title: Temporal stability of functional network configurations and its relationship to cognition and psychopathology in early psychoses.
papers.authors: Theis N, Rubin J, O'Rourke E, Bahuguna J, Cape J, Ouyang B, Iyengar S, Prasad KM.
papers.journal: Neuropsychopharmacology : official publication of the American College of Neuropsychopharmacology
papers.abstract: To design network-based treatments, it is critical to understand dynamic changes in brain networks over time. We comprehensively examined network structure using regional activation-only, pairwise-coactivation-only, and systems-level maximum entropy models (MEM) applied to the Human Connectome Project-Early Psychosis (HCP-EP) resting fMRI data (patients = 109, controls = 56). The MEM integrates regional activation levels and pairwise correlation-based functional connectivity (FC), providing the potential for better characterization of clinically meaningful brain states and how they change over time. Using the HCP/Glasser atlas to define brain regions within the default mode (DMN) and dorsal attention (DAN) networks, group differences in regional activation, graph measures of FC, and MEM features such as transition rates between minima in an energy landscape along with correlations with cognitive and psychopathological measures were examined. Psychosis was associated with reduced activation in several regions and multiple FC graph metric alterations. MEM demonstrated a wider variety of DMN and DAN activation/deactivation configurations, with more frequent switching between them, more pronounced network configuration differences and higher basin transition rates with reduced basin dwell times suggesting temporally unstable network configurations, meaning the brain cannot rely on any particular configuration for cognitive processing. Activation of only three regions correlated with working memory, but none of the FC metrics did. MEM features, in particular basin transitions and total energy, correlated negatively with working memory. Our findings suggest that MEM provides unique information, specifically attenuated inter-network connectivity with reduced stability of DMN and DAN brain states, to characterize networks as targets and their features as markers for novel treatment development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早期精神病患者脑网络配置的时间稳定性及其与认知和精神病理的关系，利用静息态功能磁共振数据，比较了仅区域激活、仅成对共激活以及整合激活与功能连接的系统级最大熵模型（MEM）三种刻画方式。结果显示，精神病与部分脑区激活降低及多项功能连接图指标改变有关；MEM进一步揭示默认模式网络和背侧注意网络的激活/去激活配置种类更多、切换更频繁、状态间转换率更高且停留时间更短，提示网络配置在时间上不稳定，大脑难以依赖某一特定配置进行认知加工。仅少数脑区的激活与工作记忆相关，功能连接指标则无此关联，而MEM特征（尤其是状态转换和总能量）与工作记忆呈负相关。作者据此认为，MEM能提供独特信息，即网络间连接减弱及默认模式与背侧注意网络状态稳定性下降，可作为治疗靶点和标记的候选特征。

papers.title: Young minds in distress: Exploring the global rise in youth mental health diagnoses.
papers.authors: Chiang HL, Chien YL, Gau SS.
papers.abstract: Adolescence represents a critical neurobiological period marked by a developmental "mismatch" between early-maturing limbic systems and the later-maturing prefrontal cortex, conferring heightened vulnerability to the onset of psychiatric disorders. This review synthesizes global epidemiological trends, differentiates true increases in morbidity from diagnostic inflation, and integrates evidence-based intervention strategies. In high-income countries, youth depression, suicide mortality, and self-harm have risen substantially, supported by objective indicators of illness severity that extend beyond changes in diagnostic practices. Key environmental drivers include pervasive digital engagement, cyberbullying, sleep disruption, and academic pressure, with sleep disturbances emerging as a central transdiagnostic risk factor. The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated these pre-existing trajectories of mental health deterioration, with particularly marked effects on eating-disorder incidence and social-emotional development. To address these challenges, we suggest a three-tiered intervention framework. Universal approaches should emphasize regulation of digital environments, implementation of Social-Emotional Learning, and institutional support for regular physical activity. Selective interventions should target high-risk youth by proactively monitoring sleep health and mitigating achievement-related stress in academically competitive settings. Indicated care requires integrated delivery of evidence-based psychotherapies alongside structured return-to-learn protocols following psychiatric hospitalization. Ultimately, translating epidemiological risk into effective prevention demands a shift from reactive, diagnosis-centered models to proactive frameworks that prioritize early risk reduction and the reinforcement of protective factors. By fostering environments that promote circadian stability, physical activity, emotional regulation, and peer connectedness, youth mental health can be strengthened as a foundation for societal well-being, resilience, and adaptive functioning in an increasingly complex world.

papers.title: Investigating acute-to-subacute neuroanatomical outcomes and the role of sex and age in adolescent concussion: A PedCARE+MRI substudy.
papers.authors: Simas KR, Dodd AB, Sicard V, Abdeen N, Yeates KO, Zemek R, Ledoux AA, Pediatric Emergency Research Canada (PERC) PedCARE Team.
papers.abstract: Background Limited research has examined acute-to-subacute neuroanatomical trajectories following adolescent concussion. To investigate acute-to-subacute longitudinal changes in cortical thickness and subcortical volume following adolescent concussion, we compared neuroanatomical trajectories relative to orthopedic injury (OI) from 72 h to 4 weeks post-injury, and explored moderation by age and sex. Methods Youth aged 10-17 years with an acute concussion or OI were recruited from a pediatric emergency department and completed acute and subacute T1-weighted MRI scans. Sixty-seven youth with concussion and 31 youth with OI were included in analyses. Results Time did not moderate group differences in cortical thickness and volume. No main effects of group were found across cortical regions, with no moderating effects of age or sex. Youth with concussion demonstrated persistently reduced hippocampal volume relative to OI across time. Age, but not sex, further moderated group differences in hippocampal volume, with similar trajectories below 12 years of age, but progressively greater hippocampal volume in OI relative to concussion around 13 years of age and older. Increasing age was associated with cortical thinning across cortical regions, except the middle frontal gyrus, irrespective of group. Conclusion These findings suggest cortical structures may not be affected within the first 4 weeks post-injury. Hippocampal volume was reduced in youth with concussion aged approximately 13 years and older from 72 h through 4 weeks post-injury, suggesting deviation from the positive age-hippocampal volume relationship in OI. This age-dependent pattern may suggest an acute-to-subacute neurodevelopmental vulnerability of the hippocampus during early adolescence following concussion.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了青少年脑震荡与骨科损伤后从急性期到亚急性期的皮层厚度和皮层下体积变化轨迹，并考察年龄和性别的调节作用。结果显示，损伤后4周内两组皮层结构未见明显差异，但脑震荡组的海马体积持续小于骨科损伤组；这一差异受年龄调节，约13岁及以上青少年中更明显，而较小年龄组轨迹相近。作者据此提出，脑震荡后早期可能存在与年龄相关、尤其集中于青春期早期的海马神经发育脆弱性，而皮层结构在伤后4周内可能未受累。

papers.title: White matter microstructure and motor function in amnestic mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's dementia.
papers.authors: Cote S, Ruitenberg MFL, van der Geest JN, Frost NA, King JB, Duff K, Koppelmans V.
papers.abstract: Introduction Up to 30% of amnestic mild cognitive impairment (aMCI) subjects exhibit motor dysfunction. However, the relationship between white matter microstructural connectivity (SC) and motor function across the Alzheimer's disease (AD) spectrum remains unclear. This study investigated 1) white matter microstructural differences among cognitively unimpaired (CU) individuals, those with aMCI, and those with mild AD; and 2) associations between white matter microstructure and motor performance. Methods Participants (CU = 68, aMCI = 44, AD = 34) underwent diffusion- and T1-weighted MRI. Whole-brain SC was assessed using weighted streamline count from probabilistic tractography between regions of the Brainnetome atlas. A subset (n = 103) also completed motor assessments (finger tapping, grip strength, spiral tracing, sequence learning). Group differences and AFD-motor associations were evaluated using threshold-free network-based statistics, corrected for multiple comparisons. Results Compared with CU participants, those with AD exhibited reduced SC in 268 connections, predominantly involving the temporal lobe, thalamus, and hippocampus. Compared with aMCI, AD participants showed reduced SC in three connections linking frontal, parietal, and temporal regions. No significant SC differences were observed between CU and aMCI, and SC was not associated with motor performance. Conclusion White matter SC is affected in AD, particularly in medial temporal lobe regions that are known to be affected early in the disease. Absence of differences between CU and aMCI, and small differences between aMCI and AD suggests that SC changes appear later in the disease course. The lack of SC-motor associations could reflect lack of variation in motor behavior in the sample.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察遗忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）与阿尔茨海默病（AD）谱系中白质微结构连接与运动功能的关系，比较认知正常者、aMCI患者和轻度AD患者的全脑结构连接，并分析其与运动表现的关联。结果显示，AD患者相较认知正常者存在广泛连接减弱，主要涉及颞叶、丘脑和海马；AD与aMCI之间差异较小，而认知正常者与aMCI之间未见显著差异，提示白质连接改变可能出现在疾病较晚阶段。研究未发现结构连接与运动表现相关，作者认为这可能与样本中运动行为缺乏变异有关。

papers.title: Cerebral small vessel disease burden in late-onset epilepsy of unknown aetiology: insights from a prospective multicenter cohort.
papers.authors: Hologne E, Machet F, Puisieux S, Papathanassiou D, Launois C, Wanono R, Martin V, Verger A, Chen Y, Tyvaert L, Moulin S.
papers.abstract: Background Late-onset epilepsy of unknown aetiology (LOEU) represents a prevalent and often disabling neurological disorder. Existing studies indicate that cerebral small vessel disease (cSVD) may play a significant role in the pathogenesis of epilepsy within this population; however, prospective investigations are currently lacking. We aimed to systematically describe the burden and qualitative aspects of cSVD in a LOEU population. Methods Patients with LOEU were prospectively included across three university hospitals (Nancy, Lille and Reims, France). Patients were systematically assessed for clinical, cardiovascular, neurophysiological (EEG, polygraphy/polysomnography), neuropsychological, and radiological features (brain MRI and FDG-PET). cSVD was assessed using MRI only. A composite score evaluating WMH, microbleeds, EPVS, and lacunar infarcts was used. Moderate-to-severe cSVD was defined as a score of 2 4. Results A total of 55 patients were enrolled, predominantly male (63.6%), with a median age of 71yo (IQR 12.7) and multiple cardiovascular risk factors. Moderate-to severe cSVD was infrequent in this cohort (23.6%). No significant association was observed between cSVD score and epilepsy characteristics. Objective cognitive impairment was prevalent but was not associated with a higher burden of cSVD. Multivariate logistic regression identified advanced age as the sole significant factor associated with moderate-to-severe cSVD. Conclusion In this thoroughly characterized cohort, moderate-to-severe cSVD was infrequent, with age identified as the sole risk factor. These findings support the hypothesis that cSVD may serve as a biomarker of brain aging. Further research is required to substantiate these results.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对病因不明的晚发性癫痫（LOEU）患者，前瞻性纳入三家医院的患者，系统评估其临床、心血管、神经生理、神经心理及影像学特征，并用脑MRI复合评分衡量脑小血管病（cSVD）负担。结果显示，中重度cSVD在该队列中并不常见，cSVD评分与癫痫特征及客观认知损害均无显著关联，多因素分析中仅高龄与中重度cSVD相关。作者据此认为，cSVD在此人群中可能更多反映脑老化而非癫痫的直接致病因素，但这一解释仍需进一步研究验证。

papers.title: Disrupted interhemispheric communication in primary progressive aphasia: a multimodal MRI study of homotopic connectivity.
papers.authors: Tao Y, Tsapkini K, Rapp B.
papers.abstract: The two hemispheres of the brain are strongly connected both structurally and functionally, and disruptions to interhemispheric communication can have significant cognitive and behavioral consequences. While alterations to interhemispheric structural and/or functional connectivity have been reported in many neurological conditions, this issue has been scarcely addressed in Primary Progressive Aphasia (PPA). PPA is a neurogenerative syndrome primarily involving (left-)lateralized gray matter atrophy and typically categorized into three variants - logopenic, non-fluent, and semantic. Here we examined interhemispheric, homotopic structural and functional connectivity in 72 individuals from the three variants and age-matched controls. Structural connectivity (SC) was calculated from diffusion-weighted MRI and functional connectivity (FC) from resting-state fMRI. Both resulting connectomes were based on the same atlas of homotopic parcels. We asked: 1) Are patterns of abnormal homotopic SC and/or FC shared across PPA variants? 2) How are the FC changes related to underlying structural changes to white and gray matter? We found, first, that average homotopic SC was reduced in all variants and was related to greater behavioral disease severity. By contrast, for homotopic FC, the three variants displayed distinct patterns. Second, direct FC-SC comparisons established that, across variants, the FC and SC changes were distinct from one another and were largely dissociated from gray matter atrophy. In sum, the structural connectivity between the two hemispheres weakens in PPA with disease progression. However, the uncoupling of FC from underlying structural changes indicates that these changes reflect complex patterns of functional re-organization of interhemispheric communication in response to the disease.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注原发性进行性失语（PPA）中大脑两半球间同源连接的结构与功能改变，纳入三种亚型个体及年龄匹配对照，结合弥散加权MRI和静息态fMRI，在相同同源脑区图谱上分别构建结构连接与功能连接。结果显示，各亚型的平均同源结构连接均减弱，且与行为症状更严重相关；而同源功能连接在三种亚型间呈现不同模式。进一步比较发现，功能连接与结构连接的变化彼此不同，且在很大程度上与灰质萎缩相分离。作者据此指出，PPA中两半球间的结构连接随疾病进展而减弱，但功能连接与结构改变的解耦提示，同源功能连接的变化反映的是疾病下半球间通讯的功能重组，而非单纯由结构损伤或萎缩直接决定。

papers.title: DPGR-Net: A disentangled population-guided graph neural network for major depressive disorder identification.
papers.authors: He X, Mei T, Du H, Zhou X, Xiang J, Liu Z.
papers.journal: Neural networks : the official journal of the International Neural Network Society
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a brain disorder characterized by substantial individual heterogeneity, and its accurate diagnosis remains challenging in clinical practice. Graph neural networks applied to functional brain networks (FBNs) constructed from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data have shown promise for MDD diagnosis. However, in multicenter settings, site differences are often entangled with disease-related information, which not only interferes with the model's learning of disease patterns but also compromises the reliable modeling of topological patterns in individual FBNs, thereby limiting identification performance. To address this problem, we propose a disentangled population-guided graph neural network with dynamic refinement (DPGR-Net) for MDD identification. Specifically, DPGR-Net first constructs individual FBN from rs-fMRI data and learns discriminative subject-level brain graph representations. To mitigate the interference of site effects, we disentangle disease-related associations from site-related variations at the population level and impose an independence constraint to learn more stable cross-site disease-discriminative representations. On this basis, we innovatively design a population-guided dynamic optimization mechanism for individual brain graphs, which feeds the stable disease-discriminative information learned at the population level back into the structural updating of individual brain graphs, thereby enhancing disease-related connections while suppressing site-related noisy connections. Experimental results on the public REST-meta-MDD dataset show that the proposed method achieves an ACC of 92.37% and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, DPGR-Net identifies discriminative brain regions and aberrant functional connectivity patterns associated with MDD, thereby advancing the interpretability and clinical utility of rs-fMRI for MDD diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对多中心静息态功能磁共振数据中站点差异与疾病信息相互纠缠、影响抑郁症识别的问题，提出一种解缠的人群引导图神经网络（DPGR-Net）。方法上，模型先由个体功能脑网络学习受试者水平的图表示，再在人群层面将疾病相关关联与站点相关变异分离并施加独立性约束，以获得更稳定的跨站点疾病判别表征；同时利用人群层面学到的判别信息动态优化个体脑图结构，增强疾病相关连接、抑制站点相关噪声连接。在公开多中心数据集上的实验显示，该方法识别表现优于现有对比方法，并定位出与抑郁症相关的判别性脑区和异常功能连接模式。这些结果提示，分离站点效应有助于提升多中心脑网络建模的可靠性，也为rs-fMRI辅助抑郁症诊断的可解释性提供了参考；但研究仍属基于既有数据集的模型验证，其临床诊断价值尚需进一步检验。

papers.title: Platelet-activating factor in multiple sclerosis: From peripheral inflammation to central neurodegeneration.
papers.authors: Baothman A, Al-Kuraishy HM, Elkady WA, Musa A, Batiha GE.
papers.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic inflammatory and neurodegenerative disease in which peripheral immune activation, blood-brain barrier (BBB) dysfunction, and central nervous system (CNS) injury are closely interconnected. Platelet-activating factor (PAF) is a potent phospholipid mediator involved in inflammation, platelet activation, oxidative stress, and neuronal signaling. Increased PAF levels in the plasma and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of patients with MS suggest its involvement in both peripheral and central disease processes. Clinical and experimental evidence supports a working model in which peripheral platelet and neurovascular activation may interact with central PAF/PAF receptor (PAF-R) signaling, where microglial-neuronal communication, glutamate/NMDA-mediated excitotoxicity, synaptic injury, and demyelination may contribute to neural damage. Altered regulation of PAF activity may further enhance these processes. However, several mechanistic links remain derived from experimental models, and some detrimental effects of PAF appear to occur independently of PAF-R. This review integrates the evidence supporting a peripheral-to-central PAF framework in MS and critically evaluates direct PAF-R antagonists, indirect PAF modulators, and exploratory PAF-related candidates. Overall, PAF/PAF-R targeting remains a mechanistically promising but clinically unestablished therapeutic approach requiring further translational investigation.

papers.title: CT-based brain frailty signs and clinical outcomes following endovascular stroke thrombectomy.
papers.authors: Shalabi F, Obiedat K, Zabida M, Assayuri M, Ishtay Y, Jubran H, Schwartzmann Y, Metanis I, Jubeh T, Leker RR.
papers.journal: Journal of stroke and cerebrovascular diseases : the official journal of National Stroke Association
papers.abstract: Background The impact of brain frailty signs on baseline imaging on clinical outcomes in stroke patients remains unclear. Therefore, we evaluated admission CT markers of brain frailty and their correlation to outcomes in patients with large vessel occlusions (LVO) that underwent endovascular thrombectomy (EVT). Methods Data from a single-center prospective stroke registry of patients who underwent EVT were retrospectively analyzed. Demographics, medical history, clinical data, admission laboratory values, and 90-day functional outcomes were reviewed. Admission non-contrast CT (NCCT) scans were evaluated for Evans Index (EI) and brain-frailty signs, including the presence and degree of atrophy, white-matter changes, and old vascular lesions. Patients with pre-stroke brain frailty were compared with those without frailty signs, and regression analyses were used to assess the effects on outcomes. Results Overall, 319 participants were included; 263 (82.4%) had brain atrophy, 158 (49.5%) had white-matter changes, and 131 (41.1%) had prior vascular lesions. After adjustment for age, stroke severity and other confounders, brain-frailty signs or the EI failed to show significant associations with functional outcomes. White-matter changes were associated with higher rates of symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage and in-hospital complications, and greater atrophy severity was linked to increased rates of in-hospital complications and 90-day mortality. No association was found between brain frailty and length of hospital stay. Conclusion Admission NCCT markers for pre-stroke brain frailty were not independently associated with 90-day functional outcomes following EVT. These findings suggest that admission NCCT-detected brain frailty should not be used to exclude patients with LVO from undergoing EVT.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于单中心前瞻性卒中登记数据，回顾性分析接受血管内取栓的大血管闭塞患者，评估入院非增强CT上的脑脆弱征象（包括脑萎缩、白质改变、陈旧血管病灶及Evans指数）与临床结局的关系。调整年龄、卒中严重程度等混杂因素后，脑脆弱征象或Evans指数与90天功能结局均无显著关联；但白质改变与症状性颅内出血和院内并发症发生率升高相关，萎缩程度较重则与院内并发症和90天死亡率升高相关，脑脆弱与住院时长无关。作者据此认为，入院CT所见的卒中前脑脆弱不应作为排除大血管闭塞患者接受取栓的依据；上述关联为观察性结果，不能理解为因果或治疗效应。

papers.title: The clinical utility of 7T MRI in skull base pathology - A narrative review.
papers.authors: Walker WD, Gillespie J, Sommerville R, Winter C.
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
papers.abstract: Introduction Ultra-high field 7 T MRI provides substantially higher signal-to-noise ratio than conventional 1.5 T/3T MRI, enabling superior depiction of neuroanatomy and tissue contrast. These advantages are particularly relevant at the skull base, where complex anatomy and intimate tumour neurovascular relationships may critically impact diagnosis and treatment. This narrative review evaluates current evidence for the use of 7 T MRI in skull base pathology, with focus on tumour detection, characterisation/delineation, and the assessment of compromised neurovascular structures. Methods A systematic search of PUBMED and EMBASE was conducted following PRISMA guidelines utilising relevant search terms. Studies published between 1st January 1991 and 25th April 2025 were screened. Included studies assessed skull base pathology using 7 T MRI in in-vivo human subjects. Given the heterogeneity of included studies, results were derived through narrative synthesis. Results 25 studies met inclusion criteria, comprising 115 patients and 155 controls. Most studies were published after 2019 and were small-scale feasibility or case control studies. Pituitary adenomas were the most commonly investigated pathology, with 7 T demonstrating improved lesion detection, characterisation and anatomical delineation. Several studies also reported the promise of tractography of the posterior visual pathway in patients with pituitary adenomas, with correlations to visual function. Conclusion 7 T MRI shows promise for improved preoperative assessment and spatial characterisation of skull base pathology. Preliminary findings indicate potential utility in identifying novel markers for dysfunction in the adjacent compressed cranial nerves. Further studies to confirm these potential clinical roles in diagnosing skull base tumours and preoperative prognostication of impacted cranial nerves are needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该叙述性综述系统检索并梳理了7T MRI用于颅底病变的现有证据，纳入的研究多为小规模可行性或病例对照研究，以垂体腺瘤最常见。总体来看，7T MRI在病变检出、特征描述和解剖勾画方面显示出优势，部分研究还报告了垂体腺瘤患者后视觉通路示踪成像与视觉功能的相关性。作者认为，7T MRI有望改善颅底病变的术前评估和空间刻画，并可能帮助识别邻近受压脑神经功能障碍的新标志物，但这些临床作用尚属初步，仍需进一步研究确认。

papers.title: Characterizing neural indices of cognitive control in young children: A school-based ERP study with naturalistic stimuli.
papers.authors: Richardson DM, Peters AN, Waters NE, Grammer JK, Hampton Wray A, Isbell E.
papers.abstract: A large body of work has advanced our understanding of the neurodevelopment of cognitive control in early childhood. Such work frequently used simplistic visual stimuli, making them well-suited for event-related potentials (ERP) research. However, more naturalistic stimuli may better mirror visually rich environments where cognitive control is engaged. Here, we measured ERPs from 171 kindergartners at public schools with diverse socioeconomic characteristics during a Go/No-Go task using photographs of animals in natural scenes. Instead of the commonly reported N2 in Go/No-Go tasks with simplistic stimuli, the earlier-occurring ERP morphology was dominated by a P2. The later-occurring ERP morphology was consistent with the P3b reported in Go/No-Go tasks with simplistic stimuli. Both the P2 and P3b displayed more positive mean amplitudes for No-Go compared to Go trials. Additionally, P2 amplitudes decreased with age for No-Go stimuli whereas P3b amplitudes decreased for both Go and No-Go stimuli, indicating different developmental changes across earlier- and later-occurring neural processes. Only larger P3b mean amplitudes were associated with better task performance, suggesting that variability in later-occurring neural processes may be more closely related to individual differences in behavioral performance. These findings suggest that earlier-occurring neural indices of cognitive control may not generalize across paradigms varying in stimulus complexity, while later-occurring indices may. Furthermore, results indicate that earlier- and later-occurring ERPs exhibit distinct age-related differences and associations with behavioral performance. Furthermore, our study highlights the feasibility of conducting school-based developmental cognitive neuroscience research, facilitating the inclusion of children from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds.

papers.title: Parkinson's disease diagnosis using machine learning and multimodal biomarkers: A systematic review.
papers.authors: Khan MI, Imran A, Alshammari A.
papers.abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disorder and the fastest-growing neurological condition globally, with an estimated 10.5 million people living with PD in 2026 and projections exceeding 14.2 million by 2040 according to the World Health Organization. Despite this staggering burden, diagnosis continues to depend on clinical motor signs that appear only after 60%-80% of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra have been irreversibly lost, and specialist misdiagnosis rates reach 25% at early disease stages even in dedicated movement disorder centers. This systematic review synthesizes evidence from 239 studies drawn from 5847 screened records (2016-2026), critically evaluating unimodal diagnostic approaches encompassing dopamine transporter single-photon emission computed tomography (DAT-SPECT), quantitative magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), alpha-synuclein (α-syn) seed amplification assay (SAA), neurofilament light chain (NfL), genetic risk markers, voice and speech biomarkers, gait and movement metrics, electroencephalography (EEG), and handwriting analysis, alongside their integration into multimodal machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) frameworks with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) components. Across 87 quantitative studies, the α-syn SAA achieved a sensitivity of 84%-92% and specificity of 93%-98% in prodromal cohorts. DAT-SPECT achieved a pooled sensitivity and specificity of approximately 90% but could not differentiate PD from atypical parkinsonian syndromes (APS). Multimodal fusion architectures, particularly cross-attention transformers integrating motor, voice, and gait data, consistently outperformed unimodal approaches by 4%-8% in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), with the largest gains in early stage detection and differential diagnosis tasks. XAI methods, including SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM), and integrated gradients, were reported in only 31% of deep learning studies. This indicates a transparency gap with direct regulatory consequences. Across all modalities, only 22% of studies reported external validation, and multicenter prospective evidence remains scarce. These two deficits, rather than model architecture, are now the principal barriers to clinical adoption. This review provides an actionable roadmap for researchers, clinicians, and regulatory agencies working in the PD diagnostics field.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了2016至2026年间帕金森病诊断的多模态生物标志物与机器学习研究，涵盖DAT-SPECT、α-突触核蛋白种子扩增、影像、语音、步态等单一模态及其融合框架。定量证据显示，α-突触核蛋白种子扩增在前驱期人群中敏感性和特异性较高，DAT-SPECT总体表现约九成但难以区分非典型帕金森综合征；融合运动、语音和步态数据的多模态架构在早期识别和鉴别诊断上优于单一模态。作者指出，可解释性方法仅在少数深度学习研究中出现，外部验证也明显不足，这两点而非模型结构本身构成临床转化的主要障碍。

papers.title: Multi-modal connectome analysis of the stereoelectroencephalography implantation effect: a case report.
papers.authors: Sayanagi T, Kosugi K, Enomoto T, Fujisawa M, Matsuoka S, Shinohara J, Tezuka T, Nakayama Y, Toda M.
papers.abstract: Stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) may induce seizure reduction in some patients, known as the implantation effect, but its network mechanism remains unclear. We investigated whether SEEG electrode insertion is associated with measurable brain network reorganisation using longitudinal multi-modal analysis. We studied a patient with drug-resistant right temporal lobe epilepsy who experienced seizure reduction after SEEG implantation and subsequently underwent anterior temporal lobectomy, achieving ILAE class 1a seizure freedom at 6-month follow-up. Structural connectivity from diffusion MRI, resting-state functional connectivity and intracranial EEG connectivity were analysed longitudinally. Connectome gradients were computed using diffusion map embedding, and resected tissue was examined histopathologically. Multi-modal analysis showed convergent connectivity changes after SEEG implantation: decreased hippocampus-amygdala connectivity, decreased fusiform gyrus-temporal pole connectivity and increased hippocampus-posterior cingulate connectivity. Diffusion MRI gradient analysis showed eccentricity reduction of 11.9% after SEEG and 17.6% after lobectomy, consistent with greater network integration. SEEG connectivity showed reduced limbic synchronisation between days 3 and 7 of monitoring. Histopathology demonstrated lymphocytic infiltration and reactive gliosis around electrode trajectories, consistent with chronic inflammation. SEEG implantation was associated with limbic disconnection, enhanced hippocampus-posterior cingulate connectivity and partial normalisation of connectome topology. The convergent findings suggest that electrode-induced micro-lesions may produce network-modifying effects that contribute to the implantation effect.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告探讨立体脑电图（SEEG）电极植入是否伴随可测量的脑网络重组，以解释部分患者术后癫痫发作减少的“植入效应”。研究对象为一名耐药性右侧颞叶癫痫患者，采用弥散MRI结构连接、静息态功能连接和颅内脑电连接进行纵向多模态分析，并结合切除组织的病理检查。结果显示，植入后出现趋同的连接改变：海马-杏仁核及梭状回-颞极连接下降，海马-后扣带连接增强，连接组梯度分析提示网络整合度提高，颅内脑电显示边缘系统同步性降低；病理见电极轨迹周围淋巴细胞浸润和反应性胶质增生，提示慢性炎症。作者据此推测，电极所致微损伤可能通过边缘系统断连和连接拓扑部分正常化产生网络修饰作用，从而参与植入效应，但这一关联尚属病例层面的观察，机制仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Acute administration of methylphenidate modulates functional connectivity during irrelevant stimuli processing in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Li L, Bo T, Lopez EM, Gonzalez MR, Fernandez-Del-Olmo M, Gurevich T, Desojo LV, Fogelson N.
papers.abstract: Objective Methylphenidate (MPD) may have therapeutic benefits in Parkinson's disease (PD) patients. However, the effects of MPD on attentional functional connectivity (FC) networks, in PD, have not been investigated to date. Our objective was to examine the effects of a single dose of MPD, on event-related FC, in PD. The study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single-dose, cross-over clinical trial. Methods We recorded electroencephalogram (EEG) in PD patients during the performance of an extended version of a visual oddball task.
