We assessed the discriminative performance of FVH using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AU-ROC). Results Among 855 AIS patients (median age, 67 (IQR 58-74 years; male, 581 [67.9 %]), FVH was detected in 154 (18.0 %) patients, and cerebral edema were observed in 179 (20.9 %) patients. Multivariate regression analysis showed that FVH was significantly associated with cerebral edema (adjusted OR 1.97, 95 %CI 1.46-2.64, p < 0.001). A combination of NIHSS and FVH had a larger AU-ROC than NIHSS alone (0.759 vs 0.729, Delong test p = 0.007). Conclusion FVH is significantly associated with cerebral edema after AIS. Moreover, FVH may help to better predict cerebral edema in this stroke population.
keywords: National Institutes Of Health Stroke Scale

papers.title: Congenital biliary abnormalities in adults: a practical CT and MRI guide.
papers.authors: Maino C, Franco PN, Cristoferi L, Cannella R, Mensi E, Donati F, Vernuccio F, Ippolito D, Boraschi P.
papers.abstract: Congenital abnormalities of the biliary tree are increasingly identified in adulthood as incidental findings on cross-sectional imaging. They range from clinically silent anatomical variants to complex malformations with relevant clinical or surgical implications. This review provides a practical framework for radiologists who encounter these entities in adult patients, organizing them into four categories: congenital cystic biliary dilation, fibropolycystic liver disorders arising from ductal plate malformation, anatomical variants of the biliary tree, and rare developmental anomalies such as ductal duplication, ectopic biliary drainage, and gallbladder agenesis or hypoplasia. Magnetic resonance imaging with cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) is the diagnostic cornerstone, allowing non-invasive assessment of ductal communication, morphology, and pancreaticobiliary junction anatomy, while computed tomography (CT) plays a complementary role in evaluating complications. Key diagnostic CT and MRI features are discussed, including the central dot sign of Caroli disease, the diffuse non-communicating cystic pattern of polycystic liver disease, and the abnormally long common channel characteristic of pancreaticobiliary maljunction. The review also addresses the surgical relevance of biliary anatomical variants. A compact diagnostic algorithm and a structured reporting checklist are provided, together with the acquired conditions that most often mimic congenital disease in adults. From a clinical standpoint, malignant potential varies substantially across entities, ranging from negligible in polycystic liver disease to substantially increased in choledochal cysts and pancreaticobiliary maljunction, although the available estimates derive largely from heterogeneous, mostly retrospective rare-disease series and should be interpreted as orders of magnitude rather than precise risks. This variability nonetheless drives surveillance strategy. A systematic diagnostic approach, combined with close collaboration between radiologists, hepatologists, and surgeons, is essential to guide appropriate management and avoid both missed malignancies and unnecessary intervention.

papers.title: Drug-resistant epilepsy in an autosomal recessive copper metabolism disorder from SLC33A1 mutation.
papers.authors: Singh R, Kuo CY, Sharma S, Lundstrom BN, Starnes DK.
papers.abstract: SLC33A1 mutation (Huppke-Brendel Syndrome) is a rare, autosomal recessive disorder associated with copper metabolism and characterized by global developmental delay, sensorineural hearing loss, congenital cataract and generalized hypotonia. We report two siblings under 6 years with novel SLC33A1 gene mutation, born from heterozygous parents. The first patient developed early onset drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) secondary to the novel genetic mutation; the second patient did not develop seizures but shared several other phenotypic features of the syndrome, highlighting intrafamilial variation in seizure penetrance. On electroencephalography of the first patient with DRE, independent spike and wave discharges were noted in the temporoparietal region with generalized background slowing. Diffuse electrodecrement with overriding paroxysmal fast activity was correlated with seizure semiology. Neuroimaging revealed generalized cerebral and cerebellar atrophy, ex-vacuo ventriculomegaly, and bilateral chronic subdural collections. We describe a shared genetic mutation in two siblings and highlight their overlapping and distinct clinical features, management challenges, and complications with invasive neuromodulation. These cases expand the differential diagnosis of copper-related metabolic disorders. Practical implications Variable seizure penetrance in SLC33A1 related disorders could manifest as epileptic phenotypes.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一对携带新型SLC33A1基因突变（Huppke-Brendel综合征）的同胞病例，该病为常染色体隐性铜代谢障碍，表现为全面发育迟缓、感音神经性耳聋、先天性白内障和全身肌张力低下。其中一名患儿出现早发性药物难治性癫痫，脑电图见颞顶区独立棘慢波放电伴背景弥漫性减慢，神经影像显示大脑及小脑萎缩、代偿性脑室扩大和双侧慢性硬膜下积液；另一名同胞未出现癫痫发作，但具有该综合征的其他表型特征，提示同一家系内癫痫外显率存在差异。作者据此指出，SLC33A1相关疾病的癫痫表型可变，这些病例也拓展了铜相关代谢障碍的鉴别诊断范围。

papers.title: Waves of control: An ER(S)P study to explore the neural dynamics of proactive and reactive stability.
papers.authors: Viviani G, Visalli A, Montefinese M, Di Pietro I, Ruz M, Vallesi A, Ambrosini E.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Cognitive stability, the ability to maintain task focus while facing distractions, is a core component of cognitive control. According to the Dual Mechanisms of Control model, stability can be implemented proactively, through anticipatory goal maintenance, or reactively, through transient, conflict-triggered adjustments. However, their neural dynamics remain debated, mainly due to the limited temporal resolution of fMRI and to EEG designs that fail to disentangle different forms of stability. Here, we recorded EEG while 40 participants performed a spatial Stroop task to dissociate predictive proactive stability, induced by list-wide proportion congruency (LWPC), and predictive reactive stability, induced by item-specific proportion congruency (ISPC). Moreover, using response-locked analyses, we exploratively probed the late, corrective form of reactive stability engaged after conflict detection. Using a state-of-the-art analytical approach combining trial-level Bayesian estimates of the manipulated variables with multilevel modeling, we isolated these predictive mechanisms from low-level confounds like contingency. The analyses of event-related potentials and time-frequency activity revealed neural signatures of proactive stability, including anticipatory pre-stimulus modulations and a systematic reduction of post-stimulus conflict-related activity. In contrast, no reliable neural evidence for predictive reactive stability was observed once contingency was controlled. Importantly, response-locked analyses revealed distinct late neural markers compatible with a corrective reactive stability mechanism engaged to resolve conflict when predictive mechanisms failed. Together, these findings provide clear electrophysiological evidence for predictive proactive stability neural mechanisms, while failing to reveal those of ISPC-dependent predictive reactive stability. Moreover, exploratory analyses provided insights into late corrective reactive stability neural mechanisms, engaged when predictive mechanisms failed.

papers.title: Protocol for a prospective, single-arm pilot trial assessing the clinical and supraspinal neural effects of non-invasive transcranial neuromodulation in adults with overactive bladder.
papers.authors: Salazar BH, Colbert K, Hoffman KA, Khavari R, High RA.
papers.abstract: Background Overactive bladder (OAB) is a prevalent condition characterized by urinary urgency, frequency, and nocturia, with or without urge urinary incontinence. It significantly affects quality of life and is associated with increased rates of depression and sexual dysfunction. Lower urinary tract (LUT) control relies on coordinated activity across peripheral, spinal, and supraspinal networks. Individuals with OAB exhibit abnormal supraspinal network activity. Current treatments primarily target peripheral pathways and have limited efficacy. Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) offers a non-invasive approach to modulate networks involved in LUT control. Methods This prospective, single-center, single-arm, pilot trial evaluates the clinical and neural effects of neuronavigated rTMS in individuals with OAB. Baseline functional MRI (fMRI) guides individualized targeting of OAB-relevant regions. Participants undergo five sessions of low-frequency stimulation of the pelvic supplementary motor area (SMA) followed by high-frequency rTMS to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Primary endpoints are changes in LUT control network functional connectivity (FC) during full and empty bladder conditions. Secondary outcomes include changes in OAB symptoms, urinary frequency and incontinence episodes, quality of life, and patient-perceived bladder condition. Pelvic floor muscle (PFM) electromyography (EMG) recorded during the first and fifth sessions provides exploratory physiological outcomes. Clinical outcomes are assessed immediately, three and six weeks post-treatment. Discussion This study is the first to evaluate non-invasive neuromodulation of supraspinal regions in individuals with OAB. By targeting brain networks involved in LUT control, this neuronavigated approach may improve FC and provide a novel therapeutic strategy for individuals with OAB refractory to conventional treatments. Trial registration number NCT06198439. Participant enrollment and follow-up have been completed.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一项前瞻性单臂预试验方案，旨在评估导航rTMS对成人膀胱过度活动症患者的临床与脑上神经效应，以基线功能磁共振引导个体化靶区，对骨盆辅助运动区行低频刺激、对背外侧前额叶行高频刺激。主要终点是膀胱充盈与排空状态下下尿路控制网络功能连接的变化，次要结局包括症状、排尿频率、漏尿发作、生活质量及患者自感膀胱状况，并辅以盆底肌电探索性指标。作者指出这是首个针对该人群脑上区域无创调控的研究，认为该导航策略可能改善功能连接，为常规治疗无效者提供新思路；但作为预试验，其临床获益尚待验证。

papers.title: Time-frequency EEG markers of word boundaries in speech production.
papers.authors: Eustace SD, Guediche S, Brasiello L, Rocha M, Correia JM.
papers.abstract: Speech production requires orchestration of multiple brain systems that support the unfolding of the spoken message across hierarchical linguistic levels, such as phonemes, syllables, words or phrases. Transitions between linguistic levels are critical for connected speech production, yet the neural dynamics of, for example, syllable-level and word-level transitions remain unknown. In this electroencephalography (EEG) study, we use time-frequency analysis and source localization to determine differences between word-boundary and within-word syllable transitions. To this end, pseudoword pairs comprising a total of six consonant-vowel (CV) syllables with different word-boundary positions were used. Adults produced the pseudoword pairs at the pace of a visual metronome, such that syllables were uttered at matching times independently of their relative positions. Accordingly, target syllables could reference either within-word or between-word syllabic transitions, while other linguistic properties, including articulation, stress patterns, co-articulation or prosody were matched. EEG time-frequency analyses of neural sources revealed sensitivity to hierarchical structure. Sources in left and right inferior frontal lobes, as well as left superior temporal lobe were differentially recruited when producing the same syllables, in the same utterance position, but under different pseudoword boundary contexts. The right inferior frontal source showed extensive time-frequency modulation in word transitions that included elevated event-related synchronization across theta and beta oscillations. Alpha suppression was found in the left superior temporal lobe, possibly related to increased sensory prediction at word onset. Despite efforts to control speech pace and syllable acoustics across conditions, small residual differences in timing and acoustic properties were observed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注连续言语产出中词边界与词内音节过渡的神经动态差异，用脑电时频分析和源定位比较成人在相同节奏下朗读不同词边界位置假词对时的反应。结果显示，左、右额下回及左颞上回等脑源对层级结构敏感：相同音节、相同话语位置在不同词边界情境下被差异性地调用，右额下回在词过渡中表现出跨theta和beta振荡的时频调制增强，左颞上回则出现alpha抑制，可能与词起始处增强的感觉预测有关。作者指出，尽管控制了语速和音节声学特征，时间与声学属性仍有少量残余差异，因此这些脑电标记与词边界的对应关系需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Transcranial Doppler Ultrasonography as a Complementary Exam in Brain Death Determination: Impact on Protocol Duration and ICU Length of Stay-A Single-Center Study in Brazil.
papers.authors: de Freitas MR, de Lima AF, Coutinho CFA.
papers.abstract: Background/objective Brain death (BD) determination is a critical process in intensive care with significant clinical and logistical implications. Transcranial Doppler ultrasonography (TCD) is accepted as a confirmatory exam for BD in Brazil and several international guidelines, yet its operational impact on protocol efficiency remains poorly characterized. We evaluated whether TCD use is associated with shorter BD protocol duration, reduced post-protocol intensive care unit (ICU) length of stay (LOS), and higher organ donation rates. Methods Retrospective cohort study at a tertiary public ICU in Belo Horizonte, Brazil (December 2017-December 2023). We included 178 patients (≥ 18 years) with completed BD protocols, stratified by confirmatory exam: TCD (n = 141) or non-TCD (n = 37; EEG or cerebral angiography). Primary outcome was BD protocol duration (h); secondary outcomes were ICU LOS after protocol initiation (days) and organ donation rate. Negative binomial regression adjusted for age, Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI), Simplified Acute Physiology Score III (SAPS III), sex, calendar year, and protocol opening time (business hours vs. after-hours). Results Groups were comparable in age, CCI, SAPS III, and sex (all p > 0.05). TCD use and business hours were the only independent predictors of protocol duration. TCD was independently associated with a 53.9% reduction in median protocol duration [9h (IQR 5-23 h) vs. 35h (IQR 20-66 h); IRR 0.46, 95% CI 0.33-0.65; p < 0.001]. Subarachnoid hemorrhage was more frequent in the non-TCD group (49% vs. 26%; p = 0.015); ischemic stroke was more frequent in the TCD group (28% vs. 11%; p = 0.047). ICU LOS after protocol initiation was shorter in the TCD group [1 day (IQR 1-2 days) vs. 2 days (IQR 2-3 days); IRR 0.51, 95% CI 0.37-0.70; p < 0.001]. Organ donation rates did not differ significantly (35% vs. 38%; p = 0.876). Conclusions TCD use was independently associated with substantially shorter BD protocol duration and post-protocol ICU LOS in a Brazilian tertiary ICU where confirmatory testing is mandatory. These findings support broader TCD implementation in countries with mandatory confirmatory testing requirements, contingent on trained practitioner availability. Generalizability to settings without this requirement is limited.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在巴西一家三级公立重症监护病房回顾性分析了完成脑死亡判定流程的患者，比较使用经颅多普勒超声与使用其他确认性检查（脑电图或脑血管造影）的差异，主要关注判定流程时长、流程启动后ICU停留时间和器官捐献率。结果显示，使用经颅多普勒超声与判定流程时长和流程后ICU停留时间明显缩短独立相关，而器官捐献率在两组间无显著差异。作者认为，在确认性检查为强制要求的地区，这些发现支持更广泛地应用经颅多普勒超声，但前提是有经过培训的操作人员；该结果能否推广到无此要求的地区则有限。

papers.title: Eight-year longitudinal changes in functional connectivity of the fatigue network in Parkinson's disease: evidence from four timepoints.
papers.authors: Lucas-Jiménez O, Zabala-Gómez O, Nambu I, Zubiaurre-Elorza L, Tijero B, Gabilondo I, Peña J, Ojeda N, Acera MÁ, Del Pino R, Gómez-Esteban JC, Ibarretxe-Bilbao N.
papers.abstract: Fatigue is a prevalent non-motor symptom in Parkinson's disease (PD), yet its long-term neural substrates remain poorly understood. The aim of this study was to characterize eight-year, four-timepoint longitudinal changes in the fatigue-related brain functional connectivity (FC) in PD and examine their associations with fatigue severity. Fifty-one PD patients and 37 healthy controls (HC) were recruited. All variables were assessed at four timepoints: baseline (year-1), year-3, year-5, and year-8. Region of interest (ROI)-to-ROI analyses targeted a predefined fatigue-related network. A visual network served as a control system. Longitudinal FC effects were assessed using a 2 × 4 ANCOVA (group×time), adjusting for age, sex, and Levodopa Equivalent Daily dose. Fatigue severity was measured with the Fatigue Severity Scale. PD patients exhibited a significant progressive reduction in FC between the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) and left dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (dACC) compared with HC. Results remained significant also including depression and global cognition as covariates. Within PD, lower right DLPFC-left dACC FC was associated with higher fatigue, whereas no associations were observed in HC. The fatigue network was specifically associated with fatigue scores, but not with depression or cognition; no longitudinal or fatigue-related effects were found in the visual control network. Across eight years and four assessments, PD is characterized by a gradual disruption of prefrontal-cingulate connectivity within a key fatigue-related hub. This evolving DLPFC-dACC decoupling is linked to worsening fatigue and is specific to the fatigue network, providing preliminary evidence for a neural marker and therapeutic target for fatigue progression in PD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察帕金森病患者疲劳相关脑网络功能连接在八年间的纵向变化及其与疲劳严重程度的关系，比较了51名患者与37名健康对照在四个时间点的静息态功能连接，并以视觉网络作为对照。结果显示，患者右侧背外侧前额叶与左侧背侧前扣带之间的功能连接随时间逐渐减弱，且该连接越低，疲劳越重；这一关联在健康对照中未出现，控制抑郁和整体认知后仍成立。疲劳网络与疲劳评分相关，而与抑郁、认知无关，视觉对照网络也未出现纵向或疲劳相关效应。作者据此认为，前额叶-扣带连接的逐步解耦可能是帕金森病疲劳进展的初步神经标记和潜在干预靶点，但相关发现尚属初步，不能直接推及临床疗效。

papers.title: Scale-Dependent Development of Neural Signal Complexity and its Association with Working Memory in Childhood.
papers.authors: Han J, Liang L, Ding J, Zhao J, Li X.
papers.abstract: Neural development during childhood involves progressive reorganization of brain dynamics across multiple temporal scales. The present study examined developmental differences in neural signal complexity, indexed by modified multiscale entropy (mMSE), in 253 typically developing children aged 3-9 years. Resting-state EEG was analyzed across 20 temporal scales spanning approximately 4-80 ms, and age-related differences were assessed using linear mixed-effects models with sex included as a covariate. Results showed systematic age-related increases in neural signal complexity, with developmental effects varying across individual temporal scales and scalp regions. Although positive age-related effects were observed across multiple scales, their magnitude differed across temporal resolutions, indicating a scale-dependent pattern of neural maturation. In addition, regional mMSE values showed positive associations with short-term working memory capacity, with significant effects observed in frontal, occipital, and temporal regions across multiple temporal scales.Together, these findings indicate that childhood brain maturation is characterized by scale-dependent increases in neural temporal complexity that are associated with the development of working memory.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童期神经信号复杂性随年龄发展的变化及其与工作记忆的关系，分析了3至9岁典型发育儿童的静息态脑电，并在多个时间尺度上计算多尺度熵。结果显示，神经信号复杂性随年龄增长而上升，但不同时间尺度和头皮区域的效应大小并不一致，呈现出尺度依赖的成熟模式。此外，部分区域的信号复杂性与短时工作记忆容量呈正相关，提示儿童脑成熟过程中时间复杂性的尺度依赖性增长可能与工作记忆发展相关；但这一关联并不等同于因果或干预效果。

papers.title: What Static Connectivity Misses: Dynamic Alpha-Band Brain Network States in First-Episode Psychosis.
papers.authors: Aubonnet R, Hassan M, Gargiulo P, Seri S, Di Lorenzo G.
papers.abstract: This study investigates resting-state EEG alpha-band connectivity in first-episode psychosis (FEP) using a novel dynamic connectivity pipeline and examines its relationship with cognitive functioning and psychopathological scores. Data from 78 individuals with FEP and 60 healthy controls (CTR) were analyzed. Source estimation was performed using eLORETA, and connectivity was quantified with the weighted phase-lag index. Static connectivity matrices were assessed using graph theory and edge-wise metrics. Dynamic connectivity matrices were clustered into five distinct brain network states (BNS) using a modified k-means algorithm, from which temporal and graph theory metrics were extracted. Static connectivity metrics revealed lower alpha connectivity in FEP than in controls. The dynamic approach identified reduced variability in the characteristic path length within the default mode network-associated BNS 1 in FEP, suggesting diminished adaptive modulation of functional integration. Subgroup analysis by medication status uncovered distinct BNS signatures for medicated and unmedicated FEP. BNS metrics were correlated with social cognition measures in CTR and with positive formal thought disorder in FEP, whereas static metrics showed no such associations. These findings suggest that relative to static connectivity metrics, dynamic connectivity provides non-redundant information and underscores the impact of medication on neural dynamics in psychosis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以静息态脑电α频段连接为切入点，比较首发精神病患者与健康对照，并考察连接特征与认知功能和精神病理评分的关系。静态分析显示患者α连接整体低于对照；动态分析进一步发现，患者在与默认网络相关的脑网络状态中特征路径长度的变异性降低，提示其功能整合的适应性调节减弱。按用药状态分组后，用药与未用药患者呈现不同的网络状态特征，且动态指标与对照的社会认知、患者的阳性形式思维障碍相关，静态指标则未见此类关联。作者据此认为，动态连接能提供静态指标之外的非冗余信息，并强调用药对精神病神经动力学的影响。

papers.title: Chronic kidney disease and cognitive decline: choroid plexus remodeling, glymphatic dysfunction, and alzheimer biomarker interpretation.
papers.authors: Corrêa LMA, Oliveira da Silva R, Brandão LKV, Delmiro Silva YR, da Silva ÉVB, Tretow J, Gomes EDC, Fernandes CCS, Moreira GNCM, Zanella J.
papers.journal: Neurological sciences : official journal of the Italian Neurological Society and of the Italian Society of Clinical Neurophysiology
papers.abstract: Background Cognitive impairment is common in chronic kidney disease (CKD), yet vascular, uremic, dialysis-related, and neurodegenerative mechanisms are often considered separately. We propose an integrated kidney-brain tissue-environment framework to support neurological interpretation of cognitive, imaging, and biomarker findings in CKD. Methods We conducted a narrative synthesis of clinical, neuroimaging, experimental, and biomarker studies retrieved from PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science through June 2026, focusing on barrier dysfunction, choroid plexus remodeling, cerebrospinal fluid dynamics, neurovascular coupling, white-matter injury, glymphatic-related imaging markers, and Alzheimer disease-related plasma biomarkers. Results CKD is associated with convergent vascular, inflammatory, toxic, barrier, and neurofluid-related abnormalities that may contribute to a mixed cognitive phenotype. Human studies report choroid plexus enlargement, lower diffusion tensor image analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) indices, altered cerebrospinal fluid-related signal coupling, and neurovascular decoupling; however, evidence is predominantly cross-sectional and does not establish temporal or causal sequencing. Choroid plexus enlargement is morphologically nonspecific, while DTI-ALPS reflects a composite tissue environment rather than direct glymphatic flow. Reduced kidney function may also increase plasma phosphorylated tau, amyloid-β, neurofilament light chain, and glial fibrillary acidic protein concentrations. Ratio-based measures may attenuate, but do not uniformly eliminate, kidney-related confounding. Conclusions CKD should be regarded as an active modifier of cognitive phenotype, neuroimaging interpretation, and plasma biomarker assessment. The proposed framework is testable rather than causal and supports reporting kidney function, dialysis context, and multimodal markers when evaluating cognitive decline.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇叙述性综述，梳理慢性肾脏病（CKD）中认知障碍的血管、炎症、毒性、屏障及神经流体等多重机制，提出一个整合肾脏与脑组织-环境的框架，用于解释CKD患者的认知、影像和生物标志物发现。作者指出，人类研究报道了脉络丛增大、DTI-ALPS指数降低、脑脊液相关信号耦合改变和神经血管解耦，但证据多为横断面，无法确立时间或因果顺序；脉络丛增大形态上不特异，DTI-ALPS反映的是复合组织环境而非直接反映类淋巴流。肾功能下降还可能升高血浆磷酸化tau、淀粉样β、神经丝轻链和GFAP浓度，基于比值的指标可部分但非一致地减轻肾脏相关混杂。作者据此认为CKD是认知表型、神经影像解读和血浆生物标志物评估的主动修饰因素，所提框架可检验而非因果，并建议评估认知下降时报告肾功能、透析背景和多模态标志物。

papers.title: Rapid Resolution of Apophenic Psychosis With Low-Dose Olanzapine in Very Late-Onset Schizophrenia-Like Psychosis.
papers.authors: Jamal Y, Mohamed MA, Malik N.
papers.abstract: Very late‑onset schizophrenia‑like psychosis (VLOSLP) presents diagnostic complexity due to the broad range of medical, neurological, and psychiatric conditions that can manifest with late‑life psychosis. We describe a case of a man in his mid‑70s who developed progressive apophenic experiences, characterised by the perception of patterns, rhythms, and "algorithms" in everyday environments, leading to referential beliefs and behavioural change. Investigations showed normal blood tests, preserved cognitive screening scores, and MRI evidence of chronic white matter ischaemic changes and diffuse cerebral atrophy. Differential diagnoses included vascular psychosis, autoimmune encephalitis, obsessive-compulsive disorder with poor insight, and neurodegenerative disease; however, the overall presentation was most consistent with VLOSLP. The patient was treated using a bio‑psycho‑social approach, with limited response to quetiapine but rapid and sustained remission following initiation of low‑dose olanzapine. Symptom recurrence after dose reduction further supported a primary psychotic process. This case highlights an atypical presentation of VLOSLP dominated by apophenia and underscores the importance of thorough assessment and cautious, individualised antipsychotic treatment in older adults.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例70多岁男性出现的极晚发型精神分裂症样精神病，其突出表现为逐渐加重的“无端关联”体验，即在日常环境中感知到模式、节律和“算法”，并由此产生关系性信念和行为改变。检查未发现血液或认知筛查异常，影像仅见慢性白质缺血性改变和弥漫性脑萎缩，鉴别诊断涵盖血管性精神病、自身免疫性脑炎、伴自知力差的强迫症和神经退行性疾病，但整体表现最符合极晚发型精神分裂症样精神病。患者接受生物-心理-社会干预，喹硫平效果有限，改用低剂量奥氮平后症状迅速且持续缓解，减量后复发进一步支持原发性精神病过程。作者据此提示，该病可有不以幻觉妄想为主、而以无端关联体验为核心的非典型表现，并强调老年患者需全面评估和谨慎的个体化抗精神病药治疗。

papers.title: When Speech Signals Wilson Disease: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Zahid AA, Ehsan N, Ali MM, Ahmed H, Amjad U.
papers.abstract: Wilson disease (WD) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder of copper metabolism that usually presents with a wide spectrum of seemingly unrelated symptoms, such as dysarthria, tremors, dystonia, features of advanced liver disease, and psychiatric manifestations. Atypical presentation may lead to delayed diagnosis. We present the case of a 25-year-old man who presented with slurred speech and abdominal distension. Workup revealed the presence of Kayser-Fleischer rings, reduced serum ceruloplasmin levels, elevated 24-hour urinary excretion of copper, and decompensated liver disease. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain was significant for altered signals in the basal ganglia, thalami, and periventricular white matter. He was diagnosed with WD and commenced on D-penicillamine and zinc therapy, with clinical improvement on follow-up. This case signifies that WD must be considered in any adult presenting with unexplained neurological symptoms. Early diagnosis is essential to prevent disease progression and complications.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一篇病例报告，报告一名以言语含糊和腹胀起病的年轻男性，经检查发现角膜K-F环、血清铜蓝蛋白降低、尿铜升高及失代偿性肝病，脑MRI显示基底节、丘脑和脑室周围白质信号异常，最终诊断为Wilson病，接受D-青霉胺和锌治疗后随访临床改善。作者据此提示，对出现不明原因神经系统症状的成人应考虑Wilson病，早期诊断对防止疾病进展和并发症十分重要。该文为单个病例的经验总结，不能据此推断治疗疗效或普遍适用性。

papers.title: Two dominant axes structure high-dimensional object representations in the human ventral temporal cortex
papers.authors: Wang Y, Zhuang K, Liang X, Feng J, Hebart M, Vatansever D.
papers.abstract: The ventral temporal cortex is critical for visual object recognition, yet the principles organising its representations remain unclear. Using ultra-high-field 7T fMRI and dense sampling of 1,854 object concepts, we applied exploratory factor analysis to multivoxel response patterns to estimate the main axes of representational variation. Despite high dimensionality, over half of the explainable variance concentrated along two dominant axes: a continuum spanning objects of high biological salience, and a second integrating spatial context, physical scale, and manipulability. Importantly, neither reduced to a single semantic label, instead reflecting mixtures of visual and conceptual properties. Together they defined a triangular geometry, anchored by animal-, furniture- and food-related objects, stable across participants and two independent datasets, that mapped onto a lateral-to-medial cortical gradient, with category-selective regions emerging as local peaks within a broader continuum. These findings reveal that high-dimensional object representations in the ventral temporal cortex are structured by a small number of interpretable axes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注腹侧颞叶皮层如何组织高维视觉物体表征，利用超高场7T fMRI密集采样大量物体概念，并对多体素反应模式做探索性因子分析以估计表征变异的主要轴。结果显示，尽管表征维度很高，可解释方差中过半集中于两条主导轴：一条跨越生物显著性较高的物体，另一条整合空间情境、物理尺度和可操作性；两者都不能归结为单一语义标签，而是混合了视觉与概念属性。这两条轴构成以动物、家具和食物相关物体为锚点的三角几何结构，在不同参与者和两个独立数据集中保持稳定，并对应外侧到内侧的皮层梯度，类别选择性区域则表现为这一连续体上的局部峰值。作者据此认为，腹侧颞叶皮层的高维物体表征由少数可解释的轴所组织。

papers.title: Convergent connectivity of sleep disorders and its neurotransmitter and cell enrichment correlates
papers.authors: Afshani M, Saberi A, Reimann GM, Chu C, Elmenhorst D, Lotter L, Valk SL, Dukart J, Genon S, Müller VI, Eickhoff SB, Tahmasian M.
papers.abstract: Sleep disorders are highly prevalent and impose a substantial public health burden, yet the neurobiological mechanisms underlying shared and disorder-specific abnormalities remain incompletely understood. We conducted a pre-registered transdiagnostic study to identify shared and distinct normative macroscale connectivity patterns associated with reported brain abnormalities across insomnia disorder, obstructive sleep apnea, narcolepsy, and rapid eye movement sleep behavior disorder, and to characterize their microscale neurotransmitter and cellular correlates. We obtained peak coordinates from 80 experiments reporting meta-analytic brain abnormalities across these four sleep disorders. Convergent connectivity mapping was then applied to these coordinates using dense connectivity matrices derived from 100 unrelated participants from the Human Connectome Project, with connectivity patterns evaluated relative to a null distribution generated from randomly selected foci. We subsequently examined the spatial correspondence of the identified connectivity maps with 19 neurotransmitter systems using curated positron emission tomography-derived density maps and assessed cellular enrichment across 24 cell-type systems using regional gene-expression profiles from the Allen Human Brain Atlas. Statistical significance was assessed using spin-based permutation testing and false discovery rate correction (pFDR < 0.05). Shared convergent connectivity patterns were identified within the default mode network (zmean = 1.103, pspin,FDR = 0.019), as well as the dorsal attention (zmean = −0.674, pspin,FDR = 0.014) and frontoparietal (zmean = −0.239, pspin,FDR = 0.019) resting-state networks. Disorder-specific analyses revealed broadly overlapping connectivity patterns, with some disorder-related variability. Both transdiagnostic and disorder-specific connectivity patterns showed selective spatial correspondence with multiple neurotransmitter systems, including serotonin, dopamine, norepinephrine, and glutamate, and were enriched for excitatory, inhibitory, and non-neuronal cell types (pFDR < 0.05). These findings indicate that sleep disorders share convergent macroscale connectivity architecture while also exhibiting disorder-specific variations, with the identified network patterns linked to distinct neurotransmitter and cellular profiles. Together, the results provide a normative systems-level framework for understanding shared and distinct neurobiological mechanisms across sleep disorders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对失眠障碍、阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停、发作性睡病和快速眼动睡眠行为障碍，从已发表的脑异常坐标出发，结合连接矩阵与随机对照分布，考察四种睡眠障碍共享和特异的宏观连接模式及其神经递质与细胞层面的关联。结果显示，跨诊断的汇聚连接主要涉及默认模式网络以及背侧注意和额顶静息态网络，各障碍的特异模式则大体重叠并存在一定变异。这些连接模式与血清素、多巴胺、去甲肾上腺素和谷氨酸等多个递质系统存在选择性空间对应，并富集于兴奋性、抑制性和非神经元细胞类型。作者据此提出，睡眠障碍在共享连接架构的同时保留障碍特异性差异，为理解其共同的系统层面机制提供了框架。

papers.title: Brain functional dynamics linked to depression and anxiety: cross-sectional and longitudinal associations over 9 years
papers.authors: Lopez JG, Van Wingen G, Jansen R, Labus J, Penninx BW.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) co-activation patterns (CAPs) capture recurrent whole-brain states that may index neurobiological substrates of affective psychopathology, but whether their temporal dynamics co-evolve with symptom severity over the naturalistic long-term course of depression and anxiety remains unknown. Methods We examined rs-fMRI and clinical data from 340 participants of the NESDA neuroimaging cohort [228 with major depression (MDD) and/or an anxiety disorder (AFF), 112 controls (CTR)] collected at baseline (Y0), 2-year (Y2), and 9-year (Y9) follow-up. Four CAPs were identified, internally validated, externally replicated against an independent dataset, and quantified by dwell time (time spent of each brain CAP) and entries (initiation of each CAP). These metrics were related to depression symptomatology (IDS score), anxiety (BAI), and fear (FQ) severity at two levels: cross-sectionally, between subjects and groups, and longitudinally, through within-person associations between changes in CAP expression and changes in symptoms severity. Results At baseline, attention–somatomotor (AT-SM CAP ) dwell time was negatively associated with depression severity in controls (rho = −0.29, q < 0.05), an association absent in individuals with AFF ( rho = 0.09, q = 0.79;). Longitudinally, group-level CAP trajectories did not differ between AFF and CTR, but within-person changes in frontoparietal–default-mode (FP-DM CAP ) dwell time tracked changes in depression severity exclusively in AFF (Y2→Y9: rho = 0.47, q = 0.04). Patients whose FP-DM CAP dwell time increased were those whose depression failed to improve. Conclusions CAP dwell time carried clinical meaning at two levels: AT-SM CAP distinguished health from illness at baseline, while FP-DM CAP dwell time indexed within-person illness course over nine years. Because FP-DM CAP co-activates frontoparietal control with default-mode regions implicated in rumination, its rebound in dwell time may reflect a shift toward perseverative self-referential processing in patients who fail to remit. These findings position CAP dwell-time–symptom coupling as a neurobiologically grounded, individually resolved marker of naturalistic illness course relevant to precision psychiatry.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于静息态fMRI共激活模式（CAP），考察其时间动态是否与抑郁和焦虑症状在自然长期病程中共同变化，比较了患者组与对照组在基线和多年随访中的表现。结果显示，基线时注意—感觉运动CAP的停留时间与对照组抑郁严重度呈负相关，而这一关联在患者中未出现；纵向看，组间CAP轨迹无差异，但仅在患者中，额顶—默认网络CAP停留时间的个体内变化与抑郁严重度变化同步，停留时间增加者抑郁未见改善。作者据此提出，不同CAP的停留时间在横断面和纵向层面分别承载临床意义，额顶—默认网络CAP的回升可能反映未缓解患者转向反复的自我参照加工，提示其作为个体化病程标记的潜力，但相关发现仍属关联性证据。

papers.title: Epigenetic misprogramming of cell differentiation links transient viral infection to chronic diseases across tissues
papers.authors: Friedenson B.
papers.abstract: Virus-induced epigenetic changes in stem-cell differentiation pathways emerge here as a shared mechanism linking fundamentally different chronic diseases, offering candidate biomarkers and new intervention targets. Chronic diseases increasingly trace back to transient viral exposure, yet unrelated pathologies also arise in tissues showing no signs of infection. Using Epstein–Barr virus (EBV), I show that different chronic EBV-associated diseases share epigenetic misprogramming within stem-cell differentiation hierarchies. These alterations propagate across diverse cell lineages, creating latent vulnerabilities unmasked by secondary insults. Breast cancer, long debated for possible EBV involvement, carries EBV-like methylation signatures in both precursor and invasive lesions, independent of lymphocytic infiltration. In multiple sclerosis, three independent cohorts (non-pathologic brain tissue, normal-appearing white matter, and blood) showed methylation abnormalities in the same stem-cell differentiation pathways disrupted in proven EBV-driven tumors and breast cancer. These findings identify virus-induced lineage misprogramming as an occult cross-disease mechanism supported by direct primary evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以EBV为切入点，探讨短暂病毒感染如何通过表观遗传改变与多种慢性疾病相关联。作者发现，不同的EBV相关慢性疾病在干细胞分化层级上存在共有的表观遗传错误编程，这些改变可跨细胞谱系传播，形成由后续损伤暴露的潜在脆弱性。乳腺癌的前驱和浸润性病变中均可见EBV样甲基化特征，且不依赖淋巴细胞浸润；多发性硬化患者多个独立队列的脑组织和血液样本也显示相同干细胞分化通路的甲基化异常。研究据此提出，病毒诱导的谱系错误编程可能是一种隐匿的跨疾病机制，但相关发现仍需进一步验证其因果性和临床意义。

papers.title: Cortical microarchitecture supports preadolescent functional brain network connectivity
papers.authors: Bottenhorn KL, Sukumaran K, Morrel J, Cardenas-Iniguez C, Herting MM.
papers.abstract: A century ago, Brodmann suggested that local cortical microarchitecture dictates function, yet modern structure– function mapping overwhelmingly focuses on white matter macroarchitecture. Here, we reframe structure-function coupling by linking gray matter microarchitecture and macroscale connectomics, demonstrating how gray matter cellular and neurite density are linked to functional network organization in preadolescents. By applying partial least squares correlation to cortical microarchitecture (i.e., cellular and neurite density) estimates from diffusion MRI and network connectivity estimates from functional MRI, in 6,320 children ages 9-11 years from the U.S.-wide Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, we identified several principles of structure-function coupling. First, we found that functional connectivity is associated with one dominant and global pattern of cellular density differences explaining nearly 80% of shared variance, but by several patterns of neurite density differences. Second, we found similar gradients of sensorimotor network connectivity related to this dominant cellular density pattern and the secondary, rostro-caudal neurite density pattern (explaining 17% of shared variance). Third, we found a profile of attention network connectivity associated with the primary neurite density pattern (44% of shared variance) and the secondary, rostro-caudal cellular density pattern (5% of shared variance). Altogether, this work suggests that cellular density (i.e., neuronal cell bodies, support cells) across cortex largely supports a sensorimotor network connectivity gradient. Conversely, there are several connectivity-related patterns of neurite density (i.e., axons, dendrites) across cortex, providing a glimpse into how local neurite connectivity may differentially support long-range functional connectivity of sensorimotor networks and attention networks.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年前期皮层灰质微结构（细胞密度与神经突密度）如何与宏观功能网络连接相对应，利用扩散MRI和功能MRI数据，对大规模儿童样本采用偏最小二乘相关分析。结果发现，功能连接主要与一个全局性的细胞密度模式相关，该模式解释了大部分共享变异，而神经突密度则对应多个连接模式；感觉运动网络连接与主导细胞密度模式及次级神经突密度模式呈现相似梯度，注意网络连接则主要与主导神经突密度模式相关。作者据此提出，皮层细胞密度大体支持感觉运动网络连接的梯度组织，而神经突密度的多种模式可能差异化地支撑感觉运动与注意网络的长程功能连接。

papers.title: Hippocampal and cortical oscillations support the encoding of event memories during movie watching
papers.authors: Silva M, Wu X, Sabio M, Conde-Blanco E, Roldan P, Donaire A, Carreño M, Fuentemilla L, Baldassano C, Jacobs J.
papers.abstract: Remembering temporally-extended experiences requires integrating information over time into coherent event representations that can be stored and later retrieved. Oscillatory dynamics may provide a flexible mechanism to support these operations by coordinating communication across regions and organizing neural activity in time. Yet most evidence for the oscillatory basis of episodic encoding comes from discrete-stimulus paradigms, leaving unclear whether these mechanisms can help organize memory during continuous experience. Using iEEG recorded while participants watched a 50-min film, we measured how power, synchrony and phase alignment support memory formation at the beginning, middle, and end of the events. At event onset, remembered events showed reduced gamma power with increased hippocampal–frontal synchrony, indicating that successful events begin with transient long-range coordination rather than heightened local processing. Within an event, memory was predicted by the direction of change, with recalled events showing increases in temporal gamma power and hippocampal–temporal gamma synchrony, consistent with the progressive binding of incoming information into a developing event representation. At the end of an event, memory was supported by an increase in hippocampal theta power and a phase resetting. Temporal gamma power was likewise elevated and hippocampal–temporal gamma synchrony increased, suggesting that information bound locally over the course of the event might be transmitted to the hippocampus as the event closes. Frontal beta power decreased at the same moment, consistent with disruption of the outgoing event model. Naturalistic memory formation therefore does not rest on a sustained encoding state, but on the appropriate temporal coordination and stability of oscillatory states across brain regions and event phases, in which stable oscillatory states support ongoing representation while transient, boundary-driven reorganization of hippocampal–cortical networks switches the system between consolidating the completed event and encoding the next.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用颅内脑电记录参与者观看长片电影时的脑活动，考察连续自然体验中事件记忆编码的振荡机制。结果显示，记忆形成并非依赖持续稳定的编码状态，而是随事件阶段变化：事件开始时，被记住的事件伴随局部伽马功率下降和跨区长程同步增强；事件进行中，记忆与伽马功率及海马—颞叶同步的变化方向相关，反映信息逐步绑定；事件结束时，海马theta功率升高并出现相位重置，同时额叶beta功率下降，提示完成事件向下一事件的切换。作者据此认为，自然情境下的记忆编码依赖不同脑区振荡状态在事件各阶段间的适时协调与重组。

papers.title: Talking Brains: Neonatal Aperiodic Activity in Resting State EEG Relates to Later Communicative Abilities
papers.authors: Reimann-Ayiköz M, Ameen MS, Reisenberger E, Florea C, Preiß J, Angerer M, Schabus M, Roehm D, Heib D, Männel C.
papers.abstract: Communicative abilities acquired over the first year of life are foundational for language development. Understanding the neural mechanisms underlying these abilities can explain individual differences and improve predictions of later language outcomes. While prior research on neural markers of language development has focused predominantly on oscillatory neural activity, the underlying aperiodic component of the neural signal may provide further insights into cortical maturation by indirectly reflecting variation in neural excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance. In neurodevelopmental conditions, both reduced and elevated aperiodic activity are linked to atypical development, and initial evidence from at-risk cohorts also relates aperiodic activity to language outcome. Moving beyond clinical populations, the present study examined whether aperiodic activity during neonatal resting-state EEG relates to 12-month communicative abilities in typically developing infants. Aperiodic offset and exponent were extracted from resting-state EEG recorded two weeks after birth in n = 50 neonates using the FOOOF algorithm. At 12 months, communicative abilities were assessed with the parent-report CSBS-DP Infant-Toddler Checklist. Quadratic regression analyses showed an inverted U-shaped relationship between the neonatal aperiodic exponent and communicative abilities: both lower and higher exponent values were associated with poorer outcomes, with intermediate values linked to better abilities. No robust association was found for the offset. These findings suggest that aperiodic activity captures variability in early communicative development, with an optimum at intermediate levels, consistent with a balanced E/I state. The scope of aperiodic brain activity as a developmental marker may thus extend beyond clinical populations to predicting communicative development in healthy infants.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察新生儿静息态脑电的非周期活动能否预测其后的沟通能力发展，对足月健康新生儿在出生两周时记录脑电并提取非周期偏移与指数，至12个月时用家长报告量表评估沟通能力。结果显示，非周期指数与后续沟通能力呈倒U形关系：指数偏低或偏高均对应较差表现，中间水平对应较好能力，而偏移未见稳定关联。作者据此认为，非周期活动可能间接反映兴奋/抑制平衡，其作为发育标记的适用范围或可延伸至健康婴儿的沟通发展预测，但这一关联并非因果，且样本与随访范围有限。

papers.title: Structural, Functional and Cognitive Validation of a Deep-Learning MCI-to-AD Conversion Model in OASIS-3
papers.authors: Fin S, Moayedikia A.
papers.abstract: Background Deep-learning models predict mild cognitive impairment (MCI)-to-Alzheimer’s disease (AD) conversion from structural MRI with high accuracy. However, they are typically validated within a single cohort and judged on discrimination alone. Whether their risk scores are biologically grounded, and whether they generalise to independent data, remains unclear. Methods We applied the ADNI-trained Temporal Adaptive Fusion Network (TAF-Net), without retraining, to 101 MCI participants from OASIS-3 (25 converters, 76 stable) and tested whether its conversion-risk scores were grounded in independent structural, functional, and cognitive markers of AD. Regional atrophy rates were derived from longitudinal FreeSurfer, cognition from longitudinal MMSE and CDR-Sum-of-Boxes, and baseline resting-state functional connectivity from fMRIPrep, in structural and functional subsamples of 41 and 40 participants. Associations used rank-based statistics with false-discovery-rate correction. Results Higher TAF-Net risk tracked faster atrophy in medial-temporal AD-signature regions but not in AD-spared cortex — an anatomically specific coupling that survived adjustment for global atrophy. In external validation, risk discriminated converters (AUC = 0.72), comparable to native atrophy and strongly concordant with it; atrophy statistically accounted for the model’s prognostic signal. Discrimination transferred but calibration did not: the two lowest tertiles of risk were assigned near-zero probability yet converted at 15%. Risk also tracked the multi-year rate of cognitive decline and, at baseline, was associated with reduced within-network functional-connectivity integrity, concentrated in salience and default-mode hubs; longitudinal functional analyses were underpowered. Conclusions A conversion model trained on one cohort produced risk scores that, in an independent cohort, were grounded in the structural, functional, and cognitive hallmarks of Alzheimer’s disease — supporting biological validity and external generalisation. The score, however, largely re-expresses the neurodegenerative substrate captured by structural atrophy. Rank ordering transferred across cohorts but absolute risk did not, so the score requires recalibration before its values can be interpreted as individual probabilities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将在一个队列训练的深度学习轻度认知障碍向阿尔茨海默病转化预测模型不经再训练应用于独立队列，考察其风险评分是否具有结构、功能和认知层面的生物学依据。结果显示，较高风险与内侧颞叶等AD特征区的更快萎缩相关，而与AD相对保留的皮层无关；风险评分能区分转化者，但其预后信号在很大程度上可由结构萎缩解释。风险还伴随多年认知下降速度，并在基线时与显著性网络和默认网络枢纽的功能连接完整性降低相关。研究提示该评分主要重新表达了结构萎缩所反映的神经退行性基础，排序可跨队列迁移但绝对风险校准不佳，需重新校准后才能解释为个体概率。

papers.title: Expanded Access use of Intravenous Gene Transfer with AAV9-GLB1 in a Juvenile GM1 Gangliosidosis Participant
papers.authors: Lewis CJ, Akmal H, D’Souza P, Johnston JM, Ashraf S, Vezina G, Chipman SI, Blackwood M, Yousef MH, Quezado Z, Gahl WA, Byrne BJ, Flotte TR, Jiang X, Thurm A, Gross AL, Keeler AM, Martin DR, Sena-Esteves M, Gray-Edwards HL, Wang RY, Acosta MT, Tifft CJ.
papers.abstract: GM1 gangliosidosis is an inherited and progressively neurodegenerative lysosomal storage disorder with no approved therapy. We report 5-year safety and 3-year clinical, biochemical, and neuroimaging efficacy outcomes following expanded-access intravenous AAV9-GLB1 gene therapy in GT01, a 6-10-year-old female with juvenile-onset GM1 gangliosidosis. During participation in a natural history study before gene transfer, GT01 developed seizures, dysarthria, loss of ambulation, and progressive neurodegeneration. She received a single intravenous administration of AAV9-GLB1 at 1.5×10 13 vector genomes per kilogram of body weight. Early improvements included the resolution of dysphagia, increased interactions with others, assisted ambulation, and gains in specific domains of adaptive functioning. She was seizure-free without anti-epileptic drugs 18 months post dosing with sustained seizure freedom at the study completion. Cerebrospinal fluid concentrations of GM1 ganglioside and H3N2b (a pentasaccharide biomarker indicative of biochemical improvement in this disorder) concentrations decreased by 50% and β-galactosidase reached normal activity. Brain, thalamic, and net fiber tract volume assessed by differential tractography increased and ventriculomegaly improved three years post-dosing. These results indicate that meaningful benefit can be achieved even in advanced neurologic disease.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一项针对青少年型GM1神经节苷脂沉积症患者的扩大可及性个案报告，患者接受单次静脉注射AAV9-GLB1基因治疗，研究描述了治疗后5年的安全性及3年的临床、生化和神经影像学结局。治疗前患者已出现癫痫、构音障碍、丧失行走能力和进行性神经退行性变；治疗后早期可见吞咽困难缓解、与人互动增多、可在辅助下行走及适应性功能部分改善，且停用抗癫痫药后无癫痫发作。脑脊液中GM1神经节苷脂和H3N2b浓度下降，β-半乳糖苷酶活性恢复正常，影像学显示脑、丘脑及净纤维束体积增加、脑室扩大改善。作者据此认为，即使神经系统病变已较严重，仍可能获得有意义的获益，但该结论来自单个个案，需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Diffusion tensor imaging measurements for computer-aided diagnosis of autism: derived data from ABIDE II.
papers.authors: Cardenas-Hernandez NA, Perez-Diaz M, García-Ramó KB, Valdés Hernández MDC.
papers.abstract: Advancing the understanding of neuroimaging biomarkers in neurodevelopmental research requires structured, well-documented datasets to support reproducibility and comparative analyses. This dataset comprises diffusion MRI-derived measurements from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE II) database-fractional anisotropy (FA), axial diffusivity (AD), mean diffusivity (MD), and radial diffusivity (RD)-across multiple brain regions for both ASD and control groups, associated with unique image identifiers. Data were generated using standardized image acquisition and computational processing pipelines, resulting in uniformly processed and reproducible quantitative region-specific metrics to facilitate cross-sectional comparative studies. The dataset is structured with explicit metadata, detailed variable descriptions, and complete case records to support programmatic access and automated workflows. Data visualization and harmonization codes accompany the dataset. This resource enables the investigation of white matter microstructural properties in relation to autism through different analytical approaches, including hypothesis testing, machine learning, and meta-analyses. The structured format and transparent documentation promote its reuse in other neuroimaging studies. FAIR2 Data Portal: https://www.doi.org/10.71728/senscience.dbrh-5zc8.
papers.summary_zh: 该数据集整理自ABIDE II数据库，提供孤独症谱系障碍组与对照组在多个脑区的弥散MRI衍生指标（各向异性、轴向扩散率、平均扩散率和径向扩散率），并配有标准化采集与处理流程、明确元数据及可视化与协调代码。其核心价值在于形成统一处理、可复现的区域特异性定量数据，便于开展横断面比较，支持假设检验、机器学习和荟萃分析等分析路径，用于考察白质微结构特征与孤独症的关系。作为数据资源而非原始实验研究，它本身不报告诊断效能或组间差异结论，主要意义是促进数据复用与可重复研究。

papers.title: Material context moderates the occupation-adjusted association between Visualization and prefrontal hemodynamics during naturalistic design: an exploratory wearable fNIRS study.
papers.authors: Nagamori Y, Suzuki F, Isobe M, Miyoshi H, Shikata T, Ando T, Yaegashi K.
papers.abstract: It remains unclear whether individual differences in a design-related disposition relate to prefrontal hemodynamics during naturalistic design, and whether the material context of the task moderates any such association. We addressed this using the Visualization subscale of the design attitude measure (DAM), a preference for externalizing ideas visually that we treat here as a continuous disposition beyond the designer job label. Thirty-nine working adults completed an open-ended block-building chair-design task using a constrained material set and a broader, higher-variety material set. Prefrontal total-hemoglobin change was recorded with a wearable two-channel fNIRS device (NeU HOT-2000; Fp1/Fp2; a single 810-nm wavelength; 10 Hz), and each self-paced trial was resampled onto a common proportional-time axis. Visualization was higher in designers than non-designers (d = 1.07). After adjusting for occupation, higher Visualization was associated with a greater broad-constrained Fp2 difference. This Condition × Visualization interaction was localized to a single window at 60-79% of the proportional timeline at Fp2 (cluster-corrected p = 0.013), with no cluster at Fp1; however, the formal between-channel comparison was not significant, so channel specificity was not established. Within this window, the effect remained significant in all 39 leave-one-out refits. The positive simple slope was present under the broad set but not the constrained set; the broad set was also rated as less difficult, more enjoyable, and more conducive to idea generation. Adjusting for occupation increased the whole-design estimate from β = +0.11 to +0.19, because occupation and Visualization related to the Fp2 difference in opposite directions (at a given Visualization level, designer status was associated with a smaller broad-constrained difference), a statistical suppression that separates the visual-externalization disposition from the occupational label; this whole-design estimate was sensitive to one participant. The findings indicate a material-context-dependent association between Visualization (a continuous disposition rather than a proxy for the designer category) and the prefrontal hemodynamic signal, and call for preregistered replication. De-identified data are openly available.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究考察设计相关倾向“可视化”（将想法外化为视觉形式的偏好）是否与自然设计任务中的前额叶血流动力学相关，以及材料情境是否调节这一关联。39名在职成人分别用受限材料和种类更丰富的材料完成积木椅子设计任务，同时用可穿戴双通道fNIRS记录前额叶总血红蛋白变化。结果显示，在控制职业后，可视化倾向较高者在材料更丰富条件下Fp2通道出现更大的血流动力学差异，这一关联仅在任务时间轴中段的一个窗口内显著，且在受限材料条件下不存在；但通道间比较不显著，通道特异性未获确立。作者据此认为，可视化倾向与设计过程中前额叶血流信号的关系依赖材料情境，并强调需预注册研究重复验证。

papers.title: The gut microbiota-short-chain fatty acid-inflammation axis in Parkinson's disease motor dysfunction: mechanisms and future of dietary interventions.
papers.authors: Wang W, Sun W, Ma L, Xu M, Dong X.
papers.abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized mainly by motor dysfunction that severely affects quality of life. In recent years, the gut microbiota and its metabolites, short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), have become a focus in PD research. These factors are proposed to influence disease progression, potentially by modulating neuroinflammation and gut-brain axis signaling, although the causal relationship between specific microbial metabolites and clinical deterioration remains to be conclusively demonstrated in human studies. PD patients show characteristic gut dysbiosis, with fewer beneficial SCFA-producing bacteria and more pro-inflammatory bacteria, which may drive disease progression via the gut-brain axis. Dietary interventions can regulate the gut microbiota, increase SCFA levels, and reduce inflammation, and have shown promise for improving motor symptoms in PD. This review summarizes the current understanding of the "gut microbiota-SCFA-inflammation axis" in PD motor dysfunction, focusing on the potential mechanisms by which specific dietary strategies-prebiotics, probiotics, and the Mediterranean diet, and emerging patterns such as ketogenic diets (KD) and intermittent fasting (IF)-may ameliorate motor symptoms through modulation of this axis, while critically appraising the limitations and inconsistencies in the existing literature. By integrating disease-specific mechanistic insights with a translational evaluation of dietary interventions, this Review aims to complement existing immunological frameworks with a clinically oriented perspective on PD motor dysfunction. We also integrate recent preclinical and clinical evidence, discuss current research limitations, and offer perspectives on future therapeutic directions.

papers.title: Dense-Sampling the Menstrual Cycle Using EEG in a Single Case Study: Relating Markers of Cognitive Control and Mental Health
papers.authors: Nijboer A, Lucchi F, Giltay EJ, Putman P, de Bruijn E.
papers.abstract: Introduction. Women may show menstrual cycle-related susceptibility to depressive and anxiety symptoms during estradiol (E2) and progesterone (P4) fluctuations. Electrophysiological (EEG) markers, including the error-related negativity (ERN) and resting-state theta/beta ratio (TBR) index cognitive control processes and are emerging biomarkers of adverse mental health outcomes. Methods. Using a proof-of-principle, hypothesis-generating approach, we intensively tracked one healthy, naturally cycling woman in her late twenties for 30 days. We collected daily salivary E2 and P4, mental health data, and EEG. We provide a descriptive case study to showcase a dense-sampling and dynamic time warping (DTW) combination. Results. EEG markers varied considerably across the menstrual cycle. The ERN was larger around ovulation, coinciding with an E2 peak. Around midluteal phase the ERN was smaller, coinciding with a P4 peak. TBR varied most during the early-follicular phase. The DTW networks suggested the ERN was related to TBR, that TBR was related to positive and negative affect, and to response bias on a Go/No-Go task. Discussion. Our descriptive, hypothesis-generating results suggest that cognitive control markers can vary across a menstrual cycle, and that they can be important targets for further study regarding women’s mental health and precision medicine. Cognitive control markers exhibited considerable daily variability, underscoring the importance of accounting for such fluctuations in research.
papers.summary_zh: 这项概念验证性单例研究对一名健康自然月经周期的女性进行了约一个月的密集追踪，每日采集唾液雌二醇和孕酮、心理健康数据与脑电，并用动态时间规整分析指标间关系。结果显示，脑电指标随月经周期明显波动：错误相关负波在排卵前后雌二醇峰值附近较大，在黄体中期孕酮峰值附近较小；静息态θ/β比在卵泡早期变化最大。分析还提示错误相关负波与θ/β比相关，后者又与正负情绪及Go/No-Go任务反应偏向相关。作者据此提出，认知控制指标在整个月经周期内存在可观的逐日变异，可作为女性心理健康与精准医学的后续研究靶点，但强调这仅是描述性、假设生成性的结果。

papers.title: The more, the better? Behavioral and neural correlates of frequent and infrequent vowel exposure
papers.authors: Tsuji S, Fikkert P, MINAGAWA Y, Dupoux E, Filippin L, Versteegh M, Hagoort P, Cristia A.
papers.abstract: A central assumption in the perceptual attunement literature holds that exposure to a speech sound contrast leads to improvement in native speech sound processing. However, whether the amount of exposure matters for this process has not been put to a direct test. We elucidated indicators of frequency-dependent perceptual attunement by comparing 5-8-month-old Dutch infants’ discrimination of tokens containing a highly frequent [hɪt-he:t] and a highly infrequent [hʏt-hø:t] native vowel contrast as well as a non-native [hɛt-hæt] vowel contrast in a behavioral visual habituation paradigm (Experiment 1). Infants discriminated both native contrasts similarly well, but did not discriminate the non-nativecontrast. We sought further evidence for subtle differences in the processing of the two native contrasts using near-infrared spectroscopy and a within-participant design (Experiment 2). The neuroimaging data did not provide additional evidence that responses to native contrasts are modulated by frequency of exposure. These results suggest that even large differences in exposure to a native contrast may not directly translate to behavioral and neural indicators of perceptual attunement, raising the possibility that frequency of exposure does not influence improvements in discriminating native contrasts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以5至8个月大的荷兰语婴儿为对象，结合行为视觉习惯化范式与近红外光谱技术，考察接触频率是否影响婴儿对母语语音对比的知觉调适。结果发现，婴儿对高频和低频母语元音对比的辨别表现相近，却无法辨别非母语对比；神经影像数据也未显示母语对比反应受接触频率调节。作者据此指出，即便母语对比的接触量差异很大，也未必直接转化为行为或神经层面的知觉调适指标，提示接触频率可能并不影响母语对比辨别能力的提升。

papers.title: mstsa: A Python Library for Information-Theoretic and Statistical Analysis of EEG Microstate Sequences
papers.authors: VON WEGNER F.
papers.abstract: EEG microstate analysis decomposes a multichannel EEG recording into a discrete symbolic time series: each sample is assigned to one of a small number of voltage topography templates, the microstate maps, typically at sampling rates of 100–500 Hz (Lehmann et al., 1998; Michel & Koenig, 2018; Pascual-Marqui et al., 1995). Back-fitting the templates into the original EEG dataset yields a symbolic time series, the microstate sequence. Many research questions address the temporal structure of these sequences, such as: time series memory (Markovianity), autocorrelations including persistence and long-range correlations, measures of syntax and complexity, and comparison against certain null models.mstsa (Microstate Time Series Analysis) is a Python library that addresses these questions. It provides a comprehensive set of information-theoretic, Markov-chain, and statistical tools for the analysis of discrete symbolic sequences, with EEG microstate data as the primary application.
papers.summary_zh: 该文介绍了一个名为mstsa的Python库，用于分析EEG微状态序列这类离散符号时间序列。作者指出，微状态分析将多通道EEG记录转化为由少量电压地形模板构成的符号序列，而许多研究问题关注其时间结构，如马尔可夫性、自相关与长程相关性、句法复杂度和与零模型的比较。该库整合了信息论、马尔可夫链和统计工具，以EEG微状态数据为主要应用对象，为这类序列分析提供统一的计算支持。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Language Sample Analysis Identifies Linguistic Markers of Children’s Social and Cognitive Development
papers.authors: Lammert JM, Butler BE, Osborne E, Vuppala S.
papers.abstract: Narrative-based Language Sample Analysis (LSA) is an informative approach for evaluating school-aged children’s social and cognitive development. Traditionally, LSA has relied on human evaluations, which are often subjective and require significant time and resources. Recent advances in Natural Language Processing (NLP) have made automating LSA easier and more accurate than ever before, yet the effectiveness of this approach remains largely unexplored. The current study sought to determine whether NLP can be used to extract features from narrative retelling samples that are useful for predicting cognitive and social skills in school-aged children. We used data from the Healthy Brain Network, a large open access pediatric database (N = 242; aged 6 – 16), where children watched a short animated movie, answered objective comprehension questions, and retold what happened in the movie in their own words. We used Coh-Metrix, a computational tool for discourse analysis, to automatically extract several linguistic features of interest from the resulting narrative language samples. Several NLP-extracted features were predictive of social difficulties, phonemic decoding ability, age, socioeconomic status, and language screener scores (R2 = 0.12 – 0.37). Moreover, NLP-extracted features frequently improved predictions over objective question accuracy (∆R2 = 0.11 – 0.15). These findings demonstrate the ability of automated approaches to improve the efficiency of LSA and complement traditional assessment methods.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察自然语言处理能否从学龄儿童的叙事复述样本中提取有用特征，以预测其认知与社交能力。研究者利用公开儿科数据库中的叙事复述数据，借助Coh-Metrix自动提取语言特征，发现若干特征可预测社交困难、音素解码能力、年龄、社会经济状况和语言筛查得分，且这些特征常能在客观理解题正确率之外提升预测效果。结果表明，自动化语言样本分析有望提高评估效率，并补充传统测评方法；但研究属于预测性关联分析，尚不能说明因果关系或临床效用。

papers.title: Reduced theta-gamma coupling during real-world episodic encoding
papers.authors: Taheritorbati A, O'Connor J, Silito T, Klamer K, Kress S, Allahdad N, Musial JA, Rollingson J, Craig j, Gregoire M, Ekstrand C.
papers.abstract: Episodic memories are rarely formed under the controlled, simplified conditions typical of laboratory research. They are built from continuous, embodied experiences unfolding in real time and real space. We examined how theta-gamma phase amplitude coupling (PAC), a candidate neural signature of encoding demand, differs when an experience is encountered in a live setting rather than an approximately matched screen-based version. 62 healthy young adults encoded an identical narrative vignette, presented either as a live theatrical performance or as a two-dimensional (2D) video recording, while high-density EEG was recorded. Coupling between frontal theta and parietal gamma activity was computed during encoding as an index of this cross-frequency coordination, and free-recall memory was assessed immediately after. Real-world encoding was associated with significantly lower frontal theta to parietal gamma PAC than 2D encoding, even though recall performance did not differ between conditions. PAC positively predicted recall only in the 2D condition, with no equivalent relationship emerging for Real-world encoding. In the Real-world condition, PAC was negatively correlated with general cognitive ability, suggesting that higher cognitive functioning requires less cross-frequency coordination during naturalistic encoding. Together, these findings position theta-gamma PAC as a compensatory neural mechanism, recruited more heavily when the encoding environment provides less external structure. This suggests that real-world experiences may place a lighter coordination burden on the encoding brain, consistent with a compensatory account of theta-gamma PAC.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察真实场景与屏幕呈现下情景记忆编码时额叶theta—顶叶gamma相位振幅耦合的差异，62名健康年轻成人观看同一叙事片段，分别以现场戏剧或二维视频呈现，同时记录高密度脑电并测试自由回忆。结果发现，真实场景编码的耦合显著低于二维条件，但两种条件的回忆成绩无差异；耦合仅在二维条件中正向预测回忆，在真实场景中则与一般认知能力负相关。作者据此提出，theta—gamma耦合可能是一种补偿性神经机制，当编码环境提供的外部结构较少时被更多调用，真实世界体验对编码脑的协调负担可能更轻。

papers.title: From brain networks to the patient-environment system in clinical neuroimaging
papers.authors: corredor d, Carriere M, Vallet A, GASTELUM M, Raja V, Eustache F, guillery b.
papers.abstract: Despite substantial advances in clinical neuroimaging, its impact on defining and treatingpsychiatric disorders remains limited. Current approaches in clinical brain imaging framepsychiatric disorders as dysfunctions of brain-based information processing. Here, wepropose a shift in this explanatory focus, from how aberrant neural processes generatemaladaptive behavior to the brain's participation in the dynamics of the patient–environment system. Drawing on organism-environment approaches, we conceptualizebehavior as emerging from context-dependent coordinated interactions among brain,body, and environment. Within this framework, we conceptualize psychiatric disordersas excessive stability or flexibility in patient-environment dynamics that impair thepatient's capacity to adapt to changing situations. After examining the ontologicalcommitments of current clinical neuroimaging and recasting psychiatric disorders interms of patient–environment dynamics, we outline concrete strategies foroperationalizing this framework. These progress from combining ecological momentaryassessment with neuroimaging, to naturalistic brain and body imaging that jointly tracksneural, bodily, and environmental dynamics, and finally to explicit dynamical models ofthe patient–environment system in which maladaptive stability or flexibility can beformally defined and identified. By making these dynamics measurable, we aim to turn aconceptual reframing into a concrete empirical program, recasting the brain not as theseat of psychiatric disorders but as one participant in the patient–environment dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇立场/框架性文章，针对临床神经影像对精神障碍界定与治疗影响有限的问题，提出将解释焦点从脑内异常信息处理转向患者—环境系统的动态变化。作者借用生物体—环境视角，把行为视为脑、身体与环境在具体情境中协调互动的产物，并将精神障碍理解为患者—环境动态过度稳定或过度灵活，从而削弱适应变化情境的能力。文章在检视现有临床神经影像的本体论预设后，提出从生态瞬时评估结合神经影像，到自然情境下同步追踪脑、身体与环境动态，再到建立可形式化定义适应不良稳定或灵活性的动态模型的递进策略，意在把概念重构转化为可测量的实证方案。

papers.title: Mood stability and change map onto distinct insula-centered networks
papers.authors: Danan N, Ramot M, Keren H.
papers.abstract: Mood is changing continuously even when external events are minimal. These spontaneous mood dynamics may reveal how the brain maintains and modifies affective states. Yet mood is typically studied in response to external input, leaving the neural basis of spontaneous mood changes largely unknown. Here, we combined repeated mood sampling with functional neural connectivity across two resting-state fMRI sessions separated by several weeks to identify the neural systems associated with different spontaneous mood dynamics. Our most robust finding was that stronger insula-striatal connectivity was associated with greater mood stability. Additional analyses revealed that stronger connectivity within an insula-cingulo-frontal network was associated with greater spontaneous mood decline, while reduced insula-frontal connectivity was associated with higher depressive symptoms. Together, these findings suggest that distinct insula-centered functional networks are differentially associated with affective stability and affective updating and change, providing a neural framework for spontaneous mood dynamics and their relation to depressive symptoms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在没有明显外部事件时情绪仍持续波动的神经基础，将重复情绪采样与相隔数周的功能连接测量结合，考察自发情绪动态与脑网络的关系。最稳健的发现是，岛叶与纹状体之间连接较强时情绪更稳定；进一步分析显示，岛叶-扣带-额叶网络内部连接较强与情绪自发下降更多相关，而岛叶-额叶连接减弱则与抑郁症状较重相关。作者据此提出，以岛叶为中心的不同功能网络分别对应情绪的稳定与更新变化，为理解自发情绪动态及其与抑郁症状的关系提供了神经框架；这些均为关联性结果，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: AI-Based Approaches for the Identification and Quantification of Traumatic Brain Injury in Computed Tomography Imaging: Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Pham VT, Logothetis I, Thaveenthiran P, Vajda S, Jithoo R, Mathew J, Mouzakis K.
papers.abstract: Background Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a leading cause of global disability and mortality, requiring timely diagnosis to prevent secondary injury. Manual computed tomographic (CT) evaluation often causes diagnostic delays, especially in smaller hospitals with limited radiological expertise. AI methods have been increasingly proposed to automate CT-based TBI assessment. objectives The aim of this review is to present a comprehensive review of AI techniques applied to CT scans for TBI assessment. Methods This study presents a systematized review conducted in accordance with PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) 2020 reporting guidelines. Titles, abstracts, and full texts were screened against predefined eligibility criteria. Data on datasets, model architectures, preprocessing, and performance metrics were extracted using a structured form. Risk of bias was not formally assessed using a standardized tool. Instead, we qualitatively evaluated common sources of bias, such as dataset size, clinical evaluation, and external validation. Due to substantial heterogeneity in tasks, datasets, and outcome measures, we performed narrative synthesis only. We searched PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore from inception to December 31, 2025, for English-language peer-reviewed studies. We included original research papers that used AI or machine learning methods applied to human noncontrast head CT for TBI-related assessment. Studies had to report quantitative performance metrics. Nonoriginal papers, non-CT modalities, pediatric-only cohorts, and non-TBI applications were excluded. We restricted inclusion to English-language, peer-reviewed studies and did not perform a formal risk-of-bias or publication-bias assessment, which may overestimate the strength of the evidence. Results By screening the 674 publications found, we identified 101 studies for evaluation. We grouped these 101 studies into 4 categories: binary TBI classification (TBI or non-TBI), hemorrhage detection (classification, localization, segmentation, and quantization), midline shift measurement, and increased intracranial pressure estimation. Most work focused on hemorrhage detection, with fewer studies on TBI severity classification, midline shift estimation, and increased intracranial pressure assessment. Reported performance was frequently high, but many studies relied on small, single-center datasets, limited annotation detail, and internal validation only. External validation and prospective clinical evaluation were rare. Conclusions AI methods for CT-based TBI assessment demonstrate strong performance in retrospective evaluations under controlled conditions, particularly for hemorrhage detection and segmentation; however, the current evidence base is constrained by limited dataset diversity, incomplete reporting, and lack of clinical validation. Accordingly, these findings should be interpreted as evidence of methodological feasibility rather than clinical readiness.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了将人工智能方法用于头颅CT评估创伤性脑损伤的研究，按任务分为二分类、出血检测、中线移位测量和颅内压升高估计四类。多数研究集中于出血检测，报告的性能普遍较高，但常依赖小型单中心数据集、标注信息有限且仅做内部验证，外部验证和前瞻性临床评估很少。作者因此指出，现有结果更多说明方法学上的可行性，而非已具备临床就绪度，证据基础受数据多样性不足、报告不完整和缺乏临床验证的限制。

papers.title: Amplitude of physiological brain pulsations in Alzheimer’s disease
papers.authors: Perkiömäki V, Raitamaa L, Mattila H, Elabasy A, Huotari N, Väyrynen T, Tuunanen J, Helakari H, Järvelä M, Kananen J, Korhonen V, Krüger J, Kiviniemi V.
papers.abstract: Abstract Physiological pulsations maintaining brain neurofluidic homeostasis are altered early in the course of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). In this study, we analyzed amplitude changes in physiological brain pulsations of 43 AD patients diagnostically validated by cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) biomarkers and 72 controls using ultrafast functional magnetic resonance imaging. We thereby tested the hypothesis that pulsation changes would correlate with the commonly used AD CSF biomarkers. The very low frequency (< 0.1 Hz) vasomotor waves, respiratory and cardiac frequencies and cardiorespiratory modulation all displayed significantly higher amplitudes in overlapping brain structures of AD patients compared to the controls. The increased amplitude was most pronounced in gray matter (GM) (49%), but also substantial in white matter (39%) with lesser increases in CSF spaces (12%). The amplitude increases in AD correlated spatially with GM atrophy (r = 0.47), relative hypometabolism measured with [ 18 F]fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography ([ 18 F]FDG-PET) (0.26), and with early amyloid-β deposition measured with [ 18 F]florbetapir PET (0.17). There was no linear correlation to CSF biomarkers. In conclusion, the amplitudes of all physiological brain pulsations increase in AD, possibly in association with failed solute efflux.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阿尔茨海默病（AD）中维持脑内神经流体稳态的生理性搏动是否发生幅度改变，用超快功能磁共振成像比较了经脑脊液生物标志物诊断验证的AD患者与对照者的脑搏动幅度，并检验其与常用AD脑脊液标志物的关联。结果显示，AD患者在多个重叠脑结构中，极低频血管运动波、呼吸与心搏频率以及心肺调制的幅度均高于对照者，其中灰质最明显，白质次之，脑脊液空间增幅较小。这些幅度升高在空间上与灰质萎缩、相对低代谢及早期淀粉样蛋白沉积相关，但与脑脊液标志物无线性相关。作者据此提出，AD中各类生理性脑搏动幅度普遍增大，可能与溶质外排失败有关；这属于关联性观察，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Drosophila Connectome Topology Provides No Measurable Language- Model Advantage: A Preregistered Negative Experimental Program
papers.authors: Matyukhin V.
papers.abstract: Abstract Whether the synaptic wiring of an animal brain can serve as an inductive bias for language models is an empirical question, not a metaphor. We tested that question in a preregistered experimental program that transferred Drosophila melanogaster anatomy—and, later, a Drosophila -shaped memory interface—into small language-model and memory computers. Win rules, controls, and seed counts were written before each queue. Across the closed tests, no protocol showed that a fly-derived operator reduced pair-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) or cross-entropy relative to both a no-graph baseline and a non-brain control at the preregistered margin. A washed diffusion prior built from top-degree FlyWire nodes never beat scrambled or random graphs on lexical, factual, or morphological probes and is architecturally near-identity after a forced unit diagonal. Raw syntax kernels of size 64 × 12 and 256 × 12 beat a non-brain graph on holdout area under the receiver operating characteristic (AUROC) on three of three seeds, and the 64 × 12 kernel beat the same control on TinyLM pair-NLL on three of three seeds, but never beat the no-kernel model by the required margin of 0.02. Replacing the TinyLM feed-forward block with a frozen antennal-lobe projection neuron → Kenyon-cell expansion and hard k -winner-take-all was worse than a dense feed-forward network and worse than Erdős–Rényi and degree-matched expansions on three of three seeds. A trainable projectome residual first failed to enter computation under a degenerate zero initialization. After a non-degenerate reparameterization the communication channel was used (relative residual norm ρ ≈ 0.02–0.06), yet fly topology won Quality, Anatomy, and Specificity on zero of three seeds. Using the same expansion as a retrieval hash lost to random expansion plus the same winner-take-all (primary recall@1 at noise 0.2 ≈ 0.31 versus 0.37) and to dense cosine lookup (≈ 0.85). Isolated central-complex heading persistence did not meet preregistered attractor criteria. A silent-engram interface is realizable by construction; a learned recovery operator failed already on training data; a family-bank expression computer that beat weak controls was matched by a generic constrained selector (mean success 0.80 on all learned arms, gap 0, five seeds). We conclude that trainable family-level sparse communication is viable, but the Drosophila projectome topology provides no measurable pair-NLL advantage over vanilla, random or degree-matched topology, or learned sparsity under the C1-R interface. Mushroom-body expansion is not a language feed-forward substitute and is not a superior associative hash in these tests. The Drosophila -specific silent-engram claim does not survive a matched constrained control. An 800-million-parameter model’s Russian multiple-choice score is not a connectome result: no same-corpus ablation without the blueprint was run. Efficiency, latency, and training cost were not measured and are not claimed.
papers.summary_zh: 该预注册实验程序检验果蝇突触连接拓扑能否作为语言模型的可训练归纳偏置，将果蝇解剖结构及类似记忆接口引入小型语言模型和记忆计算装置。在各项封闭测试中，果蝇来源的算子均未在预设幅度上同时优于无图基线和非脑对照：扩散先验未胜过打乱或随机图，蘑菇体式前馈扩展不如稠密网络及匹配对照，可训练投射组残差虽被实际使用却未在质量、解剖和特异性上稳定胜出，检索哈希也逊于随机扩展和稠密余弦查找。作者据此认为，可训练的家族级稀疏通信可行，但果蝇投射组拓扑在所用接口下未带来可测量的配对词元损失优势，蘑菇体扩展不能替代语言前馈层，果蝇特异性静默印迹主张也未通过匹配约束对照；效率与训练成本未测量。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Individual Graph Construction Methods from Static FDG-PET Images: an ADNI study in Alzheimer’s Disease Subjects
papers.authors: HOROWITZ T, PHAM MT, WOJAK J, Parlak IB, Trung NL, GUEDJ E.
papers.abstract: Abstract Purpose: Connectivity analysis using static fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) images offers an effective approach to explore brain network organization through resting-state metabolic activity. Graph theory modelling is increasingly applied to these networks; however, construction methods profoundly shape analytical outcomes. Methods: Here we systematically evaluate and compare methods for constructing individual graphs from FDG-PET images in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) subjects. We assess five methods— categorized into mean-based and probability density function (PDF)-based graphs—across cognitive normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD groups, using two criteria: structural similarity between individual- and group-level graphs to capture AD disconnection patterns, and predictive power for AD classification. Analyses include connectivity visualization, graph topology, correlations with cognitive scores via principal component analysis (PCA), and classification performance. Results: Our findings indicate that all methods captured AD disconnection patterns but exhibited variability in preserving connectivity profiles, which seemed non-random but rather systematically linked to clinical measures and predictive power for AD classification. In which, the Effect Size-based (ES) method best preserves group-level graph structure (≥ 80% similarity for both CN and AD graphs), but showed the lowest predictive power for AD. PDF-based graphs, despite lower group-level similarity (≤ 70% for CN, ≤ 50% for AD), demonstrated superior AD classification performance (up to 7% gain over ES) and stronger correlations with clinical scores—particularly DTW, which showed robust positive correlations with MMSE (𝑟 = 0.48 with the first PCA component). There is no one-size-fits-all method; the choice depends on the classification task. PDF-based approaches like KLS and DTW emerged as strong candidates, with DTW excelling in AD tasks and KLS in MCI tasks. Conclusion: This analysis reveals the distinct strengths and limitations of each method, underscoring the essential need for careful selection aligned with specific research goals.
