Here, we show that the lung functions as an in vivo programming niche that generates functional CIML NK cells for systemic cancer immunotherapy and immunoprevention. By decoupling immunostimulation from silicosis, we identify an obligate alveolar macrophage (AM)-NK cell axis. Upon engulfing biodegradable amorphous nanosilica (nSiO2 ), AMs release a transient IL-12/15/18 triad that reprograms circulating NK cells into memory-like effectors. The resulting NK cells meet all three canonical CIML criteria: proliferative expansion, transition to an armed resting state, and enhanced IFN-γ recall upon tumor rechallenge, with specific surface area serving as a key physical determinant of programming potency. In mouse models, a brief prophylactic pulmonary nSiO2 regimen (120 μg/dose, 4 doses) establishes durable (≥60 days) protective immunity, suppresses melanoma growth, prevents postsurgical recurrence, and synergizes with anti-PD-1 therapy in an NK-dependent manner. Crucially, this therapeutic regimen does not induce pulmonary fibrosis; the amorphous nSiO2 is completely biodegraded and cleared within 90 days, with no detectable systemic toxicity. Our study establishes a cell-free framework for in vivo NK cell programming, informing next-generation cancer immunotherapies.

papers.title: Landscaping neurodevelopment of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder.
papers.authors: Liu N, Wang YS, Zhou ZX, Gao P, Luo C, Zhang X, Zhu Z, Gao Y, Ren F, Zhu Y, Chen LZ, Li H, Ju C, Wang P, Bedford S, Terroba CP, Dorfschmidt L, Bethlehem RAI, Yang N, Gong ZQ, Xu T, Zang Y, Wang Y, Lifespan Brain Chart Consortium (LBCC), Chinese Color Nest Consortium (CCNC), Chinese Brain Health Imaging Consortium (CHART), Chinese Child Brain Development (CCBD) Consortium, Dong Q, Liu L, Qian Q, Zuo XN.
papers.abstract: We aim to decipher the neurodevelopmental diversity of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) using lifespan brain charts within a brainality landscape framework. It first generated age- and sex-referenced centile scores of brain morphology for 270 children with ADHD by revising the worldwide lifespan brain chart (n = 177,701) for 31,894 healthy Chinese samples, including 25,768 scans from the Chinese Brain Health Imaging Consortium (CHART) and 6126 scans from the Chinese Child Brain Development (CCBD) study. Children with ADHD were then classified using partitioning around medoids based on their centile scores as deviations from a developing control reference to identify trait constellations underlying ADHD's landscape heterogeneity. The brainality landscape identified two neurotypes: children with smaller volume (SVC-ADHD) and children with larger volume (LVC-ADHD), who are not different between sex, imaging site, gestational and maternal age as well as clinical symptom composition. SVC-ADHD children are younger and have lower mean birth weight, and showed neurocognitive impairments and poorer hemispheric differentiation within the default network as well as more gene expressions related to organism developmental processes, and more prenatal risk factors such as maternal passive smoking. In contrast, LVC-ADHD children are older and demonstrated more pronounced behavior and emotional impairments, while their language, somatomotor, and cognitive control networks exhibited poorer hemispheric specialization. Genetic findings were less pronounced in LVC-ADHD and remained exploratory and mainly linked to neurogenesis. Our work charted the brainality of ADHD to reflect distinct developmental profiles with combinations of genetic, prenatal, and later-life influences, implying clinical potential of future precision translation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在借助寿命脑图谱和“脑性景观”框架，刻画注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的神经发育异质性。作者先基于大规模健康中国人群数据修订脑形态的年龄和性别参照百分位，再据此对ADHD儿童进行聚类，识别出脑体积偏小和偏大两种神经类型。两类儿童在性别、成像站点和临床症状构成上无差异，但偏小类型年龄更小、出生体重更低，表现为神经认知受损、默认网络半球分化较差，并与更多发育相关基因表达及母亲被动吸烟等产前风险因素相关；偏大类型年龄更大，行为和情绪问题更突出，语言、躯体运动和认知控制网络的半球特化较差，遗传关联较弱且仍属探索性。作者认为，这反映了遗传、产前和后期因素组合形成的不同发育轨迹，并提示未来精准转化的可能，但相关发现尚不能直接用于临床。

papers.title: CT imaging-led diagnosis of Parry-Romberg syndrome: A case report and literature review highlighting craniofacial and neurologic involvement.
papers.authors: Ahmed AD, Saliha HN, Nuguse MK, Jemal EM, Getaneh FH, Assefa TD, Mohammed S.
papers.abstract: Parry-Romberg syndrome (PRS) is a rare neurocutaneous disorder characterized by progressive unilateral facial atrophy involving soft tissues, fat, muscle, and sometimes underlying bone and brain tissue. The exact cause remains unclear, although autoimmune, neurogenic, vascular, traumatic, and inflammatory mechanisms have been proposed. We report a 43-year-old man in whom progressive unilateral facial atrophy was incidentally identified during evaluation after facial trauma. Computed tomography and three-dimensional craniofacial reconstruction demonstrated characteristic unilateral soft-tissue atrophy, maxillary and mandibular hypoplasia, and orbital asymmetry, which were instrumental in establishing the diagnosis and defining the extent of craniofacial involvement. A narrative review of 100 reported cases published over the last 2 decades was also performed to evaluate clinical manifestations, neuroimaging findings, and potential triggers. Neurological manifestations, including seizures, headache, stroke-like episodes, trigeminal neuralgia, and white matter abnormalities, were identified in a subset of patients. Craniofacial imaging frequently demonstrated soft-tissue atrophy, mandibular and maxillary hypoplasia, orbital abnormalities, calcifications, cerebral hemiatrophy, and white matter lesions. PRS appears to represent a heterogeneous multisystem disorder with important neurologic and neuroradiologic associations.
papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例43岁男性在面部外伤后评估中偶然发现进行性单侧面部萎缩，经CT及三维颅面重建显示单侧软组织萎缩、上颌骨与下颌骨发育不足及眶部不对称，从而支持Parry-Romberg综合征诊断并界定颅面受累范围。作者同时叙述性回顾近二十年100例报告，梳理临床表现、神经影像所见及可能诱因，指出部分患者存在癫痫、头痛、卒中样发作、三叉神经痛和白质异常，颅面影像常见软组织萎缩、颌骨发育不足、眶部异常、钙化、大脑半球萎缩及白质病变。文章据此认为该病可能是累及多系统的异质性疾病，并与神经系统及神经影像学异常相关。

papers.title: Multilevel brain functional heterogeneity in major depressive disorder based on normative modeling of multicenter resting-state EEG.
papers.authors: Sun S, Guo H, Kong W, Wang Z, Chen H, Li X, Hu B.
papers.abstract: Background Depression exhibits substantial neurobiological heterogeneity. Conventional group-level EEG analyses often fail to identify reproducible biomarkers, limiting objective diagnosis and treatment. This study employed a normative modeling framework to characterize individual EEG abnormalities by quantifying deviations from a healthy reference distribution. Method This study integrated multicenter resting-state EEG data from 1163 participants (participants with major depressive disorder [MDD] = 369; healthy controls [HC] = 794). Normative models were constructed using Dortmund Vital Study data (HC = 608). In the test set, individual deviations in time- and frequency-domain EEG features were quantified at both scalp and source levels. Abnormal patterns were subsequently characterized across electrode, regional, connectivity, and network levels. Group differences were assessed using permutation testing with FDR correction. Results Normative modeling revealed that EEG abnormalities in MDD were predominantly characterized by highly individualized deviation patterns, with limited overlap at the group level. Significant abnormalities were mainly observed in prefrontal regions and the orbitofrontal cortex (OFC), particularly in beta-band relative power. At the network level, only the limbic subnetwork remained significant after multiple-comparison correction, with approximately 25% of MDD patients showing significant deviations. Conclusion Multilevel EEG analysis based on normative modeling reveals pronounced individualized neurofunctional abnormalities in MDD and identifies relatively stable alterations in the OFC and limbic network. This framework provides a robust basis for characterizing neurobiological heterogeneity and supporting individualized precision diagnosis in depression.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍在脑功能上的异质性，采用规范建模框架，基于多中心静息态脑电数据，在头皮和源层面量化个体在时域与频域特征上偏离健康参考分布的程度，并考察电极、区域、连接和网络多个层面的异常模式。结果显示，患者的脑电异常主要表现为高度个体化的偏离模式，组水平上的重叠有限；较一致的异常集中在前额区域和眶额皮层，尤其是β频段相对功率，网络层面则只有边缘子网络在多重比较校正后仍显著，约四分之一患者表现出显著偏离。作者据此认为，规范建模下的多层面脑电分析能够刻画抑郁的神经功能异质性，并提示眶额皮层和边缘网络存在相对稳定的改变，为个体化精准诊断提供了框架，但相关发现仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Exploratory imaging in SWEDD: Insights from dopaminergic PET, synaptic density PET, and volumetric MRI.
papers.authors: Ebrahimian Sadabad F, Volpi T, Tinaz S, Honhar P, Colon L, Mayeli M, Pittman B, Naganawa M, Dias M, Angarita GA, Comley R, Carson RE, Finnema SJ, Matuskey D.
papers.abstract: Objective Scans Without Evidence of Dopaminergic Deficit (SWEDD) refers to individuals with Parkinsonian symptoms but no presynaptic dopaminergic deficit on dopamine transporter (DAT) imaging. Given its likely heterogeneity, we used a multimodal imaging approach to compare SWEDD with Parkinson's disease (PD) and healthy controls (HCs). Methods Twenty participants with Parkinsonian symptoms (15 PD, 5 SWEDD) and 10 HCs underwent PET imaging with 18 F-FE-PE2I (DAT) and 11 C-UCB-J (SV2A), along with structural MRI. Binding potential (BPND ) was quantified in striatal and midbrain regions. SWEDD classification was based on putamen DAT binding >80% of age-matched HCs. An exploratory sub-analysis compared SWEDD with early PD (disease duration <4 years). Results SWEDD showed higher putaminal DAT binding than PD (Z = 2.41, p = 0.01) but no difference from HCs (Z = 1.24, p = 0.21), indicating preserved nigrostriatal integrity. Unexpectedly, SWEDD had lower ventral striatum DAT binding versus HCs (Z = -2.79, p < 0.01). SV2A binding in the substantia nigra was higher in SWEDD than PD (Z = 2.33, p = 0.01), with no difference from HCs (Z = 0.49, p = 0.61), suggesting preserved synaptic density. Structural MRI showed no volumetric differences across groups. Clinically, SWEDD had lower MDS-UPDRS II, III, and total scores than PD, with similar MDS-UPDRS I scores. Conclusion SWEDD demonstrated preserved dopaminergic and synaptic integrity compared with PD, without structural differences. Multimodal imaging may help characterize biological heterogeneity within SWEDD, though larger studies are needed.

papers.title: Modified shuffle Net-DCNN architecture with cepstral and spectral feature for epileptic seizure detection using EEG signal.
papers.authors: Jonna ST, Natarajan K.
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
papers.abstract: Epileptic Seizure Detection plays a crucial role in identifying irregularities in brain activity patterns, such as seizures, focal onset, and generalized seizures, which often go unnoticed until they escalate into more severe conditions like prolonged seizures or cognitive impairments. Therefore, early prediction of epileptic seizure activities is vital for enabling timely medical responses, optimizing treatment strategies, and improving overall patient care and management. The difficulty of accurately and promptly detecting epileptic seizures from EEG data is addressed in this work. This effort is made more difficult by noise, signal pattern fluctuation, and the requirement for quick analysis. The limitations of current detection techniques, which frequently struggle with accuracy and dependability in clinical settings, define the issue. Addressing this critical need, the research introduces a novel hybrid model that combines Modified Shuffle Net V2 (MSNetV2) and Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) architectures through Electroencephalogram (EEG) signal data. The novelty of the research is to decrease false positives and increase detection accuracy by combining an advanced hybrid architecture model along with robust feature extraction techniques and sophisticated preprocessing techniques. This innovative model is designed specifically for early epileptic seizure detection and employs a comprehensive methodology that includes several key processes. Initially, the EEG signal data are preprocessed using the Modified Wiener Filtering (MWF) technique to remove noise and improve signal clarity. The preprocessed signals are then subjected to feature extraction to identify the most pertinent features, which are further enhanced to improve the dataset. Here, the min-max normalization procedure is used to carry out the data augmentation process. To identify epileptic episodes, the two network architectures independently process the augmented features before feeding them into the hybrid MSNetV2-DCNN model. The study uses detailed simulations and experimental evaluations to verify the efficacy of the suggested paradigm. The study comes to the conclusion that the MSNetV2-DCNN model exhibits a reliable and effective technique for epileptic seizure identification, underscoring its potential for practical use in traffic management situations as well as medical diagnostics. The proposed work achieves the highest accuracy of approximately 94% in 90% of the training data, which is the highest among the other conventional models.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电信号中癫痫发作检测易受噪声和信号波动干扰、现有方法准确性与可靠性不足的问题，提出一种结合改进Shuffle Net V2与深度卷积神经网络的混合模型，并配合改进维纳滤波去噪、特征提取与归一化增强等流程处理脑电数据。作者通过仿真与实验评估称，该模型在训练数据中取得约94%的最高准确率，优于所比较的传统模型，并认为其有望用于癫痫的早期识别。不过摘要未报告独立测试集表现、假阳性率等关键指标，且文中关于交通管理场景的表述与医学诊断语境不符，实际应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The developing adolescent brain: Implications for youth justice and children in criminal proceedings.
papers.authors: Blakemore SJ.
papers.abstract: Adolescence is a unique developmental stage, defined by neural reorganisation and a heightened sensitivity to the social environment. Brain maturation is a prolonged process extending well into the twenties, involving microstructural refinements such as axonal myelination and synaptic pruning, which are partly dependent on environmental input. This period of heightened neuroplasticity coincides with a shift toward peer affiliation and increased susceptibility to risk-taking, particularly in social settings. Consequently, adolescent decision-making should be viewed through a social lens, in which the drive to avoid social exclusion and to secure peer acceptance acts as a powerful motivator of behaviour. This framework underscores the importance of social connections and suggests that, conversely, disruptions to these relationships, and in particular social isolation, can be harmful to adolescent development. Studies have demonstrated that even brief periods of social isolation in adolescence can increase reward seeking and reward learning, heighten threat sensitivity and reduce risk perception. The research reviewed in this paper has implications for how young people are treated in the youth justice system. I argue that justice systems should evolve from punitive approaches toward rehabilitative frameworks and age-appropriate legal thresholds grounded in evidence-based insights into the developing adolescent brain and mind.

papers.title: Compression as a neural mechanism of mnemonic chunking in prefrontal cortex.
papers.authors: Chiang FK, Rich EL.
papers.abstract: Chunking is the mental process of grouping information into meaningful units and plays a central role in many cognitive processes such as working memory, yet the neural mechanisms that form chunks remain unknown. Here, we investigated how chunking impacts the representation of mnemonic information in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC). Macaque monkeys performed a self-ordered visuospatial working memory task, in which spontaneous chunking could be behaviorally characterized. We found that chunking improved memory performance overall and produced lower accuracies and longer reaction times at chunk boundaries. In the dlPFC, chunking systematically biased neural representations of spatial targets toward common chunk centers. At the same time, chunking reduced the dimensionality of population activity, indicating a compression of mnemonic information. Memory-guided behavior was also biased in the same direction as the neural distortions, which suggests that the compression mechanisms are lossy rather than lossless. Together, these results offer a mechanistic account of chunking as a form of lossy compression in neural coding that sacrifices detail within a chunk but improves overall memory retention.

papers.title: Distribution and age-interactions of cortical thickness associated with specific classes of medication used to treat obsessive-compulsive disorder: Results from the international ENIGMA consortium.
papers.authors: Ivanov I, Dzinalija N, Abe Y, Alonso P, Ameis SH, Arnold PD, Baker JT, Balachander S, Banaj N, Bargalló N, Batistuzzo MC, Benedetti F, Beucke JC, Bollettini I, Brennan BP, Buitelaar J, Calvo R, Cheng Y, Ching CR, Cho KIK, Dallaspezia S, Denys D, Diniz JB, Ely BA, Ferreira S, Feusner JD, Fitzgerald KD, Fontaine M, Gruner P, Hanna G, Hirano Y, Hoexter MQ, Hu H, Huijser C, Jahanshad N, James A, Jaspers-Fayer F, Jiang H, Kang MJ, Kathmann N, Kaufmann C, Kim M, Koch K, Kwon JS, Lázaro L, Liu Y, Lochner C, Marsh R, Martínez-Zalacaín I, Mataix-Cols D, Menchón JM, Minuzzi L, Morer A, Morgado P, Naaijen J, Nakagawa A, Narayanaswamy JC, Nurmi EL, Oh S, Perriello C, Phillips ML, Piacentini JC, Picó-Pérez M, Piras F, Piras F, Reddy YJ, Rodríguez-Manrique D, Sakai Y, Shimizu E, Simpson HB, Soreni N, Soriano-Mas C, Stern ER, Stevens MC, Stewart SE, Szeszko PR, Tang J, Thomopoulos S, Tolin DF, van der Werf YD, van Wingen GA, Vecchio D, Veltman DJ, Venkatasubramanian G, Walitza S, Wang Z, Watanabe A, Xu X, Yun JY, Zarei M, Zhang F, ENIGMA-OCD Working Group, Thompson PM, Stein DJ, van den Heuvel OA, O'Neill J.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: MRI studies have revealed structural brain abnormalities in obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). Less is known about how age and medication influence them. We analyzed cortical thickness (CT) data from the ENIGMA-OCD Consortium, the world's largest OCD MRI database (46 datasets from 35 centers). Subjects comprised 2057 healthy controls, 1167 unmedicated individuals with OCD, and 1073 individuals with OCD taking one or more psychiatric medications at time of scan. Using a harmonized FreeSurfer protocol, each MRI was parcellated into 68 cortical regions. Linear mixed models controlling for site and symptom severity mapped associations of OCD diagnosis and medication-any psychiatric medication and the medication classes serotonin-reuptake inhibitors (SRIs), tricyclics, antipsychotics, and benzodiazepines-on CT and their interaction with age in each region. Findings surviving FDR-correction included: 1) Unmedicated OCD participants showed thicker cortex and/or lesser CT decrease with age than controls in precentral, inferior parietal, superior parietal, and superior temporal regions (p < .001-.002); 2) In several regions, OCD participants taking any medication had thinner cortex than unmedicated; negative associations of age with CT were similar to controls (p < .001-.005). 3) Findings for SRIs resembled those in for any psychiatric medication. 4) CT was lower in participants taking benzodiazepines than in unmedicated participants in 30 regions (p < .001-.014). No associations of CT involving tricyclics or antipsychotics survived FDR-correction. Commonly prescribed OCD drugs may influence CT in ways that vary with cortical region and medication class. Potential mechanisms are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ENIGMA-OCD联盟的多中心MRI数据，分析强迫症诊断及不同类别精神药物与皮质厚度的关联，并考察其与年龄的交互作用。结果显示，未服药的强迫症患者部分脑区皮质较厚或随年龄变薄更慢；服用任何精神药物者多个脑区皮质较薄，且与年龄的负相关类似健康对照，其中血清素再摄取抑制剂的结果与总体用药相似。苯二氮䓬类使用者在较多脑区皮质更薄，而三环类和抗精神病药未见经校正后仍显著的关联。作者提示常用强迫症药物可能以随脑区和药物类别而异的方式影响皮质厚度，相关机制尚待探讨。

papers.title: Neuroinflammation induces aberrant activation of Wnt signaling in astrocytes and impairment of cholesterol homeostasis and myelin integrity.
papers.authors: Zhang J, Zheng J, Ai Y, Yang J, He C, Zhao J, Qiu M, Zheng K.
papers.abstract: Neuroinflammation often disrupts cerebral cholesterol homeostasis and leads to white matter damage and demyelination. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying these defects have remained enigmatic. In this study, we report that inflammation is associated with aberrant activation of Wnt signaling in astrocytes. While Wnt signaling increases astrocytic expression of SREBF2 protein and intracellular cholesterol level, it simultaneously inhibits the expression of APOE and reduces cholesterol efflux from astrocytes. The extracellular cholesterol supply is essential for the activation of the expression of MYRF transcription factor and myelin-associated genes in oligodendrocytes. Moreover, the defective oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelin gene expression caused by astrocytic Wnt activation in transgenic mice can partially be rescued by chemical-enhanced ApoE expression. Our findings suggest a regulatory pathway of "inflammation → Wnt signaling → cholesterol metabolism → myelin integrity" and provide important insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying inflammation-induced demyelinating diseases and future therapeutic strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注神经炎症如何破坏脑内胆固醇稳态并导致髓鞘损伤，其分子机制此前并不清楚。作者结合细胞与转基因小鼠实验发现，炎症会异常激活星形胶质细胞中的Wnt信号：该信号一方面提高星形胶质细胞内的胆固醇水平，另一方面抑制ApoE表达、减少胆固醇外流，而细胞外胆固醇供应对少突胶质细胞表达髓鞘相关基因至关重要。在星形胶质细胞Wnt激活的转基因小鼠中，少突胶质细胞分化与髓鞘基因表达的缺陷可通过化学增强ApoE表达得到部分挽救。这些结果提示一条“炎症→Wnt信号→胆固醇代谢→髓鞘完整性”的调控通路，为理解炎症相关脱髓鞘疾病提供了机制线索，但相关治疗潜力仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Divergent neural dynamics of multidimensional semantic access for concrete and abstract words.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Wang S, Zong C, Lin N.
papers.abstract: Semantic comprehension requires accessing multiple dimensions of meaning, yet the temporal dynamics of these dimensions remain unclear. Previous research has predominantly examined the neural dynamics of lexical semantics as a whole, which is equivalent to investigating the average of neural dynamics across various dimensions of semantic processing. Here, we analyzed openly released electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from 9 participants listening to naturalistic stories and used time-resolved encoding models to decompose neural responses into six semantic dimensions: vision, motor, space, time, socialness, and emotion. When analyzing all words together, nearly all dimensions showed a common response peaking around 350 ms. However, when neural dynamics of multidimensional semantic access were analyzed separately for concrete and abstract words, a dissociation in access latencies emerged: for concrete words, sensorimotor dimensions reached peak activation earlier than non-sensorimotor dimensions; whereas for abstract words, the social dimension peaked at 225 ms, earlier than other dimensions. These findings demonstrate that the brain dynamically prioritizes semantic dimensions depending on concept type.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语义理解中不同意义维度的神经加工时序，利用公开的颅内脑电记录和时程编码模型，将听故事时的神经反应分解为视觉、运动、空间、时间、社会性和情绪六个语义维度。若把所有词合并分析，多数维度呈现约350毫秒的共同峰值；但按具体词和抽象词分开看，则出现加工潜伏期的分离：具体词的感知运动维度早于非感知运动维度达峰，抽象词则是社会维度在225毫秒最早达峰。作者据此认为，大脑会依据概念类型动态调整各语义维度的优先顺序，提示语义加工并非单一平均过程，而具有维度特异的时间组织。

papers.title: Muscle age acceleration shapes resting-state brain connectivity: an EEG study on older adults.
papers.authors: Frasca F, Pappalettera C, Cacciotti A, Ventura L, Morrone M, Manca A, Deriu F, Vecchio F.
papers.abstract: Aging is a multifaceted process where physiological metrics, such as brain age and muscle age (MA), provide deeper insights than chronological age alone. These nonlinear trajectories are heavily influenced by exogenous factors like lifestyle and nutrition. In older populations, muscle age acceleration (MAA) critically impacts functional autonomy and cognitive health, necessitating research into its link with brain network organization to refine assessments and, based on these, integrated motor and cognitive rehabilitation strategies. In this study, eyes-closed resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) was recorded from 101 healthy, neurologically intact older adults. MA and MAA were quantified using a regression model incorporating the functional assessments recommended by the European Working Group on Sarcopenia in Older People (EWGSOP-2) consensus (anthropometrics, muscle strength, and motor functional tests). Participants were stratified into three groups based on their MAA: decelerated MA, normal MA, and accelerated MA. Brain connectivity was assessed through magnitude-squared coherence (MSCoh) and node strength analyses. The results demonstrated that decelerated MA subjects exhibit significantly lower MSCoh compared to the normal and accelerated groups in the Alpha 1, Alpha 2, and Beta 1 bands. Furthermore, node strength analysis revealed that the decelerated MA group possessed lower values in the right frontal area across Alpha 1, Beta 1, and Beta 2 bands. Conversely, the normal MA group exhibited lower values in the right temporal region compared to the accelerated MA group. These findings may suggest that divergent muscle aging trajectories significantly modulate brain network topography. This brain-body interconnection highlights the potential for personalized interventions designed to redirect muscle aging trajectories, ultimately enhancing global functioning and quality of life of older people.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注老年人肌肉年龄加速（MAA）与静息态脑网络组织之间的关系，对健康、神经系统完好的老年人进行闭眼静息态脑电记录，并依据肌肉年龄将其分为减速、正常和加速三组，比较脑连接与节点强度。结果显示，肌肉年龄减速组在多个α和β频段的连接强度低于正常组和加速组，其右侧额区节点强度也较低；而正常组与加速组之间则在右侧颞区呈现差异。作者据此提出，不同的肌肉衰老轨迹可能与脑网络拓扑结构相关，提示肌肉与大脑之间存在联系，并可能为通过干预肌肉衰老轨迹来改善老年人整体功能和生活质量提供线索；但这一关联性发现尚不能说明因果关系或干预效果。

papers.title: Cognitive and Neural Preservation in Older Language Learners: The CNPOLL Framework.
papers.authors: Zhang H, Li J, Xiao Y, Wu YJ.
papers.abstract: The plasticity of bilingual language systems across the lifespan remains a central issue in theories of language representation and control, yet late-life language learning is rarely integrated into these accounts. This review synthesizes behavioral and neurocognitive evidence on older adults acquiring an additional language, with the aim of clarifying how aging shapes bilingual language learning mechanisms. We first report a quantitative synthesis of behavioral studies examining the effects of late language learning on control-related domains implicated in bilingual language processing, including executive coordination, attentional regulation, and working memory. Results indicate a small but reliable effect, with modest improvements primarily observed in higher-order executive processes rather than broad enhancements in general cognitive function. We then review neuroimaging evidence showing that late language acquisition engages language, control, and memory systems, including frontal-parietal and memory-related networks, in patterns shaped by task demands, age-related constraints, and learning stage. Building on these findings, we propose the Cognitive and Neural Preservation in Older Language Learners (CNPOLL) framework as a lifespan account of bilingual language plasticity in older adulthood. By situating late-life language learning within contemporary models of bilingualism, this review highlights older learners as a theoretically informative population for understanding the adaptability and limits of bilingual language systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合行为与神经影像证据，考察老年人学习额外语言时双语语言系统的可塑性。行为研究的定量合成显示，晚期语言学习对执行协调、注意调节和工作记忆等控制相关领域有较小但可靠的效果，改善主要见于高阶执行过程，而非一般认知功能的普遍提升。神经影像证据则表明，晚期语言习得会调动语言、控制和记忆系统，其活动模式受任务需求、年龄相关限制和学习阶段影响。作者据此提出CNPOLL框架，将晚年语言学习纳入双语研究视角，并强调老年学习者是理解双语语言系统适应性与局限性的重要人群。

papers.title: Direction-Dependent Effects of White-Matter Conductivity Anisotropy on Modulation Depth and Spatial Extent in Transcranial Interference Stimulation: A Simulation Study.
papers.authors: Xu T, Yu L, Li X, Gong Q, Roberts N, Xing H.
papers.abstract: Transcranial interference stimulation (TIS) is a non-invasive neuromodulation technique designed to modulate deep brain structures. Although most TIS simulation studies assume isotropic tissue conductivity, white-matter (WM) conductivity is direction dependent. This study investigated how diffusion-tensor-imaging-derived, volume-normalized WM conductivity anisotropy affects the magnitude and spatial distribution of the maximum low-frequency envelope amplitude, here termed maximum modulation depth (MDmax), in individualized TIS models. Six individualized head models were constructed from structural and diffusion MRI data. Isotropic and anisotropic conductivity models were compared under two manually selected proof-of-concept TIS montages designed to produce contrasting modulation-depth directions relative to the dominant fibre orientation of the corpus callosum. For each voxel, MDmax and the corresponding unit modulation-depth direction vector were calculated. Directionality was evaluated in the corpus callosum by comparing this vector with the principal diffusion eigenvector, v₁. To assess whether these effects extended beyond the corpus callosum, additional target-specific analyses were performed in the left M1 and left hippocampus using montages selected in the isotropic model and held fixed between conductivity models. Anisotropic conductivity altered both the magnitude and spatial distribution of the simulated TIS envelope. Whole-brain MDmax was higher in the anisotropic than in the isotropic model under both montages, whereas threshold-defined high-MD volume showed montage-dependent differences. In the corpus callosum body, regional peak modulation depth was higher when the modulation-depth direction vector was more collinear with v₁, but lower when the two directions were approximately orthogonal. Under the target-specific montages, regional peak modulation depth increased modestly in the left primary motor cortex but decreased in the left hippocampus. These findings indicate that anisotropy-related changes are direction- and region-dependent and vary across target-specific montage configurations. Local fibre orientation should therefore be considered when interpreting individualized TIS field models.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用六名个体的结构与弥散磁共振数据构建经颅干涉刺激（TIS）头模型，比较各向同性与基于弥散张量成像的各向异性白质电导率模型，考察其对低频包络最大调制深度及空间分布的影响。结果显示，各向异性使全脑最大调制深度在两个示例性刺激方案下均升高，但高调制深度体积的差异随方案而变；在胼胝体，调制深度方向与主弥散方向越接近平行时局部峰值越高，越接近正交时则越低。针对左侧初级运动皮层和海马的目标特异性分析还显示效应方向不一致，提示各向异性影响具有方向与区域依赖性，解读个体化TIS场模型时需考虑局部纤维走向。

papers.title: Hemimegalencephaly With Diffuse Cortical Malformation in a Child With Drug-Resistant Infantile Epileptic Spasms: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Essaher B, Sqalli Houssaini Y, Amar S, En Nouali H, Boui M.
papers.abstract: Hemimegalencephaly is a rare congenital malformation of cortical development involving hamartomatous overgrowth of part or all of one cerebral hemisphere. It commonly presents during infancy with early-onset, drug-resistant seizures, developmental impairment, and contralateral motor deficits. Infantile epileptic spasms may be an initial manifestation. Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to diagnosis and surgical planning. We report the case of an 11-month-old boy with West syndrome and severe developmental delay whose epileptic spasms persisted despite treatment with vigabatrin, sodium valproate, and levetiracetam. Brain MRI demonstrated marked asymmetric enlargement of the left cerebral hemisphere, diffuse cortical thickening, blurring of the gray-white matter differentiation, enlargement and morphological distortion of the left lateral ventricle, shallow sulcation, and extensive pachygyria with areas approaching an agyric appearance. The right cerebral hemisphere was structurally preserved. These findings were consistent with left hemimegalencephaly associated with an extensive malformation of cortical development. An anterior corpus callosotomy was performed as a palliative disconnective procedure; however, the epileptic spasms persisted, and the patient was subsequently referred for evaluation of definitive left hemispherotomy. This case illustrates the characteristic MRI appearance of hemimegalencephaly with diffuse cortical malformation and highlights the limitations of anterior corpus callosotomy when the epileptogenic substrate involves an entire malformed hemisphere. It also emphasizes the role of imaging in guiding escalation to definitive hemispheric disconnection when seizures remain drug-resistant.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一名11个月大、患有West综合征和严重发育迟缓的男童，其癫痫性痉挛对维加巴林、丙戊酸钠和左乙拉西坦治疗均无反应。脑MRI显示左侧大脑半球显著不对称增大、弥漫性皮质增厚、灰白质分界模糊、左侧侧脑室扩大变形、脑沟变浅及广泛巨脑回，部分区域接近无脑回，符合左半球巨脑畸形伴广泛皮质发育畸形。作者报告，作为姑息性离断手术的前部胼胝体切开术后癫痫性痉挛仍持续，患儿随后被转诊评估确定性左半球切开术。该病例提示，当致痫基础累及整个畸形半球时，前部胼胝体切开术存在局限，影像学在指导升级至确定性半球离断中具有作用。

papers.title: Machine Learning Models for Early Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection: Systematic Review With a Pediatric and Engineering Perspective.
papers.authors: Onyango C, Wanjiku LN, Oketch C.
papers.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition for which earlier identification may facilitate timely developmental assessment and intervention. This systematic review synthesized evidence on machine learning (ML)/ deep learning (DL) approaches for early ASD detection, with particular attention to pediatric populations, data modalities, model architectures, reported diagnostic performance, validation strategies, methodological quality, and clinical and engineering translation. PubMed and IEEE Xplore were searched through July 29, 2026. The supplied database exports contained 794 PubMed records and 455 IEEE Xplore records. After removal of seven records published after the prespecified cutoff, 1242 records remained. Thirty-eight duplicates were removed, leaving 1204 unique records for screening. Following title/abstract screening, 314 reports underwent detailed record-level eligibility assessment, of which 237 were classified as record-level eligible on the basis of available titles, abstracts, bibliographic metadata, and accessible record information. The identified evidence encompassed questionnaire and clinical-information models, home-video and behavioral analysis, speech and acoustic features, eye tracking, EEG/MEG, MRI/fMRI, wearable sensors, and multimodal approaches. Reported diagnostic performance varied substantially across populations, modalities, algorithms, and validation settings. Some retrospective studies reported very high classification accuracy, whereas independent and cross-cultural validation generally produced more variable performance. For example, an ML model based on medical and background information reported an AUROC of 0.895 during development and 0.790 in independent validation, while a real-world evaluation of an AI-based diagnostic system reported sensitivity of 99.1% and specificity of 81.6% among determinate outputs. Because the available evidence was heterogeneous and full-text reports were not available for all candidate studies, quantitative pooling and definitive study-level risk-of-bias assessment were not considered defensible. PROBAST+AI domains were therefore assessed only when sufficient methodological information was available, with otherwise unclear or not-assessable judgments. Across the evidence base, external validation, prevention of data leakage, dataset shift, explainability, privacy, fairness, reproducibility, computational requirements, and clinical workflow integration remain major barriers to translation. ML and DL approaches show promise as adjunctive screening and risk-classification technologies, but the available evidence does not support replacing specialist ASD assessment with autonomous AI diagnosis. Future research should prioritize prospective multicenter validation, transparent reporting, independent testing, clinically meaningful explainability, privacy-preserving methods, health-equity evaluation, calibration, and deployment within real-world pediatric clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了机器学习与深度学习用于自闭症谱系障碍早期识别的研究证据，关注儿科人群、数据模态、模型架构、报告性能、验证策略及方法学质量，检索覆盖问卷与临床信息、家庭视频与行为分析、语音、眼动、脑电与脑磁、磁共振、可穿戴设备及多模态等多种路径。作者指出，所报告的分类性能在不同人群、模态、算法和验证条件下差异很大：部分回顾性研究报告了很高的准确率，而独立验证和跨文化验证的结果通常波动更大，例如基于医学与背景信息的模型在开发阶段与独立验证中的判别性能存在明显落差。由于证据异质性大且并非所有候选研究都能获得全文，作者未做定量合并，也未给出确定性的偏倚风险评估，并强调外部验证、数据泄漏防控、数据集偏移、可解释性、隐私、公平性、可重复性和临床流程整合仍是转化中的主要障碍。总体而言，这些方法有望作为辅助筛查和风险分类工具，但现有证据不足以支持用自主人工智能诊断替代专科评估。

papers.title: [Advances in the application of individualized white-matter functional networks in children and adolescents with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder].
papers.authors: Yang HH, Hou JL.
papers.journal: Zhongguo dang dai er ke za zhi = Chinese journal of contemporary pediatrics
papers.abstract: Individualized white-matter functional networks provide a new paradigm for parsing individual differences and neural mechanisms in attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) among children and adolescents. This review summarizes construction approaches for such networks, including clustering analysis and independent component analysis, and synthesizes current progress. Group-level studies in children with ADHD have shown increased white-matter functional connectivity in the default mode and sensorimotor networks, but decreased white-matter functional connectivity in attention-related networks; these connectivity abnormalities are associated with core symptoms and impairments in executive function. However, group analyses can obscure inter-individual network heterogeneity and overlook gray-white matter functional coupling, limiting clinical translation. Individualized white-matter functional networks hold promise as potential neuroimaging markers for early screening and precision intervention in ADHD, yet challenges persist, including methodological inconsistency and the difficulty of acquiring pediatric data.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了儿童青少年注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）中个体化白质功能网络的构建方法（如聚类分析和独立成分分析）及研究进展。基于组水平的研究显示，ADHD儿童在白质默认模式网络和感觉运动网络的功能连接增强，而注意相关网络的功能连接减弱，这些异常与核心症状及执行功能受损相关。作者指出，组分析会掩盖个体间网络异质性并忽视灰白质功能耦合，限制临床转化；个体化白质功能网络有望成为早期筛查和精准干预的潜在影像标记，但方法学不一致和儿童数据获取困难仍是障碍。

papers.title: [Early resting-state functional connectivity characteristics in preterm and full-term infants: an exploratory study using functional near-infrared spectroscopy].
papers.authors: Wu Y, Zhu XY, Meng FZ, Gao HR, Cao JY, Yang H, Luo DD, Jin ZP, Zhou H, Wang J.
papers.journal: Zhongguo dang dai er ke za zhi = Chinese journal of contemporary pediatrics
papers.abstract: Objectives To compare resting-state brain functional connectivity among neonates of different gestational ages using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). Methods Forty hospitalized neonates were enrolled and categorized by gestational age into very preterm (n =10), moderate-to-late preterm (n =10), and full-term (n =20) groups. At a corrected gestational age of (40 ± 4) weeks, resting-state whole-brain oxygenation signals were acquired with fNIRS. The frontal, parietal, and temporal lobes were defined as regions of interest (ROI). Functional connectivity strength was calculated, and between-group comparisons were performed at both the whole-brain and ROI levels. Results At the whole-brain level, the mean functional connectivity strength in preterm infants was significantly lower than that in full-term infants (0.55 ± 0.20 vs 0.68 ± 0.16, P =0.030). Subgroup analysis showed the lowest connectivity strength in the very preterm group (0.46 ± 0.19), significantly lower than in the moderate-to-late preterm group (0.64 ± 0.19, P =0.030) and the full-term group (0.68 ± 0.16, P <0.01). At the ROI level, the very preterm group exhibited significantly reduced connectivity relative to the full-term group across multiple key connections, including left frontal-right frontal, left temporal-right frontal, bilateral frontal-bilateral parietal (both ipsilateral and contralateral), and left parietal-right parietal connections (all P <0.05). Conclusions Preterm birth exerts a gestational age-dependent gradient effect on resting-state brain functional connectivity, with smaller gestational age associated with more pronounced reductions. Very preterm neonates show widespread decreases in connectivity at the whole-brain level and between key cortical regions.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究用功能性近红外光谱比较不同胎龄新生儿在矫正胎龄约足月时的静息态脑功能连接，按胎龄分为极早产、中晚期早产和足月三组。结果显示，早产儿全脑平均功能连接强度低于足月儿，且胎龄越小降低越明显，极早产组最低，并显著低于中晚期早产组和足月组；在感兴趣区层面，极早产组在额叶、颞叶和顶叶之间的多条关键连接上也较足月组减弱。作者据此认为，早产对静息态功能连接存在随胎龄变化的梯度影响，极早产儿表现为全脑及关键皮层区域间较广泛的连接下降，提示早产程度可能与连接减弱相关，但研究为探索性设计，相关发现尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Multidimensional diffusion MRI reveals heterogeneous microstructural remodeling associated with amyloid pathology
papers.authors: Or PSK, Yon M, Narvaez O, Sitnikova V, Malm T, Bouhrara M, Sierra A, Topgaard D, Benjamini D.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) pathology involves amyloid deposition, reactive gliosis, and localized tissue alterations that coexist within the same brain regions, creating heterogeneous microstructural environments within individual imaging voxels. Conventional diffusion MRI averages these environments into aggregate measures, potentially obscuring their distinct contributions. Frequency-dependent multidimensional MRI (ωMD-MRI) resolves distributions of water components with different diffusion length scales, anisotropies, and relaxation properties, providing sensitivity to microstructural restriction, heterogeneity, and shape-size correlations within a voxel. Whether these measurements reveal microstructural complexity associated with AD pathology remains unclear. Here, we performed ωMD-MRI on ex vivo brain specimens from approximately 8-month-old 5xFAD and wild-type mice and interpreted the imaging findings alongside complementary histology. ωMD-MRI revealed widespread but spatially nonuniform differences between 5xFAD and wild-type brains. Measurements sensitive to microstructural restriction, heterogeneity, and shape-size correlations consistently indicated greater microstructural heterogeneity in 5xFAD brains, with the most prominent differences in the hippocampal formation and major cerebral white matter tracts. Complementary qualitative histology demonstrated extensive amyloid deposition and glial activation in affected regions, while overall cytoarchitecture and myelin organization remained largely preserved. Thus, the ωMD-MRI abnormalities occurred in tissue characterized by multiple coexisting pathological and relatively preserved microstructural environments rather than widespread structural degeneration. These findings demonstrate that ωMD-MRI can reveal the spatial and microstructural heterogeneity associated with amyloid pathology and provide a more comprehensive characterization of AD-related tissue alterations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注常规扩散MRI将体素内异质微环境平均化、可能掩盖不同组织成分贡献的问题，采用频率依赖多维扩散MRI（ωMD-MRI）对约8月龄5xFAD与野生型小鼠离体脑标本成像，并结合组织学解释结果。成像显示5xFAD脑内存在广泛但空间不均的差异，对微结构限制、异质性和形状—尺寸相关性敏感的指标一致提示其微结构异质性更高，以海马结构和主要大脑白质束最明显。组织学显示受累区域有广泛淀粉样沉积和胶质激活，而整体细胞构筑与髓鞘组织基本保留，说明这些影像异常出现在多种病理与相对保留的微环境共存的组织中，而非广泛结构退变。作者据此认为ωMD-MRI能揭示与淀粉样病理相关的空间和微结构异质性，更全面地刻画AD相关组织改变。

papers.title: Time-averaged and Time-varying Structure of the Gastric Network Revealed Through fMRI-Electrogastrogram Synchronization
papers.authors: Zair Y, Avidan G.
papers.abstract: The gastric network, comprised of brain regions whose activity synchronizes with the stomach’s slow-wave rhythm, offers a unique window into the brain-body interaction involved in interoceptive processing. While previous work has established the existence of this network, its intrinsic organization and temporal unfolding remain poorly understood. Here, we reanalyzed resting-state fMRI-electrogastrogram data from 43 healthy adults of both sexes to characterize the time-averaged architecture and time-varying reconfiguration of the gastric network. We identified regions exhibiting phase-locked synchronization with the stomach slow electrical rhythm (0.05 Hz) and characterized cortical parcels comprising this network. Time-averaged graph-theoretical analysis revealed a fixed unimodal organization of functional communities, with primary visual, default mode network (DMN) and dorsal attention regions emerging as the principal time-averaged hubs. Next, we applied edge-centric functional connectivity (eFC) to capture the network state during transient high-amplitude “bursts”. Time-varying community detection revealed communities whose compositions formed integrative combinations of DMN, visual, attentional and control elements. Edge-derived hubs shifted away from primary visual dominancy in the time-averaged analysis, and were instead directed by DMN regions, suggesting that moments of heightened connectivity in the network are coordinated by multisensory integration rather than passive sensory processing. These findings demonstrate that the gastric network is not merely a time-averaged, sensory-bound system, but rather a flexible and dynamically reconfiguring interoceptive network whose organization is selectively coordinated by transient cofluctuation events. This work provides a comprehensive network analysis of gastric-brain coupling and reveals a temporally structured mode of interoceptive integration that may support adaptive physiological and cognitive regulation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究重新分析健康成人静息态fMRI与胃电图同步数据，考察胃网络的时间平均架构及其动态重组。时间平均的图论分析显示，功能社区呈固定的单峰组织，主要枢纽包括初级视觉区、默认模式网络和背侧注意区；而在瞬时高幅共波动期间，网络社区由默认模式网络、视觉、注意和控制等成分整合而成，枢纽也从视觉区转向默认模式网络区域。作者据此认为，胃网络并非仅由感觉输入限定的静态系统，而是一个由瞬时共波动事件选择性协调、具有时间结构的灵活内感受网络，可能支持适应性生理与认知调节。

papers.title: Preserved brain hierarchy supports residual vision without awareness after visual cortex damage
papers.authors: Orsenigo D, Luppi AI, Diano M, Ciorli T, Borriero A, Willis HE, Petri G, Bridge H, Tamietto M.
papers.abstract: Damage to the primary visual cortex causes loss of conscious vision, yet some patients retain the ability to respond to stimuli despite reporting no visual experience. Why similar lesions produce such different behavioral phenotypes remains unclear. While research to date has focused primarily on spared pathways that bypass V1, here we asked whether these divergent outcomes are also linked to the brain's intrinsic functional architecture. In the largest resting-state fMRI cohort of patients with unilateral V1 damage reported to date, we quantified information sharing between regions across cortical and subcortical parcels in blindsight-positive and blindsight-negative patients, as well as in age-matched healthy controls. Despite comparable lesions, the two patient groups displayed distinct hierarchical patterns on the cortex: B+ patients preserved a sensory-to-association organization as in healthy controls, whereas B- patients exhibited a marked flattening of this hierarchy. The effect was driven by abnormally low shared-information coupling within unimodal cortices and scaled continuously with single-subject behavioral blind-field detection performance. A thalamic region consistent with the pulvinar, linking the contralesional visual cortex and the frontal eye field, discriminated B+ from B- patients. These findings highlight the system-level consequences of V1 damage supporting blindsight, suggesting that the unimodal-transmodal axis might track not only global states of consciousness, but also whether sensory information can guide behavior without awareness.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注初级视觉皮层损伤后，为何部分患者虽无视觉意识却仍能对刺激作出反应（盲视），而另一些患者则不能。作者利用单侧V1损伤患者的大样本静息态fMRI数据，比较盲视阳性、盲视阴性患者与健康对照者脑区间信息共享的分层组织。结果显示，尽管病灶相近，盲视阳性患者仍保留类似健康人的感觉—联合层级，盲视阴性患者该层级明显扁平化；这一差异与单模态皮层内异常低的信息耦合有关，并随个体盲视野检测表现连续变化。研究提示，V1损伤后的系统层级组织可能与无意识下的视觉行为有关，但相关关系不等于因果，其临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Structure-Constrained Intrinsic Timescales Across Tasks
papers.authors: Wu K, de Palma Aristides R, Herzog R, Mirasso CR, Sorrentino P, Gollo LL.
papers.abstract: Intrinsic neural timescale (INT) quantifies the persistence of spontaneous neural dynamics and offers a principled metric for characterizing brain-wide temporal organization. Although a hierarchy of INTs has been established during rest, how task engagement reconfigures this organization and how it is constrained by the structural connectome (SC) remain poorly understood. Here, we systematically mapped whole-brain INT using high-resolution fMRI data from the Human Connectome Project during rest and seven tasks spanning working memory, gambling, motor, language, social, relational, and emotion domains. Task engagement induced robust, regionally heterogeneous changes in INT while largely preserving the brain-wide temporal hierarchy across cognitive states. SC-INT coupling remained strong but consistently decreased during tasks, indicating that anatomical architecture continues to constrain INT, although its influence is attenuated under task demands. To investigate these findings mechanistically, we employed a multiscale, whole-brain neuronal-network model, which revealed that INT increase and peak within a broad critical-like regime. Strong SC-INT coupling, as observed empirically, emerged in the subcritical regime, weakened progressively with increasing network excitability, and reversed in the supercritical regime. These results demonstrate that task engagement reconfigures INTs while maintaining their hierarchical organization, suggesting that both resting and task states operate largely within a common subcritical dynamical regime.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注任务参与如何重塑全脑内在神经时间尺度（INT）及其与结构连接组的耦合关系，利用高分辨率功能磁共振数据比较了静息状态与涵盖工作记忆、语言、情绪等多个领域的任务状态。结果显示，任务引起区域异质性的INT变化，但全脑时间尺度层级在认知状态间基本保持；结构连接与INT的耦合在任务中依然较强却持续减弱，说明解剖架构仍施加约束，只是任务需求下影响被削弱。作者进一步用多尺度全脑神经网络模型解释这一现象，发现INT升高及峰值出现在类临界区间，而经验观察到的强结构-功能耦合出现在亚临界区间，并随网络兴奋性升高而减弱、在超临界区间反转。这些结果提示，静息与任务状态可能主要运行于共同的亚临界动力学区间。

papers.title: Schizophrenia-like neurodevelopmental pathology reshapes experience-dependent brain network remodeling following adolescent alcohol exposure
papers.authors: Houdant C, Khalilian M, Fortineau Z, Rouanet C, Leuillier E, Madeline M, Fall S, Aarabi A, Jeanblanc J, Naassila M.
papers.abstract: Background Alcohol use disorder (AUD) is highly prevalent in schizophrenia, yet the neurobiological basis of this vulnerability remains poorly understood. Neurodevelopmental models suggest that pre-existing brain dysconnectivity may increase vulnerability to AUD. We therefore tested whether schizophrenia-like neurodevelopmental pathology alters how alcohol-related experience is incorporated into large-scale brain networks. Methods Resting-state functional connectivity was assessed in male Sprague-Dawley rats ( n = 18-21/group) with neonatal ventral hippocampal lesions (NVHL), a neurodevelopmental model of schizophrenia, and sham-operated controls, with or without voluntary adolescent alcohol exposure. Functional connectivity was assessed using seed-to-voxel and seed-to-seed analyses within a cortico-striato-limbic network. We additionally examined whether individual alcohol intake during adolescence predicted adult functional connectivity according to neurodevelopmental status. Results NVHL and adolescent alcohol exposure independently produced predominantly hypoconnected cortico-striato-limbic networks. However, alcohol exposure did not exacerbate NVHL-associated dysconnectivity but was instead associated with a distinct network organization characterized by relative hyperconnectivity. Although alcohol intake was comparable between groups, dose-dependent relationships between adolescent alcohol consumption and adult functional connectivity were observed in sham animals but were absent or markedly attenuated in NVHL rats. These effects were primarily centered on prelimbic cortex connectivity with the amygdala, hippocampus, and dorsal striatum, implicating this circuitry in altered experience-dependent remodeling. Conclusions These findings suggest that vulnerability to AUD associated with schizophrenia-like neurodevelopment may arise less from additive network dysfunction than from an altered capacity of large-scale brain networks for experience-dependent functional remodeling. Schizophrenia-like neurodevelopmental pathology may therefore change how alcohol-related experience is translated into persistent brain network organization.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在大鼠中考察了类似精神分裂症的神经发育病理如何改变青春期饮酒经历对成年脑网络的塑造，采用新生期腹侧海马损伤模型，并结合静息态功能连接分析。结果显示，神经发育损伤与青春期酒精暴露各自造成皮质-纹状体-边缘网络以低连接为主，但酒精并未加重损伤相关的连接异常，反而伴随一种相对高连接的独特网络组织。更关键的是，青春期饮酒量与成年功能连接之间的剂量依赖关系在对照组中存在，在损伤组中却缺失或明显减弱，且主要涉及前边缘皮质与杏仁核、海马及背侧纹状体的连接。作者据此认为，这类神经发育病理带来的酒精使用障碍易感性，可能更多源于大规模脑网络经验依赖性重塑能力的改变，而非网络损伤的简单叠加。

papers.title: Progress of Digital Technologies in the Perioperative Management of Postoperative Delirium Among Older Adults.
papers.authors: Lin Y, Lu T, Liu C, Wu X, Jiang H, Zhu M, Dai W.
papers.abstract: Postoperative delirium (POD) is one of the most common and severe complications among older adults, and is closely associated with poor outcomes, increased healthcare costs, and long-term cognitive decline. With the rapid growth of the global aging population and the continuous emergence of new geriatric surgical procedures, the prevention and management of POD have become a major challenge. Traditional risk assessment tools have inherent limitations in clinical practice and are insufficient to meet the growing demands of precision medicine. In recent years, digital technologies have shown tremendous potential in perioperative management; innovations such as machine learning-based predictive models, wearable sensors, electroencephalogram (EEG) monitoring, and large language models are increasingly being adopted for POD risk identification. This review comprehensively summarizes research advances in digital technology for POD risk identification and their role in clinical decision support for older adults, with the aim of providing evidence-based insights and implementation guidance for clinical practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦老年患者术后谵妄的围手术期管理，梳理了数字技术在风险识别与临床决策支持方面的研究进展。文章指出，传统风险评估工具在临床实践中存在局限，难以满足精准医疗的需求；而基于机器学习的预测模型、可穿戴传感器、脑电监测和大语言模型等数字技术，正越来越多地被用于术后谵妄的风险识别。作者据此总结了这些技术对老年患者临床决策支持的潜在作用，并希望为临床实践提供循证参考和实施指导，但摘要未报告具体验证结果或临床应用效果。

papers.title: Time-specific comparison of gray-white matter ratio models for predicting outcomes after cardiac arrest: basal ganglia as the leading model.
papers.authors: Cheong H, Feng L, De Z, Li X, Wang Y, Zeng X, Du L.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND To identify optimal time-specific gray-white matter ratio (GWR) models for predicting poor neurological outcomes after cardiac arrest (CA). METHODS We retrospectively analyzed a prospective single-center cohort of comatose adults who survived CA. Brain computed tomography (CT) scans were performed at three predefined phases following the return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC): the early phase (<12 h), intermediate phase (12-72 h), and recovery phase (>72 h to 1 week). Patients with ≥1 scan were included. Five GWR models (basal ganglia [BG], cortical [CO], average [AV], simplified [SI], and cerebellar [CE]) and a combined model (BG+CE) were evaluated for their ability to predict poor neurological outcomes (cerebral performance category of 3-5) at discharge. RESULTS In all, 173 patients were included, 40 (23.1%) of whom achieved favorable neurological outcomes at discharge. The five GWR values were consistently lower in the poor-outcome group across multiple phases. In the early phase, the area under the curves (AUCs) for GWR-BG, GWR-AV, GWR-CE, GWR-SI, and GWR-CO were 0.83 (95% CI 0.75-0.91), 0.78 (95% CI 0.68-0.87), 0.73 (95% CI 0.61-0.84), 0.72 (95% CI 0.62-0.82), and 0.64 (95% CI 0.51-0.74), respectively. In the intermediate phase, the AUCs increased to 0.87 (95% CI 0.77-0.95), 0.88 (95% CI 0.78-0.96), 0.84 (95% CI 0.73-0.93), 0.81 (95% CI 0.70-0.92), and 0.79 (95% CI 0.66-0.88), respectively, while in the recovery phase, they decreased to 0.76 (95% CI 0.63-0.88), 0.75 (95% CI 0.61-0.86), 0.74 (95% CI 0.60-0.87), 0.64 (95% CI 0.49-0.77), and 0.67 (95% CI 0.52-0.80), respectively. GWR-BG remained comparable to the other individual models. The combined model achieved AUCs of 0.87, 0.90, and 0.80 across the three phases. In the early phase, the combined model significantly outperformed the other four individual models and exhibited numerically higher performance than GWR-BG. CONCLUSION GWR-BG was superior or comparable to the other GWR models across all three post-ROSC phases; GWR-CE was validated as a predictor of poor neurological outcomes, and the combination of GWR-BG and GWR-CE further enhanced early-phase prediction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于单中心前瞻性队列中心脏骤停后昏迷成人的回顾性资料，比较五种灰白质比（GWR）模型及基底节联合小脑模型在复苏后不同阶段预测出院时不良神经功能结局的能力。结果显示，基底节模型在各阶段均优于或不劣于其他单一模型，小脑模型也被验证具有预测价值；联合模型在早期阶段的预测表现优于多数单一模型，并在中期达到较高水平。作者据此认为，基底节GWR是较稳健的预测模型，联合小脑GWR可进一步提升早期预测，但结论仍需外部验证。

papers.title: Epilepsy in Children with Celiac Disease: Clinical and Electroencephalographic Characteristics and Outcomes in a Ten-Patient Case Series.
papers.authors: Işıkay S, Demirçubuk A, Bozkurt H, Işıkay N, Gülşan M.
papers.journal: Annals of Indian Academy of Neurology
papers.abstract: Abstract Celiac disease is an immune-mediated systemic disorder triggered by gluten exposure in genetically predisposed individuals. Epilepsy has been reported among the neurological manifestations associated with celiac disease; however, the relationship between epilepsy and celiac disease remains incompletely understood, and their coexistence does not necessarily imply causality. This ten-patient case series describes the clinical, electroencephalographic, and follow-up characteristics of children with both epilepsy and celiac disease. Seven patients had focal epilepsy, whereas three had generalized epilepsy phenotypes, including presumed juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, presumed juvenile absence epilepsy, and sleep-related generalized tonic-clonic seizures. Electroencephalography most commonly demonstrated posterior epileptiform abnormalities. Following initiation of a gluten-free diet and appropriate antiseizure medication, seizure freedom was achieved in all patients during follow-up. These findings suggest that epilepsy may occur in children with celiac disease and that favorable outcomes may be observed after dietary treatment. However, the present data should be interpreted as an association rather than evidence of causality.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例系列描述同时患有癫痫与乳糜泻的儿童，结合临床表现、脑电图特征和随访情况，探讨两者共存时的特点及转归。十例患儿中多数为局灶性癫痫，少数表现为全面性癫痫表型，脑电图以枕区癫痫样异常较为常见。在开始无麸质饮食并配合适当的抗癫痫药物治疗后，随访期间所有患儿均实现无发作。作者据此提示，乳糜泻患儿中可能出现癫痫，饮食治疗后或可获得较好结局；但现有数据只能说明两者存在关联，不能证明因果关系，也不能据此推断治疗效应。

papers.title: Evaluation of Macro- and Microstructural White Matter Changes in Hot Water Epilepsy.
papers.authors: Kenchaiah R, Parthasarthy S, Krishna BG, Dawn BR, Saini J, Kulanthaivelu K, Mundlamuri RC, Asranna A, Viswanathan LG, Sinha S.
papers.journal: Annals of Indian Academy of Neurology
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Hot water epilepsy (HWE) is a form of reflex epilepsy and usually lacks definitive magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) features. Although white matter abnormalities have been extensively investigated in patients with temporal lobe epilepsy or generalized epilepsies, very few studies have examined quantitative changes in reflex epilepsy. This study aims to explore the white matter changes in HWE. The objective is to investigate the white matter micro- and macrostructural changes in patients with HWE using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) indices and three-dimensional structural-imaging-derived subcortical white matter volumes. Methods Eighty-eight subjects with HWE and 50 age- and sex-matched controls underwent high-resolution volumetric MRI and DTI. DTI and volumetric data were processed using tract-based spatial statistics and FreeSurfer, respectively. Between-group differences in DTI metrics and regional subcortical white matter volumes were assessed. Correlations between DTI metrics, white matter volumes, and epilepsy-specific clinical variables were also evaluated. Results Subjects with HWE showed significant alterations in DTI metrics indicative of impaired white matter integrity, including decreased fractional anisotropy and increased mean diffusivity, axial diffusivity, and radial diffusivity. These changes were evident both globally (whole-brain) and within specific supratentorial and infratentorial white matter tracts. Subcortical white matter volume loss was predominant in the thalamo-limbic, somatosensory, posterior cingulate, cuneus, and frontal regions. Positive correlations were observed between alterations in global fractional anisotropy and changes in macrostructural (subcortical) white matter volumes. Conclusion Subjects with HWE exhibited global and region-specific white matter alterations at both micro- and macrostructural levels. Somatosensory subcortical involvement may be associated with the stimulus sensitivity characteristic of this disorder. Involvement of temporal-limbic and default mode network regions is consistent with the clinical semiology, while brainstem changes concur with the reflex nature of the disease.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注热水性癫痫患者是否存在白质微结构与宏观结构改变，采用弥散张量成像指标和基于三维结构像的皮层下白质体积，对患者与年龄性别匹配的对照进行比较。结果显示，患者在全局及多个幕上、幕下白质纤维束均出现提示白质完整性受损的弥散指标异常，皮层下白质体积减少主要见于丘脑-边缘系统、躯体感觉、后扣带、楔叶及额叶区域，且全局各向异性改变与宏观白质体积变化呈正相关。作者据此认为，该病在微结构和宏观结构层面均存在全局与区域特异性白质改变，其中躯体感觉相关受累可能与刺激敏感性有关，颞叶-边缘系统及默认网络区域受累与临床症候一致，脑干改变则与疾病的反射性特点相符。

papers.title: Open-Loop Deep Brain Stimulation Versus Closed-Loop Responsive Neurostimulation in Drug-Resistant Bitemporal Epilepsy: A Narrative Review.
papers.authors: Zehra SF, Hassan MA, Baliga P, Khatib AS, Ullah F.
papers.journal: Annals of Indian Academy of Neurology
papers.abstract: Abstract Drug-resistant bitemporal epilepsy presents a therapeutic challenge when resective surgery is not feasible due to bilateral seizure onset or eloquent cortex involvement. Neuromodulation has emerged as an alternative, with open-loop deep brain stimulation (DBS) and closed-loop responsive neurostimulation (RNS) as implantable strategies. Comparative indications for modality selection remain unclear. A narrative review of articles published from January 2007 to January 2026 was performed in PubMed/MEDLINE. Approximately 120 articles were screened, and 39 studies were included. Due to heterogeneity in study design, findings were synthesized qualitatively. Both DBS and RNS significantly reduce seizure frequency in drug-resistant bitemporal epilepsy, with a median seizure reduction of approximately 60% to 75%. Seizure freedom, however, remained limited, reflecting the palliative nature of these treatments. Open-loop anterior nucleus of the thalamus (ANT) DBS provides network-level modulation with low maintenance, while hippocampal DBS offers localized temporal inhibition. Conversely, closed-loop RNS delivers adaptive focal stimulation via real-time sensing and yields chronic intracranial electroencephalogram data. While both modalities show comparable efficacy, RNS may be advantageous in focal or asymmetric bitemporal epilepsy. Cognitive outcomes were favorable for both techniques, with RNS demonstrating the prevention of memory and language decline. Both DBS and RNS are palliative neuromodulatory options for patients in whom resective surgery is not feasible. Treatment selection should be individualized based on seizure network characteristics, laterality, monitoring needs, participation capacity, and cognitive considerations. The primary goal is to reduce seizure frequency and improve quality of life rather than to achieve seizure freedom. Future multicenter studies and biomarker-driven strategies are needed to refine selection and improve long-term outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述比较了开环深部脑刺激（DBS）与闭环反应性神经刺激（RNS）在药物难治性双侧颞叶癫痫中的应用，重点讨论在切除性手术不可行时如何选择这两种植入式神经调控策略。作者检索并定性综合了相关文献，发现两种方法均能显著减少发作频率，但实现无发作的比例仍有限，说明其本质为姑息性治疗；两者疗效总体相当，RNS可能更适合局灶性或非对称性双侧颞叶癫痫，并可能有助于避免记忆和语言功能下降。文章据此提出，治疗选择应结合癫痫网络特征、侧别、监测需求、参与能力和认知因素个体化决定，主要目标是减少发作并改善生活质量，而非追求无发作。

papers.title: Mapping the literature about brain-computer interface in rehabilitation: a graph-theory-based PCA framework for semantic space analysis.
papers.authors: Coraci D, Regazzo G, Masiero S.
papers.abstract: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) are increasingly used in neurorehabilitation, but the rapid expansion of scientific literature complicates the identification of clinically relevant studies. This study investigated whether expert-defined relevance within BCI rehabilitation literature emerges as a structural property of semantic networks through the integration of graph theory and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). A Lexical Network Analysis Based on Graph Theory (LENGTH) was applied to randomized controlled trials indexed in PubMed over the last decade using the query "brain computer interface" AND rehabilitation. Titles and abstracts were analyzed to construct a semantic network linking articles and lexical terms. Multiple graph-theoretical metrics were calculated and residualized against weighted degree to minimize document-size bias. PCA was subsequently applied to the residualized metrics. Forty-eight studies were included. The network showed a compact and highly interconnected structure, centered on motor and functional recovery concepts. PCA identified two principal components explaining of total variance. Relevant articles tended to occupy regions characterized by higher semantic integration and lower hierarchical influence. Although no clear categorical separation emerged, a consistent positional tendency was observed. These findings suggest that relevance may be represented as a topological property within a multidimensional semantic landscape, supporting the use of semantic-network approaches for literature screening and evidence synthesis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注脑机接口康复领域文献快速增长、临床相关研究难以识别的问题，将图论与主成分分析结合，对PubMed近十年相关随机对照试验的标题和摘要构建语义网络，考察专家判定的相关性是否体现为语义网络的结构属性。结果显示，网络结构紧凑且高度互联，围绕运动与功能恢复概念展开；相关文献倾向于分布在语义整合度较高、层级影响较低的区域，但并未出现清晰的类别分离，只表现为一致的位置倾向。作者据此提出，相关性可被理解为多维语义空间中的拓扑属性，这为用语义网络方法辅助文献筛选和证据综合提供了依据。

papers.title: Education Moderates the Biomarker-Cortical-Thickness Relationship in Females With Cognitive Decline: A Descriptive Study With Sex Comparisons.
papers.authors: Moon Y, Jeon HJ, Kim HJ, Noh MY, Kim SH, Han SH, Kim H, Moon WJ.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Education is a well-established proxy for cognitive reserve and hence may influence the relationship between Alzheimer's disease pathology and brain structure. This is particularly relevant in South Korea, where historical sex disparities in educational level among current elderly populations create unique cohort characteristics. This study examined how educational level moderates the biomarker-cortical-thickness relationship in females with cognitive decline, with descriptive sex comparisons used to contextualize these findings within a cohort reflecting disparities in the history of educational opportunities in South Korea. Methods In 80 patients (58 females, 22 males) with cognitive decline, we assessed plasma amyloid-β 42 (Aβ42), phosphorylated tau 181 (p-tau), and total tau levels, p-tau/Aβ42 ratio, regional cortical thickness, and scores on the Mini-Mental State Examination. Given the substantial confounding between sex and educational level in this cohort, moderated mediation analyses examining the biomarker-cortical-thickness-cognition pathway were restricted to females (n =53 with complete data). Results Females had a higher p-tau/Aβ42 ratio (p =0.026) and thicker frontal cortex (p =0.049) despite the absence of a significant difference in age-adjusted cognition. No significant sex× educational level interaction was observed for the biomarkers or cognition. In females, educational level moderated the relationship between the p-tau/Aβ42 ratio and cortical thickness (p <0.05 in all five brain regions), with high-educational level females showing the expected cortical thinning with pathology, while low-educational level females exhibited preserved thickness, which did not mediate the cognitive performance. Conclusions Descriptive sex comparisons revealed a higher biomarker burden yet greater cortical thickness in females. Importantly, educational level significantly moderated the biomarker-cortical thickness relationship specifically in females, with lower-educated individuals showing structural preservation despite the presence of pathology. These findings suggest that measurements of the cortical thickness can underestimate the disease burden in lower-educated females, which highlights the need for educational level-stratified interpretations of structural biomarkers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察教育水平是否调节认知衰退患者中阿尔茨海默病生物标志物与皮层厚度的关系，并比较男女差异；研究纳入80名认知衰退患者，检测血浆Aβ42、p-tau、总tau及p-tau/Aβ42比值，测量局部皮层厚度和简易智力状态检查得分，因性别与教育水平高度混杂，中介分析仅限女性。描述性比较显示女性p-tau/Aβ42比值更高、额叶皮层更厚，但年龄校正后认知无显著性别差异。在女性中，教育水平显著调节p-tau/Aβ42比值与皮层厚度的关系：高教育女性随病理加重出现预期皮层变薄，低教育女性则皮层厚度保持，且该厚度未中介认知表现。作者据此提示，皮层厚度可能低估低教育女性的疾病负担，结构生物标志物解读需按教育水平分层。

papers.title: [Clinical characterization and genetic analysis of a patient with Fahr disease due to a homozygous variant of JAM2 gene].
papers.authors: Ma Q, Shao W, Wang Y, Hu Z, Liu F.
papers.journal: Zhonghua yi xue yi chuan xue za zhi = Zhonghua yixue yichuanxue zazhi = Chinese journal of medical genetics
papers.abstract: Objective To explore the clinical presentation and molecular etiology for a patient with Fahr disease due to a variant of JAM2 gene. Methods A male patient who had presented at the Department of Neurology of the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University in January 2021 for unsteady gait for over six months was selected as study subject. Clinical data including medical history, family history, physical examination, routine tests such as blood, urine, and stool examinations for the proband were collected. Cranial CT and MRI were carried out. Peripheral blood samples from the patient and his parents were collected. Following extraction of genomic DNA, whole exome sequence (WES) was carried out. Candidate variant was verified by Sanger sequencing of the family members. Pathogenicity of variant was rated based on guidelines from the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG). Swiss-Model was used to analyzed the impact of variant on the protein product. This study was approved by the Medical Ethics Committee of the hospital (Ethics No.: KS-2018-KY-36). Results The patient had developed unsteady gait 6 months before without clear cause, manifesting as a feeling of heaviness in the head and lightness in the feet, a sensation of walking on cotton wool when standing or walking, without facial drooping, blurred vision, numbness or weakness in the limbs, hand tremors, or slow movement. Cranial CT revealed multiple high-density calcifications in the bilateral cerebellar hemispheres, basal ganglia, thalamus, and gray-white matter junction of the cerebral hemispheres. MRI plain scan showed left frontal lobe lateral ventricular infarction, bilateral paraventricular white matter demyelination, bilateral maxillary sinusitis, and right maxillary sinus cyst. No other family members had similar clinical symptoms. WES and Sanger sequencing results showed that the patient has harbored homozygous c.460C>T (p.Arg154*) variant of the JAM2 gene, for which both of his parents were heterozygous carriers. Based on the guidelines from ACMG, the c.460C>T (p.Arg154*) variant was predicted as likely pathogenic (PVS1+PM2_Moderate+PP3+PP4). The variant was unreported previously, and Swiss-Model analysis suggests that it can significantly affect the tertiary structure of JAM2 protein. Conclusion The homozygous c.460C>T (p.Arg154*) variant of the JAM2 gene probably underlay the pathogenesis in this pedigree, and the detection of the novel variant has enriched the mutational spectrum of the JAM2 gene.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道一例以步态不稳为主要表现的Fahr病患者，通过临床资料采集、头颅CT与MRI检查，以及全外显子测序和家系Sanger验证，探讨其临床特征与分子病因。结果显示，患者携带JAM2基因c.460C>T纯合变异，父母均为杂合携带者；该变异此前未见报道，被评定为可能致病，蛋白结构模拟提示其可明显影响JAM2蛋白三级结构。作者认为该纯合变异可能是该家系发病的原因，并丰富了JAM2基因的变异谱。上述结论基于单例患者及家系分析，致病性判断和蛋白结构影响均属预测性质。

papers.title: [Alterations in olfactory and spatial navigation abilities and their neural mechanisms in subjective cognitive decline: an fMRI study].
papers.authors: Li SY, Ma XF, Li WP, Lu H, Lu JM, Zhang X, Zhang B.
papers.abstract: Objective: To investigate the characteristics and neural mechanisms of altered olfactory and spatial navigation abilities in individuals with subjective cognitive decline (SCD). Methods: A total of 44 cognitively normal participants and 69 participants meeting diagnostic criteria for SCD were recruited from Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital, Affiliated Hospital of Medical School, Nanjing University from September 2023 to October 2025. All participants underwent neuropsychological assessments, olfactory testing, spatial navigation testing, 3.0 T resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI), task-based functional MRI (task-fMRI), and high-resolution T1-weighted imaging. Independent samples t -tests and Mann-Whitney U tests were used to compare olfactory and spatial navigation behavioral differences between the two groups. Left and right anterior lateral entorhinal cortex (alEC), posterior medial entorhinal cortex (pmEC), and primary olfactory cortex (POC) were selected as seeds to analyze functional connectivity (FC) under resting state and during odor stimulation, with multiple comparisons corrected using false discovery rate (FDR). Partial correlation analysis was performed to explore the relationship between olfactory and spatial navigation and FC metrics in the SCD group, controlled age, gender and years of education. Results: No significant differences were found between the two groups regarding age, gender and years of education. Compared with the NC group, SCD participants showed reduced olfactory memory (old) (Z =-3.05, P =0.005), lower composite olfactory memory Z-score (t =3.53, P =0.001), and lower overall olfactory Z-score (t =2.48, P =0.014). They also exhibited increased average error distances in allo-egocentric navigation (AEN) (Z =-9.17, P =0.001), egocentric navigation (EN) (Z =-8.84, P =0.003), and allocentric navigation (AN) (Z =-8.09, P =0.024), along with a decreased composite spatial navigation Z-score (t =3.84, P <0.001). rs-fMRI results revealed that, SCD participants showed significantly reduced resting-state FC within EC and POC related pathways, but enhanced FC with frontal, cingulate, and parietal regions during odor stimulation (all q <0.05, FDR-corrected). Partial correlation analysis indicated that in the SCD group, the FC between left alEC and left angular gyrus (ANG) positively correlated with EN average error distance (r =0.26, P =0.033), while the FC between right POC and right posterior cingulate cortex(PCC) positively correlated with AEN average error distance (r =0.29, P =0.028). Conclusion: SCD individuals already exhibit deficits in olfactory memory and spatial navigation, suggesting possible coexistence of impaired baseline network connectivity and compensatory network activation during tasks, or inefficient and abnormal recruitment due to diminished network integration efficiency. Abnormal functional connectivity between alEC and ANG, and between POC and PCC, is associated with spatial navigation performance and may represent key neural substrates underlying olfactory and spatial navigation changes in SCD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较主观认知下降个体与认知正常者在嗅觉和空间导航上的表现，并结合静息态与任务态功能磁共振探讨其神经机制。行为结果显示，主观认知下降组嗅觉记忆和总体嗅觉表现较差，空间导航各条件的平均误差距离增大、综合导航成绩下降。影像上，患者组静息状态下内嗅皮层和初级嗅觉皮层相关通路的功能连接减弱，而气味刺激时与额叶、扣带及顶叶区域的功能连接增强；部分连接强度与导航误差相关。作者据此推测，基线网络连接受损与任务中代偿性激活或网络整合效率下降可能并存，内嗅皮层与角回、初级嗅觉皮层与后扣带皮层间的异常连接或与空间导航表现相关。

papers.title: Dataset Fragmentation, Cognitive Variability, and Reproducibility Challenges in EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces: A PRISMA-Based Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Peksa J.
papers.abstract: Public EEG-based brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets are expanding rapidly, yet differences in sensors, experimental protocols, task/event semantics, preprocessing, participant context, and evaluation limit reproducibility and cross-dataset learning. This review examined whether heterogeneous EEG-BCI resources can support reproducible analysis across sources. A PRISMA-based systematic mapping review of literature published from 2014 to June 2026 was conducted across Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, IEEE Xplore, PubMed, and ACM Digital Library, yielding 16,920 records. Following screening and evidence-focused curation, a curated synthesis corpus of 129 publications was retained and confirmed by full-text review. Evidence was coded across structural, semantic, procedural, human/contextual, and computational fragmentation, and reporting transparency was assessed using ten criteria. The synthesis identified heterogeneity in acquisition, channel layouts, task/event definitions, preprocessing, participant/session context, and evaluation design. Existing standards, ontologies, software platforms, benchmark frameworks, and transfer-learning methods address complementary layers but do not provide complete semantic interoperability. Within the retained corpus, the median transparency score was 9/10; data availability was stated in 61.2% and code or pipeline availability in 20.9%. These frequencies describe the curated corpus rather than the field as a whole. Scalable cross-dataset analysis requires analysis-dependent compatibility rules, explicit provenance, contextual metadata, and auditable transformations that preserve dataset identity, uncertainty, and information loss.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述基于PRISMA流程系统梳理了2014年至2026年间的脑电脑机接口文献，考察异构脑电资源能否支持跨来源的可重复分析。作者将证据按结构、语义、流程、人/情境和计算五个层面的碎片化进行编码，发现采集设备、通道布局、任务与事件定义、预处理、参与者与记录情境以及评估设计均存在异质性；现有标准、本体、软件平台、基准框架和迁移学习方法只覆盖互补的层面，尚不能实现完整的语义互操作。在纳入的文献中，报告透明度中位数为9/10，但仅约六成说明数据可获取、约两成说明代码或流程可获取，作者强调这些比例只描述该筛选语料而非整个领域。文章据此提出，可扩展的跨数据集分析需要依赖具体分析的兼容规则、明确的来源记录、情境元数据以及可审计的变换，以保留数据集身份、不确定性和信息损失。

papers.title: Intermittent Theta Burst Stimulation Combined with Cognitive Training in Mild Cognitive Impairment: Protocol for an 18-Week Randomised, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Feasibility Pilot Study (The iCog.X Boost Trial).
papers.authors: Bou Merhy RM, Cavaleri R, Alhassani G, Oxenham V, Metri NJ, Hochstrasser D, Hohenberg MI, Nagaratnam K, Singh K, Steiner-Lim GZ.
papers.abstract: Introduction: Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) is a transitional stage between normal ageing and dementia, affecting ~35% of adults aged 70+ and carrying a 15-18% annual risk of progression. Cognitive training (CT) shows promise but outcomes are variable and transfer to daily function is unclear; intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) may enhance prefrontal neuroplasticity. Few studies have evaluated whether combining CT and iTBS in MCI is practical, acceptable, and safe. Methods: This 18-week, randomised, double-blind, sham-controlled feasibility pilot trial will recruit 44 individuals with MCI, randomised 1:1 to CT + active iTBS or CT + sham iTBS. Participants complete 14 CT sessions over 10 weeks; accelerated iTBS is delivered in five sessions per day over five consecutive days at 75% resting motor threshold to the left DLPFC using neuronavigation, with reversed-coil sham. Primary outcomes are feasibility, acceptability, adherence, and safety; secondary (exploratory) outcomes are cognitive, functional, and psychological; tertiary (mechanistic) outcomes are EEG- and TMS-derived neurophysiological measures. The trial is not powered for efficacy: feasibility and neurophysiological outcomes will be analysed descriptively, while secondary outcomes will be analysed using linear mixed-effects models. Ethics and dissemination: Ethical approval has been granted by the Western Sydney University HREC (H16500); written informed consent will be obtained before enrolment. Trial registration number: ACTRN12625000952448.
papers.summary_zh: 这是一项针对轻度认知障碍（MCI）的18周随机、双盲、假对照可行性试点试验方案，计划将认知训练与间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）联合使用，并与假刺激进行比较。研究主要关注这种联合干预在MCI人群中是否可行、可接受、依从性如何以及是否安全，同时探索性地观察认知、功能和心理方面的结果，并考察脑电和经颅磁刺激衍生的神经生理指标。作者明确说明该试验不以检验疗效为目标，因此可行性及神经生理结果仅作描述性分析，次要结果采用线性混合效应模型分析，尚不能据此判断联合干预的临床效果。
